title: Roast Eggplant and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 lb mushroom | 1 habaneros, halved ( wear gloves ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup coriander leaves | 2 1/2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 1/2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat the oven roast eggplant and eggplant for 20 minutes or until it is tender. Trim all any browned skin on the eggplant and discard it. Slice thinly lengthwise. Chop mushrooms and set aside. Cut up habanero and clean the mushroom. Place eggplant and eggplant in a large bowl. Stir in other seasonings. Toss gently. Add olive oil and toss to combine. Taste and add more seasoning if needed.

title: Cream for Two or More days
ingredients: pumpkin seeds, for garnish | heavy whipping cream, for serving
instructions: Boil 1 cup of water with a pinch of salt in a large, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the pumpkin seeds and reduce heat to low. When the water is boiling, stir with a wooden spoon or a wooden spoon every 5 minutes until the liquid has evaporated and the seeds begin to stick to the bottom of the pan. Transfer the hot mixture to an ice cream maker and blend until smooth but not runny with a few small lumps. Transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vermicelli,fish sauce,cream tartar,active yeast,milk ricotta cheese,head cabbage,bacon
title: Bacon Wrapped Calzones
ingredients: 2 cups warm whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 5 slices thick-cut bacon | 25 ounces whole head cabbage, coarsely chopped | 5 ounces dry vermicelli | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a saucepan, heat the milk and warm the ricotta. Dissolve the yeast and the cream of tartar in 1/2 cup of warm milk and stir into ricotta. Set aside for 15 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the bacon, cabbage and vermicelli in the hot skillet until the cabbage and vermicelli are tender, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, strain the remaining cream of tartar into a small bowl. Pour the remaining sour cream into the skillet and cook until reduced and thickened, about 2 minutes. Spread 1/2 the sour cream on a large baking sheet, leaving a 1/2 inch border. Spread 1/4 of the cabbage mixture over the sour cream, then top with the noodles. Spread about 2/3 cup of the cheese filling over the top, breaking up any lumps. Sprinkle with fish sauce and remaining cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted and the cabbages are warmed through.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,tart apple,cremini mushroom,dill sprig,superfine sugar,olive oil cooking spray,nutmeg
title: Mushrooms With Apples and Strawberries
ingredients: 12 medium tart apples | 1 3/4 lbs cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar or 2 tablespoons caster sugar | olive oil flavored cooking spray or olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 large strawberries, washed and quartered | freshly grated nutmeg | fresh dill sprig ( garnish ) or fresh parsley, to serve
instructions: Peel and core the apples and cut into bite sized chunks. Using a large heavy saucepan, sprinkle over the sugar. Add the olive oil spray or cooking oil. Heat for 3 minutes or until sugar starts to melt. Add the apples, mushrooms and turn the heat up a couple of minutes until apples begin to soften. Toss gently and transfer to a large oven proof bowl. Sprinkle each serving with a nutmeg, fresh dill or parsley and serve warm.

title: Quick  Veal  With French  Baguette
ingredients: 1 lb veal, trimmed | 1/4 cup mushroom miso | 1/4 cup french baguettes
instructions: Cut cleaned veal into bite size pieces or smaller. Preheat oven to 450°f. Heat a grill pan or stovetop burner. Brush with miso, cover. Place meat in skillet. Fry approximately 4 minutes until lightly browned. Drain. Wrap in a slice of french baguette and serve.

title: Canadian Bacon Wraps (Canapes)
ingredients: 1 slice canadian bacon, cut into thirds | 1/4 - 1/2 cup lettuce or 1/4-1/2 cup kale, finely shredded ( enough to wrap up a wrap but not too tight )
instructions: Wrap up a piece of Canadian bacon to fit the flap of a wrap. Wrap the wrap with a piece of lettuce. Fold in the sides and then the tail of the wrap. You may wrap as much as you want but be sure to fold it tightly. Place on a lightly oiled grill, or broiler pan. Flip every few minutes for about 8 minutes or until the wrap is golden brown.

title: Fennel Spaghetti with Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and chopped | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, brown fennel in hot olive oil. Mix in spaghetti sauce and garam masala.

title: Green Pepper Spinach
ingredients: 2 packages frozen spinach, defrosted | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Toss together frozen spinach, maple syrup, and green pepper. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Refrigerate leftovers.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,turmeric,breadcrumb,green chili pepper,rye bread,egg noodle,oregano
title: Tex Mex Egg Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 12 ounces low-fat breadcrumbs | 3/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 dash picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups dry breadcrumbs | 2 cans diced mild green chili peppers | 8 eggs noodles
instructions: Combine bread crumbs, oregano, turmeric, picante sauce, and 2 cups breadcrumbs in bowl in larger bowl. Dip eggs noodles in bread crumbs, then set aside. Combine peppers and remaining bread crumbs in large bowl. Coat in bread crumb mixture. Place on a greased griddle and cook until browned, about 4 minutes per side. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork,coriander powder,wheat germ,herb,cumin powder,white flour,stout beer
title: Stout Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg lean pork | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup stone ground white flour | 1 3/4 cups stout beer or 1 3/4 cups dry white wine | 1/4 cup herbs, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut pork into 3 inch cubes. Mix wheat germ and coriander in bowl. Stir in pork & coat well with mixture. In separate bowl, combine wine, flour, and spice mix and stir into dry ingredients. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a saucepan, add bread, and cook on both sides for a few minutes. If the bread browns, allow them to cook until browned on both sides. Serve hot with salad and tomato ketchup.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,chocolate chip,mediterranean oregano,ladyfinger
title: Chocolate and Olivefinger Trifles (Cookies)
ingredients: 4 ladyfingers ( savoiardi ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons toasted chocolate chips | 3 tablespoons chopped mediterranean oregano
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees and lightly oil a baking sheet. Arrange ladyfingers in single layer on baking sheet and spray with cooking spray. Bake on center rack for 8 to 10 minutes, or until light golden brown. Meanwhile, melt chocolate chips in a small saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and whisk in oregano. Spread softened butter evenly over cookies. Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with toasted chocolate.

title: Borsht
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon fillet | 1 large beet, about 3/4 inch thick, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper, preferably hot
instructions: Drain the salmon well, but do not remove the skin. Set on a cutting board and, using a sharp small knife, chop the beet in 1/4 inch pieces. Transfer to a large saucepan. Halve the salmon, cut into thick slices. Cut the pepper into thin slices or shreds. Dribble into the beet with the red pepper flakes and toss gently. Cover and saute over medium high heat until the beet becomes wilted and the salmon is just barely barely cooked through, about 3 minutes.

title: Easy Taco Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb sweet taco sauce | 1 large lemons, peel and pith of or 1 large lime, peel and pith of | 1/4 cup scallion, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Place the lime peel in a food processor with most of the salt. Add the garlic powder and pulse until you have a coarse textured, evenly distributed mixture with no significant chunks. Transfer the taco sauce to a small saucepan. Add the scallions, if using, and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Remove the lemon peel, pith or lime peel and scallion, if using. Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to medium or low. Cook until the sauce thickens about 8 minutes. Serve as a dipping sauce or with your favorite mexican meal.

Random Ingredients: tortellini,stewing beef,anaheim chilies,salt pork,white fish fillet,wide egg noodle
title: The Icelandic Delight
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked wide egg noodles, broken in half | 4 ounces fresh tortsini | 1 lb lean stewing beef, such as sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 white fish fillets, such as haddock or 1 1/2 other white fish fillets, sliced into very thin strips | 3 anaheim chilies, seeded and sliced into rounds ( wear gloves for presentation ) | 8 ounces raw salt pork, sliced into thin strips ( for presentation )
instructions:
The night before, in a large skillet cook the noodles as per package instructions. 
    -. Drain and set aside. Cook the stew beef and chilies until well browned. Reserve. Drain all but 2 tbs. Of fat from skillet. Place the noodles in a large casserole dish. Place the beef, green chilies, and drained noodles, overlapping the noodles with the solid white meat on top. Add the reserved beef mixture on top of the meat. Sprinkle the reserved noodles on top and then scatter over the reserved beef mixture. Dot the top of the contents with 1 tbs. Of remaining butter. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for about 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Note, to serve.

title: Raspberry Tomato and Cilantro Soup
ingredients: 7 ounces raspberries, rinsed in cold water and drained | 1 cup tomato puree | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Wash and coarsely chop raspberries and mix with tomato puree. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Yummy, Yeasty and Elegant Polenta!
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon wheat germ ( optional ) | 1 cup polenta | 3 tablespoons currants | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease an 11 x 7 1/2 inch baking pan. Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain. Rinse the spaghetti, pat dry and set aside. In a large saucepan, bring the milk and 1 1/2 cups water to a boil. Add the polenta in a thin stream, whisking as you stir. Whisk again until the polenta begins to thicken. Add the currants, cocoa powder and 2 cups water. Continue to whisk until the mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat, stir in the drained spaghetti, season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the foil and bake another 5 minutes of toasting, stirring every 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Spicy Refried Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried kidney beans | 1 teaspoon dried chili powder or 3/4 green chiles | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 jalapeno | 1/2 cup flour | 1 piece fresh gingerroot | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Combine the beans, chili powder, cumin, jalapeno, ginger and enough water to cover the beans. Let stand for 2 hours, then drain.

Random Ingredients: raisin,flour tortilla,pork chop,salad oil,virgin olive oil,rosemary,chicken fillet,baking powder
title: Pork, Honey and Rosemary Wrap
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 1/3 cup fresh basil, chopped | 8 flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 chicken fillets
instructions: To wrap wrap, rub chicken with the extra virgin olive oil and place in microwave for 3 - 4 minutes. Flip chicken. To wrap, spread the basil and raisins all around chicken. To wrap, place the chicken inside tortillas, then wrap up. To wrap again, place in a microwave for 5 minute. To wrap, place in baking dish, cover and microwave for 45 - 60 seconds to heat through. Serve warm. To prepare, place on a platter, spread with extra virgin olive oil and sliced rosemary and serve with honey and slices of orange to match the grilled rosemary.

title: Pancake from the Times
ingredients: 2 cups crispy french bread cubes | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tortilla, cut into 6 triangles ( or more see below )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450f and lightly oil a baking sheet. Combine the crust ingredients and cut them into 8 triangles of equal width.

title: Chinese Tofu Steamed Vegetables in Dashi
ingredients: veal, cut into bite sized pieces | 300 g vermicelli, cut into 4cm strips | 1 cup daashi stock, made with dashi and beef flavoured vegetable stock or 1 cup water | 1/2 of a cube fried tofu with sugar ( see my recipe ) | lemonade
instructions: If using a non aluminium steamer, place a large glass or ceramic bowl and the steamer basket inside. Place steaming bowl on the sink in the far end of a double boiler over boiling water. If using a steamer basket, place the bowl in the far side of the double boiler. You will know that the basket is not holding your water when its ready because the tofu will cook faster. Place your watered bamboo steamer bowl in a pan of just over boiling water and place the pan over the trivet. Place the steamer basket over the steamer basket or in the pan of bamboo steamer and steam till veal pieces are cooked, around 3 - 5 minutes. Place the cooked meat on a plate and set aside to cool. While waiting for the steamer to cool, start making the gravy. To get that lovely bite sized bite sized, poke your finger in the thick part of the vermicelli and make a dent in the vermicelli. It will pierce all over the vermicelli. If you are unable to find this, a meat grinder should be your closest substitute, but if you don't have this appliance then use the rice paddle or a spoon to make this. If you are short on time this really is a matter of personal preference but there is enough of these to make things so you can put the pan in the microwave for one minute. If you are cooking for a shorter time then 15 - 20 minutes it won't hurt anything. Serve with lemonade or your choice of choice of toppings. The best part is when each bite of tofu is cooked. Note, i like to add my fried tofu to about halfway through the steaming process to get a creamy taste. Then i put the tofu on top of the fried tofu so that it can absorb the spicy gravy without the sauce drowning the tofu. I don't drain the tofu. I just mix in the vermicelli noodles, mushrooms and broccoli florets. You can also substitute whatever vegetables you choose, you can add more sugar and/or spices. The tofu is now ready in time to cook and is much easier to slice. You can then add the sliced meat and top with sauce. Sometimes the tofu is thicker than the mushrooms and broccoli, so you can put it on top for extra crunch.

title: Torta Ahogada (Carne Asada)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 pound cooked meat, cubed | 3 poblano chiles, thinly sliced | 1 radish, sliced
instructions: Mix the parsley, sugar, and meat together. Place in a serving bowl and garnish with the poblanos and radish slices. Chill until serving.

title: Italian Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 cups cold water | 1 1/2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Place the bread cubes in a large, deep bowl. Pour water over the cubes, and stir to coat evenly. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove plastic wrap, and return bread to the bowl. Sprinkle with creole seasoning, and oregano. Stir to evenly coat bread with crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven until crumbs are golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,marinara sauce,white pepper,scallion,sugar snap pea
title: Maple Pea Marinara
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce ( homemade, homemade or store-bought ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 6 -8 ounces white pepper, coarsely chopped | 3 large scallions, sliced | 1 package sugar snap peas
instructions: Heat grill to high. In a small bowl, combine marinara sauce, maple syrup, pepper and scallions. Thread about 1/4 cup peas onto 12 skewers.

title: Spaghetti and Oat Stuff
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked spiral shaped pasta ( rotelle or bowtie ) | 1 cup quick oats ( or oat flakes ) | 4 ounces uncooked dry spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, add cooked pasta, oats and cooked noodles. Mix well. If stuffing is to thick, add water a little at a time until desired consistency. Spoon into an oiled casserole dish.

title: Pepperoni & Crab Cocktail
ingredients: 2 ounces sliced pepperoni, finely chopped ( fresh ) | 2 ounces lump crabmeat, drained | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce dried fruit ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mixed fruit, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients of ingredients and serve in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,rosemary,dark chocolate,soya sauce,sun tomato oil,thyme leaf,baby green pea,italian parsley
title: Spinach, Sun-Dried Tomatoes, and Baby Greens
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta | 2 lbs fresh baby green peas or 2 lbs frozen baby green peas | 8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 8 ounces sweet salted roasted italian-style salted tomatoes, drained ( reserve 1/4 cup reserved oil ) | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Place remaining ingredients in large bowl. Add pasta and toss with dressing. Top each plate with parsley.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,pizza crust,apple cider,turnip,poblano chile,chicken stock cube
title: Prawns, Turnips and Apple Cider Rissoto
ingredients: 250 g king prawns, peeled and butterflied | 1/2 turnip, peeled and diced | 1 poblano chile, chopped | 1 chicken stock cube, crumbled | 300 g ready-made pizza crust | 50 wonton wrappers
instructions: Place the prawns, poblano chile, and stock cube in a saucepan, cover and cook over medium heat until the prawns are just cooked, set aside and cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 190 degrees. Remove the chicken from the poaching liquid. Roughly chop the prawns and add to the chicken stock, stir and simmer for 5 minutes. Lay your wonton wrappers in a baking tray lined with parchment paper and brush with water. Place the filling mixture on one of the wonton wrappers. Moisten the edges with a little more water and fold in half. Seal and crimp the edges with the tip of a knife. Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.

title: Irish Skirt Steaks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ale | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled mushrooms | 1 pound skirt steak, cut into 3/4-inch slices | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix beer, mushrooms, and steak together in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange steaks in foil lined pan.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,flat leaf parsley,beef stew meat,coconut milk,beef sirloin steak,paprika
title: Steak Neptune
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | 1/2 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup torn flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: fritos chili cheese corn chip,pinto bean,mayonnaise
title: Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 1/2 cups fritos chili cheese flavored corn chips | 3/4 cup mayonnaise, or as desired
instructions: Mix pinto beans, frito corn chips, and mayonnaise together in a bowl. Serve hot.

title: Rhubarb Spiced Martini
ingredients: 2 pounds rhubarb, cut into 2-inch chunks | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons jigger vodka | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
instructions: Place rhubarb, sesame oil, vodka, and crushed tomatoes into a blender on medium high setting, and puree until smooth. Strain the tomato juice through a fine mesh cloth into a glass measuring cup, and pour in the tomato puree into the pitcher. Rinse the rinsed rhubarb, drain, and coarsely chop. Pour the contents of the pitcher into your ice cocktail shaker, and add the chili powder. Stir well, fill glasses with ice, and stir.

title: Quick Blue Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the blue cheese and diced tomatoes and green chilies. Place one teaspoon in the middle of each of two teaspoons of the cheese mixture. Fold the sides over the cheese mixture to form two semi circles to make triangles.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,italian seasoning,brown rice,yellow onion,croissant
title: Easy Croissant Bread
ingredients: 2 loaves soft rolls ( use a loaf of crusty rolls if you need ) | 1 small yellow onion, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning ( wildtree italian seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups brown rice ( about 4 cups cooked )
instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 f. Arrange the loaves of bread on a cookie sheet or baking sheet. 
    -. Coat with a small amount of cooking spray, then sprinkle with the onion slices. Sprinkle with a little italian seasoning. Drizzle with sesame oil. Bake in the preheated oven for about 45 - 50 minutes, until crisp on the edges and some of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from oven and spread cooked brown rice on top of the loaves.

title: Greek Steakhouse Gyros (Mushrooms on a Stick)
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 lb button mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon kahlua ( optional ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons hot greek yogurt
instructions: Combine the garlic powder and bouillon cube in a small bowl. Stir well in bowl. Dip the mushroom slices in yogurt and then into garlic powder until your desired consistancy. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Stir fry half of the mushrooms until they release their liquid. Continue to stir and fry mushrooms until they release their liquid. Place mushrooms on a piece of foil large enough to wrap tightly around the meat. Place meat on top of mushroom to keep them from drying out and circulate around their meat. Wrap foil around the meat evenly and cook the meat. Cook for 2 minutes per side or until steak is just pink. Serve with rice and veggies.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,white bread,bread,almond flour,ginger paste,garlic,rice noodle,fennel bulb
title: Smoked Salmon Jalfrezi
ingredients: 8 pieces white bread, cubed | 4 pieces smoked salmon fillets | 3 tablespoons almond flour | 1 bulb fennel bulb, chopped | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 loaf fresh bread | 3 1/2 tablespoons crushed dried rice noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 160 deg c/325 deg f/gas lightly grease or line a 15x10 inch ovenproof casserole dish. Combine bread and 2 tablespoons almond flour in a shallow dish and press onto the base of the dish. Tear the remaining 2 pieces of bread into small, even sized pieces and place in the dish. Top with salmon and season with salt and pepper. Dry fry fennel bulb and garlic cloves in cooking oil until just starting to turn golden. Remove fennel and garlic with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper. Arrange bread cubes and salmon slices on top of the fennel and garlic. Mix remaining 2 tablespoons almond flour, ginger paste and dried rice noodles in a cup. Taste and add salt as desired. Pour onto the dish. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Preheat oven to 190 deg c/325 deg f/gas bake in oven for 1 hour or until the fish just flakes when tested with a fork. When ready to serve stir through the cooked rice noodles and serve the jalfrezi as an extra garnish.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,marmalade,tomato green chilies,pepper flake,caster sugar,cremini mushroom
title: Low-Fat Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 50 g low-fat mascarpone cheese or 50 g light cottage cheese | 1/3 cup low-fat whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon crushed bottled pepper flakes | 250 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup light salad marmalade
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 deg c. Whisk together the first 5 ingredients until combined. Mix in the mushrooms, combining until the mushrooms are evenly distributed and the mixture is crumbly. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Divide the pizza mixture among the pizza bases then top with the marmalade. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 mins to 35 mins or until done.

Random Ingredients: oregano sprig,sun tomato oil,grape leaf,golden syrup,italian turkey sausage link
title: Sausage with Grape Leaf
ingredients: 1 -12 sweet italian turkey sausage link | 4 -5 fresh oregano sprigs | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into thin strips | 4 -5 whole fresh grape leaves ( or large jar ) | 2 -3 teaspoons golden syrup
instructions: Poke holes in the sausage links with a fork or skewer. Insert oregano seeds into a grid over a large stockpot. Add sliced tomatoes, grape leaves, and golden syrup in a thin layer over the top of the sausage. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat uncovered for about 2 hours, until the sausage is cooked through. Remove meat from the pan and shred with two forks.

title: Normandy Spritz
ingredients: 12 slices canadian bacon ( about 1/2-inch thick slices ) | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 cups catsup | 2 1/4 cups sour cream or 2 1/4 cups heavy cream | 6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Wrap each slice of sausage separately in a double thickness of double-pack foil. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Remove foil and cook bacon over medium heat, turning occasionally, until lightly browned, about 9 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Heat chile sauce through in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir in cream and cocoa. Cool to room temperature. Dip each slice of bacon into sauce, coating evenly. Cook bacon in a nonstick nonstick skillet over medium heat about 3 minutes on each side, until bacon is lightly browned and heated through. Serve with hot bacon.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,baking soda,mascarpone cheese,oregano leaf,yogurt,nutella,chicken breast,beef brisket
title: Chef John's Spicy Shredded Beef
ingredients: 5 whole skinless, boneless beef brisket, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons baking soda | 2 cartons yogurt | 1 jar heavy cream | 1 pound mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 1 package shredded mozzarella-style cheese blend | 1 sprig fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 2 sprigs fresh oregano, chopped | 8 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Make the spicy goat cheese topping. In a 9x13 glass baking dish, stir together the yogurt, cream, mascarpone cheese, mozzarella style cheese, and oregano. Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium high heat. As soon as oil begins to smoke, stir in the spicy goat cheese. Remove from heat and pour into the prepared dish, coating the entire bottom. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least six hours and up to 9 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the corned beef from the refrigerated yogurt mixture by wiping the rim of the dish with a paper towel. Place the brisket strips onto a cutting board, and gently pound to flatten slightly. Place onto a clean cutting board and cut into thin strips about 3/8 inch wide. Heat 2 tablespoons of the reserved yogurt mixture in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until heated through and smooth, being careful not to reduce the fat content of the curdled yogurt. Serve topped with the spicy goat cheese sauce and the toasted oregano sprigs.

title: Brown Rice With Pesto
ingredients: 1/3 cup basil pesto | 2 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 2 cups quick brown rice
instructions: Pour entire can of condensed soup into a slow cooker. Add brown rice, mix thorougly. Cover and cook on low setting 7 hours.

title: Creamy Fish and Black Bean Raita
ingredients: 400 g cod or 400 g haddock, skinned | 400 g canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 200 ml half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons fresh cream | 1 teaspoon fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon instant hing
instructions: Place fish pieces in a bowl, pour over enough boiling water to cover them and leave for 20 minutes or until cooked. Drain fish, chill and keep the fish warm in the oven, while you prepare the sauce. Place beans in a saucepan with the cream, cream and seasoning. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 5 - 10 minutes until the beans are tender. Spoon the cream over the beans and leave to cool slightly. Blend the coriander leaves and instant hing in a pestle and mortar. Stir into the cream mixture, then stir in the fish and serve sprinkled with the sprigs.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,couscous,date,vegetable oil cooking spray,raspberry jam
title: Raspberry Curried Couscous Salad With Dates
ingredients: 1 cup instant couscous | 15 ounces raspberries in jam | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | vegetable oil cooking spray or cooking spray | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry jam
instructions: Place the couscous in the bowl of a large bowl. Pour the raspberry jam into a small bowl and stir in 2 tbls of raspberry jam. Add 2 tbsp of curry paste to the couscous, then spoon half the raspberry mixture over the couscous and sprinkle with 1/4 of the remaining curry paste and 1/4 of the raspberries and combine well. Cover the bowl with a damp paper towel or a damp towel and set aside for 10 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with more curry paste. Mix thoroughly, then cover with the damp towel or the damp towel again and set aside for an additional 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from the bowl and allow to sit until it cools. Fluff up the couscous with a fork, and mix with the raspberry jam and remaining raspberry paste and curry paste. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Obatzda (Cheese Spread - Spread)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricot, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender or 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender | 1/2 cup unsalted butter or 1/2 cup margarine, slightly softened | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Drain apricots, reserving the juice. Press apricots through a sieve, discarding pits and any remaining pulp. Add rosemary, lavender and almonds to reserved juice. Mix together the butter or margarine, sugar, vanilla and almond extract until creamy and well blended. Spoon into serving bowl and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,chili seasoning mix,egg noodle,brown rice
title: Noodle & Brown Sugar Slice
ingredients: 1 packet brown rice & bacon flavored seasoning mix | 1 package egg noodles ( or any other kind of noodles you like ) | 1 can chopped brown sugar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°c. Grease 18x28 x 2 inch tin. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix. Press half of the mix into a prepared tin. Bake on the bottom shelf of the oven for 20min. Take off oven and leave for another 10 25min until the mix is well risen. Slice and enjoy you may like to add more brown sugar to your favourite toppings if you like.

title: Fusilli in a Yogurt Crumble!
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat flour | 1 pinch coriander seed | 400 g tomatoes, chopped | 200 g fresh baby spinach | 200 g fresh mango, chopped | 3/4 cup thick yogurt, drained | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: Tear the dried wafer into 3/4 1 inch size pieces, sprinkle over with a little extra flour and roll out on a floured work surface to about 6 inch square. Line a non stick oven proof dish with baking parchment and spray with cooking spray. Place flour and coriander in a food processor or blender and blend briefly. Add the tomatoes and blend until smooth, then turn mixture into a large bowl. Stir in the spinach, mango and yoghurt. Seasoning with salt and pepper if necessary. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish, then sprinkle with horseradish. Bake in 200c oven for 15 - 20 minutes until centre is browned and bubbling and tinged with parsley and drizzle with olive oil. Serve warm with a fresh salad or chutney. If you don't have any bread on hand, make your own crumble cheese by beating the feta, cream cheese etc, and whipping it with half the yogurt and flour until smooth. Tip, you can make a whole meal of crumble and make a crumb if you like a lot of cheese, make this first and cut it into wedges just before bringing it to the table.

title: Patsy's Easy Dried Venison Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs venison ( ground ) | 1 large egg | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 1/2 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom pod | 1/2 cup grated coconut ( optional ) | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions:
Combine the venison, egg, sherry, paprika, cardamom and coconut into a large bowl and mix well. 
    -. Shape mixture into small balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot pan or in batches in the reserved pan, adding about 1 - 2 tbsp water to each batch when the meatballs are nicely browned. Remove from heat, and sprinkle with peanuts if using.

title: Fried Rice (For a Rainy Day)
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice | 4 pieces toast
instructions: Spread each fried rice with 2 pieces of toast. Cut a slice of toast into pieces 1/2 inch wide from the middle of the toasted. Serve with green salad, tea or coffee. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,cucumber,nutritional yeast,serrano chili pepper,large shrimp
title: Cucumber and Shrimp Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapples ( unsweetened ) | 1/2 cup cucumber, seeded, peeled, and finely minced | 1 serrano chili pepper, seeded, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons nutritional yeast | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled, deveined, and chopped
instructions: Place pineapples, cucumber, serrano chile pepper, nutritional yeast, and shrimp in a large resealable plastic bag set in a shallow glass dish. Toss to combine. Skewer shrimp on skewers. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Skewer shrimp on skewers. Cook in a large skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes per side or until shrimp turn pink. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Bell Pepper With Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell peppers or 1 yellow bell pepper, halved, seeded, and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth, fat-free low-sodium, divided | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, divided | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450f degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the bell pepper slices on the foil, cut side up, in a single layer. Bake for 10 minutes to soften. Remove from oven and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup broth and the yoghurt. Drizzle the mixture over the the peppers, spreading it evenly. Scatter the remaining ingredients over the top. Put the foil side up on top. Bake for 10 minutes or until warm.

title: Chinese Snow Pea Salad (Sweet and Sour)
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch the snow peas until crisp tender, but still slightly chewy. Drain, and peel any excess water off of the peas. Sprinkle the snow peas with jello. Pour the cider vinegar, and stir to mix then pour the mixture over the snow peas and snow peas. Chill until the dressing is frothy. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,spinach leaf,pine nut,self rising flour,jicama,peanut oil,apricot preserve
title: Jicama and Pine Nut Rollups
ingredients: 18 jicama ( small ) | 15 dried apricots in light syrup | 3 -4 cups fresh spinach leaves ( or your favourite salad leaves ) | 2/3 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup salted peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, powder | 3 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. If using fresh spinach, steam it until tender. If using fresh leaves, drain well. If using fresh leaves, boil them in salted water for about 15 - 20 minutes or until tender. If using fresh leaves, rinse well with cold water. Cut peeled jicama in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Remove thick center vein from each jicama half and cut jicama into small squares. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Place jicama on baking tray. Bake until almost dry. Take out paper and sprinkle with ground pepper and the chipotle chile powder. Place a spoonful of the fruit filling on the base of a jicama square. Top with a second jicama square and spoon on the rest of the sauce. Continue until the filling is used. Continue layering the ingredients until all the jicamas and fruit topping are used and arranged onto baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 4 cups cold and crushed ice
instructions: Mix pizza sauce with garlic paste.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,msg,panko breadcrumb,yukon gold potato,new potato,pie crust,pineapple
title: Sweet Potato & Pineapple Potpie Slice
ingredients: 1 pie crust, such as < a href= '' https : //www.|geniuskitchen.|com/recipe/pie crust-425441 '' > peachy & herb pot pie < /a > | 500 g baby yukon gold potatoes, peeled and chopped | 400 g grated new potatoes | 6 canned crushed pineapple, drained | 3 chicken stock cubes, dissolved in | 2 ounces water | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Put your sweet potato & pineapple in a microwave safe bowl & add just enough water to cover them. Cover & cook for 6 minutes on full, or until water has almost evaporated.

title: Peanutty Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 36 slices monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Mix the cream of celery soup, butter, hazelnuts, and cheese in a bowl until well blended. Spread the mixture onto a 9x9 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until the top is bubbly and beginning to brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Break up any large chunks of cheese onto a serving plate. Cut into squares, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: candy sprinkle,yellow bell pepper,asparagus,cashew,spanish olive oil,olive
title: Faux Cashew Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed arachula olives ( drained ) | 1 package frozen chopped asparagus ( thawed ) | 1 yellow bell pepper ( diced ) | 3 tablespoons toasted cashews | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons spanish olive oil
instructions: Cook and stir cashews in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat until golden brown and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Cool. Drain on paper towel. Set aside. Cook bell pepper in a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,banana,chicken cutlet,cherry,pinto bean,fajita seasoning mix,beef stew meat,pasta shell
title: Beef Stew for Feijoada
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 1 packet fajita seasoning mix | 2 1/2 cups hot cooked pasta shells | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 can chicken cutlets ( undrained ) | 1 can mixed cherries ( undrained ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle beef with fajita seasoning and place in pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour mixture over beef. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 2 1/2 hours or until beef is tender. Serve over hot cooked pasta. Note, i don't like sweet potato pieces as i like them.

title: Jicama-Cocoa Dipping Sauce - Vegan
ingredients: 1 bag jicama | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 jar alfredo sauce ( or 2 tbsp.| jarred sauce )
instructions: Cut jicama into 2 or 3 pieces, cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices, then into a food processor with 1/4 teaspoons salt and/or cocoa. Blend until fine powder. Spread on toasted or toasted bread and spread with 1 tbsp. Alfredo sauce.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,rice noodle,tahini,white wine vinegar,coconut milk,spinach leaf,pimento olive
title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crispy rice noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons tahini, to taste | 2 -3 dried chipotle chiles | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 4 cups canned coconut milk
instructions: Spray cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Place noodles in large bowl with a slosh of the vinegar. Toss to combine and set aside. Place chipotle peppers in spice/seeds in a small food processor jar and blend until mostly smooth. Add 1/3 cup of water and blend to form a thin paste. Add to noodle mixture and mix to combine. Set aside. Drain spinach and pat dry. Cut green leaves into 3/4 pieces, and divide among 4 dinner plates. Arrange wilted spinach on top of greens, then top with sliced olives, then drizzle with remaining sauce just before serving. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,corn oil,apple cider vinegar,cognac,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Sauce, Shallot & Feta Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb feta cheese ( can use danish if you're lucky ) | 1/2 lb unsalted vegetable oil ( may substitute canola oil ) | 1/2 lb cognac | 1/2 lb apple cider vinegar ( may substitute apple cider vinegar if preferred ) | corn oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Crumble feta cheese into a food processor and process until crumbly. Add vegetable oil and process until smooth. Pour into a cruet or cruet container and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,turkey meat,extra virgin olive oil,sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,chocolate
title: Pico De Gallo Turkey Dogs With Chocolate
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb turkey meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup pico de gallo, canned | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate, chopped ( or use bittersweet chocolate, chopped into matchstick pieces )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Spray a baking sheet with veggie spray. Rinse and pat dry turkey. Place cubes on the baking sheet. Coat with vegetable oil spray and sprinkle with your chopped cheese.

title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 3 slices pork tenderloin ( about 1/2 thick ) | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 medium onion ( thinly sliced ) | 1 cup minced cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped fresh red chili pepper | 2 cans sliced oysters, drained ( about 16 slices )
instructions: Line the sides of a jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Layer the pork slices, sugar, and gelatin on one side of pork slices to cover. Repeat with onions, cabbage, chili, and half of the oysters to make 3 double decker rolls. Layer remaining oysters over top of rolls. Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to set the rolls up. Remove rolls from the refrigerator, and slice across the grain into very thin slices that are about 1/2 wide. Serves note, jelly roll wraps freeze well.

title: Swiss Wafer Mix
ingredients: 1 cup flour, all purpose | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup gouda cheese, aged and grated | 2/3 cup canned apricot, cut in quarters | 1/4 teaspoon sweet hot paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together flour, baking powder and gouda cheese. Add apricots to dry ingredients and stir until well blended. Spread about 3 tbsps. Of the cheese mixture into the base of a 1 1/2 inch glass baking dish or pie plate. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Dollop the apricots over the top of the cheese. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.

title: Sunflower Paste in Oil
ingredients: 2 ounces sunflower oil | 2 ounces pimiento, in the jar
instructions: In a heavy fryer, heat the sunflower oil until very hot. Add the pimiento and fry for 10 minutes, until it is quite dark in color. Add the sunflower oil to the oil and fry for 3 minutes. Add the pimiento and fry for 10 more minutes until it has been cooked. Use immediately.

title: Guacamole Relish
ingredients: 3 -4 small dried red chilies | 3 -4 fresh basil leaves, washed and chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet red chilies ( seeded if dried ) | 1/3 cup sweet creamy-sour sauce ( kikkoman ) | 1/3 cup dry sherry ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Soak dried chillies in sherry in microwave for 30 - 50 seconds. Stir and microwave for 1 minute or until soft. Use 2 1/2 tsp of hot sauce and 1/4 tsp of red pepper for all relishes. Stir to mix well. Chop dried chillies and mix with hot sauce. Serve as an accompaniment to cooked rice, or with tortilla chips.

title: Quick Chickpea & Ricotta Omelet
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas ( can use canned ) | 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped and packed | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon canned low sodium soy sauce | 1 - 2 1/2 tablespoon crab or 1 -2 tablespoon tuna, chopped
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the egg whites, parsley, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and crab or tuna. Heat the olive oil in a hot skillet and add the egg mixture. When a small amount of egg will run, add it to the egg mixture. Scoop the mixture out of the egg whites onto a plate. When it is almost done, add the bean sprouts onto it too. When the egg has fully cooked, use the spatula and fold in your egg whites to coat. If a spatula can be used to flip the mixture, just slide it back into the skillet and cook a few more seconds on subsequent attempts. Slide onto plates the next day. To freeze, put the omelet straight onto a freezer safe plate. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a little while to make the omelettes icy cold.

title: Braised Skirt Steaks
ingredients: 6 fresh t-bone skirt steaks | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh bouquet garni
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix together vinegar and bouquet garni and brush into steaks. Place on rack in roasting pan in a baking dish just large enough to hold them in a single layer. Roast in oven for 2 to 4 hours. Remove from oven, cover and let rest for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Champagne
ingredients: 100 ml champagne | 10 balsamic or 10 apple juice, if too strong | 1 red leaf lettuce or 2 green leaves, torn
instructions: Pour one quarter of champagne into each champagne glass and swirl in the sesame oil. Float the lettuce leaves around the edge if using. Place the remaining champagne around the lettuce. Serve.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 bell peppers | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut away the tops and remove all the seeds and ribs attached to the pepper. Cut the peppers in to 1 inch wide strips on the diagonal, and place them in the bowl of a kitchen towel. Sprinkle the allspice and red wine vinegar into the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth. The mixture should be quite oily and runny. Transfer the red pepper strips to a large salad bowl. Pour the spice mix over them and toss evenly. Refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Indonesian Green Cabbage
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 100 g roasted white pepper, in water | lemon slice, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring coconut milk to boil. Lower heat and simmer for 15 - 30 minutes, or until it is thick. Remove from heat and keep aside, keeping it warm. Put a small amount of cooking oil in a frying pan for cooking the cabbage. Add the roasted peppers and lemon slices, if using. Stir to coat with oil. Serve with rice and other indonesian dishes as desired.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,brown lentil,cream chicken soup,pumpkin seed,kiwi,cardamom pod
title: Spicy Orange Lentil Spread  (Rajma)
ingredients: 1 medium kiwi, peeled & diced | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup brown lentils | 1/8 cup orange liqueur | 2 cardamom pods, crushed | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds, lightly toasted
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine kiwi, soup, lentils, orange liqueur, cardamom pods, and pumpkin seeds. Beat until combined but firm. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard seed,tamarind juice,phyllo pastry,leek,thyme,ranch dressing mix,red curry paste
title: Carroc's Thai Samoan Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs leeks, trimmed and thinly sliced ( white and light green parts only ) | 1 package pre-shredded fat-free ranch dressing mix | 1 yellow mustard seed ( not yellow ) | 1/3 cup tamarind juice | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons packed fresh thyme | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Thaw leeks, remove hard outer white portion and discard. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place in container of a food processor or blender with a 1/2 cup of the hidden sauce ingredients. Cover and process until finely chopped. Set aside. Lay out 2 sheets of filo in a 9x13 inch baking dish and brush with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons veggie oil or butter. Place 2 strips of leeks lengthwise along one edges of the filo, next to each other. Divide mustard seed into 3 equal parts. Place 1 mustard seed and 1/2 tsp tamarind juice into a small bowl, add remaining tablespoon of prepared yellow mustard, curry paste, remaining 3 spice blend and thyme. Stir to combine and pour over leeks. Lay out next 3 sheets of filo and brush with 1 1/2 teaspoons oil or butter to cover top. Spread 2 tablespoons of peanut sauce generously over top, leaving one inch around each on all sides. Make a slit in each filo corner and fill with leeks, patting well to submerge. Repeat process with remaining 3 strips. Place on baking sheet, seam side down. Cover with baking sheet. Bake in preheated 375°f oven for 30 minutes. Turn baking sheet over and bake until top is dark brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, remove cover and bake about 7 minutes more, until phyllo is slightly crisp and fishy. Cool on a baking rack in a bowl before cutting into 12 triangles.

title: Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cups chicken-flavored rice-a-roni | 2 bananas | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Drain chicken rice a roni in a colander or strainer and save for later. Slice banana into 1/2 inch slices. Place roni in a small saucepan. Cover with vegetable broth so that it reaches halfway up the sides of the roni. Bring to a boil, turn down to a simmer and let it simmer, loosely covered, for 30 - 45 minutes, or until rice is tender. Add a teaspoon of nutmeg to the cooked rice. Note, if serving chilled, allow to cool and then remove from fridge overnight to let moisture in the pan dry out. Remove roni from broth before serving by spooning rice a roni on your serving plate, placing banana slices over it, and sprinkling with a little cheese. Enjoy.

title: Chilled Pasta With Currants
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta, dry | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons currants
instructions: Cook the pasta in a pot of water following your favourite method and then drain. Combine the tumeric with the worcesteshire sauce and add to the noodles and then gently toss to coat the pasta. Add the currants and serve on warm toast or fresh crusty bread to accompany.

title: Polish Sausage and Applesauce
ingredients: 12 slices polish sausage | 3 cups peeled, shredded tart apples | 12 grapes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the sausage in half lengthwise and spread both sides evenly on a large baking sheet. Bake until the sausage is browned and cooked throughout, 15 to 20 minutes. Slice apples on the bias and arrange in a large serving bowl. Sprinkle with sausage and applesauce. Sprinkle grapes over everything and serve.

title: Tomato and Honey Pizza
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces italian tomatoes ( preferably petite cut ) | 3 ounces honey | 1 1/4 ounces yeast | 1 pinch dried marjoram | 16 ounces kielbasa or 16 ounces other sausage, links sliced diagonally in 1/2-inch pieces
instructions:
Place all ingredients in the mixer and blend well. Heat pizza pan over medium heat for 10 minutes. 
    -. Place a piece of sausage on the dough and spread out evenly, leaving a 1/4 round. Punch down dough and let rest for a few minutes. Pizza pans should be about 3 inches larger than the pizza or baking pan. Place dough on a pizza screen or jelly roll pan. Top with remaining sausage slices on the dough. Cover pan loosely with a towel or lightly spray pizza pan with cooking spray and put in a pre heated oven for about 45 minutes. Remove cover, uncover and bake 10 - 15 minutes, until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,walnut half,orange juice concentrate,bacon,biscuit,burgundy wine,fish stock
title: Smoked Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup burgundy wine | 1/2 cup chopped walnut halves | 8 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 4 cans refrigerated biscuit rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine orange juice concentrate, fish stock, mayonnaise, wine, and chopped nuts. Place bacon in a large skillet and saute over medium high heat until crispy. Break bacon into small pieces and set aside. Open biscuit rounds and fill with fish mixture and roll up. Arrange in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Turn bread over and bake an additional 15 minutes, or until golden to a golden brown.

title: Cheesy  Swiss Roll
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh pepperoni | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 medium green apple | 1 tablespoon chocolate, grated
instructions: Cut the pepperoni into 1/8 wide strips, then lengthwise into 1/8 strips or less depending on size. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread mixture evenly over pepperoni. Roll the pepperoni up tightly jelly roll style. Chill in the refrigerator 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Style Brownie Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 3/4 cup craisins | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Melt cornmeal and cocoa in 1/2 cup of water. Add craisins, cover and simmer. Heat sesame oil and lemon juice in another sauce pan then stir into cooked mixture. Drop on wax paper and cool. When cool roll into small balls about 2 1/2 inches in diameter and store in airtight container. They freeze well.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,hamburger bun,apricot jam,catsup,garlic salt,egg yolk,chicken breast half
title: Jalapeno Garlic Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 1 jar barbecued pickled jalapenos, quarters drained | 1 1/2 cups apricot jam | 3/4 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 egg yolk | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness | 2 thick hamburger buns, split
instructions: Drain jalapenos reserving liquid. Heat jam and 1 1/2 cup cooking liquid in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until preserves are melted. Stir in remaining jam, catsup and garlic salt. Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper and press out into a thin slice. Spread about half of jam mixture onto each piece of chicken. Cover, and marinate chicken at room temperature for 15 minutes. Heat buns, cut side down, in a grill, broiler or stovetop grille until hot, about 1 minute. Fill each bun with a chicken patty, top with remaining tomato jelly mixture, and serve.

title: Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 2 tortillas, size cut in half | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Heat the tbs. Of butter in a non stick frying pan. Place the tortilla cut side down in the pan on the heat, cook for about 2 minutes. Turn and cook other side for another minute. Remove from heat and fold in 1/2 tsp. Serve hot in a tortilla. Optionally, you can spread the rest of the butter over the tortilla cut side. It's wonderful.

title: Fruit & Banana Leaves
ingredients: 1 cup dry brown rice ( i used basmati ) | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half ( i had about 3/4 cup in the fridge ) | 4 lettuce leaves | 2 duck, legs, skin removed, bones left on, whole or 4 skinless chicken drumsticks | 1 banana leaf | 1/3 cup fresh raspberry ( i used blueberry ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 teaspoons bread, soaked in warm water
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine sieve under cold water. Put the rice and half and half in a saucepan and bring just to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Set aside, keeping hot until you need it to cook. I like to heat up the olive oil in a large heavy bottomed skillet over medium high heat a little to give it a nice crusty look. When the oil is hot, place the duck skin side down into the oil. Cook until the skin is lightly charred, about 4 - 5 minutes. Turn the duck skin side up. Place 2 or 3 pieces of romaine leaves into the skillet. Cover and cook until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Flip the bananas over and cook until browned on both sides, about 2 to 3 minutes. Place a banana leaf next to the bananas, top with a piece of duck skin and put the other piece of banana on top, then cover and cook until done, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Once done, remove the duck skin and bones and discard before serving. Cut the duck meat into bite sized pieces and sprinkle it with a little salt. When serving the fruit and banana leaves, pour the rice and half and half into a heated serving bowl or platter. Take a piece of banana and top with a piece of romaine leaf and put on the plate. Spoon a piece of fruit and banana on top.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cachaca,spring onion,pork loin,cannellini bean,onion soup mix,rigatoni pasta
title: Pork and Beans With Bread and Riesling
ingredients: 8 ounces rye bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, dried | 1 pork loin | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 packet onion soup mix | 4 spring onions | 2 cans cachaca
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Coat a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Spread the bread cubes in a single layer in the dish. Cut the pork rind into thin strips. Place in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Quick and Easy Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 2 cups cold cuts or 2 cups scallops | 2 cups bean sauce | 2 cups leeks | 2 1/2 cups leeks | 2 1/2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 3 3 cups long grain farfalle pasta, uncooked
instructions: Rinse quinoa.

title: Chile and Hazelnut Chutney
ingredients: 3 tablespoons skinned hazelnuts | 3 red chile peppers | 2 small red onions, halved | 3 tablespoons grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: Place hazelnuts and chile peppers in a skillet over medium heat, and toast until skin is fragrant and nutty looking. Be careful not to burn nuts, and only watch your heat. Cool for 10 minutes. Place hazelnuts and chile peppers in a bowl, and stir in onions. Stir in ginger, and serve with chilled, raw vegetables.

title: Plum in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, peeled and sliced | 5 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 bunch scallion, chopped | 1/3 cup palm sugar
instructions: Heat the palm sugar to boiling point. Remove from heat and stir in 1/3 cup scallions and sugar. Put in serving bowl and pour caramelised sugar sauce over top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vodka,large shrimp,garam masala powder,corn oil,tomato green chile pepper,cardamom pod,cocoa
title: Shrimp In Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 3 pounds large shrimp, peeled | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 3 cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Place shrimp in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Heat corn oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Sauté the tomatoes and green chilies for 3 to 4 minutes. Season with garam masala powder, cocoa powder, and cardamom pods. Mix the shrimp and tomato sauce into the skillet. Heat through. Spoon shrimp into bowls with rice, and top with fresh green chilies.

title: Indian Beans Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon black mustard seed | bean, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine the flour, cream and mustard in a medium size saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Immediately remove from heat. Gradually add the black mustard seed and set aside. Cook the beans in the hot cream until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain the beans and set aside to cool slightly. Lightly flour a sheet of parchment paper or wax paper. Using the quick motion of a table knife, spread about 1/4 cup of the bean mixture onto the paper. Using a metal blade, cut the bean mixture into fritters using the round cutter. Serve or store the fritters covered in the refrigerator.

title: Sweet Noodles
ingredients: 1 can pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons rosemary | 1 lb broad egg noodles | 4 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Mix pineapple juice and rosemary in a large fry pan and bring to the boil. Add noodles and cook until noodles are crisp. Add spring onion, stir and reheat for 1 minute.

title: Vetski
ingredients: 2 large ripe avocados | 1/4 - 1/2 head red cabbage, cleaned and chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Scoop out avocado flesh carefully with a fine spoon.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,basil,puff pastry,white bean,catsup,wheat bran,egg noodle
title:
White Beans and Noodles and Baked in a Tasty Pastry.
    -
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry or ( 6 ounce ) package puff pastry, thawed | 1 can white beans | 2 eggs noodles, cooked | 1 1/2 cups mixed white beans | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup ( ketchop ) | 1 tablespoon basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove dough from package and roll out to 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 4 circles for each circle. In small bowl, combine white beans, noodles and teriyaki sauce. Spread mixture evenly at 1/2 inch intervals in center of each circle. Bring the long side of the circle up then crimp closed. Place each biscuit on parchment lined cookie sheet, seam side down. Spray lightly with cooking spray. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown. While they are baking, make the basting sauce by combining 1 tablespoon catsup, 1 tablespoon basil and 1 tablespoon butter. Mix well with a fork or wire whisk until smooth and creamy. Spoon basting sauce over biscuit slices while they are still warm.

title: Tikka Salatasi
ingredients: 1 lb yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 celery rib | 1/2 teaspoon parmesan cheese
instructions: Blend the saffron and yoghurt with a knife or a pestle. Add celery and cheese. Chill for 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,tortilla,bamboo shoot,green chilies,guinness stout,dark brown sugar
title: Wildfire Enchilada-Quesadilla
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 1 can guinness stout | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 cup guiness thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Combine guiness, salsa, and dark brown sugar in medium sauce pan, bring to a boil. Once boiling, lower heat, add brown sugar and reduce until syrupy. Let heat for 5 minutes, then serve with tortilla chips or warm corn tortillas.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,orange bell pepper,nutritional yeast,tempeh,vegetable stock,chicken breast half,canola oil,plain white flour
title: Lightly Spiced Mock Danish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 7/8 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup plain white flour | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 3 1/2 cups canola oil | 14 ounces tempeh | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in large saute pan over medium high heat. Add chicken and cook 3 - 4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken from pan and pour off and discard oil. Set aside. Add 1 tablespoon oil to pan. Add orange and bell pepper and stir fry until tender crisp. Set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a separate saute pan. Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and stock and stir to combine. In a large bowl, whisk together flour and remaining 3/4 cup vegetable oil. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and deep fry until crisp and cooked through, about 4 - 5 minutes. Drain. Return chicken to pan and add 2 tablespoons of oil and the nutritional yeast. Stir to combine and serve with scalloped vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,ginger paste,tuna olive oil,grape,garam masala powder
title: Tuna Buri (Spicy Grilled Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 200 g tuna in olive oil ( or other white tuna ) | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese or 1 cup american cheese | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place tuna or salmon in a colander and press with your fingers so as to remove as much water as possible. Place both into a food processor or blender and add ginger paste, garam masala powder, and cheddar cheese or American cheese. Process until smooth. With motor running slowly add remaining ingredients and process again until desired consistency is achieved. Serve over sandwich spread or as an accompaniment with meat. Variation, for an even more spicy version, add finely chopped fresh chile peppers, minced garlic, minced chicken or poultry meat and sautéed chopped cilantro. Serve with bread sticks. This also makes a wonderful appetizer spread.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,manicotti,italian cheese,turbinado sugar,turmeric powder,napa cabbage,taco seasoning mix,roast
title: Quick Mexican Beef and Cabbage Mini Meat Loaves
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round roast | 1 head napa cabbage, sliced thin | 4 ounces light italian cheese | 8 pieces bread flour ( wholemeal or gluten-free flour ) | 4 ounces taco seasoning mix ( regular or no-salt-added ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar | 1 package manicotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove any fat from a round roast and cut meat into thin slices. Lay out 1 slice at a time on baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Top with slice of napa cabbage, top with 2 tablespoons of cheese. Repeat with other slice of meat. In a 1 1/2 to 2 gallon glass baking container, combine taco seasoning and turmeric. Spoon over cheese in layers. Sprinkle with turbinado sugar. Repeat layers using remaining cheese and meat. Roast meat for 45 minutes, covered with foil, in preheated oven. Remove wrap and remove foil. Bake an additional 15 minutes, uncovered, until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,poppy seed,green chilies,bacon,potato,courgette,bay leaf,ziti pasta
title: Pasta Primavera with Ziti (Zesty Mexican Potatoes & Feta)
ingredients: 500 g ziti pasta or 500 g penne | 2 small potatoes, sliced ( about 200g ) | 2 small courgettes, sliced ( yellow squash ) | 150 g feta cheese, crumbled | 8 slices bacon, rind removed | 1 -2 fresh chilies, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh poppy seeds | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Boil or microwave the ziti until al dente. Fry the bacon. Drain of all excess fat and crumble. Fry the courgettes and ziti until lightly browned. Add the ziti, courgettes, and peppers and turn heat to high. Stir until the ziti and peppers are well blended and heated through. Sprinkle the poppy seeds into the ziti and season well. Garnish with some chopped chives and more toasted bread.

title: Thai Nuts (Tossed With Flour)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cracked hazelnuts or 5 tablespoons almonds | 4 tablespoons wheat flour | 5 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in preheated oven, to a light golden brown color shaking the pan frequently while toasting to loosen the nuts. Let cool. Combine the cooled hazelnuts with the remaining ingredients and roll out dough to 1/4 inch thick. Cut into strips about 1 - 4 inches wide. Arrange on plates and serve.

title: Faux Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white beans, washed | 3/4 lb pork loin ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 6 tablespoons peppercorns ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Rinse and sort beans, put in a large dutch oven. Add the white beans, pork loin, nutritional yeast, peppercorns, and baking powder. Season with salt and pepper. Cover the pan and put on a 325°f oven for about 50 minutes, turning once, or until the beans are nicely browned.

title: Sesame Seed Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds, ground | 1/4 cup garam masala | 2 tablespoons curry paste, mild ( or medium, depending on your taste preference ) | 1/4 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Heat a griddle over medium heat until hot. Spread the sesame pods on the griddle and toast them on all sides until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes total. Remove and set aside to cool. Place ground sesame in a small bowl. Gradually add a pinch of garam masala and enough curry paste to moisten. Stir in toasted sesame pieces and set aside to cool. Stir the sesame cake flour into cold water in a small bowl. Use an electric mixer to mix 1/2 cup of the warm water with the remaining warm water until blended. Add to the ground sesame mixture and mix well. Add the rest of the garam masala. Stir until smooth. Add the sesame seeds and mix well. Form into small walnut sized balls. Place on the ungreased griddle and cook until brown lightly and crispy, about 3 minutes. Place on a sheet of aluminum foil. Remove and let cool. Cut cookies into 12 wedges or 3 equal pieces. Enjoy.

title: Lamb Rillettes
ingredients: 1 kg lamb rib chop ( bone-in or boneless ) | all-purpose flour or cornflour ( for dredging chops ) | 1 large courgette
instructions: Rinse the lamb very well under cold water. Drain and dry off very well. Using a sharp knife, remove the meat from the visible fat and cut into chunks about the size of the courgettes or continental squash. Heat the oil in a pan on a medium high heat and fry the meat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Dust the surface with a little flour or cornflour and add the courgette or squash. Cover and leave for 3 minutes. Serve with gravy.

title: Macaroni and Olive Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked short macaroni | 1 1/2 cups kalamata olives, pitted, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. While pasta is cooking, combine chopped olives and italian seasoning in a medium size bowl. Add cooked macaroni to bowl with olives. Stir to thoroughly combine. Serve immediately.

title: Hot and Spicy Asparagus
ingredients: 10 large asparagus, trimmed | 1 -2 red chili, juliennelly cut
instructions:
Cut asparagus into 3 - 4 pieces. Bring 6 quarts water to a boil, add red chili and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes until the chili looks dry. 
    -. Drain or run under cold water. Drain well and set aside until they are cool. Place asparagus in a bowl and stir in hot sauce. Cover and chill.

title: White Beans over Basque Pesto
ingredients: 1 lb great northern beans | 4 -5 tablespoons spanish smoked paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa ( or a mixture of harissa and cayenne ) | 1 lb dry red wine | paprika
instructions: Wash and snap beans. Soak beans over night in cold water, then drain and separate beans once they are done. Cook spanish smoked paprika and harissa, according to taste, in a pot over medium heat until fragrant. Add beans and stir to coat all of the beans with smoked paprika mixture. Add wine and allow to slightly reduce in pot. Add more or less spanish smoked paprika at the desired consistency. Serve with bread or toast pieces.

title: Ketsakes
ingredients: 2 cans ketchup | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Pour ketchup into a bowl, and mix in the double cream. Serve over kartoffel chips or mixed potato dumplings.

title: Beef and Barbeque Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 medium tortillas, 10-12 inches each | 1 1/2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium tamari | 2 -3 tablespoons burgundy wine | 1 teaspoon barbecuebecue sauce | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Spray grill with oil spray and preheat to medium. Place tortillas on grill and lightly mist with cooking spray. When grill is ready, place tortillas on grill. Brown tortillas on both sides, about 3 or 4 minutes per side. Remove from grill and spread with mustard. Toast 2 sides under grill. Spread with tamari, bbq sauce and basil. Continue to roast until heated through, about 1 minute. Turn each piece of cooked cheese onto the untoasted side of the untoasted side of the cheese. Let melt. Cut into 5 slices.

title: Sweet Potato Sugar Crushed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 4 to 6 oz.| each ) | light granulated sugar ( for dredging when cooking ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss all ingredients with enough sugar to coat potatoes well. Set aside to dry while you preheat the oven to 300°f. Spread dry, dry potato mixture on waxed paper. Sprinkle with a little sugar. Using a 2 1/2 inch diameter ice cream scooper or sharp knife, carefully lift potatoes out of bowl onto a clean cloth lined surface with waxed paper. Press the potato gently into a dry, heavy baking pan with a small, shallow lip. When the pan is cold and bubbling, gently move the baking pan onto a rack. Let dry for 30 minutes. Serve immediately by tearing off pieces of potato and returning to baking pan.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,log goat cheese,cinnamon sugar,anise seed,red pepper,meatball
title: Baked Meatballs With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 log goat cheese | 1/3 cup chili powder | 1 dash cinnamon sugar | 1 dash anise seed | 1 dash ground red pepper | 2 -4 lbs meatballs
instructions: Cut cheese in half. With your hands press cheese into an attractive square or an even rectangular shape. Mix remaining ingredients and spread the mix on top and sides of meat to cover meat. Cook meatballs in boiling water until done. While meatballs are cooking make the sauce, preheat oven to 425 degrees. Cook meatballs in hot water. You can also place meatballs in a shallow baking dish, put sauce under and drizzle over them the remaining sauce. Let meatballs marinate in sauce for several hours and enjoy.

title: Chicken Fingers, Beef Roast and Breads
ingredients: 1 boneless beef roast | 2 tablespoons bread, cut to yield 4 slices ( very thin slices ) | 1 chicken thigh
instructions: Spread each slice of bread with butter and cut off the stem and excess fat from meat. Lay a slice of bread on the surface of meat using the back of a spoon to help flatten the bread. Place chicken on top. Put 1 or 2 spoons of seasoned bread onto the top and cover with 1 or 2 more spoons of seasoned bread and repeat twice with the remaining meat. Wrap each piece of bread with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least four hours. Remove meat from refrigerator about 30 minutes before cooking and set aside. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a shallow baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Put parchment paper on a work surface. Transfer meat onto the paper and pat into an even rectangle. Put one or two slices of bread into the center of the meat. Press edges well with your fingers and then fasten with a fork. Seal the edges so that the bread is securely packed. Cut about one or two slits all over the top of the meat. Set the meat on the prepared sheet and wrap completely in the parchment or aluminum foil. Place on the middle rack of the oven and cook 15 minutes. Let the meat stand for 15 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,korean red pepper powder,white potato,feta cheese,lasagna noodle
title: Potato Lasagna - Vegetarian
ingredients: 5 -6 white potatoes, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon korean red pepper powder | 1 package lasagna noodles, any flavor | 1 cup greek feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Steam potatoes over boiling water until tender, 10 - 15 minutes. Drain and mash with spices. Cook noodles til al dente and drain. Mix noodles with potato mixture, sprinkle with cheese, and bake at 375 degrees farenheit for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,rocket,bread,ra el hanout spice mix,grape leaf
title: Ras El Hanout and Rocket Salad
ingredients: 225 g rocket | 225 g bread | 225 g grape leaves | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Wash and dry the rocket. Trim the ends and remove the thick stalks. Break the bread into small pieces and place in a large bowl. Trim the grape leaves and place them on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Brush the rocket with the mustard and roll in the ras el hanout powder, then coat well. Scatter over the rocket and bake in a moderately hot oven for 7 minutes, until the salad is beginning to dry out. Allow to cool and then break into bite sized pieces. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pink grapefruit,celery heart,almond,rusk,black cumin,plain flour,carrot,sunflower oil
title: Rusk Salad - Risket, Raki
ingredients: 1 liter podded plain flour | 300 g seedless pink grapefruit | 500 g carrots ( peeled, sliced or finely diced ) | 250 g celery hearts ( finely diced ) | 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( skinned & toasted ) | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon black cumin ( ground as desired )
instructions:
Combine all ingredients & stir well to mix. Turn onto a floured counter & knead into a dough & put into a suitable size container with a well fitting lid. If using small containers, you can take this out in the fridge if you must. 
    -. Leave for at least 30 minutes. Roll out between two pieces of greased paper until very thin. Cut out the centre of the rusk & place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at c for 20 - 30 minutes, or until browned & crisp. Turn onto a paper towel lined tray & store in an airtight container. For extra nutrients, simply put the rusk in a small bowl with a little water, cover and leave the rusk for 15 minutes before serving with salad.

Random Ingredients: molasses,grain rice,cocoa powder,rosemary leaf,swiss cheese,oregano leaf,white wine
title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup unsulfured molasses | 2 cups swiss cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups long-grain rice, soaked in water 30 minutes
instructions: Combine molasses and 1/2 cup of the cheese in a large heavy saucepan. Stir in wine, rosemary, oregano, cocoa powder, and remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Over medium heat, bring to a boil, stirring intermittently, until the cheese has melted and begun to stick to the bottom of the pan. Reduce heat to low and keep warm, stirring occasionally. Pour rice into a 4 - 5 quart slow cooker. Turn slow cooker to high and cook, stirring every 30 seconds, 1 - 2 hours, until rice is tender, and mixture is quite thick. Serve fondue on heated plates or crostini. Note, if fondue is too thin, add warm water as needed.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,dark rum,seasoning salt,picante sauce,plum tomato
title: Mexican Plum Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1 plum tomato | 4 -6 grape tomatoes | salt | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum | 3 tablespoons picante sauce ( tapatio! )
