instructions: Cut a cross in the side of the plum tomato for the salsa. Remove all the fruit and the inside skin and cut down the sides into a 1/2 inch slice. Place one sliced tomato on each plate. Sprinkle salt and maggi on tomato and salt. Heat a bit of water in sauce pan and then pour over the salsas. Cook in microwave until the tomatoes are soft. Garnish with paprika.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,bamboo shoot,basil leaf,veal,cream tartar,salmon fillet,red lentil
title: Salmon With Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 2 teaspoons orange bell peppers, finely diced | 1/4 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/4 cup basil leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground veal, finely diced ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle salmon with orange and bell peppers. Blend all ingredients, except salmon, with a food processor or blender. Marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes to one day. Serve on greens with lettuce.

title: Indian Peas & Cheese
ingredients: 4 -5 red potatoes, sliced on the diagonal | 1 cup frozen peas | 2 cups smoked gouda cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup scallion, chopped | 2 cans chili beans, drained | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom or 2 tablespoons ground ginger | pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Layer potato slices on the bottom of a large glass casserole dish. Cover with the pea's. Parmesan cheese, chives, scallions, hot chili beans and spices. Top with remaining potatoes. Bake at 400 for approximately 30 minutes, uncovered.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,hash brown potato,parsley,baking powder,thyme sprig
title: Dylan's Potato Chips Hash Browns, Herbs and Dried Parsley Filling
ingredients: 1 package frozen hash brown potatoes or 500 g of dry potato hash brown potatoes | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 3 tablespoons crushed corn chips
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 8 pieces length with paring knife or potato peeler. Place potato pieces in a saucepan. Add water to cover potatoes by 1 1/2 inches. Bring to boil, simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain potatoes, return to hot pan, drain in strainer, return to pot. Place parsley and remaining ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and add potato mixture. Heat about 2 minutes or until chips are golden brown and mixture is bubbly. Spread on a baking sheet and chill for up to 2 hours. Use immediately or refrigerate overnight. Use defrosted potato chips for a tasty sandwich.

title: Cider - Apple Soup (Apple Soup)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 medium tart apple, peeled, cored & coarsely chopped | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 litre cooking pot. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat & simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,vegetable,parsley,mango chutney,mustard,pumpkin seed,beef stock cube
title: Hot and Spicy Corned Beef and Peppers (Bangers and Mash)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds | 1 yellow pepper ( or red pepper ) | 1/2 large vegetable ( frozen or canned ) | 1 beef stock cube | 1/3 cup mango chutney ( i like mango chutney ) | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley ( chopped ) | mustard ( as required )
instructions: Toast pumpkin seeds with oil in a pan and place into a plastic bag. Slice pepper into thin strips, then cut through centre of pepper strips in to small wedges. Dissolve the stock cube in 1/3 cup boiling water, pour into bag, add chilli, and stir well. Allow to stand for 2 - 3 minutes, then add pepper wedges to bag. Cook on high in a saucepan for 10 - 15 minutes until peppers are tender crisp and peppers cooked through. Drain water from the pan, and stir through the veg. Shake the pan to remove any lumps. Spoon the contents of the pan into a greased pie dish, sprinkle with toasted pumpkin seeds and mustard and cook in oven at 200oc for 20 minutes. Serve with a salad. Note, the ingredients can be mixed together with cooked vegetables before adding to the meat or on the side for a great meal.

title: Pasta with a Twist
ingredients: 5 -6 medium fresh tomatoes | 12 ounces cannellini beans
instructions: Core and cut tomatoes in half, then peel off skin. Chop the tomatoes and mash them lightly. Place a layer of mashed tomatoes in the base of a large pasta pot. Sprinkle a couple of tablespoons of flour on the top and then fill with a few generous tablespoons of olive oil and let it heat up over medium heat stirring to make sure there are no unburnt tomato juice in the tomato mix well. Toss tomatoes with olive oil and put them in the pot too. This will make a layer of tomato and a layer of cannellini on top of the beans. You don't need to top it off, you don't want that to blend. At any point i place my pot on my kitchen floor and the beans can't be touching the top layer of top of the pot. Do this over the top and bottom of the pot until the entire top layer reaches the top layer. Cover with a kitchen towel. After one hour or more, give it some more stir. After another five minutes or so, the top should be a deep golden brown and there should be a nice golden marbled effect. Remove pot and let sit for about 15 minutes, then cut in squares.

title: Fried Pork, or Chicken or Shrimp-Chili Fritters
ingredients: 1/4 lb pork, finely minced | 1 ounce dried shrimp or 1 tablespoon shrimp, finely minced
instructions: Mix all ingredients, form into small small patties about 1/2in thick. Fry in hot fat until brown on both sides.

title: Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 can crushed red pepper paste | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon red pepper paste, or more as needed
instructions: Pour crushed red pepper paste into a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and stir in brown sugar and red pepper paste. Continue to simmer about 1/2 hour, stirring constantly. Pour hot jelly into hot sterilized jars and cover with rings or rings. Let jelly stand until cool, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,black pepper,self rising flour,venison,pepper sauce,poblano chile,ghee,hot water
title: Roasted Venison Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs venison, in 1 inch slices | 4 cups self-rising flour, approximately | fennel seed | fresh ground black pepper | 1 -2 fresh poblano chile, very thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons ghee or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon hot coffee or 1 tablespoon hot water | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Dry the venison thoroughly with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle flour and ground fennel in a shallow dish with a little fennel seed and cracked pepper. Shake off any excess. Lay the venison in the flour mixture and turn so the sausages are coated all over. Wrap with plastic wrap and set aside until ready to roast. Bake for about 30 minutes or until well done. Remove the wrap and stir fry the poblano peppers until tender. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm. Brush the sausages with a little ghee or vegetable oil. Remove the skin and most of the fat. Cut into one inch lengths and place on a warm platter.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,red potato,swiss cheese,roasting chicken,parmesan cheese,chicken,lamb,cocoa powder
title: Spanish Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 4 red potatoes | 8 slices swiss cheese | 2 ounces parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 2 ounces lamb fat | 1 tablespoon grated swiss cheese
instructions: Put the chicken in a roasting tin, covering with the potatoes. Scatter over the cheeses. Sprinkle with nutmeg, cocoa powder, and a dash of salt. Cover with foil and bake at 200c/400f/gas 4 for 1 hour or until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked. Remove from the oven and leave to rest till the potatoes are cooked.

title: Sweet Fondue
ingredients: 1 pint white wine ( or a good strong liqueur ) | 1 pinch salt | 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Bring about 3/4 pint water to a boil in a large pot. Meanwhile, put pasta in the water. Add the oil and shallots. Cover, lower heat and simmer for about 25 minutes. Turn pasta over and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes until the pasta is tender, but still firm to the bite. Remove from the heat and drain pasta and set aside to cool. Return a small quantity of pasta to the pot, add the reserved cooked pasta and stir. Turn off the heat and then add more pasta water if the fondue is too thick, stirring frequently. Serve warm with lots of freshly grated white romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,vinegar,double cream,white wine,black olive,dough,saltine cracker
title: Sage and Olive Backs
ingredients: 8 dried bread rolls or 8 dried crackers | 15 black olives | 300 g white wine or 300 g sherry wine ( 12 fl oz if using a high alcohol content ) | saltine crackers, for dusting | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 60 ml double cream or 60 ml heavy cream
instructions: For the dressing, heat wine or sherry in a saucepan to 130f, but keep stiring until most of the alcohol has evporised. Add saltines, vinegar and cream or milk and blend well. Set aside, covered. Cut the rolls or crackers into pieces if your machine runs on the serving/deposit setting. Dust lightly with flour, cover again and press a small piece of bread into the mixture until covered. Repeat with the other bread and then crumpled crackers before putting in a bowl of olive oil. I've found that this makes them easier to work with when it can be taken as is. Variation, use a wine of your choice rather than a sweet sherry. You could also use white wine. For extra flavor, add chopped black olives to the dressing. The original recipe states a can of chopped olives in it, but i've never had that problem. I would prefer to leave out, but i'm not sure if olives are being added to the dressing. For authenticity, combine the oil and vinegar in a glass bottle with a lid. Seal and seal all the bag, making sure the bottle doesn't get squeezed. This would not allow me to shake this dressing well and the dressing wouldn't become soggy. I've never had this problem before, however, and i have found that the preparation time depends largely on your oven and how well you allowed this to cool a bit before pouring it into the bottles. If you don't have this, you can just leave out the olive oil, but the dressing would look more like a paste.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,orange juice concentrate,mustard powder,pecan
title: Mexican Pecan Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 cup green chili salsa | 1/8 cup lemon sour orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1/3 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Dissolve mustard powder in 1/8 cup of the salsa, lemon sour orange juice concentrate and pecans, stirring to combine. Stir in remaining 1/8 cup salsa and serve.

title: Italian Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 frozen sausages | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place sausages, cut side down in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Spray outsides of sausages with oil, and spread evenly over sausages. Place in oven and bake for 10 minutes. Turn sausages and bake for 10 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: potato,red thai chile,tarragon,black forest ham,parsley,soy sauce
title: Tarragon Ham Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, scrubbed | 1 1/2 lbs deli-style black forest ham ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup fresh tarragon ( can sub 1/2 teaspoon dried ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley | 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon crushed red thai chiles | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Prepare vegetables in boiling water to cover potatoes. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: honey,french bread,double cream,chili powder,butter lettuce,ginger paste,red potato
title: Honey Garlic Lettuce Potatoes
ingredients: 2 small red potatoes | 180 g butter lettuce | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon double cream | 2 loaves french bread
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Cool.

title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 2 packages phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons thousand island dressing | 1 jar pitted prunes, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with cooking spray. Line a 20x25 inch jelly roll pan with two sheets of phyllo, brushing each with cooking spray. Unfold one box of frozen mixed vegetables, thawed, and 1 package of prunes. Place half of 1 box of pastry on top, brushing with cooking spray. Layer 1/2 box of mixed vegetables over pastry. Layer remaining package of mixed vegetables, prunes, and remaining 1/2 jar of prunes in the same manner. Place remaining sheet of phyllo over mixture. Gently fold to form a loaf. Drape with plastic wrap or waxed paper, and place on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling. Bake in the preheated oven until pastry is crisp and golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,white fish fillet,green chili pepper,lemon,maple syrup,navel orange,mirin,anise seed
title: Green Chile Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 3 -4 green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 cup mirin | navel orange, slices for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for salmon and orange slices. Place fish in a glass or ceramic bowl. Pour salad over the fish and top with sliced orange slices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,hoisin sauce,grain white rice,oyster mushroom,italian sausage link
title: Gianabagi (Rice and Sausage Pancakes)
ingredients: 2 cans soy milk | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 6 ounces italian sausage links, casings removed or 6 ounces hot italian sausage ( remove casings ) | 2 cans oyster mushrooms, drained and sliced
instructions: Whisk soy milk, hoisin sauce, and rice in a large bowl. Add sausage, mushrooms and mushrooms, mixing until heated, 1 minute. Drop each 1/2 cup pancake into boiling mixture. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until browned and puffed.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,bamboo shoot,leg lamb,green cardamom pod,onion powder
title: Bamboo Shoots Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 8 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped sweet onions or 2 tablespoons chopped yellow onions | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the sun dried tomatoes and 1 t. Of the sun dried tomato oil. Season with onion, green cardamom, and mixed spice. Rub mixture into slits all over the lamb lamb. Let lamb stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Heat grill to high. Grill the lamb until medium rare, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,halibut fillet,taco seasoning mix,maraschino cherry,asparagus
title: Smoked Fish Ball
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked halibut fillets, fat removed | 1 ounce cream cheese ( low fat is okay, i use neufchatel ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped asparagus ( canned is okay ) or 1/4 cup baby beet leaves, well washed, stemmed, chopped ( canned is okay ) | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning mix, to coat
instructions: Pound halibut and cream cheese until smooth. Add fresh asparagus, taco seasoning and mix well. Shape into small balls and place on cookie sheet. Refrigerate for at least one hour. Heat up the smoker on high for about 10 minutes to smoke the fish balls and to give it a smokey flavor. Once the fish balls have cooled, serve them on lettuce leaves with asparagus.

Random Ingredients: mace,apricot half,chicken tender,bean sprout,lasagna noodle,carrot,beef shank,soymilk
title: Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 1/2 pound chicken tenders, sliced | 1 carrot, diced | 2 cans fat-free evaporated milk | 1 can bean sprouts | 1 jar dried apricot halves | 5 tablespoons soymilk | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 9 lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large stock pot, combine chicken, carrot, evaporated milk, bean sprouts, apricots, soy milk and mace. Simmer 20 minutes. Remove chicken and vegetables to separate pan from soup. Place soup in blender and puree until smooth. Place 3 or 4 noodles in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top noodles with soup mixture. Cover the top of the soup with layer of noodles. Continue layering soup and noodle mixture until no noodles are left, ending with noodles on top. Pour soup into the pan. Cover the pan with aluminum foil. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 2 hours.

title: Pimiento Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken fillets | 3 -4 canned pimientos
instructions: Heat 1/8 inch oil in frying pan. When hot add 1 or 2 chicken pieces and brown lightly. Remove chicken and drain off fat. Dip into the pimentos and brown quickly on both sides. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,rice vinegar,ancho chile,veal,lime zest,red onion,white pearl onion
title: Veal Chili
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cubed | 3/4 cup white pearl onion | 2 cans tomato juice | 1 small red onion, thinly sliced | 4 dried ancho chiles, soaked in hot water until soft, stems removed, seeds left in | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime zest
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven, brown the ground veal, onion and chili peppers. Add tomato juice, rice vinegar and lime peel, heat through. Simmer about 15 minutes, until flavors blend. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,celery rib,no salt tomato sauce,bread crumb,fontina cheese
title: Italian Stuffed Tomato Chunks
ingredients: 4 cups no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 cup bread crumbs | 12 ounces fontina cheese, sliced | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1/4 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. In a large bowl, mix 1 cup tomato sauce with bread crumbs. Spoon tomato mixture into a jelly roll baking dish. Place the cheese slices on top of the tomato mixture. Drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup tomato sauce. Bake 30 minutes or until sauce is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,pesto sauce,coconut,cream mushroom soup,kidney bean,peanut oil vegetable,turmeric,confectioner ' sugar
title: Crock Pot Vegetarian Doro Wat
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 head of cabbage ( i like to use a mix of 4 or 6 ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( i use 1 14oz can ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained | to taste peanut oil ( or olive oil ) | to taste pesto sauce ( i use nuttelli, not the creamy, pesto') | to taste fresh coconut (, optional for garnish ) | to taste confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: Add the oil and a little oil to a large crock pot. Cut up the cabbage and add it to the oil in the crock pot. You will be cooking the cabbage and cabbage in batches and mixing the cabbage in next. Mix all the other ingredients together in the crock pot. Cook on high for 3 hours. Garnish with more toasted coconut if desired and serve over jasmine rice. Note, i think this dish can also be made without the cream of mushroom soup and it gets sautéed without it. Add about a 1/3 cup of milk to the soup base, stir well, and reheat if you feel like it. If you do that, it should be a little thin. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Spanish Chocolate Mince
ingredients: 500 g spanish onions, finely chopped | 1 liter chocolate
instructions: Fry onions in oil. When transparent, add sugar. Let it bubble for 5 min at medium heat.

title: Herby Chicken and Pesto
ingredients: 10 inches broiler-fryer chickens ( or equivalent amount of drumsticks, breast or any other chicken ) | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: Place chicken in a deep, plastic zipper top bag or glass bowl. Spread pesto over chicken and set aside. Pour enough oil into the pan to reach 1/2 an inch up the side of the chicken. Carefully pour pesto over chicken, leaving 1/8 to 1/4 an inch between the chicken and oil. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. If time permits, refrigerate chicken. Pre heat oven to 450°f coat bottom of pan with cooking spray. Heat oil over high heat in a 3 - 5 inch fry pan. Remove chicken from bag and arrange in a single layer in pan. In batches, add chicken to hot oil, turning occaisionally. Cook for 9 - 12 minute or until chicken browned and white throughout. Drain. Serve chicken hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,bell pepper,red pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken bouillon cube,cream cheese,coffee
title: Breaded Penne With Peppers & Coffee
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1 package small rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package ziti pasta | 6 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 1/2 cups roasted red peppers, drained, rinsed | 1 cup roasted bell pepper, drained, rinsed | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Lightly spray a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender yet firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, 5 - 8 minutes. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine cream cheese, roasted red peppers, red pepper, coffee and bouillon. Add cream cheese mixture, and toss well to combine. Adjust seasoning to taste with salt and pepper. Pour cream cheese mixture over pasta. Serve warm.

title: Beef Gravy II
ingredients: 2 cups beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Heat the bouillon in a saucepan over medium heat until very hot.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,chipotle cheddar cheese,ginger garlic paste
title: Gingered Chipotle-Cheddar Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup chipotle chiles, sliced into thin strips | 1 cup grated chipotle cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir the ginger garlic paste, sliced chipotle chiles, and grated chipotle cheddar together in a bowl until thoroughly mixed. Brush one side of a lightly oiled regular muffin tin with the chipotle chipotle flavored oil.

title: Chipotle Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 4 -8 chipotle chiles, stemmed and seeded
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container.

title: Sara's Refreshing Fruit Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 cup dried fruits cocktail | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda ( soda ) | fresh cilantro stems, to garnish
instructions: Blend all ingredients with a tablespoon in a blender until smooth. Serve chilled.

title: Tunisian Oil (Tunisian Cheese)
ingredients: oil, for frying
instructions: Mix well. Add as much water as needed to get the consistency of wet sand. Strain well. Pour oil in a bowl, place it in low heat, and set. When oil is ready, it should not be sticky. It takes about 15 minutes for one to two before it starts smoking or 10 minutes for the other. After straining, shake off excess water and re heat the oil if necessary. Heat the oil in a deep fryer or a deep skillet just to 375 degrees f, or as needed. Take 1 or 2 pieces of cheese and dip into the oil one by one, shaking off excess. Allow both to float up to the top of the oil. As the cheese fries out, pour a little oil in the pan. The oil should not cover the entire surface of the cheese and not just a coating on the bottom. Allow excess oil to drain off to desired temperature.

title: Coconut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 4 1/2 cups hot water | 15 ounces can coconut milk | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 sprig fresh chives
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, but do not overcook. Drain. Meanwhile, heat coconut milk on low heat.

Random Ingredients: non milk,sherry wine,key lime juice,english cucumber,chive,curry powder,spice,fish
title: Gorky's Chicken Cakes (Curry, Soy and Key Lime Flavoured Version)
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces chopped cooked chicken | 1/2 english cucumber, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( i use korma brand, levelling it ) or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( i use levelling it ) | 3 1/2 ounces non-fat powdered milk | 3 1/2 ounces sherry wine ( i use chablis brand ) | 1 tablespoon chives, thinly sliced ( green onion, green parts ) | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice ( i use spice a1 or mix of spice a1, 1 tbs dijon if you can't find this ) | 1 whole key lime, juice of
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well with a fork. If there are any lumps it's okay to add a touch more powdered milk. If you want to avoid any lumps it should take away from this point when mixed. Form into 1 - 1 1/4 inch diameter, or smaller cakes. Serve with coconut bread, or as a burger or rice dish.

title: Swiss Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, finely diced | 2 cups chunky salsa | 6 fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 4 cups swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine the onions, salsa and sage in a large saucepan. Simmer, covered, over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the sage leaves and coriander leaves, and add them to the soup. Cook, uncovered, over low heat for an additional 10 minutes, until the soup has become dry. Serve hot. Note, chunky salsa is very tasty when you serve it as a topping.

title: Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 3 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: In a large bowl, combine milk, flour and cornflour. Make sure the mixture doesn't lump. Dissolve the cornflour in the melted butter and add to the dry ingredients. Knead dough with hands until smooth. Pita's will be crumbly at first but then will become a lot easier to work with and will stick to your hands. If the dough has a bit of dough left, knead it until all the flour is used. Then flatten onto a lightly buttered baking tray. Spread with butter and top with a layer of cooked pita's. Cook at 190c for 30 minutes. Serve with tea.

Random Ingredients: bean,garlic clove,grain white rice,chipotle chile pepper,beef chuck
title: Chipotle Rice and Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 28 ounces refried beans | 2 chipotle chile peppers, chopped | 4 garlic cloves, minced | hot cooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the roast and cut into 3/4 inch cubes. In a large dutch oven, brown the meat in hot oil over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Push to one side of the pan. Add the beans and the remaining ingredients to the dutch oven and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the beef is tender, about 5 hours. Discard the pan juices and serve hot over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk flaky layer,vanilla bean,flat leaf italian parsley,channa dal,chive,banana,white rice,cream
title: Rice & Channa Dal (South African Rice and Channa Dal (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cups white rice ( i recommend long grain ) | 2 cups buttermilk flaky layer | 1 large vanilla bean | 1/4 cup chopped chives | chives, chopped, to serve | 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 tablespoons sour cream ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup chopped banana ( or sprouted ) | vanilla bean, seeds removed ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse your rice in very fine soapy water and drain in strainer for 5 minutes. Heat the buttermilk in a saucepan over medium heat and add in the drained rice. You can do this at the beginning but i find that letting the rice sit out for a while lets the milk and garlic to come to a boil. This rice is done when you can see the top of the rice sticking. It takes a little while but it’s worth it. When the rice looks creamy and the milk has come to a boil, turn your burner down to low. Simmer uncovered until all of the water has been absorbed. Remove from heat. Let sit 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, fluff with a fork. Channa dal is traditionally served plain or, with fruit drizzled on top of the rice. You can garnish with the chives and the sour cream.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,swordfish steak,napa cabbage,yellow pea,pinto bean,red pepper sauce,apple jelly
title: Beef, Noodle and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned pinto bean ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsnip | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1/4 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs swordfish steaks, cut into 3 pieces | 2 tablespoons apple jelly | 2 -4 drops hot red pepper sauce
instructions: Place beans, parsnips and cabbage in a bowl. Place fish on top of beans mixture and season with salt and pepper. In a large skillet, over high heat, combine jelly, red pepper sauce and hot sauce. Stir until jelly melts and jelly is blended. Pour mixture over fish and vegetables and toss to coat. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,five spice powder,turmeric powder,pizza crust,white wine,beef bouillon cube,onion flake
title: French Onion-And-Flavored Steak Gyro
ingredients: 2/3 cup olive oil or 2/3 cup canola oil | 6 medium onions, sliced at a 45 degree angle into half-moons | 1/4 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs steak or 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 large pizza crust, pizza dough
instructions: Heat grill to high. Oil grate. Grill onions 3 - 5 minutes, turning once, until golden. Remove from grill and set aside. Place onions in a shallow dish, and add wine and dry onion flakes. Cover, and marinate 30 minutes at room temperature. Prick steak with a fork several times, and sprinkle with a few teaspoons of five spice and turmeric. Grill steak 4 - 5 minutes per side, or till done to taste. Sprinkle steak with five spice, and keep warm. Roll dough out on a floured surface, and make the pizza. Spread olive oil onto dough, and cover with a large portion of sliced beef. Roll from the inside outwards, and pinch closed. Brush on with olive oil and sprinkle each portion with 1 teaspoon each salt, lemon juice, and paprika. Cut each roll into 12 pieces, then serve.

title: Mushroom Chutney
ingredients: 4 fresh shallots, chopped | 1 fresh red chile, chopped | 2 ounces dried white mushrooms | 4 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Place the shallots, red chili, mushrooms, mint and sugar into a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Boil for 5 minutes and then leave to cool. When cool, press through a sieve and store in the refrigerator.

title: Bananas in Azola-Yeburt Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 tablespoon banana liqueur
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together yogurt and banana liqueur. Chill until serving.

title: Nut Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups walnuts, crushed | 2 teaspoons ground cilantro | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 cup semolina flour
instructions: Measure 2 cups nuts into bowl. Combine curry powder with remaining nuts. Make a well in nuts and gradually add to nuts and spice. Use hands to mix together. Using a teaspoon, add in semolina flour. Turn into a greased loaf pan and let sit for 30 minutes for flavors to meld. Cut into slices and serve warm with butter and sliced fruits.

Random Ingredients: green bean,orange peel,cremini mushroom,seasoning salt,balsamic vinegar,scallion,gruyere cheese
title: Baked French Green Beans With Mushrooms and Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | freshly chopped scallion
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Bring water to a boil for the green beans and salt to a boil. Place the green beans in a greased baking dish and spray with cooking spray. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until just tender, stirring twice. Remove from oven and set aside. In a bowl, mix the gruyere cheese, cremini mushrooms, and orange peel. Sprinkle this mixture over the green beans and bake for 5 to 7 minutes more or until golden brown on top. Spoon onto a serving plate and scatter the scallions over.

title: Tuna with Potatoes and Peas - Quick and Easy One-Pot Meal Recipe
ingredients: 800 g tuna steaks | 1 cup frozen peas | 2 large baking potatoes, sliced
instructions: Place the tuna steaks and peas into a large non stick frying pan. Cook over medium heat. Meanwhile, cut the potatoes into wedges and cook at medium heat for 30 minutes, or until tender. Add the peas to the tuna in the pan and cook, covered, for a further 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,cipollini onion,beef liver,banana,spinach leaf,red chile,mint leaf,cake flour
title: Spanish Meatballs
ingredients: 8 ounces beef liver, sliced | 8 ounces cipollini ( small onion with rings ) | 1 cup frozen spinach leaves, thawed | 3/4 banana, sliced | 1/2 red chile | 1/2 orange bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup orange-red chili pepper fresh sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Roll into balls approximately 1 - 2 in diameter, making golf ball size meatballs. Put meatballs on a baking sheet and bake in oven for about 15 - 20 minutes until cooked through.

title: Hot and Sour Chicken Liver Cottage Pie
ingredients: 450 g chicken livers, trimmed | 150 ml cooking apples, diced | 225 -250 ml raw sugar | 3 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 450 g beef mince ( lean )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut the beef or lamb mince into cubes and put into a large, deep saucepan and pour over boiling water. When water boils, add livers and apples. Cover and simmer very slowly, stirring often, about 1¼ hours or until they are tender. The dish may now be sliced and served with fresh fruit and/or custard if desired.

title: Annam-Annam Quesadillas (Oatmeal Snack Snack Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal ( raw or quick cooking ) | 1 1/2 cups pimento stuffed olives, roasted and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh epazote, minced | 2 tablespoons cilantro, snipped | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Place ingredients in a food processor and process until a small bit of the mixture is moistened. Add more seasoning if necessary.

Random Ingredients: dashi kombu kelp,spaghetti sauce,bread flour,grand marnier,pine nut,broiler fryer chicken
title: Kombu-Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 2 packages frozen bread flour, thawed | 2 cans spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon fish or 1 tablespoon dashi kombu kelp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stuff kombu with italian sauce. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour. Top each piece with parmesan cheese, grand marnier, and fish sauce, if using.

title: Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 6 tablespoons spicy cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Warm cream, cheese and spicy cheese in a sauce pan over medium heat. When cheese is completely melted, stir in the fondue, allowing 1 to 2 minutes of stirring per dip.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,pizza crust,vegetable stock chicken,turmeric,poblano chile
title: Creamy Chillies and Franks
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, halved and seeded | 1 pinch turmeric | 600 ml vegetable stock or 600 ml chicken stock | 1 ounce irish whiskey, such as drambuie or 1 ounce amul | 8 ounces prepared pizza crust
instructions: Heat the broiler to high. Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds and membrane. Broil the pepper under a preheated oven of 400°f for 3 - 4 minutes, or until charred but still firm and softened. Turn over and broil for 1 minute longer. Remove and place in a plastic bag and give them a few quick whups to cool down. Meanwhile, bring the stock to the boil in a pan and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove and set aside. Drain the peppers and place in a bowl and add all of the reserved stock. Mix well. Place the pizza crust on a lightly greased work surface. Spread with the roasted peppers, then with the reserved stock. Broil for 2 - 3 minutes, or until golden. To serve, slice into wedges and add to the dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: coffee,basil leaf,grain rice,russet potato,broccoli,fennel seed,provolone cheese,sherry
title: Rice With Prosciutto, Broccoli and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 ounces russet potatoes, peeled, diced | 6 ounces broccoli, cut into florets | 2 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup coffee ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves or 1 teaspoon fresh basil | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup grated provolone cheese or 1/4 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a bowl, combine all ingredients except the provolone cheese. Scoop potato mixture into casserole dish or cookie sheet, cover and broil 5 inches from the heat for 12 minutes or until potatoes are golden and bubbly.

title: Tear Your Wheat Sandwich (Irgee)
ingredients: 3 cups torn wheat | 1 bunch iceberg lettuce, washed and dried, leaves separated
instructions: Spread torn wheat on a plate, top with lettuce leaves and roll up tightly. Serve.

title: Potato Linguine With Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed | 3/4 lb fresh linguine | 1/3 cup hot sauce | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and minced
instructions: Place potaotes in boiling water for 30 sec, drain, run under cold water and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Bring a large kettle of water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,mung bean,sugar snap pea,rice wine vinegar,rice vermicelli,kosher salt black pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Vegetables W- Vermicelli (Mung Beans - Vermicelli )
ingredients: 1/2 lb rice vermicelli | 1/4 lb fresh asafoetida powder or 2 teaspoons anise extract | 3 teaspoons sugar-free spaghetti seasoning or 3 teaspoons sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 lbs large green sweet potato, peeled, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 1 package fresh moong beans, trimmed and washed
instructions: To make the vermicelli, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in a large heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add the rice vermicelli and cook, stirring once or twice, until golden, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain the vermicelli and transfer it to a bowl. To make the vignoloni, in a small dish, mix 1/4 teaspoon of the anise extract and 1 teaspoon of the sugar free spaghetti seasoning with the vinegar. Dip the vegetable slices in the vignoloni to coat them well and to steam, turning once, for about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,celery,salmon fillet,linguine,pecorino romano cheese,bean thread noodle,mint leaf
title: Smoked Salmon and Noodle Salad for 2
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 4 salmon fillets ( about 175g ) | 200 g dried bean thread noodles | 150 g mixed mushrooms, chopped | 6 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped | pecorino romano cheese | 4 pita bread, triangles, to serve
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the noodles for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Meanwhile, remove the skin from the salmon fillets and set aside. To make the sauce, heat 100ml water in a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat, until the water is boiling. Cook the salmon for about 5 - 2 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Drain and set aside. Cut the salmon in half lengthways and then crossways into chunks. Cook the mushrooms in the water for 4 minutes or until softened. Drain well and roughly chop. Combine the salmon with the linguine, bean threads, mint, pecorino romano cheese, and pita bread triangles and chill until serving time. Divide the pasta salad among serving bowls, top with the salmon, and serve immediately with the toasted pita triangles.

Random Ingredients: red potato,serrano pepper,mustard seed,cilantro leaf,apple,snow pea,chickpea,stewing beef
title: Spicy Indian Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 3/4 lb red potato | 3/4 lb snow peas | 1 small apple, diced | 2 serrano peppers, cut into very thin slice | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f. Rub beef with mustard seeds.

title: Beef
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 3 1/2 cups chicken broth or 3 1/2 cups low sodium chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup stock, approximately
instructions: Place roast into a heavy lidded, non aluminum roasting pan. Pour broth over roast. Turn and coat the meat with the cornflour and mustard seeds. Cover, turn over and place in a pre heated oven of 325f for 2 - 3 hours or until the meat is very tender. Remove the meat from the oven and remove the fat from the pan juices, discarding the solids. Discard the fat. Remove meat from pan and keep warm. Add liquid and cook over high heat until thick. Pour sauce over the meat and serve.

title: Easy Greek Lasagna
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 9 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a skillet over medium heat, cook squash until tender. Sprinkle with cinnamon and soup. Arrange tortillas on a baking sheet, overlapping as necessary. Mix squash mixture and tortillas in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 12 to 14 minutes. Top each serving with a scoop of sour cream and sliced cherry tomatoes.

title: Green Beans in water and with Turmeric
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled green beans ( or baby green beans of your choice ) | 1 lb of cleaned shelled squid or 1 lb small baby calamari | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons of good quality ice water | flour or breadcrumbs
instructions: Soak the fresh green beans for at least one hour. Put all the ingredients in a large pot, including any additional water they'd normally be soaking in, cover and bring to a boil, then simmer until everything is tender. Drain everything and serve immediately.

title: Cape Leaves With Almonds (Dorie Greens)
ingredients: 1/2 lb almond extract | 1/3 cup fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Puree the almond extract in a food processor. Place the coriander leaves in a medium size bowl and add 1 tbsp of puree. Cover with a clean towel and set aside. Wipe your palms with a clean cloth and dry your palm by pressing the coriander leaves into them with a dry cloth. Add this to the bowl with the almond extract and mix well. Take a small piece of almond paste and use this to lightly coat the edges of the leaf using a rolling pin. Sprinkle the leaves lightly with salt and place in a dry towel in a steamer or in a deep glass dish. Steam for 12 - 15 minutes or until the blochon turns a little golden and is limp and dark brown. Take off the steamer or dish, cut into quarters and serve.

title: Easy Bbq Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons guacamole | 1 lettuce leaf ( i 'll use romaine )
instructions: Cut steak across grain into thin pieces. Marinate in dijon and guacamole for as long as possible. Spread on rolls.

title: Vegetable Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package uncooked farfalle pasta | 2 small potatoes - peeled, halved and sliced | 1 carrot, diced | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 1 tablespoon sliced black sesame seeds
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a large colander set in the sink. Mash the potato, carrot, and garlic together in a bowl, and mix with the tahini, sunflower seeds, and black sesame seeds in a small skillet over medium heat. Spread the mashed potato mixture over the pasta and toss to coat with the spread.

title: Quickened Chicken Stock
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable or canola stock | 1 stalk fennel, cut into pieces
instructions: Rinse and destem fennel. Chop fennel. Put all ingredients into a saucepan or stock pot. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,dark soy sauce,broccolini,lemon juice,mango,chili pepper,guacamole
title: Guacamole Broccolini Salad
ingredients: 3 cups broccolini ( small broccoli florets ) | 6 tablespoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 2 drops yellow food coloring | 1/2 small chili pepper, finely minced | 1 mango, peeled seeded and sliced
instructions: Combine the broth, guacamole, soy sauce, lemon juice, yellow food coloring and chili pepper in a large bowl. Stir until well blended. Taste and season with additional sugar if desired. Set aside. Place chopped mango in a serving bowl and top with the broccolini. Pour the guacamole sauce over the top and serve.

title: Simple Slow-Cooked Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chuck roast, cut in 2 to 3 serving size pieces
instructions: Put the roast pieces in the crockpot. Sprinkle them with salt and pepper. Pour tomatoes over the top. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours. Remove the roast to cutting board and let cool. Shred with 2 forks or a fork.

title: Tortellini With Nuts
ingredients: 2 ounces salted tortellini | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 0.|75 can pitted drained capers, packed | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Cook tortellini in boiling salted water until just tender. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup of cooking water. Return to pan over medium heat. Meanwhile, heat chili oil and canola oil until very hot. Add drained pasta, capers, and fenugreek. Stir until heated through. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mace,ancho chile powder,spring onion,lemon peel,raisin,mozzarella cheese
title: Cheese and Chiles Stuffed With Raisins
ingredients: 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 24 even sized chunks | 6 ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons spring onions or 2 tablespoons celery tops | 1 tablespoon light molasses or 1 tablespoon light coconut oil | 2 tablespoons finely diced lemon peel | 1/4 teaspoon mace
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well. Set aside. Place the mozzarella cubes on a greased baking sheet. Sprinkle the mozzarella with the raisins. Bake in a pre heated oven with a turn on if you wish, for about 25 minutes at 200 degrees c. Serve immediately, as an appetizer, or spread on sandwiches.

title: Spanish Oven Potato, Broccoli and Onions Soup
ingredients: 2 spanish onions, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 lbs potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, minced | 5 cups chicken broth | 1/2 lb broccoli rabe, coarsely chopped
instructions: Put onions into a large casserole and put in oven on broil. Put potatoes into the oven. Bake at 400&#8260.

title: Mussels in Tomato Cream
ingredients: 1 dozen mussels | 150 ml grape tomatoes, canned drained | 150 g double cream
instructions: Remove and discard any unopened mussels from the shells. Preheat oven to 230c/450f/gas put mussels in a roasting dish and roast for about 2 minutes per side. Remove the mussels and spread the tomatoes out. Replace the lid and bake for 10 minutes. Stir the cream through the mussels. Replace the lid and bake for 15 minutes or so.

title: Broccoli With Mushrooms, Ouzo and Ouzo
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 8 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 lb white onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 8 star anise
instructions: Toast the dried mushrooms for 1 minute and remove. Rinse the mushrooms under water, dry with paper towel. Add 1/2 cup of the water to a large sauce pan and melt over medium heat. Add the broccoli and onion and cook over medium heat until softened. Add the ouzo and bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 10 mintes or until the ouzo is reduced and the broccoli is tender. Remove from the heat and let cool to room temperature. Place the mushrooms on a large serving dish and spoon the mushroom mixture over the top.

title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 500 g macaroni | 7/8 cup guacamole | 1 cup canned mandarin orange segments | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 400 g fresh straw mushrooms
instructions: Cook macaroni in a large pan until tender. Drain and cool. Combine cooked macaroni, guacamole, mandarin oranges, sherry and mushrooms in a salad bowl. Mix well. Chill before serving.

title: Spicy Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh cheese, sliced thinly | 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 dashes hot sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of salted boiling water according to package. When al dente, add cream of chicken soup to pasta and mix well. Cook 3 to 5 minutes or until warmed thoroughly. Add hot sauce to taste.

title: The Best Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars of your favorite tomato sauce | 1 large chopped onion | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place ingredients into a crockpot and turn on on low. Stir every 2 hours or so and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red potato,baking potato,cinnamon sugar,onion soup mix,hot water,linguine,jumbo shrimp
title: Linguine With Shrimp and Red Potatoes
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs shrimp ( uncooked peeled, about 1/2 pound ) | 1 small onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons water | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar ( or to taste ) | 4 linguine, cooked al dente
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Heat oven to 375 f with rack in middle.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,pinto bean,dark chocolate,chili paste,orange peel,raspberry,vermouth
title: Lime Chocolate Beans
ingredients: 250 g canned pinto beans | 120 ml sweet vermouth | 50 g chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange peel | raspberries, to serve
instructions: Soak the beans overnight then drain. Place the beans in a pan with a layer of water about 2/3 capacity. Add the vermouth and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently for 6 - 8 minutes until the beans are soft and creamy. Meanwhile heat the chinese five spice and dark chocolate together in a small frying pan and stir until completely melted and smooth. Add the orange peel and chilli paste and continue to cook until the chocolate has become dark and smooth. Drain the beans and add them, stirring well to mix. Spoon the mix into a flameproof casserole dish, then scatter over the dried fruit. Heat in an oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the beans start to soften and the fruit browns. Serve with the raspberries to dust.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,chinese egg noodle,vanilla ice cream,gruyere cheese,allspice berry,currant,cardamom seed,irish cream
title: Chikhlor Khiyar (Homemade Irish Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 7 cups vanilla ice cream, softened | 6 tablespoons barbeque sauce, heated | 1 tablespoon dried currants or 1 tablespoon raisins | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 allspice berries | 6 cups fresh chinese egg noodles ( bihon noodles ) | 4 cups grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine the ice cream, barbeque sauce, currants, cardamom and allspice in large bowl. Mix well to combine and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. Bring large pot of water to a boil. Add noodles, cook until tender, drain. Add cheese and stir through. Spoon warm sauce to individual servings.

title: Roasted Brisket for Two
ingredients: 2 pounds turkey bacon, diced | 1 beef brisket | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange turkey bacon slices in a skillet over medium heat. Cook until bacon bits are crisp and lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove from skillet, and cut bacon into 1/3 inch chunks. Arrange brisket slices in a roasting pan, and arrange bacon, cooked bacon, and kosher salt onto the rack in the pan. Pour enough yogurt into the pan to just cover the meat. Cover, and remove from oven. Roast in the preheated oven until the brisket is tender, about 2 hours, adding water as needed to reach halfway up the rack. Remove from heat, and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Chipotle Adobo Nibbles
ingredients: 6 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 teaspoon orange peel | 6 ounces icing sugar or 6 ounces granulated rice flour | 3/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Prepare all ingredients according to package instructions. Place on cookie sheet and allow to dry completely before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Chickpea and Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, drained, liquid reserved | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1 lb boneless pork loin, fat trimmed, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 ounce escarole, rinsed, dried and chopped
instructions: Combine chickpeas, chutney, vinegar and pork in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate. Add escarole and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,pimiento,margarine,beef bouillon granule,curry paste,chinese mushroom
title: Spiced Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces margarine or 2 ounces butter | 5 tablespoons self raising flour | 2 -3 teaspoons curry paste ( i used pataks ) | 1/8 cup chopped dried chinese mushrooms | 1 -2 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 4 ounces chopped pimientos or 4 ounces other vegetables
instructions: Combine flour and curry paste in a bowl, mix well with a wooden spoon. Dissolve bouillon in water and gradually add to mixture. Bring to boil. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add mushrooms, cook for 5 minutes longer or until vegetables are tender. Remove from heat. Mix in pimientos or food colour.

title: Pear, Turnip, Bean Soup(Lengua)
ingredients: 1 small turnip, peeled, halved, and thinly sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons boiling water ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups peeled and finely chopped turnips ( about 2 medium ) | 1/2 cup watercress ( preferably green ) | 6 cups organic chicken stock or 6 cups broth | 2 ripe bananas or 2 firm bananas | 1 can white beans, drained | 1 1/2 - 2 cups torn iceberg lettuce ( more or less to suit ) | 1 -2 pinch salt, to taste
instructions: Place the turnips/watercress in a medium sauce pan with the boiling water and cook until crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: allspice,liquid smoke,fennel seed,chili paste,half,red chili pepper flake,cayenne pepper
title: Jamaican Creamy Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon chili paste with poultry ( see note ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup fat-free cream or 1/2 cup light cream, for thinning and garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.

title: Country Chicken
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons country style hot pork sausage | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut the chicken into slices about 1/4 thick. Heat the griddle or frying pan. Dip the chicken in the sauce before grilling. Cook until cooked.

title: Lobster Cakes A Taste of Havana
ingredients: 10 large lobster tails | 1 sweet brown onion | 1 tablespoon ground ginger ale | 1 tablespoon ground chili paste | 4 sprigs fresh parsley, chopped | sweet guacamole, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Peel the onion and dice it into 1/4 inch coins. Place it between two sheets of waxed paper and pound with the flat side of a meat mallet until coarsely grated. Discard the remaining onion. In a medium size bowl, stir together the ginger ale and chili paste. Sprinkle the grated onion over the ginger ale mixture and mix well. Peel the tail and the tail from the tail on each side and cut each tail tail into 4 equal portions, each portion about 2 inches wide and 4 inches long. Reserve any exposed fat for grilling.

title: Double Chocolate  Spiced Bread (For a Snob or Grill)
ingredients: 1 loaf raisin bread | 1/2 cup good quality chocolate chips | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 3 cloves garlic sourdough bread | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Split the bread in half horizontally. Spread the chocolate chips and lemon juice over each half of the bread. Crush and add the garlic sourdough bread. Sprinkle with cayenne. Grill on low for 5 minutes. Turn to medium. Turn back, cover and let sit for 10 more minutes until bread is dark brown and soft toasted, maybe less.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,head cauliflower,spinach leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray,lentil,tortilla,pistachio nut
title: Lentil and Spinach Wraps
ingredients: 4 ounces lentils, sorted and rinsed | 4 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed & chopped | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package tortillas, flour tortillas | 4 ounces chopped pistachio nuts | 2 tablespoons chopped pimento-stuffed green shallots or 2 tablespoons roasted red bell peppers, drained
instructions: Put 1/2 cup of the lentils into a bowl of water with 1/2 teaspoon salt and let stand until softened, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, pulse the spinach in a food processor until smooth. Put the spinach, remaining lentils, lime juice and olive oil into a serving bowl. Toss with the tortillas and the pistachios. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Arrange the wraps on a plate. Sprinkle with green onion and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,loaf bread,red chili pepper,black olive,yellow onion
title: Soupa Fel Felho y Seda (Spanish Bread Bread Pizzas)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons crushed red chili peppers | 1 teaspoon black olives, sliced ( kalamata are nice ) | 8 slices loaves country bread, cut crosswise
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan. Add the onion, chillies and black olives. Sauté on low heat until the onion has softened. In a medium to large plate, lay out the bread slices and add the onions and chillies. Top with a layer of tomato puree. Drain the bread slices and drizzle with the tomato puree. Enjoy.

title: Solo Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons coffee | 1 -2 tablespoon light golden syrup ( optional ) | 1 ounce vodka | 2 -3 tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 225 degrees f. Cut a deep pocket into the top of the roast. Dissolve coffee in the 1 tb of golden syrup, if using. Push the roast into the pocket of the roast. Rub the remaining 1 - 2 tb of golden syrup into the skin on the roast, and place in a roasting pan. Cover the pan with foil or a lid or other large enough to wrap snugly around it. Put the pan onto a rack in the lower third of the oven and bake at 225 degrees f about 2 1/2 hours, turning every hour. When the internal temperature of the roast reaches 145 or 160 degrees f, check the temperature for doneness. It should be just a little pink all the way through. Remove the roast from the oven, and tent loosely with foil if it will not easily be removed by the tmmps. Put the roast back into the pan and pour the juices back into the pan. Strain the juices into a saucepan. Keep the juices hot until serving but not boiling, if necessary. If you like, you can heat the juices in the pan with the meat and gravy.

Random Ingredients: curd,greek yogurt,artichoke heart,pimiento,sesame seed,flat leaf italian parsley,gruyere cheese
title: Artichoke and Cheese Roulades
ingredients: 2 packages dry curds, chilled | 24 pieces cheese-flavored lindi pimentos | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, finely minced | 2 tablespoons snipped pimiento | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered, chilled ( can also use artichoke hearts with juice added ) | toasted sesame seeds, for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Drain curds through a sieve lined with a paper towel, pressing on curds with paper towels to extract as much moisture as possible from the curds. Line baking sheet with waxed paper and lightly oil waxed paper. Stir curds and cheese flavored lindi pimentos in a medium bowl with yogurt and parsley until well blended. Gently stir pimentos mixture, artichoke hearts, and reserved pimento juice into cheese mixture until well mixed. Turn mixture into a well buttered 10 inch tart pan and place in a larger baking dish to catch any spills of yogurt. Bake for 25 minutes. Sprinkle top of roulades with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,beef broth,paprika,pork tenderloin,egg noodle,yellow bell pepper,italian herb,port wine
title: Beef Tenderloin, Pork & Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup port wine | 1 3/4 teaspoons dried italian herbs | 1 teaspoon paprika | 5 pork tenderloin | 1 large egg noodles, cooked per package directions and drained | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, diced | soft french bread rounds or crackers, if desired
instructions: Combine beef broth, port, italian herb & paprika in a slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Set on high heat setting and cook 2 hours or low heat setting for 6 to 8 hours. Serve with french or crackers if desired and enjoy.

title: Tasty Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cubed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 bulb of garlic, bulb peeled and sliced lengthwise | 2 carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup water | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine pork and taco seasoning mix in large mixing bowl, stirring in garlic, carrots, water and dillweed. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove pork mixture from refrigerator and drain fat. Thread pork onto skewers. Place on grill over medium high heat and grill for 5 - 7 minutes on each side, or until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, brushing with egg after 1 minute. Serve hot.

title: Zwieback and Mint Dressing
ingredients: 7 ounces zwieback toast crumbs | 3 teaspoons sea salt | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped of fresh mint | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the zwieback crumbs, salt, mint, and vinegar. Chill until serving.

title: Quinoa and Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 bag quinoa | 1/2 cup sliced cooked sausage | 4 cups iceberg lettuce ( thinly sliced ) | 3 teaspoons anise
instructions: Boil quinoa according to package directions. Drain and rinse rice well under cold water. Set the quinoa aside and let cool. Place cabbage in a large salad bowl and add diced sausage. Toss lightly. Combine cooled rinsed quinoa and cooled quinoa and toss with the other ingredients. Chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Chinese Steak
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces | 1 green pepper
instructions: Heat large skillet. Place beef in skillet. Cover and cook on medium heat until brown. Add green pepper, cover and cook for 15 minutes or until done. Add seasoned rice & mix well until all rice grains and peppers are covered with rice/pepper mixture. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,lemon zest,apple juice,potato starch,nori,iceberg lettuce,cauliflower,double cream
title: Tropical Mashed Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 cups waxy potatoes or 3 cups waxy potatoes, cooked | 3 cups cauliflower, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup double cream | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup sifted icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 4 sheets nori, seaweed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Combine confectioner's sugar & nori sheets on large serving platter. Spoon potato mixture onto nori, sprinkle with confectioner's sugar using a round bladed knife. Serve immediately, or cover & chill for up to 2 days.

title: Grilled Veggies With Mexican Flavors
ingredients: 4 zucchini | 2 cans white beans | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Wash, peel and slice zucchini into long strips about 1 to 1 1/2 inches wide and 3 inches long. Combine in a bowl the zucchini, white beans, cheese, molasses, lemon juice and zest.

title: Streweed and Root Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs large rutabagas, peeled | 1 cup sultana
instructions: Boil peeled and roots of carrots for about 8 minutes or until just tender in salted water. Drain. Cover and cook on low heat 2 minutes more, or until tender, but still slightly chewy. Mix with sultanas. Enjoy, d.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,steak,alfredo sauce,malt vinegar,pork shoulder roast
title: Roasted Alberta Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder roast | 1 1/4 cups malt vinegar | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups alfredo sauce | 1 package steak, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Place pork roast in a resealable plastic bag, and pour the malt vinegar and vegetable broth into the bag. Seal tightly, and marinate at least 4 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cooked pork roast onto a rack in a roasting pan, and cover tightly with foil. Roast for 1 hour in the preheated oven. Lower the oven temperature to 375 degrees f, and continue to roast, stirring occasionally, until the internal temperature of the meat is 145 degrees f when pierced with a knife, about 2 hours longer. Remove the pork from the oven, and let stand for 10 minutes. Slice and serve with alfredo sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,hamburger bun,beef bouillon,orange juice,peanut oil vegetable,heavy whipping cream
title: Thai Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon ground orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon | 8 ounces lean sirloin steaks ( sandwich-cut, 1 inch thick ) or 8 ounces flank steaks ( sandwich-cut, 1 inch thick ) | 8 hamburger buns, split | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaf, loosely packed
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 teaspoon of the oil over medium high heat until just smoking. Add the orange juice, 3/4 teaspoon of the beef bouillon, and the steak. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Transfer the steak to a plate. Discard any accumulated juices. Return the skillet to medium heat. Add the reserved oil. Add the remaining bouillon cube and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Add the meat. Reduce the heat to medium. Cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until meat is just cooked through, about 4 minutes. Remove skillet from the low heat. Spoon steak onto the toasted bun halves. Spoon the cream on top of the steak and top with cilantro leaves.

Random Ingredients: msg,olive oil,flour tortilla,onion powder,plum tomato,sparkling wine
title: Guasacaca - Guasacaca Style Steak Quesadillas
ingredients: 8 -12 large flour tortillas | 4 teaspoons onion powder or 4 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons oil or 2 teaspoons olive oil | 4 -6 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/8 inch slices or 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes, drained | 1 cup sparkling wine or 1 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( msg )
instructions: Place a single tortilla on a griddle pan with 1 teaspoon onion powder or 1 teaspoon onion powder over medium setting. Flip the tortilla when the edges start crisp, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. Repeat these steps until all the tortillas are grilled. When done, remove from griddle and coat on a kitchen towel. Set aside. Cut 1 tomatoes into 1/16 inch slices or 1 - ½ medium and save the other ingredients. Set aside. Heat up 2 tsp vegetable oil or olive oil in a large nonstick skillet. Place 1 tortilla in the hot oil, turning once, for about 30 seconds on the first side, but not the second side, or 30 seconds on the second side. Remove tortilla to a warm platter. Repeat procedure with remaining tortillas and set aside. Spread 2 tsp of onion powder or 1 tsp onion powder over tortillas. On the platter, spread 2 tsp of oil or olive oil on the left side of all the tortillas. Place 2 tomatoes over the oiled tortillas, pressing the tomatoes down in the center of the tortillas. Spread 1/8 tsp onion powder or 1/8 tsp onion powder over the tomatoes. Add 1/8 tsp of msg or msg and cover tomato and tomato with the remaining 2 tsp of oil or olive oil. Place 4 - 6 slices or 1½ cup of tomatoes over tomato and press down slightly. Place 4 - 6 slices on top of tomato and press down lightly. Place 4 - 6 slices over tomato and press down lightly. Place 4 - 6 slices over tomato and press together. Place 4 - 6 slices over tomato and press down slightly. Continue pressing down and adding slices until all 4 servings are finished. Heat a very heavy 3 to 4 minute frying pan over moderate heat. If using a nonstick skillet, heat about 3 tbsp of oil or olive oil to high. Add the four tomato slices and press down lightly. The tomato slices will turn golden brown when the slices are browned, about 5 minutes, flip and brown the other side. Remove from pan, allow excess oil to drip off, and remove to paper towels to drain. Serve immediately.

title: Hungarian Gherkins (Gherkins on the Stick)
ingredients: 2 large gherkins | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cut the gherkins in half horizontally, and trim off the top and bottom layers. Remove any tough outer peel from inside the gherkins, then finely chop them together in a small bowl or food processor. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a heavy large pot. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups of water to the boil and drop in the chopped gherkins. Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes, or until the gherkins are soft and floating to the top of the water. Turn the gherkins, drain, and squeeze out any excess water. Wrap the gherkins in a clean cloth and tie with kitchen twine. Place gherkins in the hot water, bring to a rapid boil, and cook for 15 minutes. Do not remove the twine. Drain and discard the twine. Sprinkle chopped parsley over the gherkins. Serve immediately.

title: Curried Green Chiles
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh poblano chiles, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cook the poblano chiles in ample boiling water for 5 minutes, or until chiles are completely blanched.

title: Faux Couscous With Anchovies
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked couscous | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons sugar syrup | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste, roasted
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. Heat remaining ingredients over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Place couscous in a serving bowl, pour hot liquids over, and toss to coat. Chill. To serve, stir mixture in bowl.

title: Corned Corned Beef With Cabbage and Oranges
ingredients: 1 large corned beef brisket ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 cans beef stock or ( 15 ounce ) cans broth | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 large rutabaga, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 4 cups ) | 8 cups cabbage, chopped ( about 6 cups ) | 12 ounces plain yogurt or 12 ounces sour cream
instructions: Wash and trim the corned beef of all excess fat. Rinse and pat dry. Slice a lengthwise slit in the meat with a sharp knife. Then put the meat in a roasting pan and add the stock, orange juice, rutabaga and cabbage. Cook at 300 degrees f. For 45 - 50 minutes or until the beef is tender and easily pierced with a fork. Remove the meat and vegetables. In a small bowl mix together yogurt and sour cream until well blended and refrigerate until ready to serve. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pillsbury french bread dough,mint leaf,california avocado,leek,chocolate
title: Schaum Torte (Antipasto Bread Roll-Ups)
ingredients: 1 loaf pillsbury french bread dough | 6 tablespoons melted semisweet chocolate | 1 large ripe hass avocado, peeled and sliced | 4 tablespoons shredded leeks or 4 tablespoons minced scallions ( white parts only ) | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries, halved, plus | 1 tablespoon extra sliced almonds or 1 tablespoon sliced almonds ( optional ) | 12 fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Place bread dough on a cookie sheet that has been lightly brushed with cooking spray. Place dough in oven and let it bake for 20 to 25 minutes until loaf is golden and emits a hollow sound when rapped on the bottom of the bread dough. Turn out onto a flat surface cut into 4 rectangles and brush tops with melted chocolate. Repeat this procedure, transferring bread to a cookie sheet sprinkled with chocolate. Top each torte with sliced avocado, leeks or scallions and cherry halves. Sprinkle with almonds or almonds and drizzle with a small amount of remaining chocolate. Heat in microwave until heated thoroughly. Garnish to taste.

title: Holiday Sausage
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless top round steak, trimmed well | 1 pound top round kielbasa, cut crosswise into 8 slices | 1 pound turnips, peeled and cut into eighths | 1 pound cherries, pitted and halved | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Trim meat. Cut meat in half. Place both halves, cut side up in 2 gallon resealable bags. Cut each into 3 pieces. Stir meat, kielbasa, turnips, cherries, pecans, and orange juice into bag with marinade. Refrigerate 1 to 8 hours, turning bag occasionally. Sauté meat in 2 to 3 tablespoons oil until light brown, turning once. Garnish with walnuts and serve.

title: Mock French Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 ounces cotija cheese | 1 1/2 ounces prosciutto
instructions: Pre heat oven. Line 9 x 5 loaf pan with parchment paper, if using. Combine all ingredients, except ham, in a processor. Turn on and whiz until dough forms a nice ball. If dough seems difficult to mix, add more bread flour until desired dough ballicness is achieved. If mixture seems too dry, add more flour until desired dough ballic texture is achieved. Transfer dough to pan. Using a round baking dish rimmed with parchment or wax paper, press dough into pan, creating a flat base layer. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until lightly browned on top and springy to the touch.

title: Vanilla Mustard
ingredients: 2/3 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig, crushed | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pinch of grated fresh orange rind ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to one week depending on the nature of the mustard. To use, mix a pinch or two of orange rind into 1/4 cup hot dry mustard and add immediately to hot cooked salad. Let cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,self raising flour,baby spinach leaf,chili garlic sauce,fish stock,roast beef,hamburger
title: Sicilian Beef and Spinach Patties
ingredients: 600 g roast beef | 175 g hamburger ( minced ) | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 250 g self-raising flour | 125 g baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( or hot sauce to taste ) | 2 cups fish stock, hot
instructions: Line a 5cm deep, 14cm x 28cm swiss roll tin with baking paper and line with baking beans. Combine the beef, burger and half the golden syrup in a bowl and season to taste. Mix well. Spoon about 2/3 of the mixture into the tin and smooth it out evenly with a fork. Fold in the baby spinach leaves, then roll up the mixture neatly in the tin and trim the ends. Trim any excess overhanging paper and make sure the paper is very well rolled. Make more patties by cutting the pastry and leaving the ends of the pastry on at least diagonal. Carefully ease each pattie into the prepared pan. Repeat with the remaining mixture. Combine the chilli garlic sauce and stock and pour into a jug. Pour over the patties. Cover the pan with foil and bake in the oven for 20 - 45 minutes test that the beef is cooked when you insert a pattie tip the pastry should come off easily with a skewer. Remove the foil and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes to dry the patties. Leave to stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,poblano chile,broccoli,red chili powder,molasses,ricotta cheese,pine nut,anchovy paste
title: Broccoro Del Sol
ingredients: 1 head broccoli ( cut into bite size pieces ) | 3 poblano chiles ( roasted, skinned & roasted, cut in half, seeds removed ) | 3 lbs ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon molasses | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler over high to high. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Put the roasted poblano chilis on a clean, dry towel & rub with the garlic. Place the brocco on the foil on the broiler rack & bake 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly browned. Remove from the oven & set aside. In a large mixing bowl, with an electric mixer, blend the ricotta, cocoa, chile powder, anchovy paste & molasses add the brocco & mix well. Pour the mixture into an 11 by 7 inch baking dish or casserole dish with a tight fitting lid. Place on the upper rack of the broiler & broil 8 to 10 minutes or until the mixture bubbles & starts to brown on top. Sprinkle the toasted pine nuts over the top & continue to broil until browned.

title: Fruited Sweet and Sour Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1 1/4 cups water chestnuts | 1 can sweetened condensed milk ( not skim ) | 16 small frozen meatballs, cut into 1 inch pieces ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup fresh cherries
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, omitting salt.

title: Chilled Potato and Swiss Chard Soup
ingredients: 1 cup rutabagas or 2 cups yellow squash | 1/2 cup corn pepper | 1/2 cup tart apple, chopped | 1 cup sweet potato, diced | 15 ounces greek yogurt | 3 cups macaroni, cooked
instructions: Cook rutabaga and drain. Add other ingredients and cook for an additional 4 hours.

title: Squash and Snow Peas Filled With Indian Flat Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 cup yellow squash, medium diced ( about 8 ounces ) | 3 cups snow peas
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add 1 cup of the squash and snow peas, with 1/4 cup of water. Heat to almost boiling. Remove from heat. Cover, let sit in warm place for 10 minutes. Add additional 1/4 cup water to make 4 cups dough and shape into 4 round loaves. Place on a greased cookie sheet and cover with a clean tea towel. Let rise 1/2 hour until dough is doubled. Brush with egg wash. Cut slits or rounds in tops. Bake for 15 minutes at 400 degrees.

Random Ingredients: spanish paprika,dill,shortening,pineapple,rye flour,self raising flour,red capsicum,vanilla bean
title: Rye-Filled Turkish Loaf
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 150 g shortening | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 2 tablespoons dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthways | 1/2 cup dried pineapple, chopped | 1/2 cup small red capsicum, chopped ( bell pepper ) | 1 teaspoon spanish paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 100°c. Rub the shortening into the flour. Add dill, vanilla bean and pineapple. Stir in capsicum and paprika. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth. Shape into a 30cm x 25cm rectangle. Wrap in greaseproof paper. Place on wire rack and bake in a cool oven for 50 - 60 minutes, or until firm. Slice and serve.

title: Artichoke-Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloin | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare jelly roll pan by greasing. Insert a small piece of pork tenderloin into each piece of pork, being careful not to tear the fat.
