Place coated pork tenderloins in jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated oven 30 to 40 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear. Remove pork from pan and arrange on warmed platter.

title: Maharaja Pie
ingredients: 3 cups urad dal | 3 cups dry sherry | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 baked pie crust
instructions: Rinse the urad dal well several times and drain well. Combine the urad dal well with the dry sherry, ginger garlic paste and some water in a bowl. Place dough on a greased tray and cover with a towel or cloth to prevent drying out. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil and preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Place the mixture into the prepared pie crust and prick the top all over with a fork all over. Prick the top of the pie in 4 places with the tines of a fork. The secret is in using a fork, not a pastry brush, to prevent it from sticking to the pastry. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, then lower heat to 375 degrees f and continue baking for another 25 minutes. Remove from oven and cool completely. Cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,black peppercorn,ghee butter,walnut half,sirloin,jalapeno pepper,walnut,vegetable shortening
title: Lori's Spiced Marinated Stuffed Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, trim, cut about 3/4 to 1 inch of the fat | 1 tablespoon walnut halves | 1/4 cup walnut halves, coarsely chopped | 3/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable shortening or 1/2 teaspoon lard | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, minced
instructions: Marinade and filling. Mix all ingredients together except meat. Tie roast with butcher string so that meat is totally covered and place in fridge for at least 2 hours turning the meat now and then. Grill at high heat, basting roast with marinade for approximately 20 minutes or until a thermometer reads 135 degrees. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: dill,parmesan,goat cheese,iceberg lettuce,almond extract,hoisin sauce,beef chuck,red currant
title: Grilled Beef Sandwich With Goats Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 3/4 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 cubes by 1 1/2-inch intervals | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 12 leaves iceberg lettuce, large stems reserved | 4 slices parmesan or 4 slices fontola cheese, grated | 1/2 cup red currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Whisk together the hoisin and salt and pepper to taste. Add beef and almond extract and toss until coated.

title: Hungarian Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Place rice in rice cooker, or on regular setting. Stir in tomato paste and paprika. Close cooker and press regular or flck to warm through. Serve immediately.

title: Pistachio Farfalle With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie, acchigliette work best ) | 4 ounces pistachios, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil and add a large pinch of salt. Cook the pasta until al dente, and drain. If it's too mushy for your liking, drain it immediately. Transfer the pasta to a large bowl and stir in the remaining ingredients. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: arugula,cooking spray,baking potato,onion soup mix,vanilla pudding,ramen noodle,vinegar
title: Ranch Cottage Kugel
ingredients: cooking spray | 5 cups leftover cooked baking potatoes | 2 1/2 cups instant ramen noodles | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 package frozen chopped arugula | 1 teaspoon vanilla pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the potato's, ramen noodles, onion soup mix, vinegar and dry onion soup mix, in a large bowl. Spread the potato mixture into the bottom of prepared baking dish. Layer the arugula over the soup mixture. Carefully spoon the ramen mixture into the baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the kugel is hot and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,sugar,basil pesto,vanilla extract,heavy whipping cream,cake flour,egg yolk,bamboo shoot
title: Presto Baked Cream Cake
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 1/2 cup sugar ( or use raw sugar ) | 1/4 cup chilled heavy whipping cream ( or milk ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 3/4 teaspoons minced basil pesto | 1/2 cup chopped white chocolate ( optional ) | 1 can sliced bamboo shoot ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sugar ( or use raw sugar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl beat egg yolks with sugar until thick and lemon colored, about 5 minutes. Remove from bowl and discard any remaining white. In a second bowl whip cream until thick and pale, about 4 minutes, then stir in the vanilla until mixture is smooth. Fold the cream into the egg yolk mixture just until incorporated. Stir in pesto and cheese. Pour into a greased and floured 12 inch springform pan. Bake until the center holes are golden brown, about 55 - 65 minutes. Allow the cake to cool and invert onto a cutting board. Remove from the pan and let cool completely before using. To make the glaze, in a large bowl melt chocolate using a small amount of cream until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in remaining cream. Drizzle over warm cake.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,queso fresco,beef,thai chili sauce,oatmeal,green curry paste,radish,spice
title: Thai Beef Balls With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs ground beef | 3/4 cup instant rice vinegar | 1/4 cup thai green curry paste ( to taste, see notes above ) | 1/4 cup oatmeal ( use quick ) | 2 teaspoons spicy thai chili sauce | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon spiced thai chili sauce | 2 tablespoons queso fresco ( cheese for garnish ) or 2 tablespoons monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( cheese for garnish ) | radish, sliced over ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix ground beef with rice vinegar, curry paste and oatmeal. Stir to combine. Form into 1 inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet, cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile, make dipping sauce. In bowl, stir together thai chili sauce, rice vinegar, thai chili sauce and queso fresco. Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes. Arrange meat balls atop dipping sauce. Garnish with radish slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: salad green,white mushroom,juniper berry,cardamom seed,lemon,plain nonfat yogurt,linguine,lemon peel
title: Linguine With Mushrooms(Yogurt)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon grated lemon rind | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon peel | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon verbena leaves or 3 tablespoons fresh lemon verbena | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed or 1 tablespoon crushed cardamom pod | 3/4 lb white mushroom | 8 ounces large white mushrooms, cleaned and halved | 4 -8 cups mixed salad greens, mixed ( spinach, green leaf, baby bok choy, etc ) | crushed juniper berries ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling, salted water according to package directions until al dente. Drain, return linguine back to pot, then add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Turn off heat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,cashew,vegetable oil cooking spray,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Tortilla Cashew Hummus
ingredients: 2 cups grated whole, unblanched unsalted cashews | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix ( dry moroccan spice mix ) | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( garbanzo beans )
instructions: Process or process the cashews in a food processor or mortar to yield 1/3 cup texture. Transfer to a medium bowl and stir in the ras el hanout, chickpeas and spices. Serve at once or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Beer and Whiskey Marinara
ingredients: 1 bulb garlic, cut into thin slivers | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce
instructions: Put garlic into pot of salted boiling water. Let steam for 10 seconds. Drain, rinse under cold water to cool, squeeze dry. Blend or process garlic with enough whiskey to make 1/2 cup. Pour into a bowl and refrigerate. Use marinara sauce to baste chicken slices.

Random Ingredients: baby green,fennel seed,gruyere cheese,white bean,egg yolk
title: French White Beans Früté
ingredients: 14 ounces fresh white beans, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup thinly sliced gruyere cheese | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | baby mixed greens
instructions: Combine the white beans and a dash of sea salt in a saucepan. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 60 minutes. Stir cheese into the bean mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until cheese becomes golden. Stir in egg yolk, fennel and half the greens. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce just begins to thicken, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve with the remaining greens.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,green pea,pork shoulder,pea,chinese rice wine,italian salad dressing,shrimp
title: Cantonese Pork and Shrimp Salad Bowls
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, cut into 3 pieces | 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1/4 cup chinese rice wine | 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing | 1/2 cup frozen white or frozen peas, thawed | 1 pound cooked shrimp, peeled
instructions: Place pork cubes and roma tomatoes in a mixing bowl. Slice three fresh green peas diagonally and add to pork mix. In a separate bowl, mix rice wine and salad dressing. Pour half of dressing mixture into pork mixture, stirring to coat. Stir in frozen and thawed shrimp, mixing well, making sure shrimp are evenly coated. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: 10 hardboiled egg, shelled and quartered | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon sultana | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Divide each ingredient into 3 pieces. Roll the egg quarters in the ketchup mixture and sprinkle with sultanas, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,ginger,habanero chile pepper,parsley flake,ancho chile powder,bacon,chicken bouillon cube
title: Jim T's Killer Quarters
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 1/4 cups dry red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Place bacon in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain off drippings. Add 2 1/4 cups vinegar and all the ancho chile powder, red wine vinegar, bouillon cube, ancho chile powder, parsley flake and remaining 1/4 cup vinegar. Cook 15 - 20 minutes, tossing often.

Random Ingredients: rotelle pasta,roast beef,peanut oil,red capsicum,lime wedge
title: Roast Beef With Yams' Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup rotelle pasta or 1 cup elbow macaroni | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 small red capsicum, diced | 120 g deli sliced roast beef, chopped | 1 lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Meanwhile heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add capsicum and roast beef and cook, stirring regularly for 4 - 5 minutes until heated through. Drain cooked pasta and place in a large bowl. Add the roasted vegetables and drizzle with lime juice. Serve immediately. Serve with a wedge of lime on the side.

title: Sliced Chilies & Ricotta
ingredients: 1 can whole canned anaheim chilies ( or 1-4-1/2 lbs fresh chilies or 1-4-1/2 lbs frozen chilies ) | 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon sugar | tortilla chips
instructions: Drain roasted chilies and set aside. In medium bowl mash chilies and ricotta well with a potato masher or your hands. Add sugar and mix well and set aside. Put drained chilies in blender jar, sprinkle with salt and blend at high for 1 minute until smooth. Put cheese mixture in blender jar that has been drizzled with olive oil/olive oil, and blend until a dough forms. Put a small piece of foil on work surface and put a small handful of filling in each tortilla chip. Roll to form a circle, then fold in sides, then roll to form crescents. Place on baking paper on a baking pan. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes. Serve immediately with salsa and sour cream.

title: Apple and Cream Scones
ingredients: 5 large tart cooking apples, peeled and finely grated | 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large bowl, mix together the grated apples and pastry flour. Add just enough water to bind to a soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly and roll out to cut as desired. You may need to work in additional flour or water if dough becomes too sticky. Cut in half and roll each half into a circle to fit a 12 inch pizza pan as desired. Place on oven rack and bake until light brown, 12 - 15 minutes until browned on the edges and puffy inside. Remove from oven and cut into wedges. Serve warm.

title: Sara's Thai Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 cans baby corn, drained | 425 g canned bamboo shoots | 50 g canned apricots, drained and sliced | 125 g canned baby corn, drained | 1/2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Combine everything except cornflour into a bowl except cornflour, mix quickly together. Slowly add the cornflour and mix well until the dressing comes together. Add the drained baby corn, mix well and then chill for 2 hours before serving with fresh veggies, etc.

title: Dal With French Onions
ingredients: 1 cup french-fried onions | 2 small red chile peppers | 7 ounces urad dal
instructions: Boil the lentils for about 15 minutes stirring frequently, until the lentils are soft. If water level is not clear, add another teaspoon or two of water. Add the french fried onions and chilies, and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Russian-Dill Pecans
ingredients: 2 cups pecan halves | 1 cup fresh dill sprig, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | dill, and additional sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Place nuts in a large dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the skillet occasionally, and cook to a pale golden color, 5 to 8 minutes, stirring frequently. Do not burn, or they will become bitter. Remove to a large bowl and sprinkle nuts with cinnamon and dill weed. Cool. Store in an airtight container. They will keep about 5 days.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,extra virgin olive oil,cremini mushroom,mix,water chestnut,wheat bread,chili flake,coriander
title: Wild Mushroom Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, and | extra virgin olive oil, to saute the mushrooms ( for cooking ) | 6 canned sliced mushrooms, drained ( see directions ) | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms | 8 ounces sweet tart apples, tart, sliced thin ( see directions ) | 1 tablespoon crushed coriander ( use fresh coriander if you're nuts or nuts of your choice ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 can sliced water chestnuts ( reserve liquid ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup prepared low-fat prepared mix | 3 -4 cups toasted wheat bread ( sliced, to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: Brush a lightly greased 8 x8 x2 baking dish with about 2 tbls of the olive oil. Heat 1tbls. Olive oil in a frying pan set on medium high. Add mushrooms and saute 1 minute. Add apples to pan and saute 2 minutes. Remove to plate. Brush pan with remaining oil. Add remaining 2tbls. Olive oil to pan. Add coriander, chili flakes and sliced water chestnuts to pan and saute 2 minutes. Toast bread. Spread half the apples and water chestnuts on toasted sides of baking dish. Spread half the mushrooms and half the other half of apple and water chestnuts on toasted sides of baking dish. Spread half the remaining mushrooms and water Chestnuts on toasted side of baking dish, followed by the rest of the apples and water chestnuts. Spread remaining mushrooms and water chestnuts on toasted side of baking dish. Sprinkle top with toasted, slivered whole wheat bread. Bake for 25 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown on top.

title: Walnut-Spinach (Carciofi)
ingredients: 1 ounce spinach leaves, washed and stemmed | 1 cup walnuts
instructions: If using fresh spinach, remove thick ribbing from stems. Separate leaves lengthwise with scissors. Stack leaves on end of cutting board and cut into slices about 2 inches wide at the widest end, about 1/4 inch thick. Using a sharp knife, cut 2 or 3 slits in center of each slice to allow steam to escape. The sharpest cuts of the knife will be most efficient, leaving a little room for the filling. Place the spinach and walnuts in a heavy skillet with 1 cup water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until spinach has wilted and walnuts are slightly browned and mixture has thickened, about 3 minutes. Drain leaves well and transfer to a serving bowl. Serve immediately or store in fridge up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: yucca root,anaheim chile pepper,beef sirloin steak,romaine lettuce,serrano ham,caraway seed
title: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
ingredients: 2 bunches romaine lettuce | 1 pound beef sirloin steak, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 large anaheim chile peppers, sliced into thin rings | 1 cup diced roma ( plum ) radially-smashed dried new mexico chiles peppers | 1 pinch caraway seeds ( optional ) | 4 slices serrano ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Line the bottom with romaine lettuce leaves. Place sirloin on top of the lettuce leaf, and top with anaheim peppers, roma chilies, and caraway seeds. Layer with more romaine. Cut serrano ham slices into thin strips. Top with a slice of ham and press to adhere the ham.

title: Horse-Bundt Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 3 tablespoons beer | 1 tablespoon haorseradish | 1 tablespoon crushed slivered almonds | 1 lettuce
instructions: Put hamburger in a food processor and grind into 1/4 inch bits. Add all other ingredients and pulse about 3 times. Form into 4 patties. Grill on bbq until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: egg,baking chocolate,rice flour,cremini mushroom,rosemary sprig,phyllo dough,rose petal,jalapeno pepper
title: Portuguese Cigarette Cups
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo dough | 9 ounces firm mild-sweet baking chocolate | 3 ounces sweet baking chocolate | 2 cups finely chopped cremini mushrooms | 6 large eggs | 6 fresh rosemary sprigs | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour | fresh rosemary sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a heat proof bowl set over a pan of steaming water, melt the 3 ounces of chopped bittersweet and sweet baking chocolates with the cremini mushrooms in the microwave stirring every 30 seconds or so for 20 seconds or until the chocolate has completely melted. Beat the eggs lightly in a separate bowl. Add the rosemary and jalapenos to the eggs, add this mixture to the chocolates, and stir well. Remove the phyllo dough from the steamer and cut it in half, lengthwise. Lay the rectangles, one at a time, on a clean board. Spoon a scant 1/4 cup of the filling in each half rectangle, and roll up, jellyroll style. Cut into 1 ounce rolls by making sure its seam is at least 1/4 inch wide. Line the bottom of each small cup with a sheet of wax paper or parchment paper, and set them on top of the wax paper/parchment to prevent drying out for about 15 minutes, or until they are a deep golden color. Fill up the paper lined cups with the same size wrappers. Refrigerate for a least 1 hour. In a nonstick skillet, melt the remaining 2 ounces of bittersweet and sweet baking chocolates with the jalapenos. Carefully place the filled cups on top of the hot chocolate, leaving the air in the pan. Place a few rosemary sprigs in the center of each to make decorative cups. Cook over low heat or in a 300°f oven for about 20 minutes, keeping an eye on the pan so they don't burn.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,penne pasta,tomato sauce,black pepper,garlic salt
title: Easy Cappuccino (Pasta Con Papas Y Ancho)
ingredients: 1 cup dry penne pasta | 1 can tomato sauce, italian-style | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain well. Meanwhile, heat tomato sauce over medium heat in a blender until well blended. Stir in the cocoa powder, garlic salt and pepper. Slowly stir in cooked pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Yogurt Sauerkraut Chicken
ingredients: 600 g sauerkraut, drained | 500 g chicken breast fillets, roughly chopped | 250 g frozen light carrots | 150 g shaved chicken breast fillets | 200 g chopped veal | 1/2 cup low-fat natural yogurt or 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt | 100 g chopped chocolate | 100 ml low fat natural yogurt or 100 ml light greek yogurt | 100 ml sauerkraut, preferably bittersweet and thick
instructions: Preheat oven 160°c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place sauerkraut, chicken, carrot, veal, yogurt and chocolate in a large bowl. Pour over half the yoghurt, and toss to combine. Pour remaining yoghurt over the chicken mixture and toss once or twice more. Spread mixture into the tray and bake in the oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until chicken pieces are cooked through and the sauce is bubbling through. Serve sprinkled with extra yoghurt, chopped chocolate and extra sauerkraut.

Random Ingredients: white flour,peppercorn,black pepper,white bread,mint sprig,jalapeno chilies,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mexican Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups unbleached white flour | 1 1/2 cups whole white bread, crusts removed | 1 cup finely chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 4 fresh jalapeno chilies, stemmed seeded finely chopped | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon finely ground peppercorn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f/180°c. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Toast the bread, about 5 minutes, on the highest rack. Let cool slightly and cut into 12 slices, working from stem to bottom, cutting to fit a 10 x 12 inch bread slice. Spoon the mint sprigs and jalapenos over the top and spread evenly. To make the marinade, combine the flour, bread, mint, chiles and olive oil in a non reactive bowl. Shake until all the ingredients are evenly combined. Gently stir in the peppercorns. Spread on the bread, top with remaining bread slices, and cut on the diagonal. Place on prepared baking sheet and bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes. You may serve the bread hot or cold, drizzled with warm olive oil or marinade. The bread may be served warm, room temperature or cooled and stored for up to 2 days.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning Salt (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili ( new mexico or new mexico red enchiladas ) | 1 tablespoon mrs.| dash seasoning
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except for the mexican cheese. Place a damp cloth or paper towel on the rim of a crock pot. Sprinkle mexican cheese over the cheese. Put the crock pot into the oven, and set for low heat setting or over low heat setting for 9 to 10 hours. Do not remove the lid until the liquid is absorbed, or the cooking liquid may not be enough.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,annatto seed,marinara sauce,turmeric powder,bell pepper,mirin,cayenne,bean sprout
title: Quick and Easy Sweet-Sour Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons annatto seeds ( small black sprouts ) | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup bean sprouts ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons mayonnaise ( miracle whip preferred ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup marinara sauce | 2 cups whipping cream
instructions: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat, add annatto seeds. Toss for about 1 minute, taking care not to burn. Add bell pepper and bean sprouts to pan.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,bay leaf,shiitake mushroom,margarine,alfredo sauce,almond extract,garam masala
title: Zucchini Alfredo
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, trimmed and sliced | 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup sliced shiitake mushroom | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Saute zucchini in margarine, almond extract and bay leaf until golden. Stir fry until zucchini is tender. Remove from skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, saute mushrooms until warm. Stir in zucchini and sauce until heated through. Stir in garam masala.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,seasoning salt,baby lima bean,mandarin orange,cottage cheese,bay seasoning,bacon
title: Lima Beans & Cottage Cheese Rigatoni
ingredients: 1/4 lb bacon, cut into 1/4 inch pieces, i use a lean one cut in 1/4 inch pieces but not too thin | 2 lbs small baby lima beans or 2 lbs small romano beans, soaked overnight in warm water | 1 head bacon, diced | 1 can mandarin oranges | 16 ounces small cottage cheese | 2 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons old bay seasoning | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked according to box
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp, crumble, remove from pan and set aside. Saute lima and bacon in bacon fat. Add mandarin oranges, seasonings, and cottage cheese to skillet. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Add pasta and simmer until pasta is cooked and sauce has thickened somewhat and flavors mixed.

title: Waldorf Style Green Beans
ingredients: 1 pound frozen broad beans, thawed | 2 leeks | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained, divided | 1 pound ground meat | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed | 1/2 can or bottle beer
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the thawed broad beans, and cook until tender but still a little crisp, about 5 minutes. Rinse with cold water to soak, and drain again. Place the leeks in a saucepan, and cook over medium low heat, stirring frequently, until transparent, 10 to15 minutes. Add the leeks to the drained broad beans, and stir in the 1 tablespoon of cherry liquor, the meat, and 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: leek,kosher salt black pepper,hamburger bun,wheat flour
title: Leek and Bread Crust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus extra pinch salt ( for crust ) | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1 large leek, white and light green parts only, sliced | 1 lb hamburger bun
instructions: Sprinkle the leek with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Preheat your grill to high. On a rimmed baking sheet, spread the flour on a large piece of plastic wrap, pressing down on the seaoning in the bag to release the air beneath. Shake your hands so the flour doesn't break into clumps. Spread the salt onto the leek and put in your hand. With your fingers, stretch the flour from the bag onto the leek. Slice the meat into thin slices, and sprinkle the slices with salt. Starting at the short side of the bag, roll the meat up like a jelly roll. Put the rolled meat on the grill and grill, turning once, until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees and the meat is dry. Slice the meat and serve with your favorite condiments. Store in a ziplock bag in the fridge up to 2 days.

title: Golden Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 yellow squash, grated | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Mix the oil and squash together. Pour over salad and top with whipped cream or sour cream as desired.

title: Cashew and Sun Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cashew nuts | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( i use soy sauce ) | 8 tablespoons low fat natural yogurt ( i prefer greek ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place cashews in a medium sized skillet. Using a wooden spoons or a food process spice grinder blade pulse the nuts until the nuts are finely ground. In a medium bowl, mix all the ingredients together except the cheese until just combined. Scrape into a small serving bowl and add the cheese and toss through carefully. Serve with toasted crusty bread, crackers, vegetables or as a topping for grilled meat, etc. If you would like to make up more, make a double batch just for yourself.

title: Charishma's Raitha Balsamic Scented Raisins
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons of your favourite balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together, and store in an airtight bottle in the fridge for up to 1 week.

title: Spanish Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears fresh sweetcorn or 4 ears fresh pumpkin, cut from the cob ( 4 cups ) | 4 roma tomatoes | 4 -5 tablespoons orange juice | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Combine mustard seeds with a small amount of orange juice, sprinkle on both sides of corn and corn, and grill, turning, until lightly toasted and blackened. If more seeds appear, add 1 - 2 teaspoons liquid, or more orange juice if desired. Cut the rind off the tomatoes, and cut all the flesh in half crosswise. Place in an oven safe bowl, and add the mustard seed mixture. Place on a grill over a very hot coals, or underneath the grill to the desired consistency. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: peach schnapps,beef stew meat,splenda sugar substitute
title: Peach Bourbon Glaze
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches into schnapps, undrained | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 3 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,bulb garlic,caster sugar,arborio rice,sauce,sauerkraut,cherry tomato,ice water
title: Baked Rice and Arugal Greens
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 bulb of garlic, sliced | 400 g frozen sauerkraut, thawed | 425 g canned whole blanched cherries in tomato sauce | 4 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup torn basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c and place the rice in a pan and pour over boiling water. Cover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until cooked. Meanwhile heat your oven to 200 degrees c and cook the garlic for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and leave to cool. Drain the sauerkraut well and press through a sieve. Tip the sauerkraut, garlic and cherry tomatoes into a roasting pan, discarding any excess juice. Pour over the hot sauce. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until warmed through and the cheese is lightly browned and bubbling. Remove from the oven and stir the chopped basil into the rice, then place on a serving plate and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baker yeast,anise seed,oil,turmeric powder,sesame seed,onion powder
title: Moroccan Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup oil | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 teaspoons baking yeast | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons ground anise or 2 teaspoons anise seed | 2 teaspoons ground sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bread maker in the order listed. Process on the french bread setting cycle, when cycle is complete turn out onto a greased and floured loaf pan or cake pan. Cover loosely and let sit for 20 minutes. Bake at 400 for 25 - 30 minutes. Turn out into a loaf pan and cool.

title: Pear Shooters
ingredients: 3 pears, peeled, cored and diced | 1 jar frozen peas and carrots, in the bag thawed | 1/3 cup triple sec | 4 cups rice krispies
instructions: Boil the pear and peas together for 10 minutes. Drain. Puree the mixture in batches in blender until smooth. Put the rice krispies in a medium sized bowl and mix in the pear puree. Fill into a reamekin or glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Keep in the fridge at least 3 days before using, but can be kept for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,horseradish,cumin powder,double cream,apple cider vinegar,roasting chicken,strawberry,plain flour
title: Chicken, Strawberry and Apple Smoked Horseradish Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs roasting chickens, cut into serving portions | 6 ounces plain flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 pint double cream | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 4 ounces smoked hamburger | 2 ounces strawberries, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the chicken pieces on a rack in an ovenproof dish. Combine the seasoned flour and cumin powder in a plastic bag. Add in the cream and honey and shake to mix. Pour over the chicken and bake for 40 - 50 minutes, or until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickened. Transfer the chicken, cut side down, to a board and slice thinly. Arrange the chicken on a warmed dinner plate and top with the ham and strawberries. Make toasts with your favourite mustard and serve with horseradish sauce.

title: Couscous Salad with Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 1/2 cups water, lukewarm | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 3/4 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1 cup cubed cooked salmon | 7 1/2 ounces sliced watermelon | 1 can sliced green olives ( i omit if i can find them )
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and set aside. Stir in fennel seeds and curry paste until well mixed. Heat water in a saucepan over medium heat until it boils. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside for 5 minutes. Stir in watermelon and salmon. Pour hot couscous onto the mixture, and toss lightly to coat evenly. Top with green olives and/or green olives. Serve.

title: My Nikomi Udon (Japanese Noodles)
ingredients: 8 1/2 ounces egg noodles | 2/3 fluid ounce sake | 1 can fruit cocktail, drained | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Pour boiling water over noodles in a large pot. Let sit 10 minutes, then drain. Pour sake over noodles and let stand 5 more minutes. In a large serving bowl combine the fruit cocktail and kalamata olives. Toss with noodles, season with salt and serve.

title: Balsamic Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a glass pie plate or deep mixing bowl combine the vinegar, mace and canola oil. Add the dry potatoes and toss to coat evenly. Pour the mixture into a medium sized baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes. Turn and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Pour the ranch dressing over the potatoes and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes then serve.

title: Italian Drunken Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lump crabmeat, picked over for shells | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Mix crabmeat and italian seasoning in medium size bowl. Divide into 3 portions. Roll each into 1 inch balls. Roll in remaining coating. Gently press balls to flatten a little. Place on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: sorghum flour,breakfast sausage,boston lettuce,mint,icing sugar,guajillo chilies,italian bread crumb,tortilla chip
title: Mint and Sage Sausage Nachos
ingredients: 1 pound breakfast sausage | 6 fresh guajillo chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint | 1 tablespoon orghum fait flour | sifted italian seasoned bread crumbs | 8 tortilla chips, or as needed ( optional ) | 1 bunch fresh italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook sausage in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Drain, remove sausage to cool, and slice into 1/2 inch pieces. Place chiles, 1 tablespoon chopped mint, and orghum fait flour in a bowl with 2 tablespoons chopped Italian bread crumbs and 1/2 cup icing sugar, mix well. Place 1 tortilla in a skillet on medium high heat, sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the seasoned crumbs. Top with 2 tablespoons of sausage and 2 tablespoons of italian bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons of italian bread crumbs. Repeat until tortilla is filled and toasted. Spoon more crumbs on top of sausage before breaking apart with your hands, and top with more crumbs. Repeat with remaining tortillas and sausages. Bake nachos in the preheated oven, turning once, until lightly browned and crispy, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,poblano chile,white peppercorn,rice noodle,sage leaf,fine sugar
title: Noodles With Chiles and Sage
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs firm pomegranate-flavored rice noodles, broken up | 2 ounces dried white peppercorns | 10 fresh sage leaves | 6 large fresh sage leaves | 4 toasted firm-ripe poblano chiles | 1/2 cup fine sugar | 1 lb fresh bamboo skewer
instructions: In a bowl, soak the noodles in hot water to cover for 30 minutes. Drain well and spread out on dry sheets of waxed paper to dry. In a small, dry skillet, bring 2 1/2 cups of water to a boil. Add the noodles and the peppercorns. Return to a boil and stir with a wire wisk. Cook, stirring, for 4 - 5 minutes. Drain the noodles. Add the sage leaves and chilies to the noodles and set aside. Place a bamboo skewer in a large bamboo steamer. Add 1/4 cup of the sugar to the water in the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then boil for a minute or less. Dip wooden or bamboo skewers into the hot sugar and move them off the skewers. Place remaining sugar in a small, heavy nonstick skillet. Cook over medium low heat until the sugar has melted, about 5 minutes. Place the soaked noodles in the skillet and stir to coat. Serve the noodles with the sauteed sugar, sage leaf and chilies. Enjoy.

title: Turnips (Tourtiere)
ingredients: 2 cups turnips, diced ( or rutabagas ) | 1/2 teaspoon savory ( optional or add 1/2 tsp.| fresh savory )
instructions: Sprinkle with savory, or add 1/2 tsp. Fresh savory or 1/2 tsp. Sourdough bread crumbs, if using dry. Let sit 10 minutes to draw moisture out of the onion, and remove any bitterness.

title: Veal and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cubed | hot water ( enough to cover the veal ) | 1 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 cups wine ( dry, nonalcoholic )
instructions: Cover the veal in hot water. Let stand 10 minutes. Boil the veal cubes until cooked through. Return to broth and add undrained baked beans, wine and majoram. Heat to simmering.

title: Green Chili Peppers and Spinach
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach | 125 g pecans, lightly toasted and coarsely chopped | 200 g green chili peppers, chopped | 2 teaspoons arrowroot powder
instructions: Place the chopped green chilli pepper, chopped pecans and arrowroot powder in a large bowl. Toss with the salad leaves to coat and add to the dressing. Toss well to combine.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,black olive,green chili,black bean,red pepper flake,rye flour,bay leaf
title: Rye Black Beans with Black Olives
ingredients: 1/4 cup black beans ( rinsed and picked over, washed thoroughly, and drained ) | 2 -3 tablespoons green chili ( or more to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili paste ( to taste ) or 1 -2 tablespoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried yeast ( optional ) | 2 bay leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 cup rye flour ( optional ) or 1/4 cup gluten-free cornmeal ( optional )
instructions: Warm oil in a pan. Combine beans, green chilies, chili paste, crushed red pepper, and dried yeast. Stir in a few tablespoons of the soaking bean liquid.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,angostura bitter,molasses,strawberry,garlic clove,oregano leaf,turkey sausage
title: Sweet and Sour Breakfast (With or Without Meatballs or Eggs)
ingredients: 500 g sweet turkey sausage, sliced | 20 g dried oregano leaves | 30 g dried basil | 10 g garlic cloves, sliced | 150 g strawberries | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 600 ml light molasses
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1cm cubes. Drain the sage leaves and basil. Slice the garlic slices into halves, discarding the centre stem. Place in a small pan and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and stir over low heat for another 5 minutes, being careful not to scorch. Stir in the sugar and molasses, then remove from the heat. While waiting for the sausage to soften, carefully roll out a small amount of sausage into a circle of 4cm diameter. Roll up each sausage slice, keeping the sausage in one piece, and cut into quarters. Serve with freshly picked hot vinegar and extra marmalade.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,yukon gold potato,lime cream,oatmeal,red currant jelly,baby spinach,shrimp paste,cauliflower
title: Shrimp and Potato Crumble
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes | 14 ounces tiny broccoli florets, cut into 1-inch lengths | 1 cup baby spinach, cleaned and de-stemmed | 1 cup cauliflower, separated into small florets | 4 ounces shrimp paste | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 cup old fashioned oats | 1 tablespoon lime cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the potatoes are tender. Set aside and let cool enough to handle. Remove and set aside. In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook the florets 5 minutes. Drain and reserve. Cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch squares. Steam the broccoli and spinach for 2 to 3 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain the broccoli and spinach, transfer to a bowl and mash, then stir into the mashed potatoes. Transfer the mixture to a large dish. Stir in the cauliflower and spinach, then fold in the shrimp paste. Mix the bread crumbs, oats, and lime cream and toss until thoroughly combined. Sprinkle over the top of the potato mixture and bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until light brown.

title: Chicken Alpas
ingredients: 2 cans chicken breasts, in broth | 2 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 1/4 cup dry red pepper, cubed | 1/2 cup wine, saignon blanc or 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to place almond in a shallow pan and bake 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Place chicken on a rack in a baking dish. Cover chicken with broth. Bake 20 minutes, basting occasionally. Combine the slivered almonds and red pepper in a shallow bowl and add to chicken. Bake at 375°f for 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Combine the wine and remaining broth. Pour over chicken. Bake, basting frequently with broth, for 15 minutes, or until chicken is tender and almonds are lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: lentil,gorgonzola,pork tenderloin,tart apple,shallot,extra virgin olive oil
title: Gorgonzola Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lean pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup minced shallot | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup dried lentils | 6 fresh tart apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb gorgonzola, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a medium bowl, mix together pork, shallots and 1/4 cup olive oil.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,sun tomato oil,italian salad dressing,rice wine,white bread,chicken bouillon,caper
title: Carnivian's Rice-Covered Sticky Italian Girlfinger Sandwiches
ingredients: 16 low-fat ladyfingers ( each 2 or 3 ladyfingers, room temperature ) | 2 slices country white bread | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons chicken flavored instant chicken bouillon | 1/3 cup light salad dressing or 1/3 cup italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Cut 2 - 12 inch long sections from a loaf of bread, about 1/2 inch thick. Place bread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Using a spoon, scoop out bread from 1/4 inch thick walls of bread, letting any excess bread soak into the bowl then flatten to a 3 inch x2 inch rectangle. Spread each ladyfinger with 1 teaspoon of tomato oil, 2 tablespoons capers, bouillon and 2 tablespoons salad dressing. Starting at one end of bread rectangle, place a ladyfinger seam side down on the tomato jelly mixture. Beginning at the narrow end of the bread rectangle, place a second bread rectangle on top. Repeat with remaining ladyfingers and tomato mixture. Cut sandwich diagonally into 12 slices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,baby carrot,corn tortilla chip,parsley,bisquick,russet potato
title: Confetti Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 12 small russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 -2 lb baby carrots, sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups crispy corn tortilla chips | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup piccalato | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 sprig fresh parsley
instructions: Pierce potatoes with a fork.

title: Prawn Noodles (Shrimp)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 whole scotch bonnet pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 cup light coconut bean sprouts | 6 ounces uncooked fresh medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Blend peanut butter, flour and half of scotch bonnet pepper in blender. Add rest of scotch bonnet pepper, water, and mirin.

title: Sponge Pasta With Grilled Scallops
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 1 lb sea scallops | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Cook scallops in boiling salted water until they are crisp and firm. Drain. Drain and rinse ziti under cold water and drain. Toss w shrimp and scallops well. Pour yogurt into a resealable plastic bag and snip off corner with a knife. Place shrimp on top and refrigerate 2 hours. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, but is still slightly firm. Drain and toss w scallops and pasta well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,clear honey,vodka,mozzarella cheese,puff pastry,tomatillo,egg white
title: Tomatillo Pizza Appetizers
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry ( thawed overnight ) | 3 tomatillos ( quartered lengthwise, seeded ) | 1 egg white ( beaten ) | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup clear honey | 2 teaspoons vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat a cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Unfold pastry on a lightly floured surface. With a rolling pin, gently press down pastry to form a 10 inch 12 inch circle. Transfer to prepared cookie sheet, trim side of edges. Using a sharp serrated knife, slice through top of rolled pastry into 36 even pieces to form 12 evenly spaced 6 inch rounds. Transfer pieces to prepared cookie sheet. Using a fork, prick tomatillos in 1/4 inch pattern and top each tomatillo with a second tomatillo. Brush lightly with egg white and lightly sprinkle with pesto. Place on cookie sheet and bake in middle of preheated oven for 12 - 18 minutes, or until slightly browned. Remove from oven and top each tomatillo with 1/4 cup grated mozzarella and 1/4 cup grated orange rind. Continue baking for 9 minutes or until cheese is melted and tomatillo is lightly browned. Combine honey, vodka and 2 tbsp water and pour over pizzas. Return to oven and bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until heated through. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Baked Mushroom and Potato Bake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs, divided | 1 lb sliced fresh mushrooms ( can be frozen, thawed ) | 1 lb thinly sliced raw squash | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom, sliced | 1/2 lb yukon gold potato ( i used red potato ) or 1/2 lb white pearl onion, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices ( i used red potato )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a 2 cup casserole dish with cooking spray. Melt half the bread crumbs in a bowl and set aside. Arrange mushrooms and squash in casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs. In a bowl, combine broth and reserved bread crumbs. Pour over ingredients in casserole dish. Cover tightly and bake 40 - 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove cover for last 15 minutes, stir.

title: Homemade Whole Wheat
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 bay leaf | 4 slices whole wheat bread, cut into crumbs
instructions: Boil the apple juice, vegetable broth and bay leaf in a small saucepan until reduced to only 1 cup. Place bread crumbs in a shallow baking dish. Pour the reduced liquid over the bread and toss until bread is well coated. Turn oven to broil and toast bread until golden brown.

title: Mexican Beer Can Mussels
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs mussels, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/8 teaspoon sweet paprika, plus more as needed | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups canned red enchilada sauce | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, trimmed, coarsely shredded
instructions: Wipe your mussels with a damp paper towel and remove the eyes and grit from under the shell. Set the mussels aside and, if they are really large, cut them in half lengthwise, discard the top shells. Rinse in several changes of water with cold water. Cut off and discard the tip and devein the mussels. Pat them dry with paper towels, then place them in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside in the refrigerator. In a 12 saute pan over medium heat, warm the oil and add the mussels. Cook for 2 minutes, turn and continue cooking for about 1 minute. Scratch out of the shells with a wooden spoon, remove the shell and set aside. Drain the mussels and discard the broth. In a bowl, toss the mussels with lettuce, enchilada sauce and any remaining broth from the shells. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,papaya,guacamole,dark brown sugar,beef tenderloin,peanut oil corn,bread crumb,rotisserie chicken
title: Grilled Chicken with Crab-Wrapped Papaya
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 1/2 - 2 cups seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 24 slices papayas | 24 -36 slices refrigerated grilled or to taste cooked lobster meat | 24 thin slices precooked crabmeat | 12 thin slices rotisserie chicken, such as halibut or 12 chicken wings | peanut oil or corn oil, for brushing
instructions: Soak 12 bamboo skewers in a bowl of water for at least 30 minutes. In another small bowl, combine bread crumbs and brown sugar. Slice tenderloin into 1 1/4 inches thick slices. Pat bread crumbs into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Lay the slices out on a board and spread a thin layer of sugar crumb mixture into the entire surface. Cover breaded bread slices with papaya slices. Dampen the edge of the strips with water and fold them over to form a triangle shape. Repeat with remaining slices until all have been used up. Brush with cooking spray or water and sprinkle papaya lightly with bread crumb mixture. Prepare grill for direct heat or preheat a charcoal grill for direct heat on high. Lightly oil the grilling surface. Using tongs carefully place the fish in direct heat and grill 1 1/2 minutes per side, until just cooked through. Turn and continue to grill until fish flakes easily and breadcrumbs are lightly browned. Use tongs to keep fish from sticking to your hands when turning. Place grilled or baked papaya onto a flat, metal platter. Remove excess fat from grill and place papaya, cut side down, on top of the papaya. Arrange slices of lobster over the lobster. Drain shrimp and add to the platter. Cover with grilled crab or chicken wings. Drizzle with oil and serve at once.

title: Beef, Turnip and Potato Skewers
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes ( about 1 kilogram, peeled ) | 500 g turnips, peeled | 2 slices ginger | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 4 kaiser rolls
instructions: Cook potatoes and turnips with ginger until tender. Cool slightly and cut into chunks. Peel turnips and cut into chunks. Combine half the pickling suace with the vinegar until well combined. Pour this over the vegetables and gently mix gently until all the ingredients are well coated in the suace. Set to one side. Thread the turnip on to 12 bamboo skewers that have been soaked in water for 2 hours and soaked overnight in a humid oven. Grill over high heat for 7 - 10 minutes until the turnips are charred and crisp, turning from time to time until charred all over. Serve with the reserved suace if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,vanilla essence,italian tomato,chicken bouillon cube
title: Easy Tomato and Basil Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 can chopped italian tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat oil/butter in sauce pan. Add 1/2 can of tomatoes and one soup can of sliced tomatoes. When it comes to a boil add veg stock. Add chopped vegrot and vanilla essence. Boil for 20mins add salt and pepper if needed. You can use a food processor to pureree it. If you do, add crushed garlic, cream cheese or pure vanilla extract before boiling or other ingredients. Enjoy.

title: Basic Egg Tortellini With Basil & Basil
ingredients: 4 eggs | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil leaves | 3/4 cup chopped fresh italian cheese blend
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. In a small bowl beat together eggs, basil, and italian cheese using a fork. Reduce heat to low and pour mixture into a 9 inch springform pan. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place pan in oven and bake for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f and bake for an additional 45 minutes. If you want to be really fancy, after removing from oven, top with lots of extra italian cheese and bake until set, about 2 to 3 minutes. Let sit for a couple of minutes, cut into wedges and transfer wedges to a plate. The tortellini will keep for up to a week in the refrigerator.

title: Thai Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh cilantro | 3 cloves garlic, chopped | 1/2 cup peanut butter, smooth
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cilantro, garlic and peanut butter. Place the chicken breasts into the peanut butter mixture. Marinate chicken in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Preheat the grill for high heat. Remove chicken from skewers and cook on the grill until no longer pink inside. The cooked chicken will cook much faster than the packaged. Serve the chicken with sauce on the side.

title: Cucumber Soup-Soup
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber ( or other cucumber ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 can beef stock | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped
instructions: Peel the cucumber of its own without removing the peel or the outer layer of the stalk and cut away the seeds using kitchen shears. Cut the cucumbers into 1/4 slices along the length and width of the long side. Cut the cucumber into thin strips about the size of the prawns or if you prefer, you can leave the skin on because the prawns will give you that extra flavor. Heat the vinegar until all the vinegar has been absorbed and add the prawns. Keep turning till prawns are opaque. The soup should just cover the prawns. If the soup starts boiling, add the prawns. If it doesn't, cook for a few more minutes. If soup does, add more vinegar and keep cooking. The cucumber will then be very soft. Stir in the hot soup, making sure it is hot before eating. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Simple Vegetable Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 600 g chopped raw peanuts ( or ground ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Make sure the pieces are well coated with the marinade. Thread on to metal skewers. Grill or broil until lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,carrot,dill,yogurt,greek yogurt,white creme de cacao,dark chili powder
title: Spicy Carrot & Creamy Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup carrot, coarsely grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1/3 cup white creme de cacao | 1/3 cup fat-free greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon lemonade | 1/2 teaspoon hot dark chili powder | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, minced ( not dried )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients with whisk.

Random Ingredients: salsa,cardamom pod,red chili pepper,orange peel,oregano,dark soy sauce
title: Marinated Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 cup salsa | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 large cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 red chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve with tortilla chips, crackers, or as an accompaniment to meat or vegetables.

title:
St.
    - Patrick's Day Chocloaf
ingredients: 500 g green beans, trimmed and halved | 500 g parsnips, trimmed and halved lengthways | 100 ml double cream, warmed up
instructions: Place the beans, parsnips and cream in a greased and lined 2lb loaf tin. Bake in a slow oven for 1 - ¾ hours or until tender when tested with a skewer. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before turning onto serving platter with a sharp knife. Serve with fresh bread.

title: Irish Cream Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups teriyaki sauce ( bottled ) | 2 teaspoons dry tarragon | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce, tarragon, gingerroot and irish cream. Chill until ready to use.

title: Pressed hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | cooking spray
instructions: Brown hamburger. Spray with cooking spray. Brown hamburger lightly and cook 3 minutes. Place cut up hamburgie in a 9x13 pan or baking dish that has been sprayed with pam. Cover with foil. Bake in 350f degree oven 15 to 20 minutes or according to your hamburger recipe.

Random Ingredients: spice,apple jelly,sauce,beef bouillon cube,buttermilk,green bell pepper,apple cider
title: Dynamite-Spice Beef Sauce
ingredients: 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dried mixed spice | 3 tablespoons apple jelly | 1 cup buttermilk, at room temp | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 cup green bell peppers or 1 cup red bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 can apple cider
instructions: Dissolve beef bouillon in buttermilk. Stir in jelly, hot sauce, bell peppers, apple cider and spices. Refrigerate up to 3 days, stirring occasionally. Let the sauce sit at room temperature if it is in season for 3 days. You don't want to go to next, ya?.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,orange juice,penne,sherry wine,red pepper flake,leek
title: Seared Macaroni With Pecorino & Caramelized Leeks
ingredients: 16 ounces penne, dry | 1 small leek, white and green parts separated and thinly sliced | 1 cup low-fat pecorino cheese, coarsely grated | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup orange juice | crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large skillet, cook leek in hot drippings over medium heat for two minutes or until beginning to soften. Add penne and stir to coat. Stir in 1/2 cup cheese. Stir in sherry and orange juice. Season with crushed red pepper. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili pepper,spring onion,bread flour,vanilla,chili oil,green olive,spinach
title: Spinach-Stuffed Green Olives
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh spinach, cleaned
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f degrees. Cook the spinach until just wilted. Transfer spinach to a bowl. Squeeze out excess water. Set aside. Remove the stems from the spinach and finely chop. Combine the spinach with all of the other ingredients except the olives in a mixing bowl. Knead with your hands until well mixed. Spoon the mixture into two 9x5 loaf pans. Bake for 45 minute. Cool.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,sherry wine vinegar,cherry tomato,green bell pepper
title: Soy Sauce Lasagna
ingredients: 8 fresh lasagna noodles, broken in half | 10 cherry tomatoes | 1 green bell pepper | 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the broken noodles in a pot of lightly salted boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain. Arrange a single layer of uncooked noodles in the prepared baking dish. Place a layer of sliced cherry tomatoes on top of noodles.

title: Easy Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 can fire-roasted diced tomatoes, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Heat a large cast iron pan on medium high heat and cook the meat for 5 minutes, until well browned. Pour in the salsa and top with the diced tomatoes.

title: Sopa De Fuba (Brazilian Farmer's Bean Soup)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 1/2 kg farmer cheese ( farmers cheese ) | 6 cans cannellini beans, drained ( i prefer cannellini beans, drain well if canned, but if fresh beans are used they may need a little extra.| ) | 2 bottles belgian-style beer ( baibacardi or hoegaarden are good brands )
instructions: Filling, in a frying pan, heat the ghee over medium heat and add the farmer's cheese, breaking it up with it's wooden spoon. When the cheese is browned, remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Add the undrained cannelloni beans and drained beer and heat through. Serve warm with freshly made breads. Note, if you can afford to do this, make each bean separately.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,lime juice,baking powder,apricot jam,red potato,white wine vinegar
title: Lime and Onion Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa ( about 1 cup packed ) | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot jam ( more or less to taste ) or 1/4 cup apricot preserves ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 4 small red potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4- to 1/2-inch strips | 1/2 lime, juice and rind of, divided | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large salad bowl toss together the quinoa and 1/4 cup jam. Sprinkle with baking powder. Add the potatoes, remaining 1/4 cup jam, and 1/4 cup water. Toss lightly with the vinegar. Add in the lime rind and juice, mix gently. Serve with remaining 1/2 cup jam or preserves and/or sliced ripe fruit. Note, more or less lemon and lime juice can be added to taste, or just use a bit of the vinegar.

title: Blueberry, Corn, Corn and Pineapple Raita
ingredients: 1 can chopped fresh pineapple with juice | 2 cups fresh pineapple slices, with their peels removed | 3/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 cup drained water-packed blueberries | 1/2 cup frozen cooked corn | 1/4 cup pure corn | 1/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Pineapple raita, in a blender combine the first 7 ingredients. Blend until smooth. Stir in the corn and half and half. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Serve.

title: Tahini (Honey-Infused Oil)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup of fresh mint sprig | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients to make a thick, shaggy sauce.

title: Crock Pot French Fries
ingredients: 6 -8 large potatoes, peeled | 1 can cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 3 celery ribs, cut tops off ( optional )
instructions: Put the potatoes into the crock pot, add the cherry tomatoes, seasoning mix and coffee powder then stir. Do not stir until potatoes are cooked. Add celery if desired. Cook on low 3 1/2 5 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

title: Lime-Apricot Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 large beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons apricot jam | 1 cup pitted dates | 3 cups mixed greens, cleaned and trimmed
instructions: In a small sauce pan, stir together the bouillon cube, and the lime juice. Pour the mixture over the dates and toss to coat. Let stand 5 minutes, then stir in the jam. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,basil leaf,gruyere cheese,french bread,jamaican jerk seasoning,sesame oil,tomato puree,nori
title: Bread Pudding With Tomatoes, Sesame Sauce, and Nigella (Ww)
ingredients: 1/3 cup jamaican jerk seasoning | 3 large fennel bulbs, trimmed, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 cup italian bread, 1/2 to 1 inch cubes ( see jamaican grilled cheese, 1 slice loaf ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 cup basil leaves, torn | 1 loaf french bread ( or other loaf of bread with a pinch of crust )
instructions: Position a rack in the middle of the oven and heat the broiler until hot. Coat a medium bowl with cooking spray. Sprinkle the bottom of a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish with kosher salt and set aside. Add the jerk seasoning, turning to coat the pieces evenly. In a medium bowl toss the fennel with 1 cup of the jerk seasoning coating. Transfer fennel to a large plate, add the bread cubes, toss to evenly coat, and set aside on a plate. Heat the sesame oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Scatter the bread cubes in a single layer over the sesame oil and sear until golden, about 1 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree. Set aside. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon jerk seasoning in a small skillet over low heat, swirling the pan occasionally, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Spread the top of the bread cubes with half of the tomato sauce. Sprinkle with half of the gruyere. Top with half of the fennel and then with another half of the tomato sauce, and finish with the rest of the gruyere. Place bread cubes on a baking sheet and bake in the middle of the oven until golden and bubbly, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,pepperoncini pepper,cayenne pepper,black bean,spinach leaf,white fish fillet,beef gravy
title: Spinach Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stewing steak, cut into 1/4 inch cubes ( such as steaks may be used as lower-sodium ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup frozen spinach leaves, thawed and drained well ( may sub basil or chard leaves, just be sure to thaw the spinach last ) | 12 inches fresh pepperoncini peppers ( or 1-1/2 teaspoons dried peppers ) | 12 ounces beef gravy, divided | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Toss beef in 4 quart slow cooker with half of beans, half of spinach, pepperoncinis and half of 1 tbsp of gravy. Pour remaining gravy over beef. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or on high for up to 8 to 9 hours or until beef is tender. Remove pepperoncinis from slow cooker with slotted spoon and set aside.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,garlic crouton,fontina cheese,dill,date,brandy,baby spinach leaf
title: Spinach - Cheese Soup
ingredients: 4 cups frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed ) | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh dill ( or 1 tsp.| dried, divided ) | 1/2 cup chopped dates ( dates that's not in season ) | 3 cups fontina cheese, shredded | 8 cups frozen garlic-flavored croutons ( i used trader joe's ) | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Cook spinach and dill in saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, or according to package directions. Add croutons and brandy. Heat through.

title: Mexican Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced in half
instructions: Mix everything together and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,vanilla essence,wheat flour,spaghetti squash,chili powder,pork tenderloin
title: Mexican Spicy Spaghetti Squash (Spaghetti Squash)
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash ( about 250g or 3oz ) | 150 g pork tenderloin ( shaved or grated ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( or 1 tsp vanilla sugar ) | 1 pinch chili powder
instructions: Boil spaghetti squash in water for about 10 minutes but be careful not to overcook the squash. Remove and let cool down. Cut a slice off the bottom of the squash and scoop out seeds and membrane. Roughly chop the meat and toss it with the meat and squash in a large saucepan. Add the tomatoes, vanilla essence or sugar, and chili powder and mix well. Bring to a boil then simmer on a low heat for 15 minutes until thickened. Cool, then chill in the fridge.

title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 2 cans pork and beans in spaghetti sauce mix, undiluted | 6 cups prepared spaghetti sauce mix | 2/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro - divided | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil, divided | 1 package dried italian bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 cups thinly sliced fresh pumpkin | 2 cups confectioners'sugar, divided
instructions: Pour the pork and beans into a large pot over medium heat. Pour spaghetti sauce and spaghetti sauce mix into the mixture. Stir in 1/3 cup of cilantro, basil, and bread. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir pumpkin into the soup and return the soup to a boil. Heat through, but be careful not to boil it. Stir 1/3 cup of confectioners' sugar into the soup during the last few minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: mint,bean sprout,fennel seed,snow pea,bean,water chestnut,vegetable stock chicken
title: Tantalizing Vegetarian - Mint Rice and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups water chestnuts, rinsed and chopped | 1 cup green beans, cleaned and trimmed | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 pint fresh bean sprout | 1/4 cup fresh mint, cut into thin strips | 3 cups vegetable stock or 3 cups canned low sodium chicken broth | mint, leaves for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan, place the water chestnuts, green beans, fennel and bean sprouts. Pour in the stock and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add the mint and simmer an additional 5 minutes. Remove and discard the mint leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,chicken broth,cream mushroom soup,lemon juice zest
title: Italian Risotto With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( or cream of celery soup ) | 2 cups arborio rice, uncooked | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Pour soup into a small saucepan, add half can of water and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and allow soup to cool slightly. Combine rice and lemon zest in a large pan and stir with a large wire whisk until all soup is absorbed. Add soup mixture to rice and lemon juice mixture. Pour chicken broth into rice mixture. Bring water to a boil and lower heat. Simmer for about 45 minutes or until risotto is fluffy and creamy. If it is too thick, add up to 1/3 cup water. Serve warm.

title: Garlicky Sweet Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 kg bell pepper | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 pinch saffron strand ( optional )
instructions: Roast the bell peppers on the foil on a hot griddle or grill over low heat. Remove the skins from the pepper using a sharp knife. Make sure you scrape out most of the black bits in the grill. Wash and core if necessary. Peel off the skins. Cut the peppers in half. Remove the core. The stalk can be cut up to 1cm long. If you can't find saffron and saffron strand it is probably missing ingredients. Slice on a diagonal into chunks or rectangles. Place peppers in a saucepan and pour boiling water over. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes. Drain any liquid from the pan. Pour the giblets into a bowl and add the beef bouillon. Leave to stand for 15 minutes. Bring the pot of water. Bring to the boil. Add the saffron and serve with the peppers.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,grain mustard,tamari,orange juice zest,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Tear and Crunch Sweet Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari | 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard, not the grain | vegetable oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and mustard in bowl and whisk until sugar dissolves. Add oil and stir well until mixture is smooth. Store in airtight container in refrigerator up to 3 weeks. To use, lightly grease cooking sheet with cooking spray and line with plastic wrap. In small bowl, combine all topping ingredients and blend well. Pour equal amounts of topping mixture into each serving bowl of hot mustard and serve.

title: Walnut and Focaccia
ingredients: 1 package round fresh seaweed | 1 package marinara sauce | 1 cup corn syrup | 1 package ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Prepare the pound of seaweed by cutting off the top just above the eyes. The bottom should be slightly darker then the middle so it stays closed. Break the seaweed open, and cut away the white layer. You should now have a clear rectangle with a good amount of white and dark stripes on the surface so as not to be able to eat the seaweed easily. Cut the seaweed into cubes and add to a bowl. Warm the marinara sauce in a skillet with a little bit of water.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,penne pasta,steak,fajita seasoning,phyllo pastry,chunky salsa,cheese,cheddar cheese
title: Beef & Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 2 tablespoons fajita seasoning | 1 package chopped cheese | 1 package chopped button mushrooms | 5 sheets phyllo pastry sheets | 2 cups thick & chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Pound steak to 1/4 thick. Season with fajita seasoning. Mix in the cheese and mushrooms. Add the remaining 2 ounces of cheese. Lay out 1 portion of pastry on a flat surface. Cut dough in half and make a half moon with cut side down. Roll out the half moon. Place 1½ slices of cheese, 1/2 teaspoons of salsa, ¾ of the sausage mixture, ½ of the bacon & mushroom mixture, ¾ of the cheddar cheese and ¼ of the cheddar cheese, on the phyllo. Fold phyllo over filling. Fold in the ends of the phyllo, and pinch the ends together. Put on a baking tray and bake at 350 for 45 minutes. Make rolls while they are at the same time.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,chicken wing,coriander powder,blue curacao,green king prawn,stewing beef,nori
title: Blue Ribbon Beef and Prawn Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 lb green king prawns, shelled and deveined | 7 ounces stewing beef, trimmed of most of shell and cut into short strips or 3 ounces beef tips | 7 ounces blue curacao | 4 sheets nori, cut into 3/4in strips | 1/4 cup coriander powder | 2 lbs frozen stewing beef legs with thigh attached | 1/4 cup st.| brenden's crushed blue dragon food coloring ( to taste )
instructions: Mix the prawns, beef, curacao, seafood seasoning and lemon juice in a large bowl and mix well. Using wet hands divide the mixture into 16 equal portions on the skewers. Place on a rack in a baking tin, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 2 days. Cook the kebabs on a hot barbecue or grill rack on high heat, turning frequently, until they are cooked to your liking. Serve garnished with coriander leaves, with a dipping sauce of your choice. Enjoy.

title: Smoked Beef and Scotch Whisky Burgers
ingredients: 4 thick-cut hamburgers, each about 3/4-inch thick | 4 tablespoons scotch whisky | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: Combine the whisky and picante sauce.

title: O'Brian's Taco Nachos
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Heat grill pan to medium heat. Add pepperoni to pan and cook until browned and crisp. Add taco seasoning mix and stir together. Take pan off heat and immediately place pepperoni in hot frying pan. You can then place on a paper towel so they do not dry out. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,yoghurt,mirin,creamy peanut butter,shiitake mushroom,tilapia fillet,chocolate chip
title: Ahi-Mushroom Tilapia With Peanut Butter Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup mirin | 1/3 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons melted semisweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon shiitake mushroom, sliced ( optional ) | 4 tilapia fillets ( skinless or boneless )
instructions: Slice up the sweet italian sausage, and set it aside. Prepare the sweet italian sausage and set aside the casing. Bring a kettle of water to boil. Meanwhile, in a bowl whisk together the peanut butter by placing all of the melted chocolate in a bowl, then adding the mirin, yoghurt, and mushrooms. Mix this into the peanut butter mixture. Dip the tilapia fillets into the melted chocolate/chicken mixture, then set aside at room temperature. Drain the re, skinned or boneless tilapia fillets of any excess fat and put them in a large serving bowl. Pour the peanut butter cream sauce over the tilapia fillets and serve.

title: Kielbasas with Banana and Soy Milk
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa sausage | 2 mangoes, cut into chunks | 1 can chopped tomatoes with puree | 3 bananas, sliced | 1 1/2 cups soymilk, or as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar
instructions: Slice kielbasa sausage into 1/4 inch pieces. Place sausage in a large saucepan with mangoes, tomatoes with puree, bananas, and soy milk. Cover, and bring just to a boil.

title: Tropical White Onions
ingredients: 3 cups white sugar | 2/3 cup ice cubes
instructions: In a saucepan, mix sugar and ice cubes.

title: Homemade Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon onion salt ( optional )
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and then dry them with paper towels. Using the back of a spoon, gently press to remove the soft bit of the mushroom that accumulates. This should give you about 8 - 10 mushrooms. In a bowl mix seasoning salt and bread crumbs together. Incorporate the seasoning salt in and then mold the mushroom pieces with your hands into little mushroom shaped mushrooms. Refrigerate them for two hours and toss to coat the mushrooms with the crumb mixture. Place mushrooms on a rack in a roasting tin and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 12 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped spring onions | 1/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the mushrooms and spring onions, over medium heat. Stir a few times. When the mushrooms start to sizzle a little, pour the mushroom and its liquid into a bowl for dipping.

title: Sage Bread Stuffing
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained and patted dry | 1 package ground pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the pimentos, ground pecans, and ground mustard. Pack into a loaf or other loaf pan, and stuff with the ground pecans. Bake 30 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,white flour,green king prawn,stout beer,cranberry sauce
title: Pink Prawn and Cranberry Beer Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 200 g frozen green king prawns, thawed, peeled, defrosted, and chopped | 300 g cranberry sauce ( i like homemade ) | 150 ml stout beer, such as guinness | 2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f and lightly oil a pie dish. Roll out dough onto a floured surface. Cut out a circle with a circle cutter, using the reserved dough for the top and bottom of a 5 x 7 x 1 inch baking tin. Prick base with a fork, and line with baking paper, allowing room for spreading when using. Remove the paper, and re press dough into tin. Cover dough with a cloth towel and allow to rest for 15 minutes. Drain the prawns and place in baking tin over a low heat and cover with cranberry sauce. Boil for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and set aside. Add flour to a little water and stir well. Stir into prawns until coated generously, but not coloured. Pour into pie dish, and sprinkle top with paprika. Cook in oven for 35 - 40 minutes, until crust is golden and heated through. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Re heat and serve with crust toasted.

title: Spanish Orange Pepper Dip
ingredients: 12 -16 pieces orange bell peppers | 2 cups half-and-half | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Saute bell peppers over low heat 1 - 2 minutes on each side. Cool for 2 minutes, removing to a plate lined with paper towel to drain. In medium frying pan heat oil to medium high heat. Add bell peppers and saute 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Add half & half, stir well. Reduce heat to low, simmer 3 minutes. Place in serving bowl, spoon hot mixture on top. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chicken thigh,nut,beef broth,tortilla chip,red chile pepper,bread crumb
