title: Tortilla Chip Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pound boneless chicken thighs | 1 cup instant bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons finely ground nuts | 1 medium red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt. Wrap chicken in bread crumbs. Sprinkle nuts over chicken. Cut a slit in the side of the chile pepper to help loosen the blackened flavor. Place chicken on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until no longer pink and juices run clear. Mix beef broth and crushed tortilla chips in a small baking dish until hot and blended. Pour broth mixture into the baking dish, coating the chicken. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,angel hair pasta,plain flour,milk,cauliflower,yellow squash
title: Pasta and Vegetables in Pastry Creamy Pepper
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 medium vidalia onion, finely diced | 1 medium yellow squash, finely diced | 200 g cauliflower, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups angel hair pasta
instructions: Mix flour and milk and stir until it starts to thicken a little. Cook the onion, squash and cauliflower for 10 mins, stirring occasionally. Add pasta, mix until it is heated through and season to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Pesto Appetizer (Pesto)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds mozzarella cheese, cubed | 1 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place cubed mozzarella cheese on a large piece of aluminum foil. Spread pesto sauce over the cheese, then top with cubed mozzarella cheese. Wrap foil tightly around mozzarella cheese until it's completely wrapped. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is completely melted, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Easy Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups non-dairy topping, any flavor ( chocolate or chocolate ) | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, melted and cooled | 1 jar pasta sauce, any flavor
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until blended and smooth using an electric mixer. Enjoy.

title: Hot Potato and Pistachio Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups sifted confectioners'sugar | 4 small baking potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 cup chopped pistachios | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Place the potato, confectioners' sugar, and nutmeg in a skillet over medium heat, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potato is slightly browned, about 8 minutes. Spread the pistachios onto a plate with tongs. Toast them until golden brown. Stir in the chile sauce. Place the cooked potato on a plate, sprinkle with the pistachios, and drizzle with the sweet chili sauce.

title: Bengali Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb, cut into small chops | 2 bunches bok choy, washed and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut the lamb into very small pieces and place in a bowl. Cover and leave for at least 30 minutes at room temperature. Remove the lamb from the marinade and place in a colander. Sprinkle both sides of the meat with salt and lightly rub with the salt. Place in the oiled casserole. Add the chopped bok choy and fry over a medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until bright green. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Tomato & Cherry Tomato Jam
ingredients: 4 lbs ripe cherry tomatoes ( about 4 tomatoes ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried marjoram
instructions: In a large, heavy pot heat the tomatoes gently on the top of the flame, just to bring out all the juices. Add the marjoram and continue roasting. When the jam reaches a jam like consistency and the tomatoes have begun to give off a lot of juice, turn off the heat. Transfer the jars to a wire rack and let stand for one week before using.

title: Homemade Niter Kebabs by Sy
ingredients: 1 1/2 inches below the ground level of peshaw seeds with piblets | 1 1/2 inches below the ground level of peshaw powder | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Prepare your berbere by soaking a large piece of turkish parchment or cheesecloth in water for at least two hours. Using your hands, make five impressions about 1 1/2 5 inches high above the surface of the paprika. This should take about 4 - 4 hours. The parchment is soft enough to roll onto the surface of the water in between kneading. When it starts to stick, remove with one spatula and set aside. Repeat with remaining sheets of parchment and/or cheesecloth to pound out some extra moisture. Place in a large bowl and add a pinch or two of salt. Use the peshaw water, the spice and bay leaf to moisten all the sand in the bowl with the water. Gather the spices together lightly and mix with the sand. Cover the bowl and put it in a warm place for 12 - 18 hours. The sand should be very hot. If necessary, increase heat to medium and allow to boil away for 15 minutes. Remove the soaked parchment and/or cheesecloth with a slotted spoon and onto a clean cutting board, forming small bits from the sand. Roll each piece of sand off into golf ball sized sand and place on your hands. They should stick together like sand balls in the sand. Place a paper towel onto the board, but do not wipe out the sand. Roll each piece in the sand. The sand should remain covered with sand at all times. Use a fork and fingers to assist in the sanding. Allow the sand to dry completely.

Random Ingredients: catsup,ginger garlic paste,daikon radish,cream mushroom soup,meat,cognac,lemon,sesame oil
title: Sinigang Naikon (Filipino meatballs)
ingredients: 500 -6 1/2 lbs ground meat or 500 -6 1/2 lbs pork | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon catsup | 3 tablespoons cognac | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 lemon, zested | 1 daikon radish, peeled and grated ( optional )
instructions: Combine meat, sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest and cognac. Mix well. Take about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture and form it into balls. Roll the balls with a rolling pin. If desired, dredge each ball with sesame oil and lightly with sugar. Brown in batches in a skillet with a small amount of sesame oil. Remove from the skillet and repeat process until all the meat meat is cooked. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the oil from the skillet. Heat the skillet with the meat balls over medium heat. Add onions and brown slowly, stirring frequently, for 15 to 20 minutes. Add the remaining saki sauce. Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Roasted ancho Chile Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb cherry tomatoes, halved and cored | 3 tablespoons ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Arrange tomatoes on a jelly roll or baking dish and sprinkle with ancho chili powder. Roast in the oven until fragrant, about 7 minutes, depending on the length of the cherry tomatoes. Sprinkle evenly with lemon zest. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Bacon Chowder
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, chopped | 1 package dry vegetable soup mix | 1 package baby spinach | 1 cup marmalade | 8 slices prosciutto, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon until crispy. Drain the bacon, and return to the pan with the vegetable soup mix. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens slightly. Add spinach, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes. To serve, place a slice of prosciutto onto the soup, and top with a few spoonfuls of soup mixture.

title: Blue Cheese Boursin Lasagna
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles, cooked | 32 ounces low fat yogurt, no low fat | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 24 ounces low fat blue cheese, crumbles | cooking oats ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt, worcestershire sauce, cayenne and blue cheese. Place 1 - 2 tbsp in the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking pan. Spread 1/2 tsp of yogurt cheese mixture on the top of the yogurt cheese mixture. Place 2 noodles on top of the cheese mixture. Spread on 1/3 of the cheese mixture. Drizzle 1 - 2 tbsp of cooking oats on top. Cover with remaining noodles. Top with remaining cheese mixture, sprinkle with remaining oats to sprinkle on top. Cover with foil and refrigerate for 2 - 4 hours.

title: Mexican Raita
ingredients: 2 cups cooked kidney beans | 2 cups sauerkraut | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 teaspoons saffron | 1/4 cup red wine, heated | 3 cups baby carrots | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint leaves, torn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and puree. Serve cold with raita.

title: Homemade Provolone & Chili Appetizer
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons red roasted red chili | 8 -12 slices provolone cheese ( or other cheese )
instructions: Place a slice or piece of provolone or other cheese on a flat surface and smear with a thin layer of pepper. Top with another slice of cheese so that it resembles a thin layer. Grasp the edge of the cheese with a moistened finger and place the cheese on them. Press on the edges lightly to make a cheese sandwich. Repeat with remaining cheese and chiles. Place the cheese sandwiches on a flat baking sheet and let them rest at room temperature about 1 hour. When ready to eat, spread about 1 teaspoon of prepared red chile with your finger and put somewhere heated to melt the cheese while it is still warm. Spread a nice thin layer or more of the melted chile on the cheese. Enjoy these are best eaten the day they are made.

title: Pigs and Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 6 slices thin-sliced whole wheat flour or 6 slices thick-sliced whole wheat spelt flour | 1 pinch salt | 8 slices white bread, crust trimmed, crusts removed, but cut in fours ( such as sourdough ) | 1/2 cup guacamole | 12 slices crisp smoked sweet peaches | 1 cup salsa verde | 4 juniper berries | 1 sprig parsley, for garnish
instructions: Heat half the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle a pinch of salt over each slice of bread, until lightly toasted. Set a second slice of bread on the toast and spread with half the guacamole. Spread half the salsa verde over the guacamole, then top with the second bread slice. Spread the rest of the guacamole on top. Garnish with a bouquet garni and a juniper berries and parsley sprig. Cook 1 minute.

title: Pineapple and Pineapple Scones
ingredients: 1 pineapple, washed and cored | 2 cups plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Cut a deep cross into the top of the sallow and prick with a fork to vent steam. Bake for 20 minutes until golden and tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,apple cider vinegar,clove,no salt tomato sauce,green onion
title: Tomato Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green onion | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place chicken in a medium skillet. Pour tomato sauce over chicken. Cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet, and place on a serving platter or cutting board. Chill, 10 minutes, or until slightly warm, and cut into bite size pieces. Combine vinegar, onion, and cloves in a small saucepan. Cook and stir over medium high heat until lightly browned. Pour vinegar mixture over chicken and vegetables.

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Caribbean-Style Beans)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 3/4 cup cracked black pepper | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns
instructions: Drain and rinse beans well. In an electric blender, grind beans until coarsely ground. Transfer coarsely ground beans into a nonstick skillet or serving dish. Stir in pepper and white peppercorns. Cover and cook over medium heat until hot, about 10 minutes.

title: Honey Mint Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1 -2 tablespoon honey | 6 -8 mint leaves
instructions: Break eggs into bowl. Heat pan on burner with honey and melt. Add mint leaves. Crack eggs into pan. Stir all ingredients. Turn stove to low. Let egg cook at a slight crunch for about 20 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Pear and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 2 jars sweet french onion soup | 1/2 cup diced pears | 1 clove crushed garlic, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons sliced shallots | 8 ounces whole-wheat spaghetti, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 container frozen lemonade
instructions: Pour french onion soup into a large pot over medium heat. Stir in pear, pears, garlic, shallots, and spaghetti. Mix in lemonade just until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, small, no stem | 1 can diced mild chili peppers with oil | 3 -4 tablespoons cold water | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon grated peeled real vanilla
instructions: Remove the heads from the cauliflower and cut into small florets. Combine all the ingredients and boil until the cauliflower is tender, about 30 minutes. Note, this freezes well and is great reheated once cooled.

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning mix,gingerroot,coriander leaf,chicken bouillon cube,ziti pasta,green curry paste,liquid smoke
title: Somali Penne
ingredients: 7 ounces ziti pasta or 7 ounces penne pasta | 1 tablespoon green curry paste or 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 6 ounces green curry paste or 8 ounces red curry paste | 2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes, depending on quantity of cube | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 -5 coriander leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Directions, soak ziti for 8 - 10 hours, drain and place in a large bowl. Add green curry paste, liquid smoke, green curry/red curry paste, fajita/liquid smoke and chicken cubes. Stir and combine well. Chill in refrigerator for approximately 2 - 3 hours. Garnish with corriander leaves before serving note, prep time includes chilling time.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice cocktail,almond flavoring,spanish onion,hard egg,sea salt black pepper
title: Cranberry and Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup cranberry juice cocktail | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | sea salt and black pepper to taste | 1 pinch almond flavoring
instructions: Place the onion into a salad spinner and remove the ends. Pour cranberry juice into a small bowl with chopped onion. Add hard boiled eggs, pepper and almond flavoring to the bowl. Toss to combine and garnish with toasted whole almonds and/or fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: lemon thyme ca n't,basmati rice,cannellini bean,white breadcrumb,ginger,rice wine
title: Creamy Rice With Beans (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked cannellini beans ( about 1 pound ) | 1 3/4 cups white breadcrumbs | 3 packages white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons minced peeled fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon thyme ( or 1/2 tsp dried ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry white vermouth
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans and combine the rice, bread crumbs, ginger, lemon thyme and dry vermouth in the rice cooker bowl. Close lid and set to'slow' mode and set a timer for 15 minutes. Remove lid and allow to steam for 15 minutes. Note, if your cooker is to hard, do a quick pressure release, but do not overheat. The rice should be slightly firm to the touch when done. After 15 minutes, turn off machine and remove lid. Allow the rice to sit on'slow' for 5 minutes while you prepare the rest of the meal.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,corn kernel,mozzarella cheese,hot sauce,brown sugar
title: Stuffed Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 3/4 cup icing sugar | 2 cans corn kernels, drained | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | hot sauce, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar and icing sugar. Set aside. Open corn and drain well, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. In a medium bowl, mix corn liquid with brown sugar mixture until well combined and corn mixture has been well mixed. Stuff mixture into the cheesecloth lined 1 1/2 quart glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Slice in thirds, and serve with the desired dipping sauces.

title: Tarragon Meatballs
ingredients: 600 g meatballs | 2 bunches baby carrots | 3 bunches bok choy | 1 tablespoon freshtarragon, finely chopped
instructions: Bring enough water to cover the carrots with a pinch of salt and bring rapidly to the boil. Skim the foam as it rises, then reduce heat to medium. Cook the meatballs, stirring occasionally and adding a little salt as needed until they are cooked through and all the pink has evaporated.

Random Ingredients: artificial sweetener,mace,ginger powder,apple cider,butter flavor shortening,cumin powder,beef chuck roast
title: Crock Pot Pulled Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter flavor shortening | 3 cans commercial stewed tomatoes ( 3 1/2 cups, or one 15.| 5 oz.| can diced tomatoes with juice ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed
instructions: Melt shortening in large skillet. Add stewed tomatoes, onion, cider or juice, molasses, ginger, cumin, mace, and cindi, mix very well and cover. Set the crock pot to high and cook 3 1/2 4 hours or until very roast is fork tender. Check to see that the meat will not fall apart when pulled apart. This doesn't matter, as long as it does because of the butter flavor shortening. You could also remove the roast after 3 1/2 hours of cooking. Remove the meat from the crock pot, shred, and return to crock pot. Stir well to mix. Cover and let cook the next 2 hours. Serve with any or all of the above suggested accompaniments, like rice, pasta, or vegetables. This recipe can serve up to 4 as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,nonfat milk,feta cheese,champagne,head romaine lettuce
title: Low Fat Chickpea and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and chopped | 3 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed | 1/3 cup champagne, chilled | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,dark brown sugar,vodka,beer,gruyere,elbow macaroni,corn tortilla chip
title: Tortilla Chips and Cheese  With Vodka & Beer
ingredients: 3 cups elbow macaroni ( or angel hair ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 bottle vodka | 1 bunch gruyere ( rind and all ) | 3 cups beer | 10 corn tortilla chips ( the small white ones, such as ricksha )
instructions: Combine water and noodles in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. While noodles are boiling, mince the gruyere and toss it lightly together in a shallow dish. Stir in brown sugar and oil in a saucepan. Pour vodka over the gruyere, stir, and set aside. When noodles are done, drain and toss. Transfer to a bowl, stir in cheese and beer, mixing well to coat. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Cider Gravy
ingredients: 1 package dried onion and mushroom soup mix | 3 tablespoons cornmeal, or as needed | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Measure dry onion soup mix into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: sesame,sherry wine vinegar,peach,celery seed,oriental sesame oil,cream chicken soup
title: Peach Sesame Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons toasted oriental sesame oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1/4 cup fresh peach - peeled, pitted and chopped
instructions: Puncture one side of each peach with a knife several times and chop in half. Use a fork to scrape peaches open. Combine the soups, sesame oils, sherry vinegar, celery seed, and peach in a large saucepan. Heat until soup starts to bubble. Ladle into serving bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,sirloin steak,green chili sauce,brown rice,triple sec,peppercorn
title: Steak-Slow Cooker Supper
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup triple sec | 3 tablespoons sweet green chili sauce | 1 tablespoon brown rice ( or jasmine rice ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red peppercorns | 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, trimmed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large slow cooker. Add steak, and turn to coat. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Slice, and serve.

title: Marinated Onions
ingredients: 3 pounds red onions, very thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: In a large glass jar, mix together the peeled and thinly sliced onions. Sprinkle italian seasoning over the onions. Add vinegar and shake well to mix. Cover the jar and refrigerate to marinate in the refrigerator for at least one week. Onion marmalade.

title: Danish Red Wine Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2/3 cup red wine vinegar, divided | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Cook and stir cream in a saucepan over medium heat until hot, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 2/3 cup of red wine vinegar. Remove from heat and mix in allspice. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,pork chop,black currant,plain yogurt,ketchup,tamari,plain flour
title: Tikka Pork with Sweet Ginger
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork chops | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 50 ml peanut oil or 50 ml vegetable oil | 150 ml ketchup | 100 ml plain yogurt ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 200 g black currants ( use 1 3 oz/170 g dried currants )
instructions: Season the pork chops generously. Mix the flour and ketchup in the palm of your hand, then dip in the flour mixture. Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium/high, then sear the pork for approximately 2 minutes each side in the pan. Serve alongside the yoghurt ketchup. Make the syrup by combining the yoghurt, tamari and blackcurrants in a small saucepan and bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thick, stirring constantly. Pour into the heated yoghurt sauce and stir to combine. Serve with the sliced pork, and the cooked yoghurt sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,coca cola,red wine vinegar,triple sec,fruit,ricotta cheese,cognac,catsup
title: Creamy Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1 pint heavy cream or 1 pint low fat sour cream | 8 tablespoons cognac | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons triple sec | 1/3 cup catsup
instructions:
Steam cauliflower in boiling water until fork tender. 
    -. Drain well and cool slightly while preparing other ingredients. In large bowl mix ricotta with cream, cognac, vinegar and triple sec. Mix well. Add cauliflower to the cheese mixture. Let sit until ready to serve. Serve at room termperature.

title: Mexican Mole Chicken
ingredients: 12 skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 cup finely chopped shallot | 1/2 cup finely chopped nuts | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cans fire-roasted whole plum tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | salt
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f coat 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place chicken, shallots and nuts in single layer in baking dish. Sprinkle with cocoa powder. Arrange chicken over mixture. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Stir in undrained tomatoes and chilies. Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with salt. Top with cheddar cheese.

title: Edam and Grapes in Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb edam cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 green grape, washed, halved | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place cheese in center of a small round piece of parchment paper. Sprinkle with adobo seasoning. Arrange cheese in a circle on top of cheese. Add grapes around cheese and sprinkle with additional adobo seasoning. Place parchment paper on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, remove from oven and cool 5 minutes.

title: Herbed Beef With Pita Chips
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fresh herb ( rosemary, thyme, oregano, marjoram, or parsley for added flavor ) | 1 - 1 1/4 tablespoon fresh sage leaf | 2 teaspoons of minced serrano peppers | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 4 large pita bread, halves
instructions: Cut beef across the grain into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place the beef slices in a plastic bag and add herbs, minced chilies, grated nutmeg, and pepper sauce. Toss well to coat. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat grill. Place beef on the preheated grill. Oil grate. Grill until internal temperature reaches 130 - 140 degrees for medium rare beef and 145 degrees for medium rare to medium. Transfer to a carving board and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes before carving. Serve on top of warm pita chips.

title: Lemon Rhubarb Potato Pie
ingredients: 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes, or as needed | 1 cup cornmeal | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 2 lemons, zest of | 1 lemon, zested | 1 cup diced fresh rhubarb | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting ( optional ) | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and salt and cook until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and allow to rest 10 minutes. In a medium pot, combine 2 cups cold water with 2 tablespoons cornmeal.

title: Creamy Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/3 cup drained canned chives ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish
instructions: In a food processor, combine all the ingredients.

title: Rosemary Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: In a small dish, stir together milk and rosemary until completely incorporated. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Pour in about 1/3 cup of water. Place rosemary into the water. Cook and stir continuously for 2 to 3 minutes, constantly scraping the bottom of the pan. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until the sauce thickens, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool about 15 minutes. Transfer to refrigerator and let stand at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,rosemary,nonstick cooking spray,sauce,chili paste,corn oil
title: Sauce and Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 cup chili paste | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 1/2 cups dry egg noodles | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: In large bowl, combine chili paste, oil, hot sauce, and rosemary. Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add noodles, stir fry 2 minutes, then add sauce. Cover and cook 4 minutes or until noodles are tender. Serve and enjoy with a side of yogurt or chutney.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,apricot brandy,chinese rice wine,salmon fillet,chile,red curry paste,salt black pepper
title: Chile Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 750 g salmon fillets, cut into 2 equal portions | 1 1/2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons chile paste | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil, extra | 6 dried apricot brandy | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( i use sharwood ) | 1/4 cup sweet chinese rice wine | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade, 200°c if using the oven, 200 degrees c if using the oven. Place the salmon in the bowl of a food processor and add the oil, chilli paste, extra sunflower oil, brandy and rice wine. Process until smooth season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,madeira wine,juniper berry,kalamata olive,masala,brown onion,chicken cutlet,lemongrass
title: Aglio
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken cutlets, cut in 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 cup madeira wine, chilled ( or any good quality sweet, white, or red wine ) | 1 -2 tablespoon kalamata olive, freshly chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass, tender inner leaves only, trimmed and crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons light brown onions, chopped | 2 -3 whole juniper berries, crushed | 2 tablespoons marsala ( optional )
instructions: Toss the chicken with 2 tbsp of kosher salt. Allow to sit for 20 minutes. In a small mixing bowl, blend together the madeira, olives, lemon grass, onion and juniper. Sprinkle 1/4 tablespoons of the marsala on the chicken and marinate for at least an hour or as much as overnight. Preheat the grill, to medium high heat. Add the chicken skewers and grill until they are cooked to your liking, turning once. Serve with a side of steamed greens, rice, pasta or toast. Note for those who have a hard time with making a lot, you can prepare them up to 1 day in advance and then store them in the refrigerator in individual ziplock bags. When you take out the chicken, remove as much of the fat as you can and keep the chicken warm. For those with a lotier taste, boil the fat until it is just a little bit solid. Meanwhile, strain the broth and reserve. To make a gravy in a small saucepan, heat the remaining 2 tbsp of the olive oil in a small saucepan. Add brown onion and juniper and fry over medium heat for 10 minutes until tender. Add the broth and boil over high heat to thicken. Add the cooked chicken and turn into the gravy. Simmer for about 3 - 4 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cashew,yellow cornmeal,spinach leaf,apple juice,green chilies,flat leaf parsley,cream tartar
title: Akkoor (Spinach-Parsley Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 1 green chilies, finely chopped ( seeded, deveined and finely chopped ) | 2 fresh spinach leaves, finely chopped ( or 2 bunches - 14 oz.| of frozen chopped spinach ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped cashews, toasted ( or peanuts if you have it ) | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat sour cream ( or low fat greek yogurt-if you have it ) ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon flat leaf parsley ( finely chopped ) or 1/2 tablespoon cilantro, finely chopped ( finely chopped )
instructions: To get rid of all the steam inside of the pancake pan, line the bottom with parchment or wax paper. Put cornmeal and green chilies in a bowl & blend well until you have a smooth paste. Add the spinach, cashews and cream of tartar, mix thoroughly so the ingredients do not form lumps. Using a pastry brush, coat the cooking plate/sour cream with cooking spray and set it on top of the parchment in a circle. Pour about 2/3 cup of the batter into the pan & spread the mix evenly. Make more pancakes or test with a tablespoon of the mix at the time, if you see the mixture has dried out it needs more liquid. When the top of the pancake is completely dry, lift the pancake out of the pan & carefully slide it back into the pan with any or a spoon. When about 1 1/2 minutes later the mixture should be puffed up into a golden brown shape and the pancake should have a firm firm, shiny appearance. Remove the pancake onto a plate lined with the wax paper & let it rest 2 - 3 minutes. If using as a topping, dust with a little parsley or a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and serve immediately.

title: Mushroom Brown Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain brown rice or 1/2 cup medium brown rice | 2 ounces white button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, add rice and mushrooms and return to a boil. Reduce heat after 2 minutes and continue to boil for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Fluff with a fork and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cornstarch,kalamata olive,chicken meat,red food coloring,dark rum
title: Rum and Lemongrass Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat, strips | 2 ounces dark rum, use rum flavoured | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 package fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except green beans. Chill at least 30 minutes. Serve over greens.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,romaine lettuce,bicarbonate soda,heavy cream,lime
title: Indian Style Bicarbonate of Beef (Shankoobe) Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 lbs good quality heavy cream | 8 heads romaine lettuce, washed well
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Chill for 6 hours. Divide mixture into serving sized portions. Serve chilled. Keep stored in a tightly closed container. Use as directed in recipes.

title: Italian Grilled Greens
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed | 1 bunch celery
instructions: Slice or dice greens into quarters and place in a salad bowl. Mix well and scatter with celery. Drizzle with any remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,italian turkey sausage link,irish cream,cheese spread
title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet italian turkey sausage links | 8 ounces cheese spread, grated | 1 jar saltine crackers, crushed | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Grill ground sausage over medium heat until cooked through, about 10 minutes.

title: Bengal Ruzo (Pasta with Nuts)
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 4 tablespoons bengal-flavored curry paste | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spiced Cherry Raisins With Rosemary
ingredients: 10 medium golden raisins ( see note ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh cherries ( i like the pittery variety ) | 4 large rosemary sprigs | 1 medium sweet red pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions:
Note, buy pitted cherries that have been peeled and pitted, removing the stones if you do not. Chop cherries. You will lose a lot of cherries if they are not thoroughly cleaned. Place raisins in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes. Drain. 
    -. Discard water and sprigs. Place raisins, red pepper and rosemary in food processor in batches. Puree until fairly smooth but still slightly chunky. Press into a 8 inch springform pan. Refrigerate for several weeks. Serve while still warm. Note, the original recipe was to remove the dried rosemary needles from the rosemary sprigs, but it was not necessary so called for the rosemary sprigs to be omitted.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,pineapple juice,coriander seed,tofu,water chestnut,green onion
title: Tofu Poke
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, finely diced | 2 green onions, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup chopped water chestnut | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander seed
instructions: Combine tofu, onions, pineapple juice, and water chestnuts in a blender or food processor. Blend until thick. Combine flour and coriander. Sprinkle over tofu mixture, mix until well blended. Form into 1 inch balls. Set aside to cool thoroughly. To bake, place balls on a foil lined baking sheet, close foil, and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,yoghurt,sun tomato oil,chinese mushroom,marzipan,almond paste
title: Mushroom Pies With Oil and Almonds
ingredients: 400 g fresh chinese mushrooms | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon almond paste | 1/4 cup blanched almond, chopped | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated from a microplane
instructions: Slice stems from mushrooms so that they stand upright and cut caps into thin strips. Heat sun dried tomatoes in oil and fry mushroom strips until tender and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Mix aprinated mushrooms with the aprinated mushrooms and almonds. Beat yoghurt until smooth. Stir in orange zest and pour over mushroom mixture. Chill in refrigerator. Cut into squares or diamonds and serve. Note, the almonds should be slivered or crushed slightly with a mortar and pestle. If possible, you can use a food processor to grind them and keep them in a tightly closed container to keep them from turning brown or slim.

title: Pistachio Sauce With Beans and Chiles (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight in | 1 cup boiling water | 2 dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon dried pistachios, shelled | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon harissa
instructions: Rinse and pick through the soaked beans to make sure they are not actually soaked. Place in the pressure cooker and cover with 1 1/2 inches of water. Close the lid and lock the pressure cooker on top of the cooker. Over medium high heat bring water to boil for 10 minutes, remove the lid and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes. Remove the lid and continue cooking for 20 - 30 minutes until the beans are tender. Stir in the ground pistachios. In a small bowl, combine the brewed coffee and harissa. Pour the coffee mixture over the top of the beans and serve.

title: Ziti con Noci
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can tomato preserves | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot preserves | 2 pounds uncooked ziti pasta
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Sear the brisket on all sides in 2 tablespoons of the apricot preserves until browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Spread the ziti into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with 1/2 the meat mixture, then spread with 1/2 the tomato preserves and 1/2 the dill. Dot the ziti with the remaining 1/4 of the preserves. Top with remaining meat, apricot preserves, and the remaining 1/4 of the dill, preserve mixture and herbs. Cover and refrigerate the dish, loosely covered, overnight. To serve, remove the brisket from the sauce and slice into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,beef,white pearl onion,crabmeat,hard salami,gingerroot,turkey gravy
title: Crab Melts
ingredients: 250 g turkey gravy | 175 g mango chutney | 1/2 cup soft fresh goat cheese or 1/2 cup soft fresh sour cream | 100 g fresh crabmeat, picked over and chopped | 1 small fresh gingerroot, peeled | 1 hard salami, chopped | 1 large white pearl onion, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celcius. Place the turkey gravy and chutney in the base of a microwave safe dish and mix well. Add the cheese and stir until melted, around 10 minute add the crabmeat and salami, then place the onion on top. Transfer to the baking tray, and bake in the oven for 20 minute or until golden and tender. Serve with new seasonal vegetables.

title: Chipotle Home Lentil
ingredients: 1/2 lb red potatoes, unpeeled | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( cider is best ) | chipotle chile ( chipotle in adobo sauce or canned chipotle peppers )
instructions: Scrub the unpeeled potatoes and cut each into sixths. Place them in a single layer in a large saucepan and cover with water. The water should just reach the top of the potatoes. Bring to a boil over a high heat then reduce the heat to medium and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Lift out the scum from the top of the pan with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl of ice water to halt the cooking. In the mean time, boil the unpeeled potatoes for about 20 minutes. Drain and cool. When cool, peel the potatoes. Slice the potatoes into thin wedges then arrange on a serving platter surrounded by the chipotle. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Lamb Chops Kebabs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 lb boneless lamb chop
instructions: Prepare a grill pan with 2 inches of water. Heat italian seasoning in pan and brown half at a time lamb chops. Repeat steps 7 - 8 until all chops are browned. Spray pan with non stick spray. Thread each chop onto one skewer and grill or broil 6 - 8 minutes for rare or 6 - 8 minutes for medium rare for medium. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,ale,ricotta cheese,ice,pine nut,green pepper,cannellini bean
title: Pine Nut and Ricotta Dip
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 bottle fat-free ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup dried cannellini beans | green pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, chopped | 1 packet carbonated ale ( i use bamber's brand )
instructions: Prepare and refrigerate any leftovers from the italian salad dressing mix. In a large bowl, mix ricotta cheese and cottage cheese. Add beans, peppers, pine nuts, and ale. Add lemon juice last or it will overpower the salad.

title: Green Beans With Chantilly Cream Frosting
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated baking ammonia | 1 lb green beans, trimmed and cut into thirds | 2 -3 tablespoons grand marnier ( your favorite liqueur ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped
instructions: Place the baking ammonia in a small frying pan over low heat, swirling to evenly coat the bottom. When the ammonia is very warm, sprinkle in the green beans and stir until coated with the foamy ammonia. Remove from heat and add grand marnier and vanilla. Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle with additional grand marnier. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,heavy cream,thyme leaf,white hominy,mint leaf,cinnamon
title: Greek Posole-White Hominy
ingredients: 1 can white hominy, drained | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Combine hominy, cream, mint, thyme, garlic salt, and cinnamon in a blender.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,barley,shiitake mushroom,chicken stock,kosher salt black pepper,lentil
title: Barley Soup or Lentils in the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs puy lentils | 1 lb shiitake mushroom | 5 ounces barley | 4 fluid ounces chicken stock ( i use low sodium ) | 5 fluid ounces ketchup | 1 1/2 lbs shiitake mushrooms, chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the puy lentils and shiitake mushrooms in the pressure cooker. Add the chicken stock to the pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat. When the soup boils, add the barley and mushrooms.

title: Puchero
ingredients: 2 cans coconut rum | 1 1/2 pounds broiler-fryer chickens, cut into pieces | 1 jar sliced carrots, drained | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 1 can or bottle meat juice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the coconut rum and coconut milk. Add chicken, carrots, and sugar.

title: Julia Child's Faux Chunky Salsa
ingredients: 1 head escarole ( or any green or red kale ) | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( we love prunes ) | 1 jicama ( peeled, finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup chopped celery ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and chill. This is also good chilled.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,shiitake mushroom,tomato,cherry,beef rib,pineapple juice
title: Chinese Style Braised Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 4 -6 shiitake mushrooms | 2 -3 large tomatoes | 1 can pineapple tidbits with juice | 2 -3 lbs beef bones ( preferably from a roast ) | 1/3 cup cherry ( optional )
instructions: Clean and de stem the mushrooms, reserving the liquid for later use. Chop the beef bones into small pieces and place in a casserole with the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook at 325 degrees for a couple of hours. Turn down oven temperature to 275 degrees and cook for 1 more hour. Slice into long rib slices and serve with rice.

title: Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lean veal | 1/2 cup finely textured brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons pimientos, chopped | 3/4 cup yogurt | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle peppers, minced | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Mix the meat with the yogurt, seeds and spices and set aside while preparing the vegetables. Stir fry the veggies in a little oil and drain well. Pour meat into a casserole dish and top with sprouts and sliced veal.

title: Ranch Curry and Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yogurt and molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 cup oatmeal ( not instant ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup dry vermouth, plus, a little, heated | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Mix everything together in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 3 to 5 min. Drain cranberries, reserve liquid. Stir until curries are just slightly sticky and hot. Pour over noodles and serve.

title: Yogurt and Salmon for One!
ingredients: 2 ounces plain yogurt | 4 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat the grill and line 1 piece of foil with the top sheet. Put the salmon on its piece of foil. Pour the yogurt on top of the fish. Close the sides of the foil and fold in the sides of the two sheets of foil. Put the fish on the grill and cook for 12 minutes. Turn the fish over and grill on the other side for 10 minutes or until it flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Quinoa With Celery & Dairy (Whole Grain & Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 lb celery rib ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 tablespoons nonfat dry milk | 1/4 cup light fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon nonfat milk | coriander powder | 4 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar
instructions: Place the quinoa, celery & quinoa in a saucepan & cook over med low heat for 15 - 20 mins, or until the celery is tender. Remove from the heat & place in a food processor. Add 3 tbsp of the skim milk, sour cream & milk & process until just combined. Scrape the mixture into a shallow bowl. Stir in the coriander & add remaining skim milk, 1 tbsp of nonfat milk & sugar. Sprinkle the top with the remaining nonfat milk & serve. If you have little toddlers that are very picky cook them in a little oil, a little garlic & lemon juice & sprinkle top of quinoa with that before serving.

Random Ingredients: bacon,oregano leaf,double cream,liquid smoke,onion soup mix,heavy whipping cream,mozzarella cheese,red pepper
title: Italian Bacon and Cheese Pie
ingredients: 6 bacon, slices cut into small pieces | 1 can condensed cream of cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 dash crushed red pepper ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the bacon pieces in batches until crisp. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon, draining on a plate lined with paper towels, and sprinkle with salt. Reserving 2 tablespoons of bacon grease, saute the remaining bacon in drippings until the juices run. Remove bacon from skillet, and set aside. In a saucepan over medium high heat, combine the condensed cream of mushroom soup, liquid smoke, minced onion soup mix, oregano, red pepper, and 2 cups mozzarella cheese. Heat mixture, stirring constantly, until warm and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Stir in bacon and cream of mushroom mixture.

title: Italian Pecan Salad
ingredients: 3 cups pecans | 1 head carrots, coarsely grated | 1 package herb seasoning mix ( i like mccormick's herbed chef mix ) | 1/2 teaspoon chile ( i use jalapeno, my blend ) | 2 cups red wine vinegar
instructions: Line a large platter with plastic wrap and top with pecans. Mix 1 bunch of the salad ingredients together in a bowl. Dollop all the salad over the pecans and toss. Taste and adjust seasonings. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. This salad goes very quickly if refrigerated. Note, you can leave the rest of the herbs in the herb seasoning if you would like a smoother dressing.

title: Sichuan Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw sichuan nuts ( nam pla ) or 1 1/2 lbs raw corn oil ( nam pla ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: If the nuts are large, break them up into pieces before cooking. Pour some hot water over them to cover, and allow them to steam until they become tender. Drain and dry them thoroughly with paper towels. Transfer to a mortar and pestle, adding a tbsp of dark soy sauce. Grind the nam pla well, then add more dark soy sauce if it's necessary, to make an 'emoo paste' that is sticky. Serve immediately, keeping in mind that one won't eat while eating. It can last for 7 days, stored in the freezer in airtight containers.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,anchovy fillet,arugula,coconut,yeast,grand marnier,asiago cheese,whipping cream
title: Asaga Salad
ingredients: 3 cups prepared coleslaw mix | 4 anchovy fillets, minced | 1/2 cup grated coconut | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 1/2 teaspoons soft yeast | 1 1/4 cups grand marnier or 1 1/4 cups other strong coffee liqueur | 1 head arugula
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, anchovies, coconut, cheese, and cream in a large bowl. Sprinkle yeast over cheese and sour cream mixture. Gradually add grand marnier. Transfer to a large bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Just prior to serving, add arugula. Cover and let sit 5 minutes to wilt greens. Toss with french dressing.

title: Sukiyaki-Dipped Raspberries With Cucumber Spread
ingredients: 2 lebanese cucumbers | 50 g raspberries | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or curry powder of your choice ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Cut cucumbers in small pieces and boil until soft. Set aside until needed. Drain cucumbers through a fine sieve or cheesecloth lined with a tea towel. Reserve half of the cucumbers and discard remainder. Place raspberries in blender and pulse until finely chopped. Add cucumber and curry powder and pulse until mixed and chopped together. Add vanilla and mix until combined. Spoon mixture onto a serving plate and cover with remaining cucumber halves. Note to split or split your recipe, place raspberries in a microwave and heat on high for 1 minute, or until soft. Spread raspberries on a plate and set aside. Place curry powder and curry powder in a mortar and pound them into a pestle and mortar. Remove raspberries from microwave and stir into curry powder in mortar and pestle. Return raspberries to microwave and mix until blended. Spoon raspberry mixture into a bowl and add 1 - 2 tablespoons of water if mixture is too dry. Allow mixture to cool to room temperature. Serve with dipping bread. Note, you can use a lemonade/splenda/vanilla syrup if you prefer.

title: Green Curry With Swiss Chard and Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups swiss chard, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons reduced fat sour coconut, grated
instructions: Cook the chard in a large saucepan of boiling water for 2 minutes or until tender. Remove the chard. Add the chard, bell pepper, basil and sour coconut to the pan. Reduce the heat to medium low. Stirring constantly, cook the mixture for 5 to 10 minutes or until the chard is heated through.

title: Spicy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 24 jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Wash and core the jalapenos. Slice them into long strips, about 1/4 inch long. Remove the stem from the peppers and slit them vertically in half, or just slit it a little bit, to make them easier to remove later. Fill a saucepan about 1/3 full of water. Bring to a boil. Place half of the jalapeno strips in a plastic bag and freeze on top of the water. Remove from freezer about 1 hour before the sauce is finished freezing. Add the tomato paste and pulse about 3 times, to break up as much as possible. Stir in the remaining jalapenos and pecorino cheese. Continue to stir until the desired thickness is achieved and the sauce is smooth. Keep the sauce heated over low heat until ready to use.

title: Hot Coriander Tomato Salad With Tomatoes & Arugula
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes | 4 cups arugula | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 cups bottled oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half and remove outer pith, then cut each half into 8 wedges, then cut each wedge in half again. Cut arugula crosswise into about 1 inch lengths and chop coarsely. Drain the tomatoes, reserving the liquid, and chop coarsely. Set aside a few tablespoons of tomato juices for dressing. Combine the mustard seeds and corriander in a small nonreactive skillet and set over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mustard seeds turn golden brown. Add the oil in a slow, steady stream. Cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Add the oyster sauce, seasoning salt, and reserved tomato liquid and stir. Bring to a boil. Cook 5 minutes, stirring all the while, to thicken. Immediately place under running water and let cool to room temperature. Stir into dressing. Toss warm arugula with tomato dressing in a large bowl. Spoon dressing over tomato salad and sprinkle with coriander seeds.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,starch,self rising flour,red chili powder,chicken leg,ramen noodle,lime zest
title: Szechwan Chicken Legs in Chili Lime
ingredients: 12 chicken legs ( can use breast or drumstick ) | 3 inches piece fresh lime zest, 4 strips | 3 inches piece fresh lime zest, 4 strips | 1 1/2 lbs self rising flour, sifted with flour | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 3 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 -2 tablespoon hot red chili pepper flakes
instructions: In mixing bowl place chicken legs, zest strips, and half the lime zest. Then add the flour, 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes, and 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder. Mix and then knead well. Place mixture on plate, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat a heavy skillet and cook the chicken until golden on all sides. Remove chicken and drain fat. Reserve chicken juices in skillet. To skillet add reserved juices, red chili flakes, and corn oil and sauté on medium heat until thick. Serve chicken for dipping. Note, for the dipping sauce, i usually just coat the chicken legs with 3 tablespoons of cornstarch, then dip them into the flour. This makes them more manageable.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,bay leaf,palm sugar,cauliflower floret,scotch,simple syrup
title: Thai Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 7 cups beef stock | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons simple syrup ( or honey ) | 1 tablespoon palm sugar ( or brown sugar substitute ) | 1 cauliflower floret, broken into florets
instructions: Bring the stock to a simmer in a large saucepan over high heat. Add the bay leaves and nutmeg and simmer 1 minute while gradually adding the syrup and sugar. Simmer until the cauliflower is tender. Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with the remaining bay leaves. Serve with a variety of dipping sauces such as coconut milk, sweet papadums and other nuoc cham.

title: Grilled Pear and Bacon Suet
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced canadian bacon | 1/2 lb sliced beef suet | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1 pears, cored and sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients into an electric skillet and cook on high for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens slightly. Spray a large sheet pan or cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons of the sauce on to the centre of the sauteed bacon. Place pear slices on top and serve warm.

title: Italian Tomato and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, broken asparagus | 1 1/4 cups plain greek yogurt | 10 ounces baby spinach, torn | 1 plum tomato, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons pickled cucumbers, wedges | 1/4 lb asparagus, cooked and rinsed, tips trimmed ( can sub green beans )
instructions: Mix together the greek yogurt, spinach, tomato, cucumber and asparagus and divide salad among 4 serving plates. Garnish with cucumber wedges.

Random Ingredients: spinach,head lettuce,rice noodle,worcestershire sauce,chicken bouillon cube,apricot jam,liquid smoke,green chili pepper
title: Garlic Noodles (Asian)
ingredients: 9 ounces rice noodles, thin | 14 ounces chopped green chili peppers | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 head lettuce, washed
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions, or follow package instructions. While noodles are boiling, chop green chilis. Drain rice noodles, leaving 1/4 cup liquid in pot, or alternatively, rinse noodles & rinse in cold water using a colander. Drain and put in a large bowl. Dice chilis. Add to bowl with noodles. Dissolve 2 bouillon cubes in 1 cup water, add to noodle mixture. Stir well. Add in undrained spinach or other greens. Stir well. To serve, place on platter with lettuce leaves and shredded or sliced hard boiled egg on top. If desired, drizzle with a bit more of the liquid smoke.

title: Hot and Spicy Curd
ingredients: 1 head garlic, peeled and sliced crosswise into half | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons brandy, sauce | 2 fluid ounces strong black coffee, hot
instructions: Place sliced garlic in a saucepan with the vinegar. Cover and bring to a boil. Cook over medium low heat for 10 minutes. Remove garlic with a slotted spoon and place garlic in a bowl. Stir in brandy sauce. Add hot coffee and stir until well mixed. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,red pepper flake,crescent dinner,anise seed,thyme leaf,vanilla,greek yogurt
title: Danish Kebabs
ingredients: 8 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon finely crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, toasted | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: Cut the rolls in half lengthwise, and seal the seams. Open the cans of rolls and put in medium sized ziploc bag, add in the yogurt, the red peppers, thyme, aniseed, red pepper flakes, and dill pickles. Chill until ready to use. If grilling, preheat grill to high with the rack in the middle. Brush each kebab with a teaspoon of yogurt mixture and cook kebabs 3 to 4 minutes per side or until browned.

title: Brown Rice Salad With Blue Cheese, Apricots & Apricots
ingredients: 4 cups cooked short or short grain brown rice | 2 oranges, juice of | 1 lemon, juice of | 100 g blue cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup thinly sliced apricot, chopped
instructions: Mix the rice, oranges and lemon juice in a bowl. Add the crumbled cheese and apricots, mix well. Taste and correct if desired, then serve.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,snow pea,tomato sauce,baking soda,chocolate,habanero pepper
title: Korean Noodles With Snow Peas and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb dry bow tie pasta | 4 ounces sweet unsweetened chocolate | 1/2 cup snow peas, halved ( or more if desired ) | 4 tablespoons tomato sauce ( kimchi ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda ( or use your favorite baking soda ) | 1 habanero pepper ( seeded and finely chopped ( wear rubber gloves for safety )
instructions: Boil pasta for 4 minutes or until tender. Drain. Transfer to bowl of ice water. Microwave chocolate until completely melted together, then set aside to cool to room temperature. While still warm, stir in other sauce ingredients. Stir until well blended and set aside to cool to room temperature. Scoop enough sauce into pasta bowl to cover, then cover with plastic wrap, then chill until ready to serve. Sushi.

title: Homemade Porcini
ingredients: 8 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1/4 cup coffee or 1/4 cup espresso, diluted with | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Soak mushrooms in the coffee or espresso water for 2 days, then squeeze out excess water. Rinse mushrooms under running water, and slice in half if they are larger, use a mortar and pestle. Place mushrooms in a plastic bag and add the dissolved coffee/coffee mixture. Close tightly, and store in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Penne With Chicken and Peppers
ingredients: 2 ounces penne ( or other dried pasta ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken, cut in bite sized chunks
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Meanwhile, place chicken and peppers in microwave safe dish combine all ingredients. Cover, cook on high 2 to 3 minutes, turn off, and set aside. Drain pasta, reserving pasta water. Stir pasta and veggies in skillet in microwave. Heat through, and serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,red enchilada sauce,mint,cider vinegar,porridge oat
title: Rice-Oat Risotto
ingredients: 4 ounces porridge oats | 3 ounces arborio rice | 1 ounce caster vinegar | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 9 ounces fresh mint
instructions: Scoop the porridge oats into small saucepan on the hob and place over a medium heat. Stir until they begin to give off a nutty aroma. It’s not rocket science but you can try to press them as much as possible back into the hot porridge oats. Turn the heat down and place in a warm oven to bring it to a simmer. Cook for 10 minutes. Rinse and drain the porridge oats. Melt the caster vinegar and stir in the enchilada sauce. Drain the porridge oats and transfer them to a bowl. Add the roasted oats and most of the mint to the bowl. Mix thoroughly together and leave to stand for a few hours before serving, until flavors are well absorbed.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 150 g creamy peanut butter | 1 dash angostura bitters
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. If not using right away, store in a airtight container. Makes around 3 to 4 bars. Note, this will vary depending on the size of your peanut butter bars.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,yellow onion,sesame seed,beef bouillon granule
title: Easy, Whole, Simple Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef with oats | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 yellow onion, diced fine
instructions: Brown ground beef until very browned. While beef is cooking, pour taco seasoning and sesame seeds into a small bowl. Stir in onion and remove from heat. When beef is done, drain ground beef and put in a bowl. While beef is cool, mix olive oil and garlic powder in a small bowl, and stir until the meat will evenly coat. Mold the ground beef mixture into the bowl with the onion, and mix well. If there is too much filling to stuff, just add water to help it bind.

title: Feta Soup
ingredients: 2 pounds chopped feta | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 piece fresh ginger root
instructions: Place the feta, half and half, and ginger into a blender. Pulse until smooth, and pour into a large pot, or saucepan, to serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,cooking wine,sultana,white vinegar,cheese,broccoli,madeira wine
title: Gourmet Broccoli Salad Con Broccoli
ingredients: 5 ounces broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup sultanas or 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons cooking wine | 1 -2 slice cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill for 1 hour. Arrange on serving platter.

title: Cumin Dip
ingredients: 1 bag mexicorn | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Drain mexican corn in colander, then rinse in warm water. Pat dry with towel. Place on cookie sheet or pizza pan and toast in oven at 550 degrees fahrenheit for 10 - 12 minutes if using a convection oven, about 10 minutes. While the corn is roasting, combine catup, vinegar and lemon juice in a microwavable bowl and microwave on high about 40 seconds or till hot and bubbly. Remove from microwave and place in a bowl. Pour hot mixture over corn. Sprinkle with cumin. Serve with crackers or enjoy as is, or with vegetables for scooping and eating. Note, to thaw, mix well drained corn in a baggie with a little bit of water or broth. If you prefer a smoother flavor, stir in more catsup.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,peanut oil,green curry paste,seasoning salt,canadian bacon,cheddar cheese soup,italian salad dressing
title: Bacon Cheesy Broccoli and Bacon
ingredients: 2 cups finely diced bacon, cooked | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 bunch broccoli floret, cut into fourths ( about 4 cups ) | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon pieces, diced | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp, bacon grease drips off, and crumble. Set aside and keep warm while making the other sauce. Heat peanut oil in saucepan and brown broccoli about 2 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients except the salad dressing and fry until heated through. Place in bowl and top with bacon.

title: Celtic Aioli
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup celtic aioli dipping sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cotija cheese
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Let sit at room temperature for 2 hours before using as a dip for vegetables etc.

Random Ingredients: chuck,red onion,serrano chili,rotel tomato chilies,peppercorn,cocoa,coriander powder
title: Taco Meat
ingredients: 3 lbs ground chuck | 1 -2 teaspoon whole coriander powder | 8 ounces chopped red onions | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 10 -15 peppercorns, crushed | 1 serrano chili, chopped | 3 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies
instructions: Drain ground chuck and shred with your hand. Set aside. In a large cast iron skillet, add coriander powder, onions, cocoa, peppercorns, serrano chili, and beef. Cook over medium heat until spices are soft and meat is crumbly. Drain off excess grease, if necessary, and break up meat with back of a spoon. Add undrained tomatoes and chilli. Simmer, covered, for an hour to two hours.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chili powder,pea,bean sprout,serrano chilies,white onion,chicken meat
title: Quickie Fried Rice Noodles With Chicken and Peas
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles ( rice sticks ) | 1 can fat-free refried beans with chili and beans | 1 small white onion, chopped | 2 -3 serrano chilies, seeded | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 lb cooked chicken meat
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, spread the beans on paper towels to soak up grease. Heat the refried beans to medium, and saute the onion and serrano peppers until soft. Remove from the heat and set aside. In another skillet over medium heat, warm the chili powder until fragrant. Stir the chili powder into the refried beans until mostly absorbed, and then set aside. In the same skillet, put the chicken meat along with about 1/3 of the chili powder and the peas into the skillet, stir until heated through. Put noodles into a bowl, pour about half the warm chili bean water over the noodles, and toss to combine. Set the rice noodles aside and keep warm. Add the rest of the chili bean water to the skillet and return to the heat. When the hot chili comes to the boil, pour in the noodles and spread the noodles with the chicken and onion mixture. Serve and enjoy.

title: Smokey Chipotle Beef (For a Crowd)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck or 3 lbs round roast | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chipotle chiles | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 apple ( peeled and cut in wedges )
instructions: Boil chuck meat until tender. Then shred with a fork. You should have about 1 1/4 cups for every pound of meat. Save broth. Then add the rest of the ingredients to the broth and simmer until thickened. Add cubed beef and simmer until meat is hot and flavors are blended. Serve over rice.

title: Grilled Chicken Rolls With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced | 4 chicken breasts | 1/2 cup vinegar | 4 slices prosciutto, thin slices
instructions: Place the 1/2 lb prosciutto slices on a flat surface, place each chicken breast onto the prosciutto. Pull each chicken breast down into the prosciutto, firmly pressing the prosciutto and proscuitto into the chicken. With a sharp knife, score each chicken breast half at 1 inch intervals. Set aside at least 1 slice of prosciutto per breast. Repeat this procedure with the remaining prosciutto, placing the prosciutto slices on top of each, and then using your fingers, gently push 1 or 2 slices of prosciutto under each chicken breast to make a patty. Place the 2 prosciutto wrapped chicken breast onto the grill and grill for about 10 minutes on each side, or until done. Remove the chicken from the grill and let stand for a few minutes, then slice thinly.

title: Rajma
ingredients: 2 tablespoons safflower oil | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons vodka | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a small saucepan set over medium low heat. Add the pomegranate seeds and mustard seeds.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Tagine
ingredients: 12 large eggplants, peeled and cut on the bottom of the eggplant | 2 -4 cups vegetable broth ( or water ) | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats
instructions: Place the eggplant in a colander, wash and dry with paper towels. Place the pieces on a rack over a baking pan of slightly salted water, cover and sweat for about an hour, stirring occasionally, until the flesh turns a coarse green skin and tender. Set the pieces aside. Heat the oven to 400°f put the oats in a shallow bowl, put a plate on top to weigh it and put the baking pan upside down on the oven rack. Warm the broth in a small saucepan. Remove the eggplant from the pan, rinse it under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place the eggplants, a small amount at a time, on top of the oats. Do not turn or flip the pieces. Place the pan over moderate heat for about 15 minutes until the liquid evaporates. Add more broth if you feel necessary. Pour the broth over the eggplant and serve.

title: Mom's Spinach Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Combine uncooked spinach, won ton wrappers, and fontina cheese in a large pot. Heat to boiling, stirring often.

title: Tracelett
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | lettuce leaves ( about 8 cups )
instructions: Combine cream of tarragon and tartar in small bowl or pie dish. Line rimmed baking sheet with lettuce leaves. Spoon tarragon cream over leaves. Sprinkle with a little of the reserved chopped tartar. Bake at 350°f until lightly browned and slightly softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove and let stand about 5 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title:
Mexican Nachos With D.
    -C.
    - Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice, uncooked | 1/3 cup canned bean sprouts | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon lime juice ( optional ) | 1/2 cup salsa ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat beans for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse rice with cold water. Place rice in strainer set over bowl and toss with bean sprouts and cilantro. Toss with rice. Top with cottage cheese. Chill for 30 minutes. Squeeze lime over top. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: greek salad dressing,chive,tamari,chinese five spice powder
title: Lebanese Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried chives | 1 1/4 cups greek salad dressing | 3 tablespoons tamari ( japanese soy sauce ) | 1 tsp chinese five spice powder
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Parsley Glazed Oranges
ingredients: 5 oranges bell peppers, halved and seeded | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat over to 450 degrees f. Put pepper halves, cut side down, in a skillet with enough water to cover them. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Boil for 15 minutes. Drain water and pepper. Combine glaze with peppers and nuts.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,rom tomato,green cardamom pod,crescent dinner
title: Spiced Tomato-Cinnamon Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup roma tomato, peeled chopped finely | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc. Grease a deep, large baking tray. Separate the crescent rolls and place in the centre of the tray. Toss the sugar and chopped tomato in a large bowl and season with cardamom and seasoning, remembering to season all the way through. Roll the crescent rolls in the tomato mixture, then place on the tray. Bake for about 25 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool completely and transfer to a tea towel if liked. Serve cut into small triangles when ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: beet,fettuccini noodle,cumin seed,apricot jam,italian breadcrumb,mint leaf,soymilk
title: Chef Bevsky's Fettuccini Beetroot and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 400 g canned beets | 1/2 cup dried apricot jam | 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 cup low-fat soymilk | 16 ounces fettuccini noodles, cooked
instructions: Grate raw beets with peel if any large ones remain attached.

title: Glazed Balsamic-Glazed Balsamic Doves
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Whisk egg yolk with vinegar and oil in a bowl. Brush tops with glaze. Place on a greased baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Oyster Butter
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, cream butter and oyster sauce together. Mix in half of the italian herbs and the baking soda. Stir in the remaining herbs. Pour mixture into prepared baking sheet. Using the back of a spoon, spread to coat evenly. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Stir and bake until golden.

title: Marjoram and Onion (Poppy Seed) Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces poppy seeds | 1 ounce marjoram, chopped | 2 ounces tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions:
In a blender add all the ingredients and blend until smooth. Chill for 1 hours in the fridge before using. Keeps up to 6 months. 
    -.

title: Swiss Veal Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1/4 lb veal ( sliced thin in a chiffonade ) | 1 tablespoon kosher salt ( or to taste ) | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. When it's ready, add the veal slices. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and hot sauce – if using. Let sear until the veal slices turn golden. Serve on a heated plate in a drizzling of the lovely gravy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,tomato green chilies,celery,french fry,corn oil,summer savory
title: French Fried Spicy  Sausages
ingredients: 6 -8 links french fries | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3 -4 stalks celery | 2 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon summer savory | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Cube french fries or fries and fry or let cool in frying pan, place in a 2 quart casserole dish. Cut celery in small peices. Mix all other ingredients and pour over fries and celery. Cover with foil, bake at 375f degrees for about 45 minutes or until tender. Serve warm.

title: Sopa De Bueno
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 cup cocoa | sugar | cheesecloth
instructions: Soak the rice in water for 3 hours. Drain. Dry thoroughly. Add 2 cups of water and 1/3 cup of sugar. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, rice. Strain and discard the rice. Put in microwave and cook on high for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching. Remove from the heat and cool. Cover and store in the refrigerator for 4 days. Shake the rice after 2 days. The longer it sets the more you can handle it. You can also refrigerate it for 5 days. When ready to serve, sprinkle sugar and 1 tablespoon of cocoa in hot soup and stir. Ladle into soup bowls and serve. You can also add more cocoa to taste.

title: Gram Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 5 dried black peppercorns | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Crush peppercorns and rub into flour. Add cayenne pepper and roll into ball with the palms of your hands. Cut in half width ways. Heat a griddle on gas mk 4 until very hot. Cook on a 1/2 tsp side until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Variation, use 2 tsp of baking powder, 1 tsp of baking powder, 1 tsp cayenne, 4 tsp of rosemary, 4 tsp of nutmeg. For extra spice add cinnamon to spices. Also replace cayenne in the recipe.

title: Rump Roast Sandwiches With Caramelized Cheese and White Wine
ingredients: 1 rump roast ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons ice water | white wine ( for dipping )
instructions: Trim fat from rump roast and cut into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece in ghee, then coat evenly with the meat drippings. Heat oven to 300°f. Place the sandwiches on a baking sheet or large shallow roasting pan fat side down. Place the foiled pan in the oven just before serving and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender and the meat thermometer reads 125°f when inserted into the thickest part of the leg. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes, then slice meat into thin slices.

title: Homemade Kahlua
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Put cinnamon in the palm of your hand. Rub the palm with kahlua and rub until thoroughly coated. Add the ibrik, or the rest of the recipe. Use with your favorite coffee.

title: Plum Tomatoes with Thyme
ingredients: 16 plum tomatoes ( about 2 1/2 lbs ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, fresh | 1/8 teaspoon fresh thyme, finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place tomatoes on a rimmed baking sheet and toss with the lemon juice. Brush tomatoes with oil and sprinkle with thyme. Roast until slightly golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,garlic salt,hot paprika,green pepper strip
title: Green Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 12 green pepper strips, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix paprika, bell pepper strips and garlic salt. Use a pastry brush to coat the tops and bottoms of the strips. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray, and set over medium high heat. Place the strips, flat side down, in the pan. Cook, stirring frequently until the strips are light brown on the edges, about 3 to 5 minutes. Using a spatula, carefully flip strips, reduce heat to medium low and cook, stirring frequently, until peppers are crisp and beginning to turn golden, about 3 minutes more. Spread green pepper strips in the skillet, and cook, stirring frequently, until crisp outside and tender crisp inside, about 3 minutes. Spread the green pepper strips on a dish to cool.

title: Chinese Greens and Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon fat | 2 bunches chinese chives | 1 package dried black beans, rinsed and drained | 10 ounces fresh kale, stems removed and leaves sliced into rings | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam, seedless
instructions: Melt the bacon fat in a heavy large skillet. Cut the chives in half and finely chop. Place the chives in a colander over a bowl and pour enough boiling water over to cover. Let drain for 30 minutes or so, then rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly. Set aside. Bring the beans to a boil in water and cook for about 3 minutes, or until tender. Add the kale and cook for a few minutes longer. Drain the greens thoroughly, then stir in the greens. Place in a serving bowl and drizzle on the jam.

title: Red Lobster's Southwest Grill Copycat
