ingredients: 16 ounces frozen limeade concentrate | 8 ounces enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 2 cup resealable plastic bag or resealable plastic bag. Close bag and shake in plastic until well mixed. Transfer contents of bag to crock of crock. Sauté on medium high in enchilada sauce until heated through, about 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kasuri methi,garlic herb seasoning,egg,coconut milk,flour tortilla
title: Crispy Scrambled Eggs in Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 egg | 1 packet garlic and herb seasoning blend, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon kasuri methi ( dry fenugreek leaves ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup plain sweetened coconut milk, or as needed | 12 large flour tortillas
instructions: Beat egg and garlic herb seasoning blend in a bowl until smooth. Fold in kasuri methi. Spread a heaping tablespoon of egg mixture onto one side of a tortilla and roll up, jelly roll style. Repeat with remaining tortillas and egg mixture, wrapping each tightly. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add olivia or other cooking spray.

title:
Coconut Thyme V.

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned tropical vegetable juice ( v14 coconut flavour ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 - 2 cups coconut cream
instructions: Mix together the v14, thyme, coconut cream, and salt. Simmer gently until reduced a little, about 5 minutes, stir a few times. Keep warm and serve.

title: Corn and Aniseed Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seed, crushed | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh aniseed, crushed | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/3 cup cognac
instructions: In small bowl, mix together and store in refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Polenta Rounds With Corn
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated all-purpose flour | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place flour in a bowl. Sprinkle the cheese in the flour, and stir gently to blend. Stir in corn with your hands, and pour into an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle pepper flakes on top now. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

title: Grape Beans and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups canned kidney beans | 1 pint grape, washed if desired ( they should not be rinsed )
instructions: Put 2 - 3 cups of fresh rinsed grape in the bottom of each of a large, well buttered baking or crockpot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover with foil.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cayenne pepper,summer savory,pernod,lemon juice zest,rosemary,crawfish tail,pork tenderloin
title: Lemon Roasted Pigfish
ingredients: 14 lbs pork tenderloin | 8 ounces pernod | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/3 cup pernod | 1/2 cup summer savory | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( i like more of this ) | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon dried summer savory | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | grated pecorino romano cheese for garnish
instructions: Slice the pork into 1 1/4 cubes, and place them in a large roasting pan. In a small saucepan, mix all ingredients together except the cheese. Put the pan in a cold oven and set to 300°f. Bake at 300°f for 40 - 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until the meat is tender. Uncovered, remove the pork from the pan, and drain the pan juices and place half the hot liquid in a pan. Mix together the reserved hot liquid with the lemon juice. Pour over the pork, and let stand. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Sprinkle the reserved cheese over the top of the pork. Return the pork to the roasting pan. Put a lid on the pan, and bake for another 10 minutes to allow the cheese bubbles to subside. After 10 minutes, remove the lid, and cook for another 10 minutes or until a thermometer reads 180f. Take the pan out of the oven, and let stand for approximately 10 minutes before serving.

title: Braised Lamb with Tomato Purée
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cubed leg of lamb | 2 cans tomato puree | 1 can beef stew meat
instructions: Rinse the lamb under cold water, then drain. Heat a large pot on high.

title: Pesto Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice | 1/3 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Place the rice and pesto in a skillet, and add 2 cups water. Bring to a boil, then cover, and reduce heat to simmer. Cook until the rice has absorbed all the water. Serve topped with your favorite cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,tilapia fillet,apple juice,pepperoncini pepper juice,beef steak
title: Apple Beef Rolls
ingredients: 4 apple slices | 4 tilapia fillets | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup pepperoncini pepper juice | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Prepare the dipping sauce,. In a small bowl, stir together the confectioners' sugar and pepperoncini.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,chicken bouillon cube,scallop,red chile,mango
title: Smokey Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb scallops | 1/2 lb mushroom | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 -5 drops liquid smoke flavoring | 1/4 finely julienned red chile
instructions: Cut scallops. Wash the mushrooms and pick them off. Cut or tear the chile into quarters. Place the mushrooms in the microwave in 1 tbsp. Oil. Add liquid smoke, chicken bouillon, and optional liquid flavoring to taste. Cook on high setting for 45 seconds or until done. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Drumsticks With Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 8 fresh chicken drumsticks ( with the bone ) | 8 fresh bamboo shoots ( sliced in half ) | 1 cup greek yogurt ( sour or nonfat, to taste ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley ( minced )
instructions: Wash and trim the chicken parts and arrange them on a large platter.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,water chestnut,beef chuck,cheddar cheese
title: Beef & Cheddar Cheese Filling for Mini Toads
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Line baking sheet with foil.

title: Apricot Tart  - Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed and chilled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the pastry to fit the tatin dish. Line the edge of the tatin dish with a circle of wax paper and set aside. Brush the pastry with beaten egg and sprinkle with some flour. Then with a few dabs of apricots. Brush the sides of the pastry with beaten egg and bake for 10 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: deep,hominy,worcestershire sauce,white flour,grain rice,plain yogurt,sesame seed,almond extract
title: Empanadas with Yogurt and Stove Top
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 2/3 cups whole grain rice ( long grain ) | worcestershire sauce, to taste | 1 can hominy, drained | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 3 3/4 cups frozen deep-frozen mixed pulses ( also called masa harina or masa harina ) | 2 cups flour | 1/4 cup warm plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Lightly oil 2 cookie sheets and set aside. Mix yogurt and sesame seeds in a bowl until smooth and creamy. Combine rice, worcestershire sauce and 1 1/3 c water in another bowl. Combine flour, 1 c water, hominy and almond extract in a large bowl and gradually blend into yogurt. Stir in rice mixture and pour into oiled cookie sheets. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with yoghurt.

title: French Bread Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 package spaghetti | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Open the package of french bread and cut it lengthwise in half lengthwise. If using whole loaf, cut it lenghtwise in half if using a regular loaf. Cut the crusts into 1/2 inch slices, then place them on baking sheet. Bake at 450f for 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,ziti pasta,lemon zest,sherry wine,asiago cheese,grain brown rice,white wine vinegar,paprika
title: Ziti With Ziti and Asiago
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup long grain brown rice | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons sherry wine, plus additional | sherry wine | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 2 cups grated asiago cheese | ziti pasta, cooked to al dente
instructions: Combine the flour, rice, vinegar, 2 t sherry, lemon zest and paprika in a medium bowl and stir to blend then set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Add 3 cups of the asiago cheese to the cooked and drained ziti and toss. Transfer to a 2 - 3 qt. Baking dish. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup asiago cheese. Bake in the hot oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Breads toasted Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet and bake until just toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately place on a towel. Remove all of the skins. Place hazelnuts on a clean towel and blot dry. Add poppy seeds to hazelnuts and pat until evenly covered. Place hazelnuts on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake until nuts become fragrant, about 10 minutes. Store in airtight container until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,kosher salt,red pepper flake,green bell pepper
title:
Grilled Peppers With Mustard.
    -
ingredients: 8 small green bell peppers | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons prepared yellow mustard ( must have a good grind ) | 1 -2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Prepare your grill. Lightly coat the peppers with the salt over a plate, just covering it. Place peppers on the grill, close the cover, and place them on the grill. Grill them for 15 minutes on each side, or until the peppers are charred, bubbly and blackest. Remove from the grill. While the peppers are still warm, drizzle with a little more mustard and sprinkle with red pepper flakes and serve warm.

title: Pork Sausage With Mango Marsala
ingredients: 2 large peeled papaya sweet potatoes | 1 large mango | 2 ounces pine nuts | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground aniseed | 4 -6 ounces pork sausage | 4 tablespoons marsala wine
instructions: Prepare sweet potato according to package instructions.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,plain flour,pesto sauce,white bean,yellow onion,mango powder
title: White Bean Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup pure pesto sauce | 1/4 cup plain flour | 2 cups cooked white beans | 1/4 cup canned white beans | 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds or 1 teaspoon ground dried mango powder | 2 teaspoons tomato passata or 2 teaspoons mango powder ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Pour sauce over cooked white beans and bake at 190ºc /375ºf/gas 4 for 1 hour. Serve warm with crusty bread.

title: Pistachio Spinach Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup macaroni | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed and drained | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pistachios or 1 teaspoon almonds | 1 leaf fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Prepare macaroni per package directions, omitting salt as called for in soy milk. Drain and rinse in cold water. Drain well and set aside. Heat oven to 375°f. In 2 quart casserole dish, mix all ingredients except spinach. Cover and bake 50 minutes or more. Stir and bake 25 minutes or until heated throughout. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.

title: Baby Finger Food Dogs With French Fries
ingredients: 1 lb french fries | 7 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 3 -4 tablespoons whole meal flour | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a bowl mix french fries and cheese. Add flour and almonds to form crumbs. Drop by small tablespoonfuls onto parchment paper lined baking sheets, sprinkle with remaining cheese, place in oven for 20 minutes.

title: Easiest Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 can cornbread | 1 package sazon goya | 2 cups brown rice | 4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup ice cream, melted
instructions: Place cornbread in a large bowl. Set aside. In a separate bowl, stir together sazon goya, rice and 4 cups of flour. Mix well and then stir through the cornbread mixture. Make sure all the dry ingredients are completely blended into the liquid. Form into 1 inch balls and place on a cookie sheet. Roll in melted ice cream, and then either cook in the oven or bake on an oven rack in a 375 degree oven for about 15 minutes. They will be golden brown.

title: Pasta Sauce With Italian Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut thinly into pieces | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 2 poblano chiles, roasted with or without seeds | 1/4 cup vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon olive oil | dry yeast | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the dried dough ingredients. When sauce is starting to bubble, strain out the seeds. Sprinkle the pieces of veal with the dry yeast. Place in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer until veal is tender, approximately 2 hours. Cool and transfer to jars. Refrigerate for up to a month.

title: Tofu, Lima Bean and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground meat | 1 1/2 cups lima beans | 1/2 cup chopped italian bread | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Slice up the tofu 1/2 inch thick and line a baking pan with the tofu. Place on a cookie sheet or tray lined with parchment paper and bake at 375 degrees, checking often to make sure they are firm but not watery. Cut tofu into 1/2 slices and in a food processor, combine everything and pulse until creamy. Drain the tofu, reserving liquid, and place tofu on a paper towel lined plate to dry. Return skillet to oven and bake tofu, uncovered, at 350 for 10 minutes. While it is baking, prepare beans and meatballs. Place beans and meat in a saucepan, cover with just enough water and a pinch of sugar to cover, and simmer until beans are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir well, let cool, then stir in cooked tofu. Serve topped with chopped italian style bread or croutons or lettuce.

title: Orange Peel Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin tip steaks | 1 large orange, zested and cut into wedges
instructions: Rinse steak well under cold water.

title: Irish Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh mint | 3 tablespoons slivered almonds | 4 fresh mint leaves, julienned
instructions: Place the whiskey in a medium size skillet over moderate heat. Add the hard boiled eggs, mint and chopped nuts and continue to cook for 4 minutes. Break the whites into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes or just until the whites have set. Break the uncooked scrambled eggs into the skillet and toss to toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: polish sausage,chinese cabbage,potato traditional,sage,raspberry jam,lime wedge
title: Thick Sausage Crunch
ingredients: 3 links polish sausage, thinly sliced | 1 large potato, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 chinese cabbage, shredded ( about 30 slices-i grate the cabbage leaves to measure ) | 2 teaspoons fresh sage, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon jam, depending on how sweet you want it | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: In a large skillet over medium low heat, cook the sausage slices until slightly browned. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add the potato slices to the same skillet and cover. Cook, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, for 5 minutes. Uncover the skillet if the sausage is starting to stick and brown, cover and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside. Place cabbage on a plate, and sprinkle with sage. Sprinkle sausage on top. Heat the jam and lime juice in the skillet. Drizzle over the sausage mixture and garnish with slices of the lime. Serve hot. If possible, allow guests to make up the amount of sausage according to their liking, but it may be easier to arrange them on individual plates and place the sausage, potato, cabbage and sausage in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: salt,half canning ring,red bell pepper,meat,almond,mango chutney
title: Mango Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 cups mango chutney | 1 1/2 cups cooked meat | 1/2 cup almonds, sliced | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half canning ring, lids included | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: In food processor, puree all ingredients until smooth. Spoon into jars, refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before use.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,stewing beef,greek yogurt,water,cornstarch,tia maria,raspberry,black peppercorn
title: Beef and Blackberry Sauce--Inspired by Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cubed | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 pint sunflower seedless raspberry | 1 cup water | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Marinate beef in 1 cup sunflower seeds, tomato paste and 1/2 cup water overnight. Place on broiler tray and broil 30 - 35 minutes, turning or basting with leftover marinade, until beef is cooked.

Random Ingredients: tonic water,egg white,bay leaf,walnut oil,papaya,cannellini bean
title: Walnut Nigella's Tortilla Espanola
ingredients: 30 g walnut oil | 40 g tinola cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 medium size papaya ( small dice ) | 140 g fried egg whites | 200 ml tonic water | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Heat walnut oil in fry pan add diced papaya. Wait for it to turn soft. Add fried egg whites and fry to a white color. Pour in tonic water and add bay leaf. Let it all mix into a smooth, uniform texture. Turn onto plate and enjoy.

title: Creamy Haloumi and Butternut Squash Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into chunks | oil, for frying | 3 ounces halloumi cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes ( or any other thick cut cut cheese you like ) | 2 ounces baked beans | 8 ounces cooked chicken quarters, roughly chopped ( or grilled chicken ) | 1/3 cup plain lowfat greek yogurt, to serve
instructions: Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Cook squash in batches until golden brown. Remove and set aside. Heat remaining oil and cook halloumi until golden brown, adding beans and chicken meat last. Layer ham, butternut squash and cheese in a buttered shallow ovenproof dish. Top with yoghurt. Bake, uncovered, in a moderate oven 35 - 40 minutes until heated through and golden brown.

title: Worcestershire Oven Baked Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 cup shredded yellow onion
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spray the asparagus with oil and toss lightly. Spray with oil again and put in the oven. Cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce and toss well to coat. Sprinkle with onion.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,vegetarian sausage,coconut cream,ranch bean,apple,taco shell
title: Apple & Coconut Spaghetti Tacos
ingredients: 8 taco shells | 1 apple, peeled, cored & finely chopped | 1 can vegetarian sausages ( or kangaroo, etc.| ) | 3/4 cup coconut cream ( fat free if the fat free cream of coconut is not available ) | 1 can ranch style beans ( rinsed & drained ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Cook the sausage in a non stick pan just until the fat is no longer visible. Drain off any excess fat. Add coconut cream & beans & heat through. Add the spaghetti sauce and stir till warm throughout.

Random Ingredients: grey poupon dijon mustard,great northern bean
title: Crock Pot Favorite Beans
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans navy beans, drained | 1/2 cup grey poupon dijon mustard
instructions: Place beans in crock pot with mustard. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove lid and stir. Replace lid and cook on high for 45 minutes more. Turn crock pot to high and cook on high for about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,kosher salt pepper,sun tomato oil,rom tomato,thai red curry paste
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Wraps
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 -3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 whole roma tomato | 1 -2 tablespoon thai red curry paste | kosher salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Roll out the frozen puff pastry sheets on a lightly floured work surface. Cut rounds with a 1 round cutter and transfer the rounds to a large platter or pizza crust tray that has been sprayed with pam. Tightly fit the rounds into the tart pans with the paper rounds.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,baking powder,hot water,chicken drumstick,panko breadcrumb,italian parsley,marsala wine
title: Chef John's Chicken Legs and Rice Noodle Pies
ingredients: 2 chicken drumsticks, skin removed | 1/2 cup hot water | 1/2 cup rice vermicelli, broken into bite-size pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons marsala wine
instructions: Pour chicken thigh and water into a bowl. Cover and allow to sit for 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, soak rice vermicelli in a bowl of warm water. Drain well. Remove chicken from water and pat dry. Place chicken and vermicelli in the bowl with hot water. Stir to coat. Sprinkle baking powder on a plate. Place panko, parsley, and marsala in a separate plate. Dredge chicken in panko. Place chicken in panko mixture, and shake off excess. Transfer coated chicken to paper towels. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken legs in a baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy and browned, about 1 hour.

title: Quick Scallops and Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb fresh scallops ( or use frozen, thawed ) | 1 head cabbage, shredded or chopped ( 1 1/4 cups ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 cup dried basil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup brown sugar or 1/4 cup turbinado sugar
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Add cabbage and cook for 3 minutes. Taste cabbage for tenderness. Remove cabbage to separate bowl. Combine applesauce, basil and oregano in bowl with cabbage tossing well. Add 1/4 cup sugar and toss to coat salad. Put salad on platter and top with cabbage and sprinkle with remaining sugar. Enjoy.

title: Coffee Jack
ingredients: 1 beef shank | 1 ounce butterscotch schnapps | 1/2 ounce dry instant beef shank, soaked in water
instructions: Place the beef shank in a large heavy saucepan. Pour 1 ounce of butterscotch schnapps and 1/2 of instant beef shank into a small bowl. Set aside in a warm place, away from direct sunlight, just until the beef shank becomes saturated with the butterscotch schnapps. Heat the remaining butterscotch schnapps and the second 1/2 of instant beef shank together in a double boiler over very low heat until the foam subsides, stirring now and then, especially with a metal spoon. Place the beef shank in the top of the simmering schnapps, and skim any foam from the top. Cover and braise in a preheated 325 f degree oven until tender, 2 - 2 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours. Pour off the cream accumulated fat, if any, and slice thinly. Serve with a side of potato sticks.

title: Crock Pot Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 2 ounces tequila | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Drain beans and put in crock pot. Add 1/4 cup of shredded cheese over top of beans. Add 2 - 3 teaspoons of tequila on top of cheese. Cook on low. Note, this seems like an overwhelming recipe if you are not used to eating it all the way to the end. Also, i can't imagine why some of the cheeses not being melted and not being added. When done, stir and serve. Some people top with sour cream if they like.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,cilantro leaf,taco seasoning mix,palm oil,ice cube,cornmeal,chocolate chip,red leaf lettuce
title: Taco Salad III
ingredients: 2 cups shredded iceberg red leaf lettuce | 1 cup crumbled semisweet chocolate chips | 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 cup cornmeal | 2 cups ice cubes | 1/4 cup palm oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lettuce, chocolate chips, pepperoncini peppers, cilantro and taco seasoning. Combine the cornmeal and ice cubes in a second bowl. Drizzle palm oil evenly over the cornmeal mixture while shaking the bowl in the freezer until slightly solid. Stir in the cornmeal mixture. Spoon dressing over greens, toss, and serve.

title: Guilt-Free Refresher Style Vinegar Salad from Chile Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 3 oranges
instructions: Juice oranges, remove peel and pith. Cut juice into sections, peel oranges and pith. Add orange sections back into juice to make 1 1/2 cups of juice. Sugar may be sprinkled on top. Keep refrigerated. Note, you can also add 4 tbsp sugar to a champagne vinaigrette to moisten.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,golden syrup,baby bella mushroom,beet,farfalle pasta,cauliflower floret,garlic salt
title:
St.
    - Brenden's Day Spuds
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 small beet ( about 1/3 lb ) | 4 ounces mixed baby bella mushrooms | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 7 ounces cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Start a large pot of salted water to boil. Break the bella mushrooms into chunks about 1/4 wide and 1/2 thick. Bring to a boil and set aside. Cut a lengthwise slit through the bella mushroom stems and discard. Slice the caps into about 1/4 thick slices and set aside. Cook the pasta, drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking toss the cauliflower with oil and a small pinch of salt in a large bowl. Add to the hot water and cook the cauliflower until barely tender, stirring a couple of times. Drain the pasta then toss with beefsteak sauce. Place the bella mushrooms on a large platter, pour beefsteak sauce over them and top with bella mushroom slices. Combine all the ingredients for the golden syrup in an 8 inch skillet and begin heating over high heat. As soon as the bubbles subside, pour the glaze over the mushrooms and beefsteak sauce and set aside to warm.

title: The English Rose's Wine Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast, in one ball | 1 fluid ounce red wine | 1 red onion, diced | 1 tablespoon marmalade, of your choice ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and 1 oz of wine. Add a 1 oz of red onion and 1/2 oz of marmalade and mix together well and put in a greased loaf pan and put in the fridge to rise. After 15 minutes it's ready to be taken out and placed on a baking pan under a hot grill. It will be bubbly and will be very tasty when the bread is ready. This can be topped with a little cream or honey and grated parmesan cheese on top or on top of the bread. Delicious i like this with sauteed carrots, onions and leeks. Happy baking.

title: Tofu and Apricot Wrap
ingredients: 100 g tofu, cut into 8 equal pieces | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube | 50 g dried apricots | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 romaine lettuce | 16 slices bread
instructions: Place tofu slices on a plate, with a side of paper towel and cover with extra paper towels. Soak tofu until the water is drained and completely changing its texture, at least 20 minutes. Drain tofu on paper towels and arrange on a tray with a side of paper towel and a hand towel. Heat up your chicken bouillon in a microwave oven or on a stove top. Stir in the apricots, paprika and half the romaine. When the water is nearly gone, arrange the tofu slices by overlapping them with one end overlapping the tofu side of the plate over the tofu slices. Put a piece of crusty bread alongside and press lightly. Slice into pieces, and wrap with the remaining romaine lettuce.

Random Ingredients: pecan,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,fillet cod,ziti pasta,mint sauce,sesame oil,lamb stew meat,meat
title: Slow Cooker Baked Whole Foods Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 large ziti pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 pound sliced top round lamb stew meat | chopped fresh mint sauce | 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups dry meat broth | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 leaves fresh mint sauce
instructions: In a 2 quart slow cooker, toss the ziti and pecans with the contents of the slow cooker's seasoning packet. Arrange the meat over the ziti mixture to just cover. In a blender or food processor, chop 1/2 chipotle pepper into half a chile. Heat the skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir the chile mixture in the skillet until warm, about 2 minutes. Transfer the mixture in the slow cooker to the slow cooker. Stir in the broth. Cover, and cook on low for 7 hours. Stir in the sesame oil. Remove the lid, stir in the mint sauce, and heat through.

title: Hogkit a L'ail
ingredients: 6 thick slices bacon, cut in half | 4 lamb chops
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the bacon pieces in a large, deep frying pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Drain off the bacon fat, but leave enough bacon fat in the pan to cook the lamb chops. Add more bacon fat to the pan to keep them moist. Place the lamb chops in the pan one at a time and brown on both sides. Place in a baking dish, cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Turn the chops over and bake for 15 minutes more. Check after 15 minutes and make sure there is enough liquid to keep from burning. Spoon the reserved bacon fat into a saucepan and gently heat it over low heat, whisking constantly. Pour into a bowl and serve with the lamb chops.

title: Cheater's Easy Garlic & White Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 lb navy beans, rinsed and drained | 12 -18 lasagna noodles, cooked as per package directions on box ( about 24 noodles ) | hoagie rolls, for serving
instructions: Preheat over to 450 degrees. Place the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Lightly brown the bean, if using the canned beans, and drain off any excess oil. Set the beans in the skillet. To build the lasagna, spread about one third of the bean mash onto the bottom of a 10x11 inch casserole pan. Next add one or two more slices of the uncooked meatless side of the noodles. Spread about half the meatless side of the noodles. Add an additional third of the beans, meatless side of the noodles, and bean mash. Continue adding and topping until pan is 2 inches deep. Top with the remaining meatless side of the noodles. Bake until golden, about 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,tea,corn syrup,mustard seed,corn oil
title: Japanese Corn
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup loose ear dried tea | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seeds
instructions: In a saucepan, stir together the corn oil, light corn syrup, tea and mustard seeds until dissolved. Pour mixture into a small bowl. Dip each grain of soaked grain into the tea mixture to coat, shaking off excess. Grasp on skewers and cook over hot coals or on lightly oiled grill tops, turning once, until golden brown and the kernels are tender, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,red capsicum,white fish fillet,french bread italian,tomato ketchup,fennel seed,ginger syrup,green olive
title: BBQ Fish Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 firm white fish fillets ( australian ) | 4 slices french bread or 4 slices italian bread | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to cook | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh ginger syrup | 1 can condensed tomato ketchup | 1 small red capsicum, grated | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced
instructions: Preheat the grill, or bbq. Cut the fish fillets into 4 large slices. Place them on a greased large baking pan. Brush the fish with 1 tablespoon oil, and sprinkle with fennel seed, ginger syrup, tomato ketchup and capsicum. Bake for 10 minutes, or until cooked through. While the fish and sauces is grilling, cut the bread into 8 slices, and arrange bread slices on two plates, each with a small slice of tomato and a small slice of red capsicum and a small slice of green olives. Serve fish topped with the sandwich mixture.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Steak
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 4 1/2 lbs round roast | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 cup frozen orange section | 3 tablespoons tequila | 1 cup long grain rice, cooked
instructions:
Combine corn syrup, garlic powder, orange section, tequila, rice and 2 tablespoon of the corn syrup mixture in a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Place steak in slow cooker. Cook on low for 3 1/2 hours. 
    -. Remove steak to platter, and use a slotted spoon to remove juice from slow cooker. Pour all remaining juices from slow cooker into a small saucepan, and heat through. Serve steak on plate. Sprinkle steaks with additional remaining corn syrup mixture and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: bread french,baking soda,pearl barley,cream celery soup,cardamom,ziti pasta,cayenne pepper
title: Beefy Barley Soup With Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package other long pasta, uncooked | 10 ounces cream of celery soup | 3 cups hot buttered french-fried onions | 2 cups frozen pearl barley | 3 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Brown the ziti or other long pasta in a large pot of boiling water for about 7 minutes. Add to the soup. Heat on medium heat about 4 minutes. Add french fried onions to heat through. Stir in barley and cayenne. Cook 2 minutes. Season with cardamom and baking soda. Cook 2 more minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,kidney bean,wasabi paste,red enchilada sauce,saffron thread
title: Wasabi Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 box red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed | 2 pounds fresh kidney beans, rinsed
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat, mix enchilada sauce, ricotta cheese, wasabi paste, saffron, and red kidney beans and heat through, about 15 minutes.

title: Lemongrass Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 1 stalk lemongrass, scored | 1 teaspoon plain flour | 400 ml low-fat milk | 10 -15 prepared artichoke hearts, quartered | 200 g cabbage, shredded | cooky pastry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c cut away any rough edge on the sides of the chicken drumsticks and then arrange the pieces on a greased oven tray. Trim the lemongrass stalk, cut off any hard outer stalks and discard. Cut the lemongrass into slivers and add to the chicken, along with the flour, milk and artichokes. Mix well to combine. Roast, uncovered, in the oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until chicken is tender and cooked through. Remove from the oven, set aside to cool, then chill covered in the fridge for 30 minutes. Thin out the sauce a bit and then return to the pan and combine with the cabbage. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve with a pastry if using.

title: Smoky Pork Dip
ingredients: 500 g pork | 150 ml cream cheese | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 cup olive
instructions: Cut meat into bite sized chunks. Shred cheese and add to the mix. Leave in refrigerator for at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve with your favourite chips.

title: Homemade Pizzas
ingredients: 1 pound frozen meatballs | 1 red onion, chopped | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place the frozen meatballs in a large skillet.

title: Kaffoori
ingredients: 1 small cucumber | 2 scotch bonnet peppers | 1 tablespoon ground chile | 200 g chopped vegetables | 1 tablespoon ground palm sugar | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor and blend to form a thick paste. Set aside. Heat a wok until smoking. Add the kaffoori mixture and heat through. Add the pepper and cook for a minute or two until fragrant.

Random Ingredients: spatini spaghetti sauce mix,ladyfinger,daikon radish,green pepper
title: Daikon Salad
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish | 1 cup green pepper | 8 ladyfingers | spatini spaghetti sauce mix ( for salad ) or homemade spaghetti sauce ( for salad )
instructions: Cut daikon into 1/4 inch cubes. Cut green pepper into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a strainer and rinse with cool water. Drain well and set aside. Boil and drain salted water. Drain water. Place prepared salted water on a platter to avoid getting any water in the salted water. Put a layer of soaked lady fingers in the water to prevent drying out. Cover with a layer of salted green pepper and a layer of canned spratini. Repeat this layering process until all ingredients have been used. Cut in half and serve.

title: Sweet & Tasty Kumara Mash
ingredients: 500 g kumara, peeled and cut into 2cm chunks | salt and black pepper | 1/2 tablespoon garlic, crushed | 2 tablespoons kahlua ( or other coffee liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons celery roots, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place the kumara chunks in a large bowl. Sprinkle over the garlic, kahlua and celery root. Toss to combine. Heat a non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the kumara chunks, one layer deep, until the mash turns golden brown and the kumara has softened. Scatter over a pinch of salt and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,cardamom pod,tomato juice,dark beer,beef bouillon cube,yellow onion,cornstarch,green bean
title: Famous Bavarian Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 2 large yellow onions | 8 ounces green beans, drained | 1/2 cup low-sodium tomato juice | 2 tablespoons dark beer, use beef stock if using broth | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 2 teaspoons cornstarch, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon water
instructions: In a skillet, brown the ground beef with the chopped onions until cooked through. Drain grease and stir together the beef, onions, green beans, tomato juice, beef stock cube, beef broth, and water. Season with the cardamom, cornstarch solution and seasonings. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed and the green beans are tender.

title: Beer and Zucchini Stew
ingredients: 2 cans tomato juice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod | 2 1/2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 1 cup light beer | 2 packages zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1/8-inch slices | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Combine tomato juice, parsley, cardamom, tapioca, and beer in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Cover and set cooker on high. Stir zucchini, cornstarch, and onion powder together in a bowl.

title: Steak Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1/2 cup dried basil leaves | 1/2 cup dry roasted, salted peanuts | 1 small red onion, minced
instructions:
Slice the steak across grain into 1/4 inch strips. Place the beef in large resealable plastic bag. Add triple sec, basil and peanuts. Seal, and toss around to combine. 
    -. Refrigerate overnight, turning bag over at least once to distribute seasonings. Cook over hot coals or over medium hot coals for 10 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Serve with rice. 
    -.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,french dressing,lima bean,vinegar,yellow squash,toothpick,sugar
title: French Market Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 bag french dressing | 1 bag yellow squash, unpeeled and thinly sliced | 4 bag lima beans, rinsed and picked over | 1 bag frozen stuffing mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 4 toothpicks | 1/2 cup granulated sugar
instructions: Make french french dressing, in a non reactive saucepan, combine french dressing and all remaining ingredients except toothpicks. Over low heat, stir to combine all. Heat until hot.

title: Grilled Kale (Cottage Cheese)
ingredients: 2 lbs kale, stems trimmed, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup fine salt | 1/4 cup double cream | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons fine salt | 12 ounces barbeque sauce
instructions: Divide the kale into 4 even portions.

Random Ingredients: green onion,beef,asafoetida powder,chile,dill pickle,asparagus,pea pearl onion
title: Quick and Easy Ground Beef and Asparagus Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dill pickle | 2 teaspoons chile, chopped or 1/4 teaspoon ground dried chile | 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup frozen pea pearl onions or 1/4 cup finely chopped raw onions | 4 fresh asparagus, cut on the diagonal to make 1-inch pieces or 7 -8 baby asparagus pieces | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 2 green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to high, or alternatively place a metal rack on a cookie sheet, set aside. Place the pickle on to the prepared cookie sheet and cover with foil. To prepare filling, in a bowl combine the chile, beef, pea, onion, asafoetida and green onion. Mix well and coat the beef with the mixture. Place a kebab in the centre of the prepared cookie sheet. Spoon enough of the meat mixture in the centre to just cover the meat. Make a few slits in the kab with a sharp knife. Brush with oil from the grill. Place the cookie sheet under the grill and grill the meat for about 8 - 10 minutes or until the meat begins to brown on the top with the lid slightly ajar and the meat is no longer pink inside.

title: Pecan and Chile Popcorn
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup pecans, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Place poblanos into a microwave on high for 1 minute. Turn and spray the other side with non stick spray. Microwave for 3 - 4 minutes. Let cool. Place pecans into a bowl. Place flour into a large bowl and add pecans. Using a pastry blender add pecan mixture to flour mixing well. Roll dough out thin and using a rolling pin with the thickness of your hand, roll out 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 3 inch rounds. Repeat with remaining rounds on the other side. Place on a sheet pan coated with non stick spray for 30 minutes at room temperature. Cook as directed on your box.

title: Solo Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks ( cut 1-1/2-inch thick ) | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno peppers or 1 tablespoon chiles, chopped | 1 bunch thin celery, leaves picked from stems and coarsely chopped ( about 8 cups ) | 3/4 cup beef stock
instructions: Trim steak of all visible fat and cut into 1/2 by 1/2 pieces. In a soup pot, bring 1 quarts water to a boil. Add all remaining ingredients and return to a boil, skimming any scum that rises to the surface. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer partially covered, until steak is tender, about 3 hours remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: syrup,kaffir lime leaf,canadian bacon,white pepper,roast beef,mayonnaise
title: Smokey Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb roast beef, trimmed and julienned | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise | 3 kaffir lime leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons country bacon fat or 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper, crushed | syrup, sauce, and crushed hot pepper sauce for dipping
instructions: Toss beef and mayonnaise in bowl with lime leaves. Garnish with hot pepper sauce. Cover and chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,wheat bread,chunky salsa,green chili pepper,paprika,italian sausage
title: Eggless Sausage and Salsa Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup thick chunky salsa | 1/2 cup sliced green chili pepper | 12 slices whole wheat bread, toasted
instructions: Brown sausages for 10 minutes, drain and set aside. Spray pan with non stick spray, pour in remaining ingredients except bread. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Slice toast, place toasted bread in a sprayed 8x8 baking dish, arrange sausages on top. Bake for 10 minutes in a 375°f oven, then take to bake for 5 - 10 minutes more if you like your toast crispy.

title: Quick and Easy Fish Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb of your favorite fresh fish | 10 -12 pieces scallions | 2 tablespoons green chili ( jalapeno, habanero, etc ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant minced curry | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 6 ice cubes, crushed ( optional )
instructions: The night before to take the fish, make a slurry with the curry, orange juice, lime juice, and cayenne pepper. Mix thoroughly until dissolved. Pour over fish and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours. Serve on toasted buns, or with crackers. Note, this is a great served with fresh veggies that have been marinated overnight. I've mastered this to a sauce with the curry powder, which has been adopted as the gat mein sauce. I usually make this using the hokkien asian green chili sauce for a very different way of making it. Use a green chili/jalapeno asian flavor, or a habanero pepper for more kick.

Random Ingredients: flour,chicken bouillon cube,ditalini,plain yogurt,tortilla,chinese wine,bicarbonate soda,pistachio
title: Mama's Easy Chicken Tortilla
ingredients: 1/2 kg sirloin, sliced thinly | 200 g ditalini, broken into approx 1 inch sized pieces | 200 g refined flour | 35 g chicken bouillon plus 5g cube | 25 g chinese wine | 300 ml plain yogurt | 25 g pistachios, coarsely chopped | 4 tortillas
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on a medium flame. Toss chicken pieces, making sure they are all coated with the oil, and allow to lightly brown slightly. After cooking, drain meat. Heat oil in frying pan on medium flame. Add flour and stir continuously until it turns golden brown and smells a bit like raw flour. Add chicken and pour in the wine, stirring constantly. Cook until chicken gets a good consistency, stirring constantly. Pour in yogurt and blend well. Allow to cook for about 10 minutes, stirring regularly until thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Add pistachios and mix. Serve with tortillas or eat right away.

title: Italian Style Chili Pot Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs prefluted pizza dough | 3 cans chopped sweet red peppers, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh tarragon or 1/3 cup oregano | extra tarragon
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Oil the inside of a 12” round, 12” frypan with veg. Oil. Place on foil lined cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes or until crisp on top. Set aside to cool. Serve sprinkled with a little extra tarragon.

title: Peppered Beef Rib Eye Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 rib eye steak, fat trimmed | 1/2 cup frozen meat, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced
instructions: Brush exterior of steak with some of the tabasco, then sprinkle with spices and let rest 10 minutes. Spread remaining tabasco over entire steak, place in grill. Cook 4 - 6 minutes per side, or internal temperature for rare, 15 - 20 minutes per side for medium rare.

title: Ceviche Verde
ingredients: 2 cups lebanese cucumbers, sliced coarsely | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 cups spinach leaves, fresh ( or frozen ) | 8 ounces vermicelli, cooked, but firm | 1/2 cup fresh alfalfa sprout, fresh ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons horseradish, grated
instructions: Place lebanese cucumbers in a colander.

Random Ingredients: green olive,phyllo pastry,chocolate chip,baby salad green
title: Healthy Chocolate Green Olivieh
ingredients: 1 package whole baby salad greens | 4 ounces chocolate chips | 1/3 cup stuffed green olive, finely chopped | 20 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the salad green greens on your sprayed baking sheet. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the green green olives and top with the olives. Bake for 8 minutes, or until the chocolate is melted and the green olives are warm. Carefully unfold the phyllo sheets from the baking sheet and spray with cooking spray. Fold them over the layered green olive mixture and place them on your prepared baking sheet. Bake for 5 more minutes, or until the phyllo has been lightly browned. Remove from the oven, and let cool for 5 minutes on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,green bell pepper,white pepper,hot paprika,black sesame seed
title: Spiced Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 5 -7 ounces hot paprika | 2 green bell peppers | fresh ground black sesame seed | 1 tablespoon white pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on the package. Meanwhile, prepare the spicy dressing by combining the paprika, pepper and white pepper in a glass jar. Shake well and pour over drained pasta. Drain, rinse with cool water, add sesame seeds and toss to combine. The salad can be tossed or refrigerated for a few more hours.

title: Danish Red Onion
ingredients: 6 red onions, peeled and halved ( about 1 to 3 pounds ) | 3/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Combine the onions, whiskey, and ¾ teaspoon salt in a large shallow baking dish. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Dvernight is best. The next day heat the oven to 350°f. Uncover the dish of onions, drizzle with honey, and bake 15 minutes, or until crisp and browned. Serve hot.

title: Namibian (Leban Barley)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups barley
instructions: Cook barley according to package directions. Cool and break into small pieces. Cook in a heavy skillet over medium heat with peanut oil until light brown. Pour off all excess oil. Stir in 1 cup of the barley and heat until boiling and thickened. Serve hot.

title: Rutabaga in Cream
ingredients: 1 rutabaga, peeled and cubed | 1 small onion salt | 1 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Sprinkle the rutabaga with the onion salt. Add some arrowroot and toss. Put into the pan slowly, over low heat, stirring, until it is tender,.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,chili sauce,french bread,orange peel,parsley leaf,pineapple juice,brandy
title: Beef Skewers With Pineapple and Mushrooms (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak | 8 ounces sliced mushrooms ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( sriracha if you have it ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons orange peel powder | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place beef skewers in a 5 - 5 cup clay pot or crock pot. Combine all of the remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Mix well. Pour over the skewers. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. Thirty minutes before serving, remove skewers from refrigerator. Brush skewers with any remaining marinade. Thread the steaks onto skewers. Cook on high for 3 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours. Serve hot with a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,venison steak,monterey jack pepper cheese,rice vinegar,cornflour
title: Baked Venison Steak With Monterey Jack
ingredients: 2 ounces venison steaks | 1 plum tomato, seeded and chopped finely | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 ounce monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Score the venison steaks with a sharp knife so that they are at least 3 - 4 inches long and 2 1/2 inches wide. Place the venison steaks in a pan with the plum tomato, vinegar, and cornflour and heat on high for 2 - 3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly. Place the venison steaks in a lightly oiled baking dish. Pour the sauce over the venison steaks. Sprinkle the pepper cheese on top. Bake in oven for 15 - 25 minutes, basting the venison steaks with the sauce during the cooking process. Serve hot with fried potatoes.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,broccoli,sardine fillet,chive,pork sausage,white wine
title: Sardines in Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sardine fillet ( or other meat of your choice ) | 1 can sardines in sauce, drained and rinsed under running water, cut into thin slices ( or other thick type of fish ) | 1 ounce chives, snipped | 2 cups broccoli, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 ounce chinese chinese hot chili sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the fish slices in a baking dish, about 1 inch thick and 1/4 inch deep. In a saucepan, mix all remaining ingredients except for the chinese hot sauce or chili sauce. Bring to a boil, and pour over the fish slices. Cover tightly, and bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 3 hours. Uncover, and continue to bake for about another 20 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, basting frequently. Serve hot.

title: Ginger Beef
ingredients: 1 can green chili | 3 cm gingerroot | 1 litre beef broth | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Open can of chilies and remove seeds. Finely slice ginger. Peel and thinly slice chili. Add beef to frying pan. Pour broth over and simmer for 20 minutes until it is reduced by half. Mix cornflour with a little water and pour slowly over the beef. Stir until mixed. Serve with rice.

title: Asparagus With Radishes and Garlic
ingredients: 4 cans asparagus | 3 tablespoons garlic pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 whole radish
instructions: Wash the asparagus and slice the stem into 3 or 4 pieces, depending on how long the stems go lengthwise. Bring a pot of water to a boil, remove and rinse the asparagus. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While the water is coming to a boil, season the asparagus with the garlic pepper seasoning and turmeric. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer the asparagus for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until tender but not mushy. Meanwhile, slice the radish and toss with half of the garlic pepper sauce in a microwave safe bowl. Spread onto the cooked asparagus. Cook in the microwave on high for 2 minutes at 20 second intervals, depending on the microwave's heat, until vegetables are heated through. Stir frequently while cooking, so the vegetables don't burn. Serve immediately.

title: Raita
ingredients: 16 ounces strawberry yogurt ( low fat or no fat ) | 2 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon oyster sauce | curry leaf
instructions: Combine yoghurt, mascarpone and oyster sauce in mixing bowl. Chill for 1 hour in fridge to develop the flavours. Line a serving plate with curry leaves. Spoon onto curry leaves, garnish with sprigs of curry and serve with your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,pork sausage,tomato paste,black eyed pea,anise seed
title: Cremini Mushrooms With Sausage
ingredients: 1 can sliced cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup black-eyed peas | 3 tablespoons hot smoked pork sausage | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: In a medium sized sauce pan, add sausage and cook over a medium heat until a bit of pink remains on both sides. If it remains, move the sausage to the side. Remove from heat and set aside. Add cremini mushrooms and aniseed to pan and add the tomato paste. Stir until mixed and then add the black eyed peas. Heat through. Serve hot.

title: Muhammara - Greek Hamburgers
ingredients: 6 hamburger buns with sesame seeds, split in half | 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 egg
instructions: Place sesame seeds in small frying pan, sprinkle each side with cinnamon and fenugereek seeks. Crack raw egg into small bowl, add to bowl. Heat buns or grill about 3 min, sprinkle with ground fenugeugreek seeks. Remove to work surface and spread egg mixture inches top buns with mixture. Enjoy.

title: Thai Linguine Salad
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1/4 cup red curry paste, thai-style depending on your tastebuds | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 green pepper, cut into julienne strips
instructions: Cook the linguine in plenty of lightly salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 3/4 cup of pasta cooking water. Combine linguine with remaining ingredients in a large bowl, tossing well. Serve right away.

title: Farina With Daikon and Smoked Pacific Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 lb daikon radish, peeled and diced | 4 ounces smoked sweet pacific salmon, in 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 iceberg lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Combine daikon, smoked sweet papaya and coconut cream in a medium mixing bowl and stir until well blended. Add the greens and gently toss. Serve immediately.

title: Pepperoni Melts for Two
ingredients: 8 -10 slices toast, any type toasted | 2 tablespoons roasted almond meal | 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur | pepperoni | 1 orange, zest of | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Spread roast with amaretto. Slice pepperoni slices about 1/8 thick. Toast almonds and spread with amaretto, add a few pepperoni slices to one slice of bread and then finish with a slice of toast. Squeeze orange zest into another slice of bread and place on toast. Add coconut milk to coconut milk then pour onto toast. Serve hot.

title: Fruit Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cranberries or 2 cups frozen cranberries | salt and black pepper
instructions: Using a blender or the blade of the food processor, process to puree the chopped fruit. Season with salt and pepper. Serve cold.

title: Sour Cream Cheese Bananas
ingredients: 4 bananas | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander or 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro | shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: To peel the bananas, cut them in half lenghtwise and then slice diagonally crosswise. Combine the sour cream, chili paste, vanilla and coriander. Spread the sour cream mixture over the bananas and gently place in refrigerator. To serve, place a scoop of the cheese and 1 tbls of the sauce in serving bowl. Add the bananas and top with remaining cheese. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Pears Spiced Fettuccine With Oranges
ingredients: 1 navel orange | 1 ripe mango | 2 pears, trimmed | 5 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 7 ounces fettuccine
instructions: Slice off the orange rind about 1/4 inch deep, and then slice the fruit into 1/4 inch thick wedges. Peel the mango if it doesn't have a fruit slicer, slice it into thick wedges. Toss the oranges and mango with half of the olive oil, 1/2 teaspoons cardamom, and 1/2 teaspoons salt in a bowl. Divide the orange/mango mixture among 4 dinner plates. Thinly slice the pears in half and put a pear slice in each plate. Drizzle half of the remaining olive oil over the top, and sprinkle with the remaining cardamom and salt. Set the dessert plates on the table. To serve, preheat the broiler and line up a baking sheet with foil. Cook the fettuccine in a large pot of boiling water, according to package directions till just tender but firm to the bite, and drain. Transfer to plates, drizzle with remaining olive oil and serve at once.

title: Sizzling Spicy Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 pounds beef sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup chili bean sauce | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 15 minutes. Soak wooden skewers in a cool place for 1 hour. Heat the grill for high heat. In a large plastic plastic bag or bowl, mix beef cubes with chili bean sauce, and confectioners' sugar. Arrange beef onto the skewers. Place skewers on the grill, and cook about 30 minutes, turning frequently. Skewer beef when cooked.

title: Mexican Breadcrumbed Peppers
ingredients: 3 1/2 1 1/2 lbs whole serrano peppers or 3 1/2 lbs pepitas | 2/3 cup white breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a bowl, mix the bread crumbs, fennel, and cloves. Add the peppers, close to being flattened a little. Put the mixture in a heavy skillet. Cook over medium heat, shaking the pan several times, just until they turn a deep golden brown color at the edges of the pan. Remove from the heat, turn, and sprinkle the tops with a little more fennel. Serve at once.

title: Roasted & Chopped Squash
ingredients: 1 large squash | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wash squash and cut diagonally in 1/4 inch slices. Heat butter in a 10 nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add squash and cook and toss, stirring, until tender. Stir in vinegar, salt and pepper. Cook 10 more minutes until squash is crisp. Remove squash from heat and arrange on warm serving platter.

title: Peach Oatcakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup oats, flakes | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 peach, very ripe, peeled, pitted, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Mix the oats and chilli paste in a bowl. Add the peach slices, mix thoroughly and place on a greased baking tray. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Quick Chinese Seafood Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup carrot, finely shredded | 1/2 cup chinese mushrooms, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 lb fresh crabmeat | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 4 -6 large burrito sized wraps ( i use `` soft roll '' wraps )
instructions: In a bowl combine the carrot, mushrooms, oil and crab meat and mix well. Place about 1/3 cup of the mixture in the center of a wrap and roll up. Secure with toothpicks if desired. Repeat for all wraps. In a non stick skillet heat the sesame seed oil until it sizzles. Carefully place the roll in the pan along with the lettuce, pistachios and nuts and drizzle each with some sesame seed oil. When the roll is crisp and the lettuce is tender crisp to your liking remove from the pan and place in a serving plate and slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pepper,cumin powder,extra sharp cheddar cheese,clear honey,white bean,cream tartar
title: White Beans Dip With Black Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans white beans or ( 15 ounce ) cans red beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup unrefined light cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | grated extra-sharp cheddar cheese | clear honey for dipping
instructions: In a food processor, whir and combine bean, brown sugar, cream of tartar, cumin and pepper until thick and creamy. Spoon mixture into an even serving dish and sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Serve with toasted chips, savoury biscuits or crusty breads, such as springform. Alternatively, you can serve this as a dip for a crisp crusty bread that has just become crisp and gooey.

title: Pico De Gallo Aioli (Azerbread for Dipping)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pico de gallo | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3/4 teaspoon arrowroot | 6 ounces commercial pico de gallo ( homemade is best ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Scoop or spread onto paper lined baking sheet. Allow to dry at room temperature up to 2 hours. When cool, break off chunks of bread like small sourdough chips and use for dipping. Use as dip for bread sticks.

title: Baked Sausage and Barley Soup
ingredients: 12 sausages, cut in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 2 cups quick-cooking barley, coarse
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the sausages and barley in a baking dish. Place on the middle rack of the oven and bake for about 50 minutes, or until the sausages are browned. Let cool, cut into ½ inch pieces, and serve with soup.

title: Smoked Salmon Croquettes With Baked Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 4 skinless salmon fillets | 10 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1 ounce black olives | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons crisco or 2 tablespoons butter | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius, gas mark 6. Put a shallow ovenproof dish on a hob and add the salmon fillet. Bake for about 8 minutes until the fish flakes easily. Meanwhile put the bean sprouts and olives into a large pan along with freshly chopped cilantro and just enough cold water to cover. Bring to the boil and simmer on low for a couple of minutes. Drain immediately and leave to cool completely. When the salmon is cooked it should be slightly flakey but still have a little bite inside. Strain the cooled beansprouts and put in a bowl. Dice in half and then put to one side. Toast your own biscuit and put on a tray. Spread a sixth of the bean sprout mixture over each biscuit then spread each with the rest of the bean/olive mixture. Roll up and place on the tray and flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for a further 15 minutes, then turn the broiler on. When the broiler is just right put in the tray and broil for a minute or two until golden brown.

title: Stir Fry Canadian Bacon With Beef
ingredients: 8 slices canadian bacon or 8 slices smoked bacon, 1/2 inch thick | 8 ounces stir fry beef
instructions: Pour boiling water over 2 slices of the bacon. Slice in half and fast fry in hot oil until brown. Remove bacon with slotted spoon while cooking second side, drain on napkin lined plate. Turn off heat. Add the frozen stir fry beef in the same pan as the first and cook for a few minutes until heated thoroughly. Transfer beef with slotted spoon to warm serving platter and spoon off accumulated fat. Increase heat to high and add bacon. Stir fry beef for 1 - 2 minutes or until crisp. Serve with french fries or rice.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,port wine,cheese,chocolate,olive oil,red capsicum,beef chuck,kidney bean
title: Beef, Chocolate & Olive Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck ( trimmed of fat ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 red capsicums, diced | 1 serrano pepper, diced | 1 can kidney beans ( drained & rinsed ) | 1/2 cup port wine | 3 ounces cheese, shredded | 6 tablespoons chocolate
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan & saute the beef chuck until browned, remove & set aside. Heat the remaining oil & saute the capsicums & chilies for 2 minutes. Add the beef & brown slightly. Pour in the beans, wine and cheese & simmer for 30 minutes, until the beef is tender. Serve with rice, noodles, or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,radish,asparagus,pine nut,pecorino romano cheese
title: Green Chile Asparagi (Asparagus with Pine Nuts)
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 2 -4 tablespoons grated pecorino-romano cheese | 2 cups pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper | radish ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil water in a pot for asparagus. Cut off tough ends and discard. Use small scissors to cut asparagus diagonally into 1 inch pieces. When water comes to a boil, add asparagus pieces and toss with 1 tbsp grated cheese. Cover and cook for about 3 - 4 minutes. Add pine nuts, chili pepper and remaining cheese and toss well to combine. Place on serving platter and garnish with radishes before serving.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,rigatoni pasta,bell pepper,radish,white potato,baking soda,black eyed pea
title: Black-Eyed Pea 'n' Potato Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb small white potato, peeled | 1 medium bell pepper | 1 tablespoon finely minced jalapenos or 1 tablespoon serrano pepper ( if unavailable, use 1 tsp cayenne pepper ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained & rinsed | 1 tablespoon finely minced radish, optional ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 small ritzi-roll pasta or 1 small rigatoni pasta, as needed
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat for 30 second. Add the bell pepper and jalapeno and continue cooking until the peppers are tender. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool completely. Place the black eyed peas in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to cool until easy to handle. When they are cool enough to handle, roughly chop them and set aside. Add the onion and potato to the hot skillet and cook for about 10 minutes. Add the black eyed peas, bell pepper mixture, ritzi or rigatoni pasta, and stir. Cover and chill about 2 hours. When ready to serve, add one teaspoon baking soda to 1/2 teaspoon baking powder and toss. Garnish with more bell pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,bailey irish cream,rice flour,snow pea,orange marmalade,milk
title: A Little Italy Raisins and Snow Peas (With Thanks to Chef Fabio)
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice flour ( fine powder or use white rice flour ) | 1 2/3 cups skim milk | 1 1/2 cups fresh shaved snow peas ( about 2.|7 ounces ) | 1/4 1/4 cup sliced orange marmalade or 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon unsweetened baileys irish cream | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese or 1/2 cup cottage cheese
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, whisk up the milk and flour until well amalgamated. Whisk in the 1 1/3 cup of the milk mixture. Using a fork, scrape the bottom of the bowl with a wooden spoon and start whisking. Then gradually add the rest of the milk mixture and whisk until well incorporated. Keep whisking until all the flour is incorporated and smooth. Remove the bowl from the refrigerator. Stir in the shaved snow peas or orange marmalade or maple syrup. Stir until well coated with the sauce. Refrigerate overnight or at least 30 minutes stirring occassionally. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Stir the ricotta into the sauce and mix well. Add the remaining 1 1/3 cups of milk to thin slightly. Spread the mixture in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish and top with the flaky cheese. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown. Remove from the oven and immediately pour the sauce over the cheese. Serve warm.

title: Crunchy Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 3 ounces polenta | 2 - 2 1/2 tablespoons triple sec or 2 -2 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 4 -5 tablespoons frozen strawberries | 1 large shallots or 1 small chives ( 6 to 8 inches long )
instructions: Pulse the polenta and triple sec in a food processor to crumb mixture. Add strawberries and shallot and pulse to combine. Roll into a log. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill until firm, at least 30 minutes or up to 48 hours. Cut in half, then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.

title: Simple Japanese Dipping Sauce for Meat or Broccolini
ingredients: 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until warm.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,white onion,beef tenderloin,farfalle pasta,saffron thread,salt,turkey,zucchini
title: Greek Sausage and Zucchini
ingredients: 1/2 lb turkey, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 white onion, sliced | 1/2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 package farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1/2 orange, zest of
instructions: Preheat the oven to boil a large pot of water, add 1 tablespoon salt, the pasta, and the saffron. Cook until the pasta is done, about 12 minutes. When cooked, drain well. Return the pasta to the pot. Add the onions, zucchini, and turkey. Mix well and season with the salt. Cover the pot and return to a boil. Put on the oven until the sausages are done fully or until desired doneness, about 15 to 20 minutes. Place on a platter, and garnish with the orange zest.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,baking potato,granola cereal,poblano pepper,worcestershire sauce,mirin
title: Mexican Beef and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin or 1 lb round steak, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 medium poblano pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 packagegranola cereal | 24 ounces reduced-fat plain doritos | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons mirin | additional worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line 8 inch square baking pan with aluminum foil, letting excess moisture from pan drippings over sides of pan. Place steak, poblano pepper and 1 packet cereal in medium saucepan over low heat. Cook and stir 7 minutes or until beef is browned and vegetables are tender crisp. Drain steak, vegetables and cereal in pan.

Random Ingredients: pecan,black peppercorn,jicama,beef tenderloin steak,white sugar,oat,extra beef,margarine
title: Jicama-Pepper Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1/4 cup packed finely chopped pecans | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped jicama | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup shredded beef tenderloin steaks | 1/2 cup quick oats | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon ground black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground szechuan peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together 1/2 cup margarine with pecans, jicama, 2 tablespoons margarine, and beef tenderloin. Shape into four 1 1/2 inch thick patties. In a separate small bowl, combine the oats, sugar and 1 tablespoon ground peppercorns. Sprinkle half of the spice mixture over the patties. Place them in a 9x5 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with the remaining spice mixture. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,thyme leaf,hominy,cod,thai red curry paste,plum tomato
title: Indian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cans hominy, drained, rinsed | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 can plum tomatoes ( or tomatoes and green peppers ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 2 lbs cod, cut into 3-by-1 pieces
instructions: Heat 3 t of oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Season stew meat with salt and pepper. When oil shimmers, add stew meat and saute until slightly browned on all sides. Pour remaining oil into same pan and heat to medium, 1 - 2 minutes. Spoon in 1 can of hominy, 1 can each of plum tomatoes and green peppers, thyme leaves and 2/3 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 50 minutes, stirring once or twice. Place cod in a separate casserole dish. Cover and return to simmer. Cook, covered, 15 minutes or until fish is tender. Spoon stew into bowls. Top with croutons, if desired.

title: Coriander and Walnut Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Grind the coriander seeds and the whole nut to a fine powder. Sprinkle the walnuts onto a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,yellow bell pepper,curry leaf,pecorino cheese,nutmeg,baking powder
title: Curried Pepper Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss cheese, cut into eight pieces | 1 yellow bell pepper ( pepper of your choice ) | 8 -12 fresh curry leaves ( not dried leaves ) | 1 pinch of ground nutmeg | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon baking powder | 6 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese or 6 tablespoons other grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Cut peppers into six equal pieces, each piece about 3/4 of an inch thick. Cut about 8 - 10 curry leaves from stems, leave stems in and slit each one lengthwise, discarding outer layer. Cut out and discard the center core of each pepper completely. Now cut pepper into four squares of at least 2 inches long and place cut up squares on a foil covered plate. Preheat an electric skillet to 375 degrees f. Place a piece of cheese at a time on top of each pepper square on the foil covered plate. Sprinkle the inside of the plate with all of the spices and bake in the preheated skillet for 3 - 5 minutes, covered, or until the cheese is bubbling and lightly brown. Place plate under a hot broiler, about 4 inches from the heat for about 3 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and lightly browned. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese and place back under the broiler for 1 - 2 more minutes, or until the cheese has browned a little. Remove from heat. Cut into squares.

title: Quick Puff Pastry Tart
ingredients: 1 sheet thawed frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1/2 cup fresh grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 450° f. Spray a small baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Roll out thawed pastry on a lightly floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness. Line a 12 inch nonstick muffin tin with half of pastry. Spoon grated cheese into center. Top with remaining pastry, making sure it gets into all the crevices. Gently press edges of pastry into the cheese. Bake tart 20 minutes. Invert tart onto a serving platter. Carefully remove bottom and thawed pastry and cut into wedges, if desired. Cut tart into wedges as desired. Serve warm with warm spiced maple syrup or fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,shallot,chicken part,part mozzarella cheese,red potato
title: Italian Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs skinless chicken parts | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup minced shallots | 1/3 cup chopped kalamata olive | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Arrange chicken in 2 quart baking dish. Toss potatoes in remaining 1 tablespoon salt. Spoon over chicken and toss to coat evenly. Place in single layer in dish. Sprinkle with shallots, olives, and cheese. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour or until chicken is done.

title: Beets in Radish Juice
ingredients: 3 lbs beet, peeled and sliced | 5 tablespoons lemon juice and zest, fresh lemon only | 1/3 cup radish, sliced | 1 package fresh whipped topping, made with a bit of milk
instructions: Fill a big saucepan with cold water.

title: Panch Phoronios (Spanish-Style Onion Rings)
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh panch phoronios | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Put a deep tray on the counter and put several sheets of plastic wrap on it. On the table, this table, on the counter, put a stack of wax paper across it. Place a sheet under the paper to weigh out excess moisture. When the tray is full, cut the stack into 24 even sized rings. Place one ring on the tray, cut side down. Repeat with remaining rings. They should make no more than 24 rings. Allow the rings to sit, uncovered, in the refrigerator for 20 minutes and up to 48 hours, if possible, before using. If using a mortar and pestle or processor, it will be necessary to crush the rings and mix them together. Add the garlic, cayenne and pinch of cayenne pepper and pulse to grind finely. Store the garlic mixture in a tightly lidded jar in the refrigerator. They make delicious snack dishes that are crisp and chewy, sweet and salty.

title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 1 1/2 x 1 inch sticks | 1 cup sliced strawberry | 3/4 cup jalapenos or 3/4 cup other fresh jalapeno chile, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 cups diced peeled ripe strawberries | 1/3 cup maraschino cherry, sliced | 1 radish
instructions: In a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker, with a lid, toss the beef, 1 cup of the strawberries, chile slices, baking powder, 1/2 cup of the maraschino cherries, and all but 1/4 cup of the strawberry chunks. Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 10 hours, or until tender when pierced with 2 forks. Remove one third of the beef and slice into thin strips and return to cooker. Repeat with the remaining beef and strawberries, adding the remaining maraschino cherries and strawberries at the end of the cooking time. Remove all the meat from the slow cooker and keep warm, and serve at once with the remaining ingredients, such as mashed potatoes, rice, or hot wide egg noodles. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkled with the reserved maraschino cherries. These are best eaten at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,turmeric,chili pepper flake,bouquet garni,olive oil
title: Mexican Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 lb fresh chili pepper flakes ( cayenne or to taste ) | 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 3 teaspoons bouquet garni
