instructions: Heat olive oil over medium high heat. Add the chili flakes, and fry stirring often for 5 minutes. Add the minced, seeded jalapeno pepper and bouquet garni. Cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

title: Veal With Butterscotch Chips
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal, shaved | 1/2 lb chicken, shaved | 1/2 cup butterscotch chips
instructions: Spread butterscotch chips on a platter. Put shaved veal, shaved chicken or whatever on top of the chips. You can also add chopped hard boiled eggs to the top of the veal.

title: Ethiopian Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo pastry | 1 package saffron | 8 green peppers ( green pea pods, roasted )
instructions: Thaw phyllo pastry for an hour. Cut green peas into 2 in pieces, wash and deseed the peppers, cut in 1 in strips lengthwise. Put a tablespoon of saffron and 3 table spoonsful water into a small bowl. Put one sheet of phyllo pastry onto a lightly floured surface, brush with the saffron water and fold it over. Brush a 2nd sheet of phyllo pastry with the saffron water and turn it down. Sprinkle the green pea pods over the phyllo, then layer the green pea pods and pepper strips. Continue the process until all the ingredients are used and the phyllo pastry is now ready.

title: Beef Consomme Orange Peel and Horseradish Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg sliced beef consomme ( or any other veggie you desire ) | 75 g white onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 teaspoons grated orange peel
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the beef consomme. On a tray, mix the onion and horseradish, and sprinkle over the horseradish mix as before. Add the onions to the beef consomme mixture, and refrigerate for at least one hour or overnight. If you are going to leave them overnight, cover and bring to the boil slowly. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the beef is tender and creamy. Stir occasionally. Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,purple cabbage,saffron thread,walnut,japanese soy sauce,chili,broccoli,cake flour
title: Sweet, Sour Crunchy Salad
ingredients: 180 g purple cabbage | 180 g broccoli | 180 g cabbage | 1/4 cup japanese soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 -2 chili, red, coarsely crushed | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon nuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Slice the carrot into thin slices and the sweet cabbage into shreds and place in a large salad bowl. Thinly slice the broccoli and place it over the carrots. Chop the lettuce and place it over the lettuce. Tear or dice the chilies into small pieces. Mix together the saffron, chili, oregano, chopped nuts and cake flour, and add it gradually to the salad along with the soy sauce, to make a sweet and sour dressing. Toss into the salad and serve. Variation.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,cold water,black soy sauce,seasoning,egg,apple juice
title: Apple Egg Dish
ingredients: 6 large apples ( like granny smith ) | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon black soy sauce | 8 large eggs
instructions: Cut apples into cubes. Combine soup and water, apple juice, soy sauce and black soysauce, stirring in apple cubes. Pour into lightly buttered 2 quart casserole. Place 6 egg quarters on top of soup mixture in 3 batches alternating with about one third of apples. Pour soup mixture over apples. Bake at 350 for about 50 minutes, or until apples are tender. Top with soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: butter flavor crisco,lettuce,turmeric powder,clam juice,jumbo shrimp,parsley,rib,worcestershire sauce
title: Lettuce, Lobster & Cl Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rib eye steaks or 1 1/2 lbs shrimp | 1 cup bottled clam juice | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon butter flavor crisco | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 heads lettuce, shredded | chopped parsley or cilantro, if desired
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place the steaks in a baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes, uncovered. Pour over the steaks. Cover and marinate 2 to 4 hours in the refrigerator, but do not allow to marinate longer than 24 hours. Grill steaks 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 10 to 15 minutes, or until done. Brush with a little remaining marinade during the final 2 to 3 minutes of grilling. Sprinkle salad with parsley or cilantro if desired.

title: Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb black-eyed peas | 1/2 whole dried red chili pepper
instructions: Cover beans with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, 45 minutes. Drain water from beans and place in a large container. Cover with hot water until beans are just covered, but not too hot to kill from steam. Add whole dry dried chili pepper and stir until well blended. Cover and refrigerate in a cool dark place for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,lemonade,chicken,sherry wine,tabasco jalapeno sauce,dark chocolate,salt,purpose flour
title: Chicken With Leaches
ingredients: 3 aubergines | salt | 1 chicken, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon lemonade | 3 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon tabasco jalapeno sauce | all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut the aubergines lengthwise into half moons and slice thinly. Spread slices with thinly sliced salt so they show little skin on the egg. Place half the slices on a baking sheet and broil for about 4 minutes, turning once, until lightly charred and crisp. Remove from the oven and set aside. Place the remaining slices on the baking sheet. Heat a small amount of oil in a small saucepan. Remove from the heat. Melt the chocolate in a metal bowl or in the microwave. Mix in the lemonade, sherry, tabasco, and half the hot chocolate mixture. Dip the aubergines into the melted chocolate and arrange on each plate. Pour the remaining hot chocolate mixture over. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Tuscan Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, uncooked | 1/3 cup coriander seed, chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine coriander, green pepper and chili powder. Add the pasta and toss to mix. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 6 sourdough ladyfingers | 1 jar medium-hot beef broth, at room temperature | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Soak ladyfingers in beef broth in an air tight container overnight in the refrigerator. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. When the oven is just off turn the oven on to broil. Place the ladyfingers on a baking sheet and baste with beef broth, turning frequently. Broil until the crostini turns golden, about 10 minutes more. Stir about 2 minutes. Remove from oven and pour into serving bowl. Spoon over thawed whipped topping. Serve immediately.

title: Vital-Pounded Flavored Gluten
ingredients: 2 cups vital wheat gluten | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree. Enjoy your discoveries.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,puff pastry,chai tea teabags,lemon zest,red chili,half cream
title: Chai Cream Filled Pastries With Lemon and Chai (Tongua)
ingredients: 5 -6 medium frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 -3 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 chili, roasted, deseeded and finely chopped | 4 -6 tablespoons half-and-half cream ( i reduced it by half to add a little more if i had more liquid left on the pies.| ) | 2 lemons, zest of, grated | 1 long red chili, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c gas lightly spray a baking sheet with oil and line it with parchment paper. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out the pastry sheets to ½ inch thickness. Lightly flour the pastry sheets as necessary to ensure they don't end up sticking, then cut them into 2 equal measures. Place one teaspoon of the chilies and half the sugar into a mortar and pestle or a small bowl. Add a few generous sprinkles of zest and grind some black pepper over the chilies, then the juice of half a lemon. Stir together and then add the remaining chilies and lemon zest. Fold in the cream and season, to taste. Place the pastry strips on 1 lined baking sheet and prick with a fork to make the crust more uniformly shaped. Bake for 15 minutes, then remove from the oven and prick again. Allow to cool slightly before filling, if you like a bit of tartness. To make the filling, heat the cream, lemon zest and chili paste together and season. Drain the pastry and arrange on serving plates, topped with the chai filling. Decorate with a sprig of chili and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Corn Chips (Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat broiler. Stir corn, oil, and salt and pepper in a small baking dish until corn chips are coated, about 2 - ½ minutes. Broil coated corn 1 - ½ from heat until corn chips have darkened, 5 to 7 minutes, until toasted. Spread a single layer on a large dinner plate. Using a metal spatula, transfer to a cutting board and immediately sprinkle with corn chips, breaking apart any crumbs that have stuck to the plate. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,sage,savoy cabbage,juice from one lime,coriander powder,chili sauce,cocoa
title: Tofu Savoy Cabbage and Kimchi
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage | 1 can soft silken tofu | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Wash the cabbage, but do not clean under cold running water. Slice to desired pieces of about 1 in thickness or less. Combine all ingredients. Spoon over the cabbage and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: tuna olive oil,cumin powder,cottage cheese,shortening,heavy cream,basil leaf,thai fish sauce,oyster sauce
title: Thai Basil Tuna Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 -6 large fresh fresh mushrooms, washed, stems removed and caps left intact | 1 package low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup fat-free sour cream or 1/4 cup light sour cream | 4 -5 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 -4 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons bottled minced basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons tbs shortening ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Chop 1 mushroom into small pieces and place in a bowl. In another bowl combine cottage cheese, sour cream, 2 tsp. Of the fish sauce and basil and mix well. Add the second ½ tsp. Fish sauce to the cream mixture and stir. Drain the drained mushrooms and set aside. Add the tbs. Cumin powder to sour cream mixture and stir well. Add the sour cream mixture to the mushroom mixture. Fold in the reserved mushroom pieces and the cheese mixture. Fill mushroom caps and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes before removing from the oven and taking out the parchment paper.

title: Kolache (Oatmeal Lour or Muesli)
ingredients: 10 cups plain oatmeal ( or masa harina ) | 1 white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime juice or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and knead for 2 minutes, adding buttermilk last to absorb it completely before you shape your kolache as the dough is quite sticky. Use a wet spatula to roll out dough onto a floured surface to a 14x2 inch rectangle or your desired product. If necessary, use more butter or margarine as needed to prevent sticking or even shrinkage from the dough. Form into a loaf.

title: Carnation Onions
ingredients: 1 lb white pearl onion | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Clean and trim onions, peel off outer layer and trim tops, leaving root ends exposed. Cut the onions in half lengthwise and then in half again so they become like french fries and then slice thinly. Place panko, a small amount at a time on a clean work surface, and stretch lightly to dry panko like pieces. Put the panko in a resealable plastic bag, close, and store in the refrigerator. This will make enough for 6 - 8 servings.

title: Mutton Shank & Pine Nut Sausages
ingredients: 500 gms mutton | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: Cut up the mutton into long, thin slices. Combine the pine nuts & salt with 1/2 tspn of vegetable oil. Dry roast the pine nuts w/the meat until lightly browned & tender, basting with the sauage from time to time. This should take about 20 - 25 min's or so.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,andouille sausage,salt black pepper,graham cracker crumb,cucumber,ice
title: Baked andouille Sausage
ingredients: 1 pound andouille sausage | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup crushed ice | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 cucumbers, sliced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the sausage links onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and crumbly, about 60 minutes. While the sausage is cooking, combine the graham cracker crumbs and the graham cracker crumbs in a mixing bowl. Spread 1/2 of the coconut milk onto the sausage slices and press into the graham cracker crumbs. Layer the cucumber slices over the graham cracker crumbs. Place another piece of sausage over the cucumber pieces and press into the graham cracker crumbs. Continue layering the sausage, coconut milk, and cucumbers until the graham cracker crumbs have soaked up all the coconut milk and sausage. Season with salt and pepper to serve.

title: Azerbaijane (Blueberry Soup)
ingredients: 1 pint white berry slices | 1 quart chicken broth ( home made is best ) | heavy whipping cream, for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the berry slices and the broth. Cover and simmer on medium heat for 30 minutes, or until the berry and broth mixture is very richly flavored and creamy. Remove the cover and simmer for 15 minutes longer. Let cool slightly and whip cream to stiff peaks.

title: Pistachio Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup italian bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Mix pistachios with italian bread crumbs in the bowl of an electric mixer. Turn mixer to low and add coarsely chopped pistachios. Mix until well coated. Drop the biscotti onto the prepared cookie sheet. Bake until slightly puffed and golden brown, approximately 15 minutes. Transfer onto a rack and cool to room temperature or room temperature before serving.

title: Crispy Crab Cakes (Matt Preston)
ingredients: 1/4 lb imitation crabmeat or 1/4 lb crabmeat ( about 3-4 in size ) | 1/4 cup chopped savory | 1 medium italian stewed tomatoes ( about 1/3 cup ) or ( 2 ounce ) can diced italian plum tomatoes ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon low-calorie margarine or 1 tablespoon unsalted margarine | 1 tablespoon tamarind juice | 2 cups all-purpose flour | oil ( for frying ) | msg ( optional )
instructions: Add imitation crab, savory, and tomato/powdered tomatoes to food processor. Pulse to chop tomatoes into small chunks. Set aside. Melt the margarine in a bowl. Add the tamarind juice and mix. Add flour to margarine mixture a little at a time, mixing and mixing with fingers until the mixture is a ball. Place mixture in palm of hand and shape into a ball about 2 inches in diameter. If the mixture seems dry, add a little water. Chill for about an hour or a bit longer. Heat oil until hot in a wide frying pan, about 1 1/2 tablespoons. Dust hands with a little flour only when working with small portions of the dough. If batter still sticky add a little oil. Using a wooden spoon form the dough into small balls about the size of a golf ball and gently press the dough into a disc about 1 inch diameter. Transfer the disc to the oil, holding the balls flat.

title: Grilled Lemongrass
ingredients: 4 small leg lamb | 2 pints lamb fat or 2 pints pork fat | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Use a hammer to hammer the joint of leg of lamb if it breaks up. Don't worry, it's easier to work with when you do it by your hammer. Use a meat mallet to pound the joint of lamb to the thickness you prefer. Don't worry if there are little pieces of leg of lamb on the underside. Cut down into flat pieces. Slice the leg of lamb across into thick slices. Make sure each piece is slightly thinner than the surrounding meat. Mix the sugar in a saucepan, bring to the boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Pour the fish sauce over the lamb. Let stand for 5 minutes while you grill them. You can add a splash of water to help loosen the sauce if necessary. They're ready when the lamb is nicely charred and tender.

title: Blueberry Pineapple Mustard
ingredients: 12 fresh pineapple chunks or 2 cups fresh unsweetened pineapple tidbits | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | generous pinch asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup packed cilantro | 3 cups blueberries, washed | white wine ( your preference, i prefer grape ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine mustard, asafetida and cilantro. Add blueberries, stirring well to coat, and wine to cover. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or overnight. About 10 minutes before serving, place pineapple into blender with mustard mixture and whirl to a coarse puree. Stir in ginger.

title: Baked Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 2 cornish hens | 4 strips bacon, cooked and crisped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap a cornish hen inside 2 pieces of bacon rind that have been soaked with water. Secure ends of cornish hens with toothpicks. Place on a tray and bake for 2 hours. Baste hens occasionally.

title: Sweet Italian Sausage and Squash
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs skinned sweet italian sausage | 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, cut into cubes and seeds removed | 2 cans tomato paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the sausages in a dutch oven with the squash cubes. Pour tomato paste over. Cover with a tight lid and bake for 12 to 24 hours until squash is tender.

Random Ingredients: hot water,cider vinegar,red wine vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Red Chile Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar or 1/2 cup regular vinegar | 1/2 cup hot water | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together except cheese when ready to serve.

title: Mexican Pineapple (Canned) Salsa
ingredients: 1 can diced pineapple with juice | 5 tablespoons tomato bouillon ( or to taste ) | 4 -5 fresh fresh cilantro stems ( optional ), or more to taste
instructions: Mix all but cilantro in medium bowl. Add more to taste.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,egg yolk,brown rice,pecorino romano cheese,chickpea flour,mushroom,black eyed pea,pork
title: Capellini Di Riso (Black-Eyed Pea Soup)
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless pork loin, diced | 2 ounces lean pork fat, diced | 3 large egg yolks | 1 tablespoon instant brown rice flour | 1 cup canned black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 cup canned chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 12 ounces mushrooms, sliced fresh
instructions: In a soup pot, heat enough water to cover the pork, sausage and fat over medium heat. When it is slightly bubbling, add the instant rice flour and stir. Cook about 2 minutes to make a roux. Add the black eyed peas, chickpea flour, cheese and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and serve with cracked black pepper.

title: Italian Restaurant Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 garlic clove ( i use 1 tsp ) | 1 dash pepper ( i've even used white vinegar, which is just not necessary ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/3 cup whole milk or 1/3 cup half-and-half | ice | 2 thin slices fontina ( thin slices )
instructions: Preheat grill. Place shortening in a heavy frying pan. Turn flame to medium. When it is completely melted, add garlic and pepper and saute over low heat a few minutes until fragrant. Once the garlic smells fragrant remove garlic and discard. Place mixture into a small bowl. Add bouillon and milk to pan and bring to a boil. Cook on medium flame or over high flame for 2 minutes. Carefully place cheese in garlic mixture. You want the cheese to be pretty thin and juicy. Be sure to keep stirring cheese throughout the process. You don't want to cook the cheese as long as it sits, the flavor will change.

title: Nigella Lawson (Nigella Lawson)
ingredients: 3 cups good quality chicken or 3 cups vegetable stock | 4 ciabatta, very ripe ( about 8 slices ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: Note, don't omit salt unless you plan on serving the soup in a nonstick frying pan. This recipe gives no weight, but you can use it if you need it all to make a 1½ litre soup. Place stock in a small saucepan over medium heat. Slice bread in half horizontally, scoop out bread and set aside. Dip bread in warm stock, pressing out excess starch. Place on oven tray in the oven. Cook for 8 minutes, turning once or twice. Remove bread, and return pan and toast for another 2 minutes. Remove bread from oven, and allow to cool slightly. Spread with salt and serve soup cold with bread. Note, if you have an electric beater, do a preheat your oven to 200c. Baking in a bread pan will ensure a fairly hot oven. This technique should give you some bread colour outside and some colour outside. The ciabatta bread should bake well to brown the outside and crispy inside but still have some shape inside.

title: Pickled Beets in Mustard (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 1 kg beet, peeled | 8 fluid ounces mustard ( from a jar ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( or paste made with 1/2 tsp sugar ) | 3 tablespoons spicy steak sauce ( such as teriyaki sauce ) | 2 tablespoons cold water | ice | rose water ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the beet in a large saucepan with water and add the salt. Bring to the boil, add the mustard, garlic paste and spicy steak sauce. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the beet is tender. Cool and reserve, refrigerated, for about 2 hours. Slice the cooled beet and discard the remaining beet stalk. Transfer to a bowl and add the cold water and mix well, then chill for 2 hours. Add the sliced beets to the warm mustard, garlic paste and spicy steak sauce. Serve chilled straight from the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,salt pork,maraschino cherry,beet,avocado,green cardamom pod
title: Easy Capirotada (Beet and Avocado Dip)
ingredients: 6 small beets | 1 package salt pork | 8 ounces can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 large avocado, peeled and cubed | 4 green cardamom pods, chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | sour cream, for topping
instructions: In a large skillet, place the salt pork, and cook over medium heat until fully cooked. While the salt pork is cooking make the mushroom soup by mixing it together with the cream of mushroom soup and the avocado, reserving ¼ cup for garnishing the top later on. When the salt pork is fully cooked drain the fat from the pan and set aside. When the pork is completely cool, add the mushroom soup, then mix well. To serve, place a scoop of the capirotada mix on the plate, then top with a few cubes of avocado, some capirotada juice, a few capirotada pits and a sprig of maraschino cherries. Garnish with additional avocados just before serving. To make ahead, wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,tomato juice,graham cracker crumb,white sugar,serrano pepper,pasta
title: Quick and Easy Garlicky Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 can chopped serrano peppers | 1 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: agave nectar,vegetable oil cooking spray,idaho potato,filling,beef chuck
title: Grilled Peruvian Potato Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs idaho potatoes, cut into 1 inch by 1/4 inch pieces | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon agave nectar | 4 slices dried beef top round beef flank steak or 4 slices other lean cuts, about 3/4 inch thick | filling
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Place potatoes in a large saucepan, and cover with water. Bring water to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes. Rinse potatoes under cold water, and pat dry. Lightly coat a grill pan with cooking spray, and heat over medium and add beef and lightly brown it on both sides. Meanwhile, stir agave nectar into warm potatoes and set aside. To assemble filling, spread the potato crust with filling, then spread about 1 teaspoon of the potato filling over the crust. Top with additional filling.

title: Vegan Hot and Sour Samosas
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 2 -3 dashes ground cumin | 2 -3 dashes habanero peppers | 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 6 small red seedless grapes, halved | 12 miniature grape leaves
instructions: In bowl, combine milk & spices. Set aside to soak over low heat. Meanwhile, heat a skillet on medium high heat & add the pepper halves along with the grape leaves. Cook just until softened, about 2 minutes. Turn over & repeat with rest of the grape leaves. Remove from heat & top with sweetened/sweetened/spicy salsa mixture. Serve immediately, or cover & refrigerate 30 minutes or over night to marinate.

title: Tasty Pork Rolls
ingredients: 1 sirloin, trimmed of any fat | 200 g lean shaved lamb or 200 g smoked pork ribs | 2 slices raw smoked ham hock | 4 dates, chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves | 125 g grated parmesan cheese, divided | 60 g raw banana
instructions: Cut away fat from sirloin and cut it into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut ham hock in half lengthwise and then into half pieces, then slice lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Toss the meats in a large bowl with 1 teaspoon or more of coriander. Sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of grated cheese, then toss well. Preheat a griddle until very hot, then cook the meat in batches, turning until browned all over. Transfer all the meat to a warmed plate. Add another teaspoon of coriander to the pan and cook the marinated meat in it for 10 minutes or until crisp and browned all over. Set the barbecue to its hottest setting, or leave to cook the meat until all the surfaces are cooked. Roll the meat out and line a 24cm long roll tin with baking paper. Spoon a little of the meat onto the lined tray, top with some of the sliced marinated meats and dates. Cover with the remaining rolls and cheese, then lay slices of banana on top. Place in the grill and then cook over a medium heat for 3–5 minutes, depending on the thickness of the rolls. Remove from the grill and serve immediately with a side of soup or steamed vegetables.

title: Boti Roti (Beef Patties on White Gravy)
ingredients: 500 g beef chuck, sliced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Heat oil in a large wok. Add corriander powder and fry, stirring, for about 20 seconds. Add beef slices. Fry until the surface of the meat turns red. Remove from heat. Serve on a flat indian pilaf with plain boiled rice and raita.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,dijon mustard,lemon extract,pasta shell,pork shoulder,tomato ketchup
title: Slow Cooker Spicy Baked Pork Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( in tomato sauce ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes, diced tomatoes | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 7 ounces dry small shell pasta shells, uncooked
instructions: Place pork shoulder in slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients except shells. Cover, slow cook for 8 - 9 hours on low. Place shells in a large serving bowl. Toss with pork mixture. Serve over spanish rice. Pass cheese, sour cream, etc.

title: Tortillas for Fish & Chips
ingredients: 6 3/4 cups white flour, sifted | 1 3/4 cups fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon lime wedge, to garnish
instructions: Dredge your fish in the flour, dip in the lime juice, coat on both sides with the cardamom and leave to marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Dip fish again in the flour. Heat a non stick frying pan and spray well with pam spray over medium heat. Place the fish in the pan. Cook the flaked fish for 3 - 4 minutes. Garnish with lime wedges and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,mirin,iceberg lettuce,orange juice,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Asian Slaw
ingredients: 2 cups napa cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 cup iceberg lettuce ( shredded ) | 5 tablespoons low-sodium mirin | 5 tablespoons orange juice | 2 -3 crushed chili peppers flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the medium bowl of a food processor and blend until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes to let flavors develop. Serve with soy sauce dipping sauce for dipping.

title: Ginger Grated Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages shredded fontina cheese | 1 jar pickled ginger root
instructions: Place the grated fontina cheese in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Top with pickled ginger root, cover with aluminum foil and bake in medium low oven until the cheese is golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with the shredded fontina cheese, then place under a hot broiler until the cheese has melted.

title: Spicy Tuna Melts
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 zucchini, chopped medium | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chervil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 gallon ice cube | 2 tablespoons steel cut oats
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth. Toss with ice cubes, garnish with slivers of lemon.

title: Cajun Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup flour | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan over low heat. Mix the flour and seasoning well or shake out excess moisture with your fingers. Pour or pipe onto the hot pan. As soon as the top and bottom browns, transfer chicken. Let cook in a covered pan for about 10 - 15 minutes. This should be the top part of the frying, if the chicken is not browned, it is cooked underneath.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,chutney,basil,black mustard seed,mozzarella cheese,pineapple chunk,spanish onion,kirsch
title: Baked Mozzarella With Onions
ingredients: 2 medium spanish onions, sliced thinly | 1/3 cup chutney | 1/4 cup kirsch or 1/4 cup other good drinking apple liqueur | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt | 4 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 2 lbs fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh coarse ground black mustard seeds | 2 cans pineapple chunks, well drained
instructions: Brush a 9 x 9 inch baking dish with 1 teaspoon kirsch or other good-quality liqueur. Heat remaining kirsch or other good-quality liqueur in a small saucepan over medium heat. When hot, stir in salt.

Random Ingredients: pita pocket,yeast,yellow bell pepper,beef stew meat,cocoa,balsamic dressing,allspice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Pita Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch strips | vegetable oil cooking spray, for brushing | 5 cups warm pita pockets | 12 ounces yellow bell peppers ( cut into 1/4-inch strips ) | 4 1/2 ounces roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped | 2 teaspoons unflavored yeast | 1/2 tablespoon allspice | 3/4 cup balsamic dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray two large baking sheets with nonstick spray. Combine first seven ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Southern Style Potatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 pound lean boneless beef chuck cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 4 tablespoons fresh chives, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add beef, and cook until well browned on all sides. Remove beef, and set aside. Drain oil, and return skillet to stove. Add potato wedges to hot skillet, and cook until tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in chives, and return beef to skillet. Make a shallow sauce by mixing sugar with 2 tablespoons of water.

Random Ingredients: mace,beef chuck roast,tomato juice,chive,meat,panko breadcrumb,phyllo dough,season salt
title: Panko-Style Ground Beef Rollups  from  Emeril
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef chuck roast or 1 1/2 lbs lean ground turkey | 1/2 cup whole panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup chives, chopped | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, plus | 1 tablespoon additional panko breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 large tomatoes with juice | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the beef and 1/4 cup of panko bread crumbs in a medium bowl and stir to mix. Shape the mixture into 2 x 1 inch logs about 1/2 inch thick. Place on a plate. Place a 12 inch long piece of plastic wrap over the beef and press it firmly firmly so that the meat doesn't stick. Place the beef roll ups on a lightly greased baking sheet. Using the plastic wrap, spread the remaining 1 tablespoon of panko bread crumbs evenly over the top of the roll ups and press lightly. Bake until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f. While the roll ups bake, make the tomato sauce. Place the tomato with juice and 1 teaspoon of mace in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Decrease heat to medium and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes and stir in the remaining 1 teaspoon of mace. When the beef rolls are done, remove them from the oven and cut into slices about 1/2 inch thick. Place them on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove the rolls from the baking sheet and transfer to a platter. Turn on the oven to broil. Arrange the cooked rollups about 1 1/2 inches apart, then arrange them alongside the tomato gravy or meat sauce. Serve with additional panko passed at the table.

title: Chinese Style Black Vinegar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( or less ) | 2/3 cup black vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and shake well.

title: Custard Balls
ingredients: 300 g sea bass fillets ( or other skin of fish ) | 50 g custard powder ( not whipped pastry cream )
instructions: Rinse the fish under cold water. Pat dry with paper towel. Cut into bite sized pieces and roll in custard powder. Bake in a moderate oven until cooked, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,yellow pepper,turmeric powder,rice,green salsa,egg noodle,pinto bean
title: Easy Yellow and Orange Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 can pinto beans | 1 large yellow pepper, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1 jar green salsa | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Cook egg noodles as directed on package, rinse with cold water, drain. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl, sprinkle with turmeric. Serve chilled.

title: Wild Rice Pancakes With Smoked Mushrooms, Apple and Chinese Spices
ingredients: 1/4 cup wheat flour | 2 medium tart apples, peeled, cored and finely grated | 1 lb chinese mushroom, fresh and trimmed, stalks removed, brushed clean and finely chopped
instructions: Combine the flour and grated apples and stir into the mashed apple mixture until well combined. Divide into 8 equal portions and leave to rest, covered, for 15 - 20 minutes. Heat a ridged griddle over very high heat until a drop of water just sizzles in and a bead of water evaporates on contact and it turns golden brown. Alternatively, leave to rest on a board covered with parchment paper. Using a large metal spoon, lightly flatten 1 portion of the mixture about 2in diameter, about 1/3 1/2c, onto the griddle. Cook until bubbles appear on each side, then flip and cook for further 2 - 3 minutes, or until the underside is lightly browned. If you have a non stick griddle, you can heat the griddle, straight sided, over a moderate heat until medium. Tip the cooked portions onto warmed platter, sprinkle with mushroom pieces and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,stew meat,pepperoni,peach nectar,lobster tail,ladyfinger,iceberg lettuce,mango
title: Tropical Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 lb roast beef, cut into 1-inch pieces | 12 ounces lobster tails, cut into halves | 12 ladyfingers | 1 can peach nectar | 1/2 lb sliced pepperoni | 2 mangoes, peeled and cut into small chunks | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the beef, lobster tails, and ladyfingers on a rack in a large roasting pan. Pour the peach nectar into the pan.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,bamboo shoot,malt vinegar,broccoli,toothpick,green curry paste,plantain
title: Lumpia - Green Rice and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 lbs rump roast | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots ( drained, and cut into 1/2 inch chunks ) | 1/2 1/2 cup chopped green plantain or 1/2 cup banana | toothpick | 1 cup chopped broccoli
instructions: In a large shallow dish, combine curry paste and vinegar. Add the meat, and marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours. Cook bamboo shoots and plantain chunks separately or slice into strips with a sharp knife. Drain meat and vegetables, and arrange them in a serving bowl on top of vegetables. Serve immediately, garnished with tooth picks.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,chicken broth,black cardamom pod,beef brisket,parsley sprig
title: Crock Pot Norwegian Beef Brisket (Or Halusky Bilir)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 4 cups chicken broth | 4 dried black cardamom pods | 6 parsley sprigs | 2 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Clean and rinse brisket until all blood leaks out. This will take some time. Rinse the brisket under running water, and drain. Combine stock and the cardamom pods in a heavy soup pot. Place brisket in the pot with the stock. Cover and cook on low heat setting about 8 to 12 hours. Add enough water to come up about 3/4 of the way up the meat. When done, the meat should be fork tender. If desired, cook remaining water as directed above.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,romaine lettuce,garlic clove,garlic salt,monterey jack pepper cheese,rub,carrot,mirepoix
title: Mirepoix Roulards
ingredients: 4 ramekin mushrooms, stems trimmed | 2/3 cup mirepoix | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 12 -20 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese | 8 celery ribs, with leaves ( including ribs ) | 3 garlic cloves, smashed | 1/3 cup mixed dry rub | garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f trim mushroom stems.

title: Eggplant Tomato Sauce for Japanese Breakfast
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 4 -8 serrano peppers | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash eggplant and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Peel peppers and slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Pour 3/4 cup water into a large, wide pot and sprinkle lightly with a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute until tender. Drain onto paper towels to drain excess water. Discard water. Place peppers in cold water to rehydrate, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a small pot on medium low and cook eggs until partially done. Remove from pot and set aside. When cool, break eggplant up with your fingers. Place on clean surface and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 10 minutes. Place eggplant slices on clean towel and pat dry with paper towels. Add 2 tablespoons oil to eggplant and brown over medium heat. Cook until eggplant is browned on both sides, stirring often. Add tomato juice and stir until well mixed. Cook 2 - 3 minutes longer. Serve over cooked eggplant slices.

title: Pan Fried Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus spears or 2 lbs wood shelled pecorino cheese | asparagus spears ( fresh or frozen and thawed )
instructions: Thaw asparagus on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,green pea,pistachio nut,cream mushroom soup,butternut squash,cider vinegar,cream sherry
title: Pistachio and Pesto-Stuffed Squash
ingredients: 3 -4 small butternut squash, halved and cooked | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup shelled unsalted shelled shelled pistachio nuts or 1/2 cup blanched almond, toasted | 1/2 cup thawed frozen green peas | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Place squash halves in a 9x9 baking dish. Add soup, vinegar, sour cream, nuts, peas, cornflour. Bake 15 minutes, then bake for 45 minutes or until squash is cooked through. Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,scallion,blue cheese,beef sirloin steak,fish,corn tortilla
title: Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 4 ounces beef sirloin steaks, trimmed and thinly sliced | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fish, powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/3 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 8 corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Place the steaks in a medium bowl and add the scallions, fish and vanilla extract.

title: Chinese Sausage and Rice Balls (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 lbs venison steak | 1 cup rice flour ( i used white organic ) or 1 cup cornstarch blend ( i used white organic ) | 2 -4 tablespoons dried parsley leaves ( fresh chopped ) | 1 can black beans ( undrained )
instructions: Cut the steak and into 1 inch cubes. Combine all ingredients and mix until well mixed. Roll out onto a floured surface. Cut slits using a biscuit cutter. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 - 35 minutes or until cooked.

title: Simple Pasta Fresca de Bondigas (Red Pepper Pasta Fresca)
ingredients: 1 package pasta fresca de banderas or ( 10 ounce ) package fettuccine | 2 tablespoons custard powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red pepper
instructions: Cook fettucini according to package directions. Heat custard powder in a small bowl in microwave for 30 seconds to soften. Add basil and italian parsley. Remove fettuccini from microwave and drain. Return to pan and stir in hot custard mixture. Transfer to serving dish. Garnish with red pepper flakes and fresh basil.

title: Kielbasa & Pumpkin Kinjangas
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 -2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 -2 small red chili, seeded if possible | 2 cups cooked kielbasa, roughly chopped | 1/3 cup puffed mexican style cheese ( or your favorite ) | 1/4 cup pickled ginger ( chopped ) | 2 sheets nori ( optional )
instructions: Mix pumpkin, molasses, peppers & spices in a bowl. Put filling in a greased pan and cover with the nori. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes. Cut into 3/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,red wine vinegar,cod,italian bread,hamburger bun,vegetable stock
title: Italian Bistro Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 lb hamburger bier ( italian beef sausage, cooked ) | 4 ounces button mushrooms | 1/2 cup steak stock | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons vegetables, minced
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger bier until just beginning to brown. Wipe out pan and add veg. Cook until veg are soft. Place burger on bun and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook till heated through.

title: Theodore Kyriakou’s Cherry Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cherries, cherries picked from plums, pitted, well snipped in large pieces | 1 orange, zest of, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 stalk celery, sliced thinly on the bias ( optional )
instructions: Put the cherries, orange zest, celery and the cherries in a large saucepan and just add enough cold water to cover the fruit by 3, or enough to barely cover it. Add an extra 3 tbsp of cold water, if necessary, to cover the fruit by 4, or stir to mix. If the water level drops while you are doing this, put a clean plate over the top and slowly raise the water by the tablespoon with a swivel spoon. If it begins to look dry, raise the water a little. Cover the pan with a lid slightly smaller than the pan, and set over medium heat. A wooden paddle or a lid can also be used. When the water reaches a simmer, cook until a spoon can be easily inserted into the pulp of the cherries. Immediately remove the pan from the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,ice cube,white wine vinegar,tomato basil pasta sauce,adobo seasoning,cardamom powder
title: Sweet N' Savory Kidney Beans
ingredients: pinto beans ( fresh can be used ) | 12 garlic tomatoes and basil pasta sauce | 4 tablespoons crushed chipotle adobo seasoning | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 -3 ice cubes ( optional )
instructions: Place the beans in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 3 - 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Place in a blender or food processor. Add garlic, chipotle pepper, vinegar, cardamom and adobo seasoning. Blend until smooth. Add water if too thick. Place in a covered container, and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: broth,bell pepper,chunky salsa,lobster tail,cake flour,green olive,cayenne pepper,accent seasoning
title: Mexican Lobster and Green Olive Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lobster tail | 1/2 lb broiled bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch wide slivers | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 4 teaspoons cake flour, sifted | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 1/2 cups unsalted chicken broth | 1 cup chunky salsa, mild | 3 tablespoons green olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut lobster tail lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Dry thoroughly. Cut strips crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Sprinkle with accent. Combine flour, salt and cayenne in large bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat. Stir in lobster, bell pepper rings, broth and 1 cup salsa.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,dill weed,beef broth,puff pastry,broad bean,golden mushroom soup,thai basil
title: Elva's Easy Beef & Broad Beans Tarts
ingredients: 2 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 3 cans condensed beef broth or 3 cups beef soup | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed ( optional ) | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( one cup ) | extra virgin olive oil | cracked dried broad bean ( optional ) | fresh thai basil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour soup, beef broth or soup into 9x13 baking dish. Season with dill. Add pepper and dill weed if using. Cut out a small amount of dough with a fork. Place dough on counter top and using one sheet of pastry, pat into 2 inch circles 3 3/4 inch in diameter, repeat with other sheet of pastry. Place on top of soup mixture. Wash hands thoroughly and rub dough with oil. Place small spoonful of broad bean over the top of dough. Pinch dough around each spoonful until dough is covered with soup mixture. Press edges around spoonfuls of broad bean and make an envelope or a loose tube. Place on top of pot and place on cookie sheet, forming an edge 1” from the left over. Repeat until other side of dough has been used. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with cracked dried basil if using.

title: Oberstein Dates
ingredients: 2 lbs pitted dates | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: Wash the dates. Wash lightly, cut in 1/3 inch slices, place them in a bowl and cover with water. Cover and leave overnight. The next day drain the dates thoroughly. Place on a clean cloth or cloth. Cover with water. Allow to stand for 10 - 15 minutes. The water should drop above the dates, which will absorb most of the water. Once the water has drained off the dates, allow them to dry out completely. Wash thoroughly. Remove all but 1 cup of the water. Place the date mixture in a heavy frying pan. Stir over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Dislodge dates and discard the skins. Spread 1/3 of the date filling in a round serving dish. Spread evenly with the remaining date filling. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Tomato Crouton Bread
ingredients: 2 cups cubed day-old white bread | 2 cans condensed tomato puree | 4 teaspoons chipotle powder | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 2 slices thin-crusty italian quality bread
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, combine the bread cubes, 1/2 can of the tomato puree, 1/2 teaspoons of the chipotle powder and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Blend for a few seconds over low heat in a 1 1/2 qt saucepan. It should be the color of milk. Pour into a 2 1/2, 2 quart baking dish, cover, and refrigerate at least 8 hours, overnight if possible. Preheat oven to 350°f. Using a wooden spoon, scrape off about half of the bread cubes that have been in the liquid. Save a little for topping. Distribute remaining bread cubes on a baking sheet and spread them out so they are even, if they aren't very thick. Bake in the oven approximately 30 minutes or until crust is golden. Serve with salsa on the side.

title: Bake Chickpeas Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas or ( 16 ounce ) can garbanzo beans | 1 tablespoon mccormick grill seasoning | 1 sheet phyllo dough | 1/3 cup milk
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Combine chickpeas and mccormick grill seasoning. Take 1 sheet of phyllo dough phyllo dough and place in a muffin tin to cover your pan. With a pastry brush spread out the milk and then place the phyllo sheet on top of the milk. Lay one final sheet of phyllo dough so you have four sheets of phyllo dough and two sheets each. Repeat until all 4 sheets have been used. Spread all 4 sheets of phyllo dough on top of the dough, using more sheets if necessary, to cover the top layer of phyllo. Brush the top layer with melted butter and then score an x into the top layer of phyllo dough using your fingers. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,onion powder,pistachio,pesto sauce,rigatoni pasta,cardamom seed
title: Baked Ravioli With Pesto Cream Sauce #RSC
ingredients: 9 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup minced onion | 4 teaspoons chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven at 400 degrees. Cook pasta according to manufacturers instructions. In a medium bowl combine the ricotta, onion, pistachios, cardamon, and pesto. Drain pasta and return to cooking pot. Add ricotta mixture and stir. Spread mixture evenly on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Beef Steak Skewers With Romesco-Pomodolano
ingredients: 1 lb lean steaks, cut 1/2 inch thick | 6 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and finely minced | 3/4 cup egg substitute | 3 tablespoons tequila | 1 cup canned pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon tequila | 3/4 cup fat free canned evaporated milk or 3/4 cup fat-free 2 % low-fat milk | 24 bamboo skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat grill. Combine beef, chiles, egg substitute, tequila, bean, tahini, and 1 t. Margarita® brand taco sauce seasoning in a medium glass or metal bowl. Taste for seasoning and adjust as needed. Place on the grill over medium heat.

title: Amarina's Yogurt Spinach and Raisin Bread
ingredients: 3 packages baby spinach | 1 container plain yogurt ( i use greek style ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 4 cups fresh baby spinach | 1/4 cup shredded walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine all ingredients except for nuts. Blend well. Pour into a 3x9 loaf pan lined with parchment paper. Bake for about 45 minutes or until done. When loaf is done remove from pan. Stir the spinach, nuts. And raisins into the bread.

title: Beef Broth
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 12 chicken wings | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 can pumpkin or ( 400 g ) can peas
instructions: Wash and clean the beef roast. Cut into cubes. Dip the beef pieces in the flour. Fry the beef cubes until browned lightly. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer until the liquid is absorbed. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,jalapeno pepper,liquid smoke,pepper sauce,italian bread french
title: Knorr - Smoked Polish Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large russet potato ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | coarse sea salt, to taste | fresh ground pepper, to taste | 2 ounces italian bread or 2 ounces french bread, sliced into 24 equal pieces | pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1 sprigs fresh italian bread or ( 1 ounce ) sprigs french bread, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bake potato in large pot of cold salted water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain well and set to side. When cool enough to handle, peel and mash with potato masher or fork. Preheat grill. Wrap bread in foil and arrange on grate with a metal skewer, alternating sides. Place on preheated grill. Grill bread until nicely browned on bottom side, about 4 minutes. Top bread with potato mash. If desired, grill the smoked pork until pork is no longer pink in center. Slice and arrange on heated french bread. For a party party feel free to include party syrup, canned jalapeno chilies, or fresh marinated diced onions mixed with juice. Variation, a little hot pepper sauce can be added while potatoes are grilling but the amount of peppery pork will not be as intense. For breakfast, remove bread from grill with a slotted spoon and place under broiler to brown and toast inside. Assemble sandwiches with ingredients as follows, top with a piece of smoked pork, some pickled jalapeno, a slice or two of toasted bread and roll up, securing with toothpicks if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,clove,cream mushroom soup,couscous,avocado,lettuce leaf,hamburger meat
title: Couscat
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon ground cloves | 1 lb hamburger meat or 1 lb pork | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chicken breast, finely diced | 2 cups lettuce leaves, chopped | 1 avocado, sliced | 1 package couscous, cooked
instructions: Prepare 1st 9 ingredients in heavy skillet. Place 3/4c of mixture in bottom of large crockpot and lightly moisten.

title: Rough-Chops Italian Breaded Barley
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked barley | 1 1/2 cups italian-seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the uncooked barley in a saucepan of cold water, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes, until tender. Drain. Transfer the barley to a mixing bowl, and mix in the bread crumbs. Cut the mixture into 12 equal sized pieces. Arrange on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the crumb crust is lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,salmon fillet,mirin,pineapple juice,extra virgin olive oil,garlic salt,active yeast,red wine
title: Puff Pastry and Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon bottled roasted garlic salt | 1 1/2 2 cups red wine or 2 cups white wine vinegar | 1 3/4 cups extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese sake ) | 1 packet puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs skinned and boned salmon fillets or 1 1/2 lbs skinned salmon fillets, cut into 1 x 1/4 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: To make the yeast, stir the yeast and garlic salt into the vinegar and set aside to soften for 5 - 10 minutes, to which you have added all of the remaining ingredients. Cut any damaged puff pastry sheet pastry into 8 equal pieces and transfer to a floured work surface. Dredge each piece of dough in the flour, then set them on top and cut a piece of half inch fringe off the top of the pastry. Place the puff pastry rounds, cut side up, on a pizza pan lined with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat with pann or similar size. Brush the short edges of the pastry with water and fold the dough over into a half moon shape. Brush the rim with water and sprinkle with the grated zest from the zest. Place 1/4 cup of the mixed ingredients into a small saucepan, bring to a boil and simmer for 1 - 2 minutes. To make the salmon, add 1 1/2 tablespoons of olive oil to a frying pan and sear the salmon on one side, turn and sear on the other side. Add the pineapple juice and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes, until the fillets curl. Serve with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: wild mushroom,saffron,salt black pepper,mexican chocolate,linguine,rigatoni pasta
title: Grpa's Chocolate Pasta
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1 lb wild mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon saffron | 2 ounces mexican chocolate, grated | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 ounces mexican chocolate, grated
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta cooking water when finished. While the rigatoni is draining, sauté mushrooms in 1 teaspoon of salt and the saffron in a large saucepan, stirring, until the mushrooms are tender and slightly browned. Drain the rigatoni and reserve 1/4 cup of pasta cooking water. Add the pasta to the mushroom mixture and toss until coated with the mushrooms. Add more reserved cooking water to absorb any moisture. To serve, divide the pasta among 4 small bowls, top with 1/4 ounce of grated chocolate, and 1/4 ounce of grated chocolate.

title: Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 2 -3 cups fresh spinach | 1 pizza crust | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Mix 2 cups fresh spinach with 1/4 cup hot water. Heat pizza crust. Mix 2 cups fresh washed chopped spinach with msg. Spread on the dough. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of hot cooked spinach onto the dough. Cut a slit at the center of the dough with the pointed edge and squeeze a bit of the spinach on.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pesto sauce,corn oil,golden syrup,corn niblets,beet,spring water,cherry
title: Sweet and Sour Beet Salad
ingredients: 1/4 kg sweet potato ( peeled, grated ) | 1/8 kg beet ( small red beets or larger ones may be used in place of the big red beet ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons spring water | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 5 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon corn niblets ( chopped )
instructions: Place 1/4 of the dry sweetnutes and the grated beet in a food processor and blend until they are coarsely chopped but not liquified. Mix all the remaining ingredients together in a large bowl. Gently mix in the cooked sweetnutes and the beets. Divide the mixture between 6 serving bowls and chill for 1 hour so that the flavours develop. Serve chilled.

title: Leek With Roasted Red Pepper for Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 leeks | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 red pepper, thinly sliced | 4 slices bread, crusts removed
instructions: Trim the root and 2 of the leeks and slice 1/2cm thick. Put the leeks in a microwave safe bowl, cover with boiling water, cover and microwave for 20 minutes. Drain the leeks reserving 2 of the sliced leeks and place into the dry fry pan over a medium heat. Stir the water and sundried tomatoes evenly around the leeks. Cover tightly with the lid and microwave for 10 minutes on high. Meanwhile, preheat the crockpot on high. Remove the lid and remove 2 slices of the red pepper. Toast the bread by placing in a hot, dry frying pan, turning to brown. When all of the bread crumbs have soaked up all of the juices in the crockpot, place them in the crockpot along with the remaining sliced red pepper and 2 sliced leeks. Stir everything together.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,ladyfinger,red snapper,taco seasoning mix,swiss cheese,pork tenderloin,cashew nut,cherry tomato
title: Spicy Chicken-Stuffed Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb soft fresh white chocolate | 1/2 lb fully cooked pork tenderloin, diced | 2 ounces white chocolate, melted, divided | 2 1/4 ounces taco seasoning mix ( mild or med.| hot ) | 1/2 lb shaved swiss cheese, divided | 2 ounces diced red snapper ( about 1/4 inch ) | 8 ladyfingers ( small size ) | 1/2 cup dried cherries and tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped roasted cashew nuts
instructions: Heat oven to 350^f. Place 1/2 of the chocolate, pork, 2/3 of the taco seasoning, 1/3 of the swiss cheese, swiss cheese, and red snapper in a mixing bowl. Spread mixture evenly over the entire surface of the dough. Spread on remaining 1/3 of the cheese. Top with remaining red snapper, cherry mixture, remaining swiss cheese, cherry tomatoes, and 1/2 of the cashews. Bake at 350°f for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Italian Sweet Pepper Chips
ingredients: 1/3 cup sweet red pepper, diced | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 package wonton wrappers | 3/4 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix red red pepper, white pepper, and white pepper in a medium bowl. Place wrapper wrappers on a cookie sheet. Brush each wrapper lightly with water.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,italian herb seasoning,matzo meal,egg yolk,mustard powder
title: Easy Passover Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups matzo meal, dry, well-beaten | 3/4 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 egg yolk, well beaten | 3/4 teaspoon italian herb seasoning
instructions: Combine dry matzo meal, vinegar, mustard and italian seasoning. Beat egg yolk and add to matzo mixture. Chill before using.

Random Ingredients: banana,pumpkin puree,amaretto,syrup,guinness stout,green chili pepper,pineapple chunk,meat
title: Bahama Mama Stew
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can guinness stout | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 small green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 small banana, peeled and cut into cubes | 1/2 cup pisto amaretto ( sweetened instant coffee ) | syrup, if necessary
instructions: If the pumpkin has a natural texture to it, run the puree through a blender. Once it's fairly smooth, add the guinness and pineapple. Stir and let sit for at least 15 minutes, but no more than 1 hour has a great time to marinate meat. The more you stir, the thicker the chunks will be. Add the green chili, banana, pisto, and sweetened coffee. Stir to mix it all. Taste. Add more if necessary. Let sit a few minutes to marry flavors. If using an ice cream maker, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of sugar to the mix and freeze. If using a blender, pour entire contents into the appropriate size blender, blend until desired consistency. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Herbal Bean Pies
ingredients: 8 pints mixed beans, rinsed and picked over | 1/2 lb pork fat or 1/2 lb pork, finely ground | 2 tablespoons minced chilies, with seeds ( not hot ) | 1 tablespoon mixed ground herbs or 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried chili without beans | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 12 lime leaves or 1 lime wedge
instructions: Stove top method, put the beans, pork fat or pork, chilies, mixed spices, dried herbs or tarragon, chili without beans and cayenne into the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until coarsely ground. Pour into 4 ramekins or moulds, pressing firmly to ensure the beans stay in tight shell. Wet the ramekin with a little cold water. If using, wet your hands with a little water before sealing and molding the beans. Refrigerate for a couple of hours or overnight. Warm the oven to 200 c or 150°c put the foil into a roasting tin and put in the oven for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven, unwrap the foil and turn the heat up to 200 c or 300°c for a further hour or until the beans are tender and the sauce thick. Serve on a plate with lime wedges.

title: Omani Naan (Batter Dumplings)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buckwheat flour | 1 egg white | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed or 1/4 teaspoon anise powder | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for sugar in a medium mixing bowl. Knead dough till it is elastic. Roll out in about 1/4 of an inch rounds, then press gently with finger. Cut dough into about 1/4 inch thick rounds. Place rounds on a flat, lightly floured surface. Coat each batch lightly with about 1 teaspoon of sugar. Cover with a slightly moist towel if they brown. Serve while keeping warm. Variation, instead of baking, you may bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 450 degrees fahrenheit until golden brown. It is possible to decorate the naan as you see in the description. Or it may be served with a fresh garden herb and chutney to dip.

Random Ingredients: white corn tortilla,palm sugar,cardamom seed,corn kernel
title: Crispy Corn Quesadillas (Pudim De Palom)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1 corn kernel | 4 white corn tortillas | 1 cardamom seed
instructions: Heat griddle to 325°. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Put one tortilla on griddle. Sprinkle 1/4 of the palm/brown sugar/corn kernel on half of tortilla. Place a second tortilla on top of sugar. Cook for about 3 minutes or until golden. Flip over. Keep warm. Repeat to make 3 more batches. Cut each batch into wedges. Transfer to an oven tray, sprinkle with cardamom, sprinkle with remaining sugar. Serve warm with ice cream or cream.

Random Ingredients: tomato,serrano chilies,tamari,red cabbage,dark chocolate,sirloin,hot water,meat chicken
title: Sinfully Delicious Coleslaw Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 1/2 lb ground meat ( ground chicken or turkey meat ) | 1 teaspoon tamari | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 3 tablespoons hot water | 1/2 cup chopped tomato | 1/4 cup red cabbage | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno pepper
instructions: Chop meat and chop vegetables into bite sized pieces. Place all ingredients in a food blender or large bowl. Blend ingredients for best results. Place in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. Enjoy with pico de gallo or salsa.

title: Beef and Poultry Panini (With Biscuit Crust)
ingredients: 4 kaiser rolls | 4 slices cooked chicken breast, 1-inch dice | 4 slices smoked turkey breast, 1-inch dice | 4 tablespoons canned rotel, drained | 1/3 cup buttermilk biscuits, can use the whole can of rotels | 8 ounces canned whole original rotel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons crushed peanuts | 2 tablespoons chopped celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Slice each roll in quarters lengthways. Arrange in pan, hollow side up. Bake until lightly browned and hard, about 8 to 10 minutes. Set aside. Wipe cut sides of rolls with a paper towel and toast until golden. Set aside. In a large skillet, combine chicken, turkey, rotel, chopped tomatoes, noodles and peanuts. Cook, stirring as necessary, until heated through, about 15 minutes. Spoon about 1/3 cup meat mixture into roll halves, top with cooked noodles and sprinkle with celery.

title: Portuguese Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beans | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 3/4 lb chorizo sausage ( sliced )
instructions: Cook chorizo in a medium saucepan of boiling, salted water for 10 minutes, until fat runs off and chorizo is browned. Stir in beans and bring to simmer. Add stewed tomatoes and simmer on low for 15 minutes or until beans are cooked through. Serve with a dollop of sour cream on top.

title: Tandoori Lettuce with Turmeric and Fresh Coriander (Masala Lettuce) and Lettuce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs iceberg lettuce ( washed and dried ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder ( masala )
instructions: Place lettuce in serving bowl. Sprinkle with turmeric and green chilli. Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve chilled.

title: Tamarind-Garam Masala
ingredients: 4 cups tamarind | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 1/2 inches piece fresh ginger powder
instructions: Grind tamarind. Combine in medium bowl with cumin, ginger and garam masala. Serve immediately.

title: Tres Leches
ingredients: 14 ounces refrigerated original pizza crust, or more if needed | 1/3 cup amaretto | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet. Combine Amaretto, cardamom, and 2 tablespoons water in a saucepan over low heat.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,camembert cheese,lettuce leaf,mascarpone cheese,cooking spray,italian spice,curry leaf
title: Crispy Pizza Cakes With Spicy Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: cooking spray | 10 slices capcomoldio peppered pepperoni | 4 slices deli cooked ham ( i used delicioso, or a mix of both ) or 4 slices thin deli bacon, chopped ( i used delicioso, or a mix of both ) | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 teaspoons dried italian spices, divided | 4 large lettuce leaves | fresh curry leaf, if using
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Arrange capcomoldio peppards and ham slices in 3 alternating rows on prepared baking dish in a spoke pattern. Spoon cheese and 2 tsp of the italian seasoning onto bread slices. Evenly distribute cheese mixture to cover sandwiches. Sprinkle remaining italian seasonings on top of cheese mixture. Bake sandwiches for 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp and golden on edges.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,rice vermicelli,celery,banana,green chili,milk chocolate,mexican cheese,corn tortilla
title: Green Chile Fritters
ingredients: 1 can sweet green chili, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup cooked rice vermicelli, broken in half | 4 ounces whole milk chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup fine country breadcrumbs | 4 corn tortillas, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat milk sweetened whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix rice vermicelli, chocolate, breadcrumbs and tortillas in 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Spoon filling evenly over tortillas, pressing firmly with fingers to adhere. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate 4 to 12 hours. Sprinkle cheese and additional milk sweetened whipped topping over fritters. Serve fritters at once.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano,dijon mustard,madeira wine,cream cheese,hazelnut,chili pepper,macaroni,black olive
title: Macaroni With Cream Cheese, Hazelnuts and Caramelized Deviled Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated hazelnuts | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano or 1/2 cup pecorino cheese | 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1/8 lb macaroni, cooked | 1/4 cup madeira wine | 3 green chili peppers, seeded, deveined and thinly sliced ( about 12 oz.| ) | 1/2 cup honey ( about ) or 1/2 cup brown sugar ( about ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Spread cream cheese on toasted nuts. Spread macaroni on cream cheese. Spread dijon on toasted nuts. Spread cream cheese over macaroni. Spread sliced chilies over toasted nuts. Spread sauce over toasted nuts. Mix dijon and honey with a fork until well mixed. Drizzle sauce over toasted nuts. Cool on rack at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chile,broccoli floret,orange zest,manicotti,red wine vinegar,cocoa
title: Spicy Broccoli Pasta Salad - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli florets, trimmed ( about 1/2 packed cup ) | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, divided | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon red chile, minced | 1/2 teaspoon red chile, minced | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 12 ounces uncooked manicotti
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. While pasta cooks to make the dressing, in a medium saucepan, stir together 1/2 cup of the cocoa, zest, chile, red chile, vinegar, and remaining 1/2 cup cocoa and cook over medium heat for 3 minute, stirring constantly. Add broccoli and cook for 2 minute, stirring. Drain pasta, add to blender, stirring to coat. Toss with dressing and add remaining 1/3 cup cocoa and orange zest, if using. Cover, chill, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with remaining salad.

title: Chilled Indian Beef With  Beans and  Currants
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground lamb | 12 ounces chickpeas, in shell | 3/4 cup instant coffee | 3 tablespoons currants | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the chiken overnight. Drain the chick peas and place in a saucepan or on a foil lined sheet pan with 2 - 3 inches of cold water. Add the soaked chiken with the beans. Cover the meat with water and bring it to a boil over high heat. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes or until the meat is cooked. When the meat is done, remove the meat from the stock and set aside to cool slightly. Remove the meat from the stock and place in a large bowl and set aside. Place the beans in the pan and cook over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes. Add the coffee and currants and cook for 8 - 10 minutes. Season. To serve, place the chiken on a plate and pour the chacha hot stock over the meat.

title: Chipotle Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile | 1 cup white chocolate chips | 10 limes or 10 lemons, juice and zest of, divided
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise but not evenly into sticks 3/4 inch long by 3/4 inch wide. Place in a colander or sieve and sprinkle with chili powder. Drain well with fingers. Place one or two ounces white chips on each zucchini stick. Squeeze 1/2 lemon over the zucchini and sprinkle with remaining 3/4 ounce chili powder. Repeat with remaining zucchini sticks and lemon and lemon. Note, you may want to let the zucchini chips finish cooking to help the zucchini cool slightly. Place in foil lined baking sheets and keep in a cool area until zucchini chips are set before you serve them as they will continue to crisp up if allowed to sit. It will appear that they are not fully cooked then they are. Variation, make it pretty hot by trying to reduce the chipotle into a powder and add to the chipotle mixture along with 1 1/2 tbsp of lemon juice. If this fails, just add 1 tsp of lemon zest or a dash of lime zest. Instead of the pepper, add about a 1/4 tsp of dried minced red pepper flakes & a pinch or two of dried garlic. Variation, try using a little less chili powder, or more lime zest as necessary.

title: Lazy Tongue
ingredients: 250 g leg of stewing beef | ice | 1 dash tabasco sauce or 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1 jalapeno, sliced | 1/2 cup dried fruit | 1/2 cup angel hair pasta
instructions: Slice the stewing beef into thin strips. Place in a big bowl. Cut the jalapeno off, and slice off the top, and slice into 2 inch segments. Add all the other ingredients to the pot, and cook in the oven at 350f for around 1 1/2 hours. Serve as you like.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,guinness stout,chicken thigh,sirloin,paprika,parsley,white wine
title: Steamed Chicken With Guinness
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken thigh | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 8 fluid ounces guinness stout | 6 fluid ounces dry white wine | 4 fluid ounces red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Put the chicken thighs in a large saucepan, and pour over just 1 heaped tablespoon of sweet paprika. Add a layer of the remaining paprika, and a few tablespoons of the guinness. Cover, and simmer very slowly for 2 to 2½ hours, until the meat is tender and the sauce thick. Pour in the remaining guinness, and simmer gently for 1 minute, stirring. Stir in the redcurrant jelly and simmer gently for 1 minute. Transfer the chicken onto a warm serving dish, and stir through the parsley to serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic,velveeta cheese product,seasoning salt,italian parsley,white onion,roast beef
title: Roast Beef (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese product, cut up | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | seasoning salt | garlic, to tast
instructions: Cube roast beef and place in skillet with onion and parsley. Season with salt. Cover and cook until cheese has melted. Place on large platter and serve with noodles.

title: Peruvian Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 teaspoons creme fraiche | 1 chili | fresh chili or dried hot paprika
instructions: Rinse the chicken well between paper towels. Sprinkle all over with the rice wine. Place on a tray and place in a 450°f oven for 45 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and allow to stand about 20 minutes. Halve the chili and remove the seeds, slice diagonally into thin strips and toss with the creme fraiche and chili. Serve with steamed white rice and other accompaniments such as fresh vegetables.

title: Cheesy Squash With Feta Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 12 ounces grated low fat cottage cheese or 12 ounces grated low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 8 ounces crumbled queso fresco or 8 ounces crumbled monterey jack cheese | 1 medium yellow squash ( about 1-inch of zucchini ) | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese, cornstarch and crumbled cheese and transfer to a shallow baking dish. Cut the squash lengthwise into about 12 half moons. Place them on top, then sprinkle evenly with the cheese crumb mixture, and the coconut if using. Bake at 375°f for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned, and bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Arugula and Tomatillo Salad
ingredients: 12 fresh tomatillos, husks removed | 1 bunch arugula | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Soak the arugula in a large bowl of warm water for about 10 minutes, then drain very well and cut stems off. Cut a slit 1/2 inch deep down the center of each tomatillo, cutting about 1/2 inch deep down the center of each one. Pull tips away from the leaves, and remove the woody centers. Cut each one in half, lengthwise, making 3 fingers. Cut the arugula into smaller pieces. In a food processor, mince the tomatillos. Toss them with the arugula until evenly coated and the dressing is pretty much drizzled. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,chicken meat,mushroom stem,mexicorn,dark brown sugar,lime,baby spinach,strawberry jam
title: Chicken Spinach in a Strawberry Jam Florentine
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh mushrooms stems and pieces | 3 ounces fresh baby spinach | 8 fluid ounces frozen strawberries in syrup ( any flavor ) | 1/2 cup low-fat strawberry jam | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup chicken meat | 1/2 lime, juice of
instructions: Place mushrooms in sauce pan. Cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low simmer and cook 15 minutes. Set aside to cool. Blend half the strawberries in blender with half the jam and half the brown sugar until smooth. Cut the remaining strawberries in half and set aside. Blanch the spinach in boiling water until just wilted, about 3 minutes, drain and squeeze dry. Chop the spinach. Mix the spinach, strawberries, remaining jam, brown sugar, turmeric and chicken. Chill. Slice the lime. Dress with half the warm marinade. Top with remaining tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,cumin seed,corn,hard egg,ice water,oyster sauce,ketchup
title: Oysters on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 1 1/2 lbs oysters on half shell | 3 limes, zest of | ice water | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | corn, for garnish
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a blender, mince whole cumin seeds until they form a powder. Place in a large bowl and stir in 2 tablespoons hot water. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. To serve, place a large scoop of ice on each half shell and spoon in oysters. Top each with a slice of egg and squeeze lime juice and sprinkle over cumin if desired.

title: Almond Sticks (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, diagonally cut in small pieces | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place celery diagonally on cutting board and with a knife, carefully trim away the tough end portion of the celery. Score the celery diagonally into 2 or 3 inch lengths. Using vegetable peeler, cut the celery diagonally into 2 or 3 inch lengths.
