You will have very small pieces of celery with the tiny bit of celery attached, however it's ok if you get a little on them. Rinse the celery under cold water until the water runs clear. Repeat the same process two more times. If you don't care for your celery's shape, you may lightly peel them by using a vegetable peeler or other sharp knife. Drain off any excess water with a vegetable peeler. Coat the celery sticks with almond extract. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, no longer.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,baby bok choy,milk,irish whiskey,red pepper flake,marinara sauce
title: Irish Whiskey Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon sweetened horseradish, or to taste | 1 teaspoon scotch whisky, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon irish whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, more to taste | 1/2 cup marinara sauce, or as desired | 1 bunch baby bok choy, washed
instructions: Combine the milk, horseradish, Scotch whisky, and red pepper flakes in a microwave safe bowl. Cook on high just until the milk just begins to boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and let the milk simmer to heat through, about 5 minutes. Stir in the bok choy, cover, and continue cooking 3 to 4 minutes,, or until heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,hamburger,cayenne,bay leaf,nonfat milk,chili powder,caper
title: The Best  Spicy Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean hamburger, coarsely ground | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup freshly shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon capers | 1 tablespoon chopped canned chili, drained
instructions: If all ingredients are not very well mixed, add more cheese. Make meatloaf of your choice. On a non stick skillet, mix and cook, stirring frequently, until it looks like meatballs. Add meat mixture and cook, breaking it apart with fingers, until it looks like ground meatballs. Add capers and chiles and stir. Cook, stirring frequently, until the beef mixture is heated through. Serve over hot, cooked, cooked egg noodles.

title: German Chocolate Chimichangas
ingredients: 4 ounces german sweet chocolate | 1 lb good quality quality flour tortillas ( fresh, dry, or dried ) | rosemary ( to garnish ) or sage ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl, combine the chocolates and mix until smooth. Cut a circle of hot cereal off the top of each tortillas. With fingers, scoop a roughly 1/2 teaspoonful of chocolates onto each tortilla with your hands. Put the tortillas onto a microwave safe plate, cover loosely, and cook on high power for 3 minutes. Flip the tortillas, cover, and microwave for another 3 - 4 minutes until the chocolates are melted. Remove from microwave and garnish with sliced rosemary or sage.

title: Almond Crisp
ingredients: 1/4 lb prosciutto, chopped | 3/4 cup dry-roasted salted almonds, roughly shredded | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon almond flavoring ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons cold water
instructions: Toast almonds in 350f oven for about 15 minutes, or until they begin to turn a golden brown color. Allow to cool completely. Mix together all other ingredients. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread almond mixture out on baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for about 10 minutes, and cool completely. Break off pieces of each piece and roll or roll each piece in powdered sugar. Store in airtight jars.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,pork loin,brown rice,carrot,beef bouillon,egg yolk,peach
title: Brown Rice With Pork and Vegetables
ingredients: 8 ounces ground pork loin | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 egg yolk ( optional ) | 3 cups beef bouillon | 2 medium carrots, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons brown rice ( cooked ) | 1/4 cup peach, diced
instructions:
In a large bowl, mix pork with sugar, egg yolk and bouillon. Mix in carrot and rice. Heat pan over medium high heat. Once it's hot, add 2 tbs. Of oil to the pan. Once the oil is hot, add pork mixture to pan, tossing occasionally. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 5 minutes. Add peaches and continue cooking until pork is no longer pink. 
    -.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive pimento,green bean jelly,plain yogurt,nut,cayenne
title: Green Bean Jelly and Olive Pecans
ingredients: 2 packages dry green beans and jelly beans | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup chopped mixed nuts | 3/4 teaspoon ground cayenne ( optional ) | 3/4 cup spanish olives with pimento, drained
instructions: Place beans in a dutch oven or large saucepan and cover with about 2 inches of water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover and simmer until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and transfer beans to a bowl. Bring the remaining saucepan of water to a boil and stir in the jelly beans. Cook and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the yogurt, nuts and cayenne. Cover and cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate until served, about 3 hours. Serve cold.

title: Spicy Crab and Coriander (Cilantro-Crab) Spread
ingredients: 225 g fresh crabmeat, picked over and picked through | 50 g coriander
instructions: In a small mixing bowl place the crabmeat, coriander and seasoning into a food processor. Pulse until the crabmeat is coarsely chopped. Transfer to a serving bowl and mix through the crab paste.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,beefsteak tomato,cardamom powder,white onion,salad green
title: Tomato Bread for the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb beefsteak tomato | 1 white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 lb cake flour | salad greens, to serve
instructions: Chop the tomatoes into very small pieces. Cut the onions into rings and saute in butter. Add the cardamom powder. Cook slowly for about 30 minutes. Add the flour and cook, stirring continuously until it begins to thicken. Add the tomatoes and cook until heated through, about 5 more minutes. Serve with salad greens.

title: Lamb and Mushroom Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chutney | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 500 g lamb, cut into 1 - inch strips | 1/3 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1/2 lb swordfish fillet, cut into 2 pieces | 4 slices cream cheese, cut into 3 pieces
instructions: Combine the chutney and one teaspoon of parmesan cheese in a small bowl and set aside. Thread the pieces of lamb onto skewers and lay on the skewers alternating with the mushrooms. Place the remaining parmesan cheese and half a cup of cream cheese onto a sheet of cling film and make sure the cream cheese is completely covered. Place onto your plate and set aside. Heat a nonstick frying pan. Once it has heated up, pour in the remaining cream cheese and cook until melted. Set aside. Heat a grill pan or similar on low. Once its very hot, grill the kebabs for 3 - 4 minutes on each side, until cooked to preference. Serve. Variation you can use a combination of onions, garlic and herbs of your choice on skewers.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,beet,baby onion,curry paste,sesame seed,swiss cheese,olive oil
title: Roasted Beet and Swiss Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs roasting chickens ( i use a combination of the two ) or 2 lbs chicken ( i use a combination of the two ) | 12 tiny beets | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 large baby onion ( quartered ) | 2 tablespoons fresh curry paste | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line bottom of a roasting pan with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Brush with olive oil. Roast the chicken breast side down for 45 min, or until just cooked. Let rest, then place in a large bowl and shred into small pieces. Slice baby onions as thin as possible. Place all ingredients except cheese into same bowl and toss. Toss in the shredded chicken. You just want to bring all ingredients to a boil and cook. When ready to serve, combine a ladle of the heated soup with the grated cheese. Stir, taste, and adjust amount of cheese as desired.

title: Gorgonzola En Sote En Brochette With Cream of Chicken
ingredients: 8 slices prosciutto, or more to taste ( optional ) | 3/4 cup cream of chicken soup, warmed | 1/4 cup butter, softened | 1/4 teaspoon anise seeds, or to taste | 2 tablespoons crumbled gorgonzola cheese, or to taste
instructions: Arrange prosciutto slices on an elegant, festive serving dish. Heat cream of chicken soup, butter, and anise seeds in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until warm. Pour over prosciutto slices. Garnish with crumbled gorgonzola cheese.

title: Baklava, Mezezi, Tunisi Talebi
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry, thawed according to instructions | 1 lb yogurt, strained of excess water | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f or 150°f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Using a brush, brush the rim of a large glass baking dish with oil or spray with cooking spray. Place half the phyllo in the dish, lightly brushing each sheet with the oil or spray with the cooking spray. Spread the yogurt in a thin layer over the phyllo. Sprinkle lemon zest over the yogurt. Continue to layer phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil or spray with cooking spray, in a spiral action with the zest and extra yogurt until top is completely covered and very lightly browned. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and crisp.

title: Tamarind Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 whole chicken legs | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced prosciutto | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon | 1/2 cup grated raw cashews
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken legs in a large baking dish. Squeeze out the tamarind pulp into a bowl, and mince the pulp. Pour the pulp into a saucepan over medium heat, and cook, stirring frequently, until very warm, about 5 minutes. Stir in the prosciutto, 1 1/2 tablespoons tarragon, and cashews. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,ginger,canola oil,bacon dripping,sesame oil,guacamole,lemon zest,almond extract
title: Stove Top Guacamole
ingredients: 8 slices bacon drippings, room temperature | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon guacamole, sour cream or 1 teaspoon sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated
instructions: In a large skillet, heat bacon drippings, 2 tbsp at a time, 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain. Drain fat in skillet. Stir in soup, zest, oils, almond extract, ginger and 1/4 tsp salt. Heat to boiling. Cook and stir 3 minutes, remove. Stir in guacamole, then spread on top of bacon. Garnish with more sesame oil and lemon zest as desired.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,pork hock,salt pepper,italian plum tomato,ketchup,pizza crust
title: Baked Italian Pork Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 lb pork hocks | salt and pepper | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 italian sweet roll dough, partially rolled and placed on bottom of crust | 1 cup chopped swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Rinse pork hocks and cut along the side of the bone into 3 inch long chunks. Season with salt and pepper. In large bowl combine the tomatoes and the sauce. Place the pork chunks into the tomato mixture, and then add the cheese. Fill the greased pie pan with the potato mixture. Cover the mixture and bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove and place on a baking rack and let warm for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: almond meal,cocoa powder,chili oil,rump roast,beef stew meat
title: Chili Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast, lean and tied | 1 teaspoon ground almonds meal | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chili oil ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons beef stew meat, browned
instructions: Combine almond meal and cocoa powder in bowl.

Random Ingredients: saffron,garlic infused olive oil,white bread,escarole,fish stock,garlic,pine nut,mint leaf
title: Escarole With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb escarole ( about 5cm dice ) | 1 cup white bread ( toasted bread, sliced 1/4-inch thick ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts ( toasted, to sprinkle ) | 1 tablespoon garlic infused olive oil | 1 teaspoon garlic | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( or turmeric ) | 1/2 cup fish stock | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cut stems off escarole and coarsely cut stem off leaves. Using a peeler, cut 2 or 3 inch lengths off greens.

title: Quickie Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound button mushrooms, sliced | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained
instructions: Place the mushrooms, diced tomatoes, and diced chiles in the bottom of a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on high 5 hours, or on low 20 minutes for a thicker sauce.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Pear Toss
ingredients: 1 medium sized pear | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 12 toothpicks | 1/2 cup ouzo | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Core the pear by using the peels on the peels to make a small square. Remove the core by slicing the top of the pear into thin slices. In a small dry frying pan, toast the ground coriander and anise and mace over medium heat till fragrant and light brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. In a small bowl, add the ouzo and vinegar and set aside. On a platter, place a toothpick out of each piece and place on the top of a pear slice. In my house we prefer to use the tooth picks on the plate and then pour the ouzo over the dish. The toothpick will then stick to the entire dish. You can also use a clean dish towel for these to remove any excess moisture out of the pear. The pieces should be in the shape of a little baby and the pieces should be on the same size as the pieces of pear. The pieces should be on the same size and thickness, noticable. Sprinkle the dressing on the toss to coat all the pieces and allow to set in the refrigerator. These are served hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,mango chutney,self raising flour,yellow onion,maple syrup
title: Easy Mango Chutney Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 packet taco seasoning | 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to gas mark 4, 220°c, 220°f, gas mark 1. Grease a baking sheet & line it w/greaseproof paper, parchment paper or baking paper. If you have a 2 kg scones use the same method as above but make sure they are slightly wider than the baking sheet, about 1/4'' in across. Combine all ingredients, mixing with your hands. Add as much of the remaining mix as you like to the flour mixture. Mix to a firm dough, but should be very firm & not too wet. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface & knead gently for another 5 minutes. The dough should be soft & pliable. Place the dough on the baking sheet, then divide into 6 even portions depending on how thick the scones will be. Lightly brush the tops of scones with a little olive oil or bbq the griddles for approximately 15 mins or until golden brown on both sides. Serve with butter, sour cream or anything else you like.

title: Chili Crusted Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 cup white onion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the onion, chili powder and 3/4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Pat the beef dry with paper towels. Place on a nonstick baking sheet. Bake the beef in the middle of the oven for 25 minutes, then turn the temperature down to 400 degrees f and continue to bake for 10 minutes or until desired doneness. Transfer the beef to a cutting board, let stand for 5 minutes before slicing. Remove the beef from the oven and top with the onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,pesto sauce,cucumber,thyme sprig,green pepper,asparagus spear
title: Saucy Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce | 8 asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 medium cucumbers or 2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 large green pepper, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce ( prepared, use vh ) | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Pour sauce in a large bowl, and toss with sliced vegetables, mixing well. Dress with pesto. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh thyme.

title: Wasabi Shrimp Balls
ingredients: 1 pound medium shrimp | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 slices pancetta, finely chopped | tzatziki, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp, leaving shells on. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise. Place halves between plastic wrap, and pound with the flat side of a cleaver to flatten slightly. Stir shrimp, ketchup, wasabi powder and bouillon in a bowl with shrimp. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook shrimp in hot oil until shrimp are evenly pink on the outside, about 3 minutes. Place shrimp in a large glass baking dish. Serve right away.

title: Lebanese Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup diced cantaloupe | 1 cup diced unpeeled apple | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 3 tablespoons rose water | 1 teaspoon jam
instructions: Combine the cantaloupe, apple, parsley, water, and rose water in a bowl.

title: Scottish Horseradish Spread
ingredients: 1 cup grated horseradish | food coloring
instructions: Place the horseradish in a small bowl. Mix in enough food coloring to make the mixture pinkish to dark. Store in the refrigerator. Stir well before using if desired.

title: Sicilian Street Snack
ingredients: 20 ounces chicken broth | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 dried ancho chilies or 2 pasilla chiles ( 4-inch long ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon agave nectar | 12 tostones or 12 toothpicks | 20 tostadas
instructions: Warm oven grill. In small saucepan, heat broth over medium heat until it is bubbling. Add bouillon cubes, chili peppers, hot sauce and cinnamon. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,onion soup mix,beef tenderloin filet
title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin filet, sliced | 1/2 cup corn oil for frying | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a slits in the top of the filets to vent steam. Place meat into a shallow baking dish. Combine corn oil and onions soup mix in a bowl and pour over the meat. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes. Serve with additional soup mix.

title: Foil Wrapped Orange Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck or 4 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 navel oranges | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Cut the beef chuck diagonally across the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices and then cut out as many slices as you don't need to pound out each bit. Place the beef slices in a foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Cut the oranges in half and set aside. Slice the oranges into half again and set aside. Sprinkle the cut sides of the beef slices with half of the orange rind. Lay the sliced, orange slices, and a pinch of salt per the beef. Cover the meat with reynolds wrap and crimp the edges down. Place under a hot broiler and cook the beef until nicely browned on both sides and fork tender, about 35 - 40 minutes. Transfer the beef to a cutting board.

title: Chili Flowers
ingredients: 4 leaves boston lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Wash lettuce leaves and separate into leaves. Rinse mint leaves and mint leaves. Using damp hands, crush mint leaves slightly in a mortar, then sprinkle with chili paste if using. Pound mint leaves by pressing the mint leaves between the fingers. You can also grind them in a food processor, to facilitate peeling. Serve with fish or meat.

title: Quick Beef Nests
ingredients: 1 lb steak, thinly sliced | 2 packages farfalle pasta | 1 can roast beef, well drained
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender, drain and rinse with cold water. Drain and put back into pot. Heat 1/2 can of beef in a large skillet set over high heat until liquid evaporates. Add beef with all ingredients and mix well, bring to boil, lower heat to simmer. Cook nests 2 to 3 minutes, add noodles and toss.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,meat,mustard,pepper,lime juice zest,vanilla essence,graham cracker crumb
title: Baked Dumplings with Caramelized Chilli
ingredients: 400 g minced meat | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the mince meat, juice, zest and seasonings and chill for 30 minutes. In a separate bowl, combine the crumbs with the crumbs and roll half the dough into 20 cm x 5 cm fingers. Place 1 cm from the edge of each finger and fold the fingers over to make a triangle, pressing the edges to seal inches. Place the wontons on a baking tray in a single layer. Spray tops with non stick. Place the tray in the oven and bake for about 15 - 20 min at 200c/400f/gas 4. Allow dumplings to warm up for 5 minutes. Serve alongside caramelized chilli in individual soup bowls.

title: Artichokes With Pesto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1/2 tablespoon mixed spices ( basil, thyme, sage, rosemary ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 3 ounces fontina cheese or 3 ounces other hard cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine the orange juice and spices. Combine the pesto and cheese in a small bowl. Spoon mixture into chokes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato sauce,fine breadcrumb,sauce,mango chutney,orange juice,salsa,italian sausage,garlic
title: Mango Chutney-Stuffed Sausages Roll
ingredients: 6 mild italian sausage ( or hot, your choice ) | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons italian sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup salsa | 8 tablespoons mild mango chutney | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sausage links in a large roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer, and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Combine both mixtures in a bowl, and spoon 1 or 2 tablespoons into each sausage link. Insert wooden picks into the center of each sausage to prevent stuffing from forming a pocket. Pour remaining contents of roasting pan into a small bowl. Pour salsa into bowl containing sweet chili sauce and whisk until smooth and spreadable. Spoon 1/4 cup of chutney mixture into each sausage link and roll up tightly. Place skewers in a roasting pan. If using the slow cooker, pour all of the contents from crockpot into a crockpot. Set crockpot on high for 6 hours, or low for 9 - 10 hours. Serve warm, or refrigerate, and serve over your favourite pasta.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bottom beef roast,garlic,honey,margarine,milk chocolate,yogurt
title: Lazy Tongues
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless bottom round beef roast | 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 2 cups milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 3/4 cup yogurt
instructions: In a large heavy pot, melt the margarine, then stir in the chocolate, honey, and garlic. Heat to a boil, stirring often. Remove from the heat and stir in the chopped bell pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the roast in a large casserole dish. Cover the dish with foil and set aside while the oven preheats. Bake for 3 1/2 hours, turning beef and basting frequently. Remove from the oven, uncover, and let cool for 20 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Kecan Mango Stir Fry
ingredients: 450 g bok choy, sliced | 4 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons bottled sweet and sour sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared sauze | fresh cilantro leaves or fresh parsley, to serve
instructions: Stir the sweet and sour sauce and sugar together in a small bowl. Add the sauze and toss to combine. Heat a wok or large non stick frying pan over high heat until smoking. Stir fry the bok choy, stirring until tender.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,tahini,eggplant,orange zest,baking soda,purpose flour,white onion,pork shoulder
title: Sicilian Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 2 large baking eggplants ( about 1 pound ) | 2 pounds ground pork shoulder | 2 white onions | 1 1/2 cups light bread crumbs | 5 eggs | 3/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons orange zest, minced | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium high heat, add the eggplants and saute until tender and slightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,green bell pepper,teriyaki sauce,green cabbage
title: Creamy Teriyaki Slaw for Two
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage | 1 cup green bell pepper, julienned | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce
instructions: Cut the stem from the cabbage. Separate the leaves in four, then cut each section into 4 pieces lengthwise. Cut each of the quarters crosswise into 1/4 strips. In a salad bowl, whisk the cream or milk with teriyaki sauce until well mixed. Add the cabbage strips and green bell peppers, tossing to coat. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Makes 16 servings.

title: French Quarter Figs
ingredients: 12 large fresh figs, sliced crosswise | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons shredded american cheese | 12 slices fresh pecans, toasted | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place a rack in the center of the oven. Combine the first 4 ingredients in shallow baking dish. Drizzle with bouillon cubes and sherry.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,corn oil,honey mustard,lemon zest,butter lettuce,head cauliflower,cold water
title: Warm Cauliflower and Canadian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup cold water | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon, shredded | 1 teaspoon honey mustard | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir together the cauliflower, cold water, 1 tbls. Of the shredded old bacon, honey mustard, lemon peel, 1 tbls. Of the canadian bacon fat, and 3 tablespoons of the canadian bacon fat. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Once mixture reaches a boil, remove from heat and allow to stand until mixture is cool slightly. Whisk cold water and corn oil into the cooled cauliflower mixture.

title: Pear Lettuce
ingredients: 1 lb baking soda | 1 lb iceberg lettuce | 1 pear
instructions: Cut pears in half and remove the peel. Use your hands. Peel and cut lettuce into bite size pieces if your family has them. Cook pears in water for about 20 minutes. Put pears in a bowl. Add about a tsp of baking soda. Put lettuce in lettuce bowl. Put the pear mixture in the bowl. Cut the pear in bite size pieces, and put them in the pear bowl. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Red Curry Mashed Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Diced the potatoes into bite size pieces. Place them in a microwave safe bowl, and add the curry paste. Microwave on high for 15 - 20 minutes. Add potatoes to the bowl of simply potatoes, and stir. Continue cooking on med high for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes to keep the potatoes from sticking. Add salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: red wine,green food coloring,kosher salt,white bean,chicken breast
title: Tortelles De Feuilles II
ingredients: 16 ounces white beans ( soaked overnight ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( boiled & shredded ) | 1 bottle red wine | green food coloring
instructions: Drain the beans and add a light sprinkling of salt. Bring to a boil and then boil for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain the drained beans to remove salt. Return the beans to the pot and mix in the shredded chicken. Pour all the wine into the pot and add food coloring. Mix and let it boil uncovered for 5 - 7 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Tapioca Flour Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup white corn | 3/4 cup tapioca flour
instructions: Blend tapioca and corn in a food processor until completely smooth.

title: Spinach and Okra
ingredients: 15 fresh okra, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 24 fresh spinach leaves | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeded
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange okra in a single layer in a single layer, and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Broil the okra, cut side up, until lightly golden brown, about 5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer okra to a bowl. Cook and stir the spinach leaves in the oven's broiler until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Remove the okra to a plate. Place the serrano peppers in the broiler, and cook until brown and beginning to blacken, about 3 minutes. Arrange the okra on a platter, and drizzle with some okra juice from the skillet. Return the skillet to the burner, and cook the okra, 3 mintes, and 3 mints until hot and starting to blacken, about 5 minutes. Cut each mint leaf in half, and arrange them on a platter. Spoon some okra juice around the okra, and serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,teriyaki sauce,seasoning salt,dark sesame oil,green chili pepper,lobster tail,chicken broth,garlic alfredo sauce
title: Cafe Rio Lobster Saute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons minced garlic ( i use fresh garlic, but fresh is best! ) | 3 tablespoons green chili peppers ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup green bell pepper ( diced ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce ( kikkoman if available ) | 20 large lobster tails ( cooked in a little of the juice ) | 1 cup alfredo sauce ( kikkoman brand is a good brand )
instructions: Heat 1 t. Of the sesame oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the seasoning salt, garlic and chili peppers and saute for 1/2 5 minutes. Remove the garlic, chili peppers from pan. If using fresh garlic, add it right into the pan. Add the green bell pepper, and saute for additional 1 minute. Add the chicken broth, teriyaki sauce and remaining 1 t. Oil. Return the garlic and bell pepper to the pan. Remove the lobster tails. Add the olives into the pan. Using a slotted spoon, pull the meat and any juices from the lobster meat. Discard the shells. Stir the mixture to incorporate. Bring to a simmer. Serve over the cooked alfredo sauce.

title: Spanish Tapas
ingredients: 1/2 cup black or green olives, halved | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican-style processed cheese with butter, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange olives on a medium baking sheet, and sprinkle evenly with capers. Bake in the preheated oven until capers begin to burst, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over olives. Return to the oven, and bake until cheese is bubbly and golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Tex-Mex Grapefruit Margaritas
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 2/3 cup canned tomato puree | 2/3 cup tequila | 1/3 cup seedless grapesfruit | 3/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Place lime juice in a medium bowl. Pour tomato puree, tequila, grapesfruit, dry sherry, and lime juice mixture over ice.

title: Cuban Pork Roast and Bananas
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder roast ( or other lean pork roast ) | 8 fresh bananas | 1 1/2 ounces grated fresh gingerroot | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 5 tablespoons amaretto | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 cup sugar, for sweetening ( optional ) | coarsely grated cheese
instructions: Place pork roast in large roasting pan. Top meat with sliced bananas, gingerroot, plum tomato and amaretto. Sprinkle with mirin, sugar and extra amaretto if desired. Cover and bake at 350°f basting occasionally for 45 - 50 minutes, basting twice, until pork is tender. Remove the pan from the oven and let sit, covered, for 5 - 10 minutes. Carve and serve with rice and hot cooked vegetables.

title: Sliced Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain flour or 1/2 cup gluten-free flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 can rotel | fresh mixed vegetables, of choice
instructions: Mix flour and salt, using your fingers. Dump in the rotel and mix well. Dump vegies over and mix, add any other herbs. Drop on to greases baking sheet. When golden brown, turn when cool and then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,fenugreek,chunky salsa,ginger ale,vegetable,colby monterey jack cheese,half
title: Mexican Party Spread
ingredients: 15 ounces vegetable spreadable frozen vegetables, thawed | 15 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 3/4 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 8 -10 large lettuce leaves | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger ale
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a large bowl. Mix very well. Serve on lettuce leaves, garnished with ginger ale.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,almond extract,almond paste,pork butt shoulder,greek yogurt,egg,cayenne powder,onion powder
title: Ceylonese Pork Braid
ingredients: 4 lbs pork butt, boned and tied ( ask your butcher to cut for shoulder or ask your butcher to cut it for shoulder ) | 2 eggs, slightly beaten | 1 cup cake flour ( you may need more ) | 2 cups greek yogurt ( i use lactose-free plain yogurt and use non-dairy ) | 1/4 cup almond paste | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 3 teaspoons ground cayenne powder | 1/2 teaspoon anise extract
instructions: Make this dough using your favorite cake flour, but if you don't have a flouring machine, or you are using vegetable peeler, you can get a cake/bread mix that has flours and a flake/oval shape to the knead. Pour the flour into the mixing bowl slowly so that a big, straight, ball comes out clean. The flour that has been mixed with your kneaded flour may be mixed in with your hands to be a little sticky to the hands. Make sure to knead the dough with your hands so that the ingredients are moistened. Place the dough onto a floured board and knead for 5 minutes or so, if it is too wet. It should feel slightly elastic and pliable. Cover the dough and let rest in the fridge for 1/2 hour or so until the dough rises a little. Put the dough onto a floured board, pat it down a little then shape it into a rectangle about 10 x 14 inches. Set aside and let it rest while you make the filling. Cut the pork into 1/2 inch cubes about the size of a golf ball. Place them onto a tray and set aside. You could use leftover meat stuffing if the desired. Whisk together the eggs, flour, almond paste, onion powder, cayenne powder and anise extract. Make sure that a nice, thick paste is made out of the mixture. Then coat the pork cubes all over with the egg mixture, then roll in the crumb mixture. Set the coated pork on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees for 30 minutes. Take the pork out of the oven, take off the parchment paper and let rest for 5 minutes. Note, i usually use a glass pyrex dish for the baking sheet, and if there is some leftover crumb mixture in there, this is a great tip for getting the crumbs to thicken while baking. I can see where there are various stages where i can take this step and sometimes i can then just put a pan of water on to boil to cook the crumbs instead of making the glaze. I like to put my foil on the bottom of my oven, but it is optional. This will help to keep the pork moist while it bakes. Enjoy with your favorite rice, or with some homemade vegetables.

title: Feta Cheese Wrapped Sweet Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons minced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Mix feta cheese, sun dried tomatoes, and rice vinegar together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,red wine vinegar,chorizo sausage,star anise,raspberry vinegar
title: Chorizo Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 cup raspberry vinegar | 3 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon red rose wine vinegar, or to taste | 1/2 star anise, minced
instructions: Bring red wine vinegar, raspberry vinegar, cocoa powder, and red rose wine vinegar to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until syrupy and slightly reduced, about 5 minutes. Remove saucepan from heat. Stir star anise into remaining syrupy vinegar mixture.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,lime juice zest,allspice,spinach,balsamic vinaigrette,chipotle chile,polenta,confectioner sugar
title: Lime Dressing With Polenta Chips
ingredients: 2 cups dry textured polenta | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, plus 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 8 cups confectioners'sugar, plus more for dusting | 1 pinch red pepper | 1/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette ( i use nuttelli )
instructions: Combine polenta, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 teaspoon chipotle, and allspice in a large bowl.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter lettuce | 1 garlic clove | 8 ounces oatmeal, uncooked | 1 egg noodles, cooked and drained ( optional ) | chopped fresh dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Spread butter lettuce on a cutting board or tray. Crush the garlic and mince the clove, and mix with the oatmeal. Mix in the cooked egg noodles if using. Spread a small amount on a very thin slice of lettuce, sprinkle with dill, if using. Roll up like a burrito, tucking in the sides. Place on a non stick frying pan, or serve with your favourite condiments to dip it inches.

title: Broccoli Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 green cabbage, outer leaves removed ( about 1lb/3oz ) | 2 teaspoons creme de cacao ( or rum ) | 1 head fresh broccoli, trimmed
instructions: Halve the head of cabbage and leave about 8 - 12 inches over the stalk and ends intact. Using a peeler, remove the stalk until it is about 2 inches wide and 2 inches long. Cut the leaves into the leaves with a vegetable peeler and then cut in half. Separate the leaves. Repeat with the smaller piece of cabbage. You will need about 8 servings to feed about this recipe. Mix together the creme de cacao with the water and drizzle over the cabbage. Cover and leave for 15 minutes. Remove the lid and simmer until the liquid has reduced by half and the cabbage is very soft. Stir occasionally. Taste. If the sauce is too thick, add some water until it is the desired consistency. Cover and keep warm until serving. Serve with hot mustard.

title: Irish Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon dried minced needles | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning mix
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small food processor and grind into a coarse powder. Store in air tight glass container.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,fish sauce,cake flour,sesame oil vegetable,red onion,stewing beef
title: Beef Shortcrust Beef
ingredients: 550 g stewing beef | 60 g cake flour | 2 tablespoons fresh chinese parsley ( finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red onions | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Cut each piece of beef into four equal portions across the grain. Toss the meat lightly with flour and place each piece in plastic bag. Add all ingredients to bag and shake to combine. To cook in steamer, bring 3 cups water near the base of steamer to the boil over a medium high heat. Add meat, cover and steam for 3 minutes. Place on platter, remove bag of meat, reheat water and add any juices separately. Serve with rice.

title: Quinoa and Bacon Empanadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sausage | 1 cup dry quinoa, rinsed | 1 can sliced blackberries, drained | 1 packet pie dough | 3/4 lb thinly sliced cooked bacon, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, stirring to crumble, until just cooked through. Remove sausage from skillet and set aside. In a large mixing bowl, combine the quinoa, cooked sausage, blackberries, and pie dough. With floured hands, mix and press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 13x9 inch pan. Cut bacon slices crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and place over the quinoa mixture. Top with bacon pieces. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,cherry,baby spinach leaf,sherry,grand marnier,trout,jasmine rice
title: Grilled Trout With Fresh Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry or 1 1/2 tablespoons sake | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 4 trout, skinmed, cleaned and dried on each side | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh sweet cherries, with stems | 2 cups jasmine rice, cooked | 4 cups baby spinach leaves
instructions: To make the sauce, whisk all of the ingredients together in a small bowl. Reserve. Preheat a grill to high. Lightly oil the grill grate. Arrange the trout on the hot grate and cook, turning once, until the cooked side is opaque and beginning to flake when tested with a small finger, 5 - 7 minutes for a 1/2 lb. Flounder or up to 7 - 6 minutes for a maine weight of 1lb or 15 1/2 lb. Fish. Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the pack instructions. To serve, place each piece of fish on a serving plate and top with half each of the cherry sauce and half the spinach. Drizzle with remaining sauce.

title: Turkish Beets in Noodles or Chips
ingredients: 3/4 cup hazelnuts | 1 lb lasagna noodle, cooked ( dry ) | 1 can black beans, drained | 8 ounces mixed dried figs, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups italian vinaigrette dressing | salt | 1 pinch of sumaq | assorted dried fig, for garnish or pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toast hazelnuts, remove skins, and crush with a rolling pin. Cut noodles into 4 sections and set aside. Place hazelnuts and 3/4 cup dressing in a medium frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hazelnuts become golden brown and fragrant, about 20 minutes. Drain and spread hazelnuts on a baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated oven until nut crust is brown and crispy, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Remove hazelnut crust from oven and spread beets onto cookie sheets and arrange chips on top. Toast the almonds in the oven until light, about 10 minutes. Watch carefully to make sure not to burn. Cool. Place peanuts on a plate. Add 1/4 cup of italian dressing and season with salt and sumaq. Toss to coat and serve. Garnish with fresh figs or a dollop of additional italian dressing if desired.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,white pepper,button mushroom,white wine vinegar,lettuce leaf,pork shoulder,cooking oat,brandy
title: American Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, bone in | 1/4 cup brandy ( or rum ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons cooking oats | 6 button mushrooms, sliced | 3 baking potatoes, peeled and sliced into 8 wedges | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place pork in large roasting pan and cover with aluminum foil. Put in a preheated oven and roast for 45 to 55 minutes, basting and turning until browned on all sides. Remove pork to serving platter and make gravy. Pour off most of fat from roasting pan and combine brandy, vinegar and oats into roasting pan. Bring to a boil, simmer 5 minutes. Return pork to pan and stir. Set aside to cool down. Cook potato wedges in boiling, slated water until tender. Drain and plunge into cold water, and drain well. Arrange potatoes, mushrooms and pork on lettuce leaves. Serve hot.

title: Swiss Chard With Mango-Mango Sauce
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, stemmed, washed, and trimmed | 2/3 cup mango juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Rinse chard under running water. Pat dry with paper towels and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place chard in a bowl filled with ice water. Let sit until softened, about 10 minutes. Using fingers, pull away some of the ribbbings. Cut in half crosswise. Place chard in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook until tender from the heat and the chard wilts, about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, divide chard among 4 serving plates. Top with mango mango sauce. Sprinkle with thyme and serve.

title: Curried Crisp
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons spiced curry paste
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Brush shortening in a 9x12 inch pan with shortening. Sprinkle curry paste over shortening. Broil for 5 minutes or until beginning to turn golden.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,peanut,baby spinach,pork chop,pistachio,white flour,nutmeg,green bell pepper
title: Green Peppers Stuffed Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white flour | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( or more, depending on taste ) | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, chopped ( or cashews ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green bell peppers or 2 tablespoons red bell peppers | 2 tablespoons finely chopped roasted pistachios ( or other nuts ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh baby spinach | 4 thick pork chops, 1 1/2-inch thick ( from two 10-ounce pork chops )
instructions: Combine flour and nutmeg. Stir in peanuts, peppers, pistachios, and red pepper flakes. Toss with spinach. Spread stuffing evenly over pork chops. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place pork chops in a 9x13 inch baking pan. Bake in oven uncovered for 25 minutes or until well browned.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,green bean,red bell pepper,asiago cheese,chocolate chip,spaghetti squash
title: Roasted Halibut With Spaghetti Squash and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets, about 1 pound each | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1 inch squares | 3/4 lb spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices | 1 lb firm fresh green beans, trimmed | 12 ounces semisweet chocolate chips or 12 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese or 1/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Arrange halibut fillets, bell pepper, squash and green beans in large shallow baking dish. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons oil.

title: Linguine With Chutney and Feta
ingredients: 2 cups feta cheese ( may use less ) | 1 1/2 lbs linguine ( linguine will probably not need this ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney, sweetened with | mango chutney
instructions: Soak chutney in to hot water until it turns a light amber color. While waiting for the water to boil, put the feta cheese in a colander. Drain the chutney through a cloth or cheese cloth, then put into a medium pot. Add the chutney and bring to a boil. When the water boils, add the linguine and stir. Cook until pasta is tender but slightly firm, about 12 - 15 minutes. Drain pasta, then toss with the mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: scallion,potato chip,red wine,milk chocolate,elbow macaroni,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Naked Macaroni With Faux Schmicks #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box elbow macaroni | 2 -3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 4 scallions, minced | 2 -4 tablespoons milk chocolate chips | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 - 1 cup milk chocolate piece
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Boil elbow macaroni, drain and put to the side. In a large bowl, combine parmigiano reggiano cheese with scallions, add macaroni and cheese and toss to coat. Transfer to a large casserole dish. Dot with 1 tbls butter. Make faux chocolate, melt chocolate pieces in milk in microwave and pour over macaroni. Cover and bake in oven for 40 - 45 minutes until bubbly. Serve warm with warm green salad, garlic bread, grilled pate, black forest ham, mushrooms, or as a sandwich spread to your taste.

title: Pollo Rojo
ingredients: 20 -24 lbs pimento-stuffed fresh cajun rojo ( store-bought is ok ) | 1/3 cup sherry wine ( use a funnel with a funnel in canning to measure )
instructions: First you want to make the chile de arbol so, if possible, remove the seeds from your chile de arbol pods using a small melon baller or a teaspoon.

title: Pesto-Black-Eyed Peas Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup light store-bought pesto sauce | 1 can large black-eyed peas ( drained ) | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | lemon wedge
instructions: Combine pesto, beans, and hot sauce. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve in small bowl with lemon wedges.

title: Best Fried Rice on the Planet!
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice, washed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place rice in a medium size nonstick fry pan that has been coated with oil or pam. Pour warm ingredients over rice. Fry until golden brown on the top and bottom, about 4 minutes, depending on desired browning. Remove from heat. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Bread Machine French Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon white spanish shallot, finely diced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine
instructions: Note, i would highly recommend using french bread flour, which i don't.

title: Chocolate Crabmeat
ingredients: 1 lb fresh crabmeat ( remove bones ) | cocoa powder
instructions: Slice the crabmeat into 1/4 inch slices. Place the crab and crab pieces into a large bowl. Sprinkle with cocoa powder. Use a fork to combine. Roll into balls, then serve hot.

title: Portuguese Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped
instructions: Bring the beans and apple to boiling water in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to low, partially cover, and simmer until tender, and the apples are beginning to show some color, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve the soup hot, passing plenty of crusty bread for soaking up the flavorful broth.

Random Ingredients: brandy,cream chicken soup,squash,topping,raspberry,walnut oil,orange zest,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin With Creamy Swiss Chard (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 1 teaspoon dried orange zest | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup frozen young okra ( optional ) | 1 cup frozen raspberries ( optional ) or 1 cup frozen blueberries ( optional ) | 1 cup low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Slice the meat about ½ inch thick onto a 1 inch thick angle. Place the sliced meat in a 12 skillet on top of a double layer of wax paper to prevent a skin from forming while you are cooking. Set pan over medium high heat. Pour the walnut oil into a 6 quart stovetop or dutch oven. Sprinkle both sides with the orange zest. Place steak in pan, fat side down. Use the long blade or a metal spatula to press the oil into the meat. Turn the meat over so the pan is lined with oil. Fork is easier to remove and browns evenly and cook longer with a higher heat. Brown meat on second side until meat is nicely cooked, but not burnt on the outside. Remove meat and place in a serving dish. Reduce the heat to medium. Stir in the brandy. Simmer for 2 minutes, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Slice the meat into 1/4 inch slices. Place the slices on top of the browned bits in the pan. Stir the soup, okra, and raspberries into the pan with the hot cream mixture. Simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes. Spoon the mixture over the meat and on top of the meat.

title: Peanut Alternative for Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground ginger | 2 tablespoons table salt substitute or 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or spice grinder/blender, grind the ginger using the mortar and pestle or in the blender. The salt may cause the same thing to occur. Add the salt substitute or salt. Blend well and store in a jar in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,tomato juice,garlic clove,black bean,tuna steak
title: Cindi's Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 1/2 lbs tuna steaks | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 2 garlic cloves, minced, divided | 5 -6 jalapeno chiles, deseeded
instructions: Mix the 1st 7 ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and chill. Serve over your favorite tortillas, grated cheese, lettuce, avocado, guacamole.

title: Roasted Plantains
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast fillets ( skinless, about 5cm x 3cm ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 fresh plantain, cut into 2cm-thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets aluminium foil on lightly oiled baking paper. Combine nutmeg and nutmeg in small bowl. Spread 1 teaspoon nutmeg mixture evenly over chicken. Top with plantains, pressing lightly. Wrap with second sheet of foil, pleating sides of foil to seal. Place on centre shelf of oven, bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from oven and transfer to wire rack to cool. Repeat with remaining veg. To serve, place 2 chicken breast fillets on plate, spoon over remaining nutmeg mixture and serve. Variation, serve with potato salad.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,double cream,vegetable oil cooking spray,chervil,sesame seed
title: Sesame Seed Ice Cream Pudding
ingredients: 400 ml single cream | 1 -3 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried chervil
instructions: Place the cream in a small pan with a little more water and bring to boil. While waiting for the cream to boil, toast the sesame seeds, over a gentle heat. Do not brown. When the cream starts to boil, remove it from the heat and add the cardamom, stirring well. Cover the pan and let sit overnight. The next day, heat the oven to 180c/350°f. Coat or spray an oven dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. After 20 minutes, remove the dish from the oven. Pour the sesame cream into a large bowl and whisk in the eggwhites. Then, stir in the chervil. Turn out into a large serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and leave at room temperature for 5 days. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Lentil Spread (Zheng Ji)
ingredients: 250 g green lentils | 600 g breadcrumbs | 1 small cinnamon stick | 1/2 inch fresh gingerroot | 100 g of knead farina ( optional ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 200 ml of warm chicken stock
instructions: Wash lentils and cook them over a fairly high heat until soft. Add the breadcrumbs and cinnamon stick in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Slice the ginger root and add to the lentils. Dissolve the chicken base and add to the lentil mixture. Mix thoroughly then add the farina, mix well and then add the 100ml of warm stock.

title: Mosaican Fried Plantains
ingredients: 10 plantains, peeled | 1/2 pound wild ducks, skin removed
instructions: In a cast iron skillet over medium heat, place the plantains and duck, skin side down, and cook until the duck is cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes.

title:
The Easiest Spaghetti and Sauce.
    -
ingredients: 1 1/3 liters plain non-fat greek yogurt | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( homemade or home made ) | 4 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves | crusty bread
instructions:
Place a few tablespoons of dried fenugreek on a plate and place the bowl under your tap so it drys on the bottom. Once dried and wet, carefully pour yogurt into bowl, stirring to mix it well. Dissolve extra sugar and/or water in a 2 1/4 cup measuring cup. Add water or milk until you have a thick sauce, but not boiling. You will need to use it gradually. 
    -. Pour sauce into a large bowl and stir in the dried fenugreek. Allow to sit while the bread is baking. Pour sauce into a pan and boil until it thickens a little, then pour it over the spaghetti. 
    -. Allow the spaghetti to cool slightly on a rack before attempting to eat. Enjoy.

title: French Herbs With Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence, or to taste | 4 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the mozzarella cheese and herbes de provence into a large baking dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil, then bake in the preheated oven until the cheese begins to brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with some mint.

title: Chocolate Mexican Rub
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb lean pork fat ( coarsely chopped ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a bowl, mix the pork fat and cocoa. Add more cocoa if needed for the best results. Use immediately or store in small airtight containers in the refrigerator. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans | 1 -2 cup pineapple juice | powdered chocolate ( or powdered sugar )
instructions: Place pinto beans in a saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 40 - 50 minutes. After 40 minutes, check they still have some personality. The beans will become softer. If they become really creamy/tiny, cook an additional 10 - 15 minutes, or until they are.

title: Vietnamese Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 thin slices cucumbers | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 12 fresh asparagus spears | 12 asparagus spears | 6 thin slices red chile | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chile ( optional ) | 8 seedless sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Cook cucumbers in unsalted water for 2 seconds. Drain. Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise. Remove and discard membranes. Mix together 1 tsp maple syrup and remaining ingredients. Lightly brush both sides of each slice of beef with 1/4 cup warm syrup and arrange on a plate. Combine remaining dressing ingredients except sun dried tomatoes. Toss beef slices in dressing. Garnish with sun dried tomatoes and serve on top of lettuce leaves with a sprinkling of shredded lettuce.

title: My Favorite Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb mexican blend cheese | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems, with stems | vegetable oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients in cheese grinder until very fine. Transfer mixture to a small bowl and let rest for 5 minutes before shaping into ball. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Form balls and place into a shallow pan. Drizzle with oil and bake for 15 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: sugar cookie mix,milk chocolate,curry leaf,beef tenderloin,basil,breadcrumb
title: Curried Beef Stovies
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 5 tablespoons curry leaves | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, divided | 1/4 cup unseasoned dried breadcrumbs | 1 package sugar cookie mix | 1 tablespoon milk or 1 tablespoon light cream
instructions: Trim the beef and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place in a large, heavy skillet. Add 3 tablespoon of the curry leaves and 2 tablespoons of the milk chocolate. Saute over medium to low heat until meat is browned on all sides. Remove the meat, pour the remaining tablespoon of curry leaves between the pieces and set aside. Stir together the breadcrumbs and 1 tablespoons cocoa in a small bowl then add milk or cream. Dip each piece of meat into the crumb mixture coating each piece of meat. Transfer the meat and the bread crumb mixture to a nonstick 15x10x2 baking pan. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons of cocoa, cover, and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until tender.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,vanilla bean,lime juice,colby monterey jack cheese,lobster meat,liquid smoke,celery,spring onion
title: Shrimp-Lobster Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cooked lobsters, drained ( i usually buy about 18 and leave the tails on.| ) | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or any cheese you prefer, i like mine with a mexican mexican mexican flavor ) | 1/2 lb fresh poblano chile, seeded and sliced ( buy 2 ) | 1 bunch fresh spring onion, trimmed | 15 fluid ounces low-fat liquid smoke | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 -3 sprigs fresh lime juice | 1/8 teaspoon pure vanilla bean
instructions: Combine lobster meat with reserved lobster tail meat and cheese in a bowl. Blend together well. Chop spring onions very finely and add with cheese, poblano chiles and green onions. Pour liquid smoke over mixture and let sit for approximately 30 minutes or so to absorb flavours. Add lime juice gradually and mix thoroughly. Add vanilla bean and whisk well. Serve on crackers, toast, or on a bun.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,white breadcrumb,black bean,sun tomato,green,egg white
title: Fiesta Black Bean Patties
ingredients: 8 ounces black beans, cooked and cooled | 4 eggs, slightly beaten | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, from 1-2 lemons | 7 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup soft white breadcrumbs ( or 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb ) | 1/2 cup chopped green ( or green lettuce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 fahrenheit or a fan forced oven. In a small bowl, mash the black beans with the back of a spoon until completely smooth. Stir in eggs, lemon juice, tomatoes and 1/2 cup breadcrumbs. Mix just until the mixture is coated evenly. Form mixture into 6 patties. Place 1/2 cup bread crumbs on a plate, spread with oil, and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup crumbs. Dip each patty in the crumbs, coating both sides well. Place patties on a greased baking sheet, and bake, turning once, for 40 minutes or until golden brown on both sides.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,dark corn syrup,cranberry,pita chip,bread flour
title: Cranberry- Shiitake Bread
ingredients: 1 cup dried shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and chopped | 1/4 lb fresh cranberries or 1/4 lb frozen cranberries, thawed and slightly patted dry ( 16 to 18 ) | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 3/4 cup bread flour | pita chips or pretzel chips
instructions:
Put the dried mushrooms and the cranberries in a large bowl and mix with the corn syrup. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Lightly grease the inside of two 8 inch by 4 inch loaf pans. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in the flour. Stir in the crème fraîche, if using. Transfer to a round serving plate or a parchment lined sheet of wax paper and spread it evenly on the top of the bread. Press the bread into the crème fraîche. It will not be totally smooth. 
    -. Turn the loaf out onto a baking sheet and roast in the middle of the oven until the bread is golden brown, about 40 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes. Turn out of the pan and cool on a rack. Cut into 24 slices or into 3 pieces and serve.

title: Italian Crock Pot Meat-Crock Pot (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, bulk or 1 lb ground beef | 1 small head cabbage ( about 1 1/2 lbs.| ) | 1 lb stewing beef ( about 1 1/2 lb.| ) | 3 ounces saffron threads or 2 teaspoons instant saffron threads, ground | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Turn crock pot on high setting, add sausage, browning it up and stirring. Add cabbage, beef, saffron and oregano and mix thoroughly. Set on low for 3 hours. With slotted spoon remove most of the grease, vegetables and meat. Using 2 forks shred meat into smaller pieces and return to pot. Add 1/2 cup water and stir well. Serve with cooked pasta at your discretion.

Random Ingredients: sherry,savory,sun tomato oil,pork chop loin,lime wedge
title: Pork Chops With Sherry
ingredients: 6 -8 pork chops, 1-inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and sliced | 1/4 cup dry sherry | toasted pita triangles or toasted greek triangles, triangles about 2-3 inches in diameter
instructions: Sprinkle pork chops with savory. Coat with sherry. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight, turning occasionally. Heat a grill or broiler to medium. Grill or broil pork, 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until crisp. Serve on a platter.

title: Mexican Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tapioca flour | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 large tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 cup macaroni, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, combine the tapioca flour, broth, and baking powder. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Add the tomato and macaroni, stirring to mix. Grease a 13 x 9 inch baking pan and pour in the mac and cheese mixture. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Pan Seared Salmon with Brown and Caramelized Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup caramelized sesame oil
instructions: Pat salmon filet dry with paper towels and sprinkle lightly with dark sesame oil. Heat caramelized sesame oil in a 12 inch straight sided sauté pan over low heat. When oil is hot, sear salmon, one fillet at a time, turning once, until golden brown and just cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer fillet to a warm platter. Spoon pan juices around filets, serve with sauce.

title: Simple Beef Tips (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | pinch seasoning salt, to taste
instructions: Sprinkle the stewing beef with the seasoned salt.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,grain white rice,corn flake,mustard powder
title: Gramma's Rice with Corn Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet corn chips, divided | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder ( optional ) | 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place 3/4 cup of the corn chips in a microwave safe dish or bowl.

title: Quick and Easy One Pot
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 cups rice noodles ( i use japanese flavor but the real stuff is up to you ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350°f for 15minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,parmesan cheese,fennel seed,corn oil,cardamom,stewing chicken
title: Moroccan Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs peeled stewing chickens | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( from 1-2 limes ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 6 teaspoons corn oil | 3 -4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place chicken in a saucepan. Cover with water.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,red wine vinegar,peanut butter,flat leaf italian parsley,vanilla sugar,self rising flour,wine vinegar,red cabbage
title: Salad for Two or More!
ingredients: 8 large head red cabbage, cored and sliced thin | 2 cups self rising flour | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, leaves only, rinsed, dried & chopped | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3/4 cup peanut butter, smooth or the real stuff | 1/2 cup good quality vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup good wine vinegar | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: In large mixing bowl, mix all ingredients. The salad should have been ready to roll up. Line a colander lined over a large bowl with some plastic wrap, and place the salad on that. Cover tightly& place in the fridge to set for approximately one hour, or until the cold weather strikes. When ready to roll, remove plastic wrap, and sprinkle salad with cheese, toss lightly. Store in cool place. This will keep in the fridge for up to a month or so, and is so yummy with little spillovers.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,chili pepper flake,spinach,lettuce leaf,pork shoulder,cola,kalamata olive,marzipan
title: Greek Pork Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless pork shoulder | 6 lettuce leaves | 3 -4 spinach, bunches | 1/2 cup lima beans | 6 -7 kalamata olives ( black or green ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon marzipan ( the type from the marzipan jar ) | 12 -16 slices cola
instructions: Cook pork in skillet with some salt until brown on all sides. Remove from skillet and let cool and slice thinly. Shred meat and add the remaining ingredients except lettuce and spinach in a large bowl and mix well. Taste and adjust seasonings if needed.

title: Pear Kebab With Nut & Vanilla
ingredients: 750 g mutton | 1/2 pear, peeled, halved & amp, diced | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon chopped peanuts
instructions: Combine chops & marinade ingredients in a plastic bag. Add meat & marinate at least 1 & 1/2 hours. Thread onto skewers & brush with a little water & grill or bbq over hot coals for 5 minutes each side or until cooked.

title: Acapulco
ingredients: 1/2 cup salami | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/4 cup curacao | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Slice salami into 1/4 inch wide strips about ¼ inch long. Slice capers into ½ inch wide strips about 1½ inch wide. Shake the oil in a wok or deep fryer until luke warm. Place salami in hot oil and fry until brown on both sides. Remove salami and drain on paper towels, then arrange on a plate and sprinkle with the curacao. Sprinkle the bay leaf over all and serve.

title: Enchiladas Verdes
ingredients: 2 skinless salmon fillets | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 3/4 cup blackstrap molasses | 3 tablespoons capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the salmon skin side down in a baking dish or roasting pan. Drizzle the fish with olive oil. Place the fillets atop the fish. Combine enchilada sauce, molasses and capers in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and pour over fish. Bake for 30 minutes, or until fish flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Beef & Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin, cut into bite sized chunks | 2 medium russet potatoes, sliced | 4 -6 whole daikon radishes, sliced | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Marinade the beef, vegetables, and bouillon cubes in your favourite marinade overnight. Place in a shallow baking pan and cook on 160 - 190 c for 1 hour. Stir and re cook until beef is cooked and potatoes are browned.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,lard,chickpea,balsamic vinegar,rotel tomato,peanut,pizza crust,dark chocolate
title: Spud's Yummy and Good
ingredients: 1 pre-made pizza crust ( like store bought or bought ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( not salted ) | 1 can crushed chickpeas, drained | 2 cans rotel tomatoes, chopped ( about 1.|5 cans ) | 4 ounces dark chocolate, broken into chunks | 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( for extra color )
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spray a 9×13 inch pan. Lay pizza on the bottom of dish, spread on the peanut butter topping, then spread over the chickpeas. Top with the rest of the toppings and bake at 350°f for about 25 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,rose water,mango,chorizo sausage,tomato sauce,serrano chilies,rocket,baking potato
title: Mango and Chorizo Potatoes With Tomato & Rocket
ingredients: 450 g baking potatoes | 1/2 cup chopped mango | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 teaspoon rose water ( or lemon juice to taste ) | 1 teaspoon chorizo sausage, sliced ( vegetarian, but can use vegetarian, or vegetarian bacon ) | 1/2 serrano chilies, chopped ( or other spicy-flavoured chiles ) | rocket, to serve
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Scrub the potatoes, prick the tops with a fork, place in the oven and bake, shaking the potatoes halfway through, for about 1 hour. Heat up the tomato sauce, simple syrup and rose water until boiling, remove from the heat and set aside, leave to cool. When the potatoes are fully cooked, peel them out, rub off skins with the skins and mash the potato until smooth. Stir in the chorizo, mango and tomato to make a thickish smooth paste. Tip the mixture into a serving dish and sprinkle over the rocket and serve with a green salad.

title: Veal Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 can spaghetti sauce | salt and pepper | 1 dash msg | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix up the spaghetti sauce, veal, salt, pepper, and msg. Line a casserole dish with cooking spray. Spray sauce mixture into casserole. Place meat on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350 for 1 hr, or until meat is cooked.

title: Lamb Chops and Tzatziki
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb chops | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 2 cups fat-free and low-fat yogurt ( any flavour ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 8 pita bread, cut in 3/4 | 1 can light coconut or ( 14 ounce ) can phew nuts
instructions: Place lamb in large dish and sprinkle with baking soda. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove lamb from marinade. Drain excess marinade. Cover and refrigerate lamb for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place pita wedges on baking sheet. Place on middle rack for 5 minutes or until light brown. Brush with egg wash. Bake at 425 degrees for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare tzatziki sauce by combining yogurt, cumin and nut. Slice lamb thin on diagonal. Top with yogurt sauce. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,baby shrimp,hot red chili pepper,butter,spanish paprika,curry paste,black olive,vanilla
title: Paprika Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter | 2 tablespoons spanish sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1 cup spanish paprika, with peppers ( spanish brand ) | 1 lb fresh baby shrimp | 1 pint black olives, sliced in quarters | crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Melt butter on medium heat in a skillet on medium heat. Add paprika, curry paste, chili pepper flakes and vanilla and stir until it’s fragrant. Add green paprika and mix. Lower heat to medium low and add shrimp. Cook until shrimp turn pink, about 5 - 7 minutes, stirring and removing shrimp if they brown too quickly. Add olives and crushed red chili flakes and cook for another minute.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Con Omoc Mamus
ingredients: 1 can rotisserie chicken ( the meat is leftover, but the con ` amus can be refrigerated at this point ) | 1 can beef consomme | 1 shallot ( finely chopped )
instructions: Open all the con ` amus and place into a crockpot. Place the entire can of consomme on top. Place the shallot into the crockpot. If it is a little damp, pour liquid over it. Turn the slow cooker to low, if it is a lot more moist, just cover. If not, just stir and let simmer for about five minutes.

title: Seared Steak With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hoisin sauce | 2 -4 teaspoons minced sweet onions ( or onion powder )
instructions: Place steak in dish and coat in hot hoisin sauce. Let sit for 20 minutes. Remove steak. Place in preheated 325f oven for 30 - 45 minutes until meat thermometer reaches 140f. Do not over cook, or it will toughen. Serve on a bed of lettuce or hot cooked rice.

title: Homemade Hot-pot (Smem)
ingredients: 3 lbs prawns, shelled and deveined, shells left on | 1 cup pimiento, rinsed and patted well | 3 ounces szechuan peppercorns, cracked slightly
instructions: In an 8 quart kettle combine the prawns and pimentos.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,onion,chicken bouillon cube,apple juice,lamb shank,beef brisket,beef mince,head romaine lettuce
title: Somerset (Lamb and Mince)
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped | 1 beef brisket, trimmed and cut into 2 inch chunks | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs lamb shanks | 12 ounces beef mince, minced | 1/4 cup apple juice, unfiltered | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and put the brisket and pork shanks in the oven. Cook for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and allow to cool and chop into chunks. Place the onion, mince and apple juice in a bowl and mix well. Place pork and beef meat back in oven and cook for another 30 minutes then remove from oven. Cut the beef brisket open to expose meat. Pour olive oil into a roasting pan and place on top of the brisket. Place the pan into the preheated oven and cook for about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and drain all but about 2/3 of the pan juices. Place roasting pan into the oven for a final 30 minutes. Put brisket, meat, any drippings and onions back in the oven for a final 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is meltingly tender and a thick consistency is reached, stirring occassionally. When the meat is tender, put it onto a cutting board and slice, using two forks. Put shredded meat back into the roasting pan and cook for an additional 10 - 15 minutes to heat through. Serve over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: coconut,chuck,white kidney bean,cardamom seed,beer,orange peel,apple cider vinegar,cranberry
title: Coconut Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans | 1 can coconut ( not sweetened, please ) | 1 1/2 lbs chuck or 1 1/2 lbs blade roast | 1 1/2 cups beer | 1/4 cup orange peel | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in crockpot, and cook at low setting for 1 hour. Remove the roast and discard any fat if you wish.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,vegetable broth,thai red curry paste,food coloring,dill,sherry,potato starch
title: Soup V8
ingredients: 8 cups vegetable broth or 8 cups chicken broth | 1 cup potato starch | 1/2 cup thai red curry paste | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 5 -6 curry leaves | food coloring | dill ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large pot, add all ingredients except dill and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes or until the potato starch is thick. Add the dill and stir to mix. Do not over cook. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,chive,ice water,white sugar,cold water,wonton wrapper,vidalia onion
title: Mary’s Favorite Bittman’s Wontons
ingredients: ice water, for brushing the edges of the wontons | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 small vidalia onion, minced | 2 teaspoons water | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 12 wonton wrappers, or as needed | 1 quart ice water to cover
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet with a lid over medium heat. Add the onion, water, and chives.

title: Hot Dogs for Dogs
ingredients: 1 package hot dogs | 2 cans sweetened flaked coconut | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 2 hot red chili peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. On a piece of aluminum foil, place the hot dogs. Sprinkle the peanuts and coconut on top and fold the edges to seal. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve while warm.

title: Easy Pogaca (Crusty Fried Meat Kabobs) With Feta and Curry
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup dry cherries
instructions: In medium bowl, mix pork, feta cheese and curry powder thoroughly. Shape mixture into 1 1/4 inch diameter kabobs, inserting meat only as much fat as possible along sides of meat. Set on baking sheet, and bake at 400f for 25 minutes, or until meat and feta are no longer pink in the middle. Turn meat and bake a further 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt butter in a deep large frying pan over medium heat. Add cherries.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,pea,dill,cream celery soup,pork steak,sauce,bamboo shoot
title: Chinese Pork Steaks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork steaks | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/2 canned bamboo shoot | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, snipped | 1/4 cup peas | 3 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Cut pork into strips, 3/4 inch wide and 1 inch long. In a 3 quart saucepan, combine soup, juices, bamboo shoots, dill, and peas.

title: Italian Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 1 can chunky salsa
instructions: Mix all together. Serve with crackers.

title: Cabbage Borscht
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place cabbage in a large, deep pot with jalapenos over low heat. Cover the pot, and cook until cabbage is tender but not mushy, 2 to 3 hours. Add water as needed to keep cabbage covered.

title: Miso Shells
ingredients: 1/2 lb shell pasta | 6 tablespoons oil, light | 4 tablespoons white miso
