instructions: Boil the pasta in boiling water until al dente drain and toss with miso in small bowl. Serve with a green salad and parmesan.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,red kidney bean,flat leaf parsley,chili sauce,soymilk,italian salad dressing mix
title: Quick and Easy Italian Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon low fat soy milk | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the salad dressing mix, soy milk, and salt. Transfer the kidney beans to a medium bowl. Stir in the chili sauce and parsley to taste. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: French Fried Onions
ingredients: 1 pound french-fried onions | 1 can french-fried onions
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir frank onions in hot skillet, cooking until onions are browned and crisped, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Magic Bullet Gluten Free Hot Wings
ingredients: 1 lb whole kernel corn, drained | 10 ounces chicken wings | chia seed instant coffee ( optional ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Place corn, wings, raisins, and chia seeds into a bowl, add enough instant coffee to make the mixture fluffy and easy to work with. Use a skewer to secure the wings together. This allows to remain in the bowl if the chick is dry and not fully submerged in the glaze. You don't need to add any additional coffee or a lot of water, but if necessary, get the hang of it and work the mixture with your hands until it is completely smooth or creamy. If it is too wet, add a tablespoon of water whenever the glaze turns to gluten free consistency. Keep on your hands to get everything evenly incorporated until they are ready for use.

title: Easy Mexican Halibut
ingredients: 4 halibut steaks | 2 cans salsa ( choose your favorite ) | saltine crackers ( your choice ) ( optional ) | 1 whole star anise | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Rub baking pan with anise to lightly toast crackers in oven. Take steaks out the first, then dredge in remaining salsa. Place the steaks and salsa on baking sheet and place in center of oven. Bake about 20 minutes.

title:
White Beans St.
    - Joseph's Day (White and Dark Bean Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white navy beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini beans ) | 3/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 fresh sage leaf
instructions: Place the drained beans into a food processor. Add the asiago cheese and 1/2 cup water. Process in bursts to give you a coarse consistency to taste, as desired. Return to your soup pot. Add the sage and cook slowly until the cheese has melted and the soup is heated through.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,vegetable oil cooking spray,ice water,curry leaf
title: Indian Style Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked al dente | vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 curry leaves | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups hot water or 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Coat rectangular baking dish with cooking spray. Spread a small amount of vegetable oil and curry leaves on one end of the noodles. Sprinkle curry leaves on other side. Place cooked noodles on top of curry leaves. Carefully pour hot stock evenly all over noodles. Place in refrigerator until time to bake. Preheat oven to 375°f. Slice into 4 equal pieces across. Bake until the curry is bubbly and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Place sliced, cooked squares in an ovenproof baking dish. Cover with foil to protect from over burning top.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,almond,strawberry,saffron thread,ginger root,corn syrup,flat leaf parsley,spring onion
title: Ginger Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup slivered almonds, blanched, cooled and coarsely ground | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger root | 5 spring onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons crushed saffron threads | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 2 cups fresh strawberries, chopped
instructions: Combine almonds and 1 cup chopped spring onions in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,apple juice,red wine vinegar,spanish onion
title: Salsa De Molcajete (Mexican Onion Salad)
ingredients: 2 large large spanish onions, sliced thin, about 4 cups | 1 can low-sodium sweet red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 2 cups apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place slices of onion in a medium size bowl. In a small bowl, dissolve red wine vinegar in 1 cup apple juice. Remove and discard the onions. Place sliced onions into a lightly greased 8 inch square baking dish. Whisk red wine vinegar, orange flower water and 3/4 cup apple juice together in a small bowl. Pour the red wine vinegar mixture over the onions in the pan. Cover dish with parchment paper and foil. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 20 minutes or until crisp and browned.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,white button mushroom,caster sugar,tea,spaghetti sauce,jalapeno pepper,plum tomato,cabbage
title: Smoky Beef and Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti sauce | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3 wholemeal spaghet teas ( pita bread or brioche bread ) | 400 g lean ground beef | 1 cup cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup white button mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup plum tomato, diced
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions on packet until al dente. Drain and mix with remaining ingredients. Place on oven tray, spoon the mixture into 18 x 25cm / 12 x 7 cm patty cases and freeze until firm. Bake on oven tray at c for 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Beef in Vodka and Hominy
ingredients: 12 ounces beef sirloin, thinly sliced ( boneless chuck steak, about 3-inch long ) | 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a large frying pan or dutch oven, combine the first 5 ingredients, except the cream, and cook slowly over med low heat, stirring frequently, until meat is browned and juices evaporate. Stir in the cream and simmer for about 10 minutes.

title: Danish Chicken (Crock Pot)

instructions: Combine contents of meat grinder, combine in slowcooker, or deep nonstick skillet that has been lightly brushed with lard or cooking oil. Add meat. Cover.

title: Sizzling Beef Balls (Korean Style)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/4 lb korean chili paste ( gochujang ) | 1/2 lb beef chuck, cut into fine pieces about 2 inches long | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons korean style chili paste ( gochujang ) | 5 ounces shitake mushrooms, chopped | 3 -4 ounces cheese, grated | fresh radish ( to garnish ) | 1 white onion, cut into thin strips
instructions: Mix the egg white and gochujang in a bowl and set aside. Cut the beef into long strips and then cut strips into very small pieces, about 2 inches long. Heat 2 - 3 tablespoons of oil in a skillet and add the beef in small batches and brown on all sides. Set the meat aside and leave the oil in the skillet. In the skillet add a little more oil and put the chili paste, meat and mushrooms. Stir fry for a few minutes until meat is cooked. Mix the cornflour with a little water in a cup, add to meat and stir until the sauce thickens slightly. Put the meat back into the skillet along with the egg white mixture and stir until combined. Serve with white onion strips.

title: Vegetarian Lunch
ingredients: 1 green pepper | 1 potato | 2 sheets round pastry, thawed | 1 packet ready-made rice paper sheets, each packet ( i use the `` round '' variety ) | 2 sheets rolled rye flour or 2 sheets soy flour, lightly floured | 30 g frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Peel and finely chop the peppers. Boil or microwave the potato until just tender, drain and place in a bowl. Peel and slice the potato into rounds, then slice thinly across the grain. Place the rice sticks on a tray or in a muffin tin. Place the pastry sheets in the centre of the plates and cover with a layer of potato, pepper and 2 pastry sheets, overlapping well. Brush the top of each stack with olive oil and fold over the edges to seal. Repeat this step until all the stack of potato and pepper are used up. Bake the stack at 230 degrees celcius for about 20 minutes or until the pastry shrinks away from the edges. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the flour to help it set. Serve with extra salad and vegetables.

title: Marinade for Beef

instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add steak. Marinate meat overnight or for up to 8 hours.

title: Kaffir Lime Ice

instructions: Wash the leaves and cut them lenghtwise on a sharp grinder. Using a small grater blade or vegetable grater, grate the kaffir lime leaves. Using the smallest you have, squeeze as much water out of the rind as possible. In a large bowl, pour enough water to cover all of the limes. In the wintertime, stir in the kaffir lime leaves and about 1 1/2 cups of the lime juice. Cover and freeze until solid. When ready to use, stir in the seltzer until smooth. Serve with ice cubes for dipping.

instructions: Peel grapefruits and cut in half. Cut each half crosswise into two segments. Place in a bowl with sauce ingredients. Mix lightly. Top with grapes, if desired, and serve.

title: Spicy Orange and Cajun Chicken

instructions: Boil 1 1/2 cups of broth in microwave safe bowl. Stir in other ingredients. Cover, and set aside for 5 minutes. Serve with toast, french bread, or as entree dippers.

instructions: Heat sun dried tomato oil in small nonstick skillet over medium heat for 1 minute. Stir in chili pepper flakes, and ground veal. Increase heat, and cook until veal is lightly browned and no longer pink. Stir in cauliflower floret. Sprinkle on chili powder.

title: Baked Swordfish with Dijon Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 lb swordfish steak, trimmed of excess fat and sinew | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds | 1/3 cup dijon-style mustard | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon honey ( preferably greek, if you're unable to find it ) | 2 tablespoons currants ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thai basil, chiffonade | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f brush 2 large baking sheets with oil. Cut the swordfish into 1 1/2 inch squares. In a small bowl, mix together the mustard and lemon zest. Spread half of the remaining mustard on a sheet of parchment paper and spread it over the surface by 1 inch, leaving a 1 inch border at both ends. Place 1/2 cup water on another sheet and cover with another sheet of parchment. With a table knife, carefully loosen the pastry, shaking off any excess flour. Make a small indentation with your fingers or a sharp, narrow sharp knife into the center of the pastry. Spoon 1/2 cup of the honey mustard into the indentation and spread it evenly around the mustard. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of currants/cranberries/cranberries over the mustard. Top with the remaining pastry, pressing in slightly. Cut a slit along one side of the fish. Put a small spoonful of the remaining mustard on top and press down firmly. Place the fish on the top of the honey mustard, cut side down. Using a pastry brush, liberally brush over any marinade remaining on the fish. Cover the fish and refrigerate for 1 hour. In a small bowl, lightly beat the remaining honey mustard and spread on the top of the fish. Bake the fish for about 20 minutes more, or until lightly browned and cooked through, and the honey mustard is sizzling. Serve the fish from the baking sheets or scatter the basil leaves over the mustard. Serve at once.

instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in 4 tablespoons corn syrup. Set aside. Add beef, 1/2 cup of maple syrup, and 1/2 of beef bouillon cubes. Mix well, breaking pieces of beef as they mix. Heat and stir until mixture boils. Reduce heat. Add corn.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. In medium bowl, combine 1st 4 ingredients.

title: Crock Pot Chicken & Salmon Rigatoni

instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Place chicken in crock pot, top with nutmeg, red curry paste, beans, salmon, and pasta. Sprinkle thyme over top. Cover.

title: Peach-Chive Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin ( or top sirloin steak ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh tarragon | 2 cups frozen green pea, thawed | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 peach, sliced | fresh tarragon or basil, for garnishing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the tenderloin on a roasting rack in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of each of chives and tarragon, cover tightly with aluminum foil, and roast for 20 minutes. Remove the tenderloin from the oven, and allow to rest for 10 minutes. While the beef is roasting, tie the chives and 2 tablespoons of chives together with 2 slices of cheesecloth. Remove the steak from the oven, and carefully slice into 1/2 inch slices. Reserve the broth in a pan, and add 1/2 cup of the simmering broth. Boil over high heat for 3 minutes, or until no longer pink. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of chives and chive. Pour the sauce over the meat, and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar. Return the pan to the oven, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through. The internal temperature of the beef should be at least 130 degrees f. Remove to a cutting board, let stand for 3 minutes, and cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick. The cooked meat should not bleed. Arrange some slices on plates or serving plates, and garnish with some sliced peach and chopped fresh tarragon or basil.

title: Apple Baked Cod

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Put cod, apple and vinegar in a saucepan and mix gently. Cook over high heat for 3 minutes or until fish is opaque. Spoon apple mixture onto lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with cardamom and bake 15 minutes, or until fish is just cooked through and apples are tender when tested with a fork. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Spicy Tomato Rounds

instructions: In a bowl, whisk together oil and lime juice. Remove casings from sausage, and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Pour oil mixture into a large bowl and toss with sausage. Garnish with olives. Note, i prefer the lime dressing recipe above, but you can use fresh or bottled juice.

title: Pigs and Beef Tenderloins

instructions: Split tenderloin crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Trim off any excess fat from slices. Place one slice in each of 2 large nonstick skillets. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Serve with the remaining picante and green onions.

title: Seafood and Cheese Stuffed Beef Brisket

instructions: Combine the crabmeat and the remaining ingredients except the mozzarella and cherries in a mixing bowl. Stir well. instructions: To assemble pan place salmon and queso fresco together in a rectangular dish. Pour salsa over, then place in refrigerator for at least 15 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Pizza Algeri or Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1 1 lb salmon fillet, cut into 4 pieces | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss salmon pieces in marinade, cover and chill for at least 4 hours. Turning occasionally, lightly spray grill on high heat and cook salmon for 12 minutes, turning once, or until cooked and flaky. Remove salmon and set aside. Brush each piece of fish with melted butter or nonfat cooking spray. Sprinkle with sumac. Serve with couscous, salad or with bread to make a starter.

Random Ingredients: turnip,jasmine rice,turkey meat,green chilies,vinegar,italian bread,soya sauce,cold water
title: Aussie Style Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cold water | 3 cups japanese rice ( not the quick cooking type, but regular japanese rice is good as long as it is still hot.| ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1 lb pork, diced ( or chicken breasts, or a combination ) or 1 lb turkey meat, diced into cubes ( or chicken breasts, or a combination ) | 2 cups turnips, peeled ( or a combination ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 3 cans chopped green chilies | 8 slices italian bread ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, bring the water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,chocolate chip,thyme sprig,green cabbage,green pepper,allspice,ginger root
title: Barley-Ginger Sweet Potato Medley
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups pearl barley | 1 green cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green pepper | 1 tablespoon sliced fresh ginger root | 3 allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package miniature semisweet chocolate chips | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place barley in a 3 quart saucepan over low heat. Cover, and raise heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Stir in green cabbage, green pepper, ginger, and allspice.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,nonfat milk powder,orange juice,taco seasoning,water
title: Creamy Taco-Sweetened Condensed Milk (Oamc)
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 3 tablespoons brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, packet | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl and microwave uncovered on full power for about 3 minutes. Do not bring to heat. If using a whisk, place mixture in microwave safe container and reheat for about 30 seconds.

title: Lemon Ginger Chinese Style Rice Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup preserved lemon, drained | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup chinese rice wine ( shaoxing wine ) | 1 3/4 cups cooked rice cakes, cut into 3 x 3 x 1/2 inch strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons capers, chopped
instructions: Place the lemons and apple cider in a small saucepan. Place over medium high heat, just until the cider simmers. Place rice cake strips in a single layer on a cookie sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Set aside heat the lemon mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly and constantly, for 5 minutes. Watch carefully so it does not burn. Stir in a small amount of the cooking liquid until the liquid has just been absorbed. Place rice cakes on a plate and pour the cooked lemon mixture evenly over them. Sprinkle with capers. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,flat leaf parsley,dill weed,green chili pepper,fruit,jam,onion powder
title: Spicy Yogurt Dip (For Dessert or Meat Loaf)
ingredients: 500 g yogurt ( dasheen ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon ground dried coriander seed or 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( 1/2 tbsp ) | 1 small green chili pepper, finely chopped ( about 1 tablespoon, red only ) | 2 teaspoons jam ( warmed ) | 3/4 cup mixed dried fruit | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: Drain the curd from the curds and reserve the curd. Place in a small bowl and mash well with a fork. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well to combine. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight. Serve with fresh bread, or pita or crusty bread slices.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,lobster tail,cilantro leaf,anchovy,irish whiskey,poblano chile,lamb,salmon fillet
title: Lobster With Anchovies and Smoked-Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 2 ounces irish whiskey | 4 anchovy filets | 1 smoked salmon fillet, halved | 4 ounces lamb, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups assorted cracker-sized raw shrimp ( optional ) | 1 small poblano chile
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine cilantro and yogurt. Add 1 tablespoon whiskey and process to blend well. Set aside. In a large skillet, toast anchovies over medium high heat, stirring frequently, just until anchovies begin to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Stir anchovies into yogurt mixture and add lamb. Cover skillet, reduce heat to low, and simmer about 10 minutes. Add shrimp and cook until just done, about 3 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Stir in cilantro mixture. Serve immediately with crackers.

title: Tomato Ketchup Gravy for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meatballs | 1 can chopped tomatoes packed in oil | 4 ounces all-purpose flour
instructions: Brown the meatballs in butter. Add the tomatoes, flour and enough water to make a thick gravy. Heat and serve with toast.

title: Cranberry Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 ounces cornflour | 3 tablespoons cranberry sauce | 1 serrano peppers or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and cut in four
instructions: Combine 3tbsp cornflour, cranberry sauce and jalapeno pepper in a small bowl. Spray pan with oil spray, add beef, and brown well. Add sauce, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 1 to 2 hours or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,grain rice,onion soup mix,cherry tomato,egg white
title: Onion Sushi With Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 cherry tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 packet onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons grated onions ( about 1-2 tablespoons ) | 4 egg whites | 2 -3 cups uncooked long-grain rice
instructions: Seed tomatoes, then cut away the stem ends. Arrange tomatoes on a baking sheet. Bake at 350°f until the skins are black and the tomatoes are soft, about 15 minutes. Cool and remove the skins. Peel the tomatoes, then chop them into chunks and transfer to a bowl. Add the vinegar and onion soup mix. Toss all the ingredients together until well blended. Shape into 4 balls and thread onto skewers that have been soaked in water for 30 minutes. Cook over hot coals for 15 - 20 minutes, turning until browned. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Thai Apples
ingredients: 4 ounces tart apples | 2 tablespoons thai green chili peppers ( seeded if you like ) | 1 teaspoon fresh thai basil ( optional )
instructions: Peel and dice apples. Add all ingredients and mix gently.

title: Chile Roasted Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces irish cream | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/4 cup tequila or 1/4 cup your favorite light beer | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 pinch sea salt ( optional ) | 3 1/4 ounces cheese, such as monterey jack, grated ( optional )
instructions: Line a shallow roasting pan with foil. Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Spoon the cheese into prepared pan and sprinkle evenly with the sea salt. Spread cheese evenly over the top. Roast in a preheated oven at 400f degrees for 45 minutes, until cheese is bubbling and beginning to brown. Cut into squares. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,five spice powder,cranberry,phyllo dough,picante sauce,almond
title: Crazy Good Chili Phyllo Triangles (Veggies!)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 pinch chili oil | 1 cup fat-free blanched almond | 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cranberries, picante sauce, five spice powder, and chili oil. Let stand 5 minutes. Drain cranberries and add almonds to meat of your choice and chop roughly using a food processor or blender. You can leave the almonds whole if any are in there. Combine meat and cranberry mixture and set aside. Pre heat your oven to 350 and spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the remaining phyllo ingredients in a small bowl, mixing lightly with a fork. Lay one sheet of phyllo out on a work surface and using two fingers, wet the top sheet of phyllo with water, brush with water on the sides to cover phyllo completely, and lay down a small piece of the phyllo so that the phyllo looks like the top of a small, heavy, flat sheet of phyllo. Place the stack of phyllo on your cookie sheet and brush with water. Fold the bottom and right edges in to form a triangle and brush with water. Carefully turn the triangle over, brush with water, and fold right side of phyllo to form a triangle. Continue folding triangle over and over for about 3 - 5 more turns, until you have a total of five spice powder and six inch stack of phyllo. If you see any lumps in the phyllo after folding, blot them with paper towels for about 30 seconds and turn over. Brush with more water. Repeat with the five spice mix, brushing stack with water, and place a piece of almond in the center each triangle. Fold the remaining triangle over the square and brush with water. Fold the bottom, right, and right corners of phyllo over the almond.

title: Pickled Asparagus
ingredients: 12 lbs fresh asparagus | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Wash asparagus in a large pot of boiling salted water, removing any tough parts. Cut tips from asparagus heads and set aside. Place peeled asparagus in a large bowl, sprinkle with salt and cover with cold water. Let soak for 24 hours. Drain, cover and refrigerate. Drain again and discard the water. When cool enough to touch, peel asparagus but do not cut into 2 inch pieces. Rinse and pat dry. Arrange in a single layer on 2 foil lined baking sheets. In large stainless steel or glass bowl, mix vinegar with about 2 teaspoon salt. Gradually stir in vinegar so as to create a syrup consistency. Pour over asparagus. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Refrigerate a few hours or overnight. Remove from vinegar solution. Pack asparagus into sterilized jars, making sure there are no hard sections of asparagus on top. Pack remaining asparagus into hot sterilized jars. Wipe asparagus clean with a damp cloth. Apply a little less than 1 tablespoon each of vinegar mixture to each jar lid. Set aside in a cool, dry place for 2 weeks or until needed. Seal tightly. Store in a cool dry place. Use a hot water bath filled with hot water to lower jars into the boiling hot water. Turn off heat and leave for 20 minutes. Using a fine mesh strainer, remove asparagus. Repeat with remaining asparagus and cool to room temperature. Pack into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Pour boiling water over asparagus to just below top of jar. Close jars, making sure they have been thoroughly covered by water. Place a large piece of plastic wrap directly on jar lid or plastic wrap. Place a rack in a medium pot or large dutch oven. Cover loosely with aluminum foil. Place a rack of asparagus over plastic wrap and bring up to a boil over high heat. Cover and boil 30 minutes. Remove from heat and remove plastic wrap. Place a large plate on top of the jars. Remove asparagus and place onto platter. Cover and weight down with a large, heavy skillet or saucepan to keep hot. Place over medium high heat, add 1 cup of boiling water, cover and bring up to a boil. Reduce heat slightly and simmer until asparagus is tender and liquid is reduced, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: caper,chicken breast half,thai red chili pepper,gingerroot
title: Gingery Grilled Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup thai red chili pepper | 1/4 cup chopped peeled fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup capers
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. Slice off lower edges of chicken breast halves if large. Place the chicken in a glass baking dish. Cut chilli pepper into chunks. In a small bowl, mix gingerroot and capers. Remove chicken from the marinade and coat thoroughly with the ginger and caper mixture. Set aside. Place remaining marinade in a small saucepan and bring to boil over medium heat. Boil for 20 minutes, or until reduced to a thick gravy. Brush chicken with the gravy and grill or broil for 5 - 7 minutes per side.

title: Amaretto Poached Beans in Sweet Red Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 6 small refrigerated pie shells or 6 small refrigerated pie shells | 2 egg whites | 1/2 cup watercress
instructions: Pour hot pinto beans into a colander. Toss to remove excess water. Place 1 shell on work surface and spread with 1/4 cup liqueur and top with remaining shell. Top with remaining shell and remaining 1/4 cup liqueur and sprinkle with watercress leaves. Fold two edge slices of pie crust over crust, overlapping edges. Pour hot bean mixture into pies and top with remaining onion slices. Dunk pies in egg mixture, then arrange on a baking sheet with sides. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until deep golden brown.

title: Mexican Baked Sweet and Smokin Chipotle Chips
ingredients: 4 cups grated coconut | 3 chipotle chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Stir the coconut, chipotle chiles, and enough water to cover in a bowl. Spread evenly on the baking sheet.

title: Sheet-Chickpea (Biscuits )
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 cup crumbled feta, divided | 1 package ladyfingers, split in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix chickpea flour, cornstarch, and kosher salt. Stir in water and 1/2 cup feta. Place the biscuits on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,russet potato,grand marnier,spring onion,pizza crust,chicken bouillon cube,chutney
title: Sweet Potatoes Pizza
ingredients: 400 g pizza crust | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 15 ml grand marnier | 400 g russet potatoes ( about 1.|5 kg ) | 45 ml chutney | 1 spring onion ( small, finely chopped ) | 3 tablespoons arborio rice ( or medium grain )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a greased oven proof microwave safe dish, such as a ceramic dish, large capacity baking tray or a pizza dish. Stir to combine. Cover with foil and microwave on full power for 2 - 3 minutes. Loosen foil and bake on high power for 1 - 2 minutes, then cook on high power for 30 - 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and remove foil and rice and top with toppings.

Random Ingredients: egg white,tomato juice,red pepper flake,italian seasoning,scallop,yellow squash,baking potato
title: Scallops and Squash Chips
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato | 8 ounces fresh scallops | 1 yellow squash | 2 tablespoons minced italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 egg whites | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Peel and dice potato. Cut squash into matchstick size pieces, about 1/4 inch and the length of the scallops. Spread on parchment paper and place on a cookie sheet with sides. Bake until squash chips start to become soft enough to pinch. Add scallops, squash and italian seasoning. Season with crushed red pepper. Mix egg whites and juice thoroughly. Gently toss into potato mixture. Spread on a large baking tray and bake until crisp and golden, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Barbecue Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 8 lamb shanks | 2 cups brown sugar | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. In a large roasting pan, combine the brown sugar, celery salt and lamb shanks. Spray the inside of the pan with non stick cooking spray. Add the meat. Insert a wire rack into the pan. Cover with foil. Bake until the lamb is a tender, about 1 hour. Turn off the oven and let the roast rest in the oven for 1 hour, or longer. Spoon off any excess fat from the pan juices and serve.

title: Chickpea and Ziti Salad
ingredients: 500 g ziti pasta | 2 -3 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro stem, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cook pasta. Mix remaining ingredients. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,cooking spray,hot chili pepper
title: Hot Chilli Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 cup white bread flour | 1 teaspoon of very hot chili pepper | cooking spray
instructions: Combine the flour and chilli in a mixing bowl and using your fingertips rub the flour/ chilli mix quickly. Turn out the flour mix onto the board. Form a smooth roll around the flour mixture and using your hands roll it so that it becomes flat and flat. Cut into small pieces. Roll out again. Place the bread on a lightly greased baking sheet and brush with cooking oil. Place in the preheated oven and bake for about 15 minutes, until the bread has a lovely aroma and a crunchy aroma has been yielded. Take out of the oven and leave to cool on a wire rack. Serve with any dip or relish.

Random Ingredients: collard green,kernel corn,green chilies,asafoetida powder,superfine sugar
title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 1/2 pound collard greens, chopped | 1 large green chilies - deseeded and chopped | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Combine the collard greens, green chilies, and sugar in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 container creamy peanut butter, regular margarine and cream style preferred | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Cut 1/2 teaspoon of the cream style peanut butter into small pieces. Combine with cream of choice, onion powder and spices. Can also be mixed in a bowl and refrigerated for up to 4 days. Serve with crackers, chips, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,green bell pepper,vanilla,beet,orange peel,fleur de sel,turmeric
title: Persian Beef and Pork Ribs
ingredients: 6 lbs country-style pork ribs ( about ) | 2 lbs rawspicebar, neck, boneless pork spareribs | 3 tablespoons fresh turmeric, coarsely ground | 2 tablespoons freshly grated orange peel | 2 tablespoons chopped green bell peppers or 2 tablespoons red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon fleur de sel | 2 3/4 cups canned beets or 2 3/4 cups beet leaves, rinsed, coarsely chopped
instructions: First make the beets. In a blender, combine the shallots, peppers, orange peel, turmeric, and 3/4 cups water. Cover and blend 3/4 to 1 1/4 minutes to loosen mixture. In a large heavy dutch oven, place the beef and pork ribs and coat with a mixture. Sprinkle the top and sides of the meat with 1 teaspoon of the salt and 2 teaspoons of the pepper mixture. Cover and cook slowly, basting occasionally with the beet liquid, until the meat is tender about 2 hours. Remove the meat.

title: Lemon Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 cup cooked black beans, mashed ( can use a good-quality beans such as mashed brown or cannellini beans ) | 1 tablespoon lemon extract
instructions: In a small bowl or 1 cup measuring cup, stir together mashed beans, lemon extract and lemon oil.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,balsamic vinegar,mexican cheese,turkey,cauliflower,lemon peel,five spice powder,breadcrumb
title: Roast Turkey and Cauliflower With Sesame-Cauliflower Crumbs
ingredients: 2 cups torn fresh cauliflower | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat mexican cheese blend | 1/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lemon peel, finely shredded and zested
instructions: Preheat over to 500 degrees f. Combine cauliflower and salad oil in a shallow roasting pan. Season with five spice powder. Spread cauliflower mixture on a baking sheet. Roast for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Combine cheese, bread crumbs, vinegar and lemon peel. Stir until creamy. Spread crumb topping over cooked turkey. Bake until topping is bubbly.

title: Basmati Rice With Beef, Sticky Dates, and Amaretto
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 2/3 cup greek yogurt | 2/3 cup light sour cream | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed ( we used the 1-1/2 tsp.| and it was very strong ) | 1 cup basmati rice | 6 fresh pitted dates ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place beef in a large baking dish and bake for 1 hour. Remove beef and cover with foil. Bake for one hour more, or until beef is tender. If there is any fat on top of the beef, remove the beef and pour off any drippings into clean a 1 1/2 quart glass pan. Wipe the pan clean with a clean kitchen towel. Drain beef and place in a large bowl. Add greek yogurt, sour cream, amaretto, and anise seed. Mix thoroughly. Add rice and mix until well coated with the yogurt mixture. Let sit for 15 minutes. Garnish rice with dates if desired. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,beef tenderloin steak,tomato sauce,sun tomato oil,clam juice
title: Peppered Chipped Beef Tenderloin Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup bottled sliced pickled maraschino cherries | 1 boneless beef tenderloin steak, cut 1-inch thick
instructions: In a bowl, combine the clam juice, sun dried tomato oil, cherry halves, and beef. Place on a platter, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to 8 hours. Preheat the broiler. Grease a large baking sheet. Place the steak on the prepared baking sheet and broil 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until just done. Remove from the oven, cover loosely with foil, and keep warm. Spoon the broth into a gravy boat or small dish. Serve the steak with the broth mixture.

title: Crock Pot Ketchup Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 lbs stewing beef
instructions: Place stewing beef in crock pot and pour ketchup over beef. Cook for at least 8 hours on low. Dumpling up meat with fork, stir, eat, or eat with rice. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef,white sugar,red wine vinegar,radish,part mozzarella cheese,pearl barley
title: Barley Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 pound lean ground beef | 1 cup pearl barley | 3/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 5 -6 radishes, sliced
instructions: Combine the vinegar and sugar in a glass bowl with salt. Add beef, vinegar mixture, barley, and cheese. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or overnight. To serve, place salad on a large platter, and surround with slices of radishes.

title: Puffed Cranberry Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups fresh cranberries, roughly cut | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt | 2 cups plain flour | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Put everything together in a bowl and mix until they all make a ball. Set aside in the fridge. Pour a cup or two of warm water into the bowl and then use a stick blender to mix the flour into the liquid until well mixed. You can do this on a flat working surface, using a floured rolling pin, or your hands if needed. Heat the oven to 230 degrees centigrade and grease or line an oven tray with baking paper. Divide the batter into 3 or 4 portions, and then spread each on the baking tray. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes on the centre of the oven, or until browned and puffed up and the edges are starting to curl up. The pancakes can also be reheated in a non stick frying pan or a well buttered griddle. Serve immediately.

title: Tortillas with Currants
ingredients: 1 tortillas | 1/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Place the tortillas between waxed paper, and stretch them to fit the size of your skillet. Toast them until brown. Place the currants, wrapped at least in a kitchen towel, in the center of the tortillas, and place on a microwave safe plate. Microwave for 2 minutes. Sprinkle with salt. Cut into 4 wedges, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,red curry paste,apricot brandy,pork fillet,asafoetida powder,manchego cheese,pork
title: Asian Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 4 pork fillet, sliced paper thin | 4 ounces applesauce | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 lb manchego cheese, grated | applesauce | asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons apricot brandy or 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Combine all ingridients and chill overnight. Bring to room temperature prior to grilling. If using a charcoal grill it should be put on the shelf 4 - 6 inches from the coals and as close to temperature as possible. Grill the steaks for 2 - 3 minutes or until they are cooked to your liking. Allow to rest 1 minute before slicing. Cut the vegei into thin strips. Serve on a bed of manchego cheese. Note, i use grated manchego asiago cheese for the cheese and marinade.

Random Ingredients: almond,wild rice,manchego cheese,mini chocolate chip,turmeric,beef brisket
title: Crock Pot Wild Rice & Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket or 4 lbs boneless bottom round roast | 32 ounces sliced wild rice ( i prefer jasmine ) | 4 ounces manchego cheese ( i use a mild flavored brick ) | 12 ounces mini chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Place meat in crockpot. Add remaining ingredients except almonds and cheese. Cover. Cook on low all day, or on high for 7 to 9 hours. Remove beef from broth and slice across the grain into thin slices. Put beef back in crockpot. Stir in sliced almonds. Cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Smoked Snapper and Chocolate
ingredients: 8 slices of peppity smoked unsweetened chocolate | 1 small eggplant | 4 -6 thin slices red snapper fillets, about 1/8 inch thick | 4 -6 slices french or italian sandwich buns
instructions: Wrap each side of the chocolate with four fish slices of eggplant and a thin slice of red snapper. Secure with toothpicks. Place each filled roll on foil lined baking sheets. Cook under broiler just until golden brown. Serve hot with syrup on the side. Store in a cool spot or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Serves.

Random Ingredients: yeast,plain flour,salt cod fish,raisin,ricotta cheese,madras curry powder,tea
title: Ricotta and Curry Crackers With Raisins
ingredients: 225 g plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( optional and to taste ) | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 tablespoons treacle or 2 tablespoons molasses | 600 g raisins, drained and patted dry with paper towel | 1/2 cup tea, warmed slightly | 600 g salt cod fish or 600 g salt cod fish, bones and skin removed, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: First make your yeast cake. Dissolve treacle and yeast in a little of the warm milk. Sift flour and salt into a mixing bowl. Make a well in the centre and stir in yeast mixture, treacle and 1 cup of the warmed milk. Gradually stir in enough more milk to make a soft but not sticky dough. Knead on a floured board for about 5 minutes, until soft and elastic, adding flour as required, so that the dough doesn't stick to the board. Cover dough with a clean cloth and return to a warm, lightly oiled bowl. Let rise in a warm place, free from draft until doubled in bulk, about 45 - 60 minutes. Turn oven to 190 deg c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. When you have risen the dough, divide it into 8 portions. Roll each portion in flour to coat evenly, and shape each into a ball. Cover lightly with a tea towel. Place on baking trays. Place an empty baking tin on top of the bread, then place in the oven. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, turning trays over after about 10 - 15 minutes and stirring twice and switching oven temperature after 15 minutes. Serve with plain, greek tea biscuits, sliced raisins and ricotta.

Random Ingredients: wheat spaghetti,beef roast,beef suet,parsley,oregano leaf,cake flour,mushroom soup
title: Quick Beef Loaf on Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat spaghetti, cooked in a large pot of boiling water until tender | 1 1 lb beef roast, cut into 1/2 slices | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1/4 cup cake flour | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup finely minced dried beef suet ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9 x 3 inch metal loaf pan, or 10 x 15 baking pans. In shallow dish, toss together noodles of spaghetti or whole wheat pasta. Using a slotted spoon, set aside 2 tbsp pasta water. In large bowl, combine roast, soup, flour oregano and suet and mix well. Spoon into prepared pan and top with remaining pasta. Combine parsley and remaining pasta water, and sprinkle mixture over top all. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until meat is hot and bubbly and top is lightly browned. Serve.

title: Pesto Toast - Indian Bread Bread With Asafoetida
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat plain yogurt ( i use greek brand ) | pesto sauce or sriracha hot sauce | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 25 -30 slices french bread
instructions: First, combine the yogurt, pesto& the asafoetida. Cover & allow to chill for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cut frenchbread slices in half lengthwise. Place in a single layer in a flat baking dish. Spread pesto mixture on both sides of frenchbread slices. Top with asafoetida. Bake for 15 minutes, then turn slices over & bake for 5 - 10 minutes more or until browned.

Random Ingredients: ice,marsala wine,spring onion,garlic salt,cream cheese,cottage cheese,curry powder
title: Cottage Cheese Balls in Curry Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, softened ( you can use low fat or plain yogurt ) | 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder ( i love it hot! ) | 1 teaspoon ground spring onion | 1 teaspoon ground garlic salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon marsala wine
instructions: Mix cream cheese, cottage cheese, curry, spring onion, garlic salt and marsala sauce in a bowl. Roll mixture into large balls using 1 - 2 tbsp of mixture for each ball if needed. Bake in low oven for about 30 minutes. Serve with indian style rice.

title: Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 5 -6 grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Remove the outside layer of skin from the tomatoes. Cut off the top and remove the seed from each. Cut in half. Place the tomatoes on paper towels. Cover with fresh water. Let stand for 20 minutes, then drain well. Remove skins and seeds. Place in a large bowl. Mash with a fork. Add tomato skins or other ins, and salt and pepper to taste. Serve at room temperature.

title: Stefekteschnetzel (Sfekteschnets)
ingredients: 1 cup porterhouse steaks, chopped | 3/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Remove the hard center core from the porterhouse steaks. Make the cuts as narrow as possible, about 1/2 inch deep, 1 1/2 inches apart, along the length of the steaks. In a large sauté pan, bring the chicken broth to a boil and pour it into the pan. Sprinkle the steaks with salt and pepper and add them to the skillet. When they begin to float to the surface, remove them from the pan and place them on a piece of wax paper. Place under the broiler. When the tops are a light golden color. Turn the steaks over and brown the other side. Do not overcook. When each batch is done, remove them individually and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: plantain,french baguette,feta cheese,red chili,baking soda,hazelnut,lime juice zest
title: Sizzling Vegetarian Baguette
ingredients: 3 small plantains, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 4 ounces feta cheese | 12 slices french baguettes | 6 slices of natural roasted hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 red chili, sliced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Peel, seed and dice plantains. In a large pan, heat enough water to cover half of the plantains. When water comes to a boil, add 1 tbsp of salt, then add the plantain. Cook until plantains will soften and are easy to peel with a spoon. Drain water from pan. Place cooked plantain into a medium bowl. Add feta to bowl and toss well. Arrange bread slices on a work surface and place 1/3 of the bread slices on top of each plantain. Top half of each slice with 2 to 3 teaspoons of hazelnuts and 2 tsp of lime zest. Place 2 slices of chili on top of chili and brush with olive oil. Heat 1 tsp of oil in a small non stick skillet over medium low heat and place 1/3 of the slices diagonally into the pan. Cook for 3 min on each side, until crusty and golden brown. Remove to a serving plate. Repeat steps 2 and 3 until all the bread slices are finished. Garnish with remaining hazelnuts and lime zest. Serve with a salad of green salad, sliced cucumber and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,red chili pepper,oregano,virgin olive oil,lemon curd,egg yolk
title: Gnocchi With Preserved Lemon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs preserved lemons ( do not use the peel ) | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Rinse the lemons well and dry with absorbent paper. Cut the pulp out of the peel and use as directed. Heat the olive oil in a large saute pan over high heat. Whisk with the egg yolks to blend. Place the lemon peel in another bowl. Add the oregano, chili powder and sesame oil. Whisk vigorously, then pour over the egg yolks and mix to combine. Place the grated cheese on a serving platter and add the lemon oil. Garnish with chopped basil or parsley if desired.

title: Totally Twisted
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 2 ounces catsup | 4 ounces instant tea
instructions: Mix catsup and coffee. Bake on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Use toothpick to keep toothpick. Use scissors to remove from the paper. Place 2 more toothpicks on top of ladyfingers and brush with tea mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,mushroom soy sauce,monterey jack cheese,asiago cheese,cumin
title: Grilled Cheese With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs monterey jack cheese, shredded ( preferably sharp aged ) | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons mushroom soy sauce
instructions: Place cheese, sage and cumin in a small bowl. Stir in soy sauce. Heat grill. Spread mushrooms on foil lined rimmed grill pan. Grill about 10 minutes on each side.

title: Easy and Delicious Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb fish ( red-tail, halibut, snapper, monkfish, or flounder may be substituted ) | 1/2 cup texturized vegetables, frozen ( corn, carrots, peppers, mushrooms, broccoli, cauliflower ) | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red onion | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 10 soft flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat nonstick pan or griddle to high temperature. Arrange fish in single layer on grill. Do not overcook. Place 1/4 cup vegetables in medium bowl.

title: Thai Red Chili Paste for Roasted Vegetables (Bistec Elegant)
ingredients: 2 red peppers, seeded and sliced into thin strips | 1/2 cup roasted unsalted pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the chillies, pistachios and roasted red peppers in a pestle and mortar or food processor. Process, pulsing the food processor often, until the nuts are crushed into finely ground texture. Store the paste in an airtight jar.

title: Thai Red Chili
ingredients: 1 package thin spaghetti | 2 lbs nonfat milk | 1 can hominy | 1 red curry paste | 1 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions:
In large deep skillet with over medium high heat pour 1/4 cup water into skillet add spaghetti. Cook over medium high heat until the pasta is no longer crisp. 
    -. Drain pasta but reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Add remaining ingredients to spaghetti in skillet including the water and mix. Cover skillet and heat until noodles are hot.

title: Buffalo Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanuts, roasted and coarsely chopped ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 6 cups french bread cubes, torn into 3-inch pieces or 6 cups other crusty bread cubes | 3 cups buffalo mozzarella, shredded, about 8 ounces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, stir together peanuts and half and half. Spread half of mixture evenly over bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,hickory bacon,tomato green chilies,fettuccine pasta,chickpea,white potato,chutney
title: Sammy's Fettuccine Potato Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb bacon, diced | 1/2 lb mild italian sausage, bulk | 1 1/2 cups diced white potatoes or 1 1/2 cups brown potatoes | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/4 cup hot chutney | 9 ounces cooked fettuccine pasta
instructions: Cook bacon in a 10 inch nonstick fry pan over medium high heat until crisp. Remove from pan, drain, crumble & set aside. Remove casings from sausage & place in same fry pan. Brown potatoes, drain. Combine all ingredients in frying pan, except pasta, bacon pieces & hot sauce, then add to fry pan with bacon. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat if mixture starts to thicken, then reduce heat& simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,sea scallop,chipotle chile,tortilla,chili sauce,cooking oat
title: Grilled Sea Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 canned chipotle chile, minced, can sub 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, from a can | 8 sea scallops | tortillas, warmed, to serve
instructions: Place the quickcooking oats, chili sauce, and greek seasoning in a shallow dish. Add the chipotle chiles, reserving the liquid. Dip the scallops in the liquid a few at a time and then press them into the oats. Lightly cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, but no longer than 1 day. Cook the scallops on a hot, lightly oiled grilling pan until they are browned, and cooked through, about 16 minutes, depending on the thickness. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

title: Easy Beef and Noodle Curry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cumin seeds | 300 g round steaks, trimmed | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 150 g green gram flour or 150 g fenugreek gram flour | cooked rice noodles
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or skillet over a high heat. Fry the cumin until it seeds start to splutter. Quickly fry the cubes of beef in batches for about 2 minutes. Add the tomato purée to the pan.

title: Mexican Chocolate Chip and Apple Pudding
ingredients: 5 -6 cups apples ( such as granny or granny smith ) or 5 -6 cups pears, peeled, cored and very finely chopped | 1/4 cup of fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/2 cup light cream ( use half and half ) | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon guacamole | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated ( if fresh pearn't available, just add orange peel, the bitter jut ) | 5 tablespoons double cream
instructions: In a large deep pan, heat one third of an inch of water, and bring to a boil. In a food processor or blender puree the apples, mint and chocolate for five minutes. With the blade in the food processor still running add the cream, brandy, guacamole, and orange peel and process for two minutes, until the mixture is smooth and the ingredients are thoroughly combined. With the processor running slowly pour in the double cream while it is still running. Stir in one third of the orange peel, and then spoon into serving glasses and sprinkle with remaining orange peel.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups prepared marinara sauce | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,cream cheese,white wine vinegar,channa dal,romaine lettuce heart
title: Channa Dal With Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup channa dal | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 4 romaine lettuce hearts
instructions: Blend cream cheese until smooth. Fold in channa dal, vinegar, syrup and 3/4 cup water. Chill at least 30 minutes. Fill each romaine lettuce leaf with the chana dal mixture. Top with remaining 2/4 cup of water and serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,confectioner sugar,chili pepper flake
title: Chili Sauce for Grilled Meat
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced canned chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Drain chili pepper flakes when cool. Mix the hot chili pepper flakes and vinegar together in a small bowl. Stir in the sugar until completely dissolved. Cover the bowl, and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or until chilled.

title: Horseradish Hoisin Sauce for Fish or Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup dry-roasted peanuts, finely chopped ( or cashews ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped serrano chilies | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons instant minced serrano chilies, or more ( to taste )
instructions: Toast peanuts or cashews in frying pan over medium heat, shaking occasionally, until golden brown, 8 - 10 minutes, or until dry to the touch.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese soup,white cornmeal,balsamic vinegar,channa dal
title: Baked White Corn Polenta With Channa Dal
ingredients: 14 ounces reduced fat cheddar cheese soup, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 5 -8 white cornmeal | 1/4 - 1/2 cup channa dal, soaked in water and drained | 1 -3 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix the channa dal. Dry the corn with a paper towel. Take the corn husk in a big pot and add 4 cups of water on top of the corn husks. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat so it stays at a simmer. After about 30 - 40 minutes put the lid on the pot. After 8 - 10 minutes check to see if the water has mostly dried out. If it turns out the amount of channa dal is still liquidy, you may need to add about 3 - 3 teaspoons of water if the water looks dry. If nothing is happening you may need to add a bit more water. If it tastes dry, add a little bit more water. The last ten minutes of baking, add the cheese and balsamic vinegar and mix. It’s done when all the cheese is well melted. Keep stirring until all the cheese is incorporated. Serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Curried Chicken
ingredients: 4 large boneless skinless chicken breast halves | pesto sauce | amaretto | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1 -2 cup raspberries or 1 -2 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot, pour amaretto over. Cook on low about 6 hours until chicken is cooked and tender, and falling off the bone. Remove chicken from crock pot and cool to room temperature.

title: A La Huajillo
ingredients: 1 whole head garlic | 1 lime, zested | 1 lemon, zested
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Remove the garlic's shell from the head, and discard. Use a knife and cut off and discard the very top portion. Place the garlic on the grates, and place the grate over the top of the garlic. Squeeze the juice from the zested lime into the cavity of the garlic. Close the cover and cook for 10 minutes, or until the garlic is soft. Turn, and cook for an additional 15 minutes. Gently peel off the garlic, and peel off any skin or grated solids. Place the lime zest in a bowl, and squeeze in enough juice to cover. Place the lemon zest into a small bowl with 1 teaspoon water to cover. Stir in 1 teaspoon of water if desired. Rub the juice mixture onto the inside of the guajillo, and serve.

title: Grebbel (Pepper Jelly)
ingredients: 5 yellow peppers | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Cut skin off of green peppers and remove seeds and hard bits in the pepper's cavity. Cut pepper in half and remove stems from the bell pepper's stems. Sprinkle the peppers with cornflour, mix well and set aside to sit for 30 minutes. Place in a suited pot and cover with water. Bring to the boil, add sugar, stir. Heat for 4 minutes. Remove from heat and leave the pepper's skin on skin. Leave the skin on, remove the outer skin of the pepper and discard. Strain all of the liquid into a pan. Return to boil and boil gently for 10 minutes. Place pepper into a clean sterile jar or a sealable container and cover. Store in a dark place for up to one year. If you wish to bring this up to 5 times after processing, you can seal the pepper.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,poblano pepper,banana,red wine,beef chuck roast,beef bouillon cube,flounder fillet
title: Flounder With Pepper and Red Chili
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, 3-4 lbs | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning or 1 teaspoon browned onion powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon flour | 2 medium poblano peppers, seeded peeled, slit lengthwise, then cut into strips
instructions: Cut chuck roast in half lengthwise. Place beef, chile powder, and seasoning in crock or slow cooker and pour in wine. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Remove beef, reserving cooking liquid. Remove beef and wipe clean with damp fingers. Slice beef into thin slices. Set aside. Meanwhile mix reserved liquid with flour.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,chocolate chip,broccoli floret,rye bread,cumin,chuck roast
title: Chocolate Beef Panini
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs chuck roast | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 cups halved broccoli florets | 3/4 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chip | 12 slices rye bread, lightly toasted
instructions: Place beef in a medium bowl. Drizzle with flour.

title: Pork Ribs With Chilli Pies
ingredients: 1 kg pork spareribs | 1 bunch fresh broccoli, sliced into florets | 1 jar dried apricots | 4 red chilies, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Trim excess fat from the spareribs, and cut into 2 inch lengths using scissors. Place the spareribs in a large pan with 2 cups cold water and cover with the lid. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer gently, for 3 hours. Meanwhile, place the apricots in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 minutes, then drain. Place remaining ingredients in a pan and bring to the boil. Turn heat to low and simmer until the apricots are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly. Remove from heat and mix in the sausages and broccoli.

title: Grasshopper Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces asiago cheese ( grated ) | 24 ounces dark chocolate or 24 ounces gouda cheese, cut into 1/2 inch squares | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Place grated cheese in a bowl and add cold water. Mix until mixture becomes creamy. Form a small meatball with a 1 tablespoon or so of the grated cheese mixture. Place the meatball on a plate covered with wax paper. Refrigerate this cheese mixture for 1 hour to firm up. Dip meatballs into cooled chocolate and refrigerate for another hour. Place on a flat surface, and roll each one with a rolling pin or wooden skewers. If using a gas burner, the chocolate should only be melted once to darken. Remove from refrigerator when chocolate has completely melted. Sprinkle top of balls with a pinch of nutmeg for decoration. Sprinkle with asiago cheese or gouda cheese to help melt.

Random Ingredients: pancetta bacon,kosher salt,red chili powder,taco seasoning,green,hazelnut,pepper flake
title: Vegan Mexican Bacon Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts, skins removed | 1/2 cup shaved green fat ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pancetta bacon ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Process all ingredients in a food processor until well combined. Spread between 2 pieces of parchment paper, and roll up burrito style. Spray a cookie sheet or pizza pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place in the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until crispy. Cool, wrap burrito in foil, and keep the burritos from drying out. It's best when they cool off before they're too cold.

title: Veal and Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 lb ground veal
instructions: Heat grill to hot. Add sesame seeds and ground veal.

title: Chicken With Ginger and Garlic
ingredients: 1 cup fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 lbs bone in chicken pieces
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add the ginger garlic paste. As soon as the paste begins to sizzle add the chicken. Sear them on all sides, then remove the chicken onto a baking sheet in a preheated 400 degree oven for approximately 40 minutes or until crispy.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,pomegranate juice,lasagna noodle,thai red curry paste,sesame seed,white bread,lemon extract,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Thai Sweet Red Curry and Pomegranate Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups pomegranate juice | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3 teaspoons lemon extract | pomegranate juice, to taste | 8 ounces cooked lasagna noodles or 8 ounces ziti pasta, uncooked | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 4 slices white bread, toasted | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds
instructions: In medium size saucepan, combine the pomegranate juice, curry paste and lemon extract. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, simmer, stirring occasionally, until curry paste is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Add noodles and cook until heated through, about 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer noodles to serving bowl, cover and keep warm. Add cheeses and bread. Place a piece of toast on each serving plate. Spoon hot curry mixture evenly over noodles and top with sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,red currant jelly,mandarin orange,flat bread,nori,green bean,tomato paste
title: Mandarin Panini (Mandarin Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red currant jelly or 2 tablespoons other jelly | 1 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 8 ounces fresh flat bread | 4 -8 ounces fresh green beans, trimmed and halved or 4 -8 ounces frozen green beans, thawed | 1/2 lb fresh salad greens | 1 -2 nori, sheets toasted
instructions: Put jelly, tomato paste and oil in small bowl and beat until paste is smooth. Cut bread in half horizontally.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,wonton wrapper,swordfish steak,orange juice,orange juice zest
title: Korean-Style Steak Wontons (Bien Blom)
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | canola oil ( for frying ) | 2 lbs swordfish steaks, cut into 3/4 inch wide strips crosswise ( or other firm white fish ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of, finely grated ( about 4 teaspoons ) | 4 -6 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Prepare a steamer with 2 to 3 inches of water and a rack set on the rack, set it beside the stove. Place a bamboo steamer basket and a colander in a bowl and add the wonton wrappers to it. Brush the edge of the won ton wrapper lightly with a tiny drop of oil. Place 2 large sheets of wax paper, about 12 x 9 in. Flatten them slightly with a rolling pin. Brush the bottom and sides of the steamer basket with oil. Heat 1 inch of canola oil in a 12 inch skillet for a few seconds, but do not allow the oil to smoke. Carefully slide the steamer basket out of the oil and onto the paper, with the seam side up. Carefully, lift out the steamer basket and drain water from the bowl. Sprinkle each piece with the orange zest and a sprinkling of orange juice and sprinkle with fresh ground pepper. Arrange the swordfish evenly in the center of the won ton wrappers and roll up, placing them side by side in the steamer basket. If a few pieces stay moist, moisten a bit with a bit more oil by moistening a little water. Scoop the fish out onto each won ton wrapper and serve immediately. Variation, place the fish fillets on a platter and top with marinated pineapple for a touch of authenticity.

title: Nancy's Spicy Oven-Fried Bananas!
ingredients: 3 -4 medium bananas, ripe and well ripened | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 3 -4 tablespoons prepared horseradish, and | taco seasoning mix, for dipping
instructions: Heat up the oil in a skillet. Mix taco seasoning in with the horseradish and heat the oil on medium high. Peel and slice the bananas, place in bowl or serving dish. Sprinkle the hot mixture over the bananas and serve while still warm. Serve with your favorite toppings.

title: Easy Veal Polish Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs veal ( cut into chunks, about 3 lbs ) | 2 tablespoons brown gravy mix ( mccormick or good seasoning mix ) | 2 bell peppers or 2 green peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f and place the veal cut up in the casserole dish. Sprinkle with the brown gravy mix. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the veal is tender and the juices thicken. Peppers, remove foil and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes or until the peppers are tender crisp. Enjoy.

title: Fish Stew
ingredients: 3 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme | 8 ounces fish fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | 8 ears fresh borlotti beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 packages frozen celery, thawed and leaves
instructions: Heat tomato juice, thyme, fish, and borlotti beans in a dutch oven over medium heat. Cook until fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 5 minutes. Add celery.

title: Cousin Pete (Beef Stew Served With Mint, Basil and Basil)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat or 1 lb other flavorful stew meat, cut into 1-2 pieces | 2 pints beef stock or 2 pints bouillon | 2/3 cup sugar | 10 large basil | 12 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place steak in crock and cover with beef stock or bouillon. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,extra virgin olive oil,pomegranate seed,cooking spray
title: Spiced Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/2 cup reserved juice from pomegranates ( about 1/2 a pomegranate ) | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f toast pomegranate skins until black, about 5 minutes. Carefully transfer to a baking dish, and put in oven to dry out for 10 - 15 minutes. When dry, remove skins, and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Place pomegranate juice in a medium saucepan, and warm over medium heat. Add reserved pomegranate juice, and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes. Cover, and set aside to keep warm. Spray a rimmed baking dish with cooking spray. Place pomegranate skins on the baking dish, and pour warm pomegranate juice over the skin. Smooth down the skins. Sprinkle with maraschino cherries, and bake for an additional 5 - 10 mintues or until edges are toasted. Serve warm.

title: Cheese Stuffed Grapefruit
ingredients: 2 lbs seedless grapesfruit | 1 jar grapefruits, drained and juice reserved | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds | 2 quarts bread crumbs | 1/4 cup mixed spice | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using a vegetable peeler, peel back the grapefruit, then cut around the center a little to make a striped shape with the fruit running through the skin. Slice off the ends from stem at the top of the grapefruit, so the grapefruit can stand upright without wobbling. Place in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Soak for 30 minutes, drain and reserve juice. Cut the grapesfruit pulp in half from top to bottom. Cut out and discard core. Reserve 1 cup of the reserved grapefruit pulp. Chop pulp finely, discarding the outer flesh, and discard the white center. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place pulp in a medium bowl and mash with a fork. Add poppy seeds and 1 - 1 cup of strained grape juice and mix. In a large baking dish, toss together bread crumbs, mixed spice, gruyere cheese and the reserved grapefruit juice. Place 6 grapefruit halves in the mixture and roll in the bread crumb mixture. Place breaded grapefruit in small roasting tray or a baking dish, cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes, until just tender. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Baked Sausages and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 ounce chorizo sausage or 1 ounce other hot italian sausage | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 lb shredded cabbage leaf | crushed ice | toasted panko breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons instant coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place the sausages on a lightly greased shallow piece of foil. Sprinkle with the rosemary. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, allow to cool, and then cut into slices. Bake the cabbage on a tray with plenty of paper towel on it for 7 minutes and squeeze. Sprinkle with panko. Remove the paper towel and place the sausages on top and bake for 10 more minutes. Serve with toast and coffee.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 pounds pork chops, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup white vinegar | 3 cups long-grain rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown chops, about 5 minutes per side. Remove chops, and add vinegar to the skillet.

title: Kelkake
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ketchup ( use as much or little as you like ) | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon batter
instructions: Mix ketchup, cocoa and batter in large frypan. Use as much or little as you like it. Do not boil.

title: Macaroni Burritos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( heaping ) | 16 soft flour tortillas
instructions: Heat 1 tbs of oil over low heat in a small pan or skillet. Heat the flour and garlic paste over medium heat in the flour, stirring constantly. You can add a little water as needed to keep from burning. When the mixture bubbles. Add a few spoonfuls of the meat patties on and they are brown on both sides. This will depend on the size of the patty. If you are cooking them on a gas stove, fry them until done. Keep the cooked tortillas warm in a 200 degree oven. Add another tsp oil to the pan. Quickly put in the soft flour tortillas. Quickly toss with a spatula and toss until all the tortillas are well covered. Add more oil if necessary.

title: Brazilian Spicy Swordfish (Gkai Tomates - Portuguese Swordfish)
ingredients: 4 swordfish steaks, about 1 lb.| each | 2 large white onions, thinly sliced | 24 ounces long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: Heat a nonstick 3-topped skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then add onion and rice and cook, stirring, until both are lightly toasted and rice is golden, about 5 minutes. Place 4 swordfish steaks in the middle of a plate or other flat surface and spread 1 tablespoon of cocoa evenly over the top and sides. Turn the steaks and brown on the first side, about 3 minutes per side, then turn and brown on the second side for 3 - 4 minutes longer. Transfer to a platter, sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons cocoa, and serve.

title: Garlicky White Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups bread machine yeast | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 cup galliano
instructions: Place ingredients in bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select dough cycle and start machine. Remove dough from machine after the 2nd knead. Press dough out onto a large greased baking sheet. Use additional oil for brushing over the surface of the dough to prevent the dough from drying. Sprinkle the tops with a cup of Galliano and 1 1/2 tsp of the remaining fennel seeds. Allow to rise until doubled, about 20 - 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 450°f brush with more of the Galliano. Bake until bubbly and lightly golden brown on the bottom, about 10 - 14 minutes.

title: Rajasthani (Black-Eyed Pea and Lentil Soup)
ingredients: 7 -7 ounces black-eyed peas, preferably yellow ( fresh will do ) | 2 ounces brown lentils | 3 -5 inches ginger, peeled, chopped finely | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 cup vodka ( optional )
instructions: In large saucepan, combine black eyed peas, lentils, ginger, marjoram and marjoram. Cover, and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat, simmer for 20 minutes. Remove fromheat, and strain to remove residue of solids. Puree in blender or with immersion blender. Return soup to pan, and mix.

title: Philly-Style Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 3 large jumbo shrimp, thawed if frozen | 12 slices thinly sliced prosciutto | 4 slices whole meal bread | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 1/8 cups molasses | 6 eggs noodles, cooked | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Arrange the shrimp in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange 1 slice of prosciutto over each shrimp, then top evenly with the remaining shrimp slices. Dot the top with 1 teaspoons molasses. In a small bowl, whisk 2 1/8 cups of molasses with 3 eggs until frothy. Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium high heat. Add the shrimp, then cook just until browned on 1 side, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the shrimp to paper towels to drain. Repeat with remaining shrimp. Spoon 1/3 cup molasses molasses mixture over the shrimp. Remove from the heat. Break each shrimp up open, using the back of a large spoon. Arrange the shrimp upright on a platter. Spoon some of the molasses mixture over each shrimp. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pumpkin Honeydew
ingredients: 2 lbs pumpkin, peeled, deseeded, cut up, and cut into quarters | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped ( i chop stems, leaves and stems too ) | 1/2 habanero pepper, seeded, and minced | 2 tablespoons almond oil | 1/2 cup strawberries, frozen pitted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange pumpkin chunks in a single layer in an ovenproof dish sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Combine parsley, chiles, and oil in small bowl and pour over pumpkin. Spread fruit evenly over mixture. Bake until tender, about 20 minutes. Serve drizzled with reserved juices.

title: Banana Bread (Pumpernickel Bread)
ingredients: 2 loaves rye bread
instructions: Cut loaves of rye bread into 2 x 1/8. Cut each loaf into 3 pieces. Arrange bread pieces on baking sheets. Score with a sharp knife. If your broiler is too close to your source of heat, you want it to pre heat in a 375 degree oven for about 20 minutes. When bread is done, place on a rack, cut side down. Cool. Broil or toast bread for 5 - 10 minutes. Eat immediately, with or without ice cream or cream, for a healthier side.

title: Warm White Wine Hazelnut Sauce
ingredients: 250 g dried hazelnuts | 600 ml white wine vinegar, not wheat | 2 1/2 tablespoons grapefruit juice | 500 ml chicken stock cubes or 500 ml water, warmed | 150 italian cheese, cubed | 4 tablespoons toffee pieces, finely chopped | fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Remove the hard shell from the hazelnuts by scoring them with a sharp knife and placing them on absorbent paper towels. Sprinkle over the hazelnuts with a grinding cube and shake to cover. Place the dried hazelnuts in a small frying pan and pour in the white wine vinegar. Cook over medium heat, shaking the pan often, until the hazelnuts are lightly roasted and the vinegars are very aromatic. Remove the hazelnuts from the heat and transfer to a blender or food processor. Add the grapefruit juice. Add about 10 cups of warm water and cook at high speed for about three minutes, stopping the motor several times. The mixture should be a thick, sticky sauce rather than a smooth puree. Add the chicken stock cubes or water and beat vigorously until the broth is smooth. Place the hazelnut puree in a clean pan with the toffee pieces and cook over medium high heat for three minutes. Remove from heat and taste for seasoning. Transfer the hazelnut sauce into a clean sauce pan with a saucepan lid. Add the grated cheese and mix thoroughly. Heat until the mixture is starting to warm but has not yet reached the boiling point. Add a little lemon juice or vinegar if it is too thin. Season to taste with pepper. Spoon into a warmed glass bowl and serve immediately.

title: Lentil Gratin
