ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, washed and drained ( basmati rice is preferred but any grains or fenils will work ) | 1/4 cup barley flour or 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup coriander | 3 teaspoons harissa, spice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 4 ounces dry unsalted cashews, roughly roughly chopped | 9 ounces beer
instructions: Heat oven to 400f, grease an 8x8 inch baking dish with pam. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water for 2 - 3 mins until al dente and refreshed in cold water. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain. Place rice, cornflour and coriander in a bowl. Toss lightly in flour on the work surface and set aside to make your noodles. Add harissa to the oil in a small frying pan and stir in dried cashews. Cook for 30 secs, then remove from heat and stir into the noodles. Transfer noodles to the prepared baking dish. Pour the beer over the noodles. Make an indentation in the rim of the dish with an indentation in the top. Bake for 25 mins, brushing with a little oil if the bread browns too quickly. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing with a pizza cutter. Serve with a green salad and some freshly ground black pepper.

title: Roasted Potatoes With Sun-Dried Tomatoes on the Half Shell
ingredients: 2 lbs whole red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash, pat dry, and cut each potato into 2 or 3 pieces. Place in a single layer in 1 9x13 inch cake pan. Sprinkle with the sun dried tomatoes. Bake 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Note, you may cover the pan and the potatoes with aluminum foil during the cooking time if desired.

title: Spiced Steak
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, ground | 1/2 teaspoon dried chives | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Place cumin toasted cumin seeds and chives in a small frying pan and toast over medium heat until fragrant. Watch carefully. Combine with other spices. Rub mixture on steaks to coat. Grill steaks for 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare, or 8 to 10 minutes per side for medium.

title: Corned Potatoes and Shreds
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed ( i prefer purple or purple ) | 3 lbs extra lean ground beef ( i use no fat beef in it )
instructions: Cut potatoes in half and place in large large pot. Add ground beef. Toss to blend and cook over medium heat until beef is completely cooked through. Cut out top of potatoes using a teaspoon or an ice cream scoop. You want to retain some of the crunch left on the potato. You want the meat to absorb some of the moisture. I use a potato masher but if you don't like potatoes with their flavor, you can probably use an immersion blender instead. Add potatoes to beef mixture and toss to combine. Add a teaspoon of water if you need more liquid. I leave some whole for those that like heat.

title: Brown Rice Breakfast
ingredients: 1 burger bun | 1 -2 tablespoon brown rice | 1/2 - 1/2-1 tablespoon hamburger bun, for individual servings
instructions: Place the burger buns in a pan big enough to accommodate a large slice of hamburger in the center of the bun. Add rice to the bun. Add desired amount of rice to the hamburger. Top with desired amount of brown rice. Top with desired amount of hamburger. Wrap in your favourite microwave safe dish. If microwaving, you can heat the dish by turning on heat and sizzling it in the pan until the rice is sizzling hot.

title: Baked Green Olives
ingredients: 2 green olives, halved lengthways | 1 red onion, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup sweet german chocolate ( i use nougat brand ) | chopped fresh thai basil, for garnish
instructions: Put halved green olives, onion and cheese in the top half of a greased, 12x6 or ceramic. Sprinkle with thai basil. Cook, uncovered, at 375 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes, or until cheese is melted and starting to brown.

title: Tomato-Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark raisins | 1 teaspoon shrimp, crushed | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup canned tomato puree | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 cup chopped frozen raspberries | ice
instructions: Combine raisins, shrimp, garlic and chicken stock in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in tomato puree, vanilla and raspberries. Serve warm over ice.

title: Easy Guacamole Cookie Dough
ingredients: 1 lb fine dry breadcrumb | 3/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 3/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Drain excess water from bread.

title: Raspberry Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 cup seedless grapeseed grapeseed grapeseed grapes in juice, halved | 1 pint seedless raspberry | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet pickled cashews, chopped
instructions: Drain grapeseed grapes, reserving juice. Wash grapeseed and seedless grapes in 3 changes of salty water. Pat grapeseed dry. Transfer grapeseed pulp to blender. Add remaining ingredients with reserved grape juice and whirl until smooth. Chill several hours. Serve.

Random Ingredients: fish,italian seasoning,kosher salt,cod fillet,egg white,white bread
title: Cod Fish Bread Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup shredded fresh white bread | 1 cup shredded peeled cooked cod fish | 3 beaten egg whites | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | kosher salt | 1 dash old bay seasoning, ( a dash! )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over medium high heat. Place bread in a bowl and cover with warm water. Let sit until bread is soft, about 5 minutes. Drain bread and discard liquid. While bread is soaking, mix cod with egg whites, italian seasoning, salt and old bay herb in a bowl. Form bread into a ball and scoop into a large skillet with a tablespoon or two of cod in each. Cook each side for a little over 2 - 3 minutes or until golden, then remove from pan and serve immediately.

title: Eton Mess
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sweetened enchilada sauce | 1 cup lychee | 1 carrot | 1 pinch chopped mixed herbs | 1 pinch vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon mirin | cherry tomatoes
instructions: Dice/mince/slice the carrot into small pieces. Wash lychee. Mix with carrots and spices in a small bowl. Cover and refridgerate for 2 hours. Mix and eat garnished with cherry tomatoes.

title: Sweet Italian Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 4 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Store in air tight container.

title: Portuguese Cod Fish
ingredients: 1 small red chili pepper | 4 medium raw cod fish | 3 jalapeno peppers | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions:
Wash and dry the fish, cutting into small pieces. Boil water in a pot. Add the fish, cover and let it boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Using a fork, flake apart the fish into pieces that can be separated and threaded onto metal skewers. 
    -. Meanwhile place the chili pepper on a baking sheet and cook it for 15 to 20 minutes on each side. To serve, run the fish under a hot broiler and brown the pieces quickly on top. Remove the chile. When your ready to serve, pull the flesh from the skewers. Serve with the sauce poured over the fish and rice.

title: Peach Preserves
ingredients: 1/2 cup peach preserves, preserves chilled ( see note') | 1 vegetable bouillon cube
instructions: Note, peach preserves have two types of liquid, preserves chilled and both are processed. Peal the preserves with a damp cloth extracting all the liquid out of the preserves. In a small saucepan, add all the ingredients and warm gently, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes. Cool the syrup. Pour the syrup over the preserves and freeze according to package instructions. Serve with cold butter and crackers or a crusty french bread.

title: Eggplant, Radicchio, and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 5 large eggplants | 6 cloves garlic, peeled | 8 pieces fresh radicchio, outer leaves discarded, leaves reserved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the eggplant, garlic, and radicchio in a roasting pan, and bake in the preheated oven until the eggplant is softened and beginning to color, about 40 minutes. Remove the garlic cloves and radicchio and place in a blender. Process until smooth. Place in a blender or food processor with the reserved radicchio leaves. Process until smooth.

title: Korean Grilled Cheese Fondue Recipe
ingredients: 10 ounces gruyere cheese ( soft ) | 12 ounces dark soy sauce | 4 teaspoons splenda granular
instructions: Cut the gruyere into medium sized chunks, about the size of a dime. Combine the soy sauce and splenda in a small saucepan and heat over medium low. Stir to incorporate the sugar. When it comes to a simmer, remove from the heat and add the cheese. Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes, then stir well to distribute the sauce evenly.

Random Ingredients: cabernet sauvignon wine,tofu,cabbage,black olive,mandarin orange,chicken thigh
title: Cabbage Chicken Saute
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 pound cabbage | 1 package imitation mandarin oranges | 1 jar cabernet sauvignon wine | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1 inch cubes. Slice the chicken thighs into 1 inch pieces. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Toss the chicken pieces with the chicken, tofu, cabbage, mandarin oranges, and pouches of coucheron in the hot skillet, and sear until the chicken is no longer pink and the cabbage has begun to wilt, about 15 minutes.

title: Creamy Beef and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 12 whole fresh cilantro stems | 2 cups double cream, hot
instructions: Peel and partially freeze beef to allow for easier slicing later. Cut into 3/4 cubes, then put into a bowl covered with ice water for about 10 minutes to thaw, or until really cold. Remove ice from beef under running water. Slice off top and bottom very finely. Set any remaining pieces so that they are easier to handle. Cut a slit diagonally at top of each piece and remove excess fat from meat. Then, with your fingers, press the meat firmly into the ice water and pat to remove any brine that forms. This step can be done over night, or if you leave in the refrigerator overnight. The meat should be very tender. Heat oil in a wide, heavy based pan and fry meat on all sides until meat starts to brown slightly. Reduce heat to low and add cilantro, cooking for 1 minute less. Add the cream and cook covered over low heat for about 20 minutes without removing the cover. The longer the cream simmers, the drier it will be. After about 10 minutes, remove meat to individual plates. Stir the contents of the pan through with a pinch of salt if desired, or heat through for a minute or two. Spoon hot meat mixture over meat and sprinkle each serving with chopped peanuts before serving.

title: Veal Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 4 ounces ham, minced | 1 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup sriracha sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and knead until the paste is soft and moist. Divide into 8 equal parts. Shape into flat patties and refrigerate. Grill patties to desired taste, brushing with 1/4 cup sriracha sauce during the last few seconds of grilling.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,confectioner sugar,cucumber,vanilla extract,peanut butter,self rising flour
title: Garden Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup red pepper | 1/3 cup chopped cucumber | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, confectioners' sugar, peanut butter, pepper, cucumber and vanilla until thoroughly combined. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. Use half of the batter for each cookie. Spoon 3 tablespoons peanut butter mixture into the center of each cookie. Bake in the preheated oven until the cookies are puffed up and lightly browned, 7 to 9 minutes.

title: Apple-Veal Veal Tarts
ingredients: 4 tender veal cutlets | 4 tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 2/3 cup vermicelli, broken into small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with waxed paper. Line paper with plastic bags. Place pork and apples into the lined baking sheets, and place several pieces of vermicelli on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Place a large piece of plastic on the top of the tarts, and carefully remove the waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,plain yogurt,english cucumber,american cheese,cilantro leaf,rhubarb,broth
title: Rhubarb & Cucumber Soup - Crock-Pot or Stove Top
ingredients: 3 cups low-sodium broth | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cups cubed peeled raw rhubarb or 2 cups frozen sliced rhubarb, thawed | 2 medium english seedless cucumbers, chopped | 2 cups shredded low-fat american cheese ( optional ) | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Combine broth, cilantro, and rhubarb in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 3 - 4 hours, or on high for 1 hour. Stir in cucumbers, cheese, yogurt, and baking powder. Serve hot.

title: Gujarati Plantain Saag
ingredients: 1 green plantain | 2 ounces mustard seeds | 1 green chilies, slit length wise | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Peel and cut plantain into 3/4 inch rounds and set aside. Heat oil and when it is hot, add mustard seeds and as soon as it sputters, add green chilies, onion and green plantain slices. Saute well on low heat and sprinkle with ground cumin. Serve hot.

title: Stacked Cheese-Wrapped Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 8 large corn tortillas, preferably fresh | 200 g goat cheese, chopped | 1 red capsicum, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 8 -10 flour tortillas
instructions: In a bowl, combine goat cheese, red capsicum, cayenne. To make a wrap, lay 1 tortilla on a work surface with the 2 tbspn of goat cheese spread over, making sure the outside is covered with the cheese mix. Wrap the wrap in a piece of cling film, then place in the fridge to chill. Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Wrap the stack of corn tortillas around the goat cheese mix, wrap the wrap in the cling film. Place the wrap back into the refridgerator, leave for 15 minutes. Place the stack of corn tortillas on a baking tray, lightly butter the wrap and place in the centre of the oven for 15 minutes. Take off the oven and turn the heat down to 200 degrees c, while still in the bread pan, place tortillas out of the oven. Use a sharp knife to cut the stack into 3rds, then serve with salsa and refridgerator's to dip.

title: Dill Potato Biscuits
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled | 1 teaspoon dill seeds
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot, cover with just enough water to cover them and bring to a boil. Cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, and drain them. When cool enough to handle, peel the potatoes and cut into thick slices. Toss them with the dill seeds in a bowl and sprinkle with salt. Drop the biscuit sized pieces into the boiling potatoes, cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, until the tops are a golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,potato flake,chinese five spice powder,black pepper,mandarin orange,tomato,baby spinach leaf
title: Chinese New Year's Eve Breakfast
ingredients: 1/3 cup sherry wine, divided | 3 large tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 8 baby spinach leaves | 1/4 cup fat-free canned mandarin oranges, drained | 1/4 cup miracle whip, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring 1/3 cup sherry to a boil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Remove from the heat, and stir in tomatoes and five spice powder. Cover, and allow to infuse for about 5 minutes. Uncover and stir in pepper. Place spinach in a bowl, and stir in 1/4 cup reserved sherry. Let cool, about 10 minutes. Place spinach in a bowl with remaining 1/2 cup sherry. Stir in oranges, and add any residual sherry. Cover, and chill in refrigerator until cold, at least 30 minutes, at least 3 hours.

title: Tunisian Harissa Hearts of Palm Salad
ingredients: 1 cup hearts of palm, drained | ice cube
instructions: Pare and devein hearts of palm. Chop hearts into small pieces and toss with ice cubes. Drizzle with harissa and serve.

title: Chile Con Queso (Green Beans Filled Wraps)
ingredients: 4 cups greens ( i like a combination of spinach and tomatoes ) | 4 -5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar or 4 -5 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 -2 tablespoon browning sauce ( optional ) | 4 -5 tortillas | 1/2 handful flat leaf parsley ( can be omitted ) or 1/2 handful chives, chopped ( can be omitted )
instructions: Steam the greens to a limp texture. Wash them and cut them in 1/2 inch lengths. Place them in a bowl with the confectioner's dip or cornstarch, toss to coat the greens. In a skillet or wok, heat 1 - 2 tbls. Of water. Put a few tortillas in the water at a time, you may need to do this in two batches, just to soak up the moisture. Remove from the pan and place on a plate. When all of the tortillas are used, spoon about a tablespoon of greens onto a tortilla. Fold the tortilla in half and then the greens. Sprinkle with more confectioner's dip, sprinkle with a few pinches of browning sauce and a sprinkling of parsley, if using.

title: Spiced Lamb
ingredients: 600 g cubed lamb | 3 tablespoons minced jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup flaked hazelnuts
instructions: Combine the jalapeno and half and half and hazelnut half and place in a freezer bag. Place lamb in the freezer and freeze. Remove the lamb from the freezer about half an hour before you need to bake. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cut a large piece of foil and place on a work surface, put in the lamb and roll up. Place the lamb in the centre of the foil. Wrap with foil and place in the oven. Bake for 30 minutes or until cooked. Turn the oven off. Leave the foil up for at least a minute and check that the lamb is cooked. This will depend on how you feel about it but don't leave it off. Turn off the oven and leave the pan covered for at least an hour and up to 24 hours. If making ahead, let the lamb rest at room temperature for at least 20 minutes before using. Slice. Serve with boiled vegies or rice.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 32 ounces tomato and green chilies condensed beverages ( cola, 796 ml ) | 1 bottle cola flavored beverage ( 796 ml )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric fondue pot. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil vigorously for 2 hours, stirring occasionally. The liquid should coat the back of a spoon. If you can smell it, you can dilute the beverage a little bit. Taste, adjust seasoning if necessary. Transfer to warmed bowls and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,green chili pepper,red bean,sesame seed,godiva liqueur,chicken wing,irish cream
title: Dragonballs
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings | 3 jars red beans | 8 ounces green chili peppers | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 6 fluid ounces irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 3 fluid ouncesgodiva liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Put all in a pot that has a tight fitting lid. Turn on heat to medium and simmer 1 hour. Take lid off and simmer 30 more minutes. Remove cover and stir at 2 minute intervals. Stir until all liquid is absorded. Serve with kiwi and white bread.

title: Quick and Easy Plain Lunch
ingredients: 1 small bun ( hamburger/pork/pimiento/green cardamom ) | 1/3 small lettuce, cut into small pieces | 2 tomatoes, cut into slices | 1 spring onion, thinly sliced | radish, chopped | 1 medium fat free sour cream | 2 tablespoons fat free mayonnaise | 1 coconut, shredded or grated
instructions: If using the bun i usually cut the loaf in half, then cut a little of the bun. Then split the loaf in half again so you have four smaller pieces. Combine the salad ingredients. Combine the salad and salad ingredients. To serve, spread each piece of bun with about 1/4 cup of the filling and garnish with sour cream. Sprinkle shredded coconut or other desired garnish.

title: Cumin-Pimento Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1 jar chopped pimento stuffed olives | 1/4 cup cumin powder
instructions: Open the jar of olives and remove 1/2 cup of the juice and reserve. Pour the jar of olives into a food processor and add the cumin. Process the mixture until the olives are finely ground and mixed well. Pour into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate the tapenade in the fridge for about a week before serving.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,red jalapeno chile,cooking wine,cake flour,broccoli,cream chicken soup,carrot
title: Quick Cheese and Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking wine | 2 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 ounce sour cream | 1 ounce finely chopped red jalapenos or 1 ounce green jalapeno chile | 1/4 teaspoon cake flour | 1 medium carrot, grated | 1 medium head broccoli, broken into florets | 1/2 cup grated grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 25 - 25 minutes. Add carrots and broccoli, stir. To make sauce, stir fry cheese in a small amount of oil for about 4 minutes. Add to hot cheese sauce, stir well and serve with hot cooked pasta and rice.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cider vinegar,chili oil,pork loin chop,curry powder,chicken breast half,green chilies,chili
title: Green Chile Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin chops, cut into 4 x 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 4 x 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup green chilies, sliced | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Preheat broiler. Coat a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange pork chops in a single layer on foil lined baking sheet. Broil approximately 6 inches from heat until meat is lightly browned, about 8 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Stir green beans and chilies into meat. In a medium bowl, whisk together chili sauce ingredients. Add meat mixture to vegetables. Serve in warm bowls.

title: Grilled Vinegar-Spiced Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad dressing ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root
instructions: Drain and rinse vinegar from ginger root. Combine ginger and 3 tablespoons salad dressing in a small jar with a lid. Shake and pour over salad greens.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,white rice flour,canola oil
title: Baby Bok Choy Chips
ingredients: 600 g baby bok choy ( washed ) | 15 ml dark rice flour | 15 ml canola oil
instructions:
Steam the bok choy about 10 minutes. Heat the oil in a wok till smoking. Add baby bok choy and stir fry till they turn golden brown and crisp. Remove, drain well and serve. 
    -.

Random Ingredients: tomato jalapeno,coconut cream,wheat flour,topping,vegetable stock,chicken broth,yellow squash,tomato paste
title: Spanish Squash & Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat coconut cream ( or use canned ) | 1 1/2 cups reduced sodium vegetable stock | 1 small yellow squash, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos ( or less if desired ) | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 cup fat-free reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping (, thawed ) | 1/4 cup low fat sour cream ( optional ) or 1/4 cup low fat sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, puree the coconut cream. Add the stock, squash and tomato paste, and pulse just enough to combine. Add the remaining ingredients, except for the whipped topping.

title: Chef John's Butter
ingredients: 1 package light cream or unsalted butter | 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice and zest | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Cut butter into small pieces. Sprinkle butter with lemon zest and cayenne. Serve with pita bread or crisp bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,lard,self raising flour,golden syrup,amaretto,almond extract,caraway seed
title: German Caraway Chips
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 lb lard | 1/2 lb manchego cheese | 1/2 lb slivered almonds ( or roasted almonds, crushed into small bits, i use the whole lot ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon amaretto
instructions: First make the caraway chips. Mix the flour with the lard in a bowl. Next cut in the cheese to fit the size of the chips. Dip the almonds into the flour/lard mixture. Then roll the chips in the amaretto and then the slivered almonds. Place on a tray and bake in hot ovens 400f degrees for 15 minutes. The caraway chips should be light golden colored.

title: Fried Eggplant With Cheddar and Garlic
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 1/2 cups leftover rice wine | 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Clean and cut the eggplant into cubes. In a large, deep pan fry the eggplant until golden brown. Add half the wine to the pan, bring to a boil and then simmer for 5 minutes. Add the salt, pepper and crushed garlic, mix well, add the rest of the wine to the pan and bring just to a boil again. Add the cubed cheese and the marjoram. Mix well. Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or with egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,lentil,hoisin sauce,dijon mustard,sunflower seed,kernel corn,masa harina
title: Bean and Corn Sook
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower ( large ) | 2 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 1 bag frozen garbanzo bean harina, and cauliflower mixed | 1 cup dried lentils | 1.|5 packages dry masa harina | 1/3 cup lard or 1/3 cup sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Cook cauliflower according to package directions. Boil 3 cups water and add garbanzo bean and cauliflower stir in harina until well blended. Put in large bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. While mixture is cooling, bring 3 cup of water to a boil. Add dried lentils and cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in cauliflower and cover with lid back off burner cook for 15 minutes or until slightly tender and cooked through. Let cool, stir in Dijon and let set to room temperature before serving or storing in freezer, can be reheated up to 1 hours ahead.

title: Pesto Fish
ingredients: 1/2 kg fish fillet, gutted | 1 cup pesto sauce | 1 fresh chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cut any skin into medium sized pieces. Place the fish into a casserole dish, and coat evenly. Cook in a moderate oven approximately 10 minutes, until the fish is cooked. Spread the pesto over the fish, and heat through with a little hot water. Serve as an accompaniment to fish.

title: Fruit Soup
ingredients: 2 cups sweet red wine ( i use sweet whateon's, which i like! ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | glace cherries or other dried cherries
instructions: Wash and drain cherries. In your largest saucepan, you will have 2 cups. Pour over warm red wine and dissolve the chicken base. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Add the bouillon cubes. Cover, turn down and simmer on low for 30 minutes. Just before serving add some cherries to each cup.

Random Ingredients: pecan,garam masala,green bell pepper,baby spinach,mint,parmesan cheese,red chilies
title: Sizzling Peppers with Sauteed Spinach
ingredients: 1 cup pecans, toasted | 1 cup packed baby spinach | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 3 red chilies, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 1 tablespoon garam masala | shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook bell pepper in 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until tender. Remove from skillet, and keep warm. Heat remaining olive oil in skillet, add mint and garam masala. Toss with bell pepper and toss until coated. Serve peppers with spinach topped with parmesan cheese, and serve.

title: Pavella (Fun Kids Spam)
ingredients: 16 ounces vegan sour cream | 1/2 cup baby spinach ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup chocolate, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour 1/4 into individual champagne glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: basil,dark chocolate,grain white rice,salmon fillet,grape tomato,chocolate baking square,italian seasoning
title: Rice Wrapped Salmon
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets ( about 1 pound/1-inch thick ) | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup fresh basil, coarsely chopped | 1 cup halved good quality dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate baking squares, melted | fresh basil, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,jalapeno pepper,lemon juice,roasting chicken,lemon,raspberry,lettuce leaf,stewing beef
title: Mexican Restaurant Style Chicken on the Trees
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb roasting chickens | 4 green chili peppers | 12 -24 baby lemon leaves | 8 -10 small lettuce leaves | 1 pint frozen raspberries | 1/2 fresh jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: In a large pot large enough to hold all of the ingredients, bring to a boil the stew beef and chicken. Reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 2 hours. After about 2 hours, add the green chili and lemon leaves, and cook until tender. At the very end, remove half of the lemon leaves, and stir them into the stew. Cut the stew beef or chicken into cubes or cubes.

title: Red Delicious Corn Chowder
ingredients: 4 cups fresh sweetcorn | 2 green cardamom pods
instructions: Wash corn to remove impurities and dust. Cut kernels from cob. Cut into small pieces no need to cut off the husk. Place corn, cardamom pods, and sugar together in a small cooking pot and cook until the corn is well cooked. Serve hot with flatbreads, rice, soup sticks, or chappati.

title: Crab Salad
ingredients: 30 -35 small imitation crabmeat, flaked | 1 1/2 cups water crackers | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice
instructions: Place pineapple filling into a bowl. Crush crackers in a food processor and add fish sauce, water crackers and crab meat.

title: Quick and Easy Low Sodium Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen ground meat | 1 can red cabbage, chopped | pepper flakes
instructions: Thaw frozen ground beef. Place all the ingredients into a dutch oven that has been coated with cooking spray. Stir.

title: Tomato Vodka-Lavender Blossoms(Szechuan)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes | 10 scallions, halved lengthwise and chopped into 2-inch lengths | 1 onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried lavender flowers | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 -3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Slice the tomatoes at an angle into 1/4 slices. Lay out on a baking sheet in layers and bake at 400°c/f for about 20 minutes, until they are soft and just starting to brown and give off liquid. Cut into halves lengthwise.

title: Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 cups velveeta cheese | 1 quart vegetable stock
instructions: Cut velveeta cheese into 1 1/2 cubes. In a sauce pan put in stock and add cheese cubes. Heat until cheese is melted into soup like consistency.

Random Ingredients: sherry,dijon mustard,vegetable oil,rice wine vinegar,tomato puree,milk powder,cod,extra tofu
title: Baked Cod Tofu With Tomato-Breading
ingredients: 1 lb extra firm tofu, drained of excess oil | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 7 tablespoons whole milk powder | 5 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dried sherry | 2 lbs boneless cod, cut into 2-inch pieces or 2 lbs shiitake mushrooms, cleaned | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tofu on a lightly buttered baking sheet and mist with cooking spray. Roast tofu on top of a hot grill until slightly browned and soft, 15 to 20 minutes. In a food processor, combine 2 tablespoons of the dijon and the milk powder, vinegar, and tomato puree.

title: Chipotle Cauliflower Jam Filler
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower or 500 g broccoli | 3 chipotle chiles | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 3 tablespoons strawberry jam
instructions: Trunch the cauliflower and break away hard ends. Slice into thin slices. Place in a pan with a little water or sunflower cooking oil. Place over a medium high heat and bring to the boil. Strain off the water if needed. Add the whole chiles and leave. Simmer for about 15 minutes. Beat the yolks then slowly pour into cooked sauce. Simmer for another 5 minutes on low heat or until it begins to thicken enough to coat the back of a spoon. Remove from heat. Place the sliced fagrets into a buttered shallow baking dish. Strain the sauce but leave the solids and peppers behind. Dice up a couple of chipotles, combine with a little warm milk or cream and set aside. Whisk the jam with a little water or milk until thick and creamy. Spread over the top of the fagrets. Dot with the chipotle sauce, decorate with sprigs of the mint and a sprinkle of dried mint. Refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours or overnight. It should be nice and dark.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,chicken bouillon cube,mango,cream cheese,broccoli,agave nectar
title: Spicy Chicken and Broccoli  Mango Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 medium mango ( not too ripe but too firm, i usually just use 4-5 chunks per fruit ) | 1 package cream cheese, at room temp | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1 cup chicken bouillon cube | 2 -3 cups fresh broccoli, chopped into small pieces | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Puree mango in blender. In a large pot, combine cream cheese, agave, and bouillon with mango mixture. Stir in fresh broccoli and add balsamic vinegar. Bring to a low boil, reduce heat, cover and let simmer for 5 - 10 minutes or until broccoli are tender to your preference. Remove from heat, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes and remove the pan from heat. Serve with tortilla chips or veggies.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,french bread italian,cannellini bean,orange flower water,apricot jam,romaine lettuce heart,mustard,black mustard seed
title: Faux Balsamic-Glazed Italian Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( or your favorite italian bread ) or 1 loaf italian bread ( or your favorite italian bread ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup orange flower water | 1/4 teaspoon mustard ( yellow mustard ) | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 romaine lettuce hearts, washed and finely chopped
instructions: Cut the loaf in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: mexicorn,blue cheese,red food coloring,cilantro leaf,tarragon,anchovy,deli ham
title: Mexican Cheesy Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages deli ham roll pieces | 2 packages shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 can mexicorn, drained ( drained canned corn will work ) | 1 package crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 drops red food coloring | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place ham roll sections on a sheet of foil and drizzle with olive oil. Cover with seams of aluminum foil. Fold foil over ham and tightly roll up, and seal seams. Place wrapped ham rolls on foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,lard,blueberry,garlic paste,peanut butter,ice water,ghee,brown sugar
title: Blueberry Chicken With Prawns, Prawns and Rocket (Indian)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken meat ( or any other type of meat ) | 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons melted ghee | 1/4 cup peanut butter ( not natural ) | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons garlic paste or 1/2 tablespoon red hot pepper paste | 4 -5 tablespoons ice water | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Mix peanut butter, brown sugar, garlic paste or garlic in a bowl. Add 1 - 4 tbsp of ice water. Melt peanut butter sauce in the microwave or in a bowl in the microwave until well blended and smooth. Dip the prawns into the peanut butter sauce then deep fry until cooked. Drain on paper towels. Put the remainder of the sauce on the table and present as a table dish with rice and enjoy.

title: Mini Pulled Pork Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/4 cup cold water | topped topping | 1 cup light vanilla extract, divided use | 10 ladyfingers | 1/3 cup toasted tahini ( plus extra for brushing on top ) | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons cold water
instructions: Slice pork on the bias and place in a crockpot. Sprinkle on taco seasoning and add 1/8c water. Cover and cook on high 15 minutes. Turn down to low for 10 minutes. Remove pork from crockpot and slice across grain on the diagonal. Place a dollop of topping in the middle of each roll and place in the fridge for 3 hours. Combine 1 tbsp of tahini and 1 tbsp of tahini water and brush on top and sides of rolls. Let set for 1 - 2 hours. Preheat oven at roll size, brush with extra tahini and then brush again with extra tahini and oil. Bake on a parchment lined cookie sheet at 400 for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove and let set 5 - 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Baby Corn With Olives
ingredients: 14 ounces baby peas, rinsed and drained | 4 green olives, pitted
instructions: Empty cans of peas into bowl and stir in olives.

title: Edamame and Beer Can Cake
ingredients: 2 cups pitted ripe edamame, shelled | 3 cups boiling water | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 can beer | 2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup sweet hot sauce | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in an electric mixer except for sauce and puree. Blend well. Spread into an 8x8 inch square baking pan. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Bake 45 - 50 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes in the pan before removing.

title: Greek Seafood Salad Imitation - (Dorie Greens)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked crab | 1/2 cup dried cracked wheat pickled grape leaves | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon fresh minced oregano or 2 -3 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 package nori | 1 1/2 cups low fat greek yogurt
instructions: Drain crab well and rinse with cool water. Spray nonstick nonstick skillet with cooking spray, place over medium high heat, for 3 minutes. Add 2 cups crab, grape leaves, and oil, and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in oregano. Sprinkle nori over top and serve warm with low fat greek yogurt.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,cucumber,part mozzarella cheese,barbecue sauce
title: Hot BBQ Spinach
ingredients: 1 tablespoon light barbecue sauce ( or more ) | 1/3 cup fresh baby spinach | 2 tablespoons shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 medium cucumber, cut into slivers
instructions: Preheat grill to low. Add barbecue sauce to spinach in bowl. Stir to combine. Sprinkle cheese on top. Top with cucumbers. Place on grill. Cover and grill until top begins to char. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,taco seasoning,chick pea,green cardamom pod,tortilla chip
title: Crunchy Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups finely shredded cabbage | 2 cups cooked chick-peas, drained and rinsed ( from a can of chickpeas ) | 3/4 cup mild taco seasoning | 2 packages tortilla chips ( about 4-6 per serving ) | 3/4 cup finely shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 green cardamom pods | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place cabbage and chickpeas in a mixing bowl. In a small dish combine the taco sauce and taco seasoning.

title: Tamarind-Rimmed Roast
ingredients: 1 large fresh tamarind pulp ( or 2 tsp.| of frozen, unpeeled, cracked and chopped ) | 1 cup monterey jack cheese ( or cheddar cheese, grated ) | 1 -2 lb lean rump roast
instructions:
Trim the tip end from the tamarind pulp that it detaches easily from the outer shell. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the peel, discard the top portion of the pulp and discard. Remove the pulp by placing a knife blade into your hand and holding the blade at a 45 degree angle to give you a 1/4 inch slice. This will give you a more interesting bread shape. The texture will be the same depending on ripeness that you desire. Using a spoon, squeeze the pulp through the pulp extracting as much pulp as possible. You will also have to squeeze the mixture to extract all the pulp. In a clean bowl, mash the pulp with a fork or use an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Add the cheese and mash well, scraping the bowl as necessary from time to time. You should have a smooth, creamy texture. Place the rump roast on a sturdy cutting board and pound it thinly with a meat pounder, about 1/8 inch thick. This does not have to be perfect on a gas stove but if it is a bit too crumbly, add a 1/8 inch tbs. Water. This will produce a more compact rind. Cut several slits with a sharp knife down the thickest part of the rump roast about 1 inch wide and 2 inches long, cutting about 1/2 inch deep into the rind. 
    -. The cuts may have to be made in batches if they go into cold, unglazed water, and you don't have a sandwich press. When they are all in, place a small plate over the top to keep them from oozing out. Lay the meat on a large platter with the slices, seam side down, and cover with plastic wrap. Freeze overnight. Unwrap the plastic wrap, remove the strings, and slice across the grain into slices or rectangles. Allow the slices to harden up, about 2 or 4 more days or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Beets in a Bowl
ingredients: 2 beetroots | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Peel the beets and cut into chunks. Place the beets in a large skillet and fill with just enough water to cover them. Simmer over high heat for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain, saving the cooking water. Place the beets in a bowl. Refresh with cold water. Cut off stem ends of beetroot. Add the water to the beets. Stir to mix. Spoon into bowls, garnish with lime wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,chinese cabbage,ginger,dark brown sugar,rump roast,fast chicken soup base,duck,veal
title: Chicken Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces duck ( can use other cuts ) | 4 ounces veal ( can use other cuts ) | 1 bunch chinese cabbage ( shredded ) | 10 slices lean rump roast ( thin slices ) | 15 ounces french creme fraiche ( can use full-fat ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 sprig ginger | 1 teaspoon fast chicken soup base
instructions: Cut the duck or other cuts into serving size pieces and place into a large casserole dish. Peel and shred the veal. Wash the cabbage and cut in half lenghtwise. Remove the leaves, place into a large bowl of water to prevent them from bending and then drain. Trim any tough parts from the cabbage. Place the duck carcass/discard in the casserole and cover with 3/4 of the cabbage. Add the remaining shredded cabbage, trimming any tough parts of the cabbage if they are very large. Cover with the 4 oz of french creme fraiche and sprinkle the sugar over top. Add the ginger, chicken base, and 3/4 of the ginger slices. Stir. Pour over enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the casserole dish. Dissolve the soup base in the leftover duck or duck stock and pour over casserole. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot with rice.

title: Quick and Easy Coconut Corn
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 cup coconut cream
instructions: Place corn, onion, coconut cream in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until sauce is desired thickness.

title: Parsnips Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 large parsnips, peeled
instructions: Place bacon grease, rosemary, parsley, olive oil, and sugar in a non reactive bowl and whisk until the sugar has dissolved. Place parsnips in a large resealable plastic bag, pour in the vegetable oil, and close the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator, flipping occasionally, for 1 hour. Preheat grill for medium high heat. Remove parsnips from the marinade and grill for 4 minutes on each side, or until tender. Serve with toasted bread.

title: Basic Vegetarian Refried Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs dried pinto beans | 10 ounces hominy | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles
instructions: Wash beans and soak overnight. The next day wash, de stem and rinse the beans. In a large pot add all ingredients except for the fried beans. Cook at a simmer, uncovered for 1 hour. Drain the beans and add to the beans along with any other ingredients. Heat and serve over white rice.

title: Trader Vic Reeves' Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 32 ounces brussels sprouts, washed and trimmed | 1 jar pickled brussels sprouts | 1 whole radish, sliced
instructions: Place brussels sprouts on a platter and pour pickled brussels sprouts on top. Cut radish and slice into rings. Garnish with a whole radish.

Random Ingredients: non dairy topping,chili sauce,tomato soup,pineapple juice,dark sesame oil
title: Fantastic Party Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can pineapple tidbits in juice, drained | 1/4 cup sriracha chili sauce, such as tabasco | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 container non-dairy topping
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a 2 - 3 qt baking dish. Stir in sesame oil until blended. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Remove from oven and sprinkle with non dairy topping just before serving.

title: Mexican Chipotle Cabbage (Alton Brown)
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cored and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon, crumbled | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup mexican-style shredded chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with water.

title: Dessert Risotto With Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup short-grain rice, soaked in water for 15 minutes | 2 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 3/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 dozen ladyfingers, trimmings or 1 1/2 dozen homemade ladyfingers, trimmings | 2 -3 tablespoons corn or 2 -3 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Soak rice with water in large bowl for atleast 20 minutes. Drain and repeat process with 1 - 2 more cups or the amount of water needed for soaking. In a small bowl, stir together cottage cheese, walnuts and lemon juice. Set aside. Lightly oil a 6 cup risotto dish or bowl. Spread ¾ cup of the ricotta cheese mixture over the bottom of the dish. Dip ladyfingers or ladyfingers in the oil, letting excess drip off. Arrange in a single layer in dish until all of the ladyfingers are covered. Add the rice mixture to the dish. Spread the remaining ricotta cheese over the rice mixture. Sprinkle the rice mixture on top of the ricotta. Let stand for 20 minutes. Serve in individual bowls with a sprinkling of walnuts.

title: Corn, Cheese and Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cup corn, frozen | 1/2 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Heat a teaspoon of cooking oil in a small frying pan over medium high heat. When oil is hot, use a paper towel to gently scrape the bottom of the pan to avoid damaging the surfaces of the heat, then sprinkle the corn and cheese evenly over the top. Cover with the second teaspoon of oil. When it is bubbling, turn heat to low and leave corn and cheese to cook for about 1 minute, or until the cheese has melted.

title: Italian Pork Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 jar sliced pepperoni ( i like it with hot red peppers in it ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions:
Cut tenderloin crosswise into six equal strips. Starting at narrow end of thick strips of pork, tie strips together with string. 
    -. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread 2 tablespoons canola oil over a small baking dish. Arrange strips of pork on baking dish and bake in oven until browned, about 20 minutes. Remove from baking dish and cool for 15 minutes. Remove meat from bones and slice. Reserve heat and set aside. Spoon 1 can cream of mushroom soup into a 6 cup glass bowl and mix with meat and 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Roll meat mixture into 6 balls. Roll balls in cheese and place on a platter seam side down. Mix remaining can of mushrooms soup and 3/4 cup reserved broth. Brush over balls and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes until hot and bubbly. Cool 10 minutes.

title: Curried Quinoa
ingredients: 1/3 cup raw quinoa | 1/4 medium green curry paste | 1/2 small orange bell pepper ( i use red, but adjust for more color ) | fresh coriander ( to garnish )
instructions:
Bring 2 - 3 cups water to a boil and add the quinoa & mix well. 
    -. Cover over a high press, lower the heat to simmer & cook 5 more minutes. Set aside & let stand, covered, for 5 - 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork & stir in the curry paste, mix well & adjust seasoning, serve cold or warm garnished with fresh coriander. Variation, add 1 to 2 diced red peppers, 3/4 cup water, & diced orange bell pepper for a variation.

title: Simple Chicken with Herbs
ingredients: 10 chicken tenders | 1 bunch fresh chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a pan with aluminum foil. Spray the pan with a vegetable cooking spray. Place chicken tenders on the foil. Pour the 1/2 cup of water into the pan and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Uncover the chicken and bake for 10 more minutes. The tenders should be golden brown, and cooked through. Remove from the oven and scatter with chives.

title: Creamy Onion, Cucumber & Bread Sticks
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup cubed peeled cucumber | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed and wrapped tightly in parchment paper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread bread sticks with soup, cucumber & thyme leaves. Wrap bread in foil and bake 10 - 12 minutes, or until bread is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,heavy whipping cream,egg yolk,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Key Lime Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 large egg yolk | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh key limes juice
instructions: Heat cream in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat on the stove. Stir in egg yolk and parmesan cheese. Cook, stirring constantly, until egg is just cooked and cheese is melted, 5 to 7 minutes. Reduce heat if necessary. Stir in the hot cream mixture and cook, stirring constantly for 1 minute. Serve with more pepperjack cheese sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,maraschino cherry,chili sauce,spanish olive oil,snow pea,beef stew meat,pork loin chop
title: Pork Loin Steak with Spanish Olives
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin chops | 1/2 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons chili sauce ( such as sriracha ) | 2 tablespoons spanish olive oil | 2 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries, plus maraschino cherries for garnish | 14 1/2 ounces sliced spanish olives | 12 ounces frozen snow peas, thawed
instructions: Cut pork loin crosswise into thin half moons. Place in a large bowl and sprinkle both sides with gelatin. Mix in chili sauce and let soak for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a wide, shallow skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add maraschino cherries, and sear until fragrant and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in pork.

title: Grilled Zucchini With Sausage on Pineapple
ingredients: 600 g pork mince | 2 zucchini, cut into 3cm pieces | 1/2 cup pineapple, chopped | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix the pork mince with the dressing to combine and season.

Random Ingredients: porridge oat,bacon,ginger paste,chicken breast half,chile pepper,vanilla bean,horseradish
title: Jamaican Grilled Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup porridge oats | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon minced hot chile pepper | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger paste | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 2 tablespoons lemon-flavored liqueur, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Place the porridge oats, bacon, horseradish, hot peppers, ginger zest, and vanilla bean in a large glass bowl. Pour enough hot water over the ingredients so that they cover the oats entirely. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, or for as long as possible. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Bring the liquid to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat, cooking until most of the liquid has soaked up the spices. Remove from heat, and stir in the lemon flavoring. Place chicken on skewers, and cover with liquid sauce. Cook for about 15 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink in center, but firm and cooked thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,turmeric powder,cinnamon,amaretto,lemon juice,turkey sausage,beet,green curry paste
title: Indoor Kebabs
ingredients: 300 g turkey sausage | 2 teaspoons lemons, juice of | 2 teaspoons green curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper | 1 small beet, shelled and diced | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Cut the sausage in half and rub all over with the lemon juice. Combine the curry paste, turmeric, cinnamon and chill pepper and rub it into the turkey, ensuring that it is fully covered. Thread the beef onto a skewer and grill over medium heat until no longer pink on the outside and cooked to your liking about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with steamed green beans alongside.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,wine vinegar,spanish rice mix,french bean,eggplant,cauliflower floret,bell pepper
title: Spanish Style Eggplant and Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 package spanish rice mix | 2 lbs eggplants, in 1/4 inch slice | 4 large bell peppers, in 1/4 inch slices | 4 small cauliflower florets | 1 can french beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on package. While rice is cooking, coat 8 x 8 inch square baking pan with pam spray. Arrange eggplant slices in a single layer on hot bottom of the pan. Scatter bell pepper slices around eggs. Arrange cauliflower florets around eggplant. Sprinkle cauliflower with taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: white flour,ginger garlic paste,penne pasta,orange marmalade,peanut oil
title: Peanut Butter Pasta Pasta - Padman Style
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta ( or other long pasta ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup orange marmalade or 1/4 cup plum jam | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Cook the penne pasta acording to the package directions. Drain and transfer to a large mixing bowl. While the pasta is cooking, put peanut oil into a saucepan. Add ginger garlic paste, and fry briefly, then transfer this paste to the bowl with the pasta. Cook sauce in the peanut oil until the sauce has thickened and become quite dark in color. Add orange marmalade, and add flour. Mix well. While the pasta cooks, stir fry the sauce with the pasta until the pasta is cooked and the sauce is cooked.

title: Rosemary and Fresh Ginger Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets | 4 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon fresh sage | 2 tablespoons fresh tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Coat a baking sheet with a coating of cooking spray. Place cutlets under the broiler or in a shallow baking dish. Place a baking sheet over the cutlets and brush them with the cooking spray. Sprinkle the ginger juice all over the chicken. Sprinkle evenly with the rosemary, sage and tomato juice. Bake, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked and tender.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,blueberry,brown rice,vegetable oil cooking spray,szechuan peppercorn,watercress leaf,teriyaki sauce,beef brisket
title: Spiced Beef Brisket With Blueberries and Sherry
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, fat trimmed | szechuan peppercorns | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups watercress leaves ( optional ) | 1 lb fresh strawberries or 1 lb fresh blueberries, washed | 3 1/2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 tablespoons packed brown rice or 2 tablespoons barley
instructions: Cut a 6 lengthwise slice crosswise 1 1/3 inches deep lengthwise of brisket to fit into a 4 1/2 qt crock of heavy duty foil. Place brisket in crock.

title: Krautfleckerl - German Potato Candy Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb potato starch | vegetable oil ( for deep frying ) | 8 cups miniature marshmallows | powdered candy ( confectioners )
instructions: Place potato starch in a plastic bag and refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the oil to 350 degrees f. Dip the marshmallows into the hot oil. Dip the sweet potatoes into the marshmallow syrup, then carefully roll into krautfleckerl sticks. Place the sticks on a lined cookie sheet. Sprinkle with the confectioners' sugar. Allow to dry on the cookie sheet for 3 to 4 hours or until the krautfleckerl become light and fluffy.

title: Chamomate
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons salted sherry | 1 tablespoon seltzer water or 1 tablespoon club soda ( carbonated water )
instructions: Mix together vinegar, salt, and water in a shallow glass bowl or glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Stir in sherry, then refrigerate covered 4 to 6 hours or until flavors meld. Serve at once.

title: Spice Rubbed Beef Roast for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 1 jar beef gravy ( or 1 lb.| jar beef gravy and 1 lb.| jar beef gravy, mix ) | spices
instructions:
Place beef roast in crock pot. Mix 1 lb. Slowly pour gravy mix over roast. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 10hrs or high 4 5hrs. After cooking meat for a few hours, turn to high and add additional gravy mix to the gravy. Cover, lower the heat and allow the meat to cook for about 1 1/2hrs per pound of meat. 
    -. Do not stir during cooking time.

title: Sweetcorn Filling for Malaysian Recipes
ingredients: 2 cups sweetcorn | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground galangal
instructions:
Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Meanwhile, place sweetcorn and marinara sauce in a bowl. Sprinkle in the thyme and mix well with whisk. Slowly whisk in the warm marinara to thicken. Pour into a container to cool completely. Place thawed sweetcorn filling into freezer plastic bag and freeze until firm. 
    -. You can also make this filling in a food processor or blender according to manufacturers directions.

title: Grilled Sardines
ingredients: 1 can sardine, drained | 2 cans chopped yellow squash | 1/3 cup bread crumbs | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat. In a medium bowl, mash sardines until crumbly. Remove and mash the sardines with a fork until they are no longer textured and can penetrate easily with a grainy texture. Transfer the sardines to a bowl and stir in the yellow squash and bread crumbs. Brush a grill with vegetable oil and lightly oil the grate. Heat the sardine mixture until warm, about 10 minutes. Place the breaded sardines on the grill, close the lid of the grill, and cook 6 minutes, or until thoroughly heated and the bread crumbs are lightly golden brown. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

title: Authentic Cojita Con Queijo
ingredients: 3 ounces fresh cilantro leaves | 4 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 4 cups double cream
instructions: Place cilantro in a small bowl. Sprinkle with a small pinch of salt, and mix thoroughly. Add about 2 tablespoons of the cheese, and squeeze over the fresh cilantro. Chill. In a double boiler, stir about 3/4 cup of the cream with the remaining ounces of cheese. When it starts to boil on top of the double boiler, remove from heat, and strain the mixture through a fine mesh strainer into the empty bowl. Place a serving plate over the top, and carefully pour the hot cream into it. Garnish with more cheese and serve immediately.

title: Fennel in a Cup - Appetizing the Apple!
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed of root end and feathery stalk and trimmed of feathery stalk and fronds | 2 cups unpeeled apples, cut into 1 � inch dice | 2 tablespoons finely chopped spring onions, including green tops
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut fennel bulbs vertically into 1 inch cubes and place in a large glass baking dish or roasting pan. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the fennel off the stalks and reserve, placing them in a bowl. Squeeze out and discard the feathery stalk and fronds, leaving about 1 inch of stalk.

Random Ingredients: lemon thyme,yogurt,egg noodle,cremini mushroom,pam cooking spray,rump roast,linguine
title: Grilled Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 4 small rump roast | 2 tablespoons lemon thyme, minced | 4 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces medium egg noodles, uncooked | pam cooking spray | 1 container sour cream or ( 18 ounce ) container low fat sour cream | 4 ounces yogurt
instructions: Mix the lemon thyme with 2 tbsp of yogurt and set aside. Place the cooked and cooled beef in a shallow dutch oven dish. Combine the sour cream with the remaining yogurt in a small bowl and pour over the beef. Serve on a bed of cooked noodles.

title: Broccoli Salad With Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 fresh broccoli, heads chopped.| i like to use frozen | 4 ounces cream cheese, cubed ( i prefer fat free ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup mirin | 24 chicken wings, frozen | shichimi togarashi or shichimi togarashi, to taste
instructions: Marinate chicken wings while preparing the salad in the fridge. Chop all parts of the broccoli into about 1 inch squares. Combine the cream cheese with 2 tbsp of white wine or mirin to taste. Add 2 more tbsp of white wine or mirin if you like your dressing sweeter. Add the frozen chicken wings to the dressing. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Toss well to coat. Chill for at least several hours. Remove the chicken wings from the mixture. Cook at high heat in a large skillet until just cooked through, about 1 minute. Drain on paper towels. When ready to serve, arrange broccoli in the bottom of a bowl. Place 4 - 5 pieces of chicken on the broccoli, and top with 4 - 5 pieces of grilled broccian. Drizzle with vinaigrette and drizzle generously with the remaining vinaigrette. Garnish with shichimi togarashi or shichimi togarashi. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Chocolate Nachos

instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Prepare noodles by dropping hot, drained pasta out of package onto cookie sheets covered with parchment paper. Spread noodles out with 1/2 cup of chocolate chips.
