title: Quick and Easy Hot Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 ounces beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons fresh cream of tartar | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine or 1/2 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 -2 cup hot chili pepper, sliced ( seeded and diced ) | 2 tablespoons cherry, halved
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, stir together the cream of tartar and tomato juice until blended. Add stew meat and stir to coat. Stir in wine. Add the stock and chili peppers. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 8 hours. Sprinkle each serving with cherry halves just before serving.

title: Bourbon Boston Platter(Food Network)
ingredients: 2 bags cabbage leaves | 1 1/2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 3 tablespoons bourbon | 1/3 cup shredded apple ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Place the shredded cabbage in the bottom of one platter. Sprinkle with bourbon. Divide shredded lettuce, apple, and cayenne. Top with remaining lettuce. Serve warm. Variation, substitute a 1/2 cup of sliced cabbage with the iceberg lettuce. Variation, substitute 2 cups of shredded cabbage with the shredded napa cabbage. Substitue, substitute 1/4 cup of sliced red onion. Variation, substitute 3 to 4 cloves of sliced garlic for the apple.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,extra virgin olive oil,cauliflower,filet mignon steak
title: Beef With Cauliflower
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 4 filet mignon steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drizzle one side of cauliflower with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Rub paprika onto both sides of steaks. Place cauliflower in roasting pan or baking dish. Drizzle remaining olive oil over cauliflower. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of paprika. Place in oven. Bake until cauliflower is tender and knife tender, 2 to 2 1/4 hours.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,fish sauce,pizza crust,parmesan cheese,tamari,chive,ancho chile powder,triple sec
title: Baked French Toast With Spicy Tomato Squid
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 4 ounces tri-colored sweet potato chips or 4 ounces parmesan cheese, cut in half | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon snipped chives ( optional ) | 1 1 teaspoon tamari ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Prepare your prepared pizza crust dough or preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine chile, paprika, potatoes and fish sauce. Mix to combine. Spread potato mixture equally on prepared pizza crust or top with sweet potato chips. In a small bowl, combine triple sec and snipped chives. Brush over top of pizza dough or top with sweet potato chips. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until crust is set. Cut into wedges to serve, or to allow extra flavor to soak into the noodles.

title: Mennonite Noodle and Date Sushi
ingredients: 2 ounces dried wide egg noodles, broken or 2 ounces rice vermicelli | 1/2 lb fresh date, pitted or 1/2 lb dried black fig, sliced | 3 -4 medium ripe tomatoes, cut into thin rings or 1/2 lb tomato puree | 1 -2 teaspoon mild to hot mirin | 3 tablespoons walnut pieces ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons other nuts, such as pistachios, cashews, or pecans, coarsely ground ( optional )
instructions: Soak the noodles in water overnight to loosen the saltiness. Drain and cut into 1 inch squares. If using dried figs, soak for 30 minutes in warm water.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,onion soup mix,taco seasoning mix,pearl barley,culantro cilantro
title: Mexican Barley
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package onion soup mix | 3/4 cup chopped cilantro | 2 packages shredded semisweet chocolate
instructions: Spray 4 quarts of water with non stick cooking spray. Rinse barley and drain. Place in a large pot, with water to cover barley. Bring to a boil, turn down heat. Simmer about 1 hour or until tender. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve, melt chocolate over top, and top with a slotted spoon.

title: Hot Chocolate Bread and Butter Spread
ingredients: 2 cups day old white bread,, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 tablespoons toblerone chocolate bars, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried sweet salsa | coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup frozen cranberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl, tossing to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve at room temperature or chilled up to 3 days.

title: Salmon Kebabs with Ginger-Ginger Glaze
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and roughly chopped | 1 bunch kale, stemmed and chopped into chiffonade | 8 hamburger buns | 2 pounds salmon fillets, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Whisk egg whites and sugar in a bowl until foamy.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,black eyed pea,chili paste,ginger powder,olive
title: Khandi
ingredients: 2 cups black-eyed peas ( hari mirch ki dal or black kidney ) | 1 cup cashew nuts | 1/2 cup grated ginger powder | 3 -5 drops chili paste | olive oil
instructions: Rinse the black eyed peas well. Take 2 tbsp of oil in a pan. Add the ginger, cashew nuts and chilli paste. Stir fry until they are golden in colour. Add the black eyed peas. Mix well. Cover. Cook until the water starts leaving the above. Mix well. Turn off the flame. Serve hot on a big platter, with fresh mint garnished on top.

Random Ingredients: harissa,pandan leaf,soy sauce,heavy whipping cream,sesame oil
title: Taste of the Islands (Malay, Malaysian)
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon agave nectar | 1/2 teaspoon ground sesame oil | 1 teaspoon harissa | 4 pandan leaves, cut into 3-inch lengths
instructions: Mix cream, honey, sesame oil, and harissa together in a blender if using.

title: Chicken wing salad
ingredients: 5 pieces chicken wings, rinsed | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce, torn | white mushrooms, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Quickly brown the wings in the hot oil, about 4 minutes per side, until the chicken is no longer pink inside.

title: Simple Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: 1 pineapple - peeled, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Pour half of the pineapple, sauce, garlic, and remaining contents of the skillet into a blender. Blend until completely smooth. Pour into a serving bowl, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Hot Red Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs hot red chiles | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Wash, stem and devein the chiles. Devein the tomatoes and chillies and add to them. Chill and serve immediately or refrigerate until cold before serving.

title: Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground turkey | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 3 bay leaves | 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Place turkey in a large pot. Sprinkle with creole seasoning and bay leaves. Cover, and cook over medium heat until turkey is cooked through. Drain fat. Remove bay leaves, and adjust seasoning. Melt the margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Gradually stir turkey into the hot butter. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through and mixture is slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: red potato,spinach leaf,graham cracker crumb,honey,lime,pandan leaf,kielbasa,cucumber
title: Sweet and Savory Kielbasa with Garlic Crumble Potatoes - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 -4 large red potatoes, cut into 3 or 4 pieces | 6 ounces kielbasa, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 6 ounces sliced cucumbers, diced | 11 1/2 ounces chopped fresh spinach leaves | 5 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup honey | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 1/2 lime rinds, grated and zest | 8 pieces fresh lime ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry potatoes. Coat a 4 - 5 quart crock with olive oil cooking spray and set. Cut kielbasa lengthwise into 6 thick slices. Spray crock with olive oil, arrange 1/3 of the potatoes on crock. Add spinach, pkielbasa, cucumber, and kielbasa slices, alternating between the kielbasa slices and spinach leaves. In a small bowl stir the remaining ingredients together and pour over all. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours. Stir to mix ingredients and serve immediately.

title: White Beans With Oranges & Bran Chips
ingredients: 3/4 cup frozen white beans | 2 tablespoons chopped mild-tasting bran cereal | 1/4 cup canned enchilada sauce ( your favorite ) | 3 -4 radishes, julienned
instructions: Put beans, bran, & enchilada sauce in microwave safe bowl, cover, microwave for 1 minute. Stir, cover, microwave for 2 additional minutes, stirring, until cereal is melted, stir, cover for about 1 minute, remove cereal bowl from microwave, put on plate, pour some broth into bowl& cover to keep warm. Stir, cover, microwave for 1 additional minute. Stir, cover.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,coffee bean,roasting chicken,my take sneaky orange puree,cilantro,stewing beef
title: Moroccan-Spiced Beef and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 -2 roasting chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 2 cans coffee beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can stewed tomatoes and orange puree | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped ( or more if needed to measure ) | 4 cups beef tips ( optional ) or 4 cups cubed cooked chicken breast ( optional )
instructions: Place meat, chicken pieces and enough water to cover meat. Add all ingredients except cilantro and beef, if using and stir to blend. Cook 5 to 8 hours, until meat is fork tender. Remove chicken and discard bones or skin, shred meat, return meat and any collected juices to pot and cook for a few more hours. Transfer meat to a serving dish and drizzle with any juices left in pan. Garnish with cilantro before serving.

title: Taco Leaf (Mexican-Style Fresh Green Sauce)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed and dried | 1 can tomato paste | 1 hot red chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, toast the lettuce until crisp and evenly browned. Transfer to a bowl and stir in the tomato paste. Place a few spoonfuls of dressing in the can on the lettuce and tomato and stir.

title: Shrimp and Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby shrimp, cleaned and shelled | 1 large radish, peeled, cored and sliced crosswise | 20 sprigs fresh radish
instructions: Combine shrimp and radish in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Canadian Bacon and Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork chop | 1/2 lb boneless sirloin steak | 1 bag canadian bacon ( slices ) | 8 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Cut pork and sirloin meat into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut Canadian bacon into 1/2 inch squares. If using a whole grain sirloin beef steak, trim off both ends so the meat can get a good piece of meat without getting stuck to the skewers. Cut in half and roll up each piece like a swiss roll. Thread on toothpicks. Combine mayonnaise and barbecue sauce in a small bowl. Skewer each piece of meat onto a skewer. Place on a preheated, grill over medium heat until the bacon is golden, about 10 minutes.

title: Cashews Spread
ingredients: 200 g cashew nuts | 1 pinch celery salt
instructions: Process all ingredients in a food processor. This can be stored tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,duck breast,white truffle oil,golden syrup,dark soy sauce,serrano pepper,mango chutney
title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 100 g duck breast fillets, coarsely grated | 50 g dark soy sauce | 50 g mango chutney ( sweet or chunky mango chutney ) | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper or 1 teaspoon jalapeno hot pepper, finely chopped | 100 g heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | white truffle oil, to drizzle
instructions: Put all the fruit/vegetable oil into a bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste. Blend the grated duck into the sauce and allow to sit out for about 15 minutes. Heat up the gf cream and when it's warm whip it up a little bit, if you need it, and then pour this onto the chicken. Taste it for sweetness, add more salt, pepper or hot pepper if you would like. Whip in the syrup and drizzle a couple of drops of truffle oil. Enjoy.

title: Czechoslovakian Sausage (Pot-York-Korean Style)
ingredients: 12 links pork sausage | 2 1/2 cups cold cuts ( korean pate ), cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, cook sausage over medium high heat until most of the liquid has evaporated, stirring constantly. Drain and discard any fat accumulated on the pan, saute sausage until browned, crumbling it with a wooden spoon. Stir in cold cuts. Poke several holes into the pork and return to skillet. Cover, cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Let stand covered, 10 minutes before cutting and serving with kimchi, spicy kimchi and dipping sauce from a jar. If using the pork as above, cut into 1 inch cubes.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,coconut rum,picante sauce,beef tenderloin,pancetta,sun tomato
title: Picante Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 3/4 -inch cubes | 12 slices pancetta, thick end, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 12 sundried tomatoes | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon coconut rum | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a shallow baking pan, place beef and cover with slices of pancetta, and about 2 sundried tomatoes. Cover with picante sauce and rum. Add raisins. Cover with foil. Bake in the oven for 2 hours, or until very tender. Let stand, about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken drumsticks | 3 cans sliced pepperoncini peppers, chopped, with liquid
instructions: Drain juice from peppers into a large saucepan, and set aside 10 pieces of pepperoncini pepper to soak in juice for 1 hour. Rinse chicken and drain off juice. Arrange chicken in a 5 to 6 gallon resealable plastic bag, and spoon about 2 teaspoons of pepperoncini pepper paste on top. Seal bag and place chicken in the plastic bag with the pepperoncini peppers.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,jasmine rice,caster sugar,chili sauce,scallion,mustard powder
title: Spicy Scallion Rice With Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground mustard powder | 2 cups hot cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Cook your chosen pasta. Drain the pasta and rinse well in a colander under cold water. Reserve. While the pasta is cooking, heat the scallion, sugar, chili sauce and mustard powder in a heavy medium sized pan. Stir a few times, until the garlic begins to smell fragrant. Add the pasta, and stir. Add enough warm water to cover. Cook the rice until just tender and creamy. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Toss the cooked rice and pasta with the hot sauce and scallion mixture and serve.

title: Tikka Kebab
ingredients: 2 cups bulgar wheat | 2 jalapenos, diced | 1 package shredded sweetened coconut, drained
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Wrap cereal grains in aluminum foil or plastic wrap to ensure air pockets can circulate around dish. Place in hot preheated grill and close lid. Cook for 25 minutes. Remove cereal and wrap well in paper towels. Allow to steam dry before serving.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,tomato juice,nori,kosher salt black pepper,maraschino cherry,red enchilada sauce,zucchini,ginger juice
title: Sushi Roll-Up
ingredients: 2 pieces zucchini | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper, to taste | 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger juice | 1/2 cup canned crushed tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce, heated | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 nori ( dry seaweed ) sheets | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Trim the ends from zucchini by rolling over them first in your hands and then pressing onto the roll. Cut each slice on a diagonal into 1/2 inch strips. Season zucchini with salt and pepper and squeeze a little juice over them. Mix ginger juice, tomatoes, and enchilada sauce together in a medium bowl and set aside. Heat a large, nonstick pan over medium heat. Place nori sheets in the pan and cook for 4 minutes, or until crisp. Remove nori from heat and roll up in the nori. Press a potholder or toothpick in each slice, til both sides of each slice are lightly browned. Remove toothpicks. Garnish each serving with a cherry and serve. Sushi roll ups can be made ahead and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,pork,monterey jack cheese,soy sauce,canadian bacon,greek seasoning,cumin seed,white vinegar
title: Crock Pot Pulled Chicken (Or Tater Tot) With Canadian Bacon Chutney
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 3 ounces canadian bacon, slices cut in half diagonally, then crosswise into 1/8-inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat, drippings reserved from chicken | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon fat, drippings reserved from meat | 1 tablespoon canadian-style smoked paprika ( use regular and hot paprika if available ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 3/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Trim chicken of excess fat and cut into 6 - 8 servings. Cut chicken breasts into 1/2 slices. In a dutch oven coated with cooking spray, cook half the slices of canadian bacon in 1 - 2 tbsp of canadian bacon fat over medium high heat for 1 minute or until browned. Place all of the cooked bacon chunks along with any remaining chicken pieces in a 5 - 8 quart slow cooker. In a medium bowl stir together the canadian bacon fat, canadian bacon fat, smoked paprika, soy sauce, vinegar, cumin seed and greek seasoning. Pour the dressing over chicken pieces ensuring they don't touch and stir. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours or on low for 2 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Cherry Canapes
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried cherries ( about 1 1/2 pints ) | 1/2 cup dried italian cheese | 4 anchovies, peeled | 1 stalk rosemary leaf | 1 sprig fresh rosemary sprig
instructions: Using a small spoon, coarsely crush anchovies. Spread anchovies in a small dry skillet over medium low heat. Cook anchovies until fragrant and slightly softened, stirring once or twice. Stir in cherries and sprinkle cheese over anchovies. Return to a medium low heat and cook, stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Stir in rosemary, then increase heat to medium low and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened. Immediately remove from heat and transfer to a small bowl or serving plate. Serve at once.

title: Warm Cranberry and Cheddar Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons walnut-flavoured plain flour | 1 tablespoon chickpea seeds from a can or 3/4 cup craisins | 1/4 cup celery, finely chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese, finely grated, more if desired | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnut pieces, toasted | 8 leaves of mixed lettuce | 4 tablespoons shredded lettuce
instructions: Combine tahini, flour, chickpea seeds and celery in a bowl and mix well. Add cheese, nuts, and mixed lettuce and mix well. Serve at room temperature.

title: Dijon Pork Loin
ingredients: 3/4 cup dijon mustard, prepared | 1/2 cup grated bittersweet chocolate | 1/2 cup snipped fresh dill, or to taste | 1 boneless pork loin roast
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the dijon mustard, bittersweet chocolate, dill, and pork loin roast into the bread. Cover the roast with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the loin is cooked through, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f. Let the meat stand about 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Sparkling Strawberries With Pineapple
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fennel powder | 1 lb fresh strawberries | pineapple chunk ( optional )
instructions: Combine fennel and salt in large bowl of ice cold water. Dry strawberries in bag using towel or paper towels. Divide in half. Place strawberries on serving plate, top with pineapple chunk as desired, and drizzle with additional salt.

Random Ingredients: black bean,kale,chicken soup base,celery rib,bread flour
title: Black Bean Stuffing (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cans dried black beans, undrained | 1 can condensed chicken soup base | 1 cup shredded celery rib | 2 cups chopped kale | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Stuff turkey. Use as stuffing for tacos, enchiladas, burritos, or on top for quesadillas.

title: Green Gressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup finely chopped scallion | 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | 4 heads green leaf lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together scallion and vinegar.

title: Easy French Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup hot coffee | 4 -5 leaves baby bok choy ( or other green leafy leaf ) | 1 can tomato soup | buttermilk, for topping
instructions: Warm up the coffee with enough soymilk to make it hot enough to make a dousing.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,green cardamom pod,cranberry,sauce,chicken bouillon,raspberry,vanilla extract
title: Raspberry-Raspberry Fusion Soup
ingredients: 1 pinch sauerkraut ( or another herb or non-vegetarian cheese substitute ) | 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups fresh raspberries ( or frozen ) | 1/2 cup frozen unsweetened raspberries, partially thawed ( or fresh ) | 1 green cardamom pod, smashed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon mild-flavored hot sauce
instructions: Place sauerkraut in a large saucepan and over medium heat, pour in the stock.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,tuna water,tomato soup,lasagna noodle,snow pea
title: Chilli Prawns for Two
ingredients: 20 g tinned sun-dried tomato soup | 3 cups self-raising flour | 1 packet lasagna noodles | 1 cup fresh snow pea
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160c. Rinse the tinned sundried tomatoes, chop and place in a large bowl with the soup. Season well with salt and pepper. Add the flour and mix. Mix well and place a portion of the mixture on the bottom of an oven proof dish, just large enough to cover the tomato mixture. Place the snow peas on top of the tom and sprinkle over the tomato mix. Repeat this two more times and top with noodles. Cover and leave in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, cut a small slice and pop back into oven to crisp up those lovely browned prawns.

title: Simple Dilly Smoothie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped celery ribs | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill | 5 cups ice cubes
instructions: Combine celery, dill and ice cubes in a blender. Process until smooth. The ice will become slushy as it whips.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,apricot,steak,plain yogurt,pearl barley,shiitake mushroom,sharp cheddar cheese,mango
title: Barley Risotto
ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley | 1/2 cup pecorino cheese | 1/2 ounce shiitake mushroom, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried apricot | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 12 ounces small sirloin, trimmed and cut into thin slices | 6 -10 slices ginger, peeled and cut into thin strips
instructions: Soak the pearl barley in a large bowl of cold salted water for 1 hour. Heat a large saucepan over high heat. Add the pecorino, mushrooms, apricots, cheddar and yogurt, stirring constantly. When the baki begins to bubble rapidly, lift the pan of the yogurt from the heat. When it has been sufficiently mixed, pour the liquid into the pan, leaving sediment behind. Add the sirloin slices and ginger strips, then put the lid on and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 40 - 50 minutes, or until the broth is thin and barley is cooked to your liking. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: paprika,mozzarella cheese,dill,heavy whipping cream,rigatoni pasta,cumin powder
title: Cheese and Dill Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1/2 lb mozzarella cheese | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 tablespoon paprika | 1/4 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Cook rigatoni al dente as directed. Drain well, saving 1 cup of liquid. Cut mozzarella cheese into bite size cubes. Combine the mozzarella and cream in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high 7 - 12 mins, or until melted and smooth. Add remaining ingredients, except dill. Stir well to blend all. Cover and microwave on high 7 - 7 mins, stirring well. Serve with freshly ground black pepper, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken fillet,chili paste,haddock fillet,peanut butter,onion soup mix
title: Chicken with peanut butter
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 4 chicken fillets ( fillets about 2 pounds each )
instructions: To make the peanut sauce, in a small bowl, combine the first four ingredients. Rub the first four ingredients into the chicken fillets and leave to marinate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a shallow pan fry the fillets slowly over a moderate heat, turning them until all sides are browned. Serve hot, with the peanut sauce and a salad.

title: Tuna Cheeseburger Helper
ingredients: 1 package processed cheese, cubed | 1 can tuna, drained | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon blackened saffron | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup american cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees. Combine everything together in a large bowl. Form into burgers for Burger or sandwich buns or make sandwiches as desired.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,parsley,sea salt black pepper,celery seed,mirin
title: Baked Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soy sauce ( kikkoman ) | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together in a measuring cup till well combined and season with salt & pepper. Pour into a small rimmed baking dish or glass dish sprayed with pam or oil.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,panir,salmon,kaffir lime leaf,king prawn,saffron,asian pear,egg noodle
title: Kaffir Lime Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups uncooked medium egg noodles | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste ( kombu kombu ) | 1 tablespoon chopped asian dried pears | 1/2 tablespoon shrimp paste ( kombu honito ) | 3 -5 slices of peeled asian pears | 1 slice thin slice salmon | 1 teaspoon chopped kaffir lime leaf | 1 teaspoon saffron ( sujoyu ) | 3 -4 large chunks anchovies packed in oil
instructions: Cook the noodles as directed and set aside. To prepare the dressing, place the shrimp paste and the shrimp paste in a mortar and pestle and pound well. Combine with noodles and top with pears, asian pear slices, julienned kaffir lime leaves and saffron. To store, cover tightly with a lid and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,superfine sugar,ladyfinger,monterey jack cheese,beef base,kielbasa,fajita seasoning mix,plum tomato
title: The Real Thing! Easy Beef and Kielbasa Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced kielbasa ( a pound of sliced sausage will do.| i like hillshire farms brand ) | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( i use earth balance ) | 14 1/2 ounces plum tomatoes, preferably san marzano, coarsely chopped | 3/4 lb monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/8-inch-thick slices | 1 envelope dry fajita seasoning mix | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 cups store-bought ladyfingers | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening ( for pan frying ) | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar, for topping
instructions: To make pam's beef fajitas, in a large, heavy skillet, brown the kielbasa in 1 tbl. Oil over moderate heat, stirring, until browned. Transfer to a paper towel. Repeat with the remaining oil and kielbasa. Add the fajita seasoning to the skillet and heat over medium heat until fragrant, about 20 seconds. Add the shortening and tomatoes to the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, then remove from heat. Spread half the fajita meat on the bottom of a 13 x 9 greased baking dish. Arrange the sausage, tomatos, and cheese over the top. Layer the spanish onion mixture over the cheese and spread evenly. Top with the reserved fajita meat. Bake at 350°f for about 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted into the center of the fajitas comes out clean. Meanwhile, prepare the ganache, in a small bowl, mix the fajita seasoning and 1/4 cup superfine sugar until well mixed. Quickly pour over the fajita meat in the baking dish. Let cool about 20 minutes. To serve, top with a dollop of ganache and sliced green onions.

title: Apple Marsala
ingredients: 8 granny smith apples | 1 cup sliced fresh strawberries | 1 cup dry marsala
instructions:
Place apples in a slow cooker with a lid, and cover with water. Cover, and cook over low heat setting for 7 to 8 hours. 
    -. When ready to serve, mix in the strawberries and marsala. Serve warm, or cool completely and serve in thin chilled glasses.

Random Ingredients: tamari,monterey jack cheddar cheese,corn,orange zest,pesto sauce
title: Soupy Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 cup frozen corn | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce, divided | 1 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly oil grill grate. Combine corn, zest, tamari, and ½ cup of the cheese in a medium bowl. Transfer mixture to the grates and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Close lid and grill until corn is hot and cheese is melted, 3 - 4 minutes longer. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk powder,butternut squash,purslane,tahini,cream,water artichoke heart,rice vinegar,beer
title: Vegetarian Baked Butternut Squash(Paleo)
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup cream | 1/2 cup lukewarm beer | 1/4 cup purslane, leaves ( italian ) | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained, chopped | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup light coconut milk powder
instructions: Scrub the inside of the squash with a vegetable brush, using a vegetable peeler. Cut it in half lengthwise. Turn out the seeds. Rinse the squash with some cold water. Place a steamer insert directly over the squash, and cover tightly. If you are using a large pot, cover and steam the squash until the squash is just tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Remove the steamer insert, and add the rice vinegar to the pot. Place the pot over high heat. Bring the water just to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and continue simmering until very thick, 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often to prevent scorching. Add the cream and stir well. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place the purslane leaves in a bowl. Add about 1/4 cup of the beer to the purslane, and whisk in 1/4 cup of the curry mixture.

title: Blueberry Jam

title: Perfect French Fries

ingredients: 4 fennel, stalks cut off | 1 jar pizza sauce | 2 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 4 tomatillos, husked and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Strip off the leaves from the fennel stalks, then slice into 1/4 inch slices. Roughly chop the fennel stalks with back of a cleaver, and place into a 9 x13 inch baking dish, overlapping the surrounding pieces of fennel. Stir the pizza sauce into the apple juice over medium heat. Bring to a boil, and pour evenly over the fennel and top with the sliced fennel. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven, sprinkle with cream and tomatillos, and return to the oven, stirring several times. Return to the oven, and bake for an additional 8 minutes, or until the fennel is tender and bubbly.

title: Fresh Strawberries and Egg Egg Nog
ingredients: 3 lbs ripe strawberries | 3 egg yolks | french bread or country bread, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 3 egg whites | 1 cup tamarind pulp | 3 ounces baguette ( cut into 1/2 inch cubes )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the strawberries, egg yolks and tamarind pulp. Let stand, covered, at room temperature for 2 hours. Soak bread cubes or bread slices in warm water for 5 minutes. Drain, squeeze excess liquid into a small bowl and set aside. In a small heavy saucepan, heat 1 cup of warm water to boiling. Add the bread, stirring to soak in chunks of bread about 1 inch thick. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until just tender. Drain and allow to cool. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f, or to 450 degrees f. Lightly grease 4 baking sheets. Stir fry bread cubes or bread slices into beaten egg whites in a large skillet for 1 to 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper towels and set aside. Repeat with remaining bread cubes or bread slices. Divide the bread mixture evenly among the 4 baking sheets. Bake for about 30 minutes, or until custard is thickened.

title: Mexican Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs yellow squash, cut into 1 inch wedges | 12 ounces masa harina, or more if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place squash in a colander, and sprinkle with salt and let sit 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place masa harina in a large resealable plastic bag, and squeeze out excess air. Place squash into the bag, and squeeze out excess water. Place squash onto prepared baking sheet, and pat down lightly with hands. Bake 45 to 50 minutes, or until just tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chocolate baking square,pepper sauce,mozzarella cheese,chili flake,ciabatta,walnut,rump roast,ham
title: Lola's Mexican Chocolate Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lean boneless rump roast | 1/2 lb sliced ham | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 ounces chocolate baking squares | 1/2 cup low-fat mozzarella cheese | 2 slices ciabatta | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Cook beef, ham, chili flakes and hot pepper sauce in a small skillet over medium heat until browned, stirring to separate meat. Divide mixture among sandwich rolls, spreading to edges. Top with cheese and place on a foil lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,mini chocolate chip,red chili pepper
title: Simple, Easy Indian Chiles
ingredients: 2 large red chili peppers ( or a hot jalapeno pepper ) | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the chiles by placing stem end through slit and cutting a slit down center, cutting vertically, removing seeds, and cleaning out the veins and any veins. When done, the chiles will be somewhat open, but will retain some of their chunky texture. Rinse the chiles with hot water until thoroughly dry. Put the chiles into the bowl of a blender, add the chipotle puree, and blend until the chipotle is well mixed, adding more puree if necessary. You can add more puree if it's too thick, or more chili powder, depending on your taste. You can also add more chillies at this point. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Kiwi and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 2 kiwi fruits
instructions: Boil water in a large pot. Add the cauliflower florets and kiwifruit. Serve chilled. Variation if serving cold, substitute 1 cup of sugar as suggested in description.

title: Linguine With Cucumber-Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 1 cup beef broth | 3 tablespoons marsala | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom | 1/4 cup thinly sliced english cucumber
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions while making the sauce. Combine broth, marsala, and vanilla in shallow baking dish. Add mushrooms, and stir until coated. Place cooked linguine in centre of four serving plates. Top with cucumber slices, and drizzle with sauce.

title: Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cream with the chipotles and stir until well combined. Cover and refrigerate until service time. To serve, spoon into individual serving bowls, garnish with shaved chipotle.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,tofu,cream cheese,spinach leaf,iceberg lettuce,beef chuck
title: Easy Beef and Tofu Tacos (Veggies)
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu or ( 18 ounce ) package extra firm tofu, drained of liquid and cut into 2 or 3 chunks | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch long strips | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 8 large leaves iceberg lettuce, torn into 1/2 inch strips | 3 packages light sour cream cheese | 10 ounces spinach leaves, rinsed and dried
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking oil. Cut the tofu or extra firm tofu into 1/2 inch cubes and transfer to a resealable plastic bag. Add the chuck and curry powder to the meat and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Heat a large heavy skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Add half the beef and half the meat drippings to the pan. Cook until well browned, being careful not to burn the meat and turning to cook evenly. Transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Return the heat to medium high. Place the remaining beef and accumulated juices in the baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the meat is hot and beginning to crisp. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and shred with two forks. Preheat the broiler to high and place a lettuce leaf in the center of a plate. Top with a piece of beef, followed by two or three spinach leaves. Spoon on a portion of the beef and bean mixture and squeeze over a little cream cheese. Repeat layering until all vegetables have been used and are piled on top of the beef and bean layers in the plate. Repeat layering with the remaining noodles and meat and shredded chicken and top with sour cream and green onion. Garnish with slices of lime and serve hot.

title: Garden Oatmeal Stuffing
ingredients: 3 cups quick cooking oats | 1 1/2 cups broth or 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 jar of sliced pimiento
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Add a few cups of water to the mixture. Put into a greased, large loaf pan and bake 25 minutes at 300°.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,cornstarch,chili flake,chicken bouillon granule,black cumin seed
title: Mexican Chicken in a Hurry
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken pieces | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 cup light pasta sauce
instructions: Combine the cornstarch, bouillon powder and chili flakes and then toss the chicken with the marinade. Set aside 10 minutes. Add pasta to hot pan and heat through, about 2 minutes. Serve over warm, fluffy, plain white rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,bulgur,focaccia bread,zucchini,brandy,spinach leaf,red curry paste
title: Grilled Vegetable and Nut Stew
ingredients: 7 tablespoons dry bulgur | 6 tablespoons brandy or 6 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste | 4 large chicken drumsticks, skinned | 2 zucchini, halved and sliced ( about 8 ounces ) | 2 cups frozen chopped spinach leaves, defrosted | 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat grill, or set broiler to high. Stir bulgur, brandy and curry paste in skillet and heat until warm. Add chicken and cook, turning to brown evenly, about 4 minutes. Remove chicken pieces, leaving cooking liquid in skillet, and set aside. Add zucchini, spinach and half the reserved cooking liquid to skillet and reduce heat slightly. Add remaining cooking liquid and bring to boil scraping up any sticking to the bottom of the skillet, and return chicken pieces. Simmer, covered, 5 minutes, and remove chicken. Arrange bread, overlapped at a slight angle on grill rack, and bake in middle of grill 5 minutes, or until crusty underneath. Transfer bread to plates and serve stew with bread.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,mexican cheese,blue cheese,lemon,tomato juice,cornflour,cannellini bean
title: Baby Finger Food  Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs frozen hash brown potatoes | 2 cans cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese | 2 -3 slices blue cheese | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 tomatoes, diced
instructions: Fry the hash browns in a frying pan and drain off any fat. Set aside and let it cool slightly. Place all ingredients in a saucepan and heat on medium high heat until cheese melts. When potatoes are cold mash the potatoes with the cornflour until combined and creamy. Spray a casserole dish with veggie oil spray and place the layers the potatoes and cheese. Then pour tomato juice over the top and bake in the oven at 200 degrees for 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beer,turmeric powder,tomato juice,cantaloupe,romano cheese,white mushroom,red wine vinegar,whipping cream
title: Meloladene's Melomakaráš
ingredients: 3 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup white mushrooms | 1/4 cup cantaloupe, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup beer ( preferably riesling )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine tomato juice, vinegar, canned tomatoes, mushrooms, cantaloupe, cheese, turmeric and sugar until heated through. Stir in beer and heat to just warm.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,grain rice,white sugar,topping,southern comfort,gouda cheese,large curd cottage cheese,cooking spray
title: Southern Light Gouda Cheese and Rice
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed but not drained | 1 package shredded regular gouda cheese or 1 package shredded emmenthaler cheese | 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons dark southern comfort | 1 can flaky whole-milk greek-style curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a medium baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix the rice and anise seeds.

title: Roasted Tomatoes & Fresno Chiles
ingredients: 3 large seedless grapes ( or 4 medium ) | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 3 serrano chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Remove seeds from chiles. Cut out any stems preventing a milder, hotter tomato sauce. Roast chiles under broiler for 3 - 4 minutes, or until they begin to lightly turn brown and blister. Do not burn remove chiles from heat and let cool. Place chiles in a plastic bag, seal and refrigerate until ready to use. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the crushed tomatoes and chili peppers. Pour the tomato mixture into a shallow medium baking dish and bake, stirring and turning the chiles frequently, for 30 - 40 minutes, or until sauce is bubbling. Serve cool and serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: allspice,fine bread crumb,bamboo shoot,raspberry,tomato paste,bay seasoning,garlic salt,barley
title: BBQ Sweet and Sour Ripe Barley Balls
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked barley ( may use white or brown or whole wheat ) | 1/2 cup fine dry bread crumb | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 - 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon minced garlic salt | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 1/4 cups raspberries, in light syrup or 1 1/4 cups frozen raspberries, in light syrup, and fresh berries, in light syrup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour. Shape into walnut sized balls. Grill or broil until meat is cooked through, and topping is browned and bubbly.

title: Peach Chutney Soup With Mango-Spinach Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups beef stock | 1 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup peach preserves | 1 sprig thai basil, leaves removed
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the beef stock to a boil on high heat. Reduce heat to medium and stir in the mango chutney. Stir occasionally and allow soup to bubble. Pour soup into individual bowl. Top with peach preserves, basil leaves and basil leaves.

title: Prawns With Easy Microwave Directions
ingredients: 450 fine shelled prawns | cooking spray | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Spray a large microwave safe plate with oil. Wash prawns and dry with paper towel. Dip prawns in batter. Let sit for 45 seconds or more. Place in microwavesafe plate, cover and cook on high for 3 to 5 minutes or until prawns turn pink, moist and opaque. Remove and serve hot with vegetable.

title: Fresh Fig Jam
ingredients: 10 fresh figs, diced | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix minced garlic and ginger into diced figs. Let stand to allow flavors to blend, then transfer to a saucepan, and heat to boiling while stirring. Simmer until figs soften slightly, and the jam simmers, about 10 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Green Tea Dump
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 - 1 1/2 drop green food coloring
instructions: Mix soup and food coloring in a 2 pint glass jar. Microwave for 1 minute, stir. Pour into a warm 2 pint glass jar, place lid on jar and shake. Chill for at least one week.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,tart apple,marsala,water chestnut,maple syrup,rice wine vinegar
title: Apple Marsala
ingredients: 2 medium tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 2 small hot banana peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped water chestnuts | 6 tablespoons dry marsala | 1 tablespoon unsweetened maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Place apples in an 8 x 8 x 2 baking dish. Slice banana peppers in 1/2 inch lengthwise until sliced. Combine water chestnuts and marsala in small bowl. Sprinkle over apples. Combine remaining ingredients.

title: Cucumber and Lemons
ingredients: 1 small cucumber - peeled, halved lengthwise, and sliced lengthwise into thin strips | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 3 tablespoons minced onion | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron
instructions: Combine the cucumber strips, soy sauce, onion, ginger, capers, lemon pepper, saffron, and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.

title: Ww 5 Points – Harvest Style Leeks
ingredients: 1 leek, sliced | 1 tablespoon extra light vanilla yogurt | 2 tablespoons hunts tomato sauce | 1 cup cherry or 1 cup strawberry
instructions: Heat grill to high. Line baking sheet with parchment paper or nonstick spray. Add sliced leek. Brush with yogurt. Sprinkle with sauce. Grill, 3 minutes. Flip leeks to the other side. Remove from heat. Cool for 5 minutes. Serve warm or let stand several hours, covered. Garnish with fruit.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,veal,wide egg noodle,baby pea,tomato puree,italian turkey sausage
title: Italian Fusion Suppé
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian turkey sausage | 1 medium cucumber | 20 ounces frozen baby peas | 20 ounces canned italian turkey sausage | 1 can tomato puree | cooked broad egg noodles
instructions: Boil a large pot, add turkey sausage, sausages, vegetables and tomato puree. Stir fry until veggies are well cooked.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,bay leaf,italian tomato,palm sugar,salmon,ranch dip,oregano
title: Mom's Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 smoked salmon | 1 can diced italian tomatoes | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons crumbled dried oregano | 1/3 cup dry ranch dip, < a href= '' https : //www.|geniuskitchen.|com/recipe/ranch-dish-mix-dipping-47939 '' > ranch dish mix dipping < /a > | 1/4 teaspoon smoked palm sugar
instructions: Place salmon in a large bowl. Top with diced tomatoes, celery, bay leaf, oregano and ranch dip plus a little more for sprinkling over if desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,green,iceberg lettuce,monterey jack cheese,cake flour,italian plum tomato,chunky salsa
title: Crispy Southwest Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup prepared chunky salsa | 1 cup thinly sliced monterey jack cheese | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, drained | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 3/4 cup all-purpose cake flour, divided | 6 cups mixed greens | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Whisk first 3 ingredients in medium bowl to blend. Stir in flour until dough can be molded into an 8 x10 inch rectangle on a lightly floured board. Cut dough into 6 wedges, keeping each wedge slightly larger than the bun top. Spoon 1 tablespoon salsa into each wedge, dividing evenly. Fold opposite edges of each wedge of green beans over salsa. Seal well with a fork. Arrange in a single layer in ungreased 10 inch skillet. Cook, covered, 10 minutes. Uncover, raise heat to medium, and cook until bottom is golden, pressing gently with a metal spatula to flatten and brown beans, about 10 minutes. Place lettuce leaves on a large platter, spoon cooked beans over. Serve beans, garnished with chopped fresh Italian plum tomatoes, if desired.

title: Quick Chunky Onion Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup yellow mustard
instructions: Cook and stir enchilada sauce in an old fashioned glass with a tight lid over medium heat in a medium saucepan until heated through, about 5 minutes. Pour sauce over prepared bread cubes to coat. Serve hot with the crouton on the side.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,turmeric,cream cheese,margarine,hard egg,grain rice,pesto sauce,coriander
title: Stuffed Irish Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 8 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice, cooked | 3 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 2 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 cup guinness stout
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease four 6'' shallow 2'' ovenproof dishes with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the margarine. Crack open hard boiled eggs and carefully remove the yolks. Place half the egg yolks in each of the dishes. Combine coriander and turmeric with rice and then mix in cream cheese. Divide the mixture evenly between the eggs. Mix together the coriander and pesto sauce with remaining 1/2 tablespoon margarine and pour over eggs. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until just set. Meanwhile, place guinness in a small saucepan and heat gently for about 3 minutes. Stir in remaining coriander. Serve immediately.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream (French 77)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons almond meal | 1 cup almond meal | 1/2 cup peach schnapps | fresh peaches or peach jam
instructions: Combine almond meal and schnapps to form a well and then add the peaches or peach jam. Press into a freezer film lined 20 x 30cm slice tin. Freeze over ice cream and freeze overnight. To serve remove and allow to thaw in fridge as much as 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Mushroom Cheese Ball
ingredients: 10 whole button mushrooms | 1/2 cup pitted dates | 1/4 cup lime wedge | 1 cup flour | 2 1/2 cups ice water | guacamole, for garnish
instructions: Cut cleaned mushrooms in half. Drain the stems and discard. Mushrooms in a cheese cloth bag squeeze out the water that leaks out of mushrooms with your hands. Cut the caps in half if using whole mushrooms. Place the mushrooms in a food processor and pulse until it is fine breadcrumbs. You need some saltiness for salt to your taste. Take mushrooms out of food processor and squeeze out excess water using your hands or a spoon until it is a fine crumb like texture. Add dates, lime wedge, salt and flour and pulse to mix. Add water in tablespoon quantities until you measure 1 cup of liquid and set aside. Form mushroom mixture into ball and flatten out to about 1/8 inch thickness. Make sure you leave enough space for your balls to expand. Take out 1 ball then repeat with remaining balls. Place on a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. When ready to serve top with guacamole. Some folks like it with sour cream or chopped fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,chicken meat,mango chutney,beef chuck,chicken wing,pearl onion
title: The Best Chicken Wing Casserole
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 pound chicken wings, separated from tips | 8 ounces mango chutney, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 container sour cream, divided | 16 ounces ground beef chuck | 1 jar pearl onions, drained and chopped
instructions: Place chuck and wings in a slow cooker. Pour chutney around chicken and beef, and stir in 1/2 cup sour cream and beef and onion. Set slow cooker to high setting, and cook for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Stir in mushrooms, and continue cooking for 15 more minutes. To make meat sauce, thicken with cornstarch mixed with 1/2 cup sour cream.

title: French Beans With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 lb navy beans, soaked overnight - cooked | 4 cups heavy cream or 4 cups yogurt | 1/2 cup thick yogurt or 1/2 cup yogurt, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f put beans in a casserole dish or roasting pan with deep sides. Place in oven and bake 1 hour. Remove from oven and let stand, covered, for 1 hour. Turn into serving dish and drizzle with 1/2 cup yogurt and 3/4 cup cream. Add remaining yogurt or cream, if desired.

title: Shredded Green Cabbage
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced green cabbage | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 small head garlic, peeled and sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cabbage, vinegar, and garlic. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 3 days. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,cilantro,green olive,green tomato,bacon dripping
title: Garden Green Tomato Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1/2 yellow cake mix | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1/2 green tomato, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped green olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Grease and flour a loaf pan. In a medium bowl, mix together the yellow cake mix with 3 tablespoons of bacon drippings. Spread in the prepared pan. Arrange tomato slices over the mixture. Scatter the green olives around the edge of the cake, if using. Pour the remaining bacon drippings over the green tomatoes. Bake in the preheated oven for 65 to 70 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then serve.

title: Veal Choclate
ingredients: 225g ground veal or 225g ground veal | 175 g fresh crushed mace cookies | 25 -35 miniature marshmallows | 4 large red chiles | 6 very ripe hass avocadoes
instructions: Grind the mace cookies and marshmallows, and mince the chillies. Beat the avocados in a bowl. Mix together with all the above. If you find it is too liquid, you can put a little more mixture in the bowl. You can even roll into large balls from a rolling pin. Cut the meat into squares or diamonds then wrap each half in aluminium foil. Place into the fridge for a couple of hours or overnight. When ready to eat take a piece out of the package then put the meat through a meat grinder. This is just the process, no kneading involved. You can also do it in batches, rolling out the meat a little at a time, and pushing down into the mace cookies or mince. You can also roll them in flour to seal, or you can wrap them in extra flour and freeze them before freezing. When ready to serve they should look a little puffy and a little golden in the middle. Place the meat balls into a baking dish, cover with aluminium foil and return to the fridge for about 2 hours. These will last several weeks or several months.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,idaho potato,cream tartar,vegetable oil cooking spray,cauliflower
title: Vegetable Chips (With Hint of Idaho and Cauliflower)
ingredients: cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 idaho potato, cut into chunks | vegetable oil cooking spray | sour cream or dairy sour cream | cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray a baking sheet with vegetable oil cooking spray. In a large bowl, mash the potato chunks to get smooth with a potato masher. Coat the vegetables with the sour cream. Place the potato chips on to the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with desired amount of cilantro.

title: Japanese Sweet Potato Sushi
ingredients: 5 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking potatoes, japanese sweet potato | 4 large green peppers, cut into julienne strips
instructions: Preheat oven 425°f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Place sweet potato julienne strips into a medium bowl and mix with vinegar. Divide potato mixture into 4 even portions, placing one portion on the short edge of a palm full of the sweet potato mixture. Roll up like a jelly roll. Repeat with remaining potato mixture and sweet potato mixture. Place the wrapped roll with the green peppers and sweet potato mixture on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, until hot and lightly browned around the edges.

Random Ingredients: red jalapeno chile,paprika,pasta,orange juice,feta,green cabbage,mace,cocoa powder
title: Chile-Feta Pasta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces chinese chinese baby cabbage ( about 1 medium head ) | 3 cans red jalapeno chiles | 8 ounces feta, crumbled | 4 teaspoons mild paprika | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 7 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground red jalapeno chile ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and toss to combine. Serve warm.

title: Fiesta Pizza Dough
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant yeast ( one package ) | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce
instructions: Sift 2 tablespoons yeast in mixing bowl. Add 1 1/4 cup taco sauce and mix lightly. Let stand 5 minutes. Add 1 1/2 cups more taco sauce. Mix well. Grease cookie sheet. Stir into remaining yeast. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Divide in 15 equal portions. Form each into ball. Flatten each ball into a 6 inch circle. Place on oiled cookie sheet. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake in 450 degree oven 10 minutes or until top of crust is light brown.

title: Chunky Mexican Pepper Rings
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, seeded or 3 -4 green bell peppers | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 eggs
instructions: Thaw off the peppers. Cut bell pepper lengthwise into 1/4 inch strips. Dip strips into the eggs. Mix flour and egg in a small bowl, stir together. Put peppers into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish. Sprinkle with the flour mixture, pressing with fingers. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,kiwi,green serrano chilies,shiitake mushroom,lamb,white onion
title: Lamb and Kiwi in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup sliced white onion | 6 -8 shiitake mushrooms | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 chopped green serrano chilies | 2 kiwi, peeled and smashed
instructions: Spray skillet or frypan with pam and saute the sliced onions and mushrooms over medium heat until golden brown and soft. While vegetables are cooking, brown the mince under broiler. When browned, add soup, chiles and kiwifruit to skillet and simmer 10 - 15 minutes to blend flavors. Serve over white rice with salsa and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,chili,jicama,baking powder,mozzarella cheese,chicken thigh,italian spice,irish cream
title: Skinny Mexican Chicken Bake
ingredients: 2 baking sheets | 2 lbs chicken thighs | 1 head jicama, diced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 ounce dried chili | 1/4 cup light italian spices | 1/2 cup light monterey jack pepper cheese, grated, divided | 4 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese ( approx ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. In a medium mixing bowl, mix chicken, jicama, chili, italian seasonings and 1 cup of the cheese until well combined. Spread mixture into the pan and top with remaining 1/4 cup of the cheese. Bake in middle of oven 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of the cheese and bake 5 minutes longer until cheese is melted.

title: Pecan Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | stuffing ( for dredging ) | peeled pecans | soy sauce ( for dipping )
instructions: In a zip seal plastic bag with the salt/pepper. Add chicken breasts to bag and gently toss to coat. Heat large nonstick skillet. Place in a 375 degree oven for 5 to 8 minutes or till just cooked through. Remove from skillet. Spray in nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and lightly toast pecans. Add pecans to chicken breasts and toss to coat. Serve with soy sauce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,blueberry,self rising flour,italian seasoning,scotch bonnet pepper,caraway seed,chicken bouillon cube,sirloin steak
title: Baked Haitian Beef with Blueberry
ingredients: 2 boneless sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons poppy seed | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 8 cups self-rising flour ( approximate, can use whole wheat if preferred.|.|.| i hadn't tried flour ) | 1/4 cup steel cut oats ( approximate, can also use 1 cup of flour ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot italian brot bonnet pepper ( optional ) | 1 bouillon cube ( i used knorr )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375'f. Slice beef into 1/2 thick half moons, then coat with italian seasoning. Place in greased casserole dish. Combine oats, italian seasoning, poppy seeds and caraway seeds.

title: Lamb Liver (Lebanese)
ingredients: 4 slices lamb, cut 1-inch thick | 8 eggs | 1 teaspoon cognac | 2 fresh green chilies, chopped
instructions: Beat eggs well. Dredge each piece of lamb in egg, and fry in hot oil until golden brown on all sides. Remove and drain on paper towels. Add cognac to pan drippings.

title: Gramma's Rice with Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons uncooked long-grain rice, divided | 13 fluid ounces heavy cream ( divided )
instructions: Wash rice and leave it in the water to soften. Place half of the rice in a blender and process to a fine puree. Add remaining 10 fl oz of cream and blend to make a stiff consistency. Place rice in an 8 inch square pan and spread some cream over the rice. Dot with remaining butter. Spread with rest of cream. Cover, bring to a simmer in an oven set at 300 f degrees. Cook 18 to 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Remove from oven, remove from pan and let stand until cream is warm. Spread leftover cream on top and serve with additional cream and sprinkled with more of the rice.

title: Scotch Scallops
ingredients: 1 pound sea scallops, thickly sliced | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 stalks celery, chopped
instructions: Lay the scallop scallop shells on a rimmed baking sheet. Place a few tomato halves on top of each shell so the scallops will be completely submerged. Sprinkle celery over them and season with sea salt. Bake in preheated 450 degrees f oven for 10 minutes. Turn the scallops, and continue baking until the scallops turn bright red and the cherry tomatoes turn to mush, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Moroccan Baked Hazelnuts, Oranges, and Turmeric

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in a food processor, combine hazelnuts and turmeric. Puree. In a large bowl, carefully pout orange segments, separating segments with a fork, so as to give a rough texture. Add hazelnut mixture, to taste, and toss to evenly coat everything. Bake in a shallow, glass, or ceramic baking dish, until lightly browned, 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Mushroom Bread
ingredients: 4 cups cooked and shredded mushrooms | 1/3 cup peanut butter, softened | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the butter, baking soda and mushrooms in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,shiitake mushroom,kalamata olive,orange juice concentrate,flour,ranch dressing mix,cumin

ingredients: 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice concentrate ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed orange juice ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup kalamata olive ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushroom ( stemmed sliced ) | 1/2 teaspoon black ground mustard seeds ( toasted )
instructions: Preparation, mix together ranch and orange juice concentrate, orange juice, and cumin. Spread in an 11 cup pie plate or an 8 inch pie plate. Cover with sliced mushrooms and sprinkle the top with mustard seeds. Bake at 400of for 20 minutes or until lightly browned and hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,milk,ziti pasta,mango,ginger paste,taco seasoning mix,sharp cheddar cheese,tip steak
title: Mango Kebabs With Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 4 tablespoons minced mangoes ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 lb ground round round | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. In large bowl, stir together bread crumbs and milk until well blended. With fork, poke holes all over beef. Add ginger paste and ground ginger to bread crumb mixture, stirring until combined. Add mango and mix until thoroughly coated meat with ginger paste. Cut meat into thin 2 to 3 inch long slices, discarding any fat or excess fat. Add meat to bread crumb mixture and mix well. Place kababs on grill and discard any excess meat and milk mixture. Let meat rest 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook ziti according to package directions and set aside. Remove foil from kababs and spray pan lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Spray kababs with nonstick cooking spray. Place platter on grill and cook on each side until cheese is melted and ziti is warmed through.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,red onion,salt pepper,pork,dark brown sugar,strawberry,wine vinegar,semolina flour
title: Sweet & Savoury Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina flour | 1/4 lb ground lean pork | 3/4 red onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh strawberries | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons seasoned salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons mango chutney
instructions: Mix the semolina flour and ground pork with your hands for a couple of minutes. Add chopped onion, fresh strawberries and chutney. Mix well. Chill in the fridge or leave overnight.

title: Korean-Spiced Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks ( about 1-inch thick ) | 2 teaspoons ground allspice berries
instructions: Combine beef with allspice berries. Let stand at room temperature 1 - 2 days, stirring or re mixing several times. Heat electric grill to high. Cook for 3 minutes. Remove steaks.

title: Beef With Yogurt (Tiroka
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 4 ounces pineapples | 1 teaspoon hungarian sweet paprika | 1 pint plain yogurt
instructions: Cut sirloin into thin slices. Boil sirloin slices and drain. In separate bowl mix yogurt with paprika. Marinade beef with yogurt mixture. Serve on a bed of rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: brand rice,parsley,beef tenderloin steak,gruyere cheese,chicken bouillon cube
title: Quick and Easy Swiss Steak
ingredients: 4 slices gruyere cheese | 4 slices beef tenderloin steaks | 1/2 cup brand rice | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup parsley
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat. Brush both sides of steaks with the brand rice and place them on the grill. Close lid and grill for 7 - 10 minutes on each side, depending on the thickness of the steaks. To serve, place steaks on a serving platter and sprinkle each with a small amount of the parsley.

title: Veal and Cashews With Chipotle
ingredients: 350 g baby carrots | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 250 g veal, minced | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 2 teaspoons chipotle peppers ( canned ), minced
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, cook the carrots for 7 minutes. Drain and peel. Combine with remaining ingredients in a large bowl then toss well. Cover tightly and set aside in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight. Remove the carrots from the water, stir well then leave for 2 minutes. To serve, spoon a mound of the veg mixture onto a warmed serving plate and top with a spoonful of chipotle.

title: Lazy-Southern Corn on the Cob, by Jerry Hines
ingredients: 2 -4 corn cobs, cut from cob | 1 lb lean ground meat | 12 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 garlic clove, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Pierce the corn with a fork. Grill, basting with juices until evenly golden brown. Remove corn from gas and cool to room temperature. Remove some of the husk and as much as possible from the cob using a knife. Cut off the corn, leaving about half inch of kernels. Set kernels aside so you have four kernels. Wrap a strip over the outside of a large dinner plate, then set aside. In a skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Drain of any excess drippings, crumble and set aside. Sauté the garlic and celery seeds in bacon fat until just beginning to soften. Stir in meat and fry until evenly browned. Drain of any excess grease. Remove and slice corn kernels from cob using a fork. Place the meat in a bowl and mash until mixture is smooth. Add the corn kernels and the sour cream. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hominy,plain flour,chicken breast,purpose flour,thyme honey,stew meat
title: Chicken and Hominy Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, diced into cubes | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 4 tablespoons fresh thyme honey | 8 cups chicken stock or 8 cups water, divided | 1 cup hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 cup plain flour
instructions: Place flour and thyme in casserole, or dutch oven. Add stew meat and mix well. Add 2 cups of the water along with the honey and stir to form soup. Bring to boil on high heat, then immediately turn to lowest setting, cover and simmer at lowest setting for approximately 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Check liquid in 15 minutes, and add more if necessary, about 1/2 cup at a time. Add rest of the water and simmer on low setting for another 15 minutes. Place rinsed hominy in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Let sit for 15 - 20 minutes. Drain hominy. Place flour in a food processor with a few tablespoons of water and process until fine. Place rinsed hominy in another large bowl. Add flour mixture to rinsed hominy and stir until just combined. Add the rest of the water and mix gently to spread the flour flour paste on all sides of the chicken and stew. Preheat oven for 425°. Bake for approximately 45 - 50 minutes, until the gravy is thick and bubbly.

title: Walnut and Cheese Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1 tablespoon minced white onion | cooking spray | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread walnut butter onto one side of a large piece of aluminum foil and lightly sprinkle minced white onion on top. Layer chopped walnuts over mixture and cover with cheese. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is golden brown and mixture has a crumbly texture and lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,almond,pinto bean,chicken rice soup,grape,wasabi paste
title: Noodle-Free Wasabi Poached Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons wasabi paste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup diced seedless grapes ( optional ) | 1 small cubed cooked chicken-rice soup, to serve | 2 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds, for garnish
instructions: Place the beans in a bowl, pour boiling water over them, cover and chill. Drain the liquid from the pinto beans, reserving it, if desired, in another bowl. Add the wasabi to the reserved liquid and blend until smooth. Add the swiss cheese and grapes to the bean mixture and stir. Add the pinto bean mixture and chicken rice soup to the bowl with the beans, using the whisked wasabi mixture to get the soup to mix with the soup. Mix until everything is evenly coated. Garnish with sliced almonds.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cayenne pepper,yellow onion,cooking oat,grand marnier

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Roll 1 large tablespoon onto a greased baking sheet in biscuit size circular portions.

title: Simple Microwave Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 1/2 cups rice | 1 teaspoon instant rice ( i used jasmine jasmine )
instructions: Microwave rice according to directions. While rice is still on, add chicken bouillon and instant rice & mix well. Add water as needed to cover all rice.

title: Soy Chai Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 -3 tablespoons dried cranberries ( more or less to taste ) | grated nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Place everything in a blender & blend until it turns into a smooth paste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,farfalle pasta,fruit,quinoa,red chilies,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chocolate curl
title: Spinach and Quinoa Salad With Chocolate curls
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, uncooked | 1 cup white wine vinegar, distilled | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly shaved | 4 dried red chilies | 1 bunch mixed fruit | 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) or 12 ounces penne pasta | chocolate curls, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring 3 cups water to boil in large saucepan. Stir in quinoa and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, for 9 minutes or until quinoa reaches desired doneness. Drain and cool slightly. Combine quinoa and 1 cup water in medium bowl. Stir in vinegar and cheese. Chop chilies and add to quinoa mixture. Toss lightly to coat. Bring salad to room temperature and cover and chill, covered, about 2 hours. Remove lid and refrigerate salad. Cut chilled vegetables into thin strips. Add to quinoa mixture and toss gently to coat. Serve with chocolate curls.

title: Sauce for Roasted Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 medium yellow squash | 1 cup catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Place skin side down onto baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, then remove. Combine catsup and squash. Drizzle over squash mixture. Roast for 25 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Peach Stuffed With Feta
ingredients: 2 fresh ripe peaches, peeled and pitted | 2 -3 tablespoons feta cheese ( or use greek cheese )
instructions: Cut each peach in half and scoop out the stones. Set your peaches in the ice bath, just until soft. Place a small plate or bowl under the skin of each peach half, then stuff inside the pit with 2 tablespoon or more of the feta cheese, leaving a little of the skin. Place the peach halves in a casserole dish, and then add about 3 tablespoons of water to cover the peach halves. Cover tightly, and bake about 35 minutes. Remove from oven, carefully serve, and enjoy.

title: Homemade Grated Cheese (Cheese Patties)
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs of fresh breadcrumbs, about 1 1/2 pounds ( not dry ) | 3 lbs grated cheese ( the best possible flavor of your choice )
instructions: Knead together the cheese and bread crumbs. Roll into balls approximately the size of a golf ball. Cut into 8 smaller pieces of varying size. Prick each ball several times with a fork. Spray a griddle with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium heat. Toast each cheese patty first. Toast each patty about 5 - 6 minutes. Don't be scared if they stick together. To allow proper drainage of excess moisture, they need to be soaked up by the cheese. When you take one out and you can see the cheese mixture drain off excess water by putting the cheese mixture in a sieve and straining it or you can just eat it right back where it's done.

title: Vegetable-Beef-Orzo-Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 50 wonton skins | 100 1 cup orzo pasta or 100 1 cup any other small pasta | 1 cup uncooked bok choy ( about 1/4 lb, i use about 2 small bunches, but small bunches work just fine ) or 1 cup chopped broccoli stem ( about 1/4 lb, i use about 2 small bunches, but small bunches work just fine ) | 8 -10 bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: In large pot or steamer over high heat, cook orzo until tender but firm through, about 5 minutes, or according to package directions. Drain and cool slightly. While waiting for the pasta, in large bowl, mix orzo with bok choy, bean sprouts and sliced bamboo shoots. Let cool to room temperature before using.

title: Easy Pesto Burritos

instructions: Heat coconut milk in microwave on high until warm, about one minute. Place about 2 or 3 warmed burritos in a serving bowl.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a glass bowl and serve.

title: Basic Chinese Fried Steak

instructions: In bowl, combine dark soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and canola oil to make the marinade. Refrigerate unused portion of marinade for a few days.

title:
French Onion Seasoning Mix.

title: Mango Chutney Stuffed Artichoke Bottoms

instructions: Dry roast saffron over low heat in your electric skillet or grill until evenly golden, about 2 - 3 mins do not burn. instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas 5, or until chicken thighs are completely flattened. Sprinkle chicken lightly with flour. instructions: Coat a 1 1/2 quart casserole or baking dish with cooking spray. Fill the noodles with sauce, and layer with mushroom slices. Refrigerate, covered, 8 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Pepper Mix

instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Store in a air tight jar.

title: Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 2 cups snow peas, trimmed | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 can sliced olives, drained | 1 package seitan, crumbled
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add snow peas and cook for 1 minute. Drain. Combine flour with the olive juice in a resealable bag. Place the snow peas into the flour mixture. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the mixture for topping. Place the other 1 tablespoon of dough into a plastic bag with the vegetable mixture. Pipe mixture into 8 paper muffin cups. Sprinkle top with reserved crumbled mixture. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat with cooking spray and place 1 cup of snow peas in the pan. Cook, turning occasionally, for about 5 minutes, or until puffy.

title: Paleo Muffins
ingredients: 4 ounces self raising flour | jalapeno, seeds and other spices to use ( optional )
instructions: Grease and line 12 muffin tins and preheat oven to gas mark 8.

title: Italian Sausage and Rice

instructions: Brown sausage in heavy skillet. Crumble into skillet. Add rice and golden syrup. Simmer, covered, over low heat about 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Cheesy Baked Pork and Swiss Tacos
ingredients: 8 pork sausage links, thinly sliced ( i use johnsonville brand ) | 4 -6 romaine lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup freshly grated manchego cheese ( about 3 ounces ) or 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese ( about 3 ounces ) | 8 slices swiss cheese ( about 3/4-inch slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Arrange sausage in a lightly greased rimmed baking dish.

title: Rigatoni With Beef or Pork with Fenugreek Gravy

instructions: Prepare fenugreek rub combine the dry fenugreek seeds, 2 tablespoons olive oil and the 2 beef cubes in a mixing bowl. Mix well and set aside. title: Irish Red Onion Jelly
