instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in 3 tbsp of water and let stand until the water is completely set. Heat and stir a few drops of cream of tartar in the gelatin. Add the onion and stir. Let sit for 5 minutes. Add the sour cream and mix. Chill for several hours or overnight. Stir before serving.

title: Sailor's Day Apricot Chicken Legs
ingredients: 16 chicken legs or 16 chicken thighs | 1/4 cup dark dried apricot | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon orange flower water | 1 fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Remove pits from apricots and put in a colander. Sift them under running water to get rid of salt and black spots. Mix in cocoa and orange flower water and leave to soak for 1/2 hour. Bake for 45 minutes then stir and watch them. If they are dry, take them out 5 - 10 minutes before removing from the oven. Remove any extra sauce that has developed over an open flame. Use a fork or chopsticks to pull skins off. Strain to make a smooth sauce and serve with chicken pieces. Note, the original recipe listed 8 pieces, which would give you 8 servings.

title: Baked Sautéed Roma Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 pints roma tomatoes, quartered | 2 dried red chile peppers, seeded | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a baking paper lined tray. Sprinkle with a little salt, sprinkle over the chile peppers and the sage, cover with more oil and bake in a preheated oven for 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Baked Sausages With Port Wine and Cabbage or Carrots
ingredients: 1 -2 medium cabbage or 1 -2 large savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning ( or less ) | 1 teaspoon sage leaf | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup other medium-dry white wine
instructions: Core cabbage, cutting off tough stem pieces, removing the center core. Separate cabbage leaves, keeping the loose leaves attached to the body. Slice the cabbage crosswise into thin strips and wash thoroughly in a colander. Combine creole seasoning, sage, and garlic in 2 - ½ tablespoons cold water and blend well. Rub mixture evenly evenly over the sausages. In a large dutch oven, arrange cabbage half submerged in the water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to moderately low. Cover and cook, stirring, until cabbage is tender when pierced with a fork, about 25 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer cabbage to a serving dish. Discard any remaining liquid. Cover and let rest 10 minutes, then serve at once.

title: Honey Glaze for Chicken

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Cover and simmer on low heat. Simmer for about 1/2 an hour, stirring occasionally. Cool before using.

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large nonstick frypan over medium heat. Add the pork and cook, turning to brown all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove the pork to a plate. Return the pork and shrimp to the pan and heat until heated through. To serve, arrange the mushrooms over a large serving platter. Sprinkle with the rice and pour the pork mixture over the mushrooms.

instructions: In a small dish, toss together the sesame seeds, mushroom meat sauce, vinegar, cheese, garlic, chili flakes, herbs and vanilla.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°. In a small mixing bowl stir together the marinade ingredients and set aside. Place a large oven proof skillet over medium high heat for 20 minutes. Remove the onions from the skillet and set aside and keep warm. In a large mixing bowl stir together the cheese and spinach. Place the meat on a large serving platter. Place spinach back in the skillet. Serve the meat and vegetables over the meat. Drizzle with any accumulated juices from the platter.

title: Persian Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled and cut into thin long slices | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Cut cucumber into 1/4 inch pieces. Pour a little olive oil into a colander.

ingredients: 1 lb vegetarian baked beans | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 10 tablespoons currants | 1/3 - 1/2 1/3-1/3-1/2 cup dried currant | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon fresh minced flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Prepare vegetables however you wish. These are not necessarily to be used but can be prepped several hours ahead of time. Pour beans into an 8 x 8 baking dish. Pulse to chop as you go, stopping occasionally to scrape down the bowl from time to time. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 20 minutes or until warm throughout, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.

title: Blue Cheese Tomatillo and Tomatillo Salad (Tomatillo, Tomatillo, Bleu)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh tomatillos | kosher salt, to taste | 4 -6 ounces bleu cheese ( more or less )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400º. Slice the tomatillos in half lengthwise, and remove the husks and stems. Slice them crosswise, and set aside. Slice the tomatillos across in a thin, crosswise, piece about ¼ centimeter thick. Place them in another bowl, add salt to taste. Place a platter or dish on your work surface. Dry the tomatillos on your work surface. Remove the soft, flat tops with your fingers, and remove any hard center bits of skin.

title: Piquant Eggs (Antigua and Barbuda Antigua)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red peppers, finely ground | 1 hard-boiled egg, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the pepper and egg together and form the mixture into small balls.

title: Cucumber-Avocado Salsa

instructions: Place the cucumbers in a colander and sprinkle with celery salt and italian style seasoning. Let stand 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess liquid. Stir into the cucumber mixture. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes. To serve, place in bowls and sprinkle with avocado.

title: Pork and Caramelized Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 6 large onions, halved and thinly sliced | 6 paddy oil or 6 porterhouse pork fillets | 1 1/2 cups french-style grand marnier, plus extra for serving
instructions: In a large saucepan set over medium high heat, add 2 tbsp oil and onions. Cook, stirring frequently for 10 minutes, or until onions soften. Reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer until onions are soft, approximately 25 minutes. Add grand marnier. Simmer until liquid is reduced slightly and soup has thickened slightly, approximately 20 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper. Add pork, cover and leave for 5 minutes. Serve in soup bowls with plenty of gravy.

instructions: Drain chickpeas saving liquid. Transfer drained chickpeas to medium bowl and add remaining ingredients and mix well. Season with sea salt and pepper. Let flavors meld for about an hour at room temperature, stir again. Serve in bowls immediately for best results.

title: Salsa Crust Beef over Steak and Pasta

Arrange the stuffed chilies on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 350°f for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Indian Cheese Salad

instructions: Stir cheese, bay leaves, vinegar, and masala together in a bowl. Gently stir in the cheese mixture.

ingredients: 2 thick pork cutlets | 8 slices salami | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 8 flour tortillas, warmed | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes | 1/4 cup shredded mixed pecorino romano-reggiano cheese blend | 1 dash aromatic bitters, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat a heavy pan or large skillet over moderately high heat until very hot. Sprinkle both sides of the pork with salt. Add to hot pan.

title: Chile Roasted Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsweetened chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1 jalapeno, roasted, diced | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small saucepan over medium high heat, combine chocolate, chile paste, jalapeno, lemon juice and liquid smoke. Bring to a simmer and cook until chocolate has fully melted, 7 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in pepper to taste. Spread onto a sheet of parchment paper and spread to 1/3 of up the sides of a glass baking dish or other 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Cover and chill until completely set, at least 2 hours and up to 2 days. Cut into thin slices.

title: Classic Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs top sirloin steaks or 4 lbs top round steaks | lemon wedge, for garnish | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a rimmed roasting pan or other shallow heavy duty foilproof baking pan with a double layer of paper towels or wax paper and spray generously with cooking oil. Using a meat tenderizing hammer, pound out the thickness of your steaks to a thickness of about 1/4 to 1/2 inches. Using a sharp knife, poke several deep holes in the top of each steak to allow the juices to penetrate. Place the steaks onto the prepared pan. Coat lightly with oil and rub in the blackened surface. Broil, covered, about 4 minutes. Turn the steaks over and broil 6 to 8 minutes more. Brush with more oil and broil 6 to 8 minutes more or until a thermometer reads 145 degrees f to 150 degrees f for medium rare or 145 degrees f to well done. Turn steaks over and broil 2 minutes longer. Transfer to a cutting board. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing diagonally. Serve garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 lbs swiss cheese, at room temp | 1/4 cup dry port wine ( dry white wine )
instructions:
Cut cheese into four small sticks about 4 long by 2 wide and 1/2 in wide. Insert sticks into a hot fry pan of the right temperature, and heat over high heat until cheese starts to brown, but not hard. Add port and continue to cook until wine is almost all evaporated, then remove from heat. Place in a small freezer bag. Freeze until solid, about 3 1/2 hours. 
    -. To serve, remove from freezer at least 1 hour before using. Transfer to a large bowl and serve immediately.

title: Tossed Pork-Chicken on Fritters (Filipino Sandwich Cookies)
ingredients: 1 yellow onion | corn tortilla | soya oil | 3 slices white bread
instructions: Slice the onion thinly. Soak sliced onion in salt water for 15 minutes and drain. Slice the bread into two equal sized triangles. Heat an iron skillet and dry fry the bread. Spread the fried bread evenly with soya oil. Put the fried bread onto a hot skillet. Turn over the bread and brown the other side. Slice the fried bread into two equal sized triangles. Slice the onion thickly. Soak the bread triangles in salt water for two minutes and drain. Serve the slices of bread with sliced onion and fried onions, along with some fried onions as a dipping sauce.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line a loaf tin with foil or baking paper and spray lightly with oil. Place the bread on a baking tray and toast under the grill. Pour the tomato puree into a food processor and process until smooth. Add the worcestershire sauce and coriander powder to the tomato paste and mix well. Pour into a dish and scatter over the soaked bread.

title: Mcdonald Family Cheese Rice and Lemon

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat a 4 to 5 quart deep skillet over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Cook cheese until beginning to brown, breaking into small pieces with a wooden spoon. Drain excess fat if desired. Reduce heat to medium.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Slice apples in half horizontally. Place apples on baking sheet, cut sides up. Roast 5 minutes in oven, or until golden. Place apples on wire rack to cool. Place peppercorns in small bowl.

title: Grill Glazed Linguine with Turkey and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beer | 1 can chopped smoked turkey | 1 package linguine | 3/4 cup pine nuts | 1 cup diced, cooked turkey
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together beer, turkey, and linguine. Place linguine in a large dutch oven or other large soup pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until the pasta is cooked about 11 minutes. Drain.

title: Blueberry Salad II
ingredients: 2 packages frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 3 tablespoons dried minced onion flakes | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup bourbon
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine blueberries, onion flakes, dried onion flakes, garlic, mint leaves, irish whiskey, and horseradish. Let sit at room temperature for 2 hours to allow flavors to intensify, but do not allow to cool. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

title: Roasted Eggplant With Croutons
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced lengthwise 1/2-inch thick | 8 slices bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/8 thick slices. Toss the slices in a large bowl. Mix bread crumbs, 1/2 teaspoons salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in a small bowl. Dip eggplant slices in crumb mixture and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake about 15 minutes or until golden.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a bowl with 2 tablespoons water, combine squash, cornmeal, flour, bell peppers and garlic.

title: Beef and Rice Bowls With Sushi (Kyuuri)
ingredients: 1/4 lb beef brisket ( thinly sliced ) | 1/4 lb spaghetti ( broken into 1/2 in wide pieces ) | 2 2 tablespoons ku kyuuri rice wine or 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 cup coriander leaves ( i used whole ) | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika ( or a mixture of sweet paprika and chilies ) | 3 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2/3 cup unsweetened shredded coconut | 4 dill pickles ( or other pickle garnish )
instructions: Combine meat, spaghetti, half of the kuuri rice wine and coriander in a large bowl. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours or overnight. Toss with remaining kuuri sauce. Arrange on a platter. Garnish with pickles and remaining coriander.

instructions: Trim the excess fat off the lamb shanks, if necessary. Place the shanks in a large bowl and add the cherries and remaining ingredients. Serve hot with cooked vegetables.

title: Mochi Con Leche (Cheese in Red)
ingredients: 12 ounces grated monterey jack cheese or 12 ounces gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup hot coffee
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Enjoy.

title: Cocktail
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta, cooked per package directions | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 ounce stilton cheese, crumbled or 1 oz blue cheese
instructions: Rinse the pasta and drain. Meanwhile, mix together the lime zest and juice, cheese, and seasoning and set aside. Drain the pasta and stir. Note, it should be thick and dry. Stir in the lime zest and lime juice mixture. Transfer to a pretty platter and sprinkle on the grated cheese.

title: Chinese Sticky Rice Ball
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thigh | 2 cups glutinous-rice flour ( japanese rice flour ) | 1/3 cup water | 1 can turnip, grated | 1/2 cup catsup ( chinese red hot pepper sauce )
instructions: Cut the chicken thigh into small pieces. Dip the chicken in the rice flour then arrange on a greased platter so the flattened coating runs under the chicken. Spoon the turnip and any accumulated juices out onto the chicken and roll tightly. Arrange a piece of wax paper over the chicken to prevent drying. Wrap the wax paper around the chicken and refrigerate. In a mixing bowl, add the water, rice flour and catsup and beat well until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Dip a wooden speculan or other flat object in the water and roll the meat in the batter until completely coated. Place meat in the warm skillet and cook until golden brown. Use slotted spatula and serve with hot chinese vegetables.

title: Pesto Alfredo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard | 2 cups freshly grated lobster meat | 1 jar good alfredo sauce | 3 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for a couple of hours.

title: Sweet Potatoes Pasta With Orange Peel (Zwt 3)
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs potatoes flour or 3 1/4 lbs unbleached all purpose flour | 2 large oranges, zested and juiced | 1 vanilla pod | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Prepare 1 big bowl of pasta water by placing it in the 3 1/4 quart bowl of your electric mixer along with the salt and water. Dump in the pasta to boil and when it comes to a boil, add the farfalle and let it boil for another 5 minutes drain the pasta and put it back in the water. Mix the vanilla, zest, orange juice, and vanilla pods in together and pour it into the bowl with the flour. Mix the ingredients together with a wire whisk or your hands until it forms a soft dough. Turn it out onto a greased or floured surface and knead it for about five minutes or until the dough starts to form a ball. If the dough is too sticky, add more cooking water. Once the dough comes together into the shape of a large walnut form, divide it into about 1/2 inch balls and place on greased paper to rest for an hour. On a floured board roll the dough out to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 1 inch slices. Put a circle on your hand, moisten the surface a little with a bit of the pasta water, squeeze out as much water as possible, and spread about 3 tablespoons of the orange/nut mixture onto it. Turn it in half and press again and pat again so it fills the circle. Repeat until you've used up the dough and fillings. Keep adding circles, pushing the edges into place as you go and press for air pockets between each to prevent sticking. Cook the zhugi, pasta, and squash in boiling, salted water over medium heat for about 15 minutes. Remove the zhugi and let cool slightly.

instructions:
Boil water in a medium saucepan. Once at a boil add rice, onion and spices, return to boil and allow to boil for about 18 - 30 minutes. 
    -. Once done, remove from heat. When completely cooled, stir in oranges and ice water. Enjoy.

title: Hazelnut Cod Baked With Whitefish With Glaze
ingredients: 2 lbs whitefish, cooked ( such as cod, flounder or cod ) | 2 ounces hazelnuts | 1 lb dried navy beans, soaked over night in | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 ounce ham, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Sausage Italian Style
ingredients: 1 lb dry hot italian sausage or 1 lb italian sausage, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine italian sausage or sausage, and any remaining sausage mixture, in dutch oven or heavy medium size pot. Cover and bake covered about 2 hours, stirring once or twice. Uncover and add italian sausage and any remaining sausage mixture, if desired, and bake 30 minutes to 1 hour more. Remove cover, and uncover. Bake 15 minutes longer, or until sausage flakes when tested.

title: Mussel with Kahiki
ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried red chili pepper | 2 greek style yogurt
instructions: Wash mussels, remove beards, and bring to the boil. Add kiwi fruit. Cook uncovered until the shells open. Remove from heat and drain well. Stir into mussel mixture and serve with kreek style yogurt.

title: Sauerkraut and Meat Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 2 cups cooked corned beef consomme
instructions: Drain sauerkraut and add to crock pot. Mix in 1 can of corned beef consomme. Cook on low for 8 hours serve with crusty bread and salad.

title: Herbed Greek Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary, chopped or 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 3 cups italian parsley, chopped | 1 package fresh phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Boil potatoes until tender, drain, cool slightly, then cut in 1/2 inch thick slices. Place potatoes in a large mixing bowl, add rosemary, parsley, and phyllo, tossing with a hand held mixer until the mixture is well coated. Spread 1/2 of potato mixture into a lightly sprayed 10x1 inch jelly roll pan, pressing it down so it covers the edges of the pan. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes or until phyllo is golden.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,brussels sprout,spring onion,mustard seed,red chili paste
title: Spicy Mustard Seeds and Sprouts
ingredients: 300 g dry pinto beans ( black ) | 2 -3 spring onions, finely sliced | 225 g brussels sprouts | 1 -2 fresh red chili paste ( or less depending on how much heat you want.| i use 2 ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, coarsely crushed
instructions: Cover dry beans with cold water, boil 3 hours, drain well, allow to cool, remove skins and rinse well. Place the beans in the microwave safe bowl and cover with 2 3cm of water, cover, allow to heat up for 5 minutes to soften, then drain well and place in a large bowl. Add the spring onions, sprouts, chili paste or red chilli paste, mustard seeds and half the remaining water and mix well. Cover and microwave on high for a further 4 minutes or until all the water has been absorbed. Variation, to improve the flavour of the mustard seeds, add 2 teaspoons of ground black pepper powder. Stir into the bean and vegetables before adding the rest of the water.

title: Cod and Herbed Milk Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 2 cups freshly cooked chunk white-fleshed cod | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1 dash dried thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cod in a baking dish. Distribute butter over. Place cod onto dish. Cover with milk. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with thyme, and bake 15 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,onion powder,shrimp,ginger root,peanut,bean black,tahini,guajillo chilies
title: Camarones de Siri
ingredients: 4 guajillo chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 onion powder | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger root, grated | 2 pounds medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3/4 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup dry roasted ginely shaosing bean ( green mexican black bean ), rinsed and dried
instructions: Blend guajillo chilies, sesame oil, onion powder, ginger root, and shrimp in a food processor until smooth.

title: Peperoni
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 whole white onion, peeled | 2 can stewed tomatoes, undrained
instructions: In a small bowl, mix sherry, mustard oil, onion and tomatoes.

title: Simple Spanish Oven Oven Potatoes
ingredients: 12 small new potatoes or 12 small sweet potatoes | 2 cans v8 roasted red peppers ( or one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and one and a half cans rotel or green chilies, as your taste
instructions: Preheat your oven's temperature. Grease a large casserole dish or baking pan. You don't need to oil the pan, just lightly browning it a bit. Add your potatoes and roast them in the oven just until they are soft. If they are still semi soft, add less water and re mix. Take out your crockpots and dump in the rotel or chiles. This will make any leftover potato lucks easier to roll back in. Add your red pepper mixture to the crockpot and stir. Add the v8 peppers to the pot and mix. Turn your oven to 350 and return the potatoes and their liquid to the casserole dish. This will make a small amount of sauce over the potatoes and make them so tasty. Pour the sauce over the potatoes so they are evenly coated. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Serve with sour cream and salsa or salsa cheese, if desired.

title: Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef sirloin steak | 8 cups cooked chicken, chopped ( approx.| 5 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Slice beef. In a large bowl, combine beef, meat, and vegetables. Pour soup into a 3 litre oven proof soup crockpot. Place lid on crockpot and bake for 8 - 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: acorn squash,red chile pepper,marsala,flat leaf parsley
title: Acorn Squash Marsala
ingredients: 3 acorn squash, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 can red chile peppers | 1/4 cup flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 cup dry marsala
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a 9x13 glass baking dish in the oven to warm. Place squash into a pan of boiling water with about 1/4 can of red chile peppers washed out of the can of juice. When squash is tender, but still firm, drain, and discard chilies and juice. Toss squash with 3 tablespoons of parsley and marsala until the marsala is evenly distributed. Spoon squash filling into baking dish, and spread out to the edges. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and chile peppers to serve.

title: Chopsticks and Beef Ribs (Fatsee)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef ribs, cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 garlic cloves, smashed | peanut oil | zucchini, lengths lengthwise ( about 2 inches in length )
instructions: Arrange a few pieces of zucchini on cutting board or clean flat plate and, using sharp knife, butterfly the zucchinis lengthwise. Then, using sharp knife, cut zucchini lengthwise crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Tie loops of garlic on end of zucchini and cut about 1 inch from end.

title: Homemade Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless chicken, about 8 | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Wash the chicken thoroughly. Rinse it with cold water and pat dry. If it is very dry rub it on your finger tips. Place the chicken in a large roasting pan. Rub salt all over the chicken. Cook in a 325 degree oven for a minimum of 90 minutes. Turn the chicken and cook for 15 minutes longer. Note, if you like your chicken crisp, remove from heat and place it in a roasting pan. Turning the chicken so it bakes evenly. Cook for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,green chili,salmon fillet,pear,grain rice,mayonnaise
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 fresh green chili, seeded | 1 red ripe pear, cored, seeded and sliced or 1 cup canned pear, drained | 1 cup cooked long-grain rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 12 ounces salmon fillets
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix mayonnaise and sun dried tomatoes. Spread on sliced chile. Arrange pear and rice on top, sprinkling with a little sun dried tomato dressing. Cut salmon fillets into 3 or 4 pieces. Arrange on top of rice. Drizzle rice with remaining dressing. Serve at once. Note, do not add oil to pan. Heat in pan. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes or until tender.

title: Baked Cod With Cornflake Crumbs
ingredients: 4 cod, whole | 1 cup corn flakes, to taste ( or more, if needed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the whole cod in a single layer on the baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut a deep cross on the top of each piece of cod. Sprinkle each piece lightly with corn flakes. Cover and bake the cod until the edges just begin to turn golden brown, about 15 minutes. You'll have to watch some closely after 15 minutes, because the chips don't set up until the last 15 minutes of baking. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let stand 5 minutes. Turn the oven temperature down to 325 and bake until the cod is tender and has nice grill marks, about another 15 minutes. You want the fish to flake easily with the fork. Serve with sour cream for dipping.

Random Ingredients: paprika,fire tomato,ricotta cheese,parsnip,beef sirloin,bamboo shoot,shrimp paste
title: Rabo's Beef Gumbo
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1/2 - 3/4 cup bamboo shoot, diced | 1/2-3 cup crushed fire-roasted tomatoes | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons paprika, preferably sweet hungarian | 1 -2 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1 parsnip
instructions: Place beef sirloin slices in freezer, covered, until meat is frozen solid about 1 hour and up to 1 day. When ready to cook, remove beef from freezer, scrape meat and save for later. Dice bamboo shoots and tomatoes. Drain beef and set aside. Mash up tomatoes and reserve juice. Combine in slow cooker beef, tomato juice, ricotta cheese, paprika, shrimp paste and half the parsnip. Stir until mixed well, serve.

Random Ingredients: cornish hen,chicken stock,golden syrup,mexican cheese,onion salt,dill pickle,apple cider,tabasco sauce
title: Hemp-Thing Cornish Game Hens With Cheese Gravy
ingredients: 4 cornish hens, 4 ounces each and ( 1 lb.| ) | 6 -8 thin sliced apple cuds | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder ( to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 dill pickles, slices sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f. Place hens skin side up and fat side up on a rack and bake for 45 minutes, or until juices run clear when legs are pierced with a skewer. While chicken is baking, combine first 7 ingredients in a large crock. Bring to a boil, scraping the bottom of the pan. Add pickles. Reduce to a soft simmer and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer, stirring often until desired consistency is reached. Add pickles to sauce in crock. Heat until horseradish mixture is hot again. Spoon horseradish cream into serving dishes and top with slices of hens, and ladle horseradish cream over.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,green chilies,pearl barley,nutmeg,vanilla sugar,black olive,cocoa
title: Mexican Pumpkin Barley & Nuts (Barley Taco Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 100 g green chilies, chopped ( fresh or canned ) | 100 g black olives, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( mexican taco seasoning or mild to mild, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for 1 hour. Enjoy.

title: Salmon Pita Chips
ingredients: 2 pita bread, rounds or 5 -6 slices pita bread | 1/2 lb salmon, skinned and cooked | 1/4 cup currants | 1/4 cup chopped dried vegetables
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Toast the pita rounds in the oven 5 - 7 minutes or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,arrowroot,vanilla,egg white,peppermint extract,mustard powder,chili pepper flake,egg
title: Chinese Hot Peppermint Sponge Cake
ingredients: 6 large egg whites | 1/4 cup arrowroot ( made using 5 egg whites from 50 grams of flour ) | 200 g dried shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped ( about 12 1/2 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( yellow ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( add more if you like it ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pinch vanilla ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 egg ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a 26cm springform pan with parchment paper, line the base with parchment paper and spray with cooking spray. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and set aside. Add the yeast and continue beating the whites with a mixer on medium speed until they are very smooth and glossy and glossy, about 5 minutes in a large bowl. Add the chile flakes, salt, pepper and vanilla and increase the speed to high. Beat in the dried mushrooms. The dough can be used immediately or chilled for up to two days or for up to 2 weeks. Beat the egg whites on medium high until stiff peaks form. Gently fold 1 tablespoon of the egg whites into the other egg mixture. Stir in the other 1 tablespoon of the egg whites. Spread the dough in the prepared pan and using a metal spatula, spread the peppermint and mustard mixture evenly over the surface of the sponge. Gently swirl the hot peppermint mixture over the top of the sponge, smooth the top and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Place in the centre of the oven and bake for 35 minutes or until the sponge is golden. Remove from the oven and allow to cool before cutting.

title: Easy Beef & Rice Bowls
ingredients: 3 hamburger bags, separated by 1/2 inch | 4 teaspoons long grain brown rice, uncooked | 4 ounces beef sirloin steaks
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brown both sides of the meat on the grill. Set up your bowls on a baking sheet. Place two hamburger bags on top of each other. Place two teaspoons of brown rice over the tops of each bag. Remove the top of the bags and place each one on a baking sheet. Broil for 2 - 3 minutes. Watch carefully because rice will release steam. Remove from the oven and top with two slices of steaks. Set the steaks under running water and let sit for a few minutes while the rice is cooking.

title: Simple and Low Fat Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 yellow onion | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Put barley into a dutch oven or a pot with boiling water, add 1 tbsp. Water, cover, and let rice steam for about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes to steam the barley. Remove the lid, fluff with a fork, and then return to the stove for a minute to dry out the barley and release some of its moisture. When barley is done, remove from heat and stir in the onions. Sprinkle with bouillon, turmeric and cayenne.

title: Sesame Sesame Semolina Balls
ingredients: 2 cups semolina flour or 2 cups cornmeal | 1/2 cup whipping cream, softened | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Mix the semolina flour and whipping cream until well blended. Add the cayenne pepper and process until combined. Cover with plastic and refrigerate for at least an hour. Place the sesame seeds on a baking tray. Roll the pastry into a ball and press some of the seeds into the balls using your thumb and index finger. Place the balls on top of each other and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: double cream,chili oil,rose essence,spaghetti sauce,canola oil,horseradish,chipotle chile adobo
title: Spicy Tomato & Horseradish Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon minced fresh chili oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rose petals ( red or green parts from your jar jar ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon horseradish, grated | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 3 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 jar prepared spaghetti sauce, of your choice
instructions: Heat the chili oil and rose petals in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds. Remove the skillet from the heat, and add the canola oil. Transfer the heated oil to a blender, and blend until it liquefies. Gradually add the horseradish, chipotle chiles, and 2 teaspoons of prepared horseradish. Blend until the horseradish becomes completely mixed into the sauce. While blending, reheat your sauce in the microwave for about 30 seconds, and remove from the heat. Pour into a small saucepan over low heat, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is reduced by about half. Stir in your choice of pasta, and serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: lobster meat,dark soy sauce,apple,celery rib,cod,green bell pepper
title: Chinese Lobster
ingredients: 600 g of precooked lobsters, with their shells | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple wood vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 200 g of cooked cod, in one piece ( or use a mixture of both ) or 200 g shrimp-shrimp-shrimp, from a shell ( or use a mixture of both ) | 2 celery ribs, sliced into thick strips | 1 small green bell pepper, sliced into thick strips | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Steam the lobsters in a bamboo steamer over boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes or until just cooked through. Combine the dressing ingredients and whisk to combine. Dice the fish into small bite sized pieces. Mix the diced fish and sauce with the vegetables and serve.

title: Baked Halibut W- Herbs or Herb Crust
ingredients: 1 packet dry yeast | 4 tablespoons herbed fresh yeast or 4 tablespoons dried herbs | 600 g halibut fillets
instructions:
Preheat oven to 200c. Spray or bake proofing pan with oil. Add yeast to oil and yeast. Stir in herbs. Dredge fish on both sides and place in single layer. Top with remaining herbs. Cover and bake for about 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with the centre. 
    -.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,sun tomato oil,curry powder,provolone cheese,brandy,lime wedge,vanilla extract,cube steak
title: Aussie Steak Au Poached in Sweet Tomato-Sun Dried Tomato Paste
ingredients: 1 boneless white fish fillet, cut into 4 equal serving pieces ( such as halibut ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 8 ounces provolone cheese, cut into 8 thin slices, thinly sliced lengthwise | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, thinly sliced lengthwise | 8 slices capons or 8 slices caponata | 8 slices provolone cheese cut into 8 thin slices and quartered | 8 lime wedges | 4 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) or 4 tablespoons rum ( optional )
instructions: Place fish in a large dish. Combine curry powder and vanilla and sprinkle over fish. Cover evenly with sliced cheese. Cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to 3 days, turning fish occasionally. Soak tomatoes in hot oil with a pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper for 1 minute. Serve fish topped with tomato and cheese strips, with remaining slices of provolone and sun dried tomato slices. Serve lime wedges separately for squeezing over fish. Note, a ripe tomato would be very attractive, as a marinade for the fish, although it will have a bitter taste unlike the ripe tomato paprika.

Random Ingredients: olive,thai red curry paste,poblano chile,chicken thigh,red capsicum,cantaloupe,saltine cracker
title: Thai Chicken Cakes With Roasted Vegetables (Bhoon Mamuang Muir)
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh bone, skin removed | 400 g medium sized cantaloupe, peeled, seeded, quartered, finely chopped | 1 poblano chile, thinly sliced ( red bell pepper, habanero or anaheim ) | 1 small red capsicum, finely chopped ( bell pepper can be omitted ) | 5 tablespoons thai red curry paste, to taste ( see notes ) | 200 g saltine crackers | 1/4 cup fresh olive, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c rub chicken with curry paste, place into a baking dish or baking dish to roast, and cool. Roast until just cooked through or about 15 minutes. Cool. Combine chicken, cantaloupe, chile, capsicum and olives in a bowl. Add cooked rice seasoning, taste and adjust seasoning according to your preference. Serve while it's still warm. Note, some of the food in your food processor can sometimes be quite salty and it will really make your dish taste bitter and tough.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,yellow cornmeal,red enchilada sauce,yellow pepper,parsley
title: Grilled Squash and Pepper Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup yellow squash, cut into chunks | 1 yellow sweet pepper, seeded and cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon red enchilada sauce | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place squash, sweet bell pepper, and enchilada sauce in a bowl.

title: Black and Red Eyed Peas (Mashed Peas and Pistachios)
ingredients: 1 cup butter beans, soaked overnight | 1 cup shelled black-eyed peas, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place butter beans in a pot. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Drain, and mash with potato masher until smooth. Return to the pot, and mix in beans and remaining ingredients, adding additional water if necessary.

title: Balsamic Onion Jam (Spanish)
ingredients: 2 heads spanish onions, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 quart balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to boil. Add the onions, season with salt, and cook for 30 minutes. Turn off the heat. Drain in a sieve. Place in a large saucepan with enough water to cover the onions. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the onions rise to the top, stirring occasionally. Add anise seed and bring to a boil. Cook for 15 minutes, then remove from the heat. Store in a covered pan in a cool, dark place up to 3 months.

title: Swiss Chard With Chard
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard ( about 1 1/2 lbs.| ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Place swiss chard in a pan large enough to accommodate all three quarters of the chard in it. Add water to the pan, about three quarters inch high. Cover and place over medium heat to steam. Steam until tender, 4 to 7 minutes. Remove from pot and let cool. Cut into manageable sized pieces. Add half and half to chard and toss carefully so as not to tear it. Serve.

title: Dee's Steak and Apricot Burritos
ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks | 24 ounces apricot preserves | 8 large cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 8 flour tortillas, warmed | 12 ounces cooked pork, cut in strips
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place steaks on rack in broiler pan skin side down. Grill for 4 - 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Cut steak into thin slices. While still hot, drizzle slices with 1/4 cup apricot preserves. Place tomatoes in separate shallow nonstick baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining apricot preserves. Place tortillas on top, and arrange strips of pork over tortillas. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place two tortillas on top of each other, and press down to spread remaining preserves on tortillas. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until heated through. Cut into 8 portions, and serve on warmed tortillas with hot dipping sauce.

title: Pesto Polenta
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 cups pecorino romano or 1 3/4-2 cups other pecorino romano cheese, coarsely grated ( about 7 1/2 oz.| net weight ) | 1 3/4-2 cups coarsely ground cornmeal
instructions:
Combine grated cheese and cornmeal in a large bowl. Mix together the cheese mixture and remaining ingredients and mix well. 
    -. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend. Preheat the oven to 400°. Bake for 15 minutes to give an even golden color. Cool for at least an hour before removing from the pan.

title: Kythoni or Turkish Orzo
ingredients: 5 cups dried orzo pasta | 1 cup rye flour | 1 whole clove, crushed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place wheat gluten in a large bowl, and stir to coat the surface evenly with gluten. Cover, and allow to steam for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove wheat gluten, and stir in rye flour. Cover, and continue steaming until orzo is cooked, at least 10 minutes more, stirring periodically. Drain well, and allow to cool. When completely cooled, add clove studded with whole clove. Cover, and store in the refrigerator until served.

title: Easy Greek Roast Lamb Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 pound cold butterflied boneless leg of lamb, sliced into thin slices | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 2 sheets pastry for double-crust deep-fry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Open bread loaf and remove bread from crust. Cut into six pieces and separate slices into two sections. Place each piece on a square of waxed paper or plastic wrap and pound it flat with a meat mallet until flat. Place the bread pieces, cut side up, in a single layer on a sheet of foil. Spread 1 teaspoon taco seasoning over each slice of meat. Top each piece of bread with equal amounts of slices of butterflied meat. Roll the paper around each piece of meat so the seams are tight. Fold the top and bottom edges of the paper over the meat, and secure with toothpicks. Spray a skillet or frying pan with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Place the meat rolls into the hot skillet and cook until meat is well browned, about 3 to 5 minutes per side, then transfer to a baking sheet lined with foil and bake in preheated oven until internal temperature is 160 degrees f, about 30 minutes. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,grand marnier,vanilla ice cream,yellow pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,beef stew meat,beef chuck
title: Grilled Mini Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, trimmed of fat | 1 package hot dogs or 2 1/2-ounce packages fast fry fries | 8 ounces deli ham, coarsley chopped | 2 teaspoons grand marnier or 2 teaspoons regular wine vinegar | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 4 scoops vanilla ice cream ( optional ) | 1 yellow pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill. Place beef, fries, ham, and 1/2 tsp of grand marnier on grill rack 4 inches below hot coals. Grill, turning once, until beef is done, 3 - 4 minutes for pouches and 5 minutes for fajitas. Remove from heat. Cut beef into bite size pieces. Place in a medium bowl and add cheddar and scoops of icecream. Toss, adjust seasonings with salt and pepper. Divide among four dinner size dinner plates. Top with red pepper. Serve with a green salad.

title: Hummus for Two
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, chopped | 2 shallots, seeded & diced | 1 tablespoon dry red wine | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons minced garlic powder | 1 package ready made ladyfingers
instructions: Saute cauliflower and shallots in 1 tablespoon of margarine until cauliflower is tender. Transfer to a bowl and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. Combine wine, peanut butter, garlic powder and garlic powder. Spread mixture evenly on ladyfingers in a shallow baking dish or pan. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 2 lbs fat-trim beef eye round, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 5 -8 tablespoons lard
instructions:
You will need a frying pan to fill with the refried beans. To make refried beans heat one medium size saucepan on medium high heat with about 6 tbsp oil. 
    -. Place the pieces of beef eye round in the pan and stir a few times. Add browned pieces of the bean liquid and 1/4 cup water and stir. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until meat is done. Do not drain the beans after they are cooked. You can also use a slotted spoon and spoon to put them through a food mill, this would make more manageable and less messy. If you make these your family likes to be spicey, you can use 1 tsp ground cinnamon and 1/2 tsp ground cloves. You can also use a combination of cinnamon and cloves. Add water, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp water if desired. You can add a whole 1/4 cup of olive oil to the pan, or you can spread the beans over a casserole dish, it doesn't spread out. You will need a skillet for this, so you may want to line it up in a 9x13 baking pan. Spoon the beans into your frying pan, fill them with your choice of meat mixture and put them into the pan in the pan. Turn heat to low, cover, and set timer for 40 min, turn heat to high and continue to cook for 15 mins. You want the beans as firm as you can manage without burning them. If too dark, cover and continue cooking 10 mins until it is very dark.

title: Persian Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 english seedless cucumbers | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Wash cucumbers and dry with paper towels. Put the cucumbers in a bowl of very hot water, and leave for 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out excess water. In a bowl, lightly pound the cucumbers with a mortar and pestle so they are a chunky texture but not too finely. In a deep fryer or deep frying pan, heat 1/2 inch of oil to 350 degrees f. Deep fry the cucumbers in small batches in the hot oil, until golden brown, about 1 minute. When done, drain on paper towels. Arrange on a serving platter and drizzle with a little vegetable oil.

Random Ingredients: chop suey vegetable,active yeast,tortilla chip,lemon juice zest
title: Quick and Easy Easy Italian Breadsticks (Gourmet)
ingredients: 5 cups tortilla chips, at room temp | 1 can chop suey vegetables, drained | 3 teaspoons salt ( i use seasoned salt ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Put the chips in a mixing bowl. Pour the suey veggies onto top, then stir in the salt and lemon juice. Using a pastry brush, lightly mist the surface with vegetable oil. The breadsticks should have a good sheen. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours. Line a pizza peel with foil and line the dough with the breadsticks. Cut them around the peel a little so the dough doesn't stick to the peel. Put the pizza into the oven and bake for 20 - 30 minutes at 425f. Enjoy.

title: Basic Pasta With Coffee
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 500 g pasta shells
instructions: Boil the water. When it comes to a boil, add the pearl barley, and then the beans, and the coffee. The liquid the barley was sitting inches the heat will go down so check occasionally. Reduce the heat.

title: Creamy Mushroom Soup II
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 package dry mix
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup with dry mix. If soup is too thick, slowly mix it back in, mix well. I prefer to refrigerate for a day or two before serving.

Random Ingredients: half cream,creamy peanut butter,cold water,basil,tomato green chilies,frying chicken,avocado,active yeast
title: Chicken Peanut Butter Peanut Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, divided | 1/2 cup cold water | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 - 2 1/2 cups chicken or 2 - 2 1/2 cups turkey, shredded | 1 large ripe avocado, peeled and crushed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 4 -7 cups ungreased all-purpose frying chicken or 4 -7 cups turkey, cooked and torn into small pieces | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream or 1 1/2 cups whole milk, lightly shaken
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup of the sauce with the peanut butter and water in medium saucepan. Sprinkle yeast over the top, then add the rest of the sauce ingredients. Mix until smooth and creamy. Set aside. In a 13x9x2 inch glass bowl, add chicken or turkey, avocado, chilies, and remaining 1/2 cup of peanut butter sauce. Mix well. Pour half and half and chicken mixture in and mix. Add remaining cream mixture. Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap, then a dish towel, and set aside. In a deep, heavy skillet, cover and set over medium heat until it begins to simmer. Do not cover the pan. When the mixture reaches 185f on a instant reading thermometer, begin adding the hot mixture into the skillet. When it comes back to 185f on the surface, turn the burner off, so the mixture is completely hot. Turn off the burner. Allow it to sit for 20 - 25 minutes, then stir the entire mixture.

Random Ingredients: banana,russet potato,yellow onion,vanilla pudding mix,tomato puree,pasta,baking potato
title: Papa's Easy Banana and Potato Pudding
ingredients: 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 1/2 whole baking potatoes | 1/2 cup tomato puree ( not-sweetened ) | 3 bananas | 1 small russet potato | 1 yellow onion | 1/2 cup pasta ( we chose farfalle ) | 1 medium banana
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pudding mix in a bowl and add mashed potatoes. Stir to combine. In a separate bowl, dice the potato, onion and tomato puree and mix together. Dice the banana and place into a mini crockpot using the small bowl to soak up the juice. Add potatoes and tomato to potato mixture and stir just until potato is coated in potato mixture. Place the diced banana on the top of the pudding mixture, and set aside until ready to cook. Once the oven is preheated, place pudding mix in oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until pudding is dry and potatoes are soft. In the meantime, dice up the mango and place into blender or food processor. Add the diced banana, vanilla bean and puree, and blend for about 30 seconds or until desired consistency. Serve warm with crusty italian bread.

title: Broccoli and Walnut Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1/2 cup halved walnuts | 1 pinch ground red pepper ( optional ) | 1 pinch wheat flour, or as needed
instructions: Place broccoli and nuts in a bowl. Sprinkle with red pepper and wheat flour.

title: Tiella's Italian Potatoes With Wine
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes ( about 1 inch in diameter ) | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes ( or more if you wish ) | 3 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Peel and wash the potatoes and boil in salted water until fork tender. Drain potatoes well and mash with a potato masher. Add the chile flakes and the white wine and mix well. Cover and let sit in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,crawfish,jalapeno,nonfat milk,snow pea,self raising flour
title: Stirfry Crawfish Squash (Australian)
ingredients: 3/4 cup reduced-fat plain nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, finely chopped | 2 sheets snow peas, trimmed | 2 1/2 cups crawfish, drained, finely chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons self-raising flour
instructions: Place all but 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce and jalapeno in a medium saucepan, place over medium heat, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Increase the heat to high. Add snow peas to the saucepan, stirring to coat. Cook, stirring for 1 minute, or until heated through. Remove from the heat and stir in crawfish, then add flour and stir until smooth. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot water,red capsicum,bay leaf,bacon grease,zucchini,serrano chilies
title: Nepalese Vegetable Nido (Stir Fry)
ingredients: 200 g red capsicums, sliced thinly ( bell peppers ) | 1 medium zucchini, sliced thinly | 2 serrano chilies, sliced thinly | 100 g bacon grease | 2 bay leaves | 1 cup hot water
instructions: Heat oil in a wok in a deep pan. Saute the onion, capsicum and zucchini until the onion is lightly coloured and tender. Add bay leaves and continue to saute for a minute or two. Add the hot water and mix well. Remove the bay leaves from the wok and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,vodka,shallot,allspice,italian seasoning,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,basmati rice
title: Chipotle Zabaglione With Saffron Rice
ingredients: 2 pomegranate-infused vodka, chilled | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 shallot, minced
instructions: Dice the shallot and saute in a skillet over medium heat until it's golden. Add the chipotle pepper, allspice, italian seasoning and salt. When the chipotle pepper is fragrant, pour 1/4 cup of the vodka over it and stir. Raise the flame to high and add the rice, stirring to coat evenly with the infused vodka and saffron. Cook, stirring, until the rice is golden and sticky. Place the sliced shallot into the skillet, then toss with the rice. Add the remaining 1/4 cup vodka, increase the flame to high, and cook, stirring until the vodka turns a darker red. Remove the dish from the heat and serve at once.

title: Mexican Street Croutons
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces taco seasoning | garlic-flavored croutons
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread taco seasoning in a shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Bake just until slightly brown, about 10 minutes. Spread croutons out on a large, resealable plastic bag. Scoop croutons from bag onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned and crispy, 15 to 20 minutes. Watch oven as bread browns and stir to ensure croutons won't burn.

title: Banana-Soaked French Toast
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas | 6 slices bread ( white or whole grain )
instructions: Peel bananas and cut into thin slices. Wrap up slices in two slices of bread. In toaster oven preheated to 480°f on the inside rack. When it is heated through remove from oven, and put 4 banana slices in each slice, to resemble a sandwich. Return to oven and brown on both sides. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Devon French Toast - West Coast Style (Devon Street)
ingredients: 3 -4 slices of your favorite dark rum | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Spread mustard on one side of each piece of bread. Place on a hot griddle. Heat mustard to smoking point. Add port and honey and let melt. Serve with spoons.

title: Lamb and Tofu Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 slices lean lamb, cut in matchstick strips | 300 g rice vinegar | 1 package firm tofu, drained | 2 tablespoons pickled pepperoncini peppers, coarsley chopped | 1 cup miniature marshmallow ( optional )
instructions: Coat the lamb with the rice vinegar. Slice the tofu crossways into six wedges each and dip into the vinegar to coat. Place the tofu, pepperocini peppers and the noodles in serving plates. Top with the lamb and sprinkle with the mrs. Dash.

title: Sunflower Seed Snacks
ingredients: 225 g sunflower seeds | 1 cup sweet italian sausage
instructions: Place a sheet of baking parchment on a large baking sheet. Mix together the sunflower seeds and italian sausage. Using your hands shape the mixture into small balls, approximately 2 - 3 inches in diameter. Heat a pan with a little olive oil, placed in it, over medium heat. Fry the snacks for about 2 - 5 minutes until they are crisp and golden, and have a matte brown colour. Set aside to cool for 2 min then transfer to an oiled tray and return to the oven to keep warm. Cut into rounds, serve with a little crusty bread and some salad.

title: Chinese Chili Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons finely minced fresh chives
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat. Spray surface of the pork with nonstick cooking spray and sprinkle with chives. Cook pork in hot oil 2 minutes per side, or until thermometer reads 150 degrees f.

title: Spicy Chipotle-Chile Gouda (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated gouda cheese ( can use cheddar or a mexican melting type cheese ) | 2/3 cup minced scallion ( a green onion ) | 2 chipotle chiles, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mash very well. If necessary blend in blender until mixture is smooth. If you have a stand mixer with a hook attachment, add a few more drops of vinegar, one teaspoon at a time until mixture becomes thick enough to spread out easily. Spread on cheese or spread on crackers.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup sugar,walnut,coconut oil,chive,romaine lettuce leaf,italian bread
title: Coconut Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 small romaine lettuce leaves, torn into bite size pieces | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut oil, plus 1 tablespoon extra for dusting | 1/4 cup simple syrup ( to taste, i use sugar or cinnamon sugar ) | 3 tablespoons snipped snipped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons walnuts ( optional )
instructions: In a salad bowl, toss the lettuce with the oil, syrup, chives & walnuts. The bread should not sink to the bottom of the bowl & should not be dry.

Random Ingredients: white rum,asiago cheese,pecorino romano cheese,almond extract,cabbage,broccoli,snow pea
title: Christmas Eve Baked Cabbage and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage | 1 head broccoli | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/4 cup shredded asiago romano cheese | 1/2 cup white rum | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup shredded cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut cabbage and broccoli into bite sized pieces. Peel broccoli. Chop into bite size pieces. Bring medium size pot of salted water to boil over high heat. Remove from heat and stir in broccoli, cabbage and asiago. Pour into baking dish coated with non stick cooking spray. Add remaining ingredients except cabbage. Bake for 1 hour or until vegetables are crisp tender.

title: Almond Beef Turnovers
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubes ( or use 2 smaller stewing beef cubes cut up ) | 3 teaspoons almond extract | 1 teaspoon lemon, rind of | 7 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Thaw beef, if meat cubes are small, they need to be frozen for easier handling. Mix all ingredients except phyllo and roll up carefully over the counter so as not to tear them. Cut with 2 inch cookie cutter until you are able to work with pieces about 1 1/2 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Put on a baking sheet lined with wax paper or parchment paper.

title: Korean Green Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour or 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 - 3/4 fluid ounce green food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Mix flour or cornstarch and knead with fingers till smooth. Spread on wax paper lined pan. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Bring to room temperature before spreading over finished dish. Fyi, korean style food coloring can be found commercially. This recipe is korean style food color. It tastes like an omlette ompe.

Random Ingredients: baguette,avocado,corn oil,baby spinach,chicken stock cube,soy crumbles,coffee granule
title: Creamy Spinach Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 baguette, sliced in 1/2 in.| slices | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 5 tomatoes ( or 1/3 cup of tomato puree ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1/3 cup soy crumbles | 1 cup baby spinach, washed
instructions: Heat a frying pan over a medium high heat. Add corn oil. While it's heating up and you're waiting for the pan to get hot toss slices of bread into hot oil. Cook the slices of bread until they're crisp and golden, then turn over. Keep the toast on the toast. Remove the toast from the pan as it's done and transfer it onto a plate. Add tomatoes to hot frying pan. Reduce heat to medium. Pour chicken stock through a strainer over a bowl and set aside. Mix soy crumbles into the chicken stock. Toss in the spinach. Taste for seasoning if necessary. Pour over the toast on the toast and serve straight away.

title: Lamb and Corn Stew (Tse Bi-Yeay)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cubed | 1 small bunch whole kernel corn | 1 dried red chili pepper
instructions: Peel the whole kernel of corn or use frozen kernels of corn and chop it. Chop the red chile and rub into the lamb in a pot, place in a pre heated oven, on a medium flame. Add water and bring it to boil. Cover over medium heat until the lamb is tender. Check the lamb often as it cooks to avoid burning. Cook for two hours or until most of the water has been absorbed. If the water starts drying out, just mix some water and water again. Serve with rice or vegetables.

title: Peachy Stilton Smoothie
ingredients: 225 g stilton cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 peach, diced | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1 ounce shredded coconut
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together. Serve immediately.

title: Cabbage Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 cups cabbage, finely shredded | 1 small cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 bay leaf | 1 small red pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe casserole. Stir to mix lightly. Cook on full power for 7 - 9 minutes. Remove from microwaves and stir. Serve warm. Sauce should slightly thicken.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,honey mustard,cherry,cayenne pepper,yoghurt,broccoli floret,chicken stock vegetable
title: Broccoli Murgers With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups low-fat yoghurt | 3 teaspoons low fat honey mustard | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup canned drained dried sweet cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine yoghurt, honey mustard and liquid smoke in a medium bowl to blend. Stir in the cayenne pepper and broccoli florets to coat. Let stand 20 minutes. Shape broccoli mixture into 6 thick patties. Place on a plate and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Combine stock and tomatoes to make a smooth dipping sauce. Dip patties into dressing and cook on a barbecue or griddle pan over medium high heat, turning frequently, until golden, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Serve with reserved sauce.

title: Easy Olive Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 jars alfredo sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 12 small kalamata olives | fresh dill
instructions: Pour the alfredo sauce in a bowl with the balsamic vinegar in it. Slice the olives crosswise into a 1/4 inch dice or place them in a blender and process with dill. Pour into a serving dish and stir in the olives. Serve immediately at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: wheat pita bread,green cabbage,vegetable shortening,cooking apple,vegetable,wide egg noodle,pine nut
title: Vegetarian Apple Noodle (Cabbage and Noodles)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking apples, finely chopped | 2 cups shredded green cabbage ( about 12 ounces ) | 3/4 cup finely chopped green cabbage | 1/3 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted | 1 package wide egg noodles ( or 8 eggs ) | 1/2 cup chopped mixed vegetables
instructions: In 2 quart deep heavy saucepan, melt shortening over medium heat. Add apples and cabbage. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture starts to soften, about 3 minutes. Add nuts and cook until mixture begins to sizzle and starts to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in noodles.

title: Gourmet Japanese Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean beef | 1 liter beef stock ( can use a 50/50 mix of bouillon cubes and water with 1/2 cup vegetable stock ) | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon soy milk | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: In medium saucepan, add beef and stock and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 min or until beef is cooked through and tender. Remove beef from the pan, drain all but 1 tbsp fat and return the rest of the broth to the pot. Add the celery salt and soy milk and bring back to a boil. Pour in the meat mixture and return to simmer and cook for 20 min or until gravy thickens and thickens to desired consistency. Serve this also over noodles. Garnish with freshly grated parmesan/romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,swiss cheese,coffee,tri color spiral pasta,kiwi fruit,mustard,graham cracker crumb
title: French Quarter-Style Kiwifruit Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces tri-color spiral pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked | 1 container cool whip | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 4 ounces sliced swiss cheese | 1 cup shredded kiwi fruit | 1 1/2 cups crumbly graham cracker crumbs | 2 -4 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for about 13 minutes or until al dente.

title: Artichokes Cubes
ingredients: 2 artichoke hearts ( see notes below ) | 1/2 cup white mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons calvados or 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat the calvados or apple cider in a small saucepan until it is just beginning to simmer. Add the mushrooms, artichoke hearts, and water. Peal off each artichoke heart. Use a fork to break apart the artichoke hearts and stir to combine. Place the artichoke pieces onto a lightly greased baking paper. Brush the tops of the artichoke hearts with the calvados or apple cider. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake in a preheated 400 degree oven until golden brown and tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lentils, Pineapple, & Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 350 g green lentils, drained, rinsed | 120 g broccoli florets, chopped | 2 medium red capsicums, very thinly sliced | 140 -250 ml cooking sherry ( cooking sherry vinegar ) | 200 ml pineapple, in chunks, drained | 2 tablespoons clear honey | fat-free whipped topping, to serve
instructions: Place lentils into a saucepan of boiling, salted water. Return to a boil and cook over medium heat for approx 12 - 15 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, toss all the remaining vegetables and fruit with sherry, honey and a little extra honey. Serve over lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,turkey,carrot,vegetable oil,chicken broth,red chile pepper,sage,avocado
title: Corn-Corn Turkey Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound ground turkey | 1 can chicken broth | 12 cups whole kernel corn, drained | 1 carrot, chopped | 2 cans creamed corn, drained | 1 small red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1 bunch fresh sage, leaves stripped
instructions: In a large pot, heat 1 teaspoon of oil over medium heat. Add ground turkey and cook until no longer pink. Stir in chicken broth, whole kernel corn, carrot and creamed corn. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Stir in crushed or grated cheese, and chile. Continue to simmer for 10 minutes. Season with chopped sage with salt and pepper before serving.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,hazelnut,baharat,farfalle pasta,green chili,cardamom pod,garlic clove
title: Bamia N' Cardamom Pasta With Chili and Herbs
ingredients: 200 g bamia n'lentils ( i like podds or arabic ) | 500 g farfalle pasta | 3 garlic cloves | 1 green chili | 200 -300 g of fresh mint sprigs ( or a combination of mint and basil leaves ) | 1 -2 tablespoon of chopped hazelnuts ( to garnish ) | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Boil pasta as per instructions on the packet. Drain pasta and place back into the pot. Keep on the boil. Now finely cut the chili and garlic, add to pot and fry on medium heat until garlic and chili are golden brown. Add farfalle and stir for a few minutes making sure it does not stick to the bottom of the pan. Mix in the chopped mint or basil leaves, mix through and continue cooking. Taste and adjust seasoning with cardamom and sea salt. Pour in 1 - 2 tablespoons of olive oil while still warm and toss through the nuts.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,sunflower oil,veal,pork liver,escarole,potato,chipotle chile,salt pepper
title: Veal Lasagne
ingredients: 600 g veal, thinly sliced | 400 g pork livers or 400 g prosciutto, thinly sliced | 400 g enchilada sauce or 400 g chilies | 2 potatoes, peeled and cut into small chips ( i prefer red potatoes ) | 4 teaspoons salt and pepper | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, coarsely chopped | 400 g escarole
instructions: Heat oven to 220c/450f remove any string from the veal and thinly slice. Set aside one third of the liver for garnish, chop the remaining liver and set aside for use in sauce. In a large frying pan over medium heat, add oil, fry the liver for 5 - 6 minutes, until the liver begins to brown a little, stirring often. Return the reserved liver mix to the pan and add the chipotle chile. Stir and cook for 1 minute, then transfer the mince mix to a baking dish. Top with the potatoes, season with salt and pepper and roast for 30 - 35 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly and the liver has cooked through. Spoon the sauce over the top of the noodles, sprinkle with the shredded olives and serve.

title: Mini Dark Chipits
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a pie shell. Using an 8 inch square baking pan, take your chocolate chips and put them in a heat proof paper bag, close and leave for 10 mins or so, depending on how sweet you want the chips to be. Take out the bag of chocolate, add a couple handfuls of chips, if using, and shake until the chips are all coated in chocolate. Melt the remaining chips by pouring over the mini chips in your baking dish. Set your oven to 400°f. If you are using a 9 pan, bake for 8 - 10 minutes, depending on how light you made it, or until golden brown and crispy. Note, you may prepare the pie from a week or two ahead, just don't put the chocolate in a bag the day before, just bake them in the pan, it will melt back in the fridge. If you are using the unbaked pie shell, preheat your oven to 400°f. Pour melted chocolate into pie shell, spreading to within 1/4 inch of the edges. When the crust is golden brown and chocolate has melted, sprinkle the remaining chocolate on top. Let rest for 5 - 10 minutes. Place the tart in the fridge or freezer. Serve.

title: Lentil Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup yellow lentils, rinsed and picked through | 1 cup rice, prepared | 10 -12 cherry tomatoes ( fresh, halved or frozen ) | 1 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1/2 - 1 cup sake ( or chicken or vegetable flavor enhancer ) | 1/2 cup cornmeal ( optional )
instructions: Put all into a food process or blender and process until smooth. Serve warm. You can also use plain yogurt, tofu, tofu, soy milk, cream, etc. If desired, you can use tofu for gluten free and soy/peanut butter substitue.

title: Cashew Applesauce I
ingredients: 1 package ground cashews | 1 large green apple, cored | 6 whole green olives, seeded and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, blend the cashews with chopped apples and olives. Spoon into an 11x13 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Spice Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 cup honey | 2 cups tea ( hot or strong )
instructions: In bowl mix all ingredients together. Shape dough into 2 inch balls. Cover and let stand one hour. Roll out on lightly floured board into a rectangle on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 minutes.

title: Chile-Beetroot Snack (Baraonda)
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley | 6 canned chipotle chiles, stemmed and chopped | 1 1/2 pounds kielbasa, sliced | 1 beetroot, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 pounds red snapper, skinned and thickly sliced
instructions: In a dutch oven or large pot, combine the barley and chiles. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, until the barley is tender. Transfer the chiles and cooked barley to a food processor or blender and process to a fine puree, about 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl and fold in the kielbasa, beetroot, and snapper. Serve hot, with cornbread or crackers.

title: Smokey Pear Burgers
ingredients: 1 ripe pear | 1 can chick-peas, undrained | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint | 4 slices turkish bread
instructions: Peel, core and slice pear into 1/4 inch thick rounds.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil sesame,liquid honey,corn cob,chili powder,chicken meat
title: Chicken Satay With Sesame Peanut
ingredients: 2 fresh corn on the cob ( the long skinny ones ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 350 g chicken meat or 350 g chicken tenders | 1/4 cup chili powder | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 -2 tablespoon toasted sesame
instructions: Preheat a bbq or grill pan with a high heat. Remove the corn from the cob and slice it into pieces approx 1 long, 1 wide and 1/4 thick. Set aside. Cut a piece of parchment paper into 8 squares about 1/2 wide. Heat the oil in a frying pan until smoking hot and cook the satay squares over medium heat, stirring frequently until lightly toasted. Keep turning over with a wooden spatula or tongs until it is well browned. Add a little more oil if the satay sticks to the pan. Drain the satay on paper. Add the chicken, chili powder and honey to the pan and coat well. Turn the heat down and stir frequently until the chicken is nicely coloured and cooked. Serve immediately with toasted sesame.

title: Dijon Parsnips and Radishes
ingredients: 2 parsnips, peeled and shredded | 2 tablespoons pickled parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons red currants or 2 tablespoons black currants | 1 tablespoons dijon mustard | liquid smoke ( optional ) | chopped parsley, for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the parsnips with the remaining ingredients. Put in a shallow glass, casserole dish, sprinkling with the parsley.

title: Pear Kebabs
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 3/8 inch cubes | 1 pear - peeled, cored and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can diced pears, drained | 1 cup canned black olives, drained | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 6 whole cloves
instructions: Thread the squash, pear, pear slices, pears, olives, currants, and cloves onto skewers. Place skewers on a greased grill over high heat with medium coals for about 4 minutes on each side for a crunchy topping. Brush the kebabs with oil, and grill for 5 to 7 more minutes.

title: Onions With Chutney
ingredients: 1 large onion, halved | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 3/4 cup chutney, with chiles
instructions: Place the onion half in the center of a cutting board and slice it from the top to within 1/4 inch of the edges on the root end. Place slices in a bowl of ice water. Sprinkle with salt and toss to combine. Drain the onion, discard the onion and rinse out the liquid and slice the onions thin, using scissors if necessary. Add the onions back into the food processor with the rest of the ingredients and blend until well combined, adding more water if necessary to facilitate blending. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,white mushroom,kidney bean,canola oil
title: Easy Mushroom Chili Non-Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil, extra virgin | 1 lb white mushroom, sliced ( i used button ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 box low-fat dry curd cottage cheese, frozen
instructions: Heat 1/3 cup of the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms, stirring regularly, until soft, about 3 minutes. Drain and transfer mixture to saucepan. Add mushrooms and remaining canola oil to skillet. Cook until mushrooms are tender, about 8 minutes. Add bean and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. In blender or food processor, puree half of the beans. Stir in cottage cheese until just combined. Add remaining flour until desired consistancy is achieved. To cook, pour half mixture into a 2 litre oven proofed crockpot. Top with remaining bean mixture. Cook on low heat for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,horseradish,sauce,orange zest,self raising flour,plain yogurt,pepperoni,bratwurst
title: Bratwurst and Mustard Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 250 g bratwursts | 3 tablespoons horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons creamed horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/gas lightly grease or line a 5 x 5 inch loaf tin with parchment paper. Place flour and brats in a large bowl. Rub the brats through the flour. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Spoon into prepared loaf tin. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until cooked. Cool on a wire rack, cut into slices and serve.

title: Spanish Sizzlin Burritos: Lunch That Can't Be
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas, cut in half | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Melt your dry sherry in microwave. Heat sherry until foamy or about a minute. Spread a small handful of tortilla at a time over the bottom half of a plate. Place tortilla on plate about 1/4 inch or so from the bottom. Dip your finger in a little lard and coat the edge of the tortilla. Roll it up, jelly roll style. Repeat until all the tortillas are used. In a large frypan melt your lard and a few tortillas together. Roll in sherry to coat. Continue frying until tortillas are crisp and golden brown about two minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,red potato,tomato green chile pepper,caster sugar,confectioner ' sugar,dijon mustard,golden raisin,liquid smoke
title: Potato Salad With Dijon
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 cup golden raisin | 2 -3 tablespoons good quality low-fat dijon mustard | 1/3 cup good quality liquid smoke | 3 -4 tablespoons reduced sodium castor sugar ( caster sugar ) | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon light-brown dijon mustard
instructions: Layer the potato slices with the tomatoes on top of the potatoes. Put the dark raisins in a small plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin or the tines of a table fork. To make the dressing, whisk together the mustard and sugar, until the sugar has dissolved. Slowly whisk in the dijon mustard and keep whisking. Just before serving, add the dressing to the potatoes. Serve warm.

title: Basic Poached Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups chicken, cut into 6 pieces | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 large chicken
instructions:
Add chicken pieces to the slow cooker. Sprinkle vanilla on top.
