    -. Cover and cook on low 4 - 5 hours or until chicken juices run clear. About 1 hour before serving time, remove chicken from slow cooker and set aside. Skim fat from soup and discard. Slice chicken into thin strips across the grain or use slices as garnish to garnish.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,apricot,coconut cream,miso paste,green chili pepper
title: Quick & Easy Microwave Thai Burritos
ingredients: 4 burrito-size flour tortillas or 4 large flour tortillas, for burritos | 2 teaspoons miso paste ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons soy sauce ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup dried apricot, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup coconut cream, whipped ( optional )
instructions: Heat a non stick griddle, or skillet over medium heat until a drop of water sizzles. Place one tortilla in the griddle at a time for approximately 30 - 60 seconds per side, flipping after about 10 seconds. Repeat with the other ingredients, adding more miso or soy sauce if desired. Transfer the hot griddle to a cutting board and cut into four wedges. Serve with cream, if desired, chopped fresh tomato, chopped green onions, or other accompaniments if desired.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pistachio nut,flat leaf parsley,nonstick cooking spray,water chestnut,cayenne pepper
title: Pistachio Crusted Chestnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 10 -12 fresh water chestnuts, halved, stemmed, caps cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil ( such as pam )
instructions: In a food processor, pulse pistachios with parsley and cayenne until mixture is coarsely chopped. Add water chestnuts a few at a time and pulse until the stuffing is finely ground. Spray 2 1/2 cup portions of an 8 inch skillet with nonstick cooking spray and add stuffing. Use a fork to pry chestnuts into the crumbs. Fry, stirring, until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chestnuts to paper towels to drain, retaining the cooking oil in the skillet. Sprinkle with extra virgin olive oil. Serve warm.

title: Artichoke-Prawn, Prawn and Vegetables Casserole
ingredients: 30 large cleaned prawns | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed | 20 ounces fresh mixed vegetables, cooked
instructions: In a skillet, heat the prawns with 1/4 cup of the sauce, just enough to coat the prawns, stirring occasionally, and saute them until they turn pink and curl away from the shell, about 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the size of the prawns. Put aside. Heat the artichoke hearts, and vegetables to the very end. Spread over the prawn mixture in the casserole. Cook in 375 degree oven for 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are soft. Serve on top of the casserole.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,kalamata olive,chicken wing,herbes de provence,red cabbage,green pea,pimiento,water
title: Crock Pot Chicken Wings With Olives, Pimentos & Coleslaw (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 3 cups red cabbage, sliced ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can chicken wings, frozen and thawed ( 2 1/2 lbs ) | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup green peas, frozen | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives, drained | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 3 1/2 cups water
instructions: Place cabbage in crockpot. Add chicken wings and next 7 ingredients except water. Cover. Cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Stir the vegetables until tender. Place liquid in measuring cup. Add water to equal about 1 cup liquid and pour over. Cover. Cook on high 20 - 30 minutes. Note, prep time does not include overnight resting in cool area.

title: Sizzlin' Hot Smoked Pork
ingredients: 2 kg smoked pork | 100 g yogurt ( lactose free ) | 1 teaspoon red food coloring ( mixed ) | 2 whole green chili peppers or 2 jalapeno chilies ( chopped and seeded ) | aluminum foil ( approx 1 inch to 3 inches in length )
instructions: Cut meat into small rounds and set aside. Put the red food coloring into the yogurt and mix well. Spray with a little milk and sprinkle with the food color on top. Mix gently with your hands, making sure the color spreads evenly. Put the meat pieces on a tray and set aside for about an hour or more. Heat up smoker and smoke the meat rounds for about 30 to 40 mins on a medium heat until they are light brown on all sides and well cooked. Put the meat onto a warmed dish, cover with foil and let it rest. In a different tray, put the chiles under the heat and cook them on an upper shelf for about 15 minutes to soften them slightly and give them color. It should take about 10 minutes for them to dry out and get browner. Add a little water towards the end, if the chiles are drying out. Enjoy.

title: Irish Cream Shredded Beef
ingredients: 6 lbs shrimps ( trimmed of excess fat ) or 6 lbs filet of beef ( trimmed of excess fat ) | salt | 5 tablespoons minced shallots | 10 fluid ounces chicken broth or 10 fluid ounces chicken broth | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f put the shrimps into a bowl of cold water and salt them and let them drain in the sink for 15 minutes, changing the water a few times. Place the shallots, chicken broth and cream into a 3 qt crockpot on the stove top, put the lid on the pot and put the temperature on and turn it to high. When the oven reaches 350°f, put the meat on a rack and put in the over, skin side down and put the meat on a baking tray skin side up. Bake it for 45 minutes, then turn the oven down to 300°f and bake for 2½ hours, or until the meat has a nice brown colour when you prick it with a fork. Shred the meat with two forks and put back into the gravy and serve.

Random Ingredients: coffee,cauliflower floret,anchovy paste,potato,lemon juice,marmalade,taco seasoning mix
title: Spiced Cauliflower & Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1 large potato, peeled and cut into four wedges lengthwise | 1 tablespoon grated lemon juice | 2 teaspoons low-fat coffee ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 425 g reduced-fat mascarpone cheese or 11 ounces vegan mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup strong coffee or 1/4 cup strong white wine
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Place cauliflower into an ovenproof dish, and sprinkle with lemon juice. Add all other ingredients and stir to combine. Roast for 40 - 45 minutes, stirring regularly until vegetables are tender, and sauce has reduced on the bottom. Allow to cool about 5 - 10 minutes, then serve as desired.

title: Easy Mexican Style Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken pieces, cut into pieces | 1 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can tomato juice | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Place the chicken pieces in a deep pan over medium heat, and cook them just until browned. Season with salt and pepper, then set aside to cool slightly. Place the ground beef and taco seasoning in a skillet, and cook and stir until evenly browned. Drain excess fat. Pour in the tomato and tomato juice, and simmer over medium heat until heated through. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sprinkle sugar in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and arrange the chicken pieces evenly in the dish. Pour the sauce over the chicken. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until sauce has thickened and turned a rich red color.

title: Cumin, Salt and Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 7 cups unsalted dry lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds
instructions: Combine cumin and cumin seeds to a small bowl, add to the bowl, cover to allow flavors to develop. Combine 2 c of cumin seeds and 2 t salt in a small skillet over medium high heat and toast cumin seeds, stirring constantly until the seeds give off a reddish-brown aroma, 3 - 5 minutes or until fragrant. Place a large bowl filled with water with a lid over top of the bowl. Bring water to a boil. Add noodles, and stir to coat evenly. Return to a boil, then remove from the heat. When noodles are cool, spread 1 1/2 tsp of cumin seeds on a dry towel. Sprinkle half of the dried basil over the 1/3 cheese mixture, place 5 noodles on top and sprinkle the rest of the basil on top. Roll up in the towel and refrigerate for 4 hours or up to an hour, tightly covered. To serve, place the unused noodles on serving plates, sprinkle with remaining cumin and serve with the cumin and remaining basil.

title: Chicken Parmesan With Cauliflower
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 head cauliflower, trimmed and cut into florets | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Place chicken in a large saute pan. Fill pan with water to cover chicken, cauliflower and cheese. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and simmer on medium low heat for 30 to 40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,cardamom pod,paprika,pork chop,shiitake mushroom
title: Persian Pork and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 large fresh mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 4 boneless pork chops, with bone
instructions: Spray large skillet with vegetable oil cooking spray. Heat over medium heat until hot.

Random Ingredients: apple,vegetable oil cooking spray,crouton,bell pepper,crabmeat,sea salt,marsala wine,white onion
title: Cracker Nests
ingredients: 1/2 lb crabmeat, picked over and shredded | 2 tablespoons chopped white onions | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar vermicelli, drained and rinsed well | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 cup crouton ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crabmeat, onion, bell pepper, and 1 tablespoon oil. Spray a large non stick skillet with cooking spray, and heat over medium high heat. Place noodles in a single layer in skillet, and cook, stirring, until golden, about 2 minutes. Turn noodles over, and continue cooking, pressing down on noodles with the spatula, until cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes. Top noodles with cooked crabmeat mixture, and serve warm.

title: Crispy Oat Cookie Dough
ingredients: 2 cups soft bread crumbs | 1 can refrigerated biscuit ( i have tried to use the 1 cup per pie crust size ) | 3/4 cup oats
instructions: Put the biscuit in a medium size bowl. Make sure they are well drained then add the softened biscuits. Mix well. Add the oats. Add more biscuit if needed. Knead the dough on a floured surface. Roll dough until small balls. Place on a floured cookie sheet. Flatten with a floured fork or use a floured rolling pin. Bake at 350 degrees for 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Italian Egg Tortellini Pie
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie shells | 1/4 cup prosciutto, chopped | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: In a bowl, combine prosciutto, garlic and egg.

Random Ingredients: salt,cod,lemon extract,chow mein noodle,extra virgin olive oil,poppy seed,cayenne powder,olive oil cooking spray
title: Korean Fried Cod and Chow Mein
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cod, cut into bite size chunks | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | salt, to taste | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon extract, to taste | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil, to taste | 1/4 cup chow mein noodles, chunji ( sweet potato noodles, may be found at most asian grocers ) | olive oil flavored cooking spray or other cooking spray
instructions: Rinse the cod and pat it dry with paper towels.  Place it in a large freezer bag or other shallow container.  Sprinkle the cayenne powder over the cod, close the seal and shake to coat well with the cayenne pepper.  Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.  Remove the cod from the bag, shake off any excess marinade and discard the cayenne spice bag.  Heat a large nonstick frypan or griddle over medium heat and add a couple tablespoons of olive oil.  Add the cod to the pan and cook to desired doneness.  While the fish is cooking, mix the reserved cayenne spice packet, 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds and a little water to form a dipping sauce using the water.  Serve fish with dipping sauce and chow mein noodles.  This recipe can also be prepared to this point up to 1 day in advance.  Cook the cod according to the directions on the packet.

title: Rosemary-Puerto Rican Gin Reduction
ingredients: 8 ounces gin | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 1 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary leaf | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan combine gin, brown sugar, vinegar, rosemary and anise seed.  Heat to boiling, then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes or until liquid is reduced and syrupy.  Serve over ice cubes.

title: Pear Brandy
ingredients: 20 cardamom seeds | 4 firm pears | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar
instructions: Put 2 tablespoons of sherry into a frying pan with the nuts, and toast them over a medium heat for about 3 - 5 minutes until they turn a pale golden brown colour.  Set aside.  Pour remaining sherry into the frying pan, and bring to the boil.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Slice the pear into thin slices, and add them all to the pan, and season with salt and pepper.  Return to the heat.  Heat gently, stirring until the sugar has dissolved.  Watch carefully.  Serve warm with cream and ice cream.

title: Faux Spring Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 spring onions or 4 -6 scallion tops | ground cardamom or cardamom pods
instructions: Peel the onions with an apple corer and cut into thin slices.  Place the onions into a frying pan with a large pot of water and a dash of ground cardamom/cardamom.  Keep adding little water if necessary.  Boil for 5 to 10 minutes.  The onions should be limp and cooked but not mushy.  Remove pan from fire and puree the soup in batches in a blender or food processor.  Add 1/2 cup water to adjust to taste.  Remove one cup of the soup and set aside for use as a condiment.  Strain the remaining soup through a sieve or colander and return to the frying pan.  Add the reserved soup back into the pot.  Toss in the scallions and serve.  This soup can also be used as an accompaniment to serve meat, chicken or seafood.

title: The Perfect Garlic Mint Scented Tea
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of fresh mint ( not the dried mint leaves, but fresh mint leaves only ) | 1 tablespoon fresh garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine mint leaves and garlic powder.  Pour into teapot or glass mug. .  Top with freshly cracked black pepper.  The mint is added now to flavor to give it a tangy flavor.

title: Coffee Carrots and Molasses Lasagna
ingredients: 3 heads baby carrots, peeled | 3 cloves garlic, peeled and lightly crushed | 1 container molasses | 8 lasagna noodles | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place carrots and garlic into a dutch oven or oven safe pan with just enough water to cover them.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, then bring to a full boil.  Cover the pan and transfer to the oven.  Cook until carrots are cooked but still slightly crunchy, and are tender when pierced with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes.  While the carrots are cooking, bring molasses and salt to a simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,cellophane noodle,oatmeal,orange peel,italian herb,plum tomato,tabasco sauce
title: Spanish-Style Skillet Oatmeal Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick oatmeal | 7/8 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb ( dried herbs, divided ) | 6 large leaves cellophane noodles | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1/2 orange peel, thinly sliced, for garnish
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.  Stir the oatmeal, picante sauce, plum tomatoes, italian herb, and 1/2 teaspoon of the seasoning mix in a bowl to blend.  Lightly coat a medium bowl with cooking spray, and spoon 1/6 of the noodle mixture into the bowl to coat.  Stir the eggplant into the bowl with the oatmeal mixture.  Season with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix, and spoon 1/6 of the picante sauce on top.  Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, fold the plastic wrap over, and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Remove the oatmeal from the refrigerator, and sprinkle with the sliced orange peel.  Serve with the remaining picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: feta,creme de cassis,spring onion,black mushroom,puff pastry,chili oil,topping
title: Miniature Mini Frozen French Fies
ingredients: 6 tablespoons creme de cassis or 6 tablespoons brie cheese, finely crushed | 150 g puff pastry ( thawed ) | 140 g frozen topping, thawed | 140 g frozen sourdough fetta ( thickly sliced ) or 180 g fresh mushrooms ( thickly sliced ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 spring onion, chopped to serve ( scallion ) | 100 g sliced black mushrooms ( capsicums ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: To make the creme de cassis, preheat oven to 200 degrees.  Grease 24 miniature muffin cups.  In a small bowl combine the cheeses.  Spoon equally into each cup.  Top each with an equal amount of the cheese filling from 3/4 of the pastry cup along the edge of each cup.  Using a 2 tablespoon pastry bag, pipe the filling and cheese into each cup.  Trim pastry bag ends and set aside.  Place the sourdough fetta, chives or spring onions, and 1 or 2 of the mushrooms in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.  Heat 1 teaspoon of the chilli oil in a small frypan, add the chopped spring onion or scallion and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until spring onion is tender.  Stir in reserved cheese.  Spoon remaining chilli oil from frypan.  Place 3/6 of the fritters, with their tops on top, on a greased oven tray, pressing gently, so as not to break.  Sprinkle with remaining fritter tops and bake for 3 - 10 minutes or until golden and crisp.  Serve warm.

title: Tofu Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium russet potatoes | 4 ounces tofu, cut into very small square pieces ( one per potato ) | 2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Coat the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray.  Bring a pot of water to a boil, then cut a slit in the side of the potatoes.  Drop in potatoes.  Cook 5 - 8 minutes, until potatoes are fork tender.  Drain.  Pat the potatoes dry with paper towels.  Mash potatoes.  While the potatoes are cooking, brown the tofu in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add to potatoes the cheese, tomato puree, and a sprinkling of salt.  Stir potatoes to combine, and remove mixture from heat.  Serve immediately.

title: Catalina Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup pancetta, diced | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/8 pound catfish fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Warm the pancetta in a skillet over medium heat.  Pour vinegar, honey, and cake flour into a bowl.  Cook and stir until the sugar has dissolved.  Cook and stir the catfish fillets in the hot liquid until the fish are hot and easily flaked with a fork, 5 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,ladyfinger,white bread,red pepper,cheesecloth,baby bok choy
title: Roasted Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted red pepper | 1/2 cup thinly sliced baby bok choy | 1/3 cup shredded cheesecloth | 3/4 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper ( optional ) | 20 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup shredded cheese cloth
instructions: Preheat oven and a few inches of oil in a large oven proof skillet over medium heat.  Add red pepper and baby bok choy.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,mexican corn,green cardamom pod,hing,wheat flour,cornflour,chocolate curl,ginger ale
title: Baked Veggie Chapati
ingredients: 2 green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons ginger ale ( can be left out or you may use 1/2 cup low fat yoghurt for a healthier option ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 cup mexican-style corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 teaspoon chocohole's honey or 1/2 teaspoon honey | chocolate curls, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius.  Place cardamom pods on baking paper lined oven trays and bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly coloured.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix all other dry ingredients.  Blend well.  Add egg, ginger ale, cornflour and bean sprouts to the dry ingredients and mix.  Divide the mixture and shape into 5mm thick patties.  Arrange on to parchment paper lined tray and bake for about 10 minutes each side, or until crispy.  Serve with chocohole's or honey.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,romaine lettuce heart,hot dog bun,rice wine,clear honey
title: Crunchy Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb sweet-spiced cooked rice ( i use basmati ) | 6 hot dogs buns | 1/2 cup cooking oats, not instant or presoaked | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Place all ingredients except rice wine into a bowl.  Break rice grains in half with a rolling pin, so both halves fit evenly.  Toss until well combined.  Spread rice over hot dog buns and top with dressing, if desired.  Let soften in the refrigerator.

title: Sherry Bananas
ingredients: 4 medium bananas or 4 medium bananas, peeled, cut in half | 4 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Put bananas on a buttered baking pan and bake, turning once or twice, for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned.  Add sherry and toss to coat.  Serve hot.

title: Sausage and Pear Strudel
ingredients: 12 links sweet italian sausage | 20 ounces phyllo pastry | 1 large fresh pear, peeled, cored and cut into small pieces | 1/4 purple onion, peeled and diced | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 - 1/2 cup rum ( optional, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon chopped sweet onion for topping
instructions: Heat skillet over medium heat.  Remove sausage from casing and brown in skillet.  Drain well on paper towels or cool.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a bowl, combine sausage, ¼ pound of pears, ¼ red onion, and ¼ cup rum.  Reserve ¼ cup of pears and onion for later use.  Layer a double layer of phyllo pastry into an 11x2 inch greased baking dish.  Pour reserved sausage and pear mixture over phyllo pastry.  Fold pastry over sausage mixture on top of the pie, then fold in half.  Make sure phyllo pastry is not tearing, just slightly overlapping with some of the pastry.  Using a sharp knife, score into 1 inch pieces, giving 3 pieces a lot of length.  Brush each pie with rum or extra rum.  Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until pastry is golden and pears are tender.  When ready to serve, add additional rum if desired.

title: Swedish Stuffed Beef
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 vanilla pod | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1 packet frozen whipped topping, thawed ( or cool whip, or vanilla whip.
    - ) | 1/4 cup sesame seeds or 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs ( or as preferred ) or 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( or as preferred )
instructions: Cut a pocket on each steak, near the bone, lengthwise.  Open out the center portion of the vanilla pod with a fork and scrape the seeds and seeds into a bowl.  Cut a thin slice from the top of vanilla pod and scrape out the inside of the pod, set aside.  Cut the meat into 5 pieces and place them between two sheets of wax paper, placing them into a bowl and using your hands, rub the meat with shortening.  Place two pieces of the vanilla and the seeds inside the vanilla pod in the cut up meat.  Stuff with the remaining 2 piece of meat.  Pour 1/4 cup of the cool whip or 1/4 cup of vanilla frosting over the meat.  Sprinkle with the sesame or poppy seeds.  Roll into a ball, pressing lightly to help.  Set the meat pieces on a tray and return to the freezer for at least 1 hour.  If freezing ahead, let sit in fridge for several hours to become firmer or more pliable.  Roll the meat again, then cut into 1 inch cubes.  Heat a skillet over moderate heat.  Add meat, without sauce, and when the surface is getting dry, pour in half of the sauce.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds or poppy seeds, the rest of the cool whip or sieved frosting, or just nuts.

title: Spinach with Chives and Chiles
ingredients: 7 ounces spinach ( about 1 bunch ) | 1 3/4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more to drizzle | 3 tablespoons chives, finely chopped
instructions: Put the spinach and 1/4 cup water in a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap, press the moisture out, and leave to steam for 10 minutes.  Unwrap and squeeze as much water as possible out of the spinach.  Wipe out the large pan with paper towels, heat the oil over medium high heat, then add the spinach, chives, and salt and black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,bean sprout,spaghetti sauce,process cheese sauce,yogurt,plum tomato,chive,chicken
title: Creamy Chive Crisped Fish
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets or ( 6 ounce ) tilapia fillets, 4 inch thick | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 3 tablespoons process cheese sauce | 2 cups plain yogurt ( thick is better ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 2 plum tomatoes, sliced or 2 jalapenos, sliced lengthwise | 1 cup fresh bean sprout | fresh chives, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan heat the tomato sauce.  Combine the cheese and chives and pour over the fish and marinate for 5 minute.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spray a large, shallow baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Spread yogurt evenly over the baking dish.  Bake for 15 minute.  Remove the fish from the baking dish and top with sauce.  Return to oven and bake for 15 minute.  Sprinkle with chives, if using, and serve.

title: Quick Veal Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fennel seeds | 1 1/2 lbs veal sirloin steaks, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3/4 cup beef broth | 1 can v8 vegetable juice, undiluted | table cream, to serve
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle the fennel seeds evenly over the surface and cook until a dark golden brown crust forms, about 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer the fennel to a plate and set aside.  Reduce the heat to medium.  Working with 1 piece of veal at a time, cook the sirloin, turning once, until browned, about 8 minutes per side.

title: Thai Green Beans & Shrimp
ingredients: 2 cans baby shrimp, drained and shelled | 4 ounces green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces ( i like to use frozen ) | 2 -3 teaspoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish.  Bake at 350 until shrimp are cooked about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,cake,beef sirloin steak,graham cracker crumb,cardamom,green bell pepper,green onion,grainy mustard
title: Beef Stuffed Bell Peppers(Afghanistan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 cup crumbs from crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°.

title: Fast Easy Ziti Baked With Tomato, Grape Tomatoes and Chicken
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs grape tomatoes, sliced or cans drained canned tomatoes, juice reserved | 3 1/3 cups ziti pasta or 3 1/3 cups similar long pasta, dry ( i prefer a tube ) | 1 chicken bouillon granules ( i've found that chicken flavored chicken flavored boullion cubes or a little packet of mccormick's )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Put a large, oven proof casserole dish in the oven as you are waiting for the dish to heat up.  If you're using canned tomatoes, dump them out into the bottom of the casserole dish they will keep the juice and heat in another pan.  If you're using canned tomatoes you don't need the juice as long as they are fresh and can be packed in their own juice.  If you want a slushy dish, add one bag of ziti and two bags of marinara, reserving about 3/4 to 1 for later.  Dump the contents of the casserole into the casserole dish and mix well.  If using a ziti, drain the ziti and combine with the other bag, reserving about 2/3 of the juice.  Put the rices into a small bowl.  You can keep some rices and any leftover rices in the bowl for later use.  Pour the reserved tomato juice into the casserole dish.  Add enough boullion cubes to just cover the tomatoes. .  Dump it all in the casserole dish.  Pour 2 cups of water into the bottom of the casserole dish and place the casserole dish into the oven as you prepare the rest.  Turn off the oven and open the door to the broiler.  Place the casserole dish under the broiler right side up in the oven. .  Cook for approx 25 - 30 minutes, until the dish is crusty.  Don't forget to stir it around.  You can also put the casserole dish under the broiler at the end of the cooking time to brown the top.  The ziti can be cooked in batches of 5 - 6 hours, by my experience the ziti is done as soon as it comes out of the oven.  I always do this.  If you use ziti which is packed in juice, that will take around 20 - 30 minutes.  It depends.  It's a good idea to take the casserole out of the oven after 5 - 6 minutes as the ziti is baking.  After tasting the ziti and adjusting the amount of chicken bullion, the tomatoes will be salty, so be careful when removing the tomato chunks from the can.  Strain the liquid into the dish and serve hot with parmesan or romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,red lentil,mexican cheese,red snapper fillet,bok choy,clove,onion soup mix,broth
title: Fish and Lentil Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups broth | 2 teaspoons onion soup mix, can use equivalent ( or 1-2 tablespoons dry ) | 3 whole cloves | 1/2 cup red snapper fillet or 1/2 cup cod, chunked | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped fresh tomato and green chilies ( canned is fine ) | 3 cups chopped bok choy ( or other greens ) | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese, can use more or less
instructions: Place the lentils in a large dutch oven or large saucepan, add enough water to cover, and bring to boiling.  Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes, until lentils are tender.  Drain and discard any excess water.  While lentils are cooking, combine broth, onion soup mix and cloves with the stock and bring to boil.  Add fish and simmer until fish is cooked through.  Add cooked lentils, tomatoes and chilies.  Simmer 2 minutes or until heated through.  Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,fine breadcrumb,mexican corn,ear corn cob,brandy,green onion
title: Mexican Grilled Corn on the Cob (Grilled Aspic)
ingredients: 4 ears corn on the cob, husked | 1 ounce fine breadcrumb | 1 ounce green onion, finely chopped | 1/2 ounce mexican style chorizo sausage, chopped | 1 ounce brandy | 4 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs, for dusting
instructions: Remove the corn from the cob and rinse under cold water.  Drain and dry thoroughly.  In a large bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, green onion, chorizo, brandy and salt and pepper to taste.  Add the corn and bread crumbs, mix well.  Heat an oiled grill pan over a medium hot fire. title: Indian Rangoon Eggs
ingredients: 6 ramekins, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 eggs white, beaten | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 12 ladyfingers, split lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried red chile | 6 slices ham | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Pour enough water into a large pot to yield 3/4 to 1 cup of water.  Bring to a boil and immerse ramekins into water.  Boil for about 2 minutes, then remove from heat and drain.  In a large bowl, combine egg whites, ginger paste, mango chutney and ladyfingers.  Toss ham slices with the ginger mixture.  Arrange a portion of the egg mixture on each ramekin, then top with a slice of ham.  Cover with another layer of egg mixture and continue layering and layering until they are all gone.  Top with red chile and remaining cream.  Refrigerate 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,italian pork sausage,yeast,water chestnut,daikon radish,seasoning salt,tart apple,hominy
title: Korean-Style Stewed Sweet Baked Sausages
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1 pound sweet italian pork sausage | 3 cans hominy, drained | 1 pound tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 cup diced aikon radish ( filipino-style ) | 1/4 cup chopped canned gingerroot | 3 cups rye flour | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 tablespoon instant yeast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the sausage in a large, deep skillet.  Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,courgette,lasagna noodle,pork shoulder,green olive,pimento pepper,green cardamom
title: Piggy Giouve  [ Hungarian Manti Gio]
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles | 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into fine pieces | 4 ounces pimento-stuffed green olives, with stem | 8 -10 green olives, with stems | 3 tablespoons pimento pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pimento-stuffed green cardamoms | 1/8 teaspoon green food coloring
instructions: To prepare the meat, put pork in a soup pot.  Cover with water.  When it comes to a boil, add salt & remove water immediately from heat.  Cover and boil, skimming the scum off the top as you do. .  Once all the meat has boiled, add the rest & cook over medium heat until the temperature is reduced by about one half.  To prepare olives, chop green olives in a food processor.  Put about 2 tablespoons of olives in the bottom of each lasagna noodle & spread them lightly using a spatula.  Next, place a layer of olives, followed by a layer of meat, then a layer of paprika.  Continue in this pattern, layering olives, meat and olives ending with a layer of olives.  Sprinkle black pepper over the top.  Top each dish with a piece of pimento stuffed green olive.  Cut the lasagna into slices and serve with sour cream, yogurt or sour cream sauce or my ggoskate.  We have also made this with the parma deen.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,tamarind paste,black peppercorn,french bread,beef stock,lasagna noodle,coriander seed
title: Noodle Brik
ingredients: 2 liters beef stock | 400 g fresh lasagna noodles | 200 g green peppers, chopped | 300 g french bread, sliced lengthways | 6 dashes black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Boil the stock.  Add the green pepper and simmer for 20 minutes, drain.  Soak the noodles in hot water for 10 minutes, drain.  Put the cooked noodles in a large bowl and pour boiling hot stock over.

title: Blueberry, Zucchini and Sage Smoothies
ingredients: 300 g green zucchini, sliced | 100 g blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup sultana | 50 g grapefruit juice, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender with 2/3 cup of water and pulse a few times until well combined & slushy.  Scoop into a small glass bowl & drizzle with remaining juice, cover and chill until required.

title: Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 6 ounces vinegar | 1 tablespoon crushed garlic or 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions.  Drain and allow to cool slightly then stir in the rest of the ingredients.  Serve immediately or store covered in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Easy Microwave Blush!
ingredients: 2 ounces vanilla instant pudding mix, vanilla powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup brandy or 1/4-1/2 cup rum | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir well to combine.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours and up to 8 hours before serving if using.  If desired, remove the lid about 2/3 of the way up on an individual serving plate.  Spoon some of the mixture onto a serving dish and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,onion,grape tomato,white button mushroom,dressing,napa cabbage,margarita mix,beef stew meat
title: Easy Slow Cooker Thai Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 3/4 inch pieces, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 large onion, cut into thick half rings and separated | 2 cups napa cabbage, sliced as thinly as possible | 1 package white button mushrooms ( can also use fresh if no fresh mushrooms available ) | 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 package nippy size salad dressing | soya sauce ( optional ) | napa cabbage head, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Combine beef, onions, napa cabbage, and mushrooms in crock pot.  Prepare salad dressing using the directions as pkg.  On the side of the salad dressing.  Pour over the top.  Cook on lo heat for 8 to 10 hours or on hi heat for 4 to 5 hours.  You may add a dash of soya sauce or toasted sesame oil if you like.  I use no soya sauce, though.  Serve over noodles and garnish with napa cabbage leaves.

Random Ingredients: tea,saffron thread,beef stew meat,egg noodle,chili paste,flax seed,water
title: Beef Patties in Saffron Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground flax seed | 2 cups boiling water | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup strong tea | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 2 eggs, beaten | 8 ounces dried egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In small bowl, combine flaxseed and boiling water.  Let stand one hour.  In 12 inch skillet, brown stew meat on all sides.  Pour off liquid.  Combine tea, chili paste and 1/2 cup cold water in 1 cup measuring cup.  Pour into skillet with meat.  Cover.  Simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, stirring occasionally.  In medium bowl, combine eggs and remaining 1/2 cup water.  Add to meat in skillet.  Cook and stir until thick.  Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb firm cheese | 1/2 cup nam pla | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard with parmigiano reggiano cheese.  With a hand mixer, add mustard and cheese in the order recommended by the manufacturer.  Mix for 10 - 15 minutes.  Serve with fresh bread slices, crackers, or assorted veggies.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,bean sprout,onion powder,pecan,sea salt,escarole
title: Mexican Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts | 1 -2 hot scotch bonnet pepper ( optional ) | 1 small onion ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon sea salt ( or kosher salt ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried shrimp ( optional ) or 3/4 teaspoon dried shrimp ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon pecan pieces ( optional )
instructions: Wash the bean sprouts and remove the top layer of stems.  Rinse the sprouts with warm water and dry on paper towels.  Chop the scotch bonnet very fine and add it to the sprouts.  If the onion has the option of using the scotch bonnet, add it here also.  Slice the pepper into 1/2 inch thick strips.  In a large bowl, combine the sprouts, pepper strips, onion, and seafood if desired.  Season to taste with salt.  Mix in pecan pieces just before serving.  If serving cold, toss well and chill thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,wild blueberry,red thai chile,phyllo dough,penne rigate
title: Tilapia Fillets With Bleached Blueberries Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 1 box penne rigate | 1 can wild blueberries | 2 tablespoons red thai chiles | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 package fresh phyllo dough, sheets
instructions: Cook penne rigate as directed on package, omitting salt.  Meanwhile, combine blueberries and chillies in small bowl.  Drain tilapia fillets on paper towels, then blot with fork.  Dredge tilapia in phyllo, then coat with phyllo.  Lightly spray a large baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange tilapia fillets in dish, and brush fish with lemon juice.  Cover, set aside for 15 minutes.  Boil penne and blueberries as directed on package, then remove from heat.  In a small dish combine 1 package of phyllo dough into small ball, then lightly coat with cooking spray.  Place thawed pasta onto a baking sheet, making sure sheets are well coated on both sides.  Cover, and stack thawed pasta sheets in a dish.

title: Homemade Chile Brownie Mix
ingredients: 3 pounds sausages | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, or as needed | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  Arrange the sausages in a large baking dish with enough boiling water to cover.  Cover, and bake sausages 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Drain, and cool completely.  Pour cocoa powder into a bowl, and set aside.  Pour worcestershire sauce into the remaining water, and bring to a simmer.  Pour into pan with cocoa, and stir until smooth.  Cover, and refrigerate 4 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,graham cracker crumb,chunky salsa,mexican cheese,ginger,tomato sauce,green cardamom,red kidney bean
title: Mexican Pork and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 4 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into thin strips | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup miniature graham cracker crumbs | 1 medium green cardamom, crushed, seeds removed | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine pork strips, salsa, kidney beans with liquid, tomato sauce and cracker crumbs.  Spread in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Bake for 45 minutes or until heated through.  Sprinkle with cardamom seeds.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Smoked Salmon from Scratch
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked salmon | cloud ear mushrooms, soaked for about 15 minutes
instructions: Drain the salmon, and cut into slices.  Wash and lightly dry the mushrooms.  Fry a slice of smoked salmon in a little bit of oil.  After a couple of minutes, pour over mushrooms.

title: Italian Sausage and Black Peas
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausages | 1/2 pound dried black-eyed peas | 1 bunch fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and brown the sausages for about 10 minutes.  Stir in the peas and basil.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,sauce,poultry seasoning,apricot,sesame seed,cheese tortellini,orange marmalade
title: Holiday Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 1 cup chopped dried apricots | 2/3 cup orange marmalade or 2/3 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 4 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 teaspoons steak seasoning ( mccormick's )
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Place tortellini in a large mixing bowl, pour marmalade over, and toss to coat.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cover and chill 1 hour or overnight before serving, or serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,cream,yellow squash,cider vinegar,fava bean,asafoetida powder
title: Kari Udang Koori
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fava beans | 5 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 lb yellow squash | 7 tablespoons light fish sauce | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons cream
instructions: Peel and cut 1/2 the yellow squash into small pieces.  Put water on to boil in a saucepan.  In a strainer, place the fava beans and mash them with the back of the spoon.  Add the cider vinegar, cover and set aside.  Dice the remaining squash into small cubes.  Add the cubes to the kari, cover and simmer for about 50 minutes until the beans are cooked.  To test for doneness, take a small piece of kari and test it with a fork.

title: Puerto Rico Flavoured Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut rum | 2 teaspoons hot water
instructions: Place the coconut rum and hot water in a heat proof glass measure or small bowl.  Pour the mixture over medium heat and heat until bubbles form, about 1 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,cilantro leaf,rye bread
title: Faux Faux Bread
ingredients: 1 green pepper ( capsicum ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 loaf rye bread | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Cut up the tops of the peppers and slice each vertically into four equal pieces.  Place on baking tray or baking paper.  Coat with cooking oil.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.  Garnish with chopped cilantro leaves.  Serve hot with german fries.

title: Duck & Eggplant Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 eggsplants, peeled & cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 pint canned duck, drained and flaked | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3/4 cup minced onion | 1/3 cup pico de gallo | 12 whole wheat tortillas | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked eggplant ( about 6 to 8 cups )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine eggsplant with duck, sherry and onion.  In a 10 inch skillet, heat the tortillas over moderately high heat for 30 seconds, switching the pans occasionally, until the tortillas are softened.  Working with one tortilla at a time, dip it into the eggplant mixture, then transfer to a plate.  Repeat process with the remaining tortillas, eggplant and duck filling.  Spoon about 1/2 cup of the mixture into each tortilla, roll and arrange them in an 11 by 7 inch baking dish.  Brush the tops of the enchiladas with the remaining duck glaze, then bake the enchiladas, uncovered, in a 400f degree oven for 18 minutes, or until the tortillas are golden.  Serve the enchiladas hot, passing the cheese and salsa at the table.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup oil for frying ( such as grapeseed or sunflower )
instructions: In a medium heatproof bowl, mix molasses, cream and canola oil.  Microwave on high for 2 minutes, or until warm to the touch.  Stir constantly while heating.  Add more cream if needed.  To prevent boiling, cover bowl and return to microwave.  Microwave on high for 30 seconds at a time, stirring frequently, until thickened.  Do not let it boil.

title: Mexican Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons mayonnaise | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 12 slices imitation crab-style seaweed
instructions: Cook spaghetti over medium heat according to package directions.  In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise and oregano.  Add bean sprouts, peanut butter and crab style seaweed to spaghetti.

title: Toucinho
ingredients: 6 large potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place potatoes in a single layer in a large roasting pan, and cover the pan with a lid or a kitchen towel.  Turn on oven to 450 degrees f.  Bake potatoes for 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown, and tender.  Drain off any excess liquid.  Sprinkle with orange zest, and serve hot with a side of creme fraiche, such as orange juice, cream, or ice cream.

title: Gruyere Cheese Mondi
ingredients: 1/2 lb gruyere cheese | 1 carrot
instructions: Peel the carrot by cutting it in half lengthways and then down to it.  You'll find it eventually going from the core to the outside of the carrot.  Cut the carrot into very small pieces.  Put the grated cheese into the mortar and pestle, a little bit of fine grated rind, and mix with a fork.  Mold the mixture into a ball like shape, about the size of a walnut.  Wrap the cheese around the carrot pieces, pressing firmly, and then cover with plastic wrap.  Leave to stand for about 8 to 10 hours, shaking the carrot a couple of times.  The cheese should be soft and tender but not fully melted.  Serve as is or with any meat dish.

title: Crumbled Fresh Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 medium roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped fine | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup grated freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( or parmesan )
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a skillet.

title: Lazy Tongues (Spicy Tongues)
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | cooking onions or other chopped onion | 2 -3 cans pork fat, heated
instructions: Wash the tongue well, inside and out.  Place the tongue at the bottom end of a deep platter, or in the center of a large piece of platter with overlapping edges.

title: Italian Dried and Sticky Toffee
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pitted dates, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Place dates and vinegar in a heavy bottomed non reactive saucepan over medium heat.  Cook until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain nuts, and return all ingredients to pan.  Stir to combine evenly.  Cool to room temperature, then sprinkle with additional toasted or coarsely chopped nuts.  Store up to 2 days.  The toffee can last up to 2 weeks.  Refrigerate unused portions.

title: Cheese Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 box rice noodles, any flavor | 6 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook rice noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 6 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a greased 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Stir cheese into the noodles.  Toss the mixture until coated with the cheese.  Spread evenly into the baking dish and let stand in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.  Cut and serve.

title: Blueberry and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 lb fresh blueberries, rinsed and picked over
instructions: Stir together the tomato sauce and season salt and pepper.  Place 1 whole blueberry on each plate.  Spoon with 1/4 a cup of the sauce onto the berries.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cumin powder,pecan half,pear,ice water,red chile powder,yeast,kale
title: Fruit and Nut Kale Venn-Bread
ingredients: 1/4 ounce yeast | 2 1/2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon dried red chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2/3 cup pecan halves, toasted | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 can kale, drained | 1/3 cup pecan halves, toasted
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water.  Combine chile powder and cumin in another bowl.  Add to yeast mixture, pecans, water chestnuts and kale.  Stir until just blended and mixed.

Random Ingredients: chicken base,salmon fillet,angostura bitter,amaretto,salt pepper,shell pasta,ginger
title: Ginger-Scented Salmon Pasta With Spicy Amaretto Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces frozen small shell pasta ( capelli ) | 1/3 cup amaretto | 1/4 cup orange light glaze or 1/4 cup dark bitter flavored liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon salt & pepper | 1/4 teaspoon chicken base ( optional ) | 1 boneless skinless salmon fillet, cut crosswise 1/2 inch thick
instructions: In a large skillet large enough to hold salmon fillets, heat amaretto, orange liqueur, ginger, salt, pepper and chicken base over medium heat.  Simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.  Add salmon and cook through.  Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,salmon,red food coloring,red chili powder,garam masala,granny smith apple
title: Chilled Moroccan Salmon Appetizer
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces salmon, cut into 6 equal portions | 2 medium granny smith apples, peeled and sliced into 4 parts | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon red food coloring | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Put the salmon in a medium bowl and mash it with a fork to achieve desired thickness.  Place the apples into another medium bowl.  Sprinkle the chili powder and food coloring over them and set aside.  Place the curry powder and garam masala in a small mixing bowl and mix well.  Dip each salmon piece in the curry powder mixture and coat each piece of salmon with the curry powder mixture.  Let chill in the refrigerator for approximately 20 minutes or until salmon is firm.  Heat the grill.  Oil the grill with cooking oil.  While oil is heating, put the pineapple slices onto the grill.  Cook until they soften and turn a nice golden brown color.  Arrange each salmon piece on a warm serving dish.  Pour the hot curry mixture over the fish.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple Cinnamon Muffin Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 leaves lettuce
instructions: Mix apple juice, apple juice, baking soda, and cinnamon together in a bowl.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise
ingredients: 6 egg yolks, at room temperature | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Whisk together all the ingredients.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Hot Vritika
ingredients: 8 tablespoons hot paprika or 1 - 1 1/4 cup paprika | 1 cup white vinegar
instructions: To prepare, heat in coffee/spice coffee cup for 1 - 2 minutes or until hot.  Remove coffee/spice coffee cup from coffee/spice coffee cup and let cool.  Place in a blender jar and process until all the liquid is extracted and processed.  Measure liquid and measure into a cup and stir or shake until liquid is reduced by half.  Add vinegar to reduction in the coffee/spice coffee cup and whisk to mix.  If you are intending to use this as a dip for meat, you can dip in the mixture now or proceed.  Dry meat of choice is a good accompaniment.

title: Artichokes With Artichokes (Saliago)
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 cup corn oil ( or other oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f.  Combine the artichoke hearts and about 1 cup water in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: red pasta sauce,chinese five spice powder,cod fish fillet
title: Cafe Rio Steak
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 jar red pasta sauce, such as ragu
instructions: Rub steaks with five spice powder.  Heat a nonstick frying pan on high heat.  Place fish on the prepared pan.  Pour half the contents of 1 jar of red sauce into it.  Cook on both sides on medium high heat for approximately 4 - 5 minutes or until fish is cooked through and sauce has reduced.  Turn after 2 minutes and cook for 3 - 5 minutes more, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,rom tomato,yellow pea,orange zest,dijon mustard
title: Pease Celery Peas With Tomatoes and Dijon
ingredients: 1 lb yellow split peas | 1 lb roma tomato, in 1/2 inch pieces | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: If using split peas, add them to a saucepan of boiling water.  Cook, covered, over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender.  Drain and cool.  Stir in all the ingredients.  Season to taste, with salt and pepper.

title: Baked Teriyaki Marinated Zucchini
ingredients: 2 medium oranges, washed, peeled and cut into 2-inch long wedges | 6 tablespoons teriyaki marinade | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Arrange the zucchini wedges in the pan, and spray each wedge lightly with teriyaki marinade.  Bake for about 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until done, turning once or twice.

title: Auntie Theresa's Spicy Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup chocolate chips | 5 tablespoons baking powder | 2 lbs chipits chocolate chips ( roughly 8 or 10 large cookies ) | 6 whole pints apples, peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 500 ml vanilla beans, cut in half
instructions: Melt all 3 ingredients together in a double boiler with a cover on over simmering water.  Stir once in a while.  Stir in the marjoram.  Pour into a cookie press fitted with a diameter about 1 1/2 inches thick.  Set the cookie press into a baking dish and fill the rest with warm water.  Refrigerate for 15 minutes.  Use a fork to break off a portion and run across the edge of the cookie press.  Use a small ice cream scoop or 2 smaller ice cream scoop on one side of the cookie.  Then remove that scoop onto the baking plate with the cookie.  Let cool completely, then remove the cookie with a spatula and serve.  They keep in an airtight container for up to 1 year.

title: Raisins and Roasted Red Leaf
ingredients: 1 small red leaf lettuce, washed and dried | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup cottage cheese, drained
instructions: Tear off a large handful of the leaves from the top and place in one bowl along with the dried fruits.  Use a salad spinner or kitchen scissors to squeeze out the moisture.  Place the raisins into a dry sauté pan to toast over medium heat.  When the raisins have softened, stir in the cottage cheese.  Cover and reduce heat to medium and cook for about 5 minutes or until the cottage cheese is just beginning to turn golden and bubble.

Random Ingredients: catsup,broccoli floret,white pepper,confectioner sugar,tomato green chile pepper
title: Connie's Broccoli and Hot Chile
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli florets | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon catsup | white pepper to taste | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the broccoli and return to a boil.  Cook the broccoli uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Bring the tomatoes and green chiles to the boiling skillet, pour in the catsup, and pour in the beans and broccoli.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the hot chiles are tender, about 30 minutes.  While the vegetables are simmering, stir the confectioners' sugar into the hot sauce.  Once the vegetables are tender and the sauce is hot enough to coat the back of a spoon, spoon servings onto toasted french or italian bread or muffins.  This recipe can also be served hot.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,soya sauce,vegetable,grain bread,vegetable shortening,almond extract,paprika,anchovy paste
title: Grilled French Fries
ingredients: 3 cups vegetables ( cut into 2 inch fries ) | 1 cup vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 2 teaspoons coarse grain bread | 1 teaspoon pure hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon pure english mustard | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the bread and blend well.  On the griddle or broiler, cook the french fries for 9 to 10 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: angel food cake,brown sugar,kidney bean,turmeric,focaccia bread,soya sauce,red pepper flake
title: Easy Baked Bean Bread
ingredients:
1 cup dried kidney bean | 2 cups chopped focaccia bread | 1/2 cup soya sauce ( i prefer kikkoman.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons focaccia bread
instructions: Soak beans overnight in water to cover, then drain.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Pour boiling water over soaked beans and soak at least two hours, or overnight.  Remove beans, reserving soaking liquid.  Combine all other ingredients in a casserole dish.  Add soaked beans.  Stir.  Bake uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes.  It will be dry and crumbly.  Serve with bread slices.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,green cardamom pod,dijon mustard,cauliflower,cannellini bean
title: Mexican Coliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, ends trimmed | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to medium low and cook, covered, for about 45 minutes.  Stir often to avoid burning.

title: Chinese Noodles with Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut into chunks | 1 package japanese egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup chinese rice wine dipping sauce ( kikkoman )
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water 1 minute, drain.  Toss noodles with dipping sauce.  Arrange in 4 quart casserole.  Cover and bake at 350°f 50 minutes.

title: Couscous for 2 - 4 People
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c.  Use a fork, or fork or whisk until the couscous is just covered in small lumps.  Whisk the egg white through the sultanas and lemon pepper and pour over the couscous.  Stir to combine.  Divide into 4 smaller serving bowls, or shape the rest of the mixture into balls.  Place in hot oven and bake around 10 - 15 minutes, until the tops are golden.

Random Ingredients: butter,wine vinegar,grain rice,flour tortilla,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Rice Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 cup short-grain rice | 12 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix melted butter, vinegar and rice together.  Spread evenly on tortillas, then sprinkle each with cheese.  Place 2 inches from griller and bake, covered, for 3 minutes or until cheese melts and bubbles.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tart apple,green tea powder maccha,raisin,spicy sausage
title: Cape Apple and Smoky Sage Spud
ingredients: 8 tablespoons prepared green tea powder ( maccha ) | 6 cups diced tart apples | 4 cups spicy sausage, crumbled | 3 cups raisins | ice cube, for serving
instructions: To make the syrup, bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil.  Add the green tea powder and return to a boil.
