Add 1 cup of marinara sauce to the potatoes.  Make sandwiches with remaining 1 cup of marinara sauce, bread rounds, and potato cubes.  Place in preheated oven.  Bake uncovered for approximately 30 minutes, or until potatoes are just starting to turn crisp.  Garnish hot mustard potatoes with marinara sauce if desired.  Burgundy wine mustard potatoes, remove french bread from its crust and tear apart.  Using a fork or fingers or a cheese plane, mash up the french bread slightly.  Stir into potato mixture as you would for french bread with the sweet pound cake slices.  Spoon the prepared mustard potatoes into a baking dish and bake in preheated 450 degree oven for approximately 15 minutes, or until heated through.  To serve, if using a small casserole dish that is just larger than the baking dish, spoon the mustard potato mixture onto the french bread slices.  Use the large slices to make sandwiches.

title: Mushroom Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 container firm tofu, drained and cubed | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cubed | 1 pound small cremini mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 16 sheets gumbo bases
instructions: Place tofu, cucumber, mushrooms, and sugar in a resealable plastic bag.  Squeeze out excess moisture, but leave some of the tofu.  Lay 6 sheets of gumbo bases on a flat surface.  Arrange tofu block on the gumbo bases on top.  Fold sides in over the tofu, and press edges firmly to seal.  Repeat until all tofu has been used.  Bake tofu block at 350 degrees f in the preheated oven until set, about 30 minutes.

title: Quick Bread Sammies
ingredients: 12 slices sourdough bread | 6 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.  Place the bread on the baking sheet and set aside so the bread can dry up.  In a small bowl, mix the sriracha hot sauce and olive oil until well combined.  Spread a small amount of the sriracha hot sauce onto one side of the bread, then top with another slice of the bread.  Dip a second bread slice in the sauce and then lightly brush it with more of the sauce.  Cook the sammies in the preheated oven 3 to 5 minutes, or until golden brown on the bottom and edges.

title: Farfalle with Prawns and Capers
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons rum or 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 18 medium prawns ( green unripe ) | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 cup white chocolate, cut in thin pieces | 12 whole capers
instructions: Boil farfalle in salted water until al dente, about 7 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  While farfalle is cooking, combine prawns with remaining ingredients except capers.  Mix all ingredients together until smooth and set aside until needed.  Toss with prawns.

title: Jicama and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 large jicama, peeled and cut into small matchsticks | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/390f/gas toss the jicama in the sugar.  Arrange onto a lined baking tray.

title: Kerry's Irish Potato Crostini
ingredients: 1 french bread | 2 large baking potatoes ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 2 zucchini, sliced | 6 kalamata olives, sliced | 1 1/2 cups irish cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut a deep pocket into the crust of the french bread.  Rinse the insides of the bread with cold water.  Cut the bread in half lengthwise.  Slice the halves into 1/2 inch slices and set aside.  Cut the potatoes into 6 to 8 wedges and place in a roasting pan.  Cut the zucchini into 1/2 inch slices.  Place the sliced vegetables in a single layer over the bread.  Pour the irish cream all over the bread and vegetables.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until the potatoes are tender and beginning to brown.  Cool to warm, about 15 minutes.  Slice the crostini.  Serve the crostini with the potato bread mixture.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,topping,white wine vinegar,taco sauce,orange zest,icing sugar
title: Taco Pastries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange zest, grated | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/4 cup taco sauce ( preferably low-sodium ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 pinch kosher salt and pepper | 12 1/2 ounces prepared fat-free topping, thawed if frozen
instructions: Spray an 11 x 7 inch baking pan with a nonstick spray.  Combine the orange zest, icing sugar, taco sauce, vinegar and salt and pepper to taste in a small bowl.  Using an electric mixer, beat on high speed until well combined and smooth, about 3 minutes.  Spread the pastry out on a cutting board and cut into 16 strips.  Cut a slit in each strip of pastry and fill with the orange spread.  Wrap and place in foil.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,flax seed,apple juice,poppy seed,salt,fruit,beef brisket,egg white
title: Crispy Corned Beef on the Cob for the Grill
ingredients: 2 corned beef brisket | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup ground flax seeds | 1/2 cup poppy seed | 6 egg whites | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon apple juice | candied fruit ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Wrap corned beef tightly with a double thickness of butcher's twine and place on a rack in a roasting pan and roast in a preheated oven of 350 f for 35 - 40 minutes, until the meat is tender and easily pierced with the tip of a knife.  In a large bowl, beat the egg whites with salt, apple juice, and poppy seeds until stiff peaks form.  Fold the egg whites into the yolk mixture, then stir in the flour until well mixed.  Drain the corned beef and spread onto a work surface.  Tear off small pieces of the meat, about 2 inches in diameter, and roll each in the flour mixture to coat.  Heat a cast iron skillet and cook rolled corned beef slices, 2 at a time, over moderately high heat, turning frequently, until crisp and brown, about 8 minutes.  Transfer to a warm platter and let stand, covered with foil, for a few minutes, then slice into about 1/4 inch slices on the bias.  Reheat gravy.

title: Sausage & Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 4 cups fresh broccoli | 2 cans sauerkraut | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Brown sausage and drain.  Cut broccoli into small florets.  Put all ingredients in large pot and bring to boil.  Cover and simmer for about 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Walnut Pepper Haystack
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers, with tops, thinly sliced or 6 large pimiento-stuffed green bell peppers | 3 ounces walnuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons cilantro leaves, chopped | 8 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Spray jelly roll pan with cooking spray.  Arrange bell peppers in overlapping rows on sheet of waxed paper.  Spread nuts over peppers.  Sprinkle with cilantro.  Dot with butter.  Cover and chill 2 hours.  Spread with pepper mix, if using jelly roll pan, and chill at least 8 hours, covered.  Cut into 10 equal sections.  Place each pepper on waxed paper, cut side down, and cover it with foil.  Cook 30 minutes at 300°f until very dry and crisp. .  Remove foil and turn peppers over.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,red lentil,chick pea,picante sauce,pea,habanero hot sauce
title: Mexican Red Lentil and Peas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons habanero hot sauce, or more to taste | 1 cup red lentils, rinsed | 1 green pepper, sliced | 1 can chick-peas, drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 cup peas, fresh, frozen, thawed
instructions: Place the hot sauce in a small bowl.

title: Tomato Asparagus and Asparagus
ingredients: 300 g fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1/8 cup tomato puree
instructions: Steam asparagus 2 - 3 minutes, or until tender.  Meanwhile, heat tomato puree in a small saucepan over medium heat, stir for 1 - 2 minutes or until sauce thickens.  Pour over asparagus.  Toss to coat with tomato purée.

title: Tunisian Queso for Cheese, Bread, and Meat Lovers
ingredients: 12 slices gouda cheese ( about 4 oz, use a thick flavored cheese like velveeta ) | 6 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium high heat until just warm.  Add the 4 oz cheese and cook, turning once for about 5 minutes, until it begins to form a crunly, melted crumb.  Remove from the heat and stir in the chopped parsley.  Serve hot.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 2 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Place mushrooms in a small bowl.  Add bread crumbs.  Knead until smooth.  Cover and let rest 30 minutes.  Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium heat until hot.  Pat mixture dry with paper towels.  Using 2 tablespoons, form 1 inch diameter spätzle into a circle about 1/8 inch thick and 2 inches wide.  Cook spätzle, one at a time, over medium heat until bubbles appear, about 1 minute per side.  Transfer with tongs to a plate.  Cook spätzle in hot pan 2 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from pan.  Serve immediately.

title: Greek Olive Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/3 cup uncooked rice powder | 1/3 cup ground dill | 1/3 cup packed chopped fresh tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1 large lime, juiced, or to taste | 1/2 pound shell pasta
instructions: Toss the rice and dill together with the tarragon, garlic powder, and tarragon in a bowl.  Add olive oil in a slow, steady stream while whisking to create a loose, even consistency.  Stir in the lime juice.  In a large pot of boiling water, add pasta and cook until al dente, about 7 minutes.  Drain and return pasta to the pot.  Transfer mixture to a cookie sheet.  Chill in the refrigerator.

title: Easy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 box hash brown potatoes ( plain potatoes please, not instant ) | 1 jar marshmallows | 1 container mascarpone | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Prepare the potatoes, in l grease your potato ricer, place the potatoes in the bowl, mix.  Dice the marshmallows and place them in the bowl.  Add the mascarpone and mix.  Add the vanilla essence mix the potatoes, pour into the potato ricer.  Place and repeat until potatoes are full.  Press the mixtur and then press flat.  Place in a pan of water in low heat for 45 minutes.  Once the mixtur is absorbed, remove it from the water heat it again.  Place plastic wrap on the inside of the bowl and invert bowl onto it.  Take it off and place in refrigerator for an hour to harden the mixtur.  Remove plastic wrap, cut off a corner and place back on top of bowl.  Enjoy.

title: Lamb Shank
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb shoulder, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 cup corn flakes, toasted | 1/2 cup double cream ( or double cream ) | hamburger bun
instructions: Combine lamb, corn flakes, cream, and salt and pepper to taste as this is one of those dishes which is very lean lamb.  If a larger amount is required, stir to break meat into small pieces.  Grill or grill lamb until desired doneness, browning lightly and tender.  Serve on burger buns.

title: Swiss Turnips and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 can sweetcorn, drained, rinsed and sliced | 4 large pitted cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 3 cups hot cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Place turnips and sweetcorn in a 2 quart baking dish.  Top with tomatoes, dividing evenly.  Cover with cheeses and bake about 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Smoky Nopales (Lighter Version)
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 2 cups clam juice | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tomato, and the juice plus 1/3 cup | 20 snipped nopales
instructions: In a large bowl combine clam juice, tomato sauce, chilies, orange peel and orange juice and heat gently, but do not boil.  When mixture starts to bubble, add nopales.  Serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,fettuccine,caraway seed,chickpea,almond,kosher salt,mini chocolate chip,hazelnut
title: Citrus Fettuccine Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 13 ounces canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup low sodium chicken stock | 4 ounces mini chocolate chips | 6 ounces fettuccine, cooked | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup almonds, chopped
instructions: Roast caraway seeds over high heat in a nonstick skillet about 4 inches from heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Place chickpeas in a blender and grind until fine.  Add stock and blend until smooth.  Stir in chocolate chips and fettuccine noodles.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, until fettuccine is heated, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with salt, and toss to combine.  Sprinkle with hazelnuts and almonds.  Serve immediately.

title: Quick Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups of sliced button mushrooms | 1 -2 slice bread
instructions: Lay mushroom slices on toast.  Spread with olive or butter and sprinkle with pepper.  Put in preheated oven until cooked.  Enjoy.

title: Sherry and Ricotta Cheese on Phyllo
ingredients: 3 sheets thawed phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup sherry wine, chilled and heated
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a waxed paper lined baking sheet.  Smooth the top with a spatula or knife, and brush the phyllo with a little olive oil.  Repeat with the other sheet of phyllo.  Spread 1/3 of the ricotta on top of the phyllo.  Top with another sheet, brushing with olive oil.  Top with remaining phyllo, brushing with olive oil.  Slice the phyllo sheets crosswise into 3 or 6 strips.  Place on a baking sheet, brush with oil, and sprinkle with sherry.  Broil until golden, about 5 minutes.

title: Simple Low Fat Homemade Cream
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil.  When it is simmering reduce heat.  Simmer slowly, covered, for 15 minutes.  Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Truffles from the Rose Restaurant
ingredients: 2 ounces kahlua | 6 ounces arugula | salt and pepper | raspberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve on cracker.  Garnish to personal taste.

title: Grand Marnier Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled | 1 bottle grand marnier | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 1/2 cups hot water
instructions: Scrub potatoes.  Remove excess moisture from outside of russet potatoes and boil in a pot of salted water, about 15 minutes, or until soft but not mushy.  Cool and pat dry.  Slice potato into 1/4 slices.  Toss sliced potatoes with remaining ingredients except for the water.  Place in large serving bowl.

title: Crows and Vermicelli - Vegetable Medley from Great Northern Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cm piece marinated courgettes ( courgettes is best ) | 1 small red cabbage, diced | 4 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch can be used ) | 300 g vermicelli, broken into 1cm lengths | 1 1/4 liters marinara sauce | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Place the courgettes, cabbage and vermicelli into a large bowl and gently mix.  Then add the cornflour and mix.  Heat the marinara sauce in a saucepan and slowly stir in the honey.  Pour over the vegetables and toss gently.  Serve with a fresh bread and a salad.

title: Simple Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 16 corn tortillas | 1/4 cup green pepper ( finely diced ) | 26 ounces marinara sauce ( your favorite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Lay tortillas out on the counter and just stretch them out.  Place a small amount of cheese in a spoonful at the top of each tortilla.  Roll up and place in a 9 x 13 baking dish.  Spray the tops with a little cooking spray.  Pour marinara sauce over the tortillas.  Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.  Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Simple Salsa Soup
ingredients:
32 ounces vegetable stock | 4 ounces chunky salsa ( your fav.
    - brand.
    - here on zaar brand, there will be many other brands of salsa all you need ) or 4 ounces hot pack salsa ( your fav.
    - brand, there will be many other brands of salsa all you need )
instructions: Add the vegetable stock and salsa to a large pot and bring to a boil.  Pour into individual serving bowls and enjoy.

title: Wattleseed Drop Biscuits
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups finely chopped green cabbage | 1 tablespoon green branston pickleseed | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups wattleseed
instructions: Combine all ingredients, shape pretzels out of mixture and place on baking sheets covered with parchment or waxed paper.  Bake at 350 degrees f.  For 25 to 30 minutes.  Watch for bubbles.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,grain rice,cayenne pepper sauce,red onion
title: Spicy Thai Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1/2 cup finely minced red onion | 2/3 cup lemon juice | 3 dashes cayenne pepper sauce
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together.  Dip rice in mixture.  Fry in oil over medium heat in a hot pan you will be using it from step 1 to let it smoke.  This is one of those items that you might be able to sneak in while your cooking, so check after the rice is browned.

title: Basic Pasta Dough
ingredients: 3 cups cake flour | 2 cups fish stock
instructions: Using a mixing bowl, make a well in the center and pour in the fish stock.  Blend to create a thick batter with flour, gradually adding flour until it comes together to form a ball.  Turn out onto a floured board and knead for 2 to 3 minutes, adding more flour or water as necessary to create a smooth elastic paste.  Place into an oiled bowl, cover and stand in a warm place to rise until doubled in size, about 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, shape your dough into round balls measuring approximately 2 inches in diameter.  Dust with flour and place on greased cookie sheets.  Gently press a thumb hole into centre of each piece and press through a small, slightly floured doughnut into the center and press again onto a floured board, pressing with a floured stick until evenly spaced.  Bake the pastas for about 15 to 20 minutes, or until very pale gold color and hollow sounding when tapped.

title: Grilled Pineapple (Or Pomegranate) Salad
ingredients: 1 pineapple, ripe | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup tamarind juice or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/8 cup soy sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut ( optional ) | nut oil or vegetable cooking spray | 1 cinnamon stick, for sprinkling
instructions: Cut the pineapple into wedges and remove the core.  Cut the wedges into 1 inch segments and set aside.  In a blender or food processor, grind the pomegranate molasses and tamarind juice and strain.  In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, oregano, coconut or pomegranate flour, and cinnimon.  Add the pineapple wedges and toss to coat.  Let stand at room temperature, covered, for 15 minutes.  Remove 2 tablespoons of the pomegranate molasses mixture and set aside.  Dry the remaining pineapple on paper towels.  Dip into the molasses flavored molasses and then, turning, drizzle them over the salad.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Cover with remaining molasses mixture and serve at room temperature.

title: Cashew Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 150 g mexican cheese | 1/4 cup cashews or 1/4 cup peanuts | 3 -8 large tortillas
instructions: Heat a frying pan.  Add cashewnut to the pan you are using.  Fry until cashewnut browns.  Remove cashewnut and set aside.  Place tortilla in pan and flip with a tong, coating the outside.  Add the cheese on the tortilla.  Spread the cashew/nut mixture on the cheese.  Fold tortilla over and cook in a nonstick pan for 2 minutes on each side, using a slotted spoon.  Cut the quesadilla into wedges, place on a serving plate and sprinkle with the desired amount of cheese, salsa and fresh chives.  Enjoy.

title: Chunky Shallot Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped shallot | 7 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Cover and refrigerate salad greens.  Mix shallots and dressing in a large bowl to a paste consistency.  Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: topping,active yeast,strawberry,paprika,plain yogurt,yellow bell pepper,mahi fillet
title: Mahi Mahi With Strawberries and Yoghurt
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt, at room temperature | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 3/4 lb mahi mahi fillet, cut crosswise into thin strips | 2 3/4 cups sliced fresh strawberries | 1/2 yellow bell pepper | 1/3 teaspoon spanish smoked paprika
instructions: Sprinkle salt and pepper inside and outside of mahi mahi.  Stir together yeast, yogurt, and the whipped topping.  Place mahi mahi and strawberries in a greased 9 by 13 by 2 inch baking dish.  Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.  Pour half of syrup over fruit.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with remaining syrup.  Bake at 450 for 10 to 15 minutes or until fish is opaque and center is just firm.  Serve with hot plain rice.

title: Strawberries With Almonds
ingredients: 2 cups thawed fresh strawberries | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Place strawberry quarters on a baking sheet and bake in the oven until tender and lightly glazed.  Turn quarters over and sprinkle with almond extract.  Bake 2 to 3 minutes until glazed.  Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Chicken With Pork and Apple
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 12 ounces chicken legs with thigh | 12 ounces pork loin | 1 roasting chickens, 8-9 | 1/4 cup peanut | 2/3 cup fresh apple juice or 2/3 cup apple cider | 2/3 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place smoked paprika in pie pan and place chicken legs with thigh in pan.  Cut pork into 12 slices.  Remove bones and skin and place chicken on top of chicken.  Using oven safe plate as a guide, poke holes in chicken with a fork.  Roast for 90 minutes, brushing the chicken with a mixture of the paprika and the remaining oil that has been rubbed onto the chicken, if desired.  Place the pan on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.  In the meantime, cook the apple, garlic, and peanuts in a saucepot over low heat, until peanuts are golden.  Transfer onto a serving platter and drizzle with some of the apple cooking juices and vinegar from the pan.  Serve with apples, garlic, and a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,raspberry,black pepper,cream chicken soup,pine nut
title: Shrimp and Raspberry Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste | 1/2 cup crushed raspberries | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the chicken soup and shrimp paste.  Stir in the raspberries and pine nuts.  Season to taste with black pepper.

title: Thyme Roasted Vegetables(Lengua)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 3 cardamom pods | 8 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 medium potatoes, peeled and halved | 1 1/2 lbs baby cos lettuce leaves | 1 small romano lettuce leaf | shredded lettuce | chopped rhubarb ( optional )
instructions: Toast cardamom pods in a dry pan.  Turn off heat and let fragrant for 3 - 5 seconds. .  Spread yogurt on a large plate.  Top with cardamom.  Lay mushrooms, potato and any other vegetables you may choose on it.  Drizzle top with a little bit of the oil.  Place the lettuce leaves on top of the vegetables.  Place a few ramekins on top of the lettuce, then drizzle with more oil or butter.  Place a few more ramekins on top of the lettuce.  Cook in a hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked and the romesco golden.  Warm up rice on a platter.  Cut top portion of rice into eight wedges with a knife.  Fluff the grains up with a fork and serve alongside vegetables.  Garnish with chopped rhubarb on the side.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon peel,chicken meat,marsala wine,bow tie pasta
title: Baked Chicken Marsala Pasta
ingredients: 1 box bow tie pasta | 3/4 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 teaspoon dried lemon peel | 1 cup diced cooked chicken meat | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook the bow tie pasta until just tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, 2 to 4 minutes.  Drain, place in a large bowl.  Stir the marsala wine, honey, lemon peel and 1/2 cup water into the pasta and toss to combine.  Spoon pasta mixture into an 11x7 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup of parmigiano and bake at 400 degrees f for 30 to 45 minutes, until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,chili pepper flake,liquid smoke,baby octopus,black eyed pea,onion flake,yellow bell pepper,serrano chili
title: New Orleans Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut in 1/2-inch squares | 1 lb baby octopus, cut in bite size pieces | 2 large serrano chili, halved lenghtwise | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1 jar sliced black-eyed peas ( jell-o ) | 12 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  In a 13x9x2 inch pan, line base of pan with plastic wrap.  Add next 5 ingredients, mixing completely.  Toss peas with seasonings.  Pour half the pea mixture into the prepared pan and spread evenly.  Layer with half the squid and half the noodles, ending with squid.  Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: meat,yogurt,beef bouillon cube,cremini mushroom,orange,cayenne pepper,self rising flour,limeade concentrate
title: Curry Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stew meat, cubed | 1 can yogurt | 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons limeade concentrate | 1 small beef bouillon cube | 2 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, more if desired
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker.  Cook on low for 9 hours or on high until meat is tender.

title: Microwave Brunch
ingredients: 2 lbs small whole button mushrooms | 3 medium parsnips | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 tablespoon mirin | 2 large flour tortillas
instructions: Place vegetables in 2 microwavable bowls with lid,.  Put the lid on top of bowl, or.  Put lid on bowl, or.  Put the bowl under the bowl and microwave 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.  Add 1 tablespoons of mirin.  Let vegetables cool for 10 to 15 minutes and.  Microwave, stirring every 30 seconds, until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Lettuce Cups With Spicy Saffron Rice (Dal Luttuce)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked short-grain white rice | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac or 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander leaves | 1/2 cup finely shredded cabbage | 2 teaspoons sweet and hot sauce | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar ( or lemon juice ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Stir the rice, sumac, coriander and turmeric together.  Set aside.  Mix the cabbage, sweet and hot sauce and vinegar together.  Stir well.

title: Italian Style Crepes
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms without ends | 1 package sliced pepperoni
instructions: Preheat an electric skillet over medium high heat.  Pour one tablespoon of oil, about 3 tablespoons, into the skillet.  Add mushrooms, pepperoni, and a few sprinkles of green cilantro if desired.  Quickly stir the mushrooms and pepperoni into the skillet.  When the pan is very dry, carefully lift the pan from the heat and drop tablespoons of the reserved mushroom mixture to make a pancake like consistency for filling.

title: Tamarari Smoked Clay Chips
ingredients: 5 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter | 2 -4 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a food processor, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl.  Heat the bacon grease in a non stick frying pan and drop the chips in, a few at a time for 2 - 3 minutes on each side.  You can also spread on a newspaper lined baking pan so they don't stick and smoke on the bottom when you fry them.

title: Puff Pasties
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, chopped coarse | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 cup strong coffee
instructions: Cook bacon over low temperature till almost crisp, about 15 minutes.  Drain off all of the fat.  Add the tomatoes, sherry, and coffee to the bacon.  Cook until heated through, then stir in.

title: Spicy Parsnips With ancho
ingredients: 1 parsnip, peeled and sliced lengthways | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 bouquet garni ( the italian spice packet ) | 1 slice country bread, thickly cut
instructions: Preheat the grill.  Peel the parsnips and slice thinly.  Place in a large frying pan with the spices and cook over a moderate heat for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring until fragrant.  Pour in enough boiling water to cover the parsnips.  Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 - 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.  Meanwhile, toast the bread.  Place the parsnips in a baking dish and pour over the soaking liquid.  Sprinkle with the croutons.  Dress with a little more cayenne and serve immediately.

title: Microwave Tortillas
ingredients: 1 package soft corn tortillas | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 package frozen vegetables or 1 package fresh vegetables | 1 -2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Microwave tortillas on high for 30 seconds.

title: Cherry Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 medium plump green glazed cherries ( can also use cherry berry halves ) | 1 jar dry rice wine
instructions: Dry cherry halves and place in a single layer in 4 one cup glass dishes.  Combine the rice wine and cherry juice and pour over the cherries.  Let stand in refrigerator for 24 hours then stir to distribute glaze.  Enjoy.

ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lean beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-1/2 by 2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup rum | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Place the beef and 1/4 cup of rum in a large skillet.  Cook over medium high heat until the beef just loses its pink color, stirring often. Using slotted metal spoon, transfer the beef chunks to a dish and cover loosely with foil.  Return the skillet to the stove and turn the heat up just to medium high. title: Tuna Vanilla Bean
ingredients:
2 cans tuna in olive oil, drained ( you will need a lot of tunas, the smaller you can get.
    - i like to get the can from the tuna itself ) | 2 vanilla beans
instructions: Peel the vanilla beans and slice them in half across the width.  Cut the tops off the vanilla beans but leave them whole and scrape out the seeds.  Set aside.  Drain most of the tuna of its oil, removing any muscle cartilage or blemishes.  Reserve 1/2 can of tuna for later use, or you can flake the tuna for some other use.  Place the beans on a plate and cover with a tea towel to keep them soft.  After 5 minutes, remove the towel and the vanilla beans and place the tuna in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade.  Process for about 1/4 minute or until you see an oil free red/orange color.  The tuna should be a little thick and smooth, like mayonnaise.  Set aside/freeze for later.

Random Ingredients: chicken,kiwi fruit,pimiento,bay leaf,turmeric powder,white onion,oil,pesto sauce
title: Mexican Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup chopped white onion | 3 kiwi fruits | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 lbs chicken, cut-up | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Marinade chicken pieces in pesto sauce until they are tender.  Cut kiwis into 1/4 inch slices.  Cut onion and pimientos into strips.  Dice chicken pieces.  Put kiwis, onions, and pimientos into a colander and press out extra liquid to remove excess moisture.  Rinse chicken with cold water, drain and pat clean.  Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.  Put chicken pieces and all marinade into the center of a heavy duty paper towel and gather together until combined.  Cover with a damp cloth and shake off excess marinade.  Arrange chicken on a paper towel lined plate and pat dry.  Heat skillet to low heat, then turn paper towel on.  Heat oil over medium heat in skillet and deep fry chicken about 3 minutes or until done.  Drain on paper towels.

title: Chocolaty Polish Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa sausage | 1 cup corn oil | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1 inch thick slices.  Heat corn oil in skillet and add sausage slices.  Brown both sides.  Add cocoa and continue cooking until sausage are done.  Serve.

title: Easy "French Toast" (Danish)
ingredients: 8 slices french bread | 1 ounce sour cream | 6 eggs, well beaten
instructions: Slice bread diagonally 2 or three times.  Place on cookie sheet, put cream on the top of each piece, turn top down.  Brush with a little beaten egg.  Broil in oven until top is browned.

title: Garden Fresh Fruit Salad with frozen orange juice concentrate
ingredients: 4 cups mixed ripe fruit | 1 1/2 quarts fresh orange juice concentrate, thawed ( recommended ( guilt-free foods brand )
instructions: Prepare oranges in a medium saucepan of boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain and cool under cold running water.  Peel and chop.  Place orange fruit into a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients, mix well.  Chill.

title: Moroccan Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 tablespoon minced yellow pepper | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix couscous, yellow pepper, and adobo sauce together in a bowl.  Cover bowl with damp cloth and let sit 5 minutes at room temperature or transfer to a covered bowl and refrigerate several hours, or until completely cooled, stirring occasionally.

title: Huevos Beef Nachos
ingredients: 5 tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch size pieces | 2 -3 cups shredded cabbage, separated into leaves | 4 slices of your favorite sweet breaded hamburger | 12 -15 thin tortillas ( i like to use a whole grain flavored tortilla ) | cabbage ( i use fresh cut cabbage ) | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips | 4 tablespoons chocolate syrup ( optional ) | mustard ( optional ) or hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch by 1 centimeter pieces ( optional )
instructions: Fry hamburger.  Break into smaller pieces.  Put aside.  In a large skillet or frying pan, fry tortilla, cut way down sides, until crisp outside.  Remove from pan.  Sprinkle crushed tortilla chips over slices of breading.  Top with cabbage.  Fry one more time.  Put on plate.  Top with hamburger.  Spread tortilla chips evenly over cooked nachos.  Top with choc.  Sprinkle with mustard or hot sauce.  Sprinkle with bell pepper pieces or eat as is, or serve with a side of your choice.  Serve with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, green olives, salsa etc.

title: Chorizo and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 250 g small mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon chorizo sausage, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill pan or fry pan.  Pile mushrooms on a plate, then scatter with chorizo.  Drizzle over a little olive oil over the top.

title: Quattro Formaggio
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow-tie ) pasta | 1/2 pound grated muenster cheese | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 2 pints chopped pecans
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Stir in farfalle and return to a boil.  Cook until bows float to the surface, 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain in a colander set in the sink.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place muenster cheese in a small bowl and stir in superfine sugar.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,peanut oil,savoy cabbage,mandarin orange,mozzarella cheese,head iceberg lettuce
title: Bibingka's Crunch Salad
ingredients: 2 heads savoy cabbage, chopped | 1 can mandarin oranges ( or equivalent, drained ) | 1 can mandarin pimento stuffed olives ( optional ) | 1 container small-mildly shredded mozzarella cheese | peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Serve as part of a sandwich, or to form sandwiches with a salad.

title: Korean Beef Bulgogi (Galbi Kogi)
ingredients: 1 package beef or ( 1 lb ) package pork loin | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Cut meat into very small pieces and place pieces in a bowl, add soy sauce and saffron.  Marinate in refrigerator for at least an hour.  Grill or roast meat until done.

title: Chocolate-raisin Glazed Roast Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs organic whole chickens, or 2 -3 lbs chicken parts | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/4 cup white wine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup passion fruit pulp or 1/4 cup passion fruit juice | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons raisins ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Arrange chicken skin side down in a shallow baking dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,beef brisket,cream cheese,artichoke,hot paprika,chicken wing,liquid smoke
title: Smoked Chicken and Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 4 chicken legs | 2 cups dried artichokes | 12 ounces smoked beef brisket | 2 teaspoons hot smoked paprika | 2 packages cream cheese, softened at room temperature | chili powder to taste
instructions: To make the brine, soak it in water for at least 24 hours, and drain.  Place each chicken wing and half of the artichoke in a bowl.  Season the brine, and refrigerate overnight.  Drain the chicken and artichokes, reserving the brine, and place both in a 3 quart glass baking dish.  Cover with foil, and marinate on the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or overnight.  Remove the meat from the brine and place on a rack in a roasting pan.  Season with a mixture of paprika and chili powder.  Bake in a preheated oven at 450 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, or until very brown and tender.  Remove from oven, and allow to cool for a few minutes.  Slice the meat, and serve with brine on the side.

title: Pierogi With Orzo and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 1 package cream cheese, thawed | 1 teaspoon msg ( i use msg soy sauce )
instructions: Add all ingredients together and mix well with hand.  Let sit in refrigerator for about 15 minutes to let flavors blend.  Enjoy.

title: Spiced Cauliflower and Vegetable Tabbouleh - Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 32 ounces vegetable stock, heated | 1 ounce hummus | 2 1/2 ounces cauliflower florets, broken into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Place the fennel seeds in a coffee grinder and crush roughly until finely ground.  Stir in the vegetable stock.  Heat a frying pan, add the hummus and allow it to sizzle for about 1 minute, stirring regularly.  Spoon the cauliflower into a roasting tin.  Pour the hot tabbouleh into the roasting tin and bake, drizzling the hot tabbouleh with a little olive oil.  Cook for 12 minutes until it is golden and bubbling around the edges.  Serve warm, with fresh baked vegetables and crusty bread.

title: Curried Parsnips With Parsnips and Mandarin Orange
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder ( depending on taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained or 1 can mandarin lite oranges
instructions: Peel and cut parsnips into 1 inch pieces.  Cook in boiling water just until tender, add curry, lime juice and mandarin orange juice.  Serve with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,coriander leaf,green onion,buttermilk,orange marmalade,cumin seed,sherry wine vinegar
title: Moroccan Broccoli With Orange Cream Soup
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 2 small green onions, chopped ( scallion tops ) | 2 small heads fresh broccoli florets, cut in florets | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon orange marmalade
instructions: In a large bowl add buttermilk until boiling.  Add chopped and drained green onions, chopped broccoli, coriander and cumin to buttermilk.  Cover and simmer for 8 minutes.  Do not overcook.  Remove from heat and stir in vinegar and marmalade.  Cover and chill until ready to serve.  To serve, divide among your favourite serving bowls.  Serve garnished with finely chopped coriander.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,golden raisin,pea,masa harina flour,dark chocolate,curry paste
title: Slow-Cooker Spicy Lamb Shank and Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb shanks | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 300 g dark chocolate | 3/4 cup golden raisins | 1 1/4 cups wholemeal masa harina flour | 80 g split peas
instructions: Place lamb in a shallow ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle over the curry paste and spread evenly.  Place chocolate in a microwave safe bowl and heat on high for 30 seconds until melted and smooth.  Stir in raisins and pour over lamb.  Cover and cook for about 1 hr 1 hour on high, then reduce heat and cook for a further hour.  Stir in harina and split peas and cook until thickened.  Serve with polenta.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,flour tortilla,whipping cream,radish,taco bell home ' n chunky salsa,sage leaf,gingerroot
title: Quinoa-Ginger-Salsa Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 tablespoon chopped gingerroot | 12 fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups shredded taco bell home'n chunky salsa | 1/2 cup chopped roasted radish | 6 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups water and the 1 tbls.  Of chopped gingerroot to a boil over high heat.  Stir in the quinoa and return to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until the quinoa is tender, about 15 minutes.  Stir in the sage.  Transfer quinoa to a plate and cool.  When cool, stir in the whipping cream until well blended.  Mix in the salsa and season with salt and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  To serve, spread one side of each warmed tortilla with the remaining salsa and filling.

title: Roasted Yellow Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb yellow bell pepper, cored and sliced in 1/4 rounds | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place peppers on a foil lined baking sheet.  Coat with the mustard.  Roast 5 minutes.

title: Peppered Beetroot
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beetroots, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 red pepper, cored stemmed, seeded and cut into 2-inch squares | 1 cup pesto sauce | 4 tablespoons cognac ( optional )
instructions: Boil the beets for 8 minutes, or until tender.  Drain and cool.  Blot them cool and then slice them in half.  Arrange them in layers on a heavy duty foil or individual baking sheets lined with a double thickness of foil, overlapping if necessary.  In a mixing bowl, stir together the red pepper squares and pesto.  Sprinkle over the vegetables.  Place the top sheet of foil over the vegetables and seal tightly with the foil.  Bake at 400f for one hour and 30 minutes, or until the vegetables begin to bubble and brown.  Remove from oven and serve hot, or cold.

title: Cucumber and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut into bite-size pieces | 2 cups snow peas, trimmed | 2 tomatoes, seeded, chopped, or cans diced tomatoes | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon tomato juice
instructions: Mix cucumber, snow peas, tomatoes, and eggs in a large bowl.  Sprinkle with vanilla and tomato juice.  Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.

title: Quick Thai-Style Broccoli Chips
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed, drained and cut on florets | 1/4 cup pineapple juice, chilled | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, chilled | salt and pepper, to taste | corn chips, for serving
instructions: Preheat broiler setting.  Arrange broccoli and remaining ingredients in a lightly oiled baking dish.  Broil, 4 to 5 inches from heat until hot and crisp and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: The Best Chili in the World
ingredients: 2 cans old el paso thick & chunky salsa | 1 1/2 tablespoons tequila | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the chunky salsa, tequila, horseradish, crushed garlic and spices.  Cover and refrigerate overnite or serve immediately.

title: Beef Sosaties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, ground | 1/2 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 32 ounces lasagna noodles
instructions: Brown chuck in skillet.  Mix ground coriander and add to beef.  Cook noodles in boiling water or in microwave.  Put mixture into casserole dish over meat mixture and bake at 350°f for 2 hours.  Serve over hot, freshly cooked noodles.  Note, you can prepare 1 lb beef and 1 lb beef bouillon cubes.  Or use 1lb oxo beef cube.  If mixture is too wet, add water.  Simmer, covered, 40 to 50 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Mika's Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 10 corn tortillas | 8 cups chicken broth | 1/3 cup wondra flour
instructions: Heat a pot over medium low heat.  Add the tortillas, and cook until golden on both sides.  Add more oil if desired.  Remove the tortillas from the pot.  In a saucepan, heat stock.  Add worcestershire sauce and flour, stir until smooth.  Remove soup from heat.  Cover.  Simmer about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,broth,grain white rice,brown onion,garlic,tomato paste
title: Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Spicy Rice)
ingredients: 1 lb long grain white rice, washed | 1 brown onion, finely chopped | 3 cloves garlic, crushed | 6 large red chilies, seeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons broth, if needed
instructions: Soak rice in a large bowl of hot water until water is absorbed, 1 to 2 hours, then drain.  Place rice in a heavy 8 inch skillet and cook over low heat, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes, or until fragrant and slightly browned.  Stir in white onion, garlic, chilies, and tomato paste.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until liquid is absorbed, the rice should be soft but not mushy.  You may use a combination of rice and vegetables to make this somewhat moist. .  Remove from heat, cover, and set aside 20 minutes.  Fluff with a fork and add chicken or broth.

title: Prawns With Herbs
ingredients: 250 g white onions, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried herbs, soaked in | 1 tablespoon water | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c, 400°f.  Heat a heavy based frying pan over a high heat.  Once hot, add the onions and all the other ingredients and cook for 5 minutes, stirring to make sure that everything is coated with the herbs.  Remove the pan from heat and transfer to a baking tray and toss the mixture well, coating all the prawns in the gravy.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Mexican Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon serrano pepper ( canned )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in small bowl.  Use your favorite recipe.

title: Champagne and Chive Flavoured Rice
ingredients: 150 ml dry champagne | 125 g long-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the rice and champagne in an earthenware bowl.  Cover and let stand for 30 minutes until it has absorbed all of the liquid.  Place a large saucepan over high heat.  Add the chives and stir to coat.  Add the rice mixture, stir to combine and bring to the boil.  When it boils, cook for 5 minutes or until rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.  Transfer to a serving dish, cover loosely and let stand for 5 minutes.  Fluff with a fork and serve hot or cold.

title: Rostebagas
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach | 3 medium turnips | 3 medium roasts | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Cut spinach into 4 bundles of 3 or 4 smaller portions.  Wash turnips and roast in frying pan.  Cut roasts in pieces, lengthwise, then on diagonal into slices 1/4 inch thick.  Remove husks and wash spinach leaves.  In bowl, put spinach, potatoes, rotel, and taco sauce and mix.  Put roast in baking pan.  Add baking powder.  Pour marinade over meat.  Bake in the oven at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.  Serve with beans.

Random Ingredients: bisquick baking mix,red cherry,cider vinegar,lasagna noodle

ingredients: 2 boxes of ready-to-use fresh lasagna noodles | 1 package frozen pitted sweet red cherries | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 package bisquick baking mix
instructions: Prepare lasagna noodles according to package directions.  Drain well.  While noodles are cooking, place cherries in a small sauce pan.  Drizzle with vinegar and mix.  Put aside.  Combine baking mix and baking powder together in a small bowl.  Mix well.  Add cherries and mix well.  Spoon a few cherry mixture into bottom of 9x13 dish.  Spread 1/2 of the dry mix into the bottom of the dish.  Arrange 1/2 of the noodles over the cherry mixture.  Cover with 1/2 of the crumb mixture.  Repeat layers and top with remaining crumbs.  Spray with pam cooking spray and cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Wild Mushroom Salad

instructions: Place the tomatoes halves over a saucepan of simmering water.  Cover and cook for 2 minutes, then remove the lid.  Cook briefly, then remove the tomatoes and set aside for 5 - 7 minutes.

title: Moroccan Raisins and Mix
ingredients: 2 cups golden raisins, soaked in water 30 minutes to plump and plump | 1 tablespoon flax seed meal ( ground flax ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling on bread
instructions: Place all but 1/2 teaspoon salt in a food processor or blender.  Process until well combined.  Transfer raisins to a clean glass container or baking sheet.  Stir in remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours and overnight.  Sprinkle the bread with salt after chilling.  Tightly pack the raisins into a resealable plastic bag.  Squeeze out excess air and discard the air before storing in the refrigerator, for up to a week.

Place baking sheet on oven rack.  Bake until the puff pastry has puffed and is golden brown.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chilled Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 fuji apple, about 10 x 3 x 1-2-inch | 1/2 lb fresh stringless green beans, trimmed | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped or 2 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Chop the fuji apple into pieces no larger than 1/8 inch thick.  Put the apple pieces together with the green beans in a salad bowl or other container with raised edges.  Sprinkle with dill and refrigerate.

title: Chinese 5 Spice and Four-Pepper Pone Focaccia

instructions: Grease or spray pan lightly with cooking spray.  Set aside.  In mixing bowl, combine flour, buttermilk, egg, orange peel and five spice powder. title: Faux Pepper & Garlic
ingredients: 4 bell peppers | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Place the peppers in a roasting pan or saucer.  Drizzle all with the olive oil and sprinkle with the salt and fresh herbs.  Roast on the middle shelf of the pre heated oven for about 90 minutes or till the peppers are tender crisp.

title: Penne With Black Peas, Jalapeno and Jalapeno
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1 jalapeno chile ( optional ) | 7 ounces dry penne
instructions: Cook penne as directed on package.  While pasta is cooking, place black eyed peas, jalapeno& chile in a saucepan over medium heat.  Cook 8 - 10 minutes or until peas are soft.  Drain excess liquid from beans.  Return cooked peas to saucepan and stir to coat.  Add pasta to saucepan along with enough pasta cooking liquid to moisten.  If desired, toss with desired amount of scallion and serve topped with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Sweet and Sour Lemongrass
ingredients: 2 lemongrass ( or 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemongrass ) | 1 cup italian dressing ( italian is preferred but can use regular dry white vinegar )
instructions: Clean and de stem lemongrass, taking care not to tear the roots.  Place the leaves on a cutting board or in a bowl lined with a few layers of damp paper towels.  Cut each leaf into a cone shape using a sharp knife or scissors.  Place in a bowl and drizzle over salad.  Combine the 1 cup of italian dressing and 2 tbsp of water and stir until mixed.  Taste for any additional seasoning.  Sprinkle on the lemongrass.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 8 hours.

title: Baked Salmon Rice
ingredients: 1 lb salmon | 2 cups jasmine rice ( soaked in water ) | 3 carrots, cut into medium chunks | 5 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf.  Cut salmon into 2 x 1/2 inch pieces and place in a roasting pan or baking pan with the bones side up.  Add 2 cups jasmine rice, along with all the remaining ingredients, including turmeric.  Pour enough water into the roasting pan to measure a full depth of ¼ inch.  Bake, uncovered for about 40 minutes or until a knife inserted in the middle of the rice comes out clean.

title: Chicken Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 package sliced romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon shortening
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.  Cook the chicken thighs in the hot oil until they are beginning to brown on both sides, about 10 minutes on each side.

title: Beef and Beans

instructions: Place beans in a large bowl and cover with cold water.

title: Easy Peppers Mole
ingredients: 1 cup bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons mild unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of cocoa powder in a small frying pan over a low heat.  When the color darkens, stir in 1/2 cup of pepper.  Dipping the peppers, add the pepper mixture to the hot sauce and stir well.  Pour over fish or meat of your choice.  Cook under medium heat approximately 5 minutes or until the peppers are tender and glazed.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and shape into 2 thick round kebabs.  Allow to sit for 1 hour in the refrigerator.  Turn on grill.  Spray grilling plate lightly with oil spray over medium high heat.  Grill kebabs for 5 minutes on each side or until cooked through.  Serve kababs with salad, fresh vegetables and slices of fresh apple.

title: Easy Beef and Noodle Baked Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb ground sausage | 1/2 lime, juice and zest chopped | 1 cup masa corn flour ( corn flour ) | 6 eggs | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted ( or a few pecan halves ) | 3 cups potato chips, crushed
instructions: Mix beef and sausage in a greased baking pan and set aside.  Beat eggs with juice and zest and pour over beef in pan.  Combine the masa flour with salt in bowl and add to the beef mix, mixing well with hands until it starts to cling together the mixture.  Add crushed chips.  Bake at 350º for 45 - 50 minutes or until heated through, and golden brown.

title: Polish Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 3 packages link sausage ( sliced ) | 1 bunch romaine lettuce, washed and stemmed | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut into bite size pieces | grated orange zest ( fresh zest ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | salt
instructions: Prepare salad.

title: Mexican Burrito Pie
ingredients: 1 package chopped chili | 2 cups guacamole | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Prepare the pie crust according to package directions using frozen dough and thawed pastry.  Spray a 9x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Add the chili, guacamole, and taco seasoning to the pie crust.  Place phyllo in the baking dish, brushing the last tablespoon of cooking spray on the top layer.  Unfold the phyllo, and spread it with a rolling pin onto your baking sheet.  Use a sharp, wet knife to score a cross in the crust for ease.  Brush the phyllo with the remaining nonstick spray.  Top the pastry with half of the filled pie crust.  Press the seam to seal, and then sprinkle the remaining filling on top.  Bake in 375 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes, until the edge is bubbly.

title: Elegant Easy Sherry Canapes
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( or sherry juice )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine mushroom soup and sherry.  Using a pastry bag, pipe approximately 1 - 2 tbsp of mixture onto each canilla.  Serve immediately.

title: Strawberry Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 red peppers, roasted | 4 ounces ground pork | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch baking powder | 1 punnet thawed frozen strawberries, rinsed under cold water
instructions: Slit the top off each red pepper and remove the seeds.  Remove the pulp from the peppers leaving about 2 inches of pulp to shells.  Place the pulp in a bowl.  Use your hands to mash the pulp into a thin paste.  Cook the pork in a large non stick frying pan over a medium high heat, stir, breaking up clumps with a wooden spoon.  When the pork is browned, reduce the heat.  Add the parsley, cayenne pepper, and baking powder.  Stir and cook until the spices are fragrant, about 1 minute.  Stir in the strawberries and cook for 1 - 2 minutes.  Take care not to burn the mixture.  Place the peppers into a plastic bag and pour a little of the pork mixture over each one.  Seal the bag, squeeze out and discard the air, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and a half.  Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving.  Serve at once.

title: Spicy Cranberry Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup canned red enchilada sauce | 1 cup fresh cranberries ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Place asafoetida into food process and mix.  Add in the cranberries and mix.  Then transfer the mixture into a saucepan and add the puree of your choice into it.  Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for about five minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve over your favorite meat.

Mix well, and remove the top layer from the baking pans.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix together the rest of the adobo, the baking cocoa, and the slivered cilantro.  When the 50 minutes are up, remove the cake and spread the toppings evenly over the cake.  Cut crosswise into quarters.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,italian salad dressing,pine nut,red bean,vegetable carrot,catsup,sage leaf,sherry wine

instructions: Place red beans, carrots, or vegetables of choice in a large bowl and pour dressing over.  Mix well and cover and chill several hours or overnight.  If serving hot, top with a dollop of catsup or sherry.

title: Flourless Oats - Oatmeal Snack
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into balls.

title: Grilled Salmon with Pesto
ingredients: 3 ounces fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 ounce fresh sage, trimmed | 1 lb salmon fillet ( skin on ) | 1 dash pesto sauce

Thinly slice the asparagus and sprinkle with a little salt and dried sage on the cut side of each piece. title: Chocolate Bean and Rice Pudding

instructions: Wash the rice and put it into a small pot.  Add the greek seasoning, msg and stock.  Bring to the boil and then turn the heat down to low.  Cook the rice until it is soft. Random Ingredients: whipping cream,lemon,green grape,sun tomato,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato puree,tea,oyster sauce
title: Chinese Tea Scented Grape With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/3 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato | 3 cups mixed fresh greens ( or a mix such as spinach, kale or mixed chard ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sun-dried tomato puree, to taste ( homemade or from asian or asian food aisle ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup finely chopped tomato puree | 1/3 cup freshly brewed tea | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lemon rind
instructions: Spray a large sauté pan with cooking spray.  Place the uncut sun dried tomatoes in a blender or food processor and process until finely chopped.  Transfer the tomato mixture to a bowl and stir in the sun dried tomato puree, to taste, and mixed greens/chard.  Place in the refrigerator until dinner time.  Lightly spray 2 tsp of vegetable oil in a sauté pan and place over low heat.  Add the sundried tomato purée and cook, stirring frequently for 5 minutes, or until tender and fragrant. title: Cheesy Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup broth | 1 can tomato-and-green chilies, drained ( mild, hot or mild with juice ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herbs ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried basil -optional ) | shredded jalapeno jack cheese, to coat the tops of the nachos
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine the broth and green chilies, stirring to loosen the seeds from the chilies.  Heat, uncovered, on microwave until hot.  Stir in the tomato and green chilies to heat through, about 3 minutes.  Spoon the mixture onto a plate, top with freshly grated cheese.  Microwave at high for 1 minute.  Stir with a fork or spoon to loosen the cheese and to mix well.  Serve right away, or keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.

title: Salmon Appetizers
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces salmon | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Open the salmon's spine like a book.  Trim, clean, and slice in half lengthwise, and cut into 1/2 inch thick slice.  Place on a parchment lined tray.  Spread each slice with pizza sauce.  Heat a nonstick pan over low heat.  Brush with peanut oil, or heat on a gas bbq grill.  Cook salmon with oiled side on top.  Reduce heat to low and cook, uncovered, for 10 - 15 minutes, turning once, or until cooked through.  Serve on a heated platter.

Random Ingredients: oat bran,steak,flour tortilla,button mushroom,green enchilada sauce,celery,tennessee whiskey
title: Green Chile Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, cut into 1/2 by 1/2 inch pieces | 12 small flour tortillas | 12 ounces green enchilada sauce | 12 slices celery, about 2 cups | 12 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 12 ounces tennessee whiskey | 1 cup rolled oats bran
instructions: Cook meat in water for about 15 minutes, drain and then cool.  Cut meat into smaller bite sized pieces.  Roll tortillas in 1/2 cup of oat bran, place in a microwave safe dish and microwave on high for 90 seconds 30 seconds, or until heated through.  Drain on paper towels.  When all tortillas are rolled, place on a plate, put 3 enchiladas in a microwave dish and put 1 tablespoon of meat mixture in the middle of each tortilla.  Roll tortillas and place seam side down in the baking dish.  Place remaining enchilada sauce ingredients into a saucepan and heat on medium.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes.  Batter should thicken slightly after reaching temperature.  Pour mixture over the top of meat enchiladas.  Cover and bake at 350f for about 45 minutes, then remove cover and continue cooking for about an additional 10 minutes to thicken more.  Serve.

title: Spinach with Gorgonzola
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee liqueur
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet.  Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until evenly brown, about 10 minutes.  Drain of any remaining fat, remove and crumble bacon.  When cool, crumble and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add spinach.  Cook until tender, about 2 minutes.  Drain, cool and squeeze water out, squeezing out as much water as possible.  Combine spinach, gorgonzola and peanuts with bacon, spinach, and coffee liqueur, stirring to blend.  Toss in warm skillet and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,broiler fryer chicken,graham cracker crumb,vegetable oil,mango,ketchup
title: Ancho Indian Chicken
ingredients: 1 small broiler-fryer chickens | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 package sliced mango | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Cut away excess fat from chicken and place chicken in a large plastic bag.  Stir together graham cracker crumbs and mango.  Pour oil over chicken pieces and coat.  Firmly pound with moistened hands to moisten slightly.  Arrange on a plate and sprinkle with soy sauce, ketchup and chile powder.

title: Peas on the Road by the Pitcher
ingredients: 2 large pork tenderloins, halved | 3 cups frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place pork in a baking dish and spread evenly with a thin layer of cooking spray.  Roast pork 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until a thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 145 degrees f.  Remove from oven, and cool 10 minutes before slicing into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Transfer pork to a plate and discard marinade.  Bring peas to a boil in a large pot, and cook uncovered 5 minutes, or until peas are tender.  Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Serve with pork.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,poblano chile,red onion,italian bread crumb,salt pepper,rye flour,flour
title: Rye Blitzel
ingredients: 2 pounds poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup rye flour | 2 large red onions, shredded | 1/3 cup fresh maraschino cherries | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Pulse the poblano peppers on a grill until very fine and slightly charred on all sides, 7 to 10 pulses.  Transfer to a bowl and stir in the salt, bread crumbs, rye flour, red onion, and maraschino cherries.  Season with salt and pepper and let rest a few minutes.  Form the mixture into 1 inch balls and press into 1/4 inch thick pitzels.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate the blitzel for 45 minutes to allow the flavors to blend before cooking.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,lemonade,italian plum tomato,brandy,hard egg,mustard powder,gruyere cheese
title: Deviled Clams
ingredients: 6 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons fresh lemonade or 4 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 lbs italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup rum, optional to taste | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Shred cheese into small pieces and set aside.  In a blender, process tomatoes with 1 tbsp lemonade, mustard powder, chiles and 1/4 cup brandy/rum.  Add cheese and continue to blend.  Set aside.  In a small bowl, mix the remaining 1/4 cup brandy with the remaining lemonade and chill.  Scramble eggs in a small frying pan, add lemonade mixture and cook on medium high heat, stirring occasionally until just cooked.  Spoon cheese mixture onto plate and serve.

title: Guar Gummy (Glamb Cheese)
ingredients: 8 ounces ground cashews ( can use less if you want ) | 1 lb guar gum | 1/4 teaspoon cashew nuts | 1 small bunch fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Prepare an 8x8 pan by lining the bottom with waxed paper and topping with the nuts.  Mix the cashew nut crumbles with guar gum until thoroughly blended, press into the bottom of the pan with the back of a spoon.  Add cashew nut mixture on top of the nuts.  Sprinkle with cilantro if using.  Chill for an hour before removing from the pan.  Cut into squares.  Variation, when making this glamb, add 3 3/4 teaspoons of guar gum with ground almonds instead of cashews.  Try different flavors of cashew nuts, nuts can be found at asian bbq shops.  Also, if making these for guests, combine 1/4 teaspoon of guar gum with 1/4 teaspoon of cashew nut crumbles.

title: French Canadian Sour Cream Pasties
ingredients: 12 medium cake flour, or more as needed ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon arrowroot, or as needed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 cup double cream, or as needed | 2 sprigs fresh thyme for garnish
instructions: Place flour, arrowroot, thyme, and cream in a bowl.  Use your fingers to mix well.  Divide dough into 18 portions.  Roll each portion into a ball on a floured surface.  Place in a freezer bag, and freeze until firm, about 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Remove the frozen pastry to a work surface and roll out into a circle 1/4 inch thick.  Use a small cookie cutter or a 2 inch round cookie cutter.  Cut a slit lengthwise into the edge of the pastry, and remove the pastry with a sharp knife.  Repeat with remaining dough.  Use a sharp knife to cut the pastry into 6 or 8 strips each.  Roll each strip out to a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.  Cut the edge of each pastry strip 1/8 inch thick.  Line an 8 inch square cake pan with pastry, leaving a 1 inch rim on all sides.  Sprinkle about 1/2 teaspoon of flour around the edge of each pastry strip.  Arrange 5 or 6 pastry strips crosswise on the pastry.  Wrap each pastry strip completely with a piece of cheesecloth and twist ends to seal.  Set pies on a parchment covered baking sheet, and repeat with remaining pastry and cheesecloth strips, flour, and herbs.  Use a sharp knife to cut a cross 1/4 inch deep into each pastry strip.  Spread the sour cream over the tops of the pies, and sprinkle lightly with more flour.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are puffed and golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Scottish Oats

instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 quart casserole, stir to mix well.  Cover and let bake until well heated, about 15 minutes.  Remove lid and stir.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Beef Strips(Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fully cooked beef round steak
instructions: Whisk vinegar, beef and sugar together.  Cover and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours.  Heat broiler.  Brush grate with extra virgin olive oil.  Thread beef strips onto skewers.  Place skewers on well oiled racks, and broil about 4 minutes or until cooked to taste.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,dijon mustard,tahini,garam masala,kaffir lime leaf

title: Macaroni and Beef

Serve hot topped with parmesan toasts or whole wheat toast.

instructions: Place the sausages in a large saucepan that has been coated with cooking spray.  Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cover, and set over medium heat. title: Spicy Pineapple Stuffing from Saphni Palatski
ingredients: 150 g diced rindless rindless streaky bacon | 3 shiitake mushrooms, roughly chopped | 100 g pineapples ( chippari ) | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 8 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted | 12 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 small jalapeno, chopped ( wear gloves )

title: Hot Wiener Sauce

instructions: Place the cashews in a pan and cook over a medium heat with a pinch of salt.  They will immediately take on a golden brown colour and be crispy.  Leave to cool.  Put all the remaining ingredients except for the nuts in a food processor and process until smooth and creamy.  Pour into a clean bowl and mix in the cashews and mix gently.  Serve at room temperature with crackers or toasted rye bread as an accompaniment.

title: Lettuce Wrapped in Veal
ingredients: 1 medium aubergine, peeled and very thinly sliced lengthways | 250 g ground veal | 1 cup chopped deli franks feta cheese | lettuce, leaves trimmed
instructions: Toss the aubergine with half the veal and half the feta in a bowl with the remaining veal and then transfer to a hot platter.  Arrange on a board with the lettuce leaves, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and continue to scatter over the feta.

title: Peanut Butter Asparagus Salad

instructions: Cook asparagus for 2 minutes or until tender crisp.  Plunge into cold water to crisp asparagus and drain.  Set aside.  Place tomatoes on a serving plate, and toss with peanut butter.  In a small saucepan, add tomato juice and pepper.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Stir in buttermilk or soy milk.  Ladle tomato mixture over peanut butter asparagus mixture to serve.

instructions: Clean and cut cabbage, removing seeds, and removing stem and leaves.  Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Cook for about an hour or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Tuna Sushi Melt (Fat Free)

instructions: Spread butter on sheet of nori, lightly moisten with cold water and then set aside.  Place tuna and saffron in a large saucepan or frypan.

instructions: Toast one side of one slice of bread and keep other slice in place.  Place 1 tomato slice on one side of the toast.  Spread split raspberries with 1 teaspoon of arrowroot or cornstarch and top with second slice.  Lightly spread slices with additional arrowroot or cornstarch.

title: Homemade Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin seeds | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a mixing bowl.

title: White Gravy With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 5 -6 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon summer savory | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese ( shredded ) or 1/2 lb asiago cheese ( shredded )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, old bay seasoning and savory.  Add the cheese and mix the mixture together until the flour is fully incorporated.  Form small, round balls out of the dough, place in your favorite pie dish and bake at 450f for 15 to 20 mins until the top is light brown and bubbly.  Great served with a side of your favorite vegetable dish.

title: Poblano Salsa
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles, halved | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 1 bunch green onions, chopped | 1/2 cup corn oil for frying ( or more )
instructions: Grill or broil poblanos, turning if necessary, for 10 minutes.  Wash and dry chilies, remove skin.  Cut in half lengthwise, remove seeds and veins.  In a blender, blend the chilies and tomatoes, onion and 1/3 cup water.  Heat the oil in a frypan over medium high heat.  In batches add chiltes and fry for 2 minutes.  Cover and cook until skins blister.  Drain briefly, then transfer to a bowl and discard skins.  Chop chilis and transfer to bowl with tomato mixture.  Stir well and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Chinese Buffet Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 package frozen whole string beans | 1 container sour cream | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
instructions: Combine the mushrooms and beans in a 2 quart casserole.  Sprinkle with sour cream and peanut butter.  Bake at 375°f for 50 minutes, covered.  Serve over rice.

title: White Fish Pies
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 white fish fillet, cut into 4 pieces | 1/4 cup chopped bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped kahlua ( or anise extract to taste ) | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup unbleached white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees.  Place defrosted pastry sheet in a baking dish, and cover with a lightly dampened towel.  Microwave on high power for 15 - 20 seconds to warm pastry.  Combine white fish, bell pepper, red pepper, and kahlua in a saucepan over medium heat.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes, or until fish is heated through and vegetables are crisp tender.  Stir in cheese.  Unfold puff pastry onto a work surface.  Cut into 4 - 4 squares.  Place 1 tablespoon of fish mixture in the middle of each square, and top with another pastry square, seal edges.  Dampen the edges with water and fold together to make a pleat in the center of the pie.  Place on a lightly oiled cookie sheet.  Bake 425f degrees for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: My Feta Noodle
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles, broken | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup chopped feta cheese | 2 cups quick cooking barley | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 teaspoon season salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place rice in a large roasting pan, and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven uncovered for 15 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 5 minutes, or until crispy, and lightly browned.  Meanwhile, in a separate large skillet, bring 2 tablespoons of the oil to a high heat.  Add 1/4 cup of the feta cheese and cook until bubbly, stirring frequently.  Add 1/4 cup of the barley, and stir until coated well with the oil.  Add 1/2 packet of the seasoning salt, and stir well.  Cook the mixture for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has melted.  Remove the noodles from the oven and drain them, tossing them so they are evenly coated with the pan drippings.  Arrange on a baking sheet with the cheese and parsley.  Pour remaining 1/4 cup of tomato sauce over the top, and toss to coat well.  Cover skillet and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the topping is creamy and bubbly.

title: Japanese Creme Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender with half cup of water, blend until smooth, then pour over desired salad or meat.

title: Pavlova With Baked Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb ladyfinger, cut lengthwise in half | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup grated parma cheese ( not extra virgin ) | 1 large chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced ( canned in adobo sauce can be removed for more heat ) | veal, for dipping | caramel ice cream topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Put a pot of water on to boil for grilling instructions.  Wrap the ladyfingers in double foil, place them under cold running water, and bring to a boil.  Cook until cooked, but still firm but not mushy.  Cut them into small squares, about the size of a walnut, and set aside while you prepare the fondue.  Put the grated cheese into a small bowl. Add half the fondue to the fondue and stir to combine.  Dip the stuffed ladyfingers into the fondue.  Dip the stuffed ladyfingers into the cheese and then dredge them into the reserved fondue.  Place in a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish and top with the remaining grated cheese and the remaining cooked meat and sauce.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.  Variation, a tablespoon of tomato salsa may be sprinkled on top of fondue prior to baking if desired.

title: Pasta Shells

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  To start the sauce put all ingredients into a sauce pan and bring to a boil.  Toss with the cooked pasta and garnish with egg slices.

title: Garlicky Dill-Dill Chicken

instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil in small pan over medium heat.  Add remaining 1 teaspoon sesame oil and lime strips.  Quickly stir fry for 1 minute or until lime strips are crisp tender.
