title: Apple and Olive Soup
ingredients: 2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 cup peeled, cored and chopped sweet potato | 1 cup sliced thinly-spiced sweet apple | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon coriander seed
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine broth and next 4 ingredients.  Bring to boil over high heat.

title: Pickled Asparagus
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh asparagus | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds, ground | 1 dash cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Place the asparagus in a large bowl, and sprinkle with poppy seeds.  Stir together cayenne pepper and salt, sprinkle over the asparagus, and refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving to draw out the flavors.

title: Strawberry Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh strawberries, washed | 1 lb brown sugar | 2 dozen whole tortillas
instructions: Cut off the berries and cut apart the large strawberries.  Sprinkle the strawberries with lots of brown sugar and toss them in some salt and some pepper.  Grill briefly with tortillas.  Top with butter or margarine and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,oatmeal,silken tofu,tomato soup,red cayenne pepper,red cabbage
title: Tofu Corned Beef Cabbage & Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 12 ounces smoked silken tofu or 12 ounces soy tofu | 1 can tomato soup | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 cup oatmeal | 1/8 teaspoon red cayenne pepper
instructions: Drain the tofu and cut it into small cubes.  Set them aside in a colander.  Rinse the cabbage well then place it in a large bowl.  Slice the cabbage into strips, and add it to the bowl with the tofu.  Add the tomato soup, sherry, oatmeal, red and cayenne pepper to taste.  Mix well, and serve immediately.

title: Prawns & Jerk Sauce With Cured Porcini & Pepperoncini
ingredients: 300 g baby king prawns or 300 g raw king prawns | 4 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 bunch fresh pepperoncini pepper, stems trimmed | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Shell, devein & roughly chop prawns.  Place onion quarters in the work bowl, pour over 3 tablespoons boiling water & turn to low.  Cover & cook until all the water has drained away & the onion has softened slightly.  Meanwhile soak dried porcini mushrooms in boiling water for 30 minutes, drain & rinse the mushrooms & set aside for 5 mins to soften.  Finely chop onion quarters & place onions along with the mushrooms along with the dried mushrooms, curry & allspice.  Drain cooked prawns & remove heads from the shells & place in a bowl.  Add sour cream & mix thoroughly.  Add the prawns, prawn skins and pepperoncini caps & mix well.  Cover & leave to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hr or preferably overnight.  Turn on the oven to 200c f or 160°c.  Uncover & heat for about 15 - 20 minutes stirring often.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,mozzarella cheese,breadcrumb,broccoli floret,part mozzarella cheese,chicken fillet,shrimp
title: Stirfry
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets | 1/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup fresh shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/2 cup fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into small cubes
instructions: Mix bread crumbs, sun dried tomatoes and the cheese together on a board or plate.  Dip chicken strips in bread crumb mixture and place in a shallow dish.  Pour half of the sun dried tomato sauce mixure over chicken.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.  Drain any remaining marinade in pan.  Stirfry chicken strips in remaining sauce until golden.  Remove from heat and place on paper towel to drain.  Put broccoli and shrimp in pan, cook and stir until broccoli is crisp tender.  Drain shrimp.  Arrange broccoli on plate, top with chicken.  Top with mozzarella cubes and serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Paprika Cookies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon fresh blueberries, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a small cup, stir together flour, paprika and blueberries.  Drop rounded tablespoon sized balls of dough onto the parchment onto a baking sheet in 1/4 inch/3 inch slices.  Bake on the middle rack until lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Zinfandel
ingredients: 4 teaspoons savory | 4 teaspoons lime, freshly squeezed | 4 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Combine the zinfandel, citrus zinfandel juice, garlic powder, and lime juice in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid.  Shake thoroughly to thoroughly mix, and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 1 week.  Once opened, the zinfandel mixture will keep indefinitely in your fridge, but zinfandel may also be frozen.

title: Polenta All'os (Mexican Polenta-Goat Cheese)
ingredients: 12 ounces polenta ( mexican polenta ) | 3 cups grated queso blanco ( or monterey jack cheese ) | 1 package frozen okra ( thawed or fresh ) | 1 cup chopped plum tomato
instructions: Melt cheese until light brown.  Cook okra in 1 1/2 cups of hot water.  Set aside.  Spread polenta on a large flat surface.  Make polenta from remaining ingredients and top with okra/tomato mixture.  Cover and allow to cook at 70 c for 25 minutes.  Remove pan from oven and allow to cool.

title: Baked Green Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh green beans, cut into 1 inch lengths | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Arrange the green beans on a greased cookie sheet or cookie sheet.  In a small saucepan, melt butter or margarine.  Add garlic salt and cook over low heat for about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coffee,banana,chicken meat,channa dal,cream cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Channa Dal and Chicken Pate
ingredients: 4 ounces dried channa dal or 4 ounces basmati rice | 1 cup cooked chicken meat | 5 ounces fat free cream cheese | 1 large banana | 4 teaspoons low-fat brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, coley garnish
instructions: Rinse and drain the channa dal and rice.  Place in a microwaveable bowl and cook on full power for 3 to 4 minutes or until just tender.  Put 1 cup of the cooked chanad into a food processor and process to a pesto paste.  Add the chicken, cream cheese, banana, coffee and chopped parsley.  Blend until well mixed.  Spoon the mixture into a bowl and place into the fridge for 30 minutes to chill slightly, then place into the fridge for a further 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,soy sauce,italian sausage,black bean,ouzo,serrano chilies,peanut
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage, removed casing and slice very thin | 3 serrano chilies, halved lenghtwise and thinly sliced | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup ouzo ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce | 1/4 cup sweet hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Cook the sausage and chiles in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring, until browned, about 3 minutes.  Add the beans and ouzo.  Cook, stirring, until the mixture is hot.  Stir in the soy sauces and chili sauce.  Cool to room temperature.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Just before serving, stir in the peanuts.

title: Chocolates for Two
ingredients: 6 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 6 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon garlic, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried garlic
instructions: Combine the parmesan and tamari, add the oil, garlic and crushed garlic.  Spread on the surface of the bar m bread.  Allow to set for at least 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Pomegranate (Saffron) Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried currant | 2 cups pure maple syrup
instructions: Soak currants in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain.  Combine currants and 1 teaspoon of salt in a small bowl.  Pour maple syrup into a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.

title: Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh alfredo sauce | 4 ounces taco seasoning mix | 10 ounces white distilled vinegar
instructions: Pour the alfredo sauce into a medium sized microwavable measuring cup.  Heat on medium until the water has come just to the top of the alfredo sauce.  Remove from microwave and stir in taco seasoning.  Add vinegar.  Stir until combined and pour into a jar to cover.

title: Tantalizing Chinese Sweet Sour Pork Belly Rolls
ingredients: 100 g pork belly, sliced very thinly and fatty | 1 green chili, chopped finely | 100 g shaoxing wine ( i use chinese sherry to reduce the alcohol content of the pork ) | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons ground mild ginger and chili paste
instructions: First combine all ingredients except the phyllo pastry for the rolls.  Add pork mixture and knead to a firm, firm dough.  Cut roll into equal sized squares.  Fold in half and roll into balls.  Put some ginger and chili paste onto each rolled ball and roll up from the longest side.  Make as many rolls as possible from this dough, depending on the size of the roll and how large they are.  Put on an oiled tray and freeze until ready to use.  Cut rolls to desired size and refrigerate.  I freeze about 1/2 a lb before cooking, so the rolls taste even better.  Spray oiled grill with oil and preheat according to instructions and add rolls.  Grill over a hot fire until well browned on outside.  These can be cooked to the desired stage, but are more likely to get crisp before that stage and have a burning smell as burnt on the outside.  These can be frozen if frozen, and the meat mixture from the pork belly becomes oily and sticky.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,lime juice,jarlsberg cheese,apricot jam,serrano pepper
title: Jarlsberg Saucisson
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced jarlsberg cheese | 3 teaspoons apricot jam | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 4 hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon minced serrano peppers
instructions: Place 1 ounce cheese on the bottom of 4 small oven proof serving dishes of your choice.  Top with jam.  Sprinkle with lime juice and hot pepper sauce.  Garnish with remaining cheese.  Place in a 375 degree oven and bake until cheese is bubbling and golden, about 10 minutes.

title: Sweet Woodcock Salad
ingredients: 3 cups unbleached white flour | 3 cups pineapple juice or 3 cups pineapple tidbits, drained | 3 teaspoons dried marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano | lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Place the flour in a large food storage bag.  Make a well in center of the flour and pour the juice or tidbits, it will thicken.  Place it in the freezer until needed.  When ready to serve, use scissors to cut the lettuce if desired.  Place the flour in a salad bowl, and mix in the marjoram or oregano and pineapple.  Toss gently.

title: Grape Tomatoes and Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork | 1/2 lb green pepper | 12 ounces grape tomatoes
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 x 1/4 inch slices.  Cut the green pepper into 1/4 inch slices.  Cut the tomatoes in half.  Put pork slices and green pepper in a large plastic bag with a good seal.  Shake to coat.  Put bag on top of sink.  Put 1 1/2 lbs of grape tomatoes and bag of pork on top of the vegetables in the bag.  Put all bags under the sink into a large bowl.  Let sit for at least an hour.  Thread the pork onto your skewers.  Heat grill.  Add enough oil to the grill to cover the bottom.  Place the skewers.  Cook for about 10 minutes or until dark brown, turning frequently.  Let rest for about 10 minutes before removing skewers from grill.  Slice and serve.

title: Ancho Chile Powder Eggs
ingredients: 2 ancho chile powder | 2 large eggs
instructions: Place chile powder in your coffee mug, and place a small spoonful of water in the bottom of the mug to get the liquid in your chile.  Pour in the eggs, then slowly begin pouring the chile liquid over the chile.  Continue stirring until the eggs have fully absorbed the liquid.  Let the chile powder rest for 15 minutes on the counter and serve.

title: The Best Cucumber Loaf
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the cucumber in a bowl, and stir in the flour.  Place the mixture in a 10x15 inch loaf pan.  Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: lime,sultana,lemon peel,marsala wine,cream cheese,cream chicken soup,milk,peanut oil vegetable
title: Sultana Chicken
ingredients: 1 lime | 1 lemon peel | 1 can condensed cream cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon cream of chicken soup | 1 cup parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 cup milk | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Rinse the lemon peel & lemon peel then place in a plastic bag & add with the rest of the ingredients except for the oil.  Seal the bag then shake the bag to mix the ingredients before dropping in the oil.  The oil will be released during this stage and the oil will continue to rotate around to coat the chicken evenly.  Allow the bag to marinate 10 minutes.  After 10 minutes, remove the bag & allow it to cool then cut into 6 equal pieces.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Cheese Logs-Rolled in Kiwi
ingredients: 2 lbs pork, ground | 3 tablespoons garlic powder | 4 kiwi, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 2 tablespoons grated cheese | crushed ice
instructions: Mix the garlic powder with a quarter cup of cheese and rub onto the inside of a roll.  Make sure all of the meat and kiwi is coated in the garlic mix then stuff the meat with the cheese mix and press some crumbs around the outside edges, then close the roll.  When you have rolled out the kiss roll stick in your freezer until you need to slice.  You can use your ice cream slicer here, slice or cut in slices.  Serve the kiss roll with your favourite sauce.

title: Spinach With Harissa
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 8 -10 -10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed and drained well
instructions: Combine salt, cardamom and about half of the spinach leaves in a shallow bowl and stir to combine.  Spoon the harissa onto a clean cutting board and place it over medium heat.  Let it bubble away for about 1 - 2 minutes.  Then take your spray bottle and the spinach and scatter around a little bit of the spinach.  Let it bubble away and then turn the spinach with a rubber spatula or hands.  Let everything cook for about 3 minutes or until the spinach turns to limp and pliable, adding a touch more oil as needed.  Add the remaining spinach, cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until the spinach wilts and turns more opaque.  You may serve immediately or let cool and store, covered, for up to four days.

Random Ingredients: lime,dark sesame oil,icing sugar,red grape,white rice,chicken bouillon,masa harina flour,veal
title: Sweet and Sour Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 1 cup frozen sliced veal, cooked | 1/4 cup masa harina flour ( corn masa mixture ) | 3 tablespoons white rice ( not converted ) | 1 lime, zest and juice | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 cup red seedless grapes, halved | 1/2 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place the veal in a freezer bag and add the masa harina, rice, lime zest and lime juice.  Close and shake to blend.  Place mixture in refrigerator for 20 minutes, rotating bag over a few times.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the sesame oil in a large skillet set over medium high heat and add the shredded pork.  Stir in the chicken bouillon and cook for about 2 minutes, then remove from pan.  Roll the pork mixture into golf ball size empanadas about 8 in diameter, or 1 inch round.  Slightly flour a work surface and place about 3 tbsp of filling in the center of each empanada.  Wrap the empanada around the filling to enclose the filling completely.  Arrange the empanadas on baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.  Serve garnished with extra lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: summer squash,sake,achiote paste,peanut butter,hunt tomato sauce,red food coloring,green olive,marjoram
title: Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 cup light soy sauce ( achiote or adobo ) | 1 cup hunts tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon achiote paste | 1/4 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts or 1/4 cup almonds | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons goya sazon goya or 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon hunts red food coloring | 12 large fresh summer squash or 12 large zucchini, cut from ends to end | 1 -2 drop red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Combine soy sauce, tomato sauce and achiote paste in a saucepan over medium heat, bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently to avoid the mixture sticking to the bottom, 30 - 60 minutes or until thick.  Stir in peanuts or almonds, marjoram, sazon goya or marjoram, food coloring and squash, cover and cool to room temperature, stirring once halfway through. .  Spread 1 cup of marinade over a 9 x 13 x 2 baking dish.  Place a single layer of squash mixture atop the marinade and spread evenly.  Sprinkle with more marinade, if desired.  Spread 1/2 cup marinade over squash mixture.  Sprinkle on more marinade if desired.  Cover baking dish with foil and place in refrigerator over night.  When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut squash into 2 inch diagonal slices, or cut each piece of zucchini into about 3 - 4 wedges.  Arrange on top of grilled squash mixture and spoon remaining marinade over all the slices, or scatter on top of grilled squash mixture before grilling.  Remove foil from pan, sprinkle with red food coloring and bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until zucchini is tender and squash is well browned.  Allow to rest and firm a few minutes before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,tomato juice,yeast,mascarpone,rosemary sprig,kosher salt,ginger powder
title: Rosemary Mascarpone "whiskey"
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups tomato juice ( strained tomatoes can be used ) | 3 cups mascarpone | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 3/4 teaspoon ground ginger powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig | 2 cups good quality arbailey irish cream ( can be purchased in specialty liquor stores in 1 '' sizes ) | 1/4 cup instant yeast | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Scald tomato juice and add mascarpone.  Add 1/2 tsp yeast and whisk.  Add 1/4 cup arbaïoli and 1 tsp kosher salt.  Whisk.  Add 1/4 cup of the hot tomato juice mixture to mixture and mix.  Add the rest of the tomato juice mixture to form thick cream.  Set mixture aside and let cool to lukewarm.  Add remaining 2 cups arbaïoli to cream sauce and blend.  Fold one third at a time into cream sauce.  Add another third of arbaïoli cream to cream mixture and blend.  Add 2 more tsp yeast and 2 tsp kosher salt.  Mix.  Serve with french bread, crackers, and other assorted cookies.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,cinnamon,green chilies,gouda cheese,dark brown sugar,lemon juice,sugar,mint
title: Green Chile Asparagus Salad With Creamy Cinnamon Dressing
ingredients: 12 ounces asparagus, sliced long and fresh | 1/2 cup fat free gouda cheese or 1/2 cup other firm white cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar or 2 tablespoons splenda brown sugar blend | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 green chilies, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon of fresh mint or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Combine the cheese, brown sugar, lemon juice, chilies, cinnamon and mint in a very large bowl.  Add the asparagus, toss to coat and serve.

title: Tasty Beef Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: 1 box coleslaw mix | 1/2 - 1 cup white wine
instructions: Chop coleslaw and shred with two forks.  Add white wine.  Mix until combined well with shredded beef.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,onion salt,chick pea,lime juice,pecan,lentil,nutritional yeast
title: Moroccan Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked lentils | 8 ounces chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chopped pecans, toasted | 1/4 cup chopped onion with top | 2 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 1/2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix everything together in a bowl.  Chill and serve.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 500 g mature cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons coriander | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Chop the cheese finely.  Mix in a blender with the coriander and turmeric.  Roll into small balls out on a floured surface.  Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Bake at 200 c for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mushroom stem,white wine,chicken,dark soy sauce,grenadine,kalamata olive
title: Chicken Salad With Shiitake Kamatis
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup white wine | 4 tablespoons grenadine | 1 1/2 lbs chicken, boiled and shredded | 2 cans mushroom stems and pieces | 10 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: In a large container or glass bowl combine soy sauce, wine and grenadine.  Coat the chicken with a little of this mixture.  Refrigerate the rest of the marinade.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,mace,lasagna noodle,filet beef,green leaf lettuce,quinoa
title: Vietnamese Beef Salad in a Clay Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 cup medium-grind instant quinoa | 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons nuoc mam or 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 heads green leaf lettuce, trimmed and chopped | 6 slices filet of beef, cut into strips | 12 sheets lasagna noodles, each 12x8-inch and 1/2 inch wide | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cover the quinoa in cheesecloth and tightly seal it.  Let sit 10 minutes.  Put the beef, quinoa, 1 tablespoon nuoc cham and half the chopped lettuce in the clay cooker, pressing down to compact it.  Sprinkle the beef with the mace.  Cover and cook on low for 18 to 19 hours or until the beef is very tender.  Remove the beef and set aside to cool slightly.  Remove the rice and quinoa from the clay cooker and set aside.  When cool enough to handle, shred the beef into 1/2 inch cubes and transfer it to a mixing bowl.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoon nuoc cham and the fish sauce to the beef in the clay cooker.  Cover and set aside at room temperature for another 8 to 19 hours.  Meanwhile, cook the noodles in 4 quarts of salted boiling water for 5 to 8 minutes or until tender and drain.  Dividing the noodles, place an overlapping mound of noodles on the dessert dishes, then scatter with beef, quinoa and lettuce.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Simple Greek Feta Cheeseball
ingredients: 1 lb feta cheese | 10 ounces canola oil
instructions: Drain and crumble feta cheese.  Using an electric mixer, blend feta cheese into the oil.  You might not use all the cheese blend, but keep adding cheese.  When cheese looks creamy and you can see the mixture with hands, take it off the heat and slowly add in the can of oil, stirring.  The size of the ball you're going to use depends on how deep and deep the can of oil is.  I usually use an electric mixer, but if you can see the oil running down it should be done immediately.  Cut into about 15 pieces and enjoy.

title: Lamb and Shiitake Mushrooms in Syrup
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/2 lb shiitake mushrooms or 1/2 lb crimini mushroom, stems removed and caps cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 1/2 lb lamb stew meat or 1/2 lb beef stew meat, thinly sliced
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms under cold water.

title: Mexican Pasta Shells
ingredients: 24 large pasta shells, any name | 2 cans black beans | 2 -3 teaspoons pure vanilla | 1 package taco-size taco shell | 12 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  While pasta is cooking, prepare the beans and mix together in a microwaveable bowl.  Heat oil in microwave at high for 2 minutes or until hot but not smoking.  Pour beans into a large mixing bowl and add the taco spice.  Mix with a fork.  When pasta is done, drain and add to the bowl with the beans.  Mix well.  Serve with warm, freshly grated cheddar cheese.  Enjoy,.

title: Fish With Dates
ingredients: 1 kg cod ( or any firm white fish ) | 1 kg dates
instructions: Cut fish into 8 pieces and mix together with dates.  Cover and refrigerate for 5 hours.  Grill or broil fish on both sides.  Serve with lemon wedges on side for an extra taste.

title: Chocolate-Slimmed Lamb Chili
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground lamb | 1 package dry four-bean mix | 1/4 cup grated chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place lamb in a large, deep skillet.  Pour water into the skillet as needed to cover the meat and make sure it's not touching the bottom of the pan.  Stir in the dry beans mix and heat to boiling.  Bake covered 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until cooked through.  Remove from heat and sprinkle with chocolate.

title: Simple Bourekia Bulgokee (Lamb Bulgokee)
ingredients: 24 ounces lamb ( cut in 1-inch cubes ) | 2 cups dashi granules | 3 tablespoons granulated garlic granules
instructions: Bring dashi to boil.  Add sugar and garlic.  Slowly add meat.  When meat is almost done, take off heat.  Let meat sit, covered for 20 - 30 minutes to absorb the boukia, then serve and enjoy.

title: Smoked Salmon Swiss
ingredients: 5 salmon steaks | 1/2 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill for high heat, about 5 minutes.  Place salmon steaks on the preheated outdoor grill, and sprinkle with the cheese.  Place on an oven proof skillet, and bake in a preheated oven.  Cook, turning once, until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,beef brisket,cumin powder,cream chicken soup,roast pork
title: Texas Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 4 teaspoons dry roast ground pork | 3/4 cup sour cream or 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 packages frozen cut-up cured roast in pork, thawed and rinsed well | 5 lbs beef brisket, tied
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cumin, ground pork, sour cream and 1 cup hot water.  Mix well.  Rub this mixture into the meat, leaving some visible.  On a foil lined baking sheet, place meat on the meat.  Sprinkle with more cumin than desired.  Cover with remaining 1 cup hot water.  Roast in a 350°f oven for about 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.  If roast sticks, trim off thick fat.

Random Ingredients: tapioca,irish whiskey,american cheese,thyme leave,red chili pepper,cold water,anchovy fillet
title: Potted Brains
ingredients:
1 tablespoon tapioca | 4 cups cold water, divided | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb blend ( such as mccormick ) | 2 red chili peppers, chopped ( about 1-1/2 oz.
    - each ) | 3 anchovy fillets, rinsed and drained | 24 slices american cheese
instructions: Dissolve the tapioca in 4 cups cold water in a large glass/ plastic bowl.  Add the thyme, italian herbs, chiles and anchovies.  Drain the tapioca mixture well, discarding the solids and any hard stalks.  Working quickly, transfer the tapioca mixture and the rest of the water to the top of a double thickness of heavy cheesecloth over the pot or the top of a heavy double thickness of greaseproof paper and press down to squeeze out as much liquid as possible.  Once the liquid has been incorporated, transfer it to a saucepan and add 4 cups of the hot water.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat.  Stir and return to the boil.

title: Green Beans With Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium green beans | 1 tablespoon lavender oil | picante sauce
instructions: Trim the ends and cut the ends off of the green beans.  Cut each bean into 2 lengths.  Combine the lavender oil and salt in small bowl and sprinkle over the green beans.  Toss well.  Let it sit in refrigerator for at least an hour.  The longer the green bean sits, the more flavorful the dressing is.  Before serving, sprinkle with vinaigrette just before serving.

title: Easy Nacho Chip Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried currants ( optional ) | 2 cups chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons dried minced chianti rice or 2 tablespoons jalepeno flavored rice crackers
instructions: Spray baking dish with cooking spray.  In medium bowl, stir together currants and salsa.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,greek yogurt,russet potato,caster sugar,fish sauce
title: Indian Sambal
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce, extra | 7 ounces greek yogurt
instructions: Rinse potatoes under cold water.  In a medium saucepan, bring to the boil the sugar and remaining ingredients.  Simmer, covered, for 15 - 20 minutes until potatoes are just tender and a little syrupy.  Drain potatoes, reserving the syrup.  Cut potatoes into thick slices.  To serve, place potato slices on serving plates and spoon sauce evenly over.  Serve warm.

title: Spanish Style Pork and Bean Stew (Crock Pot Version)
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloins, trimmed | 1 yellow onion, sliced thinly | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: In a 5 to 6 qt baking dish or crock pot, combine pork, onion and beans.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 to 10 hours or on high heat setting for 5 to 7 hours.  Add water if necessary.  Serve with cooked white rice.

title: Portuguese Hot Dogs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon fat | 5 hot dogs | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: In a 12 inch non stick skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon fat until crisp, then remove and discard.

Random Ingredients: steak,island dressing,stock,white flour,fish sauce,pinto bean,flour tortilla,brown sugar
title: Steak and Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: 500 g steak, thin sliced | 1 cup dried pinto beans, soaked overnight, then cooked and drained | 1 cup fish sauce | 1 cup flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 cup thousand island dressing | sour stock ( add more if needed ) | 4 small flour tortillas
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and marinade at least 2 hours or overnight.  Thread 2 slices of steak onto each tortilla and cook under a hot grill on medium high for 4 mins each side or until browned and cooked to your liking.  Serve with toppings of choice.

title: Walnut Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup walnut halves | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the walnut halves, coarsely ground, on a baking sheet, and let them cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes.  Dry roast the walnuts in the preheated oven until fragrant but not browned, about 5 minutes.  Remove to a bowl and cool completely, about 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Gently stir in the parsley, then transfer the pesto to a jar with a tight fitting lid and store it in the refrigerator.

title: Mexican Pizza Pie (Copycat)
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/4 cup capers | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed ( or other puff pastry pastry ) | grated mexican cheese ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon kale, chopped ( optional )
instructions: To make the orange marmalade, mix together orange juice, vanilla sugar, brandy, capers, and spread on pastry, leaving 2 inch border.  Sprinkle cheese and kale over top if using.  Roll up pastry tightly.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,clear honey,oyster sauce,saffron,pork sausage
title: Chinese Sate Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 lb barbequed pork sausage | 3 tablespoons clear honey | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, lightly crushed
instructions: Combine the pork with the honey, oyster sauce, rice vinegar and saffron.  Use clean hands to rub the mixture evenly onto the meat.  Let stand for 10 minutes until the mixture is well coated on all sides.  Barbecue over hot coals, turning the meat when necessary, until done at about 20 minutes.  Remove the meat, cut into slices, and serve at once.  Note to test whether the flavour of the sauce is correct for your liking make a small incision with a small knife into the centre of the meat.

Random Ingredients: slab bacon,orange juice zest,raspberry,chicken stock,taco sauce,caster sugar,corn oil
title: Crispy Bacon 'n' Gold Sausages
ingredients: 5 ounces thick slab bacon | 2 ounces thick slab bacon fat | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon orange juice, zest of | 32 ounces chicken stock | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry or 1/2 cup fresh raspberry | 1/2 cup thick taco sauce
instructions: To make the bacon.  Break the slab slab of bacon into small chunks and chop the fat.  Fry the bacon over a medium heat in the hot fat until crispy.  Remove with a slotted spoon, draining onto kitchen paper and set aside.  To make the gravy.  Put the corn, sugar and orange zest in a pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.  Remove and set aside.  To make the salsa.  Put the stock and the salsa in a pan and simmer on a medium heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is reduced by a quarter.  Stir in the bacon and reserved orange zest, bring to the boil, then place in the fridge until ready to use.  To use, cook the sausages in a non stick frying pan over medium heat until crispy and golden, about 5 minutes.  Serve hot with the orange rasco sauce.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green lentil,dark chocolate,italian tomato,wild rice,baby pea,anise extract,cottage cheese
title: Spanish Dark Chocolate and Creamy Lentils
ingredients: 2 cans diced italian tomatoes | 4 ounces good quality dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 4 1/2 ounces green lentils | 1/2 cup green gram flour or 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1 1/2 cups fresh cottage cheese ( can substitute dairy cheese or cream cheese, of choice ) | 1/4 cup baby peas

Put 1 - 2 tablespoons of the lentils into a large casserole dish.  Stir remaining lentils into tomato mixture.  In a bowl, beat cottage cheese with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy.  Stir through the cream cheese mixture and sprinkle each serving with baby peas.  Put all ingredients in a blender and blend until well mixed.  Pour into hot bowls and enjoy.

title: Easy Baked Potatoes, Potatoes, Beef and Goat Cheese

instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, add the cubed pot roast, cubed tomatoes, stewed tomatoes, vanilla bean and enough water to cover the roast. Remove the vanilla bean from the can and discard.  Place 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture onto one side of a piece of cardboard to form a 2 quart circle or circle.  Dab the piece of cardboard with a very clean, dry cloth and use to line with a piece of cheesecloth.  Take one circle of phyllo and cover with 1/2 of the meat mixture. instructions: Place the lima beans in a large container with a lid, and cover with several inches of cool water.  Let soak 8 to 12 hours.  Drain, and set aside. instructions: In a large saucepan, fry chorizo in olive oil over medium heat until almost browned, then remove from pan with slotted spoon and set aside. title: Cream Cheese Filled Cake

instructions: Break the chocolate into cubes and melt in a microwave for a full minute.  Add the milk chocolate mixture and stir until it is well blended. title: Chilies Choclo
ingredients: 4 -6 plum chili peppers | 6 large anaheim chilies | 12 sheets frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed | 2 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa or 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup plum sauce or 1/2 cup light cream | 1 fresh lime, thinly sliced ( to garnish )

Place in a large bowl.  Using a spoon, mix the chilies with the cheese mixture and then set aside.  Heat oil to 180c or gas mark 4 and soften pastry sheets for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly crisp.  Place in the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from oven. In a microwave, on high, heat until cereal is light brown, about 2 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes.  Cool to room temperature before cutting.  Cut into bars.

Stand skewers between two pieces of foil and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until the vegetable is done to your liking.  Remove skewers to a oven dish.  Serve.

title: Roasted Pumpkin and Guacamole

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Coat a large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray, and set aside. title: Beef and Vegetables Skewers - Beef Skewers
ingredients:
2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 1/2 lbs beef roast, preferably eye of round | 1/3 cup basil leaves, chopped ( flat leaf or cilantro, both ok.
    - ) | 1 plum tomato, chopped ( plum tomatoes have a bit of heat and are not'smoking'- i've had several beers in it ) | 6 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 14 ounces fresh spinach leaves, chopped
instructions: Trim any access fat from the meat.  Slice it across the grain into 1/8 inch thick slices.  Dry roast in a dry non stick pan or skillet, for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the slices blacken and feel soft.  Remove from heat, cool slightly and put in a bowl, then cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least an hour and up to overnight.  To remove the grease from the meat, you can either leave the meat in the marinade, or wrap it loosely and freeze it.  If using skewers i sometimes use the marinade as needed to remove those stubborn pieces of meat from the marinade.  I don't know how many skewers this makes, or how much meat it produces, but about 2 to 3 racks worth.  Cut the meat into very thin slices.  Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl.  If using skewers, thread them onto the soaked skewers.  If using bamboo skewers, soak in water for at least an hour prior to placing them on the grill, and then thread onto the soaked skewers.  Cook over hot coals or use a bbq, indirect method.  The cooking time can vary based on the depth and size of your grill and the charcoal.  Grilling methods may also vary, depending on your particular grill.  For medium to well done skewers, cover the meat in a clean, wet towel and allow 25 - 30 minutes on each side for the moisture to thicken, perhaps this could take up to 45 minutes.  Brush 1/4 cup of the tomato sauce over each portion of the meat skewers.  Preheat an outdoor grill for direct cooking over high heat, and lightly oil grate.  Put skewers, meat sides up, on the hot grill and cook for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked to your liking.  Turn as necessary, brushing them with any remaining tomato sauce.  Turn meat and cook 10 minutes more to brown the other side, and then serve on the side or open individual plates.  I serve this with a tossed green salad and a rustic french bread to dip the skewers into.  Enjoy.

title: Lentil Balls, Stove Top or Yummy Curry for One

instructions: Cut 2 large bell peppers in half, remove seeds and membrane.  Remove the tough ends from both.  If using 1 cup croutons, coarsely crush them.  Bring a large non stick skillet over medium heat, add the bell pepper halves and toss until lightly browned.  Stir in the croutons.  Cook stirring often just until the croutons are toasted and heated through.

title: Wild Mushrooms from the Farm
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, brushed | 4 -6 tablespoons ice cubes | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | green, red or purple chilies, to garnish
instructions: Pierce mushrooms with a fork and fill with 1/2 tbsp ice cubes and sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake in the oven for 5 minutes.  Garnish with a red/green chile, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bread,vanilla ice cream,button mushroom,beef tenderloin,moist white cake mix,cayenne
title: Quick Beef Tenderloin Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs trimmed beef tenderloin, filet cut into 3/4-inch thick medallions | 2 cups soft bread roll ( i use pepperidge farm brand ) | 1 loaf unsliced white cake mix | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup other favorite cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Cook meat for 6 to 8 minutes per side in a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Transfer to a cutting board, tent with foil, and let stand 5 minutes, then slice.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to combine bread rolls, cake mix, cheese, and ice cream.  Divide meat among 8 bread portions, and top with remaining bread, cheese, and cheese.  Heat until bread is toasted.

title: Homemade Quick and Easy One Cracked Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chicken wings or 4 -5 lbs your favorite chicken parts | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried breadcrumbs or 3 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and place in a large bowl.  Add all remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs/bread crumbs.  Whisking until well mixed.  Spray large plastic bucket liberally and lay the chicken pieces in and pat into an even layer.  Cover with lid or other non stick surface, pressing down firmly so that the chicken can breathe.  Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour to let the coating thicken a bit and the bread crumbs/bread crumbs to coat the chicken pieces.  Place covered chicken pieces in the refrigerator about two hours or longer to chill.  The chicken can be served at room temperature or chilled.  Note, you may need to use your fingers to separate them when they are done.  If you don't have a chicken slicer, use a meat tenderizer or a special knife to trim off excess fat/sauce.  Instead, you may use your fingers to cut pieces into 3/8 inch pieces or smaller.  You may add about a teaspoon or so of salt depending upon your taste.  The meat mixture may also be shaped into a ball with your hands or a rolling pin if preferred.  I love roller pinching the dough to help the coating fall off easier.

title: Kerry Turnips
ingredients: 2 large turnips, peeled and divided into two wedges each | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Arrange half the turnips in the roasting pan.  Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons jelly.  Roast in preheated oven until tender, about 40 minutes.  Transfer turnips to a food processor and puree the turnips with 2 tablespoons jelly, adding more jelly if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,chili sauce thai chli,yellow squash,avocado,tomato green chilies,strawberry
title: Guilt Free Guacamole
ingredients: 1 avocado | 1 tablespoon tomato and green chilies | 1 tablespoon yellow squash | 1 tablespoon low-sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon chili sauce thai chili ( or chili flakes to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh strawberries, chopped
instructions: Halve avocado and scoop out flesh.

title: Beef Fennel
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin, cubed | 400 ml v8 vegetable juice | 6 -12 fennel seeds | 1 fresh red chilies
instructions: In the meantime, heat the v2 up.  Cut the fresh chillies into 5mm lengths and slice them thinly.  Take the fennel seeds out of the seeds and grind them in an electric coffee grinder.  When the v8 is cooled, blend it into a paste with the fennel seeds to make a smooth paste.  Serve on top of the meat while still warm.

title: Egg Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen peas and carrots | 250 ml meat stock | 4 eggs
instructions: Put the peas and carrots in to a large pot or pressure cooker.  Add the stock and bring to a boil.  In 4 - 4 minutes the soup will start to thicken, so do not let the soup boil rapidly.  Separate the eggs from the whites, and scramble, so they are cooked but not frothy.  Put the eggs back in with the soup and stir well.  Let simmer for 5 - 10 minutes so the eggs can set up in the soup.  Serve hot. .

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,taco seasoning mix,beef bouillon cube,bicarbonate soda,liquid smoke
title: A Simple Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 packet beef bouillon cube | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Combine your favourite ingredients.  Place kebabs in a shallow baking tin.  Pour over the liquid smoke and bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on your temperature and the size of the tin.  Allow the kebabs to rest for 15 minutes before serving over brown rice.

title: Rice Cooked Potatoes and Thai Chips
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch rounds | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and pour out any water into the pan.  Place the potatoes onto the aluminum foil in a circular fashion, leaving the sides and ends uncoated.  Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 25 minutes.  Drain the potatoes, and cool.  Turn off the oven, and put the fries on a plate.  Melt the fish sauce in a separate saucepan, and set aside.  Arrange the potatoes over a rice stick or slice of aluminum foil to prevent them drying out.  Top each potato with a few slices of fish sauce.  Top with strips or sticks.

Random Ingredients: fruit cocktail,tart apple,apricot preserve,buttermilk,cashew,asafoetida powder,barbecue sauce
title: Apple and Apricot Applesauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons chopped cashews | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored, finely chopped | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon beeti asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon apricot preserves | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: To make sauce, combine and mix the 1/2 cup preserves, cashews, apples, bbq sauce, beeti asafoetida and apricot preserves.  To serve, spoon 1/2 cup sauce onto each plate.  Garnish w/diced apple slices.

title: Dad's Excellent Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 3 slices cooked bacon | 3/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Lay the bacon slices on the counter.  Place the cream in a saucepan over medium heat.  Let the cream simmer until thick and creamy.  Pour sauce mixture into a blender.  Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.  Pulse 10 times or, until creamy, 2 - 10 seconds.  Serve hot over alfredo or fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: fruit,cooking spray,chili bean paste,canola oil,marshmallow,black eyed pea,artichoke heart,baking soda
title: Corn Bean-Black-Eyed Pea Spice Muffins
ingredients: cooking spray | 3 cans black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 2 cans marinated artichoke hearts, well drained and chopped | 1 1/4 cups canola oil | 3 1/4 cups miniature marshmallows | 4 tablespoons chili bean paste ( or kochujang ) | 2 2 tablespoons baking soda
instructions: Spray 12 nonstick muffin cups with cooking spray.  Process black eyed beans, artichoke hearts, and oil in a food processor until coarsely chopped.  Stir together mallows, chili bean paste, and baking soda.  Add to bean mixture in pan.  Stir until evenly coated.  Spoon mixture into muffin cups leaving about 1/2 inch of headspace at top of each cup, and sprinkle evenly with marshmallows.  Bake in 400°f oven for 18 to 22 minutes on each side or until tops are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,basmati rice,coconut,apricot,lasagna noodle,red chili pepper flake,honey
title: Thai Apricot & Honey Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 2 cups cooked chopped white basmati rice ( can use white ) | 1 jar marinated apricots, undrained | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded sweetened coconut, divided | 2 cups hot cooked egg noodles ( uncooked, can use more or less )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process.  Mix together all of the ingredients except the noodles in a bowl and mix well.  Spoon the mixture into a greased 13x9 inch baking dish and sprinkle with the coconut slices.  Cover completely with foil and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 - 35 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,rosemary,bamboo skewer,tomato soup,penne pasta,dashi stock,whipping cream,sherry wine
title: Savory Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can condensed soup, undiluted | 1 cup dashi stock | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 4 -5 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 bunch fresh finely chopped fresh rosemary | 2 -3 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 mins or 1/2 cup dried soaked wood chips, for garnish
instructions: Prepare pasta in a large pot of boiling water.  Once water is boiling, add pasta.  Cook al dente.  Drain.  While pasta is cooking, combine remaining ingredients in 2 - 3 qt pot over medium heat.  Heat through, stirring, 1 minute.  Transfer to a serving bowl.  Garnish with rosemary springs.  Serve at once.

title: Mexican Spicy Steak
ingredients: 1 box frozen asparagus, thawed | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray.  Layer asparagus with tomatoes with green chilies, tearing apart the pieces with your hands.  Bake in a preheated oven until hot, about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Bananas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons fresh chives blossoms, snipped or 6 tablespoons green chives, snipped | 5 tablespoons canned italian tomatoes, with their juice, chopped | 4 medium firm firm ripe bananas | 1/2 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup vegetarian mozzarella cheese
instructions: Pound the chives or chives into the mixture.  Set the mashed bananas in a baking dish.  Sprinkle with tomato.  Bake at 400° degrees f for 20 minutes until the topping is golden.  Or bake in a 400° oven for 20 minutes until the topping is crispy.  Cool on a wire rack.  Mash with a fork, add the cheese and stir until evenly melted.

title: My Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 5 -6 tablespoons lemon juice | lemon peel ( optional )
instructions: Cover container of yogurt with fresh cold water and freeze overnight for best results.  Combine yogurt in medium bowl with lemon peel and lemon juice, stirring well to blend.  Cover tightly and freeze for at least 4 to 6 hours.  Serve plain or over ice cubes.  Store in freezer container for up to 3 months.  Enjoy.

title: Russian Turnip Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1/2 cup finely diced yellow squash, unpeeled | 3/4 cup finely diced turnip | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Chill covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.  Heat cream in a saucepan over medium heat until just beginning to simmer.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,beef sirloin steak,garbanzo bean,red wine
title: Cuban Steak for Two
ingredients: 4 boneless beef top sirloin steaks, about 1/2 pound each | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine | 1 large yellow onion, cut into wedges and separated
instructions: Heat coals or gas grill for direct heat.  Place steak on grill.  Brush steak evenly with cooking oil.  Broil 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare or 5 to 7 minutes per side for medium rare.  Transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil.  Let rest about 3 minutes.  Cut into 2 pieces.  Meanwhile, combine beans, wine and 1 onion wedge in a medium bowl.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Remove steak from grill and let stand about 5 minutes.  Transfer steak to cutting board.

title: Pepper Beef Burgers With Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 -2 tablespoon triple sec | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs or 1/4 cup fine breadcrumbs | 2 -4 teaspoons lemongrass, minced, to taste | 2 -3 teaspoons thai basil or 2 -3 teaspoons thai basil
instructions: Mix all the ingredients to form a firm, even batter.  Place about 2 tbs of the batter on the work surface and shape into patties.  Grill on middle rack of an an open griddle / toaster oven, about 6 - 6 minutes on each side, or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,chicken,hoagie,horseradish,silken tofu,purpose flour,sea salt pepper
title: Honeydew Chicken and Tofu Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken, preferably organic and skinless | hoagie rolls or kaiser roll, split horizontally | sea salt and pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons fresh horseradish, grated | 1 lime, zest of, grated or 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 1 1/2 cups silken tofu, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Season the chicken with 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper.  Set aside.  Combine the horseradish, lime zest and 1/3 cup of the water in a small bowl and, using a potato masher, mash the mixture until it becomes a paste.

title: Chicken Wrapped in Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole | 150 g cooked chicken breast fillets, roughly chopped | 1 package cannellini beans | 1/4 cup mixed herbs, such as rosemary and continental or 2 teaspoons dried herbs | 1 corn, fresh or frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Spread each piece of chicken with guacamole, then top with remaining ingredients.  Tightly roll up tightly and secure with tooth picks.  Place on tray lined with baking paper.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Place a large plate on top to allow extra to run down around sides.

title: Kathy's Best Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb flank steak | 1 container pomegranate molasses | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 10 pomegranate molasses | 8 slices deli roast beef | 8 -10 rolls
instructions: Combine molasses, cinnamon, pomegranate molasses, and 2 3/4 tblsps.  Of the liquid from pomegranate molasses jars in a slow cooker.  Add roast beef, and let sit on high for about 4 hours.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Insert 8 or 10 roll tops into a 9x13 baking dish.  If necessary, use more liquid to cover roll tops loosely.  Spoon meat from marinade into a small roasting pan, and tent loosely with foil.  Bake uncovered about 1 hour, or until heated through.  Let meat rest 15 - 20 minutes before slicing.  Discard foil, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,baby green,pinto bean,white bread,chocolate chip,lime leaf
title: Choco-boy Cannelloni
ingredients: 6 slices fresh white bread | 6 fresh lime leaves | 3 containers baby greens | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 1 package lasagna noodles, broken in half ( about 6 servings )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place bread slices on a foil lined sheet pan.  Bake in middle of oven 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly toasted, turning once.  Cool bread slightly.  Stir together the bread, lettuce, pinto beans, chocolate, and lime leaves.  Spread 1/3 cup chili sauce over each noodle.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,black mustard seed,crouton,red onion,margarine,puff pastry,genoa salami,corn
title: Corn on the Cob Antipasto
ingredients: 1 cup corn ( frozen ) | 1/4 lb genoa salami, sliced in 1/4 inch pieces | 1/2 lb norwegian sweet pepperoncini pepper ( chopped with seeds ) | 1/2 lb crouton | 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 small red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat your grill or a heavy bottomed frypan on medium, with a very small amount of oil if you use one.  If your grill has a lower rack heat the oil.  In a bowl, mix together the corn, salami, pepperoncini, croutons, mustard seeds, onion, sugar and margarine with a fork or pastry cutter until just combined.  Spread this mixture onto the hottest grill/frying pan/skillet, so it is of a even thickness.  When it's hot add the mustard seeds.  Spread it onto the entire mixture.  Cook the mixture on the hot griller/skillet until it is all the way cooked.  Take it out of the grill.  Slice into pieces on a diagonal, or use a cookie cutter to cut out the squares.  Allow to cool and serve with french bread.  Enjoy.

title: Black Bean Hummus
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper
instructions: Blend black beans, lemon pepper, and lemon juice in blender until smooth.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,salmon fillet,chicken breast half,guacamole,star anise,coconut flake,walnut
title: Aunt Kathy's Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground star anise | 1 cup shredded coconut flakes | 1/4 cup ground walnuts, divided | 1 tablespoon guacamole ( optional ) | 3 thick slices country-style smoked salmon fillets
instructions: Season chicken with taco seasoning and star anise, and coat with coconut flakes and 1/4 cup coconut and the ground walnuts.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir chicken in the hot skillet in a few batches until the chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 7 minutes per side.  Remove from the skillet and keep warm.  Spoon some of the hot chicken juices into a small serving bowl.  Spoon some additional coconut into a small bowl and pour over salad greens.  Top with other salad greens to serve.

Random Ingredients: meat,mexican crema,currant jelly,tart apple,red kidney bean,salsa,cabbage,poundcake
title: Potpie Con Queso
ingredients: 2 cans mexican-style processed cheese food | 1 jar red kidney beans, drained | 1 pound lean stew meat, cubed | 1 cup salsa | 1 package frozen miniature cake rounds | 3 tart apples - peeled, cored, and diced | 1 package shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup dried currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  In a large bowl, stir processed cheese food, kidney beans, stew meat, salsa, cake rounds, apples, and cabbage together.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight.  Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and crust is browned.

title: German White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans | 2 packages mild kielbasa, sliced into 1/2 inch slices ( about 8-10 slices ) | 2 cans reduced-sodium beef broth | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Turn stove to high and place kielbasa and beef broth in a large 4 quart dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,confectioner sugar,feta cheese,taco seasoning mix,mirin,grand marnier
title: Grilled Feta Cheese
ingredients: 3 pounds feta cheese | 2 pinches cayenne, or amount to taste | 1/2 cup grand marnier, liquir, or other liqueur | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Cut the feta cheese into 1/8 inch slices.  Brush slices with grand marnier on both sides.  Place slices on grill and broil until cheese is melted, 3 to 5 minutes.  Place cooked feta cheese on a plate with a towel lined with paper towels to absorb excess juices.  Allow to cool until warm, about 5 minutes.  Mix in taco seasoning, cayenne, and confectioners' sugar until thoroughly combined.  Spoon into serving dishes, and serve.

title: Easy One-Dish Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package yellow peas, thawed | 1 can chickpeas noodles | 12 sheets nori | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 can guacamole
instructions: Soak peas overnight in water to cover.  Drain peas, and refill pot with cold water.  Stir in noodles.  Bring to boil.  Cover, and reduce heat to low.  Cook for 10 minutes, then uncover and fluff with fork.  Allow to cool for a few minutes to allow noodles to absorb flavors.  Place one sheet nori on plate.  Turn over, and slice diagonally into 1/2 inch wide, 2 inch wide strips.  Spread about 2 tablespoons of the vodka on each strip.  Garnish with guacamole, and serve.

title: Hong Kong Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 package chow mein noodles | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Place the egg yolks in a bowl and mix with about a cup of hot water.  When the egg yolks are completely mixed with the water, add the egg whites for a ribbon like appearance, stir gently and allow the batter to sit for about ten minutes for the egg to set.  Heat a wok or large frying pan.  When it is quite hot, pour enough oil so that it reaches about three quarters inch of temperature.  Heat to 375 degrees f, or until the surface is half covered with tiny bubbles.  Drop or stir the noodles into the hot oil, a few at a time, and fry until they are golden brown on both sides.  Drain all the noodles in a strainer briefly, and place into a warm serving bowl.  Stir the egg whites in the sift, then spoon over the noodles.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,olive,camembert cheese,lemon sorbet,chili sauce,onion salt,celery
title: Sweet Potato & Camembert Hot Potato Parcels
ingredients: 1 camembert cheese | 2 sweet potatoes | 1/2 cup olive, drained, oil-packed | 1/2 cup onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon celery | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 1/2 ounces ripe olives | 1 1/2 ounces ripe olives ( drained ) | lemon sorbet
instructions: Pierce camembert with sharp knife in 2 or 3 inch intervals.  Cook potatoes, peel if desired, in lightly salted water to cover for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked.  Drain and set aside.  Cut cheese into 1/3 inch cubes.  Slice sweet potatoes thinly into 1/4 inch slices and toss with cheese.  Combine remaining ingredients with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle over cheese mixture.  Chill.  Serve with lemon sorbet.

title: Sinful Spinach & Chili Chip Pudding
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 6 -10 pimientos, finely chopped ( or less ) | 1 tablespoon minced chile paste | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1 teaspoon white salt | 3 tablespoons butter, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup toasted almond, finely chopped | 1/2 cup butterscotch chips
instructions: Steam spinach until wilted about 3 - 4 minutes or so, just until tender, not mushy.  Using tongs, gently toss spinach with peppers, pimentos, chile, salt, butter, and garlic paste.  Divide among 8 dessert dishes.  Sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,guacamole,cream celery soup,shallot,vanilla vodka,stewing beef,cardamom pod,phyllo dough
title: Beef Cigars(Caribbean, Caribbean)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in bite-size pieces or | 1/2 lb shallot, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup guacamole, to taste | 1 can cream of celery soup | 3 tablespoons vanilla vodka | 1 cardamom pod, crushed or 1 cinnamon stick with seeds | 4 small red chilies, seeded and chopped, plus | additional garnish, for garnish | 6 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Heat stew beef in a large skillet over medium high heat until browned, about 10 minutes.  Add shallots and sauté until soft, about 3 minutes.  Stir in guacamole, soup, vodka, and cardamon.  Simmer for 5 minutes.  Taste and adjust spices, if necessary.  Sprinkle with chiles and remove cardamon pods if using.  Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough in bottom of a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish.  Repeat layering until all have been used.  Pour half of beef mixture into each phyllo stack, leaving about 1/2 inch uncovered with the edge nearest you.  Top with 2 more sheets of phyllo dough, then brush with the glaze.  Repeat layering twice using 1/2 cup of beef mixture, then drizzle with remaining glaze.  Bake at 350f for about 45 minutes, or until phyllo is golden brown and crispy.  Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: haddock fillet,cream tartar,ketjap manis,soya sauce,vegetable oil,clove,chipotle pepper
title: Creamy Smoked Haddock
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 whole cloves | 24 ounces smoked haddock fillets | 3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 3 tablespoons light soya sauce | vegetable oil
instructions: Place the pepper in a saucepan and half fill it with water.  Place over high heat, bring to a boil and simmer for about 3 - 5 minutes until peppers are soft and soft.  Place the haddock in a bowl and pour boiling water over it to cover and add to the saucepan, keeping an eye on the water level.  Cover and leave in a warm place for 10 minutes until fish is cooked.  Drain water from pan and return the fish to the pan.  Stir the cream of tartar and cloves with the ketjap manis.  Add the ketjap manis slowly through the water in the bowl and keep stirring until it has a creamy consistency.  Place fish on serving plates and pour the sauce over.

title: Raspberry, Pineapple, Tomatillo, and Banana Filling for Two
ingredients: 1 cup white mushroom, sliced ( any small variety will do ) | 1 cup ripe mango, diced | 1/4 cup frozen peaches, thawed and sliced ( or canned sliced mango ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, to taste | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 12 tomatillos, husked and washed | 1/4 cup walnuts, crushed
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients.  Cover, and let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes to allow flavors to mingle.  Remove husks, and serve.  The filling should be thickly and subtly flavored.  To assemble, lay tomatillo and walnut pieces in the center of four plates.  Place a scoop or two of the banana filling onto middle of the plate.  Garnish with mango slices and a few sprigs of pineapple if you like enjoy.

title: Chimichurri
ingredients: 5 -6 cups diced rotel tomatoes | 1 package active dry yeast | 4 cups plain pork and beans | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside.  In a large bowl, mix all ingredients until well blended.  Cover bowl and let sit 90 minutes to 1 hour.  Starter will be bubbling hard.  To test for doneness, poke one with thumb and make a dent in center of sour dough.  Then release bubbles and/or stir mixture.

title: Cheesy Chicken Paprikash or Crispy Chili
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 4 slices swiss cheese ( thick slices ) | 2 dried red chiles | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Boil some water.  Meanwhile, in a frying pan, saute chiles, garlic and paprika until hot.  Add chicken and cook over medium heat for a few minutes on each side.  Drain.  Add the drained chilies and cheese to the chicken, then spread out to cover the bottom of a pyrex dish, top with chicken slices, and top with paprika.  Place under the broiler and cook, uncovered and bubbly, for about 10 minutes, or until cheese is golden brown.  If you have any chicken bits left over, stir them into the chicken, just before they turn bubbly.

title: Homemade Dressing for Seafood
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice or 1/2 cup arborio rice | ice water | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Make the rice and tamari in a medium size pan, mix the tamari, mustard powder, and salt.  Chill until needed.

Random Ingredients: peanut,cream chicken soup,tofu,artichoke heart,apricot preserve,mexicorn,jerk seasoning,bottom roast
title: Roasted Tofu Sandwiches (The Best Ever)
ingredients: 1 bottom roast | 4 cups peanut mashed potatoes ( i know peanut fat free ) | 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces artichoke hearts | 8 ounces small pitted dried apricot preserves | 8 ounces firm tofu | 1 tablespoon jerk seasoning | 2 tablespoons jerk seasoning
instructions: Cut the roast in half, then slice across the grain into long, narrow, wide strips.  Toss the meat with the jerk seasoning in a plastic bag and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Put the mashed potato into the oven and set it timer for 15 - 20 minutes.  While the potatoes are cooking add the cream of chicken and tomato soup to a bowl.  Place the meat strips onto a lightly oiled bread pan that has been lightly brushed with olive oil.  Arrange the meat strips in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Top with mashed potatoes then spread the cream soup mixture over the potatoes, making sure the meat is covered with potatoes.  Top with the dried fruit, if using, then top with tofu.  Sprinkle generously with jerk seasoning on top.  Place in preheated oven and bake until the potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.  The bottom should be light brown and crisp and the meat should be falling apart, yet a little crispy and chewy.  Insert a fork into the top of the sandwich and check for doneness, adding more jerk seasoning if you like your sandwich crispy.  Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Camarones Al Mejillo
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shrimp, peeled, deveined and peeled | 12 fluid ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1 lb masa harina
instructions: Cook the shrimp in boiling, salted water for 1 minute or until just pink.  Remove with a slotted spoon and drain well.  Place the shrimp in a shallow dish and spread both sides of each piece with the mascarpone.  Sprinkle with chilli if desired.  Heat a cast iron griddle or heavy skillet until very hot.  Place the masa in the bowl of a food processor and process until it becomes very small crumbs that stick together, about 1 minute.  Place 1/2 tablespoon on each plate.  Spread the shrimp crumbs over the shrimp, and roll them up.  Serve in a warm warm dish with any remaining shrimp crumbs on the side.  Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Sweet Prawn Pasta
ingredients: 500 g pasta | 400 -450 g raisins | 2 -3 poblano chiles | 2 -3 cardamom seeds
instructions: Peel the prawns if they are large, remove all the shell and devein if they are smaller.  If there is one prawn, remove all the intestines and heads and discard.  Using a mortar and pestle, crush the cardamom seeds until they form a pestle.  Heat oil and fry cardamom until the sugar starts to foam.  Fry chopped peppers until softened, remove from pan and put them on paper towel to dry off.  Add small quantity of oil to the pan, fry prawns until brown, remove and put on paper towel to drain. instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

instructions: Put canadian bacon and sage in a saucepan over medium heat and saute until the bacon releases some of its fat.  Drain off excess fat.  Add the canadian bacon and sage mixture to a large clean non stick pan.  Heat for about 1 minute.  Serve with crackers or toast.

instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the directions on the package.  Drain the macaroni and stir it into the pesto sauce.  Stir in the tomatoes, lime juice, baking soda, cardamom and boiling water.  Let the mixture sit, covered, for about 15 minutes or longer if desired, and serve.

title: Quick French Onion Seasoning Mix - for Crock Pot

4 packages onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons mrs.

title: Raspberry-Maple Jam Granita®
ingredients: 5 ounces raspberry jam | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: In a medium bowl whip the raspberry jam until soft.  Fold in the maple syrup, grand marnier and jam.  Pour into a shallow glass or ceramic dish, cover tightly & refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving.

title: Easy and Easy Carnitas
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch thick strips | 1/2 lb beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/2 lb veal cutlet, cut into 1-inch squares | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package mushroom pieces, drained | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Toss together pork and beef squares and veal in a large bowl.  Combine taco seasoning in a separate bowl and pour over meat.  Let sit in refrigerator at least 1 hour.  Prepare a gas grill or a medium high flame.  Remove meat and vegetable mixture from bowl and discard.  Place meat on hot grates.  Discard marinade and cook, turning once and laying pieces of meat on grill, until charred, about 5 minutes for boneless, 15 minutes for well done.  Turn meat pieces over and continue cooking for an additional 7 - 8 minutes.  Turn meat over in order to brown evenly on all sides.  Serve with lime wedges.  Garnish with lime zest.

title: Easy Beef Baskets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 500 g ground beef eye round | 1 red capsicum, finely chopped | 1/2 cup low sodium tomato soup | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 50 wonton wrappers
instructions: Combine cardamom, worcestershire sauce and xanthan gum in a small bowl.  Add the beef, capsicum, tomato soup and rice vinegar and mix well with clean hands.  Line 2 - 12 hole mini baggies or muffin trays with non stick baking paper.  Dip each won ton wrapper into the water, then moisten the tip of each won ton wrapper with 2 tbs water.  Place about 1 1/2 mins from the end of the baking paper.  Make 2 space in the centre of each bun by pinching 2 of the won ton wrappers together.  Place the won ton parcels on a tray lined with non stick baking paper and place the tray in the freezer for 30 min to chill.  Serve the beef hot with a side dish of chopped parsley and your favourite red chutney.  These can be made for up to 7 days in advance, or freeze for up to 2 months.

title: Green Chile & Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 large poblano chile, roasted, peeled and seeded | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 tablespoons matcha green tea powder ( or other green powder )
instructions: Cut chile in half lengthwise and devein, removing seeds.  Cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Place the chile pieces in a salad bowl with the broccoli.  Sprinkle with matcha and toss.  Chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Peanut Slice
ingredients: 1 shortcrust pastry ( or two sheets of frozen pastry ) | 1 spanish onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon lemongrass ( finely chopped ) | 600 g kielbasa or 600 g cooked chicken | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1 package biscuit ( or 1/2 package plain sandwich breadsticks )
instructions: Roll out pastry to a rectangle with a 25 cm x 30cm strip.  Trim excess pastry and spread the onion over the pastry leaving a 5cm slice on one side.  In another pan melt the peanut butter using a little of the liquid from the jar to thin the peanut butter to a spreadable consistency use a spoon or whisk until all the peanut butter is used.  Remove the zest from half a spring onion with a finely grated zest, and finely chop or put through a food processor, until smooth.  Place half the peanut butter mix, mix in the cinnamon and lemongrass, mix well, and spread over the onion.  Place the sausage meat on top in a long, straight slice, place on top of the peanut sauce, and roll up neatly.  Transfer to a baking sheet and cover with the other pastry layer, making sure it is completely covered.  Brush the top of the pastry with the remaining oil, spread the spring onion on top of the sausage meat, then brush with remaining oil.  Bake for 30 minutes in a preheated oven at 200°c/400°f degrees, or until pastry is golden and filling is heated through.

title: Crazy Crawfish Potato Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag crispy salami | 1/4 lb sliced crawfish | 1/2 cup sweet corn flour | 1 small idaho potato
instructions: Heat oven to 400 f degrees.  On cookie sheet place potatoes.  Slice salami into 1/2 thick slices.  Place salami slices onto potatoes.  Top with crawfish.  Add corn flour and mix it up.  Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Mozambique Mussels
ingredients: 1 kg mussels | 1 lime | 3 tablespoons muskels, shell in | 50 g kirsch | 150 g mixed green olives, drained | 1 tablespoon mirin | 3 tablespoons kirsch | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Boil mussels until shells open.  Remove mussels.  Cut lime into half lenghtwise and remove all pith.  Squeeze juice from half lime to prevent browning.  Set mussels aside to cool.  Add limes to mussel base.  Add olives and simmer for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Combine honey, mirab, kirsch, garam masala, turmeric and sugar until well blended, stirring well to dissolve.  Pour over mussels, and toss gently.  Serve in a shallow dish or a bowl.  Garnish as desired with additional lime wedges and serve with pita bread.

title: Quick Broccoli and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 can broccoli florets, drained | 1/2 head cauliflower, separated into florets
instructions: Place cauliflower and broccoli florets in a saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, uncovered, over high heat.  Simmer 3 - 5 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender.  Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining ingredients.

title: Curried Corn
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes | 3 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f coat a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Layer corn, cheese/curry mixture and curry powder in the baking dish.  Bake for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Simple Croutons
ingredients: 4 pork chops, bone-in | garlic powder
instructions: Heat frying pan over medium heat.  Sprinkle pork chops with garlic powder.  Lightly brown chops in hot oil.  Drain chops on paper towels, leaving excess fat in pan.  Serve with mashed yummy garlic bread, or your chosen sandwich.  Enjoy.

title: Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve the almond extract in the vinegar.  Using a pastry brush, brush on the almond/water mixture.  Store in a cup to ensure the glaze does not turn to run over.

title: Guacamole

1 medium plum tomato, coarsely chopped ( or 1/2 cup tomatoes and 1 tbsp.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized serving bowl.  Top with fresh mint if using, if using, or serve with sliced pita bread.

title: Coconut Pork
ingredients: 2 pounds pork loin, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Pour red curry paste into a small saucepan, and add water to cover.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove from heat, and refrigerate for about 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray lightly with oil.  Place pork strips on the prepared baking sheet, and baste with the pan drippings.  Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour, or until the pork is dry, and a meat thermometer inserted in the center registers 145 degrees f.  Remove and let meat sit on the foil covered baking sheet for about 10 minutes.  Remove pork from pan, and cut meat into strips about 1 1/2 to 2 inches long.  Transfer pork strips to a bowl, and mix with confectioners' sugar.  Increase heat, and stir until sugar has dissolved.  Increase heat, and bring to a boil.

title: Cranberry Chutney
ingredients: 200 400 g fresh cranberries, washed, picked over and trimmed | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh fennel seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan over a low heat.  Stir often as the fruit will cook down and become mushy.  This is best eaten hot as it keeps the chilli from spreading and giving away a wonderful flavour.  This chutney can also be used as a topping for your other dishes and also as a seasoning for fried or scrambled chicken, vegetable and chicken.

instructions: Place 1 sheet phyllo on work surface.
