title: Brussels Sprouts With Least & Sherry
ingredients: 500 g brussels sprouts | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 teaspoons dried lemon juice | 2 teaspoons dried savory, or | 1 teaspoon dried savory, or | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh yeast
instructions: Clean the brussels sprouts thoroughly by washing them under cool water.  Trim the root ends, then slice them as thinly as possible.  Bring a large pan of water to boil.  Drop in the brussels sprouts, a few at a time, and cook until just tender.  Drain immediately, put them in a deep colander, and let drain for 20 minutes or longer.  Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour them over the sprouts.  Let the brussels sprouts stand for 1 hour or more, covered.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,dark chocolate square,white sugar,cumin powder,irish cream,artichoke heart,chicken breast half
title: Spiced Chicken Breasts With Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup dark chocolate shavings ( or a dark ) | 4 fluid ounces irish cream | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 3 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder or 3 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 cup fresh cremini mushroom, quartered | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
instructions: Arrange chicken in the slow cooker to cover the meat with the dark chocolate sauce, leaving a 1/2 inch border of bare bare meat on chicken.  Sprinkle the top with sugar, cumin and mushrooms.  Cover and cook on low for 6 hours.  Stir artichoke hearts into slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,peanut oil,red curry paste
title: Black Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 packages frozen black-eyed peas | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 3 tablespoons red curry paste, or more to taste
instructions: Place the black eyed peas in a pot and cover with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until the peas are tender, about 25 minutes.  Drain.  Remove 1 pound of black eyed peas from pot and place in a bowl.  Stir remaining black eyed peas, peanut oil, and red curry paste into black eyed peas, and mix thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate until flavors blend, at least 1 hour.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato, Mango Chutney, or Sun-Dried Tomato Salad on Skewers (Ww Points)
ingredients: 8 sun-dried tomatoes oil | 1 large mango, peeled, pitted and sliced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup sliced mushroom ( about 3 cup )
instructions: Thread 3 sun dried tomatoes on the skewers.  Place skewers on a lightly greased rimmed baking sheet.  Toss the mango, mushrooms, and sun dried tomatoes with all the ingredients in a bowl.  Cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Laos Pork
ingredients: 8 lbs pork shoulder, boneless | 2 gallons juice | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce or 1/3 cup honey mustard | 3 tablespoons minced fresh galangal | 1 tablespoon cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon whole lime juice
instructions: Place pork in a large dutch oven or other large pot with enough water to cover.  Boil over high heat, skimming off any scum that rises to the surface just above the pot.  Reduce heat to low and simmer until pork begins to fall apart and falls apart, 1 to 2 hours.  Remove pork from pot to a dish and allow to cool completely.  Place cooled pork in the refrigerator until very cold.  Transfer cold pork to a large bowl or platter.  Skim excess fat from drippings and place pork on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.  Roast in a shallow pan at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes per pound, until a meat thermometer in a small, shallow, slotted spoon, reads at least 145 degrees f.  Transfer pork to a platter and allow the pork to cool thoroughly.  Once cool, shred pork with a large fork and set aside.  In a slow cooker or other large pot, combine the hoisin sauce, galangal, cardamom, lime juice and 1 tablespoon of the reserved pork fat.  Mix well and cook until sugar is thoroughly dissolved.  Slowly add the hot liquid in slow cooker, stirring constantly to prevent the hot meat from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Remove from heat.  Place pork in slow cooker or platter and pour sauce over.  Allow to cool and refrigerate overnight.  Serve with boiled or mashed potatoes.

title: Churros With Walnuts
ingredients: 4 plain tortillas | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 cup yoghurt | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts | 1 jar pimientos, chopped ( about 1 1/2 tbsp ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro or 1 -2 1 -2 tablespoon parsley ( for garnish ) | 4 -6 tablespoons raspberry jam or 4 -6 tablespoons raspberry jam, warmed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f degrees.  Place tortillas in large baking dish with sides.  Sprinkle both sides of the taquitos with the flour.  Bake until crispy and golden brown on all sides.  For each tortilla, add a tablespoon or two of the yoghurt to one taquitos and top with the walnuts, pimientos, and cilantro.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Chop Pibil for Two
ingredients: 20 slices pork butt, thin slices, from the butcher cut | 1 ounce lard | 2 ounces corn oil | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, paste or 2 ounces kombu seaweed oil | 1 -2 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons frozen whipped topping
instructions: Cut each slice from the butt into 2 - 3 rib sections.  In a skillet combine the lard, oil and sundried tomato paste or seaweed oil.  Place over low heat.  If using the tomato paste or seaweed oil the recommended oils may be added immediately after frying the tomato paste or seaweed oil.

title: Baklava
ingredients: 1/2 cup semolina | 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 pound ground ham | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bake semolina in a shallow baking dish in the preheated oven for 5 minutes.  Remove and set aside, then sprinkle semolina on the ground ham, and stir to combine.  Place the phyllo sheets on a clean surface, brush with a little olive oil, and roll the sheets so they cover about half the sheet.  Place the sheet with the sheets on a damp towel or baking sheet.  Place a second sheet of phyllo on top.  Place a third sheet on top and brush with olive oil.  Repeat with the next 4 sheets, brushing each sheet with butter.  Place a fourth sheet on top, and brush with olive oil as before.  Place the last sheet on top and brush with olive oil as before.  Repeat layering until there are 6 sheets with phyllo layered on top of each other.  Place the last sheet on top and brush with olive oil as before.  Cut into 3 or 4 squares.  Place baklava triangles onto a foil lined baking sheet, and bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven until phyllo is golden brown.

title: Chicken Livers and Prosciutto With Semolina
ingredients: 12 -14 chicken livers | 1 cup white wine, preferably chianti | 4 slices prosciutto, thick | 8 -10 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons semolina
instructions: Prepare the semolina mill by boiling four cups of water.  Add 5 teaspoons salt to the boiling water.  Put 1 tablespoon of semolina mill through a fine sieve into a bowl.  When the water starts to make a frothy, carefully pour the boiling water over the semolina and mix it thoroughly.  Pour the semolina through the sieve, stirring constantly, and allow to return to the boil for 2 - 3 minutes or so.  This is very important.  When it comes to a boil, remove from the heat.  Add 2 tablespoons of broth.  In the meantime, cook the livers individually, discarding the spinal bones, and set aside.  Using a mortar and pestle, mince the prosciutto and divide into 6 squares, about 1 inch each.  Add a slice of prosciutto to each square of meat and divide into 6 equal portions.  In each of the 6 soup plates, place a small portion of the liver and a slice of prosciutto.  Dissolve the chicken bouillon in 1 tablespoon of semolina.  Remove the bouillon mixture from the heat and stir the hot semolina into it.  Divide the broth between the 6 soup plates and arrange the filled luncheon meat pieces onto the broth.  Sprinkle the tops of the 6 servings with a handful of semolina.  Garnish with finely chopped onion.

title: Blueberry Applesauce
ingredients: 1 pound blueberries | 2 tablespoons glaze, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Place blueberries into a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Cover, and simmer over medium low heat until the berries are tender but still firm, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and mash with 2 tablespoon of glaze until smooth.  Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour or until mixture is cold.  Transfer 1/2 cup of berries to a small saucepan, and pour in remaining 1 1/2 cup berries to cover.  Mix the remaining glaze into the skillet until smooth.  Drizzle over applesauce while applesauce is cooling, about 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Cannoli Shells
ingredients: 32 cannoli shells | 1/2 cup chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Stir in cannoli shells and return to a boil.  Cook until softened, about 2 minutes.  Drain and place in a baking dish.  Pour chili powder over.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Bake in the preheated oven 3 minutes.

title: Sausage Stuffed With Fresh Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 hot italian sausage ( about 1 pound ) | 2 cups assorted fresh sundried tomatoes ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Cut the sausage in half lengthwise and remove the meat from the underside of the casing.  Sprinkle the meat with salt.  Place the sausage in a large skillet.  Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until well browned all over, about 10 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Halve the tomato halves lengthwise and open them out.  Brush them lightly with oil and sprinkle the insides with salt.  Cover and keep warm over low heat.  Preheat the broiler until the broiler is ready.  Place the sundried tomatoes, cut side down, on a baking sheet.  Place under the broiler and broil for about 5 minutes.  Turn the tomatoes over and broil, turning the tomatoes over, an additional 5 minutes.  Remove and keep warm.  Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the rosemary.  Sprinkle the sausage over the pan and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.  Serve over the tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,cilantro stem,scallion,spinach,leek,greek yogurt,prosciutto di parma,fruit
title: Apple and Prosciutto Salad
ingredients: 1 tart apple, chopped | 3 green zucchini, chopped | 3 scallions, chopped | 1 sprig fresh cilantro stem, chopped | 6 ounces prosciutto di parma, cubed | 1 cup grated greek yogurt | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spinach, firmly packed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh fruit, for garnish ( such as kiwi or strawberry )
instructions: Toss apple and zucchini with scallions, cilantro, prosciutto, yogurt, and spinach.  Garnish with fruit.

title: Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 -2 chipotle chile
instructions: Remove membrane from chipotle chilies in a clean, dry small saucepan.  Place the chilies in a mortar with the salt and pound them with a pestle for a few seconds to remove the excess oil.  Add the vinegar, a few dashes of salt and the chili pepper and continue pounding and pounding until you have a thick sauce.  Pour the vinaigrette over your choice of greens and serve.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,saffron thread,beef,thyme leave,cream chicken soup
title: Beef  With Lemon (Aka Greek Roast Beef )
ingredients:
1/2 - 1 3/4-1 inch thawed beef, from deli | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 -2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( about 3 oz.
    - ) | fresh thyme leave or lemon, to garnish
instructions: Place beef in a small roasting pan and sprinkle with saffron.  Roast at 450 for 5 minutes per pound to reduce juices and char, about 20 to 30 minutes for rare, about 35 to 40 minutes per pound for medium, longer the beef if you want a longer flavor.  Remove beef from pan and cover with foil and cool 10 minutes.  Combine soup and feta cheese, stir into soup mixture.  Slice beef thick, and return to soup mixture and simmer 15 minutes.  Pour soup mixture over sliced beef and serve with thyme leaves.

title: Pepperoni Italian Roll Ups
ingredients: 4 ounces pepperoni, chopped | 1 cup sugar, divided
instructions: Take one piece of pepperoni & place on greased cookie sheets.  In a medium bowl, mix sugar with 1/4 cup of water & set aside.  Take half the pepperoni & mix well.  Sprinkle sugar mixture over hot pepperoni, then roll pepperoni up.  Repeat with the remaining pepperoni & cheese.  When all the rolls are coated, place the rolls in a deep dish.  Spread sugar/water mixture over the rolls & bake in 300 f preheated oven for 20 minutes.

title: Guacamole Cream Crowdie
ingredients: 300 g dairy cottage cheese, drained ( dairy curd cottage cheese ) | 300 ml double cream | 1 dash guacamole
instructions: Beat the double cream with the guacamole till firm and creamy.  Spoon the mixture on to four plates.  Serve with the guacamole on the side.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,black vinegar,plain flour,broccoli floret,baking potato,bread flour,vodka
title: Solo Squid Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 small broccoli floret | 4 slices bread flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 packet spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon vodka | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons bread flour
instructions: Boil 1 cup water in pan with broccoli florets for 3 - 4 minutes.  Drain.  Cut off stem so broccoli doesn't cook further.  Mash broccoli and combine it with remaining ingredients.  Leave in a bowl covered in plastic film until required.  To store, put mixture in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,wine vinegar,grape tomato,vegetable,pork shoulder,cream mushroom soup
title: Pork Normandy
ingredients: 1/2 lb finely chopped pork shoulder | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup wine vinegar | 2 cups fresh vegetables ( like zucchini, carrots or peas ) | 1 grape tomatoes or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) can cherry tomatoes
instructions: Brown pork shoulder and then remove from heat and let pork spare while preparing vegetables.  Add broth, soup, mushrooms and vinegar to pan and cook until mixture thickens and is clear.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 10 minutes.  Serve over rice.  Garnish with fresh fruits.

title: Rigatoni With Mortadella and Fresh Dill (Lidia Bastianich)
ingredients: 350 g rigatoni pasta ( fresh rigatoni ) | 20 g dried mortadella ( see notes below ) | 2 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely ground cayenne or 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder ( optional ) | 1/3 bunch fresh dill or 1/3 bunch flat leaf parsley, leaves picked ( see notes below )

ingredients: 4 -6 frying chicken | 3 red potatoes | 2 yellow bell peppers | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon clove, whole
instructions: Clean and cut all vegetables into long, narrow strips about 1” long.  Heat oil over medium heat till smoking and fry chicken in batches until golden brown, 4 - 5 minutes or till done.  Drain on paper towels.  Slice potato lengthwise and fry in separate oil until golden, about 3 - 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,cherry tomato,green cardamom seed,lemon juice zest
title: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons parmesan cheese or 1 1/2 tablespoons gorgonzola, grated
instructions: Halve tomatoes lengthwise and scoop out seeds.  Place in lightly oiled shallow nonstick skillet.  Sprinkle each with lemon juice and green cardamom seeds.  Add 1/2 cup water, bring to boiling.  Reduce heat to medium low and cook, uncovered, about 10 minutes until tomatoes are tender.  Sprinkle top with parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,shrimp,vegetable oil cooking spray,mace,dark sesame oil,white truffle oil,beef chuck
title: Shrimp and Beef Skewers
ingredients: 36 large peeled raw prawns ( prawns ) | 24 large shrimp | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes and cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 12 fluid ounces white truffle oil | 1/2 inch cube fresh mace or 1/2 inch cube fresh nutmeg, finely grated | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place the prawns in 4 large nonreactive soup bowls.  Spray with vegetable spray.  Sprinkle both sides of the beef with vegetable and fish seasoning rub.  Place each piece of beef in a separate bowl.  In a third bowl, lightly toss together the shrimp, prawns, truffle oil, and mace until coated thoroughly.  Place a cube of the truffle oil on a piece of waxed paper and roll it between your palms to cover the oil.  Spread a teaspoon of truffle oil on 2 of the skewers, then roll in the shrimp/prawn/prawn mixture.  Repeat the process with the remaining skewers, truffle and oil.  Skewer each kewert onto a wooden or metal skewer about 1 inch apart.  The shrimp and beef will have the same width.  Use two clean kitchen tongs to hold the skewers together and to avoid getting burned.  Place the skewers on 4 metal skewers and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.  Preheat the grill to about 300°f with the rack set about 6 inches from the heat source.  Remove the kewerts from the baking dishes just before cooking in batches.  Discard any leftover oil.  Lightly oil the grill rack.  Thread the kewer alternating with the prawns, shrimps and shrimp skewers on metal skewers.  Grill for 2 minutes.  Turn and brush more truffle oil on the kewerts, turning every minute or so until browned on the outside and shrimp is pink on the inside.

title: Falafel (Hummus)
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 5 tablespoons plain flour | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Mince the seeds of the vanilla bean in a mortar and pestle to a paste.  Add the flour and mash/mix it inches.  Add the chick peas and continue to add until the dough reaches your desired texture.  Cover with cling film and leave in the fridge for at least 24 hours.

title: Indian Banana Chutney
ingredients: 3 pounds sweet bananas - peeled, seeded, and sliced lengthwise or into strips | 3 tablespoons garam masala | 3 tablespoons orange blossom water
instructions: Place the bananas into a large, resealable plastic bag, and pour in the hot garam masala and orange blossom water.  Seal and shake to coat the bananas evenly.  Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, shaking bag frequently.  Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Remove banana slices and place them on the foil lined baking sheet.  Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the bananas are tender and have begun to brown on the edges.

title: Kittencal's Perfect Spinach
ingredients: 32 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes
instructions: Cook spinach according to instructions on package.  Add crushed onion.  When done, remove to a bowl.  Mix in spices to spinach.  Serve.

title: Spinach With Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach ( about 1 pound ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper or nonstick aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Toss baby spinach leaves in cornstarch in a large bowl, and toss with a kitchen towel to drain any excess.  Arrange in a single layer on the parchment or foil, and bake in the preheated oven, until tender and golden, about 20 minutes.  If frozen, transfer to an air tight plastic bag, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.  After 15 minutes, lift bag onto a dinner plate, and serve.  Cooks' note, preparation time does not reflect cooking time for baking.

Random Ingredients: yeast,graham cracker crumb,monterey jack cheese,dill leaf,biscuit
title: Monterey Jack and Dill Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 package powdered instant yeast | 16 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 15 large fresh dill leaves | 1 can refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a large mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, yeast, and pepper jack cheese.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,chili powder,chili pepper flake,bean,five spice powder,cucumber,kidney bean
title: Cranberry Refried Beans
ingredients: 14 ounces kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 14 ounces fat free refried beans | 4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon dried minced chili peppers or 2 -3 teaspoons dried minced chili peppers | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Mix all together and heat in microwave to warm through.

title: Cauliflower with crabmeat and prosciutto
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret, chopped | 12 slices prosciutto ham | 5 ounces imitation imitation crabmeat
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the cauliflower and cook for 3 to 6 minutes or until tender.  Drain.  Meanwhile, place a slice of ham and imitation crab in a small baking dish.  Top with the cauliflower and drizzle with flavored oil.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,monterey jack cheese,baking soda,chicken breast
title: Pizza Chicken
ingredients: 4 large cooked chicken breasts | 1 jar tuna in water, drained | 1 container shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place chicken on greased cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle tuna on top.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chicken stock,pickling spice,cardamom,walnut,dark sesame oil
title: Pickled Chiken
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | freshly grated nutmeg | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickling spice
instructions: Bring chicken stock and nuts to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.  Remove from heat and add the sesame oil, garlic salt, cardamom, and pickling spice.  Transfer to a jar, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 days before using.

title: Basic Bread Machine Loaf
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 4 cups flour, divided | cooking oil ( for frying )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in ¾ cups of the flour.  Add the remaining flour and enough of the remaining flour to form a stiff dough.  Turn out on a floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes.  Form into loaf about 2½ inch thick.  Place in a shallow roasting pan.  Cover the roasting pan with a clean, dry towel.  Let rise for 1 - ½ hours.  Preheat oven to 380°f.  Meanwhile, lightly grease or spray an 81/3 x 7 1/2” loaf pan.  Roll 1/4 of the dough into a rectangle ¾ inch thick.  Cover with remaining dough and let rise, in a warm place, for 1 hour.  Fold 1/3 of the dough into the loaf, covering as much of the crust as possible.  Place the loaf on a baking sheet.  Use the tip of a sharp knife to prick dough all over.  Brush the loaves with cooking spray.  Cover the loaf and put in oven.  Bake for 40 minutes.  When done, remove from oven and allow to cool on a wire rack.

title: Creamy Mushroom Salad II
ingredients: 12 ounces salad greens | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar ( optional )
instructions: Toss salad greens with soup and cream of tartar in a large bowl.  Cover and chill in refrigerator for 2 hours before serving.

title: Mango Ginger Wine
ingredients: 1 kg mangoes | 1/2 cup dry red wine, plus extra for deglazing | 4 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons dried anise seeds
instructions: Using a sharp knife, peel the mangoes and cut them into small cubes.  Place half the mango into a blender and add the mango, red wine, oil aniseed and the remaining mango into the blender and blend until smooth.  Serve immediately, with extra mango wine.

Random Ingredients: cavenders purpose greek seasoning,poppy seed,hazelnut,taco seasoning mix,parsley leaf,sugar
title: Poppy Seed Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups poppy seeds | 1 1/2 cups sifted powdered sugar | 1/4 cup dried parsley leaves, packed | 1/4 tablespoon cavenders all purpose greek seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup chopped hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 200f degrees.  Stir poppy seeds, sugar, parsley, cavender's greek seasoning, and taco seasoning together in a large bowl.

title: Torta Rosa Verde: Fatless, Super-Savory Baked Beans, Spinach and Radishes
ingredients: 15 -20 large baby litties, washed, dried and quartered | 7 -8 small red radishes, sliced finely ( about 1/4-inch ) | 1/2 cup fresh baby spinach ( i use frozen, thawed bag style ) | 10 -12 fresh limes, juiced | 20 -24 pretty looking fresh biscuits ( delallo brand recommended, or you can use storebought or home made biscuits )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.  In a large bowl, combine the beans, radishes, spinach, lime juice and a few sprinkles of salt.  Toss lightly to coat.  Arrange the bread quarters on the baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until crisp.  Meanwhile, place the lobed ladyfingers on the baking sheet.  Dredge them in water to prevent skin from forming.  Place them on top of each other on the same baking sheet and bake for 5 - 7 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from the oven and top with a few bean to dip.  Note, some people like to add a bit of cheese on this dish as well.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,nori,alfredo sauce,sun tomato oil,espresso powder,iceberg lettuce,wheat flour,rice wine
title: Tropical Chicken Nori Rollups: Chicken & Mushroom
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour ( for coating ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine ( for dipping ) | 3 teaspoons finely chopped fresh nori ( coriander ) | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder ( for dipping ) | 2 cups grated iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( for dipping ) | 5 sheets fresh nori, rolled into strips | 1/2 cup prepared alfredo sauce ( for dipping )
instructions: Cook or grill chicken to desired doneness or desired size, and drain on paper towel.  Cool completely, refrigerate.  For the fillings, heat a heavy, nonstick nonreactive skillet or wok over medium high heat for 1 minute.  Add the flour and shake pan around to coat the bottom evenly with flour.  Add the rice wine, and stir to coat it evenly.  Add 1 teaspoon of the dried instant espresso powder, plus 1 teaspoon of the chopped fresh coriander and stir to coat it evenly.  Scoop up 1/3 cup of the cheese/nut mixture, press into center of a piece of nori, and roll up from the long side.  Slice roll into 4 pieces, then spread the roll with 1/3 cup alfredo sauce and top with the remaining nori.  Wrap assembled rolls in plastic and freeze for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: meatball,cottage cheese,superfine sugar,cream cheese,rigatoni pasta,steak,cranberry,aleppo pepper
title: Stuffed Rigatoni (Pasta Al Salpicella)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons ground cranberries ( fresh or dry crushed ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente | 2 lbs lean ground round | 4 tablespoons dried aleppo pepper ( more to taste ) | 2 ounces self-raising fat-free cottage cheese | 4 ounces low-fat steak ( or your favourite meatballs ) | additional dried cranberries or oregano | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Heat the cream cheese in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium low heat, stirring frequently.  Meanwhile, pour 1/4 cup water into a large skillet and spread over medium high heat.  Once the cream cheese is melted, add the cranberries and stir.  Reserve 1/4 cup of the cranberries as garnish for garnish.  Add the ground round and 1 tablespoons aleppo pepper stir well, breaking up the meat.  When the meat is no longer pink, add the cottage cheese and stir.  Stir until well incorporated and well incorporated.  Keep the sauce warm over low heat.  At this point you may want to add a dash of beer or water, to thin it a bit while heating.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix together the remaining 1/4 cup water and remaining 1/4 cup aleppo pepper, the remaining 1 ounce of meat, the cheese mixture, and the dried cranberries.  Season with salt and pepper, then stir in the sugar.  Serve the rigatoni in the bowls, garnished with dried cranberries or oregano if desired.  Enjoy note, the meatballs are not necessary.

title: Spinach and Potato and Goat Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground pork ( it is better to use 2 loin beef chuck steak or you can use left over cooked ground veal ) | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice | 1 garlic clove, minced | 8 ounces frozen spinach, thawed, drained, and squeezed dry ( or fresh spinach, if you wish ) | 1/2 cup quick-cooking spray, plus more for drizzling ( or more if desired ) | 3/4 cup cooked whole wheat pasta or 3/4 cup other small shell pasta
instructions: Brown meat in a non stick skillet on medium heat for about 5 minutes, until cooked through and crumbly and no pink remains, but don't over cook.  Drain any fat.  Then transfer meat to a separate bowl.  Place spinach in a microwave safe bowl, pour boiling hot water over spinach and let sit for about 5 minutes.  Drain, squeeze clean and roughly chop, then transfer spinach to meat and combine.  Set aside.  Coat an 11 x 7 inch baking dish with cooking spray, place it on top of other dish, and spread the spinach mixture evenly in the dish.  Then spread the cooked whole wheat noodles evenly across the spinach mixture.  Spread the meat/wheat beef mixture evenly across the noodles.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 375°f.  Spray the top with cooking oil.  Bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Brandy Snacking
ingredients: 1 cup brandy ( or whiskey ) | 1 package caraway seeds
instructions: Combine brandy and caraway seeds in a heavy skillet over low heat.  Stir frequently until fragrant and the caraway seeds have begun to pop.  Remove from burner after 15 minutes, and remove from heat.  Shake briskly over briskly.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Rub briskly with rye meal, or wrap in dark saran wrap and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,self raising flour,rump roast,olive oil
title: Beef or Lamb Sausages With Roti-Mari, Roti Dal or Urad Dal
ingredients: 800 g rump roast or 800 g lamb sausages | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | olive oil ( for frying ) | 3 cups of split urad dal or 3 cups of whole split yellow lentils
instructions: Slice meat about 1/2 inch thick.  Dip each sausage or lamb in flour and fry in olive oil until browned.  Serve with roti mari as bread, raita, naan or parmigiri.

title: Koshary
ingredients: 3/4 cup semolina ( maleflower or durham uf ) | 1 cup plain yogurt ( balkan or whole-milk ) | 1/2 cup fresh dill weed | 3/4 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/2 cup semolina ( maleflower or graham ufala ) | 1/4 cup fresh dill weed | 2 cups greek yogurt | 4 1/2 cups farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: In a large bowl, combine semolina, 3/4 cup of yoghurt, 4 1/2 cups dill and 2 1/2 teaspoons dill weed.  Knead until the dough is not sticky.  Divide the dough into 2 balls.  Flatten each half into a circle.  Keep the centers covered with a damp tea towel or plastic wrap for 15 to 20 minutes.  While the dough is working, prepare the filling.  Dice 2 1/2 cups of greek yoghurt and mix in 2 1/2 cups water.  Stir in 2 1/2 cups dill and 2 1/2 teaspoons dill weed.  Set aside.  Remove the dough from the bowl and roll out on a lightly floured surface to cover the dough with the prepared filling.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add farfalle.  Cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.  Drain well and quickly mix in the remaining 3/4 cup greek yoghurt.  Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with a bit more dill and a dollop of the chilled yoghurt.  Serve warm.

title: Noodles With Peppery Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 package of thin noodles, any flavor | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Cook or boil the noodles and drain well.  Drain the water chestnuts, reserving about 1/4 cup cooking liquid.  Slice the canned waterchestnuts into slices about 1 inch long and place them into a small serving bowl along with the waterchestnuts.  Sprinkle with the vinegar.  Drain the noodles and serve.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,rump roast,white rice,orange peel,cherry tomato
title: Orange Rice Salad With Rump Roast
ingredients: 1 cup orange peel, chopped | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 2 1/2 lbs rump roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Cook orange peel in a 5 quart pan until starting to darken, about 8 minutes.  Add cherry tomatoes, and remove from heat.  Let stand until cool, then remove and reserve.  Peel off and discard all visible membrane and seeds from beef bones, reserving 1 cup of broth.  Remove orange peel and any undesirable pieces, then place beef bones in a mixing bowl.  Pour 1 cup hot broth over beef bones.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,lasagna noodle,spinach,basmati rice,tabasco sauce,topping,vanilla extract
title: Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups fresh spinach or 2 3/4 cups thawed spinach | 2 cups basmati rice | 1/2 lb lasagna noodle | 1 container topping, such as cool whip | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | tabasco sauce or any other hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place fresh spinach inside a colander over a small bowl, and set aside.  Rinse rice in a colander for 2 min. , then shake dry.  In a large, dry frying pan, heat enough oil to cover.  Add half the lasagna ingredients and cook, stirring, until golden brown, about 2 min.  Meanwhile, bring 2 cups water to boil in a medium pot.  Add rice and cook, covered, over mediium heat until water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 10 min.  Meanwhile, spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Spread 1/4 cup or less of the rice spinach mixture in the bottom of the baking dish.  Top with strips of uncooked spinach, 1/2 1/2 the cool whip, 1/8 cup or less of each ingredient, and 1/2 the tortillas.  Repeat layers two more times.  Dissolve remaining 1/8 cup or less of the cool whip in remaining 1/4 cup or less of cool whip, add a pinch of tabasco or hot sauce.  Pour evenly over the top layer.  The final layer should nearly cover the spinach.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and aluminum foil, and bake for 40 - 50 min until rice and thawed.  Do not allow lasagna to become too browned.  Serve warm or at room temperature.  Makes 20 servings.  This is great over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,white wine,cauliflower floret,pork belly,hoisin sauce,confectioner sugar,green pepper,sake
title: Pork & Vegetables in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork belly, sliced into thin strips | 1 bunch fresh cauliflower florets, cleaned | 1 bag frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheet | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sake | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a small saucepan, or saucer, mix the hoisin sauce, sake, and wine.  Bring to a simmer in a small saucepan.  Remove from the heat source.  Set aside.  Place the cauliflower in boiling water.  Cook until tender but still firm.  Drain.  Lay out one sheet of phyllo pastry to cover the bottom of a large baking sheet.  Lay down the next sheet of phyllo on top of the previous one.  Spread the pork over the phyllo, leaving a 1/2 inch edge on each sheet.  Top with another sheet of phyllo, and trim off any remaining pastry leaving a 1/4 inch at one end.  Top with the remaining pastry.  Repeat with the remaining four sheets of phyllo with the cauliflower and the pork.  Cover with remaining phyllo and trim off any remaining pastry.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until phyllo is golden brown.

title: Spiced Macaroni Cheese With Chilli
ingredients: 100 g macaroni cheese | 25 g dry yeast | 3 tablespoons teriyaki marinade | 2 teaspoons tamari | 80 g sliced jalapenos | 150 g fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Pilawise the jalapeños.  Dice and finely dice them.  Melt the butter.  Put the dry yeast in a bowl and whisk the warm water in the jug until dissolved.  Add the warm water to the yeast and let sit for 5 minutes or until foamy.  Mix the teaitare and tamari in a cup and combine with the dry yeast.  Stir in the zest from the jalapeños and the coriander.  Drain the macaroni cheese and put in an oiled casserole dish, pour over the cheese and sprinkle with the coriander.  Put in oven, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes for a crusty crust or until firm.  Let cool and serve.  Variation.  Taste the chilli then chilli to make sure it is not too sweet.  If you want your casserole vegetarian, cook it with its own fat.

title: Crock Pot Brats
ingredients: 4 -10 bratwursts, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 cup bone broth | 1 lemon, zest of, grated ( i get one of the smaller ones, like 3/4 or so ) | 1 teaspoon crushed rosemary leaves
instructions: Place brats in bottom of slow cooker.  Pour in broth, lemon zest, rosemary leaves, and 1 teaspoon of paprika.  Cover and cook on low heat for at least 8 hours.  I cooked the brats for 2 hours, but the longer you cook it, the better it is.

title: Scotch Glazed Pork Shanks
ingredients: 4 pounds pork shanks, or more as needed | 2 cups irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange shanks in a heavy saucepan.  Add irish cream and bring to a boil.  Place the meat into a roasting pan.  Pour hot cream over the shanks, making sure they are fully covered.  Cover tightly with foil and place the pan into a roasting pan full of water into the preheated oven.  Roast in the preheated oven until the meat is fork tender, at least 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,lime zest,yellow squash,sea scallop,penne pasta
title: Sweet & Spicy Scallops on Penne Pasta With Apricots & Squash
ingredients: 3/4 lb sea scallops | 1 lb yellow squash, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup dried sweetened apricot nectar | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest, grated | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Cut scallops crosswise into 1/2 slices.  Trim scallops of all visible fat.  Set scallops on cutting board.

title: Kothiy - Cilantro Cream
ingredients: 150 ml double cream | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder ( coriander )
instructions: Whip the double cream till it becomes very stiff.  Add the coriander powder.  Refrigerate.  Serve.

title: Pork or Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style pork ( or chicken ) | lemon juice
instructions: Place the pork in a large pan and spread the lemon juice over all.  Do not allow to touch the meat it will soak up the juice.  Place over medium high heat and cook, stirring occasionally until nicely browned and caramel colored.  The chicken should also have caramelized too.  When the meat is tender, remove it to a serving platter and serve on individual warmed plates.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,seashell pasta,chicken bouillon cube,red kidney bean,egg substitute,asadero cheese
title: The Best Italian Macaroni, Cheese, and Beans - Rachael Ray Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup small seashell pasta ( broken in half if large ) | 1/2 cup lowfat egg substitute or 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup fat free chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup egg substitute ( like egg beaters ) | 2 tablespoons asadero cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional, to help prevent crystals ) | 1/2 teaspoon red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons lowfat asadero cheese ( for a change )
instructions: Toast seashell pasta in fry pan at medium high heat.  Add 3 tbsp of all butter or margarine.  Fry until macaroni starts to turn a little brown.  Stir egg substitute or egg substitute into egg mixture and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Mix in asadero cheese, cardamom seeds, and red kidney beans.  Drain cooked macaroni and stir in to the egg mixture.  Stir until mixed well.  If macaroni sticks, stir some bread crumbs with a teaspoon of olive oil or butter.  If using eggbeaters instead of eggs, add them together.  Cook for 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve with salsa.

title: Sambosa
ingredients: 1 cup coconut oil | 20 curry leaves | 1 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a small skillet over medium heat.  Fry the curry leaves stirring constantly.  Remove the leaves from the skillet and drain on a paper towel.  Place a serving spoon in the center of each curry leaf.  Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of paprika on top of each leaf.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,mayonnaise,hot italian sausage,salmon,asparagus spear,white miso,anise extract,beef stew meat
title: Grilled Irish Salmon Stuffed With Smoked Sausage and Mustard
ingredients: 20 ounces boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1 lb smoked sausage, remove from casings | 1/2 lb cooked salmon, in 1 inch pieces ( optional ) | 2 lbs fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 1/4 cup white miso
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, creole seasoning, and extract.  Stuff chiken cubes with meat mixture.  Cook asparagus on coals for 3 minutes on each side or until tender crisp.  Meanwhile, heat grill to high.  Oil the grate.  Remove stuffing from casings.  Coat pan with nonstick spray.  Add sausage and cook for 2 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove sausage from pan, drain on paper towels, slice into 1/4 thick slices, and arrange on grill.  Cook for approximately 8 minutes, or until desired doneness.  Serve turkey and sausage over cooked asparagus.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,baby spinach leaf,goat cheese,adobo seasoning,cheddar cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,fennel seed,star anise
title: Spinach, Cheese and Chipotle Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 bag romaine lettuce or 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 8 ounces goat cheese or 8 ounces quesadilla cheese, cut into 8 slices per chipotle | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 whole star anise | 1/2 cup tomato juice or 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning, from chipotle jar
instructions: Heat 1 tbs oil in a pan over medium high heat until it shimmers.  Cook one or two slices of cheese until lightly browned and starting to give off aroma, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Repeat with remaining cheese slices, adding oil as needed.  When cheese is melted, add rest of ingredients and mix well.  Assemble the quesadillas, using tomato sauce as a dip for the quesadillas, lettuce leaves or spinach leaves.  Drizzle the chipotle dressing over the greens, then put the quesadilla quesadillas on a platter.  Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Phyllo Leaves
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint or 1/2 cup parsley, leaves only | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh fennel | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 1/2 cups finely diced lettuce
instructions: To make leaves, lightly brush each sheet of pastry with water and set aside.  Dry out the rest of the phyllo dough.  Place 1 sheet on a clean work surface and brush with a little water.  Place 1 leaf, flat side down, on the pastry sheet.  Top with 1/2 cup of the herbs and fennel.  Fold the bottom half of the phyllo sheet over the greens, overlapping the first and last part.  The pastry dough should be tightly packed.  Place on the top layer of phyllo dough.  Fold the top sheet over the greens and roll to seal.  Cut a slit about 3 inches long through the core at 1/4 inch intervals.  Repeat with the remaining sheets and leaves.  Bake on a baking sheet in a preheated 450f degree oven for 10 minutes.  Reduce oven temp to 350f degrees.  Bake an additional 20 - 25 minutes or until golden or crisp.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,potato,hard egg,italian sausage,worcestershire sauce,sherry,simple syrup
title: Potato Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 large potatoes, chopped | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/3 cup sweet sherry | cooked rice noodles, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  In a 2 quart baking dish, combine sausage, potatoes, eggs, worcestershire sauce, sherry and simplsener.  Pour sweet sherry mix onto the mixture and spread evenly.  Bake at 425f for 30 - 40 minutes.  Garnish with noodles.

title: Champinones (Creamy Rice
ingredients:
1/2 cup risotto rice, not instant ( can use long grain rice ) | 4 cups water | 1/2 large fresh chinese mushroom ( optional ) | 0.

title: Wild Rice With Apples (Aegge)
ingredients:
2 cups jasmine rice ( aegge ) or 2 cups arborio rice, washed and soaked in 3 cups water for 25–30 minutes ( aegge ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup pomegranate seed ( or other dried seeds-optional ) | 7 whole small red apples ( eg.
    -mandarin, mcintosh, mcintosh ) | 1/4 cup watercress ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh juice ( from fresh squeezed juice ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 fresh low-sodium plum | 1 fresh shiitake mushroom ( shilling type )
instructions: The day before you're going to eat, soak rice for at least 2 hours in 3 cups of water and 1/2 cup of extra virgin olive oil.  It is best to use an electric rice cooker to start soaking as it tends to stretch the heat of your rice.  After soaking, bring your 1 cup of water to a boil and add your rice.  Turn down heat to simmering, then cook, covered, 45 minutes.  This should take 15 - 20 minutes, but if it gets too much of a vigorous boil, turn down your heat just a bit and cook longer.  After the 25–30 minutes, stir the rice all the while, and add more pomegranate seeds.  If it gets too thin, break it up with your fingers.  This should take 15 - 20 minutes, but if it is too sour, just add a little water.  Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.  Cut apples into thin slices, and then cut into matchstick sized pieces.  Remove stems from woody stems, if desired and cut out stem ends.  If your apples are large, cut them in half crosswise.  If fresh woody stems are not available, leave leaves intact.  Cut the stems diagonally into 1 inch sections and then slice.  Set aside.  The day before, drain the rice using the same method as described above.  The day you're going to eat, preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine pomegranate seeds with watercress.  Spray baking sheet with cooking oil spray.  Place sliced apples in a medium bowl.  Sprinkle lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Place half of the diced parsley in a small pile on counter.  Using your hands, smear each half with a generous spoonful or so of pomegranate seeds and a tablespoon or two of pomegranate watercress mixture, pressing them in in slightly.  The apples should be quite dry so you can make a criss cross pattern, not a sharp, flat mound.  Sprinkle the apples with salt and pepper and place in oven.  Cook the apples, turning once, for 1–3 minutes or until the apples are golden around the edges.  Let them rest for 5 minutes.  Set the apple halves out of the oven, keeping warm.  Repeat until all of the pomegranate mixture has been used.  Stir watercress into cooked rice in a serving dish or small serving bowl.  Place reserved pear slices on serving platter.  Top with a few sprigs of tarragon and a few small pieces of shiitake mushroom.  Serve immediately.

title: Basic British Breadcrumb

instructions: Note, if using flank steak, cut against grain into thin slices about 3 inches wide by 2 inches long.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo on work surface.  Spread one tablespoon teriyaki sauce onto phyllo and lightly brush top with teriyaki sauce.  Spoon 1/8th of the flank steak over the sauce.  Spoon teriyaki sauce over the flank steak and spread evenly using hands.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo dough on top and brush top with teriyaki sauce.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo in the center and brush with teriyaki sauce.  Top with 1/8th of the flank steak, 1/8th of the cheese and 4 sheets of phyllo dough.  Using moist fingers, spread half of soy sauce on top and sides of phyllo in a 1 1/2 inch wide edging motion.  Use wet fingers to pull all the way around, brushing each other with soy sauce.  Using moist fingers, pull all the way around.  Use wet fingers to pull all the way around, brushing each other with soy sauce.  Using moist fingers, pull all the way around, brushing each other with soy sauce.  Make a 2 inch long cut along the side of the phyllo dough.  Pinch the outer border of phyllo dough to open the cut and brush with teriyaki sauce.  Bake the phyllo wrapped steak at 400°f for about 10 minutes to soften.  Remove from oven, cut through the length of the phyllo, and serve with more grated cheese.

title: Easy Baked Carrots on Pita Bread
ingredients: 8 carrots, cut in half crosswise | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 4 -6 tablespoons pita bread, depending on your size
instructions: Place 1/2 cup water and the carrots in a medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil, cover, and cook until tender about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the size of the carrots.  Drain and cool, then peel the carrots and cut them into rounds.  Stir together with cayenne, cardamon, and 1 tablespoons of the oil.  Stir in the carrots and allow them to cool.  Spread the carrots on a cutting board, top with 1 tablespoon of crumb topping, and fold gently over.  Form into pita shaped patties, brush the remaining olive oil onto the top.  Bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,milk,jalapeno chile,pecorino romano cheese,oyster sauce,sage leaf
title: Spicy Grilled Romesco Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces refrigerated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 2 1/4 cups ) or 16 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated ( about 2 1/4 cups ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons milk | 1 tablespoon garlic-flavored oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage leaf | 1 small jalapeno chiles, seeded and minced
instructions: Cut cheese block into 3/4 inch cubes.  Place cubes in a small bowl and pour milk over.

title: Cheese Danish
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup ( canned or fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1/2 lb american cheese, sliced
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal.  Place slices on a platter, cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, bring cheese to room temperature.  Pour soup over cheese and let sit until cheese is dry.  If soup begins to get too thick, add another 1/2 cup of soup to thin.

title: Irish Cream Steak With Onions(Cook's Country)
ingredients:
4 beef tips steak, thawed if frozen ( about 1 1/4 lbs.
    - ) | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1/3 cup irish cream or 1/3 cup light cream | 12 -24 leaf romaine lettuce or 12 -24 small leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place the steak in a resealable plastic bag.  Add the olives and the cream.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Remove the meat from the bag and thread a small amount of onions onto the meat.  Return the meat on a rack in a large shallow roasting pan.  Cook the meat at least 15 minutes, or up to 1 hour, brushing with the hot liquor from the can when the meat is finished cooking,.  Note, if the pan is covered with foil, use tongs to transfer the cooked onions to a heated platter.  Reserve any remaining onion juices.  Serve 1/4 cup juices and discard any excess fat.  Place the remaining juices in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Raise the heat to high and bring the liquid to a boil.  Boil briskly for 2 or 3 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Cover tightly and keep at a low simmer.  Heat the reserved juice in a small pot until it just begins to boil, about 15 - 20 seconds.  Reduce the heat to low and add the cream, stirring occasionally.  Let cook about five minutes, then remove from the heat.  Let stand just five minutes.  Serve the steak hot as suggested in the intro, with the onion slices scattered over the top.  Serve with the reserved onions and reserved juices.  Serves.

title: Crispy Salt Crackers
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable shortening, room temperature | 10 pounds salt pork, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Use a knife to cut salt pork into 1/2 inch squares, and place on a large baking sheet.  Brush salt pork with vegetable shortening, and sprinkle with ground black peppercorns.  Bake in the preheated oven to harden, 4 to 6 hours.  When done, crispy and crisp, about 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,black pepper,russet potato,turnip,ladyfinger,orange zest,chicken wing,mace
title: Chicken Wings-Veggies Salad W- Orange
ingredients: 6 russet potatoes, peeled & cut to 1 1/2 inch pieces | 6 chicken wings | 1 large turnip, peeled & cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 lb mixed baby-glasses ( like sugar or cinnamon-sour apples ) or 1 lb sugar mixed sweet potato, peeled & cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 fresh large orange, zest of, finely grated and juice of | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace or 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon coarse black pepper | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs or 1/2 cup coarse country bread, crumbs
instructions: Prepare the salad, put all ingredients in a large salad bowl.  When ready to serve, make the dressing, combine the bread crumbs with the orange zest & juice.  Pour over the salad & toss to evenly coat.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,mexican oregano,half cream,brandy,chicken stock,flour tortilla,vegetable broth
title: Ricotta Enchilas (Enchiladas Pollo)
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1 cup mexican oregano | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 can chicken stock | 2 large flour tortillas | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream ( optional )
instructions: Prepare sauce, in medium pot, pour both cans of broth, ricotta, brandy, and oregano into blender.  Blend on high for 30 seconds, then switch on low for 5 - 10 seconds more.  Set aside.  Enchiladas, heat a frying pan to medium.  Quickly fry tortillas a couple at a time.  Put a small amount of sauce on each tortilla.  Take care not to let the bottom touch the tortillas.  Fill with cheese, and roll them up.  Secure with toothpicks and put in a warm oven for 10 minutes.  Add any more sauce to plate and serve.

title: Peppercorn Oyster
ingredients: 2 cups white wine | 2 1/2 lbs black peppercorns | 4 deep-fried deep-fried refrigerated pie shells
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the pie shells in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.  Simmer, uncovered, until the liquids have reduced to about 1 quart.  The mixture will thicken slightly as it cools.  Ladle into pie shells and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: saffron,superfine sugar,beef stew meat,green olive,range chicken,aubergine
title: Tunisian-style Sticky Beef and Aubergine Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 aubergine, cut into 2-inch chunks | 2 green olives, pitted | 6 pitted stuffed green olives | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Cut the meat into 1/4 slices and place in a shallow dish.  Cover with boiling water and soak for 1 hour.  Drain and place the aubergines, olives and 1/4 cup of sugar into the container of a food processor.  Process until smooth.  Season with saffron and pour over meat.  Cover the dish with a plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or longer.  Heat oven to 375°f toss the meat with the remaining sugar and olive oil.  Place in a large baking dish.  Bake for 1 hour or until browned and cooked through.  Serve on a bed of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,bay leaf,cumin seed,shallot,cayenne,brandy,mustard powder,bell pepper
title: Bell Pepper Condiment
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons sweet mustard pwdr or 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 shallots | 1 bell pepper, seeded & cut into small 1/4-inch pieces ( any color ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh spring onion
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in a skillet until fragrant, about 2 minutes and then grind to a coarse powder.  Combine the seeds, mustard powder and bay leaves in a small bowl.  Set aside.  Cut the stems off the bell peppers.  Slice the peppers into 1/4 inch slices and rinse and dry well.  Cut away the membranes and seeds.  Coarsely grind the cumin seeds.  Heat the brandy, mustard powder and chopped shallots in a saucepan over medium heat until the oil is just hot enough to coat the mortar.  Stir in the grated pepper mixture and reduce the heat so the peppers soften slightly.  Stir in the grated pepper mixture.  Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until the sauce is slightly thickened.  Stir in the chopped spring onion.  This condiment can be prepared to this point and refrigerated to develop flavor and color.

title: Thai Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold water | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 bunch fresh romaine lettuce | 2 sprigs fresh dill, torn
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender, cover and blend until smooth.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Barbecue Dry Rub
ingredients: 4 tablespoons smoked paprika | 4 teaspoons molasses | 2 teaspoons dried red chilies
instructions: Mix paprika, molasses, and dried chilies together.  Place on a clean surface.  Apply to meat, poultry, or vegetables, or just leave on for your favorite barbecue sauce.

title: Anchovies and Pork
ingredients: 2 fresh artichoke hearts | 1 3/4 pounds pork roast, cut into 3 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread the artichoke hearts onto the bottom of a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Brush each slice with some of the oil from the artichokes, if desired.  Place the pork slices on top of the artichokes, and sprinkle with salt.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 2 hours.  Anchovies should not be floating over the top, so watch them carefully.

title: Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 6 corn tortillas ( halved and warmed ) | 1 lb hamburger ( or turkey ) | 1 package spaghetti | 2 cups sauteed daikon greens ( kernals included ) | 1 cup cashew nuts | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | jumbo fried guacamole ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown hamburger or turkey.  Break up meat as it cooks, but leave some of the fat in the skillet with the hamburger.  Drain.  Add sauteed daikon greens and cashew nuts.  Cook until greens are wilted, about 3 minutes.  Meanwhile, in another skillet, melt chocolate chips.  Serve with warm tortillas, a dollop of ganache if desired.  To freeze, place in a ziploc freezer bag and store in the freezer.

title: Pineapple & Honey Bread Machine Sweet Bread
ingredients: 100 g dry yeast | 400 ml pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 100 g hummus, for topping ( or your favourite topping )
instructions: Place all ingredients except hummus, in your breadmachine and select sweet bread setting.  When you are ready to bake bread, preheat oven to 180c.

title: Plum Tomatoes Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 24 plum tomatoes | 21 ounces chocolate chips or 21 ounces galaocenico
instructions: Preheat oven 190°c slice each plum tomato in half, then halve and remove the cores.  Place on a lined oven tray.  Bake for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.  Leave to cool.  Place the chocolate chips or galaocenico into a small saucepan and heat until the chocolate has fully melted, but still slightly warm.  Place into a dry heat proof jug and stir with a metal spoon or balloon whisk in a steady steam.  Cook for 2 - 3 mins on a low heat or until chocolate has completely melted.  Spread over sliced plum tomatoes and cool.

title: Easiest Ever Beer Bar-B-Q
ingredients: 24 ounces dark beer | 1/4 cup mirin ( or regular dry rice wine ) | 8 ounces golden raisins ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a bowl and stir to combine.  Serve with your favorite meat.  The darker the beer, the more flavorful your bar will be.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,syrup,saffron thread,southwest seasoning,beef sirloin,grouper fillet,head cabbage,macaroni
title: Macaroni and Saffron With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 3 lbs beef sirloin | 8 macaroni | 3 heads cabbage, sliced | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons shiro seasoning ( gulf spam brand for authenticity ) | 2 -3 saffron threads | 1 -2 tablespoon turkish-style syrup
instructions: Cook macaroni al dente.  Drain and set aside.  Cut beef into bite sized size pieces.  Slice cabbage into slices and set aside.  Heat oven to put beef in a roasting pan and rub off excess fat from the meat.  Add macaroni to the pan.  Add the seasoning and toss to coat all ingredients well inside the pan.  Roast in the oven uncovered on medium low for about 20 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Add shrimp, cabbage and saffron to the roast.  Toss well so it absorbs the seasonings and shrimp don't break.  Drizzle with macaroni syrup and serve over cooked macaroni.

title: Mascarpone Cheesecake
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese | 3 poblano chiles, deseeded and chopped ( seeded if desired ) | 1 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 25 -75 g assorted fresh vegetables ( see photos )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c or 200°c.  Mix all cheeses well and press into 8 square pan.  Place on your prettiest oven trays and bake 20 minutes or until it is firm.  Remove from the oven and let rest.  Meanwhile mix the icing sugar and vanilla essence together.  Fold into the cooled cheeses.  Slice the vegetables about 5cm thick and arrange on the cheesecake.  Garnish with a sprig of orange zest and serve at room temperature.

title: Blueberry Chicken for the Grill
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup blueberries | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place the chicken into a resealable plastic bag, and pour in the blueberries.  Seal, and push out as much air as possible without tearing the chicken.  Pour in the worcestershire sauce, and set aside for 15 minutes at room temperature.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat.  Lightly oil the grate, and place the chicken on the grill.  Cook for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,cocoa powder,chicken bouillon cube,flour tortilla,sea salt,basil
title: Basil Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 8 small flour tortillas | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Fry tortillas in 1 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan add to a bowl the bouillon powder and cilantro.  Heat same pan on medium high for a few seconds and add to tortillas bowl with bouillon mixture.  Sprinkle sea salt over fajita and simmer until done garnish with fresh basil and serve.

title: Mexican Green Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces kale, rinsed, dried and coarsely chopped | 5 ounces green beans, trimmed and halved | 1/2 cup salsa verde | 1 plum, minced ( optional )
instructions: Place the kale in a pot with the green beans, salsa verde and plump plum into the pot.  Cover and cook for 8 minutes.  Uncover and cook for 2 minutes longer.

title: Fennel and Lemon Tart
ingredients: 200 g plain flour | 15 g ground almonds or 15 g ground almonds | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 45 ml ice water | 1 lemon | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 4 slices prosciutto, chopped | 3 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius.  Rub all the flour into the fat gradually.  Mix dry ingredients into the lemon rind and juice.  Add almonds, vanilla and ice water.  Mix well.  Press the mix into a tart tin or a pie plate.  Bake 45 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Place rose petals or apricot halves on top.  Slice and garnish with chopped prosciutto.  Serve.

title: Lite Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, crust, and foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add lasagna, and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain well, and spread a little butter on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.  Cover with a layer of lasagna noodles, then the parmigiano reggiano cheese, and a pinch of salt.  Repeat one more time, using a little more butter and cheese.  Pour enough hot water into the baking dish so that it comes up about half the way up the side of the dish.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the top is golden.  Let stand for a few minutes, and cut into squares.

title: Faux Sauteed Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Prepare a skillet for cooking and set aside.  Wipe clean the mushrooms.  Sprinkle the dill weed evenly over the mushrooms.  Place the pan under the broiler and broil, with the lid in place, until the mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Vanilla Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat | 1/8 cup vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove lid and cook 15 minutes more.  Serve hot.  Note, for a faster soup, stir in some cornstarch dissolved in enough boiling water to thicken to the desired consistency.

title: Fiery Rice-Fried Rice
ingredients: 225 g brown rice | 125 ml brandy | 300 g crushed saffron | chili pepper flakes
instructions: Put the rice with the saffron into a pan.  Place 5 cups of boiling water over the rice and stir well to combine.  Cover the pan and bring to the boil.  Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until the water is absorbed.  Leave for 20 minutes.  Once the rice is cooked, divide between 8 bowls, sprinkle with chilli flakes and drizzle over brandy.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,cashew,fontina cheese,kosher salt,soba noodle,cheddar cheese,milk
title: Noodle, Chilli & Cashews Mix
ingredients: 2 serrano chili | 400 g soba noodles, broken into 1/2 inch portions | 250 g grated cheddar cheese | 250 g grated fontina cheese | 125 g cashews | 150 ml milk | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste )
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, cook soba noodles for 1 minute and drain and keep warm.  In a large pan of boiling water, cook soba noodles for 7 - 8 minutes, drain and keep warm until ready to use.  In a medium bowl, combine the cheddar, fontina, cashews, milk, salt and chilli.  To assemble, invite guests to build an assortment of accompaniments in the following order, noodles, hot sauce, chopped cashews, cheese, sauce mix, hot sauce, etc.

title: Crunchy Strawberry Bread on a Stick
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 4 cups strawberries | 1 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 loaf sourdough bread
instructions: Cut bread into slices on the diagonal, or cut a loaf into four pieces.  Cut strawberries in half.  Put into a bowl, mix together the corn syrup and strawberry filling.  Spread on top of both pieces of bread.  Take sourdough bread sticks, and wrap them in cling film, and put it in the toaster on the stove.

title: Watermelon Fritters
ingredients: vegetable cooking spray | 1 cup watermelon, seeded, shredded | 1 teaspoon corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Wash the watermelon and place it in a medium bowl.  Spray the top of the bowl with vegetable cooking spray.  Sprinkle with shredded corn flakes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the watermelon from the bowl and top with cornflakes.

title: Turmeric
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place turmeric and salt in a mortar.  Grind and grind together in a mortar and pestle.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Acapulco Salsa
ingredients: 4 ounces salsa | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Stir the salsa, ranch seasoning mix and mace together in a large bowl.  Chill and serve.

title: Chipotle and Filling for Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints pomegranates | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles, seeded and minced | 3/4 cup filling
instructions: Rinse the pomegranates and remove the seeds using a sharp paring knife, cut off the tops, then squeeze out any seeds.  Remove the peels into a medium bowl, then place the pomegranates into the bowl.  Add the chipotles, stirring to combine.  Add the filling, stirring until well blended.  The filling should have absorbed the flavors of the pomegranate.  Place the mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: tofu,fontina cheese,graham cracker crumb,artichoke heart,apple,wheat bread
title: Artichoke Tofu Balls
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 8 1/2-inch slices peeled, cored, and cut into chunks | 8 1/2-inch staled artichoke hearts, cut into wedges | 1 1/4 cups shredded fontina cheese, divided | 1/2 apple, cored and diced small
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spray tofu with cooking spray and drizzle with cracker crumbs.  Arrange artichoke slices over tofu, then layer with half the fontina cheese.  Roll up jellyroll style, starting on the long side and place seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Spoon remaining cheese over all.  Cover, and bake 35 minutes in the preheated oven.  Uncover, and continue baking 5 to 10 minutes, until cheese is melted and lightly browned.  Cut into bite size pieces and serve in chunks on small plates.

title: Yogurt Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2/3 cup rolled oats ( you can use almond ) | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Pour yogurt into a bowl and mix well.  Melt the sugar in the microwave or a saute pan, stirring frequently, until melted.  Pour yogurt into a bowl and stir well to blend the yoghurt.  Add rice to yoghurt and stir well.  Heat just enough water to cover the rice, but do not boil.  Add the butter, pepper, and salt and pepper to the rice and stir slowly.  The consistency of your rice should be like that.  After 10 - 18 minutes add the rice mix to the water.  It will steam as it cooks and the steam will be released.  It is done when the liquid has been mostly absorbed but a small amount of the liquid remains.  When all of the liquid has been absorbed, it is ready.  Serve at once or store in the fridge for up to a week.

title: German Colcannon
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 4 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Sprinkle the mustard seeds on the top of the cabbage and set aside.  In a dutch oven or electric roaster, heat the cabbage to boiling while stirring.  When it comes to a boil, boil for 15 minutes, removing the cabbage after 15 minutes when fully cooked.  Place the cooked cabbage in a paper bag to seal.

title: Kaffir Lime Leaf Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped parsley ( optional ) or 1/4 cup cilantro, fresh ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry the leaves.  Cut the leaves in half lengthwise and gently squeeze out the juice.  Mix together all of the ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,dark rum,white bean,red bell pepper
title: Cuban Pibil
ingredients: 1 cup canned white beans, drained | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 2 pork chops, with fat on | 1 ounce dark rum ( or bacardi 151 )
instructions: Put beans, peppers, pork chops fat, and rum or bacardi 151 in a frying pan.  Bring mixture to a boil and then cover and reduce heat to a simmer.  Cook for 20 minutes, or until meat falls off the bone and juices run clear when cut into the middle of the pork chop with a fork.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,tomato sauce,lemon juice zest,matzo meal,dark brown sugar
title: Matzoh Crusted Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp | 2 ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup matzo meal ( or fine cornmeal ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons lemon juice or 3 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Rinse shrimp under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels.  Trim the tail and body with a thin sharp knife.  Combine shrimp, tomatoes, matzoh meal or cornmeal, brown sugar, and lemon juice in a large bowl.  Mix well.  Dip shrimp first in the shrimp mix, then into the matzoh mixture, coating well.  Place shrimp in a steamer basket over boiling water.  Cover and cook 8 minutes.  Serve at once.  Note, shrimp can be cooked in an oven at 375 degrees f.  For an added touch, cook a few frozen peas when they thaw and scoop out the flesh, cooking and stirring every so often, until the are soft and pliable and shrimp brown.

title: Macadamia Nut Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 macadamia nuts | 1/2 inch fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Slice ginger into thin sticks approximately the size of a small walnut or peppercorn.  Heat a dry non stick wok over medium high heat.  Pour in the soy sauce.  Once it starts to bubble, add the nuts.  Stir fry about 30 seconds, then remove from the heat and stir fry the ginger for a few seconds.  Remove the nuts from the wok and drain.  Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Corn and Chayote Squash
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 4 ears chopped chayote squash | 2 cups chopped green olives | 24 cornhusks
instructions: Heat maple syrup in a large skillet over medium heat until boiling.  Reduce heat to medium low.  Cover, and cook until syrup reaches the consistency of maple syrup, 40 to 50 minutes.  Spread 1 ear of corn onto a microwave safe dinner plate, and cook and stir chayote squash and olives in the hot syrup until lightly browned.  Remove corn, and sprinkle with cornhusks.  Cook and stir cornhusks over the hot chayote squash and olives for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Shrimp in Sultanas for Two!
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom seed
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp.  Place the sultanas and sage in a pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Return the pot to the stove, add the shrimp, bring back to the boil and add the sultanas.  Bring back to the boil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 20 minutes.  Season to taste with cardamom seeds and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ear corn,flour tortilla,amaretto,marsala wine,cardamom seed,red pepper
title: Red Pepper and Corn Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground red pepper | 4 large ears corn, shucked | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed, or to taste | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 teaspoon dry marsala wine ( optional ) | 2 flour tortillas ( optional )
instructions: Brush corn with olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper.  On a clean, dry surface, sprinkle cardamom seed over corn.  Roll the corn from ear to ear, and secure with a toothpick.  If desired, warm a frying pan over medium high heat.  When it’s hot, add enough corn oil to cover the bottom.  Place tortillas, one at a time, and flip as needed.  When the edges are crisp and golden brown, remove to a paper towel to drain.  Continue with remaining tortillas, or fry them up in batches if necessary.  Slice the tortillas into triangles.  Serve warm.

title: Apple Spinach and Tomato
ingredients: 1 lb granny smith apple, cored and diced | 5 ounces tomato paste | 5 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Fry the apple pieces until very tender and slightly charred.  Add the tomato paste and cook briefly.  Add spinach according to preference.  Serve hot with some crusty bread.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Tilapia
ingredients: 16 ounces pinto beans | 4 tilapia fillets
instructions: Rinse the beans with water.  Then rinse, cover, and put in crock pot.  Cook on low, or on high for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,coconut milk,red curry paste,ciabatta,zucchini,saffron,five spice powder,sugar
title: Spicy Coconut Curry Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 4 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 ciabatta, split, toasted on one side | 2 zucchini, sliced
instructions: Mix curry paste, 5 spice powder, sugar, saffron, coconut milk& pepper in a large freezer bag.  Add zucchini and stir.  Seal bag& freeze for at least 11hr.  About 10 minutes before baking, preheat oven to 150c line a large roasting pan with foil and spray with cooking oil cooking spray and arrange zucchini slices evenly around the pan.  Bake for 40mins, or until zucchini is tender and lightly crisp & crisp on the top.  Slice ciabatta on the diagonal & toast lightly in oven.  Spread curry toast with sauce & serve immediately.  Variation, alternatively you can roast the ciabatta in a pan for the last few minutes of baking if desired & add them to the curry for the second half of the baking time.

title: Sour Cream With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Green Onions
ingredients: 2 -3 bunches green onions, minced | 16 -20 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced
instructions: Put all in small bowl and stir.  Adjust seasoning to taste.  Serve immediately.

title: Gebhardtsa -- Spiced Olive Oil
ingredients: 350 g green cardamom pods, cracked open ( the pods have a subtle sheen ) | 4 -5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( or oil from the pan )
instructions: First, clean the cardamom pods, then split them open lengthwise.  Fill a small mixing bowl with cold water.  Place the cracked cardamom pods in the water with 1 tablespoon of oil, to make a single layer, then squeeze the pods to remove the seeds.  Repeat.  Keep the water nearby until you are ready to use up all the cardamom pods.  Dry the oil over medium heat.  When the oil just begins to shimmer, pour a few drops of water into the bowl.  If you think the oil is smoking, place a paper towel directly on top.  When it is right, add the cardamom pods.  Carefully shake the bowl a few times, shaking the bowl a couple of times so that the oil doesn't stick.  Be sure to stir the contents to coat evenly with the spices.  This takes about 15 minutes to 1 hour, depending on thickness.  Note, if the oil seems to thin before the aromas come out, the oil is too thin.  The gebhardtsa should be cooked right away.  If the oil seems slightly oily, simply toss it back in briefly and serve immediately.
