ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1 package frozen snap peas, thawed | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Unroll can of crescent dough onto a lightly floured surface.  Unroll dough and separate into eight triangles, separating between both triangles.  Press each triangle into a 6 x 8 inch nonstick baking mold to form a circle about 10 in diameter.  Place 1/2 cup of peas, kahlua, red pepper flakes, and 1/4 cup cheese in each circle.

title: Irish Breakfast Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kahlua | 10 ounces dark rum | 2 flour tortillas | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped
instructions: Toast the tortillas with the kahlua in a dry frying pan.  Combine the rum and cheese in a glass bowl.  Stir well, set aside.  Spread a small amount of the rum mixture onto each of the fried tortilla wraps.  Divide the shredded cheese among the wraps and place on a paper towel.  Pat down firmly.  Wear a large, flat tin to help wrap each portion.  Tear off pieces of the bag of pecans and roll the tortillas into a bundle.  Spray a nonstick fry pan with veggie spray or line with foil.  Add the rolls to the oil and cook on both sides.  Serve with cinnamon and chocolate syrup.

title: French Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 3/8 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and juice.  Add black pepper and mix well.  Refrigerate for an hour before serving.  This dressing keeps for up to three months.

title: Fish Gyros from Scratch
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 2 loaves ciabatta | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  Lightly oil grate.  Place fish fillets in a shallow dish.  Close lid securely and shake to combine.  Grill, turning once, on high for about 7 minutes for white, 7 minutes for dark.  Place 2 slices of bread into food processor or blender with cumin and 2 teaspoons oil.

title: Chinese Steak Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup red pepper paste, or more to taste | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine red pepper paste and green bell pepper in a large bowl.  Cover and refrigerate until the steak appears opaque and no longer pink.

title: Hot and Sweet Dip
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet pepper, sliced into 1/4 inch strips | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Place the sweet pepper strips in a baking dish or large baking dish.  Drizzle with cider vinegar, and toss to coat.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until tender.

title: Hungarian Beef Roast
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs chuck roast | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees.  Combine horseradish, paprika, and paprika.  Pierce meat with a fork and place in a roasting pan.  Roast the meat in the preheated oven until done, approximately 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours.  Meat should brown slightly and the internal temperature should be 140 to 155 degrees for medium rare, or 140 to 155 degrees for medium well.  Remove meat from the oven and pour off juices into a gravy boat or gravy boat.  Serve with noodles of choice.

title: Quick Canadian Bacon, Egg and Celery Pasta
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 6 slices canadian bacon | 1/2 cup celery, chopped | 1 whole clove
instructions: Cook the rigatoni pasta according to package directions, and drain.  Meanwhile, place the canadian bacon in a nonstick skillet set over medium high heat, and cook until evenly brown.  Remove to a plate.  Crumble the bacon, and return skillet to medium heat.  Saute the celery and clove until golden brown.  Add the cooked rigatoni to the skillet, and toss to combine.  Turn down heat to low, and cook until egg are set.  Toss with cooked bacon, celery, and garlic cloves to serve.

title: Fruit Salad With Maple Leaf Broth
ingredients: 2 cups thawed mixed baby bok choy or 2 cups baby bok choy | 1/4 cup chopped leek | 3 cups prepared sweet-and-sour mix, chilled ( such as vietnamese ginger salad ) | 1/2 lb sliced young red raspberries, lightly toasted
instructions: In a heavy 3 to 4 quart heavy pot over moderately boiling, steam the bok choy and leek until just tender, about 3 minutes.

title: German Style Country Style Rib Pot Pie With Pork Rinds and Kale
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 4 -4 lbs country-style lean pork ribs, cut crosswise into thin slices about 1/8 thick ( shoulder or leg would also work ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb kale, rinsed, patted dry, leaves torn into smaller pieces ( or kale ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace, preferably dill | 1/2 cup miracle whip
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f and butter a 2 quart casserole dish.  In a large bowl, toss together the potatoes and any accumulated juices that have accumulated on the sides of the bowl.  Lay the pork in a slightly greased layer over the top, skin side down.  Sprinkle with the oregano.  Sprinkle with the kale, cover tightly with aluminum foil and transfer to the middle of the oven.  Bake until potatoes are tender, about ½ hour.  Turn on the oven to 300 degrees f and return the dish to the oven.  Bake about 30 minutes more or until nicely browned.  While the pork rinds are baking, drain fat from the pan and place it over medium high heat, when it starts to boil, add the miracle whip.  When the bottom begins to bubble, remove from the heat as soon as it starts to bubble about ¼ minute.  Be sure to check the bottom, stir a bit of the miracle whip to warm the cheese before removing from the heat.  When the pork rinds are done, transfer them to a platter, set aside.  Remove the bacon drippings in the pan from the oven and reserve it.  Bake the pot pie uncovered for 45 minutes, remove from oven and set aside when it is finished, stir bacon once or twice more.  Serve the potatoes over the top, sprinkle with more oregano.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,mustard,tabasco sauce,stewing beef,cream mushroom soup,chipotle chile adobo,pepper
title: Beef Tips over Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into bite size pieces | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3 dashes tabasco sauce | 2 -4 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | pepper
instructions: First, place the cumin and mustard in a small baking pan and toast over medium low heat until light brown.  Watch it carefully because it darkens so easily, you might add the chipoltles.  Pour into a bowl when cool and cool down.  Next heat up the beef tips over med heat for a few minutes.  Pour cream of mushroom soup into the pot and mix.  Add chipotles, stirring to combine.  If the soup starts to boil immediately, remove the pot from the burner.  Be sure to put the beef tips back into pot and stir. .  Then cover.  Leave for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  You want to thicken the soup somewhat so that it doesn't burn/stick.  It should be bubbling.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,beer,chinese celery,enchilada sauce,black olive,pinto bean,syrup
title: Easy and Healthy Syrian-Style Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans light pinto beans, undrained | 3/4 cup honey-glazed enchilada sauce | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup beer | 2 tablespoons maple syrup, or as needed | 1 bunch chinese celery, stemmed and coarsely chopped - or as needed - | 1 can black olives, drained and minced
instructions: Stir pinto beans, enchilada sauce, and maple syrup together in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium low.

title: Applesauce Tilapia
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/2 cup apple butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Brush the tilapia fillets with 1/2 cup of the melted apple butter and bake for 10 minutes.  Serve the tilapia with additional apple butter sauce.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package stir-fry vegetables | 3 cups 1 % low-fat milk | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, powder
instructions: Put the 2 cups of milk and 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder in a large skillet.  Stir and bring to a boil.  When it begins to thicken add the stir fry vegetables.  Stir fry for 3 more minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Dee's Easy Crock Pot Indonesian Beef With Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 onion, halved and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 8 small cloves | 750 g beef sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1 can lima beans
instructions: Combine onion, cardamom seeds and cloves in a large skillet over medium high heat, cook stirring frequently until onion starts to darken.  Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,corn oil,taco seasoning mix,water chestnut,pumpkin seed,steel oat,brown sugar
title: Taco Wheat Squares
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds | 1 1/2 cups water chestnuts, sliced | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 cup dried steel cut oats | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f in a 9x9 inch baking dish combine the pumpkin seeds with the water chestnuts, tomatoes with green chile peppers, taco seasoning, brown sugar, and steel cut oats.  In a medium bowl stir together the oil and corn oil.

title: Smokin' Irish Bread
ingredients: 5 slices smoked bacon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons flour ( optional and depends on how much bacon grease you use ) | 5 slices rye bread
instructions: In a medium size frying pan, fry the bacon until crispy.  Remove bacon from pan and drain off the fat.  To the bacon drippings, add the flour, mix thoroughly and set aside.  Split 1 bread slice and brush with the reserved fat, fry until light brown on one side and crispy.  Turn over and brown the other side until crispy.  Repeat with the other bread slice.  Serve.

title: Lettuce Salad With Linguine
ingredients: 4 heads romaine lettuce | 4 cups icing sugar | 5 packages linguine, cooked al dente
instructions: Cut the lettuce into pieces.  Put aside half to save on table.

title: Mom's Cheese Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 package processed american cheese, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Combine the corn, processed cheese, and processed american cheese in a large bowl.

title: Auntie Annie's Irish Stew
ingredients: 1/2 kg irish stew meat ( i had some leftover ) or 1/2 kg beef stew meat, cut into pieces | 2 cups farina | 1 can condensed tomato puree
instructions: Mix farina to form a soft dough.  Take half and half, form balls of dough.  Roll both balls of dough around the meat to coat all sides.  Add water and bring to the boil.  Once it goes to a boil, take a slotted spoon, and put meat into.  The water, while still at one end, you can add some of your stew.  You might have to add a little water to help thicken the stew.  Let it boil, and it should still be floating.  When it is all floating, it should be.  It should be tender.  Once it is cool enough, it will absorb more water and be easier to work with.  Serve immediately with a green vegetable on the side.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,baking powder,coriander powder,cornstarch,yellow cake mix,fish sauce,bulgur wheat,garam masala
title: Soy Curried Bulgur Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1 yellow cake mix | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 100c and grease and line a 10 cup frijole pan.  Soy curried bulgur cake topping.  Combine cornstarch, sugar, fish sauce and baking powder in a bowl.  Whisk the bulgur wheat with a fork and add to the cornstarch mixture.  Mix on high speed with a wooden spoon until a thick dough forms.  Turn out onto greased baking paper and spread out with spatula.  Repeat with the yellow cake mix, garam masala and coriander until you get a silky texture.  Cook the cake for 30 mins until golden brown and springy to the touch.  Let cool down before eating.  Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: corn,radish,oat bran,pistachio,graham cracker crumb,baking soda,pork shoulder,pimento olive
title: Grilled Pork Tacos, Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 cup oat bran | 1 cup stone ground pistachios or 1 cup almonds | 1/2 cup roasted corn | 1/2 - 3/4 lb pork shoulder, sliced thin | 2 cans corn, drained | 4 large radishes, sliced | 2 tablespoons crushed pimento stuffed olives | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups oat bran, for coating tacos ( optional ) | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( optional )
instructions: For the ground meats, mix together in a bowl the oat bran, pistachios, corn and roasted corn.  Heat grill to high.  When ready to cook, coat grill with corn cooking spray.  Brush about 3 tablespoons of cooking spray onto one side of a tortilla, and sprinkle lightly with graham cracker crumbs.  When just barely heated through, place another tortilla on top.  Repeat with other ingredients.  When done, remove from grill, and cut into taco sized portions.

title: Blackberry & Sage Strudels
ingredients: 1/2 cup blackberries | 3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed | 1 1/2 cups ale
instructions: To make pastry, in bowl combine berries & shallots, then bring to a simmer.  Cover & simmer 5 minutes & remove from the heat.  Cover & let stand 10 minutes.  Remove phyllo sheets from the package & separate the sheets.  Brush each sheet with some of the ale & place one sheet on a work surface.  Cover phyllo in a buttered 1 1/2 2 in.  Layer on the blackberry mixture & continue arranging sheets to cover the rest.  Cover with a dampened towel & refrigerate until the pastry is cold.  Slice & serve or refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Grilled Cheesy Shrimp Pita Crisps
ingredients: 12 pita breads | 1 1/2 cups shredded sargento mexican cheese blend | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 12 large cooked shrimp, peeled | 2 tablespoons shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to medium or medium high.  Cut pita breads lengthwise with a serrated knife into 3/4 inch slices, cutting 1/4 off center of each slice.  In a medium bowl, toss together 1 1/2 cups cheese and 1 1/2 cup grated cheese.  Arrange pita slices on the foil lined plate, leaving 2 inches between each slice.  Place pita on the grill, cook 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until crisp.  Remove from foil.  Set aside and keep warm.  Combine 1 1/2 cup of salsa with half and half in a medium bowl, stirring until well blended.  Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture into the center of each pita slice and top with 2 shrimp, 1 tablespoon of salsa mixture and 1 tablespoon cheese.  Roll up and secure with toothpicks if necessary.  Pour asiago cheese over remaining cheese and press to adhere.  Place on a preheated grill or over indirect heat, grill until beginning to brown, about 3 minutes per side.  Remove toothpicks from shrimp.

title: Nif's Barley and Tomato Barley
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 6 cups water | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 -2 bay leaf
instructions: Boil the pearl barley.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Drain again.  Bring to a boil in the water.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 40 minutes.  Add the thyme and bay leaf.  Simmer for 40 - 45 minutes more to blend the flavors.  Turn off and leave the pot alone for an hour.  Serve topped with grated parmigiano reggiano cheese.  Yummy.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,celery rib,chili pepper flake,cannellini bean,bulk italian sausage,corn oil
title: Italian Pasta Fagioli  (Sausages)
ingredients: 250 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2/3 cup corn oil | 1 small smoked sweet chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 -4 celery ribs | 1 -2 sprigs fresh rosemary ( with stem )
instructions: In a skillet, combine the beans and corn oil.  Cook over medium heat until hot.  Add the hot italian sausage.  Use a spatula to break them into small pieces.  When it is cooked through, sprinkle with grand marnier and chile flakes.  Garnish with rosemary sprigs before serving.

Random Ingredients: meat,egg white,white pepper,ricotta cheese,spinach leaf,basmati rice,broth
title: Rice Balls
ingredients: 8 cups chicken stock or 8 cups broth | 1 lb ground meat | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/4 tablespoon white pepper | 9 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves | 14 ounces ricotta cheese | jasmine rice or regular wide rice | broth ( optional )
instructions: Cook meat and add eggs one at a time.  Add pepper and cook well.  Drain fat and add spinach in large bowl.  Mix in ricotta until well mixed.  Stir in rice 1 - 2 inches of broth and then meat mixture.  You can use water to make the broth thicker or put in water to make rice balls.  Place small pieces of the cooked rice in a cookie press with about a 3/4 inch round or you can use a small plastic bag and fill with about 1 teaspoon of meat mixture.  Press a smaller scoopful of mixture in and press lightly.  Repeat until all meat is in rice balls.  You'll want about 3 layers.  Put a little more broth or broth in each pot to cover.  The rice balls will be ready when the broth rises to the top.  You can place in the refrigerator until ready to fry.  In a large pot, place enough sauce ingredients to cover meat balls.  Bring water to boil add rice balls and return to boil.  When water comes to boil, lower to medium/low and cook for about 20 minutes, adding water or more broth if needed.  Serve with extra cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,lemon juice zest,cream celery soup,sesame oil
title: Quick and Easy Tostones
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 2 tablespoons corn tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: In bowl, combine soup, lemon juice, sesame oil and corn tortilla chips.  Spread soup mixture in shallow dish to cover top.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,cocoa,orange zest,toblerone chocolate bar,stew meat,snow pea,flour
title: Toblerone Rum Balls
ingredients: 3 toblerone chocolate bars | 1 cup flour | 1/2 cup cocoa | 2 lbs stew meat | 1 vanilla bean, scraped | 1/2 cup snipped orange zest | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Melt chocolates.  Combine with flour.  Cut meat into small pieces, place in saucepan, cover and bring to boil.  Add zest and juice and remove from heat.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Return meat, vanilla and nuts to pan.  Shape into small balls and flatten with a fork to a thickness of 1/4 inch.  Bake about 15 minutes at 350f, remove and cool.  Dip balls in sugar or coat.  Melt chocolate under broiler until it turns a light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: carrot,soymilk,rice wine,self rising flour,green cardamom pod,cilantro leaf,tomato sauce
title: Yogurt Free Breaky Pancakes
ingredients: 150 g tomato sauce | 300 g soy milk | 1 small carrot, grated | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 1 g plain self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/8 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the tomato sauce, soy milk, carrot, cardamom and white flour with your hands until smooth.  Stir in the rice wine and chopped cilantro leaves.  Use a teaspoon or your index finger to scoop about a tablespoon or two of the mixture and drop into a pancake batter.  Cook on a hot skillet, turning once to cook both sides.  Serve with tomato sauce and tomato puree for an extra kick.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,water chestnut,black bean,demerara sugar,cremini mushroom,ginger garlic paste
title: Mushroom & Red Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fat-free demerara sugar, plus extra | demerara sugar, for sprinkling | 4 tablespoons black bean, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 red bell pepper, julienned ( remove seeds if you don't want any spice ) | 2 large cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Combine sugar and water in small skillet and bring it to a boil.  Turn heat to low and stir in black bean and ginger garlic.  Reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes.  Stir mushrooms into sauce mixture.  Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,margarine butter,cremini mushroom,red chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Mushroom Crepes
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms | vegetable crema ( for topping ) or butter | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes ( for topping ) | 1 pinch confectioner's sugar ( for topping )
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and chop them into half inch chunks.  If they are large, chop into smaller bits.  Heat a nonstick skillet with medium high heat, butter a crepe pan well, and let it get hot.  Butter the crepe pan well and lay your prepared spuds accordingly.  If your mushroom chunks are small, they will need about half an inch to fit your pan.  When the pan is hot, add a few tablespoons of cream or margarine a few tablespoons at a time, and stir the entire time, being careful not to let the bottom of the pan get too dark.  If your spuds are a bit dry, you may need a bit more of the cream or margarine.  Remove from the pan with a spatula, and set them aside.  Repeat until the mixture is gone.  Spread the mushrooms evenly over the entire pan or tortillas.  Top it with a dollop of confectioner's sugar.  Then top it with another dollop of confectioner's sugar to add a little spark.  When the cheese is melted and the bottom of the crepe starts to go brown, carefully flip the crepe over and then put the plate on the pan or tortilla a couple of seconds later to brown the top and bottom.  A few minutes before the bottom is browned, lay a second plate on top of the first, hold your hand and a spatula so that you can flip the crepe over and to give the other side a good flip.  If the bottom is a little brown, the rest is a little brown.  If it needs a lot of brown, just pat the bottom with a spatula and put it back on.  You may also want to blot it with your spatula if the bottom is a little brown.  When the second plate is browned, lightly sprinkle the top with confectioner's sugar to give it a glaze.  Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Ann's Irish Mist
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups irish whiskey, such as jameson | 1 1/4 cups light rum | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Combine the whiskey, rum, rice wine, and anise in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart pitcher.  Stir well to blend.  Add the ann's mist, cover the pitcher, and let stand at room temperature for 1 day or refrigerate for up to 5 days.  You may serve the mist on the side of the ann's mist.

title: Yummy & Rich Red Wine Jelly Beans
ingredients: 2 cups red kidney beans | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 bottle merlot or ( 330 g ) bottle brandy
instructions: Scald the beans then boil gently until soft.  Stir in the gelatin and then stir in flour until it has dissolved.  Add the water to the bean mixture just enough to make a dropping consistency.  Bring to the boil and put on the jelly.  Stir until the jelly starts to thicken to the consistency you like.  Pour into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Beef Teriyaki (Stir Fry)
ingredients: 1 aubergine | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Cut aubergine into bite size pieces.  Separate and fry with oyster sauce for a couple of minutes until lightly browned on one side.  Turn over quickly to brown the other side.  Enjoy.

title: The Tarragon Spirals from the Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 package prosciutto | 3 cans mixed fruit punch | 1 pound fresh pink food coloring ( for valentine's day ) | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Wrap a slice of proscuitto around each slice of spellated pink food coloring to make spiral eyes.  Mock the two spirals together by hanging a toothpick down the center of each one.

title: Super Simple Yellow Rice Noodle Satay
ingredients: 2 packages white mushrooms, sliced | 2 yellow sweet peppers, sliced | 3/4 cup semolina, toasted | 1/2 cup rice stick | 1 bamboo skewer
instructions: Soak the rice sticks in warm water for 15 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Cut the mushrooms and peppers into medium sized pieces.  Set aside.  Place the toasted semolina in a pan with a little olive oil.  Cook over medium heat until slightly dry and begin burning.  Slowly add the chopped mushrooms.  The mushrooms should not be browned to your liking.  Turn the heat down and cook for 10 minutes.  Remove and set aside.  Slice the bamboo skewers in half widthwise, then cut each piece width wise into 4 long strips.  Cut each strip into 1/4 squares.  Arrange the cooked rice sticks onto a plate with about 2 tablespoons sesame oil near each piece.  Place the mushrooms and peppers on each piece of rice sticks and serve.  Variation, when buying the yellow rice sticks, use brown rice or any other flavor of yellow rice, such as tamarind pod or black eye peas.  Also, if using cassava pods add about a teaspoon of tamarind pod to the yellow rice sticks and peppers and you can leave the yellow rice sticks whole on the cassava because it will absorb the flavor to the rice.  Try to play around with the amount of water for the flavor of the tamarind you get, the cassava also tends to go soft after it has sat for about 15 minutes.  Soak the sesame oil in a pot with some margarine and the rice sticks.  Keep the water at a slow boil, then simmer on a lowest heat for about 30 minutes.  After 1 hour, take off the sim/low heat.  Check one item and drain.  Continue to monitor the water level if not, remember the rice sticks may stick to the bottom of the pot for a different reason.  Add the rice sticks and peppers to the tamarind water in the pot, mix, and simmer for 7 - 10 minutes until desired level of flavor is reached.

title: Cheddar Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans | 4 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemongrass | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce the heat to medium low, cover and simmer until the beans are tender, about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat, and cook the lemongrass until softened, 5 to 7 minutes.  Pour the boiling soup into the simmering soup and cook, stirring frequently, until the soup thickens and separates, 2 to 3 minutes.  Serve warm topped with the shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: half cream,orange peel,superfine sugar,margarine,bread machine yeast
title: Orange Peel Bread II
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups bread machine yeast | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 cup cream or 1 cup half-and-half cream, warm | 2 teaspoons freshly grated orange peel | 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Combine bread machine yeast, sugar, cream and orange peel.  Press start.  When cycle is complete, place on a bread machine, or with a large chopping blade and process for 15 to 20 minutes or until dough has formed a smooth ball.  Place dough in a greased bowl, cover and let rise for about 30 minutes.  Punch down and divide into two.  Round loaf pans.  Place 1 1/2 cups dough in each pan.  Cover and let rise for 20 minutes.  Bake at 375 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes, or until loaves sound hollow when tapped on the bottom.  Cool on racks.

title: English Muffin Peach Veggie Sandwich
ingredients: 2 english muffins, split | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1 tablespoon cilantro or 1 tablespoon basil | 1/4 cup peach slices, chilled ( i actually used canned ) | 1/4 cup slice fresh peach, chilled | 1 cup mushroom, sliced thin | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro, packed, chopped | 12 -14 lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons italian dressing
instructions: Toast english muffins.  Remove from oven.  Spread italian dressing over each toasted sandwich.  Sprinkle italian rice seasoning, basil and peach slices evenly on.  Place sliced peaches across bread, top with sliced fresh peaches and assorted fresh leaves.  Spoon some sliced peaches and the rest of the italian dressing on top.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,applesauce,sage leaf,flat leaf parsley,tomato
title: Italian Sausage Applesauce Soup
ingredients: 2 medium hot italian sausages, cut lengthwise into about 1/8 inch slices | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/4 cup applesauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: In a saucepan combine sausage, stewed tomatoes, apple sauce, parsley, sage and enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,baking soda,kernel corn,tomato sauce,cannellini bean,sesame oil,butter bean,white mushroom
title: Gimmie's Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can peanut oil | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup canned whole kernel corn | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | butter beans, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place all ingredients in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, then drizzle with sesame oil and bake for another 45 minutes.  Serve hot or cold.  Beans can also be frozen for later.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,celery seed,carrot,black sesame seed,thyme sprig,catsup,chat masala
title: Creamy Chinese Carrot Spread
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled | 2 tablespoons green fat light cream cheese, diced ( or use reduced fat cream cheese ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon light sour cream or 1 teaspoon catsame juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder chat masala | 1/4 teaspoon black sesame seed | 1 dash dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Grate or julienne carrot.  Add all the ingredients except for the last 1/3 of the green fat.  Beat with a wooden spoon or your hands until smooth, well blended.  Let sit for 30 minutes over night.  Stir in the last 1/3 green fat.  Cover and refrigerate till ready to use.

title: Artichoke Snacks
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 limes, wedged | finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Drain the artichoke hearts reserving the liquid.  Reserve the liquid.  Mash the artichoke hearts with a fork.  Mix in the limes and cilantro and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate until served.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,peanut,kohlrabi,tomato green chilies,snow pea,coriander powder,pear
title: Vegetable Patties
ingredients: 4 ripe pears, peeled, cored | 2 heads cauliflower, finely grated | 2 kohlrabi, finely grated | 2 large tomatoes, finely diced | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 can green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celcius.  Mix all ingredients except chilies together in large bowl.  Make into large flat patties about 1 cm thick and 2cm wide.  Wrap in foil and bake for 25 minutes.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,chili garlic sauce,egg yolk,serrano pepper
title: Homemade Sriracha Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 bottle chili-garlic sauce | 2 lbs egg yolks | 2 lbs serrano peppers | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, mix all ingredients for the chili garlic sauce and add to boiling water.  Once you have your ingredients ready to go this will be your jelly recipe.  Use a fine mesh strainer and press through strainer using a double layer of sifter to drain any excess liquid.  This makes the jelly a little easier to work with.  Bring the jelly back to a boil and then turn down heat, and place over a low flame.  Let the mixture boil vigorously for 20 minutes while watching carefully.  Once it is reduced, strain the jelly and place into a large clean jar and refrigerate for upto 1 week.  Use in certi past, to make 1 cup of jelly and freeze 3 cups for future use.

title: Baby Carrots and Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 2 slices stale french bread | 2 tablespoons baby carrots ( or 2 medium carrots ) | 2 tablespoons baby stringy gouda cheese | 8 ounces baby rocket | 3 -6 drops hot sauce | 1 apple, pared, shredded ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Cut two rounds off the bread crusts of the loaf.  Using a sharp knife cut a circle in a large enough oven dish that fits under the bread.  Slice the rounds about 1/4 inch thick.  Dip the shredded bread into boiling hot water to cover.  Transfer the slices to the oven dish.  Place the bread on a baking sheet.  Bake for 5 – 10 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and crisp.  Remove bread from oven and transfer it to a warm plate.  Top with carrots and stringy cheese.  Wear gloves to prevent the cheese from running off the bread.  Cover it and keep it warm in a 200 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes to prevent it from drying out or burning.  Sprinkle the gouda cheese over the fondue.  Scatter rocket over the fondue and serve hot with bread slices for dipping.

title: Molho
ingredients: 2 tablespoons calvados ( apple liqueur ) | 4 tablespoons firm silken tofu | 5 lamb shanks ( each about 1-3 inches thick )
instructions: Mix the calvados with 1 tablespoon of the liquid from the tofu and set aside.  Preheat the grill.  Soak the lamb, shanks in the remaining mixture.  Grill the lamb, shanks, and lamb over high heat until the meat is tender and the meat just begins to brown, turning as necessary, about 10 minutes, depending on the degree of doneness you like your lamb rare.

title: Linda's Awesome Buns
ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder | 120 g caster sugar | 1 red pepper | 1 package instant yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 140 deg celsius.  Cut pork into thin slices.  Place into oven tin.  Add the sugar on top of the meat, breaking it up as it goes.  Put under the hot grill until you turn the meat.  Turn often.  Leave meat in for 2 minutes, turn the heat down on the second side and sprinkle with the red pepper.  Keep in a warm oven.  After that, stir the yeast into the meat with some water.  Leave stirring for 5 minutes.  Then put the oven back on element and bring to a near boil.  Take off the stove and in a seperate bowl dissolve the 1/2 tsp of yeast with one cup of luke warm water.  Pour slowly into boiling liquid and stir until dissolved.  When the time is up, stir in the dissolved yeast.  Leave for another 15 minutes.  Pour onto a rack to cool slightly.  Keeps for 5 days and freezes well.  Enjoy and don't forget to take it to your buns and get a glass of milk.

title: Beef and Nori Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yeast | 250 ml warm water | 600 g stewing beef, diced | 1/2 cup pecan nuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives | 1/2 cup shredded nori or 1/2 cup coriander leaves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.  Add beef and turn to coat.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to prove in a warm place for 35 minutes or until meat is very tender and cooked through.  Mix pecan nuts with pimento stuffed olives and shredded nori.  Remove meat and allow to cool.  Slice meat and serve with toasted nuts mixed with nori and coriander leaves, if using.

title: Sweet Pastry (Dessert)
ingredients:
4 sheets phyllo pastry ( approx.
    - 5 x 5 sheets ) or 4 sheets other pastry | 2 tablespoons cornflour | confectioners'sugar, to glaze
instructions: Grease a 20 x 30 cm loaf tin.  Trim ends with a sharp knife.  Place one sheet of phyllo pastry in the base of the prepared tin.  Sprinkle over the cornflour and continue layering until you have used all of the pastry.  Carefully pour the cornflour mixture in to the pastry leaving a 1 cm edge around the edge.  Brush the top layer of pastry with water and sprinkle over a little sifted confectioner's sugar.  Brush the remaining pastry strip and cut into diamond shapes.  Cut a small hole down the centre of each diamond.  Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 18 minutes.  Allow to cool slightly.  Cut in slices, as for pie.

Random Ingredients: white bean,pork sausage,fennel seed,red bell pepper,lettuce leaf
title: Pork Toss Salad
ingredients: 1 small red bell pepper, seeded, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fennel seeds, crushed | 6 lettuce leaves, rinsed and chilled | 6 thick slices pork sausage | 1 can white beans, drained
instructions: Place the bell pepper slices in a bowl with the fennel seeds.  Toss to coat.  Let stand ten minutes.  Cut the souse in half lengthwise.  Carefully remove the skin and fibers with your fingers.  Cut into four thick slices, then crosswise into four lengths.  Lay out on a serving plate.  Cut the lettuce crosswise into three, then crosswise into four even crosswise fingers.  Lay on the platter with the sausage, bean halves and red pepper pieces.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,tamarind pulp,celery seed,oil,chicken thigh,panko breadcrumb

ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry sheets | oil, for deep frying | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 4 boneless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking tray with parchment paper.  Roll out the puff pastry sheets on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1 1/2in.  Using a 4in diameter glass dish and straight from the tray, roll out the pastry into a rectangle about 15 x 10 in.  Place the rectangles on the tray and trim any excess edges with a knife.  Cover with a clean tea towel and set aside for 30 mins to dry and firm.  Drain off any excess water and then dry.  Dry the chicken with kitchen paper.  Lay the pieces on a tray and sprinkle with tamarind pulp and celery seeds.  Season and then scatter over the panko.  Bake for 40 mins, or until cooked and golden brown on top.  Serve at once.

title: Pepperoni Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cooked and cut into florets | 4 ounces pepperoni, sliced | 10 fluid ounces chocolate, melted | 4 spring onions, sliced
instructions: Combine the cauliflower, pepperoni and the chocolate in a large bowl.  Sprinkle the spring onions over.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Coat a 9 x 13 pan with non stick spray.  Place chicken in pan and brown in oven on each side about 10 minutes after chicken is brown.  Remove from oven, pour half and half and curry paste into a bowl.  Add the curry paste and stir until blended.  Boil potatoes until slightly soft.

Take out, fluff up with a fork then garnish with the remaining cilantro.

title: The Best Meat Stuffing

instructions: Rinse and discard casings from pork sausage.  Mix all ingredients together.

instructions: In a small bowl, toss beef with worcestershire sauce and salt to taste and leave in fridge for 30 minutes.  Remove beef from fridge and roll in potato starch.  Drain beef and reserve liquid and place beef in a bowl.  Cut cream cheese into 8 pieces and place in a container large enough to accommodate cream cheese.  Cover beef with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.  In a large pot, combine cheese, sherry vinegar and beef.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 4 minutes. Place on plate and roll with reserved potato starch.  To serve, warm nachos in a medium hot skillet or deep fryer, 2 - 3 minutes on each side until crisp and golden.  Serve hot or warm.

title: Roast Beef Wraps

instructions: Trim the excess fat from the beef and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Place the beef and bread in a medium sized bowl.  Add the beef, orange zest, and rice vermicelli. Then, invert the wraps onto a plate, letting the juices run down the sides.  Then serve with the reserved juices.

title: Pesto Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk, canned | 2 cups marinara sauce, from canned | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( fresh or purchased )
instructions: In a sauce pan, combine coconut milk with marinara sauce and vanilla.  Heat to boiling over medium heat.  Reduce heat.  Simmer until thick enough to coat a spoon.  Add pesto to warm tomato puree and stir.  Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

instructions: Cut figs & remove the seeds.  Soak figs in cold water until soft.  Place drained figs in a blender along with sugar & soup mix.

title: Chili, Balsamic Vinegar and Peppers

instructions: Place pepper in a microwave safe bowl.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon hazelnut oil | 8 -12 phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup celery salt | 1 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons hot sauce

Roll up and slice diagonally to make 6 rectangles.  Place on parchment paper lined cookie sheets.  Let dry for 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to brush pastries with glaze.

title: Sausages With Chilli (Kunthai Style)

instructions: Put the basil and the chilli into a mortar and pound until smooth.  Add the ground cumin and chilli flakes and mix in the basil.  Put the sausages into a large dish, pour 1 cup of boiling water over them and leave to sit until done.  Bring the rest of the water to the boil and add the basil mix to it.  Slice the sausage and serve with the salad.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 lettuce leaves | 2 chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Place lettuce on work surface and place chili peppers on them.  Wrap each bundle with string leaving one end hanging over the ends.  Wrap each in plastic wrap and freeze until hard in the morning.  To serve, remove wraps from wrap and place on serving plate.  Spoon condiments into the folds and serve warm.  Variation, sprinkle with cheddar cheese.  Serve with pico de gallo, salsa, or other condiments.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,vegetable oil,icing sugar,ladyfinger,white vinegar,ricotta cheese
title: Ricotta Crostatas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 cup finely shredded ricotta cheese | 48 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix oil, vinegar, icing sugar and ricotta cheese until smooth.  Split ladyfingers in half, and separate them into halves with a sharp knife.  Using 2 fingers for one layer, lightly dredge each piece of soaked ladyfingers into the wet ricotta mixture, and sprinkle with brown sugar.  Roll dipped ladyfingers in the sticky ricotta mixture.  Arrange on a greased cookie sheet, and bake in oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.  Let cool for about 10 minutes on cookie sheet before removing.  Serve cool.

Sprinkle with lemon juice in small pats and roast them in a 375 degree f oven for 10 to 15 minutes or on the top rack of a gas grill.  Cool, slice and enjoy.  They can also be frozen or refrigerated up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: cognac,mandarin orange,grain rice,miracle whip,shortening,yellow rice,saffron,ricotta cheese
title: Mandarin-Rice-A-Roni (Moroccan Rice Balls)
ingredients: 3/4 cup shortening | 1 cup instant yellow rice | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/3 cup pancake syrup or 1/3 cup light rum | 1 pinch saffron | 1 cup mandarin oranges, peeled and sectioned or 2 cups any citrus segments | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb mascarpone cheese ( a sweetened version of this is posted ) or 1/2 lb ricotta cheese ( a sweetened version of this is posted )
instructions: Sift the shortening into a small bowl and beat until creamy.  Add the rice and stir to blend.  Add the Miracle Whip, pancake syrup or rum, saffron and mandarin orange segments and blend well.  If necessary, add more shortening and/or rum to get the rice to coat all ingredients.  If the mixture gets too dry then add a little more shortening and/or rum to make a smooth texture.  Add this mixture to the rice and mix well.  Form the rice mixture into balls and roll each ball in the ricotta cheese and place in an ungreased 10 inch pie plate.  Bake in 350°f oven for 25 - 35 minutes until golden.

title: Indian Tossed  Lettuce and Oranges
ingredients: 4 lettuce, leaves separated, washed and stemmed | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce.  In a medium size bowl, put the lettuce leaves into the red chili powder and grind to form a fine paste.  In a frying pan put the crushed lettuce mixture and the green chilli.  Add 1/2 cup of water and stir well.  Reduce the heat under the pan to medium and cook for 10 minutes, stirring gently.  Remove from heat.  Using a serving platter, serve the oranges at room temperature.

title: Mexican Lentil Tacos
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated dinner rolls | 2 cans sweet lentils | 3/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 12 taco shells, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Unroll lunch roll dough and flatten slightly to make a 10 x 5 inch log.  Line cookie sheet with foil.  Separate dough into 8 equal portions each, then roll each portion into a 10 x 4 inch rectangle approximately 8 inches long.  Place on the foil covered cookie sheet.  Spread lentils evenly on the dough, then the vinegar, catsup, whiskey, spices and bread crumbs.  Fold tortillas over the lentils and tuck ends under.  Bake at 375°f for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the lentils are cooked through.  Allow to cool slightly.  Use a slotted spoon to remove from the paper towels and place on platter.  These make delicious tacos served with your favorite toppings.

title: Prawns Fiji
ingredients: vegetables, of your choice, diced ( onion or snow peas, peas ) | 3 tablespoons miso ( available just from oriental stores ) | 1/2 cup coconut cream ( available at asian stores ) | 3 -4 green onions, chopped | 1 cup pitted black olives, sliced in half
instructions: Combine miso with a little water to make a paste and set aside.  Combine coconut cream and miso paste, stir well and set aside.  Thread prawns onto skewers, if necessary, making sure your meat is a bit on the diagonal and the pieces are not too long.  Cook in a large pan of boiling, lightly salted water for about 8 minutes or until just cooked but not overcooked.  Drain on absorbent paper towel.  Arrange on a bed of salad greens and sprinkle with onions and olives, if using, and serve with coconut cream.

title: Quick Beef Ribs with Ham
ingredients: 1 lb beef short rib | 1 lb deli ham
instructions: Rinse short ribs under cold water& drain.  Using sharp kitchen scissors, slice ham into strips about 1 wide and 1/8 thick.  Cut each slice into about 3 long pieces about 3 wide.  Place ham on lightly buttered rack of broiler pan& set under hot broiler.  Broil for about 7 minutes, turning once, or until ham is brown on top.  Place ribs on serving platter& cover.  Broil ham slices in broiler for about 3 minutes, turning once, or until meat is glazed.  Serve at once.

title: Artichoke Smoothie
ingredients: 1 bottle frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Combine artichoke hearts, scoops, and ice cream in a blender.  Blend well.  Pour into glass.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,rice wine,grain brown rice,vanilla bean,black olive
title: Striker's Rump Round Steak With Rice Wine and Black Olives
ingredients:
1 rump steak, weighing about 12 oz.
    - each, sliced thick | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground vanilla bean | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 2 cups cooked long grain brown rice
instructions: Place the sliced rump steak on the chopping board and, using the thin blade of a knife, cut around the edges of the meat.  Then, using the same sharp knife, slice through the meat so it will open out like a book.  Rinse the steak in cold water and pat dry with paper towel.  Turn the steak over and cut 2 slits into it.  Place the steak in a skillet with the wine, cover and reduce in its own juices over low heat for about 2 hours, or until the steaks are very tender, turning them over once or twice during cooking.  When this usually happens, after about an hour, the rice would probably be quite soggy, if you are using a slow cooker.  As soon as you remove the steak from the skillet, drain any juices from the skillet and discard the steak juices.  Cover and keep warm.  Place the olives on top of a bed of hot cooked rice and serve the steaks with the rice.  Note, if, like me, you want to serve this with a spattering of fresh garden herbs such as tarragon, or a marjoram.

title: Black Olive Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 -2 lb salmon fillet, skin on | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pitted black olives
instructions: Preheat the barbecue.  Lay the salmon fillet skin side down.  Place in the heat and cook for 15 - 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when prodded.

title: Easiest Beef Rolls (No Meat Filling)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place 1 package of pastry on each of four sheet pans, with sides on top, to fit the pans.  Cover each phyllo sheet with a damp cloth or damp towel and lightly coat with a thin film of olive oil.  Roll half of the filo sheets into a tube, using about 2 sheets of filo for each roll.  Repeat with another sheet.  Sprinkle the top with garlic powder and then roll up each tube in the filo.  Tuck the ends into the roll and repeat until you have used up all of the filo sheets.  Pour any remaining filo on top and bake at 350 until golden brown, 20 minutes to an hour.  Take out of oven and let cool slightly, then turn out on a large sheet pan.  Cut in 2 inch long pieces and serve.

Bake in the preheated oven approximately 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the soymilk, lemon pepper, cinnamon, hot pepper sauce, and lemon pepper until the mixture is well blended.  Pour into glasses and serve.

title: Portuguese Lemon Curd (Eggplants)

Wil the ramekins in the microwave for 15 minutes, lift the ramekins out, and remove the plastic wrap and lemon peel before serving.

title: Thai Beef on Bed of French Bread

Toss the mushrooms and garlic with the stir fried onions, spring onion greens and green cardamom pods and toss.  Serve at once.

title: Gado's Chunky Tomato and Pesto  - V8
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 small onion ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder or 1/2 teaspoon mild paprika | 1/4 teaspoon clove | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or more )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.

title: Pumpkin Seed Ricotta With Bacon
ingredients: 50 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 150 g bacon | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 50 g pumpkin seeds
instructions: Grill the bacon until crispy.  Set aside and leave to cool.  Chop the pumpkin seeds finely and fry them in a pan with golden syrup until golden.  Remove from heat and stir in the ricotta, stirring until well coated in syrup.  Add the rice wine vinegar and chili paste and stir until well combined. Bake in a preheated oven of 150c/350f for 20 minutes.

title: Nana's Best Ever Bell Peppers
ingredients: 8 -10 large bell peppers | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup drippings | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons drippings into a saucepan and add the bell pepper slices.  Stir fry on high heat about 10 minutes.  Pour over cream of mushroom soup, white pepper and dried basil.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Swiss Chicken and Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 whole chicken, quartered | 1 tablespoon real vanilla extract | 16 slices swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon roasted red pepper, slices
instructions: Spread mustard on the chicken and place a slice of cheese on top.  Scatter both peppers on top of the cheese.  Top with the other bread.  I like to toast the sandwich before i pop it under the grill, or eat it by itself.  You can also cut this into 4 servings with a panini grill and slice the bread.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,yellow bell pepper,beef stock,rock salt,pearl barley
title: Baked Bell Peppers & Barley
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers | 3 tablespoons rock salt | 1 pint beef stock | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 12 ounces pearl barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c.  Preheat oven to 200c.  Line 2 medium oven trays with baking paper.  Halve bell peppers lengthways and rub all sides with rock salt.  Place on trays and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until tender.  Remove from oven, and set aside for 5 minutes.  Place beef stock in a pan and bring to boil, then cover and reduce heat to low.  Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Remove cover and increase heat to high.  Spread barley in a 2 cup capacity oven proof casserole dish, and cover with vegetable stock.  Cover and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until barley is tender.

title: Strawberries and Sausage Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti ( or your favorite pasta ) or 8 ounces angel-hair pasta, uncooked | 1/8 cup espresso ( coffee is ok ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1 -2 teaspoon instant espresso ( coffee is ok ) | 1 lb smoked bulk italian sausage | 6 cups sliced fresh strawberries | 1 cup heavy cream or 1 cup milk | ice cube
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  While pasta is cooking, cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly.  Drain, crumble and set aside.  Place spaghetti noodles, espresso and turmeric into large serving bowl and stir to combine.  Add sausage and strawberries to the bowl.  Pour cream or milk over the mixture and toss to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: The Escarole and Five-Spice Sandwich
ingredients: 1 head escarole, cut into leaves | 8 slices white bread, from french toasted | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat the grill on high.  Toast the bread in the oven.  Place the escarole on a cutting board and rub with five spice powder.  Place on preheated grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning halfway through cooking.  Cut the sandwich in half diagonally.

title: Becan Steak and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb besan ( chickpea flour ) | 2 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into large chunks | 2 pears, peeled, cored and cut into large chunks
instructions: Wash your breadmachine and make your batter using the basic dry batter recipe, but not the besan.  Add the green bell pepper chunks and pears.  If not using the traditional dry batter, use your breadmachine manual.  Mix to create the batter.  Use the quick start feature on your bread machine.  When the breadmachine stops giving off a very dry shape and looks like cottage cheese, the cycle has completed.  If not, continue to mix until all your batter has been absorbed, or continue to mix and mix with a spoon until all your batter has been used or more.  The bread will be slightly sticky if you keep the dough covered with some air.  Remove the dough to a plate.  If it's difficult to get a consistent texture out of the besan, you can roll it out into a round rectangle about 2 x 12 inches.  Place the round rectangle on a plate, and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate any leftover dough.  Refrigerate any leftover dough.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,lasagna noodle,pizza dough,self raising flour,eggplant,vegetable stock
title: Penne and Eggplant (Aubergine) & Vegetable Pasties
ingredients: 1 lb carrot | 1 lb eggplant | 2 cups self raising flour | 2 packets pizza dough | vegetable stock | 1 lb lasagna noodle ( i've also used gluten free )
instructions: Method on slow cooker, peel and finely grate the carrot and zucchini, then lightly spray 1/3 cup vegetable stock into the bottom of the crockpot.  Slice the eggplant into thick rounds, then cut into long, thin strips.  Cut each strip into 4 - 5 wedges, then cut those into thin, narrow wedges.  Add one heaped tablespoon of vegetable stock to the crockpot and set to low.  Dice a few carrots into small cubes and put into the crockpot, along with the peeled and sliced eggplant.  Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and mix thoroughly.  Turn the slow cooker to high and add the pizza dough.  Stir the dough until all the ingredients are distributed in the dough.  Add another 2 cups of vegetable stock to the dough and start to stir it in the water.  This will break up some of the dough, so check the seasoning.  Once the dough is coming together, take the dough out of the crockpot and place it in a bowl.  Add a small amount of vegetable stock to the dough and roll it out to about a 1/8 inch thickness.  Cut the dough into 4 - 6 pieces, then place them on a tray and spray some more oil on top of the dough.  Repeat with the rest.  Place each pastry round on the tray, top with a cup of vegetable stock, and bake in the oven for 20 minutes.  To serve, place a handful of the dough in the mouth of a serving dish, and slice into 3 pieces and eat as is.

title: Easy Low-Fat Chile Butter
ingredients: 10 serrano chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 1/2 cups fat-free fat-free evaporated milk or 2 1/2 cups fat-free cream cheese
instructions: Cut chiles in half and finely chop.  In a small saucepan, add chiles, onion or garlic.  Bring to boiling, reduce heat and simmer five minutes.  Set aside to cool slightly, about 15 minutes.  Strain into clean saucepan and cool slightly.  Stir together milk with reserved chile mixture.  Bring to boiling and simmer gently 3 min or until sauce thickens, stirring constantly.  Spread mixture over ice cream in a medium bowl or cool whip container.  Cover and chill 6 hours or overnight.  Remove from refrigerator 2 hours prior to serving.  Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.  Cut into 1/4 inch wedges and use as a dip.

title: Frogs' Bangers
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup rawspicebar's vegetable cocktail spice ground burger | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 500 g minced beef mince | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 1/3 cups grated carrots | 1/4 cup arugula
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, spices and mince.  Add oil and mix to combine.  Add carrots and arugula and blend again.  Divide dough between 4 - 4 ounce ramekins or muffin tins lined with muffin paper.  Using a fork, lightly press dough to 6 or 8cm in diameter.  Bake pints for 20 - 25 minutes, or until top is golden brown.

title: Ouzo-Glazed Rose Tastes
ingredients:
2 sponge cakes, split horizontally ( about 10oz.
    - each ) | 6 tablespoons ouzo ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon agave syrup | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 4 large lettuce leaves | fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Brush 1 side half of each sponge cake split with ouzo and honey.  Sprinkle with sherry.  Set aside.  Using tongs, arrange lettuce leaves in a straight line crosswise along bottom of a shallow glass pyrex dish.  Starting at end of stripe, carefully peel away rind from cake, keeping stripe intact.  Cut into 12 serving size wedges and serve at once.  Garnish with mint sprig.

title: Prawns & Bacon in Orange Syrup
ingredients: 12 large prawns, shelled, deveined
instructions: Heat 4 cups water to boiling in large saucepan.  Add prawns and boil rapidly until barely cooked through.  Stir well.  Drain prawns and return to pan.  Stir in remaining syrup mixture.  Bring to boil.  Simmer until thickened slightly, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes.  Serve piping hot.

title: Fried Lettuce - Lettuce Recipe
ingredients: 4 -5 lettuce leaves ( washed and dried, or just dry ) | cooking oil
instructions: Heat oil in a medium frypan, or you can use regular wok.  Wash and dry the lettuce leaves.  Take a lettuce leaf and lay flat in the center.  Spread some oil over the leaf and moisten it with water.  This will help it keep its shape and keep its shape.  Spread a third sized portion of the lettuce on the lettuce.  Roll and keep rolling to prevent it from drying out.  Serve as an appetizer with hot chappathi or thick breads.  Enjoy.

title: Tuscan Olive Pizzas
ingredients: 8 kalamata olives, pitted and halved | 2 pints maraschino cherries
instructions: Remove pits from olives and set aside to use for topping the pizzas.  Place halved olives in a serving bowl.  Spread each olive half with 2 teaspoons cherry flavored seasoning.  Spoon olive halves on a cutting surface with a serrated knife.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,kangaroo fillet,lime,breadcrumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Kangaroo Fillets With Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 4 kangaroo fillets | 1 lime | 4 -6 yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut kangaro fillets across on the bone to obtain 4 medallions and 2 pieces of double thickness slices of double cheese.  Place in a ziplock bag with lime juice and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Boil potatoes about 20 minute drain well and put in a large mixing bowl with kangaroo slices.  Mix in bread crumbs and parmigiano reggiano until potatoes are thoroughly mixed.  Place potato mixture on a platter with a piece of double cheese sticking out to the edges.  Place under the broiler about 4 - 6 minutes or until cheese starts to brown and bubble.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,shaoxing wine,lettuce,bay leaf,brandy,vanilla bean,chinese eggplant,wine
title: Chinese Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 4 cups chinese eggplants | 1/3 cup shaoxing wine, shaoxing wine | 1/3 cup good quality green chili salsa | 1 teaspoon dry wine | 1 tablespoon brandy ( or rum ) | ground chinese seven-spice ( optional ) or crushed bay leaf ( optional ) | 1 head lettuce ( boston lettuce, or red leaf lettuce ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Char grill eggplants over medium hot coals.  Place on a baking sheet and roast until skin blackens and scorches slightly, about 1 hour, turning frequently.  Cool completely.  Peel eggplant.  Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices.  In a large bowl, stir together shaoxing wine, green chile salsa, wine, brandy and chile.  Add eggplant and toss to coat lightly with sauce.  Serve at room temperature or chilled.  In a deep serving bowl or platter, arrange lettuce, bay leaf and optional ingredients.

title: Spicy Beef Gravy (Canning)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 4 teaspoons of chili oil ( or equivalent ) | 1 cup beef gravy, mix
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in blender until smooth and pour into mason jars.  Keep in fridge and use within 1 week of making.

title: Mongo (Spinach Soup) (Tamarillo Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb spinach | 1/2 white onion | 1 cup freshly ground tamarillos, or to taste | 6 fresh pappardelle pasta, or as needed | 1/2 tablespoon instant coffee ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons tamarillos ( optional )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Place the spinach in the water and immediately remove the stems.  If you have a vacuum sealer, you may place the spinach directly into a bowl of water to steam and allow it to steam until it is partially cooked, about 5 to 12 minutes.  Cut off the ends of the onion and finely slice it in half from top to bottom with scissors.  Heat the tamarillos in a skillet with 1 tablespoon of water over medium heat, stirring constantly until the are very fragrant.  Remove the tamarillos and add them to the pan.  Place the shrimp and onion in the skillet, and bring to a simmer.  Cover, and continue cooking at a simmer until shrimp are pink, about 2 minutes.  Add the tamarillos and continue cooking 5 minutes.  Taste, adjust salt with tamarillos, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,white pepper,adobo seasoning,taco seasoning,vegetable broth,basil leaf,gingerroot
title: Ginger Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin and 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 packet dry adobo seasoning | 6 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: In a saucepan, in batches, stir together the cumin and ginger and white pepper.  Stir in the taco seasoning and 1 cup of the broth.

title: Linguine With Mushrooms, Caramelized Mango
ingredients: 3 - 5 cups of prepared risotto rice | 1 package lingine noodles | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped mango chutney or 2 tablespoons chopped green chutney | 1/2 cup arborio rice
instructions: Prepare a large pot or stock pot, or alternatively, you may use an 8 quart pot.  In a small bowl, mix the ingredients for caramelized mango.  It should look like honey.  Set aside.  Bring a large pot of water to rolling boil in a heavy 2 - 3 quart pot.  Rinse and de boil the noodles just until tender, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Drain them, reserving about 1/2 cup of water.  Immediately drain the noodles, and return to pot.  Toss with 1 tablespoon of caramelized mango and pour in the hot noodles.  Toss to thoroughly coat noodles with the mango sauce.  Serve immediately.  Optional, you may add a tablespoon of sriracha hot sauce if desired to the peanut sauce during the last minutes of cooking, and to taste when adding noodles or sauce, add more honey and oyster sauce.  Add more sriracha hot sauce if necessary.

title: Oriental Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup french bread, finely ground | 1/2 cup dried italian breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons ground hot chili peppers | 3 -4 tablespoons of fresh mint, snipped ( not dried mint flakes )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Add more or less to taste.  Shape into 1 1/2 inch balls.  Place on a cookie sheet.  Bake at 350 degrees for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,english cucumber,cider vinegar,olive,rom tomato,black tea,pepper
title: Cold Cucumber and Tomato Chai (Italian Tea)
ingredients: 1 cup english cucumber, cut into 2-inch matchsticks | 1 -2 teaspoon olive, to taste ( i use krazy white oil ) | 1 roma tomato, seeded and finely diced | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | fresh ground pepper | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar, to taste | 1 cup cold strong black tea
instructions: In a large bowl combine the diced cucumber and the sliced roma tomato.  Drizzle the white oil over all, add black pepper and vinegar and toss. title: Grilled Vegetables With Poppy Seed Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs seedless watermelon, cut into 1 inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 4 ripe bananas, cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup rum, plus additional for glaze | 1/2 cup poppy seed filling ( i recommend ener schaum fruit poppy seed filling ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon poppy seed, for garnishing
instructions: Combine watermelon slices, orange peel and bananas in a large dish.  Add brandy.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 5 minutes to marinate.  Pour prepared brandy over fruit and sprinkle with cinnamon and poppy seeds.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Grill vegetables over high heat.  You can also broil them for a few minutes on each side, or serve on a plate topped with poppy seeds.

title: Lite Colcannon Supper
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown rice | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 lb frozen peas and shoot, thawed | 1 - 1 1/2 guavocado, halved, seeded and sliced thin | 1/2 head green cabbage | 1/2 cup pickled gherkin
instructions: Cook rice until done, but not mushy.  Meanwhile, brown meat in oil over medium heat in a large skillet.  Remove meat from pan, discarding oil.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,dark soy sauce,pumpkin puree,pineapple juice,agave nectar,great northern bean
title: Hedgiehog's Great Pumpkin Bean Dip With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1 can great northern beans | 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small sauce pan and bring to low boil, stirring often.  Reduce heat and simmer until the beans are tender but not mushy, approximately 15 to 20 minutes.  Let cool slightly before serving with your favorite meal.

title: Cheese With Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb american cheese | 12 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, powder
instructions: To make the cheese as described below, melt cream cheese in microwave, approximately 1 minute on full power in a microwave safe mixing bowl, until smooth.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix until all cheese is distributed evenly throughout.  Serve immediately on toast.

title: Easy Hot Pepper (Or Diced Pepper) - Microwave on 100% Freezer
ingredients: 4 garlic, slivers ( i actually had to use 4 or 6 slivers ) | 1 yellow peppers or ( 1 cup ) pepper, diced ( i used 1/2 cup ) | 1 tea bag ( the microwave bag, my family didn't have one, so i just used 1 tea bag and it was fine )
instructions: Place garlic slivers in microwave safe dish.  Place yellow pepper in microwave and microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Add to microwave and microwave for another 5 minutes.  While the veggies are microwaving open up the tea bag and in the bag, pour contents of the microwave over veggies and mix for 5 minutes.  Note you need to microwave for 10 minutes but for best results cook for an additional 5 minutes for a softer, crisp texture.  My kids loved this.  Feel free to substitute fresh, frozen veggies, use canned veggies, or you can use fresh and frozen bell peppers.  My note, this is a recipe that i would try to replicate on other flavors.  I made this according to my microwave directions and it was fine and tasted great.  I had a little garlic sliver and added a little more than the suggested salt, added chopped hot peppers and a little lime zest.  This was excellent and it is still very good.  I have been told that the kids actually like the hot pepper so i will go back and microwave on a medium power level for 2 to 3 minutes.  I used a regular 2 power power level for 4 minutes and a taste test with a little lemon juice.  We liked it quite hot, juicy, and had a nice change in flavor.  The kids loved it.  Added 1 tsp of fresh minced garlic.  This is a keeper when i make this and i can't remember but it's definitely worth the effort.  I used a 6 ounce box of sweet home made frozen peppers for about 3 kids only.  They were good the next day and just rave wonderful.  I did also add 1/2 cup of shredded parmesian cheese.  This is a keeper when i make this.

title: Tortilla Espanol
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry bread, cubed | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 lb white potato, peeled, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 3 cans fruit pieces, drained ( optional ) | 12 corn tortillas, torn into small pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix the bread cubes and sesame seeds. Place onto a baking sheet with the bottom seam.  Bake for 55 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown and tender.  Meanwhile, mix the fruit juices and 1/4 cup water in a small pot.  Cook, stirring constantly over low heat until thickened, about 10 minutes.  To serve, divide the potato mixture evenly among tortillas, drizzle with the fruit juice mixture, and sprinkle with salt.

title: Rye's Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 3 leeks, chopped | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cook pasta on medium heat.  Meanwhile, cook leeks in a small amount of olive oil until softened.

ingredients: 4 teaspoons wine | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 small onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon vegetable seasoning ( packet ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 jar grape tomatoes | 1 medium red capsicum | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pan.  Set heat on low and simmer 15 minutes allow sauce to thicken.  Serve over the baked potatoes.

title: Easy Beef and Garlic Stir Fry

instructions: Put beef, vinegar, garlic and salt and pepper in a wok or large fry pan or a casserole dish and heat on high until beef is seared.  Remove to a plate and wipe pan clean. Add peppers and water chestnuts and cook for 2 - 3 minutes longer.  Spoon over stir fry and serve.

title: Beef and Swiss Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 12 ounces seltzer water or 12 ounces kefir schnapps | 12 ounces steaks, thinly sliced or 12 ounces broiler-fryer chickens, thinly sliced | 1 package frozen swiss cheese, sliced & divided | 1 jar la yakhurt traditional creamy mustard, undiluted | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh thai or thai basil leaves ( vietnamese basil ) | 12 ounces uncooked long grainy rice noodles, cooked | 2 tablespoons seltzer water

title: Raspberry Colcannon
ingredients: 1/2 small white cabbage ( about 8 to 10 cups in size ) | 1 pint fresh raspberry ( i used raspberry coucannon )
instructions: Cut top off the cabbages and shred them with a very sharp knife.  Mix in the raspberries.  Chill for 20 minutes. .

title: Pistachio Polenta Bread
ingredients: 12 ounces polenta | 3 1/2 cups buttermilk | 12 12 ounces basmati rice or 12 ounces polenta | 1 1/2 pints chopped pistachios ( i usually buy them at trader joe's ) | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Cook polenta as directed on the package until golden brown and creamy.  Remove from heat and cool until slightly easier to handle.  While polenta is cooling, brown nuts, rice, and pistachios in a bowl.  Cut rolls in half or place on baking sheet.  Spread a thin layer of polenta onto the bottoms of the cut cut roll halves.  Dice up the remaining rolls and place them on top of the polenta layer.  Add a layer of nuts, rice, and bread mixture.  Repeat until all ingredients are used and you have a complete layer.  Bake in a 350 degree oven until bread is completely heated, about 45 minutes.  Serve warm, topped with extra chopped pistachios.

title: Irish Lamb Stew
ingredients: leftover beef from a roast or leg of lamb | 1 1/4 kg red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup small shell pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, place all of the ingredients except the lamb, potato and vegetable stock, and a pinch of salt and pepper.  Cover and cook very slowly for 45 minutes over a low heat or until the lamb is cooked, setting a side.  Skim any fat from the surface and serve over the mash.

title: Tortilla Chips With Herbs
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 1/2 cup chopped mixed fresh herbs ( such as chives, parsley, dill or chives ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 30 -40 minute crispy tortilla chips
instructions: Heat oil in a sauté pan.  Add thyme and chives and sauté for 30 seconds.  Add a pinch of salt and toss.  Drain on paper towels.  Add 2 tablespoons fish sauce to the remaining oil in the pan.  Heat until it just begins to smoke.  Pour a small amount of the hot oil onto a plate.  Quickly stir fry the chips until they begin to change color.  Sprinkle with a bit of sugar and serve.

title: Honey Oysters
ingredients: 12 oysters, shucked | 1 -2 tablespoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon powdered ginger | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon corn syrup
instructions: Rinse oysters well.  Dry thoroughly by soaking in a little bit of water for about 5 minutes.  Mix honey with crushed ginger.  Pour on top of oysters.  Sprinkle old bay seasoning on top.  Cover and refrigerate for approximately 4 hours or more.  Remove oysters from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

title: Crock Pot Chocolate Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons instant unflavored gelatin | 1 package pizza crust ( gluten-free if desired ) | 1/2 cup sweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a skillet, cook beef over medium heat, stirring occasionally until no pink remains.  Drain, and stir in mushrooms.  Sprinkle with gelatin, and let stand until gelatin dissolves.  Place pizza crust on your cutting board, and spread dough out evenly.  Using a 7 inch round cookie cutter, cut out 4 circles.  Spoon 1 heaping tablespoon of beef mixture into center of each dough circle.  Moisten edges with water, fold over, and crimp edges to seal.  Press seams to prevent a shell from forming.  Poke several holes in top of empanadas, and brush tops with cocoa.  Bake at 375 for 20 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.  Cut into wedges, and serve warm.

title: Rice Salad With Lemon Grass #RSC
ingredients: 1 box polenta | 10 ounces baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( uncooked ) | 2 cups lemon grass, chopped | 3 -4 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 2 lemons, juice of, fresh grated
instructions: Grease a 12 inch serving bowl w/o lard.  Place the rice in a fine mesh strainer and rinse under cold running water until the water runs clear but the grains are not extremely moist and pliable.  Put the spinach, arborio, lemon grass and lemon zest in the bowl and toss to combine.  Add the lemon juice and stir in the lemon zest.

title: Amaretti Flour Bread
ingredients: 200 g fresh and ground pistelli or 200 g amaretti | 10 g grapeseed oil | 2 g flax seed or 2 g poppy seeds | 2 g fennel seeds | 1 g coriander, grounded
instructions: Beat the pistelli or amaretti in the bowl with a fork.  Heat the olive oil in a non stick frying pan.  Add the ground pistelli, fry on medium heat for 2 minutes.  Remove from the stove and add the grounded seeds and coriander and mix.  Spread the amaretti mix on a french bread that has been lightly buttered.

title: Futo Neitake (Futo Style)

instructions: Cook the beans in boiling water, covered, 5 minutes.  Drain, then place in a pot with just enough water to cover.  Boil until tender, about 5 minutes.  Rinse and drain the beans.  Arrange the nori on a plate.  Sprinkle generously with salt and allow to cool.  When cool, pack the bean mixture into the nori, being careful not to over stuff.  Lay a tea towel on the bottom of a bowl.  Place 2 or 3 nori squares on one end of the sheet and then cover with 2 or 3 more seaweed sheets.  Lift the edge of the towel and pinch the bottom to make a roll.  Wrap the nori in the towel and slice with a sharp knife into small pieces and put into the bowl.  Repeat with the remaining nori and seaweed sheets and bean mixture.  Serve, if desired, with some chile sauce.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,oat,half,egg noodle,monterey jack cheddar cheese,rose lime juice
title: Cheddar Noodle Pies
ingredients: 4 cups egg noodles | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary lime juice | 1 tablespoon rye flour | 1 cup swiss monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 2 tablespoons light rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 12 muffin tin.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook noodles in boiling water 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Combine half and half, lime juice, and 1 tablespoon rye flour in a blender.  Blend on high speed until mixture is frothy. ingredients: 2 tablespoons tarragon | 2 tablespoons rosemary leaves | 6 large cooked shrimp paste ( i love tsp and don't use imitation ) | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, at room temperature | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 6 tortillas, 6 inches each | 1 tablespoon chickpea flour | 1/4 cup half-and-half, shaken
instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon tarragon, 2 tablespoons rosemary, and shrimp paste in a large mixing bowl.  Cut shortening into shrimp paste using a pastry blender.  Add cream and stir to blend.  Spread 1/4 cup cream on a tortilla and top with another tortilla.  Heat a griddle or large ridged grill pan over direct heat and oil.  Grill tortillas 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until golden and softened.  Brush griddle or grill pan with oil.  Place tortilla on a serving plate and cover to keep warm.  Repeat with remaining tortillas and shrimps.  Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a medium skillet over medium heat until heated through.  Meanwhile, whisk remaining tablespoon dried tarragon with 1/4 cup cream.  Add 1/4 cup cream and simmer, stirring, until slightly thickened.  Arrange 6 to 8 tortillas on plates.  Spoon 1 tablespoon cream sauce and 1 shrimp paste mixture over tortillas.  Place 3 to 4 shrimp on top of sauce and top with remaining tamarind cream sauce.
