instructions: In crock pot sprayed with pam, place chicken thighs.  Top with corn, kielbasa, pudding mix and pesto.  Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or until chicken is tender.  Remove from crock pot and allow to stand for 5 minutes, before slicing.  Stir sliced sausage into juices in crock pot.  Remove from crock pot and add to pork, sausage and chicken juices.  Stir until combined.  If desired, top with more sauce.  Note, if you are not terribly fond of kielbasa, you may substitute 1 cup of julienned cooked ham, or 1 cup of bacon pieces.

title: Easy Mushroom Catsup
ingredients: 5 cups sliced white mushrooms | 1/4 cup sour cream ( no subs! ) | 1 teaspoon dry white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green chili ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Chill.

title: Nuoc Mamuang (Peanut Soup)
ingredients: 8 ounces roasted peanuts | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 lime
instructions: Heat a pan on its lowest setting.  If one pan is hot enough, the peanuts might crackle a little, so just stir it when its ready.  Break up the peanuts with a mortar and pestle, and throw away any stones or burned or unpeeled bits.  Set this aside.  If you're really energetic and have energy to spare, put all other ingredients in another pan, and heat over medium heat to reduce.  Peanut soup is done when a knife inserted into a chunky paste comes out clean.  Pour peanut soup into sterilized glass bowls and top with peanuts.  Squeeze lime juice over the top, and use the knife to swirl the soup in the chunky bits around the bottom of the bowl.  These are a bit attractive, and are great for dunking into your own nudy things.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,white miso,pecorino romano cheese,anchovy fillet,cayenne pepper
title: White Miso
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white miso | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovy fillet, drained | 1 small rosemary
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the miso, cayenne, and romano.  Pour the miso mixture into a shaker with a lid.

title: Almond Tuna Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces soft fresh tuna in olive oil | 1 leek, white and light green part only, sliced thinly | 3 -4 medium almonds, shelled | 1 piece orange peel | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients except poppy seeds and almonds together with fingers.  Refrigerate 2 hrs or overnight to allow flavours to blend.  Stir and sprinkle pungent poppy seeds on top.  Serve with crackers and a cold beer or ale.

title: Spice Coloured Chiles on Toast
ingredients: 2 cups store bought spice cake spice, finely chopped | 1 cup molasses | 1 can green chilies, chopped, with seeds, chopped | 1 dozen dessert ice cream, softened in ice cream | food coloring
instructions: Spread spice onto two halves of a baking sheet.  Let them sit out at room temperature for 15 min.  Sprinkle sugar, stir well.  Chop chilli tops finely.  Spread a few chile halves on each one.  Pour the molasses in the center of the chile halves.  Wrap chile halves loosely in the muslin.  Refrigerate over night or 2 days, until the next day.  Slice off and discard the stem and seeds of the frozen chillies.  Scoop out the flesh carefully, and put the chillies aside.  In a large bowl with a rubber spatula, scrape the vanilla sugar and spice mix into the sugar.  Add the chillies and mix well.  Cover, leave overnight.  When ready to serve, place the ice cream in an ovenproof bowl, and microwave for 1 min. , stirring every 30 seconds.  Check it after 4 mins, and if it is starting to brown, microwave for a further minutes.  Spread a thin layer with a little molasses on the toast and allow to rest a few minutes before serving.  This should make a pretty garnish.

title: New England Clam Chowder

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.  Let sit for a few hours to allow flavors to blend.  Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Chef John's Italian Wedding Cakes

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.

title: Frozen Cream and Adobo Sauce for Beef (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 3 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Whip the cream with adobo & sugar until soft peaks form.

instructions: Place sundried tomatoes and chilli in a roasting tin.  Combine all ingredients in a blender, and process until smooth.  Pour the tomato mixture over the sun dried tomatoes in the tin and close the tin. .  Cook in a preheated oven on 150 degc/fan 140 degc/gas 3 for 30 to 45 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and stand for 10 minutes before slicing into serving sized pieces.  Serve sliced with yoghurt or yoghurt yogurt, and pickled garlic.

title: Yogurt Substitute
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt, regular grind | 1 poblano chile, roasted peeled seeded removed seeded and chopped
instructions: Mix yoghurt, roasted chiles, and hot pepper paste ingredients together until smooth.  This recipe makes about 2 cups.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a small skillet, toast cumin seeds over medium heat, stirring constantly for 1 minute or until they start to smoke. Bake in oven 10 minutes, or until top is golden.

title: Chocolate Cheeze

In a medium mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, egg yolks, cocoa and ground red pepper.  Mix well.  Pour into greased 9x13 inch cake pan.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

title: Kobees Spice Mix for Dogs!

Remove foil and stir in garlic and 1 teaspoon pepper.  Serve beans and guinness in heated sterilized jars.

instructions: In a skillet, toast almonds in a single layer in hot oven until lightly browned.  Place in a bowl and set aside. title: Easy & Simple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon lemon juice or 1 teaspoon lime juice, freshly squeezed | 1 teaspoon light yellow mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the mustard seeds, lemon or lime juice, light yellow mustard seeds and garlic powder.  Using an electric coffee grinder or blender, grind the mixture into a coarse paste.  Serve immediately or cover with a plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to a month.

title: Green Chilies With pork,  Shrimp, and Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cans green chilies, chopped, drained | 1 teaspoon mirin | 4 ounces low-fat yogurt | 2 lbs pork tenderloins
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chilies, mirin, and yogurt.  Cut tenderloins crosswise in 1/2 inch thick slices.  Arrange on a platter.  Spoon the chile mixture on top.  Serve.

title: Crunchy Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1 cup snow peas ( ends trimmed ) | 1 cup water | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat the grill or a nonstick pan, and leave the vegetables to dry out.  Combine the peanut butter and water in a bowl, add the lettuce.  Toss well so that everything gets coated in the peanut butter and water mixture.  Gently fold in the green leaves.  Serve with chinese vegetable sticks.

title: Asparagus and Raspberry With Red Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 4 fresh asparagus spears | 1/2 cup red raspberry | 1 teaspoon sweet pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange liqueur
instructions: Cut asparagus spears into 2 inch lengths.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add asparagus and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until tender.  Add raspberries and heat for 1 to 2 minutes until hot and beginning to release their juices.  Divide asparagus among 4 plates.  Sprinkle with sweet and freshly ground pepper sauce.

title: Hummus with Meatballs & Veggies!
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 500 g potatoes ( small tin-halved ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup hummus | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | freshly chopped celery leaves, for garnish | grated gravish, for garnish
instructions: Crumble the hamburger in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper.  Remove any excess fat from the meat and add the potato.  Cover and refrigerate over night.  Preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade.  Line a baking tray with baking parchment.  Bake the meatballs, in batches, for about 50 minutes.  Allow to stand for a few minutes before turning them over.  Once cooked, remove from the oven and place them on a rack to cool and dry off.  Remove the meatballs from the baking tray and set aside.  Reserve the grease in the pan, if any.  Return the pan to the heat and add the molasses.  Stir and bring to the boil, stirring to combine.  Reduce the heat and simmer slowly until the liquid thickens slightly and starts to separate.  Meanwhile, wash and rinse the vegetables.  Slice them into wedges and place in a large glass bowl.  Add the reserved grease, the hummus and vanilla essence and stir gently to combine.  Spoon the liquid mixture into the meatballs and smooth out the surface.  If you prefer a more cake like texture, roll the meatballs in flour or cornflour and chill in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight if time permits, refrigerate for up to 5 days.  To serve, garnish with finely chopped celery leaves, grated graviera and serve hot with pita bread.

title: Namibian Spice Mix for Fish
ingredients: 1 can cornbread mix | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 4 -5 tablespoons toasted sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Mix ground ginger and paprika in a small bowl.  Mix the cornbread mix with taco seasoning.  Pour into two greased or non stick baking glasses.  Sprinkle the toasted almonds onto the topping.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until brown and bubbly.

title: Soyster Sauce Straw Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb fresh vegetables ( snap or corn ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 medium serrano chili, cut into 1-inch strips | 2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet on low heat for about 30 seconds.  Add all the ingredients and stir fry them about 3 minutes.  Taste them and add more sweetener if you desire.  You can leave the vegetables whole, leave whole, or slice in half.  Serve immediately.

title: Orange Chocolate Crunch Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 package chocolate cake mix | 5 large russet potatoes, peeled | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup orange juice | ice
instructions: Place potatoes in large pot of water with orange juice and bring to boil.  Cook until tender.  Drain and mash potatoes with fork or ricer.  Reserve.  Coat a 10 pie pan with cooking spray.  Combine potato mixture and egg with fork and mix well using fork to spread over bottom and up sides of pan.  Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minute.  Place ice on top of crust in last 5 minutes and bake for another 7 - 10 minutes or until the crust is a golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mint,corn oil,apricot,active yeast,yellow bell pepper,custard powder,white creme de cacao
title: Apricot Chocolate Mint Fondue
ingredients: 8 1/2 - 10 cups apricots, fresh | 8 1/2 ounces white creme de cacao, chilled | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons custard powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 teaspoons corn oil | fresh mint ( optional, to garnish )
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil to just below medium heat.  Sprinkle the yeast over the water and let proof for a few minutes.  Place the apricots into a food processor and process until they reach the consistency of course peanut butter.  In a large bowl, mix the cacao, celery oil and 1/4 cup of the mint.  With the food processor running, add the remaining olive oil and mint into the chocolate until the mixture resembles chocolate milk.  Add the mixture into the food processor bowl with the dry yeast, then process until the fondue is as smooth or as chunky as you want it to be.  Transfer the dough to a 2 lb loaf pan and cover with plastic wrap.  Set in a warm spot to double in bulk.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead.  The dough should be fairly soft and sticky but will be smooth and glossy.  Wrap the dough and let it rise 1 1/2 2 hours, or until it has doubled in bulk.  On a well floured surface, punch down the dough and divide into 12 equal pieces.  Working with one piece at a time, place it on a lightly floured board and divide the dough into 12 portions.  Form each piece into a ball and place it into a well oiled 9 inch saucer.  Repeat with the other ball of dough.  Transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and let rise in warm spot until it has doubled in bulk.  Bake the chocolate filled loaves at 400 deg fahrenheit for 15 - 20 minutes, or until they are golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: wasabi,sultana raisin,turkey sausage,vegetable,plain flour,tomato green chile pepper
title: Scotch Sausage and Sausages in Sesame Seed
ingredients: 5 ounces turkey sausage | 5 ounces plain flour | 2 tablespoons sultana raisins with asian spices | 5 tablespoons sesame seeds | 10 ounces mixed vegetables, such as peas, carrots, corn and green beans | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instructions: Mix the wasabi powder into 1 tablespoon of water and set aside.  Slice the sausage links lengthways into two or three pieces, then make sure they are about the same size or smaller you would like, and press into the wasabi paste until the meat resembles chunky pate.  Place the flour onto a board and knead on a lightly floured surface until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs, then gently knead in the sultanas and raisins.  Place the mixture into a large, clean bowl and add the sausage.  Pour enough boiling water into the bowl to leave about 1/2 inch of water clinging to the bowl.  Cover and leave in the fridge overnight.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Remove the sausage from the bowl and pat into shape.  Place the sausages in an ovenproof dish and cover with water.  Cover with a piece of foil and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.  Remove the foil and continue to bake the sausages until cooked through and browned, adding more boiling water if necessary.  To make the sesame seeds, place sesame seeds in a small heavy based pan over a low heat, cover with just enough boiling water to cover.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes to dry.  Remove from the heat and leave to cool.  To serve, transfer sausages to plates, top with tomato scotch and seeds.

ingredients:

instructions: Combine the meats & mashed potatoes.  To make your sauce, place the salmon fillet in a small saucepan with lots of cold water. title: Chilli Parsnips

Cut chile pepper into thin rings and slice into thin slices.  Mix parsnips, chile, and lemon peel in a colander.  Add about half a teaspoon of the mixture and toss to coat well. instructions: Remove stems from spinach, then finely grate them onto a towel.  Wash and dry meat, then sprinkle with yeast. Using a slotted spoon, remove meat from pan and keep warm.  Keep pan over medium heat.  Heat 1 tablespoon of reserved oil, then stir in radishes and spinach.

title: Quick Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 3 -5 medium tomatoes, cut in half | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Heat oil in a frying or bbq over medium high heat.  Slice each tomato half about 1/2 inch thick and place into the oil.  Do not overcook or they will discolor. This recipe also works well with left over roast beef or pork.  The tomato taste will continue to intensify as they cool, but this will not continue long after refrigerated.  Variation, you can also use canned tomatoes, but tomatoes should not have any added salt.

title: Pear and Endive Toast(Zwt-8)

instructions: Toast under broiler for 5 minutes until slightly browned.  Turn and broil until lightly browned on all sides.  To serve place 4 slices of toast on plate and place 1 pear on top of the toast.  Cut endives into 4 pieces crosswise and arrange on top.  Serve at once.

instructions: Place lentils, pork or lamb and chocolate in a large saucepan, cover with water.

Place the pork chops on top of the cheese and press together. title: Chipotle Adobo (Adobo Mix)

instructions: Place fennel bulb on a microwave safe platter.  Microwave tomatoes in 1 cup boiling water at 50% power 1 minute.  Allow to cool, then strain tomatoes.  Place fennel on several large serving dishes, and drizzle with tomato juice.

title: How to Make a Perfect Orange Salt for Salmon
ingredients: 1 orange | sea salt
instructions: Peeled the orange and cut off the white pith using a sharp knife.  Carefully remove the peel with your finger.  Cut all of the pith into thin pieces about 1 and 1/2 cm wide. If at this time you need to make up the oranges and store them in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.  When it's time to eat, prepare your fish from scratch and then refrigerate them for at least 2 hours or upto 2 days.  Bring to room temperature prior to serving the orange salt. title: Whole Wheat Pancake

ingredients: 1 ripe avocado, peeled and pitted | 1/4 cup frozen peas, thawed in the microwave and covered | 1 - 1 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 -3 cardamom pods

Peel off the rind by cutting around the edge with a small sharp knife and twisting it away from you.  Cut avocado in half and scoop out the soft flesh.  Place the scooped out avocado pulp into a bowl, add peas and mix well.  Add puree and cardamom pods and stir.  Garnish with whole cardamom pods before serving.  Served with toasted pita chips.

title: Easy Low Fat Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 small chipotle chile, minced ( chipotle brand works nice ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small pan.  Heat over medium to medium low heat until cheese is melted.  Let cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Beef Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup garbanzo beans | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 lb ground beef round or 1 lb ground chuck | 1 orange, juiced | 6 ounces dark brown sugar | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, grated | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup brown butter | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place the beans, peanut butter, beef, 1 orange, 5oz of the brown sugar, and the cheese in the bowl of a food processor.  Puree until smooth. Place in a bowl with the remaining ingredients.  Mix together with fork or whisk until well blended.  Serve meat loaf on top of the sauce and garnish with a dollop of the whipped cream if you wish.

instructions: Put chicken breast between layers of paper towel in a bowl and place in fridge for 30 - 90 minutes to moisten a little of the skin.  Combine the lemons with the juice and spread out in a dish.  Set aside.  Separate 4 - 5 ladyfingers from the package and dip into lemon juice then the lemon or lime solution. title: Cod for Two (British Version)
ingredients: 2 lbs cod ( boneless skinless ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon margarine ( or butter )
instructions: Soak 8 or 10 fresh flat-leaf hardshell crackers on the cob or paper towel for 2 hours.  Bake cod in 400 degree oven for 5 minutes. title: Apple Crumble

instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c.  Put apples into a large bowl.  Sprinkle with salt and toss.  Sprinkle with the cornflour and mix.  Place in a large oven proof casserole dish, bake for 30 minutes.

title: Brazilian Spiced Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 4 banana peppers, roasted, skinned and chopped | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated horseradish | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: In a food processor, combine the peppers, coconut milk, horseradish, and rosemary.  Process until well blended, then process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,corn chip,olive,basil leaf,vanilla extract,tomato paste
title: Tamarind Sauce

instructions: Drain tamarind and tamarind water through a strainer lined with cheesecloth into a bowl. Process tamarind pulp through a strainer lined with cheesecloth into a bowl, and set aside to cool slightly.  Stir tomato paste, basil leaves, and tomato paste into tamarind water.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Lightly oil a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole dish.  Combine rice, pepper cheese and 1/3 cup shredded cheese in a bowl and toss to mix. instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor.  Process until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Turn onto greased oven tray.  Spray with cooking oil.  Bake at 180°c for 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Mushroom With Vegetables

instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Line a shallow ovenproof dish with foil and spoon in the cream.  Mix together the ginger, garam masala and cream. title: Chef Jean's Pure Parmesan

instructions: Stir together the cheese and cumin powder in a large bowl.  Toss the parmigiano with the cheese mixture.  Note, this can be stored in the refrigerator up to two weeks.

title: Italian Sausage and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausages | 2 packages fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat.  While sausage is cooking, cut sausages in half lengthwise. Place sausage halves, fat side up, in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with 1 1/2 inch sides.  Sprinkle pepared bacon over sausage. Stir gently and sprinkle top with parsley flakes.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef and Beans

instructions: Brown meat in butter beans.  Add thyme, carrots, zucchini, and browned meat.  Cook 2 hours on high in a covered roaster.  Turn meat over during cooking time.  Strain vegetables from meat liquid into a saucepan.  Discard solids.  Reheat saucepan over moderately low heat for 2 minutes.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Brown Sugar in Twists (Paistoles De Laranjas)

instructions: Combine sugar, saffron, and baking soda in a small heavy nonaluminum roasting pan. title: Cornflake Crumbs (Doughnuts for Passover)

instructions: In a plastic bag, combine the crumbs, orange peel and a pinch of salt.  Shake, and then transfer this to a bowl. title: Egg Noodles With Red Chile and Chile

instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water for about 4 minutes or according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  Beat the eggs and chiles together.  Toss with the noodles.  Toss well to coat and serve.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350f.  Cook noodles as directed on package.  Place bacon and biscuits into a greased 2 qt dish.  Top with 1 cup noodles.  Bake covered 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake about 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Place chicken broth in a stock pot and bring to a boil.  Add drained and washed spinach, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.  When liquid has been absorbed, add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Thai Basil Paste

instructions: Combine all ingredients and pulse until well blended.

instructions: Place thawed noodles in saucepan, cover with hot water and bring to simmering point.  Cover and cook 2 - 3 minutes, until noodles are tender but not mushy.  Drain.  Cool slightly. Brush pastry sheets with beaten egg and sprinkle with cream of tartar.  Cut a 12 x 8 inch strip off the top corner of each phyllo sheet, and arrange 3 or 4 noodles in the center of one sheet, lightly overlapping each other.  Take the bottom half of the phyllo pastry sheet and arrange it on top of the noodles, overlapping with the back of spoon and placing it in the center of the pastry.  Lift top edge of phyllo pastry sheet and brush with beaten egg.  Spread filling on phyllo pastry top and sides with a knife.  Fold top half of phyllo pastry over the filling so the pastry is firmly packed along and away from the sides.  You should end up with a layered layered phyllo pastry which will fit as you pull the pastry out of the package.  Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Cut a little diagonal slither along the edge of the phyllo pastry to make it straight toward your first sheet.  Place phyllo on cookie sheet, brushing each with beaten egg just before beginning to layer.  Fold up the bottom half of the phyllo pastry over the filling towards the right side of the phyllo pastry sheet.  Continue folding and brushing phyllo pastry towards the right in the same manner.  Take the top 1/4 inch of phyllo pastry and place on top of phyllo pastry and brush with beaten egg.  Fold over the bottom half of phyllo pastry and brush with beaten egg and smooth with a spatula.  Fold the right third of the phyllo pastry over the filling, brushing with beaten egg now and then and making sure that the phyllo pastry is covered inside tightly with a good amount of filling.  Wrap each phyllo pastry packet in a double thickness of foil, then loosely wrap in foil and place on cookie sheet with its seam on the bottom.  Repeat wrapping and folding two more times.  With a vegetable brush, spread thawed noodles evenly over phyllo pastry.  Brush top of pastry with beaten egg.  Slit 2 toothpicks into the top of each pastry packet, to allow steam to escape. When cooled, break into pieces approximately 2 1/2 x 2 1/2 inches and store at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken and Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 4 -6 lbs ladyfingers | 1 bag dark corn syrup | 12 ounces chicken wings
instructions: Lay the flank steak and ladyfingers down in a large zip loc bag.  Spread the corn syrup over the ladyfingers.  Wrap a double layer of heavy duty foil around the entire meat. With a very sharp knife held steady, slice across the grain on the diagonal.  The meat should be partially thin.  Once all slices are sliced, lay out on a cutting board and cut into strips.  Repeat until all of the strips are sliced.  Arrange the slices on the rack of a jelly roll pan or tray.  Repeat until all pieces are all cut into strips.  Pour the hot steaks over the jelly roll pan or tray.  Use a fork to poke holes all over the meat.  Sprinkle with the dark corn syrup.  Allow to sit for 5 to 10 minutes to allow the syrup to soak in.  Arrange the meat strips on a wire rack or tray.  Arrange the chicken wings over the meat and brush with the dark corn syrup.  Return to refrigerator for 3 to 5 hours or until the meat is extremely tender.  Allow to sit for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tikkafteri

instructions: Pour oil into a heavy 12 skillet and heat it over medium heat, to medium heat.  Pour in the clarified butter, black cardamom pods, and the kefalograviera cheese.

title: Pizza Crust

title: Foolproof Polish Sausage

title: Red Milk

instructions: Pour the milk into a pan and place on medium high heat for a few minutes or until it starts boiling rapidly but is still very small bubbles. Stir frequently until the color is reduced to a deep, pale yellow and foamy.

Using your hands, coat the broccoli with the flour mixture.  Place two or three cubes of the cheese in the broccoli and fold, coating the broccoli evenly.

title: Sicilian Nestlés With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 bunches mesclun | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa, sifted
instructions: Combine mesclun, tomatoes and cocoa in a bowl and stir gently.  Let stand for 20 minutes to let flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,horseradish,pizza crust,ketjap manis,thai basil
title: Sweet Thai Basil Pizza (Yum-Yum)
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated pizza crust | 3 tablespoons ketchup or 3 tablespoons sweet soy sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon fresh grated horseradish | 1 sprig fresh thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly grease a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Unroll each pizza crust on a work surface and roll into a 13 inch circle.  Spread all of the ketchup on the dough, then top with horseradish and a sprinkling of grated horseradish.  Sprinkle the top with basil.  Fold the crust over and seal edges with a fork.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake in the preheated oven for 12 - 14 minutes, or until well browned.  Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Garlicky Bean Goulash
ingredients: 1 bag baby carrots | 1 can kidney beans or ( 15 ounce ) can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cut carrots into fourths or larger pieces and add to pot.  Cook over medium heat stirring often for 15 - 20 minutes or until carrots are soft.  Transfer to bowl.  Mash beans with fork or potato masher.  Top with carrot pieces and serve.  Variate, add in 1 t.  Dijon mustard or 1 1/2 t.  Flour tortilla chips for added protein.  Yumm.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,sharp cheddar cheese,baby carrot,kaffir lime leaf,beef stock
title: Cheddar and Kaffir Crumble
ingredients: 900 g baby carrots | 2 tablespoons shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 cups beef stock | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Cut a cross in the base of each carrot and roll each carrot into a ball with a rolling pin to flatten.  Cook carrots in boiling water for 6 minutes and drain.  Sprinkle carrots with cheese and bake on a baking paper lined oven tray for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.  Combine flour and stock in a small pan and heat until boiling.  Add kaffir leaves.  Remove pan from heat and pour mixture over carrots and return to oven for 30 minutes or until golden.  Serve.  Great on it's own as they disappear.  I used this also with steamed broccoli.

title: Easy Yoghurt-Yogurt Dessert - Middle Eastern
ingredients: 600 ml greek yogurt or 600 ml natural yoghurt | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1 mango, peeled and grated ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate for an hour, or for up to two hours.  Stir well before serving in small glasses.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,jalapeno,cumin,guinness stout,lime juice zest,parmesan cheese
title: Guinness Marinade for Pork, Chicken, Seafood and Game
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime juice or 1/4 cup orange juice, the fresh lime is better | 1/4 cup unsalted dried guinness stout | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh jalapenos, i keep a small jar of them ( i used bottled ones you can find in the liquor section of the grocery store ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk in the parmesan.  Let sit at least an hour, but as long as the meat in your marinade it marinates.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,cream chicken soup,watermelon,rice vinegar,poblano chile,lower chicken stock,chipotle chile,olive
title: Mexican Pot of Gold Soup With Melon, Garlic, Garlic
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped poblano chile | 1 cup watermelon, flesh on ( about 1 large potato ) | 1 can reduced sodium cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle chile | 2 cups lower-fat chicken stock | 1/4 cup olives, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley or 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped
instructions: Toast poblano and watermelon on a grill, broiling or pan or directly over a flame until soft, about 10 minutes.  Turning occasionally.  Remove skins and seeds from pepper using a small knife.  Using the tip of a small paring knife, core pepper until seeds are crushed.  Place poblano and watermelon cut side down on paper towel lined baking sheet.  Broil or broil until skins are blistered on all sides, about 10 minutes for a milder smoke, about 10 minutes for a medium heat.  Remove with a slotted spoon or tongs.  Cut peel away from stem and discard.  Cut potato in wedges.

title: Ukrainian Spiced Wings
ingredients: 2/3 lb fresh chicken wings | 1 1/3 lbs crushed tomatoes with ketchup | 1 teaspoon pickling spice | 2 -3 slices cheddar cheese | 1/2 onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Put the chicken wings in a pot of boiling water and boil until the wings have cooked.  Drain the chicken wings and put in a saucepan with the crushed tomatoes and pickling spice.  Bring to a boil and skim off any scum that forms.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Stir over very low heat until the liquid is reduced by half.  Place in large oven proof, deep skillet or casserole dish and set aside.  Layer the crumbled cheese, sliced onions, and sliced tomatoes on top of the sauce.  Cover and bake in a preheated 400 degree for 20 minutes.

title: Carrot and Pine Nut Meal Bread
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 1 bag baby carrots, finely grated | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, finely chopped
instructions: Warm the oatmeal in a small pan until it is very warm.  Add the carrots to the oatmeal mixture and stir until all the pieces are well coated with the oatmeal.  Sprinkle with the pine nuts.  Heat for 3 - 4 minutes and serve.  Enjoy.

title: Baguettes (Italian Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs yellow sweet peppers ( green or red ) | 2 tablespoons yeast or 4 teaspoons dry yeast | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup creme fraiche fraiche fraiche | bread, with | chicken, meat or vegetables
instructions: If using dry ingredients, cover with boiling, salted water and set aside to soften for about 5 minutes.  Dry vegetables on paper towels and pat dry with paper towels.  Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of cold water.  Place warm veggies and warm crème fraîche in a small bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 hours or up to two days.  Preheat oven to 350°f cut tops off peppers without removing seeds and remove tops to use to line the loaf pans.  Line bottoms with overlapping rows of foil, allowing foil to wrap over sides.  Place peppers on sheet pan, bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until tender.  Transfer to a warm platter.

Random Ingredients: beef,white grape juice,english mustard,ginger,marinara sauce,oil,butternut squash,cream chicken soup
title: Chicken Mustard    Roasted Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef, sliced into 1 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 envelope reduced-sodium cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup white grape juice | 3/4 cup marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon dry english-style mustard | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to peel and cut squash into 1/4 inch slices.  Place the squash in a roasting pan.  Add the beef and all other ingredients.

title: Spinach With Hazelnuts and Raisins (Palatsasi)
ingredients: 10 ounces spinach | 1/2 cup dark seedless raisin | 1/4 cup hazelnuts ( or walnuts )
instructions: Wash and soak spinach 1/2 hour.  Drain and chop spinach finely.  Cover spinach with water 1/2 full.  Place remaining ingredients and simmer until spinach is tender, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes.  Cool completely and puree in blender until smooth.  Store in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Choc-Vietnamese Banh Mi
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado, peeled ( about 3 1/2 tsp/10g ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons peanut sauce ( i use thai kitchen brand and it's a lite thick sauce- i use peanut sauce ) | 1 teaspoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 250 g good quality bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Cut avocado in half lengthwise, removing stone and seed.  Brush with vinegar, then drizzle with a few teaspoons each of peanut sauce and sherry.  Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tsp each peanut sauce and sherry and allow to marinate for at least 20 minutes.  Melt bittersweet chocolate in a double boiler, then remove from heat.  Stir until smooth and pour into chocolate, pressing down to smooth it all.  Serve or chill.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresno chilies | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef chuck | 4 soft french bread, cut lengthwise into 4 diagonal slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Place the fresnos in a plastic food safe bowl and cover with water.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Drain.  Place the chuck in a 10 inch oven proof skillet.  Remove the skins from the chiles.  Dunk each meat piece into the water for a minute or two and then pat dry.  Arrange the chiles around the edge of the meat and set aside.  Place the skillet in the oven and bake for 2 hours.  Turn the meat and bake for another hour or so, or until a meat thermometer reads internal temperature of 130°f when taken in the thickest part of the meat.  Remove the beef and french bread slices from the skillet.

title: Pesto Deviled Avocadoes
ingredients:
1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 avocados ( approx 1-1/4 lb.
    - ) | 1/2 cup basil pesto, canned in jar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mustard ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dry basil ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1 package pasta
instructions: Place the dry mustard, pesto, sugar& pasta in a bowl& mix until well blended then place in refrigerator for at least 20 minutes to set.  Cook the pasta in about 1 cup of boiling water until tender.  Drain well, then add the hot infused vinaigrette to the pasta& mix.  Place in a serving dish& enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lamb rack,red chile,chili pepper,fontina cheese,dill pickle,napa cabbage
title: Grammy's Smothered Green Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds cubed lamb rack | 1 green chile, sliced | 1/2 chile hot red chile, sliced | 1/3 cup shredded fontina cheese, or to taste | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh dill pickles | 1/4 cup thinly sliced napa cabbage
instructions: Season lamb racks with salt and pepper on both sides.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook lamb in the hot oil until browned on all sides, 5 to 10 minutes per side.  Remove lamb to a plate.  Pour enough hot water into skillet to come halfway up the side of the rack.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: campbell southwest pepper jack soup,double cream,plain nonfat yogurt,catfish,coriander leaf,baking powder
title: The Bestest and Best Mouthwatering Catfish & Bacon Curry Ever!!!!
ingredients: 2 cans campbell southwest hot pepper jack soup ( any flavor ) | 300 ml plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 -6 tablespoons double cream | 2 tablespoons shredded coriander leaves | 1 cooked catfish, sliced, to serve | 1/4 cup double cream, to serve
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crab meat & cream in a bowl.  Add the crab meat & cream & mix well.  The curry will keep in the fridge for a week & a half.  Garnish with coriander leaves & serve with your favourite fish & rice.

Random Ingredients: olive,dark sesame oil,garlic powder,hungarian paprika,fine breadcrumb
title: Sweet Hungarian Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup olive, pitted drained and finely chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup sweet hungarian paprika, sweet hungarian sweet paprika preferred | 2 tablespoons light golden sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Note, can use other mild and hotter cuts of table snacking.  Note, the key to this spice mix is the heat, but not the smoke.  Note, if you’re using a nonstick skillet at low heat, then a small pan will do nicely.  Combine all ingredients and stir well.  Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.  Can also be purchased as a cracker or dip for raw meat, poultry, beef, chicken, duck, beef or other meat of your choice.  Goes well with mashed potatoes to dip into.  Note, if you are using cracker for dip, do not add the paprika until just before serving.  The cracker will become slimy and dry.  So, in small batches, add about 1/2 cup of the mixture to a resealable, dry plastic bag, and toss to coat.  Store in the freezer if you need to keep it longer.

title: Creamy Egg Substitute Dip

instructions: Whisk all ingredients till smooth.  If you feel like a creamier dip, add milk a little at a time to get the full creaminess.

title: Orange Basil Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1 bunch fresh basil | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Mix fresh orange juice with basil.

title: Quick'simply Authentic' Chicken

instructions: Prick the chicken in several places.

title: Indian Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 3 pounds bone-in pork roast, cut into pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon cumin, garam masala, sage, 1 tablespoon cumin, and 3 tablespoons cumin until well blended.  Add pork, and coat with remaining 1 tablespoon cumin and 1 tablespoon garam masala.  Heat a large dutch oven over medium heat, and coat with cooking spray.  Add pork, and sear on all sides, about 5 minutes.  Reduce heat to medium low, and keep warm, covered.  Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Place remaining 1 tablespoon cumin, 1 tablespoon curry powder, and remaining 1 tablespoon cumin into a small bowl, and spread evenly over the top of the pork.  Return the dutch oven to the roasting pan.  Bake in preheated oven until pork is no longer pink inside, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,rose water,red bell pepper,self rising flour,lime juice,chicken bouillon granule
title: Easy and Delicious Turkish Flatbread (Vegetarian Times)
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked bulgur | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 3/4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon red bell pepper, chopped or 1 tablespoon yellow bell pepper, ground in a food processor
instructions: In a small bowl, combine bulgur and flour, mixing well so all ingredients are wet.  Stir in chicken bouillon, 1/2 tsp lime juice, and 2 tbs lime juice. Reduce heat slightly, then pour over the flatbread and serve.

instructions: Preheat oven to 360 degrees.  Sprinkle fresh greens with crushed pepper and let wilt for about 15 minutes or until wilted.  In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise and hot pepper. Uncover loosely and bake for a few minutes more or until just crisp and lightly browned.  Serve with salad and extra crackers.

instructions: Prepare grill or broiler.

instructions: Cook macaroni until almost done, about 8 minutes.  Rinse with cold water.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray an 8 inch square baking pan with cooking spray.  Place the milk, vanilla beans, and green olives in the baking pan. instructions: Peel apples and cut into 6 - 8 slices.  Wrap each slice in wax paper securing with toothpicks.  Place in a bowl of warm water to cover and let stand 15 minutes. title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: 12 ounces streaky bacon | 6 ounces pork | 3 ounces wide egg noodles, uncooked | 4 fluid ounces beer | 3 drops cream of tartar | 1 rind from a peacock at room temperature ( see note ) | 6 leaves romaine lettuce
instructions: Chop bacon and pork.  Cook bacon and pork under bacon's grill until lightly brown.  Break noodles into pieces and cook in the bacon fat, stirring and mashing with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes.  Remove any browned bits from the frying pan.  Add the beer and cream of tartar to bacon fat mixture and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until mixture is smooth, stirring constantly over medium heat.  Remove mixture from heat and stir in 1/4 of the chopped bacon and pork.  Stir in the remaining chopped bacon and pork and serve immediately.

title: Salsa-Burging Sauce, Asian Style(Diabetic Crockpot)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder or 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon ground galangal ( fresh grated or crushed ) ( optional )
instructions: Dump ingredients in your crock pot and stir.  Stir til all is mixed well together.  Cover.  Set crock pot to saute and cook for a few hours, stirring every hour or so until it thickens slightly. Take it out of the crock with a slotted spoon and measure out about 1 cup for serving and add it or keep it stored in a separate container, covered tightly, and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.  Makes about one 3 cup salsa per serving over a small bowl of your choice.  I like mine as is, like mayonnaise, bland as it is, with the raw smell.  For thicker texture, add an extra cup or two of any salsa used.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Cut chilies in half and remove stems and seeds and white pith.  Place chilies and tomatoes in a large dutch oven or pot with a tight fitting lid. Cook until golden brown.  Take off heat.  Serve hot or cool.

instructions: Put your sunflower seeds, cream, irish cream, soya sauce and water in the blender and process until smooth.  Add more soya to taste if it is too thick.  Cover and refrigerate until chilled.  Enjoy.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Combine the flour and oregano and stir it in with a spatula so as not to overmix.

title: Lebanese Bean Tarts
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 bunch scallion, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried lavender flowers ( or to taste )
instructions: Blend all ingredients.  Fill the pastry shells with the mixture.  Dot with butter.  Seal well.  Bake in 350 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  Cool.

title: Cottage Cheese and Rice Salad
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese | 1 cucumber, peeled and diced | 300 g basmati rice, washed | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Drain the cottage cheese and place in a bowl.  Add cucumber, rice, mint, and cottage cheese mixture to the remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Serve.

title: Cajun Style Turkey
ingredients: 4 pounds turkey | 1 cup light corn syrup | 8 ounces shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Place turkey in a 4 quart slow cooker.  Add corn syrup.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 4 to 5 hours.  Remove turkey and keep warm.  Sprinkle cheese on top and return to cooker to warm through 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 cans enchilada sauce | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 5 ounces kielbasa, diced | 5 ounces roast, sliced into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 pint sultana, halved | 2 teaspoons crushed peppercorns | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns
instructions: In saucepan, combine the enchilada sauce, pineapple with juice, kielbasa, roast, sultanas, marjoram, black pepper, and peppercorns.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.  Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Chinese Broccoli Steak with Chestnut Chute
ingredients: 12 ounces flank steaks | 4 ounces shucked hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/4 cup hazelnuts | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 3/4 cups broccoli florets ( preferably small baby broccoli florets )
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak.  Cut steak lengthwise into 4 equal thin slices.  Cut slits across the grain of steak lengthwise into 2 inch lengths.  Insert a toothpick through the center of each length of steak.  Blend remaining ingredients with 2 tablespoons of water.

Random Ingredients: cracker meal,dark rum,grain rice,orange roughy fillet,worcestershire sauce,mace,cream mushroom soup
title: Cousin Pete's Rachael Ray's Stuffed Cracker Jars
ingredients: 1 cup cracked cracker meal ( bread crumbs ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 3 pounds skinless, boneless orange roughy fillets | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup dry long grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a medium bowl blend the cracker meal, worcestershire, rum, mace and 1/4 cup water.  Place fish in a 13x9 inch glass baking dish and coat with the cracker mixture, shaking off any excess.  Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 35 minutes.  Remove fish from oven and spoon soup into individual ramekins, evenly.  Dollop soup onto fish and return to oven, and bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Taco Pizza Pastry
ingredients: 1 box puff pastry sheet | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees.  Take one sheet of puff pastry and line a cookie sheet.  Use another sheet to line the entire sheet.  Use a fork to spread taco seasoning mix onto pastry on the pastry and the tortilla.  Use more or less according to taste.  Bake in preheated oven for about 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and crispy.

title: Corn Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages fresh mini frozen baby corn, thawed and chopped fine | 1/4 cup yellow mustard | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough ( regular if possible ) | prepared yellow mustard
instructions: Thaw the baby corn by placing in a colander over a bowl, and pressing the leaves with your hands to remove as much of the corn kernels as possible.  Drain well and set aside.  Lightly spray a non stick 10 to 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray, or coat with cooking spray.  Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees.  Toss the corn with 1 teaspoon of yellow mustard.  Unfold four sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each sheet with some of the yellow mustard.  If using an 8 inch square baking dish spray the top sheet with some of the cooking oil.  Repeat until all 8 sheets of phyllo are used.  Spoon 1/4 of the baby corn mixture into each phyllo sheet, packing it evenly in the pan.  Sprinkle 1/4 of the yellow mustard on top of the corn mixture.  Roll up one sheet of phyllo dough around the corn filling, taking care to not let it overlap so it doesn't become compressed.  Repeat until all four sheets have been used up.  Fold in half, press sides to seal and place on a sheet pan lined with parchment or wax paper.  Repeat this procedure with the remaining phyllo, corn fillingand phyllo.  Cover and let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Bake the rolls for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.  Serve warm.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Baklava - Spicy Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1 can spanish onions, drained well | 3 1/2 ounces fennel, sliced thin | 20 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll out the fennel into a 16 x 10 inch rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.  Layer the onion slices in the dough, overlapping them slightly, using at least 6 strips of french green fennel showing through.  Place about 1/2 teaspoon of fennel on each of the 4 edges of the pastry, making a border that will go around the edges.  Starting at the long side, roll up the long edge, beginning at the narrow end and pressing down to compact, leaving the ends slightly open.  Working with 1 phyllo at a time, brush the edges with melted butter and sprinkle with salt.  Repeat with the remaining 12 phyllo sheets, brush each with melted butter and sprinkle with salt.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Cover a cookie sheet with foil, leaving about 1 inch between each one, and place it on the cookie sheet.  With a sharp knife, trim away most of the white from inside the sheet.  Slice sheet across the center making 12 smaller squares.  Using the back of a small glass, make holes in the top of each square to allow steam to escape before wrapping with pastry.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,active yeast,sesame seed,lemon curd,bean sprout,pizza crust
title: Baked Herb and Dip-Dip
ingredients: 3 1/4 - 4 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose kosher and bread flour | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 package preshiradish | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 cup fresh lemon curd | 1 1/2 - 2 cups dry pizza crusts ( if unavailable, use gluten-free or gluten-free french breadsticks )
instructions: Place ingredients into a large bowl and mix until smooth.  Pour dough into a well buttered 3 1/2 round jelly roll pan, spreading dough evenly and gently to cover.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and set dough in a warm spot to rise, about 35 - 40 mins.  Preheat oven to 425f and grease a cookie sheet with 1/4 tsp salt and 2 tsp oil.  Sprinkle crust with dried bread crumbs.  Place baking sheet on the middle rack of the oven.  Bake about 22 minutes, until the crust has turned white and the top is golden.  Let cool slightly.  Slice horizontally if desired.  Let cool on a wire rack.  Store covered for up to an hour before serving.

title: Chicken Liver Pies - Malaysia
ingredients: 500 g chicken livers, trimmed and finely chopped | 300 ml peanut oil | 100 g green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Mash the chicken livers in a mortar and pestle until crumbly.  Heat the oil in a wok or frypan with the cardamom and cardamoms.  Cook the coated livers over a medium heat until dark brown.  When they have cooled slightly, add them to the hot pan.  Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the mulled livers into each patty, and fry in batches until they are golden brown and crisp, and the livers are cooked through.  These can either be cooked in a little oil or put them in a casserole dish to cool.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,lasagna noodle,black peppercorn,chicken bouillon,wheat flour,peanut butter,baby spinach
title: Tuscan Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1 cup raw peanuts ( unsalted ) | 8 ounces baby spinach | 4 cups chicken bouillon ( or use chicken soup granules ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Break noodles into small pieces and blanch in boiling water for 1 minute.  Drain the noodles in a colander and rinse under cold water until cool.  Cook the peanuts in a large saute pan until they are a medium brown brown color, about 5 minutes.  While peanuts are cooking, place the spinach in a colander and set aside.  When noodles are ready, drain, return to the pan and toss with the chicken stock granules, marjoram and peppercorns.  Set aside.  Mix flour and a small pinch of salt together.  Then, in a 9x13 baking dish, spread half of the noodles on the bottom of the dish.  Then half of the spinach mixture, half of the peanuts and half of the marjoram and half of the peanut butter mixture.  Repeat with a second layer.  After the third layer is spread out, spread out remaining noodles.  Spread out the rest of the spinach, then sprinkle with more of the marjoram and peanut butter, then the peanuts and more of the marjoram and peanut butter, and finally, the noodles.  If this is too runny, spread out some cornstarch to thicken it up.  Sprinkle with the remaining marjoram and parsley just before putting in the oven.  Bake for 55 - 60 minutes, until bubbly and a golden brown.  Serve at once.

title: Peachy Mustard Peaches
ingredients: 4 small cucumbers | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds, coarsely crushed | 5 canned peaches | 2 chicken stock cubes or 2 vegetable stock cubes
instructions: Peel and halve lengthways cucumbers.  Place in a colander and toss with mustard seeds.  Place cucumber on a serving plate.  Drain peaches and cut into slices.  Place on top of the mustard seed mixture in the cucumber, sprinkle with stock cubes.  Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,sake,green cardamom pod,green chili,shell pasta
title: Quick Spicy Shellfish
ingredients: 300 g shell pasta | 300 g baby carrots ( carrots in japanese mayonnaise called japanese carrots ) | 1 teaspoon green chili ( japanese chili pepper was my addition ) | 1 teaspoon sake ( japanese rice wine was i used dry sherry ) or 1 teaspoon sherry ( japanese rice wine was i used dry sherry ) | 1 green cardamom pod ( for garnish not a whole pod )
instructions: Start by removing the head from the baby carrots, then slice them into rounds about 3 x 5 mm.  You should have about 1 1/2 cups of carrots in total.  Grate the green chili and chop it finely too.  In a sauce pan, on medium high, add about 2 litres of boiling water, all of the baby carrots pieces in there, add the chile and sake.  Then add a pinch or two of sugar and stir well.  When the water begins boiling, add the baby carrots and stir well.  Reduce the heat and simmer for about five or six minutes.  It should look fairly dry.  If all of the carrots are slightly wet, add a tiny bit more liquid.  Add the green cardom pods and continue to simmer for a few minutes, or until the liquid of the carrots has cooked down.  If it looks dry, add water.  Season with salt or more salt.  It should not be too watery or thick as it should eventually have a thinner sauce.  At the most you will need to make it one or two days in advance, so plan ahead and stir and simmer the soup as it simmers away.  Serve the soup in big bowls garnished with a few drops of green cardamom pod and a sprinkle of green chile slices, or whatever else you like at the table.  You may also add the cooked prawns in small pieces for a flavor boost.

title: Baked Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 1/4 cup chopped fresh horseradish or 1 package prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked chicken | 1 1/2 cups quinoa or 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons rock salt | 1 cup coarsely shredded fresh graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Prepare baking dish by spraying with nonstick cooking spray.  In a mixing bowl, mix salsa, horseradish, thyme and 1 cup hot water for 1 minute.  Set aside.  In a medium bowl, combine chicken, quinoa and salt.  Add salsa mixture, mix well, and sprinkle crumbs on dish.  Transfer half of mixture to baking dish.  Drizzle top with remaining salsa mixture.  Bake at 425 degrees f for 25 minutes.

title: Alsatian Strawberries and Provolone in Amaretto
ingredients: 1 lb strawberry | 1 lb asparagus | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 pint strawberry | 1 tablespoon ascorbicarbonate of soda | 8 slices provolone cheese | 1/2 cup hazelnuts
instructions: Cut the strawberries in half.  Cook in a medium sized pot over a low heat for about an hour stirring every so often.  Remove the bicarb of soda and bicarb of soda, drain the berries and cut off any large pieces of strawberries.  Make sure you have enough time to spare.  Add some extra strawberry syrup to the asparagus and cook until the asparagus is tender.  Take the strawberries and asparagus and cut them into wedges.  Slice the provolone into 4 equal pieces.  Make sure you have enough room in the bottom for the strawberries to rest.  Toss the asparagus and strawberries in a medium sized bowl with the bicarb soda.  Grate a bunch of grated cheeses onto the bottom of your serving bowl.  Garnish the strawberries with the hazelnuts.  Enjoy.

title: Shamrock Ham Sandwich
ingredients: 2 pieces rolled rye bread | 2 tablespoons strawberry jam | 1 plum tomato, halved - or more to taste | 3 tablespoons kraft pizza sauce
instructions: Spread each piece of bread with the jam.  Spread the tomato halves with the pizza sauce.  Arrange the ham slices, sandwich style, cut side up.  Roll up.  Serve.

title: Vegetarian Brik
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 1 lb dijon mustard | 1 lb porcini mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°.  Mix dijon mustard with mushrooms and mix together.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo pastry in 9x7 baking pan.  Cover with a layer of mustard mixture.  Spread mushroom mixture over phyllo, then pour the remaining phyllo on top of the mushroom mix, making sure the phyllo is completely covered with mustard.  Cover with remaining phyllo for the last 2 minutes of baking.  If you use a loaf pan, remove the excess phyllo from the oven during the baking or remove before placing on top of the cake.  Bake for 45 minutes and then turn off oven.  Let sit for 15 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,hot chili pepper,toffee,brown button mushroom
title: The Perfect Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 lb soft dried hot chili pepper, or more to taste | 1 cup toffee, finely ground | 2 cups brown button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place chicken breasts in a 9x9 inch baking dish in one layer.  Cover the chicken breasts with hot chili pepper.  Sprinkle with toffee.  Lay mushrooms on top, with a pinch or two of salt.  Spoon the toffee sauce over all, and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes, or until chicken breasts are cooked through and chiles are tender or the sauce has thickened a bit.

title: Baked Shrimp With Dates and Salsa
ingredients: 3/4 lb jumbo shrimp, raw, peeled, tails on | 3/4 cup jumbo shrimp cocktail sauce ( or any other salsa, salsa verde or other salsa ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons finely sliced green onions | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pitted dates
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, mix the shrimp and cocktail sauce.

title: Mexican Style Hot Noodles
ingredients: 1 package hot noodles ( or more to cover noodles ) | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili pepper, finely chopped ( to taste )
instructions: Soak yellow sugar and white rice noodles in water with salt.  When water is absorbed, drain.  Mix 1 - 2 tsp of chiles with noodles, pour into boiling water and stir.

title: Cod With Creamy Sage Duxelles
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream | 12 sage leaves | 1 1/4 lbs cod ( or other good white fish ) | 6 slices french bread, toasted & crusts kept warm
instructions: In a large saucpan, warm the cream, about 1 1/2 cups, bring to a simmer, cover and simmer until it reduces to about 2 cups, approximately 20 minutes.  Strain the cream through a fine sieve into a clean bowl and discard the solids.  Remove & set aside any bones & skin left at the tail.  Set the fish on a serving platter, cut side up.  Pour the cream mixture over it and let the fish stand at room temperature for at least 15 minutes.  Slice the bread into 3 - 4 thick slices, then toast each piece of bread until golden and crisp.  Drain the cod & arrange on top of the creamy cream.  Spoon 1/4 cup of cream mixture over the fish.  Serve at once, garnished with chopped fresh sage leaves.

title: Thai King Prawns - Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs king prawns | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Shell the prawns and cut into 2 inch lengths.  Place into a bowl and coat with the dark soy sauce.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 2 hours.  To serve, divide mixture among 4 plates and top with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,roasting chicken,bread,celery,cayenne pepper,fennel seed,bean sprout,chunky peanut butter
title: Chicken with Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 large chicken thighs | 6 tablespoons creamy chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons crushed celery | 1 1/2 cups beans sprouts, drained and rinsed | 2 1/2 cups bread, crumbs ( or more as needed ) | 1 roasting chickens or 2 chicken legs
instructions: Place all ingredients into container of electric blender, and process until well blended.  Spread crumb topping over chicken, and lightly press crumb topping evenly over chicken.  Marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator.  Preheat oven 350 degrees.  Place chicken on rack in roasting pan.  Pour marinade into pot, and simmer for 45 minutes.  Bake 35 - 45 minutes, until chicken is no longer pink inside and juices run clear.  Remove and let stand 10 minutes.  Pour liquid over chicken and serve.

title: Rice Cooker Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 2 tablespoons thick chunky salsa
instructions: Put all ingredients into the rice cooker and run the machine until beans are very soft.  Serve immediately.

title: Sang Khokku
ingredients: 2 lbs swordfish steaks, cubed | 1 can coconut cream | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | fresh ground black pepper, to taste | fresh fruit, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the fish into a dutch oven, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, and simmer for about 10 minutes.  Stir in the coconut cream, garlic, and black pepper.

title: Apricot Scented Chutney
ingredients: 1 red onion, very finely chopped | 1/2 cup sultanas | 2 tablespoons apricot jam, finely chutney
instructions: Peel the onion but don't peel off the top layer.

title: Oatmeal Sushi Roll
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats | 4 teaspoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons hot water | 2 ounces amaretto | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil | naheim chili, thinly sliced | 3 sheets nori
instructions: Combine sweet chili sauce and hot water in a small bowl.  Place rolled oats onto a sheet of nori and spread evenly.  Spread 1 teaspoon sweet chili sauce mixture evenly over rolled oats.  Fold rolled oats over mixture by placing nori side by side and pressing seams together.  Roll sushi like a jelly roll.  Use scissors to cut roll into eight servings.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,japanese eggplant,pine nut,french onion dip,ketchup,salad oil,almond flour,celery
title: Chinese Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 10 japanese eggplants | 1 cup almond flour ( bob's red mill almond dipping sauce ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 cups french onion dip | 1/2 cup ketchup | 3 cups vegetable oil | 1 cup slivered celery | 1 cup pine nuts
instructions: Peel eggplants and slice diagonally at 1/2 to 1/2 thick, cutting through the top of each to create 4 slices.  Place eggplant slices in a colander and let drain until all the eggplant has been drained.  Cut remaining eggplant in half lengthwise then slice diagonally into 1/4 slices, so you have about 20 pieces.

title: Tomato Rice
ingredients: 6 large firm ripe tomatoes ( about 2 pounds total weight ) | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups carnaroli rice | 15 -20 fresh arborio rice, rinsed well | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Wash tomatoes.  Preheat oven to 350°f coat baking sheet with no stick cooking spray or butter.  Cut 2 tomato halves crosswise in half to make 2 total serving size pieces.  Cut each slice 3/4 inch thick, then cut the same length again to make 2 pieces of tomato each, allowing 1/2 cup for each tomato.  Arrange tomato halves, cut side up, on baking sheet.  Bake uncovered 25 minutes, rearranging tomato halves after 5 minutes, then rearranging tomato halves after another 5 minutes.

title: Watermelon and Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 cup finely diced seedless watermelon | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint or 1/2 cup cilantro
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and mix well.  Fold in mint.  Chill 3 hours or overnight to blend flavors.

title: Baked Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup hot alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Combine alfredo sauce and melted butter in an ovenproof dish.  Squeeze lime wedge into sauce.  Sprinkle with more of the lime wedge.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes.

title: Dynamite (German Thanksgiving)
ingredients: 1 cornish hen | 2 cups pork fat | celery
instructions: Boil one hen for about 30 minutes, cut up and set aside.  Save hen for another meal.  De bone hen and make a hole in cavity from the hen.  Fill with 1/2 cup of pork fat and 1/2 cup of cornstarch.  Mix well.  Cook over slow coals for about 50 minutes and then stir until thickened.

title: Potato Chips from the Pitcher
ingredients: 6 small baking potatoes, halved if large | fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/180°f.  Cook the potatoes on a baking tray in the oven for about 30 minutes until browned, stirring occasionally.  Place on a serving plate and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Chutney Stuffed Prawns
ingredients: 500 g uncooked elbow macaroni | 4 garlic cloves, crushed | 450 g boneless pork shoulder, chopped | 1 1/4 cups chutney, chunky | 1/4 cup nonfat yogurt | 2 prawns
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c cook macaroni in a large pan of salted water over medium heat until just tender.  Drain and cool.  Combine the garlic, pork mince and chilli together in a large bowl.  Stuff the skins of the prawns with the mixture.  Line a large ovenproof dish with baking paper.  Place the prawns on top.  Spoon over the chutney.  Bake, uncovered, for 45 mins or until prawns are cooked and prawns are tender.  Serve with extra chopped chutney.  Serve with a tossed salad.  This goes well with a veg burger or grilled chicken.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,thyme sprig,farfalle pasta,cranberry juice cocktail,salmon fillet
title: Salmon Pasta With Cranberry-Smoked Feta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon fillet | 1/2 package halved frozen farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 cup cranberry juice cocktail | 3 tablespoons roquefort cheese, crumbled | 1 fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt.  While pasta cooks, preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place salmon fillet on foil lined cookie sheet.  Place in oven for 4 - 5 minutes.  Drain pasta onto colander and rinse with cool water to stop salmon and set aside.  Combine 1/2 cup of the cranberry cocktail and 1 tablespoon of Roquefort cheese, toss with pasta and remaining 1 tablespoon each of cranberry cocktail and cream cheese.  Transfer to a serving platter.  Garnish with thyme sprigs as desired.

title: Chinese New Year's Eve Kimsho Soup
ingredients: 8 cups chinese cabbage, thinly cut | 1/4 cup anchovies | 12 small young ginger root, peeled | 1 can kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pinto beans, drained
instructions: Put cabbage, anchovies and peeled ginger into a blender and blend until desired consistency is reached.  Add beans and blend just until incorporated.

title: Mexican Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lemon | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 3/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon red hot pepper sauce ( i like peri peri )
instructions: Squeeze 1/2 inch juice from lemon.  Wash hands and rub skin dry if necessary.  Set aside in bowl.  Place rest of the ingredients in blender and blend on high until smooth.  Use 1 tsp for each serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,panir,malt vinegar,vegetarian worcestershire sauce,olive oil
title: Paneer Raita
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh olive oil | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup vegan worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar ( i used the kind that comes in a pinch of sugar and salt ) | panir
instructions: In a small bowl mash the vegan worcestershire sauce with a fork.  Fold in the oil and vinegar.  Set aside.  Drain the panir fat and cut out strips of the rind from all the cheese you cut it into into cubes.  Dip the raita strips into some water then fry in the olive oil.  Spread raita slices with a little of the panker, place in the microwave to heat through.

title: Brasato
ingredients: 1/2 kg kielbasa ( sausage ) | 1 english cucumbers | 15 canned chick-peas, drained | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, ground
instructions: Cut kielbasa sausage into 2cm cubes.  Cut cucumber into 1cm cubes.  Slice chick peas in half again and remove seeds and ribs.  Slice kielbasa into cubes and place in a bowlful with chick peas, tomatoes, ketchup, cayenne.  Marinate at least an hour.  Add salt to taste just before serving.

title: Asparagus Proscuitto
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus | 1/4 lb prosciutto, very thin | 1/2 lb crumbled feta
instructions: Snap off the tips of the asparagus just prior to boiling for some of the steam.  Break off the tough ends of the asparagus by trimming off the tough stalks and running them through a steamed basket, discarding the tips and being careful to keep them intact.  Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Trim off the ends of the asparagus, then cook the asparagus in the boiling water just until crisp tender, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Plunge the asparagus into a bowl of ice water.  Toss with the prosciutto and crumbled feta, tossing until everything is evenly coated.  Serve immediately.

title: Chili Chicken (Shredded)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken, cut up into pieces | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 cup tequila ( jose cuervo gold preferred ) | 4 black mustard seeds, freshly cracked
instructions: Heat a large, heavy frying pan over low heat.  Add tequila and mustard seeds, and stir them constantly for a few seconds.  Once they start popping add the chicken pieces, coating them in tequila.  Keep turning the chicken so the chips are evenly distributed on all sides.  Cover the pan, and simmer for one hour.  Uncover, and simmer until meat is tender.  This should take 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove chicken from heat to a plate.  Allow the juices to be absorbed by the chip before slicing.  Serve over rice, or with other indonesian dishes of your choice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,french green bean,water chestnut,chive,coconut milk
title: Phyllo Forest Bars
ingredients: 2 cups french style green beans, sliced | 20 fresh thawed frozen phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions ( preferably frozen ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 - 1/2 cup light coconut milk, plus | 2 tablespoons light coconut milk | freshly snipped chives ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Spray bottom and sides of an 8x8x2 inch metal baking dish large enough to hold a large sheet of phyllo.  Layer half the green beans in bottom of dish.  Sprinkle half the remaining green beans over green beans.  Layer phyllo dough over green beans, trimming if needed to fit dish and leaving about 2 inches clear around edges.  Place water chestnuts over phyllo.  Top with remaining green beans, water chestnuts and 1/2 cup coconut milk.  Make sure all layers of phyllo have been trimmed.  In small bowl, combine coconut milk and remaining 1/2 cup of light coconut milk.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,brussels sprout,oyster sauce,baking soda,beef stock,pork baby back rib,chili pepper flake
title: Chinese Style Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 lbs green cardamom pods, cracked open | 2 cups beef stock ( or beef broth ) | 1 cup oyster sauce | 2 lbs smoked pork baby back ribs | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 lbs brussels sprouts ( trimmed clean )
instructions: Place the green cardamom pods in the coffee filter basket of your brew maker.  You don't need to use a rubber band.  Using the beer filter basket, pour the entire cup of stock into the coffee filter basket.  Open the beer filter basket and use a hammer to crush the cardamom pods until you have roughly 8 tablespoons of crushed spices.  In a saucepan over medium heat, mix the stock, oyster sauce and pepper flakes.  Bring to a simmer and add the brussels sprouts.  Cover and simmer on the stovetop for 10 minutes or until they are cooked.  Remove the brussels sprouts from the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,kosher salt black pepper,cooking onion,orange peel,allspice,gingerroot,vinegar,ginger root
title: Jamaican Chili Paste
ingredients: 3 links chorizo sausage | 1 cup cooking onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | cooking onion, chopped | freshly ground kosher salt and black pepper to taste | 1 pinch freshly grated orange peel
instructions: Crumble chorizo in a skillet over medium high heat.  Cook until evenly browned.  Drain off excess grease.  Stir in cooking onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.  Pour onion mixture into a food processor with the chorizo, ginger, vinegar, ginger root, allspice, cooking onion, salt, black pepper, and peel.  Puree until smooth.  Transfer chorizo mixture to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,cream tartar,gingerroot,soymilk,cardamom pod,sesame seed oil,ancho chile powder,steak
title: Dairy Free Kielbasa Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks | 1/4 cup soy milk | 2 teaspoons minced gingerroot | 1 -2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 pints light cream of tartar | 1 3/4 cups whole milk, for basting | 1/4 cup sesame seed oil | 6 cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 16 -20 whole casings the sesame seeds, for garnishing ( i leave some for sprinkling on top )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large freezer bag.  Close bag and store in a cool, dark place for 3 or 4 days. After you have wrapped and wrapped your wraps on the plate, cut up the tortilla in a criss cross pattern with a sharp knife. instructions: Mix apples and artichoke hearts in a large bowl.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook artichoke heart in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but tender, about 2 minutes.  Drain and artichoke hearts in a colander set in the sink.  Mash artichoke hearts with a potato masher or fork, and transfer to the bowl with the prepared polenta and stir to blend well.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,cornstarch,ginger,bamboo skewer,double cream,rump steak,hot sauce
title: T- Bone Steak With Sour Cream Dijon Gravy
ingredients: 8 beef t-bone steaks | 10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 15 minutes | 1 cup soured cream | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, diced | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Place the steaks between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound until about 3/4 inch thick.  Cut the meat diagonally into 1/4 inch slices.  Place the slices between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound with the flat of a cleaver until both sides are somewhat flattened.  Spread both sides of the steaks with the soured cream.  Repeat, stacking the steaks and using about 1/4 cup of cream and 1/4 cup of each of the soured cream and cream for each batch.  In a nonreactive bowl, combine the cornstarch, vinegar, ginger and hot sauce to make a dressing.  Coat the steaks with the dressing and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or up to 1 day.  Preheat a grill to moderately hot.  Thread the steaks onto the skewers and cook them on the hot grill for 6 to 8 minutes, turning and brushing occasionally with the dressing, until they are cooked to desired doneness.  Transfer the steaks to a platter and let them rest before serving, covered.  For gravy, strain the sauce through muslin and serve with the steaks.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,bay leaf,french onion soup,beef broth,taco seasoning
title: Finger-Licking Beef Sandwiches

instructions: In a slow cooker, combine soup, beef broth, taco seasoning and bay leaf.  Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, or on low for 5 hours, or overnight.  Serve hot on buns with a slice of sourdough bread.

title: Red Bell Pepper Filled Pastry
ingredients: 8 tablespoons cake flour ( plain flour, all purpose or a mixture of the two, can be subed with half and half ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 medium red bell pepper | 1 1/2 cups canned italian tomato paste | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup minced red bell pepper
instructions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly.  Cut peppers in half and remove seeds.  Cut peppers in half, cut halves crosswise.  Slice in 1/4 inch slices.  Set aside.  In medium size mixing bowl, combine both mixtures and stir until smooth.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit / 177 degrees celsius.  Oil a 9 x 11 baking dish, lightly flour the base of the dish.  Coat both sides of each pepper slice with a mixture of corn oil, minced red pepper and dry mixture.  Dunk peppers one at a time into the skillet to lightly coat.  Place coated peppers in the prepared baking dish and bake for 25 minutes until golden brown.

instructions: Combine the stock, spinach and beans in a pan and bring to the boil.  Boil rapidly for 3 - 4 minutes or until spinach is wilted.  Stir the vinegar into the pan, boil for 2 minutes or until reduced to thick gravy consistency.  Add the spinach mixture to the bean mixture and stir until heated through.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Cut 2 clean potatoes in half.  Insert meat thermometer in thickest part of meat.  Spray inside of crock with non spray cooking spray.  Put potatoes over meat.  Put 1/3 cup french dressing, 1/4 cup tamari, 1/4 cup tamari and 1/4 cup water in crock pot.  Mix well.  Add 2 crushed ancho chiles.  Use 2 t.  Of ice water in a measuring cup to reach desired consistency.  Stir if desired to make it a little thicker.  If not, add 1/8 cup water.

title: Roasted Spicy Pineapple Rigatoni Pasta Salad
