instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c.  In a non stick frying pan, roast pineapple over a high heat for 5 mins.  Remove from the oven, and cut into chunks.  Place the spinach leaves, mint, tomatoes and cauliflower in a bowl, and put aside for 10 minutes.  While the pineapple is cooking, stir together the cornflour and the cornstarch mixture until smooth.  When the oven has proved the oven temperature has reached 220°c, pour some of the cornflour mixture into the oven, and cook for 30 mins, stirring every so often.  Toss the spinach mixture, drained pineapple, tomatoes and cauliflower in the pasta until coated with the sauce.

title: Savory Orzo

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Stir in orzo, and cook until tender, about 13 minutes.  Drain excess liquid.  Combine the cooked orzo, savory, rosemary, onion powder, savory, and water.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,heavy whipping cream,salt pepper,hoisin sauce,chicken breast half
title: Chicken Breasts With Poblano and Honey Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | salt and pepper to taste | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream, divided | 6 poblano pepper slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Rub about 1 teaspoon oil onto the inside of the breasts.  Stir the hoisin sauce, salt and pepper into the cream and place on the chicken.  Cover the chicken with a layer of poblano slices.  Place the remaining 1/4 cup cream in a small baking dish and microwave for 3 minutes.  Pour cream mixture over the top of the poblano and chicken and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until chicken breasts are no longer pink in the center.  Serve with rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,chili bean,pork,red wine,bean sprout,sesame seed,leg lamb

instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Place in crockpot, along with baked beans, apple, chili beans and bread crumbs or toasted sesame seeds.  Pour the wine over all.  Cook on high about 3 hours, until meat is fully cooked and falling off the bone.  Before serving slice thinly and serve with rice.

title: Double Chocolate Tofu

instructions: Slice tofu into slices about 1/8″ thick.  Place slices between plastic wrap and pound until they are 1/4″ thick.  Arrange slices in a single layer in a 9x13×1″ baking dish.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,italian parsley,coconut,macaroni noodle,tabasco sauce,purpose flour,lebanese cucumber

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the macaroni until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain. In the same cold water, toss the prawns, cucumber slices and macaroni with 1 tablespoon of the cheese.  In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and season to taste.  Serve the prawn mixture in bowls, sprinkled with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: ham,flax seed,curry sauce,basil leaf,pork shoulder,navel orange,red onion
title: Easy Orange Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, boneless | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs yellowtail ham ( or more to taste ) | 1 navel orange | 2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 2 teaspoons flax seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup curry sauce ( i use my kikkoman brand ) | 1/2 small red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f, and grease or line a roasting pan with foil.  Remove the membrane from the sausage in the casings and discard.  Cut the fat and meat from the pork and place in the pan with the meat, turning them so that they are coated evenly with the spices and oil.  Add about 1/2 cup water and orange juice.  Cover and place in the oven for about 3 hours and 1 1/2 hours.  Remove the pork from the pan and cut into medium size chunks.  Remove the meat from the pan, and slice into very thin slices with a chef's knife.  Return the meat to the pan with curry sauce and orange slices.  Add in the onions.  If using flax seed, skip this step.  The spices will not be enough for your taste.  These are not necessary but add flavor to the sauce.

title: Easy Delicious Salsa
ingredients: 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 1/2 cups soy sauce
instructions: Place diced tomatoes in saucepan, sprinkle with soy sauce, and mix well.

Random Ingredients: double cream,flour,green olive,red chile pepper,brown sugar,chicken

If the saucepan is dry, gradually add warm water a little at a time, until the sauce is thick, stirring constantly.  Roll scant tablespoonfuls of the meatball mixture into balls and fry in the hot sauce for about 10 minutes, turning once, until golden brown on all sides.

title: Tender Easy Mexican Meat (Crock Pot)

title: Sweet and Sour Yellow Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 yellow pepper, cut in strips | 1 cup flaked coconut | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 cup whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Place the yellow pepper, coconut, sugar, fish sauce, vinegar and whipping cream into a food processor and process until smooth adding more vinegar if necessary to make the sauce a thick consistency.  Scoop it into a bowl, cover and refrigerate over night, stirring the mixture occasionally.  Serve chilled over fish or vegetables.

title: Grilled Beet and Lamb Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups diced beets, thawed | 1 piece french bread | 4 slices deli sliced lamb shoulder | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Place the beets in a saucepan over medium high heat and stir occasionally until their skin is lightly browned.  Cover and steam the beets approximately 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nam pla,shrimp,basmati rice,russian salad dressing,white pepper,sherry,asafoetida powder,ham
title: Mixed-Up Ham Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 cups cooked ham ( i use deli and cut it up ) | 2 packages asafoetida powder | 3 packages smoked ham | 1/4 cup nam pla, sauce ( i get these at asian market ) | white pepper | 1/2 cup sherry ( optional ) | nuoc nam ( thai fish sauce )
instructions: Start rice and ham in boiling water, drain, and cool.  The ham will have a glue like appearance from the meat and smell like it is drying out.  Cut up the ham and nam pla into pieces and the ham will be in small pieces.  Wash hands well, and pat dry.  The rice and rice should be cool enough that easy to handle.  The ham pieces should be easy to work with.  Mix the asafetida powder, and nam pla sauce in a bowl until well combined.  Add white pepper and mix well.  Add rice, stirring gently so that all rice sticks together. .  In a large frying pan, or wok, heat up some oil.  Dip your hands in oil and spread the rice/ham mixture in 2 - 3 small batches on pan with the palm of your hand.  Fry on each side until crispy all over.  If you have too much oil to fry one batch of rice, make sure it's not too hot so you won't stick to the bottom of the pan. .  When done drain on paper towels.  Serve with nuoc nam sauce or thai dipping sauce on the side.

instructions: Place lamb slices in a 9x13x2 inch resealable plastic food storage plastic bag.  Pour in the broth.  Seal bag, and refrigerate for at least one hour, or 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange the lamb slices in a single layer in the baking pan. instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling oil until pink, approximately 2 to 4 minutes, turning occasionally, drain on absorbent paper towels. Brush the sides with milk to avoid the bottom of the tartlet from getting too thick.

instructions: Wash the bok choy and cut into bite sized pieces.  Place each portion of the leafy portion of the bok choy on each individual plate.  Fill each portion with approximately 2 tsp of the tomato juice.  Bring the tomato juice to a boil, then reduce flame and simmer for 15 minutes.

Pipe 3/4 cup of the rice mixture onto the center of 1/4 cup of the ham and 1/4 cup of the rice mixture to make an opening for each opening.  Repeat with remaining mixture and rice mixture.  Sprinkle each mound with 1/4 cup of the orange zest, green onions, and arugula.  Roll tightly so the arugula is inside each mound and does not reach the outside of the mound.  Serve rolled and accompanied by some chilled soda.

title: Baked Italian Sausage With Blueberries
ingredients: 8 links bulk italian sausage | 1 cup white beans ( frozen or canned, your choice ) or 1 cup lima beans ( frozen or canned, your choice ) | 3/4 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 °f.  Grease a baking sheet.  Break the sausages into 2 1/2 inch segments.  Pour them onto the baking sheet, and cook them for 10 minutes or until no longer pink.  Drain, discard grease, and sprinkle with salt.  While the sausage is cooking, rinse the beans in a strainer and put them in a mixing bowl.  Add 1/2 cup lima beans and the fresh blueberries.  Add the remaining 1/2 cup of lima beans and enough water to cover the blueberries.  Add the italian sausage, and mix together.  Bake in the oven for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until the sausage is cooked through and the berries pop.  These measurements reflect what i was taught when we bake it, because it tastes delicious without them.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,cream cheese,syrup,rice vinegar,navy bean,anchovy paste,ginger garlic paste,chicken bouillon
title: Pineapple Imperial
ingredients: 1 pineapple | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( from a jar of marinated anchovies ) | 1/2 cup creamy salad dressing ( i used rippy italian dressing ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( optional )
instructions: Cut the pineapple up, remove the stem and slice the flesh in half.  Cut the halves into slices, and remove the cores.  Remove the seeds from the pineapples, chop and combine the pineapple slices with the navy beans, anchovy paste, ginger garlic paste and 2/3 cup of salad dressing in a medium non reactive bowl.  Taste and adjust the seasoning.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 3 hours.  Drain the pineapple liquid from its can into a medium saucepan with a lid.  Add the remaining salad dressing, rice vinegar, chicken bouillon and peanut oil.  Heat through, stirring, and serve.

title: Smoked Ahi Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 cup medium chopped fresh mango | 3/4 cup thinly sliced celery | 3/4 cup thinly sliced cooked ahi tuna | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 2 cups ice cubes ( or as desired )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a glass serving bowl.  Top with ice cubes and smack ahi tuna with a fork.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,glutinous rice flour,cream tartar,dark rum,mint,eggplant,sultana,chicken thigh
title: Couscous Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 7 ounces glutinous-rice flour | 1 ounce sultana | 1 tablespoon fresh mint ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried mint ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 large boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 ounces dark rum ( optional ) | 1 eggplant ( very ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Mix glutinous rice, sultanas, mint, granules, and cream of tartar in a mixing bowl.  Slice the bottom of the skinned and attached eggplant into thin circles, about 2 inches in diameter, then sprinkle with a little water and place these slices on a large plate or tray.  Carefully and carefully place a spoonful of the rice mixture on each side of the chicken.  Tuck the skin over the tops of the chicken in a criss cross pattern, and leave this bread to drain in a colander or strainer for 20 minutes.  Wash and pat dry.  Sprinkle the outside of the bread with the chicken, and place each chicken breast on the tray.  Sprinkle the outside of each piece of bread with the eggplant.  Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of the chicken bouillon over each breast, and roll it into a tight cylinder.  Place the chicken in a casserole.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning occasionally.  Remove the plastic wrap, and slice the roll into 1/2 inch pieces.  Repeat with the remaining chicken breasts, placing them on individual plates as they are sliced.  Wine, muscat or brandy and mint can be stirred if desired.  Serve chicken with your favourite sauce for dipping.

title: Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb corkscrew macaroni ( or similar ) or 1 lb penne pasta ( or similar ) | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add a generous pinch of salt, if using.  Stir in the macaroni and return to a boil.  Add the sausage, stir well, and stir until cooked through.  Drain and toss with the buttermilk to coat.  Serve over pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,anchovy,marsala wine,rice wine vinegar,grain rice,baking potato
title: Sicilian Parsley Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry short-grain rice | 1/3 cup fresh mushrooms ( such as shitake or shiitake ) | 6 anchovies | 1 small baking potato, peeled | 1 teaspoon fresh celery leaves | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and cover with hot water.  Leave to stand for 20 minutes.  Drain the rice and place in a colander for 20 minutes.  Rinse the mushrooms under cold running water.  Remove the caps in strips, then chop each in half and place in a bowl with the anchovies, celery leaves and vinegar.  Fluff with a fork or a mortar and pestle.  Add to the rice, then mix thoroughly.  Replace the cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 12 hours.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,red wine vinegar,tomato green chile pepper,self raising flour,sherry wine
title: Pasta With Chiles and Tomato
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( do not use cooking sherry! ) | 1 can rotini pasta | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 2 1/4 cups chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers ( drained )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine vinegar, sherry, pasta and 1/4 cup water.  Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer over low heat for 6 - 8 minutes, or until pasta is tender.  Meanwhile, for topping, lightly grease a shallow ovenproof dish.  Stir flour and tomato into pasta mixture.  Pour mixture into dish, sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup green chilies and bake at 200°c/ 400°f for 30 - 35 minutes or until golden.

title: Mango-Spinach Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 6 tablespoons chopped passion fruit | 1/4 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Place sour cream, tomato paste, passionfruit and sumac in food processor and process until finely mixed.  Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Serve with prawns or chicken.

title: A Creamy Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup bailey's irish cream ( if you can find it, use tia maria or brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Serve either with your favourite chips or on top of fresh fruit slices or on a slice of fresh fruit.

title: Dee's Chickpea Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 large apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add potatoes and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain.  Place potatoes into a large bowl, mash with butter and salt to taste, then toss in the reserved chickpeas.  Pour into an 11x15 inch pan, and sprinkle with the chopped pecans.  Bake in the preheated oven until hot, about 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: potato,confectioner ' sugar,duck,peanut oil,egg yolk,stew meat,liquid smoke
title: Lola's Famous Duck Bites
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stew meat | 1/2 cup mashed potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 egg yolks, wellbeaten | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | oil ( for frying ) | 1 cup peanut oil
instructions: Combine potatoes, liquid smoke and egg yolks.

title: Eggs in Azul (Eggs)
ingredients: 1 egg, lightly beaten ( with a pinch of sugar added ) | 1 package sazon con azul ( use 1/2 cup for colouring, 1/4 cup for colour colouring )
instructions: Mix the eggs with sugar and salt.  Sprinkle the sazon con azul over the eggs and mix well.  Cover and let sit in the fridge.  In a skillet cook the eggs for 3 - 5 minutes and when the eggs are still slightly firm, turn them over.  Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: margarine,monterey jack cheese,tahini,mung bean sprout,jalapeno pepper,baking powder,herb,pork sparerib
title: Tahini Spaghetti

instructions: Combine the tahini w/the cheese, baking powder, and 1/2 of the marinade, stirring well.  Add half of the ham, pork spareribs, sprouts, jalapenos, and herbs, mashing. title: Mom's Vegetable Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 envelope brown gravy mix | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat over low heat.

title: Figs in Pineapple Sushi
ingredients: 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 package frozen chopped peperoncini peppers, drained | 7 fresh figs - halved | 1/4 cup crushed dried basil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Press the frozen whipped topping into the bottom of a bowl to cover.  Spread the peperoncini peppers around, leaving 1/2 inch of the flesh on each.  Place the figs on top of the peperoncini, then sprinkle over the dried basil, sage, and pepperoncini if using.  Drizzle the mixture with more pineapple juice if desired.

title: Easy Hot and Spicy Mushrooms for a Crowd

instructions: Wash mushrooms thoroughly under running water, rubbing between fingers to clean off the sand particles before removing them. Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,chicken broth,mushroom cap,worcestershire sauce,ro tel tomato,white onion,green cardamom
title: Spiced Tomato Chicken with Chutney

instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.  Add sliced onions and sun dried tomatoes and cook, stirring regularly, for 2 - 3 minutes. title: Low Calorie Crockpot Cajun Crabmeat

instructions: Combine the chili paste and splenda sugar in your crockpot place the crab in the crockpot.  Add the cheese. Enjoy note, i used 6 - 6 oz cans of crab which turned out good on the last 1/2 hour of cooking.

instructions: Prepare pinto beans according to package directions.  Meanwhile, boil asparagus spears in lightly salted water until just tender crisp, 7 - 8 minutes.  Drain. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine remaining ingredients.  Stir in beans.

title: Beef Barley Soup
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth ( or 1 14 ounce can ) | 2 cups pearl barley ( uncooked )
instructions: Combine the beef fat, broth, and barley in a saucepan.

instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees and place potatoes on a baking sheet with a light coating of oil.  Cook till tender.  While the potatoes are cooking, mix together ingredients and add to the mixture.  Bake potatoes for about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Pudding

instructions: Heat the milk in a kadhai or a small, heavy based pan.  In a bowl mix the salt and coriander powder, mix and add to the milk.  Bring it to boil and remove from the heat.  Divide the mixture onto two large aluminium baking pans and chill.  Turn over when the pudding has set.  Serve immediately as the pudding will be very dry and hot if you allow to it.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,brown sugar,marinara sauce,dark rum,tomato puree,bicarbonate soda,graham cracker crumb,white vinegar
title: Melon Balls With Baked Chermoula
ingredients: 3 tablespoons stone ground dark rum | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon baking soda ( optional ) | 150 ml canned tomato puree | 150 g marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 500 g ripe cantaloupe, peeled and cubed | 8 -10 slices good quality graham cracker crumbs ( i used ritz )
instructions: Place all the ingredients, except the chermoula, into a large bowl with a wooden spoon.  Mix well to combine.  Take the chermoula from the freezer and crush it with the back of a teaspoon.  Add the chermoula and mix together.  Roll tablespoonfuls of the mixture into balls of your desired size or shape into balls.  Place on a lined baking tin.  If using the ritz bread crumbs, sprinkle each ball with a good quantity of the crumbs.  Place in the fridge for 2 - 3 hours.  Bake in your preheated oven at 150 300°f for approximately 20 minutes.  Let cool down a little.  These should be completely dry and not browned.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Roasted Mushrooms and Fruit Compote (Food for the Heart) - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 10 shiitake mushrooms | 12 cremini mushrooms | 1 cup red seedless grapes | 6 cups mixed dried fruit ( figs, apricots, peaches and pineapple ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fenugreek leaves
instructions: Wash the mushrooms under running water, and place on the wire rack set over a baking sheet.  Remove and discard excess moisture from the caps and stems.  Cut each chantilly mushroom in half, then crosswise into six pieces each.  Place in the 4 cup pressure cooker, along with the grapes, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and the fenugreek leaves.  Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set on high pressure for 15 minutes.  Switch off the heat and let stand for 5 minutes before releasing the pressure.  Cool slightly and stir the compote into the stew in the pot.

instructions: Chop lettuce, carrots and olives.  Combine, in large bowl, all ingredients except cheese, and mix well.  Add cheese and mix well.  Serve in tall glass or martini glasses topped with crushed iceberg lettuce for garnish.

title: Lablabi - Drumsticks W- Harissa and Parsley
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb dried bread flour ( or 2 -3 cups ) or 1 -1 1/2 lb flour | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 pinch harissa ( or other dried chile pepper ) | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley, roughly chopped ( or 1 tablespoon dried thyme ) | vegetable drumsticks, etc
instructions: Place flour, salt and harissa or chile pepper in a plastic bag and shake to mix and set aside.  In a small bowl, stir together the minced parsley and the 2 tsp of fresh ground black peppercorns or thyme and toss with flour.  Cut the drumsticks into similar sized pieces to desired size about 2 or 3 inches long.  Dip in the marinade, then place them into large resealable plastic bags.  Turn the bags to coat them in the marinating mixture.  Seal the bags and shake until all coated well.  Let stand at room temperature for about 20 minutes.  Heat a skillet or griddle over medium high heat until a drop of water sizzles in it.  Place about 4 drumsticks into the skillet or griddle.  Cook, turning only once or twice, until nicely browned, about 5 minutes total.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Radish Bread
ingredients: italian bread ( any flavor ) | 4 -6 radishes | 1 dash vanilla
instructions: Put everything in a bowl.  Grate some fresh romano or parmesan over top, and enjoy.

title: Swiss Chard Cake

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Prepare a baking sheet by placing it in the centre of the oven.  In a mixing bowl, combine the celery, cornmeal, and flour.  With your hands or potato masher, mix the ingredients until they form a fairly firm dough.  Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, knead until smooth and slightly sticky, and roll out into a circle about 1/4 inch thick.  Cut into 12 wedges.  Place the wedges on the prepared baking sheet.  Cover with parchment or foil, and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Italian Fried Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs lean bottom round steaks, 1-inch thick | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 4 large ripe plantains, peeled and sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices | 2 teaspoons celery seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients except steaks.  Pat steak dry with paper towels.  Set aside.  Heat wok or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle beef in dry skillet.  Add steaks, reduce heat to medium, and cook to desired doneness, 12 to 15 minutes for medium rare.  Serve with plantains and french fried onions for dipping.

title: Torshi Lift (Torshi Lift)

instructions: Place torshi Lift into a bowl and smash with your hands.  Spread a little hot paprika onto your knuckle so it will spatter easily.  Sprinkle the grated carrot over the torshi Lift and press it over the torshi Lift to coat it.  Place into refrigerator until cool or serve when preferred.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,pine nut,pork loin chop,beef stock,tarragon

Serve with hot, crusty bread to dip.

title: Chunky Tomato Cream Cheese Dip

instructions: Combine cream cheese and tomato juice in a large serving bowl.  Blend well.  Add condensed broth and blend well.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

instructions: Preheat oven to mix biscuit mix and zucchini well.  Line a 9x13 pan with biscuit dough, pressing into a 6x8 pan.  Put a few slices of the hot dogs, on each biscuit slice. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

With the blender running, pour the hot stock into the blender and process until smooth.  Place the reserved chillies in a jar with a lid, add mustard and zest and shake to combine.  Pour this dressing into the green chilies.

title: Tex Mex Cheese Dip

2 tablespoons mrs.

instructions: In a bowl, combine the sherry, vinegar, ginger and sugar.

title: Mexican Green Chili Sauce

instructions: Empty contents of can onto the chilies.  Let simmer on a medium heat for one or two hours.

instructions: Combine meat, turnip, parsley, sesame seeds and meat tenderizer.  Shape into tiny balls.  Heat oil over high heat.  Brown meatballs in batches.  Drain on paper towels.  Discard fat, adding more oil as needed,.  Serve with rice or cooked egg noodles.

title: Okra with Cilantro

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the parsnips into a baking dish, and pour the water in to the baking dish.  Sprinkle with salt, and bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender.

2 -3 lbs beef stew meat, sliced into 8 slices ( or if you prefer, 2 -3 lbs.
    - each, see description above ) | 2 -4 cups kahlua | 10 ounces sweetened flaked coconut ( you can make your own, or mix up a jar of shredded coconut ) | 10 -15 slices jalapenos ( you can use canned, or whatever, but fresh is better ) ( optional ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 8 slices rye bread ( use any type of bread )

ingredients: 2 cups cooked red beans | 4 slices white bread | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional ) | 1 pinch oregano | 4 cups beef broth

Pour a cup of beef broth over the bread and toast squares.  Bake for 30 minutes.

instructions: Cook olive and water in sauce pan over medium heat until slightly thickened.  Bring to a boil.  When boiling, stir in turmeric.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cream of tartar. Cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until thick.  Remove from heat, stir in food colouring.  Pour into mold and chill a couple of hours until set.

instructions: Place wings into a large pot and cover with water.  Add mushrooms, onion, and chicken wings to a medium pot.  Bring mixture to a boil.

1 large red cabbage ( approx weight.
    - 4-5 cups ) | 1 mango ( about 1 lb, peeled and coarsely chopped and about 1-2 cups ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven 400 degrees.  In a large skillet or ovenproof bowl, layer cabbage, mango and bread crumbs.  Place in oven and bake 25 minutes, or until tender and topping is golden.

title: Vegetarian Panko & Mushroom Gremolata
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1/3 cup panko crumbs | 1 can coconut milk | 1/3 cup low-fat creme fraiche or 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained | 2 teaspoons vegan soy mascarpone cheese ( vegetarian is best ) or 2 teaspoons other goat cheese ( vegetarian is best ) | 2 medium sized shiitake mushrooms, trimmed and cleaned | 1 finely diced unpeeled vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a 2 - 2 1/2 cup baking dish with cooking spray.  Place rice into a large bowl, set aside to drain.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan of boiling water, stir bulgur.

title: Kielbasa and Avocado Appetizers
ingredients: 3 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 bag rye bread | taco chips
instructions: Remove rind from tomatoes and cut into 1 slices.  Spread each slice with desired amount of tomatoes.  Arrange a layer of the kielbasa on top of each tomato.  Add a layer of avocados.  Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Roll each slice of bread with the rind and secure with a toothpick.  Arrange the sandwich into a small frying pan over medium low heat and brown on each side.  Remove from heat, transfer to a paper towel lined plate, and allow to cool.  Top with taco chips to serve.

title: Easy Butternut Squash and Meat
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, cubed | 1 -2 lb meat, of choice | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat vegetable oil for frying.  Place cubed butternut squash in a colander over a bowl.  Toss to coat squash with oil and then place in the oil.  Fry to a medium tan brown colour and put aside on paper towel.  After 10 minutes, lift squash out of oil and coat with cooking spray.  Then return them to the oil and fry again to a tan colour.  Take out and drain on absorbent paper.  Serve with your favourite sauce.

title: Vegan Arhar Pies
ingredients: 2 prepared pie crusts ( you can use one per pie if you like to, they don't rise up ) | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1 green cardamom pods ( optional ) | 1 pinch ground cardamom pod
instructions: Roll the 2 pie crusts a little bit, a tablespoonful at a time and pierce all over with a fork.  The secret is in rolling so the crust doesn't stick to your fingers.  If your knife doesn't go into the center of the pies, you should just use an ordinary knife.  Bake the pies in a preheated oven 180c/350f/gas mark 4 for about 20 minutes until crisp on the top and light golden around the edges.  Cool a little bit.  To make the filling, take one teaspoon of coriander powder and sprinkle the cardamom powder over the ground green cardamon pod add some water or milk to thin it out a little.  If you have a blender or food processor, just blitz all the ingredients well and leave to stand for a few minutes the filling is ready to be used.  When the pies come out of the oven, brush some of the remaining melted butter on the tops.  Sprinkle with a little more ground cardamom if using and pop back in oven for about 5 minutes to brown the bottom.

title: Pampered Chef Spaghetti Beef
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin or 1 1/2 lbs round steaks | 7 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3/4 cup hot sauce | freshly squeezed lime | 3 cups uncooked spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  In large skillet, saute meat in hot sauce until done.  Drain off and reserve pasta.  Stir spaghetti into meat and cook until pasta is heated through.  Stir in spinach, tomatoes, lime juice, and hot sauce.  Place meat on large serving platter.  Pour hot pasta stew into bowls.

title: Roasted Garlic Roasted Tomatoes and Roasted Garlic (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 large head garlic ( about 5-6 cloves ) | 1 pint vegetable stock ( or use your favourite bottled stock ) or 1 pint chicken stock ( or use your favourite bottled stock ) | 16 ounces rolled oats ( plain or gluten-free ) | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f line a large baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking oil.  Peel and split the garlic cloves lengthways, being careful not to cut all the way through.  Put the cloves halves, cut side up, into a roasting tin.  Pour in the stock, or stock, and bake the garlic for 10 - 15 minutes, until it has softened and turned golden brown.  Add the rolled oats and toss well.  Scatter over the sun dried tomatoes and bake the tomatoes for a further 15 minutes or until the oaty mixture is golden.  Stir often to check that they are cooked, and check that they do not dry out.  Drizzle a spoonful of the roasting stock over the chopped tomatoes, allow them to rest for a few minutes before serving or cutting into wedges.  It will keep in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,walnut,green lentil,angel hair pasta,creme fraiche,coffee,lamb loin chop
title: Lamb Chops With Lentils & Apricots
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops | 1/4 cup green lentil | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 3 tablespoons hot coffee | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 2 ounces unsalted shelled walnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 ounces angel hair pasta or 2 ounces other tubular pasta
instructions: Heat an oven proof skillet over moderate heat.  Drain the lentils, rinse them under running water and let any excess moisture drip back into dish.  Slip off any clinging lentils and rinse under running water to rinse off any starch.  Combine lentils and crème fraîche in a medium deep bowl.  Stir in hot coffee and apricot jam.  Using your hands, rub 1 teaspoon curghony onto chops.  Let stand 1 to 4 minutes.  Place chops on top of lentils.  Spoon lentils and jam mixture over chops.  Sprinkle with walnuts.  Add the pasta.  Bake in middle of 500f degrees oven until browned, 45 to 75 minutes.  A meat thermometer inserted into the middle will also produce rare results.

title: Australian Mushrooms With Spinach and Irish Cream
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms | 2 lbs frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained | 1/3 cup cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons baileys irish cream ( optional ) | 1/2 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Slice mushrooms.  Combine with remaining ingredients in a large non stick frying pan.  Cook over medium heat until heated through and spinach is crisply heated through.  Serve immediately with lime wedges.

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Coat pan with cooking spray.  Add frozen spinach, green beans, mint, celery, cornstarch, lemon pepper and creole style seasoning.  Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.  Serve.

title: Creamy Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package portabella mushrooms, stems and all, sliced in half on the bottom and then sliced on the up sides | 2 egg yolks, whisked | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a large frypan heat the oil on medium heat.

title: Homemade Cilantro

instructions: Place cilantro leaves in a small bowl.  Fill 2 sprigs cilantro with water, pour water over and stir to release all green leaves.  Transfer to a decorative jar, leaving 1/2 inch of headspace.  Cap and label.  Keep refrigerated.

title: Fresh Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup basmati rice | 2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup plum tomatoes, cut in 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Place rice and stock in a medium saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Simmer for 12 minutes.  Add tomatoes and pepper.  Cover and simmer an additional 10 minutes, or until most of liquid is absorbed.

title: Gherkins on Vine!
ingredients: 1/4 cup horseradish | 2 roma tomatoes
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes by peeling the skin off the top and removing the flesh so that they are all the way down.  Using a sharp knife, slice all of the flesh down from the seeds and the rounded end.  It should not be too thin or too thick, i use a mandoline to cut in strips of approximately 1 1/2 or 2 centimeter wide.  This helps take the sharpness of the tomatos.  Drain off the excess water and mix in the horseradish and the tomatoes with as much of the juice from the tomatoes as you can get out of the rinds.  Cover and leave overnight in the refrigerator.  The longer you leave, the smoother they will be.  Serve in slices cut in 1/2 or 1/2 or with a dollop of plain icecream on top or a gherkin for an appetiser with pickled veggies.

title: Greek Arborio Rice

instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan with a lid or lid.  Bring to full boil over medium heat.

instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  While noodles are cooking, in mixing bowl combine cheese, soup and pepper.  When noodles are done, drain noodles and toss with cheese mixture.  If desired, mix in additional cheese.  Serve immediately.

Divide stuffing between the 2 wraps and top with bacon.  Serve with salsa.  Note for those really really hungry people, i like to serve them with my guacomole & sour cream.

title: Mashed Cabbage Coleslaw (Tossed Salad)

instructions: Mix the coleslaw mix and mayonnaise together and put in a large container and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Watermelon Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 leek | 1 liter watermelon | 4 pimentos | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 jar pimientos | 1 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, or to taste | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Cut off the ends of the leeks and cut them in half lengthwise.  Rinse leeks and cut into thin slices.  Place leeks in a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sauerkraut,mayonnaise,flat leaf parsley,plain flour
title: Sauerkraut Balls With Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 500 g sauerkraut | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: To make the sauerkraut, cover the base of a double thickness of baking paper with very warm water.  Bring to the boil, lower the heat to very low, cover the pan and cook for 30 minutes.  Add more water if it starts to evaporate slightly and continue cooking until the sauerkraut is very tender.  Remove from the heat, leave it to cool then drain well.  Place the drained sauerkraut in a mixing bowl and pour over the mayonnaise, cheese, mustard seeds and parsley then stir together.  Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and leave, in the fridge for an hour and a half so the flavours can develop.  Using wet hands, form the mixture into walnut sized balls.  Dust well with flour and shake off any excess, then place on lightly greased oven trays.  Leave for a few hours to dry.  To achieve this effect, preheat an oven to 190c/375f/gas lightly dust each piece with flour.  Bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes.

title: Prawns with Yogurt (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,baking powder,green cardamom pod,green pepper,sage,english mustard,ladyfinger
title: Lebanese Hot Dogs (Dajajaj Fouq Al-Leena)
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 300 g ready to use ladyfingers | 3 green cardamom pods | 3 ounces green and white peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon english mustard | 1/2 - 1 cup finely chopped english mustard | 4 teaspoons finely chopped green cardamom pods, for garnishing
instructions: In a clean towel, dry roast the cardomom pods on the open flame of a gas stovetop flame.  Immediately remove from heat.  Spread the cardom pods evenly on a clean tissue paper towel.  Allow to cool to room temperature.  Take a small sieve and drain off excess water.  Discard the cardom pods.  In a heavy saucepan, cook the green cardamom pods without stirring, until their aroma comes.  Remove their pods.  Place the sieve over the yogurt and transfer the yogurt to a bowl.  Allow it to cool.  Take one ladyfinger at a time and brush lightly with 1 - 2 teaspoons mustard.  Put one stuffed ladyfinger in the center of your palm and spread with a spoonful or the ground chilli.  Sprinkle the green cardamom over the top.  Sprinkle the finely chopped white/white pepper over the pepper layer.  Pour half the yogurt over the ladyfinger.  Fold the two ends over the contents of the ladyfinger.  Fold the top right and bottom left over the contents, then roll up and place on a serving plate.  Repeat for the remaining ladyfingers and yogurt.  Place the plate in the refrigerator until serving time.  Garnish with finely chopped cardamom, green and regular white onions.  Serve with salads, roti or breads.  Enjoy.

title: Spinach Nests With Pecans and Gruyere Nests
ingredients: 1 box angel hair pasta | 24 fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup freshly grated gruyere ( or more ) | 1/2 cup ground pecans | 2 cups fat-free beef broth | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar

Toss in pasta and coriander until thoroughly coated.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 20 minutes, preferably a little longer.  To serve, spoon equal amounts of the filling into each nckt.  Sprinkle each nut with confectioner's sugar and serve right away.

title: Fiesta Turkey Chip Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 6 ounces turkey bacon, uncooked and chopped | 1/2 cup whipped cream of tartar | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips | 16 cherry tomatoes, halved | 20 maraschino cherries, halved | 1 package pineapple rings, cut into halves
instructions: Combine flour, turkey bacon, cream of tartar, and tortilla chips in a bowl.  Stir turkey bacon mixture and tomatoes into flour mixture.  Transfer mixture into a greased 11 x 7 inch baking dish.  Spoon pineapple halves over top.  Cover and chill at least 2 hours and up to 3 days.

title: Crock Pot Lamb Shanks

instructions: Place all ingredients in your crock pot except the lamb shanks.  I use medium setting because i get about 2 hours to every hour.  Turn to low and cook 5 hours.  Turn again and continue to cook for 6 - 8 more hours depending on desired thickness of meat.

title: Cheater's Easy Mexican Rice

instructions: Place rice and 2 1/2 cups water in large pan and bring to boil,.  Cover, reduce heat to low, and steam for 20 minutes.  Place pinto beans and poppy seeds in food processor or blender and puree.  Add mixture to rest of pan.  Add taco seasonings and margarine and mix.  Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: salt,chive,ricotta cheese,italian cheese,fine bread crumb,daikon radish,chili
title: Napa Dave's Daikon Radis (Daikon and Chile Risotto)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes, peeled ( about 12 ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 3 cups fine dry bread crumbs | 3 packages fresh ricotta cheese ( about 9 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 -2 pinch chili | 1 -2 teaspoon minced, seeded chili, to taste
instructions: Grate the daikon radish coarsely.  Place radishes in a large bowl of cold water to cover.  Add the salt and let stand until slightly tender, 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain the radishes well and pat dry with paper towels.  Put bread crumbs in a 1 cup measure and set aside.  In a large bowl, stir the remaining ingredients together until mixture is moistened.  Divide mixture into four balls of about 2 tablespoons, each measuring about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  On a lightly floured surface, pat each ball into a 7 inch long, 1 inch wide oval shape.  Wrap each oval with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, 20 minutes or up to 2 days.  Transfer radishes to a work surface and sprinkle with salt and let rest 10 minutes then peel away excess salt.  Cut the chilled daikon into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Spread slices on a flat baking sheet about 3/4 inch thick and press the slices with a spatula so that excess moisture runs out.  Sprinkle with chives and chillies and refrigerate until firm, 2 - 3 hours.  Heat a large, heavy pot over high heat until a bead of water sizzles on the bottom.  Carefully lay 6 radishes in the center of a circle, overlapping them as needed to fully enclose them.  Put a radish in the center of each circle and spread out 1 teaspoon of ricotta cheese, sprinkling on 1 teaspoon of chives and chives.  Fold the radish slices in half and place it on the ricotta with the remaining radishes in the center.  Cover the top with 1 1/2 cups of the bread crumbs and press lightly to compact the shape.  Carefully roll out the daikon and scatter it over the filling.  Transfer the risotto to a parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Using a pastry brush, brush the surface of the risotto with water.  Place in a 400°f oven and bake, 15 - 20 minutes, until the topping is golden brown and puffed.  Remove from the oven and transfer to a bowl.  Serve at once.

title: Mango & Apricot Dip With Sage
ingredients: 2 medium ripe mangoes, halved & stone removed | 8 ounces rye bread | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained & chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh herb ( rosemary, thyme, oregano, basil )
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place mangoes halves on a rack in a broiler proof baking dish.  Broil about 4 inches from heat, turning occasionally, until they are softened & lightly charred, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Place bread cut side up on a baking sheet.  Brush 1 side of each slice w/the oil.  Mix 1 tblsps.  Of the apricot jam w/the sun dried tomato & 1 tblsps.  Wine syrup.  Spread 1/3 cup of jam in the bottom of each of 4 serving dishes & top with mangos.  Top each with a dollop of the remaining jam w/the sun dried tomato & herb.  Broil until the dip is bubbly & golden, 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Garbanzo and Turmeric Iceberg Lettuce
ingredients: 1 lettuce | 1 bunch fresh turkish iceberg lettuce | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained or | 2 cups double cream | 1 lemon
instructions: Gently wash the lettuce under cold water and slice into four pieces or 1/4 1/2 inch wide strips depending on the size of the iceberg lettuce.  Separate the lettuce leaves from the stalks and place them into a bowl.  Mix the garbanzo beans, cream, salt, and turmeric together in a small bowl, then pour most of the cream mixture over the lettuce, tossing to coat.  Arrange the lettuce leaves on a serving platter.  Grate a thin wedge of lemon over the top and scatter it around the lettuce.  Pour the remaining cream mixture over the salads, garnish with sprigs of turmeric.

Random Ingredients: tequila,thai basil,spice,cake flour,watercress,beef bouillon cube,hamburger,rice vinegar
title: Carolina Beef (Or Lamb) Pies, Japanese Style; Sweet or Hot!
ingredients: 1/3 cup instant rice vinegar | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 cups water, to make 2 cups ( use beef broth ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon mixed spice ( or to your liking ) | spice, to your liking ( optional to use in beef or pork pies ) ( optional ) | 5 slices precooked hamburger ( can use any meat, pork, chicken, beef or sausage, we had a combo of those and, if you don't use that, use a little bit of any of the spices listed at bottom ) | 5 slices tequila ( you may use your favourite brand ) | 6 sprigs watercress ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: In a big mixing bowl, put in the vinegar, dissolve the bouillon cube in the water, let cool a little to about room temperature.  Cut in the meat and mix it with your taste/spices, and set aside.  In a small frying pan, heat up the oil, once it is about 4/6' deep pour the oil into the pan and fry until it starts to darken slightly.  Add the diced raw meat, if using and fry all of it till cooked, drain.  Place in the bowl you will be using next.  To serve, put the meat mixture in a pie dish, put the rice on top of the meat mixture on the meat mixture.  Pour some of the marinade on top of the pie.  If you are using any of the marinade ingredients, you may bake the pie in a preheated 400' oven for 20 minutes, then put on the broiler for a few minutes until the top is toasted. title: Cabbage Tea Bread

title: Filipino Pork Chops With Warm Vermicelli (Paupao)

ingredients: 1/2 kg piece beef stewing beef ( or shin beef ) | 1 can tomatoes with green chile peppers, diced, undrained | 1 serrano chili, finely chopped | 1 celery rib, diced | 2 teaspoons red jalapeno or 2 teaspoons jalapeno pickled serrano chili powder
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes.  Place on foil lined baking sheet.  Combine remaining ingredients and spread over beef.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 8 hours.  Place a sheet of foil over the top of the meat and press meat firmly.  Remove any air pockets and foil.  Wrap foil tightly around meat and foil.  Place on barbecue grill and cover with direct light.  Bbq, basting often with any juices from the beef.  Cook 20 minutes, turning once.  Unwrap and serve.

title: Cucmber Wrapped  Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces brussels sprouts ( in the can ) | 7 ounces whole kernel corn | 12 ounces prosciutto | 4 ounces unsalted butter | 1 ounce dark chocolate ( or a mixture of dark unsweetened and white chocolate ) | 1 english cucumber ( or halved, or to taste ) | 6 tablespoons pineapples ( or chopped small pieces of fresh pineapple ) | 1 ounce pistachios ( optional )
instructions: First make the dressing by placing all the ingredients in a food processor and process until melted and creamy.  Slice the brussels sprouts in half lengthwise.  Remove the cores, then slice diagonally into 1 inch pieces.  Place all the sprouts except the pineapples into a large skillet or saute pan, and add about 3/4 cup of water.  Bring to a boil, and add all the brussels sprouts.  Turn the heat down, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until brussels sprouts are tender.  Turn off to keep warm.  To serve, place slices of prosciutto about an inch across on a plate.  Place the cooked brussels sprouts on top of the prosciutto, and top with slices of cucumber, peanuts, and pineapple pieces.

title: Stove Beef and Gravy
ingredients: 1 bag stewing beef | 1 can cream of celery soup ( cream of celery soup can be substituted )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan on medium high heat.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer about 30 minutes, or until meat is tender and gravy has thickened.  Serve with bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,parmesan cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,liquid smoke,mustard seed
title: No Fry Sticks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups liquid smoke
instructions: On a wax paper, spread about 1/3 cup of the pepper jack cheese and 1/2 cup of the parmesan cheese.  Sprinkle the remaining cheese over both cheeses.  Fold the edges of each piece tightly over the filling, pinching them together.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Heat a little oil in a medium frying pan.  Use tongs to place one stuffed wonton wrapper on top of the pepper jack cheese.  Fry the wonton wrapper over medium/medium high heat for 45 - 60 seconds, turning it over as needed.  Remove from heat and place on a cake rack.  Keep warm until all the frosting is gone.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,green chili pepper,rice flour,tarragon,pecan nut,paprika,flat leaf parsley
title: Filled Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried tarragon | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup rice flour, or as needed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans or 2 tablespoons nut nuts | 1/4 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked rice and green chili peppers, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the dried tarragon and peppers.  Remove and discard the stems and ribs from the chile and add it to the bowl.  Add the rice, stir and let stand for an hour.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove the phyllo sheets from package and separate them.  Place one sheet on a work surface.  Brush the top with beaten egg yolk.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup rice flour on the sheet.  Place 1/4 teaspoon of dried tarragon mixed with the pecans or nuts on the next sheet and top with 1/4 teaspoon paprika, followed by 1/4 teaspoon of dried tarragon mixed with the dried chopped green chili peppers.  The sheets should be about 2 inches long.  Using a 5 or 6 phyllo sheet, fold and envelope the phyllo sheets, seam side down, to enclose about 4 or 5 sheets in the shape of a triangle.  Repeat folding, envelope style, to make 10 more triangles.  Press 1 or 2 sheets together to seal.  Place the triangles on a lightly oiled baking sheet.  Repeat with the remaining phyllo sheets and sheets.  Set aside while making the filling.  Cook the rice and green chilies on the rice, covered until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is dry, 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve 1 or 2 triangles per person.

title: Noodles With Watercress and Sprouts
ingredients: 6 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 bunch watercress, washed and trimmed
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in salted, boiling water according to package directions.  Drain.  Place watercress in another saucepan, add noodles and water.  Bring to boil, add the sprouts and cook for 2 minutes until noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,heavy whipping cream,oregano leaf,wheat germ,chili pepper flake,sesame seed,sake,leek
title: Maki's Korean Salad (Sake)
ingredients: 2 leeks ( white part only ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup good sake | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 tablespoons fresh grated korean dried chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grained wheat germ
instructions: Trim the leeks, then slice in half lengthwise, remove the roots and thick stalk.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel the leeks as thinly as possible and cut into matchstick size pieces.  If you have a mandoline, chop your leeks into matchstick sized pieces.  Combine the chopped leeks, heavy whipping cream, sake, sesame seeds, oregano, chili flake, sesame seeds, chili flakes and wheat germ in a large salad bowl.  Toss lightly to combine well.  Sprinkle with the grated korean peppers and serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,black mustard seed,parmesan cheese,savoy cabbage,pomegranate seed,kalamata olive
title: Sizzling Kiwifruit Salad
ingredients: 500 g savoy cabbage | 100 g parmesan cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 sprig kalamata olive | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds or 1/2 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 kiwi fruit
instructions: Separate cabbage leaves, keeping 2 of them separate.  Place the grated cheese, pomegranate seeds, black mustard seeds and olives in a bowl.  Toss well to mix.  Core, peel & chop kiwifruit into bite size pieces place into the bowl with cheese mixture.  Toss well to combine.  Just before serving, sprinkle with extra grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: red wine,italian chicken sausage,shrimp,dark red kidney bean,extra virgin olive oil,cream,hazelnut,baby spinach
title: Angel Hair Pasta with Sausage, Shrimp & Sweet Red Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian chicken sausage, casings removed ( sweet or hot, your preference ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined ( about 2 or 3 large peeled shrimp ) | 1 can dark red kidney beans, rinsed ( about 3 cups ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, shelled, lightly toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups light sour cream | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 8 cups fresh baby spinach
instructions: Place sausage in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat and stir to break up clumps, cooking until well browned, about 10 minutes.  Remove sausage from skillet and set aside.  Pour olive oil into skillet and heat over medium heat.  Add shrimp and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.  Transfer shrimp and sausage to a bowl and stir in kidney beans, hazelnuts and sour cream.  Return sausage mixture to skillet and turn heat to medium.  Stir wine into sausage mixture.  Cover bowl and simmer until shrimp are just cooked through, about 4 minutes.  Remove casings from spinach by running it under warm running water, letting it drip off.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: french fry,yeast,monterey jack pepper cheese,spaghetti sauce,peppercorn,lime zest,italian bread
title: Easy French Fries With Pepperjack
ingredients: 1 cup spaghetti sauce ( your favourite variety, i used ragu pepperjack ) | 7 ounces bread, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( crusty or gluten free ) | 2 - 3 teaspoons yeast | 3 cups french fries, cut in 1-inch thick sticks | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 1/2-2 cups cheddar cheese | 2 limes, zest of | 10 -15 whole peppercorns
instructions: In a large bowl, mix spaghetti sauce, bread, yeast, ½ cup of cheese, 2 - ½ tablespoons of lime zest.  Add peppercorns & mix.  Cover & let sit about 20 minutes.  Drain bread, reserve liquid.  Add to bowl, coating lightly.  Stir.  Cover & return to warm place, allow to double or triple.  Turn on oven broiler & place french fries in lightly oiled 9x13 baking dish.  Cover with remaining cheese.  Cover & put back in oven until hot 3 - 5 minutes.  Remove from oven, add pepperjack, return to oven & broil.  Bake uncovered for 5 – 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.  Serve with a green salad.

title: Peppered Tomatoes
ingredients: 7 lbs hot italian tomatoes | 1/4 cup whole cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 250ºf and place tomatoes in a large shallow baking pan.  Pour boiling water about 1/2 inch deep into pan.  Bring water to a boil and add 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon.  Bake 10 minutes.

title: Chorizo Asparagus Tips
ingredients: 1 cup asparagus tips, tips sliced into 2 1/2-inch lengths | 4 links chorizo sausage, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 2/3 cup superfine sugar | 8 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Place asparagus tips in a bowl.  Cover with cold tap water.  Set aside until just tender, 3 to 10 minutes.  Drain.  Cover and keep at room temperature.  Meanwhile, heat a large skillet to medium.  Cook asparagus tips, sugar, and hot pepper sauce in hot skillet about 10 minutes, stirring frequently until sugar is dissolved.  Stir asparagus mixture and remaining hot pepper sauce into warm chorizo mixture.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,lime,vanilla pudding mix,fast rising yeast,pecorino cheese,lemon juice zest,bleu cheese salad dressing,cream cheese
title: Bourekas - Bite sized Muffins
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 pint sour cream ( or plain yogurt ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 3 lemons, juice and zest of | 2 packages of grated pecorino cheese ( salad dressing ) or ( 3 ounce ) packages grated pecorino cheese ( salad dressing ) | 1 cup freshly made cauda bureu cheese or 1 cup romano cheese, freshly made mixed with lots of sugar | 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/4 cup freshly made orange juice
instructions: Dissolve yeast with a pinch of sugar in a mixing bowl.  Beat together cream cheese and sour cream and set aside.  Combine the yeast mixture well. Cover with 1/2 of the saucrego leaves, 1/2 of the cheese mixture, 1/2 of the bureu cheese, and remaining sour cream.  Repeat layers and top with 1/2 of the mozzarella and bureu cheese.  Cover with top and knead lightly.  Form into a compact rectangle on top of the baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and a towel, and refrigerate overnight.  To bake, preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit, and bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly, and filling is very heated through.

title: The Real Chicago Calzones
ingredients: 6 slices salami | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place salami on a sheet of aluminum aluminum foil.  Cover with the salami, and season with salt and pepper.  Wrap tightly in the aluminum foil.  Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Open the foil for the last 10 minutes to crisp cheese.

title: Lamb and Pumpkin Rolls
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound lean ground lamb | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cups sliced thawedpack frozen pumpkin
instructions: Prepare idahoan signature™ russet potato hash traditional idahoan signature™ russet potato hash traditional idahoan signature™ russets mashed potato hash according to the package directions without salt added.  Cook ground lamb in a large skillet just until meat is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,italian tomato sauce,rye flour,plum tomato,fettuccine,chicken breast,yellow pepper
title: Fettuccine With Chicken and Chiles
ingredients: 9 ounces dry fettuccine or 9 ounces medium-fettuccine | 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 1/2 cups sliced yellow peppers ( about 1/2 a pepper ) | 2 cups plum tomatoes ( about 1 large ripe tomato ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken flavored hot cocoa powder | 3 cups canned tomato sauce
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente.  Drain and cool under running water or microwave.  Combine chicken and any juices in a large crockpot.  Top with vegetables.  Add pasta and remaining ingredients to crockpot.

title: Greek Stuffed Plantains
ingredients: 4 medium plantains, peeled ( yellow or white ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground lamb | 1 1/2 - 2 cups grated romano cheese or 1 1/2-2 cups asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees.  Cut off the tops about 1/4 from top of each plantain, scoop out some of the pulp, and discard.  Fill each plantain with the lamb, packing it in loosely so meat won't fall out.  Mix the cheese with the pulp and some water in a bowl.  Pinch the pulp into small balls with your hands about 2 inches in diameter, and place on a cookie sheet.  Sprinkle a little salt over the top of each ball, then bake for 20 minutes, uncovered, until golden brown.  Remove, and allow to cool until easy to handle.  Serve with a salad or garlic bread and a nice loaf of rustic country bread.  These plantains can also be prepared in the oven and served with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: polenta,virgin olive oil,anise seed,cabbage,raspberry,apple cider,brown rice
title: Raspberry-Rice Salad With Baked Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 1/2 cup raspberries ( preferably organic ) or 1/2 cup orange juice ( preferably organic ) | 1 cup cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon chipotles in adobo or 1 tablespoon chipotle powder, to taste | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons apple cider
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Combine the rice, raspberries or orange juice, cabbage, chipotle and olive oil together and toss in the anise seed.  Spread the mixture in a lightly oiled 8x8 inch glass baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: cream,chicken breast half,creole seasoning,brown sugar,iceberg lettuce
title: Creole Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/3 cup creole seasoning | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1 cup sour cream | 3 heads iceberg lettuce, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix the chicken breast meat, 1/3 cup creole seasoning, brown sugar and sour cream.  Place approximately 1/2 cup chicken mixture on a lettuce leaf and roll up, securing with toothpicks if you wish.  Place roll in a foil lined roasting pan.  Place roasting pan in oven.  After 15 minutes, turn the temperature down to 350 degrees f.  Roast chicken until internal temperature is 165 degrees f when inserted in the thickest part of the breast, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cold water,pesto sauce,radish,lemon juice zest,garlic salt,cream cheese,mustard powder
title: Pesto Cream Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 1 package light cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup pesto sauce, any flavor | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( or lime ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon cold water | 6 whole radishes
instructions: Set oven on broil.  Mix cream cheese, pesto, lemon juice, mustard powder, garlic salt, and cold water in a bowl.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup sliced leek | 1 package skirt steak, cut into thin strips | 1 jar sliced pork and beans | 1 can pearled barbeque sauce | 2/3 cup dark brown currant | 1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.  Add leeks.

instructions: Place the peppers in a small bowl and pour boiling water over them and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes then drain.  Place the peppers in a food processor with the sour cream and blend to a coarse paste.  Divide the mixture between 4 sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace.  Wipe the rims with a clean dry cloth and place on a rack to cool in a cool place before storing in the fridge for up to 10 days.  To serve, bring to room temperature and stir.  Lingered sugar optional, for an extra kick of color.  For a darker colour, use 1/4 cup brandy.  For a sweeter colour, add 2 teaspoons honey and 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch dissolved in a little cold water, or substitute with 1/4 cup white sugar.

title: Creamy Caponata Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 ounce dark rum or 1 ounce dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon sugar syrup | 2 teaspoons capers, drained and finely chopped |  iceberg lettuce or torn, leaves
instructions: Combine rum and sugar syrup in a small bowl and simmer on low heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until it is reduced by ¾.  Remove from heat and cool.  Whisk in capers and fill in a salad bowl.  Serve while hot.  Note, caponata is made with capers, and travels well within a small canner.

title: Quick and Easy Ziti
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dry ziti pasta | 1/2 cup chopped celery, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,dark soy sauce,pearl barley,rice,green pepper,herb,honey,puff pastry
title: Vegetable & Barley Scrolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 150 g dried rice | 25 g mixed herbs | 1 green pepper, deseeded & diced | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 375 g ready-rolled puff pastry sheets | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Place barley, rice and mixed herbs in non metallic bowl and mix well.  Cover & set aside.  Place red pepper and honey in a saucepan and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes.  Add the rice and barley & mix well.  Boil for about 15 mins, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat & pour onto a plate.  Roll out the pastry sheets on a lightly floured board to make 2 sheets.  Use a 6cm round biscuit cutter to cut out a circle approximately 5cm in diameter.  Repeat until you have 5 circles.  Place approximately 1 tablespoon of chopped vegetables, half the rice mixture and half the mixed herbs on each sheet of pastry.  Fold the excess pastry over the filling & brush the edges with water.  Brush the pastry with some of the remaining beaten egg.  Repeat with remaining pastry, stuffing & herbs till all filling is used up.  Bake in a casserole dish for 20 mins, brushing with some of the remaining beaten egg.  Serve hot.

ingredients: 8 ladyfingers | 85 g cream of coconut ( dairy sweetened with milk ) | 85 g semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup vegetable broth or 1/4 cup water
instructions: To make sponge fingers, put savoiardi fingers into a bowl and sprinkle with the sugar.  Cover with plastic wrap and put in the fridge to marinate for 15 minutes at least.  After 15 minutes, take it again and drain off excess liquid.  In a bowl, put cream of coconut, chocolate chips, and bouillon granules.  Cut cucumber, into rings, and add to bowl.  Sprinkle with italian seasoning.  Mix together.  After 15 minutes, take it out of the fridge and spread out on counter.  Spread mixture on the marshmallow sponge fingers.  Put in fridge for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chocolate-Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups chocolate, grated ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Put chocolate and vanilla in a mixing bowl.  Stir well with a fork and continue stirring until thick.  The sauce will thicken up quickly.  Keep refrigerated and leftovers will last up to three weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Red Pepper  Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and use as required.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,tabasco sauce,beef tenderloin,yellow cake mix,rice flour
title: French Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 6 tablespoons rice flour | 6 tablespoons yellow cake mix | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 6 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Trim any visible fat from the meat.  Tear and tie the meat into a double thickness aluminum foil package.  Combine rice flour and cake mix in a small bowl.  Pour oil into a large nonstick skillet to a depth of 1/4 inch.  Sprinkle the pine nuts over the top.  Place over moderately high heat until butter sizzles.  Add the meat, in three portions and brown on all sides.  Place in the slow cooker with the browned surface on top.  Sprinkle meat with remaining pine nuts.  Do not drain.  Cook on low setting for 4 - 6 hours or on high setting for 3 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,shiitake mushroom,hamburger bun,chili sauce,grape jelly
title: Hot Shiitake Burger
ingredients: 4 slices lean hamburger bun | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon bottled chili sauce | 1 ounce grape jelly | 2 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Brush both sides of each slice of buns with dark brown sugar.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add 1/4 cup of the mushroom sauce to the pan.  Stir often to keep the mushroom from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Remove from heat.  Place burgers in bun.  Top with remaining mushroom sauce.  Sprinkle with jelly and/or cheese.  Serve immediately.

title: Famous Sauce to Fill Frying Sauce
ingredients: 1 can hunts tomato sauce | 1 jar pimentos, minced | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Combine tomato sauce and minced onion in 3 qt saucepan.  Heat over medium heat.  Bring to boil.  Stirring frequently, cook approximately one minute or until it bubbles.  Stir in pimentos and marjoram.

title: Moroccan Dessert Fondant
ingredients: 1 lb confectioners'sugar | 1 stalk fresh lemon grass, finely chopped | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary | 8 cups fresh corn, whole corn kernels cut off
instructions: In a saucepan, mix confectioners' sugar, lemon grass, and rosemarmary.  Gradually pour in enough water to cover and bring to a simmer.  Simmer, stirring constantly, for 15 minutes, or until syrupy.  Drop in corn, and simmer for 10 more minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Cherry Pie Filling
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling ( 1 can ) | 3/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 2 teaspoons tapioca | 2 mint sprigs
instructions: Heat sugar in saucepan until sugar has dissolved.  Stir in corn syrup and ketchup.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring often.  Remove from heat and stir in tapioca.  Spoon into 2 pie dishes.  Garnish with mint.

title: Kirsch Pommeri (Basil Pomegranate)
ingredients: 1 bottle kirsch ( or your favorite liqueur ) | 1 can or bottle basil leaves, drained, rinsed
instructions: Pour the kirsch into a small, shallow bottle and add the basil leaves to the top.  Let the kirsch mixture stand in a cool, dark place for 3 days.

title: Artichoke Rice Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cups rice, uncooked | 1/2 lb mascarpone or 1/2 lb cream cheese, cubed | 2 tablespoons honey ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 can artichoke hearts ( drained and quartered, i prefer baby artichokes, and drained well, or if you wish more can artichokes if you wish )
instructions: Cook rice as directed on package.  Let cool completely, refrigerate.

title: Indian Spices - Spices
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground coriander seeds | 1 large pinch saffron strand ( can be found at indian stores ) | water or water
instructions: Place the seeds and saffron in your blender and process well.  Slowly pour water to cover the seeds and saffron.  Process for 2 - 4 minutes until all the water is absorbed.  You may strain the solids through a cheese cloth or paper.  Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Shrimp And Lettuce Soup
ingredients: 500 g jumbo shrimp ( shell on or off ) | 125 ml full fat buttermilk | 250 g lettuce | 1 tablespoon of minced onion ( a small, fresh kind such as walli walli ) | 1 tablespoon of tamarind paste ( diluted with a little water ) | 1/2 tablespoon yogurt | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: Heat the buttermilk in a pan on high heat and add the shrimp.  The shrimp will start separating and cook on one side.  Turn the shrimp and let the other side cook.  When shrimp are just cooked through, remove for a few minutes and transfer to a bowl.  Heat the remaining buttermilk on medium heat and add the onions, tamarind concentrate, yogurt and cream.  When the onion is softened add the paste and let simmer for 10 minutes.  If the paste is too thin, whisk in a little water.  Add the lettuce to the soup and stir.  Serve the soup with a garnish of shredded lettuce and a bowl of mixed rice.

title: Mushrooms on the Half Shell
ingredients: 24 large mushroom caps, cleaned and stems removed | 2 stalks celery, sliced | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Fill a 6 quart non stick skillet with water.

title: Gremolata (Gemeatan Parsley)
ingredients: 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, stems removed | 1/2 cup grated orange zest
instructions: Remove the stems from the parsley stems.  Finely chop the stems and leaves.  Stir the chopped parsley stems into the orange zest.

title: Mango & Blueberry Salad in Farfalle Croutons
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs uncooked farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried mangoes or 2 tablespoons apricots, crushed | 6 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 3 cups fresh blueberries, rinsed
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions using only 1 t.  Of the cooking oil.  Drain.  Combine farfalle & mango in a large bowl & stir in 1 t.  Of the parsley, the blueberries w/ the remaining parsley & the remaining 2 t.  Of the oil.  Stir in the remaining parsley & pour the dressing over the farfalle.  Sprinkle the remaining teaspoon of parsley over the top & serve warm.  Note, to make a more rustic taste & a more colourful color, you can make the dressing ahead of time w/more oranges, as the fruit leather will provide a slightly unpleasant color if left untreated.  Note, to make 2 servings, serve 1/2 pint of the blueberries w/the remaining dressing or as the salad + add any fruit you may like & add a little fresh minced fruit for presentation.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,silken tofu,corn oil,vegetarian bean
title: Green Beans and Tofu in Spicy Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 lb firm tofu, cut into chunks | 8 ounces vegetarian baked beans ( any type you prefer ) | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Bake tofu for 10 minutes at 475°f remove and cool.  Slice tofu into 6 pieces.  Set aside and keep warm.  In the same skillet with oil, add beans and cook on low for 5 minutes until tender.  Add tofu and toss over high heat for an additional 5 minutes.  Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,romano cheese,natural peanut butter,green chile pepper
title: Pancake Mix
ingredients: 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 3/4 cup grated romano cheese | 3 tablespoons natural peanut butter
instructions: Crumble the ricotta cheese into a large bowl.  Mash green chile peppers with a spoon and toss with ricotta cheese.  Stir in romano cheese and peanut butter.  Transfer mixture to an air tight container for storage.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Kesha - Arabic Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1 cup buckwheat flour | 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 cup walnuts | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 2 cups walnut oil
instructions: Mix the flour and nuts together in a large bowl.  Add the oil to the walnuts and pine nuts, and mix into the dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Turn onto a lightly floured board, knead lightly 10 times.  Place in a deep, clean jelly roll pan about 3 inches in diameter, brush with some of the oil.  Spread the bread with the rest of the paneer batter.  Preheat the oven to 380 degrees f.  Bake the bread on the middle oven shelf of the oven for about 40 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Spicy Banana Salad (Bananas W- Chutney)
ingredients: 2 bananas, ripe and sliced | 1/4 cup sweet chili | 1 -2 tablespoon marinade ( homemade flavour if available )
instructions: Arrange bananas on serving plates and add more chilli.  To marinate, put your chilli and sweet chutney in a small jar or jar.  Cover, shake until mixed well.  Divide mixture between plates, sprinkle with marinade and serve immediately.

title: Peruvian Spaghetti Soup
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 large jalapeno, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup freshly grated parsley | 2 tablespoons cooked spaghetti | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, mix quinoa, vegetable broth, jalapeno, parsley, and spaghetti.  Increase heat to high, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Faux Spiced Spiced Couscous
ingredients: 3 cups couscous ( i used jasmine ) | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( don't substitute ) | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese

In a food processor, process graham cracker crumbs, paprika, saffron and 10g paprika into a coarse crumbs until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Combine with rest of mixture in a bowl.  Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.  Place skewers on a flat working surface.  Thread meat onto skewers and rub spice paste onto all skewers.  Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours.  Preheat grill.  Cut meat into 2 - 2 - ½ inch pieces.  Brush with sauce.  Cook under grill for 12 minutes or until brown on all sides.  Serve with gravy poured around skewers.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,extra virgin olive oil,cinnamon sugar,pineapple juice
title: Fresh Fruit Preserve
ingredients: 12 medium basil leaves, lightly packed | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon sugar | 1 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Cut 1 1/2 inch thick slices of the basil leaves from bottom to base.  Put the stem side of a leaf on your work surface.  Sprinkle the bottom edge of the leaf with a generous amount of the basil leaves.  Arrange it on top of the basil leaves and press lightly with a wooden spoon to make sure the basil is well packed.  Dissolve the cinnamon sugar in the pineapple juice, approximately 1/4 cup, and pour into a shallow bowl.  When the pulp from the pineapple is pulverized, gently crush it with a potato masher or a molcajete.  Transfer the fruit to the pineapple juice.  Serve at once.

instructions: Combine the graham cracker crumbs and 1 teaspoon garlic paste in a medium bowl.  Coat the rims of 2 large rimmed baking sheets with cooking spray. title: Chicken Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 cups milk | 1 chicken breast | 4 cups rice noodles, cooked and drained ( if your uncooked ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice
instructions: Cook the chicken cut it into thin strips or bite size chunks.  Put it on low heat, put the chicken in the pot and add 2 cups of milk.  Bring the milk just to a simmer.  Add the rice noodles and stir.  Place the tomatoes on top and take the pot off the heat.  Let it rest for 10 minutes.  Serve.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/4 cup coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Mix together.  Let refrigerate overnight if possible.  Serve chilled.
