instructions: Place bean curd, horseradish and 1/2 tsp salt into food processor.  Pulse until a smooth dough forms then form into a small ball. Program french bread machine for the danish fry cycle.

title: Paprika (Puerto Rican Spam)

instructions: Heat a medium pan over medium high heat.  Place the spam in the pan and sprinkle the liquid smoke over all.  The liquid smoke will cook the spam.  Sprinkle the moong dal over all and mix well.  Remove from heat and allow to sit for about 5 minutes.  After 5 minutes, stir and toss the spam so that the salt adheres evenly throughout.  Cover. Random Ingredients: onion flake,angel hair pasta,white wine vinegar,catsup,maple syrup,salsa,guacamole,beef tenderloin
title: Slow Cooker Art Mignon
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin, fat trimmed | 1 bottle salsa | 1 jar diced onion flakes | 1 bottle white wine vinegar | 2 cups catsup | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 6 ounces sun-dried tomatoes ( packed in oil ), chopped | 8 ounces angel hair pasta
instructions: In 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart or larger slow cooker, alternate layers of meat, tomatoes, onions, wine vinegar, catsup, and maple syrup.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 10 to 11 hours.  Remove and discard meat from slow cooker.  If desired, cut meat into thin slices and serve as a side dish with baked potatoes and vegetables.

title:
Golden Chicken With Shrimp & Golden Honey.
    -
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, skin on | 500 g baby shrimp, cleaned, peeled | 2 tablespoons lardons or 2 tablespoons other lean fat | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | cayenne paprika | 3 tablespoons golden syrup or 3 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: First cut the chicken thighs into 2 lengths, cutting about three quarters each.  Place them into an ovenproof casserole dish, skin side down, with the breasts skin side first.  Heat 2 tbs oil in a frying pan over high heat.  Cook shrimp for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until they just turn pink.  Remove from heat, place on absorbent paper to absorb any excess oil.  Pour half the mustard into the frying pan, stirring all the time.  When it starts foaming, add remaining mustard, tranidad and cayenne.  When mustard starts to brown lightly, add baby shrimp.  Turn chicken over, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper and stir well to coat.  Cook in oven for 45 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.

title: Cajun Omelette
ingredients: 3 eggs | 6 -8 scallions, chopped | 6 -8 dried wild mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Beat the eggs slightly in a shallow bowl.  Add scallions and mushrooms, stir to coat.  Add tahini and cajun seasoning to egg mixture and slowly stir.  Dip the eggs in the egg mixture, coating well.  Chill.  Slice into 8 wedges and serve hot with lots of napkins.

title: Spicy Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh jalapeno chilies ( optional ) or 1/3 cup jalapeno paste ( optional )
instructions: Drain beans, saving liquid in a medium saucepan, and heat the tomato sauce over medium heat.  Add beans to tomato sauce, stir well and heat thoroughly.

title: Italian Hero Twists
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crusty italian-style ham slices | frosting : | 1 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a jelly roll pan or baking sheet.  Slice the ham thinly across the middle lengthwise.  Cut slices into small squares.  Spread about 1 tablespoon of frosting onto each ham sqeeze to form a triangle.  Sprinkle flour over each triangle.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Baked Halibut
ingredients: 1 cup water | 1/2 cup canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup butter | 3/4 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon garlic | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seed | 4 halibut fillets, or as needed
instructions: Mix water, artichoke hearts, butter, mustard, garlic, and dry mustard seed in a large glass baking dish and cover with plastic wrap.  Stir water mixture to loosen the salt slightly from cheese and spread on fish.  Place fish on foil lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,graham cracker crumb,watermelon,lentil,tamarind paste,tart apple,panir
title: Frozen Fruit & Lentil Salad(Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cans lentils, drained ( i use green whole ) | 1 cup watermelon, diced and seeded | 1 tart apple, diced ( use any cooking apple that has no blemishes ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 container panir ( vegan, if desired ) | 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the lentils and watermelon in this order, apples, onion, crumbled tuna, taco seasoning mix, paneer.  Toss with breadcrumbs. Toss a few times to coat and refrigerate for 15 minutes or so.  When ready to eat, transfer the frozen salad to a serving dish and garnish with a little tamarind sauce that melts.

title: Lemon Grass Fruit Soup
ingredients: 900 g fresh lemongrass | 450 g carrots | 600 ml soy sauce | 600 g frozen peas | 50 g dry vanilla pudding mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan except water, boil until vegetables are cooked.  Remove from heat and stir in the frozen peas.  Serve hot.

title: Simple Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock | 1/2 liter white wine | salt and white pepper | 1 liter of grated mexican cheese
instructions: Pour oil into a large pot.  Add beef stock and white wine.  Season to taste with salt and white pepper.  Add mexican cheese and let simmer until cheese has melted through.

title: Sesame Seed Rolls

instructions: In a small saucepan, combine raisins, corn syrup, and rice paper in 2 tbsps.  Water and bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 7 minutes or until tender.  Allow to cool.  Stir together peanuts, sesame oil, and remaining 3 tablespoons water in a bowl.  Lay out raisin mixture on 1/2 of the rice paper sheets.  Using the other 1/2 of the rice paper sheets, roll each portion tightly with the filling.  In a lightly oiled steamer basket, steam rolls, filling side up, until cooked through.  Serve warm, or at room temperature.

title: Mexican Rice

instructions: Open ro tel, drain tomatoes, add in rice, heat.  You don't have to boil it.  If you don't have it, just fluff the rice with fork and enjoy.

title: Bacon Mashed Cauliflower and Rice Skillet Meal
ingredients: 1 lb bacon bits, crisply cooked and crumbled | 1/2 cup chihuahua cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup rice ( i like jasmine ) | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup meat, deli, shredded | 1/2 cup simple syrup ( i use karo's kikkoman sweet cream, but any brand will do )
instructions: Add bacon bits, cheese and rice to your skillet.  Over medium heat, brown the bacon bits.  Break it up into smaller pieces and mix into rice.  Add cauliflower and meat and saute until cauliflower becomes tender.  If you have time to spare, refrigerate and cook the vegetables ahead and bring to room temperature.  Note if you don't have any arnugula, steam the cauliflower until tender.  When everything is soft, mash with a potato masher or large fork adding the syrup to thin the mixture if necessary.  Serve over pasta to enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green olive,allspice,cornstarch,celery rib,serrano chili,orange bell pepper,broccoli,red onion
title: Mexican Broccoli and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh broccoli | 1 lb red onion, thickly sliced | 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into thin julienne strips | 1 serrano chili, stemmed, seeded, and minced | 3/4 lb green olives, preferably spanish | 1/2 cup minced celery rib | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Trim and cut the broccoli coarsely into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Trim the root ends of the bell peppers and slice thinly crosswise.  Peel the stalks off the broccoli stems and trim off any woody parts and discard the tough cores.  Slice the crosswise into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Trim and core the onion and pepper and slice the halves thin.  Trim the tops of the broccoli stalks and cut into julienne strips.  Cut the chile into 3/4 pieces and rinse thoroughly in cold water to remove any sand.  Drain thoroughly.  In a large nonstick skillet, stir together the broccoli, onion, bell pepper and chile and add enough water to just cover.  Cover and bring to a boil over moderately high heat.  Cover and cook until the vegetables are just tender, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the olives and celery.  In the medium bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in the 1/4 cup cold water.  Stir into the cooking vegetables.  Stir to thicken the vegetables and coat with the sauce.  Remove the skillet from the heat, stir in the allspice and serve the hot vegetables over fluffy white rice.

title: Pimientos and Pois
ingredients: 4 ounces pimientos, in water | 1 orange, zest of, grated | crushed ice
instructions: Place the pimientos in a glass bowl and cover with water.  Add the zest and toss to coat.  Serve in a cocktail glass, covered with crushed ice.

title: Whole Wheat Pizza Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat starch | 1/2 cup pineapple juice ( i prefer orange juice )
instructions: Combine ingredients.  Drop in pizza dough, etc.  Cook in a preheated oven on a stone at 400°, for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Tikka Masala Marinade

instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 1 cubes.  Place in a mixing bowl with the soy marinade, chili paste, turmeric, cinnamon, allspice, and celery salt until thoroughly coated.

title: Pineapple Pumpkin Spice Ring Dessert Appetizers

instructions: Mix pineapple, pumpkin pie spice, and pineapple in a bowl.  Roll each ball into a small cone or cone, holding it in the center.  Set aside or refrigerate covered until set.

Add remaining ketchup and mix.  Add browned pork to simmering sauce.  Serve with sweetbread.

instructions: Put all ingredients except the chambord into a crock pot.  Stir well, cook on low setting, stirring occasionally for 3 - 4 hours or until everything is well mixed.  Makes about 4 servings.  You could serve it with pita chips or on sandwiches.

title: Mexican Potluck Steak Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef chuck, very thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 2 cups lettuce, shredded | 1/2 bag corn chips | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat grill.  Combine chuck, celery salt and 4/5 c lettuce.  Toss with 2t margarine and 1t cracker crumb mix.  Divide among 4 plates and top each with 1/2 c chips.  Serve topped with remaining lettuce.

title: Asparagus with Pineapple
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, minced | 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 ounce feta cheese
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, cilantro, and asparagus.  Toss with cheese and serve.

Add more or less of the oil and butter if necessary, especially if toasted bread is used.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Ciabatta - Burgers With Mayonnaise and Salty Cucumber
ingredients: 500 g ground chuck | 150 ml hard double cream | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons salad greens ( your choice or salad leaves ) | 2 tablespoons english cucumbers, finely shredded | 4 hamburger rolls, cut in half lengthways
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the rolls together in a bowl.  Shape into four burgers.  Wrap the rolls in foil, place on a cooking tray, and put them in a medium heat oven to cook for 8 - 10 mins until cooked through.  Spread the topping over the tops of the rolls and serve with lots of salad.

title: Rice Bean and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 2 cups short grain rice | 3 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Combine beans and rice in bowl.  Toss with onion and seasoning.  Serve immediately over lettuce leaves.

title: Broccoli and Blue Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 1 1/2 cups broccoli | 1/2 cup onion flakes | 10/2 ounces cherry, drained | 1/2 cup blue cheese
instructions: Cook linguini until al dente according to package directions.  Meanwhile, break florets from broccoli with back of knife.  When pasta is done, drain and set aside.  In hot saucepan, saute broccoli with onion flakes over medium high heat for 5 minutes.  Add pasta with cheese to broccoli and toss.  Top with cherry.

title: Homemade Smoky Salmon Marinade - Smoked Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups pure maple flavored lemonade ( or any fruit flavour or lemonade ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 5 fluid ounces low-sodium liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons minced dried mixed fruit | 1 1/2 cups sea salt, or additional to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: In a small bowl, combine onion soup mix, maple flavored lemonade, lemon juice, liquid smoke and dried fruit.  Stir to combine.  Pour mixture over salmon in a large resealable plastic bag.  Seal bag, pressing out excess air.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 4 hours, turning bag over occasionally.  To serve, preheat charcoal grill to medium.  Remove salmon.  Place marinated salmon on hot grill, close lid, and discard marinade.  Grill for 5 to 10 minutes, turning once, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Serve with a side of rice dishes, if desired, or cut into strips to serve alongside.

title: Curried Fish Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb cod fish or 1 lb other white fish fillet, cut into chunks | 1 lb farfalle pasta | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 1/2 lbs radishes, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped pepperoni | 3 tablespoons cornmeal, for rolling
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water with an inch of salt, cook the farfalle pasta until al dente.  Drain, return to the same pot, and boil until al dente, drain, return to the hot pot, add cod and cook through, then toss in the farfalle and cod.  Combine the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Form into patties.  Serve hot.  These can be refrigerated for up to two days.

title: Red Wine Seasoned Salt

instructions: Remove stem and seeds from peppers.  Score each pepper on both sides with a sharp knife.  Place the pepper on sheet of aluminum foil. .  Sprinkle generously with parsley and tie tightly with a loop of kitchen string.  Bake in 400 degree oven for 20 minutes.

title: Beijing Beef Steak Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder
instructions: Sprinkle the mustard seeds into a small bowl with the espresso powder.  Cover the bowl and refrigerate the steak for 2 to 3 days before using.  Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Remove the steak from the refrigerator 20 minutes before it can be sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Drain the meat slices on a paper towel lined rack, spread the mustard seed onto the strips, and toss to coat.  Arrange the steak on a wire rack, and broil the meat slices until the mustard seeds have begun to darken, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Cheddar Sticks (From the Miseries Academy, or More)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( or more ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix ( i used onion seasoning mix onion onion onion soup mix ) | 2 teaspoons onion extract | 3 cups light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, slivered ( optional ) or 1/4 cup slivered, blanched almond, blanched slivered almond ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the onions soup mix, soy sauce, mace and almonds if you are using them.  In a separate bowl, mix together the cheddar and flour until well mixed.  Stir in all of the rest of the onion soup mix.  Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes, or until dough comes together and is smooth and elastic.  Turn dough out onto a lightly oiled baking sheet.  Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  When dough has risen, preheat oven to 325°f.  Bake the dough for 20 to 25 minutes.  Turn dough out onto a cutting board and punch large holes with a sharp knife.  Spread the top with an assortment of cheeses.  Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes or till heated through and the cheese has melted.

title: Wild Mushroom and Sun-Dried Tomato Oil Fettuccine

instructions: Trim the mushrooms, and lightly fry with the sun dried tomatoes.  Allow the mushrooms to cook, covered, over very low heat to release the water.  Remove the mushrooms from the heat, and set aside.  Heat the olive oil until piping hot in a large sauce pan.  Add the mushrooms and stir.  Serve.

title: Clams and Watermelon Littleneck Clam Flatbread
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 1/4 cup buckwheat flour or 1/4 cup all purpose flour | 1 cup frozen watermelon, sliced | 1/2 lb littleneck clams, rinsed well, and drained | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce ( store-bought or homemade ) | crushed ice | chopped fresh parsley or basil ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1 pound boneless pork into thin strips.  Transfer 1/4 cup buckwheat flour to a medium bowl.  Dredge the pork in the flour, shaking off any excess.  Dredge the pork in the remaining buckwheat flour and coat evenly.  Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just hot enough to coat the bottom of the pan.  Add the pork and half of the watermelon and cook until meat is cooked through and no longer pink.  Add clams, cover and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Transfer vegetables to a serving platter, and top with remaining 1/4 cup broth.

title: Irish Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs baking potatoes, peeled | 3 lbs squash, cleaned | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Place baking potatoes, peeled and quartered, in a pot with enough cold water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook for about 1 hour over medium high heat, with the lid slightly ajar, until potatoes are tender.  Drain, cool and slice potatoes into 1/4 inch rounds and place into a well oiled large bowl.  Toss with the parsley and spread over the surface as you eat.

title: Shrimp on the Grill
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs shrimp, cleaned and deveined | 1 1/2 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 1 chipotle chile, drained and chopped | 1 package tortillas
instructions: Lay a sheet of aluminum foil on the work surface.  In a small bowl, toss shrimp with cheese and chile.  Divide shrimp mixture among tortillas.  Roll up and serve.

title: Easy Tacos
ingredients: 2 taco shells | 1 -2 tablespoon light soy sauce | aluminum foil
instructions: Put taco shells in 350 degree oven for 5 minutes.  Turn oven on to broil.  Wrap foil in foil.  Put in taco shells and broil 5 - 8 minutes until warm and heated through.

title: Brazilian Steak Hot-Roll-Up
ingredients:
1 flank steak, trimmed of excess fat | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( or use a mix of dried cilantro, coriander, and sweet red cherries ) | 3 tablespoons sugar, to taste ( about 2 tsp.

instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into 8 slices.  Toss in 1/4 cup cilantro or sweet red cherries with remaining 1 tbsp sugar.  Roll up each steak tightly and put on a rack in a baking pan or broiler pan.  Grill, uncovered, about 3 minutes on each side, or until steak reaches desired doneness.  Serve with the remaining 1/4 cup of cilantro as a garnish.

title: Chutney Canapes With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 250 g goat cheese ( soft or cow or sheep or sheep's milk cheese ) | mango chutney ( for topping ) ( optional ) or mango jam ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Toast cheese.  Spread or spread with mango chutney.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,beef eye,pistachio,cardamom powder,heavy cream,tangerine juice,bell pepper,fire tomato
title: Beef Kabobs and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef eye round | 1 cup pistachios | 1 cup pecan ( optional ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 4 fresh tangerines, juice of | 3 fire-roasted tomatoes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom powder | 1 bell pepper, quartered
instructions: Slice beef across grain and place it in a flat, heavy duty baking dish or resealable plastic bag.  Place pistachios and pecans on baking sheet and roast in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes, stirring periodically.  Remove beef from oven and place on a cutting board, with a small sharp knife about 4 inches square or so.  Use a very sharp chef’s knife and cut the meat across the grain into very thin slices, cutting down to the thickness of the beef.  Spread about 1/2 tablespoon of pistachios and pecans in the bottom of the baking dish.  Place all remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.  Pour mix over beef in baking dish.  Let stand 1 hour before serving.  Slice tomatoes and peppers and serve with remaining marinade on the side if desired.

title: Marjoram Wine
ingredients: 1/4 cup marsala wine | pinches dried marjoram
instructions: Place wine in small bowl and pour marinade over.  Let sit at room temperature for about 15 minutes.  Strain marinade through a fine mesh sieve into wine pan.  Discard solids.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Mexican Spice Rub (Copycat?)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 10 ounces apple cider | 1/2 tablespoon ground chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Wash chicken thoroughly and pat dry.  Sprinkle with chile powder.  Rub it into entire cavity.  Place chicken in an oven, 325 degrees farenheit for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until meat is completely cooked and darkens in color and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees farenheit on a rotisserie.  Use 1/2 tablespoon for an adobo sauce, for a milder rub to add to enchiladas.

title: Authentic Italian Baked Focaccia
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 6 cups unbleached all purpose flour | 2 ounces pancetta bacon, finely chopped
instructions: Add the yeast to 1 1/2 cups warm water and set aside.  In a large mixing bowl, sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup of the flour and stir it to combine.  Add the pancetta and stir until it is completely incorporated.  Add the remaining 2 1/2 cups flour and stir until it is thoroughly incorporated.  Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it lightly until it is smooth and elastic.  Lightly oil the bowl with some olive oil or shortening, place the dough in the bowl, cover the bowl with a kitchen towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours.  Turn the dough out onto the flour and knead it once more.  Divide into 6 equal sized pieces.  Turn each piece on their side and stretch each one a little.  Shape each piece into a roll and place on an oiled baking sheet.  Cover with a kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place for another 30 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  When the dough has risen, place it on a lightly floured surface and roll it out with a rolling pin until it is as thin as you can reasonably get it without getting stuck to your hands.  Cut a cross on the top of the loaf with a sharp knife and poke a few small slits into the top of the loaf with the tip of your finger, leaving a small opening about 1/2 inch wide at the bottom.  Paint the tops of the focaccia with olive oil or shortening.  Bake on the preheated oven for 30 minutes, remove the focaccia from oven, and brush generously with oil or shortening.  Bake on the bottom rack of the oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Wild Rice With Oats
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 1 cup oatmeal | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon oil, for stir fry
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions, but add oatmeal to the cooked wild rice.  Set aside and allow to cool.  Add bell pepper to cooked wild rice along with the oil.  You could also add frozen chopped or grated carrot and cook in microwave for about 3 minutes until heated through.

title: Nori-Maki
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs bone in chicken breasts | 2 1/2 ounces tea bags
instructions: Wash the nori thoroughly, and let dry a few dashes.  Take the sheets of nori, and put 2 - 3 tablespoons of tea in the center of each one on your work surface. instructions: Cook the brown & sweet rice per instructions on the packet.  Tip, nigella seeds are a dry, dark brown seeds available from middle eastern shops.  This can be bought from most supermarkets but ideally from Asian deli counters all the same aisle.  They will give you a more pronounced flavor.  Note, nigella seeds are usually available from indian shops, www.  Ethnicgrocer.  co.  Uk, & it is also sold at indian grocery stores.  The yield is not important.  In a large pan heat up the passion and fry the tortillas until they are crispy.

title: Sweet and Sour Cornbread
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 7 large eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mix together the cornmeal, baking soda, seasoning salt and dry sherry.  Whisk the eggs and milk together until smooth.  Fold the cornmeal mixture into the egg mixture.  Pour batter into a 9x5 inch loaf pan.  Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Cod With White Beans and Chocolate
ingredients: 350 g smoked cod, cut into 2 inch thick pieces ( or other flavorful fish ) | 150 g fresh pumpkin, peeled cut into 2 inch pieces | 150 g white beans, shelled ( or fresh green beans, or young green beans, if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup dark chocolate or 1/2 cup milk chocolate | 1 -2 pinch sugar pectin | 1 pinch chili powder, mixed with | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Heat nonstick or cast iron pan, add potato sticks and fry a small amount to make them pliable.  Remove and keep aside.  Heat remaining fat and fry the white beans and coconut for about a minute.  Add the cooked white beans and coconut and stir gently.  Add in the dark chocolate/milk chocolate and pectin, add a pinch of chili powder and the salt & sugar or tamarind extract.  Stir.  Place potato sticks on top and put it on heat for 2 minutes.

title: Rose Petals Roasted Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck, trimmed of any fat | 2 tablespoons rose petals, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch pieces and season with rose petals.  Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish and roast 25 minutes.  Remove meat from oven and brush with 2 tablespoons of oil, return to oven and bake 2 hours.  Serve.

instructions: Prepare pkg.  Of cream cheese according to package directions.

title: Grilled Mushrooms (Shrimp) Dip
ingredients: 8 medium mushrooms, cleaned | 8 ounces capacola sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat grill over medium heat.  Place the mushroom slices in a medium bowl and add the sausage slices.  Divide the cheese into 4 equal portions and sprinkle each with a portion of the sausage.  Place the mushroom caps directly on the grill.  Grill for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts and starts to turn golden brown.  Serve at once.

title: Quick and Easy Chipotle Tortellini
ingredients: 2 cups frozen cheese tortellini | 2 -3 teaspoons pureed canned chipotle chiles or 2 -3 teaspoons canned chipotle chiles | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 4 tablespoons organic vanilla sugar or 4 tablespoons unbleached cane sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated cumin seeds or 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1 large grated bell pepper ( optional/to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cook tortellini according to package directions, set aside.  Place the chipotle puree into a small frying pan, add the chipotle puree, baking soda and sugar.  Simmer on low heat for 30 - 40 minutes until mixture thickens and flavors blend.  Place tortellini in a large mixing bowl and stir in the chipotle sugar mixture and bell pepper.  Sprinkle with ground cumin seeds or cumin if using.  Mix well to combine.  Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish or individual baking dishes and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until heated through.

title: Carolina-Like Beef Burger
ingredients: 2 lbs lean sirloin beef | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup steak sauce | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut steak into 1/2 inch slices.  Place in bowl with ketchup, steak sauce and tobasco sauce mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hrs refrigerated.

title: Brown Sugar and Spice Fragrant Rice Cream
ingredients: 1 cup raw rice ( not instant ) | 1 1/4 cups brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 500 g mascarpone cheese ( or other creamy substitute such as mascarpone cheese )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat to low and cook gently until thickened.  Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.  Serve chilled.

title: Braised Red Beans
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red beans, chopped | 1 large fresh thyme sprigs | mixed sprouts ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Put the beans, thyme, and a little water into a saucepan and bring to the boil.  Reduce the heat partially, cover, and simmer for about 20 min.  You will know when the liquid is almost completely reduced.  Serve the beans hot, garnish with the mixed sprouts if you wish and serve.

title: Scrumptious Apricot Scones
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°f.  On a lightly oiled baking sheet, mix the two cups of flour and the jam.  Add the ground cloves.  Shape mixture into balls and flatten a little.  Mark each with a knife.  Place on a oiled baking sheet.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, turning and brushing with the remaining jam as you go.  Keep on baking sheets for a few minutes before removing after they have cooled.

title: Roasted Mushroom and Cauliflower Dip
ingredients: 1/2 small head cauliflower | 200 g cream cheese | 10 -15 mushrooms, sliced thin | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and grease an oven dish or slice into rounds with a grater so it can fit easily in the oven dish.  First take the cauliflower and break into florets.  You will see that they end up a bit chunky.  Line a large baking tray with parchment paper.  Place the cauliflower on the tray.  Sprinkle on the grated cheese, cover tightly with foil and bake for 15 to 18 minutes.  After 15 to minutes remove cover and carefully shake in the pan so that the pieces stay together.  Roast for 15 to 20 minutes more or until golden and crisp.  Remove from oven and let sit until cool enough for easy handling.  Then cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Serve warm with toasted bread or bread crackers.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,toffee,spaghetti sauce,salad green,blue cheese salad dressing,cream cheese
title: Stroganoff
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti sauce | 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 8 ounces blue cheese salad dressing | 2 cups mixed salad greens | 16 ounces toffee pieces
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for toffee pieces.  Pour into a greased 9x13 inch dish.  Sprinkle toffee pieces on top.  Bake@350 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Cashews Pasta With Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 1/2 lbs raw cashews, shelled
instructions: In a large pot, add water to the water and bring to a boil.  Cook pasta until al dente.  Drain, reserving 1/3 cup of the pasta water.  Stir in cashews.  Drain pasta in a colander and return to pot.  Add remaining pasta water and cover.  Return to a boil, stirring occasionally.  While pasta is cooking, remove cashews from cashew skins.  In a small pan, add a tablespoon of oil to a small saute pan over medium to medium low heat.  When the oil starts to sizzle, add cashews and saute, stirring, until golden brown.

title: Cock-Aduki
ingredients: 1/3 cup vegetable broth | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 3 packages fast rise yeast | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/3 cup scotch
instructions: In a small saucepan in the microwave, heat broth until hot, but not boiling.  Remove from heat.  Pour broth, half and half, and yeast into a large mixing bowl.  Add chickpeas and scotch.  Beat 2 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl and paddle.  Cover, let stand 1 hour.  Stir.  Cover again.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Stir.  Cover, let stand 30 minutes.  Stir again.  Cover, let stand 30 minutes.  Stir.  Cover, let stand 10 minutes.  Stir again.

title: Cajun Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles or 3 anaheim chilies | 2 ounces irish whiskey | fresh mushrooms | 1 teaspoon chopped onion | 8 slices country bread
instructions: Remove stems from chilies.  Cut the top and bottom off the chilies and remove any membrane.  Place chilies on a dry towel.  Place 1/2 ounce of whiskey in the center of each chile with a pinch of salt, and place on top of the chilies.  Remove the papery skin from the chilies, but leave the top shell intact, if desired.  Seal with a toothpick.  Sauce, combine the remaining 1/2 ounce whiskey with the mushrooms and chopped onion.  Place bread slices on a baking sheet.  Bake in the over at 300 degrees for 5 - 7 minutes or until crisp.  Remove with tongs and drain on paper towels.  Serve hot, accompanied with the chilies.  Mushroom gravy with potatoes.

title: Roasted Garlic Salsa
ingredients: 2 -3 whole roasted anaheim chili | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Grind chiles and seasonings until you have a uniform texture.  Note, if this salsa is too thin, just mix it up the next day and add more seasoning just before you want to serve.

Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of the rice wine over tuna.  Place approximately 1 tablespoon of tomato sauce over lettuce.  Roll the leaf with a lettuce leaf and tie with butchers twine to make a pretty little bundle.  Repeat process using remaining lettuce leaves.  In a small bowl, mix together the alfredo sauce and remaining chili sauce.  Pour over the rolls.  Place each roll on a lettuce lined platter.

title: Prosciutto (Italian Beans)
ingredients: 1 can green beans | 1 pinch italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 3 -4 thin slices prosciutto | ice cube | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | of fresh mint
instructions: Chop or dice up enough prosciutto to make the consitency of the consitancy of the consitair, or just chop enough prosciutto to make the consitancy of the consitair, and toss around in the pan.  Drain the beans and rinse them under cold water, and pat dry with a towel.  Slice or dice up enough prosciutto to make the consitancy of the consitair, and toss around in the pan, coating the beans.  Stir around as you mix the flavorings in the pan so as to ensure each peace of flavor.  Pour the tomato juice around the beans.  Add mint and toss around so as to cover it all.  Do not stir at this point.  Cover, and let it simmer for about 30 - 45 minutes to be sure all the water is absorbed.  After your 5 minutes, stir, and let it simmer another minute and a half, or so, until the beans are completely heated, stirring occasionally.  You'll want to taste the liquid for the proper amount of consitair, and you might not need all of it.  After about 2 minutes or so, stir again, and taste.  If anything is not as flavorful, just let it continue cooking a little more.  It should be nice and sour.  If you feel like eating this right away, do taste it, and adjust ingredients accordingly.  You can also use any flavor you like, but it's a bit different after that.  That's it.

Random Ingredients: bread dough,french green bean,green bell pepper,cinnamon raisin bread,shrimp,red bell pepper
title: Disney's King Ranch Green Beans
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed | 1/2 pound french style green beans, thawed | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons cinnamon raisin bread
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Slice the bread dough in half lengthwise, and form rounds to fit the baking sheet.  Line 2 slices of the crust with dough rounds, and place half of the green beans side by side on the crust.  Break an open lid to allow steam to escape.  Place a few shrimp into the center of the green beans.  Top with 2 tablespoons of cinnamon raisin bread.  Continue layering the bread dough rounds, green beans, red bell pepper, and shrimp until the two pans are full.  Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, about 15 minutes.  Cut into pieces to serve.

title: Cacok (Indonesian Banana and Coconut Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed chicken stock or 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1/2 cup finely chopped seeded cucumber | 1 cup finely chopped cooked banana | 1 tablespoon cold water
instructions: In a small bowl, soak the raisins in the chicken or vegetable stock for about 20 minutes.  Combine the raisins, cucumber, banana and water.  Blend and heat gently, stirring occasionally, until mixture begins to thicken.  Ladle into serving bowls and serve.

title: Vegan Hazelnut Polenta
ingredients:
1 1/2 teaspoons salt- free red chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 3/4 cup celery ( or use 1/2 cup chopped onion ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, chopped ( about 12 walnuts ) | 1 1/2 cups coarse stone ground cornmeal | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, of your choice ( such as spice injera, spice mixture of 3-4 c.

Add cilantro to processor and pulse, or add to dry ingredients in processor or bowl.  Place mixture into a bowl, cover and refrigerate until well chilled, about 3 hours or overnight.  Heat oven to 350 f.  In a large baking pan, spread dough out evenly and pat into smooth 9 inch circle.  Bake in center of oven, rotating every 10 minutes, until top is golden, about 12 minutes.  Cool at least 5 minutes.  Slice into 12 slices, arrange on cake board and cut crosswise into 3 slices.

title: Beef Pasta With Orange Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil or 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder ( or a mixture of all three ) | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds, toasted and ground | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pinch ground cumin powder | 1/2 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into thin strips about 1-inch wide | 1 lb penne or 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked
instructions: To make toasted caraway seeds, crush caraway seeds with a mortar and pestle.  Bring medium saucepan of water to a boil.  Add penne, and cook until al dente.  Meanwhile, in small bowl stir together olive oil, orange juice, cumin, caraway seeds, and garlic salt until well blended.  Add beef and cook until just cooked through.  Drain pasta and combine with meat mixture.  Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Black Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried black-eyed peas | 1 can fruit cocktail ( any brand ) | 3 avocados, peeled and diced | 3 -5 sprigs fresh tarragon | 1 -2 sprig fresh tarragon | 1 -2 pimiento, chopped | 3 tablespoons mixed dried fruit | 1 lemonade | crushed corn chips, to serve
instructions: Wash the peas thoroughly.  Break off any damaged peas with your fingers if the peas are large.  Pour boiling water on to boil then cover to keep warm over low heat.  Meanwhile, prepare the remaining veggies & fruit.  Slice the pimentos into thin strips and soak in warm water.  Chop the avocados & add to peas along with the tarragon, tarragon & citrus juice.  Toss well then stir in the fruit & chill.  To serve, top with crushed corn chips and add 2 - 3 tablespoons of warm peas or fresh chopped fruit.

title: Swede With Oregano and Garlic
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ice water | 4 medium swedes, peeled and diced | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Put ice water in a large saucepan.  Place chopped or cut up swedes in and over, around the leek and marjoram and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Drain.

title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, about 3 pounds, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 jar commercial low-sodium marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place squash, cucumber, and pesto in a large salad bowl.

title: Cheesy Sesame Lasagna Dip
ingredients: 24 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped pepper | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl.  Pour into a baking dish that's been sprayed and lightly coated with cooking spray.  Spray the top with cooking spray.  Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.  Let cool and serve with crackers or other meat slices.

title: Edamame and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/2 lb broccoli floret, julienned | chili pepper flakes | spices | 14 ounces shelled edamame
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except edamame in large bowl.  Cook and stir over medium heat till just heated through and sauce thickens slightly.  Cool about 5 minutes, then pour over edamame.

title: Herbed Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2 slices | 1 1/2 teaspoons arrowroot | 4 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon dried parsley leaves | 3 tablespoons mirin
instructions: In a large, nonstick skillet, sprinkle sausage with arrowroot.  Cook over medium high heat, stirring, for 1 minute.  Stir in paprika, dill, and parsley.  Reduce heat to low, add kielbasa, cover, and reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees.  Cook, covered, 15 to 20 minutes.  Uncover, raise temperature to 400 degrees, and cook, covered, 20 to 30 more minutes, until kielbasa is tender and sausage is nicely browned at the edges.  Variation, use 3 pkgs of frozen link sausage, sliced in 1/2 inch slices and thawed, if using.

title: Mom's Celery Rolls from the Grocery House
ingredients: 1 package frozen celery | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Thaw celery thoroughly, and slice thinly.  Spread a couple tablespoons in the bottom of a microwave safe bowl.  Sprinkle a few celery slices on the cut sides of the bowl.  Place a plate on top of the celery slices.  Heat the microwaved bowl in the microwave for about 3 minutes or until the celery is tender.  Sprinkle crumbs on top of the celery, and let cool until able to handle while still a little warm.  You can break up any clumps of celery like this, but it is not necessary.  Cut in half and serve on a platter.  This is a favorite served with mashed potatoes, soups, or a filling mixture.

title: Gai Pad Gai (Elderberry Bell Pepper Stir Fry)
ingredients: 20 leaves elderberry | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced thin
instructions: Cut the elderberries in halves, remove the stems and cut the tips in half.  Toss the leaves with a tablespoon of fish sauce and then set aside.  Heat a wok or small frying pan with a little oil and add a slice of bell pepper and a few leaves of elderberry.  Stir fry for about 2 to 3 minutes.  Add water and let simmer for 2 more minutes and serve.

title: Frugal Gourmet Group for Meat and Garlic Filling
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork shoulder, boneless with some fat on the outside of the shoulder | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Wash the pork with cold water.  Trim of most of any fat on the bone and cut into bite size pieces.  Place the pieces into a large bowl or crock.  Add enough water to cover.  Add the bouillon cube.  Cover the bowl or crock and let rest at least 4 hours.  Remove the fat remaining in the stock cube but remove it before using.  Mold meat into meatballs and place onto a greased pan.  Brown over medium heat, making sure to spread the fat evenly on both sides.  Remove from the heat and roll in desired toppings.  These balls can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

title: Sliced French Bread with Celery and Olives
ingredients: 1 loaf french baguette | 1 head celery | 1/2 teaspoon olive oil | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Cut bread loaf in half lengthwise.  Open can of creamed corn and place in small bowl.  Cut celery lenghtwise and diagonally in slices 1/4 inch thick.  Heat 1/2 t.  Olive oil in skillet.  Remove and drain celery pieces from olive oil and place in colander.  Salt lightly.  Toss celery in hot oil until it's softened.  Add celery to colander and stir.  Serve bread and celery on a platter.  Spoon or pour olive oil evenly over the bread.

title: Prawn and Lima Bean Salad With Tequila Infused Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles, dry roasted, preferably fresh | 3/4 - 1 cup dried lima beans, canned | 1 lemon | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1/4 cup frozen yogurt | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/3 cup tequila or 1/3 cup vodka | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: First step, preheat your oven to 450°f.  Place a dry roast bone in your oven to warm during the oven.  You have your oven going.  The bone will take away any excess grease but you want to do your best to ensure bones do not remain attached.  When the roast has reached an internal temperature of 175°f, remove with a slotted spoon to a bowl covered with a double layer of damp paper towels.  The roast must be very rare, so be careful and do not use low heat.  You may have the bone in to help control flare ups.  When the roast is cool to the touch, slice across the grain about 2/4” thick and set aside.  When the roast is cooled to the touch, slice into ½” strips.  In a medium bowl add the lima beans and lemon juice and mix gently.  Stir in the yogurt, lemon juice and sugar, mixing well.  Taste and adjust the seasonings if necessary.  Put a serving plate on top of the bowl and carefully add the prawns and lima beans to coat.  Gently fold the noodles so they fit snugly over the salad.  Pour tequila and cranberries over the top and serve right away.  Eat immediately, or refrigerate until ready to serve.  Note, you can get away with a little bit of tequila flavored vodka while it is stored in the freezer, though i haven't tried it that way.  You may also be able to buy tequila flavored vodka straight from the freezer, though it's not necessary.

title: Sour Kebabs
ingredients: 2 habanero peppers | 2 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 6 tablespoons dashi stock | 1 pinch kosher salt
instructions: Peel the black seeds from the habanero peppers, rinse out all the seeds, and place the peppers in a food processor along with the bread crumbs.  Process the mixture together on high until finely meal size.  Add the dashi and salt and process again until the mixture forms a rough paste.  Shape into small sized kebabs about 2 inches in diameter.  Broil the kebabs 4 inches from the heat for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, basting frequently with pan juices to ensure that they do not burn.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Donton soup stick and serve cold.

title: Pineapple Popcorn

title: To-Die-Dee's Hot Chile Eggplant

Add the eggplant slices and the whole baby eggplant pieces, if using.  Stirring frequently, cook until the eggplant is tender and the eggplant slices start to brown, approx 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Crock Pot (From a Crock Pot)

instructions: Trim all visible fat from chuck roast and discard any visible pieces of fat.  Place chuck roast in a crock pot and sprinkle generously with coriander and cinnamon.  Set crock pot on low for 8 hours or high for 3 hours.  Transfer chuck roast to cutting board.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,lemon wedge,fig,mango nectar,cooking spray,thyme leaf,baking soda
title: Fig and Mango Pudding
ingredients: butter-flavored cooking spray | 1 1/2 large ripe figs, coarsely chopped ( about 12 ounces ) | 2/3 cup mango nectar ( if mango nectar is not used, use 1/8 cup apple juice, but not enough ) | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 2 whole pinches baking soda | lemon wedge, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Coat a 6 inch square pan with cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, combine figs and all ingredients except the lemon wedges.  Spoon the mixture into the baking pan.  Broil at broil until the puffed figs are golden brown and tender, about 5 minutes.  Drizzle a small amount of lemon juice if desired.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,pecan half,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cane sugar
title: Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar green enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( more or less ) | 1/2 cup pecan halves | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Mix all ingredients until mixed together.  Spoon mixture into individual baking dishes, top with pecan halves and bake for 25 minutes or until nuts are toasted.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,angostura bitter,cornmeal,cashew,chicken breast,pesto sauce,lime,milk chocolate chip
title: Pesto Chicken W-Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 1 package whole-grain cornmeal | 2 2 tablespoons frozen pesto sauce | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips or 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips | 1 lime, juiced | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Spread cashews onto a large baking sheet and toast, stirring occasionally until lightly browned.  Drain on paper towels and set aside.  Whisk cornmeal, pesto, and 2 tablespoons parmigiano cheese together in a small bowl.  Spread remaining parmigiano cheese on a large cutting board.  Cut chicken breasts into thin slices on the grain.  Spread a thin slice of chicken on top of a piece of the cheese.  Spread remaining pesto on a plate.  Sprinkle with lime juice, then squeeze lime juice over the chicken and cheese.  Press the tortillas so as to wrap the chicken and cheese around the pesto.  Sear chicken in a small skillet with a small amount of peanut oil until the chicken is golden brown on the outside.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Place the chicken on top of the foil and bake until the cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.  Garnish with lime wedges.  To serve, remove the chicken and cheese slices and place on a plate.  Wrap with foil and let rest and for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,cream cheese,cranberry sauce,yeast,swiss chard,vanilla sugar
title: Swiss Chard, Butter and Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 cup cream cheese, room temp | 1 can swiss chard, drained, chopped | 1 yellow squash, cut into long thin slices | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar ( or almond )
instructions: Combine the bread crumbs and yeast, stir well and set aside.  Beat the cream cheese in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth.  Add swiss chard, yellow squash and yeast mixture.  Blend well.  Stir in the dry bread crumbs until incorporated.  Dough will be sticky, but not dry.  Turn the dough out onto floured surface.  Knead until smooth and elastic, about 3 minutes, adding more flour if necessary.  Lightly oil a large bowl, place the dough in and cover.  Let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.  Turn the dough out onto lightly floured surface and divide into 3 equal pieces.  Shape each piece into a round, place, side by side, in a 9 inch greased springform pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.  Meanwhile preheat oven to 450°f.  Brush the tops of the rounds with egg glaze.  Bake at 450f for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Persian  Karaklete Kilkil (Meat Stew, Not Meat)
ingredients: left over meat ( cubed ) | roasted coriander
instructions: Saute the meat in a pan with a little oil.  Take a big amount of oil and lightly fry it.  Add some water and cover the pan.  When it boils, cover the pan again and let it boil very slowly for 1 hour.  You can put in meat in the food processor or you can transfer it into a container for storage.  It should be done when the meat is very hard.

title: Hot Dog Panini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 2 1/4 cups hot dogs or 2 1/4 cups ham sandwich rolls, split and toasted | 1/2 teaspoon dry active yeast | 2 2 cups russet potatoes or 2 1/2 cups yukon gold potatoes, well drained | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced deli ham, cut into 12 thin strips and cooked on both sides | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced rare provolone cheese
instructions: To make the hot dog buns, stir together the yeast and hot dog dogs in a bowl and set aside.  Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with just enough of the water to cover.  Bring to a boil and boil for 10 minutes or until tender, drain, cool and set aside in a warm spot.  Cool slightly and set aside to start preparing the sandwiches.  To make the sandwich topping, in a large bowl, stir together the yeast and hot dogs.  Mix in the breads, yeast and hot dogs.  Stir in the ham and cheese.  Cover and set aside in a warm place to rise until the dough doubles in volume.  Place a baking sheet or pizza stone on the counter and grease or spray it with vegetable oil.  Knead the dough until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes.  Shape the dough into a ball, place it onto the baking tray or pizza stone, cover it and let it double in volume, about 1/2 an hour.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Form a hole in the center of the bun with your thumb, fill with bread mixture, then place the ham and cheese in there.  Close up the bun and continue on the letter flip the bun to make the egg and cheese sandwich.  Slip the bread onto a greased baking sheet or pizza stone.  Bake until it is brown and crispy and the bread is hot.  Cut into 8 wedges.  Serve hot.

title: Sausage With Preserved Pomegranate
ingredients: 12 lbs pork sausages ( or 1 pound ) | kosher salt | 1 - 1 1/2 cup pomegranate, seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut a piece of foil 1/2 inch thick around the outside of the sausages.  Wrap and seal the sausages.  Heat a heavy skillet over high heat.  Add enough tahini to reach 2 tablespoons and warm the tahini.  Drain the sausages, removing any visible fat.  Using wooden skewers, stab the sausages 3 to 4 times with a sharp tipped knife.  Cook the sausages 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until nice grill marks appear.  Sprinkle with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,maraschino cherry,peanut butter,gingerroot,virgin olive oil
title: Chef John's Satay Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/3 cup canola oil | 3 tablespoons grated fresh gingerroot | 3 tablespoons vindalapeno-sticed maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Stir the peanut butter, canola oil, ginger, vindalapeno, peanut oil, and cherry juice in a bowl until the peanut oil is incorporated.

title: Fantasy Trotter
ingredients: 12 ounces toffee | 12 ounces blue cheese | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Melt toffee in microwave or microwave and scrape vanilla bean from the base.  Cut cheese into small cubes and place in a double boiler with toffee.  Remove coffee from heat and micro or just until frothy.  Pour onto toffee and enjoy enjoy.

title: Apple Scented With Rosemary
ingredients: 3 large apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup cream | 3/4 cup whipping cream, warmed | fresh rosemary, leaves picked
instructions: Arrange apples in an ovenproof dish.  Heat oven to 450°f.  Heat cream in saucepan over medium heat, bring just to boil, stir in cream and cook gently for 1 minute.  Brush a little cream over each slice of apple, sprinkle with rosemary and serve immediately.

title: Quick Beef and Rice Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup pearl couscous | 1 cup sliced steak | 1/2 cup sliced almonds or 1/2 cup roasted pistachios | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 jar roasted almond paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Place the couscous in a large bowl with the steaks.  Pour 1 cup of boiling water over and leave to soak for 10 minutes.  Add almonds and leave to soak until couscous is softened, about 1/2 an hour.  Drain off any water from steaks and place in a blender, add 3/4 cup of flour and blend until smooth, adding some more of the boiling water if necessary.  Tip mixture into bowl, add 3/4 cup of the remaining flour and blend until mixed in.  Place in fridge for 15 minutes.  Form biscuits from biscuits using 1 cup of flour and place on greased oven trays.  Sprinkle top with remaining flour.  Bake for 15 minutes or until pale golden.

Random Ingredients: okra,vegetable oil cooking spray,radish,arugula,scotch bonnet pepper,double cream,filling,pizza dough
title: Papas De Queso
ingredients: 2 dough-size pizza dough ( about 4 1/2 oz each ) | vegetable oil cooking spray or light vegetable oil | 1/2 lb fresh okra ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 large radishes, coarsley chopped ( about 1 1/2 cup ) | 5 -6 large scotch bonnet peppers, sliced thin ( depending on your heat tolerance, i use serrano and jalapeno ) | 5 large arugula, loosely packed, chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons double cream ( optional )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 450°f roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/8 inch thick on a lightly floured cloth or silpat.  Place in the center of the oven and bake for 5 minutes.  Using the cookie cutter, cut out dough rounds that are slightly larger in diameter than the circle of pizza dough.  Brush each round with oil.  Reduce oven temperature to 325°f while dough dough is baking, blanch okra until lightly coloured on both sides, 3 - 4 minutes.  Rinse out the pan and dry okra on paper towels.  Slice okra into rounds 2 in wide and 8 in long, depending on the size.  Place okra, radishes and scotch bonnet pepper slices on a parchment lined or greased baking sheet.  Gently spread scotch bonnet pepper slices out evenly over the okra, leaving an even border area.  Make a cross on each side of the dough.  With your fingers or a sharp knife, carefully make a slit on each dough round.  Bake at 350f for 7 - 10 minutes or until puffed and golden and cooked on the inside.  While hot, put on a serving plate and serve with arugula and cream.

title: Kielbasa with Golden Syrup
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 can condensed golden syrup | 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, mix dry onion soup mix, golden syrup, and 1/2 cup water.  Place sausage pieces into the mixture so that each piece is completely covered.  Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Boil sausage in the remaining water, about 30 minutes, until the sausage is no longer pink inside.

title: Sausage and Apples
ingredients: 1 large red apple | 1 lb pork sausage
instructions: Peel core and cut the apple into chunks.  Cut the sausage into chunks or pieces and rub into apple.  Brown in a dutch oven and put in as many cans as needed for 10 minutes.  Cook in a little water.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,spicy tomato sauce,chicken,self rising flour,yukon gold potato,tarragon,button mushroom,yeast
title: French Country Pizza
ingredients: 1 kg self-rising flour | 1/3 cup spicy tomato sauce ( your favourite ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 500 g cooked cooked chicken, sliced | 350 g baby yukon gold potatoes, halved | 100 g sliced button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 500 g sliced cooked zato's fresh yeast
instructions: Combine the flour, tomato sauce, tarragon and chicken in a mixing bowl and combine until well combined.  Knead on a floured board until smooth and elastic then set aside to rest for 30 minutes.  Place the potatoes into a saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil.  Cover with a lid and boil for 5 minutes, then remove from the heat.  Drain well and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 220°c.  Divide the dough into 4 pieces and, working with a piece at a time, roll it out into a 4cm thickness and 6cm round from the short side of the dough.  Transfer to a baking tray and place in the oven to bake for 20 minutes.  The crust should be just set and sticky with a slightly jiggly texture.  Remove from the oven and leave to cool slightly.  Spread the tomato sauce in the bread and top with the chicken, potatoes and mushrooms.  Leave to cool for 5 minutes before serving.  Garnish with zato's fresh herbs and fresh thyme and serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,cardamom powder,asparagus,topping,wheat flour,beef bouillon cube,fenugreek seed
title: Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1/4 cup beef flour | 35 ounces asparagus, cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/4 cup fresh fenugreek seeds, ground ( not methi ) | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large pot.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 3 hours.  Add more water if necessary.  Remove from heat, cool, and refrigerate overnight.  Strain and freeze any fat in the refrigerator.  To make soup, remove the fat from the soup as desired and set aside the fat.  Stir soup with a fork and heat through.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,date,heavy whipping cream,wild rice,carrot,romaine lettuce,tomatillo
title: Puerco Com Massañola
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 1 3/4 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 1/2 pounds boneless pork loin, diced | 1 pound fresh tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 2 medium carrots, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 pound romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions, then drain.  Add cream and stir until mixture is smooth.  Set aside.  Heat a large skillet over high heat and stir in pork.

title: Chickpeas Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas, drained & rinsed | 1 lb stew meat ( i use extra lean, it will be used in our fritters ) | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix the flour into the chickpeas then stir in the extract.  Shape the mixture into flat fritters and fry in oil over medium heat.  Serve while still warm.  I have kids love this so i make them fry up in a little butter.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,red potato,cream chicken soup,nonfat milk
title: Tres Leches Potato Cakes With Sour Cream
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, about 1 1/2 pounds, peeled and cut into 6 wedges | 8 ounces fat free cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped
instructions: In a 3 quart casserole dish, spread half the potatoes as follows, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup milk and oranges.  Sprinkle with remaining potatoes and top with remaining orange slices.  Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees until hot and bubbly about 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Red Cherry Syrup
ingredients: 6 cups sweet red cherries, halved | 4 cups dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 tablespoons orange sugar
instructions: In a large pot, combine cherries with the brown sugar and stral and sprinkle on top.  Stir in grand marnier.  Cover and set over medium heat.  Cook, shaking pot often, for 40 to 50 minutes until cherries are dark, thick and sticky.

title: Homemade Pasta Shells
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cake flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Place flour in pan of a stand mixer.  Cut spaghetti into manageable lengths, about 3/4 wide.  Cut about 1 inch long each piece of spaghetti.  Place the strands on a plate.  Dust the shells with flour.  Pour oil into a deep frying pan, which holds about a inch or so of oil at a time.  Heat the oil to 300 degrees f.  When it's smoking very hot and quite hot, place one or two at a time, one by one.  Fry, shaking pan gently to promote color, until golden brown on all sides, about 3 minutes.  With slotted spoon, transfer prawns to paper towels to drain.  Repeat with remaining pieces.  The shells, drain the spaghetti, discarding or discarding any excess oil.  Sprinkle with a little additional flour on each shell and roll.  Serve with a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: oil,bean paste,mint leaf,jasmine rice,anchovy paste,white fish fillet,salt black pepper
title: Yummy Thai Fish Ball (Kha Neow Mamuang Kih Thit)
ingredients: 600 g white fish fillets, cubed | 5 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon white fish fillet, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon bean paste | 3 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 -2 mint leaf, for garnishing
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and fry the chicken pieces till coloured, pour in the anchovy paste and stir fry till fragrant.  Add the bean paste.  Stir fry for a further 3 - 4 minutes.  Add the remaining ingredients and fry till the rice becomes creamy and all the ingredients are incorporated well.  Transfer to a mould, and garnish with mint leaves.  Serve chilled.

title: Simple Japanese Beef Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons mirin, preferably japanese rice wine vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons sake
instructions: Combine all ingridients and let stand to one hour in cool dry place.  Can keep indefinitely until needed.

title: Golden Brown Sugar Breakfast Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup golden brown sugar, packed | 6 tablespoons rice wine | 1 cup dates, chopped
instructions: Combine in a bowl and store in the refrigerator.

title: Crab and Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 7 ounces small crabmeat, drained | 1 cup low fat sour cream or 1 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: In a skillet, cook rigatoni in boiling salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain, reserving 6 tb cooking liquid.  Pour remaining liquid into the skillet and add crabmeat.  Simmer 2 - 3 minutes.  Drain rigatoni and add to crab mixture.  Stir gently until heated through.  Serve immediately.

title: Faux Rice Vermicelli (Vietnamese Beef Noodle)
ingredients: 3 cups rice vermicelli ( fresh ) | 6 tablespoons liquid egg product ( egg beaters ) | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cover with saran wrap.  Let sit for 15 - 20 minutes.  Cook in microwave on high power for 3 minutes, then on high power for 5 - 10 minutes.  Serve over hot vermicelli.

title: Honey-Glazed Maple Syrup
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces honey | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the honey and maple syrup.  Simmer over low heat until the honey is thick, about 5 minutes.  Pour mixture into a hot, clean bowl, but not touching the surface.

title: Tortilla Fajitas With Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 8 large lettuce patties, at least 1 inch thick | 1 orange, divided | 10 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 12 tortillas
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat.  Trim and discard leafy tops of lettuce and orange and discard.  Cut into 2 inch thick slices on the bias.  Place a half cup of the orange slices and 2 teaspoons orange rind on the center of each lettuce pattie.  Wrap each slice of lettuce and the orange with some of the thyme leaves.  Grill or broil the tortillas until the bread is golden on each side.  Serve with yogurt sauce.

Random Ingredients: celery,white wine,chinese five spice powder,icing sugar,celery rib,rice noodle
title: Chinese 5 Spices on Rice Noodles - Nokos
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, dried | 8 -10 stalks celery, finely chopped | 8 -10 celery ribs, finely chopped | 8 ounces icing sugar | 1 tablespoon dry white wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 -3 teaspoons chinese five spice powder
instructions: Start by pouring boiling water over the dry rice noodles until they are completely covered.  Leave to soak in the fridge overnight if possible.  Next, place all other ingredients over a medium heat in a wok and bring to the boil.  Strain and place to one side.  Allow to thicken and stir until it begins to set.

title: Campbell's Famous Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the grill.  If the hamburger used raw hamburger, break it up with a fork a little bit at a time until it resembles hamburger.  Add a couple drops of soy sauce and dried rosemary in the mix.  Cook the hamburger until the outside is dry, then use a slotted spoon to throw hamburger back into the mix.  Put the chips in a bowl and just pile on the beef mixture.  Put them in an oven safe skillet or on a cookie sheet and put under the grill.  Turn when the chips are dark golden and are sizzling good.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,mustard,red enchilada sauce,dijon mustard,garlic salt,bow tie pasta,apricot jam,peach
title: Spicy New Baked Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons apricot jam, and or other jam | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne mustard | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder, or more if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a large bowl, mix the pasta, enchilada sauce, jam, dijon, mustard, garlic, cayenne, and cocoa powder.  Mix well.  Transfer pasta mixture to the prepared baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and let cool for a minute or two.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,tabasco sauce,russet potato,button mushroom,spanish onion,baby carrot,green chili salsa
title: Simply King Ranch Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled and sliced into thin rounds | 2 -3 cups baby carrots | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 large green chili salsa ( i like peruvian sweet chili salsa or tostitos hatch verde ) | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can plum tomatoes, undrained and chopped or 1 can diced tomatoes, with liquid
instructions: Fry the potatoes in oil until brown.  Remove from pan and drain.  Return to pan and add the onions, garlic, and cook just until onions become soft and onion has begun to brown.  Add the chile salsa and tabasco or heat, stirring to combine, do not boil.  Add mushrooms and tomatoes and heat through, but don't boil.  Add the potatoes.  Serve warm.

title: Lemon and Herb Marinade for Balsamic and Beef Salads
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ( i use bottled lemons ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make the marinade.  Pour over mixed salads and marinate for 1/2 hours or longer, tossing occasionally.  You can also marinate overnight in the fridge.

title: Yummy Cherry Tomato Chutney for the Crock Pot
ingredients:
1 kg cherry tomatoes | 1 liter yogurt ( plain yogurt is fine to add in a pinch only to thin the chutney ) | 200 g white flour ( i used all purpose white flour for a change i just don't bother to use it.
    - ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon smooth peanut butter
instructions: Chop the tomatoes and place in the crock pot.  Mix together the flour, sugar, saffron, paprika and 1 - 2 tbsp of yogurt in a medium bowl.  Add the chopped cilantro and stir to mix well.  Add the remaining yogurt and stir to combine.  Drain the tomatoes and add to the crust and mix with a spoon.  Cover the crock pot and cook on high for 3 hours.  Serve with fresh bread and/or basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,almond filling,grain rice,yellow onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,espresso powder,rice noodle
title: El Jardine's Famous Rice Nests and Dosas (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cans mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 2 packages dry rice noodles | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1/2 cup yellow onion, minced | 1/2 cup raw ground almonds or 1/2 cup sunflower kernels | 1 can almond filling | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, combine canned tomatoes and their juices with the espresso.

title: Beef, Cannellini Bean and Olive Stew
ingredients:
1 corned beef brisket | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup black olives, sliced | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, cut into 2-in.
    - pieces | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 3/4 teaspoon black nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh epazote
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Place the brisket into a 13x9 inch glass baking dish.  Pour the canned beans over the top in a layer.  Scatter the olives, asparagus and celery seed around the brisket.  Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 to 45 minutes.  Remove the brisket from the oven.  Remove the foil and brush the brisket with the cooking juices from the dish.  Sprinkle with the nutmeg, saffron, and fresh epazote.  Return uncovered to the oven for an additional 15 minutes or until the brisket becomes tender and the juices run clear.  Let the brisket rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Fried Dill
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces mayonnaise | dill weed
instructions: Whip the mayonnaise with an electric mixer.  Stir in the dill weed.  Chill well before serving.

title: Frozen Oranges
ingredients: 4 oranges, peeled and sliced very thin | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange peel, minced
instructions: Arrange the orange peel in the freezer.  Put the frozen oranges in a bowl with enough water to cover.  Let sit until the water drips from the oranges.  Remove oranges with a slotted spoon and place them in a resealable freezer proof container.  When the water turns orangey clear, remove the oranges with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Return the oranges to the freezer.  Return all of their cooking water into the freezer.  Every 10 minutes, skim and scrape the bottom so that the ice freezes completely.  Continue freezing oranges.  After 10 - 15 minutes, gently defrost in the freezer.  Transfer the frozen oranges to a blender or food processor with the minced orange peel and puree until smooth.  Return the orange puree to the freezer.

title: Papaya Pie II
ingredients: 3 cups white cornmeal | 2 cans vanilla-flavored soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mash cornmeal into a coarse meal.  Use your hands if necessary.  Stir in vanilla soymilk until completely blended.  Turn dough out onto a floured surface.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,egg beater substitute,corn,chicken breast half,dark rum,orange flower water
title: Crock Pot Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 6 ounces frozen corn | 1/2 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dark rum, to taste | 1/2 - 1 cup orange flower water
instructions: Place chicken in bottom of crock pot.  Top with corn.  Sprinkle with egg beaters.  Stir together remaining ingredients.  Pour over chicken, cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 4 - 6 hours.  Serve over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,lemon,beet,dark red kidney bean,chocolate,sea salt,pretzel
title: Mexican Baked Beet Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg fresh beet, washed | 1 pinch sea salt | 1 pinch fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes | 100 g good-quality semisweet chocolate, grated | 1 pinch candied lemon rind | 1 pinch pretzel, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 325°f.  Place the beet in a baking dish and sprinkle with sea salt, red chili flakes, chili flakes and lemon rind.  Cover tightly with baking sheet and bake 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes until tender.  Remove the beet from the oven and sprinkle with grated chocolate if using.  Sprinkle with pretzels and drizzle with more good quality chile flakes.  Serve.

title: Mexican Pastry & Pepper Lettuce Wraps (Vegetable)
ingredients: 250 g lite thin buttermilk | 4 slices lindt whipped lindt frozen pastries ( i use the fancy lindt version, you can also sub frozen ) | 1 1 1/4 cups ice ( or as described in the recipe ) or 1 1/4 cups any unpopped ice ( or as described in the description ) | 2 serrano chilies, chopped fine | 1 yellow pepper, chopped coarsely | 1 1/2 cups vermicelli ( cooked al dente and cooled slightly ) or 1 1/2 cups broken into pieces ( cooked al dente and cooled slightly ) | prepared lite topping, for serving ( optional )
instructions: In a pot over heat, whisk lite thin buttermilk with the butter and chiles.  Remove from heat and add vermicelli and mix thoroughly to coat.  Cool slightly.  Spoon 1 - 2 tablespoons of mixture into a small casserole dish.  Top with remaining pasta to form a shell.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours or until firm.  Slice lite thin buttermilk into 1/2 inch cubes and serve with chopped pepper and top of celery/lobster/lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,cashew,flour tortilla,banana,ancho chile powder,cilantro leaf
title: Mexican Bananas on Fajitas
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs bananas ( depending on size, i like dark sweeter bananas ) | 6 -10 medium flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder or 1 teaspoon roasted chile, powder | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried epazote leaves, minced or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves | 1 beef bouillon cube or 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic | fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Peel and cut bananas into 1 inch cubes.  Put all ingredients into a mixing bowl with ice cubes and mix well.  Heat skillet of your choice over medium high heat.  When hot enough, put a tortilla in the skillet.  Sprinkle 1tbs of the garlic on top of the tortilla then spread about 2 tbsp of the banana cubes on top.  Place tortilla in pan and cook till the bottom gets golden brown on the tortilla.  Turn tortilla over and cook another minute or so.  Remove from skillet and cut into wedges.  Serve right away.  Top with chopped cilantro.

title: Beetroot Cakes with Egg Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 5 beets, cooked and shredded | 1/2 cup plain fat-free refried beans sprouts | 2 egg whites | 1 avocado, peeled, pitted and cubed
instructions: Dry the coriander seeds and shred the rest.  Heat a griddle or frying pan until very hot and add the coriander seeds.  Quickly fry the seeds and greens for about 10 seconds.  Transfer to a bowl to cool.  Wash your hands.  Place the shredded beetroot in the bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Form the mixture into small flat cakes.  Place on a large serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,garbanzo bean,brandy,baking potato,custard powder,tomato green chilies
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Chilies Salad
ingredients:
2 baking potatoes | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package cream-style custard powder | 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( about 6 oz.

instructions: Line a non stick baking pan with foil and spray lightly with cooking.  Peel the potatoes and cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes.
