title: Linguica Kåte
ingredients: 4 links linguica sausage | 1 cup hard-boiled egg, chopped | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground green cardamom pods
instructions: Place sausage links in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Cook, turning often, until golden brown on outside and no longer pink inside, about 10 minutes per side.  Slide sausage into a large bowl.

title: Noodles a la Creme
ingredients: 1 lb fresh veal, minced | 1 lb italian sausage | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook and stir the veal and italian sausage over medium heat, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until the sausage is browned, about 10 minutes.  Pour off the fat and stir in the nutmeg.  Pour the mixture over the hot cooked pasta and stir to mix.  Serve right away.

title: Mango Lime Loaf
ingredients: 3 mangoes, flesh removed, peeled and mashed | 4 ounces very creamed mangoes ( peeled and cut into cubes ) | 4 ounces frozen lima beans, thawed ( white beans ) | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 3/4 cups bread flour | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f/180c.  Mix mangoes, lima beans, cornstarch, sugar, coriander, onion and ground coriander in a bowl and set aside.  Mix flour and bread flour in a large bowl.  Add sugar and mix well.  Add wet ingredients and mix well with mixer.  Press mixture into greased loaf tin and bake for 45 minutes, or until top is golden.

title: Nanayeh Fesen (Fried Yogurt With cornflour)
ingredients: 250 g yogurt ( arab preferred ) | 3 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: In a bowl mix together the yogurt and cornflour.  Take spooned yogurt and dip the top in the cornflour mix and eat it.  Enjoy.

title: Stilton and Marjoram Pate
ingredients: 200 g stilton cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Line the chopping board with greaseproof paper and cut the cheese into cubes.  Add the marjoram, stir well and then add a pinch of salt and mix through.  Add the cheese and process until the mixture resembles finely diced pate.  Scoop into a pastry bag and store in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Pesto Lasagna - New Zealander Laban Beef & Pomegranate Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1 jar pesto sauce | 1 package lasagna noodles, pre-cooked | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate, seeded, quartered | pesto sauce, for top
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Cook ground beef in a frying pan over medium heat until browned and drained.  Mix in 3 cups pesto sauce and heat through.  Set aside until ready to use.  Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.  Place the lasagna noodles in the bottom of an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish.  Spread 2/3 cup of meat mixture evenly over noodles.  Spoon 2/3 cup of pesto over meat mixture.  Spoon 1 cup pomegranate quarters evenly over pesto.  Spread remaining pesto over the pomegranate and pesto.  Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes.  Uncover, and continue baking for an additional 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly.  Top with more pomegranate and pesto as desired.

title: Sweet Spinach and Coconut
ingredients: 2 cups coconut milk | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 bunches fresh spinach, washed | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
instructions: In a wok, heat coconut milk to boiling.  Add cumin and stir once.  Add spinach and stir once again till spinach is well coated.  Add salt and stir.  Cook 2 minutes.  Add jalapeno pepper and remove from heat.  Serve hot.

title: Chinese New Year's Eve snow peas and Snow Peas in Sugar
ingredients: 1/2 lb snow peas | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 sprig rosemary
instructions: Wash snow peas and snap peas.  Cut peas crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Heat wok or large deep non stick skillet over med high heat until hot.  Add oil and swirl to coat.  Add snow peas and snow peas to hot pan.

Random Ingredients: jerk sauce,milk chocolate,red curry paste,grainy mustard,spanish onion,italian seasoning
title: Jerk Sauce for One (Chop & Me Fritters)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon red curry paste, yellow | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning, dry | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted | 2 tablespoons sweet white onion, finely chopped ( or red onion )
instructions: Blend mustard, curry paste, hot sauce, italian seasoning, and milk chocolate in blender until smooth.  Mix in onion.  Refrigerate unused portion of sauce.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,taco seasoning mix,poblano chile,champagne vinegar,beet,chicken liver,spaghetti sauce
title: Spicy Chicken Livers in Pasta and Champagne Vinegar
ingredients: 3 cans chicken livers, drained | 1 can shrimp or 1 can nrawn, drained | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup dry chile ( optional ) or 1/2 cup dried poblano chile ( optional )
instructions: Cook livers in boiling water until tender.

title: Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon bottled deli pickled jalapeno pepper, minced, with jalapeno seeds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Easy Mexican Lamb Fondue With Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb, cut into about 1 inch cubes ( or 1/2 pound and 1/2 pound ) | 1 lb potato starch, for dredging | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 cup finely shredded gruyere cheese or 1 cup other hard cheese, like cheddar | 1/2 cup salsa, for dipping, of choice, such as old el paso | 1/4 cup finely shredded pecans ( optional ) or 1/4 cup walnuts, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Make the fondue by whisking the melted cheese together.  Add the crumbled cooked lamb cubes.  Dissolve the creole seasoning and gruyere cheese in the creole and pour over the lamb cubes.  Toss lightly until the mixture is well coated.  Transfer the dough to a floured baking mold.  Press the dough into the mold.  If desired, make another fondue that does not touch the water and cheese to the top.  Place the mold onto a cookie sheet or wax paper, so the dough hangs over the sides of the mold from over.  Chill at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.  Heat the butter in a large pot or dutch oven on medium high until it foams, about 3 minutes.  Shake the dough a few times to remove excess flour.  Transfer the dough to a plate to cool.  To serve, turn the bread onto a heated serving platter.  Place a mound of the crumbled cheese into the center of the bread then surround each mound of crumbled cheese with a few cubes of lamb, salsa and a few chopped nuts.  Repeat with the rest of the crumbled cheese and lamb cubes.

Random Ingredients: sugar,linguine,pastry double crust pie,dijon mustard,margarine,cardamom seed,buttermilk,chicken
title: Dijon Fried Chicken Picnic Baked in Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 package pastry for double crust pie, pillsbury ready-made | 1 1/2 lbs chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Pour buttermilk into 2 13x9x2 inch baking dishes or large, deep dish pie plates that have been sprayed with pam.  Line a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with pastry.  In a small saucepan, combine buttermilk and 1/2 cup water.

title: Green Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 can green chilies, chopped | cornmeal
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place chilies in 2 quart shallow baking dish, sprinkle with cornmeal, and bake about 25 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Bouillon Chicken & Gravy
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 tablespoon beef bouillon, powder
instructions: Season chicken with bouillon powder and set aside.  Heat a large skillet or wok over medium heat.  Add some oil, if using a saute pan and cook chicken until browned,.  Remove chicken from pan and set aside.  Pour out all but about 1 t oil from the skillet, or if using a wok.  Add onion and sautee over medium heat until limp, but not browned.  Return chicken to the pan.  Add gravy to cover and serve.

title: Baked Apple and Avocado Barley
ingredients: 2 apples, peeled, cored and diced | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 teaspoon dried onion salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice and zest of | 1 1/2 tablespoons lard | 4 tablespoons cold butter, diced
instructions: Preheat oven 350°f.  Place the diced apple into a bowl, then pour over the pearl barley the salt and dried onion.  Toss to coat, then add the lime juice and lime zest.  Lightly butter a shallow 2lb loaf pan, then cover with parchment paper and sprinkle top with a light coating of butter.  Place into oven for about 45 minutes, or until cooked and caramelized.  Remove from oven, stir and serve hot.

title: Irish Tomato Mousse
ingredients: 16 ounces roma tomatoes | 2 tablespoons bailey's irish cream
instructions: Remove the rind of each tomato and puree in a food processor.  Transfer to an iced coffee mug.  Top with bailey's.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,sesame oil,ritz cracker,raspberry,italian sausage,farfalle pasta,grand marnier,icing sugar
title: Grandma's Sausage With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 package farfalle pasta | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/8 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon crushed dried raspberries | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | raspberry jam or preserves
instructions: Put the sausage into a skillet over medium to medium high heat with the sesame oil until well browned.  Cook until no longer pink, about 5 mintues.  Meanwhile, cook and drain the pasta.  While cooking the sausage, drain and rinse the sausage.  Add the pasta and sausage to the skillet with the sesame oil, grand marnier, raspberries, and old bay.  Pour enough water to come a few inches over the mixture.  Simmer on the stovetop until the pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Puerto Rican Steak Wrap (Antigua and Barbuda)
ingredients: 1 ripe guava ( i like guavas and guavas ) | 1/2 cup dark beer ( i like schlenker's dark beer ) | 1/2 vidalia onion | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Cut up the guava and place into a bowl.  Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of rice wine vinegar and add more vinegar.  Taste and adjust seasonings to your taste.  Let sit for 10 minutes.  Slice the onion finely.  Heat a skillet and add slices of onion.  Cook until brown and crisp.  Remove from skillet and set on paper towel to drain.  Slice the steak as thinly as possible between the slices.  Place onto a warm tortilla and wrap it in the warmed guava and onion slice.  Enjoy a bowl of guava flavored stilado with guavas and onion.

title: Vietnamese Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/4 pound ground pork | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons frozen minced onion | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the ground pork, fish sauce, onion, and oregano.  Divide mixture into 8 patties.  Spray patties with cooking spray, and grill for 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until no longer pink in the center.

title: Chile-Grilled Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 green chili pepper | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 -4 teaspoons grated scallions
instructions: Slice chile vertically, lengthwise, into 1/4 pieces.  Grind peanuts with 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 teaspoons green chili peppers, and 2 teaspoons scallions.  Spoon mixture into a shallow bowl.  Cover and chill 1/2 hour.  Heat grill to medium heat.  Remove chili from marinade, reserving marinade.  Thread 1/2 of the hazelnut into long, thin strips.  Sprinkle with salt.  Grill hazelnuts 1 - 2 minutes, turning once, until nuts are lightly browned and lightly charred.  Sprinkle with extra soy sauce.  Sprinkle with remaining hazelnuts and serve.  Serve with reserved marinade.

title: Crock Pot Corned Beef Hash
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb dried cassava, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese | 1 cup mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: In 5 quart slow cooker, place chopped cassava in a slow cooker.  Add beef, cheddar cheese and cayenne powder.  Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 6 to 8 hours or until beef falls apart and shreds easily.  Remove beef hash from cooker and cut into squares or slices and return to slow cooker for 30 minutes to reheat.  Serve hot.

title: Spanish Style Italian Apples With Pickles
ingredients: 12 -16 medium italian tomatoes | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh dill pickles | 1 small cooking apple, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a broiler to 400°f.  To make tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: herb,arborio rice,gruyere cheese,italian seasoning,basil pesto,virgin olive oil,salmon,capicola
title: Herby Rice and Salmon Bake
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1 envelope basil pesto | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 1/2 lb fresh salmon, sliced thinly | 8 ounces capicola | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Grease and flour a 9 x 13 baking dish.  In a bowl, stir the rice into the pesto until it is mixed well.  Stir in the chopped basil and italian seasoning.  Place the rice mixture in a large bowl.  In the oven while the rice cooks, heat 1 t.  Of the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add the salmon and cook, stirring the salmon once or twice, until cooked through, about 5 minutes.  Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside, reserving the cooking oil.  Spread the salmon on the top of the rice mixture and top with the capicola.  Sprinkle with the grated gruyere and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until bubbly.

title:
Artichoke and Pomegranate Pies With St.
    - Pino Di Pino
ingredients: 1 package pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 7 artichokes ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple chunk, cut into chunks | 10 -12 pomegranate juice, from pomegranates ( see note ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon verbena leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/4 cup thompson seedless grapes ( or red grape grapes ) | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Open crescent rolls and separate dough into 7 rectangles.  Set aside.  Place artichoke cubes around edge of rectangles on a tray.  Bake at 350 f for about 20 minutes or until golden.  Remove and set aside.  Add pineapple chunks and the juice to artichoke hearts.

title: Crispy Pretzel
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely crushed pretzels | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: In a bowl combine pretzels and onion powder.  Shape into small balls.  Refrigerate until completely dry.  Roll in melted butter and serve.

title: Fettuccine Carbonara
ingredients: 14 ounces fettuccine, broken in half | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 medium green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen green peppers, thawed
instructions: Cook fettuccine and set aside.  Meanwhile in a large, deep skillet, heat bacon drippings and cook peppers briefly.  Drain and set aside.  In a large serving bowl, toss all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: butter,italian dressing,cake flour,beef broth,salt pepper,thai fish sauce,bulk pork sausage,quinoa
title: Creamy Italian Pork & Quinoa
ingredients: 1 package instant potato sticks ( about 10 ) | 8 3/4 ounces pork sausage | 2 cups cooked quinoa | 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons melted butter | 1 tablespoon italian-style dressing | salt and pepper
instructions: Boil the broth in a saucepan till it is reduced and syrupy.  Meanwhile, melt the butter and thai fish sauce together in a medium saucepan over med heat, stirring.  Add the dry ingredients and mix well with the melted butter and fish sauce.  When the soup is ready and hot, add the soup to the pan, stirring well to blend.  Cook until it begins to bubble.  Turn down the heat and simmer the soup for about 10 minutes on med low heat or till all the pork and quinoa have melted into the soup and is bubbling vigorously.  Season with salt& pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: mint,cherry pie filling,pork shoulder,icing sugar,lemon zest,lasagna noodle
title: Sara's Pork and Mint Lasagne
ingredients: 450 g boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 350 g cherry pie filling, canned or ( 500 g ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 12 lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint, to serve
instructions: Place the pork in a large saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to the boil, then simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until meat has fallen off the bone.  Strain and discard the water.  Cool, then chill overnight.  Preheat oven to 200°c.  Put the can of pie filling into a large bowl, and add the icing sugar.  Mix, then divide the mixture between 6 small lasagne or baking dishes.  Spread half of the filling mixture over the noodles, then scatter over half of the mint.  Cover with the remaining lasagne or baking dishes, again spreading the filling over the noodles.  Sprinkle over the remaining mint and cover with foil.  Bake in oven for 40 minutes, until hot and bubbling.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: red chile powder,pork shoulder,cooking oil,grand marnier
title: Tunisian Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon red chile powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon crushed red chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rack and trim of fat.  Rinse well, discard it.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Score the skin and fat with sharp knife into 1 inch or less diamonds.  In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, or similar dish, combine the pork, grand marnier, 1 tablespoon cooking oil, and 3 to 5 tablespoons of crushed red chile powder.  Cover and marinate at room temperature, refrigerated, for 24 hours.  Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Transfer the pork to a cutting board and cut into bite sized pieces.  Transfer the meat to the baking dish.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for 75 to 90 minutes, or until juices run clear when the meat is pierced with a knife.  The internal temperature of the meat should be at least 145°f do not overcook the pork or it will be very dry.  Transfer the pork and marinade to a serving dish and garnish with the remaining 3 tablespoons of crushed chile powder.

title: Carnitas
ingredients: 12 fresh black olives | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Remove black olives from pack and discard pits.  Slice the olive in half and remove the membrane if desired.  Place cut side down in a square baking pan.  Dice the olives and add them to the pan.  Add a splash of adobo to the top and sprinkle generously with any remaining adobo.  Bake in a pre heated over at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken drumstick | 1 -12 cup prepared salsa ( depending on the size of the drumsticks, see note below )
instructions: Place chicken drumsticks into a slow cooker.  Pour salsa over chicken.  Cover and cook on high for 5 hours or low for 8 hours.  Serve with rice and beans and garnish if desired.  Notes, see note for salsa instructions.  Cook time includes 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,lemon juice,vermouth,granola cereal,apple cider,five spice powder,nigella seed,sage leaf
title: Five Spice French Mackerel Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup firmly packed dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth, plus some additional | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 6 large flat slices smoked streaky foisel with some marmalade, preferably with a light coating of dark sesame oil | 10 fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon granola cereal
instructions: Combine dark sesame oil, five spice powder, lemon juice, vermouth, sesame oil, lemon juice, five spice powder and sage.  Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,broth,coconut extract,semolina,monterey jack cheese,beef brisket
title: Mexican Brisket and Broth
ingredients: 10 lbs beef brisket | 1 cup semolina ( or coarse ground white rice ) | 10 cups broccoltes ( or white corn or wheat or multigrain ) | 1 cup coconut extract | 4 serrano chili ( or poblano chiles ) | 2 -3 cups broth
instructions: Place the brisket in a large pot with at least 2 inches of water.  Bring to just a boil, then lower to simmer.  Simmer, covered, about 3 hours.  Turn brisket and boil 1 more hour.  Cool.  Place the brisket in a large flat metal bowl, add 3 cups beef broth, the semolina, and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate 12 days.  When ready to serve, remove plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 4 days.  When ready to serve, remove brisket from broth, remove fat, and chop.  Discard the bones and gristle sacs and trimmings, or save the broth for later use.  Add 1 tablespoon cocoacorn or other neutral flavor flavoring like a combination of corn, rice, chiles, and enough of the retained broth to make a thick, soupy gravy.  Heat the remaining broccoltes or corn to a boiling point, then reduce heat to medium.  Simmer, covered, about 30 minutes or until tender.  Slice brisket against the grain and serve hot.

title: Italian Potatoes Crescent Roll
ingredients: 2 cans sliced green olives, drained | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 2 tablespoons prepared pizza sauce | 4 kraft ready-to-use crescent rolls | 3/4 cup leftover mashed potatoes | 3 tablespoons pitted, sliced pitted green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Combine olives, nutmeg, and pizza sauce in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive pimento,sun tomato oil,self raising flour,vodka
title: The Real Mix
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups self raising flour | 3/4 cup vodka | 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 2/3 cup spanish pimento
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Add the sun dried tomatoes and pimentos.  Mix thoroughly with a spoon.  Add the vodka and mix.  Do not overmix.  Spoon the mix into a lined 2 litre plastic pudding mould, or clingfilm lined with baking paper.  Cover with plastic wrap and stand in the fridge for 6 hours or overnight.  Preheat the oven to 160 degrees celcius.  Remove the plastic wrap and place the mould on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Mark lines around the top with a star shaped knife.  Spray the mould and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Turn the mould over a few times for 30 seconds or until the mixture resembles a large, flat round cake.  Spray again with oil, drizzle with olive oil and bake for 40 minutes until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,aluminum foil,chuck roast,baking soda,cooking onion
title: Roast Beef with Fennel & Onion
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 fennel bulbs, chopped | cooking onion, chopped | 1 chuck roast, trimmed | 4 aluminum foil
instructions: Combine baking soda over the fennel and onions.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Pierce meat with a skewer and rub with baking soda.  Place roast.  Put pan on the top rack of the oven and bake for 1 hour.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  This can be served with sautéed baby carrots, roasted potatoes or roast vegetables.  Great with a little parmesan cheese in the center.

title: Mexican-Style Baked Rigatoni
ingredients: 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapeno peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add rigatoni pasta, cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Linguine With Honey Mustard
ingredients: 9 ounces linguine | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons honey
instructions: Cook linguine at a time according to the package directions, drain, cover with cool water and reserve.  Meanwhile, mix mustard powder into mayonnaise and honey.  Add mustard mixture to hot pasta and toss together.  Serve immediately.

title: Olive Halves
ingredients: 2 cups pitted green olives, halved | 1 cup dry cherries, halved | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 cup white flour | 1 refrigerated pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a large bowl, toss olives and cherries with buttermilk, making sure to coat them evenly.  Sprinkle flour over mixture and mix well.  Roll out pie crust on a floured board.  Using a 2 inch fluted cutter, cut the pie crust into squares.  Use a 2 1/2 inch flan or round cutter to cut circles, or use a cutter to cut circles larger than the diameter of your flan.  Place equal amounts of the olives and crumbled pie crust squares into the center of the squares.  Fold the outer half of each square over the filling and crimp the edges.  Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Irish Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 head garlic, peeled
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes.  Cut them into slices about 5 x 3 1/2.  Put on a tray and bake them at 400f for about 1 hour or until the potatoes are completely cooked.  When the potatoes are completely cool enough to handle, put them in a bowl and mash them lightly with a fork.  Put the mashed potatoes and garlic into a large skillet over fairly high heat.  When the garlic is very hot, put the potatoes in and brown them lightly at the edges.  This may take up to 20 to 40 minutes, depending on how thick you like them.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,mustard powder,mint leaf,red chili pepper,back bacon,coconut rum
title: Bacon Wrapped in Tomato Mayonnaise
ingredients: 3 plums ( small to medium sized plums ) | 1 slice back bacon | 1 red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon coconut rum | 1/4 cup chopped mint leaf
instructions: Cut tomato into 5 - 6 rounds.  Bacon should be thick.  Place rounds on ungreased baking tray coated with cooking oil.  Grill or broil rounds for about 3 - 4 minutes per side until crisp and lightly browned.  Allow to cool and dice.  Chop bacon into tiny pieces and brown in skillet over medium heat until crisp.  Remove from skillet.  Mix in mustard powder and rum and set aside.  Remove from heat and add mint leaves until wilted.  Place tomato rounds on individual leaves for each other to resemble mayonnaise sandwich on your individual plate.

title: Mushrooms and Potato Chip Casserole

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f generously butter sides and bottom of a 5 - ½ quart casserole dish with 2 tb spoons or vegetable oil.

title: Cauliflower with Cauliflower (Agurkesa)
ingredients:
1 medium cauliflower ( about 2.
    -5 kgs ) | 125 g leeks, thinly sliced crossways | 1/2 cup tamari ( or other soy sauce ) | confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Clean cauliflower well.  Slice coarsely.  Wash leeks and wash thoroughly.  Cut cauliflower into slices approximately 1 1/2 1 cm thick.  In a large heavy skillet or wok, combine cauliflower slices, leeks, tamari and enough water to just barely cover.  Bring to the boil.

title: Crispy Phyllo Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves, cut into small pieces | 4 figs, diced | 1 cup finely shredded coconut | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cup shortening
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add cubed chicken and simmer until almost cooked through, 3 minutes.  Drain and cool slightly.  Stir in figs, coconut, and cumin.  Coat chicken mixture with frozen phyllo sheets.  Cut dough into 5 strips about 2 wide.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

title: Sushi Nori
ingredients: 1 square nori | 12 large raisins | 12 cherry rolls, leaves torn or 12 short sushi nori | 1/4 cup honey | 1 small head of lettuce
instructions: Arrange 1 leaf of nori on a sushi rolling mat.  Spread 1/2 teaspoon of raisins over nori.  Repeat with 2 additional nori sheets.  Spread 1/2 teaspoon of cherries over nori.  Roll and slice horizontally into 3 long strips.  Repeat with remaining nori and raisins.  Spread honey on each roll.  Cut each roll into 3 slices.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,pam cooking spray,rice wine vinegar,salsa,bean sprout
title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1/2 cup salsa ( i prefer jazz's spicy salsa ) | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/8 cup bean sprouts | pam cooking spray
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, cover, and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, turn the beans over, cover, and refrigerate overnight.  Drain the beans and measure out about 1/2 cup liquid.  Bring the rest of the liquid to a boil and add the beans.  Reduce heat, simmer, and cook 1 1/2 hours, or until tender and creamy.

title: Spinach and Beef Samosas
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef chuck, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb fresh spinach, stems trimmed | 7 cups packed fresh coriander seeds, coarsely crushed | 10 ounces jarred salsa | 12 ounces bag fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Spray electric skillet with nonstick cooking spray.  Place beef in skillet and sprinkle with salt.  Arrange on top rack in skillet and cook over high heat 2 to 3 minutes, or until browned.

title: Crum-Braised Swiss Broccoli

title: Poblanos and Espresso

Cool on wire rack and keep in air tight container.

title: Cracker Cookies II

The dish should be creamy.

title: Beef-Wrapped Flat Pan Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Stretch out a circle large enough to completely wrap out your dough.  Cut out round dough from center of dough to reach approximately 12x12. Pour the reserved sauce over.  Sprinkle the fontina cheese on top.  Place under a preheated oven for 5 minutes or until the cheese is bubbling.

title: Rotini With Veal, Veal, Vodka and Lemon

instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the rotini for 4 minutes.  Drain and set aside to keep warm.  In a nonstick pan, heat 1 t oil. title: Spanish Shrimp and Beet Wraps

title: Easy Beef Potatoes

instructions: Peel potatoes.  Cut each potato lenghtwise into four pieces using a cookie cutter, so that the pieces don't discolor.  Place potatoes on a cutting board that has been sprinkled with seasoning salt.  Cut each potato into eight wedges.  Place in a large dutch oven or cast iron frying pan and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.  Add tomatoes with liquid, mushrooms and seasoning salt and continue to simmer, covered, for approximately 40 - 60 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.  Allow mixture to cool, then drain off water before serving.

title: Cherie's Watermelon Kebab
ingredients: 1/2 cup watermelon, chunks | 1/2 cup american cheese or 1/2 cup edam cheese, of your choice | ketchup, for dipping | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 cup ketchup
instructions: Soak the watermelon chunks in water for 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Cube american cheese of your choice and mash with a fork.  Combine with shredded melon and spread on a small plate or tray.  Dip in the ketchup and sprinkle with cardamom.  If grilling, add 1 - 2 teaspoons of ketchup and heat gently.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,greek yogurt,lamb meat,brown mustard seed,vegetable broth,saffron thread,basmati rice
title: My Kebab
ingredients: 1 lb lamb meat | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 package saffron threads | 12 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup dried parsley flakes | 2 cups greek yogurt
instructions: Soak saffron threads in hot water for 15 - 30 minutes until lightly colored.  Drain and place on a cloth covered cookie sheet with a lid.  Soak for 10 minutes then rinse.  Add meat with bones to bones and cover with water.  Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes, then drain off any excess liquid.  Set meat aside and keep the broth for later use.  Wash rice thoroughly.  Soak rice in boiling water for 15 minutes, then drain and add to broth in a pot.  Add 2 cups more of the broth.  Bring to a boil and add 1 teaspoon of mustard seed and 2 cups of the saffron infused soaked saffron.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile mix rice with remaining broth.  Cover and leave in a warm place for 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and allow to stand for 10 minutes.  Rinse hands with cold water and separate 2 cups rice and place in center of a deep platter.  Pour 1 cup of the yogurt over the top and arrange remaining 1 cup of rice around.  Spoon meat mixture over it and top with remaining yogurt.  Place in a warm place for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Apple and Escarole Salad
ingredients: 2 tart apples, such as granny smith | 1 tablespoon dried chile, crushed | 1 bunch watercress, tough stems trimmed | 1/2 small head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 small head escarole, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 can shrimp, drained | 3 tablespoons cocktail-size soft cocktail onions
instructions: Place the apple in a large dutch oven or pot with just enough water to cover the apples by at least 1/2 inch.  Bring water to a boil, and add the chile and watercress.  Cover, and simmer over medium low heat with lid slightly ajar, for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, and let stand for 10 minutes.  Remove the apple core, and cut into thin wedges.  Discard the core.  Place in a large bowl along with the romaine, escarole, and shrimp.  In a small bowl, mix the cocktail onions with the cocktail onions.  Stir in the apples, and serve.

instructions: Preheat skillet on medium high heat.  Layer all ingredients in slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low heat for 5 to 6 hours.

instructions: In a large pot heat broth and add beans and boullion.  Bring to boil and simmer over medium heat 5 minutes.  Add olives and serve.  Optional, to a 6 cup bowl with cooked pasta put 3 cups cooked pasta and garbanzo.  Toss well and serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,white bean,simple syrup,yogurt,mandarin orange,dark brown sugar,superfine sugar
title: American Kitchen Classic Savoury White Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 4 teaspoons superfine sugar | 3 cups superfine sugar | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 4 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Heat the cooking oil in a 10 inch heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering.  In a medium bowl, stir 2 teaspoons sugar with 2 teaspoons of superfine sugar until dissolved.  Stir in the white beans, mandarin oranges, dark brown sugar, and syrup.  Remove from heat and chill.  The mixture will be pretty thick.  Scoop the bean mixture into two buttered 1 1/2 quart mini muffin pans.  Brush the tops of the mini muffin pans with the oil and set aside.  Bake the prepared muffins on middle rack of the oven until puffed, golden brown, and a tester inserted into the center of a mini muffin comes out clean, about 20 minutes.  Let cool for one minute, then remove the muffins to a warm platter.

title: Spinach Chicken Breasts with Creamy-Baked Lettuce Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Coat the chicken with the fennel, anise and some salt.  Arrange chicken on a greased wire rack set in a shallow baking dish, skin side down.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.  Remove from heat and let cool completely.  When cool enough, slice thin on the diagonal.  To make the dressing, put the lettuce, spinach and baby spinach in a large salad bowl.  Combine the cream and 1 tbsp.  Of the warm dressing and drizzle over the salad. Meanwhile, heat the remaining dressing in a small skillet over moderate heat, stirring until sizzling.  Transfer the mixture to a small bowl and season with pepper.  Drain chicken.  Serve with salad, topped with chicken and sauce.

title: Normandy Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast or 4 lbs pork butt roast | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | kirsch ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 8 ounces neufchatel cheese or 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 1 lb fresh raspberry ( optional ) | 10 -12 ounces cubed cured salmon
instructions: Place the meat in a crockpot and add the wine, lemon zest and kirsch if using.  Cook on low for 6 hours.  Turn the meat over, remove any excess fat, and turn the heat up to high until the temperature reaches 150 degrees f.  Remove the meat from the crockpot and shred the meat in the crockpot.  While stew is reducing, toast sesame seeds in a griddle pan over low heat.  Cool them and allow them to thaw before using.  In a microwave safe bowl, microwave velveeta for 30 - 40 seconds to soften.  Add the swiss cheese and mix using your hands until melted.  Stir in the sesame seeds.  Remove the soup from the heat.  Return the soup to the crockpot.  Stir in the salmon.  Cover and cook on high for 30 - 40 minutes or until the soup is hot and thickened.  Note, you could serve this in two large soup bowls or six 6 ounce portions.  If serving as a meal, you can serve this with boiled potatoes, but it's perfect inside a sandwich.

instructions: Put rice and yoghurt in a sieve then mix well.  Pour into a flat glass bowl then cover and leave in warm place for 30 minutes or until the yoghurt is absorbed.  Serve garnished with slices of fresh mint.

2 cups soymilk ( for vegan use coconut milk, coconut sugar, etc.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until needed use.

instructions: Put the shrimp in a bowl with a lid.  Sprinkle on the bell pepper.  Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.  You don't need to cook them long, just to heat them through.  Serve at once.

title: Guiness Black Guinness

title: Creme Fraiche-Dessert (Gâteau Lyonnaise)

instructions: Boil the rice in enough water to cover for 45 minutes.  Put all the ingredients into the rice cooker and set on medium heat for 7 - 9 hours, or until almost tender.  Cook the fettuccine according to package directions and serve over the cooked rice.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Short Ribs

Drain the dal and transfer the water into a pot along with the tomato and boil until the flesh is soft.  Drain off the water and mash the mung dal.  If you have a mortar & pestle and you want to make this little less messy, you can use a food processor.  Add the sesame seeds and sugar.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 cup pizza sauce, your favorite, warm | 1 -2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese, fresh | 4 slices bananas, cooked ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Add sauce, cream of tartar and cheese in a medium bowl.  Mix lightly, stir in bananas and cocoa to desired texture.  Spread on pizza pinwheels.  Note, i prefer to roll my dough like a meat counter to make pinwheels, using my hands to roll dough until the size you get i use a pizza roller, 9 x 10 inches.  Cut dough as in the photo, using a pizza cutter, as you cut, into 4 pieces.  I cut each piece at 1/4 to 1/2 inch intervals.  I bake in a convection oven, preheating to 400 degrees f.  About 25 to 30 minutes, depending on the size of your dough, and how big your tortillas are.  Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes.  You can cut them in smaller pieces or roll them into long strips, as long as they are thin.  I use a large pizza paddle or round pizza paddle.  Tip, for a crisp crust, make the dough while hot by spreading 1/4 inch cream of tartar on each square of dough.  Turn once.  For even crispness, lay on a piece of plastic wrap.  Remove the wrap, and spread the dough with a teaspoon or so of cream of tartar.  This will make nice puffs, or whatever shapes your pinwheels will form.  Try to get them to be about 1/4 inch in diameter.  After brushing the inside with cream of tartar, sprinkle top with some powdered sugar.  Try not to let the sugar bubble, or they will end up browning too quickly.  Bake in a preheated 450 to 400°f oven, for about 12 to 15 minutes or until crust is crispy golden.  Remove from oven, and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Cumin Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon leaves | 1 ounce frozen seltzer water
instructions: Combine cumin seed and tarragon leaves.  Crush the seeds into a small mortar using the flat edge of a glass.  Gradually stir in the frozen water.  Stir until dissolved.

title: Thai Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn kernels | 1 can coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon ground almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill.  Place the corn kernels on the grill, and cook until just starting to blacken on the kernels.  When all is hot, remove corn from grill, and set aside to cool.  Pour coconut cream into a glass or ceramic bowl, and set aside.  Stir in almond extract, if desired.  Spread the corn kernels on the top of the coconut cream, and serve.

title: Lori's Big Meat & Gravy for Pasta
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs lean chuck, very lean | 1 cup low sodium soy crumbles, i use low sodium | 1/4 cup bacon fat, low sodium is alright | 5 tablespoons harissa ( if using a real tsbp spice blend, you can choose a `` pinch '', but i use plenty.
    -.
    -.
    - ) | 1 cup low sodium soymilk ( you also want to add a little bit of almond milk to get that `` liquid '' consistency ) | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese, or more to taste ( i use more to make it a `` runny '' cheese )
instructions: Cut the beef into 1 1/2 chunks and then into ¾ pieces.  In a large pan, add a little olive oil to coat and saute the meat with the harissa, bacon fat and soymilk until there is no pink.  After the meat has been seasoned with a tsbp spice blend, saute in batches if necessary until done to your liking.  Once done, transfer to a heated bowl and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese and let set in the pan for a while.  Serve the dish over spaghetti or other pasta of your choice.  A nice salad would also help mellow the flavors of the meat and help to eliminate the dryness of the soymilk.  Enjoy.

title: Wild and Wild Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb sliced smoked chicken | 3 dried cloud ear mushrooms | 1/2 fresh lemon, juiced | 1 medium button mushroom | 1 pint fresh strawberries, quartered | 1/2 cup chopped fresh french's corn | 1/4 cup frangelico
instructions: Cook chicken in 2 tbsp water, in oiled skillet until no longer pink and browned.  Remove chicken to a bowl, cover and set aside.  Clean mushrooms and remove stems, and chop into bite sized pieces.  Dice mushrooms into bite sized pieces.  Place mushrooms and chicken in bowl with the mushrooms, mushrooms, lemon juice, fresh strawberries, and the french's corn.  Stir to combine.  Cover and place in the refrigerator to marinate for 1 hour to overnight, stirring occasionally.  Remove cover and continue over low heat until liquid has reduced to approximately 1 cup.  Remove from heat and serve over icecream with a sprinkling of the frangelico.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,blueberry,muenster cheese,beef chuck roast,yellow cornmeal,plain yogurt,enchilada sauce
title: Beef Philly and Blueberry Enchilada Bake
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 4 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups shredded muenster cheese | 3 cups fresh torn blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Pour enchilada sauce into a 13x9 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle beef with salt.  Place beef in baking dish.  Pour enchilada sauce over beef.  In a separate bowl mix together the yogurt, cornmeal and 1/2 the soup can of water.  Spoon over beef.  Sprinkle with remaining soup can of water.  Cover and bake 45 minutes or until beef is tender, stirring twice.  Serve beef with remaining soup and blueberries.

title: Tender Grilled Lobster Tail
ingredients: 1 lobster tail | 1/2 cup thick chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Place tail onto grill over medium high heat with hood closed.  Cook for about 5 to 10 minutes or until slightly charred.  Remove lobster tail and allow to cool.  Remove shell and cut into quarters.  Mix dipping sauce with salsa.  Spoon dipping sauce into a small plastic ziplock bag.  Squeeze lobster tails, ensuring that both ends are secure, and snip meat into large fingers that are no larger than 1/4 inch.

Random Ingredients: currant,corn flake,hot italian sausage,table salt,corn kernel,soba noodle,dulce de leche
title: Sausage and Noodle Supper
ingredients: 2 -3 links hot italian sausages ( or regular sausages ) | 3 2 cups corn kernels ( canned or fresh, if you are using a fresh one ) or 3 cups frozen corn kernels ( canned or fresh, if you are using a fresh one ) | 12 cups hot cooked soba noodles ( or regular white rice noodles ) | 1 1/2 cups raisins ( golden ) or 1 1/2 cups dried currants ( golden ) | 1/4 cup corn flakes, crushed | 2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Line a jelly roll pan with parchment paper and grease with no stick cooking spray.  In a large nonstick skillet set over medium high heat, saute sausages, turning, until cooked through and brown on the outside, 8 to 10 minutes.  Transfer the sausages to a plate and let cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: manzanilla olive,ketchup,cellophane noodle,self rising flour,egg wrapper
title: Spanish Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 egg roll wrap ( about 12 x 4 x 1/8 in size ) | 2 tablespoons cellophane noodles | 1/3 cup ketchup | 3 tablespoons manzanilla olives, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons self rising flour
instructions: Place egg roll wrap on a baking pan sprayed with cooking spray.  Spray it with cooking spray.  Bake at 375°f for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool completely.  Toast cellophane noodles in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring until they are just crisp, not browned, and transfer to a bowl.  In a small bowl stir together tomato ketchup, ketchup, olives, and flour, to taste.  Spread noodles in 3 - 4 tsp portions on a plate.  Spoon some noodle mixture into center of each noodle.  Sprinkle with desired amount of salt and pepper.

title: Easy and Quick Flatbread
ingredients: 2 hamburger | 1 teaspoon yoghurt | 2 spring onions
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Serve with pita bread.

title: Crispy Broccoli Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, washed and trimmed | 1 cup arborio rice | 3 -4 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Blanch broccoli in a pot of boiling water until bright green and just tender.  Remove immediately and drain well.  Place broccoli in an ovenproof dish.  Place rice on top of broccoli.  Add the rice wine.  Cover and bake at 120 °c for 30 to 40 minutes or until rice is tender.  Alternatively, steam the broccoli in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Artichoke Cocktail
ingredients: 7 ounces artichoke bottoms | 5 ounces fresh pineapple juice | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced
instructions: Drain and chop the artichokes and pineapple, and refrigerate in a jar until serving.

title: Taste for Inspiration
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 quart grape tomatoes | 1 quart string | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 12 drops tabasco sauce or 12 drops ancho chili sauce
instructions: In a kettle, simmer all vegetable stock, tomatoes, string and vinegars for 5 - 10 minutes.  Add tabasco, chili, taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Port Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cut down legs of the chicken.  Place chicken in an oven dish.  Sprinkle remaining ingredients into a ziplock bag.  Shake to coat the chicken in the marinade completely.  Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the ziplock bag.  Pour the marinade over the chicken and put the bag in the oven.  Cook at 350°f for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear, turning and basting once or twice.  Serve with pasta of your choice.

title: Black Beans and Cheddar
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker.  Cover, if using a larger crock pot, and cook on high 4 - 5 hours, or on low 6 - 7 hours, until beans are tender.  Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,cumin powder,black pepper,vegetable shortening,artichoke heart,chicken bouillon cube,lamb,green cardamom pod
title: Indian Spiced Lamb With Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 4 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts | 1/4 cup cumin powder | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 8 1/2 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained, liquid reserved | 6 chicken bouillon cubes | black pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients.  Cut shortening into pieces, one piece at a time.  Add 2 tablespoons liquid from artichokes.  Add meat to dry ingredients and mix to combine.  Shape mixture into 12 large patties.  Heat a non stick skillet over medium low heat.  Add 2 tablespoons of the reserved artichoke liquid.  Add patties to the skillet.  Cover and cook until they reach desired doneness, turning once, approximately 7 minutes per side for medium.  Remove from skillet, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

title: Sauerkraut and Ricotta (Crock Pot Recipe)
ingredients: 4 ounces sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano | 4 -5 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the bean sprouts in the crock pot.  Cover and cook on high for 4 - 6 hours until vegetables are tender.  Use the leftover sauerkraut for another use.  Add the bean sprouts just before serving.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,chipotle powder,artichoke heart,flour tortilla,orange,tomato paste,self rising flour
title: Tex-Mex Pizza Strips
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 12 -14 medium flour tortillas | 1/2 cup chopped and seeded sun-dried tomatoes ( may use a mixture of the two if desired ) or 1/2 cup chopped fresh tomatoes ( may use a mixture of the two if desired ) | 24 ounces artichoke hearts, well drained ( can use another tomatoes if desired, can use one with a jalapeno or habanero in place of canned ) | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Combine the flour, chili oil and chilli powder in a mixing bowl or work surface and stir with a fork until the flour is well blended.  Place 8 small flour tortillas on work surface and work with your fingers to form 6 - 8 smaller tortillas.  Working with 1 tortilla at a time, place each tortilla between two sheets of plastic wrap.  Tightly cover and continue patting down each one so they are about 2/3 inch thick.  Lay the remaining tortillas on top of the tortillas.  Using both hands on the tortillas, slightly flatten each one slightly.  If using a knife, place 2 tortillas at a time between plastic and plastic wrap.  Using the heels of your hands, spread flour tortillas evenly over the tortillas.  Fold each into a rectangle and pinch with the edge of a wooden spoon to seal the edges.  Repeat with other tortillas.  Slice the crusts off the plastic wrap and lay the pizza on a flat baking sheet.  Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Cut the pizza into 3 equal squares.  Place half of the sun dried tomatoes in the center of each tortilla.  Distribute the quartered artichoke hearts inside.  Distribute the remaining sun dried tomato evenly across the pizza.  Spoon the orange juice evenly over all and around the pizza.  Place the second tortilla over the top.  With a spatula, transfer the pizza to the oven and bake for 10 - 12 minutes.  Remove from the oven and sprinkle on the grated orange rind.  Serve warm.

title: Totally Wokin' Canadian Maple Pork
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin ( large 1/2-inch pieces, see tip ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 packages top ramen noodles
instructions: Pound the tenderloin pieces to a thickness of 1/4 inch.  In a large skillet, warm the maple syrup over medium heat.  Coat the tenderloin with some rice syrup syrup.  Brown the pieces for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until nicely caramelized.  While you're mashing the tenderloin, add the ramen noodles to the skillet.  Stir frequently until heated through, but do not let them get crispy.  If the noodles seem dry, stir frequently.  When the noodles are done, immediately transfer to a platter and top with cooked tenderloin slices and serve.

title: Cauliflower Madras
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cleaned, cored and chopped ( approx 6 cups ) | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise
instructions: Steam cauliflower until tender, approx 10 - 15 minutes.  Cool and flake into bite size pieces.  Add to cauliflower sauce ingredients.  Mix well before serving.

Random Ingredients: olive,farfalle pasta,tomato paste,vanilla ice cream,pizza sauce
title: Fresh Pasta and Pesto from Leftovers!
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 3 cups low-fat pizza sauce | 3 tablespoons pesto prepared pizza sauce | 1 package farfalle pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Saute olive slices, tomato paste and pesto paste in the olive oil and tomato sauce until heated.  Drain pasta and transfer to a salad bowl.  Sprinkle with pesto.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,coriander powder,black greek olive,brandy,cardamom pod,ra el hanout spice mix,lettuce
title: Moroccan Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1/2 small yellow squash | 1/2 small yellow squash | 10 medium lettuce | 1/3 cup black greek olive | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Peel the yellow and white squash and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch rounds.  Cut each slice into 2 inch wide wedges if desired.  Separate the wedges and cut into 3 long pieces if desired.  Toss together in a large mixing bowl with the black olives, and set aside.  Slice the lettuce into 1 inch pieces and arrange in the lettuce leaves.  Sprinkle on the olives and garnish with the coriander and the cardamom pods.  If desired, add a pinch of ground black fennel.  Drizzle brandy over the salad and mix gently.  Garnish with finely sliced orange slices, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pork chop,kitchen bouquet,caramel,green onion,ginger garlic paste,jalapeno chile,currant
title: Pork Chops With Jam-Currant Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons grated ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup minced green onion | 1/8 - 1/4 jalapeno chile, minced ( to taste- i use a little more ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup dry currant | 1/2 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 4 boneless pork chops | 1 tablespoons butter ( i use olive oil )
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a small bowl.  Dry the chops lightly on both sides and sprinkle with 1 tablespoons of the sauce.  Pour remaining 1/2 cup of sauce over chops.  Cover and marinate at least 4 hours or overnight.  Remove chops from marinade.

title: A-Plus Broccoli Miso Spinach
ingredients: 3 bunches fresh spinach | 1 package sazon goya | 2 tablespoons spanish-style onions, minced | 3/4 cup dried apricots, chopped | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup frozen chopped broccoli | 2 tablespoons miso ( for dressing ) or vinegar ( for dressing )
instructions: In a steamer pan steam the spinach over medium heat until it collapses.  Cut the spinach crosswise into 1 inch pieces.  Place in a bowl and toss with sazon, onion, apricots, sugar, and broccoli.  Let stand to cool until serving time.  For dressing, combine miso and vinegar to achieve preferred creamy texture.

title: Orange Chicken
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange liqueur | 3 pounds chicken, cut into pieces | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix together orange liqueur, and chicken pieces.  Dip into graham cracker crumbs.  Place chicken on greased baking sheets.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until chicken is nicely browned and no longer pink inside.

title: Cottage Pie With Brandy and Spring Onions (Paleo)
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 1 cup chopped broccoli | 1 cup tomato, canned chopped | 1 slice brandy | 1 green olives, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped spring onion | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 -2 teaspoon fast action dry yeast | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Place ground beef in large frying pan.  Add chopped broccoli, tomato, brandy and olives.  Mix well.  Cover pan tightly.  Cook for 15 minutes.  Remove cover and cook an additional 7 - 8 minutes until meat is no longer pink.  Remove from heat and mash mixture well with a spoon.  Add spring onions and yeast.  Dissolve yeast and warm water in a cup.  Beat at high speed until foamy.  Pour into bowl and cover to keep warm in a warm place for 1 hour.  Take a large ovenproof dish and cover.  Put the beef mixture on top of the base, covering completely.  Place in a pre heated oven 180c for 30 - 40 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Cheddar and Golden Sy
ingredients: 4 ounces sushi-style rice | 1 1/3 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Asparagus and Prune Cake
ingredients: 10 -12 stalks asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 cup prune, pitted and cut in half | 2 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups double cream | 2 cups coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Lightly butter a 9 inch cake tin or an 8x8 inch baking dish.  In a bowl, combine 3/4 c flour and cayenne pepper, stir together with a fork.  Toss the asparagus, cut side down in the flour to coat.  Drain.  Toss the prunes, un pitted and prenched asparagus, prune halves and flour mixture together in a large bowl to combine.  Add remaining flour, coconut milk and cream, stir until dough comes together.  Turn into prepared cake tin.  Bake on centre shelf of oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until tester comes away easily from sides of cake tin.  Remove from oven and allow to cool.

title: Lemon Pepper Steak for One
ingredients: 3 -6 ounces lemon pepper seasoning, dry | 5 -6 ounces beef steak, thinly sliced
instructions: Season each steak with lemon pepper seasoning.  Lightly coat a large heavy based frying pan with oil, or any cooking spray.  Heat to smoking point then add the sliced steak into it.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes each side depending on thickness until well browned.  Serve straight away.

title: Linguine with Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon chopped chili paste
instructions: Cook linguine until al dente.  Drain.  Combine lemon juice, chili paste, and lemon juice.  Add the linguine to the sauce.  Mix well.  Serve.

title: Italian Herbed Prawns
ingredients: 600 g prawns | 4 sprigs fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 chicken, jointed | 12 maraschino cherries, halved | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to boil, add the prawns and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes drain, and then set aside, still in the water, for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, remove the sage from the stalks and discard.  Using two slotted spoon, remove the chicken from the joint.  Wipe out the remaining oil from the joint and slice crossways into strips.  Boil the prawns for 8 - 10 minutes, remove the prawns and leave to cool.  Trim and finely chop the sage and divide into 6, then cut the remaining leafy leaves into small pieces and put together with the cherries and honey.  Set to one side in the fridge for two hours to marinate.  Dry fry the prawns in a little oil for 2 - 3 minutes, remove and set aside.  Serve with a fresh green salad and plenty of good bread.

Random Ingredients: oregano,cottage cheese,cardamom seed,bread flour,red bell pepper,sea salt black pepper,snow pea
title: Roasted Red Pepper With Snow Peas (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded | 2 tablespoons dried oregano, divided | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 8 3/4 ounces cottage cheese | 7 tablespoons red bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons dried bread flour | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Cut the onion in half and then in half again.  Using the tip of a sharp knife, scrape out the seeds.  Put aside.  Cut remaining red bell pepper in half and remove core and seeds.  Brush both sides of the pepper with olive oil and season well with salt.  Place the pepper halves on the parchment paper and bake on the baking sheet for 20 minutes, or until crisp.  Transfer to a wire rack to cool.  Remove the skin and all visible fat around the pepper halves.  Cut the pepper halves in half and arrange on the baking sheet in a single layer.  Brush with olive oil and season with salt.  Roast for another 20 minutes, checking frequently to make sure even browning.  Remove from the oven, tent with foil and let stand 10 minutes.  While pepper is cooking, combine the cottage cheese and 2 tablespoon water in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook for 2 minutes.  Add a little cooking liquid and scrape the pan around and beat with a wooden spoon.  Keep warm.  In a small bowl, combine the red pepper, oregano and 1 teaspoon oregano and toss through the cottage cheese mixture.  In a small dry skillet over medium high heat, toast the cardamom seeds until fragrant.  Transfer to a bowl and pour warm cooking liquid over them.  Stir to combine.  When pepper is cool enough to handle, peel off the skin and finely chop the pepper halves.  Stir them through the spinach cheese mixture.  Arrange peppers on serving plates and drizzle with additional olive oil and sprinkle with dry oregano.  Serve.

title: Fettuccine Phyllo Pies
ingredients: 10 ounces fettuccine | 16 ounces fontina cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | cumin powder | 12 pieces phyllo dough
instructions: Cook pasta with ginger in a skillet, add garlic, cumin, then fettuccine, mix and let sit for 5 minute drain and fill a pot with water and cook for 10 minute drain and fill pastry sheet with cheese.  Fill pastry sheets with pasta mixture and seal edges with a fork.  Brush top with a brush and bake at 350 for approx 30 minute.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,green bean,oyster sauce,date,spanish onion,avocado,parsley leaf,herb
title: Vegetable and Date Soup
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sherry ( or more ) or 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar, to taste | 2 sprigs fresh parsley leaves, or | 1/2 medium spanish onion, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth or 4 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup medium green beans, ends snapped into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh herbs or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried herbs | 3 tablespoons minced ripe avocados | 1 cup pitted dates, cut into 16 pieces
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, combine 1 tbsp of the sherry or vinegar and the parsley.  Cook over medium heat, until the liquid evaporates and the mixture just starts to bubble.  Add the onion and cook until it just starts to soften, about 3 minutes.  Then add the broth, green beans, half the herbs and 2 tbsp more of the sherry or vinegar.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to maintain a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.  Remove from the heat and let stand 1 minute, then stir in the avocado and remaining herbs.  Serve hot or warm, at room temperature.

title: A Very Simple and Delicious Enchilada Meatballs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot black tea, or as desired | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon | 1 3/4 pounds ground beef | 3 chile peppers, chopped | 2 red chile peppers, chopped | 2 dried hot red chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Combine black tea, beef bouillon, and chili peppers in a large bowl.  Mix well with your hands until evenly blended.  Roll meat mixture between your palms into 1 inch balls, and arrange meatballs into the sauce.  Bring the sauce to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.  Add red chile peppers to taste, and cook until tender but not dried out, about 30 minutes.

title: A Different Green Olive & Irish Cream Smoothie
ingredients: 5 ounces green olives, in the can, rinsed and drained | 4 teaspoons irish cream
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender or food processor, and blend until smooth.  Serve immediately.

title: Rice & Hazelnut Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup polenta | 2 teaspoons finely grated chocolate hazelnut spread ( or nutella, if you wish ) | 1 cup shredded cheese | 2 ounces shredded lettuce leaves | 2 cans sliced green beans, drained | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped fresh oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions.  Drain and cool completely.  Place rice in a heatproof bowl.  Mash to a thick paste with a fork.  Stir in melted chocolate and enough cheese to thicken slightly.  Stir in lettuce leaves and green beans.  Season with oregano if using.  Serve immediately or chill well for up to 6 hours.

title: Vanilla Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces white cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, remove all but about 1/2 inch from top of a small baking dish.  Slice the cheese and place in dish.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Turn dish to coat cheese, cover and refrigerate for 24 hours, stirring occasionlly, before serving.

title: Easy Beef Bunt
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb bulk sausage | 4 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Brown ground beef or sausage in oil, drain and set aside.  Stir in beef or sausage and bouillon until thoroughly mixed.  Heat through.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving in shallow casserole.  Serve.

title: Sausage and Strawberry Party Sandwiches

instructions: Brown sausage in skillet over medium heat.  Drain drippings from skillet and add 1/2 the mushrooms and sausage.  Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients except carbonated beverage or lime juice.  Stir in beverage or lime juice just prior to serving.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a large bowl, mix the shredded pork, mustard seed, garlic and salt and pepper. Layer half of the pork mixture, half of the kielbasa, half of the pine nuts and half of the tortilla chips.  Repeat layers and top with remaining ingredients in the same order.

title: Cantaloupe Soup

instructions: Cook cantaloupe, drain and reserve broth.  Put cantaloupe with juice and reserved broth in pot over medium high heat.  Cook 5 minutes or until meloup is soft.

title: Spicy Plums and Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1 tablespoon peri-peri, flakes | 1 eggplant, halved lengthways and sliced | 1 orange, peeled and sliced in half | 1/2 apple, sliced | 1/4 purple plums, cut into wedges | 8 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 3 tablespoons beer, light
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan, fry the bran flakes over a medium heat for several minutes, stirring until golden brown.  Drain, mix with wheat germ flakes and allow to cool.  Preheat oven to 200c.  Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer on baking tray.  Spread the orange slices evenly over the plums.  Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until soft.  Sprinkle carrot slices, orange pieces, eggplant, plums and extra bran on top.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: water,dark brown sugar,worcestershire sauce,lemon juice zest,taco sauce,pork loin,mango chutney
title: Grilled Pork Loin Tacos

    - lemon zest ) | water
instructions: Blend first 5 ingredients with 3 - 4 tbsp water to make the juice.  Trim surface of fat and add half of sauce and half of sugar.  Taste to see if you want to add more sugar or lemon.  Place meat in a plastic zipper bag and add remaining cheese blend with juice.  Allow to marinate in refrigerator for 3 hours.  Skewer meat, and grill over medium heat, or on middle rack of an open grill pan, about 4 inches from heat.  Cook meat about 1 hour, or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f, or cooked to your desired degree of doneness.  Use pork for tacos and garnish with jasmine rice.

title:
Rice with Coconut and Mint.

ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked carnation low fat rice or 3/4 cup brown rice | 1 tablespoon lime peel, grated ( see note below ) | 12 mint leaves | 1/4 cup shredded unsweetened coconut or 1/4 cup flaked coconut | 2 -3 slices bacon
instructions: Stir together rice, lime peel, and mint leaves.  Divide rice mixture among six ramekins and set aside.  Over medium heat, fry bacon slices in a large nonstick skillet until crisp and beginning to brown, stirring frequently.  Pour off the fat.  Pour bacon on a large plate.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer rice from ramekins to fat coated skillet and brown for 2 minutes.  Pour browned bacon mixture into ramekins and set them aside.  Add coconut to the pan drippings that has come to the surface.  Shake pan to coat the bottom of skillet with the drippings.  Stir briefly then add half the mint leaves and half the coconut.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,beef chuck,rice vinegar,lima bean,nori,coconut oil,chicken broth,soya sauce
title: Panda Express' Easy Nabe and Meejim
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces fresh lima beans ( i think they are called panda beans ) | nori | 2 1/2 cups water | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/3 cup soya sauce
instructions: In a large pot, add the oil.  When it is hot add the cubed meat and stir fry until the meat is browned on all sides.  Add the beans and water and boil for about 10 minutes.  Add the rice vinegar and salt and stir to mix.  In a separate bowl, pour the soya sauce and mix well until smooth.  Remove the meat and beans from the sauce.  Return the sauce to the pot and simmer for about 5 minutes or until the liquid is almost evaporated.  Taste and adjust to you like your seasoning.  Place the meat and beans under the broiler to brown the top and serve them over hot rice.  Note, you can also serve this over steamed white rice and serve it over the sticky sticky sticky sticky sticky sticky rice.  The sticky sticky sticky rice that is served in the nori can also be laid on a sheet of napkin and eaten as a snack.

title: Cranberry Noodles
ingredients:
6 cups fresh cranberries | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning ( from a 7-oz bag ) | 1 package hot dried noodles ( or 3 3.
    -8 oz.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,sesame oil,vegetable oil,chicken breast fillet,arborio rice
title: Brown Sugar Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breast fillets | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Place salt, brown sugar and sesame oil in a bowl and coat chicken well.  Heat oil in a wok to 180c or until oil is smoking, and add chicken and stir fry until the chicken is coated in the sugar oil.  Add rice and stir for a further 3 minutes.  Pour over the chicken and stir to combine well and cover tightly with foil.  Cook in the over until rice is tender.  Serve while hot.

title: Chicken and Chickpea Empanadas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 lb kielbasa | 1 can chunked fully cooked chicken | 1 cup dark chocolate | 1 lb mexican chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place chicken thighs in a large saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes.  Remove chicken thighs from pan and remove skin and place chicken in a large bowl.  Measure out 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid and place in a small saucepan over medium high heat.  Remove chicken thighs from the cooking liquid and place in the bowl with the chicken.  Place chicken pieces in the saucepan over low heat and stir until all the chicken is coated with the sauce.  Bring the sauce to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, or until chicken and chickpea flour are fully cooked.  While the sauce is simmering, prepare the dough.  While sauce is simmering, peel and cut kielbasa into bite sized pieces.  When the mixture is cooked and hot, drain and rinse the chickpea from the cooking liquid.  Set the cooking liquid aside.  When all of the other ingredients are finished, remove from the heat and place in a food processor or blender that has been fitted with the metal blade.  Add chicken, chickpea flour, and mexican chili powder to the food processor or blender.  Process until fully mixed.  Roll dough out on lightly floured surface to about 1/4 inch thickness.  Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a 6 inch circle.  Press a circle hole in the middle of each circle to close and remove excess dough.  Repeat process with remaining dough.  Line a large cookie sheet with foil and place half of the circles on one.  Repeat with the chicken mixture.  Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until the edges of the empanada bake.  Remove pan from oven, remove foil, and place chocolate in a small bowl.  Microwave on high for 5 - 60 seconds until completely melted, stirring twice.  Carefully remove the empanada from foil and place on top of the hot chocolate.  Allow to cool.  Cut into approximately 1 1/2 inch squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,brioche bread,breadcrumb,pasta sauce,celery salt,heavy whipping cream,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef Short Ribs Rollatini
ingredients: 4 beef short ribs | 1 tablespoon celery salt | breadcrumbs | pasta sauce ( homemade or store-bought ) | beef tenderloin steak | heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Sprinkle short ribs with celery salt, then rub in bread crumbs until all sides are coated.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place short ribs on baking sheet, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the heavy cream, and pat the meat gently with your hands.  Bake short ribs until they are just done, 30 to 40 minutes, basting with heavy cream 1 to 2 times during the cooking period. .  Serve with spaghetti sauce and tostada.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,water,sunflower seed,turmeric powder,lamb shoulder,paprika,ricotta cheese
title: Paprika Roast Stuffed Lamb
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder | 5 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 450 g ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 3 tablespoons low-fat butternut squash or 3 tablespoons sweet pumpkin seed oil | 1/4 cup warm water
instructions: Mix all marinade ingredients together.  Place lamb in a container.  Pour marinade over and massage.  Marinate 30 minutes to overnight.  Preheat oven to 190°c cut deep slit in leg meat and gently ease open.  Remove bone and skewer legs, reserve.  Spread on a baking tray.  Brush meat with marinade.  Bake for 1 and 1/2 hours and turn after 30 minutes.  Rest for 10 minutes and slice thinly.  Serve on top of a mound of steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,thai fish sauce,half cream,white wine,spaghetti
title: Chinese Curry Sausage and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package frozen breaded spaghetti | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream or 1/2 cup whole milk | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 cup tart apple, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Preheat the broiler.  In a bowl, beat together the half and half and fish sauce.  Stir in the wine until the mixture is combined.  In a large skillet, prepare the sausage by crumbling it into 1/2 inch pieces.  Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until pork is thoroughly browned, about 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir in the breaded spaghetti and apples and toss to coat.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,lebanese cucumber,cube steak,green chili pepper
title: Chef John's Thai Grilled Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lemon-sized cube steak | 1 tablespoon cake flour, sifted | 1/2 can chopped mild green chili peppers, drained | 1/3 green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Season the steaks on both sides with the sifted flour, and set aside.  Heat the grill to medium and set the steaks on the grate.  Cook for 4 minutes per side for medium rare, or until cooked to your liking.  Spread the chopped green chili peppers on one side of the warm steak, then arrange the slices of grilled lebanese cucumber lengthways on top.  Drizzle with a little oil, and sprinkle with a little salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Serve immediately.

title: Easter Meat
ingredients: 12 slices salami | 1 filet of beef
instructions: Lay the salami out on a kitchen board and spread it out to be about the width of your forefinger.  Place the salami onto the salami and roll it up, securing it with a toothpick.  To freeze, place on an oven pan, cover, and freeze for up to a month.

title: Italian Kale Appetizer
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, sliced in 1 and 1/2 inch slices | 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 1 bunch kale, chopped | 1 cup salted peanuts | 1 bunch mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread a layer of bread on a cookie sheet, or large baking sheet.  Place kielbasa into the center, and top with olives and kale.  Top with remaining bread, then top with mozzarella cheese.  Bake in preheated oven 5 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Homemade Beetroot Relish
ingredients: 1 kg beet, raw | 1 celery rib | 3 cups cornflour
instructions: Wash raw beet and cut into big pieces.  Cut celery into small pieces and wash until clean.  Cut the beetroot into small pieces.  Soak in salt water for 10 - 10 hours.
