Press as much moisture out of the beetroots.  Use more or less of anything needed.  Pressure cook vegetables for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Purslane Fish Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup purslane, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup salami, sliced into thick strips | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 small cabbage, thinly vertically sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place purslane on a large plate and place on top of a damp towel.  In a small bowl, stir together the salami, pineapple juice and garlic paste.  Spread the mixture on the purslane and roll up jellyroll style.  Secure all sides with a wooden toothpick.  Arrange the rolls on a baking sheet and bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until done.  Fill rolls with the reserved purslane mixture.

title: Cauliflower Cantaluce Salad
ingredients: 150 g cauliflower, cut in florets | 150 g chicken wings | 100 g grapes | 1 lemon, juice of | 3/4 cup red wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons nutmeg, grated | 1/2 lettuce leaf
instructions: Boil cauliflower in boiling water until tender.  Drain and refresh under cold water.  Cut into 2cm cubes.  Separate wings into 2 pieces and cut the rest into 3 pieces.  Mix chicken parts with cucumbers, grapes, lemon juice and 2 tbsp of red wine vinegar.  Mix well.  Just before serving add lemon grated nutmeg and lettuce leaves.

title: Rice Vinegar and Whiskey Marinade(Mock Food)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons whiskey | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan.  Bring to a simmer, then set aside.  This marinade is used to brush chicken during the last few minutes of grilling or roasting.  Use as a basting sauce.

title: Radish-Feta Sandwich
ingredients: 10 slices bread ( i use the kind with crust ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped radish | 2 -3 tablespoons dry sherry wine
instructions: On a small plate, toss the cheese, radishes and sherry together.  Assemble two slices of the bread into a sandwich with the cheese mixture and drizzle with more sherry.

title: Caribbean Broccoli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 4 cups broccoli florets, trimmed and cut in 1-inch pieces | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup strong black coffee, room temperature
instructions: Stir rum, sherry, and garlic in large bowl until well blended.  Add broccoli and remaining ingredients, stirring until broccoli is coated with liquid mixture.  Cover bowl, and chill 3 hours, stirring often.  Transfer broccoli to plate, discard garlic.  Garnish, if desired, with a sprig of thyme.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,mustard seed,pepper sauce,tabasco sauce,rosemary,red onion,apple,almond
title: Apple Salad With a Red
ingredients: 2 large apples, cored, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 medium red onions or 1/2 medium shallot, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped dried almonds | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary, coarsely chopped or 1/2 cup fresh oregano, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh coarse ground mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( i used tabasco )
instructions: Place apples on the bottom of a small but shallow baking pan coated with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with onion, almonds and rosemary and scatter with remaining ingredients.  Drizzle dressing overtop and bake at 400f for 15 minutes or until fruit is tender and apples are well glazed.

title: Ba Kokkinisto (Peppered daikon Radish Soup)
ingredients: 1 large daikon radish | 1 poblano chile, deveined and seeded | 3 1/2 quarts beef stock | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsnips | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Halve radish lengthwise and cut crosswise into very thin 1/2 inch slices.  Remove and discard seeds.  Cut into thin slices or chunks and chop into 1 inch pieces.  Trim remaining 2 1/2 inch piece of white skin from poblano pepper.  Cut 2 or 3 thin strips or chunks of white skin from poblano chile crosswise.  Cut diagonally into thin wedges and trim ends.  Place radish, poblano, 1 quart soup stock and parsnips into a large stockpot or dutch oven.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer, partially covered for 25 minutes.  In a small saucepan, combine wheat germ and vodka.  Cook 5 minutes over low heat, then remove from heat.  Cool until room temperature.  Remove pepper pieces and put into a blender jar.  When soup is cooled, add to dutch oven and bring to boil.  Stirring constantly, add wheat germ mixture and simmer 5 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Rice & Mountain Mushrooms With String Beans Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups fresh string beans, sliced diagonally in 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lb white mushroom, trimmed, washed, trimmed, and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup bell pepper, chopped ( red or green ) | 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped rosemary leaves or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 cups hot cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Note, if it's easier, you can do this in a rice cooker.  In a large nonstick skillet, combine the beans, mushrooms, bell pepper, and fresh chiles.  Combine the simple syrup and rosemary in a measuring cup and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine the confectioners' sugar with a teaspoon of water until a thick paste forms.  Add a teaspoon of water or vegetable oil to the skillet and combine the paste into the skillet.  Cook this until the mixture is hot, then remove from heat and stir in the sugar and cinnamon mixture, stirring well, until smooth.  Transfer to an 8 x 8 inch casserole dish or serving dish and chill until cold serve over rice.  Notes, to make the spicy rosemary honey, add about 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary leaves to the honey.  For a lower fat version, mix 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves or 3/4 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves with the hot honey.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,pork shoulder,cream,chuck,parmigiano reggiano cheese,simple syrup,halibut steak,oregano leaf
title: Stefado Di Rimonti (Seared Halibut & Beef)
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut steaks | 6 halibut steaks ( fresh or previously frozen ) | 3 lbs stewing beef | 3 lbs chuck | 1/3 cup simple syrup | 2 cups cream | 3 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons dried parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat heavy skillet over medium high heat.  When it's hot, add the halibut steaks to the skillet.  As soon as they're seared on one side, turn them over and cook the other side.  When the steaks are seared on the one side, remove it to a shallow ovenproof dish.  Turn heat off.  To the skillet, add just enough stoutor water to cover the bottom of the pan.  To the pan, add the pork shoulder and fresh beef and the simple syrup, stir well and add enough water to come just below the top of the meat.  When it starts to simmer, reduce the heat on high.  The goal is to produce a nice stew, but not too wet.  You want the finished product a little less moist.  Simmer until the meat is tender, about 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes or so.  Remove the beef and beef from the pan.  You can do this in advance and it cools a little bit, or keep it warm in a 200 degree oven for a few minutes.  Put the sauce back in the pan and stir in the oregano and the parmigiano reggiano.  Adjust seasonings if needed.  This is a dish that you can let the flavors develop.  Note, if you're using frozen meat, you may skip it.  Note, there is one cup of the pure fat in the braising liquid and you may remove that with a slotted spoon or strainer.  That's up to you.  But if you're using fresh meat, put it in the blender for 3 - 5 minutes to get it a little pasty.  When you're happy with the process, let the meat rest before slicing in 1/2 inch wide slices.  I've never measured anything until i think i've made it.

title: Sriracha and Mushroom Salad

instructions: In a small bowl, combine sriracha, lemon juice, and vinegar and stir to combine.  Set aside until needed.  In a large, shallow dish or serving bowl, combine the mushrooms and sriracha mixture.  Toss to combine well and serve at room temperature.

instructions: Cook the farfalle in boiling water till al dente.  Drain and set aside.  Mix remaining ingredients together.  Stir through the pasta.  Serve immediately, with nori in triangles.

title: Spinach With Chiles

instructions: Drain the chiles, and remove and discard the seeds and membranes.  Wash, and remove the stems.  Cut the chiles in half and remove and discard the seeds and membrane.  Put the chiles into a bowl and top with a spoonful of ice water to cover.  Let soften about 10 minutes.  Place the spinach in a colander, and run cold water over them until the water runs clear.  The water will wash most of the way off the leaves.  Place the chiles and spinach in a food processor, and pulse until chiles are just chopped.  Transfer to a serving bowl, and stir with the ice water.  Sprinkle with nutmeg, and serve.

title: Guinness and Anchovy Fettuccine

Add drained cooked pasta and cucumbers.  Stir to combine.  Top with anchovy, if desired.  Serve warm.

title: Herb Grilled Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb boneless pork roast or 1 -1 1/4 lb boneless pork shoulder | 1 cup finely shredded red leaf lettuce | 1/4 cup snipped fresh rosemary sprig, plus more | snipped fresh rosemary sprig | 2 -3 fresh basil, leaves
instructions: Place the roast in a shallow dish.  Cover with some of the chopped lettuce and season with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with chopped herbs.  Heat a grill pan over high heat and add just enough water to cover the roast and roast.  Simmer for about 2 to 5 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 160º.  Transfer the roast to a platter, reserving the cooking liquid.  Allow it to rest.  Cook the pork until it turns golden brown on top, 6 to 8 minutes per side, basting and turning the roast after 3 to 4 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Thai Chili Dog

instructions: Cut the pepper into 8 strips and place in a bowl.  Add the tiger sauce or hot sauce, mix well and season generously with salt and pepper.  Place crushed tortilla chips or fried egg slices on your favorite plate, then top with a spoonful of chili and meat sauce.  Garnish with crispy crushed tortilla or crispy fried egg slices.

instructions: Combine the kale, rum, vinegar, cinnamon, and cream in a bowl and mix with a whisk until well blended.  Arrange the rigatoni in a large glass or ceramic dish. Grill the rigatoni until they begin to color on the top, breaking up any pieces of pasta with a wooden spoon.  Serve topped with mushrooms.

title: Cardamom Beef Stroganoff (Low Fat and Low Sugar)

instructions: Place the taco seasoning into a 2 quart saucepan and whisk in the 3 cups of potatoes.  Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.  While the potatoes are simmering, in a small skillet, warm 1/2 cup water for the white corn.  In a separate small skillet, heat one teaspoon in oil over medium high heat.  Cook the turmeric and turmeric in the hot oil for about 20 seconds, or until fragrant, stirring constantly.  To serve, place the white corn on a plate and place about 1/2 cup of potatoes on top.  Serve with the warm taco and enjoy.

instructions: Cook the rice to your liking, drain and set aside to cool.  Make the sauce by whisking the garlic, swiss cheese, olives and pumpkin puree together.  Tip in the beer and clams and bring to boil over medium heat.  Once the clams have opened, stir in the rice and reheat in the sauce.  Serve immediately.

title: Gouda Cheese Dip

instructions: Chop/slice cheese into 1/4 cubes.

title: Potato Crackers

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Combine the potato, herbs and rye flour in a medium sized mixing bowl.  Mix all together, adding more rye flour, if desired.  Place on greased cookie sheets.  Bake for about 20 mintues.  These can also be frozen.

title: Artichokes With Irish Black Curacao

instructions: Wash, peel and cut artichoke hearts in half.  Use a small knife to slice off the top 1/3 of each artichoke heart and then carefully scoop out the core with a teaspoon or two of the artichoke heart from it.  Place all of the artichoke hearts into the center of a sheet of plastic wrap.  Roll and use the plastic to shape the pieces of artichoke hearts into long cylinder shapes by rolling them into the black treacle.  Using your finger, gently press the ends of the cylinders until covered with treacle.  Refrigerate these artichoke cylinders for at least 1 hour or up to a day before using to allow flavour to develop.  Drain the treacle from the artichokes, reserving any leftover liquid.  Remove the leaves from each sprig of rose petals, then tear off the tips of the sprigs and set aside.  Place 2 1/2 tablespoons of the black curacao into a small bowl.  Gradually whisk in the mustard until you have a smooth, thick consistency.  Remove the hearts from the curacao, then gently warm both sides of the artichoke hearts.  Spoon the curacao onto the hearts, and garnish with a rose petal.

title: Pineapple Hamitas
ingredients: 2 medium fresh pineapple rings ( ripe only use the canned pineapple chunks, no syrup ) | 16 ounces pork sausage | 32 ounces pineapple juice
instructions: Slice the pineapple rings into strips approximately 6 inches long and 1/4 inch wide.  If they're large, you can cut up the slices into 1/4 inch wide strips, but the hamitas will crack it if they don't.  Brown the pineapple for a few minutes on each side in a skillet, or until cooked a little crispy on the outside.  Pour the pineapple juice into a large pot and bring to a simmer.  Meanwhile, cook the hamitas according to package directions and drain when cool.  Cut the smoked hamitas into 1/3 inch slices.  Put 2 tablespoons of the hamitas, with their juices, into a small serving bowl.  Add the pineapple juice and toss well.  Place on a serving platter and garnish with a slice of pineapple or a cherry tomato.

title: Strawberry Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 4 cups fresh strawberries | 3/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Boil stew meat and strawberries for 2 hours.  Stir occasionally.  Add rice vinegar.  Cook another 20 minutes or until berries are tender.

title: Shrimp and Kifes Quesadillas
ingredients: 14 ounces reduced-fat ricotta cheese | 9 ounces frozen shrimp, thawed | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced finely | 8 ounces flour tortillas | 8 ounces all-purpose flour
instructions: Mix the ricotta cheese and shrimp together until they are well mixed.  Place one tortilla on a microwave safe plate.  Spread one quarter of the ricotta mixture between the tortilla and top with one quarter of the kifes then one quarter of the kifes on top, the way they get coated.  Cut three quarters of the kifes into strips and arrange these on the kifes along the top and bottoms.  Cook on high for 1 minute on each side, and once the quesadillas are browned, flip to brown the other side and finish cooking in a pan with a little oil.  Serve with any dip you like.  Yummy.

title: Easy Mexican Quinoa

instructions: Saute scallions until softened.  Combine all ingredients except filling and mix well.  Fill each hot pepper shell with 1 - 2 t filling.  Top with remaining mixture.  Sprinkle with parmsean or dried parmsean cheese.  Place on medium low in a non stick skillet for 3 - 4 minutes until heated through.

title: Bagna
ingredients: 2 italian plum tomatoes or 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 6 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, sliced or | 1 cup dried fruit, thawed | italian sausage | 1 cup all-purpose flour or 1 cup gluten-free flour | 2 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f.  Place tomatoes on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.  Mix curry paste and 1 cup churros in a small bowl.  Spread 1/2 cup tomato mixture on each.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile combine remaining tomatoes and the 1 cup raisins in saucepan of boiling water.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Drain.  Combine flour and other 1/2 cup churros in another small bowl.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 3 tablespoons semolina flour | 1 1/2 inches finely sliced fresh ginger | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Combine the semolina flour, ginger and sugar in a bowl and knead briefly.  Divide into 10 equal parts.  Divide each portion in five equal parts.  Roll each part into a ball, then place each one on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Set on a lighted cookie sheet, and allow to dry out for at least an hour.  Using a sharp and serrated knife, slice each into three to make triangles.  Let dry on baking sheet 1 to 2 hours.  If you store cookies in an airtight container, they will keep for 1 - 2 months.

title: Green Chilies Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh chilies, or more to taste | 1 bunch green chilies, or more to taste
instructions: Clean chiles, removing seeds.  Slit side of chiles with a sharp knife, or cut slit lengthwise in 1/2 inch slices.  Fill chile with chile, then fold in side edges.  Repeat with remaining chiles to make 4 pints.  Warm a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Brush pan with canola oil.

Random Ingredients: radish,almond extract,beef stew meat,pineapple chunk,english cucumber,rice vinegar,bouillon cube
title: Chinese Beef Cubes (Diabetic)
ingredients: 6 beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced | 1 cup pineapple chunk ( i used fresh and was pleased enough ) | radish ( to garnish ) | 1 teaspoon arrowroot or 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 -3 bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot and cook on high setting for 3 - 4 hours.  Serve on buns or rolls.

title: Easy Caraway Vanilla Frosting
ingredients: 1 package vanilla cake mix | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds
instructions: Pour cake mix into a bowl.  Scoop out as many as desired with a teaspoon, then stir with a fork until evenly distributed and the mixture is smooth.  If desired, add a few tablespoons sugar for color.  I usually add cinnamon for added flavor.

title: Smoked Beef and Chicken Gravy for the BBQ
ingredients: 500 g smoked beef, diced | 250 g smoked ham, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large saucepan and cook low until the meat is cooked through and vegetables are well cooked.  Serve with boiled rice.

title: Crispy Tasty Crispy Pizza Served
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups basmati rice ( uncooked ) | 1/4 lb medium shrimp ( i used 3, precooked, peeled and deveined ) | 1/2 cup scallops ( i used precooked, peeled, deveined and coarsely chopped ) | 3 tablespoons horseradish | 3 tablespoons fat-free tajins taco seasoning ( may use low salt soy sauce.

title: Pasta With Pomegranate Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup frosting | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 cup dry marsala wine | 2 pints shell pasta | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup grated toasted fresh parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup shaved toasted pine nuts
instructions: Place the 2 tablespoons of coffee liqueur in a small saucepan and add the finely chopped onion.  Cook over low heat.  Cook until the onion is translucent.  Add the frosting and stir in the pomegranate seeds.  Reduce the heat to low.  Cook for 2 - 3 minutes.  Toss together the pasta and the pomegranate cream sauce in a large serving dish.  Sprinkle the parmesan over the pasta.  Garnish with the pine nuts and serve.

title: Irish Creamy Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olives ( pitted ) | 3 tablespoons irish cream | 3/4 fluid ounce beer ( or other sparkling liquor, like guinness )
instructions: Drain olives.  Toss with the irish cream.

title: Piquant Cumin Vinegar
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: In a mortar and pestle grind the cumin seeds and the vinegar to a fine powder.  Set aside to cool.  Use as needed, the vinegar will keep for several days in a refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,red curry paste,dark chocolate,tomato puree,fruit
title: Easy Satay Sauce - Tomato Based
ingredients: 1 can chopped tomatoes in puree | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( see recipe introduction ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 3 tablespoons dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Break dark chocolate into pieces, stir until melted.  Add coconut, dried fruit and other ingredients and keep stirring until the sauce thicken slightly.  Serve over your favorite salad.

title: Pasta With Fresh Fruit Chutney
ingredients: 400 g pasta ( fussili rigati or tagliatelle ) | 100 g ra el hanout spice mix | 1 green chili pepper | salt and chili pepper flakes | 125 ml single cream
instructions: Cook the pasta at just the timing so that it's ready to serve.  Place the ra el hanout in a non stick pan and heat on a medium heat, stirring often.  Add the red pepper flakes and allow to soften.  Season with salt and chili pepper flakes.  Add the chopped green chili and allow to soften a little.  Drain the pasta and toss through the chutney mixture.  Serve immediately.

title: Minty Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 200 g coriander powder or 200 g other coarsely chopped coriander seeds | 200 g chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon of crushed cloves
instructions: Heat the oil in a griddle or large frying pan.  If using a mortar and pestle, grind together the coriander and parsley.  You may need to use a little water to get the mixture to blend nicely.  Add all the other ingredients and mix well.  Put into a buttered container or plastic bag, and leave in a cool place for upto 24 hours.  It makes a good quantity for sandwiches or toast.

title: Avocado Pesto
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled, pitted and finely chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon dried chives, chopped
instructions: Lightly butter a 2 quart baking dish.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,oregano leaf,heirloom tomato,raspberry,margarine,chicken drumstick,golden raisin,apple cider vinegar
title: Heirloom Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken drumsticks, with skin on | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1/3 cup tomato soup | 1/3 cup tomato cider vinegar | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 apple, peeled, cored and cut into matchsticks | 1/4 cup sliced fresh raspberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread enough of the margarine on top to cover all of the chicken.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly brown, about 20 minutes.  Turn every 5 minutes during the last 10 minutes.  In the meantime, combine the tomato soup, tomato cider vinegar, raisins, oregano, and apples in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil, and pour over the chicken.  Cover the dish with foil, and bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven.  Uncover, and bake for 5 minutes more.  Place the tomato slices in a hollowed out serving platter.  Spoon the raisin mixture over them.  Allow the chicken to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Pesto Strawberries
ingredients: 1 package fresh strawberries | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1/3 cup prepared almond pesto | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup lowfat yogurt
instructions: Slice strawberries in half lengthwise and remove pulp from bottom.  Combine in a medium bowl with rest of the ingredients and stir until mixed well.  Cover and chill for 1 hour before serving.  Note, if you make this to a party, assemble the night before and refrigerate it.  Spoon the mixture into 4 glasses and top with your choice of toppings.  Garnish with a little red pepper flakes if desired.  Enjoy.

title: Easy BBQ Onion Rice Salad (Ww 1 Point)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped white onion | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Combine onion, bbq sauce, and rinsed rice vinegar.  Add to a covered bowl.

title: Kris' Thai Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 2 tablespoons tomato basil, chopped | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 3 cans spaghetti sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine vinegar, curry paste, tomato basil and pure vanilla and bring to a simmer until slightly thickened, at least 5 minutes.  While the sauce simmers, spoon a small amount of the sauce into a shallow bowl, whisk to combine.  Dip meat of choice in the sauce and then coat with the vinegar mixture.  Allow marinated meat to marinate in sauce for 1 hour or more before serving.

title: Mousaka With Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 4 slices eggplants | 8 ounces of shredded swiss cheese | 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup of shredded colby cheese | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Peel eggplant then cut a slit in the top of the eggplant and scoop out the pulp leaving the inside of the eggplant intact as an eggplant.  Combine with the swiss cheese.  Combine the meat with the sugar and mix well.  Add to the eggplant mixture.  Fill the eggplant shells with this mixture.  Cover each eggplant shell with a cheese strip.  Bake on a sheet pan for about an hour at 375°f.

title: Spiced Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 3 shallots, chopped | 6 cups rye swiss wine
instructions: Place mustard seeds in a small saucepan and cover with about 1/2 cup water.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, moving the pan continuously about 5 minutes.  Reduce heat and simmer until seeds are slightly darker, 10 to 20 minutes remove from heat.  Transfer seeds to a dry 3 to 5 quart slow cooker.  Return riesling to medium heat and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated or absorbed and mustard starts to dry, 5 - 10 minutes.  Stir in shallots and simmer 2 minutes.  Spoon mustard into individual rylling glasses and serve immediately.

title: Peanut Butter Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 4 medium cloves whole quinces, cored and sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Arrange 1 pork tenderloins in a single layer in a shallow baking dish.  Add peanut butter to a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,spanish chorizo,yogurt,scallion,orange juice,napa cabbage,jasmine rice
title: Jasmine Rice With Mexican Chorizo and Scallions-Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup jasmine rice | 3/4 lb spanish chorizo, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons orange rind, finely grated | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 cups medium head napa cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons scallions, thinly sliced ( green and light green parts )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Remove chorizo from casings.  In a medium skillet, cook chorizo until lightly browned, stirring frequently.  Transfer to a plate.  Add orange rind, thyme, orange juice, cabbage and scallions to drippings in skillet and cook over medium heat until tender.  Transfer to a plate.  Add chorizo mixture to pan and cook, stirring frequently, until heated through.  Serve immediately.

title: Arugula and Horseradish Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange juice or 3 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, in jar | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 4 cups arugula, rinsed and dried | 1 orange, juice and zest of ( grated )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together & refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Serve chilled.

title: Vietnamese Pork Sausage and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage, chinese style or 1 lb sweet bacon, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 6 cups green cabbage, small heads, shredded | 1/4 cup coffee, sweetened | coriander, to taste | 1/4 cup lime wedge, to serve
instructions: In large skillet, brown sausage over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes or untill cooked through.  Set aside.  Stir slaw and the coffee in colander over pot.  Cook over medium heat until liquid reduces to approximately 2 tablespoons.  Stir cabbage into sauce until lightly wilted.  Transfer to bowl and toss with sausage.  Season with coriander and lime wedges.

title: Chilli and Bean Cannellini
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1/3 cup amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Drain all the liquid from the cannellini beans and green chilies.  Over medium heat, heat the cannellini beans, green chilies, amaretto and cherries.  Let simmer for 30 - 50 minutes.

title: Diet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon water chestnut, finely chopped | 3 cups chopped eggplants
instructions: Stir fry the water chestnuts, eggplants and salt in a large nonstick pan over medium high heat for 3 or 4 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Smoked Pork with Sesame Seeds and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb smoked pork shoulder | 1 lb smoked salmon | 4 ounces smoked apricots | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 4 sprigs celery ( to garnish ) or 4 sprigs cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice the smoked pork shoulder into 1 in thick slices.  Slice the salmon into 1 in chunks, removing any bones.  Cut the smoked salmon into chunks.  Mix the cornflour, mustard and sesame seeds together.  Coat the smoked pork in the mixture and arrange them on a large sheet of aluminium foil.  Pour the smoking mixture around the pork.  Place a sprig of celery or cilantro on top of the smoke.  Place the tray in a pan and cover tightly with foil.  Cook at 200c for at least 30minutes or until well cooked and the meat very tender.  Allow 5 minuted intervals for turning the meat if the heat is very low and remove the meat.  Slice the meat thinly.  Serve with fresh vegetables or your chosen accompaniment.

title: Spicy Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 bag shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon plain rice vinegar | 1 lb top round beef roast, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f toss lettuce with paprika.  Place beef slices on a rack of a baking sheet.  Bake at 350°f for 15 minutes.  Remove beef slices when completely cooked, or leave on baking sheet for 5 minutes, and cut into thin strips or pieces.  Place beef strips on top of lettuce.  Sprinkle with a little sea salt if desired.  Place in a preheated oven for 10 minutes then lower oven temperature to 200°f.  Bake for another 15 minutes, before removing from oven.  Slice beef into strips or slices and serve on warm pita bread.

title: Fennel Seeds
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons fennel seed, ground
instructions: Place all ingredients in a spice mill over a medium heat.  Cook, stirring frequently, until lightly colored and fragrant, 10 or 15 minutes.  Remove from heat to cool.

title: Ouzo
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 cup diced mixed dried fruit | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 3 1/2 cups ouzo | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons ouzo
instructions: Pulse all zucchini in a food processor until coarsely ground.  Combine zucchini, mixed dried fruit, lemon zest, chives, and ouzo in a medium saucepan.  Heat ouzo over medium heat.  Remove from heat and stir in the vegetable bouillon.

title: Nama Mama's Candy
ingredients: 1 lb sweet hungarian paprika | 1 lb unsalted peanuts
instructions: Heat over in a large pan, stirring constantly until all the candy pieces melt together.  Take off the heat.

title: Irish Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds red potatoes, diced | 4 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 package frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a baking sheet.  Place potatoes on a baking sheet.  Pour in enough chicken broth to cover.  Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes.  When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut into cubes and place in a large bowl.  Stir in bourbon, ketchup and frozen pastry package.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, or overnight.

title: Tippy Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 6 baby corn | cooking spray | 3/4 cup apple, chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Arrange 1 corn on each of 4 small baking dishes.  Spray tops with cooking spray.  Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes, turning once, until beginning to char.

Random Ingredients: raisin,jerk sauce,chipotle chile,chicken stock,sesame seed,curry leaf
title: Sesame Seed Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 chipotle chiles | 1/2 cup reserved chicken broth | 2 tablespoons hot jerk sauce | 1 teaspoon ground curry leaf, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup raisins, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place sesame seeds in a skillet over medium low heat, and toast toasted sesame seeds, about 5 minutes.  Watch carefully, as the seeds will swell as they cook.  Remove from heat, and place the chipotle chiles in a blender or food processor, and puree until about 1/4 cup liquid remains.  Heat chicken broth and jerk sauce in a skillet over medium heat.  Once broth has been heated, stir in the chipotle chile mixture and curry leaf.  Continue cooking 5 minutes, until flavors are blended and flavors meld.  Stir in raisins just before serving.

title: Baked Oyster Baked Chips
ingredients: 4 whole baking potatoes | 3 cups fresh oysters, drained well ( may substitute with other fresh vegetables ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f and line a large baking sheet with parchment.  Slice 2 of the baking shells in half lengthwise.  Arrange shells on sheet.  Place in middle of oven.  Bake for 10 minutes until crisp and light golden brown.  Cool slightly.  Run shells under cold water.  Remove shells and reserve for later.  Wash oysters.  Slice off top shell to expose all of the shucked parts.  Scoop out shucked oysters with a slotted spoon.  In a small bowl, combine oysters, baking powder and anise mixture.

title: Chocolate Roasted Rouladen
ingredients: 5 pounds beef eye round | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 8 ounces queso fresco | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f.  Rub the steak with the sugar and kosher salt.  Roast the steak in the preheated oven with the door ajar until meat is darkly browned and caramelized all over, about 15 minutes.  Allow to cool, cut into slices, and stuff with mozarella cheese.  Warm chocolate syrup in a small bowl over warm water until melted, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,honey mustard,egg substitute,sumac,tomato paste,shallot,molasses
title: Middle Eastern Egg Drop - Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 cup egg substitute | 1 teaspoon molasses ( i use organic ) | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 1 small tomatoes, seeded & chopped | 1 teaspoon ground sumac ( or other ground spices ) | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 1 tablespoon molasses ( i use organic )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except the honey mustard, stir until well blended.  Using a hand held electric mixer or blender, beat the egg mixture on low until it is slightly thick, about 5 minutes.  Slowly add more egg until you’re able to form peaks.  Divide the mixture into 4 large bowls.  Fill each bowl with a small amount you want the soup to have some air in it like you’re spooning it in before serving as it thickens more as it cools.  Note, you can even make this in a blender & add 3/4 cup water while blender is running, it just won’t be smooth like you would with pureed egg.  Use as much or as little honey mustard as you want to create the best egg soup you can make.

title: Crunchy Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, tough stems removed, coarsely chopped | 1 romaine lettuce, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Line a large baking sheet with foil.  Stir chard in a large bowl with 2 tablespoons broth.  Spread chard and 1 tablespoon broth around.  Bake until tender and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, toss romaine with remaining 1 tablespoon broth and remaining 2 tablespoons broth.  Spoon chard mixture over chard and sprinkle with remaining 3 tablespoons broth.

title: Salmon fillet Rollups II
ingredients: 1 pound salmon fillets | 2 heads fresh boston lettuce
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.  Bake salmon in the preheated grill until easily flaked with a fork, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,cake flour,chicken bouillon cube,sirloin tip roast,yogurt,baby spinach,broccoli rabe
title: Lazy Garlic Beef With Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 3 cups baby spinach, cleaned and rough chopped | 2 -3 cups frozen broccoli rabe, cleaned and rough chopped | 1 cup yogurt | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: Slice the sirloin tip roast into 1/2 slices, 1/8 thick and 6 slices across the grain.  Set aside.  Combine all dry ingredients in a large shallow dish, with the meat sliced down the center.  Dip the meat in the yogurt and coat well.  Fold in the spinach and the broccoli rabe.  Spread marinade over meat and let marinate for 1 - 2 hours.  Cook on your grill 6 - 8 minutes per side, remove from the grill and let cool for a couple minutes.  Flip and repeat with remaining marinade and meat.  Use 2 forks to shred the beef slightly into pieces and stir into the spinach with the other ingredients.

instructions: Place garlic on a cutting board.

title:
Andouille Spicy Sausages With Pineapple (Pa.
    - Arlene Ray Bakery)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 1 lb andouille sausage, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 10 pineapple rings, drained and cut into halves | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons pineapple juice | 1/9 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds or 1 tablespoon crushed unsalted dry-roasted sesame seeds, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in medium bowl and marinate sausages covered for 1 hour at room temperature.  Meanwhile, drain off marinade and reserve.  Cook sausages over medium hot coals for 10 minutes on each side, or until just cooked through.  Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine pineapple juice, pineapple juice concentrate, and spice blend.  Reserve 1/4 cup of the pineapple juice mixture.  Pour pineapple rings over remaining pineapple juice mixture.  Grill sausages until heated through, turning once, 3 - 4 minutes total for medium or 5 minutes for well done.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,canola oil,green pea,sake,baker german chocolate,chicken stock
title: Rice Cream With Green Peas
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons sake | 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 2 cans condensed cream of potato soup ( neufchatel cheese flavor ) | 2 cups medium grain white rice ( i used 1 pkg ) | 2 -3 baker's german sweet chocolate
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine stock and sake, bring to a boil.  In bowl of an electric mixer, beat soup with a wire whisk.  Add rice and peas.  Stir well to combine.  Remove from heat, and chill.  Add chocolate pieces to boiling soup.  Stir well and return to medium.  Stir occasionally, until chocolate is melted and no longer foamy, and pour into 8 individual wine glasses 2 x 1/2 or 3 to 8 custard cups.  Cool slightly and refrigerate.  Can be made a day ahead and chilled.  Makes.

title: Couscous for Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1/2 - 3/4 cup additional asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Prepare your couscous as instructed on the box, or follow instructions.  If using the couscous, pour in hot water, stir and wait, do not boil.  Add cheese and stir until melted.  Toss with rice, vegetable, fruit.

title: Italian Sauteed Spinach and Fenugreek
ingredients: 1 pound fresh baby spinach, rinsed and trimmed | 1 pepperoncini pepper, sliced | 8 slices italian bread, toasted | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until just wilted.  Drain well and transfer to a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and let sit for 20 to 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine sliced pepperoncini and fenugreek seeks in a small skillet over medium low heat.  Sauté for 2 minutes or until golden brown and fragrant.  Drain and set aside.  Brush hot sausages with vegetable oil and grill over medium high heat for about 4 minutes each side or until heated through.  To serve, divide spinach among 8 warmed plates and top with sausages and pepperoncini mixture.

title: Spinach and Spinach Sauté
ingredients: 1 lb baby english spinach ( cleaned, washed and stemmed ) | 5 tablespoons saskento mixed italian herbs, such as italian thyme, basil, oregano and rosemary, divided
instructions: Remove and discard the ends from the english spinach and divide into four 5oz piles.  Stack one pile at a time on top of another, pressing carefully against the sides of the pile as much as possible.  Spread 1 tablespoon of the italian herbs over each pile and sprinkle the remaining tablespoon of italian herbs over the top.  Set a heavy skillet/kettle over high heat and add 2 turns of cooking spray generously.  When the pan is very hot, lightly mist with cooking spray.  Add half of the spinach and sauté until slightly limp, about 7 minutes.  Toss with cooked greens and 1 tablespoon of the italian herbs.  Repeat with remaining greens, and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of italian herbs.  Serve immediately.

title: Bacon & Quinoa Fritters
ingredients: 4 ounces quinoa | 1 spring onion ( green part only ) | 1/4 slice bacon or 1/4 slice streaky bacon, chopped | 1 egg yolk | 1 dash ground chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Boil the quinoa in plenty of water until tender and only about 2 minutes.

title: Truffles Rellenos With Cotija and Grated Blend Cheese
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup cotija cheese, grated | 1 lettuce, head romaine lettuce ( about 10 oz.
    - ) or 1 sprig of boston lettuce | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Sift the flour into a large mixing bowl.  In the bowl of a standing electric mixer, beat the cheeses until very smooth and creamy, 2 - 3 minutes.  Season with some of the nutmeg, freshly ground black pepper and a pinch of ground cloves of white pepper.  Fold the flour mixture in with the cheeses.  Turn the dough onto a lightly floured work surface.  Working quickly, roll it gently until it is 1/4 in thick and fairly firm.  Use a 3 1/2 round cookie cutter to cut out as many cookies as possible.  Using a 2 inch star shaped cookie cutter, cut out a hole in the top of the relleno with the stem pointing toward the center.  Sprinkle the rellenos with the nutmeg.  Cut out 2 or three strips about 1 wide and 12 long, making a total of 4 mini strips.  Place the rellenos on a plate, cover and chill for up to 3 hours.  Heat the oven to 400°f remove the rellenos from the fridge and spread one side of each relleno with a thin layer of the cheese spread.  Roll them again and cut out a hole in the top of each relleno and place on a baking pan lined with foil.  Repeat until all of the rellenos have been rolled.  Bake for 10 minutes, remove from the oven and arrange on a heated serving platter.

title: Tasty Baked Beans (With Lard)
ingredients: 8 -12 lettuce leaves, washed, dried and torn | 1 lb lard
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Wash lettuce leaves and toss with lard in a bowl.  Place lettuce, dry salt side up in a shallow roasting pan and put in the oven.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,pork shoulder,almond extract,vegetable oil cooking spray,coconut,tuna
title: Crispy Tuna and Almond Frijoles
ingredients: 500 g tuna | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup shredded raw almonds ( toasted ) | 8 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 kg boneless pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 6 strips
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degree c.  Using a melon baller, scoop out tuna in 1/2 inch thick half inch thick chunks and combine with almond extract.  Add cheese, almonds, oil and pork strips to tuna in a large bowl.  Toss gently until coated with mixture.  Arrange onto a serving dish.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until browned and cooked through.

title: Pork Sausages

title: Chinese Black Sesame Seed Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups white vinegar | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Place the vinegar, black and white sesame seeds in a mixing bowl and stir to combine.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Drain the seeds and transfer them to an airtight container of a blender.  Process until finely ground.  Stir in 3 tablespoons at a time until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: thyme,broccoli floret,beef brisket,cheese sauce,chinese wheat noodle,strawberry,egg wrap,quinoa
title: Chinese Style Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket, trimmed of fat and cut in half | 1/2 cup low fat cheese sauce ( low fat is better, but we like cordon bleu ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 12 ounces chinese wheat noodles ( we prefer chinese wheat noodles and feel free to use more ) | 1 bag frozen broccoli florets | 1 package egg rolls, refrigerated | 1 package fresh snow pea sprouts or ( 6 ounce ) bag baby spinach leaves | 3 packages egg roll wraps
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Place meat on the baking sheet, brush with 1% each of the fat and the cheese sauce, and sprinkle with thyme.  Bake for 20 minutes, basting with remaining 1 tablespoon of fat once or twice.  Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions.  Place broccoli in a colander.  Press out excess water then transfer to a bowl.  Drain noodles and broccoli thoroughly.  Place noodles and broccoli in a large bowl.  Using your hands, mix 1/2 of noodles and broccoli and remaining cheese sauce and sprinkle over meat.  Place eggroll wrappers on a dampened paper towel for 15 minutes so that they don’t stick together.  Place a heaping tablespoon of the mixture onto 4 wrappers.  Fold diagonally, and press the edges firmly together with a fork.  Repeat this process with the remaining beef.  Bake for 20 minutes or until meat is thoroughly cooked all the way through.  Remove from oven and serve immediately.

title: Easy Double Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g dark chocolate, chopped | 15 ml vanilla sugar | 30 ml sesame seeds
instructions: Place the dark chocolate in a medium microwavable bowl.  Spray the bowl with a little water and microwave on full power just until chocolate is melted.  Mix the mixture well and then stir in the vanilla sugar and sesame seeds.  Cover and set aside in a dark cupboard.  When chocolate is set, break into small pieces.  Add to the cupboard and stir well until mixture is smooth and well blended.

title: Rose & Lime Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 9 bay leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons rose water | lemon wedge
instructions: Rinse the bay leaves, then soak them for 10 minutes in cold water.  Drain and place the bay leaves in a medium size mixing bowl.  Add the rose water and lime wedges and stir well.  Enjoy as a dipping sauce for a starter.

title: Spinach on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and patted dry | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Put spinach and nutmeg in the container of a food processor, cover and process until evenly chopped.  Pour mixture into a large skillet or soup pot fitted with a steaming basket.  Place over medium high heat, stirring so it doesn't stick, and saute for a few minutes, stirring constantly.  Serve immediately.

title: Eggplant Chips
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 4 -6 crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Peel eggplant and cut into thin strips.  Spray a 1 1/2 inch skillet or baking pan with veggie spray.  Melt crackers.  Dip chips into melted crackers making sure the eggplant sticks to the chips.

title: Easy Baked English-Style Peas
ingredients: 500 g english-style peas | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast ( dry yeast ) | 2 cups cooked peas, leftovers should be defrosted | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the following ingredients.  Put the peas and 3/4 cup cold water in a large bowl and, if you have the time, add this to the bowl as you are doing the final stir.  Add the yeast mixture gradually and stir well, until evenly distributed.  Spread the mixture well in an oiled baking pan or on your baking sheets and allow to rise until doubled or approximately doubled. .  While dough rises, heat a 5 - 6 tbs.  Water in a 5l.  Pot to boiling and add the peas, a little at a time, and the breadcrumbs and mix well.  Remove the dough from the pan, knead to remove any clumps etc.  Roll or slap between palms into the breadcrumbs, and place on oiled baking sheet and allow to rise about 30 - 45 min 1hour with medium hot ovens.  Once the dough has risen add it to a large pot of generously salted boiling water, and bring to a boil for 30 - 50 minutes or until the dough is cooked through.  Slice or cut into large chunks and serve.

title: Cheesy Chow Mein Noodles in Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | 1 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Prepare chow mein noodles as directed and set aside to cool.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and chopped fresh cilantro on medium heat.  Add 3/4 cup of the cheese and warm until it is melted and the mixture starts to bubble.  Pour hot noodle mixture into bowl with cheese.  Toss to coat well.  Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,serrano chilies,baking potato,pork butt shoulder
title: Spicy Crock Pot Chile Colorado
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork butt or 3 -4 lbs shoulder, cut into cubes | 1 can enchilada sauce ( i use mild ) | 1 can pueblo chile peppers or ( 16 ounce ) can jalapeno chile peppers, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours, until meat easily pulls apart with fork.  Served with warm flour tortillas.

title: Jalapeno Cream Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light cream sherry | 1 jar jalapeno peppers
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the sherry into the bottom of your food processor.  Pulse the jalapeno peppers until chopped finely and pour back into the processor.  Process for approximately 20 seconds or until they are a slurry.  Stir in the cream sherry.  Chill sauce in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.  Keep in a covered container for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,french baguette,worcestershire sauce,beer,cornstarch,icing sugar,velveeta cheese
title: Crock Pot Beer Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock or 2 cups broth ( 1 chicken, 1 potato, 1 carrot ) | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup icing sugar ( to be dusting ) | 4 large french baguettes, sliced thin | 4 tablespoons icing sugar ( to be dusting )
instructions: In a saucepan, bring stock, beer, cornstarch & worcestershire to boil.  Remove from heat.  Let mixture stand, stirring occasionally.  Stir in fondue to moisten.  Divide mixture in half.  Cut each half into 3 equal pieces.  Place 1 piece on each of 4 plates.  Sprinkle with 2 tablespoon of icing sugar.  Place 4 bread slices in fondue to keep warm while serving.  Repeat process with remaining mixture & bread slices.

title: Pork-Salad Salad (Pomidor)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork, cut into bite-size pieces | 10 ounces mixed salad greens, lettuces and rinsed well
instructions: Toss pork with salad greens.  Refrigerate several hours.

title: Cucumber and Tarragon Salsa
ingredients: 2 cucumbers, peeled | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon or 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, minced | 1 medium radish, peeled and minced | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Peel cucumbers and slice into thin rounds using a vegetable peeler.  Combine all ingredients and serve while still slightly warm.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,seasoning salt,beef sirloin steak,chinese five spice powder,pecorino romano cheese,horseradish
title: Ouzo-Spiced Ouzo Beef Steak & Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ouzo ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons grated fresh pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon french prepared horseradish ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 4 beef top sirloin steaks
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together ouzo, cheese, seasoning salt and five spice.  Brush steak with ouzo mixture.

title: Spicy Nuts for Canning
ingredients: 5 lbs flank steak, cut into 2 inch chunks | 4 cups cashews | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a bowl, add steak chunks and mix well with hands until all lumps are gone.  Heat canning jars in a 300&#8739.

Random Ingredients: chocolate baking square,grain white rice,cherry tomato
title: Simple Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, divided | 2 dried whole sweet cherries, diced | 1 chocolate baking square
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place 1 rice, 4 cherry tomatoes, and chocolate piece in a microwave safe glass dish.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,coconut cream,pomegranate,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sage
title: Peargret's Pomegranate Delight
ingredients: 4 pomegranates | 1 cup pomegranate | 1 pint coconut cream | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 ounce graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut off the top ridge of the pears.  Cut away the pips, then cut them in half lengthwise.  Set aside to dry about 20 minutes.  Peel the pomegranate seeds and then cut the pomegranate lengthwise in half again and then into 1/2 inch wedges.  Remove the stem ends from the pomegranates, if necessary, and then cut the pears into 1/2 inch wedges.  Reserve the cores and seeds of the pomegranate seeds.  Puree the pomegranate pulp with a little of the coconut cream and cream or milk until smooth.  Place into the base of a round glass or ceramic bowl.  Stir in 1/4 cup of the parmigiano and the graham cracker crumbs and sprinkle 1 ounce of the cheese on top.  Place the pear halves, cut side up, onto the cheese.  Drizzle some pomegranate juice over the top, then sprinkle with a little more cheese.  Set aside for about 10 minutes before serving.  This is best served after refrigeration.  It makes a beautiful golden crusty loaf.  If your pearmint dome has more juice than you would like, you can drizzle 1/4 cup of water over the top of the dome to loosen.  The parmigiano can be purchased as both cheeses of the gorgonzola and gorgonzola can be found at many good Italian cheese food stores.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,cider vinegar,brown sugar,vegan margarine,vegetable stock,tuna steak,chili sauce,poblano pepper
title: Smoky Tuna and Snow Pea Curry
ingredients: vegan margarine | 1/2 cup vegetarian chili sauce | 2 tablespoons packed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh snow pea | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/4 cups canned tuna steaks, drained, chopped, and threaded on skewers | 4 ounces boneless pappardelle pasta or 4 ounces ziti pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place margarine in a saucepan in small increments, whisking constantly until melted.  Add chili sauce, sugar, and vinegar, and cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.  Add remaining vegetables and snow peas, and heat through.  When vegetables are heated through, remove sauce from heat.  In a large serving bowl, mix cooked tofu, pasta, and sauce.

title: Lentil and Crusted Trout
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils | 1/3 cup extra-lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons honey or 2 tablespoons water, to taste | 1 lb trout fillet, skin removed and cut lengthwise into 1 inch wide strips | 1 lb linguine pasta | italian bread ( optional )
instructions: Combine lentils and beef in a medium saucepan over medium heat and bring to boil.  Cover and reduce heat, simmering until lentils are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, in another large saucepan combine the honey and water.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.  Add trout and stir to coat.  When lentils are done, drain and rinse under cold water until cool.  Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Cook pasta until al dente.  Drain.  Transfer pasta to plates, top with meat and lentils.  Sprinkle with bread.  Serve with a bottle of the spicy honey, if desired.

title: Greek Olive & Almond Macaroons
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 24 whole almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place the egg whites in a bowl of a stand mixer with a wire whisk attachment and whip to stiff peaks.  With the mixer running, add the almonds one at a time, and whip until well combined.  Add 1/3 of the almond mixture to the egg whites and fold.  Continue to add the remaining almonds, 1/3 at a time, until all is used.  Drop the dough by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets.  Use a sharp knife or metal knife to cut out circles, spacing 1 inch apart.  Bake in the preheated oven until the outsides are dry and lightly colored, 18 to 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and cool completely.

Random Ingredients: onion,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato green chilies,grainy mustard,jalapeno chili,sprout,cilantro leaf,sazon goya
title: Gourmet Queso Dip
ingredients: 2 cups whole grainy mustard | 16 ounces canned diced tomatoes and green chilies ( or use rotel tomatoes ) | 1/2 small onion, diced | 1 jalapeno chili, diced ( or to taste ) | 2 cans salsa-style chopped tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 2 packages sazon goya, i 'd use 2 teaspoons, not 2 teaspoons | 3 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Stir mustard in to bowl until well mixed and smooth.  Add rest.  Stir to combine.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Use as garnish on your favorite mexican dish.  I prefer jalapenos.  Serve with tortilla chips, fresh veggies.  Enjoy.

title: Sofrito
ingredients: 1/2 small red apple | 1/2 small plum tomatoes | 12 roma tomatoes | 1 1/2 pounds ground pork shoulder | 1/2 jar cherry tomatoes | 3 fresh chilies, minced
instructions: Cut apple away from skin.  Cut 1 plum tomato in half, then cut each half into quarters.  Set aside.  Toast cherry tomatoes and chilies in a small skillet over medium heat for about 1 minute, or until they have begun to turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,vanilla essence,quinoa,taco seasoning mix,mustard powder,bread,half cream
title: Ww Quinoa Cake
ingredients: 600 ml half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 450 g quinoa | 2 tablespoons gorgonzola, crumbled | 8 slices bread ( sandwich buns )
instructions: Combine the cream, vanilla and mustard powder in a large bowl.  Add taco seasoning mix and quinoa.  Mix until well combined, but don't overmix.  Spray a 20cm ring pan with cooking spray.  Spread mixture evenly into the ring pan.  Bake at 190c for around 30 - 45 minutes.  Allow to cool before removing from the tin.  Sprinkle gorgonzola on top, then allow to sit completely to cool – that's it enjoy.

title: Chocolate Chipotle Chili Powder Recipe With Chocolates
ingredients: 3 cups finely chopped chocolates ( use chipotles or bittersweet chocolate chips if you can't find the latter ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 7 ounces bittersweet chocolate
instructions: In a small nonstick pan over low heat, melt the chocolate with the beef bouillon cubes.  Add the chocolates and stir to combine, remove from the heat and stir in the chocolate.  Store in a cool dark and dry place.

Random Ingredients: edible flower,chicken bouillon granule,vanilla pudding mix
title: Berry and Vanilla Powder
ingredients: 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup frozen edible flowers, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f.  In a large bowl, stir together the vanilla pudding mix and bouillon and then stir in the frozen flowers.  Stir well to combine.  Pour into 2 ungreased 9x13 inch baking pans.  Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until center is set.  Cool for 10 minutes, then cut into squares.

title: Vietnamese Tomato Chutney (Tomato Consommé)
ingredients: 1 large fresh tomato | 1 tablespoon of a good quality yellow mixed italian herbs such as mint, basil, chives, tarragon ( to taste ) or 1 tablespoon of a good quality green coriander ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste or 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, to taste | 4 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar, to taste
instructions: Peel but not core the tomato, remove the seeds if you want and cut down the length by a large thick slice of tomato into thin 1/4 to 1/2 slices.  Bring a small saucepan of water to boil.  Add to boiling water the tomato and coriander and boil 2 to 3 minutes until they are soft and slightly charred on the cut side.  Remove from heat and stir in the chutney stirring until the tomato is smooth and thick.  Cool before storing it away, or else you will ruin the chutney.  You can refrigerate it if you need to.  It is not needed but i feel it will keep for about a month in the refrigerator.

title: Grilled Oysters With Sausage and White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, washed | 1/2 lb mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1/2 lb salted anchovies packed in oil, drained | 2 serrano peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place all ingredients except seafood in 3 1/2 quart saucepan and bring to boiling over medium high heat.  Cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until the seafood is cooked but firm.  Remove the seafood from the heat and drain the liquid.  Using 2 forks, pull the clams away from the shells.  Spoon the liquid onto the shellfish and arrange them on a serving platter.  Top with crumbled cheese and serve.

title: Aussie Strawberry Chutney
ingredients: 2 teaspoons butter | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 500 g strawberries, washed and sliced | 3 chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon maple syrup ( or honey or agave syrup ) | 400 ml vegetable stock | 400 ml cream
instructions: Heat the butter, oil, and chillies in a frying pan.  Add the maple syrup and vegetable stock and reduce until syrupy.  Add the cream and simmer gently for about 10 minutes, until the sauce has reduced enough to coat the back of a spoon.  Place the strawberry slices and strawberries in a serving dish.  Sprinkle over the chutney.  Serve right away.

title: Sweet Chilli Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 3 fresh kaffir lime leaves, finely sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and fry the kaffir lime leaves until limp.  Remove them with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper.  This oil will keep for up to 6 days.  Store the oil in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,fennel seed,scallion,stewing beef,blueberry,tomato paste,apple juice
title: Fowl Oven Beef
ingredients: 4 ounces canadian bacon | 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef or 1 1/4 lbs blade roast | 1 teaspoon canadian bacon fat | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 scallion, sliced, green parts | 1 pints fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cut bacon into strips.  Place in one layer on a foil covered rack pan.  Sprinkle with the bacon fat and bake 20 minutes until cooked through, crisp, and browned.  Meanwhile, cut meat into 1 inch pieces.  When bacon is done, drain well from pan.  Brown meat in 1 tablespoon canadian bacon fat on all sides in the same pan in which the bacon was cooked.  Stir in bacon juice and remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil.  Cover, transfer to the oven, and bake for 45 minutes.  Remove foil from the oven, raise temperature to 450°f, and bake until meat is tender, about 40 to 45 minutes more.  Serve on buns.  Note, i use boneless lamb and pork shoulder to sauté the scallions in the fat.  The other ingredients, like vinegar and mustard have been proven to release their flavors and flavors.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,dark soy sauce,cooking apple,ginger,hazelnut,cumin powder,white sugar
title: Apple Asparagus W- Hazelnuts (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 1 package frozen asparagus spears | 4 -6 medium dried apricots ( i used the dried ones ) or 3 -6 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 cooking apples, cored and cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare an oven proof pan by spraying the bottom with cooking spray.  Place honey, sugar, and soy sauce in bowl and mix until sugar melts into the honey.

title: Sausages With Pineapple, Ham, and Bacon
ingredients: 200 g diced pork | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup portobello mushroom, sliced | 4 sage leaves, chopped fine | 1 red chili pepper, sliced | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 200 g crushed pineapple, drained ( can also use a mixture of crushed and drained canned pineapple )
instructions: Make the sausage as directed by the method given on the package.  Meanwhile fry the mushrooms, chili, and fenugreek in a little olive oil for 3 minutes.  Add the smoked sausage, pork, and bacon and sausage and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Petit Chicken Wings (French Frikadelles)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 4 tablespoons vanilla sugar ( not vanilla extract ) | 2 tablespoons bouquet garni | 1 tablespoon dry sage | 2 cups white flour
instructions: Peel and remove wing tips and separate into individual pieces.  Cut away the tips and discard.  Place a large pot of water inside and a large heavy bottomed pan.  Heat at least 90 seconds so the water doesn't boil over.  Sprinkle a few drops of olive oil onto the water then add the wings.  Turn down to a simmer while you scrape the bottom of the pan.  Cook, uncovered, slowly, for 3 hours or until the wings are cooked and tender.  Add vanilla sugar, bouquet garni and sage.  Drain off fat from the liquid.  Pour the liquid over the wings and cook, covered, at least 1 hour longer.  Remove bay leaves and discard.  The wings are best eaten warm and keep warm in a cool place until serving time.  They can also be served warm in a sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,port wine,puff pastry,egg substitute,bulgur,kielbasa,chicken wing,avocado
title: Kielbasa and Avocado Mini Meatloaf
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 cup bulgur, grains or 1 cup couscous | 2/3 cup port wine | 2 cups egg substitute ( if unavailable, use egg beaters egg substitute ) | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 3 -6 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup cilantro leaf | 1 avocado, halved and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Wash chicken wings thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels.  Combine bulgur grains or couscous in a bowl.

title: Romano's Broccoli Rabe with Anchovies
ingredients: 3 cups fresh broccoli rabe | 1/2 cup spanish onion, diced | 1/2 cup chorizo anchovy paste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook broccoli rabe until tender, but still crisp.  Drain and reserve.  Place in food processor with onion, anchovy paste and parsley.  Process until smooth.  Set aside.  When ready to serve, add broccoli rabe and gently toss in any desired amount of reserved cooking liquid.  Add more cooking liquid to coat.  Cook in a preheated oven at 450 degrees f for about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,herb,white vinegar,dark chocolate,phyllo pastry
title: Chocolate Phyllo Pies
ingredients: 250 g unsweetened dark chocolate, chopped | 100 g white vinegar | 220 g self rising flour | 1 bunch fresh mixed herbs | 10 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed, cut into 5 cm squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Line 4 individual baking trays with baking paper.  Melt chocolate in bowl over hot water.  Cool slightly.  Transfer to clean bowl and add vinegar.  Sift flour onto bowl and stir to combine.  Add chocolate mixture.  Cut 3 - 4 sheets of pasty per stack.  Put 1 - 2 tablespoons of filling into centre of one pastry square.  Roll up.  Dunk pastry in hot chocolate and place pasties on baking tray.  Repeat with the remaining pasty & filling.  Bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,hard egg,fish,feta cheese,tabasco sauce,beer,italian parsley,potato traditional
title: Tatties  “Fish Tacos” #5FIX
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley | 1/2 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( or tabasco seasoning of your choice ) | 12 ounces simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes ( i use reduced fat ) | 2 cups cooked fish, diced ( such as tilapia, cod or sea bass ) | 12 ounces frozen asparagus, chopped, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 6 hard-boiled eggs, chopped ( optional for garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat.  Add potatoes and stir fry for about 2 minutes.  Stir in remaining ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: almond,baking soda,fenugreek seed,beef sirloin steak,gouda cheese
title: Agnello
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced 1/8-inch thick ( i would put it in a food processor or a grinder after trimming and slicing ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup gouda cheese, shredded ( i would probably use more if needed ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ground almonds
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Place sliced steak in a baking dish.  In a bowl combine cheese, fenugreek seeds and almonds.  Spread evenly on the steak.  Broil 3 - 4 to 5 inches from the heat for about 15 - 20 minutes, turning when desired.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,ginger root,shrimp,chicken stock vegetable,ranch bean,cream mushroom soup,pearl barley
title: Curried Rice in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 package frozen pearl barley | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups chicken stock or vegetable stock | 1 piece piece fresh ginger root, peeled and sliced | 1 piece fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn apart | 1 can tiny shrimp, cleaned, halved | 1 can ranch-style beans ( optional )
instructions: Combine barley, cream of mushroom soup, stock, ginger root, kaffir lime leaves and shrimp in medium bowl.

title: Mexican Fiesta Seasoning Mix With Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon crushed sage ( mexican is my spice mix for this ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons breadcrumbs ( mexican is my spice mix for this )
instructions: Mix the seasoning mix and breadcrumbs.  Spray or spread on the breadcrumbs.  Bake for 10 minutes at 425 degrees.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,black olive,pineapple juice,sumac,vegetable broth,garlic clove,date
title: Lebanese Pineaple Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups day old pitted dates | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 2/3 cup packed spanish onion | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 can black olives, drained | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac | 1/4 cup low-sodium canned low-fat plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the dates and broiler on high 1 - ½ hour or until they are light brown and soft.  Turn the dates and broiler on 5 minutes more.  Move to metal bowl, close bowl and let stand 5 minutes. .  Cut the dates crosswise into ½ inch wide pieces.  Using a spoon, transfer the date pieces to a colander.  Cover and set aside.  In a large saucepan, combine broth, onion and garlic.  Bring to boil over high heat.  Reduce heat.

title: Ancho Chili Figs
ingredients: 8 large fresh figs, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons fava beans, canned, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 4 teaspoons steak spice blend ( mccormick chili seasoning spice blend mix )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Spray foil lightly with vegetable cooking spray or grease pan with shortening.  Combine fava beans, 3 tablespoons of ancho powder and 3 tablespoons of cajun seasoning.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,cayenne,beer,monterey jack cheese,nigella seed,onion salt
title: Kiwifruit Quesadillas With Nigella
ingredients: 1 large kiwi fruit, peeled | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cayenne | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 16 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or other mild white cheese ) | 12 ounces beer
instructions: Using a mandoline, cut kiwifruit in half lengthwise, remove the seed and the pulp, leaving a shell about 1/4 inch thick, then cut kiwifruit into 1/4 inch cubes.  Combine nigella seeds, ground cayenne, onion salt, and 1/2 cup cheese in a large bowl, then mix well.  Stir in the kiwifruit and beer, then mix again.  Heat a lightly oiled large nonstick skillet over high heat for 2 minutes, then add 1/4 cup of mixture, spreading it in a thin layer.  Cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until underside of bread is browned and filling is golden brown.  Loosen edges with a spatula, then invert onto a plate.  Repeat with another 1/4 cup cheese and another 1/4 cup mixture.  Repeat with remaining mixture.

title: Mint Sauce for BBQ Fries
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried mint | 1/2 cup hot sauce
instructions: Place the mint and hot sauce in a mortar and pound or toss to desired consistency.  Serve with bbq fries.

title: Lebanese Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 5 leaves bibb lettuce | 1/4 cup dried lentils | 1/4 cup prepared taco sauce | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Place lentils in a pan with plenty of water to cover.  Bring to a boil and cook over low heat.  While the lentils are cooking, shred or cut lettuce into 1 inch pieces.  In a saute pan brown the lettuce until wilted, but not soft.  In a taco shell place lettuce, lentils, taco sauce, and lime for each taco server.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,sun tomato oil,steel oat,leg lamb,italian sausage
title: Scottish Oaty Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 3/4 cup ouzo | 1 1/4 lbs boneless leg of lamb, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 4 1/2 lbs ground italian sausage ( or sweet ) | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup ouzo | 1 1/2 cups steel cut oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 375.  Combine ouzo and lamb in shallow dish.  Cover.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,italian seasoning,pam cooking spray,saffron,cashew,green cardamom pod,rice,sausage
title: Spanish Sausage With Asparagus(A Memory of My Dad)
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs asparagus | 2 cups dry rice | 2 links mild sausage, sliced into 1/4's ( sweet ) | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/4 cup raw cashews ( optional ) | pam cooking spray | 8 ounces roasted salted cashews, sliced
instructions: Snap the ends off the asparagus and trim off excess tough ends.  Cut into 1 inch lengths with a knife and blanch until bright green.  Drain and set aside.  If you are using mild sausage, soak the sausages in water to soften, about 5 minutes.  Cook the rice according to package directions, then allow to cool. Spray a baking dish with pam and divide rice mixture among the 8 baking dishes.  Bake at 500°f for 8 - 10 minutes or until heated through.

Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat.  Sprinkle chips lightly with extra virgin asian oil cooking spray.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Bake ribs in a 350 degree oven overnight.  Turn off oven and let ribs rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. Break off pieces of cashew mix with fingers using a rolling pin & press the nuts down lightly, in a small bowl.  Cover wit waxed paper & keep chafing to remove air pockets.

title: Swiss Cheese Ramekins

title: Chinese Restaurant Dry Spice Mix

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Arrange the chiles on a medium baking sheet.  Roast under the broiler until the skins blister and turn black, about 8 minutes.  Allow to cool. instructions: In a small bowl, mix the creme fraiche and mustard paste.
