instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan and fry onion until soft.  Pour into a heat proof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water.  Add stock cube and then stir in chocolate and cheese.  Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until chocolate has melted.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,grand marnier,pork loin chop,sherry wine,quinoa,shortening
title: Coconut Pork With Lemons
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 boneless pork loin chop | 1/2 cup dry vermicelli or 1/2 cup quinoa | 2 -3 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 can coconut cream | 1/2 - 1/3 cup powdered grand marnier
instructions: In skillet with shortening heat over medium high heat.  Add pork and sear on all sides.  Remove pork from skillet and keep warm.  In skillet add vermicelli or quinoa and stir till it changes color.  Add sherry and allow to come to a boil then turn heat down.  Add coconut cream, stir and let it boil for approximately 5 minutes or till vermicelli is tender.  Place pork on plate.  Pour 1/2 cup of liquid over the pork and garnish with powdered grandmars.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,bulgar wheat,marjoram,kidney bean,bamboo shoot,red table wine,peppercorn,pineapple chunk
title: Bulgar and Pineapple Stew
ingredients: 2 cups canned kidney beans, drained with juice reserved | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained | 2 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme leaves, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup red table wine or 1/2 cup chicken broth ( optional ) | 6 slices fresh bamboo shoots, trimmed, cut into chunks ( optional ) | 1/3 cup bulgar wheat ( optional )
instructions: Put kidney beans, pineapple, pineapple chunks, pineapple chunks, marjoram, thyme, and red table wine into slow cooker.  Cover, and cook on high for 2 hours or on low for 4 hours, or until vegetables are hot and flavors are blended.  Stir in bamboo.  When ready to serve, stir in bulgur wheat.  Cover and cook an additional 15 minutes to heat through.

title: Grilled Apple and Garlic
ingredients: 1 package shell pasta | 1/2 cup catsup | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 apple, sliced into thin rounds | 2 tablespoons french bread, cut into 3/4 '' -thick slices
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or grill pan over high heat.  Break pasta into 3 equal parts and cook in the boiling water until al dente, 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain pasta and set it aside.  Meanwhile, combine sugar, catsup, garlic and honey in a small saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until honey dissolves.  Reduce heat to medium and stir in the tomato and apple mixture.  To assemble, place a slice of french bread on each plate and surround with the french toast slices.  Pour a little hot tomato topping onto each slice of french toast.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,tofu,extra virgin olive oil,grain white rice
title: Tofu and Peppers over Rice and Rice
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 red sweet bell peppers or 1 yellow green bell pepper, cut into strips | 1 lb long grain white rice, not quick cooking or 1 lb brown rice, washed
instructions: Thoroughly clean and devein the tofu. .  Rinse, pat dry, and slice into long, 3/4 inch slices.  Arrange a large sauté pan over high heat.  When the pan is just about to smoke, add the olive oil.  The oil is almost smoking and the tofu will begin to separate.  It should sizzle quickly, but not brown in a matter of seconds.  Add the bell pepper, stirring in quickly.  Add the rice and, working quickly, toast the rice for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring quickly and carefully.  Add a couple tablespoons of water to prevent anything burning.  Decrease heat to medium.  Cook for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Dredge the tofu, remove it from the pan, and transfer it to a serving platter.  Serve immediately.

title: Olive Paste (The Perfect Pizza Sauce) #5FIX
ingredients: 2 jars cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons chili peppers ( optional ) | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb, to moisten
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a medium sized mixing bowl.  Add 1 - 2 tblsp of the chili pepper flakes.  Mix until the tomatoes are evenly coated, then add 3/4 cup of crumbs.  Mix thoroughly.  You may also use dried spices, which can be found in the spice section of the grocery store.  Cover and let sit in a cool, dry place for 3 - 4 days.  Allow the mixture to sit at room temperature while preparing the other ingredients and other ingredients.  The longer this sits the better the taste.  For a richer, spicier sauce, you can leave out chili powder.  For a creamier sauce, you can fold in 1 tsp of fresh minced ginger.  Serve over your favorite pizza.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone,chili pepper flake,almond essence,italian cheese,spinach leaf,pico de gallo
title: Spinach with Poached Spinach With Italian Dip (Palermo Con Queso)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mascarpone or 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup pico de gallo ( may use more ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence | 1/2 bag spinach leaves | 1 italian cheese blend, 1 ``, grated ( 1 '', 3/4 '' or 100 g )
instructions: Dipping sauce, combine mascarpone cheese, chili flakes, pico de gallo and almond essence.  Cover and chill.  Salad, trim ends and rinse spinach leaves well.  Remove stems and coarsely chop.  Remove spinach from heat and place in large serving bowl.  Drizzle dressing over spinach and toss well.  Sprinkle spinach with italian cheese blend, stir lightly.

title: Orange-Cinnamon Baked Bacon
ingredients: 1/4 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup coarse sea salt | 2 tablespoons bacon fat, preferably irish bacon shank | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, spray it with cooking spray, and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine all the orange marinade ingredients well, and pour half of this mixture into a small, shallow baking dish.  Add the bacon and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the bacon is crispy and bacon pieces are a golden brown.

title: Tortillas Espanola (Mini Bread Pockets)
ingredients: 1 pita pocket | 3 1/2 tablespoons anchovy fillets, minced
instructions: Wash the pita until the water runs clear.  Dry with paper towels.  Spread the anchovies in the pita, top with the bread, and serve.

title: Hot and Spicy Curry Balls (Oriental Style)
ingredients: 8 ounces fine breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 8 ounces ground couscous
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the sugar in a large bowl and mix well using your hands.  If the mixture is sloppy, add a drop or two of water so as to form a paste consistency.  If the mixture is too dry add a little bit more water.  If it is sticky add a little more breadcrumbs.  Roll the mixture into golf ball sized balls.  If its too wet use your hands to shape it into round balls.  Fry a couple at a time in large, deep fat fryer until they look almost crisp.  Drain on medieval brown paper then place on absorbent paper to keep warm or keep warm while frying remaining balls.  Serve immediately or store in airtight container in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: boursin cheese,brown gravy mix,peanut,chicken meat,cabbage,sausage meat,mexican cheese
title: Fondue (Chicken & sausage in)
ingredients: 1 lb chopped chicken meat | 1 lb chopped ham or 1 lb bacon ( optional ) | 4 ounces boursin cheese | 2 packages mexican blend cheese | 1 package brown gravy mix | 2/3 cup salted peanuts | 2 bags shredded cabbage or 2 bags steamed sweet corn ( for vegetarian use only )
instructions: Combine ham, bacon/bacon, boursin cheese, and montershire sauce in the fondue pot or a fondue pot, and heat to almost boiling point, stirring occasionally.  Add the cheese and stir continuously for 2 minutes.  Dip the vegetables in fondue, and then place in fondue pot for 5 minutes until melted.  Serve with the shredded cabbage.

Random Ingredients: beef eye,pinto bean,sea salt,cream,taco seasoning mix,egg noodle,curry powder
title: Beef and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb beef eye round | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 cups sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Cut beef eye round into cubes. .  Place in a 3 1/2 qt casserole dish coated with cooking spray.  Sprinkle meat with taco seasoning in a ziploc bag, then add beans with their juice, undrained pinto beans, curry powder, sour cream and salt.  Mix well with a fork.  Cover and bake at 350°f for 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Mix well with a fork.  Pour over noodles, or serve with warm noodles.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces beer | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon corn flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, combine beer, orange rind, white pepper and corn flakes.  Microwave, stirring frequently, on high approximately 2 min. , or until mixture is bubbly.  Enjoy with your favorite chips.

title: Orange Rice Salad (Chinese Restaurant-Style)
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 oranges, sections with skin | 2 cups mixed fruit
instructions: Place rice vinegar in a bowl.  Peel oranges with a vegetable peeler and cut into 1/8 inch slivers.  Cut orange slivers crosswise into 1/2 inch slivers.  Place fruit in a shallow glass or ceramic dish.  Drizzle with olive oil.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 90 minutes to 2 hours, stirring before serving.  Serve right away.

title: A-Plus Hot Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder ( more or less, to your specific taste ) or 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder ( more or less, to your specific taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the vinegar, garlic and pepper and whisk until fully combined.  Stir in to your preferred taste.  Keep in a small cup covered with a lid that doesn't seal and let it sit in the fridge for a while to let the flavors develop.  If you feel a little more comfortable with your fresh garlic you can use the vinegar.

title: Quick and Easy Fresh Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice | 2 fresh green or yellow, sliced into rounds
instructions: Place one of the scallions into a bowl of a blender, and pour in the orange juice.  Cover, and pulse three times until the mixture is smooth.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,red pepper relish,cornflour,bamboo shoot,lettuce leaf
title: Hot Chilli Chicken on Bamboo Leaves and Spicy Salad
ingredients: 12 long bamboo shoots, halved | 1/4 cup red sweet pepper relish | 5 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch paste ) | 2 tablespoons bottled jalapeno peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup red sweet pepper relish | lettuce leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: Put the bamboo shoots, 3 tbs of the sweet pepper relish, and the cornflour in a heatproof bowl.  Stir until the sugar starts to melt from the cornflour.  Add the jalapeno and sweet pepper relishes, and mix well.  Serve the chicken on a bed of lettuce leaves.

title: Lemont Aignas
ingredients: 4 lemons | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: Using a sharp knife, peel the rind from 4 lemons and cut the peel into 4 thin slices.  Place the slices in a small bowl and sprinkle with the chopped tarragon.  Melt the remaining 2 - 3 tablespoons of butter in a small frying pan.  When foaming, place one slice of lemon in the fat and fry over moderate heat, turning it with a fork, for 1 to 2 minutes, or until light brown on both sides.  Place lemon slices on a dish, cover with a clean dishtowel and put in a warm oven.  When the heat has gone off, heat 30 ml of water and beat into the melted butter until the mixture is smooth and transparent and a deep, thick glaze forms.  Turn the patted butter onto an oven safe plate and cook under a hot grill until bubbling around the edges.  Remove the dish from the oven and leave on the table to serve.

title: Tropical Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 lb boneless pork loin, coarsely chopped and sprinkled with salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 mango, peeled, pitted and chopped | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees.  Whisk the oatmeal together with your hands or in a bowl and set aside.  Add your pork to the oatmeal and season with salt and pepper.  Add the coconut extract and toss with your hands to coat evenly.  Transfer pork to a baking sheet.  Bake pork for 30 to 40 minutes or until no longer pink.  Stir mango into the oatmeal and add mint.

title: Meatball Kebabs and Peas (Yakhni Chana)
ingredients: 1 kg mutton, washed, trimmed of fat and excess fat and cut into 3/4 inch lengths | 4 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 -2 slit green chili pepper | 1/4 cup yellow split peas, washed and drained | 2 teaspoons sliced garlic | 2 teaspoons saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered saffron, mixed with a little water
instructions: Combine the mutton with the cardamom seeds, peppercorns, green chile, split peas, garlic and the 1/4 cup of water.  Place on a skewer and close the slit.  Place under a very hot grill and cook on both sides for a total of about 8 - 10 minutes.  To check the tenderness, lift the kebabs and check to see if it is cooked.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,onion salt,peanut,dark rum,pasta,poultry seasoning,strawberry,lemon zest
title: Rum Sticky Peanuts
ingredients: 2 cups chopped mixed nuts | 2 cups crushed dried strawberries | 2 bell peppers, diced | 1 sweet onion, diced | 1 lemon, zest of, from 2 to 4 lemons | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 3/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 lb pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Set out the nuts, strawberries, bell peppers, onion.  Remove the zest from 2 to 4 lemons, slice them into quarters, peel and finely dice them.  Place all the ingredients except the rum into a bowl.  Stir to coat and set aside.  Place all the remaining ingredients in a large skillet.  Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer till the sauce is thickened, about 1 1/2 minutes.  Pour the rum over and simmer for 15 more minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,spinach leaf,italian seasoning,wheat bread,banana,granny smith apple,aubergine,cardamom pod
title: Aubergine Breakfast (Eggless)
ingredients: 2 aubergines, sliced lengthwise | 150 g spinach leaves, washed | 3 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and finely diced | 5 leaves fresh basil leaves, washed, stems removed and washed well | 5 whole wheat bread, slices to serve ( or brioche or german-style bread ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon fresh cardamom pod, crushed | 5 tablespoons low-fat yogurt
instructions: Dice the aubergine.  Soak both the inside and outside separately for as little as possible.  Fry in 2 tbsp olive oil in pan.  Add sliced aubergine slices and fry a few minutes more.  Mix apples, spinach and hot water.  Cover and simmer for 5 mins.  Mix all other ingredients thoroughly and serve on a bed of rice accompanied with yoghurt.  Note, alternatively, when i was eating this with fresh bread, i served it with a little vegetable and boiled yam, it was like a mush in my mouth.

title: Spaghetti and Chicken Noodle Bake
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti | 1 large savoy cabbage ( or other cabbage of your choice ) | 1 chicken ( optional ) or 1 g meat ( optional )
instructions: Wash cabbage & cut in half.  Use scissors to cut out the stalks.  Break meat into bite sized pieces or cubes and place in a microwave safe dish.

title: Macaroni With Cucumber and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces macaroni | 1/2 cup thinly sliced cucumber | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons rice wine or 2 teaspoons cider
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions.  While macaroni is cooking, place the other ingredients in a small bowl.  Combine worcestershire and rice wine together in a small saucepan over low heat.  When macaroni, vegetables and sauce are both cooking, add the macaroni mixture and warm through for another five minutes, allowing flavors to meld to form.

title: Red Beans & Rice (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red kidney beans, rinsed | 1 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh oregano ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.

title: Kourabiedes (Black Beans)
ingredients: 3 lbs dried black beans | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 2 teaspoons cognac | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Soak overnight in plenty of cold water.  Drain water, and place beans in large kettle with 3 quarts boiling water and the saffron.  The water covers the beans and makes them tender.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,kaffir lime leaf,ladyfinger,grenadine,apple cider vinegar,mozzarella cheese
title: Apple Mozzarella Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 lb grated mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 1 package ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Mix the cheese with the vinegar and kaffir lime leaves, place 2 tsp of this mixture in the center of the ladyfingers, brush the edges with a little of the grenadine and roll the sides over the cheese until the ladyfingers are covered.  Arrange them on the serving platter with the remaining cheese mixture, sprinkle with any remaining kaffir lime mixture and serve.

title: Mochiko Shortbread
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups mochiko sweet rice flour | 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup apple juice | 7/8 cup golden syrup
instructions: In a large bowl, sift together flours.  Cut in butter until it resembles a fine crumb.  Stir in dry ingredients.  Shape into a long roll.  Wrap in wax paper.

title: Beef  in a Bag - Paula Deen
ingredients: 1 package yeast | 1 lemon peel | 2 cups bread flour | 1 teaspoon paprika | 3 tablespoons bouillon | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons dried herbs | 8 ounces bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Dissolve yeast and lemon peel in 1 cup lukewarm water.  Add remainder of ingredients.  Cover and let sit overnight in a warm place.  The next day, roll out to a thickness of 1/8 inch.

title: Sobrebarriga
ingredients: 4 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 cup red cabbage, diced | 1 green chili pepper, diced | 6 scallions, chopped | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 3 cups instant potato flakes | cooking oil or corn oil
instructions: Combine cabbage, red cabbage, green chili pepper, scallions, flour, and pepper in a bowl.  Mix well and add potato flakes.  Heat oil or corn oil in a deep skillet over medium heat.  Pour potato mixture into the pan and cook on both sides until golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Tasty Cold Noodle  (Beef or Chicken) Soup

instructions: Heat oil in dutch oven.

title: Garlicky and Easy Radish & Radish Appetizer
ingredients: 1 small radish | 1/3 cup jarred garlic sauce
instructions: Cut radish into 1/4 cubes.  Place in small pan with garlic.  Boil the radish until just tender.  Drain, then transfer to medium sized bowl.  Rinse with cold water to cool slightly.  Drain the garlic and rub all over the radish.  Store at room temperature in refrigerator.

title: The Real Deal Low Fat Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 350 g duck breasts | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon soya sauce
instructions: Cut the duck breasts in half lengthways and remove all the skin.  Coat with the chilli flakes on both sides.  In the microwave oven, place the chicken.  Cover and cook in microwave for approximately 30 - 45 secs then take out of the microwave and place on a plate covered with aluminium foil.  Leave to rest in the fridge for 15 minutes.  Slice the duck across the grain and place on a plate.  Mix the soya sauce with the cheese and sprinkle over the duck.  Serve with some rice or your favourite meal and leave as is or alternatively mix up some cornflour and water to make a slightly thinner dip.

title: Pasta Shells in Creamy Chocolate
ingredients:
12 small pasta shells or 12 small pasta shells, cooked and drained | 12 yellow bell peppers ( or red ) or 12 brown bell peppers, roughly chopped | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar.

instructions: Heat all sauce ingredients in a small frypan.  Add the cream, stir to combine.  Cook until sauce thickens.

Random Ingredients: egg,icing sugar,vegetable broth,fennel seed,grape,beef stew meat,cashew nut
title: Stuffed Grape Leaves (Chokha Ki Roti)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons grapes | 3 tablespoons cashew nuts ( sesame seed meal ) | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into small pieces | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 cup grapes, halved
instructions: Dip grapes in a bowl of water to soak.  Drain in a colander and set aside.  Using damp hands, spread grapes with grapes on baking sheets.  Using a pastry brush, spread one tablespoon grapes on each grape.  Sprinkle cashew nuts over grapes.  Using a second grape on the outside of the grape, place grape leaves on top.  Lightly brush grapes lightly with a little grapes.  Bake grapes on middle rack of a preheated 400°f oven until grapes begin to soften and nuts are lightly browned.  Remove from oven.  Place 1 tbsp.  Gluten free icing sugar and 2 eggs in a medium bowl and lightly beat well.  Dip grapes into egg wash and coat with icing sugar mixture.  Sprinkle grapes with a tsp or two of sesame seeds.  Top one grape with grape leaves.  Repeat process of adding grapes and sesame seeds.  Enjoy.

title: Bread Machine Pizza
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 1/4 - 3 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Place the dry yeast into the bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer.  Add the flour and pizza dough settings.  When the dough cycle is completed, remove dough from bowl and punch down on a lightly floured surface.  Divide into 2 equal pieces and place each piece into an 11 in.  X 8 in.  X 2 in.  Baking pan coated with cooking spray.  Cover with plastic wrap or a dish towel and let rise in a warm area for 20 - 25 minutes or until light and doubled in bulk.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Using a long, thin bladed knife, score each piece on the diagonal, vertically and diagonally to yield 12 wedges.  Bake for 3 - 5 minutes or until crust is golden brown.  Slide immediately onto a wire rack and cool on a wire rack.

title: Baked Pear and Ricotta With Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 large pears | 1/2 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup light cream
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the top off each pear so that the peel slips out of the pear easily.  Cut the peel into a 3 inch long slice.  Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Cut a 1 inch wide x 1 inch deep slit in the side of each pear.  Insert a thin slice of ricotta inside each pear.  Cover the inside of the pears with 1/2 ounce of cream.  Arrange the pears in a 13x9 inch baking dish.  Bake for 25 minutes until the cream is melted and slightly browned at the edges.  Serve hot.

title: Lemon Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried green split peas | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 cup fresh lemon rind | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except lemon rind, in a pot and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until peas are tender.  Stir from time to time and stir in lemon rind before serving.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,coriander leaf,yellow mustard,cake flour,beef steak
title: Crispy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs beef steaks | 1 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into 8 slices.  Dust all over with flour and place between two sheets of waxed paper.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour half into each slice of steak, cover and refrigerate overnight.  Arrange slices of steaks on a rack in a foil tent, bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until just tender.  Serve with cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,kalamata olive,bean,cinnamon,peanut butter,chicken liver,red curry paste
title: Thai Peanut-Butter Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver | 1 lb frozen beans | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 lb kalamata olive, halved | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash and destem the chicken liver and cut into thin 1 inch long strips.  In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp peanut oil over medium heat.  Cook the chicken in the hot oil quickly, adding 1 tbsp of peanut butter per batch and stirring, to prevent burning.  Do not brown.  When all is heated through, combine with the chicken and remaining peanut butter.  Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: carom seed,philadelphia cream cheese,onion flake,flour,chili powder
title: Spicy Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature, at room temperature | 1/2 cup onion flakes, chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon carom seeds | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon flour
instructions: Line 11 x17 greased jelly roll pan with paper towels.  Combine all ingredients in blender, blend until smooth.  Add enough water to make spreadable consistency and spread over prepared pan.  Sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 teaspoon coarse ground carom seeds.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve in french style slices or with crackers.  Serve warm, or chill for up to one day.

title: Roasted Fresh Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed garlic clove | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs fresh mozzarella cheese or 1 1/2 lbs fresh cheese | rocket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Punch some mozzarella with your hands and work it into the shape of a small oval approximately the size of the wok used for roasting the mozzarella.  Brush the top surface with a mixture of the garlic and oil spray.

Random Ingredients: potato,fish sauce,chive,cream tartar,golden syrup,red chili powder,walnut half
title: Sweet Potato, Walnut and Chilli Dip
ingredients: 500 g sugar-flied potatoes | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons sweetened fish sauce | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder | 12 walnut halves, lightly toasted
instructions: Microwave the sugar, golden syrup, chives and fish sauce in a microwave safe bowl on high for about 1 minute or until just mixed, stirring after 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the sweetened, hot mixture and stir to combine.  Cook on high for 2 minutes or until heated through,.  Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle on the chilli powder and toasted walnuts.

title: Prawn and Parsnips with Simple and Delicious Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 2 kg prawns, shelled, deveined and tails left on | 1 kg parsnip | 100 g roma tomatoes | 1 1/2 liters simple syrup ( a very generous tablespoon! )
instructions: Cook the prawns, parsnips and roma tomatoes in plenty of boiling water for 20 minutes or until they are tender.  Strain them and then place in a bowl.  Add the simple syrup and salt to taste.  Serve with your favourite prawn and salsa.

title: Danish Apricot Crusted Beef
ingredients: 1 can crushed apricots | 1/2 cup amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 12 cloves | 4 slices thick-cut boneless beef chuck, 1/4 inch thick | 24 ounces white fish fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Remove any heavy objects from the raisins and set aside.  Combine apricots, amaretto, cloves and remaining raisins in a shallow baking dish and add beef.  Marinate in refrigerator for 3 hours.  Place fish on the rack of a broiler pan.  Broil 2 minutes on each side, until fish is browned.

title: Smokey & Heavenly Mango Lassi
ingredients: 3 tablespoons guiness quick oats ( or old fashioned or quick and quick cooking oats ) | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1/4 cup chopped basil | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies ( do not drain ) | 4 cups watermelon, cubed finely with the rind | 1/3 cup light cream | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender, blend well.  Chill several hours before serving.  Store in an ice cube tray in the freezer for up to 2 months.

title: Ajiaco (Cuban Shredded Pork Loin)
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 5 medium sour cherry, halves | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese, divided | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Score the fat into thin strips about 1 1/2 by 2 inches long across the width of the pork using a meat tenderizing grater or small knife.  Grind the meat with the guacamole, 2 tablespoons of the cheese, half the cherries, and one tablespoon of the remaining cheese in the small bowl, using an electric shredder, until the pork is completely smooth.  Spread the remaining 1 tablespoon of cheese on the pork, top with sour cherries, and remaining cheese.  Cover and refrigerate until serving, at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours.  Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before cooking.  Heat the broiler to high.  Place the pan of pork on a rack over a rimmed baking sheet, and broil, turning once, until the pork caramelizes, about 30 seconds to 1 minute per pound.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sugar,self raising flour,dark brown sugar,pineapple,ice,cilantro,red chili pepper flake
title: Hot and Sour Pork Balls
ingredients: 500 g pork fat | 100 g sugar | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped cilantro, leaves picked | 200 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 - 1 1/4 cup crushed ice | 1/2 cup pineapple, drained and diced
instructions: Heat up the meat fat in a pan, add the sugar and fry with half the lime leaves for approx 30 mins or until the fat and sugar starts to go golden. instructions: In small bowl, stir together pesto sauce, mustard, chili pepper flakes, cardamom pods, hot pepper flakes, shrimp and horseradish.  Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  To serve, spread on sliced french bread.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,tomato green chilies,cottage cheese,colby monterey jack cheese,green cabbage,green chili pepper
title: Mexican Strata #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed at room temperature | 1 1/2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 can of chopped green chili peppers | 1 pint cottage cheese, softened | 1 can of chopped green chili peppers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt, scant | 1 1/2 cups chicken or 1 1/2 cups turkey cooked and shredded chicken | 2 cups mixed dried fruit, such as cranberries | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 cups grated provolone cheese | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry | 2 1/2 cups frozen unsweetened raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Mix cornmeal, and salt in a bowl.  Stir in chicken, fruit, cider vinegar, and provolone cheese.  Spread mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake until heated through and bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes.  Let cool for 5 minutes.  Serve warm or refrigerate until cold.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup mix,cooking oat,thyme leave,extra virgin olive oil
title: Oaty & Thyme Croched French Onion Oat Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup fat free french onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Grease a baking tray with oil.  Use a food processor or a stick mixer to blend oats & soup mix together.  Add thyme and oil and process until everything is finely chopped & combined, but not a paste.  Shape mixture into 8 large chunks.  Lightly toss in your favourite bread or biscuit, if using, then press into oven for 10 minutes or until golden.

title: Bread Machine Calzones
ingredients: 1 lb pizza dough | 1 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Prick your thumb and thumb in two or three places using a sharp knife.  Make a hole in your neck a tiny bit bigger than your whole hand.  Insert a lightbulpoon of lightbulpoon lard.  Put your dough inside the bread machine pan and add cracked black pepper.  Select crust color or basic pie crust setting and start.

title: Portabella Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 package portabella mushrooms | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup margarine | red pepper, diced into strips | 1 scallion, chopped
instructions: Saute mushrooms, add peppers and scallion.  Cook over medium heat until all the moisture has evaporated.  You want the green parts still a bit crisp.  Stir.  Pour into bowl, sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,palm sugar,scallion,ketchup,orange juice zest,orange peel,chipotle chile
title: Kan-Bun (Spinach Salad)
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach leaves | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice, juice from 2 oranges | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon red palm sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped scallions or 2 tablespoons cilantro | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely grated orange peel | 2 chipotle chiles, paste ( in adobo )
instructions: Drain the spinach and place in a large salad bowl.  Combine with the orange and ketchup and pour over the spinach and toss to combine.  Sprinkle on the scallions, orange peel and chipotle peppers and toss again.  Let salad stand at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Fettuccine
ingredients: 300 g chickpea flour | 400 g ginger
instructions: Mix together the chickpea flour.  Cut the ginger into thin slices with a knife and add to the dough, knead gently.  The dough is ready when you feel a piece of dough is formed.  Turn the dough out onto a board and using a rolling pin gently roll out to 5cm thickness.  The dough should be soft and slightly pliable.  Heat a small amount of oil on a large pan and add the fettuccine and fry quickly, using a few drops of water.  If you find that the fettuccine is drying out and becomes difficult to remove from the pan, cover with a lid to keep from sticking to the pan and fry to desired tenderness.

title: Spices (Lactose, Salt, Bread, Rosemary, Dressing)
ingredients: 4 cups tri-colored sweet mixed spice ( spices - all purpose ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1 1/3 cups triple sec or 1 1/3 cups other orange-flavored liqueur, such as grand marnier ( cointreau )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sweet mixed spices, 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon seasoning, celery salt, and 1 1/3 cup of triple sec or other orange liqueur.  Stir to evenly blend ingredients.  Add the remaining 1/3 cup of triple sec or other orange liqueur.  Seal airtight.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,red capsicum,confectioner sugar,fish sauce,orange peel,palm sugar,button mushroom
title: Spicy Vietnamese Cheesecake
ingredients: 8 medium button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons sliced red capsicums or 2 tablespoons green capsicum | 1/3 cup light palm sugar, or to taste | 1/3 cup fish sauce, or to taste | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a 10x6 inch baking dish with parchment paper.  Place mushrooms and capsicums between 2 sheets of parchment paper and tightly roll each one up like a jelly roll.  Cut each roll into 12 slices.  Place each slice on top of one another and place in the oven to warm through.  As soon as the mushrooms and capsicums have begun to soften, remove them from the oven and cut a slit down the center, just below the stalk.  Stir the mushroom and capsicums, palm sugar, fish sauce, orange peel, and 1/4 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese into the chilled mushrooms and allow the cheese to melt.  Pour the mixture into the cooled crust.  Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until bubbly.  Remove from oven and place in a serving bowl.

title: Saffron and Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 medium rashes saffron threads | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices ( spicy, lop chong ) | vegetable oil, if necessary | 1 pinch salt | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese ( or your favorite cheese ) | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup butter
instructions: Prepare saffron threads according to package directions.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 3 minutes.  Add the kielbasa and simmer until the kielbasa is softened, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, pour 1/4 cup of canola oil or butter into a large skillet.  Add the salt and saute over medium heat until sizzling.  Taste and adjust salt.  When the saffron and kielbasa mixture are almost cooked through, add the shredded cheese.  Add 3/4 cup of canola oil and 3/4 cup of water.

title: Chard and Swiss Chard Scones (Biscuits)
ingredients: 150 g swiss chard ( shredded ) | 2 teaspoons self-raising flour | 1 stalk celery ( finely sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f.  Place all ingredients into a large bowl and mix together lightly.  Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a 5cm thick round using 3cm cutter from a swiss roll tin.  Place on well oiled baking trays and lightly prick the tops with a fork.  Bake for 30 mins or until just tender and golden.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,red potato,coconut,sea scallop,shiitake mushroom,stewing beef,garlic salt
title: Wormy Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 lbs red potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 can shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup lowfat plain vanilla yogurt or 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 tablespoon sea scallops | 1/2 cup flaked coconut
instructions: Cut meat into 1/2 inch chunks.  Slice potatoes into 1/4 inch wedges.  Place meat in shallow glass dish, and sprinkle with garlic salt.  Combine remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour over meat, cover, and refrigerate for about 20 minutes, flipping over once or twice.

title: Chinese Barbecue Dry Rub for Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 teaspoons chutney | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, lightly roasted whole roasted | 2 teaspoons chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass bowl.  Use your hands to rub.  If mixture dries out, whisk in a tablespoon of water.  Serve as desired.

title: Fruity Okra and Okra
ingredients: 8 ounces okra, cut in half | 1 tablespoon fennel | 4 fluid ounces olive oil | 4 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place all the ingredients in a food processor and process for 3 - 4 minutes, until well mixed.  Line a large baking tray with baking paper and line with aluminium foil to protect yourself from drying out the excess moisture.  Pile the okra on the foil and spread evenly.  Bake for 25 - 35 minutes, or until just tender.  Allow to cool then eat warm with butter.  Delicious warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: seasoning sauce,red cabbage,beef roast,avocado,coconut cream,sherry wine,sauce,vanilla essence
title: Crock Pot Beef and Cabbage Dinner
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef roast | 1 large red cabbage | 1 large avocado | 4 tablespoons sherry wine or 4 tablespoons port wine | 2 cups coconut cream | 1 cup savoury steak sauce ( i used a taste of thai ) | 1 cup mild hot sauce ( i used a taste of thai ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Combine the ingredients in a crock pot.  Cook on high for 3 hours.  For the last 30 minutes, stir, serve and enjoy.

title: Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pistachios, shelled | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat the oven to 400ºf and line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the pistachios in a bowl of water, toss to coat, and then transfer to the preasted baking sheet.  Bake until the pistachios are soft, about 10 minutes.  Watch carefully, the pistachios do burn easily.

title: Dump Sun Dried Tomato & Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 lb canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup sun dried tomato pesto
instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium high heat.  Add beans to pan and stir fry for 5 minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally.  Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Serve at once.

title: Crunchy Nuts and Far East Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup wheat germ ( dark or regular wheat ) | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: In a bowl add wheat germ and dark sesame oil and mix well then cover and let sit for 30 minutes.  In a saucepan, heat the sesame seeds over medium heat, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes.  Pour oil from the bowl and slowly pour in seeds.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,onion powder,beef broth,new potato,cilantro leaf
title: Yummy New York Potatoes and Herbs with Lamb
ingredients: 2 large boneless leg of lamb | 2 medium tiny onions, sliced thin | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Trim fat from lamb place lamb and onions in large pot.

title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 pint hot water | 1/2 cucumbers or 1/2 english cucumber, peeled, cut lengthwise in half, seeded, and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices ( about 4 cups ) | 1 can sliced peaches, drained, juices reserved
instructions: In a large serving bowl of salted water, combine the hot water and cucumber.  Cover and refrigerate until the cucumbers are tender.  Meanwhile, drain the peaches and remove the pits.  In a serving bowl, toss the cucumber with the peaches and reserved juice.  Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,poblano chile pepper,bean sprout,cognac,green chilies,oil,tomato paste
title: Poblano Pico Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 pound napa cabbage, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 tablespoon cognac | 2 cans baked beans with molasses | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained ( spicy ) | 1 can tomato paste | oil ( for frying ) | 2 poblano chile peppers, chopped
instructions: In a saucepan, soak beans and pimento stuffed peppers in water to cover.  When they're almost done, drain the liquid and rinse off the peppers.  Remove any papery outer skins or remaining membrane from the peppers and discard the seeds and veins.  In a large skillet, heat enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan by 1/ heat.  Saute the poblano peppers 5 minutes while stirring.  Remove the peppers with a slotted spoon and add the drained green chilies, tomato paste, napa cabbage and sauteed peppers.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes while stirring periodically.  Sauce should have the consistency of hot cereal.  If it seems dry, add water.  Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Grilled Salmon With Citrus, Chipotle, and Pear Adobo
ingredients: 1/4 cup chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup grapefruit | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 4 salmon fillets ( 3/4 to 1 inch thick )
instructions: To make the sauce, chop the chipotle pepper and grapefruit in a food processor.  Add poultry seasoning and poultry seasoning.  Mix well.  Add the salmon with 2 - 3 tablespoons of the sauce, and pulse a few times on high until evenly distributed.  Preheat grill to high heat, with an oiled rack about 3/4 of the way up the grill.  Place the salmon fillets on grill.  Cook, turning once, until lightly charred on both sides and no longer opaque in the center, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Serve the salmon with remaining sauce.

title: Yummy Lamb and Fried Rice Cakes
ingredients: 200 g ground lamb shoulder | 1 purple onion, sliced thin | 200 g plain rice | 25 g fried capers | 50 ml rice wine | 25 g fried bread flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Cook the rice to your liking using the red rice, rice vinegar and ginger.  It should have a creamy consistency, but not too sticky.  Form the rice into 4 small balls, then use a spatula to flatten each ball slightly.  Chill before using.  In a frypan, brown the ground lamb, then mix it into the other ingredients.  Spread out on a baking tray and bake at 190°c for 35 - 40 minutes until the meat is fully cooked.  Serve with your choice of salad and fresh garlic salad.

title: Vegan Cornstarch Lentils
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( or equivalent ) | 1 cup lentils sprouts ( about two 10oz package whole wheat pkg ) | 1 cup textured vegetable protein ( tvp ) | 1/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: Toast coriander seed, and let cool.  Place the bean sprouts in a small wok or shallow bowl and rinse.  Wipe the bean sprouts with a dampened paper towel and put in bowl.  Add water until it's about 1/2 inch above the bean sprouts.  Add the tvp and stir to break up.  Add the coriander seeds.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 package refrigerated buttermilk biscuits ( 8 biscuits )
instructions: Remove and discard giblets from meat.  Place meat on a cutting board.  Thinly slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Arrange slices on top of meat.  Press a biscuit cutter into centers of biscuit halves with moistened fingers.  Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 12 minutes.  Turn over, and bake 12 minutes more.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,yellow hominy,garlic clove,white vinegar,cornmeal,prosciutto ham
title: Mexican Cornmeal Soup by Giada
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked pork sausage ( bulk in bulk ) | 3 garlic cloves, diced | 3 cups yellow hominy | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 ounce thinly sliced prosciutto ham ( or other ham such as deli ham ) | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Remove and discard casing from sausage.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,green bean,lime wedge,topping,lemon pepper,lime juice,broccoli,blueberry
title: Blueberry & Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 bunches broccoli, trimmed | 1 cup fresh blueberries, halved | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed | lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Place green beans, broccoli, and blueberries in a medium salad bowl.  In a separate bowl, whisk together lime juice, lime juice, lemon pepper and liquid smoke.  Pour over green beans, broccoli and blueberries.

title: Dried Brown Lentils (Yogurt & Dill) - With Lentils
ingredients: 1 bag dried brown lentils | 3 tablespoons dill seeds ( or 1 teaspoon of ground )
instructions: Wash and sort the lentils.  Place a kettle on the stove and heat on low heat until there is just a few scaldings in the bottom of the pan and the lentils are soft enough to be picked apart with your fingers, about an hour, stirring occasionally.  If you feel the lentils are drying out, add a little water to moisten.  Drain them through a linen cloth or sieve or sieve lined with several layers of cheesecloth.  Remove all bones except for about 1/4 cup of liquid which will be left.  Place lentils in a bowl with enough water to cover and let soak overnight.  Drain well and stir in the reserved liquid.  If the lentils aren't sufficiently juicy before your mouth, cook them in the boiling water for a few minutes until they float.  Drain the water and add to the yogurt mixture.  Add the dill.  Serve either in a bowl or on toast points for a snack or just eat some plain yogurt.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,tamarind paste,lemon juice zest,chickpea,sharp cheddar cheese,frangelico,almond extract,mole
title: Mexican Hummus
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic infused wine vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, about 2 lemons | 1/4 cup blanched almond extract | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1 jalapenos or 1 jalapeno pepper, minced, to taste | 1/4 cup frangelico or 1/4 cup other liqueur | 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor fitted with metal blade and process until smooth.

title: Baked Sausage Wrapped in Limes
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 lime wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Grease a 9 by 13 by 2 baking pan.  Heat the sausage in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring to crumble.  Cook until well browned, about 10 minutes.  Add the juice from the lime wedge, if desired.  Remove sausage from skillet and drain in a colander over a bowl.  Using a large spoon, transfer 2 tablespoons of the sausage cooking fat from the sausage.  Using the back of a spoon, mash the sausage until smooth and creamy.  Scrape the sausage mixture into the baking pan.  Top with remaining 1 teaspoon bacon fat.  Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour or until bacon is heated through and sausage is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,beef tenderloin,basmati rice,cardamom pod,vermicelli,rosemary leaf
title: Vefalon Grzyyya (Veal Kabobs)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds or 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 5 cardamom pods, slightly crushed | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into long strips ( or other small cut of meat ) | 1 sprig rosemary leaf ( or marjoram ) | 1/2 lb vermicelli, broken into 1-2-inch-long pieces | cooked basmati rice
instructions: Heat a grill or large cast iron skillet over medium heat until hot.  Sprinkle oil into pan and allow oil to heat for 15 minutes or until light brown brown.  Transfer lamb to a plate.  Sprinkle lamb with remaining ground spices, and coat with the sprig.  Place the lamb on the grill and cook about 4 minutes on each side, or until juices run clear when lamb is pierced.  Remove lamb from grill and set aside.  Add vermicelli, sprinkle with any liquid left on plate, and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, or until sizzling.  Fluff with wooden spoon, or press the noodles through a sieve into a bowl and pour off all water.  Add meat to noodles and stir to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Instant Pot Cranberry Sauce
ingredients:
2 cups fresh cranberries | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules, plus more ( or 1 tsp.
    - of the equivalent amount of broth )
instructions: Combine cranberries and chicken bouillon in the pot and let sit on the low heat until cranberries release water, about 2 minutes.  Stir and check frequently just to make sure the cranberries release all their liquid.  It should have a slightly thicken consistency, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,star anise,pam cooking spray,red capsicum,cardamom powder,self rising flour,coriander,white wine
title: Cannellini Bean Bread
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans, drained | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 teaspoons crushed whole star anise | 1 teaspoon coriander | 2 tablespoons dry white wine or 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1 red capsicum, diced | 1 tablespoon pam cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c and grease 2 baking trays generously.  Place the drained beans & flour in a food processor and process for 1 minute or until well combined.  Add cardamon, star anise, coriander, wine or vermouth & capsicum and process until just combined.  Turn batter into muffin tin.  Spoon the bean bread mixture evenly through the top of each muffin tin.  Spray muffins with oil and bake for 35 - 40 mins or until golden & crisp.

title: Honeydew Melon and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 4 large honeydew melon, cut in slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon orange extract
instructions: Stir honeydew and whiskey together in a bowl until honeydew is coated.  Place melon slices in a bowl and stir pineapple juice and orange extract into melon mixture.

title: Southwestern Style Carnitas
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into cubes | 3 quarts lime juice | 2 pounds dry quinoa
instructions: Simmer quinoa in a large pot with enough water to cover in a large pot over medium low heat.  Cook until tender, 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  Drain, reserving 1 cup of the quinoa to use as a garnish.  Place cubed beef into a large bowl.  Pour lime juice over the beef.  Add reserved quinoa and stir gently to mix.  Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer until meat is very tender and most of the liquid has cooked away, about 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Nirvana Noodles in Miracle Whip
ingredients: 1/2 cup baby carrots or 1/2 cup fresh baby carrots | 1/2 cup bean, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 cups cooked medium rice noodles | 1 1/4 cups miracle whip light or 1 1/4 cups light whipped cream | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain noodles.  Heat 1 tbsp of butter or margarine or oil in a skillet over medium high heat, add carrot.  Cook 10 minutes, stirring often.  Sprinkle coriander and stir.  Add noodles and stir.  When noodles are heated through turn onto a plate until cool enough to handle.  Add miracle whip and stir briefly.  Spread noodles evenly on plate, top with carrots and garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Tasty Potato and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes | 1/2 cup hummus | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 minced jalapeno pepper
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix together the hummus and the vegetables.  Add the cheese and jalapenos and mix well.  Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,anchovy paste,taco seasoning mix,chicken breast,phyllo pastry,guava paste
title: Mexican Chicken Phyllo Bake
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup guava paste | 2 ounces ancho-stevia paste | 20 frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can pinto beans ( drained ) or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans ( drained )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the chicken breasts in a large ziploc freezer bag.  Add the taco seasoning.  Remove the air from the bag.  Using your fingers, mix and coat both sides of each chicken breast with the taco seasoning.  Remove the plastic bag, squeeze the contents of the bag into an 8x8 inch baking dish.  Place the pan in the oven for 50 minutes.  While the chicken is baking, combine the guava paste with a splash of water to make a thin paste.  Remove the baking dish from the oven and add the ancho chile paste.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Stir.  Add the peanut/avocado paste mixture.  Spread the mixture between each chicken breast.  Lay in the phyllo sheets and brush the tops of the phyllo sheets with melted butter.  Bake in a preheated oven just until the phyllo is golden brown, the sauce is bubbly, and the phyllo is crisp.  Cut into four pieces.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,french bread,natural peanut butter,chocolate syrup
title: Peanut Butter-Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 3 tablespoons smooth natural-style peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | parsley sprigs | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Stir the peanut butter, chocolate syrup, and parsley together in a shallow baking dish large enough to fit all of the bread cubes into a single layer.  Bake the bread cubes, golden brown in the hot oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until they begin to soften and start to firm.  Remove bread from the oven and dip each piece into the warm sauce, then into the bread crumbs.  Place on a serving platter.  Serve immediately note, to make dipping foods, arrange a piece of french bread on a serving platter and spoon a slice of french bread, a few spoonfuls of peanut butter, or two tablespoons of chocolate syrup, and 1/2 teaspoon of chopped candied ginger.

title: African Celery and Garlic Powder Substitute (Raw)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod, ground | 6 celery ribs | 3 teaspoons of good quality garlic-flavored seasoning or 1 teaspoon of good organic granulated garlic
instructions: Use an electric spice grinder, or a mortar and pestle to grind all the ingredients and combine with any remaining herb mixture.

title: Irish Cream Oatcakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/4 cup irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix the oats and irish cream.  Stir in the oat mixture.  Drop teaspoon onto a baking sheet.  Bake 25 minutes, or until lightly golden and firm.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,mint,sunflower seed,mandarin orange,icing sugar,lasagna noodle,five spice powder
title: Chilled Mandarin and Sweet Nuts Marmalade
ingredients: 5 sheets lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 pinch five-spice powder | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup mint, leaves
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain.  Spread sunflower seeds on the bottom of an ovenproof dish.  Layer sliced mandarin oranges, followed by icing sugar, five spice powder, barley and mint.  Cover and chill for one hour.  Just before serving, remove from the oven, uncover and sprinkle with icing sugar.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge Sundae
ingredients: 2 liters good quality vanilla ice cream, softened | 3/4 cup strong coffee powder | 60 ml flour | 1 cup finely chopped pecorino cheese or 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 liters good quality ice cream, lightly salted
instructions: Whip your vanilla ice cream, then set aside to cool.  Sift the flour into a mixing bowl and then gradually add the coffee powder.  With a wooden spoon or a teaspoon, stir and stir until you have a smooth paste.  Turn into a serving bowl and cover with plastic wrap.  Freeze at least 4 hours or overnight.  Whip the cheese until creamy, then whip through the ice cream.  If possible, beat in the soft cheese to it just before serving.  Transfer to an oversized freezer plastic bowl, then top with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: salt,pico de gallo,pistachio,cottage cheese,chicken breast fillet,beef stew meat
title: Mexican Chicken Cottage Cheese Filling for Burritos
ingredients: 400 g cottage cheese, mashed with a little water | 200 g ground beef stew meat, cooked | 1 teaspoon salt | 100 g pico de gallo, finely chopped | 150 g pistachios, finely chopped ( optional ) | 3 medium chicken breast fillets, cooked and shredded
instructions: Mix together flour, salt, cheese and a little water to make a batter.  Add meat and mix well.  Heat oven to 200c/fan 200c/gas mk.  Grease a deep ovenproof pan.  Put the batter into it, spreading it evenly.  Add the pico de gallo, pistachios, chicken and pour mix over it.  Cover with aluminium foil or grease proof paper or lid and bake for 40 minutes or until the top turns golden.  Serve hot or cold with jasmine rice.

title: Spicy Snow Peas With Poblanos and Snow Peas (Pad Khioreti)
ingredients: 600 g snow peas, washed | 2 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 100 g fresh poblano chiles, deveined and sliced
instructions: Cut the snow peas diagonally, leave ends attached.  Steam the peas for half an hour and turn over halfway through.  Add a little more fish sauce.  Heat a little chicken stock in a pan and cook the poblanos for a minute or two, until they start to stick to the bottom of the pan.  Remove the poblanos with a slotted spoon and place on a plate lined with paper towel.  Heat the remaining stock.  Add the snow peas and simmer for another 5 minutes.  Serve the cooked snow peas and poblanos over sticky rice with a sprinkling of chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,squash,malt vinegar,ice water,basmati rice,water chestnut
title: Mongolian Shashlyk
ingredients: 1 whole fresh squash, cleaned, seeded and cut into chunks | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 tablespoons cold water | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 1/4 teaspoons dry basil or 1 1/4 teaspoons chinese chives, chopped finely | 4 cups steaming hot basmati rice | 2 cups cold water
instructions: In a large bowl or 2 - 3 cups a steamer basket, steam the squash, water chestnuts and chives for 20 minute.  Rinse the bowl with cold water to remove any browned bits.  Drain the squash and return it to the bowl.  In a separate bowl add 2 tablespoons of the vinegar, 1 cup of the sushi water or salt and 1/2 teaspoon of the sugar.  To serve, place rice in a large bowl, add 3/4 cup of the rice water, followed by the vegetable mixture and rice.  Toss to coat and serve immediately.  Repeat for the remaining bowl.

title: Irish Turnips
ingredients: 2 medium turnips | 2 ounces icing sugar | 4 granny smith apples, peeled and sliced
instructions: Peel and slice turnips into rounds approx 2/3 inch thick.  Place sugar in a shallow dish and dip turnips into it.  Let sugar melt in pan.  Drain turnips on paper towel.  Sprinkle turnips with about 2 tbsp of icing sugar.  Place slice of apple on top and flip over to turn.  Repeat process until all turnips are used up. Cornmeal (Aussie Oven) (Cornmeal Co.

title: Baja Fried Spinach Salad
ingredients:
2 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1/2 cup daikon radish, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup cheese, grated ( your personal preference ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes ( optional.
    - please remember to add a few drops of chilli powder if you wish ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1 romaita lettuce
instructions: Prepare all ingredients, except lettuce, under refrigeration.  Shake well.  Combine all ingredients, and toss with dressing.  Serve.

title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can baked beans with sprouts, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f.  Spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray.  Spread a third of the bean sprouts in the bottom of the dish.  Add another third of the bean sprouts.  Repeat layers ending with beans.  Bake uncovered for about 50 minutes or until hot.  Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sweet Corn With Paprika

instructions: Heat oven to 175°c grease 2 large baking trays, put corn kernels on a foil lined baking tray and sprinkle the paprika over them.  Combine sugar, water and paprika in a small saucepan.  Cook stirring constantly over moderate heat, stirring, until sugar is golden and the liquid has dried.  Spread the mixture over the corn.  Bake, stirring from time to time, for about 45 minutes or until mixture is tender.  Remove from oven.  Using tongs, transfer corn to a plate.  Serve cool or warm.

title: Veggies and Eggs

instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the eggplant flesh on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 25 minutes.  Remove from oven, cut the flesh into cubes, remove skin, and chop flesh into 1/4 inch cubes.  Place the cubes and eggplant flesh back in the oven to bake for another 15 minutes, remove and serve.

title: Curried Squash
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 1/2 cup curry, or curry paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut squash into 1/4 inch slices, and place slices in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway through.  Remove from heat after 5 minutes and arrange on a platter.  Return to the oven to bake 5 minutes more, or until squash is tender and lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Lite Pork Loaf

instructions: Mix chopped chicken with chopped pecans, add 8oz of pork hocks and set aside.  Boil 15 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.  Add cooked lasagna noodles and allow noodles to soak 2 - 3 minutes drain pork hocks, remove bones, shred.  Drain chicken and allow meat to cool and then chop into 1 - 2 oz chunks.  In large bowl add pork mixture, 3 eggs, banana liqueur, margarine.  Mix well.  Spread some of the meat/egg mixture in the bottom of a 9x9 glass baking dish.  Spread some of the egg mixture on top of meat.  Spread some of the chopped peanuts on top of that.  Add some of the chopped pork on top of that.  Repeat layers except you have noodles, meat, egg, meat, cheese etc.  Spread the remaining 1 1/4 cup of melted margarine on top.  Bake 400 for approx 20 - 30 minutes or until top is golden.

title: Lazy Beefy Bearnaise Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb of any cut beef tenderloins | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 7 lasagna noodles
instructions: Thoroughly season meat.  Melt horseradish and ketchup and dip meat in horseradish sauce.  Layer meat with noodles and serve with ketchup side.  This meal can be easily multiplied and makes approximately 15+ noodles.

title: Jicama and Brown Lentils Phyllo Pastries

title: Mongolian Beef Roll-Ups

Transfer to a warm platter and repeat with remaining sauce and beef mixture.  Spoon meat mixture into shallow serving dishes or small ramekins and set aside.

title: Grandma's Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 1 yellow onion
instructions: Cut russet potatoes into big pieces and boil them in a colander until just cooked.  This makes about 1 1/2 pounds of potato salad.  Chop onion and toss with potato salad in a huge bowl.  Chop parsley and toss with potato salad.

title: Gruyere Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 lb gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup mirin, or more to taste
instructions: Combine grated gruyere cheese and mirin in a bowl, stirring well until all lumps are gone and filling is smooth.  Refrigerate until serving.

title: Mushroom and Tomato Dessert
ingredients: 4 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 cans canned peach schnapps | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 pinch almond extract | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | fresh rocket, for garnish
instructions: In a medium size bowl, add the canned mushrooms and the peach schnapps.  Mix, and fill the can with juice from the can.  In small separate bowl, dilute the tomato sauce with a small amount of sugar and almond extract.  Chill until serving, or serve over fresh fruit.  Top with fruit slices.  Garnish with fresh rocket.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,sherry wine,pearl barley,white onion,serrano chile pepper

instructions: Place the roast beef slices in the bottom of a slow cooker.  Place the black pearl barley and onions in a separate shallow dish or bowl.  Top with slices of serrano chile pepper. title: Canned Horseradish White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon dried pistachio
instructions: Blend all ingredients in large bowl or food processor until well blended.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Sausage & Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian turkey sausage | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sesame chili oil | 1/2 tablespoon garlic salt ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons long-grain white rice ( brown uncooked rice can be substituted )
instructions: In a large pot, brown sausage.  Drain off fat.  Stir in soup and next 6 ingredients.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until rice is tender.

title: Raisin and Olive Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package dry tri-colored pasta | 1 3/4 cups raisins | 10 ounces chopped black olives, drained and halved | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1 tablespoon triple sec | ground thyme to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a large bowl.  Stir raisins, olives, cognac and triple sec into the pasta.  Top with plenty of thyme.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: white,vanilla extract,chili,red chili pepper,yellow onion,beef stew meat,thai fish sauce
title: Soup Stuffed Whole Red Chile Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 fresh red chili peppers | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 medium yellow onion | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili
instructions: Remove seeds and membrane off each chili pepper, then slit the peppers lengthwise into about 1/4 inch wide strips, removing the ribs.  Set aside.  Cut a slit down the side and core just inside the pepper's cavity.  In a frying pan, stir fry the cubed meat, breaking it up as it cooks.  While meat is cooking, slice the onion into thin rounds and combine with sugar, fish sauce, and chili, adding more sugar and fish sauce if it is too dry.  Simmer on low to medium high heat for about 45 minutes.  When meat is tender and beginning to soften, carefully stuff the meat with the meat mixture.  Close the chili pods and place them under the broiler.  Broil on top of the heat, turning them often until tops darken, but still slightly crunchy, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove peppers from heat when they are just soft enough to pick it up by gently pulling a chunk of pepper into the pot as you are removing it from the heat.  Serve with fresh bread for dipping.

title: Cabbage and Cashew Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry small head of cabbage or 2 medium kale, stems removed | 1 can no-salt-added stewed tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping
instructions: Cover and cook cabbage in boiling water 3 minutes or until crisp tender.

title: Easy Avocado Lasagna

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the lasagna noodles for 8 minutes.  Drain the noodles and rinse with cold water.  Spread 1 cup vegetable broth on a plate.  Lay the noodles on top of the broth and lay a second plate on top.  Heat the remaining vegetable broth in a saucepan over medium heat. title: Langoustine- a Quick Tomato & Bacon & Egg Noodle Dinner

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°c.  Fry the bacon until crispy and remove from the pan.  Chop up the bacon into small pieces, leaving the fat in the pan. When all of the butter has melted, add the chopped spring onion and stir through.  Remove from heat and toss through the roma tomato and serve immediately over the hot cooked noodles.

title: Noodle Soup

instructions: Empty ramen noodles into a large pot or a large stock pot.  Add chicken stock, onion powder and salt.  Bring to a boil and then turn down to low.

title: Simple Microwave Grapes

ingredients: 2 -3 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 medium spanish onion ( diced ) | 1 whole small bunch dill pickle ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( chopped ) | 8 ounces rotini pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 medium carrot ( chopped ) | 1 medium tart apple ( chopped ) | 1 egg white ( slightly beaten )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and line a baking pan with parchment paper.  In a large pot, add 1/2 of water and bring to boil for the pasta. Stir and roast on high heat for about 10 minutes.  Take the chicken off heat and remove and set aside for now.  Bring the remaining water in the pot with the chicken to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for about 12 minutes.  When done, add in chicken back to pot and remove from heat. In a mixing bowl mix together the cooled pasta and chicken mixture, then spoon into the prepared baking dish.  Chop 1/2 of the apple and add to the top of the pasta mixture.  Cover with sliced dill pickle slices.  Cover with the remaining sliced dill pickle slices and cut into chunks just a bit smaller than the dish.  Bake in middle of oven for 40 minutes, or until chicken is done and sauce is slightly thickened.  Cool for 10 minutes, then serve.

instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Combine asafetida powder, curry paste, mixed herbs, fennel, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.

instructions: In a large dutch oven, bring broth and rice wine to a boil.  Stir in hot pasta.  Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes.  Transfer drained pasta to a bowl, and toss with sauce.

title: Apricot, Green Chili, and Swiss Enchilada Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package frozen small puff pastry sheets | 2 cups hot green chili sauce, from your chile de arbol deli | 1 cup mushroom, sliced, from the jar | 1 can apricots, halved | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets, blanched, peeled and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup puff pastry
instructions: Heat the 1/2 cup salted water to a boil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  When it comes to a simmer, add the puff pastry sheets, and continue to cook until they are crisp, but not browned, about 3 minutes.  Turn them over.

title: Cantonese Beef Pot Roast

title: Fattening and Maraschino Gazpacho

instructions: Cut a small hole in the sides of the lebanese cucumber using a sharp knife.  Place the grated cucumber in a sieve and sprinkle with salt, allow to drain for 15 minutes.  Squeeze out excess water, place in a bowl.  Sprinkle with a little olive oil.  Add grated tomato juice and maraschino cherries, mix.  Garnish with chopped olives.  Serve.

title: Granny's Chicken

instructions: Lightly grease a large skillet, and set over low heat.  Stir the zucchini and seasonings together in the skillet, and coat with seasoning salt.  Cook for 10 minutes, stirring every so often, until zucchini turns a light brown.

title: Yummy, Simple, Easy & Delicious  Sausage Rolls

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180c.  Spray the bamboo skewers with oil spray and line the base of a shallow baking dish with the lasagna sheets. Remove the rolls from the oven and place onto a plate.  Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Crab Casserole

instructions: Mix together brown and white sauce.  Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring to coat beans with sauce.  Spoon over hot cooked beans.

instructions: Heat grill.  Place pumpkin on grill or broiler pan 1 - 3 inches from heat, turning once.  Cook until tender yet firm.  Spread with feta cheese and grill.

instructions: Combine all ingredients, including mint, to make the dressing.  Toss with all your chips and serve immediately.

title: John's Cheese Dip

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9x9 inch glass dish.  Microwave, uncovered, on high power about 1 minute.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the half and half cream and green bell pepper.  Mix in the strawberries.  Heat an ungreased griddle or baking dish over moderate heat.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the jam on the griddle and sprinkle half of the nachos with the remaining jam.  Place the nachos on a large platter and spoon the warm nachos with jam over them.

title: Roasted Mushrooms and Chicken With Cremini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried savory | 8 large cremini mushrooms | 2 chicken pieces | 1 roasting chickens ( about 5 to 7 pounds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix the savory with a little water to make a thick paste.  Wash the mushrooms well, remove the stems and any woody parts from the caps.  Wash the chicken well under cold water.  Place the chicken in the cavity of the bird's cavity.  Sprinkle the paste evenly outside the chicken.  Tie a slit on one side of the bird's cavity and the remaining side of the bird's cavity with kitchen string.  Rub the spice blend over the entire chicken.  Place the breasts side by side on a large piece of aluminum foil.  Sprinkle the pieces with water and place the foil on the breast side of the bird.  Bake the bird uncovered for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Turn the oven down to 350 degrees f and continue cooking the whole time for 1 1/2 hours.  Turn the chickens over, spooning pan juices into a gravy boat.  Bake for another 15 to 20 minutes, then remove the foil.  When the chicken is finished, remove the chicken from the pan juices to a serving platter and cover to keep warm.  Cover the juices with the gravy.  To serve, slice the chicken thinly, serve with the gravy and veggies on top.

title: Choc-Melt Chocolate Fondue With Caramelized Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 1 french baguette, about 2-3 inches-thick | 6 ounces milk chocolate, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup madeira wine or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 cup red wine or 1 cup white wine | 1 teaspoon scotch bonnet peppers or 1 teaspoon habanero pepper, minced
instructions: Cut 1 baguette into 10 or 12 long, 1/2 inch thick slices or into 12 1/2 inch wide sticks.  Cut sticks of bread crosswise into 1/4 inch thick wedges.  Cut chocolate in pieces roughly 1/4 inch thick.  In a medium bowl, toss chocolate with 1/4 cup madeira or orange juice, red wine, scotch bonnet pepper or minced chile pepper.  Set aside at room temperature 30 minutes or until bubbly.  Dip meat of choice in chocolate, 1 to 2 minutes per side.  Transfer to a heavy 4 or 5 quart pot or slow cooker.  Cook on high 5 to 6 hours or until chocolate is melted and fondue has begun to stick to meat.  Transfer fondue to a heated sauceboat, allowing it to set.  Turn fondue off.  Using tongs, spoon dipping spatula, gently push chocolate onto meat to coat.  Serve with warm dipping sauces.

title: Thousand Island Curried Lamb Toast

Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 2 or 3 quart, cast iron skillet over medium high heat.  Place lamb in hot oil, turning only once.  Pour into hot pan, cover, and cook 10 minutes or until well browned on outside and tender.  To serve, cut up and top with spicy onion gravy.

instructions: For the peaches, remove the seeds and cut the fruit into cubes.  Place in bowl, add enough water to cover and marinate for about 2 hours. instructions: Heat the dripping in a wok and fry the bacon with the ginger and vegetables.  Pour in the apricots for the last minute if you like or serve as per instructions.

title: Spam Lovers Spam Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 8 cans spam | 3 containers plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons minced fresh oregano | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Cut french bread in half lengthwise and hollow out the center of each half.  Rinse out inside of loaf, leaving 1 inch shell.  Place bread hollowed out inside of shells in a large bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 8 hours.  Drain the cans of spam and reserving juice.  Place the spam into a large, resealable plastic bag.  Cover with plastic wrap, and shake until coated with flavorings.  Squeeze bag out of the juice, seal, and refrigerate at least 6 hours. title: Perfect Polenta
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cornmeal or 4 tablespoons plain polenta | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( can also use parmesan asiago, asiago, pepperjack or similar )
instructions: Using a 3 - 4 inch round cookie cutter, cut out circles, from a 3 pound cookie cutter.  Place 2 tablespoons or more in the center of each circle and press the sides.  Set aside.  Repeat with the remaining circles.  On a lightly floured board, roll each piece into a small patty shape, about the size of a large marble.  Use a spatula to transfer the polenta rings to a plate.  Sprinkle each round with the salt, if desired.  In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat.  Pour in half a cup of hot oil.  When it shimmers, carefully add half of the polenta circles, spacing evenly apart.  Cook, flipping once, until all sides are golden brown, about 5 – 7 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the polenta rings to a large platter.  Repeat with the remaining oil and polenta.  Sprinkle with the cheeses.  Serve immediately.  Variation, replace the cheese with fontina, grated parmesan, fontina, fontina etc.

title: Sundried Tomato Sauce

title: Ripe Beef Roast With Red Wine & Tomato Basil Dumplings

instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over the meat and poke holes in it with a fork or knife.  Sprinkle the beef with salt and pepper.  Place in a large, heavy pan or dutch oven, adding wine, broth, and gin.  Cover and heat to boiling over high heat. instructions: Season the steak with salt, italian herb seasoning and rosemary.  In a 12 inch nonstick skillet or a 14' 12 inch wok, heat the chicken stock over medium high heat until just boiling. title: Pizza Muffins
ingredients: 1 sheet phyllo dough | 2 teaspoons basil pesto | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 2 teaspoons basil pesto, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Line a 12 inch or larger non stick muffin tin with 1 sheet of phyllo.  Spoon 2 tablespoons of pesto onto the bottom edge of the sheet of phyllo, just touching.
