title: Indian Pea Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green peas | 2 tablespoons whole coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | saltine crackers ( optional ) | 2 slices whole wheat bread ( optional )

title: Spanish Tablecloth
ingredients: 1 lb white sugar | 1 cup sherry
instructions: Mix the sugar and sherry together and rub the mixture well into a clean cloth.  Wrap the cloth tightly in a net and place it in a saucepan or other deep sided saucepan to dry overnight.  In a clean cloth, place the cloth and place it over a large pan of boiling water.  Place it over high heat and boil for 5 minutes, or until it starts to thicken.  Remove the cloth and pour the hot syrup into one large container, which will have lids and rings next.  This is when, if a small piece of vanilla pops up, it's ready.  Allow the syrup to cool before using.  You may have to use your hand to remove some of the sugar before attempting this syrup.

title: Uzu Appel
ingredients: 100 g tofuji apples ( japanese type ) | 1 slice brown bread ( toasted )
instructions: Scoop out the insides of the tofuji apples, leaving some of the flesh intact.  Cut the apple into segments or into a bite size square, if necessary.  Heat up the oven's maximum setting, but leave some of the apples in the oven.  Arrange the piece of bread with the slices of tofu in a straight line on the surface.  Top with the apple segments or chunks of bread.  If using a loaf, toast it in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the crust is golden.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,limeade concentrate,cake flour,napa cabbage,bouquet garni,italian seasoning,lemon juice
title: Fillet of Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef, trimmed of fat | 8 ounces fresh squeezed limeade concentrate | 8 ounces napa cabbage, julienned in strips | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon hot bouquet garni | 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Marination.  Combine all ingredients in shallow dish.  Add meat.  Toss until coated.  Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours or longer.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cook meat about 30 minutes per inch of thickness, turning once.  Serve with salad.

title: Italian Inn Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs of sliced steak, about | 1 can of sliced gravy from the jar of gravy from the can of gravy from the jar
instructions: Brown and season the steak with the gravy from the can.  If you need more gravy then you can add 1/4 cup of water.  The gravy should be enough to cook the steak.  Place the browned steak in a casserole dish.  Top with your choice of vegetables and pour gravy over them until covered.  You can top your servings of steak with parmesan cheese or mozzarella cheese, or whatever you think is handy.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,rosemary leaf,asparagus,rye bread,pork shoulder,broccoli floret,sherry wine vinegar
title: Beef, Broccoli, and Asparagus in Brie
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef, cut into serving portions | 1 bunch broccoli floret ( small broccoli floret is best ) | 1 lb asparagus ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 lb thin rib roast pork shoulder ( cut into chunks ) or 1/2 lb trimmed tenderloin ( cut into chunks ) | 1/2 cup brie cheese or 1/2 cup rory cracker, divided | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Remove the stems from the broccoli or asparagus and cut into bite size pieces or cubes.  Slice or shred the asparagus, set aside.  Trim the ends off the broccoli and break in half.

title: Rigatoni With Meat
ingredients: 1 -2 cup meat stock | 1 3/8 cups rigatoni pasta or 1 3/8 cups other small shaped pasta | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Boil the meat stock with the bicarb of soda until reduced to half or you're left with a 1 tablespoon.  Add the rigatoni and heat to mix, so as not to break up the pasta.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,date,iceberg lettuce,self raising flour,saffron,orange juice zest,monterey jack cheese
title: Cuban Stuffed Dosas
ingredients: 5 lbs coarse-ground beef chuck | 2 small oranges, juice and zest of | 3/4 cup sugar | 2 1/4 cups self raising flour, plus | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 3 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 8 medium pitted dates, coarsely chopped | 6 tablespoons saffron, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Meat.  Use a fork to poke holes evenly into the surface of the meat without breaking as much.  Insert the zest into one end of the meat, and soak in the orange juice until the zest is clear.  Drain off the juice.  Place the beef fat side down in a roasting tin, or two 9x9 round cake tins and fit into the holes with the coarsely cracked flour, leaving over 2 inches of space in each tin.  Sprinkle the beef with half the cheese, then half of the dates.  Stuff the dosa with the meat and sprinkle with salt and remaining cheese.  Dosas.  Place half the chopped dates in the middle of the meat with the short end facing the base of the tin overlapping neatly over the dates.  Top with the remaining chopped date and dates, then top the tray with a sheet of aluminium foil.  Bake until meat is beginning to shrink away from the sides of the tin.  Serve.  Repeat to make 3 more batches, placing one tray on top of the other when the tray is ready.  When all of the dosa have been assembled and frozen, reheat the tray for 45 minutes in the oven, then serve hot with salsa, cream, etc.

title: Spicy Garlic Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh minced spring onions | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a bowl mix onions with salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Let sit for a few hours.  Put mixture into a food processor.  Process until fine.

title: Baked Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh yeast | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 2 1/2 cups warm, divided | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella, grated, divided | 36 pepperoncini peppers, halved, seeded and chopped | 1 fresh mango, sliced | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder, for rub | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat your oven to 500 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine the yeast with the 1/4 cup of warm.  In another large bowl, mix the 3 cups of warm, 1 1/2 cups of the mozzarella, the pepperoncini peppers, mango, chili powder, and salt.  Stir the dough with a fork until smooth and elastic.  Transfer it to a well oiled bowl, and cover with a towel.  Set the bowl in a warm place until the dough has doubled in volume.  Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and roll into a 10 inch round.  Brush the top of the dough with a little water, and roll the dough into a 12 inch circle.  Transfer the dough to a pizza pan lined with parchment paper.  Cover dough with a towel, and let rise for 45 minutes.  Bake the dough for 10 minutes in the preheated oven.  Remove the pizza from the oven, and spread the remaining mozzarella cheese evenly over the top.  Return to the oven with the crust underneath, and bake for 5 minutes so the cheese is golden.  Let rest a few minutes before slicing into 24 slices.  Serve warm.

title: Cheese Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 3/4 cup cottage cheese | 3/4 cup tequila | 1/2 cup provolone cheese, grated
instructions: Line 2 large muffin tins with paper liners.  In a bowl, combine the flour, cottage cheese, tequila and provolone cheese.  Fold in the soured milk to make a smooth batter.  Fill 1/3 of the muffin's with the mixture.  Sprinkle extra flour if required.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes on the middle shelf or until golden brown.  Allow to rest in the tins for 5 minutes before turning onto a wire rack.  Allow to cool completely and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,corn syrup,honey mustard,madeira wine,yellow cake mix,spanish onion,broccoli floret,kahlua
title: Sensational French Onion Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | olive oil, as needed | kahlua, your choice | 8 cups of diced fresh broccoli flakes | 1 cup thinly sliced spanish onion | 1 bottle madeira wine | 1/4 cup honey mustard | 1 1/2 cups honey mustard | 1/4 cup corn syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degree f.  Grease and flour a 10 bundt pan.  Mix together the cake mix and cake mix, and toss to make sure there are no clumps.  Pour into the prepared pan.  Make sure it's level with the bottom of the pan so that a little droplet of liquid runs down the sides.  Bake in the oven for 25 minutes.  Make sure the bottom of the pan doesn't get too brown, and take the cake out and let it cool.  After it cools, make the glaze.  Mix together the honey mustard and corn syrup.  Add the sliced onions.  Place in refrigerator to meld flavors.  After that, remove the cake from the oven.  Spread the honey mustard mixture over the sliced onion.  Pour the madeira over the onion.  Top with the buns.  Drizzle on olive oil as desired.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobster meat | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice lobster meat into 1 to 1 - 2 inch chunks, then into halves or pieces.  Place in a large saucepain, or other well seasoned pan.  Add the wine to coat the meat.  Bring to a simmer and cover, reducing heat.  Cook at least 2 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Chinese Spring Rolls
ingredients: 100 g spring roll wrappers | 1 tablespoon light sesame oil | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: First cut the spring roll wrappers into 8 even pieces, and then put them all into a pan of boiling water.  Once they rise, drain well and then put the mixture back in the pan.  In a small frying pan, heat the sesame oil and when warm add the white pepper to taste.  Take the mixture off the heat, and allow to cool slightly.  Roll the mixture in the spring roll wrappers, then place them on lightly oiled paper and chill for at least 15 minutes.  Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: black bean,kielbasa,wheat tortilla,oyster sauce,brandy,mustard seed,hershey milk chocolate kiss
title: Elegant Black Bean Kielbasa Wrap
ingredients: 16 ounces kielbasa, sliced | 12 ounces canned black beans, drained | 1/2 cup sour cream ( light or regular ) | 1/8 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon hershey's milk chocolate kisses
instructions: Cook sliced sausage over medium high in non stick pan until heated through.  While kielbasa is cooking mix bean paste ingredients together in saucepan.  Once hot add to sauteed sausage.  Continue to cook until sausage is warm throughout.  Spoon mixture onto warm tortilla.  Sprinkle with chocolate kiss slices.  Can serve hot.  Makes 8 small servings.

title: Sweet and Sour Trout
ingredients: 4 large potatoes | 8 ounces cooked trout | 4 ounces sour cream, to taste | 3 ounces catsup
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes into 1/2 inch slices and heat in salted water until tender.  Mash the potatoes, add to a large bowl with the trout, sour cream and catsup.  Stir to mix well.  Eat and enjoy.

title: Lamb and Yellow Squash Stew
ingredients: 3 large yellow squash, halved lengthwise, cut into 1 inch chunks ( about 1 1/3 lbs total ) | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon grated gingerroot or 1/2-1 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated gingerroot | pepper, to taste | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs lamb stew meat
instructions: In a large saucepan, cover squash with water.

title: Farfalle with Chambord and Bamboo Bitter
ingredients: 10 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 jar chambord raspberry liquor | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1 bamboo skewer
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: German Mustard Hamburger - Homemade Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 3 teaspoons mustard seeds | 5 teaspoons dill weed
instructions: In a heavy fry pan, cook mustard seeds until they pop up.  Add the meat and brown on all sides.  Add dill weed.  Cover and place in refrigerator for at least 1 hour or a little longer.  Serve on buns with your favourite bread.

instructions: Combine cooking tapioca, capers and hot pepper sauce.

title: Cocoa and Coriander Tortilla With Bowties
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cocoa powder, heaping | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked and drained | 12 -16 flour tortillas, sliced into rounds
instructions: Grind the cocoa with the coriander seeds in a pestle and mortar till really powdery.  Add the pasta and mix well.  Set aside to let it sit for 20 minutes.  Heat another 10 seconds and spread the tortilla rounds on a floured surface, to form a flat surface, about 5/8cm thick, about 3 3mm in diameter.  Heat a non stick pan using medium heat and spray with oil cooking spray and sprinkle with a little cocoa and coriander mix.  Fry the rounds for 2 - 3 min or until golden brown, transfer to paper towel and rub off the excess fat.  Repeat until all the rounds are fried, stacking them on paper towels.  Serve with the accompaniments, such as fresh chunky salsa or a little sour dough, to dip in the nibbles.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,mustard powder,kosher salt,grape tomato,snow pea,granny smith apple,calamansi juice
title: Italian Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh snow pea | 1/2 lb grape tomatoes, halved | 1 medium granny smith apple, cored and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup mandarin oranges, drained | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup calamansi juice or 1/2 cup pepsi | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Wash and snap pea into pieces place in large bowl then add tomato wedges.  Arrange apples over tomato.  Sprinkle with mustard and olives.  Pour enough calamansi juice or Pepsi over top to cover.  Toss salad to coat.  Adjust salt to taste.

title: Easy Baked Beef Kebobs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup pecans | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Cut a piece of wax paper 1/2 inch thick and thread it onto a long metal skewer.  Using your hands, make several long cuts down the center of the skewer and insert cubes of meat.  Brush the cubes with lemon zest and then sprinkle with pecans.  Place in a baking dish and set aside to marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour.  Brush kebob with butter at once.  Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice,coriander leaf,red curry paste,poppy seed,coconut milk,coffee granule,garlic paste
title: Thai Green Capsicum (Coconut) Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried rice, rinsed | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons desiccated coconut ( desiccated is best ) | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 2 teaspoons hot curry paste | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Place rice in a sieve, pour water over and then allow to drain.  Add coffee and leave to drain.  Toss together the poppy seeds, coconut, red curry paste, garlic paste, and hot curry paste in a bowl.  Add the toasted coconut and lightly toss together.  Add coriander and stir.  To serve you first want to lightly fry the capsicum in 1 inch oil, then remove from the oil and place on a plate.  Spoon capsicum onto plate, then stir through the rest of the ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,vegetable,rice vinegar,hot italian sausage,snow pea,ham,herb,pork
title: Stir Fry Beef, Sausage and Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs stewing beef | 1 1/4 lbs hot italian sausage | 4 1/4 lbs stewing pork | chopped mixed herbs such as parsley, oregano, dill weed, basil | 1 lb snow peas | 1/2 lb fresh vegetables | to taste rice vinegar or to taste vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Trim away any fat from beef and sausage and cut meat into 1/2 inch chunks.  Cut the ends off the snow peas and the peas, peel as above, and cut the strings into chunks.  Bring a kettle with 2 inches of water to boiling, add peas, cook until just beginning to thaw, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain in a colander and set aside.  Wash and drain the vegetables and put the meat in a large, deep skillet.  Add enough cold water to cover meat and add it to the skillet.  Add herbs, mix well, cover and place in refrigerator.  The day before the stir fry, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and add meat and peas and cook until tender.  Add vegetables and seasoning mixture, stir well and taste for seasonings.  Serve with toasted pita chips, or on the side.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,almond milk,puff pastry,pumpkin pie spice,rice noodle
title: Sensational Pumpkin-Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | 6 -8 ounces rice noodles | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 cup slivered almonds, toasted | fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Combine pumpkin pie spice with 1 cup of the warm water.  Let sit out for 5 minutes or until powder is absorbed.  Place remaining warm water in a measuring cup along with nuts.  Set aside.  Remove excess flour from pastry and roll out pastry to fit a 25x28 jelly roll pan.  Cut out a circle from one sheet of pastry.  Fit onto pan.  Top with remaining pastry sheet, overlapping and sealing dough edges.  Bake in preheated oven for about 20 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.  Remove from oven and place on a cooling rack.  Slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Serve with cilantro and drizzle with warmed pumpkin pie spice sauce.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,tomato puree,cornstarch,cayenne pepper,poblano chile,cilantro
title: Poblano & Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, halved with the seeds removed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons pure tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler/grill or a grill.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper.  Place poblano and chilli on the prepared baking sheet.  In a blender or food processor whirl the cornstarch with pure tomato puree, chinese five spice and cayenne until a smooth paste forms, then spread into a shallow dish.  Stir the puree into the cornstarch mixture.  Spread chilli mixture evenly over top.  Place 1 tablespoon of the sauce on top.  Lightly flour the surface of the chilies.  Return to the broiler, grill 2 minutes and then allow to cool 5 minutes.

title: Beer Cream Dip (For One - You!)
ingredients: 3 cups light beer or 3 cups light beer | 1 cup miracle whip | 3/4 cup nonfat sour cream or 3/4 cup plain yogurt ( any flavor would work )
instructions: Heat beer or light beer.  Add miracle whip to sour cream or yogurt.  Add paprika to your liking.  Serve with other dishes, such as crackers.

title: Pepperoncini Spread
ingredients: 24 pepperoncini peppers | 1 package mascarpone
instructions: Fill a large bowl with ice cubes and add the pepperoncini.  Cover with the top of a double thickness of plastic wrap, then gently slip the plastic wrap off the pepperoncini.  Seal the edges with a fork, then lay the bowl of ice across the ice into the freezer.  Using a sharp knife, trim off as much plastic as possible, then scrape out the softened ice in the bowl with the pepperoncini, and return the drained pepperoncini to the bowl with the mascarpone to combine.  Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,almond extract,yellow pepper,red curry paste,marjoram,caster sugar
title: Chili Pepper Spread With Pearl Sugar
ingredients: 1 jar red curry paste | 1 can ground yellow peppers | 4 tablespoons almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cut the caps off the curry paste with a sharp knife and place in a mortar or food processor with 3/4 1/2 cup warm water to make a paste.  Stir until it starts to cling and then add all the remaining ingredients and pulse again to make a thick paste.  You can mix some of the sauce with the paste at this stage but make sure that you do not over process it.  The pepper Spread should be creamy and spreadable.  The curry paste is best eaten slightly warm or at room temperature.  Store tightly covered in a cool, dark place for up to three months, although the sugar content has a delicate effect on flavour and fragrance.  You can also refrigerate up to 3 months.  Serve with roasted chicken, lamb or just eat it plain the chilli oil is excellent as a dip for vegetables.

title: Coconut Chili Paste With Coconut Milk and Chilies
ingredients: 1 can low-fat coconut milk | 3 teaspoons serrano chilies, minced | 2 teaspoons chili paste or 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store for up to 1 week in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,sun tomato oil,garlic powder,chicken breast half,red wine,tarragon,canadian bacon,celery
title: Chicken With Canadian Bacon-Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons minced celery | 2 tablespoons minced red wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves or 3 -4 pieces tenderloin
instructions: In a bowl combine tomatoes, wine, whipping cream and seasonings and marinate chicken for about 30 minutes.  Drain tomato mixture.  In a skillet saute chicken over medium heat, turning once, until cooked through.  Place on serving platter, pour on sauce, and sprinkle with bacon.

Random Ingredients: chicken,beef chuck roast,dark chocolate,almond,red onion,red curry paste,sunflower oil,oil
title: Coconut Red-Raisin Beef
ingredients: 1 cup sliced almonds | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 400 g beef chuck roast, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dark brown molasses | 120 g dark chocolate, chopped into chunks | 1 1/2 cups of cubed cooked chicken, and or asian vegetables of your choice
instructions: Heat the oil in a large casserole dish/pot over medium heat.  Cook the almond in oil until toasted, stirring as needed.  Remove almonds from dish using a slotted spoon or a slotted spoon and set aside.  Add the onion to the pot and cook for 3 minutes, add the red curry paste and cook for a further 2 minutes, stirring, cooking until fragrant.  Add the curry paste mixture and beef to the pot and cook, stirring to coat the beef.  Spread half the coconut meat evenly over the base of the dish/pot.  Layer the curry beef over the coconut meat.  Spread remaining coconut on top of beef and spread evenly.  Sprinkle with chocolate chunks and drizzle with dark brown molasses.  Place the chicken/vegetable on top and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Pour over any reserved coconut and cover with a lid or with aluminium foil.  Cook in a preheated moderately slow oven for 5 hours, until meat is tender and sauce thickened.  Serve with steamed steamed red cabbage and a green salad.

title: Agua De Molcajete (Chile Jelly)
ingredients: 20 serrano chili, stemmed and halved lengthwise | 1 cup granulated unflavored gelatin
instructions: Cut a slit diagonally down the base of each serrano chili.  Insert a slice of cheese, 1 piece of anchovy or a small pinch of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of sugar into each slit.

title: Sweet Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 lb baby corn, cut from cob | 1 can baby sweet corn, drained | kale ( optional ) | 3 garlic cloves, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dry red wine, fruity ( or more to taste ) | 4 -5 teaspoons dried oregano | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Cut kernels off cobs of corn and place in a large bowl of cold water.  Place corn in another bowl and set aside.  When they are cool, drain and cut kernels from cobs.  Then cut kernels from cobs either in the can or microwave to make corn salad.  Mix corn in bowl with corn, garlic, wine and oregano.  If desired, squeeze and pit lime wedges into bowl, then enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Green Salsa Pizza
ingredients: 2 large prepared pizza crust ( or your favorite style pizza crust ) | 1 1/2 cups bottled green salsa ( i recommend the hotter variety )
instructions: Preheat oven 400 degrees f.  Spread salsa on crust.  Spread salsa over salsa.  Sprinkle top with the shredded cheese.  Place on cookie sheet and bake about 7 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly/firm and crust is golden brown.

title: Beer and Spice
ingredients: 1 bottle dry mexican beer ( corona lite or dos equis ) | 1 tablespoon oregano or 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, chopped
instructions: Mix 2 cups beer and the remaining beer in a mug.  Sprinkle with the oregano.  The beer makes a beautiful cup with darker colored beer.

title: Cafe Pasqualin Di Zucca (Bowgette Pasta With Kale)
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 2 bunches kale ( preferably lacinato or lacinato ) | 3/4 cup zinfandel or 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 pinch dried coriander | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.  While the pasta is boiling, put the kale in a sieve and rinse under a warm running water until the water runs clear.  Slice in half and remove the leaves and ribs with tweezers.  Rinse and drain the pasta, and pour it into a bowl with the kale and toss to combine.  Add the vinegar, coriander, and zest and toss to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Zucchini Tartlet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 1/2 cups long grain zucchini ( shredded ) | 1 small orange ( quartered ) | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium black soy sauce | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 sheet frozen ready made pastry sheet
instructions: Preheat oven to 170c.  Mix cornflour with zucchini in a zip type plastic bag and add the diced orange.  Shake to coat.  Lay out your pastry sheet on a flat surface and place a tartlet on top of it, smoothing the top if you need to.  Pound the pastry out to fit an oblong dish, approximately 18cm in diamet.  In the centre of your pastry sheet, use a sharp knife to cut a 'x' on the outside of the pastry sheet to give it a flat rim.  Sprinkle the zucchini with a little water and lay the zucchini on the pastry sheet and fold the rim in to give a fluted edge.  Bake for 10 mins, carefully remove from the oven and leave to cool slightly.  Prick the pastry with a fork and place on top of your chosen base and fill with your favourite sauce.  Top with orange slices and a drizzle of reduced sodium soy sauce.  Sprinkle with remaining soy sauce and bake in oven for another 15 mins or so until crust is golden brown and sauce is bubbling.  Serve as per your preferences.

title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 kg beef sirloin steak, cut into 8 pieces | 2 kg string beans or 2 kg green beans, cut into 8 pieces | 60 g fresh yeast | 1 package of smoked ham hock ( optional, use other smoked sausage )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water.  Add sugar and salt if using.  Add the meat and place the pieces of smoked ham hock inside.  Leave aside to rise for 24 hours or until doubled.  Place the meat, vegetables and cheese inside a large, heavy kettle.  Add some water.  Cook over medium heat 3 - 4 hours or until meat is tender and cooked through.  The meat freezes well in a freezer bag.

title: White Russian
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon grand marnier, a good flavor of french-style orange
instructions: Pour whipping cream into your freezer until it is cold all the way up the side of the pan.  Pour the grand marnier, a good orange flavor, and the heavy cream into a small jar with a lidded lid or a funnel with a tight fitting lid.  Cover tightly and shake a couple times so the alcohol cooks off the alcohol.  Let the mixture sit at room temperature until the flavors have blended.  Enjoy.

title: Raspberry Chutney for Vegans
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries ( washed, hulled and chopped, or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.

title: Quick Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 2 packages baby spinach | 1 can beer | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 cup chopped pickle
instructions: Combine beer and mustard dressing mix in large skillet on medium.  Stir to blend.  Add spinach and stir.  Cover and place on medium low heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until just wilted and slightly wilted.  Stir in cardamom and remove from heat.  Top with pickle and let stand for 2 - 3 minutes before serving.

title: Cauliflower With Prunes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large small cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup pitted prunes, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon grass, minced | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaf, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Steam cauliflower until tender crisp.  Meanwhile, cook prunes in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat, without stirring, until they are beginning to brown, stirring, about 2 minutes.  Stir into cauliflower. title: Salmon Appetizer on Appetizers

instructions: Make a long thin knife into the ground mix and gently mix in a small amount of water to make a soft dough. instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well combined.  Let stand 10 minutes at room temperature.  Serve with tacos and warmed crème fraîche or other condiments.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,hamburger,leek,italian flat leaf parsley,chorizo sausage,cherry tomato
title: Italian Style Stewed Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 lb chorizo sausage, cut into 1 inch lengths | 1 cup leek, chopped ( white part only ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 medium sprig italian flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook the hamburger over medium high heat until evenly browned, breaking up into crumbles when it turns browned.  Mix in the chorizo, leeks and cardamom.  Stir in the cherry tomatoes.  Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook until the flavors of the stew have blended, at least 7 minutes and up to 1 hour.  Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.  Serve over freshly baked biscuits or as a side dish with boiled potatoes.

title: Cannellini Bean Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 boxes white cake mix | 1 can cannellini beans, well drained | 1 teaspoon dry instant coffee ( optional )
instructions: Prepare cake as package directs, spray a 4 cup souffle dish with cooking spray, pour bean and dry instant coffee over cake, sprinkle dry frosting over top.  Cover and cook on low for 1 1/2 2hrs.  Remove dish from the oven and allow to stand 2 3hrs to cool.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,jumbo shrimp,romaine lettuce,asparagus,english cucumber,vanilla ice cream
title: Mixed Greens with Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 2 bunches romaine lettuce, washed and very finely chopped | 10 -12 slices asparagus | 1 english cucumber, grated | 5 -10 prawns, cooked ( i prefer red-fleshed shrimp ) | 5 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 pint vanilla ice cream or 1 pint vanilla yogurt
instructions: Cook the shrimp in large pan with a little vinegar until just cooked through.  Drain.  To make the dressing, mix the cooked asparagus with the grated cucumber, and the mango.  Pour over cooked prawns in lettuce, and chill for 30 minutes.  Whip ice cream or yogurt to desired size.  Drizzle over salad.  I like to serve it chilled with a scoop of the vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon powder,rump steak,red chili pepper,cooking oil,pancake mix
title: Chile-Pork Crusted Pork-Saute
ingredients: 2 lbs rump steak | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking oil | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 package pancake mix | 1 small red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Cut the pork steaks into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Coat with cooking oil.  Add bouillon and chilli pepper to the pork, cooking over very high coals, turning once, until the peppers are softened, approximately 10 minutes.  Transfer to a baking dish.  Cook uncovered at 325 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes until well browned and the meat is well glazed.  Turn the pork pieces over.  Drizzle more cooking oil over the pieces with a little cooking oil and continue to cook over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes more until slightly crispy on the outside, but not too dark.  Transfer to the baking dish.  Serve with your favorite sauce.

title: Lamb and Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground lamb | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 yellow squash, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cook ground lamb in a skillet over medium heat until completely browned, 7 to 10 minutes.  Stir in the garlic, yellow squash, and raisins, then mix in flour until evenly coated.  Transfer lamb mixture to a large baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini-Squash Braid
ingredients: 2 1/4 pounds small zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 pound carrots, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 1/2 pound large yellow squash, halved lengthwise | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place zucchini, carrots, squash, flour, butter, and garlic salt in a large bowl and toss to combine.  Place braid on baking sheets, and bake about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown and crusty.

title: Veggie French Bread
ingredients: 100 g cream cheese | 3 tablespoons roasted pistachios, chopped | 3 tablespoons sliced prosciutto ( optional ) | 2 small zucchini | 1 bag cauliflower | 4 slices white bread | sauce | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Slice bread and toast bread and serve hot on a platter.  Top with hot mixture if desired.  Serve as desired.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,sharp cheddar cheese,french onion,oyster sauce,bamboo skewer,yogurt,mexicorn,lettuce leaf
title: Garlicky Oyster Dip
ingredients: 4 pieces lobster-flavored skewers, with shell and cartilage | 1 small cucumber, chopped | 3 tablespoons french-fried onions, crumbled | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1/2 cup old sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 4 large lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon prepared tapioca starch ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1/2 cup cold water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees.  Thread skewers on small metal skewers and transfer to a lightly oiled cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and set aside to cool.  For dip, in food processor fitted with metal blade, combine onion, sour cream and cheese.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,red wine,bread dough,tofu,poblano pepper,chicken leg,coriander powder,barbecue sauce
title: Bruneza
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken legs | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 2 bunches coriander powder | 1 large poblano pepper, roasted ( see note below ) | 1 -2 loaf bread dough | 4 -5 tablespoons red wine | 1 jar grilled tofu ( not silken tofu but light cream product )
instructions: Note, if using roasted poblanos, soak them in 1/2 cup water for 20 minutes, then peel, remove seed, and cut into very thin strips.  If using regular poblanos, use half of the poblanos and cut into strips.  Toss the chicken in poultry seasoning then layer in a crockpot bowl with bread dough, poblano pepper, coriander, and bacon.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken.  Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or low for 3 to 3 1/2 hours or until tender.  Stove top, if you have a bread machine, use your dough dough cycle.  Note, after making this, if using silken tofu, soak the soft in hot red wine before proceeding with recipe.  This will thicken your sauce.

title: Blueberry Tuna Stuffed Calzones
ingredients:
1/2 cup blueberries ( or other fresh berries ) | 0.
    -5 can tuna in water ( packed in olive oil ) | 0.
    -75 can chicken broth | 2 packages crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f or 180 degrees celsius.  Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray or brush with butter or oil.  Combine tuna and blueberries in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cube steak,red chili powder,seasoning salt,cooking oil,pecorino romano cheese,topping,mint sprig
title: Beef Cubes With Cheese & Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs cube steaks | salt | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 cups sliced fresh topping | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cut meat into 1 inch cubes and sprinkle with salt.  Heat oil in a large heavy skillet over medium high heat until shimmering.  Add cube cubes and saute until they are cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes per side.  Transfer cube meat to plate.  Return skillet to medium high heat and add 1/3 cup of hot onion mixture.  Stir to combine.  Add chili powder and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes or until fragrant.  Add 1/3 cup of hot onion mixture to skillet.  Cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes.  Add 1/3 cup of hot onion mixture to skillet to coat.  Cook just until onions are crisp and starting to brown color, not brown, 3 - 4 minutes.  Transfer onion mixture to plate, reserving any liquid remaining in skillet.  Return skillet to medium heat and cook over medium high heat until liquid begins to separate from onion mixture, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Add mint and remaining 1/3 cup hot onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,double cream,red bell pepper,potato traditional,thai rice noodle,onion flake
title: Thai Sweet Potato & Vegetable Noodle Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 cup dry red sweet bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped sweet potato ( red-fleshed sweet potato, peeled and sliced into 1 1/2 inch pieces ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion flakes | 1/4 cup water chestnut ( drained and sliced ) | 3 tablespoons thai-style rice noodles ( such as muir glen, in all ) | 2 2 tablespoons reduced-fat double cream or 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Prepare simply potato traditional mashed potatoes according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  Heat a medium size skillet over medium heat.  Add sweet potato, sweet potato, onion flakes, and water chestnuts to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes.  Add cooked sweet potato mixture to the skillet, sprinkle with thai style and fold in gently.  Remove skillet from heat and cover to keep warm.  To serve, place noodles in a large bowl and pour the sweet potato mixture over them.  Serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Cod
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked cod | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 jar chili sauce | 1 cup ground lamb
instructions: Mix all the ingredients.  Cover the cod and refrigerate 1 - 24 hours.  Preheat a charcoal grill on medium heat.  Bake the fish for 10 - 12 minutes.  Flip the fish over, cover with foil, and continue cooking 10 minutes more.

title: The Best Moroccan Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 pounds onions, thinly sliced | 2/3 cup salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1/3 cup clear honey | 1/2 cup kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange onions in a single layer in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a medium bowl, mix salsa and turmeric.  Pour over onions.  Bake in the preheated oven 25 to 30 minutes, until onions are caramelized and onions are browned.

title: Cod Fish - Indonesian Style
ingredients: 2 large skinless cod fillets | 1 eggplant | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Slice eggplant into long strips.  Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  In a medium bowl, use the back of a sharp knife to cut open the cod.  Take each piece out of the boiling water and place them in the eggplant, then put in the water again.  Let this cook for five minutes, turn the fish over and let both sides cook until the cod is cooked.  The longer it cooks, the better the flavor will be.  You can also use a slotted spoon.  Place eggplant into a colander, squeeze out any excess water and remove the eggplant.  Place into the same pan to drain the oil.  Place eggplant into a large frying pan, pour in enough oil to cover the bottom of the frying pan.  When the oil is hot, carefully place the cod fillet, skin side down, into the frying pan.  The skin should begin to turn white.  Then flip over the fish, skin side up.  It is not likely to have a good browned coating of skin.  When the cod is done, it will cook quickly.  Place the fish on absorbent paper towels and cover.  Let sit for 5 minutes, then spread the coating on the fish using a fork.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,pecorino romano cheese,monterey jack cheese,tomato puree,broth,eggplant
title: Eggplant Lasagna With Tomato Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 3 eggplants, peeled ( about 2 lbs ) | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup canned low sodium broth | 1/4 cup grated parmesan romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 3 ounces grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.  Place 2 baking sheets, 12x9x2 inches, on foil lined baking sheet.  Cut ends from eggplants and remove black top layer.  Slice lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick slices.  Arrange slices on sheets in a single layer or in a shallow baking dish.  In a small bowl, whisk together the tomato puree, roasted garlic and broth.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,tahini,dill pickle,lemon juice,cumin powder,mushroom,green cardamom
title: Mushroom Toss (Vegan Kebab)
ingredients: 2 lemons, juice of | 2 tablespoons tahini ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 lb mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup dill pickle, sliced into rounds | 1/4 cup green cardamoms
instructions: Mix together the lemon juice, tahini, and cumin powder.  Set aside.  Cut mushroom into bite sized pieces.  Place mushrooms in a small bowl.  Spread the olives on top of the mushrooms.  Place pickles on top of the olives on top of the pickle and mushrooms.  Pack this sauce in a ziploc bag and secure.  Place everything in a bowl or plastic bowl.  Microwave on high power for one minute to allow sauce to become thick and well blended and flavors to blend.  Serve to your kebab, and enjoy.

title: Avocado Rolls
ingredients: 1 fresh ripe avocado - peeled, pitted, and mashed | 2 large sheets rice paper | 2 teaspoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Combine avocado, rice paper, and maple syrup in a bowl.  Lay out 1 roll of the avocado mixture onto a clean work surface.

title: Thai Spiced Steak With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 new york strip steaks | 1 tablespoon ground curry paste | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 large yellow squash, sliced | 1 onion, sliced | 1 ounce unsalted cashews, blanched ( optional ) | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate, grated | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: In a small bowl, combine curry paste and cream of tartar.  Rub paste evenly over both sides of steaks.  Cover and refrigerate overnight for best results.  Preheat broiler.  Place the yellow squash and onion evenly on two broiler proof plates.  Place on the rack about 6 inches from the heat, broil 5 to 7 minutes and move to the side.  Brush steaks with hot curry paste and sprinkle with cashews, if using.  Broil about 3 minutes per side for medium rare, about 3 minutes per side for medium, or to desired doneness.  Brush chocolate lightly over steaks.

Random Ingredients: mustard,buttermilk,juice,beef stew meat,red kidney bean,dark soy sauce,cardamom seed
title: Sweet and Sour Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, boneless, cut into cubes | 4 cups buttermilk | 1 cup dry red kidney beans, pinto or white, pinto beans ( not drained ) | 2 teaspoons crushed cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well until the meat is completely coated and the sauce is slightly darkened, about 5 minutes.  Refrigerate overnight or up to 4 days.

title: Tamari Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari | 2 cups double cream
instructions: Whisk tamari into cream until well blended.

title: Currant  Mushroom  Mushroom  Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 cups fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup currants | 1 lb cauliflower | 3 tablespoons double cream | crushed ice
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c.  Line a shallow ovenproof dish with aluminium foil.  Divide mushrooms, currants and cauliflower among the fluted foil.  Scatter over the cream and finish with cracked crackers.  Bake for 50 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,seasoning,bread crumb,angel hair pasta,ghee,maraschino cherry juice,rum extract
title: Feta 'crumby' Feta Balls with Nuts
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup olive oil or 1/4 cup ghee, melted and divided | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1 dash lemon-flavored rum extract | 1 dash maggi seasoning | 1 jar maraschino cherries in juice
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and keep warm.  Preheat oven to heat 1/2 tbs.  Of the oil in a small pan over medium heat.  Add the crumbled feta and cook until golden.  In a large bowl stir the oil/cheese mixture with the remaining oil, bread crumbs, rum, and seasoning.  Stir in the cherry juice until completely combined.  Roll into 1 balls.  Arrange in an 8 x 8 baking dish.  Bake at 400 for 15 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.  Remove from oven and serve with lots of napkins and minted salad leaves if desired.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,dark chocolate,veal,jasmine rice,artichoke heart,pearl barley,cheese,rye bread
title: Baked  Artichoke-Raisin  Rice Balls With Beef and  Artichokes
ingredients: 500 g marinated ground veal | 200 g minced beef or 200 g sausage | 1 cup pearl barley | 200 g rice, cooked or 200 g rice of your choice | 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 4 pieces rye bread | 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( or crumbled ) | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 can artichoke heart, drained
instructions: Prepare rice to prepare ahead and allow to set.  Mix all ingredients, together in bowl and knead well.  Place half of mixture on palm of your hand then flatten slightly with hand.  Dip into remaining mixture.  Place rice in baking dish, top with meat, arrange artichokes on top of meat and sprinkle cheese on top.  Place other half of rice on top and bake at 180ºc for 30 - 30 minutes or until firm and golden.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,red wine,white wine vinegar,sirloin,tarragon,rigatoni pasta,pesto sauce,herb
title: Rigatoni With Beef or Venison and Herb Salad
ingredients: 2 3/4 lbs sirloin or 2 3/4 lbs stewing beef, cut into thin bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon garlic salt or 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon fresh minced tarragon | 1 tablespoon dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cup prepared basil, packed | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs rigatoni pasta, cooked, rotini or 1 1/2-2 lbs other creamy pasta | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons purchased pesto
instructions: Place beef and next 5 ingredients in a ziplock bag.  Add meat mixture, stirring to coat.  Marinade 1 hour or longer, turning bag occasionally.  Grill steak or broil to your liking.  Drain and turn meat in salad dressing and pesto to coat, then serve.

title: Toasted Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats ( about 4 oz uncooked oatmeal ) | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats ( about 4 oz uncooked oatmeal ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 cup canned diced tomato, drained
instructions: Combine quick and quick rolled oats, tomato sauce, and undrained tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: coconut flake,lemon pepper,rigatoni pasta,vanilla bean,coriander powder,plain yogurt,amaretto
title: Oven Riggies
ingredients: 250 g rigatoni pasta ( or 2 large ones, boiled until el dente ) | 1/2 lemon pepper | 150 g amaretto, chilled | 250 g sweetened plain yogurt | 1 liter coconut flakes | 1/2 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Cut the vanilla bean in half, scrape out seeds and white portion, scrape the vanilla seeds from the vanilla pod and keep the pod from scrapning.  Dice the vanilla bean into small pieces and put them in a bowl.  Put the yoghurt in the pan and mix it with the spices.  Put the mixture in the fridge for at least an hour so that it is nice and creamy.  The longer you leave it in the fridge, the stronger the flavors will be.  Take a pan and put the lemon pepper, milk, vanilla seeds, and coconut flakes on the bottom, stir and put the riggies in.  Turn the element to medium, stir and bake at 200 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Pepperoni and Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 200 g frozen mixed vegetables | 175 g sugar snap peas | 4 pepperoni, slices | 50 g sambal oelek | 200 g sliced pepperoni | 2 tablespoons frangelico | vanilla essence
instructions: Combine peas, snap peas, pepperoni, half the frangelico and remaining frangelico.  Toss and chill for 1 - 2 hours before serving to allow flavours to develop.  Variation, if you would like to make this salad for company, replace pepperoni with a piece of hot pepper.

title: Noodles With Sausages
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles | 1 lb sausage
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling salted water for around 10 minutes.  Drain.  Brown the sausage at the same time the sausage is cooked.  Serve with freshly grated horseradish.

title: Lemon Vegetable Cake Mix
ingredients: 1 box lemon cake mix | 1/4 cup lardons, frozen | 4 cups mixed vegetables, such as cauliflower, broccoli, zucchini, carrots, and green onions | 4 cups cooked prepared fruit ( such as apples, pineapple, applesauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease an 11 x 7 inch baking pan.

title: Spiced Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger, finely chopped
instructions: Place chopped sun dried tomatoes in a small bowl, drizzle with oil and toss to coat and distribute.  Sprinkle with peanuts and toss to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: Racotta's Swedish Fish Chowder
ingredients: 2/3 cup beef bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup italian sausage, sliced | 1/4 cup shrimp's white pepper | 1/2 cup white fish fillets, chopped | 1/2 cup beef consommé | 1 cup squash, chopped fresh
instructions: Add ingredients to crock pot.  Cook on low 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,white peppercorn,white chocolate chip,red cabbage,lukewarm milk,spicy brown mustard,corn oil
title: Corned Beef and Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb corned beef brisket, with spice packet | 1 1/2 teaspoons white peppercorns, cracked | 1/2 lb red cabbage or 1/2 lb white cabbage, cored and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons spicy brown mustard or 3 -4 teaspoons spicy mustard | 1/2 lb white chocolate chips | 1/4 cup lukewarm milk | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Tie corned beef brisket into a spiral to make a package.  Sprinkle with cracked pepper, cover and heat over high heat about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Transfer brisket and cook all the while to your liking temperature and time will vary, so keep an eye on it.  When done remove brisket, drain and tent with foil with a piece of kitchen towel.  Let sit while you heat milk in a small saucepan and saute cabbage, mustard and chocolate chips with corn oil for about five minutes.  Pour off any excess milk, stir into pan and cook until chocolate is incorporated and the sauce is hot.

title: Salmon Potatoes with Roasted Chillies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 pound russet potatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 can beef consomme | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 4 dried red chile peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 1 dash pepperjack cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.  Stir the potatoes, beef consomme, pineapple, roasted red chile peppers, orange flower water, and pepperjack cheese together in the prepared baking dish.  Bake the potatoes in the preheated oven until tender and golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Hot Prunes
ingredients: 1 pound prunes, pitted | 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 onion flakes | 1/2 cup hot sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil.  Stir in the prunes, chilies, onion flakes, and hot sauce.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Potato and Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Steam the cabbage and reserve.  Mix potato starch with 75ml cream and mix well.  Add potato flour mixture and toss to coat.  Steam for 8 mins on a lightly floured boil, stirring occasionally until mixture changes colour.  Whip remaining cream until stiff, adding a further dash of cream if you wish.  Spread half the cabbage mixture into an ovenproof dish.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,gluten flour,clam juice,beef stew meat,bay leaf,deli ham,cream celery soup,accent seasoning
title: Crock Pot Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams with juice | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, chopped | 1 package sliced deli ham | 1 package of la victoria deli 98 % fat-free cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Drain juice from clams to remove and reserve liquid.  Place meat in a crock pot with remaining ingredients except flour.  Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  Mix flour with a little of the reserved clam juice.  Stir into meat mixture.  Mix and reheat if necessary.  Serve over noodles, rice, or egg noodles.  If desired, make a roux by adding flour mixed in a little water and stirring until thickened.  May use more or less flour.

title: Yummy Chocolate Leek Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix ( or a mixture of pudding and chocolate ) | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1/4 - 1/2 cup minced leek ( about 2 cloves ) | 4 cups shredded leeks ( about 4 cups ) | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Prepare the chocolate pudding mix according to package directions.  Stir in the horseradish.  Gently heat the leek in a small saucepan, then add the leek.  Cook, stirring, until soft, about 7 minutes.  Stir in the leeks until coated.  Transfer to a bowl, and chill until ready to serve.  Cut the crusts off the lettuce leaves, creating more or less clear space to wrap and fill the sandwiches.  Warm the margarita or other strong dark beer.  Divide the chocolate filling, then drizzle on top of the leeks and/or lettuce.

title: Red Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend red enchilada sauce, dill weed, and chili powder.  Cover, and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,gingerroot,mango chutney,fenugreek seed,cream mushroom soup
title: Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can cubed mango chutney | 1 bay leaf, crushed | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 inch cube fresh gingerroot, peeled
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients except the ginger.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With Champagne and Madeira Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed ( about 3 1/2 cups shelled peas ) | 1 cup madeira wine | 1/4 cup cornstarch, dissolved in | 1/2 cup dry madeira wine
instructions: In a crock pot combine peas, madeira and cornstarch mixture.  Stir well and cook at high heat for 1 hour.  Turn crock pot to low and cook an additional 5 - 6 hours.  When done remove from crock pot, mix cornstarch mixture well until smooth.  Serve over cooked steamed hot steamed rice or steamed egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice flour,orange zest,white vinegar,chili oil
title: Chinese Dango Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups glutinous rice flour | 3 oranges, zest of | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 5 drops chili oil
instructions: Mix glutinous rice flour in a basin with all the juice and mix well.  Pour in a wok and stir well.  Deep fry until a golden brown color.  Remove from wok and keep hot on a plate.  In the same wok, add orange zest, ginger and stir quickly.  Add vinegar and stir quickly.  Remove and serve hot.  Note, this cake is good with some fresh chili sauce, as well as dried chili oil.

title: Simple Spanish Tapas
ingredients: 6 green hot pimiento peppers | 6 scallions ( green parts only ) | 24 slices scallions
instructions: Fill a hot dry skillet with water and put it over medium high heat.  When the water comes to a boil, add the pimento peppers.  You may also add 1/4 teaspoon of salt.  When the water starts to boil again and there is a light haze of foam on top to evaporate the smell of oil, remove the pan from the heat, leaving the water behind.  Wash and dry the scallions.  Slice the green scallions at an angle into very thin slices.  Drain them, and add them to the skillet.  When they are limp, add the scallions.  Heat through.  Serve immediately, or store in an airtight container.

title: Caper and Banana Chips
ingredients: 6 firm-ripe bananas ( about 1 lb/3 cup each ) | 1 package capers
instructions: Cut 4 thin slices from the top of each banana.  Slice 1/8 inch off the top and bottom ends.  Place the cut side down on paper towels.  Pat down with the paper towels to drain excess moisture.  Transfer the cut side onto the rack of a broiler pan.  Brush with 2 teaspoons of the capers.  Broil until the underside is browned, about 3 - 4 minutes, turning once.

title: Cashew Butter Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unsalted cashews butter | 1 1/2 cups plain flour
instructions: Place whole lot of butter and cashew in a bowl.  Sprinkle flour on top.  Make a well in centre of the mixture.  Shape dough into 1 inch balls.  Place balls on a lightly floured board.  Press dough into circles.  Cut a cross on half the circles.  Bake in a moderate oven for 8 - 15 minutes or until they are golden.  Transfer to an absorbent paper.

title: Pesto (Pesto)
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh basil ( depending on how much you like basil ) | 1 -4 cup fresh raspberry leaves
instructions: Put basil and raspberries in a bowl.  You can use pesto of your own or use this paste as a fresh topping.  It will be fantastic for dipping crusty bread, etc.  Enjoy.

title: Black Pepper and Rice Slice
ingredients: 16 ounces ladyfingers | black pepper, to taste | 200 g rice, cooked
instructions: Cut the sponge finger biscuits into 1cm slices.  Mix the rice with the black pepper.  Spoon half the mixture onto the bottom of an iced sandwich tin.  Arrange the lady fingers in the tin.  Sprinkle on the black pepper powder.  Slice remaining biscuits with a pizza cutter.  Bake at 175°c/ gas mark 3 for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,pepper,yellow cornmeal,cilantro stem,italian seasoning,spinach,green pepper,red pepper flake
title: Spinach Polenta With Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish ) | 3 cups chopped fresh spinach | 1 medium green pepper, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  To clean and coarsely chop the spinach, cut off woody stems and wash the spinach, pressing the leaves out with your hands if necessary.  Place the spinach and any loose leaves in a food processor and pulse until evenly distributed.  Add the italian seasoning, salt, pepper and hot red pepper flakes and pulse until evenly distributed into a rough uniform mass.  Transfer the mixture to a large, rimmed baking sheet and pat evenly, then spread on a silpat surface.  Bake the polenta in the oven for 30 minutes to make it brown on top.  Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle the polenta with cilantro, returning to the original oven for 10 more minutes until evenly browned and the polenta is tinged with a crisp finish to it.  Variation, the sausage can be cooked on a foreman grill, set aside but keep warm while making polenta.  When the polenta is baked, slice into 12 slices, about 1/4th.  Use slotted spoon to transfer the sausage to a plate.  To serve, place a large slotted spoon in each plate and immediately transfer warm polenta on top, sprinkling each plate with fresh cilantro.  Note, if sausage is frozen, transfer all the sausage to a zip lock bag with a thin seal lid.

title: Easy Hummus Salad
ingredients: 1 jar small garbanzo beans | 1/2 pound cottage cheese | 1/3 cup lemon-flavored carbonated beverage | 6 tortillas, cut into fourths
instructions: Drain garbanzo beans, reserving liquid.  In food processor or blender, puree the garbanzos.  Using low speed, add 2 cups of the reserved garbanzo bean liquid.  Cover and blend until very smooth.  Spoon the puree into a serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,serrano pepper,barbecue sauce,red cabbage,habanero pepper
title: Spicy Ricotta Cheese Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup low fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons jalapenos barbecue sauce or 3 tablespoons sweet red cabbage sauce | 1/4 medium red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 small serrano pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Combine ricotta, habanero pepper, jalapeno pepper sauce, cabbage, and serrano in a medium bowl.

title: Crock Pot Easy Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 1 cup marsala wine
instructions: Put the chicken breast in the crock pot.  Pour the marsala wine over it.  Cover and cook on high 1 hour, on high for 2 1/2 3 hours.  You don't need to turn the crock pot too much, just keep the crock pot covered for the last hour or two to allow enough time for the juices to thicken up a bit.  If you have problems, you can easily remove the lid after the first hour of cooking for a more developed cooking.

title: Baked Red Pepper and Fennel Infused Barley
ingredients: 10 dried red peppers | 9 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 tablespoons red pepper flakes or 3 tablespoons red chili powder
instructions: Wash and dry the peppers.  Make a fine slit lengthwise down the side of each, making sure to remove the seeds inside.  Place the peppers in a large ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle the barley and fennel seed inside the peppers and fill the hole with water until it measures 1/2 the depth of the pepper.  Sprinkle the top with red pepper flakes.  Cover and bake in the oven at 300f for 15minutes remove from the oven and stir briskly.  Cover and bake for 30 mins more or until tender.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,corn husk,jumbo shrimp,cherry,sherry wine vinegar,white bean,couscous
title: Prawn and Couscous Salad
ingredients: 4 boxes couscous | 500 g cherry tomatoes or 500 g tomatoes, halved | 200 g red capsicums, halved and sliced | 200 g jumbo shrimp, cooked & peeled | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry wine vinegar | 1 packet corn on the cob or 4 fresh corn shucked husks | 50 g dried purple beans
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c.  Place the couscous in a bowl and pour boiling water over.  Cover with a sheet of greaseproof paper and a tea towel.  Leave for about 10 minutes until water has been absorbed.  Fluff with a fork then spread out on a baking tray.  Repeat with the remaining couscous and filling ingredients.  Tip, make sure the couscous has cooled thoroughly before replacing in half to make it fluffy.  Drain well then cover, return to the fridge, and allow it to sit in a cool place for 24 hours.  To serve, spread a thin layer of sherry or sherry vinegar on a serving plate, place the couscous in the centre, then scatter over cherry tomatoes, capsicum, and shrimp.  Drizzle over sherry vinegar to taste.  Top with crushed corn on the cob, and scatter with dried purple beans.

title: Penne All' Campagne
ingredients:
1 lb penne | 1 1/2 lbs top round steak, cut in half | 1 can cannellini beans, with liquid | 1 teaspoon black pepper 
    - 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup green olives
instructions: Fill a large pot 3/4 full with cold water.  Add penne, and 2 t.  Of oil.  Bring to a boil, and cook 1 minute, then drain.  Meanwhile, cut steak lengthwise into 2/3 wide strips.  Add steak, beans with liquid, black pepper, and allspice to the pot.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,plum tomato,tomato green chilies,chicken stock cube,portabella mushroom cap,cilantro stem
title: Pollo Con Choclo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 cup canned tomato and green chilies | 1 portabella mushroom caps or 5 baby portabella mushroom caps, sliced | 4 large plum tomatoes, chopped | fresh cilantro stem, minced ( garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl mix together cornflour and stock cube.  Stir in the tomato and green chilies and set aside.  On a warm ridged frying pan heat oil.  Add the mushroom and cook for several minutes.  Increase the heat to high and cook until the mushrooms have softened.  Push the mushroom to the side of the pan and add the tomato and chilies to the hot oil.  Add the cornflour mixture and stir until smooth.  Cook until the sauce thickens and becomes thicker.  Remove from heat.  Place the mushrooms mixture on the serving plate, sprinkle cilantro over them and serve with warm cornflour rice.  Serves.

title: Chinese Green Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions | 2 garlic cloves, peeled | 2 celery ribs, including leaves | 2 cans water chestnuts, drained | cilantro leaf, for garnish
instructions: Slice the onions lengthwise.  Place the sliced onions in a small pot and cover with water.  Bring the water to a boil and cook the onions, partially covered, for 1 hour.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the onions to a blender or processor and puree.

title: Coconut Ziti
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 can sweetened flaked coconut | 1 package ziti pasta | 12 maraschino cherries, halved | 1 can sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Beat egg whites and oregano together in a large bowl with a fork.  Add 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut, and 2 cups sweetened coconut.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,mustard seed,hot red pepper flake,port wine,parsley
title: Grampa's Mustard-Crusted Port
ingredients: 1 cup mustard seeds | 1 cup sugar | 3 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 1/2 cups sweet red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup port wine ( optional )
instructions: Heat mustard seeds over medium heat, stirring constantly.  When it begins to crackle, remove from heat.  Do not burn.  Crush the mustard seeds with a mortar and pestle.  Pour into 3 1/2 quart jar.  Add sugar, parsley, red pepper flakes, and orange juice.

title: Champagne Nibbles
ingredients: 12 ounces pumpkin ( preferably kent or english ) | 2 yellow squash, cut into six chunks | 4 cups strong black coffee | pumpkin, seeds from ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Remove the skins from the pumpkin, then cut into four even pieces.  Place in a roasting tin.  Place around the squash chunks on top of the pumpkin, making sure they fit snugly on the tin.  Pour the black coffee into the roasting tin.  Bake for 1 hour, then increase the oven temperature to 300°f and bake for 1 - 1 1/2 hours until the pumpkin is soft and well flavored, stirring occasionally.  Remove the vegetables from the oven and transfer to a large bowl, mash down and add the pumpkin chunks.  Sprinkle over plenty of pumpkin seeds if using, it is unlikely you will need to use all the seeds.  Eat with thick bread or toast.

title: Fennel-Cabbage Tails
ingredients: 2 cups peeled red cabbage, finely chopped | 2 fennel bulbs, finely chopped | 4 ladyfingers | 2 -3 drops yellow food coloring
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and place on a baking sheet and bake at 160c for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown.  Cool.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,scallion,fennel,sauce,season salt,red pepper flake,yellow pepper
title:
Korean Style S.
    - O.
    - Meat Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons fennel | 1/4 cup yellow pepper | 4 tablespoons scallions ( with tops ) or 4 tablespoons spring onions, chopped thin ( with tops ) | 2 tablespoons season-all salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together.  Pour over meat or veggies.  Grill over medium coals.  Baste frequently throughout cooking time.  May be used with teriyaki sauce, and garlic and sherry sauce in the marinade, or just serve as is to get the yummy korean meat.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,prosciutto,macaroni,cream cheese,baby carrot,cider vinegar,chili flake
title: Chilli Pasta Salad

instructions: Combine all ingredients except macaroni.  When done, add macaroni.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Toss with extra virgin olive oil, garlic, cajun seasoning or pepper flakes.

title: Mexican Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 12 small corn kernels | 1/4 lb frozen spinach leaves | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa ( i like hershey's cocoa ) | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons honey mustard, divided | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Mix corn, spinach, cocoa, 1 tablespoon mustard, and 1/2 cup water in a large saucepan or soup pot, heating over medium high heat for 5 minute or until hot.  Pour into casserole dish, then sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon each mustard and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,pepperoncini pepper,saffron strand,red wine vinegar,vermouth
title: Saffron con Vino - Vinegar Pepperoncini Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 8 pepperoncini peppers ( optional ) | 1 pinch saffron strands
instructions: Place vinegar, sugar, vermouth, pepperoncillini, and saffron to a large jar with a tight fitting lid.  Shake vigorously until the sugar dissolves.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,currant,chicken bouillon cube,cream,lobster,mustard powder
title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 ounces dried lobster | 4 tablespoons currants | 4 tablespoons cream | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes ( depending on taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 3 sprigs fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the soaked lobster in a frying pan with enough water to cover them and cook slowly over medium heat for about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the size of the lobster meat.  Drain, remove the meat and set the shells aside until needed when doing the sauce.  To make the sauce put 2 tablespoons of cream in a bowl and put in a little water and dissolved chicken bullion, mustard and pepper.  Mix all together and taste for salt and pepper.  Place drained lobster meat and currants into the bowl and then pour the sauce over the lobster and currants.  Add a few sprigs of parsley and mix gently.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,ladyfinger,apple juice,maraschino cherry,purpose flour,red kidney bean,baking apple
title: Apple Chicken Tortilla
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 pound chicken breast meat - cubed | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup chopped maraschino cherries | 2 baking apples - peeled, cored, and diced | 1 1/2 cups red kidney beans | 3 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, combine flour and chicken.  Slowly stir in apple juice and apple juice.  Combine cherries and diced apple.  Layer 1/2 the chicken mixture, 1/2 the onion, 1/4 of the cherry mixture, 1/2 of the red kidney beans, remaining chicken mixture, and 1/2 of the apples.  Repeat layers ending with cherries and beans on the top.  Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,pork sparerib,tomato puree,flour tortilla,cilantro leaf
title: Grilled Thai Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork spareribs | 1/3 cup bottled plum tomato puree | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 8 -10 flour tortillas or 8 -10 other corn tortillas | fresh fresh cilantro leaves or fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine tomato puree and fish sauce.  Cut reserved ribs into 1 inch strips on the bias, placing on both ends of the ribs on a square of foil.  Place the ribs on the foil, with tomato mixture on them.  Place the foil and foil in a grill over moderate heat.  Prop open grill and grill until ribs are tender, about 40 minutes.  Serve with chopped coriander and chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Spicy Clam Fritters With Pasta, Citrus and Chipotle
ingredients: 2 cans small clams, drained | 2 oranges, juiced | 1 small cinnamon sugar, crushed | 1/2 chipotle chile, minced ( canned ) | 1 head of chopped lettuce leaf, washed, dried and torn | pasta | flour, for coating
instructions: In a 6 or 7 qt.  Frying pan over medium heat, add clam juice.

title: Spicy Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 jar large sliced mushrooms | 1 jar hot sauce | 12 ounces ziti pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook ziti according to package directions, drain.  Meanwhile in a 9x13 inch baking dish, pour 1 can of pinto beans with their liquid, mushrooms, hot sauce and cheese.  Mix well.  Pour drained pasta over the mixture.  Dot pasta with 1/2 cup of mascarpone cheese.  Sprinkle with chopped eggs.  Bake, covered, for 35 minutes, until ziti is tender and heated through.

Random Ingredients: broth,mexican hominy,coconut macaroon,pasta sauce,raisin,grain white rice,red pepper flake,beef bouillon cube
title: Mexican-American Hominy and Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts canned mexican-style hominy, drained | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice, rinsed, drained | 1 beef bouillon cubes or 1 vegetarian bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups broth | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 can diced mexican-style hominy, undrained | red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 can coconut macaroon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place the uncooked rice, broth, raisins, and seasoning in a large saucepan.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat.  Decrease heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in the macaroons and macaroon.  Cover and let sit 5 - 10 minutes before serving.  This serves easily.  Leftovers may also be frozen.

title: Ziti Italian Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 3 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook rotel & tomatoes until the ziti is al dente.  Drain.  In a bowl, mix the drained rotel & 3 1/2 tablespoons of cocoa.  Heat a large non stick skillet over medium heat.  Drain the ziti, and then return to the pan.  Pour ziti & tomato mixture over ziti, and then add remaining cocoa.  Let simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, or until noodles are tender and the noodles are slightly translucent.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,maraschino cherry,vegetable oil cooking spray,onion,steak,onion powder,black sesame seed
title: Korean Spicy Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, 1 inch thick | 3/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup onion, chopped | 1/3 cup sweet onion, chopped | 1/2 - 1 cup maraschino cherry, cut in half | 1 1/2 teaspoons soy black sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons green food coloring ( i use either 1-2 teaspoons or to taste ) | onion powder ( optional )
instructions: Using a sharp, small knife, cut about 5 small slits in the side of the beef flank steak.  Lightly spray both sides of the steak.  Spray the cooking spray on both sides of the meat.  Place meat in crockpot on low or high.  Saute onions and onions in skillet for about 2 minutes.  Add marazan cherries.  Saute about 3 minutes.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green food coloring.  Turn meat onto cutting board and slice across the grain.  Serve with your favourite garnish.

title: Cajun Sweet Meat With Banana Peppers & Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 lb sweet banana pepper, halved | 2 red peppers or 2 yellow pepper, halved | 6 medium capers, drained | 3 slices orange peel, finely shredded ( i use pared ) | 4 cinnamon sticks | cheddar or colby cheese, to top
instructions: Put everything except the cheese in a large crockpot, cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, stirring occasionally and adding water if necessary to keep mixture covered.  Turn meat and serve topped with cheese.

title: Pomegranate Beef Broth (Yemenitei)
ingredients: 1/2 lb cottage cheese ( kurdish ) | 2 ounces pomegranate | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon ginger ale
instructions: In a container big enough to hold all the ingredients, dump the cottage cheese.  Dissolve the beef cube in the ginger ale, pour over the cottage cheese and stir.  Cover tightly and let marinate overnight.  The next day remove mixture and discard the mixture.  Gravy, add some bread crumbs and some red wine and a few pomegranate pods and boil them down to yield 2 cups of gravy.

title: Chili Condiment
ingredients: 1 large egg whites | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Combine egg whites and chile oil in a shallow dish, stirring constantly.  Set aside.  Wash lettuce, removing both heads of lettuce and lettuce leaves.  Chop into very small pieces.  Place on a microwave safe plate, and place under a cover in the microwave for 2 minutes.  Remove from microwave and cover with a towel.  Microwave on high for 2 more minutes, stirring once, to loosen tortilla crystals.  Using tongs, remove lettuce from microwave.  Place in food processor or blender with egg whites and oil mixture.  Blend just enough to coat the lettuce pieces.  Return lettuce to food processor or blender, and blend to blend, as you would for regular enchiladas.  Transfer to serving dish, garnish with reserved lettuce, serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

title: Tagine of Beef and Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried brown lentils | 6 ounces steak fillets, cut into strips | 2 garlic cloves, sliced | 2 stalks lemongrass, bruised | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons crystallized cherries
instructions: Place lentils in a colander and weigh them until they are about 1/2 the size.  Place in a flameproof dish and add 3 1/2 cups boiling water.  Place dish under a preheated grill or in a large shallow pan with the flat of a cleaver.  Leave for 30 minutes until tender.  Drain.  Heat the beef in a frying pan and cook on both sides until browned, remove and leave to one side.  Add the garlic and lemongrass, cooking for 20 minutes until soft and aromatic.  Drain the fat from the pan.  Add the lentils and cilantro and mix well.  Sprinkle over the beef and cook for a further 15 minutes until tender.

title: Barbeque Lentil Won Tons
ingredients: 2 cups red lentils, rinsed, drained | 1/2 cup barbeque sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: Whisk red lentils, barbeque sauce, and oregano together in a bowl until the mixture is smooth.  Place 1 won ton wrapper on each of four dinner plates.  Dip each won ton wrapper, one at a time, in a large bowl of warm water.
