title: Potato and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 large red potato, halved and sliced | 4 large hass avocados, peeled and sliced | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved ( optional ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Place potato in a large saucepan and cover with 1 inch of water.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,italian plum tomato,deli ham,ancho chile
title: Ancho Chile Ham-Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 small deli ham slices ( about 5 x6-inch ) or 12 small mild forest ham ( about 5 x6-inch ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon dried ancho chile
instructions: Heat a skillet set over medium low heat.  Place a plate in the center of pan.  Arrange 2 thick slices of ham on plate and sprinkle with salt.  Top ham with 1/2 cup chopped fresh ancho.  Coat the ham with cooking spray.  Place remaining bread slices on top.  Heat a 12 nonstick skillet over medium low heat.  Place a heavy skillet or griddle over high heat.  Cook sandwiches until golden brown on top.  Cut in half.  Serve warm.

title: Creamy Cheese-Crusted Apples With Turkish Plums-Pineapple Upside Down
ingredients: cooking apple, 2 large ( preferably english american ) | sea salt, to taste | 4 tablespoons lard, melted | 2 tablespoons pure australian seasoning ( from toulouse ) | 2 large pears, peeled cored ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 cups ice cold water or 2 cups apple juice | 1 cup pineapples, peeled quartered | 1/4 cup aged asiago cheese, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Place the apple on a sheet tray, and sprinkle with salt.  Place on a roasting pan lined with plastic wrap and cover with foil.  Toast in 400 degree oven until tender and lightly golden brown, about 40 minutes.  Let cool slightly, then finely chop using a large knife.  In a large bowl, mix the mustard and 1/2 cup of the melted lard or butter, tossing well.  Core the pears and slice into half moons, then cut each half moon into 4 wedges.  In another bowl, add the pineapples, remaining 1/2 cup of melted lard or butter, the pineapples, chopped asiago, grand marnier, sea salt and black pepper.  Add the apples and mix together with your fingers, ensuring they are fully coated in the mixture of mustard, butter and spice.  To serve, top with the cooled apples and pineapples.  Serve with your favourite breakfast/baking bread, crackers or toast.

title: Polish Kielbasa

instructions: Boil kielbasa and drain.  Remove pieces from water and place in large casserole.  Cover kielbasa with chopped parsley and add 1/2 can of plum jam and broth.  Season generously with mustard powder and dried parsley.  Cover and bake at 325º for 50 - 60 minutes or until kielbasa is tender.  Serve over your favorite meal.

title: French Onion Fries
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 3/4 cup dried dates | crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in heavy duty resealable plastic bag, squishing with palm of hand to mix.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,french bread,manchego cheese,corn,fenugreek leaf,deli chicken,chicken bouillon cube,extra virgin olive oil
title: My Favorite Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil ( or other oil you like ) | 3 cups cooked chicken or 3 cups cooked chicken breasts | 1 can condensed french bread | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon chicken soup base | 3 tablespoons fenugreek leaves ( optional ) | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes | fresh corn, grilled and quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Heat oil in skillet and saute chicken until golden.  Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.  Slice french bread into 8 slices and layer them evenly into a 3 quart baking dish.  In a large bowl, mix both cans of soup together.  Add chicken in skillet and stir to completely mix.  Sprinkle in bread pieces in rows.  Add 1 heaping measure of soup to bread and chicken mixture.  Stir in fenugreek leaves and remaining soup base.  Drop 2 or 3 chicken pieces into soup mixture and stir to thoroughly coat.  Cover and bake for 50 minutes.

title: Homemade Gouda Cheese from the Farmer Shop
ingredients:
1 lb edam cheese, cut in half | 1 egg, beaten | 1 -2 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated ( about 1 tsp.

instructions: Blend cheese in a food processor until thoroughly blended, then transfer to an oiled metal bowl.  Grate in the remaining ingredients, mixing well until cheese resembles a dough.  Transfer to a well drained 9 inch nonreactive cake tin, and press the dough into the corners to form a rectangle, about 3 inches in diameter. Immediately transfer to a rack to cool.  Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

title: Sautéed Pork With Bok Choy and Grilled Cheese (Panang Muoi)
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 ounce baby bok choy, halved | 1 small orange, sliced very thinly | 1/2 cup grated tasty cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Slice the pork on the diagonal into strips, approximately 1/4 to 1/2 centimeter, then slice each slice across the grain, removing the ends.  Slice each slice into thin slices.  Put the pork slices into an ovenproof pan and drizzle with an equal amount of olive oil.  Broil the pork slices until browned and cooked through.  Remove from the oven and keep warm.  Place bok choy in a steamer and steam over boiling water for 1 minute.  Drain, plunge into cold water and remove the stalks.  Toss bok choy with the orange, cheese and bok choy mixture.  Serve with freshly baked bread.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Put pumpkin with enough water to come to the top of the pumpkin and add pepitas cook about 5 minutes. Put under the grill until golden and serve warm.

title: Almond Coated Beef

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Put dough on a baking sheet, and roll out onto a lightly floured board that is no bigger than 2 inches. Place pieces on the baking sheet.  Lightly salt and pepper the meat, then sprinkle on the almond extract.  Sprinkle on the bay leaf.  Bake 1 hour, then sprinkle with confectioner's sugar.

title: Champignons a La Provence Restaurant Style
ingredients: 1 lb button mushrooms | 1/2 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 lb cooked dates, cut in slices
instructions: Thoroughly wash mushrooms and set aside.  Cut stems off mushrooms and discard.  Scoop out liquid, discard stems then chop.  Mince garlic and stir together in a medium bowl.  Dice mushrooms into thin pieces about 1 1/2 inches wide.  Arrange on a parchment or other heavy platter.  Fold in dates and add mushrooms and garlic.  Drizzle more marinade over all. title: Cantaloupe (Mexican Beef Stew)

instructions: Combine meat, hominy, and beef in dutch oven.  Heat on high heat, stirring often until meat and hominy are hot and bubbly, about 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to medium low. title: Canola-Free Hot Peg Buns
ingredients: 2 slices bread ( i like to use crusty wholemeal ) | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce, for heat | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Preheat a griddle, frying pan or frying pan.  Using your fingers, lightly rub the bread with the canola oil.  Use less oil if necessary.  Sprinkle the bicarb of soda evenly over the bread mixture, then quickly flip the slices in the pan using a wet spatula.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes, until crisp and golden.  Sprinkle on the hot pepper sauce, if using.

title: Green Grapes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs green grapes, washed and dried, reserving some for serving ( or 2 cups green pea pods ) | 3 cups vegetable broth ( or mushroom broth )
instructions: Place the grapes or peas into a saucepan over medium low heat, cover, and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat.  Remove from the heat, and set aside to let cool.  Place the vegetable broth in a blender, or other large bowl, and blend until smooth.  Strain the broth through a fine mesh sieve into another saucepan.  Cover, and cook over medium low heat, stirring for 15 minutes, until thickened.  Remove from the heat, and set aside to cool.  Return the grapes or peas to the strained broth, and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Pawpaw's Peach and Strawberry Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 peach | 1/2 lb strawberry | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: Cut peach in half, remove pit.  Cut in half, and scoop the pulp into cocktail glasses to cover.  Sprinkle with strawberries.  Pour catsup over fruit and serve.

title: Cocoa Oil or Butter
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder ( preferably dutch cocoa ) | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock or 1 1/4 cups broth
instructions: Salt and pepper ( if you wish ).  Bring stock or broth to boil.  Mix together cocoa, cocoa powder and oil.  Pour into saucepan/skillet and bring to a boil.  Immediately remove from heat.  Taste and adjust salt and pepper to your liking.

title: Sizzlin' Franks and Spanish Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons thick & chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons shredded old el paso cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon chopped grated orange rind
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  In a medium bowl, stir together the salsa, cheese, parsley and orange rind and place 2 tablespoons of the mix on each slice of hot, oiled chorizo and roll tightly.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,thyme sprig,halibut fillet,beef stock,black bean,red potato,panettone
title: Black Bean and Halibut Stew

title: Mustard Roasted Raisins, Blackberries & Almonds

instructions: Roast raisins and olives in a 450°f oven about 10 minutes, or until blackened and beginning to brown.  Add salt and mustard.

title: Vaca Fizz
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti, cooked al dente and drained ( uncooked ) | lemon juice | 1 -2 1 teaspoon lemon juice or 1 -2 teaspoon lime juice | 1 drop vanilla extract ( optional )
instructions: Mix all together together and enjoy.

title: Cinnamon and Vanilla Pone
ingredients: 6 eggs, separated | 1 cup ground turkey | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Beat egg yolks until pale and fluffy.  In a mixing bowl, place egg whites.  Add turkey and vanilla bean, and mix well.  Stir in egg whites until well mixed.  Pour mixture into paper liners.  Let cool slightly, then remove paper liners.  Let cool completely before freezing.  Cook according to directions on package.

title: Cream of Coconut Soup

instructions: In a medium soup pot, combine cream of coconut, 2/3 cup broth, and chickpea flour.  Over medium heat, bring to a boil.  Stir in sour cream and simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly. title: Lighter Microwave Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley or 1 cup brown rice | 3 cups margarine or 3 cups ghee, melted | 1 vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar or 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 - 1 chipotle chile, finely chopped, deseeded | 100 g fresh pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup toasted pecorino romano cheese, coarsely grated | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted, to serve
instructions: Drain the barley or brown rice and place in 4 1/2 cup microwave safe ramekins or a heat proof ceramic dish, covered.  Heat on full power until almost boiling. Add 1 cup sugar or superfine sugar, cinnamon, pepper, oregano and chipotle to the softened margarine and melt into the margarine.  Stir in the onion and the pecorino romano until combined.  Stir into the rice, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on full power for 12 minutes or until the rice is tender and creamy.  Stir in remaining 1/2 cup water and set aside to cool slightly.  Pour the cooled rice into the rice pudding and scatter the pecorino over the top.  Microwave on full power on high for 5 - 6 minutes or until the top is light brown.  Serve sprinkled with the toasted pecorino romano.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,canadian bacon,oil,potato starch,curly leaf parsley,vegetable broth,veal cutlet
title: Beef Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 8 ounces veal cutlets, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, chopped | 1 ounce frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 2 tablespoons canadian curly leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon, crumbled, divided | 4 tablespoons frozen potato starch | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups water
instructions: Prep a 12 count frozen hash brown bags.  On a plate, combine the meat, bacon, vegetables, parsley, 1 1/2 teaspoons canadian bacon, and 1/3 cup of the crumbled bacon. instructions: Cut meat into 12 portions and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Lay down in a non stick frying pan and cook on medium heat for 3 minutes and turn over. title: Jicama Salad with Tomatillos

title: Sea Bass Cacciatore

instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c.  Heat oil on a large ovenproof frying pan.  Fry the zuccchini and squash until tender.  Add stock.  Cover and cook for 5 minutes.  Top fillets with capsicum and bake for 15 minutes.  Stir through.

title: Cauliflower Cones

1 medium cauliflower, small ( about 8 oz.
    - ) | 2 cups cake flour
instructions: Trim and chop the cauliflower into small pieces.  Place the cauliflower in a large steamer basket, with plenty of cold water in the bottom of the steamer over boiling water. title: Fried Noodles With Turnips & Herbs

instructions: In a large, deep frying pan over medium high heat, add the oil.  Add the turnip, cardamom, and scallions.  Stir fry for 3 minutes.  Add the herbs and season.  Stir fry another 3 minutes or until the turnip is slightly soft.  Drain the pasta and turnip if desired.  Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Rice Balls

instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl.  Using the back of a spoon, scoop balls and roll each one in the mixture.  Place the balls in resealable plastic bags and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. . .  Serve or keep warm in the fridge overnight.

Fill 3/4 cup ice cube trays or a large pot 1/3 full with water and add peas.  If using peas, add all ingredients into bowl with ice.

title: Jamaican Sausage or Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 8 ounces ground lean pork or 8 ounces ground turkey
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat.  Drop in the kale in the boiling water, and cook until tender, 3 to 10 minutes.  Drain immediately, and set aside in a bowl.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix the taco seasoning mix and pork until well blended.  Cut the sausages about 1/4 inch thick, and arrange them on a foil lined baking sheet.  Place in the oven, and bake 12 to 14 minutes, or until the pork crumbles and the sausage is lightly browned.

instructions: In dutch oven brown onion in oil, add beef& brown well, stirring constantly.  Drain beef & add to beef in dutch oven & mix lightly.  Add white beans, 1/4 t. title: Annatto Butter
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter ( margarine, softened ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed achiote seeds | 1/4 cup canned minced ham | 2 tablespoons dry catsup | 6 small fresh juniper berries | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup ice cube ( to taste )
instructions: Beat together the dry spices until combined with melted margarine, then beat in other ingredients.  Transfer the mixture into a freezer plastic bag and freeze in an ice cube tray over night.  Remove the tray from the freezer 3 hours prior to preparing.  When ready to serve, thaw the tray overnight in the fridge.

title: Lebanese Olive Paste
ingredients: 2 lbs kalamata olives | 2 cups molasses
instructions: Soak the olives in at least a 1/2 cup of water for as long as possible.  Remove the stem and remove the hard green outer layer.  Put back on water and squeeze out excess water.  Chop the olives coarsely.  In a saucepan bring two cups of water to a boil.  Put in the olives and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, drain water.  Stir the olives into the molasses.  Cover and continue cooking in low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often.  Stir the olive paste vigorously a few times.  If it is dry add a few more cups of water if it becomes too thick.  Allow the paste to sit for 15 minutes, then stir once again.  Remove from heat and cool.  Then store in fridge.

title: Garbanzo (Parsnip and Chickpeas)
ingredients: 4 parsnips | 1 cup canned chickpeas ( garbanzo beans )
instructions: Wash and peel the parsnips if needed then cut in half and lengthwise.  Drain the parsnips and drain on paper towels.  Combine the chickpeas and parsnips in a microwave safe bowl or other covered container.  Microwave on high for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes then remove from the microwave and stir with a fork.  Cover and keep in the microwave for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or longer until the chickpeas are tender.  Serve warm.

title: Maple Syrup Snow Peas Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup snow peas
instructions: Combine self rising flour and maple syrup in a small bowl.  Mix pineapple juice and snow peas together in another small bowl.

instructions: Pour dijon style mustard into a microwave safe bowl.  Heat in microwave until mustard is liquefied.  Stir in can of both beans, processed cheese, avocado, and tea until thoroughly mixed.  Stirring continuously, continue cooking 3 minutes, or until cheese is melted.  Serve warm.

instructions: Wash and steam the spinach.  Drain and add the wasabi to the spinach, making sure it is thoroughly mixed together.  Add beans and sherry to taste.  Add a dash of salt to taste.  Stir. Variation, you can mix up some wasabi powder or garlic powder.  This soup is great either as a side dish or as a salad dressing.

title: Pear and Pear Salad

title: Pig's Slow-Cooked Pork Tenderloin

instructions: Place pork tenderloin in a slow cooker, and sprinkle with tomatoes, olives, and any remaining green onion.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover, and cook on high for 4 hours.  Turn slow cooker to low, and continue cooking the pork for 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from the slow cooker, and slice, or shred using 2 forks.

title: Polenta Squares With Lemon Zest, Maraschinos and Cherry Sauce

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Put zest in a ziploc freezer baggie and add the rest of the ingredients.  Shake the bag around a little to mix, then transfer to a lightly floured surface. Prick the tops with a fork and bake at 450f for 20 - 25 minutes until lightly browned.  Enjoy.

title: Cabbage With Blue Cheese - Colcannon
ingredients: 3 small cabbage | 3 tablespoons sliced almonds, lightly toasted | 4 tablespoons crumbled blue cheese | 3 leaves finely chopped fresh dill
instructions: Cut the end off each cabbage leaf.

title: My Favorite Iranian Rice
ingredients: 4 cups white flour | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Combine the flour, salt and bouillon.  Pour water in saucepan and start gradually sifting the flour and salt.  Do until it reaches the right consistency to roll out.  Cut dough into 1x2 squares and roll each square into a ball.  Place rice on a plate.  Stretch dough into a long snake of rice on the plate.  With palm press down dough.  The pressure will stretch it.  Poke holes in the rice with your finger if the rice breaks during cooking.  Place the rice on a baking tray and spread some oil or butter on top of it.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until brown.  Serve with plain raisins or your favorite topping.  Enjoy,.

While oven is heating, grate cheese.  When meat has baked for 20 minutes, remove to serving plate and slice 1/4 inch thick. Add the grated cheese and add the vanilla essence.  Mix the ingredients together until they all are evenly mixed.  Put the mushroom, gherkin and mushroom into a bowl.  Add the mango mixture.  Pour the mixture into a 12 hole muffin tin.  If using mushrooms use sliced mushrooms.  Mix your ingredients for mushroom topping together and then spread over the muffins.  Sprinkle the mango topping mixture over the fruit.  Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees / 180 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Chutney Relish
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chutney | 3 1/2 cups red wine
instructions: Combine chutney and red wine and chill.

title: Madeira Beef Jerky - a Jerky Substitute
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs ladyfingers | 1 ounce dried madeira wine or 1 ounce dry vermouth | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup lemon peel ( from about 3 lemons ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup grapeseed oil | 1/8 teaspoon dried ground mace | 1 bottle or ( 16 ounce ) bottle liqueur, like madeira
instructions: Combine everything, except the ladyfingers and wine, in a plastic zipper bag.  Add the ladyfingers to the bag, seal, and place in the refrigerator for 4 days, turning the bag once.  Drain the excess marinade from the bag, and store in the refrigerator, if desired.  Drain the mixture 2 or 3 times, and store the liquid in the refrigerator.  Slice and dehydrate your jerky.  Place in a very clean glass jar, cover, and seal.  If your jerky lasts longer than 6 weeks in the refrigerator, it will become more crispier.

title: Greek Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 6 cups greek yogurt | 1/2 cup oatmeal ( i use psyll oats instead ) | 1/2 cup mixed dried herbs ( i use greek seasoning ) | 4 lettuce leaves
instructions: Mix yogurt with oatmeal until smooth.  Spread yogurt on lettuce leaves and arrange a few slices.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,allspice,pam cooking spray,cauliflower floret,lime,coriander powder,dark brown sugar,cream tartar
title: Cauliflower With Lime Cream
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower floret | 1 large limes or 1 large lemon, juice of or lemon | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup light cream of tartar | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean | cinnamon | pam cooking spray
instructions: Heat a large saucepan of water to boiling.  Place cauliflower and lime or lemon juice.  Let stand until cauliflower is crisp tender.  Drain. Pour the lime cream over and mix well.  Sprinkle on cinnamon to taste.  Pour over cauliflower.  Sprinkle with a bit of cinnamon if desired.

title: Creamy Artichoke and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 20 frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1/4 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1/2 cup plain soymilk | 1 cup gouda cheese, shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Combine artichokes and cashews in a medium bowl.  Toss to coat.  Stir in parsley, artichokes, cashews and 2 - 3 tbsp of the soy milk.  Mix in cheese and dill.  Cover and chill until serving.

ingredients: 5 lbs short rib roast ( bone in ) | 24 ounces barbecue sauce or 24 ounces soya sauce | 12 bouquet garni | honey, to taste | coleslaw, to taste
instructions: In a crockpot, place meat and cover with beer or soya sauce.  I place my crockpot on low for at least 8 hours.  In a skillet on high add enough beer to cover meat by 1/ lay meat on hot grill.  Turn meat when brown and brown on all sides.  Remove meat from grill and place on platter, cover with foil and rest meat for 1 hour.  Remove bone and cut meat into slices.  Reheat and pour out excess beer.  For a traditional french dinner with a horseradish garlic sauce, i place a small portion of sauce on each of the rolls, top with meat, top with honey and roll up.  Serve with polish cabbage.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,seasoning salt,chili sauce,passata,flour tortilla,green olive,meat

instructions: Boil meat with hot potato sauce for 15 - 20 mins or until done drain off fat and let cool a few minutes place meat, potato sauce, chili sauce, salt and seasoned meat in the tortillas and spread out to cover the entire tortilla.  Fold over and fry in a pan with a drizzle of oil.  Serve with salsa and corn.

title: Sweet and Sour Apple Linguica in Canadian Bacon-Sausage Ragu
ingredients:
2 cups plain yogurt | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk ( 398mls.

instructions: Sauce,.  Drain yogurt and coconut milk in a colander.  Put aside approximately 1/4 cup liquid to thin the sauce if necessary.  Reheat sauce in a small pan until almost boiling.  Add vinegar.  Stir.  Serve warm over linguica with a few slices of smoked sweet or sour apple on top.  Pass remaining wine or beer at the table or enjoy immediately after dipping the linguica.  If serving warm, refrigerate 2 minutes or just until desired sweetness and acidity is achieved.  Serve immediately.

title: Jolly Cajun-Style Shredded Cherry Glaze for Baja Style Bites
ingredients: 12 scallions | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped or 2 -5 teaspoons dried mint, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon tamale seasoning ( see my note on the recipe ) or 1 -2 tablespoon emeril's essence ( see my note on the recipe ) | 1 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 can cherry preserves | flour, for coating baked beans
instructions: Dice 1 scallion and mix with 1 tbs parsley.  Mix in 1 - 2 tbs mint, 1 - 2 tbs tamale seasoning, 1 - 2 tsp dried mint, and 1/2 tsp creole seasoning.  Combine orange juice and rest of ingredients in bowl and mix well.  Pour over cooked baked beans and toss.  Note, if using frozen cherry preserves, defrost them before starting the prep process.  This glaze can be frozen.

title: Lamb & Beet Mousse
ingredients: 12 large beet ( raw or cooked ) | 8 ounces fresh lamb ( boneless or tender cut into strips ) | 500 250 ml whipping cream or 500 ml quark | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Wash the beet well then fry them in abundant oil in a non stick frying pan for 30 - 40 minutes, turning them frequently until they are golden on all sides.  Tear the meat into fine strips and fry in the dripping for 5 - 6 minutes, until all the fat has been absorbed and the meat is cooked.  Remove the pan from the heat and allow it to cool for ten minutes.  Chop the beet into large chunks and pour all the juices into a large saucepan.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes, stir in the cream, vinegar, lemon juice and grand marnier.  Return to the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 40 - 50 minutes until thickened.  Check the seasoning and add more lemon juice if you feel necessary.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,lettuce,baby corn,red currant jelly,dark rum
title: Red Currant, Garlic or White Wine Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 head lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces ( or torn leaves of lettuce ) | 1 can baby corn, drained | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Mix together jelly, rum and sugar.  Toss with lettuce or spinach and refrigerate 30 to 45 minutes.  Top with the redcurrant dressing.

title: Tango Liqueur
ingredients: 1 cup ice, freshly cracked | 3 tablespoons kahlua or 3 tablespoons espresso liqueur | 1 teaspoon table salt | 2/3 teaspoon curry powder | 3 green cardamoms
instructions: Put everything in a coffee mug that has been crushed in the ice.  Stir it together and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,italian bread french,gruyere cheese,sherry,earl grey,filling
title: French Blankets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons freshly grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons minced earl grey or 2 tablespoons other hardwood earl grey | 1/2 lb uncooked lasagna noodle | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | filling, for filling
instructions: In small bowl, stir together sherry, 2 tablespoons cheese and minced earl grey.  Remove 1 sheet lasagna noodle sheet from package, and cut remaining sheets lengthwise into 1 strips.  Spread 1 tablespoon sherry over bottom and sides of a 12x13 inch pan with a brush and set aside.  Arrange 1 strip lengthwise at bottom of pan, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon cheese mixture, and spread with another strip of dough, and spread again with another 1 tablespoon of sherry.  Lay 2 strips lengthwise at top of cheese mixture, next with 1 strip lengthwise at top, and spread with last 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture.  Cover, and refrigerate up to 4 hours.  To prepare filling, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add remaining 1 tablespoon sherry, a few drops of water, and lasagna.  Cook for 6 minutes, or until pasta is al dente, and drain.  While lasagna is cooking, preheat broiler.  Slide 2 serrated knife lengthwise down through center of each strip of pasta.  Brush each piece of pasta with remaining sherry, and arrange on a baking sheet.  Broil until golden, then remove from oven and cut each into 4 pieces.  To serve, place an equal amount of filling on each lasagna piece, and roll, swiping with the tip of a sharp knife or toothpick.  Garnish with reserved toothpicks.

title: Pear and Cherry Jam
ingredients:
1 lb cherry, halved | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 lb pear, peeled and cut into 1.
    - 5 inch slices | 3 -4 tablespoons hot sauce ( sriracha hot sauce ) ( optional )
instructions: Place fruit in a large sealable plastic bag and sprinkle the top with salt.  Shake bag to mix pepper and salt.  Combine bag, fruit, and hot sauce in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high 4 - 5 hours.  When the first hour is up, use slotted spoon to remove fruit from bag.  Cool, transfer fruit to a food processor and process until smooth. title: Pasta With Chocolate and Rum
ingredients: 500 g quark | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 4 tablespoons light soy sauce | 455 g rotini pasta
instructions: Combine the quark with the other ingredients and cook in a pan until the ingredients are well blended.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for one hour.  If the mixture is not thick and creamy, return to heat to cook for 5 minutes before adding any extras except for the pasta.

title: Covered Star Anise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons capers | 3/4 cup pistachios | 1 1/2 teaspoons star anise
instructions: Put all ingredients into a small frying pan of a moderate oven.  Roast for 30 - 45 minutes, until just golden.  Remove from oven, cool completely on an absorbent paper and put in airtight jar.  Store away the air.

title: Chocolate and Asafoetida Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground flax seed meal | 2 1/2 cups short-grain rice, washed ( like arborio ) | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate, melted | 15 ounces sliced sliced mushrooms | 1 piece kielbasa, roughly chopped ( or link sausage ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 pinch aniseida powder ( optional ) | 1 small handful dried apricot, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large dutch oven cook flaxseed meal over high heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add the rice and cook for a few minutes more.  Add melted chocolate, mushrooms, kielbasa, asafoetida, and aniseed.  Stir to combine and cover.  Cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring twice.  Add enough boiling water to the dutch oven to come 1/4 inch up the side.  Cover the pot and cook over medium heat for an additional 15 minutes.  Remove cover, raise heat to medium and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until the top of the rice and pudding are hot and beginning to brown nicely.  Remove from heat and allow to stand for 15 minutes.  Fluff rice with a fork and garnish with dried apricots.

title: Cabbage Relish
ingredients: 1 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/4 head white cabbage
instructions: Cut the top off the cabbage, remove the leaves, and place in a large saucepan.  Cover with water and bring to a boil.  Cook for 1 minute over medium heat, then place in the refrigerator to cool down.

title: Hot Crab Ceviche
ingredients: 1 lb fresh crabmeat | 1/2 of a mushroom, sliced ( if a small amount of mushrooms are listed above use as desired )
instructions: Place the crabmeat on a plate, pour boiling water over it and let it sit in there for at least 20 minutes. .  After the crab is sitting you can prepare the mushroom.  Cut the mushroom and put it on the crab or eat your imagination.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,irish cream,tequila,french bread,monterey jack cheese,ice water,star anise,baking soda
title: Fondue for Fondue

instructions: Pour enough ice water into a large pan to cover the bottom, about 2 inches deep, and boil the salt to remove some of the excess salt.  Add the star anise and baking soda, then whisk in about 1/2 cup of the rye flour to the water and bring to a soft boil.  Remove from the heat, stir in the bread, parmigiano reggiano, and cheeses, and set aside.  Melt the remaining 1 1/2 cups of ice water in a large skillet.  Pour into the skillet the bread mixture, then stir to coat the bread with a coating of the syrup.  Heat to a boil, then let boil for about 3 minutes or until the topping is just beginning to set.  Serve with a spoonful or two of irish stout beer to dip into.

title: Jalapeno Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 3 -4 jalapenos, seeded, chopped | 2 -3 packages cranberries, halved | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Put jalapeno, cranberries, and parsley in a medium saucepan and cook on medium high heat for about 5 minutes.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minute.  Remove from heat.

title: Korma Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped chili | 1 tablespoon finely chopped mixed salad dressing | 300 g shucked oysters
instructions: Place the parsley in a pestle and mortar with the icing sugar and finely chopped chilli.  Place in a small bowl and pour over the dressing.  Add half the oysters and stir to combine.  Allow to marinate for a few minutes at room temperature, then serve on salad plates with the remaining oysters.

title: Furitas
ingredients: 4 quarts fresh quinoa, rinsed thoroughly
instructions: To prepare quinoa, pour out a few quarts cold water and soak the quinoa in it for a few hours until all water goes from the quinoa.  Rinse off the water and dry the quinoa with paper towels.  In a large stockpot, bring 4 quarts of water to a boil.  Add the quinoa and return to a boil.  Turn the heat so the water boils slowly.  Boil for 15 minutes, then remove the quinoa with a slotted spoon and place in a platter.  Cover so the quinoa is fully submerged.  Set aside for about 20 minutes, then fluff with a fork.  Serve with fritos.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,lime peel,bartlett pear,chorizo sausage,heavy whipping cream,ginger juice,kielbasa
title: Chorizo With Noodles and Grilled Pears
ingredients: 6 ounces kielbasa, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices 1/2-inch thick ( sweet italian sausage, casing removed ) | 1/4 cup lemon zest | 1/4 cup lime peel, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1/4 cup ginger juice | 2 tablespoons fresh cherries, halved | 1/8 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 bartlett pear, peeled, cored, and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: To prepare the noodles, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat.  Add the noodles and cook until barely tender, about 4 minutes.  Transfer to a large, deep platter or pasta bowl.  Let cool completely.  Meanwhile, prepare the grill.  To prepare the grill, sprinkle the kielbasa, zest, lime peel, ginger juice, cherries, and cream on both sides of each slice of kielbasa.  Spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray and set aside.  Preheat the grill and set the barbecue rack about 5 inches from the heat.  Grill the kielbasa on the rack until heated through and starting to crisp, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Transfer to the platter or pasta bowl and top with grilled pears.  Serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Chunky Swissede Chips

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the swede, return to the boil, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Discard the tips and fiber.  Dip the swede pieces into the espresso powder and allow to soak for a minute or two.  Add the port and corn chips and stir to combine.  Garnish with a sprinkle of sage.

instructions: In a small pan, toast the walnuts in oil over medium heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Stir together the cocoa, oregano, and coconut flakes in a medium bowl.  Add the hazelnuts and hazelnuts to the nuts and nuts and toss.  Spoon bean mixture into a 1 quart microwavable dish.  Cook rice, covered, in microwave on high just until heated through, about 5 minutes.

instructions: Heat the oil on medium.  Place the oil in a small pan.  Add the onion and simmer until the onion is translucent. instructions: Whisk peanut butter, dijon mustard, mexican wine, beer, cocoa, and salt in a small bowl.  Add cilantro and stir to combine.

instructions: In bowl, mix all ingredients together with hands. .  Roll mixture into 3 balls and then press into 2 circles on baking sheet.  Flatten each circle with the palm of your hand. instructions: Place spinach leaves, water, pimientos, chile oil, and molasses in a bowl, stir well.  Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap or plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Drain vegetables well.

instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  While the water is heating, put the noodles into a large strainer. instructions: In a large non stick skillet, cook the beef, green pepper and tomatoes with juice over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until meat is well browned and vegetables are tender.  Dissolve cornmeal in 1/2 cup of the beef broth.  Add to the meat mixture and stir until mixture thickens and comes to a boil.  Transfer the mixture to a fondue pot and slow warm over moderately low heat.  Transfer the fondue to a crockpot, cover and set on high heat.  Serve fondue with french bread slices and grated cheese as accompaniments.  To make beef fondue, in a 3 - 6 quart crockpot, combine the beef, pepper, tomato and cornmeal mixture.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 6 - 8 hours or until heated through.  Transfer to serving bowls and serve with fondue forks as accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,white wine,turmeric,turnip,thyme leaf,lemon peel,dinner,lettuce leaf
title: Dinner-Tunisian Stuffed Turnips
ingredients: 4 turnips, washed | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 8 -10 fresh thyme leaves | 3 tablespoons white sweet wine | 2 tablespoons chopped lemon peel | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 8 pieces dinner rolls ( or dinner rolls if you're lazy like me ) ( optional ) | lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c.  Scrub turnips, place them in a colander in a large bowl.  Cover with cold water and soak until softened, about 15 minutes, meanwhile, mix together the ricotta, thyme, sugar, turmeric and lemon peel in a medium bowl.  Cut a small, round, slice off top of a roll with a sharp knife.  Fill the roll with the ricotta mixture and place a slice of bread over the top to make a sandwich.  Squeeze a little water out of the turnips with your hands then slice in half.  Arrange the turnips, cut side down in a greased ovenproof, ovenproof dish.  Drizzle with the olive oil and brown a few dumplings for 10 minutes.  Put half of the bread on a chopping board, scatter with the turnip then a little of the thyme mix, then another 1/2 of the bread and then another couple of turnips.  Repeat, finishing with a little thyme mix.  The finished dish should resemble a big house with about 5 layers of bread, then top with lettuce.  Dinner rolls, spread the rolls with a little olive oil and sprinkle with turmeric, then add remaining bread.  Cut rolls in half and serve immediately.

title: Tortilla Espagnole
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1/2 package hard salami, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring it to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti sauce, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has cooked through, but is still slightly chunky, about 10 minutes.  Drain.  In a bowl, mix the salami and hot spaghetti sauce until evenly dispersed into the sauce.  Place a large serving platter on top of the tortillas.  Pour the hot and spicy mixture into the center of the platter.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,mustard powder,black pepper,cocoa powder,pistachio nut
title: Afghani (Afghani Dessert)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh greek yogurt | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Stir together the yogurt, cocoa powder, mustard powder, and black pepper in a bowl.  Top with pistachio nuts.  Chill in refrigerator 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,cherry tomato,butternut squash,corn cob,pork,pinto bean,malt vinegar,ramen noodle
title: Cajun Pork and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 2 whole corn on the cob, shucked | 3 ears fresh sweet corn on the cob | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 10 whole pitted cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons crushed buttery salt-free red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup diced, cooked pork | 1/2 cup diced butternut squash, cooked
instructions: Prepare ramen noodles and set aside.  Place 4 whole corn kernels on the cob.  Scrub the corn from the cobs under running water, and set aside.  Place the cajun shucked corn on the cob in a pan with the sweet corn and the sweet corn kernels.  Drizzle with the malt vinegar and sprinkle with the crushed red pepper.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.  Dice the grilled sweet corn kernels and set aside.  Combine buttery salt in a small dish and set aside.  Remove cajun pork from the bones, cutting into short thin bite size pieces.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Place the ramen noodles in the pot, turn off heat and let the noodles sit in boiling water for 3 minutes, or they will become mushy.  Drain and place in a salad bowl.  Arrange the hot ramen noodles on top of the noodles.  Scatter the diced tomatoes, roasted sweet corn and diced pork over the noodles.  Serve with chopped butternut squash and sour cream if desired.

title: Cherry Nori Sushi Roll
ingredients: 6 sheets nori | 4 cherry rolls
instructions: Cut a slit down the length of each nori sheet.  Cut a 1/2 inch vein from the bottom of the nori sheet, so it can be removed later.  Place 2 nori sheets at a time in a pan, using a rolling pin to flatten each sheet.  Spread a 2 to 3 tbls.  Amount of cherry on each bottom of the roll.  Roll the nori sheet up around the filling, making sure the nori is completely stuffed by the fruit.  Press the roll with a rolling pin to make a roll with short ends on all sides.  Repeat with the rest of the nori sheets.  Preheat an empty pan over medium high heat and press each roll with the flat of a knife so the rolls are flat.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,caster sugar,coleslaw mix,head cauliflower,prune,beef rib
title: Rib Beef With Coleslaw and Prunes
ingredients: 500 g beef ribs, trimmed and cut into serving pieces | 1 bunch coleslaw mix | 1/2 small head cauliflower, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup rioly grated coleslaw with caraway seeds | 1/2 large pitted prune | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( i used a british version of regular white wine ) | 1 tbsp caster sugar
instructions: Heat a heavy based frying pan, add beef with small bits of fat and fry until brown on all sides, then add salad vegetables and continue frying until beef is halfway cooked.  Stir through rice wine and caster sugar.  Season with salt and pepper to taste and scatter with prunes.  Serve with plain boiled or steamed french or italian style bread.  This dish can be made in advance, reheated, covered and kept chilled.

title: Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 16 ounces beer, your choice | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 package jumbo pasta shells, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chili, chili powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Pour 1 cup beer into a dutch oven over medium heat.  If you are using other types of beer, you may want to add more or less at a time to get the full flavor of the beer when baking.  Add the diced tomatoes with green chiles, green chilies, and chili powder to the pan.  Cook stirring frequently until the beer has reduced to about 3/4 or more.  When the tomatoes have reduced to about 3/4 cup, measure out the remaining beer and add to the pot stirring well to help thicken the rest of the beer into the sauce.  Turn the heat up to medium high and bring the sauce to a bubble.  Add the uncooked jumbo pasta shells, 1/4 cup pistachios, and chili powder to the sauce.  Stir until they are coated with the sauce.  Turn off the heat and serve.

title: Easy and Delicious Vietnamese Radish and Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch white radish, sliced thinly cross-wise | 1 fresh chili pepper flakes, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon simple syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the radishes in a serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,vermouth,heavy whipping cream,salad oil,flat leaf parsley,thai basil,garlic granule
title: Saffron Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream with herbs, at room temperature | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth ( such as chardonnay ) | 1/2 teaspoon roasted garlic granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ground thai basil | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/2 teaspoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, leaves shredded or chopped
instructions: Using an electric mixer, beat the cream, vermouth, garlic granules, basil, and saffron in a large bowl until thick, about 3 minutes.  Slowly pour the heavy cream into the bowl and beat well.  Strain into a fine sieve and discard the solids.  In a small skillet, heat the oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and cook the saffron mixture, stirring, until syrupy, 2 to 4 minutes.  Stir in the parsley.

title: Naranjas-Style Salami (Fennel and Garlic) from Vij's
ingredients: 6 -10 fennel seeds, crushed ( or to taste ) | 10 -12 lettuce leaves ( or to taste )
instructions: Pierce the head of the fennel bulb in 3 or 4 places using a vegetable peeler or a sharp knife, being careful not to pierce the outer coating.  If you wish to crush the fennel seeds, you can do so by grinding lightly with a mortar and pestle.  Tie the leaves into bundles of similar sized pieces, such as potatoes, tomatoes or cucumbers.  Place the fennel in a microwave safe dish and microwave on high for 3 or 4 minutes.  They should be just softened enough to be patted dry.  If they are slightly softer and more tender, microwave for 2 more minutes.  Remove the fennel from the microwave and rub it with your hands or a spoon or similar.  Allow to cool.  When cool enough to handle, scrape off the hard outer coating of the fennel.  Cut into about 1 1/2 to 2 portions, depending on size and shape.  To serve, cut each piece into about 4 or 5 pieces and gently roll each piece in the fennel and serve.

title: Easy Ziti With Veal and Ricotta
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 cup of shredded ricotta cheese | 4 tablespoons butter
instructions: Brown ground veal with salt and pepper on a large frying pan with a little water.  This will give you time to saute the ziti pasta.  Cook the ziti on a large pan along with a medium amount of butter, according to package directions, until al dente, but still chewy.  Drain the pasta and let it rest in a bowl covered with some more cold water and a teaspoon of salt.  Toss the ziti with the ricotta cheese in a large bowl to coat.  Add the ground veal and a little more of the butter if the mixture is too dry.

title: Italian Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups tarts crushed tart apples | 4 pounds pork tenderloins, cut into 12 slices | 1 pound uncooked spaghetti sauce | 1 pound fresh asparagus - rinsed, trimmed and chopped | 2 slices pepperoni
instructions: In small baking pan, mix 3 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast with 3 cups crushed tomatoes, then mix in pork slices.  Let stand 5 minutes or so, then drain.  Place bread slices on a baking sheet, then cover to let bread dry overnight at room temperature.  In the morning, spread bread slices with remaining 2 teaspoons dry yeast mixture, then turn the slices over so they are thoroughly coated.  Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread asparagus, sauce, and cheese slices on baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,hot red pepper flake,bicarbonate soda,enchilada sauce,peanut butter,pepper,anise seed
title: Mock Satay Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces ramen noodles | 4 ounces peanut butter | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon curry soda | 1 pinch hot red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place noodles in boiling water and boil for 2 minutes.  Drain.  Return noodles to pot and mash with peanut butter, enchilada sauce, curry soda, hot pepper or if preferred, bicarbonate of soda.

title: Lebanese Beef Balls
ingredients: 1 lb chopped beef | 1 cup cracked cracker crumb | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 green pepper ( sliced in wedges )
instructions: Combine the beef, crackers, ginger garlic paste, and black pepper to make into balls about the size of a golf ball.  Put a little meat mixture on the bottom end of each ball and add either a green pepper slices or some chopped vegetables.  Roll meat in the cracker crumbs to coat.  Serve with hot cooked basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,rigatoni pasta,red chili powder,hot green chili pepper,yeast,red chile,lemongrass
title: Chilli Artellar
ingredients: 100 g fresh yeast | 200 g hot green chili peppers, finely chopped | 20 g red chile, finely chopped | 150 g baby spinach leaves | 1/2 small red chile, finely chopped | 1/2 small lemongrass, finely chopped | 300 g rigatoni pasta, prepared as per directions
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 2 tablespoons warm water, stir in the green chillppers, chili, baby red chillies, and lemon grass.  Cover with a tea towel and leave to froth for 10 minutes until dough begins to form.  Remove from the heat, punch down and divide into 8 pieces.  Working on a floured surface, roll out into a long rectangle, 18 x 12 cm.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  On a lightly floured surface place the spinach leaves, red chilies, sliced lemongrass, and pinch of red chilies into a bowl, add the dough and toss to combine.  Place on top of the baking sheet, free from the draft and let rest for 45 minutes.  Pre heat oven to 200°c using a vegetable peeler, gently peel the dough out of the baking sheet onto a floured surface.  Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle, 18 x 16 cm.  Spread the dough with spinach and roll out into a cylinder that has been peeled and sliced into long strips.  Place on the baking sheet, free from the draft and let rest for 15 minutes.  Cook pasta according to the instructions on pack, drain, and remove baking sheet.  Place the sliced noodles on a serving platter, drizzle evenly with the hot sauce and garnish with chopped chillies.

title: Chilean Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons catsup ( sweetened vegemite or vanilla ) | 4 ounces cream cheese | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon agave nectar | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Pour catsup and honey into a small mixing bowl and stir vigorously.  Add cardamon and gradually incorporate cream cheese, until mixture starts to form peaks.  Place cream cheese into plastic zipper bag, add the cocoa, and snip off an corner of bag containing the cream cheese into the creamcheese.  Add cream cheese into a glass pie plate or serving dish.  Garnish with fresh green cardamom pods and a sprinkle of chocolate shavings.

Random Ingredients: sage,apple,romaine lettuce,bacon bit,rosemary,french bread dough,french bread,vegetable broth
title: Apple Filled Romaine Bread
ingredients: 5 cups romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 1 jar bacon bits | 2 cups leftover french bread dough, warmed | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 apple, very thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons dried sage | 3 tablespoons rosemary, minced | 1 loaf unsliced french bread, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place torn romaine romaine in a baking dish.  Sprinkle with bacon bits.  Combine bread with vegetable broth, apple, sage and rosemary.  Bake until golden brown, about 30 minutes.  To serve, slice french bread lengthwise.

title: Ravioli and Cheese Raviolis
ingredients: 1 cup warm water | 2 packages yeast | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon spices | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 12 ounces cheese ravioli | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Combine raisins, spices and tabasco.  Add 2/3 of spice mix to yeast solution and stir until smooth.  Stir in remaining spice.  Pour 1/3 of oil over dough.  Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until doubled in volume, about 60 minutes.  Drain ravioli and add to the dough.  Toss 2 minutes.  Brush oil on top and sprinkle with the remaining spice mix.  Bake at 350 for 25 minutes, turn over and bake about 8 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,lemon extract,cheese tortellini,garam masala,beef bouillon cube,orange zest,bread,red chile
title: Tortellini With Shredded Beef and Red Chile Flavours
ingredients: 500 g cheese tortellini, drained ( tortellini ) | 200 g roasted red chiles, chopped | 1/2 cup grated mild gouda cheese | 1/4 cup grated cheese flavored gouda cheese | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/8 teaspoon dried aniseed, ground | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Cook the tortellini in boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Put the tortellini in a bowl, add the red chillies, cheeses, orange zest, lemon extract, anise and beef base. title: Rhubarb and Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb | sugar, to taste | 1 lb yellow onion ( sliced ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 baguette
instructions: Trim the rhubarb into medium fine pieces and then cut into small pieces.  Bring water to boil in a medium sized kettle and add the rhubarb and onion.  When soup returns to boil, lower heat and simmer for 1 hour.  Transfer contents of soup to blender and puree till smooth.  Remove from heat and pass through a fine sieve or sieve.  Pour into bowl and then stir in enough sugar to bring to a boil and heat till sugar is dissolved.  Cut baguette into 6 slices and toss slices through soup.  Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Corn Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 and 1/2-inch cubes | 4 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon coconut, shredded
instructions: Cook potatoes and brisket in boiling water to cover 7 to 10 minutes, or until just tender and lightly browned.  Cool and shred meat.  Sprinkle with curry paste and coconut.

title: Simple English Parsnips
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, peeled and diced | 1 -2 small red onion, peeled and chopped | 2 teaspoons black pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Prepare the onion and parsnip in boiling water for 5 minutes or until soft.  Drain well.  Add the pepper and mix well.

title: Cottage Cheese Baked Sweet Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 cups chopped fresh pineapple | 1 tablespoon packed dark brown sugar | 1 small chicken bouillon cube | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons orange peel, grated | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the pineapple, brown sugar, chicken bouillon, chile, and pepper in a large roasting pan.  Combine.  Place the orange peel and cottage cheese in a food processor.  Process until smooth.  Spread half of the pineapple mixture in the pan over the pineapple.  Top with half the cheese mixture, drizzle remaining pineapple.  Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: grain bread,brown rice,laurel leaf,ricotta cheese,russet potato,vanilla bean,orzo pasta,almond
title: Spanish orzo with orzo and rinds
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 1/4 cup brown rice, rinsed in cold water | 1 lb medium russet potato | 1/2 vanilla bean | 4 teaspoons dried lulita leaves | 1 whole grain bread | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add orzo and cook uncovered until al dente, about 9 minutes.  Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid.  Meanwhile, coarsely chop the potato and set aside.  Slice the vanilla bean lengthwise and scrape out the vanilla bean.  Place the bean in a small skillet over medium heat, and warm just until beginning to smoke.  Remove from heat, and set aside.  When the water boils, add orzo.  Cook, covered, until the orzo is tender and has turned a dark brown color, about 15 minutes.  Toss the rice and potato in a large bowl with 4 teaspoons of dried lulita.  Cover, and set aside.  Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, and grease with butter.  Spread the orzo mixture evenly onto the baking sheet, and cover with a lid.  Transfer to the oven, and bake until the top has turned golden brown and the orzo has absorbed most of the moisture, about 20 minutes.  Let cool slightly.  Using a fork, scrape and remove the vanilla bean from the inside of the bean.  Split the vanilla up the back into one half, and scrap out the seeds and strings, removing any fibers that form on the surface.  Place these seeds in a small bowl with all of the orzo and the reserved cooking liquid.  Stir the mixture to combine.  Slice the bread into chunks, and toss into the bowl with the orzo mixture.  Add the ricotta, 1 whole whole whole head, almonds, vanilla bean seeds, and 1 teaspoon dried lulita leaves.  Taste, and adjust the salt if necessary.  Let sit for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Squash with a Nutty Crumb
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash | 1/2 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Wash the squash, remove the seed, cut in half lengthwise, then cut each half into slices.  Stem the halves.  Toss the squash with the nutty crumbs and grill until lightly browned and tender, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,salami,bread flour,green chilies,flour tortilla,ricotta cheese
title: Salami & Chilli Flatbread
ingredients: 250 g salami, thinly sliced | vegetable oil, for deep frying | 250 g ricotta cheese | 1 cup fresh bread flour | 1/2 cup green chilies, finely chopped | 4 gluten free flour tortillas
instructions: Heat oil in pan on medium high.  Dip one tortilla in oil, remove and drain.  Spread 1/4 cup of ricotta cheese over the base of two serving platters.  Layer with half of the salami slices.  Repeat with another tortilla, cheese and salami.  Spread half of the mozzarella over tortillas.  Spread the remaining ricotta cheese over the mozzarella.  Repeat for the remaining ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or for up to 2 hours.  Preheat oven to 210c.  When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator.  Cut into 4 wedges.

title: Carob Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon carob powder
instructions: Combine mustard and carob powder in a small bowl.  Microwave 2 - 3 minutes or until smooth.  Cool completely.  Transfer to clean jar and refrigerate 2 - 3 days.

title: Choc Chicken Tzatziki
ingredients: 1/2 pound chicken breast tenders | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup tzatziki | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and tough ends snapped off
instructions: Combine chicken and cumin in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Pesto Roasted Butternut Squash With Ham and Ham
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 2 sprigs rosemary sprigs | 16 slices ham ( about 4 ounces total ) | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 large pinch cardamom seed | 3 ounces canned sliced peaches | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the squash on a baking tray and bake for 50 minutes, or until it collapses easily.  Shred the squash with your hands and remove the skin.  Slice the squash into 1/4 strips.  Place the ham and a good pinch of salt in a large non stick frying pan over medium heat.  Add the pesto.  Cook and stir until it comes to the boil and is beginning to brown.  Add the cardamom and continue to cook and stir until it has darkened in colour.  Add the squash and fry for about 5 minutes.  Add the peaches and warm through, about 3 minutes, until piping hot.  Serve sprinkled with remaining pesto, garnished with rosemary sprigs if desired.

title: Shirley's Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen stir fry vegetables | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped turnip | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large pot over high heat, stirring occasionally.  Bring to boil and lower heat, simmering for 5 - 6 minutes until spinach is tender.  Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Irish Tea
ingredients: 6 cups brewed tea | 1/2 cup sweet potato, diced | 1/2 cup sweet pepper, diced
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat, stir the brewed tea and sweet potato together until heated through and flavors blend, about 5 minutes.  Cool to room temperature, then serve.

title: Spicy Sweet Beef on Pineapple & Spicy Hot Sauce(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef brisket, fat trimmed and cut into large pieces | 1/3 cup chili powder | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 can beef consomme or ( 15 ounce ) can soup cans beef broth ( undiluted ) | 1 package spaghetti, cooked according to package directions ( spaghetti or angel hair pasta ) | 1 bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine beef and chili powder in 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker.  Stir in pineapple, can of consomme and spaghetti.  Cover and cook on high 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is very tender.  Sprinkle bell pepper and serve over hot cooked spaghetti if desired.

title: Magic Nanaimo
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut cream, sweetened | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1/2 teaspoon guacamole, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a blender.

title: Quick Lemon & Sage
ingredients: 10 leaves fresh sage | 2 teaspoons lemon zest
instructions: Cut the sage leaves crosswise in half and remove the stalks.  Trim the stalks to one or two long slivers.  In a medium sized glass or porcelain bowl, combine the sage, lemon zest, and a few drops of olive oil, and toss well.  Set aside at least an hour.  Serve.

title: Wild Rice and Noodles Recipe
ingredients: 1 pint cooked wild rice | 1 package rice noodles
instructions: Place wild rice into a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil and then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until wild rice is cooked and tender.  Remove from heat and set aside, covered, for 10 minutes to allow wild rice to absorb the flavors.  Meanwhile, boil a large pot of water.  Add rice noodles and cook until tender but firm.  Drain and rinse with cool water to remove all the starch.  Drain noodles well.  Place rice noodles onto a serving dish, top with wild rice and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Leek Omelet
ingredients: 2 boxes fresh spinach leaves | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 leek, sliced into thin rings | 3/4 teaspoon oregano | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 3 eggs
instructions: In a small pot, combine the spinach, onion and leek slices.  Set over medium low heat and cook, stirring frequently, until they’re slightly caramelized, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Add the oregano and lemon juice.  Remove from the heat.  In a medium bowl, beat the butter until fluffy.  In a larger bowl, whisk the eggs.  Then, with a wire whisk, slowly stir 3 tablespoons water into the egg mixture.  Gradually whisk the egg mixture into the onion and spinach mixture, and transfer to a small, nonstick frying pan.  Spread cooked omelet into a circle measuring around 6 inches in diameter.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,tequila,black eyed pea,pecan,rotel,chicken wing,pepitas,vegetable broth
title: Beer Can Chicken & Pecans
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, cut at joints | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can pepitas, cut up ( corn flakes ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/4 cup pepitas, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt.  In dutch oven, combine chicken, vegetable broth, tomato sauce, pepitas, and black eyed peas.  Bring to boiling.

title: Faux Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces soft bread | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon sage leaf, dried
instructions: Preheat oven to gas 3.  Wrap bread in foil and place on a baking tray.  Bake in oven for 8 - 10 minutes, until soft.  Remove foil, add mustard seeds and sage and mix well, coating bread with spice mixture.  Cool bread out and slice.  Hear oven to 250°f.  Using a shallow glass bowl, toast bread on both sides.  Keep warm in the oven.  Variations, toast bread 1 hour before adding remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: pecan,sherry wine vinegar,bamboo skewer,broccoli floret,grain rice,lemon orange

ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans | 1 bag broccoli florets, stems removed | 4 cups cooked long-grain rice ( preferably jasmine rice ) | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 loaf round unsliced grain bread or 3 pieces unsliced rye bread
instructions: Toast pecans in a single layer over medium heat, stirring for 1 minute.  Transfer pecans to a plate as soon as they begin to cool.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,white fish fillet,mayonnaise,cornflour,habanero pepper
title: Ceviche of Poached Cod
ingredients: 400 g white fish fillets, thawed and cubed | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 habanero pepper, deseeded and finely chopped, for topping | 8 jumbo pasta shells
instructions: Combine fish, 1/2 cup mayonnaise and cornflour to make a paste.  Place fish in a casserole dish and sprinkle with some chilli.  Bake at 180c for 40 minutes, or until the fish is crisp and lightly browned, and sauce is thick.  Toss pasta bowls with remaining ingredients and serve with fish.  Suggestion, serve with salad and hot sauce if desired for a thicker dish.

title: Pumpkin Turnips (Pilze)

instructions: Peel turnips and turnips and cut them in to small pieces.  Put in a skillet with a little oil, a little salt and anchovy oil and bake in low oven for 45 minutes until tender.

title: Simple Mocha Espresso
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces coffee, brew chilled | tomatoes, diced tomatoes, for garnishing
instructions: Add the coffee to a mug or glass.  Add the tomatoes and stir gently.  Pour the mug/glass into a microwaveable bowl.

title: Indonesian Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1 lamb ( leg or shoulder ) | 1/4 tablespoon dry mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 -5 radishes, thinly sliced lengthwise | 8 scallions, sliced thinly | 1/2 lb snow peas
instructions: Cut lamb into thin slices and place on a rack in a shallow casserole or baking dish.  Sprinkle lamb with dry herbs, salt, and cover with hot water.  Turning pieces so that all sides get soaked in the liquid.  Cover the casserole and marinate overnight.  The next day remove lamb from fridge 15 minutes before cooking and rinse well with fresh water.  Cover lamb and chill thoroughly.  Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Line oven safe baking sheet with foil paper or a lid with aluminum foil.  In a serving dish, arrange snow peas in a horizontal layer, then arrange the radishes on top.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,ice cube,lamb chop,thyme leaf,enchilada sauce,grain white rice
title: Quick and Easy Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 frozen stew boneless lamb chops, thawed | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 cups long grain white rice | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | ice cube
instructions: Add the stew to a large skillet and add the enchilada sauce.  You may want a few to add more enchilada sauce and to get those flavors together.  Stir and cover.  Turn on the heat to low and marinate for 1 hour.  When meat mixture is done, set aside the meat and set aside in a separate dish.  Meanwhile, in the same skillet, add the rice and stir and cook 3 - 5 minutes, or until coated with pan spray.  Add the chicken bouillon, thyme, garlic powder, and dried thyme.  Mix, and cook about 3 minutes, remove from heat and set aside to cool some as you prepare the meat for frying.  When meat has cooled enough, slice the meat into 1/4 inch strips.  You may need to keep meat in the freezer to make it convenient for frying.  In a skillet over medium high heat, add a few tablespoons of the meat cooking marinade and fry until golden brown, about 1 minute.  Stir often to avoid burning, and serve hot.

title: My Polish Easter Eggs
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 1 lb frozen kielbasa, cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch slices ( i've sub turkey sausage instead ) | 1 can ready-to-use spaghetti sauce | celery rib, slices
instructions: Cook sausage until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.  Drain and cut sausage into ¼ inch to ¾ inch pieces.  Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until done, about 10 minutes.  Drain.  While pasta is cooking, whisk egg whites with a fork until well blended.  Add sausage, pasta, and spaghetti sauce.  Heat thoroughly until pasta and sauce are hot, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve at once.

title: Pecan Galician Squares
ingredients: 1 cup toasted pecans, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs gruyere | 1 1/2 cups finely grated fresh zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh lemon zest | 2 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped galangal | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Lightly butter a 9 inch square baking dish.  Finely grind pecans in a food processor or blender.  Transfer pecans to a medium bowl.  Crumble 1/2 pound gruyere into a medium bowl.  Add pecans, 2 1/2 cups zest, lemon zest, galangal, and vanilla.  Mix well.  Scrape into prepared baking dish, press down lightly with a spoon.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 pound gruyere, and bake until golden brown, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,baby arugula,peanut butter,red chilies,chicken stock cube,daikon radish,lasagna noodle,cream chicken soup
title: Thai Chicken Lasagne Soup
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti | 100 g daikon radishes | 300 g baby arugula | 3 -4 small red hot chilies | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 chicken stock cubes or 1 vegetable stock cube | 50 g crunchy peanut butter | salt and red chilies, to taste
instructions: Start by boiling water, add salt to water, pasta and boiling vegetables, cook for 15 – 20 minutes, until pasta is al dente.  Drain pasta and vegetables.  Pour soup into separate pan and begin to heat while adding peanut butter.  Simmer a few minutes until smooth and creamy.  Add chicken stocks and peanut butter, heat and serve hot with rice, noodles, pasta, veggies, bread etc.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
ingredients: 5 cups rhubarb, cut in chunks | 2 cups plain flour | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius.  Coat a large baking tray with cooking oil spray.  Tip theRhubarb into a large bowl and place on the tray and sprinkle with the grated cheese.  Toss to combine until evenly coated.  Place in the oven and bake for 40 - 50 minutes or until the rhubarb is tender.  Serve warm with kerrygold biscuits, or savoury cream.

title: Rice-Aubergine (Rice and Vegetables) Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups arborio rice or 1 1/4 cups carnaroli rice | 2 small eggplants, cut into 1/4-inch cubes ( the thinner the cubes the better ) | 1 1/3 cups dried fruit, such as grape tomatoes, apricots, cherries, dates, figs, prunes, sultanas, figs, cranberries, figs, currants, and apricots ( use any dried fruit that may not be available ) | 6 tablespoons fruit juice ( see note ) | hot sauce ( optional ) | vegetables of choice, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Spread rice into a single layer in dish.  Sprinkle eggs over rice, then arrange vegetables evenly over.  Cover loosely with foil.  Bake 55 - 60 minutes, or until golden brown.  Meanwhile, combine fruit juice with hot sauce to taste, about 1/4 cup per serving.  Serve with rice and hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,queso fresco,green capsicum,tarragon,marsala wine,beef brisket,sesame seed
title: Soy and Herb Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 100 g chesse, chinese ( shiitake, any flavour you like ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 3 tablespoons beef and vegetable broth or 3 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 green capsicum, cut into 5 pieces ( red bell pepper ) | 2 -3 slices of rindless cheese, such as gruyere or 2 -3 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat the smoker and lightly grease the grill.  Scatter the sesame seeds all over the brisket, and sprinkle with the tarragon.  Wear a piece of foil large enough to completely wrap around the brisket as your smoke starts to smoke.  Place the brisket on the foil, and put lid on the smoker.  Cook on the low setting, or on high for 5 hours.  Leave in a warm place for up to 3 or 4 hours.  Cut the brisket into smallerish and thicker slices, depending on how hungry you are.  Place in a bowl, cover with the broth and leave overnight.  This can be done the night before, but the next morning you can just leave the smoker on, or leave it all night at room temperature, or leave the brisket in the afternoon to get a little crusty.  You can put the brisket back into the smoker, reheat and serve it on the side.

Random Ingredients: nori,fennel,pea,chinese five spice powder,italian seasoning,vegetable bouillon cube,chive
title: Chinese 5 Pepper Snacks
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 4 slices pickled fennel | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 4 teaspoons italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | nori
instructions: Defrost peas, and pat dry with paper towels.  Arrange peas, fennel, chive, five spice, and italian seasoning in 12x6x3 glass baking dish.  Add bouillon in thin layer, and cover with plastic wrap, sealing plastic tightly.  Microwave on high power until bouillon cube is almost all solid in the center, 8 to 9 minutes.  Stir, cover, and microwave 30 seconds longer, or until peas are hot and bubbly.  Let stand 5 minutes before removing plastic wrap.  Cut into squares.

title: Cannellinni Cake (Tortellini Bean Cake)
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans | 2 cups self-rising flour | 4 tablespoons coconut oil, or as needed
instructions: Place the cannellini beans in a bowl and cover with a cup of water.

title: Fresh Tomato Jam
ingredients: 16 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 8 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 24 chicken wings
instructions: Place the roma tomatoes in a large glass bowl and drizzle with olive oil.  Sprinkle turbinado sugar over the tomatoes.  Cover tightly and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours, tossing occasionally.  Preheat oven to 1/3 of an inch warmer than the oven's middle rack.  Place the chicken wings in a roasting pan.  Toss tomatoes and sugar in a baking pan.  Cook, shaking the pan occasionally, until the sugar is evenly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Quick Passover Manicotti
ingredients: 1 package manicotti or ( 16 ounce ) package jumbo manicotti | 1 jar date-stuffed dried dates | 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine
instructions: Place noodles in a 5 qt dutch oven, and fill with enough water to cover.

title: Indian Marinated Salmon (Low Fat and Low Salt)
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 lbs skinless salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat grill.  In a small bowl, stir together garam masala and salt.

title: Mellow Mocha
ingredients: 1 1/2 fluid ounces coffee liqueur | 1/8 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 lime
instructions: Squeeze the lime into a shaker and pour in the coffee liqueur.  Shake sharply until the liqueur is fully dissolved.  Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with a lime wheel.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,honey,penne,broth,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Broken Mozzarella Penne With Honey
ingredients: 1 package penne | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon grated ibaqirra el hanout spice mix | 3 -4 cups chicken stock or 3 -4 cups broth | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Boil or steam the pasta as directed.  While the pasta is cooking, warm 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet for 2 minutes on medium high heat.  Add the rest of the ingredients to the skillet, stir.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Toss with toasted pasta.  Serve hot.

title: Mashed Rice With Cheddar and Dried Dried Pimento
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 small celery rib, finely chopped | 2 small pimientos, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary, crushed | 2 tablespoons old cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Put the rice into a heated frying pan and cook over a moderate heat, shaking the pan so none of the heat is burning, until the rice begins to turn pale brown, 6 to 8 minutes.  Add the catsup, cream, celery, pimentos and rosemary to the rice and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,grape,ice cube,cinnamon,french bread,lemon juice zest,broccoli,beef brisket
title: Grape Broth
ingredients: 1 medium head of trimmed cooked beef brisket | 2 quarts of steamed broccoli | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 3 -4 tablespoons lime juice, see notes | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, see notes | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | whole grapes | 2 -3 cups ice cubes or 2 -3 cups cubed french bread
instructions: To make marinade, stir together all marinade ingredients in large ziploc bag, add brisket and seal.  Let stand overnight.  Grill over hot coals or roast in broiler or grill as directed on the package.  The meat also tastes better if cooked as follows, cut into serving pieces, place in crockpot and pour marinade over meat and vegetables.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 4 - 6 hours, until meat is very tender.  Serve on bed of rice or with crusty rolls.  Note, i use an old fashioned pan that i like to soak my rice in for a few hours or overnight, then cut it for my lunch at lunch time.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,worcestershire sauce,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Pepperjack Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise.  Spread each half with pepperjack cheese and worcestershire sauce.  Place on pan in oven, and bake at 350 degrees farenheit for about 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Lakskender Cream Sauce

instructions: In a jar, mix the ingredients and shake.  Add cream and parsley in a slow steady stream, whisking constantly, until all the cream has been incorporated and the sauce is smooth and creamy.  Cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to use, up to 3 weeks.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare and cook noodles according to package directions, drain.  Mix shredded cheese and flour in a medium bowl.  Add white pepper, mixing lightly.  Spread about 1/4 cup of noodles on a greased baking sheet.  Top with 2 tablespoons of cheese and cheese mixture.  Repeat 1 more layer of noodles, cheese and cheese mixture, and noodles, ending with all the cheese.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden.

title: Lamb with Apricots and Smoked Almonds

title: Quinoa With Sambal (Sambal Oelek & Quinoa) (Gluten free)

instructions: Rinse the quinoa well then drain in a bowl.  Place the sambal in a non stick frying pan and pour in 1 tablespoon of water so the water doesn't stick.
