When the quinoa is tender, stir in the soda water & taste to adjust salt, adding more water if needed.  Serve warm with lots of yogurt or fruit garnished with finely chopped dried onions.

instructions: Place pork roast in crockpot on low all day.  After pork is done, combine the remaining ingredients.  Pour over pork.  Add 1 pound of ground beef.  Bake at 350 deg f until internal temperature reaches 165 deg f and meat is thoroughly cooked.

title: Blueberry Pork Rolls

title: Orange-Flavored Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1/3 cup light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest ( optional ) | 1 1/3 cups plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Rinse the rice 3 times until the water runs clear.  Drain well in a sieve under cold water.  Wash and dry the rice thoroughly.  Dissolve the brown sugar in the peanut butter in a small microwave safe bowl or saucepan.  Heat the skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly until hot, about 1 minute.  Add the rice to the skillet and mix thoroughly, using a wooden spoon, until hot and sticky, 1 to 2 minutes.  Pour the hot peanut butter into another large bowl.  Dump the orange peel into the bowl and sprinkle on top of the rice to draw a sticky texture.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Cook and stir turnip cubes in the boiling water until fork tender, about 5 minutes.  Mix in panir.

title: Fajita French Fries

Garnish and serve with any of the optional accompaniments.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add the lasagna noodles, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain. In a separate bowl, mix cornmeal and italian seasoning.  Set aside.  Spread 1/2 the cheddar cheese on top.  Place half of the bell pepper slices on top, and sprinkle with the cornmeal mixture.  Repeat layers using the bell pepper, italian seasoning, and more cheese.  Bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Mango Tostadas (Tostadas De Molcajete - Mango Tostadas)

title: Faux Easy Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 -2 canned sliced bamboo shoot | 1 cup butter
instructions: Preheat oven.  Slice eggplant lengthwise and in strips about 1/2 inch wide, or you can cut into strips about the width of your eggplant.  Cut bamboo shoots into quarters lengthwise.  Put 1 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium low heat, and melt the butter.  Add half of the eggplant and fry a few moments, just until browned.  Turn the eggplant over, and fry a few more moments, just until eggplant is browned on both sides.  Place the remaining eggplant on a baking sheet.  Add a little bit of butter to the pan, and turn heat to medium.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoons of butter and fry the slices of eggplant until crisp, turning often, about 3 - 5 minutes depending on the size of your slices.  Place slices onto a paper towel lined plate while the rest of the eggplant is baking.  Repeat this with remaining ingredients.  Add the rest of the butter to the pan and heat.  Add the remaining slices of eggplant, and fry about 3 - 4 minutes.  Spoon over a little sauce, and serve.

title: The Best Curry Powder

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,bulgur wheat,radish,cranberry juice,lime juice,mascarpone cheese,pork chop
title: Pork and Cranberry Parfait
ingredients: 400 g bulgar wheat, soaked in water overnight | 200 g mascarpone cheese | 4 cm piece of boneless pork chops | 4 tablespoons of dried cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | radish, to garnish
instructions: Preparation notes, the bread can be used as a stuffing for the pork chop or as a filling for the parfaites.  Mix the couscous with the yoghurt and marinade.  Slice the pork chop into thin rounds using either a sharp knife or a fork.  Arrange them on a plate, drizzling with the yoghurt marinade.  Chop the dried cranberries into small pieces.  Mix the cranberry sauce and the lime juice.  Place the pork slices and apricots on the serving plate.  To serve, heap the couscous into 4 serving plates, top with the pork, cranberry sauce and radishes.  Sprinkle with icing sugar.  Note, to serve the pork chops or parfaites, place the chops in an oven proof dish and cook for about 20minutes at 180 degrees c.

title: Easy Spinach Raisins With Golden Raisens
ingredients: 2 packages baby spinach | 1/2 cup golden raisin | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash the spinach in several changes of water until dirt is released.  Wash the spinache well dry.  Chop in quarters and roughly chop the raisins into small pieces.  Add the spinach and raisins to the pan of fresh water and heat over medium heat until the spinach just begins to wilt.  Immediately serve.

title: Faux Porteous and Simple
ingredients: 500 g fish fillets, fresh ( salmon, prawn, snapper or haddock ) | 300 g mushrooms, canned ( i prefer portobello caps ) | 20 g dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Soak dried mushrooms in warm water until softened and pliable.  Drain mushrooms and cut through chiffonade.  Cut fish fillets into 6 cm/1 inch thick pieces and cook in frying pan over medium high heat for 4 - 5 minutes, turning fish to evenly brown.  Add drained mushrooms to oil from pan and cook for an further 1 - 2 minutes.  Toss seafood with mushrooms and cook until cooked, adding more oil if necessary.  Pour mushroom sauce over fish and serve.

title: Grilled Soba Noodles with Smoky BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces soba noodles | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock | 3/4 cup hickory flavored barbecue sauce ( i prefer `` sweet baby ray '' brand )
instructions: Prepare and wash all noodles as per package directions.  You may have to use 2 - 4 quart sauce pans depending on size and depth of noodles.  Place noodles in a large bowl and pour boiling water over noodles.  Drain well, and place in a large ziploc bag or container with a tight fitting lid.  Add the marinade from the jar to the noodles and toss thoroughly.  Cover the bowl the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least two hours or overnight.  When ready to serve, bring oil temp to 375 degree in a large saute pan over medium high heat.  Add marinated noodles and toss evenly to coat noodles until heated through.  Serve immediately or transfer to a cutting board and slice.  Toss with your favorite hot sauce.

title: Sauerkraut with Red Chile
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut | 2 cans whole red chile pods, drained
instructions: Place the sauerkraut in a dutch oven or large pot over medium heat.  Add red chiles.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauerkraut is hot and beginning to brown at the edges.  The liquid will be reduced by about half.  Pour cooked sauerkraut into a bowl, and top with cooked red chile pod.

title: Beef  &  Peas  With  Suet (Spiral)
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 package frozen peas | 1 package suet | 1/2 lb dried pepperoni, chopped | 6 ounces cooked sliced salted salmon fillet | snow peas, ends trimmed
instructions: Place chuck roast and peas in 8 quart dutch oven.  Cover with water, bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer on low for 2 1/2 hours.  Transfer roast to platter and cover tightly with foil and keep warm.  Remove peas from pan and reserve liquid in gravy pan.  Set aside.  In gravy pan, cook sausage until browned, stirring to break into small pieces and drain off fat.  Set aside.  Place peas, juice from steaming kettle, and sausage in saucepan with reserved beef liquid and heat to boiling.  Reduce heat, simmer for 20 minutes or until peas are tender.  Meanwhile put suet in mixing bowl and mix in pepperoni.  Roll in suet and arrange on platter.  Drain pork& fish.  Place over meat.  Brush with fat on both sides.  Broil on high 30 seconds or until golden and crusty.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,corn,anise seed,orange zest,chinese egg noodle,water tuna,pecorino romano cheese
title: Crunchy Mexican Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 package chinese egg noodles ( chinese-style vermicelli ) | 1 quart water or 1 quart chicken stock | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese ( about 1/2 cup packed ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon grated lime zest | 3 ears fresh corn, shucked ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package.

title: Spiced Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces consomme | 15 ounces pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 large chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon aniseed
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor and blend to a creamy consistency.  Refrigerate while bringing to room temperature.

title: Italian Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans | 1 can large white mushrooms | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup sugar | sugar, for dusting
instructions: Drain kidney beans, mushrooms, bamboo shoots and amaretto.  Combine with other ingredients.  Dust with sugar.

title: Ramen Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 cans ramen noodles | 28 large cooked clams | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Heat a large pot of water on medium high heat.  Add ramen noodles.  Toss well until noodles are hot and slightly brown.  Drain noodles and add to pot.  Add soy sauce to taste.  Serve. title: Steamed Mushrooms, Tasty Garlic Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup gorgonzola | 1/2 cup chopped oyster mushroom | 1 cup grated gorgonzola | 1 teaspoon chopped sage | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 flour tortillas, lightly flour crisped, for topping ( optional )
instructions: To make garlic rolls, in a medium mixing bowl, mix the cheese, mushrooms, gorgonzola, sage, and anise into a puree with a spoon.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Roll mushroom dough out onto a floured surface and cut into thirds, rolling about 1/4 inch rounds with a cookie cutter or biscuit cutter.  Spread about 2 tablespoons of gorgonzola dough into a tortilla round, about 2 inches square.  Carefully top the gorgonzola roll with equal amounts of mushroom filling, leaving a 1 inch border to the edge.  Roll up as tight as your tortilla can be, keeping the ends intact.  Repeat with remaining dough and filling.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add a dusting of vegetable oil if necessary to keep the roll from sticking.  Steam the rolls until tender, and place on a serving platter, about 6 minutes.  Serve with additional gorgonzola cheese on the side.  To steamed gorgonzola rolls, place cooked garlic roll on a bamboo mat or cookie sheet, cut side down.  Use a toothpick to flatten slightly.  If using a meat mallet, hammer the garlic to help it cook faster and keep its nice round shape.  Cut the wrap into slices 1 inch thick and 1 1/2 inches long, and then cut the slices into halves or wedges.

title: Filling and Corn Filling For Turnips With
ingredients: 4 cups corn kernels ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 teaspoons vegetable shortening | 2 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar or 2 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon pinch cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 3 large turnips
instructions: Place the corn, shortening, sugar, and cayenne pepper into a blender or food processor and pulse until corn is finely chopped or in tiny pieces.  Add turnips and puree until smooth.  If the mixture is too thick, add a little water.  Place in an airtight container and refrigerate until cold.

title: Saffron Pork & Broccoli (Or Rice)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon saffron or 3 -5 drops turmeric, to taste | 1 cup broccoli floret, cooked | powdered saffron ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the pork, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes, or until the pieces are just cooked through.  Sprinkle in the saffron and the turmeric and stir to combine.  Serve the pork over the fried broccoli.

title: Dill & Olive Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dried dill, or more to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together icing sugar, picante hot pepper sauce and dried dill.  Spread enough filling mixture onto the edge of each roll to cover.  Roll up and cover completely with extra picante hot pepper sauce and fresh dill sprigs.

title: Kurdish Braised Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 16 ounces chickpeas, drained | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Cover pork with cold water, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until fork tender, 35 40min.  Transfer the pork to a dish, cover with foil and set over a bowl to catch liquid, refrigerate for several hours and up to 3 days.  Pull out of the refrigerator, shred and set aside in a large bowl.  Combine the reserved liquid and saffron, drain the pork and place it in the sauce and mix well.  Allow the pork to absorb the flavor, refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.  Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, 15 - 20 min, stirring occasionally.  Serve pork warm accompanied by the chickpeas.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,grain mustard,ketchup,marjoram,beef stew meat,rosemary,green chili salsa,jalapeno
title: Indian-Spiced Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar green chili salsa | 1 jar marjoram, chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 2 teaspoons rosemary, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh ground marjoram | 1 cup rye bread, torn into small pieces

title: French Croutons

instructions: In a bowl, combine the salt and shallots.  Lay the rye bread slices on a cutting board.  Place 1/4 teaspoon of the salt mixture on each slice of bread, and form a well.  Spread the remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt mixture over the rounds.  Grasping one edge of each piece of bread, flip the bread slices onto a plate. title: Oriental Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages of ramen noodles | 1/2 cup catsup | 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a non stick fry pan, combine catsup and oil.  When the pan is ready add noodles, and stir for a couple of minutes.  Put on a plate and top with sauce.

title: Pears Poached in Dutch Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb firm pear | 1 cup muenster cheese, grated ( about 50 cheese slices ) | 3 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Peel pears.  Remove core from pears, if desired.  Cut pears at an angle into 1/4 inch slices, using a mandolin.  Combine shredded cheese, molasses, cocoa powder, and cardamom in a small bowl.  Place the pears upright on a parchment lined, heavy baking sheet.  Brush pears with a little melted cheese mixture.

title: Simple Feta Spread (Yummy Spread)
ingredients: 1 lb feta ( about 31/2 ounces ) | 1/4 cup tahini or 1/4 cup sesame paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f and line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  In a small bowl, mash feta with a fork and set aside.  Add tahini, stir and put in refrigerator for 5 minutes.  Spread on baking sheet in a thin layer.  Smooth top of spread.

title: Tunisian Molasses Grape Fritters
ingredients: 1 pint grapes, washed and shelled | 3 large egg whites, stiffly beaten | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Put several handfuls of grapes into an 8 inch hot grill and cook over medium high heat, turning once, until both sides are dry, about 5 minutes per side.  Transfer to a small bowl.  Cool, scraping into a bowl.  While grapes are cooking prepare egg whites.  Whip egg whites, cayenne pepper, and salt in a bowl with an electric mixer fitted with a whisk attachment until soft peaks form.  Slowly sprinkle grape mixture back into whites, using more if needed to form stiff peaks.  Place meringue in mitts, and turn so that uncooked portion of meringue faces up.  Holding meringue in your left hand, spread meringue in a circle about 1 1/2 inches across the top of the grape.  Close meringue with back of a spoon.  Transfer meringue to a baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate, at least 2 hours and up to 2 days before serving.

title: Beer-Maker Brod
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus | 8 ounces beer | 1 small turnip | 1/8 teaspoon red cayenne
instructions: Dry roast the anise and seed in a dry skillet on medium to high heat, shaking the pan occasionally, until darkened and a shade darker than dark.  Strain out the seed.

title: Croissants With Caramelised Garlic
ingredients: 20 plain croissants, open and split | 2 teaspoons plain flour

title: French Fried Turkey Sausage-Pear Appetizer Sandwich Rolls
ingredients: 3 cornish hens, 3 - 4 per hen | 3 large pears, peeled, cored, thinly sliced ( i also prefer red ) | 2 slices bread dough ( i use frozen bread dough that has been thawed ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup crouton ( i actually've used homemade but you can use store brand ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb lean ground turkey sausage ( sweet or hot )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the hen on a rack, close fitting, in a large baking pan.  Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until brown.  Remove, cool and remove giblets.  De bone the hens.  Slice off all the meat from the neck and replace with the body, discard the bones.  Combine stuffing ingredients together and divide stuffing between the 2 hens.  Roll up jellyroll style around the hen, and secure with two toothpicks.  If desired, roll up jellyroll style around remaining hens and stuff stuffing into the hen. If no stuffing is used, just mix stuffing ingredients together in a small bowl until well combined.  Slice hens into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Serve with sauce for dipping in or on top of the rolls.

title: Prawns W- Limeade (Spain)
ingredients: 10 -12 small green olives, stoned | 6 green olives, stoned | 6 sun-dried tomatoes, oil packed | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 24 large shelled prawns ( about 2-1/2 lbs ) | gluten-free cooking oil, for shallow frying | 2 tablespoons grape seed oil | 3 tablespoons mirin chili sauce | 1 lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Place 4 olives, 4 sun dried tomatoes and the icing sugar in a large bowl and mix well.  Pour 1/2 cup of the olive sauce over the mixture to coat.  Cover mixture and refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Drain olives and sun dried tomatoes and return them to the bowl with remaining olive sauce.  Wash prawns and pat dry.  Heat the grapeseed oil in a wide frying pan, shallow fry the prawns until they turn pink all over.  Transfer the prawns to shallow plates.  Sprinkle the prawn mixture and remaining olives over.  Serve immediately with lime wedges.

title: Cheese and Tomato Phyllo Rollups

instructions: Combine the kirsch into the yoghurt and set aside.  Combine the tomato sauce, zest and grated cheese and set aside.  Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap.  Brush a little extra virgin olive oil on the plastic inside and outside your baking sheet.  Wash the filo well with cold water, dry with paper towels, and place on the plastic wrap.  Cut into 4 strips lengthwise and then cut each strip lengthwise into 4 diagonal pieces.  Sprinkle the filo with olive oil and set aside until needed.  Brush 2 pieces of plastic wrap on one side of the pastry and then one piece on the other.  Spread approximately 2 tablespoons of yoghurt sauce evenly and about 1/4 cup of tomato sauce on the bottom piece of pastry.  Put about 2 tablespoons of the cheese onto each piece of pastry.  Roll up from the short side of the pastry, then tie to seal the pastry.  Brush tops of rolls with kirsch and refrigerate for 15 - 20 minutes prior to cooking.  Prep time, 1 hour 30 minutes will do, but start cooking before the pastry ends and take out the pastry.  When you open your pastry package, remove the top layer of pastry and brush with olive oil.  Repeat with second sheet, oiling each sheet with olive oil as necessary at the end so the pastry doesn't become sticky and dry.  When finished cooking top each roll with the remaining cheese and place under the broiler for a few minutes just until the top begins to bubble up.

title: Date-Oyster Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups pitted dates | 1/2 teaspoon drambuie | ice water | 1/4 cup yellow onion, chopped | cornmeal | crushed tortilla
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix dates and drambuie, and enough ice water to cover.  Bring to boiling.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork Carnitas

instructions: Pour can of coconut oil into baking dish.  Open pork and tear into pieces as much as you like.  You can also use your hands or a meat mallet to crush them.  Place all of the pork into the dish and sprinkle the entire contents of both cans of coconut oil all over top.  Toss a few times to mix all the flavors. .  Bake at 325 degrees for one and a half hours or until the meat is nicely browned and the meat is almost falling apart.  Enjoy.

title:
Treacle Beef Wrapped in Baked 9-Qt.
    -pie Crust

instructions: Crumble up any excess fatty meat then saute with the dried savoury, treacle and molasses in a pan.  Make sure meat is not too brown. Mix the remainder of the soy milk with the flour, tortillas and ground beef.  Put mixture of flour and beef mixture in pie shell, spread evenly then sprinkle with extra treacle if desired.  Bake at 400 for 30 - 40 minutes until the top is almost golden brown.  Cut in wedges.  If pie crust is too tough, break it up with fingers, wrap in foil and bake 10 minutes until desired consistency is reached.  Allow to cool on a wire rack.  Slice and serve as you wish with syrup, if you prefer.

title: Crispy Sausage Enchiladas

instructions: Preheat oven 350°f.  Cook and stir sausage in skillet until browned.

title: Dilly Biscuits
ingredients: 500 g plain gluten-free flour or 500 g gluten-free bread flour | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Put the flour, tarragon and baking powder into a bowl.  Add a little salt and mix.  Add enough water to the dough to make a reasonably stiff dough.  Turn out on a floured surface and form into two round biscuit shapes about 20 minutes in total.  Cut the biscuits in half and spread each side with a little of the dilly dilly dilly butter.  Bake on the middle shelf of an oven for 12 - 14 minutes at 200 degrees.  Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Bread Machine French Bread
ingredients: 1 active dry yeast | 9 1/4 cups breads, medium crust | 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: In a large bowl, stir dry yeast into 1 cup warm chicken broth.  Add remaining broth and stir into dry, 1 cup bread flour.  Set bread machine for the french bread cycle on the white bread setting.  Alternately, you can also use an electric hand mixer or dough hook.  Start the bread machine, but after 2 minutes, remove bread from cooker.  Place it on a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.  Pat into a ball, place on a baking sheet, cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes.  Place pan onto a baking sheet.  Turn over loaf and remove dough that has risen to the top.  Bake at 350f degrees for about 20 minutes, or until loaf is slightly brown on top and tester inserted tells you it's baked all the way through.

title: Wild Mushroom Dip

instructions: Cut bread loaf into 1/2 inch slices.  Preheat broiler.  Line bottom of a 12 inch x 9 inch or larger non stick broiler pan with the bread slices, overlapping slightly.  Blend the cream of chicken soup and mushroom soups.  Spread evenly over the bread.  Place the crostini on baking sheet.  Using a serrated knife just cut the bread into very small pieces until bread cubes are fine.  Remove bread pieces from pan.  Coat the cut sides of the bread with chopped parsley and chopped garlic.  Place the soaked bread in a blender.  Blend or process the mixture until it is somewhat smooth, leaving some coarse bread chunks.  With rubber spatula, spread the mixture evenly over the bread in the pan.  Cover and return to the oven.  Watch carefully, as it may spit and splatter.

title: Celeriac Puree
ingredients: 1 medium celeriac, peeled ( celeriac root ) | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Grate the celeriac on a paper towel, then squeeze out excess moisture.  Place grated celeriac in a heavy saucepan over medium low heat.  Cook, stirring, until celeriac has cooked until slightly translucent, about 15 minutes.  Stir in cream.

title: Quick & Easy Spicy Salsa Dip

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°c.  In an oven proof bowl toss the pizza sauce, onion soup mix, horseradish mustard, picante sauce, red chili pepper sauce and cayenne. Serve with corn chips or your favorite condiments as the sauce dip cooks.

title: Chili Bread

title: Thai Cashews Appetizer

instructions: Preheat oven to 360°f.  Place the cashewnuts on a baking tray and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until they are lightly golden brown. .  Meanwhile combine the fish sauce and nam pla in a small frying pan and cook on low heat stirring continuously for about 3 - 5 minutes.  Place the cashewnuts on a cutting board and cut into halves or quarters.  Place on a baking tray with the cashew halves.

title: Lamb and Green Bean Sticks

instructions: If using your lamb sirloin steaks, cut them into thin strips.  If using beef, cut into thin strips.  Cut the beans into 2 inch lengths or strips.  Cook them in boiling water with lemon zest until tender.  Drain, refresh under cold water, and leave to drain again.  If using chicken pieces, cook in boiling hot water with lemon zest, for about 2 minutes.  Reserve the marinade.  Mix all the ingredients to make a paste with 3 tablespoon warm water.  Stir well, then set the mixture aside, covered,.  Heat the remaining marinade to boiling.

title: Shrimp in Asian Noodle Broth

instructions: Cook vermicelli in boiling water for 2 minutes, stir, set aside until needed.  Bring a pot of water to the boil to soften noodles.  Drain noodles, toss with 1 tbsp cornflour, set aside.  Blanch jumbo shrimp in boiling water for one minute, drain.  Cut head of napa cabbage into small wedges, remove core and all excess white part.  Boil in salted water for 5 minutes, drain and run under cold water to stop any cooking.  Drain and add to the cooked noodles.  Bring the white wine, onion soup powder, napa cabbage, pineapple juice and half the cooked vermicelli in a pot to a boil.  Mix in noodles and remove from heat. title: Tasso's Irish Chili

Turn the heat down to med hi, and add the taco seasoning and coffee.  Stir with a wooden spoon until the turkey is fully re coated.  Add the mixture from the plastic bag into the pot with the turkey.  Stir in the remaining 1/4 cup of tapioca starch and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened and is well mixed in your desired texture. instructions: Place the parsnips and mushrooms into a medium saucepan, and cover with water.  Bring to the boil over medium high heat. title: Crispy Farfalle, Apples and Apple Tortillas

instructions: Pour 2 - 3 inches of oil in a wok/large skillet.  When the oil is very hot, carefully add cornflour, stirring constantly.  Mix the corn flour mix on the bottom of the wok. ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon fajita seasoning ( for pork ) | 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can carnitas brand doritos ( corn-free is best, carnitas brand is my favorite brand ) | 1 1/2 cups rice krispies | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: To smoke, place corningware container in oven on 325 f or just enough room to smoke the pork.  If you're using anise seed, grind a few pods in an electric coffee grinder to make fine powder.  Place pork in bowl of dry spice grinder and add corningware container and cinnamon chips.  Use your hands to rub and smear the spice mixture onto the pork.  It should have an amount of anise seed.  If not, rub in the spice until thoroughly coated.  Pour brand in a small non stick pan which has a tight fitting lid or a large roasting pan.  Use a small metal spoon to scoop up the contents of the pan.  You don't need to press it.  When you are ready to use, let the pan begin to smoke and smoke.  It's going to smoke.  Place all of the contents onto a baking sheet or cookie sheet and use your hands to push or pull the contents.  Smoke until aromatic, then fill up with about 1 1/2 cups of brand and seal the entire carrot to ensure the smoke is sealed in well.  This will make it easier to smoke.  When everything is smoking, it will take about 10 - 15 minutes to achieve a smokey smoke.  Remove the meat from the pan and place into a paper bag or glass bowl.  Place all of the ingredients on smoking sheet at once and give a good shake.  The krispies are to die for, so add more brand.  Note, if you get smokey krispies, it is best to buy a bag of brand with a tight fitting lid and seal around the meat in an airtight container.  This will prevent the meat from drying out.  As meat is smoking, you can put several paper candy cups into a large ziplock bag.  Place meat into the bag while using the brand and seal.  You have a double layer smoke.  Store in a ziplock bag in the refrigerator.  To use, place meat directly on the grill and sear the meat well, using a meat cooker.  When meat is almost ready, you can cut against the coals with a meat fork or whatever tool you use to do it.  It's best to do this on the center shelf in a charcoal grill that has been heated to medium.  Once the fire is at medium, lower heat and let smoke for approximately 1 to 2 minutes per side.  This does not take long because of the brand and oven differences.  This will only take a few seconds per side. .  When the krispies get darker and darker, they are ready.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,balsamic vinegar,grain rice,buttermilk,poblano chile,cream chicken soup
title: Easy Mexican Shrimp and Rice

title: Cherry Orange Syrup

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.  Simmer for 2 - 3 minutes over high heat.  Pour syrup into a sterilized glass jar.

title: Beer-Glazed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 1 teaspoon dark beer | 1/4 cup fat-free topping | 2 teaspoons grated fresh savory
instructions: Place asparagus in a large pot of boiling water or microwave.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp tender, about 4 minutes.  Place on paper towel lined rimmed baking sheet.  Drizzle with beer.

title: Pigs Stuffed With Canadian Bacon (Filling Only)
ingredients: 8 ripe bananas ( or sweet potatoes with peel on, cut into 12 wedges ) | 4 slices canadian bacon ( about 1 ounce per apple ) | grated savory ( optional ) | 1/2 cup melted margarine or 1/2 cup butter | pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1/2 stick margarine or butter in a non stick pan while gently rolling the bacon, the cut up apple and saute until golden, about 8 or 10 minutes. Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,nutmeg,tarragon,beef broth,farfalle pasta,garlic clove,thyme,black pepper
title: Poblano Pepper-Beef Soup

Transfer the mixture to a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over low heat.  Simmer for 25 minutes, reduce the heat to low and cook for at least 1 hour, checking often to ensure the mixture doesn't burn. title: Spicy Fennel

Cool fennel under running water, and then cut off both ends.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel the blackened outer skin from the cleaned bulbs.  Combine the fennel with the reserved liquid and spice in a clean bowl in which to store the fennel franks.  Cover and refrigerate frank until cold and firm, about 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: tofu,red pepper,cooking oat,pineapple ring,green bean,coleslaw,black mustard seed

title: Smoky Rice

instructions: Rinse the coriander seeds thoroughly under cold running water. title: Portuguese Gin, Sherry and Wine Jelly
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dry white wine ( such as sauvignon blanc or zinfandel ) | 7 tablespoons sugar or 7 tablespoons honey, of choice | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 7 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: For the jelly, in a saucepan combine the wine, sugar and gelatin.  Bring to boil and remove from the heat.  Stir to gelatin with the sherry.  Pour into a greased jelly mold.  Refrigerate until set.  Unmold onto a serving dish and sprinkle with finely chopped toasted nuts.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,green chili,vinegar,butternut squash,water chestnut,orange bell pepper,vanilla ice cream,watermelon
title: Moroccan Lamb Chops With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash | 1 cup water chestnut, canned drained and chopped | 1 scotch bonnet peppers or 1 orange bell pepper, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh green chili ( or to taste ) | 200 g lamb loin chops ( halve or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/4 cup water | 600 ml vanilla ice cream | 1/4 cup fresh green chili, finely chopped
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthways and remove seeds.  Cut halves into small thin wedges.  Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl and stir well.  Add lamb and marinate for at least 10 minutes.  Thread lamb onto metal skewers and serve with dipping sauce.

title: Mexican Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2/3 cup pumpkin seeds ( not pumpkin pie meal ) | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle powder | 1 1/2 ounces canned green chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup mayonnaise, low fat if you wish
instructions: Preheat your oven and prepare your ingredients as instructed on the back of the mayo.  Spread the pumpkin seeds and chilies evenly over a baking sheet and toast in your oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown, and toasted.  Remove from the oven and spread evenly over the mayo.  Mix the mayo with a spatula until well blended and then spread over the top to cool.

title: Khao Podi
ingredients: 4 pandan leaves | 5 carrots, diced | 1 3/4 cups vegetable broth, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Place pandan leaves, carrots, vegetable broth, and baking soda in a deep skillet.  Bring to boil over medium high heat, scraping any browned bits stuck to the skillet.  Boil to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until carrots are very tender, 4 to 6 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.  Heat remaining 1/4 cup vegetable broth in a large skillet over medium heat until boiling.

title: Wassail Bean Sprouts and Potato Salad
ingredients: 250 g red lentils | 2 large baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons crushed pineapple, in chunks | 2 tablespoons crushed almonds essence | 1/4 cup shredded pimento ( italian parsley ) | fresh bean sprout
instructions: Rinse and drain the lentils.  Wash potatoes, and pierce each with fork in several places.  Bake at 180 f for 1 hour.  Drain.  Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat, add almonds essence, potatoes and toss continuously until lightly browned.  Add beans sprouts and toss till soft.  Sugar snap peas or snow peas can be substituted for the beans sprouts.

title: Creamy Salmon and Okra
ingredients: 1 lb salmon, scaled and diced into 1 inch cubes | 2 spanish onions, chopped | 1 can salmon | 1 bag frozen okra | 3 cups stock | 1 bag frozen spinach | 1/2 cup sultana
instructions: In a large pot, put the salmon and onions on the heat with plenty of salt and pepper to taste.  Stir in the okra then cook until the okra is wilted.  Place the fish and okra mixture on top of the fish, cover the pot and cook over the lowest possible heat for 10 to 15 minutes.  Add the stocks then heat through until the okra is cooked.

title: Caribbean Lobster Appetizer
ingredients: 2 containers plain yogurt | 2 cans lobster tails, drained | 1 small white onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons apple sauce, or as needed
instructions: Place the lobster tails into a container and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate 20 minutes or longer.  Pour yogurt into the container with the lobster tails.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  About 10 minutes before serving, remove lobster tails and top with onion and apple sauce.

title: Lemon and Parmigiano Popestata
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice of and zest | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large stainless steel or glass bowl, mix together the lemon juice, zest, and cinnamon.  Stir in the cheese until well blended.  Using an ice cream scoop, scrape the ice cream into the bowl until it runs almost level with the back of a spoon.  Stir a few seconds more until the ice cream looks dry.  Transfer the ice cream to any serving bowl, and refrigerate until hard, about 15 minutes, or freeze until hard, at least 1 hour.

title: Creamy Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1/2 cup cream cheese spread | 10 leaves spinach | 10 leaves fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh rose petals, sliced | 1 cup snow peas
instructions: Mix cream cheese, spinach, dillweed, and petals.  Add crab and spinach mixture and fold.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chuck,yellow cornmeal,mace,potato traditional,chive,green bell pepper,cherry tomato
title: Traditional English Muffins
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 32 ounces canned potato traditional mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh chives, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons canned chopped cherry tomatoes
instructions: Prepare english muffin batter.  Combine beef, 1/2 cup potato traditional mashed potatoes, green pepper, chives, mace and 2 tablespoons of canned tomatoes in large bowl.  Mix thoroughly to blend mixture and set aside.  Divide batter evenly among 12 - 12 regular size oven size muffin cups.  Place muffin cups on foil lined cookie sheet so you have 12 muffins each.  Bake in 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Watch the muffins carefully after 10 minutes and do not allow tops to brown on bottom.

title: Easy Beef Tips with Onions
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Add the seasoned beef pieces in a ziploc bag to the bag, seal, and squish the bag to make sure the beef is covered with marinade.  Refrigerate overnight to marinate. .  Heat skillet to med high.  Add beef, and brown beef on all sides.  Sprinkle with salt, remove beef from skillet, and put in covered skillet.  Cook on low for 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: avocado,bell pepper,apple juice,rice,italian salad dressing,raisin,root beer,mexican cheese
title: Root Beer Avocado Rice Salad
ingredients:
2 cups raw rice ( cooked to your own ) | 1/2 cup root beer, your favorite kind | 2 cups mashed avocados | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup light sour cream | 6 tablespoons raisin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup raisins, i use a mixture of white and brown, if you like really sweet, soak the raisins in the beer for 2 hours, drain excess beer.
    - can add sugar or other sweetener of choice | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese
instructions: Cook your rice until done, set aside while you get started.  Mix all things up and enjoy.

title: Chinese Style Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs snow peas ( chinese-ishu ramen-don ) | 1 can water chestnuts, cut into thirds
instructions: Place the water chestnuts on a microwave safe plate and microwave on high 45 seconds uncovered.  Set aside and let cool slightly, then cut into 1 inch lengths.  Remove the stems from the snow peas and set them aside.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add the snow peas, stirring to coat with the oil.  Cook, stirring until they start to brown.  Add the snow peas and water chestnuts and cook just until the water is hot but not boiling.  Stir in the ramen seasoning packet, cover, and cook 5 minutes.  Stir occasionally.

instructions: In a large shallow baking pan place the fenghreek, fenugreek and curry leaves for color, and add the salted anchovies, peaches, and scallops.  Sprinkle in 1/3 of the feta cheese, onion powder, and 1/3 of the paprika.  Bake in a preheated oven for 15–20 minutes stirring every 5–10 minutes.  Garnish with a fresh peach slice.

title: Creme Mustard String Beans
ingredients: 1 can chopped string beans | 1 small orange, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup creole mustard
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the string beans and orange slices.  Using a fork, stir together the mustard and creole mustard.  Pour the mixture over the beans and orange and stir until the salad is well coated.

title: Tasty Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 lbs beef top round steak, cut into strips | 4 tablespoons pomegranate juice or 4 tablespoons light pomegranate juice | 4 tablespoons rum ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: In a large skillet, mix together pomegranate juice, rum, baking powder.  Place beef strips in the marinade.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,date,currant,heavy whipping cream,plain flour,garlic salt,mozzarella cheese,pizza crust

instructions: In a bowl, add the first nine ingredients, mix well, then place one generous spoonful on each work surface, top with another generous spoonful and roll up.  Using a sharp knife, cut a 4 inch slit lengthways down the length of each roll.  Repeat with remaining fillings. ingredients:

instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the quinoa, wine, teriyaki sauce, vanilla, chili paste, chili paste and cinnamon and set aside.  Soak the soaked skewers in water for 30 min to 8 hours.

title: Blueberry Jam (Beshi)
ingredients: 450 g fresh blueberries, washed and drained | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a heavy pot and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat and simmer till thick and reduced and jam like consistency.  If necessary, add a little water.  Remove from heat and allow to cool.  Serve hot, or refrigerate if desired and reheat gently after removing from heat.  Allow to chill until ready to use.

title: Passionate's Easy Vegetarian Tostadas
ingredients: 400 g frozen peas and carrots | 400 g frozen peas and carrots | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped green olive
instructions: Cook frozen peas and carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse with cold water.  Mix chilli flakes and olives in a small bowl, then toss the veggies in the mix with the olives.  Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.  Serves.

title: Fried Jalapenos (Or Garlic-Chili Canning Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb jalapeno pepper | oil, for frying
instructions: Cut the top off of the jalapenos or peppers from the stems and remove stems.  Cut peppers lengthwise and clean of all other seeds.  Place the peppers in a bag with all the other ingredients and shake to thoroughly mix.  To fry, heat a heavy skillet until it is quite hot or registers 360f on a deep fry thermometer.  Test a drop of the fritter with a slotted spoon in the center.  If the oil is very hot, the oil will bubble up.  Fry the peppers one or two minutes, shaking and turning over the peppers occasionally, until the skin is crispy and blackened, 12 - 15 minutes.  Remove the fritters from the hot skillet and repeat with the remaining oil.  If you make a paste with a garlic powder or other flavor enhancer, combine the contents of the bag with the paste and stir until well blended.

instructions: Combine cottage cheese, 1/2 cup salsa, and sour cream in a food processor or blender.

title: Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Combine corn, raisins, and 2/3 cup water in a microwave safe dish, and microwave on high for 1 minute.

title: Grilled Kiwi-Wrapped Beef Skewers (Skewers )
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1-inch thick slices | 4 kiwi fruits, thinly sliced ( about 1 inch ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup farmer cheese | 1/4 cup dark rum or 1/4 cup rum | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 12 slices rye bread, 1 inch thick ( about 1-inch each )
instructions: Prepare the barbecue.  Place meat on a foil lined nonreactive grill over moderate heat and cook, turning once, until lightly charred all over, 12 to 14 minutes.  Spread the kiwi slices between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and cut in half lengthwise.  Cut kiwifruit in half crosswise and cut with a serrated knife along the length of each slice of meat.  Arrange kiwifruit on the work surface with the meat folded over them.  Add the tomato halves and the rum and top with a slice of fontina, pressing the top of the meat down firmly.  Grill kiwifruit, turning once, until beef is cooked to desired doneness, 5 to 8 minutes for rare to medium doneness, 8 to 10 minutes for medium.

title: Hominy With Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 kg white hominy | 1/4 kg molasses | 150 -300 g flaked coconut | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Rinse the homins.  Place them in a large quantity of boiling water and leave them to soften.  Wash the coconut.

title: Italian Tomato Ham
ingredients: 16 lbs tomatoes, ripe | 2 lemons, cut in thin wedges | 4 ounces fresh deli prosciutto ham | 4 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons lard for frying
instructions: Cut tomato halves in halves.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,nonstick cooking spray,arborio rice,milk,ketchup,ice cube,self rising flour
title: Cheesy Yellow-Pea Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup, or more to taste | 1/4 cup evaporated milk | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup frozen yellow peas, thawed | 1 teaspoon self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons grated low-fat parmesan cheese, or more to taste | 6 ice cubes, for scooping
instructions: Stir ketchup and milk together in a bowl.

title: Maggie's American Cheese & Raisin Stuffing
ingredients: 450 g american cheeses | 50 g pancetta ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons tea ( cold brewed ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( optional- i use a strong coffee liqueur )
instructions: First of all remove the cheeses from the refrigerator to defrost.  If there is any excess liquid still left under to cool, drain off any excess liquid and return the cheeses to the refrigerator.  Preheat the oven to 180°c.  Using a cookie scoop or other object with a diameter of approximately 10 cm, roll out the cheeses and cut into approx 15 cm rectangles/bars using a biscuit cutter.  Place the rectangular shaped cheeses on your oven trays and bake until golden and crispy, approximately 15 - 20 minutes or until crisp.  While the cheeses are baking, melt the sesame oil in a large, non stick frying pan over a medium heat.  Add the raisins and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.  Remove from the heat, add the raisins, tea and grand marnier and stir to combine.  Remove the cheeses from the oven and let cool for approximately 5 minutes, taking care not to let the cheese pieces get too browned.  Using a spatula, spread the cheese mixture evenly over the cooled golden raisin mixture.  Serve at room temperature or spread the cheese over the top of the raisin.  Place in the fridge to set.  You may have to refrigerate the cheese mixture over night.

title: Faux-Loaded Salad with Spinach and Peaches
ingredients: 1 package pasta shells | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 package fontina cheese, cut in cubes | 2 peach slices
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the shell pasta, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the spinach in a bowl, and toss lightly with the fontina cheese cubes.  Top with the drained pasta, and drizzle with peach slices.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,turmeric powder,flour tortilla,icing sugar,red wine
title: Tacos De Harina (Fried Fish Fritters)

instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except the red wine, then roll into ball shapes.  Heat 2 tbsp oil in pan.  Fry for 3 - 3 minutes or until the fritters turn golden brown on all sides.  Drain on paper towels.  Sift extra red wine over fried fish and serve.

instructions: In a large dipping bowl, stir together the yogurt, catsup and seasoning blend.  Dip the skewers in the yogurt mixture.

title: BBQ Sauce for Shrimp or Chicken

instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Sour Ginger, Ginger and Palm Sugar Paste for Samosas

instructions: Mix the sugar and ginger garlic paste well.  Store in an airtight tin.

title: Smoked Salmon Sliders
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 zucchini, trimmed, halved lengthwise, and sliced into 1/4 inch thick | 1 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 - 1 1/2 lb thinly sliced smoked salmon | creole-style seasoning
instructions: Bring apple juice and mustard seeds to a boil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Add zucchini slice and tomato slices.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,red bell pepper,pimiento,fish sauce,baking powder,fire tomato,red cabbage,milk
title: Pimiento Chicken
ingredients: 2 roasted chicken wings ( or chicken tenders ) | 1 medium red bell peppers or 1 medium red pepper, diced | 2 cans diced fire-roasted tomatoes | 1/2 small red cabbage, julienned | 1 jar sliced roasted sweet peas ( optional, i used frozen ) | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons skim milk | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Heat skillet to medium heat and grease pan with oil.  Put chicken wings in pan.  Fry for three to five minutes, stirring frequently.  Remove to plate.  Add bell pepper and tomatoes to skillet.  Stir to combine.  Cook and stir five minutes to combine.  Add cabbage and continue cooking five minutes to warm through and blend flavors.  Add fish sauce and milk and stir.  Remove from heat.  Pour mixture over chicken and vegetables in pan.  Stir.  Sprinkle with baking powder.  Enjoy.

title: Beef and Raisins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 lbs lean beef, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Coat rack of a large heavy rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.  Over medium high heat, place raisins in a small bowl of warm water.  Set aside 3 to 4 tablespoons of the rinsed raisins.  Spray a plate with cooking spray.  Heat remaining raisins in water about 3 to 5 minutes.  Working quickly add beef to rice cooker, cover and let cook for at least 2 hours or up to 10 hours on high, until meat is tender and most of the water is absorbed.  Note, cooking time does not reflect any time spent stirring.

title: Korean Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers | 2 pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Scrub the skin from the cucumbers.  Slice the cucumber diagonally in 1/4 inch slices and put both slices in a medium mixing bowl.  Pour the remaining 2 cups chilled water and 1/2 teaspoon salt over the cucumbers.  When fully covered, chill the cucumbers until they are semi cold, about 20 - 30 minutes.  Just before serving, drain the cucumbers and pat dry.  Arrange cucumbers on a serving platter.  Sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper and the pepperoncini peppers.

title: Pineapple & Eggplant Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 2 large globe eggplants, peeled & thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallot | 3 tablespoons syrup | 6 large flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Arrange 1 eggplant slice at a time on a large plate.  In the centre of each slice, place a slice of tomato, followed by the pineapple juice, pineapples and shallot.  Sprinkle the surface with a little more pineapple juice if desired.  Pour over the tomato puree & drizzle with the maple syrup.  Wrap up & serve.

title: Guava-Ziti Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 12 guava nectar | 1/2 cup dry marsala | 1 can whole peeled plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 4 cups dry ziti pasta
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, combine beef, guava nectar, and marsala.  Simmer while preparing the ziti and vegetables.  Pour tomatoes into pot.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until liquid is reduced and sauce is thickened, about 45 minutes.

title: Tex-Mex Barley and Sheep's Sheep's Sheep's Noodle Recipe

instructions: Bake pork at 350ºf.  For approximately 2 hours.  Cut into 1/4 cubes.  Prepare barley and meat according to directions on box.  Remove and discard any bones.  Add tomato sauce and taco sauce or tarragon.  Continue cooking at 350ºf.  For an extra boost.

    - 5 kg ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( about 1/3 cup ) | 6 tablespoons grated fat-free cheddar or 6 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 12 tablespoons cottage cheese or 12 tablespoons ricotta cheese ( cottage cheese ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut cross-ways into 2 1/2 long lengths ( about 1 pound ) | 4 medium jicama or 4 medium other sweet potatoes, cut into 2 1/2 by 1/4 inch cubes

Bake for 40 minutes, or until potatoes are crispy and meat is falling off the bone.  Place under the broiler for 3 - 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly.  Serve immediately.

ingredients: 7 cups prepared rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 container low-fat sour cream or ( 8 ounce ) container greek yogurt | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup other orange-flavored liqueur | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 3/4 cup cooked wide rice noodles, broken as directed on package
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease 10 inch tart or non stick skillet or a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Cook rigatoni according to package directions.

title: Chilli Beef Pies
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, chopped | 1 large egg | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons bourbon ( use your favourite ) | 4 cups self raising flour | 1 large chili pepper, deseeded and chopped ( i use a hot one ) | plain nonfat yogurt ( optional )

Mix well with a large metal spoon until well combined and pour into prepared pie dishes.  Bake for 35 minutes. title: Malibu Cream Pie

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Brush bottom and sides of 6 inch pie dish with some of the coconut water. Unleash before serving.

title: Mexican Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup processed cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup minced green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | garlic salt to taste | 3 portabella mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Stir the cream of chicken soup, processed cheese, green chile peppers, liquid smoke, and garlic salt together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.  Stuff the mushroom caps with the cream soup mixture, stuffing them slightly more or less full.  Place the mushrooms in a single layer onto the prepared cookie sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are dark brown and the filling is hot, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,brown mustard,chili oil,cider vinegar,chicken bouillon,kale,rosemary
title: Salsa Verde Pulled Kale Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 bunch lacinato kale ( tough ends snapped off and discarded just slightly ) | 1 bunch kale ( coarse stems discarded and coarse stems discarded just slightly ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons chili oil ( optional ) | 1 package phyllo dough, sheets ( i like the ones from trader joe's )
instructions: Prepare kale.  I put the kale in a skillet, cover, and heat on low until bright green and slightly wilted, about 1 hour.  If it is really wilted, it may take up to 3 hours if it is very soft.  Strain, reserving about 1/2 cup liquid, and chop coarsely.  Drain and chop coarsely.  Rinse kale well and discard any damaged parts that are still tough.  Cut kale lengthwise into 1 wide strips on the diagonal.  Place kale in a large bowl, cover with cold water and set aside.  Drain kale well and dry.  Place leaves in a colander and press down to separate.  Let set for about 20 minutes.  Drain the kale and place in a strainer over a bowl.  Stir in 1 small bunch of kale, mustard, and bouillon.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Discard excess water.  Combine vinegar, rosemary, and chili oil, if using.  Toss with greens to combine.  Preheat oven to 400°f brush 3 sheets of filo with oil.  Spread 1 1/2 cups of the kale mixture evenly over the bottom of a roasting pan lined with parchment paper, being careful not to let it touch the edges of the filo.  Lay 5 sheets on top, brushing each with oil and pressing with the other 2 sheets, making a row of 4 sheets.  Do not stack 5 sheets at a time because each layer will expand during cooking.  Using a sharp knife, score 1 1/2 diagonal cuts, about 1/2 inch deep across the top of each sheet.  Make more cuts in the strips.  Spread remaining kale mixture over sheets of filo, starting on the short side and working from the center out.  Fold 1 long piece of the filo over the greens and tuck it underneath the greens.  Then fold the short piece over the greens.  Cut 1/2 of the sheets in half and lay them out flat at the edge of a large sheet of parchment paper.  Use a sharp knife to smooth the top of the paper.  Cut sheets crosswise into 1 pieces with a sharp knife.  Place on top of each piece of parchment, tucking in any stray leaves.  Brush remaining oil over top of rolls.  Bake 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,cooking oil,caster sugar,mirin,fruit cocktail,saltine cracker,dark brown sugar
title: Sweet and Sour Cracker Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces cooked & cooled mixed fruit cocktail, chopped ( or 2 cup mix of frozen mixed fruit ) | 4 ounces roasted chopped dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 pinch saltine crackers, roughly crushed | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Put the fruit salad into an ovenproof bowl.  Combine sugar, salad dressing, oil and sugar and pour over fruit and stir well.  Pour over the crushed crackers and stir well.  Place under a hot grill for 3 minutes or until golden brown and crunchy and a little crispy.

title: Cindi's Mexican Crab and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs raw crabmeat or 2 lbs surimi crabmeat, cut into 3 inch pieces | 12 ounces yellow squash, cut into 3 inch segments | 2 cups cilantro, stems trimmed, leaves only, chopped | 1 cup canned tomato puree | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 3/4 cup wine
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, add the crab meat or surimi and saute, flipping once or twice, until browned, about 3 minutes.  Add the squash pieces and cook until the squash are tender but still a little soft, about 3 more minutes.  Add the tomato puree and liquid smoke and continue cooking until the sauce is reduced, about 5 minutes.  Stir in the wine, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often, until the sauce is slightly thickened a little bit.  If using surimi, remove the excess fat.  Serve hot.

title: Curried Sweet Sausage and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( optional ) | 6 cups fat-free, low-sodium v8 vegetable broth | 1 loaf french bread, cut crosswise into 1-inch thick slices | 2 cups frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 6 ounces hot italian sausage | 1/2 cup chopped cashews | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Stir curry paste and cardamom in a small bowl to marinate.  Sauté sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat until browned, about 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Tofu Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco shells | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon whole fenugreek seeds, crushed
instructions: Prepare taco shells according to package directions, placing the shells in a glass dish with just enough water to cover.  Cover and turn upside down onto a plate to drain.  In a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt, cashews, fenugreek, and taco shells.  Place a scoop of the yogurt mixture in the center of the taco shells and garnish with the cashews and fenugreek mixture.

title: Basic Indian Onion Samosas (Dessert)
ingredients: 6 small onions ( about 4 1/2 pounds each ) or 4 large onions, peeled and finely minced ( about 4 1/2 pounds each ) | 2 3 tablespoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, place the onions, 1 tablespoon onion powder and 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds.  Cook over moderate heat until the onions turn light golden brown.  Cover and cook for about 7 minutes, then flip the samosas over.  Continue cooking, stirring at least once, until the browned surface begins to crisp, about 5 minutes longer.  Transfer the samosas to a serving dish and sprinkle the remaining tablespoon of onion powder and 1 teaspoon cardamom on top.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Kolapa - Traditional Tomato-Tomatillo Soup
ingredients: 3 medium tomatillos or 3 medium pecans, husk removed, peeled | 14 ounces condensed tomato soup | 9 ounces fresh strawberries, chopped | 12 stars anise, broken in pieces | black tea, to taste | 3 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a small saucepan, cover tomatillos with cold water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatillos, tomato soup, strawberries, and star anise until smooth.  Place the thawed phyllo sheets in a baking dish, and top with some of the tomatillo mixture.  Repeat layers, using 3 more sheets and filling each time.  Bake 35 - 45 minutes, or until the phyllo has a light dry consistency.  Serve piping hot.

title: Sue's Reuben Dip
ingredients: 1 gallon sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of tomato soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup minced garlic or 1/4 cup onion | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, chopped | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups raisins
instructions: Empty contents of sour cream into a large bowl.  Stir in 1/2 cup each of the chopped garlic and onion.  Stir in the cremini mushrooms and raisins, too.  Serve with crackers.

title: French Fries
ingredients: 8 -12 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and quartered | 2 cups mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Mix potatoes with half the mozzarella.  Spread in a well greased shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.  Bake in the oven 10 to 15 minutes, until heated through.  Allow to cool slightly before serving.

instructions: Combine the sour cream, parsley, salt, artichoke heart, and 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl, and chill for 10 to 15 minutes or even overnight. instructions: In a large bowl combine the first three ingredients and toss well to mix.  Place noodle in a colander and rinse under cold water for 1 - 2 minutes to loosen sand crystals.  Drain well and toss with bean mixture.  Sprinkle pecorino romano cheese on top and serve.

title: Honey Glazed Onions With Shells and Beef Ragu

Add the cooked pasta and toss to combine.  Divide the beef on top of the onions and sprinkle with croutons and serve.

title: Baked Ricotta With Parmigiano and Mint

Transfer the casserole dish to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the cheese bubbles and begins to brown.  Remove from oven, then let sit for about 10 minutes remove mint and serve immediately.

Sprinkle with dill and raisins, rosemary and crumbled butter mixture.  Mix together.  Spoon onto corn wedges.  Grill for 15 - 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chilindr

Place serving plate over top and add some of the sliced chili pepper.  Serve immediately.

Remove from the oven and place on a napkin lined plate.  Remove foil or parchment from the baking sheet, and place about 1/2 cup of chopped lettuce on each.

Serve warm.

instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray, add turnips, mix seasoning, and cornstarch in the skillet and turn over to brown the turnips on all sides.  Add chopped chile peppers and chopped dill.

Place oil in frying pan or large stew pan and fry ground beef or cabbage for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring frequently or until browned with dried spices and bay leaf.  Add water or beef broth and heat to boiling.  Lower heat and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, until cabbage has softened but has not fully developed most of its own flavor.  Serve warm.

ingredients: 1 jar roasted deli chopped tomatoes with basil and garlic sauce | 2 1/2 cups freshly shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut oil | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cover a large baking sheet with foil and lightly grease with a nonstick cooking spray.  Place the tomatoes and mozzarella cheese into a medium bowl and stir in the instant coffee until coated.  Sprinkle the carrot and rice over the mixture and stir to thoroughly combine.  Spoon 1/4 cup of mixture into the center of the baking sheet.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the rice is tender and the filling is heated through.  Serve warm, with additional coffee.

title: Spanish Sweet Plantain and Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 medium spanish onions, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can diced plantains, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grated lemon peel | 3 cans reduced-sodium broth | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained of juice
instructions: Place onion, parsley, and garlic powder in the slow cooker and set on high for about 3 hours, until the onions are translucent and starting to blacken in spots.  Stir the plantains, lemon peel, and condensed broth into the slow cooker.  Cook on low for 4 hours, or on high for about 3 hours.  To serve, stir in maraschino cherries.  If needed, stir some of the soup into the slow cooker, if desired.  Serve hot.

title: Swiss Chard and Cauliflower Appetizer
ingredients: 500 500 g swiss chard or 500 g beet, leaves roughly chopped small | 3 shallots, peeled and chopped | 100 g unsalted cashews | cooking spray | chopped celery rib | chopped cauliflower
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c.  Line a large, non stick baking tin with baking paper.  Spread the chard leaves and fresh beet leaves onto the paper lined baking tray and place in the oven for about 10 minutes.  Remove from the oven and, if using the stalk, cut off the stalk.  Trim the leaves but leave the stems intact.  Spray the shallots with cooking spray, then sprinkle over the chopped celery and cashews.  Cook in the oven until the sizzling sound of chard fills the oven, 4 to 6 minutes.  Remove from the oven and drizzle with a little olive oil.  Set aside to cool.  In a small food processor put 5 cm of the cauliflower into a bowl and then squeeze out excess liquid.  Heat the griller on high for 15 seconds and add the remaining 5 cm cauliflower.  Grill for 2 minutes on a side then put the grill in the middle of the griller and cook for 1 minute, until crisp and brown.  When the chard has cooled, slice and scoop out the stalks.  Cut the leaves into smaller pieces roughly, about 5 cm, then place the pieces onto a cutting board and finely chop.  Add to the cheese along with the cooked sizzled greens and mix well.  Spoon the mixture into a sterilised container or serving bowl and refrigerate for about 1 hour to firm.  Serve with toasted bread, chips or crackers.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,fettuccine pasta,white onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,coriander,tomato juice
title: Mashed Potatoes With Chilies - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 2 cups cubed peeled tomatoes with juice ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped drained green chili pepper | 3/4 cup chopped white onion | 1/3 cup freshly grated grana padano or 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | cooked fettuccine pasta or dried fettuccine
instructions: Place the tomatoes with juice, 2/3 cup of the chile, onion and cheese in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart covered saucepan.  Bring mixture to a simmer over moderate heat.  Lower the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the chiles and onions are softened, 3 to 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook your fettuccine in plenty of boiling water according to package directions.  Just before serving, drain the saucepan mixture and keep warm.  Add the coriander and remaining chile to the pot and stir to heat through.  Add drained fettuccine and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,coffee granule,sharp cheddar cheese,self rising flour,russet potato,egg,kosher salt
title: Sweet and Savory Cheddar Crusted Pork Belly Latkes
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup self-rising flour, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee granules | kosher salt to taste | 6 slices pork belly | 2 russet potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 5 large eggs
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Sprinkle cheese over the top and sides of a cast iron skillet or baking sheet.  In a small bowl, dissolve coffee granules in hot broth.  Toss the shredded bacon with the flour and salt.  Toss the potato cubes with the potato and coffee mixture until coated.  Dip the slices into the eggs, and press into the cheese mixture.  Sprinkle each latke with sugar, and place on the prepared skillet.  Set the skillet over medium heat, and carefully pour hot broth into the center.  Bring to a boil, and cook until bottom is light brown.  Turn the latke onto a large plate, and set the skillet aside to cool for 5 minutes.  Slice into 1 inch thick pieces, and serve with the sauteed bacon and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: deli turkey,celery seed,parsley,orange juice,cold water,chili oil
title: Quick Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb deli turkey | 4 tablespoons orange juice | chili oil ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Score turkey by cutting through ventral first.

title: Shrimp With Hazelnuts (Camara)
ingredients: 1/2 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined ( or equivalent amount of prepared steamed and shelled shrimp ) | 6 green onions, sliced | 1/2 cup toasted hazelnuts, shelled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat 1 inch water in a large skillet over high heat.  Add shrimp and cook until shrimp turn pink and curl.  Turn shrimp over.  Add scallions and nuts.  Cook 1 minute, or until scallions are just wilted.

title: Simple and Easy Fresh Scallion and Garlic Green Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 bunch scallion, white parts only, trimmed
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, peel off the white outer layer of the scallions.  Cut the white and green parts into rounds, then separate into 2 equal portions.  Using a large knife, finely mince the portions and toss them together with the scallions and green parts of the scallion greens.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours for the flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,green olive,yellow squash,spice,mint,lime wedge,iceberg lettuce
title: Gemma's Spanish Olive and Squash Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces yellow squash, grated | 1/2 cup stuffed green olive, chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice, juice and zest of | spices | ice | ice | 4 tablespoons lime juice and zest of | lettuce, shredded
instructions: In large bowl, toss together squash, olives, mint, lime juice, lime zest, and spices.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Guehwein
ingredients: 1 courgette, grated | 400 g jabey lemon
instructions: Squeeze lemons from some of them and then place in a food processor with the courgette.  Process well.  Add jabey lemons and process again.  Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,thai fish sauce,corn kernel,black mustard seed
title: Crispy Corn Dogs
ingredients: 8 ears corn kernels ( with husks ) | horseradish, to taste | thai fish sauce, to taste | 1 teaspoon whole black mustard seeds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the corn and cook until just tender, about 4 minutes.  Drain.  Immediately remove the corn from the pot and set aside.  Place a wire mesh strainer over a bowl, and set a large pot over the bowl to catch any drips during the process.

title: Easy Baked Zucchini
ingredients: 10 zucchini, sliced lengthwise | 1/4 lb creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 1 cup buttermilk or 1 cup sour milk, mixed with the milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the zucchini between pieces of wax paper, allowing the wax paper to absorb the water.  Use paper to gently pat the zucchini with paper towels to remove excess moisture.  Sprinkle all the zucchini with a little creole seasoning, garlic salt and cumin.  Sprinkle the zucchini with the rest of the creole seasoning, garlic salt, cumin and buttermilk.  Bake in a 400 degree f oven until tender and zucchini are tender, about 35 minutes.

title: Mince and Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g sirloin | 500 g spinach | 2 tablespoons oil | 250 g bean sprouts | 200 g beef mince | 35 g water | 1 tablespoon parsley
instructions: Slice sirloin into 1 cm slices and set aside.  Trim and cut spinach into strips about 2 cm long.  Heat oil in a frying pan.  Fry sirloin slices for 3 minutes, remove and set aside.  Stir fry beans sprouts for 3 minutes.  Place mince in another frying pan and fry quickly until browned.  Add to bean sprouts and spinach in frying pan.  Add water and boil for an additional 5 minutes.  When all the ingredients are well cooked, sprinkle with parsley.  Serve with rice.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Dough for a Freezer or Machine
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast | 2 cups scalded whole milk or 2 cups scalded plain soymilk | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Put the milk or soymilk in the container of a clean, dry container.  It helps prevent the milk from clumping.  Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk and pour it into the container.  Mix until all of the wet ingredients have dissolved.  Cover and put in the oven.  Turn the heat down to 150f or just a nice 160f if you have it the temperature should be very hot, but not too high or this dough will dry out.  Check after 2 hours and after that it will have a nice, creamy yeasty consistency like toast.  You may need to add a bit more soymilk for keeping dough soft, but i find it works best after 2 days.  Let it cool until you can handle it without much sticking to your hands.  Cover in a plastic container for at least 4 days before using.

title: Sherry and Almond Biscuits
ingredients: 3 cups cake flour, sifted | 3 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper.  Add the flour and chili peppers and combine well.  Make a well in the centre of the mixture and add the almond extract.  Make a well in the centre of the flour mixture and pour the mixture into the well.  Gradually add the remaining cup of flour with a little milk to make into a dough.  Turn onto to a floured surface and knead gently until the dough comes together, then divide into four balls.  Press a sliver of pastry or baking paper on firmly and use to line the trays.  Bake for 15 minutes, remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly.  Once cool, carefully remove from the trays, stack on a piece of biscuit, allowing room to spread.

title: Crunchy, Crunchy Bread
ingredients: 6 -8 small flour tortillas, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 - 1 1/2 cup crisp rice vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Arrange a few pieces of the crisp bread onto the bottom of a microwavable dinner bowl or glass bowl.  Dip the bread into the vinegar on the side to moisten.  Arrange the bread around the bread.  Cover with a microwave safe cling wrap or wax paper.  Microwave on high for 1 min.

title: Taquitos de Natal (Poblano Chile Appetizers)
ingredients: 2 lbs poblano chiles, washed, peeled, seeded, and slit into halves | 6 fluid ounces sweet pickle juice ( or v8 juice ) | 18 fluid ounces mango chutney | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Heat 1/2 of vegetable oil in 12 inch flat bottomed, heavy skillet over medium heat.  Fry chiles until blackened on both sides and beginning to crisp, 5 to 7 minutes.  Use tongs and transfer chiles to paper towels to drain.  Repeat with remaining chiles.  Add pickle mixture to skillet and cook until mixture thickens slightly and begins to simmer 15 seconds.  Stir in chutney, bring to a low simmer and cook until slightly thickened, 1 minute.  Spread chutney evenly over each hot tortilla.  Remove chiles and arrange in warm, not hot, serving dish.  Sprinkle with cilantro, parsley, and remaining vegetable or chutney.

title: Curried Spinach
ingredients: 1 teaspoon curry paste | 12 ounces baby spinach | 2 teaspoons reduced fat, fat free spicy chicken or 2 teaspoons extra firm tofu, crumbled
instructions: Heat up a skillet over low medium heat.  Add curry paste and saute for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add kale leaves, cover, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in cooked and drained tofu and season with salt and pepper until combined.

title: Crock Pot Caribbean Beans and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 1/2 lbs whole kernel corn | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can black olives, drained and sliced | 1 cup mango, chopped | 1 cup vodka | 1/4 cup whole grain mustard or 1/4 cup regular mustard
instructions: Put the frozen broccoli in the bottom of your crock pot.  Combine the above ingredients in a bowl and stir till well mixed.  Let cook for approx 1 1/2 hours on high, stirring occasionally.  Serve over your favorite grain of french bread.

title: Hot Mexican Burgers
ingredients: 1 red sweet pepper, sliced | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Brush the bottom of a skillet a few drops of oil over high heat.  Place vegetables in pan, top with the sweet pepper.  Sprinkle with a few pinches chili powder and stir fry for two minutes.  Turn the burner to high and cook until peppers are lightly and evenly browned, about two minutes note, i like to add a tablespoon of minced chili powder on the peppers when i serve this.  This is great served on hamburger rolls and enjoy.

title: Brown Sugar Glazed Linguine
ingredients: 2 packages linguine | 1/3 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,mace,green cardamom,vegetable broth,coconut milk,parmigiano reggiano cheese,apple juice
title: Tequila Apple Soup With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 cup cubed peeled apple into thin slices | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon mace | 2 green cardamoms, crushed | 1/2 can light coconut milk
instructions: In a large pot, combine broth, apple, cheese, taco seasoning, mace, half of cardamoms, and 1/2 can light coconut milk.  Bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Ladle soup into serving bowls, and serve with remaining cardamoms and remaining 1/2 can coconut milk.

title: Hawaiian Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 large pie shell, made from the refrigerated pie shell | 2 cups finely minced celery | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 can sweetened condensed milk or ( 18 ounce ) can evaporated milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Cook in a large greased frying pan for 15 minutes.  Remove to a plate large enough to allow for the pudding to cool.  Mix, add celery, and mix well.  Roll the bread mixture into a large cresent and place in a casserole dish with a small amount of water on the top of the bread mixture.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Cut into squares or slices.  Serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,black olive,beef bouillon granule,red chilies,potato,espresso powder,garlic crouton,white rice
title:
The Real Stuffing - Quick & Easy.
