ingredients: 2 lbs dried beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon ground black peppercorn | 2 red chilies, split | 1 tablespoon clove garlic ( or 1 tbsp of your choice ) | 2 cups raw white rice, rinsed well and drained | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 10 ounces sliced black olives, drained | 4 cups instant caio de italia rinsed black olives in olive oil and chopped ( or jar of sliced black olives, drained )
instructions: Combine everything in a large oven proof skillet or dutch oven, mix well and heat on medium low setting.  Simmer for approx 2 hours, stirring every so often.  If your pan is not oven safe, pre heat oven to in a small cup heat olive oil and sautee garlic and onions until soft.  Stir in rice.  Let cool for a few minutes, then pour rice mixture over ground rice mixture and stir well.  Put in oven and bake for 30 mins, stirring every so often.  Serve warm with fresh baked beans, rice and a salad of your choice.

title: Walnut and Walnut Fondue for Peroshky or Kålapskaus
ingredients: 4 cups walnut pieces ( optional ) | seasoning salt | 2 cups ice cubes
instructions: Heat your barbeque on high until you have enough smoke to cover the bottom of the barbeque.  Rub the inside of the fondue pot and rub the inside with the cinnamon stick.  Place the walnuts on the plate.  Sprinkle coarse or coarse salt over the top of the walnuts, or leave slightly on until the salt starts to run.  Add the ice cubes.  Use the fondue pot as a gauge with a double layer of fondue forks to move the walnuts around.  The heat should almost always be high enough to hold the food at the bottom of the fondue pot and circulate it around the outside of the pan.  Remember, if fondue forks are allowed to burn, they do burn easily and should not stick to the pot.  The sugar in the caramel should be clear and the walnuts should give off a rich caramel color.

title: Pasta With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Fresh Bell Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces penne ( or other tubular pasta ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 green pepper, diced, with seeds | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 sun-dried tomato, snipped thinly ( the kind with the stems )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, drain & keep warm.  Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, heat oil or butter over medium heat.  Add green pepper & sugar, stirring frequently until tender, about 3 minutes.  Add cooked pasta, sun dried tomatoes and sundried tomatoes.  Toss to mix well & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,lime,spanish onion,bulgur wheat,pecorino romano cheese,mushroom
title: Bulgur Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced | 1 medium spanish onion, finely diced | 1/4 cup mushroom, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 lime ( for rubbing )
instructions: Cook bulgur wheat per instructions and drain.  Combine bulgur and bell pepper, onions, mushrooms, cheese, and juice of the lime.  Stuff peppers with this mixture.  Garnish with extra grated parmigiano or romano cheese, if desired. .

title: Chow Pudding With Corn, Peanut Butter and Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 cup sweet corn kernels, fresh and frozen | 2 teaspoons creamy peanut butter
instructions: Place corn kernels on a microwave safe plate or tray, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 2 minutes.  Stir and microwave for 1 minute or until thawed.  Spread half of the peanut butter over each serving plate and top with half of the corn.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,half cream,table salt,rice wine vinegar,lemon peel
title: Baked Scallops
ingredients: 2 lbs bay scallops, with shell | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 lemon peel, finely grated | 2 packages table salt | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons half-and-half cream
instructions: Place scallops in shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle 1/2 tsp table salt and 1/2 tsp grated lemon peel over scallops.  Cover with remaining 1/2 tsp grated lemon peel.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Remove scallops from marinade.  Drain scallops on paper towels.  Stir in salt and remaining 1/2 tsp salt.  Set aside.  Preheat oven.  Sprinkle 2 sheets of foil with 1/2 tsp table salt.  Place scallops on foil and sprinkle both sides with 1/2 tsp table salt.  Roast in moderately hot oven for 15 to 20 minutes or till fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.  Pour off any remaining marinate.  Spoon half&half into shallow bowl.  Dip tops into cream, turn over, cover, and let stand 2 minutes.  Cut into wedges.  Serve scallops with remaining cream.

Random Ingredients: red chile,shoulder lamb chop,pork neck,pork rib
title: Barbecue Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds shoulder lamb chops | 12 pounds pork neck bones, trimmed | 2 cups red chiles, chopped | 1 pound pork ribs, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the lamb chops, neck bones, chilies, and pork ribs in four large roasting pans.  Rub the meat with the rosemary and salt.  Bake in the preheated oven until the meat is firm, about 2 and 1/4 hours.  Add water if necessary.

title: Cornstarch Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Combine cornstarch and 1 tsp of water in a small bowl and dissolve.  Add remaining ingredients except the bay leaf and salt.  Allow the soup to thicken.  Add the bay leaf.  Allow to simmer for 20 minutes until the soup thickens.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,fenugreek,vodka,red snapper fillet,beef tenderloin,coconut water,pistachio,rice vinegar
title: Pistachio Crusted Red Snapper With Beef Fillets
ingredients: 16 ounces beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons dry mustard greens, chopped ( green and white parts ) | 2 tablespoons pistachios, chopped | 1/3 cup coconut water | 1 tablespoon vodka ( i think other brand would work ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek, crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon coconut oil or 1 -2 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Cut beef fillets in 4 equal pieces and score the flesh cross.  Spread mustard greens on one side of each piece of beef.  Combine pistachios, water, vinegar, fenugreek and coconut oil. If using aluminium foil, place fillet on the upper middle of the foil and brush with oil.  Fold top over so tightly that the foil is completely covering the meat.  Bake at 300f/180°c for about 30 minutes, or until the coating is browned.

title: Pesto Green Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 cans chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups pine nuts | 1 -2 cup green onion, chopped to desired size
instructions: Boil chicken broth.  Add green onions and pine nuts to the warm chicken broth.  Simmer about 10 minutes.  Turn off heat and enjoy.

title: Baked Anise-Coconut Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups tapioca barley flour | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon ground anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease cookie sheets.  In a mixing bowl, sift the tapioca and tamari.  Stir with a fork to combine evenly.  Stir in the coconut milk, margarine, and aniseseed.  On a floured surface, roll the shortbread to 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut into rectangles using cookie cutter.  Press rectangles into the desired shapes.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes or until slightly golden brown.  Remove from cookie sheet, and cool on wire racks.  Store in a airtight container.

Random Ingredients: barley flour,lime,onion soup mix,spinach leaf,cooking spray,salmon fillet,cream chicken soup
title: Smoked Salmon Barley Gravy
ingredients: cooking spray | 8 ounces uncooked smoked salmon fillets, cut into chunks | 1/3 cup barley flour | 1 large onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup shredded lime rind | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a baking dish with cooking spray.  Mix the salmon with the barley flour and onion soup mix in a bowl, tossing to coat.

title: Steamed Broiled Mussels
ingredients: 12 small whole mussels | 3/4 cup aged cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f with a rack in the highest position.  Rinse the mussels but do not cut with a knife.  Put the mussels on a baking tray or baking tin that will fit into the oven.  Place under the broiler and toast 5 minutes, or until the shells are slightly wrinkled.  Scatter over the cheese and move the pan back to the oven and cook, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and slightly golden.  Variation, this would also serve as a meal with steamed french beans and plenty of crusty bread to mop up the juices.

title: Greek Frugal Gourmet Croutons
ingredients: 3 cups croutons | 1/2 cup marinated fresh mixed herbs ( basil, oregano and parsley can also be used )
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees and grease or line a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Spray the tops and bottom of a large crouton bowl with nonstick cooking spray.  Spoon in 1 1/2 tablespoons jarradicchio/marinated mixed herbs with 1/2 tablespoon bottled marinade.  Sprinkle top of mixture with 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning and top with remaining 1/4 teaspoon zuccini seasoning.  Gently press mixture into crouton shells.  Bake in preheated over for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly golden brown.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,rom tomato,spring onion,golden raisin,black pepper,scallop,brown basmati rice,grain rice
title: Scallop, Rice, and Tomato Bake
ingredients: 800 g scallops | 150 ml brown basmati rice | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup spring onion, chopped | 1 cup roma tomato, small, cut into 1cm dice | 1/2 cup golden raisin | fresh ground black pepper | 4 -6 tablespoons water | freshly cooked long-grain rice ( optional )
instructions: If using a grill, pre heat grill pan over medium high heat.  In a medium to large pan, combine scallops with rice, bay leaf, onion, tomatoes and raisins.  Sprinkle peppers over seafood and cover pan partially with lid.  Cook for 20 minutes on both sides.  Transfer scallops and tomato mixture to a plate, discard rice and season.  Transfer pan to oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes on 200°c / 400°f.  Serve with steamed long grain rice for a lovely presentation.

title: Walnut Pesto Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 7 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 ounce black olives, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apple | 4 tablespoons milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chestnuts
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package, drain and keep warm.  Cool slightly.  Combine pesto, baking powder, olives, and apples in a small bowl, mix well.  Add milk a little bit at a time until creamy consistency, mix well.  Stir in drained spaghetti and heat thoroughly.  Add pesto mixture to pasta, tossing well.  Serve topped with grated parmesan or romano cheese.

title: Irish Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 cup coarsely chopped macaroni
instructions: Place brisket in a saucepan.  Cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat.

title: Spicy Salsa
ingredients:
1 bottle prepared salsa | 1 package fresh crisp-shell lettuce ( about 2/3 lb.

instructions: Mix salsa, lettuce and five spice powder.  Serve with avocados if desired.

title: Alphabet Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 container whole wheat flour ( or any low-fat ) | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 lb skinless chicken thigh ( boned and cut into about 3/4- to 1-inch pieces ) | 1 lb velveeta cheese ( cubed ) | 24 almonds, slivered, divided ( skinned or not ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon italian five-grain thinnest rotisserie chicken recipes or 1 whole fresh salmon | 1 lb skinless red salmon, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray a 13 by 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  In a large bowl, combine the flour and bread crumbs.  Add the chicken pieces and mix until well coated.  Set aside.  Put the velveeta cubes in a large mixing bowl and microwave until completely melted, about 2 minutes.  Add the almond extract and mix until completely incorporated.  Add the cubed velveeta and mix until well combined.  Scrape onto the bread crumb mixture and stir until all the pieces are covered in the crumb mixture and a little crumbly.  Add 1/4 cup of the almonds and mix well.  Pour into the prepared baking dish and cover with foil.  Bake at 350 degrees, covered, for 30 minutes.  Remove the foil and stir in the remaining almonds.

Random Ingredients: marsala,arrowroot,flat leaf parsley,sunflower seed,vegetable oil,green bell pepper,coconut
title: Vegetarian Marsala
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 teaspoon sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( optional ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/3 cup sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: In a small frying pan over medium high heat, toast the nuts until golden.  Watch carefully so they don't burn.  Remove from heat, stir in the parsley and pine nuts.  Set aside.  In another frying pan over medium high heat, lightly toast the coconut.  Remove from heat, stir in the coconut, and set aside.  In batches, add vegetable oil and heat to between 400 and 430 degrees f, but watch to see if it has reached the desired texture.  Serve over warm marsala.

title: Italian Noodle Packets
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked & drained | cooking spray | 16 slices pepperoni, any color
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions or if canned, drain well.  Coat a large nonstick frypan or wok with cooking spray.  Place noodles over the oil and saute for 2 minutes or until golden.  Meanwhile, arrange pepperoni slices over the noodles.  Top the noodles with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,french dressing,cold water,chili paste,basil leaf
title: Homemade Mexican Dressing

instructions: Whisk together the french dressing, chili paste, oregano, and 2 cups cold water in a 2 - ½ quart saucepan until smooth. If it seems dry, add 1 tablespoon water at a time, whisking after each addition.  Keep refrigerated up to 1 week.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Zesty Salsa Dip

Minted spinach can be drizzled over finished sprouts before pouring melted butter over it. Meanwhile, heat up tortillas using a pastry brush, or spray with oil & bake on top of a flat oven tray, lined with baking paper on the bottom.  Top with rhubarb pieces & then return to oven.

title: Danish Lentils With Lemons and Almonds
ingredients: 500 g brown lentils | 40 g leeks | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Boil lentils in plenty of water and leeks for 10 mins.  Meanwhile wash leeks and trim off any soil surrounding them.  If they are not green, place in large pan with almond flour diluted in 1/2 pint of water and bring to boil vigorously for 5 mins.  Drain lentils, reserve liquid.  Boil lentils for 10 mins stirring frequently.  Add lentils and water to the lentil mixture and simmer for 15 mins at low heat or for one half hour with lid on.  If there is no lentil at this time, turn off heat and leave until lentils are completely firm again.  Place lentils in a large bowl.  Add leek and almonds, mix well together.  Add almond extract.  Eat with bread or toast.

title: Plum Conserve
ingredients: 6 plums ( very ripe, if possible ) | 2 -3 pieces red chili peppers, seeded ( optional )
instructions: Cut off the top of each plum and scoop out the white pith.  Put a small spoonful or litttle into each plum, then place a chili pepper on top of the plums.  Close with the top of the plum and tie with thread, secure with a wooden spool or other object that will keep plums in short periods of time.  Place plums in a dry pan, and press and cook over medium high heat, shaking the pan frequently, until the plums have wrinkled and all the liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes.  The plums should give off an aromatic, sweet, sour aroma that can be poured through a chute bag or small strainer lined with cheesecloth.  The plums can be eaten hot, warm, or at room temperature.  Store in a sterilized glass jar or bottle, covered, in the refrigerator.

title: Peruvian Rice and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g arborio rice vermicelli | 375 ml rice vermicelli ( dry ) | 4 serrano peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 cup cornmeal ( maize cornmeal ) | 60 g currants
instructions: Boil the vermicelli for 2 minutes and drain.  Cook the rice in boiling water for 30 seconds and drain.  Rinse under cold water and drain.  Cut into 1cm pieces.  Heat the oil in a frying pan.  Add the serrano peppers and stir fry for 1 minute.  Add the rice noodles, rice vermicelli and currants.  Let it cool.  Add cornmeal and stir until the noodles are combined and the mix is smooth.

title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried gingerroot, crushed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 6 1/2 ounces fresh raspberry jam
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, chili sauce, worcestershire sauce, gingerroot and taco seasoning mix.

instructions: Form the hamburger evenly into 4 patties.  Cut each pattie into 6 slices.  Combine the ground sirloin and five spice powder and form patties about 2/3 inch thick.  Grill patties over medium high heat about 3 minutes per side.  While burgers are cooking, prepare sauce.  Combine sauce ingredients and heat.  Serve burgers with sauce and strawberries, if desired.

title: Southern White Bean Burritos

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the beans, 1 tablespoon of the margarine, salt, and garlic salt.  Spread 1 tablespoon of the remaining margarine on each tortilla.  Spread evenly on all sides.  Top each tortilla with a few drops of green olive oil.  Wrap with foil, and heat in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 5 to 6 minutes.  Cut in half onto each side.

title: Rhubarb Sausages
ingredients: 4 links pork sausage | 6 stalks rhubarb, trimmed and chopped in half | 6 stalks green onions, halved | 6 red chile, seeded and sliced
instructions: Fry the sausages in a little oil until crisp on the outside and cooked through.  Leave them to rest for about 5 minutes, or longer depending on how they are cooked.  Return all of the contents to the pan.  Add the rhubarb and cook together for 5 minutes, stirring regularly.  Scatter the spring onion and chilli and serve.

title: Noodles and Parsnips
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs parsnips, peeled and halved | 1 large white onion, halved vertically
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine parsnips, onion and onion halves in a 2 quart casserole.  Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper, to taste.  Add 1/2 cup water.  Cover tightly and bake until tender, about 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally.  Serves note, vegetables may be peeled and cut into 1/2 inch chunks or chopped larger pieces of onion.  Use in place of parsnips when indicated in ingredients list.

title: Hard Salami and Marshmallow Dippers
ingredients: 1 hard salami, chopped | 1/4 cup marshmallow creme | 1/3 cup taco seasoning | 1 scoop vanilla ice cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and place on waxed paper and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Spread the butter on the insides of the salami roll up and enjoy you may want to cut the salami in to 1/4 inch slices.  To make smaller appetizers cut more butter, and slice smaller.  Serve with fruit spread or topping or eat plain.

title: Roast Beef Spread
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef, thinly sliced and cut into 1/3 x 1/4 strips | 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 hot pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine sour cream and mustard powder in a small bowl.  Stir in hot pepper until well mixed.  Place roast beef strips in a shallow bowl.

title: Prawns in Parsley-Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the shrimp, parsley, and salt to taste in a bowl.  Toss to coat evenly.

title: Spiced Red Lentils With Mushrooms and Mustard (Shrikarno Korma)

instructions: Place the lentils in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover them by an inch and bring to a boil.  Boil until they are tender, about ten minutes.  Drain, then transfer the lentils to a large, shallow serving dish.  Cover with cold water by an inch.

title: Cilantro Butter
ingredients: 4 large scotch bonnets fresh ginger root, peeled and sliced | 1 pound fresh cilantro, stems trimmed and leaves chopped | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 vanilla bean, split | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Arrange half of ginger slices into a baking dish.  Drizzle brown sugar over ginger slices.  Add remaining ginger slices.  Top with half of the cilantro.  Place baking dish in the preheated oven, and continue cooking the ginger and cilantro until sugar has reduced slightly, 35 to 45 minutes.  Stir the vanilla bean into the cilantro and continue cooking until vanilla bean ends show caramelization, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.  Makes 1/2 cup.

title: Spicy Chile Cream
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies | 1 pint ice cream
instructions: Roast chilis in a 400°f oven for 10 minutes.  Immediately pout onto a cutting board.  Then slice 1/2 thick.  Spread slices onto a foil lined baking sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes at 400°f remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.  Place chilis in a food processor and process until very fine.  Spoon over ice cream.

title: Pear Tapas
ingredients: 3 ripe pears ( the size of your pear ) | 6 table salt ( the amount is your preference, i will never meet a 3-salt level ) | 3 pinches table salt ( you can use 2 pinches each of salt and salt )
instructions: Peel the pears, removing the core and the stem.  Slice them finely or cut them slices in half lengthwise if they are large.  Place them in a bowl with water and salt and mix to a smooth paste.  Leave on the countertop for at least 1 hour, tossing frequently.  Drain the tapas, rinse them under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Dry on paper towels.  Cut in half if they are wide.  Put about 1 teaspoon of prepared tapas in the center of each puer, and press down on all sides to make room for the tapas.  Serve chilled.  The tapas can last for as long as 3 days, or the yield is still fairly flexible.

title: Linguica - Mario Batali
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1 liter marinara sauce ( i usually use heinz tomato & basil mix ) | 12 -16 cherry tomatoes | 12 -16 spring onions | 300 g chopped fresh clam | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Boil a pot of salted water and add tomato & basil.  Cook pasta al dente or al dente.  Boil water and cook tomatoes until softened and starting to break down.  Add cherry tomatoes to tomato sauce, cook until nearly boiling.  Add 1/4 cup of cherry basil to tomato sauce, heat through.  Drain pasta and combine with tomato sauce.  Turn sauce into a serving dish, top with cherry basil and remaining basil to create a pretty garnish.

title: Creamy Mexican Coffee
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground coffee | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons guacamole or 2 tablespoons other desired toppings
instructions: Combine all ingredients well in a small bowl.  Pour into a mug, top with toppings.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black bean,agave syrup,marsala wine,kiwi fruit,chili pepper flake,raspberry jam,dark sesame oil
title: Black Beans and Kiwi Jam (Gluten-Free and Vegan)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 500 g black beans or 500 g canned black beans, thoroughly drained | 1 kiwi fruits or 4 -5 green kiwi fruits, peeled cored and grated rind finely | 2 tablespoons cocoa shavings or 2 tablespoons agave syrup | 2 teaspoons sweet chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon black sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon harissa or 1/4 teaspoon maple flavoring | 300 ml raspberry jam, warmed in microwave, for dipping
instructions: Heat the oils in a microwave safe bowl in 30 seconds on high power.  Add the beans and rice wine mixed together and heat in microwave for about 1 minute.  Stir well.  Tip in the kiwi/papaya/grated rind and microwave on medium high power for 1 minute stirring halfway through.  Tip in the cocoa/saffron and black sesame oil, stir well.  Remove the bowl from microwave, stir well.  Return to the microwave, on high power and cook on high power for about 1 - 2 minute.  Stir and stir once more.  Microwave the jam in a microwave safe bowl for about 30 seconds to 1 minute, on high power.  Stir once after 30 seconds and microwave for about 1 - 2 minutes, on high power, on high power, on high power.  Stir once more.  Tip, it is best to do all this in the microwave before eating, as this ensures the jam being completely cooked on the bottom of the bowl.  Instead you can put the jam on top of the rice wine mix, instead of adding the saffron oil and reheating it in the microwave, but i prefer it for this recipe.  Serve with kiwifruit, sambalaya, chilli flake or a raspberry jam and/or honey to make a greek style salad.

title: Sloppy Joes With Cognac Syrup
ingredients: 12 chicken pieces, skins removed | 32 frozen peas, thawed | 4 tablespoons whiskey | 1 cup cognac | 1 cup chicken or 1 cup vegetable broth | 8 large lettuce leaves, and | powdered sugar or cinnamon sugar
instructions: Rinse the chicken pieces and remove any attached parts.  Arrange, skin side down, on foil lined baking sheet.  In a small saucepan, combine peas and 2 tablespoons of the whiskey & boil for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in cognac & simmer for 5 minutes.  Pour over chicken & marinate in the refrigerator at least 4 hours.  To serve, spoon the cooked peas over the chicken & sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of whiskey & sugar or cinnamon sugar.

ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons red curry paste or 4 -5 tablespoons curry powder ( to taste ) | 28 ounces goya ziti pasta ( about 1kg ) | 1 1/2 cups turnips ( i like turnips ) or 1 1/2 cups prawns, peeled and deveined ( i like turnips ) | 1 cup kale, shredded ( optional ) | 2/3 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Put the carrots and turnips into a large saucepan with just enough water to cover them, and boil for 10 - 15 minutes to cover the turnips. Add the curry paste, ginger, carrots, and prawns to the pasta, toss well, and place on top of your choice of greens and greens in that order.  Sprinkle with the pecans, and sprinkle with the crumbs.

title: Raspberry Fondue

instructions: Cut cheese into 2 inch chunks.  Place cheese and raspberries in a food processor with enough water to barely cover cheese and process until cheese is melted. May be served with cream or ice cream if desired.

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain.  Rinse shrimp and set aside.  Place portobello mushroom caps into a saucepan with 1/4 cup of miracle whip, tomato juice, and sugar.  Bring to a boil.

title: Savory Ginger and Beet Sticks

instructions: Bring 1 cup water to a boil.  Add wild rice and cover.  Simmer about 50 minutes or until aldente.  Drain and set aside to cool.  In a microwave safe bowl, microwave the beets until tender on high.  Using the same microwave method if using, grate beets by hand and mix with the raw or roasted beet.  Dissolve baking soda in same microwave.  Stir in ginger powder, saltines and 1 1/2 cups water.  Bring to a boil and boil to thicken, a few minutes.  Remove from heat and cool.  Add a mixture of this mixture to cooled rice, stir.  Chill for 15 minutes or until flavors are blended.

title: Ladyfingers Italiano

instructions: Slice 2 tablespoons of butter beans crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Arrange one ladyfinger slice in the middle of two pieces of butter beans and top with a second piece of butter bean slices.  Repeat with remaining ladyfingers and bean slices until all ladyfingers are used.  Fold one end of each ladyfinger slice over the top of the filled beans just a little so as not to curvage the butter bean slices.  Place on dull or round cookie sheets that hold a little room in the freezer.  The ends may be peeled off, if desired.

title: Easy French Breakfast

instructions: In a large bowl, combine dates, applesauce.

instructions: Rinse, core, and cut green tops off peppers and remove seeds.  Spray pan or roaster with non stick spray.  Arrange peppers in pan, in a single layer.  Sprinkle dressing mix over tops of peppers, making sure they are evenly distributed.  Cook at 300 degrees for 3 hours.

instructions: Combine the soup mix, pineapple nuts and beef in a 3 quart crockpot and stir well to dissolve soup mix and nuts.

instructions: Place oregano, fenugreek, apple pie filling, fish sauce, green onions, black olives, and optional peanuts in a saucepan.

instructions: Boil water for pasta.  Cook to box instructions, drain and rinse with cold water.  Set aside. title: Chop-And-Putter Bombs!

instructions: Prepare a baking sheet by lining the baking sheet with aluminum foil and extending the edges up over the rim of the baking sheet. Remove the tomatoes from the pan and arrange them on the foil lined baking sheet.  Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake the tomatoes in a preheated oven until the juices have reduced to half or until tender, about 20 minutes.  Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Miso-Glazed Turnips (Tawabu Tamarindo)

instructions: Cut the turnips in half lengthwise, then slice each half thinly crosswise.  Place in a glass casserole.  Sprinkle with miso and water.  Add brown sugar, ancho chili powder and stir to combine.  Cover the turnips with lid.  Place in a steamer over 1 inch of simmering water.  Cook until the turnips are tender when pierced with a small knife, about 15 minutes.  Remove the turnips and let cool to lukewarm.

title: Korean Beef With Zucchini and Chile

2 lbs chuck steaks ( at least 1.
    -5 pounds ) | 1 dash ground cinnamon | 2 -3 red chiles, sliced or chopped, to taste | 1 can zucchini | 2 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: In a skillet over med heat, brown the chuck steak, turning only once.  Turn heat to low.  Add cinnamon and chiles.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Remove meat and slice.  Add zucchini and cook for 30 minutes.  Stir in half and half.  Return meat to skillet and heat through.

instructions: Cook rice for 15 minutes over med heat.  Add raisins, riso and sage.  Cover with boiling water.  Cook until liquid is absorbed.  Allow to rest for 5 to 10 minutes.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.  Place chicken in a baking dish and scatter cheese evenly over the chicken breasts.  Top with carrots, then place in the oven when the oven is preheated, and bake for about 45 mins to 1 hour until the breasts are pink and cooked through.

title: Minty Chicken with Fries

ingredients: 1 frozen pounder steak, thawed | 3 tablespoons flour, divided ( beef flavored ) | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules, divided | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, packed | 3 ounces cooked medium rare sirloin steak, sliced very thinly across the grain | 2 large flour tortillas | 2 sheets lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Using one tablespoon of flour, toss steak with 1 tablespoon flour.

title: Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 cup whole milk whipping cream or 1 cup light cream and half | 3/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 4 thick sliced herbed, colored mushrooms ( such as chanterelles, shitake mushrooms, cremini mushrooms, and a sprinkling of dried herbs ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried currant or 1/4-1/2 cup raisins, mixed with | fresh herbs ( such as marjoram, basil and tarragon ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped fresh tomatillo, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Slice off both ends of the eggplant and carefully scoop out the soft flesh from the inside of the eggplant.  Discard seeds.  Place the shells in boiling water, add a handful of salt to the water and cook for 10 - 15 minutes exactly until soft.  Drain and place the shells and the shells in boiling water to stop the cooking.  Set them aside until cool enough to handle, then remove the shells and the black skin from the eggplant.  Using kitchen shears, cut a cross in the mushroom base of the eggplant.  Pull them out of the shells and set aside.  In a saucepan bring the milk to a boil and add the vanilla extract slowly, a few drops at a time to prevent scorching.  Keep doing small amounts of milk and vanilla extract until the milk is at the thickest stage.  Whip the cream and fold it into the eggplant.  In a medium bowl, mix together the herbed mushrooms with the currants and chopped fresh herbs.  Fill the mushroom caps with the eggplant and mushroom mixture.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or until the cream is set.  When ready to serve garnish with fresh tomatillo or fresh herb sprigs.  Serve at room temperature, with a good fresh bread and a crusty bread slice.

title: Baba Ganouj
ingredients: 4 -8 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 2 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: Heat oil in pan on high.  Add chili sauce and stir into the oil.  Reduce heat to low and wait until oil reaches about a smoking point.

title: Green Pea Spread With Braggs
ingredients: 1 cup green peas | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamari or 2 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons walnuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Place peas in a microwave safe dish.  Lightly coat the microwave dish with cooking spray.  Heat at high power, 4 - 5 minutes.  Swirl dish once or twice, so peas don`t cook too fast and steam for 5 - 7 minutes, or until they are slightly softened but with a little texture left.  Stir tamari and walnuts into the peas until they are evenly distributed.  Serve asap.

title: Jamaican Sea Scallop Pouch
ingredients: 4 sea scallops | 4 dried jalapeno chilies, seeded and chopped ( you can use canned, sliced jalapeno chilies if you don't mind a bit of heat ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped leeks | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed in water and drained | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/3 cup canned avocado, cut into 1/4 chunks | 2 tablespoons finely chopped unsalted dry-roasted unsalted chocolate
instructions: Set shrimp out on a plate.  Using a mortar and pestle or food processor, coarsely grind peppers and leeks and reserve for later.  If using canned pineapple chunks, drain and reserve syrup.  If using canned pineapple pieces, reserve syrup.  If using raisin water, reserve liquid.  If using fresh jamaican sea scallops, season tops of scallops with salt.  Spray a large nonaluminum saucepan or deep plate platter with cooking spray and set aside.  If using canned pineapple chunks, drain and reserve syrup.  If using raisin water, reserve syrup.  If using canned pineapple chunks, puree reserved oil from raisin water in a blender or food processor. .  Put water in a deep nonstick skillet or dutch oven and heat over medium high heat.  Add scallops and sauté 3 to 4 minutes, or according to your desired firmness.  Remove from heat and add chiles, reserved juice from canned pineapple chunks and reserved syrup.  If using canned pineapple chunks, reduce liquid in skillet to 1 cup, remove seeds and liquid.  Serve scallops with shrimp mixture and garnish with reserved peanuts.

title: Potato, Apple & Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | iceberg lettuce ( optional ) or iceberg lettuce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned cranberries ( optional ) | 1 small red apple, seeded and diced ( optional ) | 1 package chive & onion cream cheese ( optional )
instructions: Put potatoes in a saucepan and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain the potatoes and chill.  Wash, peel and dice the remaining potatoes.  Add potatoes and stir to coat with oil and toss.  Toss in lettuce, cranberries, apple if using, chives and cream cheese.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Serve warm or chilled.

title: Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 4 pounds pork butt, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package fresh broccoli cuts | 1 pound yellow squash, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Place the pork butt in a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the meat is tender and easily removed from the bone and the water has evaporated, about 2 hours.  Skim away any scum that forms on top.  Stir the remaining water and broccoli into the simmering meat.  Continue to simmer until vegetables are tender and cooked through, about 15 minutes more.  Remove the pork butt from the heat and let rest in a cool area, about 10 minutes.  Cut the fat off the broth, discarding the solids, and discard any pieces of pork.  Reserve the fat in the pot.  Strain the broth through a fine sieve, then return it to the pot, discarding solids and the meat strips of pork. instructions: Trim the lamb of excess fat.  Cut in 2 3cm slices crossways.  Mix oil with chilli, anchovy paste and sherry, allow oil to develop in refrigerator.  In a small frying pan, heat oil and fry lamb in batches until browned and cooked throughout.  Place on paper towels to drain.  Pour off any excess fat from pan, add sugar and continue frying for 2 - 3 minutes.  Slice the romaine leaves and place on a serving platter.  Sprinkle with whiskey to taste.  Pour heated dressing over, sprinkle with chilli flakes and serve immediately.  For a less smoky flavour, omit the sherry.

title: Mongolian Shredded Beef
ingredients:
1 beef brisket ( can use other cuts of beef.
    - ) | kosher salt, to taste | rice wine, to taste | 1 lemon, halved | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | crushed ice
instructions: Rub kosher salt onto the beef, inside and out.  You want it to be on the salt already.  Trim as much excess fat as you can from the meat by wrapping around the meat and securing with toothpicks.  You want about 2/3 of the way through this process, but it does not need to be completely sealed.  Leave approximately 1/2 inch of any excess fat in the bottom of the pan.  Place brisket into pan, sprinkle beef with course salt, and set aside.  Repeat with second meat.  Sprinkle lemon juice, curry paste and remaining 1/3 of salt over meat.  Place over medium heat, cover with lid and cook for 15 minutes.  Turn meat over, cover tightly, and cook for another 15 minutes.  Turn off heat, turn meat over and allow to sit in the pan for approximately 15 minutes.  You will have to do this at least once or twice while eating.  Serve with rice and serve with your favourite vegetables.

title: Zucchini & Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg chuck, in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1 zucchini, chopped | 3 large green chile peppers, chopped | 200 g velveeta cheese, broken into chunks | 300 ml cream of celery soup | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron threads | 1 sprig thyme ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Combine flour and zucchini in a large bowl and toss in green peppers.  Place half the beef into a greased casserole dish.  Sprinkle with half the cheese.  Repeat with remaining beef and cheese.  Mix soup and saffron in a jug until dissolved then pour over beef and vegetables.  Cover and bake for 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.  Remove lid and cook for a further hour or until lightly browned.  Sprinkle with thyme and serve warm with warm bread or biscuits.

title: Spanish Braised Lamb Shoulder

instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas lightly oil or butter a deep shallow ovenproof dish.  Place lamb shoulder in dish and stud with pepper. Place the beans in a saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to the boil, then simmer, covered, for 5 minutes or until just tender.  Drain and return to the pan.  Cover the pan and remove the lid to bring liquid to a boil.  Add the onion, reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes.  Serve lamb with beans and rice and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Fluffy Lemon Sauce for Pasta and Meat

title: Prawns With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 lb large cleaned prawns | 1 can condensed buttermilk, plus extra to drizzle | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 1/4 cup finely chopped semisweet mini chocolate morsels ( or 2 cups assorted bittersweet mini chocolate morsels soaked in water to cover for 25 min ) or 1/4 cup finely chopped chocolate candy pecan halves ( or 2 cups assorted bittersweet mini chocolate morsels soaked in water to cover for 25 min )
instructions: Peel and devein the prawns.  Toss the prawns, the buttermilk, pistachios and 1/4 cup of the chocolate with the 1/4 cup of candy.  Place them in an ovenproof dish.  Drizzle with the remaining 1/4 cup of melted chocolate.  The more you add the chocolate the more you want your prawn to have an orangey color you can also add a bit of the pistachios.  Bake at 375°f for about 1 hour.  Serve with any remaining pistachios.

title: Gibna's Fruit Kedgeree
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, with peel | 3 spring onions, chopped | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Cut each kiwi fruit into 8 wedges.  Place the kiwi wedges into a blender and add the peeled and chopped spring onions.  Add ice water.  Cover and process until ice is crushed.

title: Grilled Homemade Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut 2 x 1-inch pieces | 12 -16 ounces fruit, your choice ( we used strawberry, pineapple, blueberry, or blackberry ) | 24 -20 canned whole water chestnuts, sliced | 1/3 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Place meat in a plastic bag or a gallon sized plastic zipper bag and marinate, chilled, for at least 4 hours.  Drain meat and place on skewers, alternating meat and fruit with remaining fruit, marinade should be just covering meat.  Grill over medium hot coals for 15 - 20 minutes or until done.

title: Yogurt Ice Cream

instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Mix the yogurt with the seasoning and leave until cold.  Shape into a log shape on an oven tray lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 25minutes until crisp and brown.

Random Ingredients: white flour,egg,tilapia fillet,brown rice,garlic paste,golden raisin
title: Tilapia With Raisins and Fried Rice
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 egg ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f.  Arrange fish in a baking pan.  Mix garlic paste, and brown rice, and raisins in a bowl.  Pour over fish.  Place in upper middle of oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until fish is golden brown and flakes when tested with a fork.  Meanwhile, make the fried rice per package instructions.  Mix egg and flour in a bowl, sprinkle over fish.  Serve with rice.

title: Roasted Whole Grilled Squash
ingredients: 600 g yellow split squash | 5 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves, loosely packed | 1 clove crushed garlic | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil
instructions: Trim the squash lengthways and remove the seeds and the hard outer layer.  Use the largest core of the squash so the cooking doesn't go too overboard.  Use a skewer or a skewer knife to make a few small holes on the skin so the steam will escape.  The squash mustn't be too tight or it will break apart.  Cut the squash in half lengthways and set aside.  Remove the strings and fibers and any loose skin around the squash.  Make sure they're cut in half again so that you have 12 pieces.  Using a sharp knife, cut away the core in half so that you end up with 12 pieces of squash.  Use the same skewer to trim away the thickest part of the squash.  Use your fingers or a skewer to trim away any extra flesh.  Make a small incision across the underside of each piece of squash to let some of the steam escape.  Insert thyme leaves inside.  Combine garlic, hot chilli oil and olive oil and rub well over the entire surface of the squash.  Put the squash halves onto a preheated oven grill over a moderate flame and cook for about 30 minutes or until the skins are dark brown and crispy.  Turning as necessary after 30 minutes, so they brown evenly.  Place the squash on a rack to cool slightly, then cover them with a newspaper to stop drying out.  They should be dry when ready.  To test whether they are ready, put a sharp knife through the squash and you should pierce with a skewer or fork.  If they are dry, the griller will be too hot.  Serve with tomato relish and salad leaves, such as rocket, mixed salad greens, etc.

title: Japanese Beef Jerky

instructions: Thoroughly mix the soya with the sake and tabasco.  Marinate the meat at least 2 hours in the fridge, overnight is best.  Drain the meat completely before drying.

title: Aceitun (Beef Medallions with a Rich-Tasting Glaze)
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, about 1-1/2 pounds, trimmed ( each serving about 1-pound ) | lemon-flavored glaze | 3/4 cup apricot, cut in thin half-moons ( about 3/4 cup ) | 4 tomatoes, cut in wedges | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Place beef in shallow baking dish.  Drizzle with glaze, then sprinkle with lemon zest and cover tightly with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 4 hours, turning the beef occasionally.  Prepare grill.  Place beef in gas grill or charcoal grill and season with salt, pressing as much as possible out of the slits inside.  Grill, moving once or twice, about 5 minutes per side.  Transfer beef to platter and tent with foil.  Let rest 5 minutes before carving into medallions.  Remove from the grill, brush with glaze and let stand for 5 minutes.  Serve with the tomato wedges, apricots, and amaretto.

title: Sopa De Frijoles - Authentically Painted Bean Cakes With a Mint Tingling Mint
ingredients: 4 lbs white beans, washed | 1 pint white raisins or 1 pint golden raisin | 18 large egg yolks | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 3 cups of fresh mint leaves, washed ( may substitute dried mint, or use fresh coriander leaves ) | 1 medium red enchilada sauce ( may substitute 1/2 red chilli sauce, as you prefer or use black bean salsa, or other favorite hot sauce ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( or white wine ) or 1/2 cup dry white wine ( or white wine ) | 1/4 cup of fresh mint leaves, washed and chopped
instructions: Preparation, take the beans and wash them.  Soak these for about 10 to 20 minutes in hot water so that the skins can come off easily.  Drain the beans, and allow them to dry for about an hour.  After the beans have soaked for at least an hour, preheat a cast iron skillet or a grill pan to medium heat, for about five minutes.  Place the beans in a clean kitchen towel and wring them to remove as much moisture as possible.  Place them in a bowl and add enough cold water so that as much water as possible can be squeezed out of each bean.  Cover the bowl and let them sit for about an hour, then drain the soaking water from the beans completely.  Drain back into the bowl, but reserve them for later use.  To clean the pan, place the empty beans into it, and add another 1/4 cup of cold water.  Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat slightly until the beans begin to soften.  Do not remove the cooking vessel until you leave behind some of the water that is trapped at the bottom of the pan, as this stops the beans from breaking apart completely.  After the beans are cooked to your liking, remove the pan from the heat, and mix them in a bowl.  Remove the bean skins and discard.  In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg yolks with some of the water that has cooked off, and add the soaked beans and lime zest.  Mix well using a rubber spatula or hand held mixer, but be careful not to let the mixture become lumpy as the eggs may start to curdle.  When this happens, add 2 tablespoons of the lime juice back into the mixture and mix a little.  Then, with the mixer still on a low speed, add another tablespoon of lime juice into the mixture.  If the mixture is too dry, add more lime juice and lime juice.  This should make about 3/4 cup of liquid.  You don't want it too runny but, it is okay if it seems a little too thick, add more warm water.  Now, add the mint leaves and mix them into the bean mixture a little bit, don't over mix, because when everything is incorporated, the mixture is still wet.  Now pour about half of the bean mixture into the bowl you used to cook the beans in and, if the mixture starts to dry out, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of water.  Using a wooden spoon, mix the mixture thoroughly, you may need to add more water or more lime juice.  If needed, add more lime juice.  Now, using a wooden spoon, break up the beans into the bean mixture a little bit, careful not to break them.  The mixture will be wet.  This should result in about 4 cups of bean mix.  Now, using a wooden spoon, mix the mixture thoroughly, using a wooden spoon.  Do not overmix, or it will become difficult.  The mixture will become very dry.  The mixture can be kept this way for several weeks in the refrigerator

Bake in a preheated oven for 45 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through.  Remove from oven and allow to cool completely.  Serve cold.

title: Thai Sweet Bread - Rachael Ray
ingredients:
2 cups sweet bread, chopped at least small | 2 -6 teaspoons thai green curry paste, to taste ( i use japanese as i've tried to sub regular and was well liked with it.
    - ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | ice, as needed
instructions: Put bread and curry paste into a medium to shallow bowl.  Add 1 3/4 cup water to bread.  Gently knead to make bread mixture the shape of bread dough that you desire.  You don't want your bread to have a domed shape but just a bit round and flat.  If it is dry add more water.  Cover bowl in plastic wrap.  Refrigerate until chilled, about 1½ hours.  If you have time, chill bread slightly in the refrigerator, then remove plastic wrap and press bread with your hands.  Preheat oven to 400°f cut a cross on top of the bread to make the bread crispy.  It is easier to do if the bread has been chilled overnight, i prefer to wait until almost all of the water from the bread has passed out.  Spray two cookie sheets with oil and toast the bread, turning once, until golden brown.  Remove to wire rack and cover with foil.  When you are ready to enjoy, cut off about 1 - ½ - 2 tablespoons of bread dough and spread 1/2 3/4 cup of it on top of the bread, leaving an an 1 - ½ moon at the top edge.  If you like you can also spoon some of the raisins into a bowl and sprinkle with more of the raisins if you like.  If you don't have raisins you can also sprinkle a little of the golden raisins over the top of the bread as well.  Enjoy it.

instructions: Toss the bread cubes with the seasoning and leave for about 20 minutes.  Mix all the coconut milk and the coconut with a little water in a medium pot.  Slice the sausages lengthways and thread onto skewers.  Grill for 5 minutes until the sausages are cooked through.  Serve immediately with yogurt and cucumber salad and salad salad leaves.

title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine) Sticks
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 4 slices bacon, cooked and chopped | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups toasted french-fried breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Trim ends of eggplant and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices.  Set aside.  Using a vegetable peeler or very sharp knife, peel eggplant slices so that they will stand upright.  Place slices on several layers of foil, about 2 inches apart.  Turn the slices in the brine, salt liberally, and allow to drain until needed, about 20 minutes.  In a large bowl mix the bread crumbs and cornstarch and set aside.  Remove and discard the skin from the eggplant.  Remove and discard any membrane from the stem end with a peeler, then tear off any membrane along with the eggplant, and set aside.  In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium high heat until crisp.  Drain the bacon on paper towels, reserving 2 tbs.  Of the drippings.  Spread the bread crumb mixture over the bottom half of a sheet of aluminum foil, and set aside.  Place the eggplant slices on top of the crumbs until completely coated.  Place slices upright on a lightly greased baking sheet and cut a slit lengthwise down the center so they will stand nicely, then place in the oven.  Bake for 15 minutes, then carefully remove from cookie sheets and allow to cool for at least 10 minutes before removing from foil.  Serve with french fried crumbs.
