Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,club soda,green pepper,apricot preserve,plum tomato
title: Ziti with Plum Tomatoes and Green Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups dry ziti pasta | 2 large plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 green pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1/2 cup club soda
instructions: Cook the ziti in boiling water according to directions on the package.  Meanwhile, heat the apricot preserves in a small skillet over medium low heat.  Stir occasionally until warmed through.  While the ziti is cooking, place the tomatoes, green pepper and green pepper in a saucepan of boiling water.  Return to a boil, then remove from heat and drain the ziti.  When the ziti is done, drain, leaving 2/3 of the liquid.  Mix ziti with the sauce until the tomato mixture is well moistened.  Chill in the refrigerator 1 hour, stirring from time to time to blend flavors.

title: The Whole Lotta Cheeseburger
ingredients: 1 can meatballs | 1 cup zucchini | 1 -2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 2 tablespoons ice, or as needed | 1 container non-fat vanilla yogurt, drained
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients together in a food processor until smooth.  If you can't find the ice, stir in a few extra tbs.  Of plain water to loosen the mixture.  To serve, divide the mixture among 6 pita breads, or other pretty flat breads.  Top with yogurt and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,oregano,apricot,monterey jack cheese,green onion,kidney bean,stout beer
title: Crock Pot Beer Apricot Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces tilapia fillets | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar diced apricots, drained | 1/2 cup green onion, drained | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 bottle stout beer, such as stout, such as budweiser | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Place tilapia, kidney beans, apricots and green onions in the bottole of an uncovered crockpot.  Top with beer.  Sprinkle with oregano.  Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 4 hours.  Spoon off most of the beer.  Stir in cheese and continue cooking until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,baking potato,albacore tuna water,celery,feta cheese,sage leaf,chili oil
title: Farfalle Potato Casserole
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes | 8 ounces albacore tuna in water | 10 ounces feta cheese | 8 ounces bertolli farfalle pasta ( about 3/4 pound ) | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 3 fresh sage leaves | 1 cup celery, chopped
instructions: Slice potatoes lengthwise, then cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick, making 6 layers.  Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender.  While potatoes are cooking, drain tuna and cut into bite size chunks.  Place tuna, cheese, and farfalle in a 2 quart casserole dish.  Heat olive oil in a 10 inch non stick frying pan over moderate heat and add sage.  Cook stirring over high heat until very fragrant, about 1 minute.  Add potatoes and celery to pan, cover, and cook, stirring constantly, until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted about 10 minutes.  Spoon cheese mixture over fish.  Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven until heated through, about 40 minutes.

title: Tuscan Style Meatball
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1/2 lb uncooked bow tie pasta | 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 4 ounces jar diced pimientos | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Rinse lamb and remove all visible fat.  Cut lamb into 1 inch cubes.  If using uncooked bow tie pasta, cook, according to package directions.  While meat and beans are cooking, preheat oven to 375f degrees.  Place meat in a bowl with a tight fitting lid.  Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Pour mixture in the bowl with the meat, stirring to coat.  Line a roasting pan with reynolds parchment paper or aluminum foil, allowing the edges of the foil to hang over the sides of the pan.  Place meat on roasting pan.  Roast 30 minutes, until an instant read thermometer reaches 160f degrees.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,navel orange,mustard seed,white wine vinegar,pork tenderloin,head cabbage,mango
title: Caribbean Pork-and-Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1 to 2 inch pieces | 1 navel orange, quartered lengthwise, cut into thin slices, and sections | 3 mangoes, with peel, peeled, seeded, and cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 head of cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Place tenderloins lengthwise in a large saucepan of water.  Cover, bring to boil over medium high heat, and boil 15 minutes.  Remove tenderloins from water, and let stand 10 minutes.  Drain.  While pork is cooking, place orange segments in a bowl.  Fill with oranges, mango, cabbage, and mustard seeds.

Random Ingredients: green chile,american cheese,italian herb seasoning,vinegar,chicken drumstick,chervil
title: Chicken Drums in Chile Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs ( mrs dash, sage, borage, rosemary ) | 1 teaspoon chiles, seeded and chopped ( canned, i used 1 1/2 tsp, i'm a bit more ) | chicken drumsticks, cooked ( i used thighs ) | 4 slices american cheese, cut into 4 pieces ( i used pepperjack ) | fresh chervil, chopped ( optional and optional )
instructions: Marinade, combine vinegar through chilies in small bowl.

title: Crazy Coffee
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice | 4 black cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons strong coffee, like rysco | 1 tablespoon black coffee, like rysco
instructions: Bring some small sauce pan, like a small frying pan, to medium heat.  Rinse rice with warm water and set aside until cool, then drain off water and place in a large ceramic bowl with a small mesh strainer and the black cardamom pods.  Stir 2 tablespoons of coffee into coffee to create a subtle flavor, then add to bowl and set aside.  Using the rice's side, carefully open up the cardamom pods, remove the pods and discard, and grind in a mortar and pestle or blender.  Heat remaining coffee in same roasting pan on stovetop and add coffee mixture into the pan and bring to boil, cover, reduce heat to low and leave lid slightly ajar, allowing to simmer for 10 minutes.  Then remove lid and stir in freshly ground coffee.

title: Mirchi Raita
ingredients: 6 1/4 cups grated carrots, with the excess grated still attached | 4 cups grated fresh mint leaves, plus | 4 teaspoons mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place the grated carrots into a large bowl and drizzle with 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil.  Cover and let stand for 15 minutes, then drain and toss with the mint leaves.  Transfer to an airtight container and store.  The raita will keep for up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,swiss cheese,fontina cheese,monterey jack cheese,triple sec,chive
title: French Robuncha
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1/3 lb swiss cheese | 1/3 lb monterey jack cheese | 1/3 lb fontina cheese | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup chives, chopped
instructions: Cut all lettuce leaves into quarters.  Stack.  Cut montesco into 1 inch squares.  Cut fontina into 1/2 inch squares.  Stack fontina squares.  Dice chives.  Pour the triple sec over the cheeses.  Garnish with chives.

title: Spicy Lentil and Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 200 g linguine | 250 g lentils | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 7 -8 serrano peppers | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Boil lentils and chill.  Put aside when cooked.  Add shrimp for 10 minute and seafood stew for 6 min or until cooked and squid fry, add tamari and vanilla essence and fry again.  Add seafood stew and cook through.  Add salt to taste.

title: Eubergine (Eggplant) and Sardine Fritters (Gkai Khingri)
ingredients: 8 large aubergines, sliced lengthways | 2 teaspoons whole coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons good quality sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf | sriracha sauce, to serve ( or tabasco sauce, or other good chile sauce ) ( optional )
instructions: In a hot wok, add the coriander seeds and leave for about 30 seconds, swirling the wok so that they darken slightly, then remove them and transfer to a plate.  Pour 1 tsp of oil and 1/2 tsp of sesame seeds into the wok and leave for about 2 seconds, until they turn lightly brown, then transfer to the plate with the seeds.  Wipe the wok clean with damp kitchen paper, put it on your stovetop and place it over high heat.  Add the remaining 2 tsp sesame seeds and 1/4 tsp sesame garlic and heat, stirring for about 30 seconds, until they are fragrant.  Pour in the sesame garlic oil, sesame seeds and sardines, and stir fry for 5 minutes.  Remove to a plate.  Put the rest of the ingredients into the wok and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until they get a golden crust on them.  Serve immediately, with hot sriracha or tabasco, if desired.

Random Ingredients: french green bean,banana,corn oil,cream,dill,enchilada sauce,tapioca starch
title: Green and Banana Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 large ripe bananas | 24 cups frozen french-cut green beans | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 cup prepared enchilada sauce | 2 teaspoons tapioca starch | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut each banana lengthwise into 3 pieces and set aside.  Place the pieces of bananas in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer until bananas are hot, 15 to 20 minutes.  Set bananas aside.  Heat oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut 1 cup green beans diagonally in half and arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and cover with beans, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and about 1/4 cup of the sour cream.  Repeat layers, ending with a top layer of cheese.  In a small bowl, mix the enchilada sauce with the margarine, corn oil, and 4 tablespoons of sour cream.  Spread over top of enchiladas and sprinkle with dill.  Cover dish with aluminum foil.  Bake until bubbling and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mace,cornflour,chicken breast meat,taco seasoning,white balsamic vinegar,poblano chile,red bell pepper
title: Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 3 large poblano chiles, finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 3/4 cups cornflour, divided | 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast meat, frozen and thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Mix poblano peppers, red bell pepper, white balsamic vinegar, taco seasoning, and mace together in a glass or ceramic bowl.  Heat the 3 tablespoons cornflour in a skillet over high heat until it begins to simmer, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,beef stock cube,taco seasoning mix,balsamic vinegar,pinto bean
title: Pinto Bean Balsamic
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained with liquid reserved | 1 beef stock cube | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place beans with liquid into a food processor and pulse until fairly smooth.  Place bean puree back into pan and add stock cube, taco seasoning and five spice.  Turn heat up low and stir often until thick.  Add balsamic vinegar and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.

title: Pancakes With Almonds
ingredients: 3 tablespoons almond paste | 14 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese ( or a bit more if you wish )
instructions: Sauté the almond paste in an ample amount of oil in medium sized frying pan until they turn a golden brown color and smell fragrant. .  Add the part skim ricotta cheese and cook on low heat until it has melted, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes.  Note, some of my friends think the almond flavored ricotta is quite sweet, so you might want to add a few tablespoons of milk or water to reach this balance.  Enjoy with your mediterranean toast, good olives, anything.

title: Mexican Turkey-Brandy Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg turkey or 1 1/2 kg other lean stewing beef | 250 250 ml plain yogurt or 250 ml sour cream | 1 teaspoon dried chili powder ( to taste ) | 250 ml corn chips, coarse meal ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 spring onion, small ( to garnish ) | 1 dash malt extract or 1 dash saltpeter | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Trim any excess fat off the meat and cut it into slices about 3/4ï¿½´´ wide x 3/4´´´´´ long.  Soak together the crumbled chips and corn meal until the meat is dry.  In a small bowl, mix together the yogurt with the chili powder, salt and mix well till smooth.  Place the meat slices in the yogurt mix and toss to coat the meat well then place in a dish and keep refrigerated for an hour.

title: Lemon Lime Cheese Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and process until a smooth, pourable consistency.  Pour into a serving bowl and sprinkle with chopped, fresh parsley when cold.

title: Irish Nuts (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 cup bran cereal | 1/2 cup sour cream sherry ( can sub irish cream sherry ) | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds, toasted and ground
instructions: Rinse the bran cereal thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,spice,head cauliflower,garam masala,canola oil
title: Spiced Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/3 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon spiced spice | 1/2 teaspoon yellow food coloring, or as needed | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 head cauliflower, finely chopped
instructions: Stir garam masala, spiced spice, food coloring, oil, and cauliflower together in a bowl.  Transfer to a serving bowl.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate until flavors blend, at least 30 minutes.

title: Maggie Beer's Seafood Rigatoni
ingredients: 500 g chopped lobster | 3 english cucumbers | 2 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Boil rigatoni in salted water until tender.  Rinse under cold water.  Drain well with cold water.  Cook lobster in boiling salted water for 10 mins.  Drain well and cut into pieces.  Mix cucumber, and seafood in a large bowl.  Add rigatoni and toss well.

title: Easy Fast Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cod or 2 -3 cups haddock, skinned | 1 cup broccoli, florets and stems ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup brown lentils ( to taste ) | 1/4 - 2/3 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup apricot jam ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons caramel sauce
instructions: Preheat oven 400f degrees.  Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil.  Add fish, breaking up clumps with two fork.  Cook until skin is crisp, about 5 - 7 minutes.  Rinse with cold water and shake off excess.  Cut fish into bite sized pieces.  Place on a baking sheet, covered with foil, in single layer,.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Take fish out of oven and leave the foil on.  Set aside.  While fish cooks, start to fry lentils in peanut butter a minute over medium heat. .  If they don't turn brown, take the pan off the burner.  In a small saucepan, cook the noodles according to package instructions, drain, then toss with browned fish.  When fish is finished, put in a large bowl and top with noodles, peanut sauce and jam.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,rice flour,baking potato,beef broth,tomato puree,lima bean
title: Lima Bean and Potato Stew
ingredients: 600 g baking potatoes | 450 g fresh lima beans, cut into 5cm lengths | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 cups beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas wash, dry, and peel the potatoes.  Scrub them well.  Cut each into 5cm/1inch squares.  In a bowl, mix together the potato, lima beans, rice flour, puree, beef broth and marjoram with your hands until everything is evenly mixed.  Cover and place in the oven.  Cook for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Apricot-Aduya
ingredients: 1 cup apricot, chopped | 2 cups tomato juice | 1 1/4 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Put apricots into a small saucepan with tomato juice, cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.  Stir in caraway seed.  Simmer for an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,self rising flour,crabmeat,pickling spice,cake flour,irish cream,goat cheese
title: Crab and Goat Cheese Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1/2 cup goat cheese | 1 pinch of salt and freshly ground black pepper ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon pickling spice ( or other dried seasoning ) | 1 teaspoon lemon extract ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Combine self rising flour, cake flour, liquor, & remaining ingredients in a large bowl, mixing to combine well.  Place batter on a baking sheet and using floured fingers and floured hands, spread the batter in a thin layer until it has a cup shape or thicker around the edges, but it does not have to be perfectly even.  Using a small spatula and starting at the short edge of the measuring cup, gently pull the batter around the cup as you make it.  If it is not quite thick enough, sprinkle more flour on top in a decorative manner.  Bake for 10 - 12 minutes to brown slightly.  Cool.  Serve with hot jam or syrup or your favourite cheese/meat filling.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,rice noodle,half,rice wine,lime juice,chicken wing,ice water
title: Nestle Rice-Noodle Soup With Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/2 cup lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 cup rice wine | 3 lbs chicken wings, split at joint, tips on | 1/4 cup lime juice | ice water | ice water
instructions: Combine 2 tbsp lime juice, rice wine, cardamom pod, and 1/2 tsp rice wine in large saucepan over medium high heat.  Stir until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Add chicken wings and 2/3 cup water.  Increase heat to high, boil 15 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover and let stand 3 minutes.  Uncover, return to heat.  Stir and boil until volume is reduced to about 3/4 cup total, about 6 - 8 minutes.  Remove chicken and discard marinade and wings.  Puree until smooth with 1/2 cup reserved chicken broth.  Return chicken and broth to the saucepan.  Stir in lime juice and enough ice water to reach consistency of thin broth.  Bring to boil and cook 5 minutes.  Pour into large bowls or plates.  Serve with reserved chicken.

title: Swiss Salami Bread Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon molasses | 12 pieces salami
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix the flour, molasses and molasses together in a bowl.  Dip salami pieces into crumbs.  Place 2 pieces of salami on a large sheet of parchment paper.  Sprinkle flour mixture on the salami and roll to coat with flour.  Place on a baking sheet.  Paint the top of the bread with molasses mixture.  Bake 15 minutes or until cooked.  Variation, instead of salami, you can drizzle a little bit of the molasses onto the bread if desired.

title: Spanish Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 3 lbs french bread, cut into 3/4 inch slices, day old french bread is best for this recipe | 1 jar stuffed green olives, drained well and patted dry
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  Spray pan with cooking spray.  Put bread slices on grill and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Let toast, turning over when necessary for 3 - 5 minutes or until well toasted on the outside and cheese is melted.  Remove from grill and spread olives over the top.  Serve immediately.

title: Quick Beef Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 5 cups arborio rice ( risotto rice )
instructions: Brown the ground beef until no pink remains.  Drain and reserve the grease.  Add rice, brown 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Add reserved grease, 1 1/4 cups at a time.  When rice is well incorporated, stir until a thick liquid is left.  You will have some rice that can be difficult to stir with the heat on low.  Add the ground beef.  When all is incorporated and absorbed on the bottom of the pan, stir the rice gently just until all is absorbed.  Transfer to a bowl, cover and set aside until your stroganoff is ready.

Random Ingredients: caper,chili oil,tuna vegetable oil,salt black pepper
title: Caper Tuna
ingredients: 1/4 cup capers, drained | 1 small can tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 2 tablespoons chili oil | salt and black pepper
instructions: Stir together the capers, tuna, and chili oil in a large bowl.

title: Pizza Sauce (Pizza Hut)
ingredients: 1/2 cup homemade tomato sauce | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Tear off several pieces of reynolds wrap aluminum foil, then place them on the counter top.  Cover with a towel or heavy duty aluminum foil.  Place the foil over the foil and place in a microwave for 4 minutes.  Open the foil and cook for another 4 minutes.  Allow 10 minutes to cool completely.  Unwrap the foil and spread out the tomato sauce.  Sprinkle with salt and black pepper to serve.

title: Naan
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups cornmeal | 3/4 cup yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 8 cups neufchatel cheese, softened | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, ground | 3 cups mint leaves, chopped | 1 cup peanuts, finely chopped or | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Coat a 9x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Combine cornmeal, 1/2 cup onion, cheese, and saffron in a food processor, pulsing until smooth.  Add mint and pulse just until herb.  Add nuts, pulse just until mixed.  Pour into prepared baking dish and top with remaining onion mixture.  Bake uncovered 45 - 50 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly.  Let stand 5 minutes before removing from oven.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,bread flour,gingerroot,pie crust,onion,chicken breast half,tamarind pulp
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Tikka
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 3 pieces | 1 1/2 lbs fontina cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 small onion, cut into thin wedges | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, minced | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 cup tamarind pulp ( concentrate )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Roll out dough, place into bowl, place onto a foil lined baking sheet.  Press out excess dough into a rectangle 1/2 inch thick and 10 inches in diameter.  Arrange chicken pieces over dough, then top with fontina cheese, onion, ginger and tamarind pulp.  Fold 1/2 inch over filling.  Press edges of dough together to seal.  Bake 1 hour for 15 minutes, turn, and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Green Chile Con Queso (Spanish Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb gruyere cheese | 1 -2 small small green chili pepper
instructions: Wash and pat dry the chilies.  Wrap the cheese ball with kitchen string and place in a dish.  Add hot water to about a 1 inch depth and place lid in dish.  Cook over very low heat for 2 hours.  When cheese is soft, stir in grated cheese and continue cooking for a few minutes more.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1/4 ounce dry onion soup mix | 2 cans evaporated milk
instructions: Brown ground round and drain.  Add condensed milk and onion soup mix.  Put on the crockpot and cook on low heat 3 - 4 hours.  Serve over cooked noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: chive,green cardamom pod,vanilla,lemon pepper seasoning,curry paste,corn oil
title: Thai Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 cup corn oil | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon chives, chopped
instructions: Combine oil, lemon pepper seasoning, curry paste, vanilla, cardamom, and chives in a blender, cover, and blend until smooth.  Scrape down sides of blender container and continue blending until smooth.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,coriander,onion salt,mini marshmallow,cheddar cheese,corn,pickle juice,cherry tomato
title: Mini Santa Fe Popcorn
ingredients: 2 packages mini marshmallows | 1 can corn, drained | 1 can sliced pimento stuffed olives with oil | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup diced onion ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon pickle juice | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Microwave marshmallows and olives on high in 3 1/2 quart micro safe casserole on high for 1 minute.  Stir.  Stir in corn, tomatoes, onion, corriander, and pickle juice.  Cover and cook on high 4 - 5 minutes, until bubbly hot and hot.  In 4 cup measuring cup, scoop out hot marshmallow mixture and stir with spoon to combine.  Scoop marshmallow into 3 1/2 cup mini muffin cups.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,plain yogurt,red bell pepper,ponzu sauce,mushroom cap,paprika,italian turkey sausage,hungarian paprika
title: Chef John's Spicy Turkey Sausages and Crab
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds sweet italian turkey sausage | 2 cans mushroom caps, drained | 1 pint plain yogurt | 1 pound ponzu sauce | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/8 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1/4 cup ponzu sauce | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 jar imitation crabmeat
instructions: Slice sausages crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Combine the sausage, mushrooms, and yogurt in a bowl.

title: Persian Green
ingredients: 1 bunch radicchio, with outer leaves removed | 10 -12 almonds | 3 tablespoons red wine ( sherry works too! ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( dissolve in 15 ml water if using a non-alcoholic version of gravy or stock ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place the radicchio in a large bowl and cover with water.  Bundle the root end of the head with two toothpicks.  Add to the water and soak overnight.  Remove the roots and other leaves, then place in a colander with more water, cover and drain off any remaining water.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Toast the almonds in a skillet over medium heat until starting to brown.  Transfer to a plate, set aside and reserve.  Add the sauteed almonds to the onions.  Add the white wine and the bouillon cube in a 1 cup measure.  When the liquid comes to a boil, add the radicchio.  Place the stuffed radicchio on a large platter.  Drizzle with the sauteed almonds.  Drizzle with the sauteed almonds and garnish with chopped parsley.  Serve in the middle of a plate, sprinkle with a little garam masala, and if serving separately, serve with a bowl of raita.

Random Ingredients: pepper,chicken meat,amarula cream liqueur,mint,yellow cornmeal,farfalle pasta,chicken cutlet
title: Chicken and Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, broken into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 4 chicken cutlets | 1/2 pound chicken meat, cooked and cut into cubes | 1/2 bunch fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur, chilled | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the farfalle and bow tie pasta until al dente, rinse under cold water, remove starchy water and drain.  In another pot, bring water to a boil and cook the cornmeal, stirring constantly until well coated.  Turn off the heat.  Drain the pasta, return it to the pot, add the hot cornmeal mixture and stir.  Set aside.  In the bowl of a food processor, combine the chicken and the mint.  Pulse 2 or 3 times.  Add the cooked farfalle and pasta and stir to coat.  Cover and refrigerate until the farfalle is chilled.  Just before serving, garnish with chilled amarula cream.  Mint sprigs for garnish.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,corn chip,grain bread,spaghetti squash,kaiser,red pepper,spaghetti sauce
title: Zesty Spaghetti Squash Sandwich
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise | 1 small red pepper, halved | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce | 1/2 vanilla beans or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups whole grain bread, 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup corn chips, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 kaiser rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place spaghetti squash, cut side up, on a greased baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven about 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender.  Remove from oven.  Cut squash lengthwise into eight 1/4 inch pieces.  Slice red pepper into 1/4 inch squares.

title: Baked Beetroot With Feta and Caramelized Fresh Herbs (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 lbs beetroots or 2 lbs beet, washed | 8 ounces feta cheese ( about 1 cup weight ) | 2 tablespoons tamari ( dark soy soy sauce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons gingerroot, minced | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, minced | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Peel and thinly slice the cooked beetroot and mix with the feta, tamari, ginger and remaining ingredients.  Transfer to a glass baking dish.  Bake, basting every 15 minutes, for 50 minutes or until the beetroot is tender and topping is golden brown.  Serve warm or chilled.  Variation 1, use thinly sliced beetroot instead of the beetroot.  Variation 2, use any fresh vegetable on your own.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,pimiento,cocoa,pineapple chunk,noodle,jalapeno chile,bread crumb,chili pepper flake
title: Pineapple-Chili Pies
ingredients: 20 -24 rice paper sheets | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained | 2 cans sliced canned chili peppers | 3 tablespoons dried pimento | 3 tablespoons dried bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons cocoa ( optional ) | nuoc cham sauce or chili sauce, sauce, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Place paper slices into a large paper cone shape on a baking sheet.  Place 2 pineapple chunks into the center of each plate.  Place 1 chili pepper on top of the pineapple chunks.

title: Corn and Herbs
ingredients: 2 lbs green chili, red anaheim, stems trimmed | mixed mixtures, for serving ( such as sweet onion, chard flowers, tarragon and red peppers, may also be added )
instructions: Cut off the tops and bottoms of the chilis, and scoop out the flesh of the corn from inside.  Discard the outer shekins.  Cut the corn off the bottom, and cut the corn from the tip of the stalk into smaller chunks, discarding the tips.  Cut the chilis crosswise into thin pieces about 1/4 inch thick.  Place them into boiling water for 1 minute, just to soften.  Drain well in a bowl and plunge into cold water. .  Dip each piece of corn into cold water until completely coated.  Dry on paper towels.  Arrange chilis in an overlapping pattern across the chile, and pack the chilis around them.  Place 1 tablespoon of the chopped chilis and 1 tablespoon of mixture onto each chile, and roll up firmly.  Tie with a piece of cheesecloth or a kitchen string.  Place the chilis on a baking sheet or foil, and sprinkle with fresh herbs.  Cover loosely with foil, and freeze for 6 hours until firm.  To serve, remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving.

title: Vietnamese Vanilla Sugar (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 2 cups pure vanilla beans, fresh or 2 cups frozen, frozen ( vietnamese vanilla sugar ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Stir the vanilla beans with the lime juice to blend and dissolve the sugar.  Pour into a heat proof container and place in the refrigerator to chill at least 1 hour.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Lacquered Olives (With Kahlua)
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce kahlua | 1 -2 tablespoon nestle nicoise olive | 4 egg whites
instructions: Mix kahlua, nicoise olives and egg whites until smooth.  Roll up the olives, and let them steep in a bit of water to make them softer, or chill.  Slice them in half for decoration.

title: Aioli (Italian Style Seasoning)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 2 medium brown onions, sliced
instructions: Combine the parsley flakes and onions in a medium saucepan.  Add just enough to moisten the onions.  Cook over medium heat until the onion mixture has browned, about 30 to 45 minutes.  Use immediately, or refrigerate and use up to 2 weeks.

title: Yogurt Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 slices cooked lamb | 1 sliced cucumber
instructions: Mix the yogurt, flour, and taco seasoning together.  Place the slices of lamb, cucumber, and sour cream in a bowl and microwave for 2 minutes on high, then stir to combine.

title: Lime and Raspberry Sour Cream Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 lime, juiced | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: In a medium bowl, beat cream cheese until creamy and light, about 1 minute.  Stir in lime juice, then stir in raspberries.  Stir in sour cream and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.

title: Faux Chocolativo
ingredients:
1 1 cup strong coffee or 1 cup hot water | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened instant coffee powder | 3 3 tablespoons thyme or 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron strands or 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 bunches collard greens ( about 2 lbs.
    -, such as kale and boston lettuce best -optional ) or 2 bunches mixed greens ( about 2 lbs.
    - best-optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in a blender and pulse a couple times to combine.  To serve, spread on a lettuce leaf, garnish with greens and cut into 4 or 5 pieces for a heartier presentation.

title: Scotch Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup cold strong tea | 1/2 cup unsifted all-purpose flour | 1 cup strong tea | 1 1/2 cups sifted all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a small bowl, add the first three ingredients.

title: Tomatillo-Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 12 large tomatillos | 4 large skinless salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Wash and place tomatillos on a baking sheet skin side down.  Place in oven and cook at 500 degrees about 10 to 12 minutes or until the husks are wrinkled and very fragrant.  Using tongs, remove tomatillos from oven and place shiny side up on a cutting board and cut away the very top of the husks with scissors or the flat end of a heavy knife, cutting to fit the cutters.  When done, remove from oven and unwrap the tomatillos and put the flesh side down on a cutting board, with the husks in a little spinner.  Place one salmon fillet on top of the tomatillo, skin side down and using the back of a knife and a wooden spoon flatten the skin on the salmon, this will help hold the moisture in the sauce and help it cook through.  Place over medium heat and grill for 10 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Stovies for a Cold Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 6 lbs stew meat, i used 1 1/2 lbs | 16 ounces dry noodles | 2 1/2 ounces hot espresso powder | 2 ounces dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | fresh italian parsley | toothpick ( for securing with toothpick )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a crockpot, and cook on high for 5 hours.  Remove the toothpicks and serve on a platter decorated with italian parsley sprigs.  Serve hot, plain or with toothpicks.

title: Rhubarb Minted Whites
ingredients: 1 lb frozen rhubarb | 2 cups frozen thawed whipped topping | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped finely
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f.  Cut rhubarb in half lengthwise.  Remove the stem and coarsely chop.  Combine rhubarb with whipped topping and finely chopped mint and mix well.  Drop mixture onto parchment covered cookie sheets.  Bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until lightly browned.  Let cool on wire rack.

title: Sauerkraut and Toasted Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons pure sesame tami ( found near at jewish kitchen ) | 32 bread rolls or 18 soft roll | 1/2 cup drained drained currant | 1 head iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed, halved ( about 7 cups ) | 2 cans sauerkraut, well drained and well rinsed
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cheese, tami and bread crumbs.  Spread 1/4 cup cheese mixture on each bread slice.  Top with 2 bread slices.

title: Tropical Smoked Salmon Rolls
ingredients: 1 smoked salmon, sliced as thinly as possible | 1/2 head napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 bunch fresh cored grapeseed peppers or 1/2 bunch pickled cauliflower, washed and cut into 12 x 3 pieces ( a combo of green, white and purple ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup smoked pepperoni, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon corn, frozen thawed if frozen and thawed if thawed if fresh | 2 -3 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 canned soy craft rolls
instructions: Slice the napa cabbage crosswise into six thick slabs.  Cut the peppers in half and remove the ribs and seeds.  Bring a large pot of water to boil over medium heat.  Add the cabbage wedges and cook until tender crisp about 5 - 10 minutes for the white, about 7 - 8 minutes for the purple.  Drain cabbage and vegetables and place in large bowl.  Cut the salmon, pepperoni and corn pieces into 6 even strips.  Add these ingredients to the cabbage with the cabbage.  Add the vinegar and soy pickles.  Toss all the salad ingredients together and serve.  It can be served over fresh bread crumbs if preferred but it is equally good with a crusty bread roll spread or cracker.

title: Cranberry and Oka Salted Cod
ingredients: 600 g cod fish fillets | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup oka saltedo | 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Drain the cod and place in a plastic bag with the stock.  Shake out any excess water from the bag.  In a saucepan on the stove top, combine the oka saltedo, brandy, dried cranberries and cayenne, simmering for 15 minutes or until a thick sauce is formed.  Allow the roo to cool slightly then transfer it to a bowl and whisk in the reserved cooking liquid.  Stir in the cooled oka saltedo mixture and the cranberries until coated.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes to let the flavours develop.

title: Kythoni Kythoni -- Spicy Savoy-Spiced Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage ( kythoni kythoni ) | 1 piece sourdough bread, cubed | 1 green chili pepper, sliced | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs
instructions: Wash and core the savoy cabbage.  Separate the leaves and shred the head or tear the green stalk away from the core if any.  Cut the cabbage into small pieces.  Wash and trim the outer leaves of the kythoni, just enough to leave a thin layer of leaves visible.  Cut the head into small shreds.  Dice the chilie and green chili.  Place the kythoni in boiling water, add a pinch of salt and leave for 5 minutes.  Drain and leave to cool to warm.  Place the bread in a bowl with the chopped chilie, green pepper and mixed herbs, and mix well.  Divide the cabbage into smaller casseroles, pressing firmly and evenly into the bread slices.  Toss with the bread mix and serve with your favourite vegetable accompaniment.

title: Roast Pork Chops With Honey
ingredients: 4 -6 pork chops | 2 tablespoons of prepared honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  If you don't have a convection oven, you may need to bake the chops uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees fahrenheit.  Take the chops out of the oven when they are halfway done and set aside for five minutes.  Then, preheat the oven for the oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit.  Bake the pork chops for about 10 - 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and stir to distribute internal temperature, honey and roast pork for about 7 - 10 minutes until cooked.  Enjoy.

title: Indian Spiced Chutney
ingredients: 1 pint tomato juice | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried chili ( de-veined, or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves ( can use fresh )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, and simmer until thickened slightly and most of the liquid has cooked away, about 15 minutes.  This can take up to 1 hour longer.

title: Pasta With Sweet Chilli Sauce (Eggs and Sausage)
ingredients: 500 g small shell pasta, such as capellini | 2 -4 tablespoons thai sweet chili flakes ( depending on taste ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
instructions: Boil the capellini or other small pasta.  In a food processor, combine the chilli flakes and sweet chili paste.  Add the sausages and eggs.  Process or blend them briefly.  Serve on a bed of freshly cooked capellini or your favourite pasta, garnished with sprigs of spring onion.

title: Beef and Noodle Stew
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 onion, chopped | 1 container peanut-flavored soba noodles | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, peeled and minced | 3/4 cup peanut butter | 10 ounces chocolate chips
instructions: Place the beef and onion in a slow cooker.  Mix in the soba noodles, ginger, peanut butter, and chocolate chips.  Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Spicy Tomato & Onion Tostadas
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, unpeeled, cut in halves lengthwise | 2 medium turnips, unpeeled, cut in halves lengthwise | 20 canned artichoke hearts ( if canned, drain them first ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 4 -6 tortillas
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f.  Bake the onion and sweet potato for about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are almost fully cooked.  Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly.  Peel the sweet potato and turn it in cold water to remove some of the skin.  This will take around 20 to 30 minutes depending on the size of the potato.  I cut the potato in half and slice a quarter.  Once the potatoes have cooled, put them in the recipient of a food processor, or manually into a mixing bowl.  I used a hand mixer to combine everything.  Cut the artichoke hearts lengthwise into slices 1 inch long.  Once the oil is cool to the touch, scoop out the soft pulp of the artichoke hearts.  Reserve 1 tablespoon. .  In a small bowl blend the tamarind paste and sesame oil.  Using a vegetable peeler remove the outer layer of skin from the sweet potato and onion and coarsely chop the onion and mix this with the sweet potato/onion mix.  You may also add the vegetables to the bowl and mix together.  Spread 1 - 2 tablespoons of tamarind sauce in the bottom of each tortilla and layer about 3 tablespoons of cooked sweet potato onion mixture inside.  Fold the tortillas over the onion and sweet potato mixture.  Place the filled corn tortillas on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray or parchment paper.  Spray with cooking spray.  Spread the remaining sauce on top and cover with a towel until ready to serve.

title: Poppy Seed Appetizers
ingredients: 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon tamari | 3 ounces taco seasoning | 2 ripe artichoke hearts, sliced ( i use the pre-sliced canned ones ) | 3 tart apples, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  In a bowl, stir together the poppy seeds and tamari.  Add the taco seasoning to the poppy seeds, and mix well.  Add the artichokes and apples, and toss to coat.  Spread onto oiled cookie sheets, and sprinkle some of the poppy seeds on top of each.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the edges start to brown and the apples and are crunchy.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,sage leaf,jasmine rice,chicken,egg yolk,bow tie pasta
title: Chicken and Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut into serving pieces | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup irish cream, warmed | 4 large egg yolks | 8 sage leaves | 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons bow tie pasta, dry
instructions: Mix chicken, arborio, egg yolks, and sage with 1 tablespoon water in a large bowl.  Place pasta in a large nonstick skillet.  Pour half of the bowl of chicken and egg mixture over the pasta and spread evenly.  Cover with remaining pasta, egg mixture, and stir until everything is mixed well.  Place pasta on a clean dish towel.  Spray a large baking dish and set in 450 degrees.  Bake for about 15 minutes, until pasta is golden.

title: Spanish Lamb Sandwich Toast With Tamarind
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 1 lb ground chuck | 3 1/2 ounces kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | french baguette | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup lamb fat | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya ( optional )
instructions: Place the pulp in a blender and blend into a fine paste.  Heat a large skillet or griddle and dry fry the lamb fat until it is a little browned.  Remove and set aside.  Place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast under running water.  Brush with tamarind water and set aside.  Place the olives in a food processor or blender and blend into a fine paste.  Combine the bread slices with the olive paste and sazon and serve on plates with some of the meat dip.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,wedge lime,chipotle chile,green olive,nutmeg,poblano chile,mustard powder
title: Tomatillo, Poblano and Chipotle Jam
ingredients: 20 large green olives | 1 cup chopped tomatillo, drained | 1/2 cup chopped poblano chile | 1/4 cup shredded chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 wedges lime
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Place green olives, tomatillos, poblano, chipotle, mustard powder and ground nutmeg on a plate.  Grill green olives for 10 to 15 minutes, turning occasionally to brown evenly.  Place a wedge of lime wedge on top and serve warm.

title: Scallops in Chili
ingredients: 1 lb sea scallops, thawed if frozen | 2 tablespoons shallots, chopped | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Place scallops in a shallow fry pan.  Combine the shallots, oil and chili powder.

title: Tamarind Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 liter heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 3 tablespoons finely chopped tamarind pods
instructions: Place cream and sugar in a medium pan over a medium heat and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and stir until the sugar has dissolved, about 2 minutes.  Strain cream through a fine sieve into a large container.  Discard solids and return some to the pan, stirring to combine.  Return cream to the pan, stir in the tamarind pieces and chill for 1 hour until set.  Remove from the freezer, break up the pieces and stir until incorporated, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,jalapeno pepper,chicken bouillon,salt black pepper,sauce
title: Sauce Haskel
ingredients: 2 cups chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon fresh anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon, hot sauce, jalapeno pepper, anise seed, salt, and pepper in a saucepan.

title: Warm Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beet, washed, peeled and finely chopped | 2 ounces margarita mix, see note | 4 ounces quick oats ( not instant ) | 1 tablespoon cooking wine | chopped fresh herb, etc | roasted radish ( optional ) | cooked celery ( optional ) or boiled mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Place the chopped beet in a pan with about ¾ cup water and bring to boil.  Cover and cook for 2 minutes or until just tender.  Drain and cool.  Combine everything except the garnish in a glass jar.  Cover and refridgerate for at least 3 hours but no longer than 24 hours or longer.  Before serving mix everything together and chill.  Note, the best way to measure “spoon” onto a serving plate and check for doneness.  It should be quite firm but will deflate as it cools.

title: Sourdough French Onion Pot Roast (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 3 1/2 cups maple syrup | 6 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: In 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart slow cooker, stir together beef chuck roast and maple syrup.  Sprinkle yeast over top.  Cover.  Cook on high setting 5 to 6 hours or low setting 7 to 8 hours.  Transfer roast to platter.  When cool enough to handle, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: campbell cheddar cheese soup,amaretto,salt pork,lemon extract,parmesan cheese
title: Parmesan Toasted Salted Cheddar
ingredients: 1 jar of old-fashioned cheddar cheese soup | 2 1/2 ounces salt pork, shredded | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f combine the soup, salt and the ham in a medium bowl.  Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium heat, and add the cheese mixture.  Add the lemon extract and cook stirring occasionally for 2 - 3 minutes to heat.  Remove from the heat and stir in the amaretto.  Transfer the mixture to a large bowl.  Stir in the parmesan.  Cool to room temperature.

title: Perfect Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup canned pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup unsalted peanuts | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Place pumpkin seeds and peanuts in blender, or food processor, and puree.  Set aside.  Add buttermilk, and blend again until fairly smooth.

title: Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons coarse salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Use as a dipping sauce for fish, meat, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: laurel leaf,green cardamom pod,burgundy wine,tahini paste,chuck steak,coconut
title: Chaala's Tahini Beef
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steaks, cut into 1 `` pieces or 3 -4 inch cubes | 1/3 cup tahini paste | 2 teaspoons coconut, grated or 2 tablespoons grated coconut flakes | 3/4 cup burgundy wine or 3/4 cup dry red wine | 4 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 2 -3 laurel leaves, crushed ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tahini paste or 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f/230°c.  In a large bowl, combine the meat with the sesame oil and toss well to coat on all sides.  In a baking dish, toss the meat with the coconut, then transfer to a dish.  Stir in the tahini, then pour over the meat.  Add the wine and allow to stand 10 minutes.  Garnish with the cardamom pods, cinnamon leaves and or scallions, if desired.  Bake for about 30 to 40 minute serve.

title: Mexican Corn
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound whole kernel corn, drained | 10 poblano chiles, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange the corn in a single layer in the bottom of the dish, leaving about 1 inch of kernels on each.  Spread the poblano chiles into the dish, top with corn, and sprinkle with cooking spray.  Bake in the preheated oven until slightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,panko breadcrumb,graham cracker crumb,beef broth,ice,hard egg,pecorino romano cheese,black sesame seed
title: Frenchie's Chef John's Famous Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef ( not extra lean or you may use extra lean ground beef ) | 1 large hard-boiled egg, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fine panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup good quality graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup greek-style black sesame seed | 1 cup beef broth or 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed ice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly spray a 12x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, thoroughly mix the ground beef with the egg, bread crumbs, 1/4 cup panko and 1/4 cup crumbs.  You may need to do this by hand or with your hands.  Shape into meatballs about the size of a golf ball.  Arrange them in the prepared baking dish.  They may be stuffed or not, depending on what you’d like.  Blend the remaining 3/4 cup panko crumbs, grated cheese, sesame seeds and beef broth in a small bowl.  Sprinkle over the meatballs.  Bake until browned and cooked to your preference, about 30 - 40 minutes.  Remove meatballs to a platter that has been dusted with more panko, salt or pepper.  Let the meatballs cool until you are able to handle them.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: steak,asiago cheese,tequila,tahini,red cabbage,ra el hanout spice mix,thyme sprig
title: Moroccan Beef With Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1 flank steak | 6 teaspoons tahini | 4 teaspoons argentine ouzo ( spice mix ) | fresh thyme sprig, to taste | 1/4 cup seedless ra el hanout spice mix | 7 ounces silver dragees or 7 ounces silver dragees, such as sultanas
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Core top 1/2 inch of cabbage, core down and slice into 1/8 to 1/4 thick wedges.  Place the beef in a shallow pan or pyrex baking dish.  Cut diagonal cuts in the beef and rub 2 teaspoons olive oil into each piece of beef and top with the tahini.  Broil meat about 8 minutes.  Brush each slice of beef with 1 teaspoon olive oil, and broil another 3 to 5 minutes or until browned.  Transfer to a warm dish.  Brush cabbage wedges with remaining olive oil and top with ra el hanout, thyme and remaining cheese slices.  Broil about 4 minutes, until cheese is bubbly.  Note, red cabbage may be refrigerated, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red onion,peanut,hard egg,pecan,corn,white rice,fritos corn chip,saffron
title: Nacho-Corn Stuffed  Tex-Mex Restaurant-Style Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 1 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped, divided | 1 1/4 cups chopped pecans | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 red onion, finely minced | 2 tablespoons finely minced saffron or 1 teaspoon sazon seasoning | 2 cups fritos corn chips ( or to taste ) | 1 jar roasted sweet and sour corn, drained ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash rice well, drain and set aside to drain for 30 - 60 minutes.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Stir together 1/2 cup peanuts, half the chopped pecans, chopped onions, saffron, and remaining pecans.  Spread about 2 tablespoons on ungreased large baking sheet and sprinkle with half the fritos.  Spread half of rice mixture on this.  Spread 1/8 to 1/4 of the peanut mixture on this then spread on remaining rice mixture on top of this.  Sprinkle with remaining peanuts, pecans, and remaining chopped pecans and chopped onions.  Bake at 300 degrees, uncovered, for 45 - 55 minutes or until heated through and bubbly.  Serve warm or at room temperature with remaining sliced tortilla chips or warm corn chips on the side.  Makes about 4 servings.

title: Spicy Rotel Squash and Pine Nuts-Tossed in a Pesto
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 lb yellow squash, scrubbed | 2 cans diced rotel | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 4 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.  Cut potatoes in to pieces, about ½” x ¾”.  Place in a nonreactive bowl and cover with water by 1 inch.  Let stand 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain well and run potatoes through a ricer/blender, into a large bowl, adding the remaining ingredients.  Dump potato mixture into a large, resealable plastic bag.  Seal bag and turn to coat potatoes.  Toss potato mixture thoroughly with pesto.  Refrigerate for 4 hours.  Place bag of potato mixture on a plate or shallow baking dish and bake 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ginger,orange marmalade,chicken bouillon,shell pasta,yellow pepper,brandy,chili pepper flake,bacon
title: Tail Brot II

instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the shell pasta and return the water to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still a little firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Meanwhile, lightly brown the bacon in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crisp, about 10 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Add the remaining ingredients, except for the brandy, to the bacon grease in the skillet and saute until the peppers are tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain off the excess fat.  Place the drained shell pasta in the bowl of a food processor and blend to a coarse puree.  Toss the pasta and tomato puree in the bacon grease just to coat.  Serve immediately.

instructions: In a bowl combine the asparagus, zest, ginger, oil, sugar and rum.  Toss to thoroughly combine.

instructions: Place flour in a bowl and beat egg yolks with chili powder and almond extract until pale and frothy.  Add the egg mixture to the flour and stir until the dough starts to hold together.  Roll level tablespoons of dough into balls, dust with flour and set aside on a lightly floured board for 20 minutes.  Roll out remaining dough, cut out shapes with a cookie cutter/cookie cutter.  Bake on a lightly greased baking sheet at 180°c.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium bowl.  For more sweetness, add a 1 tsp.  Adobo seasoning.

instructions: In a small saucepan heat the rum, onion soup mix, sage & chicken breast fillets in the mixture for 2 - 3 mins, turning them often, till the chicken is cooked & the sauce thickened. title: Easy Healthy Sesame Beef and Bean Burger

instructions: Mix together all ingredients well and form into four patties approximately 8 inches in diameter.  Heat a grill pan until very hot, about 400 degrees f.  Cook each patty 2 minutes per side, or until desired level of doneness, but not too soft.  Serve hot.
