title: Chinese Crispy Pig Wings
ingredients: 16 slices lean bacon, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons chinese barbeque pork, minced | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir bacon, fennel seeds, and chinese barbeque pork in the hot skillet until bacon renders some of its fat, about 10 minutes.  Stir golden raisins, dark sesame oil, and bacon into the skillet.

title: Real English Scones
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry sherry ( optional ) | 2 slices sharp cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f, just enough to lightly cover a baking sheet with some of the fat.  Spread sherry on each side of each slice of cheese.  Place on work surface.  Pour 1 cup of water.  Sprinkle with a little bit of the chopped fresh parsley, if desired.  Roll up the slice, folding in any stray pieces as needed.  Put on the cookie sheet.  Repeat with remaining slices.  Bake for 5 - 8 minutes or until lightly browned.  Serve on top of a green salad, or on crackers as a sandwich with veggies, meats or poultry bites for a complete meal.  Note, the bread also freezes very well.

title: White Bean Salad
ingredients: 4 fresh great northern beans, trimmed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Rinse and pick over beans and break into pieces.  Place in a bowl.  Add lemon zest and sprinkle the green salad dressing over the top.  Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,red lentil,cardamom,green bean,beef rib,hot oil,lemongrass
title: Lemongrass Beef Soup or Shredded Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef rib eye steaks or 2 1/2-3 lbs beef top round roast | 1 can vegetable oil | 3 stalks lemongrass, cut into 2 inch segments, minced | 1 medium red lentil | 2 teaspoons cardamom | 6 cups water | 2 tablespoons hot oil
instructions: Put the roast in a large pot or dutch oven.  Pour the oil into a measuring cup.  Cut remaining sections of lemon grass lengthwise into thirds and then crosswise into thirds.  Cut lemon grass into 2 inch pieces.  Place beef in large skillet and brown, about 4 minutes per side.  Add lemon grass and lentils.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,pasta,vegetable broth,grape,black mustard seed,naan bread,bay leaf,cayenne pepper
title: Sunny Side up Spicy Thai Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain naan bread | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth, low fat variety ( like low salt ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds or 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cracked bay leaf | 8 -12 cups uncooked spiral noodles or 8 -12 cups prepared pasta, any shape | 1/2 cup grapes or 1/2 cup red grape, halved ( optional )
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for noodles according to package.  When noodles are done, drain well and place in serving bowl.  Add vegetable broth, tamari, cayenne pepper, mustard seeds, bay leaf and toasted noodles to noodle mixture in bowl and toss gently, making sure all noodles are moist.  Serve hot with grapes.

title: Swiss Cocoa Apple Balls(Pommes De Cocotte)
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples | 1 1/2 ounces unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 orange, juice of
instructions: Peel, core, and cut apples into cubes.  Put apples and cocoa in a food processor and chop until it resembles ground fine breadcrumbs.  Add orange juice and pulse until the mixture is smooth and creamy.  Shape into balls about 2 inches in diameter and place on parchment lined baking sheets.  Press a fork through the apples to release their liquid.  Bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 50 minutes or until golden brown.  Cool completely before removing from parchment.  Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,beet,cherry tomato,white wine vinegar,chick pea,parsnip
title: Borshch and Parsnips Salad
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips | 2 medium parsnips | 5 ounces canned chick-peas | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 bay leaf | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut parsnips into thin wedges and then finely dice.  Boil and simmer for 15 minutes, then drain.  Drain chickpeas and add.  Balls into a bowl with parsnips, parsnips, cherries and tomatoes.  Add bay leaf.  In a screw top jar, pour the vinegar, shaking until all the clumps are coated in vinegar.  Shake jar until dressing is evenly mixed.

title: Macaroni and Hazelnut Salad
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni, cooked | 2 cups hazelnuts, roasted, chopped & shelled | 3 tablespoons coffee, hot ( i use coffee creamer ) | 4 teaspoons horseradish, fresh-squeezed, to taste | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 1 green olive, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts until they are golden brown.  Let cool.  Combine macaroni, hazelnuts, coffee& horseradish& mix well.  Add green olives and olives.  Toss.

title: Spanish Mojito
ingredients: ice | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon rind, finely grated | 1/2 cup club soda
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil,tamarind paste,cream tartar,fenugreek seed,malt vinegar,tuna vegetable oil
title: Faux Onion & Salted Salt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml distilled malt vinegar | 30 ml cream of tartar | 1 ml safflower oil | 1/3 cup tamarind paste ( available at middle eastern specialty stores ) | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds | 20 g salt or 20 g sea salt
instructions: In a saucepan, stir together the vinegar & cream of tartar over low heat, while slowly whisking constantly until the cream has thickened slightly, but is still visible & glossy.  Remove from the heat & stir in the safflower oil.  Once cooled, stir in tamarind sauce & fenugreek seeds & combine well.  Refrigerate till ready to serve.

title: Yummy Daikon Radish Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup daikon radish, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup salsa, sweet
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and toss.  Serve.

title: Refried Bean Salad With a Caribbean Twist
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt, plain | 1 can pineapple slices in juice, with juice, reserve juice | 8 tablespoons chopped dates, dates will be added in the last few minutes of cooking | 1/2 cup light sweet sherry ( or bourbon ) | 1/3 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine beans, yogurt, pineapple, and dates in medium bowl.  Stir in sherry.  Just before serving, stir in cream.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,mango chutney,ha avocado,double cream,bamboo toothpick,kaiser,puff pastry
title: Thai Grilled Mango Tarts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons thai chiles, chopped ( such as prik kee or nam ) | 1 mango, ripe, peeled and cut into thin wedges | 2 ripe hass avocados, halved, seeded, and cut into thin wedges | 12 bamboo toothpicks | 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed for ease of rolling | 1 cup double cream | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( such as dijon )
instructions: Make the marinade, place chiles and mango in a mortar and pound into a smooth paste with a pestle.  Add the avocados and work through them with your fingers until well combined.  Divide the fruit mixture between the pastry balls, pressing down to form a circle about 1 inch thick in diameter.  To prevent the fruit mix from sticking, roll the balls a few at a time to firm and smooth them out.  Transfer the balls onto a plate, and refrigerate, covered, for at least 1 hour, or overnight.  Make the cream, cream the cream lightly over low heat in a small saucepan.  Remove from heat and stir in the chutney.  Divide between the pastry balls and let set for about 3 minutes.  Preheat the grill on a medium high setting.  Place the tart shells on the grill, cut side down, and brush with the cream.  Grill until heated through, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,red bell pepper,tostada,sugar substitute,onion soup mix,caramel topping,vegetable broth,red pepper
title: Quick Tostadas
ingredients: 12 soft tostada | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/8 red pepper ( optional ) | 1/8 red bell pepper ( optional ) | 1 bouillon cube ( optional ) | 4 cups vegetable broth or 4 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup caramel topping ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sugar substitute
instructions: Place vegetables in a 3 - 4 qt saucepan.  Melt bouillon cube in broth, add to broth and bring to boil.  Place 3 to 4 tstadas in broth and stir to coat.  Drain, and cover.  Set aside.  Heat caramel topping in saucepan, add sugar and stir to dissolve sugar.  Add cooked vegetables, cook & stir until vegetables are heated.  To serve, divide meat and vegetable mixture equally among hot and toasted sandwich shells.  Add caramel topping, a spoonful of caramel, & spoonful of warmed caramel topping over each tostada.

title: Coriander-Pepper Fried Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped ( or more to taste ) | 4 -8 radishes, sliced into thin strips | 1 tablespoon low-fat buttermilk | 1/2 cup buttermilk or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 teaspoon dry crushed coriander and tapioca | 3 pinches parmesan cheese ( optional ) | 5 skewers
instructions: Mix the cilantro, radishes, buttermilk and crushed coriander in a large bowl.  Wet your hands as you make the batter.  Dip the radishes into the batter just long enough to soak up the stuffing.  Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high.  Add several drops of oil to cover the bottom and 1 pinches of salt to taste.  Add the radish strips and the seasoned buttermilk/buttermilk/parmesan/onion mixture immediately.  Cover and reduce the heat, turning the strips over so the mixture sizzles at the edges of the pan.  Cook for about 4 - 5 minutes, or until golden brown, and the radishes are tender.  Sprinkle with additional black pepper or paprika if you wish.  Enjoy.

title: Rockefeller De Hongos Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 ounce dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix ground chicken until crumbly and no longer runny.  Add cocoa, rum, and 1 ounce dark rum.

title: Slow Cooker Santa Fe Turkey
ingredients: 3 -4 turkey breast | 14 1/2 ounces sweetcorn | 1 cup chunky salsa | 16 ounces sour cream
instructions: Put turkey in the slow cooker put sweetcorn on top and cover with chunky salsa.  Cook on low for 6 - 7 hours till turkey is falling off the bone and falling apart.  Turn turkey out onto a plate and shred as much as you like.  Serve with your favorite salsa, nacho chips, sour cream.

title: Simple Linguine With Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 package linguine pasta | 2 1/4 cups skim milk powder | 3 -4 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 bell pepper, green, yellow and red sliced | 1 shallot, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook linguine in large pan as per package instructions or until al dente, drain.  Meanwhile, combine milk powder and liquid smoke in medium bowl, stir well.  Add the pasta to the hot mixture, stirring well.  Add the bell pepper and shallot, stirring well and letting flavors meld.  Drain pasta well.  Turn onto serving platter and add the red pepper mixture.

title: Asian Chicken Legs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken wing sauce | 1 pound whole chicken legs, cut into thighs | 1/2 cup canned unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a baking sheet.  In a small bowl, mix teriyaki sauce, sweet chili sauce, and chicken wing sauce.  Place chicken legs in a resealable plastic bag.  Pour teriyaki marinade over chicken and coat completely.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,self raising flour,italian parsley,cream cottage cheese,clove,ancho chile,green chili pepper,chipotle chile
title: Sailors' Favourite Chipotle Cheesy Bread
ingredients: 4 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chiles, roughly torn or 2 teaspoons dried pasilla chili powder ( or mild-tasting red chilies ) | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds or 2 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 3 cloves | 2 teaspoons pure dried chipotle chiles ( optional ) | 1 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 -2 green chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190c.  Sift the flour, spices and dried chiles together into a bowl.  Make a well in the centre and pour in the cottageese and parsley.  Pour the mixture into the bowl and stir to combine well.  Knead quickly on lightly floured surface to form a smooth dough.  Transfer to a well oiled bowl, cover and stand in a 200f degree oven for approximately half an hour or until lightly puffy and firm.  Meanwhile, heat a lightly oiled griddle.  To test the correct doneness, roll the test to the required tackiness and then gently remove.  Cut into 1cm slices and place on griddle or large dish lined with baking paper.  Sprinkle with chilli powder.  Use a skewer or knife to lightly prick all over.  Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden.  Remove from hot griddle and cool, then cut diagonally to serve.

title: Quick Pastries
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup curry paste ( i used penzey's famous curry paste )
instructions: Preheat oven to in medium sized bowl combine flour and curry paste.  Work water out to make a thick paste.  Add flour to paste and knead with hands until ball is formed, adding more water as needed but not too much or paste will get tough.  Flour your hands so dough doesn't stick,.  Make pastry into a ball.  Add dough to oiled, hot pan and shake to roll out large pastry and place on top.  Brush with oil and bake for 8 - 10 minutes at low heat.

title: Easy Chicken Tater Tots
ingredients: 3 chicken thighs, bone-in, skin on | 2 lbs whole firm fat free turkey ( turkey can be substituted ) | 3 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Place the chicken thighs in a large roasting pan and place roast in the oven.  Bake for about two hours, brushing occasionally with the 1 1/2 tablespoons of your favorite vanilla.  Remove the chicken to cool completely and carefully transfer to a cutting board.  Pull the meat off the bones.  Chop the meat into bite size pieces and place in a medium sauce pan with the vanilla.  Cover and simmer on the stove over low heat until tender about 20 - 15 minutes.  Add in the turkey meat and cook until the turkey and meat is cooked to your liking.

title: Rigatoni With Pumpkin, Sausage and Onions
ingredients: 3 large sausages | 1 bunch asparagus, tough ends removed | 500 g pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1cm pieces | 2 1/2 cups rigatoni pasta or 2 1/2 cups other short pasta | 2 tablespoons cognac ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | salt substitute ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a large non stick pot over medium heat on the stove top.  While the pot is heating, cook the pumpkin until tender – around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add the asparagus to the pot and cook until just tender crisp.  Drain on paper towels and set aside.  When the pot of pumpkin and asparagus are done, remove from heat.  In batches, cook the sausages in the hot oil until browned on both sides, about 10 minutes total, adding more oil if necessary.  Add the asparagus, pumpkin, pasta and cognac to the pan.  Toss to combine.  Divide between four serving plates.  Add salt substitute if needed.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,pork tenderloin,urad dal,tomato ketchup,cannellini bean,pizza sauce,dill pickle
title: Mock Meatball and Beans Bakewells
ingredients: 400 g diced pork tenderloin | 1 cup cooked cannellini beans | 100 g dill pickles | 200 g frozen pearl barley | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 packet dry pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons concentrated pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and grease or line a 26 hole 2.  Sliced lamb loin is the quickest method.  Combine pork with beans, pickles beans, and 2 cups of dill pickles.  In a large non stick frying pan, heat ketchup and set aside.  Layer meat mixture in a glass baking dish, topping with pizza sauce, a layer of dill pickle mix, cheese sauce, then more meat mixture, finishing with a layer of cheese sauce.  Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes.  Serve with rice and peas that have been microwaved or baked as the suggested accompaniment.  For vegetarian, use the pork tenderloin recipe or use the beef tenderloin recipe.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,anise seed,cheddar cheese,cardamom powder,ricotta cheese,heavy whipping cream,cilantro,turmeric
title: Indian Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 250 g cheddar cheese | 250 g ricotta cheese | 400 g heavy whipping cream | 20 g cilantro ( coriander ) ( optional ) | 20 g ground cardamom powder | 1 g golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Using a hand blender or food processor blend all of the ingredients into a smooth paste.  Keep refrigerated until required.  Use a rolling pin to roll the mixture into long cylinders about the size of a walnut.  If they float the roll will not be able to roll.  Spread each of the rolls with some of the melted butter.  Keep aside for about 1 hour so that they will spread a little bit of texture.  Preheat oven to 180 c or 400°f.  Place rolls on a tray and bake on an oven tray for 25 minutes.  Allow to cool before removing from the tins.  Serve chilled.

title: Basboosa (Greek Rice Cookies)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 2 tablespoons olive | 1 1/2 cups bisquick
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Drain rice well and rinse well with cold water.  Drain.  Melt butter in microwave at 70% power, add rice and mix with hands until blended and sticky.  Add bisquick and mix well.  Roll dough into little balls.  Bake in a shallow well greased pan 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Perfect Beef Falscher
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup canola oil for frying | seasoning salt to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep fryer to 350 degrees f.  Pour about 1 1/2 cup of oil into a clean dish towel, making sure to wash away any salt on inside the daqoos.  Place 1 bag of fadas into the oil and leave to swell up a few minutes.  This is not a bad idea just to keep the oil moving and then use up the oil.  You may not need to fry the entire bag but they cook fast.  Once the oil reaches 350 degrees f, remove the bag of fadas from oil with a skimmer or slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain briefly before serving.

title: Homemade Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 14 fresh spinach leaves, washed, stems removed, chopped coarse | garlic salt
instructions: Sprinkle the top of each washed spinach leaf with a generous amount of garlic salt.  Place a large heavy skillet on the stove and set it over medium heat.  When the skillet is hot enough, add one handful of spinach leaves and cook them, turning, until golden on all sides.  Repeat this procedure to cook the rest of the spinach leaves.  Note, you can also add more garlic salt to your taste.

title: Spiced Hash Browns Beef Hash
ingredients: 1 lb steak, sliced thinly | 1 package frozen hash browns | 1 bag snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Place steak slices in crockpot.  Mix ketchup, chutney & zest.  Pour over sliced beef.  Cook on low for 4 hours or on high for 3 hours.  Stir through before serving.

title: Oven Fried Prunes
ingredients: 1 package prune | 2 cups nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a non stick or aluminum fry pan with a lid, saute prunes until dark amber and beginning to char, approximately 8 mins at med low.  Stir to coat with spice mix and keep warm.  Pour milk evenly over prunes and sprinkle again with italian seasoning.  Cover and fry until milk boils and thickens to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,mango powder,poblano pepper,salmon,monterey jack cheese,beef stock cube
title: Mango Beef Stroganoff in a Hurry(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 500 g ground venison or 500 g beef chicken | 4 poblano peppers | 250 ml mango powder | 1 beef stock cube | 150 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat a pan until it is very hot.

title: Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese, diced | 1 tablespoon hot curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well.

title: Cheese-Topped Kale With Corn Croutons and Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 head fresh kale or 1 head other kale, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, softened | 1 cup queso fresco ( or feta cheese ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 cups coarsely chopped iceberg lettuce | 2 teaspoons baking soda | juice 3/4 cup kale or quinoa cereal | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray a large baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, thoroughly wilt the kale with the butter.  Transfer kale to the baking dish.  In a small bowl, stir the cheese until it melts.  Set aside.  Toss the lettuce with the cornstarch to coat.  Spread cheese mixture evenly over kale.  Bake for 25 minutes or until the cheese is light brown and bubbly.  Toss kale with the cereal, ice and remaining cheese mixture.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,red onion,nonfat yogurt,sauce,beef sirloin steak,basil pesto,kernel corn
title: Grilled Steak With Basil Pesto
ingredients: 1 boneless beef top sirloin steak | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil pesto ( bottled pesto is okay ) | 1/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 3 tablespoons fresh minced red onion | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | your favorite hot sauce
instructions: Trim fat from steak.

title: Tamarind Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind paste ( soaked in 1/4 cup water for 20 minutes ) | 1/8 cup granulated sugar | 1/8 cup coarsely chopped kalamata olive | 2 bouillon cubes ( i used 2 small-medium size patties ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container in the refrigerator until all ingredients are chilled.  Tastes best when allowed to come to room temperature.  Can be served room temperature in a bottle, refrigerated for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: honey,french green bean,ice water,pepperoni,custard,red curry paste
title: Bunuelos De Morue: Green Beans With Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs french style green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 - 2 tbsp red curry paste, your favorite | 1 1/3 cup honey | 3 tablespoons custard | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice water | 1 lb sliced pepperoni
instructions: In a 6 quart pot cook your green beans in the 2 tbsp of curry paste for about 8 minutes or till desired tenderness.  In a small bowl combine the 2 tbsp of honey and cream.  Bring a few cups of water to a boil.  Add the green beans and cook 2 - 3 mins, or till just tender.  Drain on a paper towel.  Place the cooked green beans in your blender with the rest of the curry paste, custard, and ice water in the same pot, stir.  Bring to a boil, and simmer over a low heat for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and put in your pepperoni slices.  Let the peas heat up for about 3 mins, stirring occasionally.

title: Mexican Corn Truffles
ingredients: 1 package corn tortillas | 3 slices mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup crouton | 1 small head garlic | 1 teaspoon wine
instructions: In skillet on medium high heat toast tortillas until soft.  Spread each tortilla with cheese, jam and garlic.  Place in a plastic bag for about 20 seconds.  Flatten with a rolling pin to form a rectangle.  Top each with a generous amount of cranberries, croutons, then mozzarella.  Roll up starting at narrow end of tortillas.  Brush with wine and secure with toothpicks.  Place on a baking sheet covered with aluminum foil, bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes until crispy on top.  Serve immediately.

title: Sun Dried Tomato & Gruyere Cheese Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup gruyere, finely grated | 1/3 cup fresh italian, finely grated | 1/3 cup rice wine | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f, & line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with parchment paper.  Combine the tomatoes, cheese, and italian cheese, then set aside.  Spread the sun dried tomatoes into the loaf pan.  Dot with the sun dried tomato halves & drizzle with the sun dried tomatoes.  Add the rice wine & sun dried tomatoes, then bake 30 minutes.  Transfer to a serving plate & serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,banana pepper,daikon radish,chicken breast,pork shoulder,cilantro leaf,walnut,turmeric powder
title: Tunisian Baked Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs ( boneless or skinless ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup daikon radish, julienned | 1 cup walnuts, chopped or 1 cup almonds | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 banana pepper, seeded and sliced thinly | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream or 2 scoops other ice cream
instructions: Place chicken thigh, pork shoulder and turmeric in large dutch oven and add just enough hot water to just cover.  Bring to boil and simmer covered over low heat for 2 hours.  Drain and discard pork.  Remove meat from pot and reserve the broth.  Wipe out pot.  Return strained pan broth to same pot and place over high heat until boiling and simmer for 45 minutes.  Drain and discard solids.  Set aside, covered.  Cook daikon, radishes, and walnuts in reserved broth for 5 minutes or until walnuts are lightly toasted.  Remove from heat.  Add cilantro and cool slightly.  Cut chicken into small pieces and layer in bread bowl or serving platter with salad garnishes.  Add soup, if liked, and top with sliced fruit.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,lime wedge,broiler fryer chicken,coconut oil
title: Tommy's Chicken Dominican
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs broiler-fryer chickens ( cut up ) | 10 tablespoons light coconut oil | 10 cans rotel tomatoes | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to cut up chicken and place in 9x13 pan.  Pour can of rotel tomatoes over chicken.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add enough water to cover chicken.  Bake for 1 hour.  Remove chicken.  Put can of rotel tomato mixture on top of chicken and bake for 1 more hour.  While chicken bakes, take can of lime and put juice in pan.  Simmer on medium high heat for 5 minutes or until you can feel the juice of a lime wedge in the oil.  Serve with rice or enjoy over rice.

title: Baked Beans With Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg great northern beans, shelled, boiled and drained | 2 hot peppers, finely chopped | 300 ml double cream ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c/gas place beans in an oven proof dish.  Sprinkle over boiling water until they resemble a custard like consistency.  Sprinkle over peppers and cream if using.  Bake for about 1 hour or until beans are tender.  Variations, to enhance the bean flavours, use canned whole beans, soaked for 2 hours and drained of water.  To serve, spoon some beans inside a small, oven proof dish.  Cover lightly with a pouring layer of cream.

title: Ramen Skillet
ingredients: 1 package dry ramen noodles | 1/4 cup butter or margarine, melted
instructions: Pour noodles into a large skillet with a lid.  Fill skillet with water about half way up the side of the noodles in the skillet.  Bring water to a boil.  When water boils again, remove from heat, and add noodles.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: meat,hot red chili pepper,hot italian sausage,garlic,jalapeno pepper,radish
title: Mexican Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced cooked hot italian sausage | 1 lb sliced cooked chopped meat | 1 can sliced jalapeno peppers | 1 jar pickled hot red chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon bottled minced garlic | 2 -3 radishes, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Cover tightly and bake at 400°f for 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake 10 - 15 minutes longer depending on how hot you like your hot dogs.  Serve warm with your favorite condiments such as tortilla chips, cheese, avocado, tomatoes, etc.  May be served hot instead of hot, with pico de gallo, salsa, or lettuce, or may be served at room temperature.

title: Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 200 g white beans, trimmed | 300 g unsalted cashews | 2 tablespoons sweet red curry paste | 300 ml thickened cream of coconut
instructions: Soak cashews overnight, then break off ends and rinse.  Place soaked chickpeas, cashew nuts, curry paste and cream of coconut into a food processor and blend well.  Store in air tight container in refrigerator, until needed, but not required.

title: Squash & Broccoli Stoup
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 1 kg squash | 100 g mascarpone cheese | 400 ml dry soymilk | 600 g white onions, peeled and sliced
instructions: Separate broccoli into florets, blanch for 5 mins in boiling water with 1 teaspoon salt.  Cut squash into 1cm thick wedges, steam fry, peel and slice onion till golden brown.  Peel broccoli and squash, set aside for 15 mins in cold water to stop cooking.  Mash squash with the mascarpone cheese and soymilk to make smooth sauce.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,worcestershire sauce,chicken bouillon,monterey jack cheese,green chile pepper
title: Green Chile Pepper Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely diced green chile peppers | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix the green chile peppers with worcestershire sauce, bouillon, and hoisin sauce in a medium baking dish.  Mix together the monterey jack cheese and green chile peppers with the cheese.  Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,chorizo sausage,green,bread flour,cold water,green tea,half cream
title: Green Tea Chorizo Bread for Two
ingredients: 4 ounces chorizo sausage, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 4 ounces green tea ( green tea is preferable ) | 2 2 cups long-grain white rice or 2 cups arborio rice | 2 cups cold water | 1 cup half-and-half cream ( whipping cream may be substituted ) | 8 cups bread flour | 4 -8 leaves green leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Soak chorizo in cold water while preparing the rice.  Place rice and 4 cups of water in a bowl and add 1 cup of cream, and set aside to soak until ready to use.  Drain chorizo and set aside.  Sift the flour into a large bowl and stir in the chorizo and remaining 3/4 cups of water.  Set aside and allow to rest for 10 minutes.  Place remaining cup of cream in a heavy 4 - 5 quart casserole, and add bread mixture.  Stir the mixture to combine and place in the oven.  Bake for 1 and 1/4 hours, stirring in the reserved 2 cups of cream periodically.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,heart palm,icing sugar,corn flake,chicken tender,dill weed,coconut
title: Crunchy Lemon Bars
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders, shredded | 1/1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon corn flakes, crushed | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed | 1 cup hearts of palm, sliced | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 pan with non stick vegetable spray.  Mix chicken, yogurt, corn flakes cereal, icing sugar, dill weed and half of the palm in a bowl.  Press on pan.  Sprinkle with remaining palm.  Bake, uncovered, until lightly browned and crispy, about 30 minutes cool completely then cut into 36 bars.

title: Curried Gorgonzola

ingredients: 2 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons prepared gravy | 2 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 pound beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 1 green cardamom pod | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the chicken, gravy, and graham crackers in a large baking dish with the eggplant, meat, and the sliced beef.  Sprinkle with coriander, cardamom, cilantro leaves, and salt.  Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven.  To serve, slice the kofta into 1/2 inch wide thick wedges and garnish with a sprinkling of cilantro.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,beef bouillon cube,yam,dill pickle spear,snow pea,extra virgin olive oil,cod,white chocolate
title: Cod and Yams in Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 12 yams | 1 package white chocolate, chopped | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill pickle spear | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cook yams in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender.  Remove and cool under running water.

title: Delicious Stilton Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package stilton cheese | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons good curry paste | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon chopped celery
instructions: Blend cheese with tomatoes and curry paste until smooth and creamy.  Season with adobo, garlic, celery, and salt and pepper to your taste.  If desired, mix in 1/4 cup water at the end of cooking.  Heat in microwave for 1 1/2 2 minutes on high, stirring occasionally.

title: Prawns (Shrimp) with Nam Pla (Shrimp)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons cashews ( salted, unsalted or raw )
instructions: Cut the shrimp into 1 inch lengths and place in a bowl.  Add the fish sauce, cashews, and worcestershire sauce and toss well.  Taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Sun Dried Tomato and Jaggery Squares
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 2 tablespoons jaggery | 60 g unsalted butter, melted | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup water | 1 packet crescent rolls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper.

title: Grilled Mustard English Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups coarse quinoa, rinsed | 2 1/2 tablespoons whole grain mustard
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium heat with the rack 4 inches from the heat source.  Put a plate or serving platter on your work surface or the table.  Bring the quinoa to a boil in a pot.  Stir in 1/2 cup of the mustard and 1/2 cup of water.  Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook until the quinoa is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 30 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover with aluminum foil and let rest 5 minutes.  Fluff and divide the quinoa among 4 - 6 paper lined cups or a 12x8x2 inch baking pan that has been sprinkled with remaining mustard.  If using an english muffin pan, preheat grill to high.  Brush grates with remaining mustard.  Place the muffins on the grill and cook 15 minutes, turning once, until the muffins are golden and the quinoa is lightly toasted.

title: Zucchini With Buttermilk
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Wash, peel and thinly slice the zucchini into thin rounds.  Place in a steamer basket with just enough water to cover and steam for 20 - 30 minutes or until just tender.  Remove from heat.  Rinse with cold water, drain well.  In a medium sized bowl, mix the buttermilk and zucchini.  Cover and refrigerate for an hour to blend flavors.

title: Lentil Spread
ingredients: 1 package lentils ( brown if available ) | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Rinse lentils, removing and discarding any damaged ones or damaged lentils.  Place lentils in a large bowl.  Cover with water and let soak for 30 minutes or more.  Drain.  Return lentils to same large bowl with any additional water and mix gently.  Add parsley.  Allow to sit for at least 3 hours prior to serving.

title: Pasta Udang Manis (Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 200 g meat or 200 g chicken | 1/2 cup pasta ( udang manis ) | 1/2 red pepper, roasted and chopped into small pieces | 2 cups grapeseed oil | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cut meat into cubes and fry in oil on medium heat for 5 minutes.  Add a little water and bring to rolling boil.  Wash and dry tuang manis.  Add to meat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring until all the pieces of meat are sealed and brown.  Add the red pepper and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring to incorporate all the flavors of the meat and the red pepper.  Add the pasta and cook for 15 more seconds.

Random Ingredients: rack lamb,banana,cornflour,cabbage,strawberry jam,extra virgin olive oil,red curry paste,cardamom
title: Vietnamese Rack of Lamb, Vegetable and Banana Salad With Spicy Mustard Cream
ingredients: 1 rack of lamb, frenched, boned and butterflied | 1/2 small fresh banana, cut into small chunks | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 tablespoon cornflour | 1 1/2 tablespoons strawberry jam | 2 cups shredded cabbage or 2 cups napa cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c.  Line the rack with foil lightly oiled and lined with baking paper.  Place the lamb on the foil and top with the banana.  Whisk together the olive oil, red curry paste, cardamom into the dressing.  Sprinkle the mustard cream on top and spread evenly to cover the meat and banana.  Place the remaining banana chunks on top of the curry and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and allow to rest in the oven for a further 10 minutes before slicing thinly.  To serve, scatter over the cabbage and accompany with the cooked lamb.  Serve with the spicy mustard cream and salad greens.  Tip, you can use a combination of vinegared and butterflied carrots, cucumber, tomatoes and/or fresh snap peas for a more interesting salad.

title: Italian Sausage and Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 1 package italian sausage | 1 can chopped green chili | 1 can sliced canned pineapple | 1 can water
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks.  Brown chicken in pan.  Remove chicken.  Brown sausage, green chili, pineapple, and water in pan, then add to pan and boil until water is gone.  Add salt & pepper to taste.  Serve over pasta.

title: Seared Salmon With rose petals, Gravlax or Lemon Juice
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | bay leaf | 6 rose petals
instructions: Rinse salmon and pat dry with paper towels.  Place in a large non stick frying pan or skillet that has been sprayed with oil.  Add the bayleaf and rose petals.  Reduce heat to low and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until water is almost evaporated and fish flakes easily with fork.  Cover and cook over medium low heat, turning once, until salmon is flaky, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Koshari
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 1/4 cups cold water
instructions: Place the quinoa in a bowl, and add enough cold water to cover.  Stand for 25 minutes until water is absorbed.  Rinse, and drain the quinoa.  Place raisins in a small bowl, and pour 2 tablespoons boiling water into them.  Set aside to soak.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,sugar syrup,brown sugar,cooking spray,bread flour,onion powder,lime zest
title: Easy French Toast
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 tablespoon sugar-free syrup
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine all ingredients except for bread flour and syrup in a plastic bag, then shake to mix.  Add the bread and coat both sides.  Spray a heavy baking pan with cooking spray and add the french toast.  Cook about 8 minutes or until crisp.  Drizzle the warm french toast with syrup, and serve.

title: The Real English Cheddar, Sandwiches
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( i sub about 2 t.
    - snipped fresh parsley ) | 1 small cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 8 ounces shredded low-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine the beef ingredients and mix with your hands.  Form into 4 patties and sprinkle with 1 t.  Cilantro.  Fry in a little oil for medium to medium doneness, but not a light brown.  Serve on bun top with remaining 1 t.  Cilantro, 1 slices of cucumber and your favourite topping and cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: spicy brown mustard,farfalle pasta,corn syrup,orange liqueur,grit,pearl barley,turmeric
title: Pasta and Barley Salad With Mustard
ingredients: 3 cups farfalle pasta, dry ( bow tie pasta is the closest flavour to mustard ) | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 teaspoons spiced brown mustard | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur ( or other ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 3/4 cup grits
instructions: Boil the pasta and barley until the pasta is al dente.  While the pasta is cooking, combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl, toss well, set aside.  Drain the pasta and barley, add the mustard into the pasta, stir well then divide between two large bowls.

title: Spicy and Creamy Gorgonzola Kale
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 ounces gorgonzola cheese, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 pound kale, stems removed and leaves torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange kale in a single layer in a baking dish.  Spray kale with cooking spray.

title: Thai Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Mix the shredded cabbage and soy sauce together until it's the desired texture.

title: Date Cakes
ingredients: 600 g white bread flour | 200 ml rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon rice powdered safflower or 1/2 teaspoon safflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c.  Mix all dry ingredients together.  Using a pastry blender cut the bread into small squares/about the size of a large egg.  Spray the squares/about with oil and place on oven trays.  Cook for about 8 - 10 minutes.  Cool and store airtight.  Enjoy.

title: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, roasted red pepper pickles
instructions: Combine shrimp, roasted red pepper pickle, and red bell pepper in a bowl.  Toss to combine.

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 cup dry corn tortilla chips | 1/4 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Combine dry corn tortilla chips or flour tortilla chips in a bowl of cold water.  Dry the chips on paper towels.  Place one chip on a piece of wax paper.  Top with a second crisp chip.  Carefully roll the paper around the chips until they have a crumbly texture.  Arrange the crisp chips on a plate with the wax paper on each side.  Allow to dry at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Enjoy your meal.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,beef tongue,bird chile,graham cracker crumb,pimiento,pizza crust
title: Easy Tangy Roast
ingredients: 1 jar prepared pizza crust | 1 pound beef tongues | 1 jar sliced pimiento | 1/2 pound finely chopped smoked gorgonzola cheese | 1 jar dried hot wing sauce with liquid smoke | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a medium baking dish or roasting pan, place 1 sheet of parchment paper or aluminum foil placed on top.  Place the tongue on the foil, and place in the center of the oven.  Roast, turning occasionally, until meat is tender, about 2 hours.  Cool, then remove meat from pan and chop.  Place in a large bowl.  Wash and dry ears of tongue.  Place the tongue in a roasting pan.  Cover with sliced pimiento and enough hot wing sauce to drizzle over the tongue.  Sprinkle 1 package of gorgonzola cheese evenly over the tongue.  Cover the dish or roasting pan with aluminum foil.  Place roasting pan in preheated oven and roast until hot and bubbly, about 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and drain gorgonzola cheese from foil onto a plate until completely cool.  Arrange 1 to 2 slices of the tongue onto each of 4 plates.  Garnish with 1 to 2 slices of smoked gorgonzola cheese.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,beef eye,irish cream,vanilla,golden brown sugar,season salt,russet potato,kernel corn
title: Spicy Corn and Beef Smasher
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced crosswise into 1/8 inch thick pieces | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( or other brand ) | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 2 teaspoons good season season salt | 5 lbs beef eye round, trimmed of fat, sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices | 2 cans whole kernel corn ( drained )
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients, and mix well.  Sprinkle beef strips with mixture in a shallow baking dish or other non reactive container.  Stir the corn and the remaining ingredients into the beef and pour juice evenly over beef slices.  Cover and chill the beef at least two hours and up to 24 hours.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake the beef in a covered roasting pan approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cooked to taste, brushing once or twice with juices.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,portobello mushroom,collard green,flour tortilla,barbeque sauce,hamburger
title: BBQ Burritos
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1 barbeque sauce, divided | 1 cup sliced portobello mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped collard greens | 1 package fat free flour tortillas | 8 slices ham and provolone cheese
instructions: Shape ground chuck into small, bite size, browned meat in a large pot over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until crumbly and no longer pink, about 10 minutes.  Add a few teaspoons barbeque sauce and 1/2 cup sliced portobello mushrooms.

title: Scottish Cod With Parsley (Cacouninnnam)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cod, cut into chunks | 6 fluid ounces milk | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Heat a large roasting tin in the oven, add the cod and roast in the oven, stirring occasionally, for 10 - 12 minutes, till golden and flakey.  Transfer the cod to a mixing bowl, add the milk and half the parsley and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  To finish, pour the milk mixture into an earthenware serving bowl.  Pour the remaining parsley over the cod, cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.  Unmod the baking dish and serve.

title: Mushroom Orange Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mushrooms | 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Chilled Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 12 ounces chicken quarters | 2 leeks, cleaned and washed well | 1 package cheese tortellini
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Heat half the ghee in a skillet over medium heat and fry the chicken for a few minutes until golden brown.  Remove chicken and set aside.  Add remainder of ghee to the pan and fry the leeks for 3 - 5 minutes until tender.  Place 2 - 3 tablespoons of the shredded chicken in the center of each tortellini package.  Roll the tortellini up and place seam side down in the baking dish.  Repeat process with all the noodles.  Pour the enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.  Bake the enchiladas for 30 minutes or until heated through.  Serve warm.

title: Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups sliced seeded jalapeno peppers | 1/3 cup canned broth
instructions: Divide the peppers among 6 individual soups bowls.  Mix together the jalapeno pepper and broth and pour over the peppers.  Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Chard with Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh swiss chard | 1 jar spaghetti sauce with meat | 1/4 cup butter, melted
instructions: Trim leaves off of the chard.  Use a large bowl to pour spaghetti sauce into the bowl with the leaves.  Squeeze out excess water if necessary.  Trim remaining 2 stalks of the chard.  Fill bowl with drained spaghetti sauce.  Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.  Drain, reserving 1/4 cup of soaking liquid.  Preheat the broiler.  Arrange chard on a baking sheet and broil, turning occasionally, 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly wilted.  To serve, arrange 1 to 1 1/2 servings of chard on a serving platter.  Brush chard with butter and serve with reserved spaghetti sauce.

title: Herb Chive Garlic Sauce(For Dipping)
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves | 2 tablespoons dried chives
instructions: Make sure you get them soft, not mushy.

title: Shahi Tukray (Spiced Hard-Boiled Eggs)
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces fresh toast, or 5 slices of toasted bread | 5 cardamom seeds | 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 1 cup rum
instructions: Make sure the toast is completely dry before adding the nut & coriander powders.  Mix very well together before adding the remaining ingredients to sharpen the mixture.  The flavours will intensify as the mixture is made.  Allow 10 - 15 minutes for dry and 10 - 15 minutes for hard cooked eggs.

Random Ingredients: french,dijon mustard,lemon,vegemite,polenta,hot paprika,vegetable oil olive,italian salad dressing mix
title: Vegan French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup textured vegetable oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/3 cup vegemite ( may sub instant potato flour to make the gluten-free version ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dijon mustard | 16 ounces refrigerated prepared polenta | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon rind | 1 packet italian salad dressing mix | 2 -4 french rolls or 2 -4 other sandwich buns, cut into fourths
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Grease a 1 1/2 cup muffin tin, then line with paper liners.  Melt the oil in a saucepan over medium heat.  Stir in the vegemite.  Cook, stirring constantly, until the vegemite has dissolved and is no longer cloudy.  Remove from heat, and add the mustard.  Grease a broiler pan, and set aside.  Spread the polenta on the paper liners, spread lightly.  Sprinkle both sides of the polenta with the paprika, lemon rind, and salad dressing mix.  Place buns under the broiler and cook 2 - 3 minutes or until the bottoms of the buns are lightly toasted and the tops are golden brown.

title: Canned Mexican White Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces white beans, drained | 1 can pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce
instructions: In a food processor, process beans, pimentos and hot sauce until smooth.  Refrigerate until served with other optional ingredients such as sour cream.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,mango chutney,egg yolk,corn flake,sage,flat leaf parsley,lemonade
title: Chef John's Watermelon Mousse
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemonade | 5 tablespoons cold water | 1 1/2 pounds seedless watermelon | 4 ounces crushed corn flakes, divided | 4 ounces mango chutney | 2 hard-cooked egg yolks, minced
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,lemon peel,cremini mushroom,cashew,tomatillo,ham,beef chuck,shrimp paste
title: Cousin Pete
ingredients: 1 lb cubed ham | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 4 1/4 lbs cremini mushrooms | 1 can diced pimento-stuffed tomatillos ( or more ) | 1/2 lb peeled and deveined shrimp paste | 3/4 cup brown sugar | lemon peel, 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup cashews
instructions: In a large skillet brown hamburger and chuck in hot fat or a bit of oil.  Remove to a plate.  Drain excess fat if there is any.  Add mushrooms, pimentos, tomatoes and shrimp paste to meat.  Stir in sugar.  Cut the lemon peel into strips.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Simmer on low heat for 1 hour.  Pour over meat, rice, or couscous.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,cooking spray,yellow onion,mozzarella cheese,maple syrup,red rice,beef consomme
title: Quick and Easy Ground Beef, Rice, & Onion Bake
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow onion | 1 can beef consomme | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, zest of | 3 cups cooked red rice | 1/2 cup light shredded fat free mozzarella cheese, divided | maple syrup, as needed, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Spray a 9 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Heat 1/2 cup onions in a saucepan over medium high heat.  Cook, stirring often, for 5 minutes or until soft tender.  Drain any excess liquid from the pan and transfer the cooked onions to a small mixing bowl.  Add the 3/4 cup consommé to the mixture and stir until combined.  Spoon the mixture evenly into the prepared pan and scatter the remaining 1/4 cup of onion over the top.  Sprinkle half of the monterey jack cheese evenly all over the top.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Drizzle with maple syrup and serve.

title: Pudding Cottage Filling (Cottage Filling)
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla instant pudding | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix the vanilla pudding with the corn oil.  When pudding is warm, combine the pudding and oil and mix well.  If mixture is too thick, add a bit of water.

title: Irish Corn
ingredients:
1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp.
    - irish whiskey | 6 whole whole cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup frozen corn kernels
instructions: Stir the whiskey into the hot corona corona over very low heat.  Heat the cardamom pods in the whiskey, about 10 minutes.  Immediately remove the cardamom pods, and add the cayenne.  Quickly add the corn kernels, remove them from the whiskey.  Put the corona into a serving dish and serve.  Irish whiskey can be added to whiskey in place of cinnamon and cardamom.

title: Traditional Scottish Mincemeat, for feeding on lamb and meat pies!
ingredients: 500 g frozen meat ( meat pies, beef ) | drippings, for cooking
instructions: Cut 1 cup frozen meat into 6 portions and use this to line the top of the meat.  Brush with drippings.  Cook on a grill bbq and or on a hot oven shelf.

title: Sherry Vinegar (Japanese)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean hard salami ( about 2 1/2 ounces ) | 1/4 cup pared parsley | 3/4 cup mirin ( or 4 1/2 teaspoons japanese rice wine vinegar to 4 1/8 ounces )
instructions: Cut salami into thin slices and remove any excess fat.  Place the slices on a board and cut with scissors or a sharp knife into 3/4 inch lengths.  Blanch salami in boiling water for 1 minute then remove.  Remove salami from water and rinse with cold water.  Place the salami in a shallow bowl, sprinkle on the parsley, and pour 1/2 cup mirin over it.  Refrigerate for 1 hour.  Drain the salami.  Strain off excess mirin and serve the salami with the cooking liquid.  Make up to 1 day ahead, cover and refrigerate salad.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,red bird eye chilies,hamburger bun,spinach leaf
title: Rum-Steamed Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 20 fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 lb hamburger bun | 2 -3 dried red bird's eye chilies ( optional ) | 2 ounces dark rum ( not light )
instructions: To prepare, slice the green beans lengthwise as thinly as possible to get a total of about 8 slices.  If using chilies cut them into thin strips, and divide the stems and leaves among them.  Place a bamboo steamer over a saucepan of very hot water.  Allow it to come to a boil while you prepare the hamburger.  Drain excess water from the beans.  Place a slice or two of the meat, if preferred, on each slice of green beans.  Add a small amount of rum to the water, then place the green beans in the steamer.  When the water begins to boil again top with a lid and let steam for 10 minutes.  Remove the lid, fluff the beans with a fork, and serve with a garnish of green onions, if desired.

title: Blueberry Gluten and Dairy Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries, washed, picked over, and rinsed | 2 -3 tablespoons gluten ( if using gluten free or non-dairy soy yogurt, mix gluten-free ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 6 tablespoons green onions, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoons cider vinegar or 1 -2 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon jaswain, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients, except green onion, in a blender on low to medium speed for 10 minutes or until smooth and thick.  Add to salad.  Enjoy.

title: Watermelon Beer Dip With Horseradish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups ice, crushed | 1 cup watermelon, cubed | 1/4 cup fat-free liquid egg substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 fresh chipotle pepper, seeded, diced ( you can add in the adobo sauce from the chipotle pepper if preferred ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup horseradish, at room temperature ( you can use any bottled horseradish )
instructions: Place ice in tall glass and add watermelon.  Add all remaining ingredients except the horseradish.  Mix well.  Place in refrigerator for at least four hours until set.  Serve with fresh vegetables or raw meat as desired.

title: Sesame Oatcakes - Oatcakes With Cardamom
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Pour boiling water over the oatmeal and stir together.  Leave to stand for 2 hours.  Preheat oven 160°c.  Brush a hot baking tray with oil and scatter with cardamom powder.  Toss oatcakes evenly in the batter and bake for 12 - 15 mins, or until crisp.  Allow to cool and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,black sesame seed,sage leaf,kielbasa,maraschino cherry,sea salt,salt black pepper
title: Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 3 large leaves iceberg lettuce | 10 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 bunches fresh sage leaves, torn | 1 lb kielbasa, sliced | 5 fresh maraschino cherries, halved | 1/4 cup coarse sea salt | 1/4 cup fresh coarse ground black sesame seeds
instructions: Heat a nonstick frypan over medium high heat until hot.  Add the olive oil, sprinkle with the sun dried tomatoes and sage.  Allow the sage to wilt and the sage to wilt for 2 minutes while shaking the pan so the sun dried tomatoes release their fragrance.  Add the kielbasa slices and reduce the heat to medium.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes.  Add the cherries and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes.  Season to taste with sea salt and black pepper and remove from heat to cool 5 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the kielbasa from the pan onto a serving plate.  Garnish with the sesame seeds.  Cover with a clean cloth and refrigerate for about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,salad oil,salmon fillet,green curry paste,greek yogurt,tilapia fillet,leek
title: Lemon Grass & Curry Salmon Kebabs
ingredients: 800 g skinless salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, fresh chopped | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 1/4 cups mixed salad oil | 100 g greek yogurt or 100 g creamy white yogurt | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | salad oil, to coat
instructions: Place salmon fillets on oven tray and baste well with lemon grass & curry paste.  Set aside for 20 minutes.  While fish is baking mix all ingredients into a bowl and season with salt & pepper.  When salmon has 20 minutes prepared on oven tray, coat with oil & baste well with mixture.  Set aside for 10 minutes before serving with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,tequila,ladyfinger,pistachio nut,cumin powder,cannellini bean
title: Red Beans, Pistachios & Cannellini Mash
ingredients: 3 cups red kidney beans ( cooked ) | 14 ounces cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1/2 cup pistachio nut | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup tequila ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sifted powdered icing sugar | 24 -32 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir to combine.  Serve in small bowls topped with sifted icing sugar.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 3 ounces vanilla vodka | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Stir all in a cocktail shaker with ice, fill with ice and serve with a cherry.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,nutmeg,white bread,green cabbage,wine vinegar,corn oil,lite olive oil,egg white
title: Crispy French Fried Corn on the Cob With Sweet Potato
ingredients: 2 corn cobs, with husks | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil | 1/2 green cabbage, shredded ( leaves ) | 1/2 small red cabbage, shredded | 1 egg white, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon white bread, crumbs | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Put corn cob on a baking sheet, and brush with olive oil.  Bake corn at 400 for 10 minutes, or until tender.  Remove corn from oven and allow to cool.  When cool, split cobs in half, and remove husks.  Cut kernels from cob.  Place cabbage on a rimmed baking sheet.  Brush each half with a little olive oil, then sprinkle with nutmeg and bread crumbs.  Bake in oven for 10 - 13 minutes, or until golden brown.  Allow to cool.  When corn is cool, peel and cut kernels from cob.  Serve and cut off hard center.  Place corn kernels on serving platter.  Top with cabbage and sweet potato.  Drizzle with sweet potato and additional sweet potato to taste.

title: A French Peaches Vinaigrette
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh ripe peaches | white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato puree
instructions: To prepare a fresh peach, halve and pit the peach halves to reveal the flesh.  Use a sharp knife to slice into 1/4 to 1/3/1/2 inch slices.  Sprinkle on the vinegar.  Place in glass jar or bowl and pour tomato puree over them.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg white,cucumber,chili oil,anaheim chile pepper,curry paste
title: Thai-Spiced Quick Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste, or to taste | 4 egg whites | 1 pinch chili oil | 1 anaheim chile pepper, sliced lengthwise and seeded, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Slice about 1/4 inch thick slices from a cucumber.  Place on a baking sheet and cut into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until the cucumbers have turned tender 2 to 3 hours.  Rinse off the slices with cold water until cool.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,brown bread,caper,margarine,cream mushroom soup,amaretto liqueur
title: Amaretto Onion Crouton Sandwich Spread
ingredients: 1 ounce margarine, at room temperature | 1 cup chopped white sugar | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 1/2 cup capers | 8 slices toasted brown bread
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, warm the margarine until light and bubbly.  Remove from heat and stir in the white sugar gradually until the mixture is creamy and well blended.  Set aside.  In a medium bowl, combine the cream of mushroom soup, amaretto wine, capers and sliced bread.  Turn oven to 300 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 2 1/2 quart baking dish.  Divide the baked croutons evenly among the prepared bread slices.  Spread the onion sauce evenly over the croutons.  Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and bubbly, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Broccoli Rabe with Venison
ingredients: 2 pounds frozen broccoli rabe, thawed | 2 pounds lean ground venison
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Arrange frozen broccoli rabe in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until beginning to brown, 20 to 25 minutes.  Place venison in a medium skillet over medium high heat.  Place skillet and broccoli rabe in the preheated oven, and cook until evenly browned, about 15 minutes.  Slice venison into small pieces and place in a medium pot over medium heat.  Pour hot venison mixture into the pot.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Sirloin Steak Wrapped in Provolone, Bacon and Chives
ingredients: 3 slices white bread flour ( from day old white bread loaf ) | 1 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat | 1 ounce prosciutto ham, thinly sliced across the grain | 2 -4 tablespoons snipped fresh chives
instructions: Place the flour, prosciutto, and chives in large freezer bag.  Remove bread from bag and place the sirloin on one side.  Lift the steak from the bag onto the proscuitto and fold meat over to coat.  Place the steak, oiled side down, on a tray and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.  Remove all the steak from the freezer bag and pat dry with a towel.  Heat the broiler.  Remove wrap and place sirloin on two broiler proof plates.  Place under the hot broiler for 1 to 2 minutes for rare, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes for medium rare, 2 to 3 minutes for medium.  The meat should be reddish in color and slightly crusty on the outside.  Place sirloin on to a cutting board and cut into thick slices.  Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper.  Slice sandwich into 4 equal portions.  Divide the slices on the serving plates.  Place the chives in a small bowl, cover with boiling water and toss to combine.  Drizzle over a little chili oil if desired.  These are great served with a side dish of greens.

title: Herbed Ricotta Cookies
ingredients: 250 g ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 16 ladyfingers | powdered ginger, for grating on biscuit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°c line a baking tray with baking paper.  Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and stir well.  Place a generous tablespoon of the mixture in the middle of each biscuit and roll up firmly.  Gently press around the biscuits to flatten slightly.  Cut roll into small sticks and place on the baking paper.  Place under a hot grill for 1 - 2 minutes, turning once if desired.  Serve warm or cold, with cream or a dash of dark rum.

title: Easy Pimento Cookies
ingredients: 1 can chopped pimentos | 3 cups all-purpose flour for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix the pimentos with the flour, and roll out into rounds the size of your measuring cup.  Place the round cookies on a cookie sheet, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven.  Remove, and sprinkle with pimento flavored jam, or sprinkle with confectioners sugar for festive look.

instructions: Place lamb in dutch oven.  Add broth, tomatoes and seasoning.  Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer about 2 hours or until cooked.  Remove lamb from stew.  Reserve pan juices.  Cool well.

title: Mock Cheddar Coleslaw

instructions: Mix well over veggies.  Let sit 30 seconds before cutting.

title: Mango and Orange Peel

Pour into a glass jar and cover with saran wrap, sealing all the peel with a thin layer of orange juice on top, allowing it to'sit' in the air.  Refrigerate overnight or until ready to use.

title: Chinese Snow Pea and Snow Clafouti

Remove from heat, stir in a little of the egg mixture, then serve immediately.

title: Acorn Squash & Green Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 acorn squash | 450 g green beans, cut into 1cm slices | 2 cups button mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 3/4 cup chicken stock, extra if necessary | 350 g canned beans, drained & rinsed | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c prick the squash with a fork & place on a baking tray.  Brush the squash with oil, bake for about 1 hour or until tender.  Meanwhile, bring 2 cups of stock to the boil in a saucepan over low heat.  Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Rinse the squash under running water to catch the juices & remove the stone.  Remove the seeds & stringy white membrane.  Cut squash in half lengthways & scrape out the flesh.  Cut the squash in half again lengthways & cut each half into 3cm long wedges.  Cook beans until tender, drain & reserve.  Bruise the remaining stock in a saucepan over low heat.  Whisk in flour and white pepper until smooth.  Add the beans, squash, reserved stock, cooked beans & hot red pepper.  Bring to the boil, stirring until soup boils and thickens slightly.  Serve hot with a sprinkling of grated cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,thyme,chicken broth,chicken wing,black bean,oatmeal
title: Chicken and Black Bean Oat Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 4 cans black beans, undrained | 5 -6 cups chicken stock or 5 -6 cups canned low sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 teaspoons salt | 1/3 cup quick oatmeal
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oatmeal in crock pot or crock pot and mix well.  Cover and allow to cook on high setting 6 - 8 hours.  Add oatmeal and stir.  Serve over noodles and your favorite fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ra el hanout spice mix,plain flour,basil
title: Basil and Raisin Friands
ingredients: 12 large basil leaves | 2 cups gluten-free plain flour | 3 tablespoons dried basil, roughly chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix, of your choice | 1/2 cup egg substitute or 1 egg | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c line 2 flat baking trays with baking paper.  Toast basil leaves for 2 - 3 minutes.  Roughly chop.  Place flour, basil, and ras el hanout spice in a food processor and process to mixture.  Add egg and parmigiano reggiano cheese and process to combine.  Place mixture onto a clean board and work quickly until dough becomes smooth and elastic, about 2 - 3 minutes with hand.  Do not knead or over knead the dough.  Dough can also be kneaded briefly and refrigerated until needed.  On lightly floured surface, roll out dough to a rectangle about 20x14 inches.  Spread with basil mixture and fold into thirds.  Roll in parmigiano reggiano cheese and continue until all is used up, keeping in mind that some cheese will be grated if pressed.  Place on baking tray and allow to stand 10 minutes.  Once all dough is mixed, bake in oven for 12 to 15 minutes.  Serve warm or cold.  Great warm.

Random Ingredients: sherry,beef cube steak,cauliflower floret,green chilies,vermicelli,sage leaf
title: Cauliflower-Stuffed Beef Breasts
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower florets | 1/4 lb vermicelli | 1/2 lb lean beef cube steak, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can diced green chilies | 4 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaves
instructions: Steam cauliflower, uncovered, uncovered on a rack of a steaming pan, covered, in a steaming kettle until crisp tender, 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Tantalising White Bean Dip

instructions: Place the soy milk, cumin, cloves, star anise, cannellini beans, and vodka in a saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until thickened.  Serve warm, on the side of warm bread, toasted pita, or alongside crudites for a true chunky dip.

title: Noodles with Tomatoes and Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn | 1 1/2 cups egg noodles, uncooked | 1 small tomatoes, chopped | 3/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: To make chicken broth, melt a small skillet over medium heat.  Add corn, stir until heated through and to coat.  Add pasta, stir to coat.  Add tomato, chicken broth and bouillon.  Simmer 5 minutes, or until pasta is desired flavor.

title: Spanish Tomato Salsa With Torta Chips
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes, drained and chopped ( we use hunt's brand ) | 1/2 - 1 jalapeno, minced ( optional, adjust to taste ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( any type of good quality red wine will do, but i prefer cabernet sauvignon ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped ( i like lots! ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, grated, plus more for grating | pesto sauce ( recipe i learned from googers pesto & romano cheese mix )
instructions: In a bowl combine the tomatoes, jalapeno, wine, basil, and cheese.  Stir well, cover tightly, and refrigerate several hours or overnight to allow flavors to develop.  Serve with tostito chips.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,pine nut,farmer cheese,lime juice,coffee,coffee granule,fontina cheese
title: Cuban Cheese (Maggie Beer)

instructions: Place the farmer cheese rounds on the cutting board and cut into 1/2 inch rounds.  Place the rounds on a plate.  Sprinkle with salt.  Place a heavy baking sheet on top of the cheese.  If using the coffee granules, place them in a small cup and use a small spoon to crush them up a little.  Stir together the lime juice, ground coffee powder, and ground coffee using a fork.  Stir in the lime juice mixture with the crushed cheese rounds just until mixed.  Pour onto a platter.  Top with the grated cheese.  Sprinkle with pine nuts and serve warm.

title: Easy and Healthy Green Curry Paste for Fish or Chicken (Tirk Khsiang Kew)

instructions: Combine curry paste and mustard powder in a small pan or skillet.  Cook on medium heat until fragrant.  Add curry paste mixture, cook for 10 minutes on low heat.  Serve hot in a pate.  Note, you can make your own curry paste for this or purchase it.

title: Chinese Country Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Wash rice in a strainer for 1 to 2 minutes to remove excess moisture.  Rinse rice thoroughly and drain well.  Set aside.  Heat a wok over high heat until a bead of water sizzles on the top.  Cook rice in hot water, 2 to 3 times, until it begins to brown.  Fluff rice with a fork with a fork and transfer to a plate.

title: Chipotle Short Ribs
ingredients:
1 3/4 lbs beef short ribs ( such as chuck steak, drumsticks, etc.
    - ) | 1/2 cup fresh dill | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 fresh lemon | chili powder, to taste

Random Ingredients: allspice,red onion,black olive,wheat tortilla,cottage cheese,beer,plain yogurt,grain rice
title: Quick and Easy Browned Olive and Rice Burritos
ingredients: 4 whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1/4 cup fat free cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup light beer | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1 tablespoon red onion, minced | 1/4 cup cooked browned beans or 1/4 cup red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together yogurt, cottage cheese and allspice.  Set aside.  Spread 1/4 cup beer in the bottom of a large nonstick skillet.  Spread 1 heaping tablespoons yogurt mixture in the center of each tortilla.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoons black olives on top of yogurt mixture on each tortilla.  Arrange 1/2 cup cooked beans over the beans and top with 1/2 cup rice.  Fold tortillas in half and serve.  Recipe tips, can be made a day ahead and refrigerated overnight.  Or serve immediately.  Store in covered container in refrigerator.

title: Apple Glazed Chuck
ingredients: 1 jar sliced tart apples | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 pounds lean beef chuck, cut into 6 pieces | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 1/2 pounds trimmed, thinly sliced, zested side only
instructions: In a large casserole dish, combine apples, ginger garlic paste, and 1 cup water.  Place chuck pieces in dish, and cover.  Cook in the preheated 270 degrees f oven for 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, place an oven proof skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir 3 slices of rosemary into the hot sprig, just until browned, 5 to 7 minutes.  Remove rosemary from the cooking liquid, and pour over the chuck pieces.  Return to the oven, and bake until the meat is no longer pink inside, about 1 1/2 hours.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.  Remove meat with tongs from the casserole, and place onto a paper towel lined baking sheet.  Return baking dish to oven, and cook until heated through, 1 hour and 45 minutes more.  Garnish with fresh rosemary sprigs, and serve.

title: Grilled Sandwiches with Pork and Cheese

instructions: Place cherry tomatoes in a 9x9 inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray.  In a small bowl, stir together hot water and chile powder and set aside.  Pour soaking soaking liquid evenly over tomatoes and bake at 400f for 20 to 25 minutes or until tomatoes are slightly charred and are slightly softened. title: Easy Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons splenda granular, sugar substitute or 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 teaspoons grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, 5 minutes.  Remove meat from skillet and mix thoroughly with splenda, peel, and spices.  Return to skillet, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 5 minutes.  Serve over hot cooked egg noodles.  Garnish with orange slice before eating as needed.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,clear honey,rosemary,cinnamon,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cinnamon Apple Crisp (Greece)
ingredients: 2 cans pie crusts, drained ( or 1 lb other pie crusts, crusts should have plain crust crust ) | 2 -3 teaspoons rosemary ( fresh and chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon ( fresh or 1/8 teaspoon ground ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons clear honey

Divide into two large ramekins.  Place ramekins in rows on the cookie sheet, arranging them so half of the crumb mixture is covering them completely. instructions: Process the cottage cheese, fennel seeds and italian herbs in an electric grinder until finely ground.  Stir through the chives, italian herbs, chile sauce, icing and extra extra chillies.  Cover with wetted clingfilm & let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Pour off any excess liquid.  Shape the mixture into small balls measuring approximately 4cm in diameter.  Roll in the icing sugar & set aside 10 minutes.  Barbecue the balls 6 inches from heat for 8 minutes until well browned.

title: Pizzettes
