instructions: Preheat your oven to brush your pizza crust with hummus.  Spread remaining hummus all over the pizza crust leaving about 1 1/2 inch of crust on the bottom.  Spread remaining hummus all over the hummus using a pastry brush.  Sprinkle with basil and parsley.  Bake in the oven on your lowest oven setting for 7 to 8 minutes.  The hummus has cooled and will make easier to slice from the oven after cooking.

title: Smoked Salmon Steak and Cabbage Bake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 500 g good quality smoked salmon steaks, cut into 2cm pieces | 1 small cabbage, finely shredded ( about 4 cups ) | butter, cooking spray
instructions: Preheat non stick skillet over medium high heat and add oil.  Add salmon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp and coloured.  Remove from pan and place on baking dish.  Add cabbage to pan, then put lid on pan and turn down to medium low.  Cover pan with lid and cook until cabbage starts to soften.  About 10 minutes.  Remove lid and stir in salmon.  Remove from heat.  Spray pan, if needed and then transfer to oven at 220°c or until hot and bubbling.

title: Bangers and Mash (Beets With Beef and Backs)
ingredients: 1 can sliced beet, drained | 2 lbs sirloin steaks
instructions: Cut the steaks into thin slices.  In a large bowl, mix beet juice with beef slices.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Insert skewers 1/4 of the way into the center of each piece of beef.  Wrap each piece of beef around the steak.  Brush with some oil or melted butter.  Bake @ 400 - 10 - 15 minutes, turning once.  Serve with potatoes.

title: Lime & Apple Nibble
ingredients: 250 g macaroni ( i use thin flakes ) | 250 g red potatoes ( sliced ) | 150 ml chopped dates ( dried is ok ) | 1/2 cup brandy ( or alcohol to taste ) | 1/4 cup lime juice | cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Boil the macaroni until done.  Drain well.  Mix all of the ingredients throughly together and add to warm macaroni and toss well.  Serve with grated parmesan/kosher salt.  We enjoy this with a squeeze of lime.

title: Scrumptious Italian Pasta
ingredients: 15 ounces small shell pasta | 1/2 teaspoon thawed frozen corn kernels or 2 tablespoons corn flakes, crushed | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 dash sambal oelek
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, combine reserved pasta cooking water, corn, vodka and sambal in small saucepan, heat thoroughly.  Drain and toss with reserved cooking water.

title: Ginger Beer
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated fresh ginger | 2 cans tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups ginger beer
instructions: Combine the ginger and tomato juice in a large glass jar.  Pour the beer over it.  Cover and marinate at least 1 day.  Serve.

title: Raspberries Pilau
ingredients: 50 g fresh raspberries | 1 stalk fresh curry ( or 1 teaspoon of your choice ) | 1 small courgette ( or other type green ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 220c, 400f/gas mark 2.  Place the raspberries and curry in a casserole dish and scatter over the courgette.  Toss the raspberries slightly in the tin, cover again and bake for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle over the turmeric if using and bake uncovered for a further 5 minutes or until the raspberries are very soft.  Serve immediately.  This would also be good with puffed puff bread, toast or biscuits.

title: Rice Noodle Vanilla
ingredients: 14 ounces rice noodles, regular size | 1/2 ounce yeast | 1/2 ounce real vanilla extract ( i use organic ) | 2 ounces cooked rice noodles, regular size
instructions: Place rice noodles and yeast in a large bowl, mix well add vanilla extract.  Add hot water and stir well.  Let sit in refrigerator.  Turn noodles on to floured board and knead very quickly until smooth and elastic.  Cut noodles into 2 inch sections and place in a large oiled bowl.  Cover with saran wrap, place in refridgerator for at least 2 hours.  Spread oil over the noodles, letting them sit for a few to allow oil to rise to top.  Turn noodles once more, place in a warm oven let dry in a warm area for at least 1 hour.

Add the snapper mixture and sprinkle with the romaine/romaine.  Garnish with finely chopped fresh coriander.

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add the squash, swiss chard stems, and 1 tbsp oil.  Simmer, covered until the swiss chard is bright green and limp tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.

instructions: Place the baking potatoes into a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reserve 1 cup baking water and cool to room temperature.  While the potatoes are baking, grind the walnuts in a spice grinder until finely ground. Random Ingredients: hazelnut,asafoetida powder,grain rice,chorizo sausage,szechuan peppercorn,bulgur,garlic salt,chili oil
title: Sausage Bulgur and Chorizo Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chorizo sausages, sliced | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 cup fine bulgur | 1/2 cup fresh whole hazelnuts, chopped | 4 cups hot cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Put the sausage in a skillet and cook over medium high heat until browned and crumbly.  Drain the fat and stir in the salt, peppercorns and asafoetida powder.  Set aside.  Heat the chili oil in a separate skillet until very hot.  Put in the bulgur and stir for about a minute.  When the bulgur has turned to mush, toss in the sausage and cook, stirring, for 7 minute.  Add the hazelnuts and cooked rice and mix well.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mace,red chili powder,heavy cream,beef broth,sun tomato
title: Braised Beef
ingredients: 500 g good steak, cut in medallions | 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1/4 cup beef broth | 3 teaspoons roasted sun-dried tomatoes, roughly chopped | 60 ml heavy cream
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of meat with chilli powder and set aside.  Heat a heavy based frying pan, add oil and swirl to coat.  When it is very hot, sear meat on both sides.  Set aside in paper towel and drain off the excess oil.  Add chili powder and beef broth to empty frying pan, making sure the liquid is not boiling away.  Return meat to pan.  Add sundried tomatoes and cook gently for 2 minutes, stirring.  Add cream and turn heat to low.  Cover pan and simmer gently for 1 hour, or until meat is tender and sauce has thickened slightly and flavours and veggies are cooked.  Serve with rice or pasta.  Note, this might not cover all the meat in sauce.  If it does, you can remove the lid for the last 15 minutes of simmering.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,garlic,head cauliflower,pork,sofrito sauce,sweetcorn,basil leaf
title: Cauliflower Tacos to be stuffed with pork and salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, trimmed and cut into small florets | 1/4 pound ground pork | 1 head fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup sofrito sauce | 1 tablespoon dried sweetcorn | 1 tablespoon italian-style salad dressing | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Drop in the cauliflower florets, and cook until tender, about 6 to 8 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, warm a skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir the ground pork and basil in the hot skillet until the pork is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink.  Drain off grease, and mix in the sofrito, sweetcorn, salad dressing, and garlic.  Remove from heat, and mix the cauliflower into the meat mixture.  Serve in the skillet, and spoon the mashed cauliflower onto the side.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,red bell pepper,pork loin roast,fenugreek seed,vegetable stock chicken,italian seasoning,pesto sauce
title: Langoor-Style Pork Roast With Mediterranean Seasonings
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast, trimmed of excess fat ( or 2 breasts, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes as desired ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/2 red bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 5 -6 cups vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 8 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a heavy roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Place the pork and fenugreek seeds in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle and grind to coarse powder.  Combine with the italian seasoning, peppercorns and red bell pepper.  Spread the mixture on top of the pork and fat in the pan and place over high heat.  When it begins to sizzle on the surface, stir in the stock and pesto.  Cover the pan and reduce the heat to medium.  Cook for 30 - 30 minutes until the meat has a well browned crust.  Let stand ten minutes.  Slice the meat and serve with the pesto or sauce.

title: Chinese Chilled Spicy Soy Milk
ingredients: 2 tablespoons reduced-fat soy milk, light | 2 slices thick slab bacon, finely chopped or 2 slices cooked ham, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant espresso or 1 1/2 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 jalapeno, roasted and finely chopped
instructions: Microwave soy milk on high 2 - 3 minutes, stirring until heated.  Add bacon and chili paste and microwave another 2 minutes until heated.  Pour into a small glass or ceramic bowl and stir in espresso or strong coffee.  Stir in finely chopped jalapeno just before serving, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,gruyere cheese,sunflower oil,cream mushroom soup,celery,biscuit
title: Crock Pot Swiss Steak Au Gratin
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak, cut into four strips | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 package refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup salad oil in a skillet.

title: Spicy Grilled Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3/4 cup mango chutney | 3/4 teaspoon grated lime peel | 3 tablespoons non-hydrogenated lemon-dill pickle juice
instructions: Whisk mango chutney, lime peel, and lemon juice together in a bowl until smooth.  Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and set a kitchen towel on top.  Place mango chutney in microwave safe bowl with a lid.  Cook in microwave on high power setting until hot and chutney is warm to the touch, about 30 seconds.  Stir chutney into hot chutney.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and keep away from heat until ready to serve.

title: Easy Lemon Sage Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coarse salt | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 2/3 cup yellow onion, finely chopped ( about 2 1/2 tablespoons ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Cajun Fried Clams
ingredients: 5 cans clams, scrubbed ( reserve liquid ) | 1 large cooking onion, chopped | 1 garlic clove, chopped | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, divided | 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 1 tablespoon chopped onion | 4 -5 whole garlic cloves, chopped | 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 3 lbs chicken wings, cut lengthwise in half | additional garlic cloves, for garnish
instructions: For the sauce, in a large nonstick skillet, saute onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons butter until onion is soft.  Stir in the sliced clams and saute another minute.  Add flour and 1 tablespoon butter.  Add reserved clam liquid and stir.  Cover over a low heat and cook gently for about 10 minutes.  Just before serving, add the chopped onion and garlic and stir.  To serve, sprinkle clams with extra minced garlic.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,mustard,porcini mushroom,hamburger meat,pork sparerib,coconut extract,yeast
title: Mustard Beef Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 15 ounces meaty imitation hamburger meat | 1 3/4 teaspoons mustard, mixed spice | 1 slice pork spareribs or 1 slice roast | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 60 g coriander powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut extract
instructions: For the base, mix dry ingredients and set aside.  In a pan, over low heat add ground meat, cook for 5 minutes, remove from heat and set aside.  In another pan, over low heat, add coriander and coconut extract, cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until hot.  Mix the meat powder, dried ingredients and set aside.  When mixture is cool mix with meat.  Put in a bag, freeze it until ready to use.  To bake the sandwich, take out half of the bread, fill it with meat mixture, add the other half of the bread and cover with meat mixture.  For a more flavourful sandwich, you can cut the bread diagonally, wrap the sandwich in foil and bake at 400/50°c for 20 minutes.

title: Baked Tzatziki Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 egg roll wrap | 1 tzatziki | 1 can red food coloring or ( 5 cup ) can green food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f roll out egg roll wrap as thinly as you can.  Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray or grease lightly with pam spray and lay pastry rectangle out on sheet.  Unroll sheet and spread out the tzatziki on top of pastry.  Make sure the tzatziki gets evenly covered.  Cut the rolled out egg roll wrap into six pieces, and spread out one on top of the tzatziki.  Starting at short end roll up until the pastry is covered.  Press the tzatziki flat on all sides.  Spray with pam lightly and sprinkle with food coloring to make the color dark red.  Place on cookie sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes.  Cut into 12 pieces and serve warm.  This can be frozen in one big zip lock bag.

title: Yummy Cowboy Ramen
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain rice vinegar | 1/2 cup plain soymilk | 4 pieces dried ham hocks | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 2 cubes chicken bouillon, crushed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Combine the vinegar, soy milk, ham hocks, rosemary, mint, chicken bouillon, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.  Mix until evenly combined, about 1 minute.  Spread rice mixture in the prepared oven.  Cook for 20 minutes, stirring several times, until the rice is browned.

title: Cousin Juneau's Pork Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup saffron | 1 liter skim milk | 500 g pork, boneless lean shoulder or 500 g pork steaks, cubed | 1 leek, white part only, sliced | 1 tablespoon dark molasses | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 375 -500 thin spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Combine the saffron and milk in a small deep sauce pan over low heat.  Stir until the milk has dissolved.  Add the pork and simmer, covered, for 10 - 20 minutes or until the meat is tender.  Remove some of the water if the mixture sticks to the pan.  Blend the leek and molasses in a food processor with a little water to make a smooth paste.  Heat the saffron mixture until steaming stops.  Pour a cup of the hot soup into a heatproof jug, and leave in the pan at a gentle simmer.  Stir the hot soup slowly and pour into a bowl.  Stir the remaining soup through the leek paste and serve.

title: Chilled Mushrooms With Carrots and Cumin
ingredients: 3 ounces button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 6 carrots ( about 20 cm long )
instructions: Cut 2 slices of medium carrot lengthways on a long side from the mushrooms.  Remove stalks and gills and cut caps into thirds lengthways.  Place carrot halves, cut side up, in a blender and puree.  Place mushroom caps and mushroom stalks in a dish and add the spices.  Cover and leave in the fridge for 1 hour.  Bring a pan of water to the boil and simmer gently for 2 minutes and then remove the vegetables from heat.  Rinse off the mushrooms and reserve liquid.  Place the reserved mushroom liquid in another bowl keeping the liquid aside.  Strain the liquid through a sieve, discarding the stems and halved mushrooms.  Place the vegetables and mushrooms into a serving bowl and drizzle over the reserved liquid.  Serve.

title: Fagod Bhaji  (Garbanzos With Shallots)
ingredients: 30 dried garbanzo beans ( can use garbanzo beans that have burst holes in them during the cooking & soaked in water ) | 1/4 cup minced shallot
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight.  Drain well.  Meanwhile, place an oven proof pot with enough boiling water to cover the chickpeas.  Bake the chickpeas 40 - 45 minutes, or until tender.

title: Easy Chocolate Roesti #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate, melted
instructions: In bowl mix the potatoes and melted chocolate together until well combined.  Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes.  Cut into squares.

title: Linguine With Wasabi and Coconut Rice
ingredients: 2 cups quick brown rice, uncooked | 3 cups cooked linguine | 1/4 cup diced canned coconut | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 3 teaspoons wasabi powder | 2 tablespoons light coconut, shredded and slightly toasted ( optional ) | 1 jar spaghetti, cooked and drained ( about 3 cups )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions except substitute 3/4 cup of water and heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,chipotle chile,pumpkin,plain yogurt,tomato green chilies,spicy salami
title: Grilled Smoky Gyros (Tasty and Spicy)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless country-style leg of lamb, cut into 6 long thin slices | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( rotel style ) | 1 can spicy salami, thinly sliced ( mild flavored ) | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 -2 chipotle chile, minced ( i use 1 1-2 teaspoons minced peppers ) | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt, fat-free natural low-fat yogurt dip style ( i use `` crema de pina '' brand )
instructions: Combine lamb slices, undrained tomatoes, salami and green chiles in a non reactive dish.  Stir fry over medium heat about 6 minute or until lamb is slightly brown and hot.  If the meat is not tender, continue to cook at least 10 min, until tender.  If mixture is not hot enough, cook longer, just until heated through.  Stir in chipotles and yogurt dip.  Serve gyros with pico de gallo, salsa fresca, guacamole and green vegetables.  Note, you can add any other chilies, such as cayenne, jalapeno, chipotles, chipotles in adobo sauce, or the like.  I like them on the spicy side, so adjust to taste.

title: Ginger Garlic Scapes
ingredients: 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon black sesame seeds
instructions: Heat half-and-half in a small pan over moderately low heat until hot, but not smoking.  Stir in ginger garlic paste and sesame seeds and simmer, stirring, until hot but not boiling.  Serve warm.

title: Swiss Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until well blended.  Transfer to covered container and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Minted Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted fenugreek seeds | 150 g grated small chocolate | 1 1/2 cups peeled seeded chopped courgettes | 2 bananas, sliced
instructions: Spray the inside of a deep, non stick frying pan with oil and fry the fenugreek seeds until golden.  Mix the grated chocolate with a little wanderge in a bowl and add to the fenugreek seeds, stir to combine.  Place the fried vegetables on top of the melted chocolate and pour in the mixture in a spiral in the pan.  Sprinkle grated chocolate over and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Eggplant Patties
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, peeled, cut into quarters then into eighths | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons white flour | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed ( or dried ) | 100 g spaghettini | 2 avocados, sliced
instructions: Place the eggplant in a microwave safe dish and cover with water.  Leave to soak 30 minutes or until tender, then drain and squeeze out excess water.  Place the flour, cocoa dill, spaghettini and avocado in a shallow bowl.  Preheat a frying pan using med high heat, then add the eggplant and fry, stirring to break up the slices, until just cooked through.  Cut the eggplant into quarters and then into sticks.  Serve with salsa.

title: Chinese Lentil and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chicken or 1 lb pork | 3/4 lb celery, chopped | 12 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 can beets, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Chop chicken into 1 inch cubes and brown in a pan with celery, mushrooms and lentils over medium heat, just until the chicken is no longer pink, stirring frequently.  Drain fat and stir fry vegetables until they're tender.  Add soy sauce and cook for an additional minute.  Let cool before serving.

title: Wild Rice and Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 9 -12 tortillas | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 2 cups tajine ( japanese mustard )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  While rice is cooking, toast tortillas lightly in a dry frying pan.  Transfer to cutting board and cut into strips.  Drain on paper towels.  When rice is done, drain well.  Return to rice pan and sprinkle with cardamom and mix well.  Spoon half of rice mixture onto each tortilla and top with 1/4 cup tajine.  Cut into serving sized pieces and serve immediately.

title: Bulgogi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant dashi stock | 1 lb yellow pepper, cut into 1/2-inch squares | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups milky way light soy milk | 1/3 cup finely ground hazelnuts
instructions: Spray 8 x12 or 12 square glass dish with cooking spray.  In medium saucepan, bring dashi to boiling.  Stir in 1 lb.  Peppers.  Cover and simmer for 8 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.  Combine cornstarch and milky ways in small bowl.  Add to pepper mixture, stirring until sauce boils and thickens slightly.  Pour sauce over pepper and stir.  Refrigerate 5 minutes.  Spoon pepper mixture over hot buttered dish.  Sprinkle with hazelnuts before serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,bell pepper,chicken thigh,fenugreek seed,pork loin roast,rigatoni pasta
title: Sausages and Peppers
ingredients: 450 g pork loin roast | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 3 large bell peppers | 500 g chicken thighs | 3 large chicken thighs | 1 vanilla essence
instructions: Remove skin from chicken thighs and cut into 2 3cm pieces.  Mix fenugreek and fenugreek seeds together to make spice packet, add to chicken and chicken and rub in well.  Wash peppers and cut into 2cm chunks.  Place chicken in a wide shallow roasting tin, add bell pepper chunks and fry for 15 mins until they soften, turning frequently.  Set aside place the chicken skin side down on top of each other and add about 500ml water to the roasting tin to just cover the chicken pieces.  Cover with foil and cook in a hot oven for 30 mins until the meat pulls away from the bones.  Remove roasting tin from oven and place the chicken in a medium saucepan of simmering water for 20 mins until tender.  Transfer chicken and vegetables to a separate pot of simmering stock, bring to the boil then set aside to cool.  Skim fat from stock and use a large spoon to skim off any scum which rises to the surface.  Use a fine sieve to skim off any fat which rises to the surface.  Heat oven to 200°c remove roasting tin from oven and place the chicken pieces on top of the vegetables.  Roast for about 25 mins until crisp and brown.  Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken and vegetables from oven and serve with stock and spices.

title: Japanese Breakfast in Avocado Shells
ingredients: 1 avocado, peeled and cubed | 1/4 pound firm tofu, drained
instructions: Cut ends off of avocado and scoop out the seed, leaving about 1/2 inches attached around the perimeter of the avocado shell.  Place avocado into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let stand at room temperature until cold and firm, about 2 hours.  Mash avocado and transfer to a serving dish.  Heat a skillet over medium heat and add tofu.

title: Chipotle Ranch Okra
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen okra | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded
instructions: Thaw and cut okra into quarters.  Combine okra, raspberries, mustard, and chipotles in a microwave safe dish.  Cover dish with plastic wrap and microwave on high power until hot, 6 to 9 minutes.  Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pesto-Smoked Beef or Turkey
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck or 2 lbs top round steaks, sliced very thinly | 2 packages scotch bonnet peppers | 1 cup basil pesto or 1 cup other flavored pesto | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Combine pepper and salt, if using it.  Arrange meat on foil, then spoon hot pesto over slices, making sure the meat is well covered.  Let sit for about an hour at room temp.  Grill, broil or bbq meat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,sun tomato oil,lemon wedge,wild mushroom,cumin seed,sage leaf
title: Wild Mushroom Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 2 medium wild mushrooms ( such as oyster or button or cremini ) | 1/2 cup roasted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped ( about 2 or 3 ounces ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 teaspoon chopped seeded jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin ( to taste, see note ) | lemon wedge, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Using a brush, coat mushrooms with oil and sprinkle with the chopped sun dried tomatoes.  Sprinkle with the sage, jalepeno, and cumin.  Cover and let stand in a warm, draft free area for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until mushrooms are completely softened.  Remove stems and coarsely chopped stems from mushrooms and chop into about 10 1/2 to 12 ounce chunks.  Spoon half of the mushroom filling into each mushroom cavity and sprinkle reserved mushroom pieces into a bowl.  Using a knife, stuff the rounded ends and ends of each mushroom with some of the reserved mushroom filling.  If desired, secure stems along their length with toothpicks.  Serve in a bowl with a wedge of lemon on the side.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,pork shoulder,lime,silken tofu,salt,celery seed,beef broth,napa cabbage
title: Jamaican Stove Top Po' Boy
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into thirds | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 cup uncooked napa cabbage, shredded | 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 log frozen puff pastry dough, thawed ( half a 17 ounce package ) | 1 package silken tofu, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Pound the pork with a meat mallet until it can be picked from the center.  Stir the salt and celery seeds together in a small bowl.  Mix the cabbage, beef broth and pork together in a bowl and spread the mixture on the pork and cabbage mixture, then roll the roast up tightly.  Secure with a toothpick to hold the toothpick in place, if necessary.  Place the wrapped roast on a foil or parchment lined baking sheet.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Freeze the rolls overnight or at least 3 hours, or up to 2 days.  Transfer the pork rolls to a platter and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Unwrap the frozen puff pastry from the package and place in a pie dish, then cover with foil.  Bake for 20 more minutes, until the pastry is puffed and golden, and the pork is cooked through.  Turn the oven off, but leave the pie in the warmed oven for another hour to dry out the moisture and make the filling for the potoes.  Meanwhile, remove the toothpicks from the tofu cubes and press between the palms of your hands into rectangles about 10x16 inches.  If you’re using a microwave or other oven, remove the foil only, about half an inch wide.  Place the tofu in a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add enough water to cover the cubes and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer for five minutes until the cubes are softened.  Drain the water and mash with a potato masher until smooth.  Scoop this mixture into a bowl and set aside.  Pour the vegetable mixture into a separate pot, add the tofu, and heat over medium heat.  When hot, stir in the pork, cabbage, broth mixture and the tofu mixture.  Return to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally so the mixture doesn’t stick, for about 20 minutes.  Stir in the fried tofu cubes and heat through.  The water will make a fine sieve coating the potatoes for a gravy.  Slice the pork lengthwise into 1/4 wide strips.  Stir the pork strips into the pot.

title: Simple Mexican Soup - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef chuck | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 package firm tofu, thinly sliced | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat a dutch oven over medium high heat.  Add ground beef.  Cook and stir until meat is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink.  Drain grease.  Stir in corn.

title: Thai Cashew Paste With Raw Sprinh, Cashews, and Lime (Chew Nut Dip)
ingredients: 1/3 cup roasted cashews | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Place whole raw cashews in a dry skillet over low heat, shaking the pan to loosen nuts, shaking the pan to turn them evenly.  When they turn to liquid in short strips, remove from heat.  Squeeze handfuls of the cashews at their coarse skins into a blender.  Add cashews to blender, and blend on high until all nuts are pulverized.  Add lime juice, stir well to combine.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Lobster Dip (Gourmet Friendly)
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, grated | 1 can chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 lobster tail | 2 cups ice
instructions: Finely chop onion.  Drain water from chiles.  Heat chipotle chilies in blender until liquid is gone.  Mix in onion, chipoltes cumin and 1 cup water, blending with mixer until smooth.  Add remaining 1 cup water and mix well.  Cut lobster tail into 6 equal portions.  Use a knife to slice through crab meat in the shell, removing flesh and cartilage.  Add to onion dip and mix.  Spoon into 2 serving dishes and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of water.  Serve with corn chips or french bread.

Random Ingredients: molasses,dill pickle,biscuit,fennel bulb,chili sauce,dark sesame oil,fontina cheese,beef steak
title: Gourmet Beef Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1/3 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 1/2 lbs beef top round steaks, 1 '' thick ( or other tender-cut beef ) | 8 biscuits, split ( or homemade biscuits ) | 8 slices fontina cheese ( or gruyere, swiss, or other swiss cheese ) | 1 fennel bulb | 1/4 cup fennel pickle, sliced and divided
instructions: Mix chili sauce, molasses, sesame oil and 2 lbs of beef steak.  Place in 9x13 inch greased pan.  Cut a slit through both sides of each piece of beef for heat distribution.  Place 1/2 cup of beef on each biscuit.  Top with 1/2 of cheese.  Fold into quarters.  Spoon on sauce evenly.  Sprinkle with sliced fennel and pickles.  Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until beef is cooked through.

title: Polish Sauerkraut and Mutton in Sauce
ingredients: 500 g sauerkraut | 750 g raw mutton
instructions: Wash sauerkraut and remove all traces of the sand/oils.  Place in a large vessel and cover with cold water.  Cover, bring to the boil and boil for about 75 minutes.  Drain water and skim the foam.  Slice mutton and stir to get rid of excess fat.  Add meat to sauerkraut and return to pot.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Kitchen Kouture Tomatillo Chicken
ingredients: 14 tomatillos, husked and washed, with pith and silk removed, rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest, grated | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf.  In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cook tomatillos, covered, for 10 minutes.  Drain.  Cut off the top of tomatillos and remove the stems.  Place tomatillos, cut side down, in a glass dish and stir together lemon peel, bouillon, and buttermilk.  Brush tomatillo mixture with some of bran mixture.  Place dish on baking sheet that has been sprayed with pam.  Drizzle tomatillo mixture with more bran mixture.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,red cabbage,sage leaf,pearl barley,creme fraiche,cake flour,parsnip
title: Barley & Parsnip Scones
ingredients: 350 g pearl barley, washed ( or other pearl barley ) | 50 g baby arugula leaves | 2 parsnips, cut into 2cm pieces | 2 small red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 - 3/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 -2 sage leaf | 8 -12 fresh sage leaves | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley leaves ( or other fresh herb )
instructions: Place barley in a saucepan with water to cover.  Bring to the boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for about 45 minute.  Add water as needed during the cooking process.  Remove from heat.  When the barley is just tender, drain water, and transfer to a large bowl.  Combine baby arugula leaves, parsnips, cabbage, creme fraiche, sage and sage in a food processor, and process until fairly smooth.  Add parsley and process until finely chopped and well combined.  Stir in the barley and any herbs before serving.  Note, if you have problems getting the barley to a good consistency, you can make a quick, but nessecary, solution by boiling a small amount of water in a small pot for 7 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a large, non stick, oven proof dish or pan.  Fill with barley and sprinkle with fresh sage.  Bake in a 425 deg f oven for 20 - 30 minutes or until well browned.

title: Tarragon and Walnut Crackers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed
instructions: Dip the walnuts into the tarragon and then press lightly.  Store in an airtight container with a twist of lemon in it.

Random Ingredients: kiwi,red pepper flake,chicken,sunflower oil,yukon gold potato,lemon juice,cajun seasoning,lemon grass
title: Tropical Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken pieces | 3 large yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons lemon grass, finely chopped or 2 teaspoons dried lemon grass | 10 kiwi, peeled, sliced | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces skin side up on tray lined with foil or waxed paper.  Add potatoes, oil, lemon grass, kiwi, red pepper flakes and cajun seasoning to cavity of chicken pieces.  Brush with lemon juice as required.  Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 2 hours, basting with marinade every 15 minutes when chicken is cooked.

title: Horseradish Pasta
ingredients: 400 g farfalle pasta ( bowled will work ) | 12 red onions | 1 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 cup horseradish, grated | radish, to garnish
instructions: Drain the pasta then lightly brown the onions in oil.  Add in the flour, chilli powder, chilli.  Place the pasta in a large casserole, add the horseradish and sprinkle with the grated cheese.  Cover and cook in the oven on a low heat for about an hour until the pasta is done.

title: Crockpot Spanish Rice
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces arborio rice | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled
instructions: Place water in a bowl and add rice.  Cover with saran wrap and leave to soak.  After soaking, press rice dry with your hands.  Place in crockpot and do two more times.  Serve with sliced onion, celery and a light drizzle of maple syrup or other spice and sugar free marinade.

title: Apricot Hot Water
ingredients: 3 cups apricot preserves | 1 1/2 cups hot water
instructions: Using a spoon, scoop out the pulp from the apricot preserves and pour into a pitcher or bowl.  Add the hot water and stir to mix.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to develop the flavor.

title: Sliced Beefsteak Tomatoes and Jasmine Rice

instructions: In non stick frying pan layer tomatoes on bottom of pan, then top with cheese, pour rice on top, bake in oven at 400° for 15 minutes.

title: Walnut Pita Chips

instructions: Preheat oven to 400.  In a small frying pan toast walnuts over medium heat for five minutes, stirring constantly.  Transfer nuts to a bowl of cold water to cool. Spread rice evenly in baking dish.  Pour in egg mixture.  Add the wine if desired.  Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes to brown rice.  Serve hot.

title: Madeira Wine Jelly Spinach

instructions: Get a large saucepan and put it on to the stove top over medium heat as it will bubble some at the top, which should be way too high for my stovetop, so i will probably take it off the burner before continuing with this part. title: Quick and Easy Poached Fish Brussel sprouts
