title: Chorizo & Chorizo Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 4 -6 center-cut pork chops | mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning ( i use mccormick ) | 12 -16 ounces chorizo sausage, cut in 1/2 | 1 anaheim chilies, halved, or 1 serrano chilies, halved, or jalapeno seeded, minced | 16 ounces romaine lettuce leaves, torn | 1 jar raspberries or 16 ounces strawberry | 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Heat corn oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Season both sides of pork chops with montreal french grilling seasoning, about 3 min per side.  Place pork chops in skillet with one half of chorizo.  Cook, turning with tongs, till cooked through, 7 to 10 minute.  Transfer pork chops to a platter and cover with foil, reserving chorizo drippings.  Add remaining chorizo drippings to skillet and brown chorizo over medium heat, turning once, about 11 minute.  Remove from skillet and add anaheim chilies.  Cover and cook over low heat until tender, about 5 minute stir in romaine, and cook 2 more minues.  Add raspberries and sugar.

title: Mushroom Alfredo with Cream of Tartar and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 jar roasted cherry tomatoes, drained | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, mix together mushrooms, roasted cherry tomatoes, alfredo sauce, and cream of tartar.  Refrigerate for 20 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,cold water,sea salt,red wine,deli ham
title: Danish Christmas Ham Roast
ingredients: 3/4 cup coarse sea salt | 1/2 cup warm water | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine | 2 lbs deli ham, rind removed
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine salt, water, and almond extract.

title: Duck Dip with Pecans
ingredients: 1 package au jus mix | 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans, or as needed
instructions: Dump the au jus mix into a slow cooker.  Stir to mix, and place lid on slow cooker.  Cook on high for 1 1/2 hours.  Stir pecans into hot dip, and continue cooking for 2 to 3 minutes.  Serve hot over baked potatoes.

Random Ingredients: black bean soup,tomato soup,jalapeno,macaroni,cider vinegar,chicken bouillon
title: Spanish Macaroni and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked macaroni | 1 can condensed dry black bean soup | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 tablespoon canned jalapeno, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Place the macaroni, soup, jalapeno, and chicken bouillon in a saucepan over medium heat.  Bring the soup to a simmer, and cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Place the cooked macaroni into a serving bowl, and serve hot with a sprinkling of vinegar if desired.

title: Homemade Nests
ingredients: 1 teaspoon marshmallow cream | 1 package miniature mushrooms
instructions: Heat marshmallow cream until melted.  Add miniature mushrooms.  Drop a tbsp on cookie sheet.  Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Cornmeal and Chives Salad
ingredients: 2 cups flour, all-purpose | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 1/4 cups cooked vegetable juice | 4 -6 leaves fresh chives, cut into 5 cm lengths | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Sift the flour onto a well floured board and level the top.  Make a well in the centre.  Put the sugar, juice, chives and egg in a jug and stir with a wooden spoon until well incorporated.  Knead for about 10 minutes, or until smooth and satiny.  Add the seasoned flour to the creamed mixture and knead again to form a smooth dough.  Chill in the fridge until dough doubles its size.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,scallion,artificial sweetener,chipotle powder,salt black pepper,gruyere,coffee liqueur,wheat flour noodle
title: Hot Diggedin' Chipsotle Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 1/4 cup natural brewed coffee liqueur | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate, chunks | 1/8 cup white chocolate, chunks packed in oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper, to taste | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour noodles, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons artificial sweetener | 1/3 cup gruyere, grated
instructions: Put your blender on your highest speed, along with your coffee liqueur and chocolate in the blender.  Blend until smooth.  Add remaining ingredients and blend until well blended.  Transfer to a glass bowl, cover tightly, and refrigerate overnight, stirring every 60 - 90 minutes to prevent drying out.  To serve, line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place noodles on a baking sheet covered with foil.  Bake at 400 degrees f.  For 25 minutes or until hot and slightly firm.  Remove from the oven, stir in cheese, and eat immediately.

title: Choplets With Dried Fruit and Dates
ingredients: 4 -6 thin pork chops | 2 scallops | 12 dates
instructions: If using a pork chop, chop the meat to 1/4 inch thickness.  Remove any extraneous fat and bones from the sauerkraut and discard.  Place the sauerkraut and fresh dates in a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium high heat.  Turn the heat down to low and simmer, uncovered, for about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauerkraut and dates have begun to soften slightly and the meat is tender.  You may need to reduce the cooking time if you see signs of burning at the bottom.  Remove from heat and cool.  Freeze the meat and dates for up to a month.  When ready to use, thaw the sauerkraut dates and scallops if frozen.  Thaw the cooked pork chops if frozen and chop to the size of the dates.  Return the sauerkraut and dates to the saucepan.  Heat over medium high to boiling and bring to simmering.  Add the cut pork chops.  Heat through, then turn off the heat and cover.  Let stand 5 - 10 minutes then serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,potato flour,white sugar,water,balsamic vinegar,duck,black olive,green chilies
title: Chili and Roasted Duck
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried salted duck fat, softened | 1 tablespoon potato flour, or as needed | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | water, to cover | 1 green chilies, chopped ( optional ) | 1 can black olives, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a shallow baking dish or roasting pan, mix the duck fat, potato flour, sugar, balsamic vinegar, and vegetable stock.  Add water to cover.  Place on top of duck fat.  Bake in the preheated oven until duck is tender and beginning to brown, about 1 1/2 hours.  Place the roasted duck on a serving dish and scatter sliced green chilies around the duck.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,nutmeg,marinara sauce,pappadams,half,pork loin roast,avocado,farfalle pasta
title: Papadam Pork Wontons
ingredients: 1 tablespoon papadam | 1 pork loin roast, trimmed | 2 cans marinara sauce, divided | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 cups half-and-half | 12 large avocados, peeled and pitted | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread a scant 1 tablespoon of sauce in the bottom of a baking dish.  Place about 2 tablespoons of meat in a horizontal line in the dish.  Top with approximately 3 tablespoons of the marinara sauce and 2 tablespoons of wonton wrappers.  Moisten the edges of each wrapper by dipping your finger in a little water, and pinch the corners together.  Arrange the wontons in a spiral on the top of the sauce.  Repeat with the remaining filling, and top with remaining sauce.  Season with nutmeg.  Top each wonton with a spoonful of mashed avocado, and pinch the edges closed.  Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, until the sauce is bubbling.

title: Lavender and Graham Crumb Balls
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup dried lavender
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  In a large bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs and chopped lavender together with your fingers until well blended.  Make balls with the crumb mixture and press evenly into the prepared pan.  Allow to cool until warm enough to touch.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly golden brown.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 10 cremini mushrooms | 10 romaine lettuce | 2 celery ribs
instructions: Wash and pat dry the mushrooms, trimming the stem, cut each one in half, and slice into six long slivers.  Trim any tough ends, then cut each quarter in half lengthwise.  Pull strings from the lettuce and cut each slice into six thin strips.  Put them in a bowl of water and shake gently to wash off any sand that appears.  Fill a large non stick frying pan with about 1/3 cup water, lay out a sheet of waxed paper, and begin layering the lettuce and mushrooms in a horizontal row on the paper.  Roll up the lettuce like a cigar, and place in the pan.  Tuck the ends under and over the roll so that there are no stray pieces of lettuce.  Repeat with the rest of the lettuce.  When the water start to boil, put in the tortillas and boil for about 45 seconds to 1 - 2 minutes, turning them over once, or until the tortillas are a nice light golden color.  Serve with sour cream, guacamole, or other dip.

Random Ingredients: white onion,hoisin sauce,banana,ranch dressing,fennel seed,hard egg
title: Pavlova's Ranch Eggs
ingredients: 1 large banana | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Slice banana lengthwise and place in bowl.  Add a few tablespoons of hoisin.  Add fennel seed and chopped onion and toss to combine.  Add chopped eggs and toss to combine.  Serve egg mixture over tortilla chips or fried potatoes.

title: Easy Poppy Seed Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 12 chicken tenderloins | 1 cup prepared poppy seed | 1 cup dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Pierce each tenderloin in several places with a fork, making certain there are a few openings.  Cover with a square of aluminum foil.  Place on a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Place the poppy seeds in a small bowl, and pour enough hot water into the bowl to cover, until the seeds are about 1/2 inch submerged.  Stir in dried fruit to make a paste.  Place the chicken on a serving platter, and spoon poppy seed sauce over, coating all of the meat of the chicken.

title: Foolproof Nuts from Scratch
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, roasted and salted | white pepper
instructions: Grind the nuts coarsely or coarsely until fine.  Transfer to a blender and blend to a pulp.  Sprinkle with white pepper and refrigerate to allow the nuts to set.

Random Ingredients: pita pocket bread,cocoa,beef liver,phyllo pastry,egg substitute,herb,cavatappi pasta,blueberry
title: Alfricuchos Con Cioccolato (Phyllo Wrapped Beef Liver Patties #Alfricuchos Y Mi)
ingredients: 1 cup low-sodium beef liver | 2 cups egg substitute | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried herb ( such as basil, parsley, dill or rosemary ) | 3/4 cup low-fat ciabatta or 3/4 cup berry bread, torn into small equal pieces | 1/4 cup buffalo cavatappi pasta ( sub mackerel for beef liver or tuna or other protein ) | 2 pita pockets, sliced diagonally
instructions: Cook liver in boiling water approximately 5 minutes or until meat is brown and juices evaporate.  Drain and transfer to bowl.  Strain meat juices, cool for 10 minutes.  Chop or mince and combine with remaining ingredients.

title: Hazelnut Crostini
ingredients: 3 cups whole hazelnuts | 6 slices whole wheat bread | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Spread hazelnuts on foil lined baking sheets and toast for about 10 minutes.  Let cool completely.  Split the vanilla bean with a sharp knife and scrape out the seeds.  Slice the flesh into long pieces and rub the inside of the loaf with the vanilla bean and the hazelnuts.  Cut some of the slices into 1 inch sections and wrap the pieces in bread to serve.  Warm in the oven for about 1 hour before serving to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,lamb,cranberry juice,tomato juice,tart apple,taco seasoning
title: Low Fat, Low Carb Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons dried cranberry juice | 1 medium tart apple, peeled and finely chopped | 1 cup low-sodium tomato juice | 1/2 purple onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place the ground lamb in nonstick skillet.  Cook over medium high heat for 5 - 7 minutes, or until browned and crumbly.  Drain off most of the fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the skillet.  Add the taco seasoning and cranberry juice.  Stir fry 1 minute while breaking the lamb up into large chunks.  Add apples, tomato juice and onions.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve with your choice of salsa.

title: Creamy Yoghurt Dip for Fish Etail
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt, plain ( not low fat ) | 6 ounces yoghurt, unsulfured, unsweetened | dashes baking powder | salt & pepper
instructions: First, make sure yoghurt doesn’t get too thick.  Stir in the baking soda.  Mix well.  Then, taste for salt& pepper.  Put into trays, and refrigerate.  Serve with fish once it's cold.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon bark,tomato puree,red pepper,italian sausage,half,hot red pepper flake,pasta noodle,aubergine
title: Aubergine Noodle Stovie
ingredients: 1 large aubergine, cut into chunks | 3 italian sausage, cut in 1/2-inch slices, casings removed | 1 large red pepper, sliced | 1 quart tomato puree | 3/4 cup hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1 tablespoon cinnamon bark | hot cooked pasta noodles | italian cinnamon bark, for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a medium baking dish.  Place dumplings in a single layer in the prepared baking dish.  Combine the sausage, red pepper, tomato puree, pepper flakes, and half and half in a large saucepan.  Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally.  Pour over the dumplings in the baking dish.  Cover tightly with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle cinnamon on top.  Cut into dumplings and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: black olive,cooking sherry,filet beef,caraway seed,chocolate chip,skirt steak,romano cheese,red wine
title: Melt in Your Mouth Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs filet of beef | 3/4 cup quick-cooking sherry | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 12 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1/2 cup quick-cooking sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 225f degrees.  In large shallow roasting pan, place beef and coat with 1/2 c sherry and 1/4 tsp caraway seeds.  Insert meat thermometer in centre of beef.  Cover and roast about 1 hour or until tender when pierced with a skewer.  Transfer meat to medium plate. .  Skim fat from roast.  Combine remaining 1/2 c sherry, remaining 1/4 tsp caraway seeds, cheese, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Brush both sides of each slice with this basting mixture.  To serve, slice meat thinly crosswise, across the grain.  Place on platter and drizzle with 1/4 oil mixture.  Serve with pan wine mixture.

title: Raspberry and Roasted Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries | 1/3 cup alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red chili peppers | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Blend in blender chilie sauce base, berries and ginger.  Serve warm.

title: Mama Dalla's Chipotle Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile | 1 can sweet papayas, roughly chopped | 1 egg noodles | 1 cup golden raisin | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, remove seeds from chili pepper pods.  Remove and discard the paprika pods, and dice into 1 inch pieces.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.  Add egg noodles, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Low Fat, Gluten Free Breaky Bread
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 cloves | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1 pinch ground clove | 2 cups raw rice, soaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 180° celsius line a baking tray with baking paper.  Put all the ingredients into a large bowl.  Mix everything around to combine, and put into preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until the topping is nicely golden brown and crisp.  Use a skewer to check to be sure it's cooked thoroughly.  Serve with lots of butter.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,key lime juice,dark rum,white sesame seed,mint sprig,heavy whipping cream,extra virgin olive oil
title: White Mojito Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint sprigs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh key lime juice | 2 green serrano chile peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup dark rum, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sesame seeds, or to taste | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Stir lime juice, olive oil, mint sprigs, key lime juice, serrano chile peppers, rum, sesame seeds, and cream together in a pitcher until chilled.  Serve.

title: Indian Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 - 3/4 buns
instructions: Spray an iron skillet with pam, and heat over medium in a deep fryer to 300 degrees f.  In about a teaspoon or so of oil, brown and stir the beef until well browned.  Add the caraway, garam masala, and a pinch of salt and pepper.  Add the nutmeg.  Cook until the meat is well browned and the spices are aromatic.  Do not stir when this step is done.  Do not let the meat brown before stirring.  Set aside at room temperature for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the bun on a baking sheet, lightly toasted about 7 - 8 minutes.  Turn over and toast to desired toastyness.

title: Green Curry Paste for Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together curry paste and coriander.  Pour into a large, resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,horseradish,orange zest,meal flour,half cream,black caviar
title: Gravlax With Caviar Sauce
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, sliced | 2 ounces fresh horseradish, sliced | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 5 1/2 ounces half-and-half cream | 1 cup flour | 1/4 cup stone ground fine grain irish meal flour, plus a little extra for dusting
instructions: Put the celery and horseradish in a nonstick wok, add the orange zest and cook over a high heat, tossing, for 2 - 3 minutes until the horseradish starts to melt.  Tip in the half and half, increase the heat, and bring to a simmer, stirring.  Mix the flour and arisago together and add it to the simmering liquid, stirring to coat.  Simmer until the thickened.  Remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature before whisking in the well blended flour.  Toss a few times to blend and transfer the filling to a bowl.  To serve, mound the mixture on toasted bread rounds and serve with caviar.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,lemonade,radish,part ricotta cheese,hershey cocoa,tabasco sauce
title: Lemon-Schnapps Lasagna
ingredients: 1 cup part skim fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup honey-roasted hershey's natural cocoa | 1 teaspoon lemonade | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 6 flour tortillas ( optional ) | 8 radishes ( optional )
instructions: Combine the first four ingredients and pour over the tortillas.  Add the radishes if using.  Bake in a 350 degree oven 30 - 45 minutes, or until bubbly or hot.  Serve warm.

title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, soaked overnight | 3 rosemary sprigs | 1 teaspoon whole cloves powder
instructions: Cook chickpeas slowly over medium heat, adding rosemary and cloves until tender.  Puree with immersion blender until smooth.  Transfer to glass or ceramic bowl, and cover with plastic wrap.  Chill, at least 4 hours.  If desired, chill several hours before serving with pita triangles.

Random Ingredients: herb stuffing mix,seasoning mix,sun tomato,bean,allspice,yellow lentil,beef brisket,lemon peel
title: Allspice Roast Beef in a Tomato-Lentil Pilaf
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket ( or stewing beef ) | 3 cups yellow lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 cans bean slices, undrained | 1 cup herb and spice stuffing mix | 1 -2 lemon peel, finely minced ( optional but recommended ) ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons allspice | 1 bag sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from meat if desired and sprinkle lightly with coarse salt.

title: Nutty Nut Tofu
ingredients: 500 g wheat-free cashews ( shelled weight ) | 100 g ground hazelnuts | 100 g chopped pistachios | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 cup sweet pimiento, drained | 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning, paste ( or to taste ) | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the tumeric powder in 1/2 cup water.  Drain nuts, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid.  Place cashews and hazelnuts, 1 tablespoon of the pine nuts, 1 tablespoon of the chopped parsley, and the tumeric into food processor and pulse until nuts are finely ground.  Add remaining spices and 1/4 cup reserved cashews/nut liquid and process until smooth.  Add remaining cashews/nut liquid, egg yolk, and remaining 1/2 cup pine nuts and process again until dough forms into a ball.  Chill for 1 hour.  Shape dough into 1 1/2 inch size balls and coat with the reserved cashew/nut mixture and refrigerate for 15 minutes to firm.  Heat a non stick skillet over high heat.  Sprinkle the tops with cashews/powdered cashews.  Add 1 tablespoon of meringue, press with a fork, and cook for 3 minutes until meringue melts and tansiness of meringue is released, taking care not to burn.  Flip a few times.  Sprinkle with remaining ground nuts and serve.

title: Finger-Laps - Swedish Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 12 ounces hard-boiled eggs or 12 ounces sardines | 2 ounces sultanas
instructions: Peel the eggs and cut them in half and put them in an ovenproof dish lined with water.  Cover them with a tight fitting lid and bake them at 400 for 20 - 30 minutes until they are firm and have shrunk quite a lot.  Test with a knife towards the center of the dish.  Some might say that they are done, but i always leave the lid slightly ajar because the eggs are tough, but the eggs can still be cooked.  If they stick to the bottom of the casserole the dish is done.  Some might say to remove the lid for the last few moments before turning up the heat.

title: Lemony Russian Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cups snow peas, unpeeled | 1 package dry lentils | 1 cup gin | 2 tablespoons vodka | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon gin
instructions: In a large pot, add lettuce and cook for about 5 minutes or until it wilts.  Add snow peas, lentils and the 2 pints of gin.  Cover and cook for 5 more minutes.  Place lettuce on plates and top with the other portion of the salad ingredients so they are piled evenly.  Pour the brandy over the salad.  Serve on a cocktail stick if desired.

title: Capelles En Vins Daube (Beer-Fried Fresh Basil Cucumber)
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1/2 cup cayenne | 2 tablespoons oil | 3/4 cup fresh basil leaves | 12 ounces beer
instructions: In bowl, whisk together vinegar, cream, and cayenne.  In skillet, heat oil over high heat until it begins to smoke.  Add vinegar cayenne cream mixture.  Cook, stirring constantly, until hot and thickened, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain basil in a colander and rinse well.  Return the drained basil to the skillet and toss to coat in the sauce.  Cook until heated through and slightly crisp, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add basil and beer.  Heat to boiling, cover the skillet, and reduce over high heat until bubbles form around the edge, 2 to 5 minutes.  The sauce will lose some of its green color, so be careful if it begins to darken too much.  Cover and refrigerate until needed.

title: Spicy Mexican Arborio Rice
ingredients: 5 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 cups chopped mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Wash the rice in several changes of water until the water is clear.

Random Ingredients: potato chip,chicken breast half,cardamom pod,green pea,cocoa powder
title: Baked Chicken with Nuts
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, divided | 1 1/2 cups dry potato chips | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pods | 1 cup fresh green peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Sprinkle the chicken pieces with half of the cocoa powder, and cover with foil.  Bake, uncovered, until chicken pieces are no longer pink inside, about 35 minutes.  Remove chicken to a large dish.  Combine the potato chips with the powdered cardamom and remaining 1/2 cup cocoa powder in a bowl, then stir into the chicken broth.  Bring to a boil in a small saucepan.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer about 20 minutes.  Stir in the green peas, and remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.  Serve chicken with the reserved potato chip cocoa sauce.

title: Artichoke Hummus
ingredients: 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and squeezed clean of water | 1 cup water-packed peanut oil
instructions: Place artichoke hearts in a blender or food processor with as many water out of the can as possible.  In a large mixing bowl, combine the artichoke hearts, 1 cup of water, and peanut oil.  Slowly pour in remaining water, mixing as you go.  Cover and chill hummus at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Place uncooked rice in a dish large enough to fit both loaves in an ovenproof dish.  Place tenderloins on top of rice.  Top with pepper to taste.  Bake at 400 f for 20 - 25 minutes.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green apple,feta cheese,turmeric powder,stew meat,turnip,cannellini bean,tamarind paste
title: Harira (Feta Cheese Soup)
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut into 1 ( or use 2 lbs chicken breasts ) | 1 -2 green apple, peeled, cored, and cut up | 1 green apple, peeled and cut up | 3 turnips, peeled and cut into small chunks ( optional ) | 3 cans cannellini beans, undrained ( preferably white beans ) | 100 mija crumbled feta cheese ( greek feta cheese tastes best ) | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( or 2 tbsp tamarind paste or 2 tbsp minced fresh lemon juice )
instructions: Put meat in crock pot.  Add apple.  Add the turnips and green apple pieces if you're using them.  Cook on low for about 3 hours or on high for about 2 hours.  Add the beans. .  If using tamarind paste, add it slowly to soup while stirring so it doesn't stick.  It can be done in the end.  Serve with yogurt or a dollop of yogurt on the side for dipping.

title: Adas Polow
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils, washed and drained | 2 -3 cups white flour ( approx )
instructions: Put flour in a bowl and, using your hands, mix thoroughly using your hands.  Add lentils gradually and mix well.  Cover the bowl and leave for at least an hour.  Bring a pot of water to boil and when it reaches a boil, add salt as required to taste.  Add lentils to this water just before serving.

title: Homemade Irish Cream
ingredients: 4 ounces of cream or 4 ounces sour cream | 1 pinch double cream | of powdered egg | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Whip the cream or sour cream until it's stiff.  Fold your double cream into the whipped cream.  Gently fold in your pinch of salt and the powdered egg.  Use immediately, store in the fridge.

title: Easy and Delicious Faux Frozen Frozen Frozen Whirls
ingredients: 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Combine thawed whipped topping with grand marnier in a small bowl, stirring until well blended.

title: Maple Swiss Cheese Spread Waffles
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard
instructions: Place cheese, maple syrup, and mustard in a bowl.  Add 1/4 cup water.

title: Roasted and Spiced Turkey Breast With Mushrooms and Ranch Dressing Mix
ingredients:
4 skinless chicken breasts | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix, prepared according to pkg.
    - directions, with no salt added | 12 cremini mushrooms, halved if small
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place chicken breasts on rack in shallow casserole dish.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes for rare, or until internal temperature is 165°.  Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.  Meanwhile, prepare dressing according to package directions.  Reserve one cup for garnish.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Remove skin from mushrooms and cut in half.  Place half of the chopped mushrooms in a bowl with ranch dressing mix.  Cut remaining mushrooms into small cubes.  Slice remaining breast thinly.  Place 1/4 of the sliced chicken breasts with the drippings in bowl over mushroom and toss and coat with dressing mix.  Transfer chicken strips to baking sheet and bake 5 minutes.  Top with mushrooms and return chicken to the oven and bake 5 more minutes or until chicken juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: topping,black pepper,chili sauce,cilantro leaf,thai chili sauce,dark sesame oil,vegetable stock,cream
title: Thai Chili Sauce Dip - Vegan Version
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai chili sauce | 7 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper | 2 cups light sour cream | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons finely chopped cilantro leaves | 2 cups prepared topping, such as cool whip, thawed ( optional )
instructions: For a smooth dip with a tangy dip with a kick, in a small mixing bowl combine the sauce ingredients.  Set aside.  In a blender container combine the sour cream, chile sauce, and cilantro.  Cover and blend on medium high speed until the sour cream starts to form a liquid, about 5 minutes.  Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the blender container.  Blend for 1 minute more.  Pour into a medium size bowl, stir in the thai green chili dipping sauce and spread onto a serving platter.  Top the dip with the thai sweet chili dipping sauce.  Use immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Creamy Chile Con Chile (Hot Con Chile)
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground dry mustard, or to taste
instructions: Combine the whipping cream, diced tomatoes with green chilies, and dry mustard in a heavy skillet over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer gently until the cream is thickened, about 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweetened soy sauce | 20 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  Whisk soy sauce and cherry tomatoes together in a saucepan.  Cook over medium high heat until the cherry tomatoes are heated through, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,sambal oelek,anaheim chilies,green peppercorn,allspice,lamb loin chop,tomato paste
title: Spicy Lamb Chops
ingredients: 2/3 cup thawed tomato paste | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon crushed green peppercorns | 1 1/4 lbs rump roast | 16 anaheim chilies ( green or red, or a combination ) | 10 thin cut bone-in lamb loin chops
instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the tomato paste in a small saucepan, stirring until smooth.  Place the roast in a large casserole and pour the tomato paste mixture over top.  Bake, covered, in a preheated 275 degree oven for 4 hours, basting occasionally.  Baste often with the tomato paste drippings.  Continue to roast, basting occasionally, until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the meat registers 140 degrees f, about 1 hour longer.  Cool to warm room temperature.  Discard the pepper and chilies.  Remove the meat from the sauce and chill for 1 hour.  When cool, slice the meat across the grain.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,raisin,tofu,kaffir lime leaf,red curry paste,ricotta cheese,cauliflower floret,red chili pepper
title: Easy Baked Tofu With Cauliflower and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 8 ounces firm tofu | 1 cup cauliflower floret ( about 8 ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese or 1/4 cup vegan mozzarella cheese, plus extra for sprinkling | 1 -2 kaffir lime leaf, plus extra to sprinkle | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese ( optional, to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees farenheit.  Coat a 14x10 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.  In medium sauce pan, heat curry paste on medium until fragrant, about one minute, then stir in tofu and cook until just soft and mushy, about 5 minutes.  Spray pan with nonstick cooking spray and transfer curry paste mixture to a bowl.  Stir cauliflower florets, raisins and cheese into the curry paste.  Spread filling among the tofu in the baking dish.  Bake until the cauliflower is slightly softened, about 10 minutes.  Spread ricotta cheese over the top to completely cover the tofu.  Broil, uncovered, until cheese is lightly browned and bubbling, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Garnish with more cheese and lime leaves in between.  Recipe can be made several days in advance and reheated.

title: Sautéed Strawberries and Portuguese Onions
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, sliced thin | 1 cup chicken stock | 4 cups fresh strawberries, hulled, quartered
instructions: Place onion slices in a saucepan with just enough water to cover, and bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over medium heat until tender.  Drain, but reserve 1 cup cooking water.  Return onion to pan and gently toss with reserved cooking water and strawberries.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,walnut oil,yellow squash,garbanzo bean,wheat flour
title: Roasted West Indian Grilled Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Stir together the whole wheat flour and mustard.  Stir in the walnut oil.  Brush the cut sides of the squash slices with the oil, arrange them on the grill, and cook until lightly browned on the bottom, 5 to 9 minutes, turning once.  Spread 3/4 cup of the garbanzo beans on the bottom of a plate or shallow serving bowl and place several slices of the grilled squash on top of the beans.

title: German Sausage With Kielbasa #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup carrot, grated ( about 2 ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice
instructions: Cook sausage over medium heat about 10 minutes or until well done.  Add cream, carrot and tomato with juice to sausage.

title: Low Carb, Low Fat Oven Fried Nacho Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 8 ounces bok choy ( optional, frozen may be used ) | 1/2 bell pepper, sliced ( optional ) | 16 low-carb flour tortillas
instructions: Dice pepper into 1/4 inch pieces and onions into 1/4 inch rounds.  Sautee green chilies and bell peppers until slightly soft.  Slice bok choy crosswise into 3/4 inch pieces.  Heat 1tb oil in frying pan on medium high heat.  Coat both sides of the quesadillas with a little batter.  Fry a couple one at a time on each sides to slightly brown crisp and crisp.  The finished product should be soft and the fat should be mostly absorbed.  If a smaller amount of fat is needed, you can add 1/4 tbs water or peanut oil and fry as desired.  Drain on paper towels after done and set aside until all are done.  Serve with salsa, guacamole and sour cream.  You can eat the cheese right away, it will cool off and the rest of the way up in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: masa harina mix,mustard seed,scalloped potato mix,honey mustard,raisin,oregano leaf,white pepper powder
title: Honey Mustard & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 package masa harina mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground white pepper powder | 3/4 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed ( black or white ) | 3/4 tablespoon honey mustard | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 cup scalloped potato mix, unpleeled ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk together all dry ingredients until well blended.  Stir in the honey mustard.  Add the raisins, if desired.  Toss lightly, and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.  Serve on warm lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: green olive,cream corn,mustard seed,red pepper flake,cashew,wheat tortilla,green onion
title: Cheap Cheesy Green Olive, Corn and Cashew Sushi
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat tortilla | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1 cup whole cashews, unsalted | 6 tablespoons sour cream style sweet corn | 8 ounces creamy roasted green olives | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 bunch green onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl combine the first four ingredients.  Spread the mixture across the entire grain of the tortilla.  Sprinkle the entire stack with cashews.  Roll the whole stack into a cylinder.  Use tooth picks for tooth pick to hold toothpick together.  Repeat on other side of cylinder.  Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish covered with aluminum foil.  Bake in preheated oven until the cashews are hot and golden brown, about 30 minutes.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool.  Pour the olives, red pepper flakes and green onions over the roll and serve.  Yum.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,sesame seed,green capsicum,gruyere cheese,chutney
title: Chutney Rice Salad
ingredients: 450 g long grain white rice | 100 g gruyere cheese, sliced ( or other tasty cheese, of your choice ) | 1 green capsicum, deseeded and sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons chutney | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted, to serve
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,pickling salt,vodka,apple cider vinegar,chicken cutlet,onion salt,kalamata olive
title: German Style Grilled Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 4 whole chicken cutlets | 1/2 cup salt | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 cup pickling salt | 4 tablespoons vodka | 3 lbs hot green chili peppers | 3/4 cup kellow sweet pickling salt | 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 12 pitted and coarsely chopped kalamata olives ( about 5 to 8 )
instructions: Adjust rack to lower middle position and heat oven to 275 degrees fahrenheit.  Season cutlets with onion salt and salt.  Combine vodka, chile peppers, kELLOW sweet pickling salt, and vinegar in noncorrosive bowl and marinate chicken for 1 to 2 hours.  Heat grill pan over medium high heat.  Brush chicken with olive oil if desired.  Grill chicken, skin side down, until deeply golden, 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting with marinade while grilling.  While chicken bakes, place kalamata olives and remaining marinade in medium bowl.

title: Spinach-Crab Florentine Style
ingredients: 1 can crab | 1 can sliced button mushrooms | 1 can chopped spinach | 1 1/4 cups water | 2 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Rinse the crab and drain.  Place the seafood in a microwave safe dish and cover with plastic wrap.  Microwave on high setting on high for about 10 minutes until meat turns opaque.  Set aside.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Open the can of mushrooms and set aside.  Mix together the spinach, water, and chipotle pepper in a microwave safe bowl, bring to a boil.  When the liquid boils, stir in the shrimp and crab, mix well.  Cover with cheesecloth and microwave for about 9 minutes.  Stir the spinach mixture and transfer to a round 9x13 inch baking dish.  Make a deep slice out of the top of the crab shell.  Place it in the baking dish, cut side down.  Stir the shrimp mixture and spread over the top of the crab shell in the baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees f.  When bubbling, remove the dish from the oven and uncover.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,mace,chambord raspberry liquor,italian herb seasoning,almond,soda water
title: Netherlands Fizz
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces chambord raspberry liquor | 1 1/2 ounces coconut rum | 1 1/2 ounces soda water, chilled | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted almond, or to taste
instructions: Combine chambord, rum, and soda water in a cocktail shaker with a lid, and shake until very cold.  Strain into a glass rimmed cocktail glass to serve, and garnish with toasted almonds.

title:
A Different Seasoning for Dressing - J.
    -K.
    -A.
    - Assem
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 stalk celery, diced - 2 teaspoons
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over plenty of ice, allow it to melt, stirring occasionally, and then stir in the oregano and cornflour until you have a smooth creamy mass.  Add celery and mix.  Allow to set for about 30 seconds in the refrigerator.  Stores well, refrigerated, tightly capped, for a week.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,ice water,vegetable broth,hoagie,chinese black vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Sizzled Hoagies (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup vegetable broth, hot or hot | 1/2 cup chinese black vinegar or 1/2 cup jasmine rice vinegar | 1/2 cup ice water ( optional ) | 2 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise ( or more )
instructions: Mix ginger garlic paste and hot broth in small container and stir til combined.  Place cut up hoagie rolls on wire racks and place in microwave for a few seconds on high to warm up.  Brush tops of the hoagies with the broth mixture.  Carefully remove from microwave, leaving tops covered with plastic wrap.  If desired, drizzle with extra hot broth mixture.  Return rolls to microwave.  Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, turning once or twice until heated through.  Serve cut hoagies on a platter with cut hoagie tops on the side.

title: Rice & Cheese Stuffed Mozzarella
ingredients: 8 ounces whole green giant greek style cheese | 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 teaspoons capers | 1 1/2 teaspoons colored crystal sweet butter ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons crystal sweet butter ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Cook rice in covered saucepan on stove till rice is just done.  Drain and cool for 1/2 hour.  Mix rice with cheese in medium bowl.  Spread rice mixture in an 11x7 baking dish, sprinkle cheese over the top and roll up into a sausage roll.  Arrange on an attractive platter.  Sprinkle remaining cheese over the cheese and top with the capers.  Cover with a sheet of wax paper, plastic wrap or parchment paper and refrigerate 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,ginger garlic paste,onion powder,fish stock
title: Chinese Chicken and Root Vegetables for Two
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 onion, chopped | 2 cups fish stock
instructions: In a wok over high heat, saute ginger and garlic until fragrant.  Add chicken and stir fry 2 to 3 minutes or until just done.  Add onion and stir fry 1 to 2 minutes longer.  Add fish stock and bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over medium heat until chicken is cooked.  Serve with rice.

title: Spinach Burgers
ingredients: 1 jar baby spinach | 2 tablespoons harissa, or to taste | 1 hamburger bun | 1 teaspoon harissa for top | 1 package shell pasta ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat.  Drain the spinach, and press to extract excess liquid.  Combine spinach, 1 tablespoon harissa, and 1 tablespoon water in a bowl, and stir to combine.  Divide the mixture into 4 portions, and press each into 4 hamburger shapes on skewers.  Grill for 6 to 10 minutes on each side, until cooked through.  Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon harissa while cooking.  Serve on buns with additional harissa and a spoonful of sauce.

title: Easy Cracked Beef Fritters!
ingredients: 500 g lean round steak, cut into strips | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Mix the cheese, coriander & sugar together.  Dry the meat with kitchen paper.  Use electric mixture to gently press in cheeses and roll the meat into a ball shape.  Repeat until all mixture is used.  Heat oil in a skillet.  Cook fritters in batches until crisp and golden, turning halfway through cooking time.  Serve warm with chutney.  Variation, for seasoning, finely pound the steak, but leave the tail flap as it is.  Use a teaspoon instead of a teaspoon.  For best results, heat the fritters with half the cheese mixture.

title: The Best Saffron Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg of fresh tomatoes or 1 1/2 kg fresh tomatoes | 2 cardamom seeds | 6 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 100 g macadamia nuts ( pistachios nuts ) | 3 tablespoons saffron
instructions: Using a heavy based pot, add 1 inch of water.  Add cardamom, cardamoms, gingers garlic paste and mix well till the pieces of the nuts have soaked up the water.  Add the tomatoes and cook till they come half way to the surface, on low heat.  Take on the stove and stir till the water reduces and the sauce becomes thick.  Remove the pot from the heat.  Add saffron and mix well.  If necessary, add a little extra water.  Remove cardamom seeds and nuts.  Set aside.  When it is cool, remove the cashewnuts and soak the cashewnuts in water for 5 minutes.  Drain the cashewnuts and keep aside.  Heat oil on medium heat in a pan until smoking.  Toss in cardamom seeds.  Stir fry for an additional 2 minutes.  Add a 1 1/2 cups of water.  Once the water comes to boil, add saffron and cashewnuts and mix well.  Stir fry for few minutes more.  Pour the tomato sauce into a glass pan.  Garnish with sliced pistachios and serve on a bed of rice and yogurt.

title: Roasted Salmon Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb fresh squid ( tubes ) | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 4 tablespoons hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 lb fresh spaghetti | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/4 cup vegetable fat | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf.  Remove and discard tentacles from squid.  Thinly slice tentacles and tentacles from body cavity of squid.  Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium heat over medium high heat.  Add hazelnuts and nutmeg and sauté for 2 minutes.  Remove nuts from pan and set aside.  In a small bowl, thoroughly mix together cream of tartar, oyster sauce, and sesame seeds.  Heat a large skillet until very hot.  Add spaghetti and stir frequently until cooked al dente.  Drain pasta thoroughly and toss with sesame mixture.  Add ginger and nuts.  Serve immediately.

title: Yogurt With a Strawberry (Giant)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed dried thyme sprig | 2 cups balkan yogurt ( low-fat or soy or low-fat ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Soak the dried thyme over night or over night, or over night if you are using a regular yogurt maker, and freeze.  Place the yogurt maker on your machine's operating instructions.  To check, place a small knife in the center of the yogurt, and squeeze a rounded teaspoonful of yogurt into the machine, followed by a teaspoonful of cumin seeds.  Push the button to set the yogurt into the machine's yogurt, and pop it into your refrigerator.  If needed, cover the yogurt maker with a towel or plastic container.  Makes about 4 to 6 servings.  My note, i used this recipe in one of those recipes that is really simple, and it turned out really nice and creamy.  For an added touch, i made 1 tablespoon of garlic powder in the mixture, and used all the sourdough ingredients.  It also gave it a bit of a kick.  So next time i would serve this with bread or vegetables, and would recommend this yogurt to anyone who isn't eat gluten, or with eggs or rice, and would recommend this recipe as well.  I also topped it w/grated parmesan cheese when it was made, and loved the addition of shredded zest from the tomatoes.  The finished yogurt was just wonderful.  Instead of yogurt maker, i used regular yogurt the night before, and it was quick cooking yogurt that was perfect for me, and served it as a refreshing yogurt with veggies, bread, or vegetables, etc.

title: Baked Beans (Red Beans and Mixed Berry Mash)
ingredients: 2 cups red beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup mixed berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Spread the black beans in a shallow baking dish.  Bake beans uncovered approximately 30 minutes, or until beans are tender.  Stir the cooked beans and mixed berries into the baked beans.  Continue to bake in oven 15 minutes.

title: Easy Pig's Feet
ingredients: 2 pig feet | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/2 bunch fresh fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place pig feet on a baking sheet skin side down, and season the tops with the liquid smoke.  Place in the preheated oven and bake for about 35 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the feet reaches 165 degrees f on a meat thermometer.  Remove pork feet from oven, and place on a tray.  When cool enough to handle, remove and discard the strings and bones.  Cut off meat feet.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dough
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 cups sourdough starter ( see note below ) | 1/4 lb pepperoni, sliced thinly
instructions: Warm the dough or use bread machine dough for dough preparation, using directions on the packaging.  Mix ingredients in a large bowl.  Let dough rise at room temperature for about an hour.  Heat a large skillet on medium heat.  Turn dough onto a lightly floured board.  Knead.  Shape dough into a ball.  Oil skillet.  Place dough onto hot oil and stretch dough about 5 times.  Place the dough, oiled side down, on hot skillet.  Cook until browned all over.  Top hot rolled pizza with toppings.  Note, to soften and stretch dough, cover dough with a damp towel or towel in a large plastic bag and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Before placing toppings on top or in crust, remove air from dough and gently stretch the dough to fit your pizza maker.  Remove dough from pan with a spatula and transfer onto a lightly floured pizza screen.  Place a large baking sheet on top of the pizza and cut steam vents.  Bake at 375 f or until pizza is browned, about 12 minutes.  If desired, drizzle remaining pizza with a little olive oil.  Note, you may also spread the cheese on the dough before putting any toppings on it.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,ladyfinger,dijon mustard,parsnip,grill seasoning,parmesan cheese
title: Dijon Parsnip, Parsnip & Grill Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 4 cups dijon-style mustard | 4 cups pared parsnips | 2 cups grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 package ladyfingers | parsley sprigs ( to garnish ) or mint ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare grill, place 1 cup mustard on a sheet of heavy duty foil or waxed paper.  Sprinkle the parsnips with 1 cup parmesan cheese, 1 tsp mustard seeds and 1/2 tsp black mustard seeds.  Arrange savoury biscuits on another sheet of plastic wrap and sprinkle on remaining 1/2 cup mustard and parmesan cheese, then scatter remaining mustard and parmesan cheese.  Close up the lady fingers and fold the ends of the plastic wrap over the ends of the biscuits.  Roll up the biscuits and place seam side down on a baking tray.  Grill the biscuits until crisp & golden about 20 minutes depending on how cooked you like your biscuits.  Top with herbs if desired and serve with remaining parmesan cheese and crusty bread as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,baking powder,kalamata olive,cayenne pepper,russet potato,green pepper
title: Potato and Olive Tostada
ingredients: 1 large russet potato | 5 cups water chestnuts, sliced | 1 green pepper, cut on the bias ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup pitted kalamata olive, sliced | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Peel the potato and slice into 1/4 inch dice.  Place in a large deep pan of water.  Bring to boil, cook for 15 minutes or until a knife pierces the easily enough to push through the potato easily.  Drain and set aside.  Place the water chestnuts in another large pan or skillet.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the flesh from the skin and thinly slice.  Discard the shells.  Add pepper, potato, olives and cayenne to the water and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until potato is tender and liquid has evaporated.

title: Pina Colada Bread Soup
ingredients: 4 slices country bread, crusts removed | 2 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 4 1/2 cups pina colada mix ( found at specialty foods stores ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning | 1 star anise or 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3/4 cup creamy yogurt, greek style is best but i like plain yogurt, greek style is also okay
instructions: Toast bread.  Place in blender with vegetable stock or water.  Puree or grind.  Pour into strainer lined with cheesecloth.  Pour into strainer, over bowl or pitcher.  Save 1 1/2c soup for later.  Strain liquid through strainer into bowl, pressing down on solids and reserving liquid.  Return strained liquid to strainer with remaining soup.  Add seasoning to taste or put in fridge to chill.  To serve, soup should be thickened and the liquid to boil in the pan.  Add yogurt.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,cream chicken soup,fennel seed,salt,white vinegar,pork tenderloin
title: Japanese Beefy Potstickers
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 package dried shiitake mushrooms
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the chicken soup, salt, vinegar, and fennel seed.  Place pork in a large pot, and fill with soup mixture.  Stir to coat the pork with soup mixture.  Cover, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 hour.  Remove the lid, and cook for 1 hour, or until pork is cooked and tender.  Place fresh mushrooms in a small pot, and fill with water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Japanese Style Sushi Roll - Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups sushi rice | 3 steaks | 1/3 cup sultana | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons black bean paste ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the sushi, place rice in a pot with enough water and bring to a boil.  Cover tightly and reduce heat to low.  Cook, tightly covered for 12 minutes.  Set a portable burner on the stove, put in the vegetables and black bean paste according to package directions.  Turn off the burner, cover the pot and allow to stand for 3 minutes.  Uncover and fluff with a fork.  Remove the crusts from the rolls by laying out on a cutting board, placing each roll in the center of the board.  Spread each roll of sushi evenly with sultanas.  Spread the black bean paste over the top or scatter with sesame seeds or chopped nuts.  Roll all the sushi and wrap in heavy duty aluminum foil.  Place on a sushi rolling mat and cover tightly with a wet tea towel.  Steam for 20 minutes.  Slice into slices approximately 1/4 inch thick or until crispy.

title: Zarda (Spice Bread)
ingredients: 500 g bread flour | 1 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground mustard powder ( not hot! ) | 1 teaspoon sweet guacamole | 2 teaspoons of ground sumac ( optional )
instructions: Add the ingredients in the bread machine in this order.  Start the machine.  When the bread is ready to be mixed with the filling add it to the machine.  If the dough is too sticky, continue with the mixing and kneading process.  Cut into 8 equal equal portions.  Make the dough into 6 portions and let rest at room temperature till it is well covered.  The dough can then be made into balls and flattened flat.  Dip the flattened dough into the filling and coat evenly.  Allow to stand for ten minutes.  Heat a griddle or large non stick frying pan, on medium high heat.  If you have a non stick griddle pan, heat a tablespoon of clarified butter on medium high heat with two tablespoons of ghee.  The butter has to heat up quickly so the heat is not too hot.  Test the size of the griddle by dipping a small piece of dough into it.  If it wrinkles and the lid bubbles, you are ready to place the griddle under it.  After the two minutes pass it through a fine mesh sieve.  The zarda will have a puffed appearance on the inside.  Carefully remove the griddle from the griddle pan.  Do not touch it with your fingers because the ghee will burn your skin.  Sliding your hand under the dough, flatten it slightly with your fingers until it is 1cm thickness.  Slide the dough over and over again.  Lightly press in the dough.  The zarda will expand when it is flattened.  Slide the griddle onto it, with the help of a large plate or a napkin, so it will be warm while your hands press.  It will also release air bubbles.  The zarda will start to stick to it's plate, and as the bottom edge of the griddle starts to get well flattened, it will release itself.  The zarda may also stick to the plate, so be sure to press it firmly firmly.  Turn the griddle over and invert it onto the plate.  Cut any excess dough in half at the same time.  When you are ready to serve the zarda, gently scoop the zarda onto a plate and use as a dipping sauce or as a dip for vegetables of choice.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,hot chili powder,red bell pepper,lime juice,oatmeal,water
title: Spicy Peppers & Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, sliced | 2 red bell peppers | 1 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper flakes or 4 teaspoons hot chili powder | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oatmeal | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/3 cup water
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c.  Combine pepper flakes, oatmeal, lime juice & water.  Spoon evenly onto ungreased microwaverowave tray.  Cook for 12 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from heat.

title: Sour Cherry Barolo
ingredients: 1 pint sour cherries | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Place the sour cherries in a heavy pot with just enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir the caraway seeds into the sour cherries and serve.

title: Quick'simply Cheap' Baked Beans
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans, canned | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon feta cheese, crumbles
instructions: Put beans into a pot, add enough water to cover them.  Bring to the boil and let boil for ten minutes or until the beans are soft.  Drain the beans and mash with the back of a fork.  Stir in all the other ingredients, and simmer for 15 minutes or till the tomatoes are cooked through and the beans are tender.

title: Banana Flakes
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Peel bananas if using a fresh banana, or use vanilla extract.  Slice bananas into half lengthwise, and then half crosswise.  Insert a fine mesh or paring knife into banana, cutting all the way through until the banana is partially peeled or cut off the end.  Smash with a fork until mostly mashed, but not well mashed.  Add liquid smoke.  Mix well.  Roll into small balls about the size of a walnut, and lightly dust with additional smoked paprika, if desired.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Anchovy Spread - for Hot Dogs or Wedges
ingredients: 4 anchovies, finely chopped | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well with a fork to blend.  Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,canadian bacon,chili powder,pork tenderloin,bok choy,phyllo dough,lime
title: Bacon Green Chile Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canadian bacon, diced | 2 pork tenderloins, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1/2 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chili powder | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 1 bunch bok choy, cut into 3-inch lengths
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place bacon in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly browned, about 5 minutes.  Drain grease from skillet, and set aside.  Bring a skillet of lightly salted water to a boil, and place a rack in the boiling water.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Line the foil with a long, shallow dish towel, or other suitable covering so the water can drain away.  Place the phyllo dough onto the dish towel, and cover with dampened plastic wrap.  Set aside at room temperature for 10 minutes.  Spread green chile peppers over phyllo dough, and sprinkle with chili powder.  Layer about 1/4 of the pork tenderloin cubes over the chile peppers, and top with about half of the bacon slices.  Fold up the phyllo dough over the stuffing, and pinch closed around the stuffing.  Roll the dough out to the size of the dish towel.  Repeat until the dish towel is full.  Arrange the stuffed pastry on top of the bacon slices, and pinch ends together.  Place on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Garnish with lime wedges, and serve.

title: Indian Hot Dog Sauce for Meat
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt ( yogurt can be used in place of yogurt or other brand of milk yogurt ) | 1 -2 serrano chili ( or more chiles - use more or less ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric

Heat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas toss the mushroom slices in with the marmalade until coated.  Arrange the broccoli rabe roll on a warmed platter.  Drizzle over the pan of orange marmalade and scatter the fried spinach leaves around.  Serve with fresh mint and a sprig of mint.

title: Pesto Pear Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3 -5 firm pears | 3 -5 tablespoons basil pesto
instructions: Chop the pears by hand or a food processor.  Put them in a bowl and cover with the pesto.  Serve.

title: Kale and Corn Cauliflower Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb kale, coarsely chopped, stems included | 4 cups cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped gorgonzola or 1/2 cup montasio cheese | 1 large egg white | 1/4 cup fresh dill seed | 3 cups low sodium chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 375'f.  Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place kale, cauliflower, picante sauce to taste, and meat in 3 large bowls.  Stir well. Sprinkle the dill seeds over loaf and allow to cool slightly.  Remove baked loaf, cover with foil, and refrigerate until serving.  Serve sliced with cheese.

Serve hot or cold with crusty bread.

title: Apricot Tomato and Honey Dip

instructions: Place chilies and water in a small bowl.  Bring a saucepan of water to boil over high heat.  Stir in chilies and cook until tender, about 1 minute.

title: Mini Portobello Mushrooms from the Famous Rao's Food Network
ingredients: 4 portobello mushrooms, cleaned, stem removed | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons roasted red cayenne pepper | 2 crusty graham cracker crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Place the portobello mushrooms in the oven for 5 minutes, or until just softened.  Spread 1/4 cheese evenly over each mushroom. Slice each mushroom crosswise into 3, and transfer the mushroom slices to a baking tray.  Drizzle the remaining red pepper over the top of the mushroom caps.  Sprinkle the top of the mushroom caps with the grated asiago cheese.  Bake mushrooms for 15 minutes.

title: Chakchouka (Chicken, Plum Tomatoes, and Beer on your Crock Pot)

instructions: Preheat your crock pot to medium heat.  Open the plum tomatoes, plum tomatoes, and a small cup of aleppo pepper and place them in the crock pot.  Add the chakchouka in your crock pot. Remove chakchouka and spoon onto your favorite flat bread or serve with pita.  This sauce can also be used as a side dish for a veggie burger or grilled chicken.

title: Sesame Pasta
ingredients:

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,chive,stewing beef,vegetable oil cooking spray,soymilk

ingredients: 800 g stewing beef ( lean or boneless, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ) | 3/4 cup soymilk ( soy milk may also be used for non-vegetable mixture ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Spray a large non stick frying pan with the oil and place over a medium heat.  Add the beef and cook, stirring, for 3 - 5 mins or until browned and tender. . Add the browned beef and heat through.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve hot with steamed vegetables or salad greens.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,lettuce leaf,basil leaf,cooking apple,red wine vinegar,romaine lettuce
title: Spaghetti Apple Salad With Fresh Basil and Rind
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 4 ounces shredded romaine lettuce | 8 fresh basil leaves | 1 cooking apple ( such as a granny smith, cored, peeled, and diced in a food processor or blender ( about 1/3 cup or so ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 4 large leafy soft lettuce leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook spaghetti at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 9 minutes.  Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.  Place romaine and basil leaves on a salad plate.  Place diced apple on top.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled and seeded | 3 tablespoons ground cumin seeds
instructions: Place avocado in a bowl.  Stir in cumin seeds, and mash with a fork or a potato masher until smooth.  Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

instructions: Preheat charcoal grill.  Place squash slices directly over coals.  Grill, turning and brushing with herb spray, until tender and slightly charred on edges, 5 - 7 minutes.  Cut slices into fourths.  Spoon warm juices evenly over squash.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,irish cream,icing sugar,yukon gold potato,turmeric,taco seasoning mix,tequila
title: Tex Mex Style Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, trim and cut into small chunks | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 cups irish cream | 1/4 cup tequila | 4 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1/3 cup icing sugar
instructions: Brown meat and taco seasoning using the tequila, stir.  Mix in the irish cream and potatoes.  Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour.  Remove cover and simmer for 30 more minutes.

title: Goulash (Shredded Hot Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 box red potatoes ( i like regular size ) | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper ( green bell pepper is nice ) | 1 can sliced beets | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Wash and dry all the potatoes.  Cut into fourths.  Dice the bell pepper. If you want a thicker gravy, mix 1/2 cup water with the 2 tbsp bread crumbs in a mug.

title: Italian Toast With Spiced Hard-Boiled Eggs

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  On a large plate sprinkle 3/4 cup of the italian bread crumbs onto a baking sheet and spread with the espresso powder.  Sprinkle evenly with salt, then toss with the bread crumbs to coat.  Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until just beginning to smoke.  When very hot, add the eggs and 2 tablespoons of the espresso beans/olive oil and cook, moving them around with a wide spatula, for 3 minutes, moving them around so they cook evenly.  Transfer to a plate and set aside.  Add 5 tablespoons of the bread crumbs back into the skillet and toss again to coat.  Arrange the toast on another baking sheet making sure it is all overlapping as best you can.  Sprinkle the toast with the remaining espresso beans/olive oil.  Top with remaining 2 tablespoons of the bread crumbs and toss lightly.  Sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs.  Bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until golden brown and puffed, stirring every 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Tofu and Turnips with Radish
ingredients: 1 small turnip, unpeeled, cut into 1/8 inch pieces | 1 small radish, trimmed, quartered | 1 small handful cucumber, peeled, chopped | 1 package firm tofu, cubed | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 jar grape tomatoes, drained and lightly patted dry
instructions: Toss all ingredients of the vegrette together in a medium size bowl until well mixed.  Refrigerate until serving.

title: Ice Cream

instructions: Dissolve the onion flakes in the olive oil.  Combine with other ingredients, place in ice cream containers and freeze.  When you want to serve the ice cream, place in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  As soon as it begins to bubble, remove from heat and stir with a wooden spoon.  Transfer to a bowl and serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Danish Quark "sausage Sauce"
ingredients: 1/2 lb prepared quark | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Mix together with a wire whisk.  Serve in a saucer with cheese grated, onion rings cut off, sprinkled with salt and pepper.

title: Spicy Bread

instructions: Set oven to 300 degrees place ciabatta rolls onto oven baking sheet.  Trim bread of crusts, if needed.  Place in a single layer on sheet with tops covering them. instructions: In a large bowl, toss the tomatoes with lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes, ginger, savory and lemon zest.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to overnight. instructions: Grind coriander seeds in a mortar and pestle.  Heat about 2 tbsp olive oil in a heavy bottomed pot, add onion and fry until softened.  Add chicken, black pepper, paprika and spices and mix thoroughly.  When it has turned brown, add the tomato puree, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes covered.  When ready to serve add to the koftas, add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Easy Carne Guisana
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/8 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 6 large fresh bananas, sliced | 2 cups ice, or as needed
instructions: Place chuck roast in a large saucepan and coat with sliced rosemary.  Pour enough ice into the pan to cover completely.  Bring water to a boil and place beef into the pan.  Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until tender, about 2 1/2 hours.  Remove beef from liquid and set aside to cool.  Remove meat from cooking liquid and shred with 2 forks.  Return meat to pan.  Stir bananas into meat mixture and bring to a boil.

title: Chilli Cabbage Fritters
ingredients: 600 g green cabbage | 1 cup walnut pieces | 1 cup ground breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon semolina flour | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Grate the cabbage finely and shred any large pieces.  Pound the walnuts in mortar and pestle until fine.  Place the cabbage in a bowl and mix with the bread crumbs, semolina flour, pepper and chili paste.  Shape 1 tablespoonfuls of mixture into balls the size of a golf ball.  Roll them in the walnut mixture until they are well coated.  Deep fry in hot oil until golden.  Drain on paper towels.

title: Sweet Appetizer Red Cabbage Squares
ingredients: 2 large red cabbage, finely chopped | 1 can apple pie filling, divided | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 4 tablespoons ground sumac | 6 tablespoons marshmallows
instructions: Mix cabbage, one cup of pie filling, chili sauce, and sumac together in a large bowl.  Add marshmallows.

title: Pesto Balsamic Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon oregano | icing sugar
instructions: Combine pesto, vinegar, bouillon cube, and oregano in medium saucepan.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Boil for 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve over chicken.

title: Easy Mexican Corn
ingredients: 5 ears fresh corn, shucked | 3 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 cans small cherry tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lay the corn on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.  Heat taco sauce in a skillet over medium heat until hot.  Drain the corn, and spoon a thin layer of taco sauce into a bowl.  Place the cherry tomatoes onto the corn in a horizontal line.  Arrange the cherry tomatoes onto the corn, and continue layering until there are no gaps.  Bake in the preheated oven until the sauce is hot and hot, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Easy Vegetarian Baked Beans
ingredients: 300 g veal, slices ( cut 1/4-inch thick ) | 3 aubergines ( small, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch thick slices ) | 150 g brown sugar | 200 g cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 3 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Place two slices of the veg of meat on the bottom of a greased oven tray.  Place the aubergines, green and regular side down on top of the meat.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and place the cannellini beans, margarine and a little brown sugar in a small saucepan.  Bring to the boil, then pour over the vegetable mixture.  Bake, covered, for 35 - 40 minutes until browned all over and meat is tender.  Serve with a loaf of crusty bread, and a salad.

title: Pine Nuts Filled With Bacon Bits
ingredients: 16 slices bacon, each cut crosswise into 8 pieces | 3/8 cup pine nuts
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in a small saucepan over medium high heat.  Add pine nuts.  Cook gently 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Transfer to a paper towel lined plate.  Cover and refrigerate until well chilled.  Store in an airtight container.

Mix well to ensure correct texture of cauliflower.  In a large bowl, beat the egg whites and the yolks.  Fold in cheese and ground nuts.  Add sifted ingredients and mix well.  Make small balls with the cauliflower mixture.  Dip in the yolk mixture, then in the pistacchio/powdered pistacchio mixture.  Place on a plate and refrigerate for at least 1 hr. Using a slotted spoon, remove the lamb halves from the refrigerator and discard the skin.  Add the lamb to the bowl.  Add slices of the turkey, hot peppers, cucumber quarters, and hot pepper chunks. title: Lavender Rye
ingredients: 10 ounces rye flour ( or similar ) | 2 1/2 ounces ground pecans ( regular grind ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice ( a pinch or two is fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender, crushed ( use your favorite fresh herb, lavender buds, sage, dill, tarragon or a combination of these ) | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Stir together the rye flour, ground peppercorns, allspice, and lavender.  Add the sesame oil and work in with a fork until the dough feels like a very smooth bread dough.  Use more oil, a teaspoon or 2 teaspoons, if it seems too wet.  You can also use a fork and teaspoon to work in the flour at the start of the knead if the dough seems dry.  You can also work the dough by hand, if you have a stand mixer with a hook attachment, for 1 - 2 minutes to develop the gluten.  The dough will be sticky and sticky and unlike ground bread it can be very fragile when it's kneaded.  If you're using a stand mixer with kneading attachment, add the gluten last.  It can take anywhere from 1 - 2 minutes to reach the gluten stage, but don't let the mixer knead this dough for more than just a few minutes.  If you have a stand mixer, set the dough in to the dough hook attachment and knead it for about 7 - 10 minutes, using the mixer's hook attachment.  It should never stick to the bottom or the sides of the bowl.  If your mixer does that, use the handle of a wooden spoon to incorporate the gluten into the bread dough.  The gluten will have formed an incredibly thick crust and the dough will be rather smooth and sticky.  If you want to add a lot of extra virgin olive oil or lemon juice, add it at the same time.  The dough can be stored, covered with a very dry top and refrigerated for up to 3 days.  Cut the dough into 3 parts and shape each into an oval about 1'' thick.  Cut each oval into 3'' in diameter and shape each oval into a circle about 1'' in diameter.  The oval can be eaten right after it is cooled to room temperature, but this bread will keep for 10 to 15 minutes in the fridge.
