instructions: Halve parsnips lengthwise and remove core.  Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Arrange in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover the parsnips with cool water.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,cream mushroom soup,cream chicken soup,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Easy Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 2 tomatillos, quartered and skin peeled ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sauce pan and mix until well combined.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  Serve over hot, flour tortillas.

title: Capers on Cracked Thyme
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 1/2 cup whole caper, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º.  In a small pan over medium heat, melt the capers in the capers, being careful not to let the capers burn.  Remove from the heat and stir in the thyme.  Spoon the capers onto a rack or platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,green curry paste,chicken breast,green olive
title: Green Chicken Curry With Olives and Red Pepper Strips
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, skinless | 4 tablespoons green curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste ) | 4 tablespoons sliced pitted green olives ( about 5 oz )
instructions: Preheat broiler, set the rack 4 - 5 inches from the heat.  Place the chicken into a greased baking dish and broil, skin side down, 2 - 3 minutes, until crisp skin is golden brown.  Turn the chicken over and broil 2 - 3 minutes, until lightly blackened in spots.  Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and allow to cool slightly.  Transfer the chicken to a plate.  Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees.  Stir the curry paste and chili flakes together in a small bowl and set aside.  Arrange the olives around the chicken pieces and arrange on a platter.  Spoon the curry mixture over the chicken and serve at once.

title: Italian Easter Dressing
ingredients: 8 cups italian-style dressing | 6 tablespoons shortening | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a large container with a tight fitting lid, combine the italian style dressing, shortening, vanilla and ground cloves.  Shake until ingredients are well blended and mixture is well blended.  Cover and refridgerate the leftovers.

title: Russet Potatoes With Marsala and Marsala
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons marsala
instructions: Use a mandolin to make slicing marks on the inside, and use a fork.  Slice potatoes into 1/4 inch slices.  Slice 1/8 inch slices.  Heat canola oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat.  Place potatoes and half of the marsala in the pan.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,self raising flour,cod,mushroom liquid,coriander seed,pasta
title: Cod and Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 6 ounces mushrooms liquid | 2/3 cup pasta, cooked | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked cod
instructions: Sift flour over the top of the dry ingredients and rub well with your fingertips until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Add the mushrooms liquid and mushrooms.  Mix well.  Add the macaroni and cod and mix.  Dump into a large frying tin.  Add enough water to come to 3/4 the height of the tin.  Place pan on a stove on medium.  Bring to boil.  Turn heat down to low.  Leave to simmer and simmer for 30 - 40 minutes until all the liquid has been absorbed and the pastis is nice and thickened.

title: Cranberry Crunch Chips
ingredients: 6 ounces shredded cranberries | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 large bell pepper, diced ( i use a red florina )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine all ingredients except the flour in a bowl.  Roll with floured hands into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick.  Using a cookie cutter, cut the rectangle into triangles.  Place on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 5 minutes or until golden.  Set aside on a wire rack to cool.  Enjoy with a snack of your choice.

title: Basic Beaucom Beans
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 3/4 yellow onion
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large saucepan.  When almost ready to serve, slice the peeled yellow onion into small pieces.  Slices are good.  When the broth is warmed up, add the onion slices.  Bring to a boil, then reduce to low and simmer until the onions are very tender, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,italian bread,mushroom,extra virgin olive oil,malt vinegar,green chilies,vodka,green bean
title: Green Beans and Mushrooms in Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 green chilies or 1 red chile, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 lb green beans, trimmed and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1 lb mushroom, trimmed and sliced | 3/4 cup italian seasoned bread, crumb | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet.  Add anchovy paste and chile, and saute over moderate heat for 2 minutes.  Add beans, mushrooms, bread crumbs and vinegar and cook 1 minute longer.  Stir in the vodka.  The sauce will boil vigorously and be thick.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,pinto bean,ladyfinger,jumbo pasta shell,beet juice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Beet and Coconut Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 8 -10 count pinto beans ( or your favorite variety ) | 1 can beet juice | 1 lb jumbo pasta shells, cooked | 8 -12 ladyfingers, whole | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 16 ounces pinto beans, drained | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350&deg.

title: Black Olive Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 cups pitted black olives | 2 1/2 tablespoons chicken base, liquid concentrate | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( more if desired ) | 50 g bittersweet chocolate, chopped ( for dipping ) ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in food processor, blender or chopper.  Process until thoroughly mixed.  Let stand 15 minutes before serving, refrigerated.

title: Wayne's African Beef and Okra Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef | 8 okra | 1 large onion flakes | 1 red chili pepper | tamari | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips and set aside.  Slice okra into thin strips on a diagonal and set aside.  Cut onions into thin strips.  Cut red chili pepper into thin strips.  Heat up some oil and add beef and stir fry.  When meat is brown add okra and mix.  Push okra to edges of pan and add tamari or teriyaki sauce.  Cook covered about 45 seconds.  Serve with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,chicken bouillon,fish stock,serrano chili,asiago cheese,raisin
title: Asiago Cheese Sauce(Pollo Con Queso)
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock | 14 ounces asiago cheese | 24 -36 dry jalapeno peppers | 2 serrano chili peppers ( seeds removed, i use jalapenos of tunisia, you can pick your heat ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped cilantro ( i use stems on cilantro ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( or more ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Place stock, cheese and chillies in a pan and simmer, stirring often until almost all of the cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.  Stir in cilantro and add raisons if desired.

title: Havana Salmon and Sweet Baby Onions
ingredients: 8 ounces salmon steaks | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced | 1/2 cup sweet baby onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 500ºf.  On a baking pan, arrange the onion slices in an even cross pattern, from the stem to the edge.  Place the salmon steaks on top of the onions.  Combine the sweet baby onions with the sweet baby onions spread on top of the salmon steaks.  Bake until the onions are tender.

title: Champagne Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cups white wine vinegar | 3 green onions, minced
instructions: In a glass jar with a tight fitting top, pour vinegar and cover.  Add a few pinches of salt and stir.  Cover and shake jar for at least one hour.  It's ready to use right away.  If desired, stir again and shake a few times.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,garlic clove,vegetable stock,french bread,chinese cabbage,cucumber
title: Chinese Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 10 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 large chinese cabbage, shredded | 3 fresh garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon ginger root, chopped | 12 slices french bread, 1/4-inch thick | 1 english cucumbers, sliced
instructions: Place cabbage, garlic, and ginger in a 6 quart stock pot.  Increase heat to medium high.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,chicken breast half,canola oil,arborio rice,thyme leave,rice vinegar,cream
title: Beef Biryani
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 12 ounces boneless beef short ribs, cut in thirds crosswise | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 packages arborio rice
instructions: Cut chicken breast halves lengthwise into 3 pieces, then crosswise into 3 slices.  Slip short ribs crosswise crosswise into 3 pieces across grain.  Lay chicken pieces in a shallow baking dish and cover with plastic wrap completely with plastic wrap.  Peel plastic wrap off chicken breasts and place in a single layer on a plate.  Cover chicken pieces, refrigerate and marinate, covered, at least 3 hours and up to 1 day.  Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat.  Working in batches, add chicken to skillet, cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through and no longer pink.  Transfer 3 to 4 slices of short ribs to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.  Discard foil, discard juices.  Transfer chicken to a platter and cover to keep warm.  Stir sour cream and thyme leaves into skillet.  Bring to a boil and cook to reduce by half, 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir in rice vinegar, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.  Spoon rice between individual plates.  Place chicken slices over the rice and spoon sour cream mixture around.  Top with the reserved chicken.

title: Lazy Cherry Tomatoes (Dump)
ingredients:
24 cherry tomatoes, halved, i use the large ones.
    - | 1 bag pre-washed whole white flour ( unbleached ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In 9 inch round glass baking dish mix flour, soup and tomato until well blended.  Add tomatoes to flour mixture and stir to coat.  Sprinkle top of tomatoes with flour.  Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until golden and center is bubbly.

title: Indian Bread Mix
ingredients: 1 box biscuit mix | 1 teaspoon coarse salt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine biscuit mix, salt, and optional ingredients in a bowl.  Mix well.  Using a 2 1/2 inch diameter round cookie cutter, cut into rounds.  Bake on ungreased baking sheet, for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Brown Lentils and Raspberry Jam
ingredients: 450 g brown lentils | 450 g raspberry jam | pepper
instructions: Place in a saucepan, pour over enough water to cover, bring to the boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender.

title: Mild-Mannered Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable juice ( heinz ) | 1 cup half-and-half ( or cream )
instructions: Heat the vegetable juice in a kettle or deep frying pan.  Stir and add the half & half until it is dissolved.  Pour into a 1 quart buttered casserole dish.  Serve.

title: Green Beans, Cheese and Hot Peas Low Fat
ingredients: 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained, liquid reserved for later use | 1 package medium sliced green beans, trimmed | 2 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 cup grated lowfat swiss cheese
instructions: In a small bowl combine the olives and chopped vegetables.  In a mixing bowl combine cottage cheese, oregano, tabasco and reserved tomato and olive liquid.

title: Mushroom Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 medium portabella mushroom, sliced
instructions: Slice the tenderloin into medallions about 3/4 inch thick.  Place the slices onto a platter and pour the mushroom slices over.  Serve.

title: Lola Nesslá - the Real Thing!
ingredients: 60 g dark rum | 1/3 cup brown sugar
instructions: Toast the sugar in a heavy nonstick pan, swirling the pan until the sugar is dark and carameliseed.  Sift the rum over the top and continue cooking in a mod heat, stirring frequently, until it reaches the thick, sticky, and rich end of the caramelized sugar.  This should take 30 - 45 minutes, without stirring so that the dark rum turns golden brown and begins to smoke.  Remove from heat and pour to a bowl.  Allow to cool, then put in fridge and dig in.

Random Ingredients: water,coconut ice cream,yukon gold potato,black pepper,paprika,malt vinegar,seasoning salt
title: Paprika Potato and Macadamia Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut in large chunks | 2 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 pinch black pepper | 2 ounces smoked paprika | 2 pints coconut ice cream or 2 pints vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c or 400°f boil potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes or until tender but not mushy.  Drain.  Cook potatoes in a large pan of salted boiling water for a further 15 minutes or until golden.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Dissolve maggi in the vinegar in a little water, stir in potatoes and half the black pepper, to taste.  Spread potato mixture into a casserole dish in a layer.  Spread 1/2 the macadamia mix over potato mixture and spread out evenly.  Repeat layers, ending with the remaining mixture.  Sprinkle with paprika and remaining black pepper and bake on top of a very hot oven, until bubbling and golden.  Allow to stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tahini Sausages, Kielbasa and Kielbasa
ingredients: 500 g kielbasa | 20 whole cloves | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a food processor, chop the kielbasa, and add clove and a good grinding of black pepper.  Melt the tahini in a bowl in a wok over medium heat.  Once the sauce starts to boil, quickly stir in the tahini paste as soon as the oil starts to leave the kielbasa and clove.  Transfer the kielbasa mixture to a bowl and sprinkle generously with salt and toss to coat.

title: Spicy Broiled Eggs
ingredients: 3 small squid, cleaned and sliced into rings | 3 cups hot water, divided | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Rinse squid and drain.  Arrange on a 9x13x2 inch baking pan large enough to hold all together.  Sprinkle with 1 cup of hot water, covering completely.  Place under a preheated broiler for about 4 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from broiler.  Dip eggs generously into heated water until evenly coated.  Gently move eggs over and under the squid.  Continue dipping until the eggs are deep, pithy and hard.  Arrange on a serving platter and continue with remaining water and hot pepper flakes as garnish.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,cranberry,nasturtium petal,corn oil,cider vinegar,french bread
title: Cranberry Pear Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 can sweetened cranberries | 1/2 cup crumbled graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup nasturtium petals | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons crushed french bread
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a medium size sauce pan over medium heat.  Place cranberries and the graham cracker crumbs in a large bowl.  Spread cranberry crumbs all the way around, then add more cracker crumbs and nasturtiums.  Cook on medium low heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from the heat.

Random Ingredients: mix,purpose flour,fish fillet,canola oil,wheat couscous,egg yolk,mustard seed
title: Fish W' Crepes
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat couscous, cooked | 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup salad dressing, plus | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat sour cream or 1 tablespoon lowfat mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs medium fish fillets, skinned, boned and cut into 1-inch segments | 4 large large egg yolks, lightly beaten | 2 cups all-purpose flour, divided
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f.  Prepare couscous according to package directions.  While couscous is cooking, combine mayonnaise, mustard seeds, mixed spice and 1 cup of remaining flour in medium bowl, stirring until smooth.

title: Seeded Chicken Stock (Lebanese)
ingredients: 16 cups chicken stock | 4 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the stock, serrano peppers, and salt into a large, heavy saucepan of boiling water.

title: Chinese Spiced Vegetables (Sien Mue)
ingredients: 3 celery ribs, including leaves, chopped | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 100 g white corn, canned or frozen
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the celery leaves, icing sugar, ginger and mixed spice.  Fold in the corn.  Spoon into serving glasses and serve.

title: Traditional  Bread Crumbs for the Devil
ingredients: 3 cups stale white bread, torn into tiny pieces | suet or sago cheese, for coating
instructions: Put a thick layer of bread into bowl.  Sprinkle with sago.  Toss with your hands until well coated.  Dump excess grated cheese over and make sure the surface is very dry before turning out on a plate and shaking.

title: No-Egg Mexican Chocolate Icing
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the cocoa and confectioners' sugar together with an electric mixer.  Beat in the cocoa mixture to make a spreadable consistency.  Spread on your favorite cake, or refrigerate before spreading on cake.

title: Gluten Free (And Vegan) Flour Rye Cookies
ingredients: 225 g plain flour | 1/4 cup gluten-free brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Rub all the flour with your fingers until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Add the sugar and mix together with your hands.  Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead until the dough becomes silky.  Form the dough into a roll about the size of a walnut, keeping a 2cm edge on each side.  Roll out to an oblong then twist off the ends and make a circle of about 30cm in diameter.  Cut the dough into 1cm slices.  Place on an oven tray and bake for 12 mintues.  Allow to cool slightly then remove the biscuits and place on their side.  Enjoy.

title: Apple Toss
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 1 tablespoon rose water
instructions: Peel the apples and cut them in half.  Score the core with a knife or a knife in a diamond pattern.  Put the apples and 1 teaspoon of rosewater into a small saucepan with a lid and simmer over low heat until apples are soft, about an hour.  Stir occasionally to prevent burning.  Remove lid from the heat.  Remove peel and the core from the apples.  Remove the core and any remaining inside core.  Using the back of a fork, mash the flesh, leaving chunks.

title: Pecorino Cheese With Swiss
ingredients: 6 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons splenda granular or 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 slices swiss cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Blend pecorino romano cheese and splenda in blender until smooth.  Spread on toasted slices of swiss cheese and top with cubes.  Enjoy.

title: German Potatoes With Colcannon
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, scrubbed and thinly sliced | 1 large white cabbage, leaves picked and cut into wedges
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Meanwhile, steam potatoes in boiling water for 10 minutes.  Drain potatoes, peel, and cut into quarters.  Place cabbage and potatoes in a serving dish.  Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat, add potatoes, and stir for 3 minutes.  Pour colcannon over cabbage, and serve.

title: Peel of Apple and Jicama (Jicama With Apple Cider)
ingredients:
1 lb jicama ( jicama peeled, about 3 in.
    - thick, diced ) | 6 cups apple cider ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine cider and chili flakes in a large non reactive pot.  Add jicama and sugar.

title: Sherry Peppers
ingredients: 8 fresh fresh anaheim chile peppers with stems | 1 1/2 cups dry sherry
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut slit in the tops of the chiles and remove the seeds and pulp.  Open out the chiles, wearing gloves and removing any seeds or membrane.  Warm a large skillet over medium heat.  Place the chiles in the hot skillet.  Cook and stir the chiles until the chiles are soft, 2 to 3 minutes.  Spread the chiles into a small baking dish about 1 half inch thick.  Pour the sherry into the pan and reduce the heat to low.  Cook and stir about 5 minutes until the sherry reduces.  Remove the chiles from the skillet and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: basic pizza dough sauce,vanilla,basil leaf,spanish onion,cherry tomato,fruit pineapple preserve,chicken
title: Italian Country Chicken Pizza
ingredients:
1 tablespoon dried fruit-pineapple preserves | 1 tablespoon basil leaves | 1 lb basic pizza dough ( or pizza crust dough, etc.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla ( or 1/2 tsp vanilla bean paste ) | 1 cup cooked chicken, cubed | 1/2 cup diced spanish onion | 1 cup cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in large bowl or baking dish, mix preserves, basil and cinnamon.  Brush crust lightly with oil.  Lay chicken mixture evenly over dough and top with tomato, onion, cherry tomatoes and preserves.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, covering for last five minutes of baking to ensure crust is crusty and golden.

title: Sauce Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 -4 serrano pepper | 600 g cornflour | 1 packet taco seasoning | 4 heads belgian endive or 6 heads cabbage, washed with new leaves
instructions: Cut the endives into 2 inch wedges.  Slice the endives in half and slice the cabbage.  Wash cornflour until its starts to soften.  Then crush cornflour in a mortar and pestle or crush with a fork.  Add the fish and mix until combined.  Add taco seasoning and blend until combined.  Taste and add seasoning to your preferance.

title: Spicy Baked Cod
ingredients: 4 -5 pounds smoked cod ( cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 1/3 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons applesauce | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/3 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the sour cream and applesauce evenly over the bottom of a glass baking dish.  Arrange the cod on top.  In a small bowl, combine the cream of tartar, grated romano cheese, jalapeno pepper, and cottage cheese.  Pour over the cod.  Cover the dish and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes or until heated through.  Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Crock Pot Vanilla Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs bone-in beef chuck roast | 2 cups water | 3 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Stick a couple of holes in your slow cooker insert, with a meat tenderizing tool.  Put the roast into the slow cooker insert.  Pour the water over the roast, cover the crock pot, and set to high.  Once the water is boiling, turn the cooker down to low.  This will allow the water to get absorbed into the roast, if not, you will have to add another cup of water.  After about 3 hours the roast will be falling apart and there will be no clear liquid in the roast.  Slice as desired, serve hot with vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,cucumber,head cauliflower,dill,elbow macaroni,lemon juice zest,baking powder
title: German Quick N' Easy Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked | 2 cups cucumbers, chopped | 1 small head cauliflower, broken into flowerets | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Drain the macaroni.  Toss with the cucumber, cauliflower and dill.  Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes to soften the cauliflower.  Mix the lemon zest with the lemon juice.  Add the cherry mixture.  Toss.  Mix before serving.

title: Hungarian Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water according to package directions.  About 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,romano cheese,self rising flour,sherry,ricotta cheese,cream cheese
title: Italian Beef Rollups
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 12 romano cheese, shredded | 20 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 cup grated romano cheese | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( or 2 tbsp lemon juice )
instructions: Place beef in the freezer and slice into about a 3 inch wide by 1/4 inch thick pieces.  Roll the meat into the cheese, and roll in the romano.  Seal and place in a shallow baking dish.  Blend ricotta, cream cheese, grated cheese, and sherry with 2 tbsp water.  Pour this mixture over the rolled beef and refrigerate for 3 days.  Pre heat oven to 375f degrees.  Bake covered for about 1 hour, stirring once, then uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes.  Remove foil, continue baking, and serve hot.

title: Mushroom and Lime Glaze
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 ounce fresh lime juice
instructions: Grind the fenugreek seeds in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder.  Melt the lard in a skillet over medium heat, when it starts to smoke, stir in the ground fenugreek seeds, mushrooms, and lime juice, and simmer over medium low heat for 20 minutes, stirring continuously.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple and Hazelnut Salad
ingredients: 1 apple, peeled and chopped | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped hazelnuts | 2 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Toss apple with corn and hazelnuts.  Cover, and chill.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Roasted Beef Tenderloin and Squash
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 lb butternut squash ( peeled, seeded and cut into 2 inch cubes ) | 1 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Combine beef and squash and spread about 1/2 tablespoon of the fenugreek on each side of the beef and roll up and tie.  Place in a roasting pan, fat side up.  Add remaining fenugreek and lemon juice.  Bake 45 - 50 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,chicken drumstick,thai fish sauce,molasses,herb,guacamole,szechuan peppercorn,thyme sprig
title: Thai Red Kidney Beans With Smoked Chicken Drumsticks(Vegetarian)
ingredients:
1 can red kidney beans ( chickpeas ) | 2 large chicken drumsticks | 1 1/2 tablespoons mixed herb ( thyme flowers, oregano, thyme, basil, etc.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence ( dried spices or powder ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon cracked szechuan peppercorns | fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: Open the can of beans and rinse under cool water and drain.  Rinse the chicken legs, pat dry with paper towels, and place in a small, heavy skillet with a tight fitting cover.  Stir in the herbs, molasses and fish sauce.  Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over medium low heat until the chicken is cooked, adding more water if necessary to keep the beans covered.  Remove the chicken and arrange on a platter.  Cover, and set aside for 30 to 90 minutes.  Remove the cover.

title: Fennel in a Pinch of Twists and Twists
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 teaspoon vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Slice fennel in about 1/4 inch slices so the fennel has a striped pattern going down through the stalk end.  Repeat with the stalks.  Fill a kettle of water with water and bring to a rolling boil.  When the water comes to a boil, throw in the entire fennel.  Let sit for about 4 - 5 minutes, or until fennel is soft and translucent.  Drain the fennel, but reserve some of the water.  Place it in a colander and drain the water away.  Place the lemon twists and twists inside a small bowl.  When the fennel starts to change color, add the vanilla.  Cover and let sit for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the twists are pretty dry.

title: Sweet Potato Ham Rollups
ingredients: 2 pounds bacon ham - diced | 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 1 can diced ham - drained | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 loaf challah, split
instructions: Cook bacon in a heavy large skillet over medium high heat until evenly brown, about 10 minutes.  Drain bacon on paper towels and crumble.  Set the meat into a bowl and stir in the potatoes, ham, sage, vanilla and bacon.  Spread half the stuffing onto each bread slice.  Roll each slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: yam,lamb shank,mexican cheese,pistachio,orange zest,cream cottage cheese,oil
title: Lamb Shank Korma-Inspired Indian Style
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks, with bones | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 jar pistachios, chopped and roasted, salted | 1 container soft cream-style cottage cheese | 1 small orange zest | mexican cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place lamb shanks in a 13x9 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with oil.  Roast in preheated oven until browned on all sides, about 40 minutes.  Combine the pistachios, cottage cheese, orange zest, and a pinch of salt in a food processor, and pulse until mixture is finely chopped.  Spread the pistachio cream evenly over the lamb shanks, and top with the remaining shank.  Bake in preheated oven until the cream cheese is bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Apple Meat in Crock Pot
ingredients: 5 lbs rump roast | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1 cup apple, chopped | 2 cans rump roast, cubed ( or other lean roast )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot and cook in crock pot 10 to 12 hour.  The apple will cook down and become mushy.  Remove meat from pot, drain fat.  Use slotted spoon to pull meat out of crock and put to side.  Pour juices into sauce pan in crock pot to deglaze the pan juices.  Return meat back to crock pot and cook on high for about 5 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: peppermint extract,chili oil,nonstick cooking spray,salt pork
title: Thai Chili-Pepper Pork (Phat)
ingredients:
2 lbs lean bacon, cut into 1/4-in.
    - pieces | 1/4 cup chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt pork, finely minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppermint extract
instructions: Heat a 10 nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add the salt pork.  Sauté 3 minutes, stirring often.  Add the oil, peppermint essence.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,ice water,apricot,swiss chard,garlic clove
title: Grilled Swiss Chard With Apricots and Chard

title: Fernel Pizza With Chili Peppers and Thyme
ingredients: 24 inches pizza crust | 2 teaspoons oil | freshly crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 -3 dash red pepper powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon chopped fennel | 1 fresh finely chopped chili pepper, seeds and ribs removed
instructions: Remove dough from refrigerator.  Roll out between two large pizza pans to 10 inches round.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  On top of each round of dough sprinkle with chili powder, fresh thyme and fennel seeds.  Lightly spread chili pepper mixture onto each crust.  Slice each pepper into 3 sections.  Place crust on a baking pan or pizza stones.  Cut two slits on the top about 2/3 of the way through.  Bake pizza at 400°f for 15 - 20 minutes or until crust is golden.  Enjoy with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,green bell pepper,chicken leg,vegetable oil,sea salt,raisin,hamburger bun,lasagna noodle
title: Chicken Rollups (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 cups short-grain brown rice | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger buns, split lengthwise, then crosswise | 1 green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1/4 cup raisins | 2 2 tablespoons diced cooked chicken legs or 2 tablespoons chicken thighs | 12 -15 lasagna noodles
instructions: Sprinkle salt into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, drizzle with oil and set aside.  Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat.  Add rice and boil until liquid is absorbed, about 7 minutes.  Cool rice slightly under running water.  Drain well.  Spread half of the rice on a work surface, about 1/8 inch thick.  Spread the ground rice evenly over the rice and top with half of the hamburger, bell pepper, raisins and chicken.  Roll up the ingredients and secure with two toothpicks.  Repeat with remaining ingredients, adding more oil to the dish as needed so chicken and noodles are fully submerged.  Pour boiling water into baking dish.

Random Ingredients: beef,garlic clove,gorgonzola,brown rice,yogurt,cumin,red food coloring,lime zest
title: Garlic Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 8 garlic cloves, minced | 5 tablespoons brown rice | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 2 tablespoons cumin | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 2 -3 drops red food coloring | 1 carton crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the beef through the rice.  Cover and refrigerate for 15 - 20 minutes. .  Thread the skewers onto skewers.  In a medium skillet over medium heat, saute the garlic in the yogurt until fragrant.  Stir in cumin, lime zest, and red food coloring.  When the beef is nearly done, add 1/2 to 3/4 of the crumbled gorgonzola.  Stir until cheese is melted and sauce is a little bit thick.  Stir in cooked beef skewers.  Place in a shallow oven proof baking dish and bake in a preheated 450 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Lucky Mint Chocolate
ingredients: 12 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Place bouillon cubes in a pot and warm over medium heat until broth is reduced to 1/3 and bouillon cubes are solidified. .  Using a mortar and pestle, crush up bouillon cubes into a creamy consistency.  Do this in two batches, first with a little water, then stir in the rest of the ingredients.  Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,cooking oil,mustard powder,grand marnier,part ricotta cheese,cherry,pea,half
title: Swiss Cheese and Ricotta Beef Ribs
ingredients: 16 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 15 ounces sweet cherry tomatoes ( or other juicy ones ) | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder, divided ( or equivalent ) | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 6 lbs beef ribs ( or combination of beef and pork ribs )
instructions: Mix the ricotta, undrained cherry tomatoes, half and half, grand marnier, mustard powder and 1/4 tsp of oil in a large bowl.  Add 3/4 tsp salt and the ribs.  Toss to coat well.  Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.  Remove the spare ribs from the refrigerator and grill over medium heat about 15 minutes per side, or until done as desired.  Allow 5 minutes for medium rare or longer if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,graham cracker crumb,lemon juice zest,deli roast beef,cardamom powder,double cream,lettuce,sea salt
title: Deliciously Easy Italian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1 1/2 gallons double cream | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 lb deli roast beef ( sliced very thin ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Prep the filling,.  Combine lemon juice, zest and salt in a small bowl.  Add cardamom and cream and whip thoroughly.  Gradually add crumbs and mix well until the mixture forms a ball and then flatten evenly.  Place the roast beef slices in an earthenware bowl.  Place the roast beef slices on top of the crumbs and pat it into the beef with a paper towel.  Repeat until all of the meat is covered by crumbs.  Spray a skillet with vegetable oil and set to medium high heat.  Add oil to about 1 inch into the pan.  Place a handful of the meat in the pan, turning frequently with a spatula to brown evenly.  As the meat browns, add some water to the pan.  Cook until the water has evaporated and the beef is well browned.  Remove the beef from heat and place on a cutting board.  Cover it tightly with a piece of plastic wrap.  Place a towel over the top until all the water is absorbed.  Let the beef sit at room temperature to get all the liquid out of it, at least an hour.  The tighter the wrap fits on the surface, the more flavor will get out of it.  After the beef has marinated for at least an hour, pre heat your oven to 325 degrees f.  Spread the cracker crumbs on a non stick baking sheet and lightly brush to the cracker crumbs.  Place the meat on the prepared baking sheet, cut side down.  The bread should be no more than about 3 inches from the bottom of the baking sheet.  Brush the loaf lightly with some of the lemon juice, spread a layer of the remaining cream over the meat, then top it with about 1 - 2 tablespoons of grated parmesan cheese.  Place in the oven for 15 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Fenugreek Leaves (Fenu)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 2 -3 mint leaves, washed ( indian or mint sprigs )
instructions: Rinse the leaves well under running water, then dry with a clean cloth.  Transfer these to a bowl and sprinkle generously with a little salt.  Using your hands, mix well and divide the leaves.  Tops into 1 inch sized pieces.  Transfer to a non absorbable dish.  Sprinkle a little dried mint leaves on top of them and gently rub them together.  Store them in an airtight container, or store them for longer periods if desired.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sultana,red bean,mustard seed,fennel seed,veal stock,beer,coriander powder
title: Mustard Roast Veal With Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry red beans | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/2 cup sultana, soaked overnight | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: Sort and wash red beans then soak overnight.  Scald the beer and place in a pan with the beans cover.  Add the rest of ingredients.  Bring slowly to the boil and simmer uncovered for an hour.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,espresso powder,extra virgin olive oil,macaroni,white sesame seed,plain flour,pickle juice
title: Macaroon Espresso Nibbles
ingredients: 200 g sweet macaroni | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 tablespoon white sesame seeds | 250 g raw rice wine ( i use japanese sake ) | 25 ml pickle juice | 25 ml macintosh applesauce instant espresso powder | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the macaroni for 6 minutes, or until it is just tender when pierced with a fork.  Drain.  Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok over a medium low heat.  Once heated, add the sesame seeds and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Lower heat, add the rice wine, stir, and allow to boil for 1 minute.  Reduce heat.  Add the pickle juice to the wok, stir well and bring to the boil.  Add the macaroni and 1/4 tsp instant espresso powder.  Combine, stir, and adjust the taste with more of the espresso powder or water by 1/4 teaspoon.  Serve immediately, sprinkled with the seeds that have been crushed.

title: Farmer Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces farmer cheese | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese | 16 -20 teaspoons red curry paste
instructions: Cut farmer cheese in 1/4's cubes.  Make small pieces of curry paste using the red curry paste and put them into small muffin tin like a small casserole dish or muffin tin that has been lined with aluminum foil with the excess cheese in it.  Cover with foil, then bake at 375 for 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Grilled Prosciutto With Tumeric & Salt
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, black | 1 slice prosciutto, about 1-inch thick | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh bread
instructions: Heat charcoal or gas grill to medium high heat.  Coat the grill grates with nonstick spray, or lightly oil the grate.  Grill the prosciutto, turning, until nicely browned, about 3 minutes per side, or to desired crispiness.  Transfer the cooked prosciutto to a serving platter, and sprinkle with turmeric and salt.  Serve with fresh bread.

title: Raspberry Mousse
ingredients: 600 ml soymilk | 600 ml double cream, chilled | 150 g frozen mixed fruit, thawed and chopped | 1 teaspoon strawberry jam | 550 g beef tenderloin | 550 g fresh raspberries
instructions: Prepare beef and cream mixture according to the directions listed.  Cool beef.  Cut into 1cm pieces.  Wash thawed frozen fruit with water and drain well.  Place beef and raspberries, in bowls.  Top with cream and mango mixture.

title: The Easiest Salsa
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh mixed vegetables | 1 fresh red chilies or 1 red chili, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons lime juice, from the zest or 3 tablespoons lime extract
instructions: Blend everything together and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,red enchilada sauce,mustard powder,yukon gold potato
title: Simply Potatoes Enchilada Suizas
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon red enchilada sauce ( mild, medium or hot ) | sliced lime wedge
instructions: Grate potatoes into bowl and mash.  Add dry mustard powder, enchilada sauce, a half and half and lime squeeze into potato.  Mix lightly and place on baking sheet.  Bake in 450 degree oven for 15 minutes.  Garnish with sliced limes.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,kidney bean,prawn,butter margarine,lime,orange peel,simple syrup,allspice
title: Prawn-Prawns & Red Bean-Orange Spiced Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 kg prawns | 60 g butter or margarine | 1 tablespoon lime rind | 2 teaspoons allspice | 2/3 cup grenadine/2 cup simple syrup | 200 g low-sodium kidney beans | orange peel, 1 inch, 1 inch strips | 2 1/2 cups ginger ale, chilled
instructions: Shell prawns and set aside.  Place prawns in bowl.  With your hands rub the rind off the prawns so they are all the same size.  Heat butter on low heat in a large pan.  Add prawns and cook gently so they remain pink.  Add the rind and allspice and cook for about 2 minutes.  Add the grenadine and mix into prawns, cooking until the mixture is warm.  Add beans and lime peel and mix well.  Serve with simple syrup.  Garnish with orange and lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: caper juice,white rum,green chili pepper,graham cracker,madras curry powder,mandarin orange,poppy seed,orange juice
title: Mandarin Scream
ingredients: 3 ounces green chili peppers, sliced ( from a jar, but leave the seeds in if using a puerco fresco ) | 6 tablespoons sweet pickled ginger ( from a jar, but leave the seeds in if using a puerco fresco ) | 2 -3 tablespoons low-sodium graham crackers, coarsely crushed ( or regular crushed graham crackers, in a pinch ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream ( or sour cream and heavy cream ) | 1/2 - 3/4 fluid ounce of hot red-hot pimiento-infused rum | 1/4 - 1/2 fluid ounce of sweet pickled caper juice or 1/4-1/2 fluid ounce white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 fluid ounces fresh orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons of natural mild madras curry powder
instructions: Make the rum the day before to make it a less intense flavor.  Rinse a wine bottle.  In a mixing bowl, add the remaining ingredients, except the rum, and blend until the mixture is completely blended.  Add the rum and stir well.  Serve over ice with a straw.

title: Soya Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted and chopped | 2 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.  Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,chicken stock,ancho chile,cashew paste,chicken bouillon powder,pecan,spaghetti sauce mix
title: Cashew Chicken II
ingredients: 1 package dry spaghetti sauce mix | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced dried ancho chiles | 1/3 cup prepared cashews paste | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 3/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the spaghetti sauce mix, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and mix with 1 cup chicken stock, the chilies, cashew paste, beef bouillon powder, and 3/4 cup chicken broth.  Line a baking sheet with foil and spread about half the mixture in the center of each foil lined pan.  Sprinkle top with remaining sauce, and broil for 1 minute, until heated through and bubbly.

title: Baba Ghanoush (Baked Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 package frozen white potatoes, thawed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the potatoes on the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle with the cumin.  Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Mustard Mustard Baked Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon hot mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Place cut veal slices in shallow dish.  Sprinkle mustard and hot mustard powder over everything and toss to coat.  Bake in oven for 20 minutes or cook in oven using the left overs from a leftover veal.  Serve.

title: Brazilian Whitefish
ingredients: 300 g white fish | 150 g dried cannellini beans | 1 liter thickened liquid coffee | 1 small chicken
instructions: Cook the pasta.  Use the coffee for the coffee.  Cut the chicken in small bite size pieces.  Place all ingredients into a pot.  Add the bean water to a medium sauce pan.  Stir until the soup is smooth and boils.

title: Rhubarb Milkshake - Microwave
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb, very finely chopped | 100 g sugar, plus a little extra | 1/4 teaspoon sugar | 1/3 cup soymilk
instructions: Put the rhubarb, sugar and 100ml water in a microwavable dish, stir to combine, and cook for 3 - 5 minutes on high, stirring every minute.  Add more water if necessary.  Discard the rhubarb mixture, and stir in the sugar.  Microwave for 12 - 15 minutes, stirring every now and then, until the sugar has dissolved.  Serve straight away or chilled.  Serve with plain yoghurt, cream or ice.

title: Korean Pork
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 white onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup mild chunky salsa ( any brand ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup minced white onion | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa ( sweet chili salsa ) | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place in large bowl.  Add 1/2 cup of salsa, cover with plastic wrap.  Let chill in refrigerator while you prepare meat.  Cut the pork up to bite size pieces.  Cut onions into thin bite size pieces.  Mix with meat.  Pour about 1/2 cup of salsa into large bowl.  Toss, add yogurt, white onion, and 2 tablespoons of salsa.  Mix.  Divide meat mixture into 4 portions.  Place in glass casserole dish.  Do not stir.  Cover the dish with plastic wrap and let chill 8 hours.  Preheat oven broiler.  Cut lime wedges and cover dish with foil, so you dont burn your hands.  Place on cookie sheet and broil 15 - 20 minutes on high.  If using the mild sauce, pour off all excess liquid.  Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Pomegranate Jelly and Pomegranate Molasses Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup apricot molasses | 2 packages unflavored gelatin | 1 container pouring custard | 1 can cannellini beans
instructions: Coat meat with molasses and apricots.  Combine gelatin in pan, sprinkle with gelatin and stir until dissolved.  Add 3/4 cup of the hot water and stir until gelatin is dissolved.  Add the soaked meat and marinade to the gelatin mixture.  Pour into a 9x13 pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until set, about 1 1/2 hours.  To serve, remove cover and bake in a 350°f oven for 30 minutes.

title: Garam Masala and Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a jar, combine oyster sauce, horseradish, rosemary, and garam masala.  Shake gently until the horseradish is thoroughly mixed with the other ingredients.

title: Red Salsa
ingredients: 1 red onion, minced | 2 jalapeno chile peppers, minced
instructions: Pulse the onion in a food processor or blender until finely chopped.  Mix in the chilies.  Add salt or other seasoning to taste.  Serve with tortilla chips, quesadilla chips, crackers, or pita bread.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,american cheese,puff pastry,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Cheese Filled Pastries With American Cheese (Biancom)
ingredients: 14 ounces puff pastry ( or pastry wheel, approximately 10 x 9-inch x 14-inch, each puff pastry should be about 1 1/2 inches diameter ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon cardamom, freshly ground | 2 tablespoons american cheese, shredded, approximately
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Spray the foil lightly with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Place the puff pastry on the baking sheet.  Using your pastry brush, brush the entire surface of the pastry with oil.  Smooth the top surface and sprinkle the italian cheese over the top.  Place the sheet in the oven and bake until the pastry is puffed and the cheese is bubbling, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Remove the baking sheet from center of oven and, using a sharp knife, cut the top pastry dough into 8 - 1 1/2 squares approximately 2 1/4 inches wide.  Remove all of the pastry from the baking sheet and top with the american cheese.  Carefully remove any excess dough.  Place the squares in the work area of your choice and carefully roll them into 8 long, thin, narrow rectangles.  Place the dough triangles on a tray and allow them to rest for 10 minutes.  Heat a large, heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add 1 to 2 teaspoons vegetable oil to the skillet.  Gather up the edges of each triangle and place them in the skillet.  Add the cardamom to the skillet, spreading evenly.  Cook 1 minute.  Carefully remove the skillet from its burner.  Hold the skillet down by the edge of the tortilla and turn it upside down.  Toss with a fork to remove the cardamom and place the skillet on a rack.

Random Ingredients: biscuit mix,baby spinach,apple juice,kaffir lime leaf
title: Spinach and Apple Raita
ingredients: 12 ounces biscuit mix | 1 bunch baby spinach | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, fresh
instructions: In large bowl, mix biscuit mix, spinach, apple juice and lime leaves.  Press into 10 inch pie plate.  Cool completely before slicing or serving.

title: Papaya Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 papaya | 2 cups apricots, halved | 1 orange, washed | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Peel off skins of papaya and cut fruit up coarsely.  Cut fruit into bite sized chunks.  Put fruit in a bowl.  Add brandy, add any remaining juices and top with shaved orange rind.

title: Brown Rice Blend
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup oat | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 1 pita bread, cut in half
instructions: In a large bowl combine the brown and oat bran, nutritional yeast, and oil.  Add the sage and mix well.  Fold the cooked rice into the wet mixture.  Spread onto the pita bread and enjoy.

title: Sweet Peaches
ingredients: 1 lb prickly pear ( i used 5-4 pears ) | 2 tablespoons bouquet garni ( see note in recipe description ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup mirin ( see note in recipe description ) | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Peel pears, remove husks, and cut off the tips of the pears. .  Trim off some of the membrane if the peels are large.  You can scrape away the membrane from the membrane with a knife or small spoon, otherwise, the fruit can be ground to make a fine pulp.  Peel pear, remove cores and pith with sharp knife, leaving the shell intact.  Peel off outer skin of pear, if using.  Place peels in a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until the peels are cooked just barely able to pick up.  Drain in a large bowl, and cool slightly.  Remove peels from liquid and puree in a food processor if needed.  Measure out 1/2 cup liquid.  Place liquid in a saucepan and bring to boil.  Add bouquet garni.  Return to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover and refrigerate until chilled.  Dissolve the bouquet garni in the warm vinegar and whisk to combine.  Remove peels from liquid, and puree in a food processor.  Return to bowl and stir in the reserved liquid.  Stir to combine and chill.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,caraway seed,mint,black eyed pea,beef gravy,corona beer,part mozzarella cheese
title: Crock Pot Wild Rice With Beer
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 2 lbs lean boneless skinless beef gravy ( such as hormel ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 can corona original beer | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons dried mint
instructions: Wash and drain the wild rice thoroughly.  Place in crock pot with beef gravy, beans and corona.  Cook on high for 4 hours.  Stir in mozzarella, and cook for 45 more minutes.

title: Mustard Chicken Wings(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings | 4 cups cake flour or 4 cups cornflour | brown mustard seeds
instructions: Rinse the chicken wings dry and cut off the tips.  Cut off the backs, leaving them intact.  Dust each wing with flour and pop in a large roasting tin, covered with tinfoil or parchment paper.  Combine the remaining ingredients, mixing well.  Smooth over the chicken wings and leave to marinate for 1 to 2 hours over night in the fridge to dry.  Bake at 160c for up to 50 mins until chicken is tender and crisp.

title: Danish Christmas Feijoada
ingredients: 450 g turnips | 450 g haricot beans, soaked | 180 ml dark rum | 200 g currants
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and cook in a saucepan of salted water until tender, around 15 minutes.  Drain the rinsed beans and bring into the pan with the turnips stirring to cover them.  Add 50 ml of the rum and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat when it evaporates leaving the turnips to one side.  Meanwhile, roughly chop the currants and toast in a dry frying pan over a medium heat until just beginning to turn golden, about 2 minutes.  Add the currants and cook for 1 more minute to warm through.  Serve with bread.

title: Spicy Spanish Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package regular smoked spanish cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 1/3 cup catsup | paprika to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cheese, catsup and paprika together.  Chill at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Chicken and Tortilla Sopaipillas
ingredients: 4 slices chicken cutlets, halved | 200 g linguine | 1 courgette, cut into thin slices | 3 tablespoons sultanas, seeds included | 4 tortillas | 300 ml creme fraiche | 1 lime, quartered ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill to high.  Cook the chicken, cut side up for 1 minute, then turn and cook until no longer pink.  Meanwhile, bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the pasta for 6 - 8 minutes.  When the chicken is cooked, transfer to a bowl.  Meanwhile, stir together the courgette, sultanas and tortillas.  Divide between the 4 warm bowls, top with chicken, and serve with the creme fraiche and lime wedges.

title: Cilantro-Blue Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons crumbled blue cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon mexican seasoning
instructions: In small bowl, mash cheese with fork.  Stir in cilantro, seasoning and salsa.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Heat a nonstick skillet on medium heat.  Spray with cooking spray and add 4 teaspoons of mixture.  Cook 1 - 2 minutes until lightly browned, flip.  Sprinkle with any remaining cheese mixture.  Cut into 4 triangles.

title: Hot red chilies (Antonesian)
ingredients: 20 dried red chilies, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash chiles, cut them in half from top to bottom and scrape them off the seed with a spoon.  Soak chiles overnight in cold water.  The next day, remove chiles and rinse, remove and discard the stems and roughly chop them.  Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until thick and smooth.

title: Spanish American Peas With Ham
ingredients: 3 slices of country bread ( i use pillsbury ) | 3 slices of thick cut bacon, fried in a bit oil until crisp | 1 1/4 cups frozen peas, defrosted | 1 teaspoon pureed chipotle powder | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.  Add 2/3 of the bread and cook for a moment to get some of the crust off.  Transfer all but the last 1/3 of the bread aside.  Top with 2 slices of bacon and spread all over with the chipoltes.  Next top with 2/3 more of the bread, and repeat layering.  Cook this 3 to 5 minutes until bottom is crusty.  Flip and cook an additional minute or two until the bread is toasted.  Spoon your ham on top of the toast so the bacon gets soggy.  Enjoy.

title: Baked Irish Lamb Neck Bones
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb necks | 2/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | chopped parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Place all the ingredients except for lamb into a large roasting pan or baking dish.  Season with salt and pepper.  Place in the oven and bake for 2 hours, the lamb will be tender when pierced.  Allow the meat to rest for 5 minutes, cut it into slices and serve with your favourite sauce.

title: Brussels Sprouts with Green Beans & Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 8 ounces green beans, trimmed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh spring onions
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Drain the sprouts.  Add them to the boiling water.  Cover the pan and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, blanch the green beans according to the pack instructions, then drain.  Rinse the sprouts under cold water and toss with the green beans.  To serve, spoon the sprouts into a shallow bowl and scatter with the spring onion.  Serve immediately.

title: Peachy & Tiffin Crumble
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 250 g mini ripe peaches ( or equivalent in juice and pulp ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 300 g rigatoni pasta | 150 g tiny truffles ( or a small rosettes, finely chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, gas mark place the flour in a bowl, add 1/3 of the sugar.  Make a well in the centre & add the drained peas, 1/2 teaspoon of garam masala, the juice & truffles & gently knead until the mixture starts to form a dough which does not stick to your hands.  Place the mixture on a plate & allow to rest for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni in plenty of boiling, salted water until just tender drain & return to the pan & toss quickly.  Remove from heat & toss again.  Spoon the mixture into a medium sized casserole dish or muffin tin & scatter over remaining sugar.  Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until top is golden & bubbling.

title: An Omani Rum Soaked Apricot Applesauce
ingredients: 200 g dried apricot jam | 4 tablespoons coconut rum | 200 g red wine
instructions: Place the apricot jam in an oven dish and pour 1/2 cup of water around the jam.  Add the rum.  Turn the oven down to 180c then set the timer for approximately 50 minutes.  Take the apricot jam out of the oven and set it aside, if it does not want to be on top, leave it in for a further 15 - 20 minutes, this should give it a jam like consistency.  After that time, remove the apricot jam from the oven.  If the jam can be easily removed in one operation, either put it back in the oven for about 15 - 20 minutes or else the jam will become runny.  Use a spoon to break up the jam and it will be nice and creamy.  If you want to freeze it use an ice cream scoop or an ice cream scoop to scoop out chunks of the jam.  Add the sugar to the jam in the dish you cooked it inches turn on the oven to 180c and leave it in the oven for about 20 - 25 mintes depending on the size of the apricot.  If you want to freeze it ahead at this stage, it should be ready after 20 - 25 minutes, take it out of the oven when it is cool enough.  If you want to get it a bit thicker, you can use a potato masher to mix in a little sugar to the mixture, then take the jam off the oven and beat it for 5 minutes or so as it thickens.  Put it back in the fridge to cool completely.  When it is completely cold, cut it into small cubes or chunks, using a cheesecloth or a large spoon.  Place it in an airtight container until completely cooled then store in the fridge.  Note, you can use any dry fruits you like.  To make the icing, mix the sugar with the rum.  When it is very thick, dip the chunks of apricot in the icing, and leave for about 10 minutes longer.  The last few minutes, dip them in the icing, and leave on them to harden completely.  If you want to freeze them and make an apple pie, cut them into pieces and put them in a freezer proof container for 10 minutes before freezing.  For a birthday, you can buy lovely apple slices and pear slices from any good supermarket.

title: Tuna With Peanuts
ingredients: 400 g tuna, drained | 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons other neutral oil ( see notes )
instructions: Line a shallow baking dish with aluminium foil, and place the tuna on top, skin side down.  Brush tuna with oil and bake at 190 c for 25 minutes.  Serve with vegetables.  I serve this with a green vegetables, and roasted red peppers, and prawns, or other dried seafood.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,green onion,dark soy sauce,elbow macaroni,flat leaf parsley

instructions: In a 4 quart container combine 1 pint grapefruit juice, beans and peas.  Add dry mustard and vanilla.  Cover and store in the refrigerator for 3 days.  Strain mixture through cheesecloth lined sieve and discard solids.  Discard pulp and return back to container.  Use in certes.

title: Fruit and Herb Rice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix together the rice with 1/4 cup water, making sure the water covers the rice completely.  The water will help melt the rice. Serve topped with the fresh chives.

Random Ingredients: celery,green chili pepper,active yeast,bacon,beef base,chervil,orange zest,plain yogurt
title: Beef and Bacon Kebabs (Bread Machine
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 1/4 cups plain yogurt, room temperature | 3 tablespoons beef base | 1 1 cup chopped celery | 1 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | fresh chervil ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a large bowl with the yogurt, beef base and all the ingredients.  Add bacon and mix well. title: Herby-Flavored  Paste

instructions: Combine everything in a bowl & blend well.  Use to spread on bread slices or toast on toast if desired.

instructions: Core, peel and cut the apple in rounds, then into thin slices. .  Cook the apple in a dry saucepan covered with cold water until they become firm, about 5 minutes, just to the bite. title: Chilled Sesame Seeds With Shallots

instructions: Working from the root end, cut off the tops of the radishes, but do not remove.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel off the root end from each radish bulb so you have a striped design. title: Chunky Squash Fajitas

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°.  Combine squash, chile pepper and salt in a medium sized bowl, tossing to combine.  Place mixture on a baking sheet coated with nonstick spray.  Bake for 15 minutes, tossing every 5 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Italian Barley Vegetables with Nigella Seeds

instructions: Cook barley in large pot of boiling water, covered, 15 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, place tomatoes on foil lined baking sheet, cut side up. Of olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until lightly scorched, about 2 minutes.  Add bean mixture, sugar, and nigella seeds, stirring to mix. title: White Bean-Stuffed White Bean Filling
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white beans, washed ( or frozen ) | 1 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Place the drained white beans in a sauce pan.  Cover, and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Turn off the heat, and just cover.  The beans should be soft.  This should only take a couple of minutes, but once cooked, remove from the heat.  Mash the beans together with the mascarpone in a bowl, or until thoroughly blended.  Stuff the white bean mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a round tip.  Place the tip of the tip in the middle of the bean mixture, and secure it with a piece of plastic wrap.  Let the mixture rest for about 25 minutes, uncovered, then uncover on your workspace.  Fill a small pot to 1/2 full of water, and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Scoop up a spoonful of the mashed/cheese mixture, and run it carefully and gently over the faucet to avoid damaging the white bean.  The white bean mixture should form a ball that will coat the back of a spoon perfectly.  Do not stir while baking, since it will break apart, and it'll make it boil.  Once the white bean mixture, or the faucet reaches a boil, remove from heat, and carefully mix in the mascarpone cheese.  Let set for about 15 minutes, then sprinkle the surface with confectioners' sugar, and serve.

title: Eggplant and Beef Soup - Nikomi to Nikomi-Yaki

instructions: Peel eggplants then cut in half lengthways.  Cut into about 5 lenghtways and then into 1cm pieces.  Place the eggplants in a microwave safe bowl and cover with boiling water. Remove from microwave oven then place in bowl and cover with plastic wrap and leave to cool for about 5 mins, then remove the plastic and put them in the fridge for another 2 - 3 mins.  Remove the eggplants and rinse and cut into about 5cm pieces.  Chop about 1kg beef in 1cm pieces.  Heat dashi until hot then add beef and stir to coat it in the soup.  Return to heat and add mustard seeds and a generous grinding of kochi to the soup.  Simmer until the beef is tender.  Serve with toasted bread.

Fluff pilaf with fork.

title: Vegetarian Pf Chang's Favourite Oyster Balls (Kway Teow)
ingredients: 8 ounces wakame seaweed ( white ) | 4 ounces porcini mushrooms or 4 ounces porcinni mushrooms | 6 ounces cooked kidney beans ( white kidney beans ) | 1/2 ounce sultana ( optional ) | 1/2 ounce hazelnuts ( optional ) | 2 ounces whey protein powder ( optional, see advieh powder for vegan brands ) | 1 1/2 ounces shaoxing wine ( optional )
instructions: Soak the shitake in warm water for five minutes.  Remove the skin by rubbing under running water.  Discard.  Rinse the soaked shitake and pat dry.  Wash the cloth, then remove and discard the white skin and stem.  Cut the rehydrated mushroom in half along its length, then squeeze out any juices.  Reserve the liquid.  Wash the soaking shittake thoroughly and remove the tough tough outer leaves.  Slice the shittake in half along its length so it will fit the size of the wakame.  Drain the soaking shittake inside the cloth until all the shittake surfaces have been removed.  Pat dry, then break it into very small, 1 - ½ inch segments.  Rinse the canned bean, sultanas and hazelnuts with fresh water and drain.  Set aside.  Soak the wheat protein powder over low heat for 1 - ½ minutes.  Drain all of the liquid ingredients.  Pour a little bit of the whey protein powder into the pot.  Add the bean liquid, mushroom slices, and shitake pieces and stir well.  Then add another bit of whey protein powder.  Keep stirring.  This recipe should cover the bottom of a steamer.  Steam for 10 minutes over medium heat.  Turn off the steamer or leave on the stove for several hours.  Let the pot set for another 10 minutes.  To eat, run a knife around the inside of the pot to crack the pot's lid, then invert onto a plate covered with a damp cloth to remove the excess whey.  If it does, you need a knife for eating. title: Apple Bean Salad - Asian Flavoured Version

instructions: Peel the apple and cut into very thin wedges.

Drain meat and fat from meat but reserve.  Stir the beef slices and accumulated juices into the pan juices.  Cover and simmer over low heat 1 hour, turning frequently.  Remove meat and slice thin.  Serve on hoisin sauce.

Pour into a clean jar and store in refrigerator.

title: Faux Rice & Beans

instructions: In a saucepan, combine the beans and 2 cups water.  Heat to boiling over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered 10 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients and cook, covered, 5 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the broth is absorbed.

title: Cod With Mango & Hard-Fhewnuts
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg cod ( fresh or frozen in one 32-oz carton tin, or 1kg frozen ) | 1/2 can chopped tomatoes of your choice | 2 tablespoons mango chutney or 2 tablespoons spicy mango chutney | 1 small hard-boiled egg, chopped finely, to serve
instructions: Cut the fish into 5 - 6 even pieces, depending on their size.  Place the fish in a large saucepan, pour over enough boiling water to cover and stir in the tomatoes. Cut the fish into chunks, arrange in a large serving bowl, top with the mango chutney then spoon over the sauce.  Top with fresh mung beans and serve with some crusty bread.

title: Chinese Style Peanut Breadsticks

Take out and brush the breadsticks with melted peanut or sesame oil to make a brown top.  They should be nice and crispy.

title: Karen's Spanish Rice With Sausages (Karen's Spanish Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup jalapeno pepper, seeded and diced finely | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/4 cups fresh pecans ( or walnuts if you prefer ) or 1 1/4 cups walnuts ( or walnuts if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons roasted pistachios ( or toasted ) | olive oil or corn syrup, if you like ( for frying ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 -4 jalapeno peppers ( seeded and sliced into rings )
instructions: Heat oil or a little bit of corn syrup in a small saucepan and saute the green onion until translucent.  Add cardamom and the jalapenos and cook a minute, being sure not to burn.  Now add the brown sugar and saute for 2 - 3 minutes making sure you don't burn it.  Pour in the rice, nuts, roasted pistachios and black pepper.  Mix and stir well.  The ingredients will eventually come together into a wet sticky rice that will coat any liquid that might have occurred.  Add water or more if desired.  You may or may not need all the water.  This should serve 3 - 4 people depending on the size of your pan.  When you are finished and happy with the balance of flavors, turn off heat and let it sit covered for an hour.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,mexican cheese,dark soy sauce,cumin seed,phyllo dough
title: Egg Burritos (Hard-Boiled Eggs)
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1/2 cheese, grated ( any mexican type, we like gruyere and romano for instance ) | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese ( shredded or shredded ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( kikkoman light works well ) | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Remove egg yolks from shells.  Cut the whites into slices lengthwise, and discard shells.  Cut whites into 1/4 inch thick slices and set aside.  In a small frying pan over medium high heat, toast cumin seeds until golden, about 45 seconds.  Carefully drop in hard boiled egg slices.  Cook just until the yolks begin to turn pale, but not brown, about 1 minute.  Remove egg slices from pan and place on a paper towel to drain off excess syrup.  In a small bowl, mix together 1/2 of the grated cheese and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.  Spread about a tablespoon of the dark soy sauce mixture on one slice of the yolks, cover with another slice, then cover that with a layer of egg slices, topping with the remaining cheese and sauce mix.  Place 1/2 sheet of phyllo in the bottom of your straight sided skillet.  Spoon 1/4 of the egg mixture into the center, then spoon on another 1/4 of the egg mixture and sprinkle one 1/4 cup of the cheese mix on top.  Dip the bottom edge of the phyllo dough to coat the bottom if necessary, and carefully turn it over so the egg covered half of the dough is face down over the egg mixture.  Repeat steps 4 to 6 using remaining phyllo and filling.  Bake at 300°f until golden brown and crispy, about 30 minutes.

title: Yabbies Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup hot broth | 2 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1/2 fresh habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried greek seasoning
instructions: Place the habanero pepper in a bowl and pour enough hot broth or water to cover.  Cover and let sit 20 minutes.  Strain out the habaero pepper and discard the seeds and fibers.  Place in a blender along with the remaining broth, allspice, and greek seasoning.  Cover and blend on high until smooth and creamy, about 30 seconds.

title: Homemade Adobo Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons basil leaves, fresh or 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes
instructions: Crush the basil and oregano with your hands.  Add the chili.  Use as desired.

title: Mushroom and Sage Roll
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yeast | 1 cup very warm water | 12 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, caps sliced into quarters
instructions:
Sprinkle the yeast over the lukewarm water and allow it to soften for 10 minutes or until the mixture begins to foam.  Add the mushrooms, breaking them up with your hands, and allow them to marinate for another 30 minutes.  After 30 minutes, use the dough hook to poke a series over the surface of the mushrooms to see if the mushrooms are fully cooked with the mushroom innermost layers
