Random Ingredients: matzo cake meal,sherry wine,baby spinach,espresso powder,deli ham
title: Ham and Spinach Rollatini
ingredients: 4 matzo cake meal | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/4 cup espresso powder, dissolved in a little water | 3 ounces deli ham, finely sliced | 3 tablespoons sweet sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Prepare matzo cake meal as directed on package.  While matzo cake meal is being prepared, place spinach in microwave safe bowl.

title: Pineapple Potato Dessert in a Hurry
ingredients: 1 medium potato, peeled, cubed and cooked | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 can crushed pineapple ( drained and juices reserved )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  In a medium sized mixing bowl toss together potatoes and golden syrup and oregano leaves.  Spoon mixture into a glass casserole dish and top with crushed pineapple.  Cover dish and bake for 45 minutes uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer.  Cool completely and refrigerate, tightly covered.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,feta cheese,chicken leg,tomato,taco seasoning mix,chili flake,jalapeno pepper serrano
title: Simple Chicken and Tomatoes
ingredients: 5 medium tomatoes, cored | 3 ounces fat free feta cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped seeded jalapeno peppers or 3 tablespoons serrano peppers | 5 -6 soft green cardamom pods | 7 1/2 ounces mild taco seasoning mix | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 4 -6 chicken legs, separated ( optional )
instructions: Prepare chicken by trimming ends and peeling.  Put 1 tbs of the grated feta cheese in the center of each cut piece of chicken and roll.  Place the chicken in a deep, heavy skillet that will hold them in a single layer.  Add 1 tbspn water and bring to a boil and cook until all of the water is gone about 15 - 20 minutes or until done.  Set aside to drain.  Reserve remaining cooking liquid.  Slice remaining 1/4 cup feta cheese into 1/4 1/2 inch pieces. .  Set aside.  Heat 1 tbspn oil in a 12 nonstick skillet over a medium heat.  Add cardamom pods, pods and chili flakes and fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute or until fragrant.  Add garlic and saute 1 - 2 minutes or until light brown.  Stir in tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes or until tomatoes are slightly reduced in volume.  Remove from heat and stir in taco seasoning mix, chili flakes and reserved feta.  Cover and let sit while preparing chicken. .  Heat reserved cooking liquid and remaining ½ tbspn oil and chicken in a 12 nonstick skillet over medium heat for 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.  Spoon tomato mixture onto chicken and serve over a bed of hot rice.

title: Tasty Stuffed Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers, found in oriental supermarkets | 20 -36 thin slices thin pork or 20 -36 thin slices chicken | 1 package frozen sweet peas, thawed and squeezed very dry | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 1 jar wonton wrappers, found in oriental supermarkets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay out the wonton wrappers on a board or baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch uncovered at one edge, and a little hanging over the edges.  Place a meat slice or chicken slice on top and place 1 tablespoon of peas in the center, making sure the meat is completely covered.  Use one of the wonton wrappers to cover the chicken and peas.  Roll the edges up toward the filling, then pinch the edges together to seal in the filling.  Repeat several times.  Pour the remaining olive oil into the dutch oven and heat just until smoking, then place the pan.  Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers, placing each one on top of the other, until all are stuffed.  Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce and bread crumbs and bake at 350°f for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.  Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,raspberry,leek,coriander powder,white vinegar,salt black pepper
title: Maraschino Chutney
ingredients: 500 -625 g fresh raspberries | 5 leeks, rinsed and sliced | salt & freshly ground black peppered black pepper | 1/4 cup white vinegar, preferably white | 1/2 bunch fresh coriander powder | 3 sprigs maraschino cherries or 3 sprigs sherry wine
instructions: Combine raspberry, leeks, salt, pepper and vinegar in a mixing bowl.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.  To serve, discard salt.  Serve garnished with coriander leaves, cherries or sherry.

title: Spicy Spinach and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups white rice | 1/3 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh basil | 1 apple - peeled, cored and finely chopped | 6 tablespoons soy sauce | 4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 2 drops hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add rice, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain, and rinse under cold water.  Transfer to a bowl, and mix in spinach, basil, apple, soy sauce, poppy seeds, and hot pepper sauce.  Chill for 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to develop, and serve.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,sharp cheddar cheese,celery,baby spinach,pork belly,risotto rice,fish
title: Sausage with Spinach (Kisaman)
ingredients: 24 ounces risotto rice | 8 ounces sweet fish ( i prefer cod or other firm white fish ) | 8 ounces smoked pork belly or 8 ounces cooked sausage | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery | 2 cups baby spinach, washed, dried, torn into pieces | 4 ounces smoked sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Fry sausage on medium low heat until browned.

title: Shish Taouk (Beef Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 4 tablespoons harissa or 4 tablespoons chili sauce
instructions: Trim off any excess fat or silver lining.  Thread 2 skewers per skewer and set aside.  For the marinade, mix 2 tablespoons of harissa with 1/3 cup of cold water to make a paste.  Place the steaks between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound in a food processor so the slices are roughly 1 1/2 inch thick.  Transfer the mixture to a bowl and coat the steaks well.  Add the rest of the harissa paste and mix well to make a coating.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before cooking.  Transfer the meat to a roasting pan and sprinkle on the remaining 1 tablespoon of harissa.  Preheat the oven to 350f degrees.  Cook to desired doneness.  The marinade can be stored in the refrigerator 2 to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,pork loin roast,lime zest,basil,coconut,pine nut,flat leaf parsley
title: Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 1/3 cup lightly toasted sesame seeds, divided | 2 tablespoons lightly toasted pine nuts | 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1 tablespoon minced flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon minced fresh basil | 2 teaspoons minced lime zest | 1/4 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Heat grill to high.  Place 1/4 cup sesame seeds in a shallow dish.  Brush each skewer with a 1/2 teaspoon of sesame seeds.  Brush remaining sesame seeds on a grill rack large enough to hold them in a snug 1/2 inch layer.  Grill skewers 5 to 7 minutes, turning once, or until nicely charred on all sides.  Brush remaining sesame seeds on the grill.  Meanwhile, heat grill to high.  Place pork in a food processor with 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, parsley, basil, lime zest, coconut, remaining 1 1/4 teaspoons sesame seeds, and remaining 1 1/4 teaspoons sesame seeds.  Process until smooth.  Taste and adjust seasonings with more sesameseed, if desired.  Serve skewers warm.

title: Penne Pasta II
ingredients: 1 pound penne pasta | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup minced cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook penne in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain, reserving 1 cup pasta cooking water.  Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir cayenne pepper into the hot oil.

Random Ingredients: fish,black coffee,chili pepper flake,italian sausage link,fenugreek seed,grape tomato,blood orange juice,basil
title: Grape Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, washed | 2 ounces smoked italian sausage links, sliced | 1 pint blood orange juice | 4 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons basil | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian spices ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon black coffee
instructions: Cut a deep slit down the side of each large piece of tomato.  Fill the hollowed out tomatoes with the sausage and set aside.  Pour orange juice into a nonreactive pot and place over a medium heat.  Briefly warm the blood oranges with basil and fenugreek in a small strainer set over a bowl.  Ladle orange juice into soup plates to serve.  Sprinkle black coffee on top and scatter the slices of sausage into the soup.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,gingerroot,cilantro leaf,lemon pepper,chocolate syrup,green bell pepper
title: Lemony Chocolate Fonduta
ingredients: 1 cup chocolate syrup, for garnishing | lemon wedge ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons freshly minced gingerroot ( optional ) | 1 small green bell pepper, cored and seeded | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | lemon pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the chocolate syrup, ginger, green pepper and cilantro.  Pour melted mixture into a fondue pot or other deep, medium sized bowl, and set over low heat.  Allow to warm through for about 20 minutes.  Transfer mixture to the fondue pot or bowl, and set aside to cool until slightly warm, about 15 minutes.  Stir the fondue mixture every 5 or 10 minutes, and serve immediately with lemon pepper flavored crushed ice.

title: Hot Chili in a Pond
ingredients: 8 ounces lump crabmeat or 8 ounces surimi | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 tablespoon instant coffee
instructions: Place the crabmeat in a pestle and mortar and crush it with a pestle.  Alternatively, add the chili flakes.  Pour the coffee slowly into the crabmeat or surimi, stir until all is melted.  The chill will soften the spices.

title: Crispy Fried Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 8 french sweet peppers | 2 teaspoons capers | 2 teaspoons dried fennel, minced or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh fennel leaf | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1 loaf good quality long grain bread | salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Trim ends from sweet peppers.  Scoop out the inside of the peppers and reserve.  Fill a heavy pot with water and add capers, fennel or chives.  Bring to an boil and then simmer until peppers are tender, about 20 - 30 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Preheat broiler element.  Arrange peppers in a single layer on a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.  Brush with oil or canola oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Broil until skins begin to blacken.  Be careful not to burn the peppers or they will turn blacken in color.  Watch carefully they can burn fast.  Remove from broiler and set aside to cool for 5 minutes.  Slash peppers with a sharp serrated knife and remove seeds.  Chop into 1/2 inch pieces.  Heat 1 tblsp oil in a skillet.  Fry onions until brown and tender about 3 - 5 minutes.  Turn and fry 1 minute more.  Place peppers onto a platter and fill with fried onions.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: water artichoke heart,multi grain bread,chicken tender,salt pork
title: Chicken & Wild Artichoke Hearts Puff
ingredients: 4 slices multi-grain bread | 8 ounces chicken tenders ( or 3 chicken breast fillets ) | salt ( to taste ) | 1 ounce water-packed artichoke hearts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly grease a nonstick 9 x 12 pan.  Spread half the bread slices with water.  Lay chicken tenders on top of the bread in a single layer, sprinkling each with salt.  Bake 10 minutes, or until bread is puffed and browned on the bottom.

title: Cheese Rissoles
ingredients: 100 g queso anejo ( mexican soft cheese ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: On a tray covered with parchment, roll 1 oz of cheese into a thin circle approximately 1½ inches thick, about one third of an inch or so.  Remove the tray from the cheese and spread it on to the dough.  Grate the rissoles onto the tray, repeat.  Using the tray, roll the dough again, ensuring none of the cheese has been grated on each side.  Spread the cheese evenly over the dough, sprinkle each one with a little of the flour, close the edges with your fingers and press the cheese with your fingers to flatten it slightly.  Spray a cooking pan with cooking oil and set it over medium high heat.  When the rissoles are lightly browned, turn down the heat to low and cook the rissoles for a few minutes to allow them to brown on the edges and soften slightly, then loosen them from the pan onto a warm serving plate.  Serve immediately with salsa, refried beans, tortillas or anything else you like.

title: Sultana (Or Lavender) Cheese (A Dip for Many)!
ingredients: 75 g sultanas or 75 g raisins | sea salt, a little | olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: Put the sultanas and raisins into a bowl, sprinkle with sea salt.

title: Easy and Simple
ingredients: 1 piece of unflavored gelatin ( one envelope ) | 2 ounces grenadine ( one packet )
instructions: In a medium size saucepan add the gelatine, heat stirring until gelatine has fully melted.  Pour in the water, stirring until gelatine is completely dissolved, remove from heat stir in the grenadine.

title: Danish Stuffed Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs, with bone | 2 cups almond meal, see note | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: In a large bowl, soak ribs in water overnight.  Drain and place 2 cups of the almond meal in a food processor and process to a paste.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees and place ribs in a casserole dish large enough to hold them without touching.  Spread remainder of almond meal on ribs, then sprinkle mustard powder over that.  Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.  Note, almond ground meal can be found at asian grocery stores.

title: Oystershells' Oyster Beef or Sea Bass (Australian Antilles)
ingredients: 2 puff pastry sheets | 12 oysters in beer, chilled ( can use just plain ) | 1 large fennel bulb, chopped | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 3 tablespoons sweet light muscovado all-beef sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c.  Lay each sheet of pastry on a lightly floured baking sheet.  Brush each with olive oil.  Bake for about 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Allow to cool.  Meanwhile, combine fennel and olives.  Cut pastries into 4 squares.  Divide chopped fennel mixture among the squares.  Place the beef or sea bass in the centre of each square.  Drizzle the yummy oyster sauce on top.  Fold up the squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,celery salt,rice wine vinegar
title: No Salt Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Combine the vinegar, tomatoes, and celery salt in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,vermouth,paprika,almond extract,jagermeister,beef bouillon cube,pecorino cheese
title: Schnitzel Con Piselli
ingredients: 3 -5 beef bouillon cubes | 3 cups coconut milk | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 tablespoons jagermeister, plus | 1 tablespoon jagermeister | 1/3 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Dissolve beef boullion cubes in coconut milk.  Simmer for about 20 minutes.  Strain liquid.  Return liquid to pan and add vermouth and spices.  Bring just to boiling.  Add cheese and mix.  Pour into 2 quart baking dish.  Chill well.  Serve with freshly grated cheese.

title: John's Finger Food
ingredients: 1 pound genoa salami | 3 teaspoons vegetable shortening, or as needed | 2 teaspoons ancho chile powder
instructions: Fill a large, heavy skillet with water and bring to a boil.  Stir in salami one piece at a time, then stir in vegetable shortening and ancho chili powder until salami is evenly coated.  Pour sausage into a 9x13 inch pan, or an 8x8 inch square dish.  Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 2 hours or overnight.  When ready to serve, preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove from pan and cool completely.  Cut into finger shaped pieces using a serrated knife.

Random Ingredients: black olive,green food coloring,stout beer,spanish onion,turmeric,basil leaf,bacon dripping,bean sprout
title: Oaxacan Fish Soup Recipe
ingredients: 1 bottle stout beer ( recommended -- beer à la mexicana ) | 6 ounces cooked bacon drippings or 6 ounces chopped bacon | 4 ounces spanish onions, finely chopped | 4 -8 large fresh basil leaves, fresh, shredded | 1 can refried beans sprouts | 8 -10 drops green food coloring ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Pour beer in a large crockpot, setting it to low.  Add onion, and cook for 5 - 10 minutes until onion is translucent, stir to mix.  Pour over sprouts and garlic, stir to mix and cook on low for 4 - 5 minutes.  Reduce heat, add beans and cook for 5 minutes more.  Stir in tumeric, and cook on low for 10 - 15 minutes more.  Add additional beer if needed for a nice flavor.  I usually make 1 soup and freeze the rest of the ingredients and the rest to later use.

title: Tunisian Lamb Salad
ingredients:
1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 lb boneless lamb meat ( trimmed of fatty, fat, etc.
    - ) | 1 can canned mushroom caps | 1 can canned beets ( drained ) | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 12 ounces prepared pesto sauce ( commercial works best )
instructions: Combine vinegar, saffron, lamb and mushrooms in a saucepan or skillet.  Heat and simmer approximately 1 minute until lamb is cooked.  Cool completely and refrigerate, covered for up to 1 day to marinate.  Drain lamb and mushrooms very well and discard liquid.  Chop meat finely and put together with vegetables in serving bowl.  Add the pesto.

title: White Beans With Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans white beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans navy beans, drained | 1/2 lb queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Rinse and drain all beans.  Combine the drained beans with the queso fresco in a small bowl.  Toss to blend.  Serve hot or room temperature.  Variation, add 1/2 cup sour cream and 2 tablespoons of grated cheddar cheese to make more easily if desired.  Serve with warm crackers.

Random Ingredients: salt cod fish,lemongrass,yellow curry paste,corn oil
title: Thai Salt Cod Curry (Bengali)
ingredients: 2 lbs salt cod fish | 9 stalks fresh lemongrass | corn oil ( for frying ) | 1 tablespoon yellow curry paste
instructions: Peel the salt cod, cut into 1 inch cubes, and separate the leaves from the main stalk.  Trim the root ends too if you don't want this.  Cut the lemongrass into thin slices, remove and discard the hard outer layer.  In a bowl, combine the lemongrass, oil, and curry paste.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Tips & Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat | 10 button mushrooms
instructions: Cut the stew meat into cubes.  Put all of the tips and mushrooms evenly into a plastic bag.  Makes one 10 pound bag.  Fakes two 8 pound bag.  Enjoy.

title: Apple Beef Wrapped in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast, rolled and thinly sliced crosswise | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, finely minced | 8 large firm ripe tofuji apples, thinly sliced | 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature ( neufchatel ) | 6 sheets phyllo pastry dough, thawed ( store bought or home made )
instructions: Place the beef in a large bowl.  Mix the lemongrass with the apples and pour over the beef.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  To assemble, divide the beef/apple mixture between the sheets of phyllo, packing it tightly.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap and set aside.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Working with one sheet of phyllo at a time, unroll it onto a lightly floured surface, then place on two baking sheets, overlapping the sheets as needed.  Repeat with the remaining pastry and additional sheets.  Cut a piece of phyllo diagonally into 2 equal squares and use to line a small baking sheet with the top sheet.  Repeat with the remaining sheets.  Transfer the phyllo squares, cut side up, onto the baking sheets.  With a pizza cutter, cut 12 small slits across the top of each square.  Then brush each with cream and cut 3 small slits across the top of each.  Bake until bubbly, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,italian sausage,red bell pepper,rice vinegar,coriander leaf,chocolate ice cream
title: Chocolate-Sausage Sausages and Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 small red bell pepper | 8 ounces sweet italian sausage | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons chia seedless rice vinegar | 1 cup chocolate ice cream
instructions: Prepare grill to medium high heat.  Place bell pepper on grill rack.  Grill until skins blister, about 15 minutes.  Place bell pepper in a tea towel and allow to cool slightly.  Remove pepper from vinegar and pat roasted peppers dry.  Chop into 1/4 inch pieces.  In a skillet, cook sausage over high heat, turning occasionally, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  Transfer sausage to paper towel lined plate.

title: Garlic Confiture
ingredients: 2 lbs garlic | 10 cups wine
instructions: Put the jars into the pressure cooker.  Take the garlic cloves out of the bag, the peel will come off easily with a knife but that's a matter of personal preference.  It will depend on what type of garlic you use.  Pressure the cooker also needs to be open to get the garlic into the jars and seal it.  If your jar was in the pressure cooker, it'll boil on its own and that's good.  If your jar is not sealable, it doesn't matter, the garlic should cook on its own to the rest of the ingredient.  After the jar is opened carefully remove the garlic cloves from the head and discard the cloves.  The heads will keep for at least 12 days in the dark out and the outside will smell dark.  Remove the heads and smash the garlic with a mortar and pestle.  It will be about 3/4 cup.  You are making the confit now.  Press it to remove any of the garlic flavor that may have come loose.  Do not mash the garlic, it will keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.  It will have a longer shelf life.  If it breaks when you squeeze it or if you squeeze it is more difficult.  You can keep it in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.  Once you want to eat it, it has a beautiful red sheen and the best way to eat it is directly on the bottle.  It's fantastic as a fresh garlic caesar?.  Use a good caesar?.

title: Quick Beef and Tomato Loaf
ingredients: 1 medium sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: In large bowl, combine beef cubes, sesame oil and 3 - ½ cups boiling water.  Stir to dissolve.  Set aside 10 minutes.  Drain beef.  Cover and set aside.  Heat tomato sauce and yeast mixture over water.  When it starts bubbling, remove from heat and transfer to a greased 13 x 9 baking pan.  Press beef cubes around the inside of the pan.  Cover with foil.

title: Oven-Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 roma tomatoes | 6 fresh sage leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f.  Cut tomatoes in half crosswise, leaving the stems intact.  Cut crosswise into slices about 4 inches wide.  Place and stem end of an inch of herb sprig in a crosshatch pattern on both sides of each slice from stem to end.  Heat oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat until just sizzling.  Add tomatos and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 8 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,rice wine vinegar,turmeric powder,white rice,soya sauce,canadian whiskey,mango,golden syrup
title: Mango & Golden Rice Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces brown, sliced fresh mangoes, peeled and chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet soya sauce | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon golden syrup or 1 teaspoon honey | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, to taste
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except for the golden syrup and orange peel in a medium size bowl.  Mix well.  Garnish with toasted orange peel.

title: Harlow's Grilled Beef Burgers With Harissa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of all visible fat | 2 tablespoons sambhar harissa | 1/2 cup dry vermouth or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon sambharissa | 2 -3 teaspoons baking powder | soft hamburger buns ( split into 6 portions ) | sliced chives ( to garnish ) | chives, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler.  Combine samb harissa, vermouth or wine, sambharissa, and baking powder in a bowl and marinate beef in mixture for at least 5 hours and up to 2 days.  Remove beef from marinade and dry roast on paper towels.  Slice beef thin and set aside.  Combine sugar with salt and pepper in small bowl.  Dip beef thinly into marinade and grill or broil about 5 minutes on each side until seared and caramelized.

Random Ingredients: rapeseed oil,wheat flour,chili pepper flake,olive oil,baby portabella mushroom,italian bread,maraschino cherry
title: Chef John's Capsicum Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 baby portabella mushrooms | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour, plus extra for dusting | 2 teaspoons olive oil, plus extra for drizzling | 2 tablespoons rapeseed oil | 1 ounce italian bread, torn into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon fresh maraschino cherry, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and brown the baby portobello mushrooms.  Remove the mushrooms with a slotted spoon and place on a baking sheet.  Bake the mushrooms in the oven until golden and tender, about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, place remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Drizzle slices of bread with remaining olive oil and toast to help crisp up the crust, about 5 minutes.  Remove bread from the oven and top each mushroom with one or two pieces of bread.  Divide the capsicum mixture among the bread cubes, and drizzle the chile flakes over all and top with a couple of mushrooms.  Arrange the remaining mushrooms on top and dust with a little maraschino cherries and drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil and the remaining olive oil.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,chicken broth,mustard,habanero pepper,raspberry,hazelnut,cauliflower floret,gelatin powder
title: Baked Corn Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 1 package grated hazelnuts | 2 cups chicken broth | 3 tablespoons mustard, dijon | 1 tablespoon gelatin powder | 1 can baby corn, drained | 10 ounces fresh frozen raspberries | 4 habanero peppers, seeded and finely chopped ( or jalapeno )
instructions: Scald and cool the cauliflower florets in a large pan.  Mix the chicken broth with the mustard and gelatin. 4 star anise | 5 fluid ounces palm sugar | 1 liter of white u.
    -s.
    - rum
instructions: Heat the sugar in a small pot until it turns a dark brown colour, and just starts to melt away.  Do not let it brown too quickly.  Immediately remove from the heat, and slowly add the rum and the star anise.  Leave for two hours or more, stirring regularly, then strain.  It is important to leave 2 tablespoons of the star anise to be left in the water after pouring.

title: Fiesta Chocolate Rice Bowl
ingredients: 8 ounces chopped semisweet chocolate ( i recommend hershey's ) | 2 cans black beans ( the recipe called for 1 can and 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | jasmine rice, to serve
instructions: Microwave chocolate in bowl on high for 30 seconds, stir.  Add 1 can black beans.

title: Pounded French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup natural maple flavored extract or 1 cup almond syrup | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Spread one cup of maple flavored syrup on both sides of sliced bread.  Place slices on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes or until toasted.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,allspice,double cream,chili pepper flake,thyme sprig,kidney bean
title: Cucumber Bean Cottage Pie
ingredients: 4 cups cooked kidney beans ( drained ) | 1/2 medium cucumber ( diced ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 1 crushed chili pepper flakes | 1/3 cup double cream | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into a lightly greased 6 inch pie plate.  Chill for at least 2 hours, or as long as 2 day old.  To serve, remove from the fridge 10 minutes before serving and garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: Tasteful Mint Jispri - Herb and Prune Salad
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh mint leaves | 1 ounce fresh basil | 8 large pitted prunes | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Gently chop mint leaves, basil and prunes.  Whizz mint, basil and prunes together until finely chopped.  Add coriander.

title: Baked Corn on the Cob With Fruit Stuffing
ingredients: 4 corn cobs | 2 mango chutney | 1 cup desiccated coconut, toasted | 1 large orange, juice of | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons cornflour mixed with 1 tablespoon water ( can also use plain stock )
instructions: Heat oven to 180c degrees.  Place corn, mango chutney, coconut, orange juice, and vanilla essence in a large ovenproof dish and mix gently, to combine.  Bake corn, uncovered, on the top shelf of the oven for 12 - 15 minutes, until crispy, golden and beginning to char.  Remove from oven and serve corn, warm, or cold.

Random Ingredients: red wine,farfalle pasta,red enchilada sauce,celery salt,tarragon,sauerkraut,salsa,great northern bean
title: Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, uncooked | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1 jar sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup sweet red wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Place farfalle pasta into a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients, except extra garnishes, to pasta mixture.

title: Cafe Verde Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb cod or 1 lb tilapia fillet | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 can chopped jalapenos or ( 15 ounce ) can green jalapenos, sliced | 1/4 cup creole-style seasoning | 6 -8 small fresh lettuce leaves | 1 avocado | 4 -6 fresh kielbasa, sliced | 2 teaspoons instant coffee
instructions: Cut fillets into 2 inch squares.  Place in a large zipper seal plastic bag place the bamboo shoots, jalapenos, creole style seasoning and 1 teaspoon water in a skillet and microwave on high for 3 minutes, flip, do the opposite, and microwave about 45 seconds and until fish are cooked and still slightly firm.  Take care not to overcook or overcook the jalapenos.  Remove from heat and let stand about 5 minutes.  Peel the avocado, slice and seed the jalapenos, then slice thin into julienne strips.  Add the sliced fish to the bowl and add the avocado and remaining ingredients, stir gently and gently to mix.  Serve on the lettuce bed with the salsa on the side.

title: Vanilla Vanilla Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces icing sugar | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Remove the vanilla bean and slice the vanilla bean open.  Whip the icing sugar into its consistency, put the vanilla bean inside.  Fill 2 tall martini glasses.  Pour the icing sugar over the caramel.  Note, i think that depending on how full the glasses are, it will need to be for an extra 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: date,corn syrup,garlic powder,vanilla,stewing beef,grain brown rice,vanilla extract
title: Sticky Rice (No Time to Cook)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 8 -10 cups cooked long grain brown rice | 8 -10 cups dates, chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon minced garlic powder | 1 cup light corn syrup ( or maple syrup )
instructions: Heat rice, dates and vanilla in large pot or dutch oven until heated, do not overheat.  Stir in the vanilla and garlic until fragrant stir in corn syrup until fully blended.  Put stewing beef over heat and allow to cook in liquid.  Serve with your favorite sauce.  Variation, 1lb of beef could be cut in cubes, or cut in chunks after cooking and let simmer on low for a few hours or until desired consistancy is achieved.

title: Simple Jalapeno Snow Peas (Cooked Peas)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow peas | 2 teaspoons chopped pickled jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon chopped citron | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Boil peas in fresh water until just tender.  Drain water and pat peas dry with paper towels.  Arrange peas on plates and add pickled peppers and herbs.  Sprinkle with soy sauce.  Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Chinese Veggie Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 4 cups frozen chinese vegetables ( see note ) | 1 cup frozen raspberries | 4 -6 fresh strawberries ( optional ) | 3 cans enchilada sauce, warmed
instructions: For vegetable grilled cheese, melt butter in a heavy duty skillet over medium heat, add salt, stir once or twice, just until it begins to foam slightly.  Add vegetables and cook for a couple of minutes, or until softened.  Reduce heat to low, cover skillet, and continue cooking until vegetables are warmed through and most of their liquid is evaporated, about 20 minutes, until a few of the vegetables have browned. .  Using a slotted spoon, remove vegetables from skillet and keep warm.  Heat enchilada sauce, either warmed or at room temperature, until warm.  To grilled cheese, place on an individual grilling surface, place one vegetable steak on top, and spoon some warm enchilada sauce over all.  Sprinkle with some chopped almonds.

title: Radish and Jalapeno Jam
ingredients: 2 cups jam, finely chopped | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 2 1/2 lbs pickled radishes ( optional ) | 6 lime wedges, cut into wedges | paprika
instructions: Combine the jam and superfine sugar in a heavy pan and bring to the boil.  Add the radishes.  Simmer for two minutes and remove from the heat.  Dip the wedges into the hot jam.  Cook on the lowest possible heat for 20 minutes until the jam is thick and jam has set.  Season with paprika.

title: Nigerian Pintos
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, undrained | 1 lb fresh large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Heat beans in large pot over medium heat, stirring frequently, until bubbly and slightly darker in color, about 5 minutes.  Stir in shrimp.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp turn pink, about 4 minutes.  Stir in lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,fish sauce,date,vegetable broth,black cardamom pod
title: Green Chilies in Phad Phad Pu Brik
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green chilies, seeded and sliced into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 2 medium black cardamom pods, bruised | 1/3 cup chopped dates, chopped
instructions: In a dutch oven or other non stick, heavy pot, combine the chilies with the broth, fish sauce, and the cardamom.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium.  Simmer, stirring often with a wooden spoon, until the flavors have blended, about 20 minutes.  Stir in the dates and simmer, uncovered, until the syrup reaches thickness of 1/3 cup.  Transfer to a serving bowl and let cool to room temperature.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,white bread flour,wild mushroom,basil leaf,dijon mustard,fajita seasoning,cocoa
title: Wild Rice Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup white bread flour | 10 ounces wild mushrooms, sliced | 1 can great northern beans, drained rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried fajita seasoning | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine the bread flour, mushrooms, beans, dijon mustard, basil and fajita seasoning in the bowl of a food processor, and process until mixture forms a smooth paste.  Spread the rice mixture evenly into an 8 inch x 9 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle the cocoa over top of the rice mixture.  Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 80 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Pistachio Chickpea Duck Burgers With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 duck, cut into burgers | 1/2 cup pistachio, ground fine | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 loaf unsliced italian bread
instructions: Split the loaf of italian bread in half horizontally.  Spread out the slices until your whole loaf is full, keeping the cut surfaces intact on both sides.  If you put the flat bread on the flat bread, it will get a bit mushy.  Put the chickpeas and their juice into a mixing bowl.  Add the duck, parsley, baking powder and chickpeas liquid into the bowl until blended.  Using about half the chickpea mixture onto the bread, make into a roll.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.  I usually leave overnight and use that for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: mussel,sage,onion soup mix,pineapple juice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Crock Pot Mussels With Cheese or Pineapple
ingredients: 24 large mussels | 3/4 cup crushed pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Wash and peel the mussels, removing anything broken up on the top of the shell.  Discard any which fail to close to the top of the shell.  Wash them thoroughly in cold water, dry thoroughly and discard the outer greyish shell.  Remove the beards from each mussel with a knife.  Place 2 tablespoons of crushed pineapple in each of the following ways, either stick a sharp cheddar cheese between two mussels and sprinkle with a little cheddar cheese or finely chopped parsley.  Put the mussels on the bottom of a large crock pot.  Spoon in the remaining crushed pineapple.  Sprinkle on the sage, onion soup mix and shredded sharp cheddar cheese.  Put the top on the crockpot and light on rock to stir frequently for 2 - 3 hours.  This will make a delicious gravy.

title: Easy Beef Broccoli & Apple Soup
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef | 1 bunch broccoli, chopped ( or you can use frozen florets ) | 2 -3 small apple, diced ( i like them in the usa.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons rose water | 1 teaspoon baking powder ( no more is needed )
instructions: Brown ground beef and broccoli, drain.  Add apple and rose water.  Stir to mix well.  Mix in baking powder.  I usually cook the soup for at least 20 minutes to take the chill off.  You can also make the soup with a cornstarch and flour mixture, if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,thyme,italian flat leaf parsley,sherry wine,rosemary leaf
title: Herbed Garlic Wine
ingredients: 1 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons garlic salt ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rosemary leaves ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon italian flat leaf parsley ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingridients in a glass measuring cup and stir well to combine.  Pour wine in a nonreactive medium saucepan, place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Turn the heat on to high and bring wine to a rolling boil.  Turn the saucepan to medium high again while wine continues to boil and add garlic salt, stir well.  When wine starts reducing, add rosemary and thyme, stir well and remove from heat.  Let wine steep for 3 hours to steep the flavors and intensify the flavors.  Pour wine into a clean glass bottles, and refrigerate for at least 8 days before using.  Great on toasts, chicken dishes, bread, meats, etc.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,turmeric powder,american cheese,swiss cheese,dark brown sugar,mushroom
title: Cheese & Spice Swiss (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar, packed | 1/3 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 4 slices american cheese
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions, omitting salt.  Cool slightly.  Stir together dark brown sugar and 1/4 cup brown sugar and turmeric.  Sprinkle over mushroom slices and sprinkle with swiss cheese.  Spoon over cheese mixture and top with remaining swiss cheese.  Serve over hot greens or egg noodles.

title: Spicy Irish Whiskey Ham (Caramelized)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 6 slices prosciutto di parma ( italian thick-sliced ham ) | 1/2 cup irish whiskey, chilled
instructions: Heat 1/2 tbsp of the corn oil over medium low heat in a cast iron skillet.  Add prosciutto and cook until crisp and slightly golden around the edges.  Remove prosciutto and keep warm in pan.  Drizzle remaining 1/2 tbsp of the corn oil over ham and reduce heat to medium.  Add whiskey and continue to stir until the whiskey is warmed through, about 3 minutes or so.  Add ham and coat well.  Return pan to medium low heat and cook until the caramel reaches a dark amber color, about 5 minutes.  Sprinkle ham with salt and serve.

title: Sicilian Sundaes
ingredients: 2 cups strawberries, chopped | 1 cup prepared bolognese sauce | 1/2 cup thick and chunky salsa | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl.  Cover.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Cornstarch and Spices Baked in a Mug
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1 large red potatoes, diced finely or 1/2 small white potato, cut in half | freshly grated brown sugar
instructions: Mix together the cornflour and allspice together in a small bowl.

title: Gobi Masala
ingredients: 1 cup sifted all-purpose flour | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated ginger | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Mix flour, salt, green pepper, ginger, and garam masala together in a bowl.

title: Shrimp Patties (Prawns or Prawns)
ingredients: 1 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 ounces white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons other cooking fat
instructions: Place the shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold running water.  Pat dry.  Mix together the bread crumbs and cornstarch.  Using a small knife, roughly pound the shrimp until they are fine and crumbly.  Stir in basil.  Divide the mixture into 4 pieces and form each piece into a patty.  Melt the margarine in a frying pan and fry the patties over high heat, turning once, for about 4 minutes a side or till cooked through.

title: Pizza Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese or 1 lb mozzarella cheese ( 3 cups ) | 1 bag frisee, washed drained ( see note below )
instructions: Note, use whatever type of cheese you prefer.  Cheese can be grated or cut up to your preference.  I prefer fontene or cheddar myself.  Use whatever type of cheese you prefer.  To make crumbs, in a bowl, toss the crumbs with the grated cheese in your hands, coating the cheese well.  You don't want them to be runny.  Sprinkle the crumbs over the cheese and press them into balls.  Place the dough on a lightly oiled and floured cookie sheet and let rest about 10 minutes.  After 10 minutes, preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit, then roll out the ball of dough on a floured cookie sheet.  If your dough is too stiff, add a little water, until it holds together.  It will be a little dry.  Take a knife, cut out the ball of dough and roll it out to about 1/4 inch thick.  You don't want it to be uniform in size so you end up with flat circle shaped pizza.  Use a 2½ or 2½ inch round cookie cutter to press out each of the dough that will be needed.  The dough will be flat and slightly flat so it's easier to work with later in the process.  Place the dough on a cookie sheet and bake for about 16 - 18 minutes.  Note, frisee can be frozen.  When the pizza is done, remove from the oven and spoon the dough onto a cookie sheet or pizza peel and spread a thin layer of the crumb topping.  Repeat with the rest of the dough until you've used up the amount of crumb topping.  Use as much or as little as you like to make certain it is evenly spreadable.  It will also make it easier to peel back onto the bread.  The crust will be slightly crisp and crisp.  Sprinkle with paprika if possible.  Note, as an added touch, the friselle pepper can be sliced into rounds or sticks.  The amount of pepper is a personal preference.  You can even add other types of vegetable, chicken, or shrimp to the recipe.  Note, you could substitute any kind of cheese for the mozzarella, depending on how you like your cheese.  You can even omit the brussels sprouts if you desire.  If you use mushrooms, try to use black forest ham.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,vanilla sugar,graham cracker,mango,butter,cake flour,gingersnap
title: Mango Fies
ingredients: 120 g butter, softened | 1 1/3 cups vanilla sugar | 3 large ripe mangoes, peeled and cut into thin strips | 8 large gingernaps, chopped | 300 g graham crackers, coarsely crushed | 1 large kaffir lime leaf, chopped | 3 1/2 cups cake flour | 60 g butter
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas 6.  Line two baking trays with baking paper.  Beat butter, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until pale and creamy for approx 10 minutes.  Stir in mango, ginger naps, graham crackers and lime leaf.  Add sifted flour.  Turn dough out onto a floured surface.  Knead with floured hands for approx 5 minutes or until dough is firm, firm, and satiny.  Shape dough into 2 balls.  Lightly grease or line the same trays with baking paper.  On a plate, roll each ball of dough out using a rolling pin onto the greased paper.  Cut into 8 wedges.  Place on prepared tray.  Flatten wedges slightly and bake in oven for approx 20 minutes with the trays turned off.  Remove to wire rack to cool.  Dust with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,mango,kielbasa,sugar snap pea,spaghetti sauce,asparagus,cucumber
title: Mexican Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 kielbasa, casings removed | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 pint fresh mango, sliced | 1 pint fresh green chile peppers, diced | 1 cucumber, thinly sliced | 1 package sugar snap peas, julienned | 2 packages kielbasa-pasted green chile peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat the kielbasa and spaghetti sauce in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until hot, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cook the mango in a large skillet over medium low heat, stirring often, until tender, 4 to 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in the hot mango salsa and mangos with green chiles.  Cook the spaghetti mixture in the skillet just until heated, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the zuccini and sugar snap peas.  Pour the hot spaghetti evenly over the salad and sprinkle with kielbasa slices.

Random Ingredients: sherry,tortilla,tamari,italian plum tomato,mini chocolate chip,coconut milk,chicken stock water,tomato rice soup
title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can condensed tomato rice soup | 3/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup sherry | 6 cups chicken stock with water, or as needed | 1 package mini chocolate chips, melted, or as needed | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips, melted, or as needed | 1 tortilla, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Place crushed tomatoes and coconut milk in a soup pot, and add tomato rice soup, tamari, sherry, and chicken stock.  Cook 15 minutes, stirring frequently.  Ladle soup into bowls, and sprinkle each with mini chocolate chips and chopped chipped chocolate chips.

title: Mexican Stuff
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice | 2 1/2 cups chicken, chopped | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup quinoa, uncooked
instructions: Cook rice.  Combine everything except quinoa in large bowl, except quinoa into another large bowl.  Stuff rice with mix.  Fill 1/4 of quinoa in 8x8 square casserole, add turkey meat and quinoa, cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°f for 1/2 an hour.  Remove foil and bake for last 15 minutes or two.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Instant Pot Peas & Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 bunches peas ( or 2 bunches frozen peas ) | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon marjoram
instructions: Place peas and baking powder in a bowl.  If using frozen peas, cook the peas according to the directions on the microwave package or place the peas in a plastic freezer bag.  Allow the bag to cool for 5 minutes, shaking the bag to get all excess liquid into the peas.  If using frozen peas, microwave the peas 5 minutes on high, stirring often, until thawed and heated through.  Add a little water if the peas seem dry.  Sprinkle the marjoram on top.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: polenta,caster sugar,thyme sprig,white rice,greek yogurt,sesame seed,wasabi paste
title: White Rice Balls With Wasabi
ingredients: 500 g cooked white rice ( from a packet ) | 600 ml greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 3 cups polenta, cut into 2cm cubes
instructions: Combine rice, yoghurt, wasabi, sesame seeds & sugar in a large jug.  Add enough water to cover and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until rice is tender, about 20 minutes.  Add thyme and polenta and mix thoroughly.  Cook until mixture is thickened slightly and mixture is heated through, about 10 minutes.  Remove thyme sprigs before serving.

title: Pear and Sultana Pudding
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups fresh corn kernels ( or frozen and thawed ) | 2/3 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup sultana ( golden raisins ) | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 3 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper | 4 medium pears, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place the thawed corn kernels either in a saucepan or microwave safe bowl.

title: Spinach and Sausage Balls
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and skinned | 1/4 cup chipotle chile in adobo | 1 lb smoked kielbasa or 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup chili powder | 2 large eggs
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts over medium heat, stirring constantly, until lightly browned and fragrant in the pepper, 1 - 2 minutes.  Meanwhile, pulse the chile to your desired level of roasting and grind coarsely.  Poke holes all over the sausage and grill over medium heat, turning, until done.  Drain well, crumble and cool on paper towels.  Mix in the hazelnuts and pureed chile.

title: Ancho Hot Sauce - Vegan-Jamaican Seasoning
ingredients: 12 dried ancho chili peppers, stemmed | 1/4 cup hot chili paste | 1/4 cup chili paste, for dipping
instructions: Pit the chilies, remove the seeds and rinse.  Cut them into thin slices.  Place the chilies in small bowl of a food processor with the 1/4 cup of hot pepper paste and process until the mixture forms a smooth paste.

Random Ingredients: rotel,taco seasoning mix,pecan,cream chicken soup,chipotle chile
title: Cajun Spice Dressing
ingredients: 24 ounces cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can rotel ( jalapenos, or hot sauce to taste ) | 1/2 cup pecans ( optional ) or 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped ( optional ) | 1 chipotle chile, chopped and seeded ( optional )
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the soup, taco seasoning, cheese and peppers.  Process until smooth.  Let stand 30 minutes to hour before serving to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,mango chutney,cauliflower floret,greek seasoning,avocado,jalapeno,cremini mushroom,rigatoni pasta
title: Spicy Avocado & Mushrooms Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked according to directions in the box | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 can mango chutney | 1 jalapeno, chopped | 4 large ripe avocados, peeled, thinly sliced and pitted | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: To serve, drain rigatoni and place on a platter.  Rinse mushrooms with 1/2 cup of the chutney, then chop.  Arrange mushrooms on top of rigatoni.  Sprinkle with half the greek seasoning, half the mango chutney and half the chili.  Top with sliced jalapenos.  To serve, top with cream, avocado slices, and remaining chutney.  Garnish with remaining minced jalapeno and a sprinkle of all purpose Greek seasoning or any other spice desired.

title:
St.
    - James's Charoset
ingredients: 20 dates, pitted | 1 gherkin, chopped into small pieces
instructions: Mix together the sugar and gherkin and coat the dates.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Fresh Fruit on Skewers
ingredients:
1 lb fresh fruit ( raspberries, strawberries, grapes, strawberries, blackberries, etc.
    - ) | 1 lime
instructions: Clean fruit and slice into thin wedges or pieces.  Squeeze a little lime juice over fruit and skewer fruit.  Wrap in a clean kitchen towel.  Slice on skewers about 1/2 inch thick.

title: Pot Sticker Rice Pudding With Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 8 ounces panettone | 1/3 cup white flour | 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 1/3 cup pumpkin puree | 1 jalapeno, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons leeks, chopped | 2 ounces prosciutto, diced or 2 ounces salami, diced | 1/3 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cut the panini in half and set aside.  In a large mixing bowl blend flour, rice and pumpkin puree and set aside.  In a non stick frying pan, heat the olive oil on medium heat.  Add the leeks and proscuitto and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until fragrant.  Add diced ham, chili and leeks.  Saute until the leeks and proscuitto are tender, not browned.  Add the rice and pumpkin and stir to coat.  Spoon the mixture in to the hollowed out half of the panini, top with the chutney and ham.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes until browned.  Let cool slightly, cut into squares and serve hot.

title: Frozen Apple Schnitzel
ingredients: 1 tart apple, peeled, cored and cut into eighths. | 1/2 cup ketchup
instructions: Place apple slices into the crock of a slow cooker, and add ketchup.  Cover and cook on low 8 hours.  Serve warm with cooked egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,wheat pita bread,white wine vinegar,basil leaf,coriander leaf,flour tortilla,potato,plain yogurt
title: Faux Tiao Ki Yum
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat pita bread ( karooni bread ) | 1 lb potato ( peeled ) | flour tortilla, 8 inch ( for sandwich ) | 1/4 cup basil leaves ( dried ) | 1/4 cup coriander leaves ( dried ) | 3/4 cup plain yogurt ( plain, unflavored ) | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar ( balsamic vinegar or balsamic, to taste ) | 4 leaves phyllo dough ( fresh )
instructions: Slice potatoes in 4 1/2 inch cubes.  Put potatoes in bowl.  Sprinkle with flour.  Mix it to blend it.  Put the potatoes in the refrigerator.  If you have time, put it in the fridge for about 15 - 20 minutes.  Afterwards, put the yogurt on top of potatoes and stir it.  If not done at this time, put in the fridge for another 15 - 20 minutes.  While yogurt is soaking, sprinkle phyllo sheets on a plate.  Keep them moving about 10 times in the kitchen.  When potatoes are half cooked, cut them into pieces.  Mix yogurt with vinaigrette.  Keep aside.  Mix yogurt with flour in a big bowl with a fork.  Fold in 1/8 cup of water.  Dip the phyllo sheets in and spread 1/3 cup of vinaigrette on them making it look pretty.  Put about 3 tablespoons of mixture in the center of phyllo sheet, fold it over and pinch the ends closed so if it breaks open, it will open up and you can put it on the plate without spilling.  The idea is to have a sort of lid so that the yogurt can leak out of all corners.  Put the whole stack in a paper or plastic container.  Put plastic wrap in the container and put it aside.  Dip the tortillas in yogurt vinaigrette, sprinkle the basil and corriander leaves.  Put a few slices of potato in the center of the tortilla.  Place another slice of potato on top of the potato.  Put another tortilla on top of the potato and add the rest of the cheese in that order.  Put in a plate and serve at room temperature as you would eat it.  This dish doesn’t taste like a meal that doesn’t look like something used to come to the table.

title: Individual Peach Trifle
ingredients: 1 can peach preserves | 2 cans white beans, drained ( i use cannellini or other bean cannelini ) | 1 package chopped fresh coriander | 1 package ladyfingers | 2 cups shredded cheese | 1/4 cup milk chocolate piece ( optional )
instructions: Place peach preserves, beans, and coriander in the bottom of a 9 inch glass pie plate.  Arrange the lady fingers over the preserves.  In a small bowl, melt cheese then combine the milk chocolate.  Drizzle mixture over lady fingers.  Chill until set.

title: Lebanese Corned Condiment
ingredients: 2 cups corn | 2 cups sugar | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Combine sugar and lemon juice until dissolved.  Set aside.  Drain Corned Condiment, dry on paper towel or other clean dry surface.  Place on large rimmed baking sheet.  Mix corn corn syrup and sugar.  Drizzle lemon and sugar mixture over corn.  Roast until light brown, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Cool.  Store in air tight container up to 6 weeks.  Enjoy.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 3/4 cup coffee ( expresso, espresso or sweeten ) | 3 teaspoons banana liqueur ( kahlua ) | 6 slices ham | 1 slice cotija cheese
instructions: Combine coffee and liqueur in blender or bowl, and blend until smooth.  Pour into shallow dish.  Place ham on top of coffee, and sprinkle with cheese.  Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight into overnight of serving temperature.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,cashew,orange,dark sesame oil,spanish olive,pine nut,beef chuck
title: Beef & Pears With Cashews
ingredients: 8 ounces lean boneless beef chuck, very thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 tablespoons roasted cashews | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, plus more to serve ( optional ) | 1/4 cup spanish olives with pimento stuffed peppers | 2 pinches orange rind, finely grated | 2 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil ( or extra virgin )
instructions: In a heavy based non stick pan, dry fry the pinenuts, olives, orange rind and breadcrumbs over a medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally until golden, 2 - 3 minutes, stirring often.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pinenuts to a plate and set aside.  In the same pan, add the sesame oil and add the beef, increase the heat and allow to brown.  Cover and cook for 5 - 5 minutes.  Turn the heat down and stir in the pinenuts, olives and drained raisins.  Cook for 3 - 4 minutes more, or until the beef is warmed through.  Transfer to a warmed dish, sprinkle with a little more breadcrumbs to garnish or serve with a salad of mixed greens and/or couscous.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,liquid honey,sesame seed,salmon,triple sec,ancho chile powder,bread crumb
title: Jolita's Homemade Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 4 ounces frozen smoked salmon - thawed, without skin | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Brush olive oil onto the insides of a 3 quart baking dish.  Place the salmon skin side up onto the baking dish.  Combine the ancho chili powder, bread crumbs, honey, sesame seeds, and triple sec in a small bowl.  Sprinkle over the salmon.  Broil salmon until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Chipped Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta ( i use angel hair ) | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons light golden syrup | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream ( i use regular )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions while making sauce.  Combine graham cracker crumbs and syrup in a bowl.  When spaghetti is almost cooked, add half&half and cream and combine.  Place drained pasta on platter and top with sauce.  Garnish with shaved parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Italian Cheesy Oatmeal Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 10 ounces spaghetti sauce, bottled | 1 cup tasty cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated plus extra
instructions: Spray a 8x8 pan with a lid.  Pour the oatmeal into the pan, breaking it up as you go so it can collect the liquid.  Cover the pan tightly with foil and press the foil down to make it steam.  Set the pan in the freezer.  When the oatmeal begins to freeze, stir it frequently.  It will be thick on the outside but won't be liquidy.  If it starts to liquid, remove the foil.  When thick, stir it up a little bit.  Preheat the oven to 350°f mix all ingredients together.  Pour mixture into the pan and bake for 30 minutes.  Stir again after about 15 minutes and top with grated parm.  Let sit for at least an hour before serving.

title: Hot Beef and Raspberry Broth
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, quartered | 1 red pepper, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 2 cups fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place brisket fat side up into a roasting pan and sprinkle with pepper.  Combine sliced beef and red pepper in a large roasting pan.  Spoon raspberry juice over top.  Cover roasting pan loosely with foil.  Bake in preheated oven until meat is tender and the liquid has reduced, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: caper,sugar snap pea,hot paprika,white wine,pepperoni,garam masala
title: Stuffed Faux Pepper Peppers & Peppers
ingredients: 8 green medium hot pepper peppers, medium size | sugar snap pea ( optional ) | capers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 tablespoon dry white wine ( optional )
instructions: Wash and remove stem and seeds from pepper, wash & remove seeds and membrane from pepper.  Remove pepper from pepper as above & set aside.  Use fork to remove some of the juices & stringy white membrane from the pepper, removing as much of the white membrane as possible & removing remaining pepper as necessary.  Cut pepper into 8 equal sized peices & set aside.  Prepare spice paste by combining spices in a small container wisk together using a medium sized bowl.  Add pepper & peas to spice mixture & stir well, coating all ingredients with the spice paste.  Chill before using, as the flavors will separate.  This is very, very spicy, but delicious and very necessary to allow the flavors to develop.  Pack pepper mixture into pepper skins, using more or less peas as needed, as per your taste preferences.  Fill with cheese, sliced pepper rings, sliced pepperoni, etc.  If desired, garnish with 1 tsp.  Chopped fresh parsley & a caper.  Place in a non stick muffin tray lined with muffin papers lined with a non stick muffin tray or lightly greased papere/parmesan.  Bake for 15 - 20 mins on a heated grill turning once, or until lightly browned and crispy on top.

title: Tres Leches (Non-Fat)
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 1/3 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup sweetened cottage cheese | 1 can sauerkraut, well drained | 1/3 cup kahlua, light or regular, plus | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1/3 cup dried cranberry juice
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a small bowl.  Mix well.  Pour half the milk powder into a large microwave safe bowl.  Heat bowl on full power until milk powder is steaming, about 1 minute.

title: Orange and Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 4 oranges, zested ( about 3 cups total ) | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 lbs of room temp cheese, cut into cubes | 3/4 cup toasted nuts, finely chopped
instructions: Place orange zest and sesame oil in a resealable plastic bag, cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.  Place cheese cubes in freezer for 10 minutes, or until firm.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,cornstarch,banana,onion soup mix,bok choy,corn oil
title: Fried Bananas in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium bananas | 1/2 cup chopped bok choy or 1/2 cup chinese napa cabbage | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup corn oil | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Cut bananas into 1 1/2 2 inch chunks and set aside.  Steam or boil cabbage 4 - 5 minutes, until softened.  Drain well and set aside.  Mix all ingredients.  Heat a separate skillet, like a wok, on high heat until oil is getting hot.  Add a tablespoon and a half of the mixture and cook until hot.  Put on a plate and keep warm, keeping hot until served over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cumin powder,green bean,salad green,half cream
title: Salad With Peanuts and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups salad greens | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2/3 cup green beans, cooked | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 6 tablespoons water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Toss salad ingredients together, adding half and half to taste, and chill.  Garnish with sliced salduh nuts.  Note, if you have a vegetable salad dressing such as Miracle Whip or Cream of Wheat, you may add equal amounts of the dressing into your salad to thicken.

Random Ingredients: pecan,lentil,coconut extract,wheat pastry flour,cream mushroom soup,orange bell pepper,juniper berry
title: Creamy Lentil and Orange Peel
ingredients: 8 ounces lentils | 16 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 16 ounces diced orange bell peppers | 4 ounces diced smoked lardons or 4 ounces smoked ham | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon juniper berries | 2 cups full-fat wheat pastry flour
instructions: Rinse lentils.  Rinse and rinse lentils.  Set aside.  Combine cream of mushroom soup, orange peppers, smoked ham, coconut extract, juniper berries and white rice.  Bring to a boil.  Add lentils and rice.  Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Sift flour onto a large bowl and gradually add cream of mushroom soup and pour into soup mixture.  Add spices and mix well to mix.  Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.  Put a baking sheet underneath the baking sheet.  Put a teaspoon into the cup of water that the dough should touch before the water boils.  Put a tablespoon of kneading onto a clean work surface.  Divide dough into equal parts.

title: Cashew Yummies (Aka Yams)
ingredients: 2 cups cashews ( raw ) | 2 cups egg whites | 1/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Preparation time is for baking.  Soak cashews in warm water for 15 minutes.  Drain.  Place cashews in a medium bowl.

title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 6 tablespoons italian style bread | 1/2 cup mung dal | 2 cups corn ( canned corn may be substituted ) | 4 slices semisweet chocolate
instructions: Boil large pot of well salted water, stirring occasionaly.  Cut slits into top of cabbage with paring knife into core core.  Cut outer slits in core leaving core in cabbage.  Drop cabbage in pot and cover tightly with cold water.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat.  Simmer till cabbage leaves are slightly fluff and soft about 25 30minutes.  Drain water and set aside.  Take a handful of cabbage leaves and lightly coat with bread crumbs.  Using a small, sharp knife, remove tough core from base on 1 side only.  Turn half way thru for a slightly different effect.  Turn the other half over and place on cabbage leaves.  Dipping your fingers into the corn, roll out the other half of the cabbage leaves just to roll, then set aside.  Repeat till all slices are done.  To fill rolls in a skillet, lightly coat with oil, then fry until brown.  Remove to plate.  Repeat till all rolls are done and serve immediately with dipping sauce.  This recipe can also be made with any of the above fillings.  If you do a czech czech blend baguette, make sure that the bread crumbs are soft before putting into a bowl and refrigerating in an airtight container.  Slice the czech baguette into 1/2 inch slices on both sides, then into fourths.  Slices of chocolate melt together in a bowl, then pour into the bowl with the melted chocolate then stir the mixture together, coating the czech rolls in chocolate.  You may have to sprinkle a little more or less of the chocolate over the czech roll mix.

title: Baked Chocolate Beer
ingredients: 2 cans of prepared merlot, chilled | 1/3 cup of freshly snipped pepperoni | 2 cups bean sprouts, chilled | 1/2 cup of coarsely snipped oregano leaves | 2 drops food coloring | 1/2 lb vodka
instructions: Pour beer with mixed ingredients into a large, heavy pot.  Break up the pepperoni in a mortar over small heat.  After about 1 minute, smash pepperoni into the beer and add the rest of the ingredients.  Cover with greased, non stick parchment paper and place under broiler.  Broil until the pepperoni slices are lightly browned and the pepperoni is soft, about 10 minutes.  Pour beer into a pitcher and garnish with chopped pistachios.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,confectioner ' sugar,garam masala,mozzarella cheese,chili paste,ginger,pineapple juice,spice
title: Mango Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 container whipped mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon mixed spice or 1 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon fried garlic | 1/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into cookie press.  Bake at 400° for about 5 - 7 minutes or until cheese is slightly brown.

title: Arugula, Pepper, and Fresh Herb Trifle

instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the syrup, paprika, arugula, and thyme sprigs.  Arrange on a platter.

title: Spinach-Spinach With Thyme
ingredients: 8 fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Wash and wash spinach thoroughly.  Drain well.  Place over a flame or under a preheated grill and heat, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes until just wilted.  Remove from grill.  Add thyme.  Squeeze out excess moisture.  Serve immediately.

title: Pasta with buttermilk and Sage
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, of your choice | 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: To make the sage bread, bring a large pot of water to boil and salt it.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix together the sage and buttermilk.  Add the sage to the buttermilk and turn it into boiling water.  As soon as the pasta is cooked, it will sink in the center.  As soon as the pasta is finished, drain and quickly toss it into the bowl containing the sage mixture.  Serve immediately.

title: Goats Cheese Salad With Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup chopped goat cheese | guacamole | lime wedge
instructions: In small bowl, combine lime juice and goat cheese.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Acegobi
ingredients: 8 1/4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, at room temp | 1 1/2 teaspoons amaretto | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( or equivalent ) | 1 slice pancetta, finely diced, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour the cream cheese in the mixing bowl of a food processor fitted with the blade.  When you see tiny bits of solid dough occurring, add the amaretto and stir, mixing constantly until thick.  Add the pinch of asafoetida and stir.  Taste and add more as needed.  Sprinkle in the pancetta and serve.

title: Pepperoni and Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 package tortilla chips | 1 package pepperoni, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups fresh corn kernels | 1/2 cup dried currants
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Arrange the crisp tortilla chips on a baking dish and cover with a layer of pepperoni in the bottom of the pan, sprinkling each layer generously with pepperoni.  Scatter the corn over the top, then scatter with currants.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tortillas are tender and the cheese is bubbly.

title: Vaca's Fondue
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup cointreau | 1/4 cup pernod or 1/4 cup other orange liqueur | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 lb daikon radish ( or other small white vegetables ) or 1 lb lebanese cucumber ( or other small white vegetables ) | 6 navel oranges, preferably valerie type | 1 1/2 cups whole fresh thai basil
instructions: Combine all ingredients with water in crock to make a slow cooker.  Cook on low for 7 months, or for about 5hrs and then add fruit to crock, cook on high, serve with dumplings and other fondue, as an entrée in a traditional fondue pot, or for pork shoulder, bring to a boil and turn down to simmer the longer the better.  Add to taste spices and simmer for a couple of hours until thick.  To serve, cut into large chunks and add to stew.  Serve with steamed white rice, topped with fresh basil.

instructions: Place the potatoes into a pot and cover with salted water.

instructions: Toast the slivered almonds or flaked almonds.  Mix all ingredients in blender.  Cover.  Let stand overnight.  Use at least two hours.  Add milk, just before serving.

instructions: Cut ends off olives.

title: Spiced Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon powdered milk or 1 tablespoon water | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 10 ounces beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat broiler and set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Spray a broiler pan with non stick cooking spray.  In a small bowl combine 1 tablespoon curry powder, milk or just water, cardamom, and ground coriander.  Rub spice mixture onto the surface of the tenderloin.  Place the tenderloin on the broiler rack and broil until no longer pink and the internal temperature is 125 - 130 degrees f, 12 - 14 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Greek Style Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dijon-style prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, and mustard.  Stir in the worcestershire sauce, and cinnamon sugar until smooth.  Pour into a small serving bowl, and sprinkle the feta cheese on top.  Cover, and chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Gingered Cornmeal and Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 8 spring roll wrappers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a shallow baking tray.  Mix cornmeal and ginger in a bowl.  Brush 1 spring roll wrapper with water.  Place 1 tablespoon of the cornmeal mixture in the center of the wrapper and fold over to form a triangle.  Press the edges together to seal.  Place the spring roll wrappers on the prepared baking tray.  Repeat with the remaining wrappers, placing 2 tbsp of the cornmeal mixture in the centre of each.  Bake in the preheated oven for 12 - 14 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,snow pea,taco shell,wild rice,sourdough bread,vanilla,beef bouillon cube,rice noodle
title: Kisha's Spicy Noodle Beef and Snow Pea Stuffed Tacos
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground beef ( any type of meat ) | 8 ounces rice noodles | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 package fresh snow peas | 12 taco shells | 6 tablespoons wild rice ( prepared according to package directions ) | 6 tablespoons sourdough bread
instructions: Brown beef in skillet over medium high heat, stirring until no pink remains.  Drain off fat.  Place rice noodles in large bowl, cover with 2 cups boiling water and add broth.  Cover and let sit until noodles soften, about 7 minutes.  Drain noodles.  Stir noodles, meat, vinegar and soy sauce into noodles.  Microwave snow peas for 2 to 3 minutes.  Divide noodle mixture among taco shells, spoon some of the spicy noodle mixture over meat and top with meat mixture and extra wild rice.  Serve warm with fresh fruit.

title: Potted Spinach
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 1/2 cup dried port wine | 3/4 cup dry port | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Rinse and clean the spinach and place it in a large pot or dutch oven.  The water is mainly for flavor.  Cook over medium high heat, uncovered, stirring constantly, until the water begins to evaporate.  Immediately add the port, white wine and baby spinach and stir.  Cover and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until spinach is tender.

title: Low Fat Beef and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed | 10 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut in half, discard the oil & cut each half into 3 pieces | 8 teaspoons low fat sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Trim the fat from the meat.  Cut the meat into small pieces, toss in the tomatoes & stir well.  Cover & marinate over night, or refrigerate for several days.

title: Yummy Apple Tortilla
ingredients: 3 slices tortillas, cut into thin wedges | cooking spray | 1 ounce cherry tomatoes, halved ( or use halved cherry tomatoes ) | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons salsa ( any kind of hot, medium or hot to your taste )
instructions: Arrange tortilla wedges in a single layer on a plate.  Spray and flour tortillas.  Microwave slices on high power for 2 seconds, turning once.  Place in a paper bag to keep warm.  Add cherry tomato halves, juice cocktail, and salsa to the bag, close bag, and cook on high power for 2 minutes.  Remove and from bag, slice each tortilla into quarters, serve warm.

title: Hungarian Lentil and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 1 container cream of chicken soup | 2 teaspoons dried pears | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( i don't make this at all ) ( optional ) | aluminum foil, for the tray
instructions: Pour boiling water over lentils and return to simmer pan.  Cook until lentils are just tender.  About 20 minutes.  Place in a bowl and mash with a potato masher.  Put the frozen peas in with the lentils.  In a separate bowl, mix soup with spices and whisk.  Put 1/2 of the soup mixture into the pan with the peas and peas.  Add 1/2 of the sour cream mixture and stir to blend.  Grate the package of sugar snap peas.  Cut the aluminum foil over the peas and peas and pour over the rest of the soup mixture.  Sprinkle with more cinnamon to taste.

title: Kelsey's Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, finely grated | ice, for balls ( about 1 1/2 or 2 cups )
instructions: Pour ice into shallow dish and set aside.  Use to dip cheese balls to coat well.  Place ball in ice bath.  Refrigerate overnight.  When serving, fill with prepared cheese balls.

title: Indian Rice

instructions: Place rice and chutney in a 3 quart, microwave safe, heavy baking dish.  Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Remove lid, bring heat up to high, stir and microwave on high 20 to 30 seconds longer or til liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.  Fluff with fork and serve hot.

title: Quinoa Bean Tarts
