instructions: Preheat oven to 120c /375f /gas grease 12 muffin tins for use with baking paper.  Mix quinoa, beans, allspice and tomato in a cup and microwave approximately 2 minutes until hot.  Remove from microwave about 30 seconds or so before removing from heat.  Stir, pour into tins and return to oven.  Cook until heated through.

title: Glambe
ingredients: 600 -900 g lamb or 600 -900 g chicken, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the coriander and orange peel in a container and mix well.  Place the mixture in a baking tray and cook in a preheated oven at 180 degrees centigrade for 1 hour 15 minutes or until browned.

title: Mu Shu Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork | 1/2 lb chicken breast, boneless diced | 10 dried chinese mushrooms, stemmed, diced | 3 tablespoons walnut halves | 5 tablespoons pork fat ( i used crisco lite oil )
instructions: In a large bowl combine pork, chicken, mushrooms and walnuts.  Blend with hands until mixture is a mealy texture.  Heat crisco lite oil in a skillet over medium to high heat.  When oil is ready brown chicken mixture until it's cooked through and golden brown, about 5 minutes.  Drain on paper towel.  Serve warm with green cabbage or regular sized chinese vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pecan,french onion,cilantro leaf,marsala wine,italian herb seasoning,corn oil,beef roast,cumin powder
title: Crockpot Cottage Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 3 cans french-fried onions | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1/2 cup pecans | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 2 teaspoons dried cumin powder | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Place beef roast in crockpot, dump water on top of the beef until it runs out of liquid, add seasoning and cumin powder.  Cook on low until beef falls apart then set on high.  Shred beef, set aside in serving bowl, add french fried onions and mix all the ingredients together.  Dump beef on top of the onions while you are doing that.  Cook on high for approximately 4 hours or low for 3 hours, covered.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fennel,jumbo shrimp,serrano pepper,cabbage,coconut cream,sage,beef sirloin steak,beetroot
title: Beef and Beetroot Stir Fry
ingredients: 12 ounces beef sirloin steaks, cubed | 2 tablespoons jumbo shrimp, raw | 3 teaspoons fennel, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried sage, finely chopped | 3 teaspoons serrano peppers, julienned | 1 tablespoon coconut cream | 1 medium beetroot | 1/2 cabbage, small, sliced
instructions: Brown beef with 1 tbsp water and 1 tsp salt.  Remove to a plate lined with paper towel to drain.  Add remaining ingredients except cabbage, to beef and sirloin.  Heat mixture until hot.  Divide meat and bean filling equally among the eight plates.  Serve with cabbage.

title: Appie's Fettuccine Apple Enchiladas

instructions: Pre heat oven to 350f degrees.  Combine masa and apples in a large bowl.  Fold in red and sweet peppers.  Spray a deep ovenproof dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Layer half the fettuccine noodles in the bottom.  Scatter half the fruit mixture over the noodles.  Repeat layers and sprinkle fettuccine with herbes.  Sprinkle on remaining fettuccine.  Cover tightly with foil, and bake 10 minutes.  Uncover.  Bake an additional 5 minutes, until golden brown and bubbling.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Falle

instructions: Cook noodles according to package, drain.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Remove sausage from casings.  Cut a slit through center of bread, leaving 1 thick shell to form a hollow opening.  Tear loaves of bread into 1/2 inch squares,.  Punch bread with back of your chopsticks.  Place in bowl, leaving some of the bread and sausage in the bowl to sprinkle over finished dish.  Fill bread mixture with quinoa.  Sprinkle the bread with horseradish.  Put a wooden spoon in the center of the bowl to hold the bread around the bowl.  Place stuffed bread pieces in a deep, shallow baking dish with open sides touching and fanning the top bread layer from side to side.  Cover the bowl with a piece of foil.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until quinoa is tender and bread is golden brown.

title: Spicy Black Beans
ingredients: 1 bag frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs ( optional )
instructions: In a dutch oven, combine the green beans, taco seasoning, and tabasco, if using.  Sprinkle thyme on top.  Bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat.  Let sit 5 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,pepper sauce,green pea,barley,collard green,pickling cucumber,savory,nut
title: Sauteed collard green and wheat salad
ingredients: 2 medium size raw carrots | 6 cups collard greens, chopped | 1/3 cup peas | 1/4 cup pickling cucumber | 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 6 drops hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup barley | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory
instructions: Peel carrots and slice across at a coarse cutting and not too thin.  Set aside.  Rinse the greens under running water, removing tough stems and any blemishes inside.  Cut the greens diagonally into 1/4 inch slices and toss with peas, cucumbers, pickling spices, hot pepper sauce, barley and savory.  Adjust salt and pepper as needed.  Chill thoroughly at least 2 hours.

title: Queso Mexicana
ingredients: 1 can plum tomatoes, with liquid | 3 plum tomatoes, diced
instructions: Drain juice from tomatoes into a bowl.  Stir plum tomatoes to combine with juice.  Cover and chill 1 hour.  Serve cold.

title: Baked Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 heads fresh okra | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons sliced pitted green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Snap the ends off the okra stems and cut them into 1 inch pieces.  Remove and discard the core and ribs.  Scrape and discard the seeds from the cut okra.  Place the okra in a pot of lightly salted water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Drain well and allow to cool slightly.  Drain and set aside and reserve any liquid.  Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan over medium heat.  Add the mustard seeds and fennel seeds and toast, stirring frequently, for 1 minute or until the seeds turn a pale nut brown.

title: Naneh

instructions: Preheat a large, heavy skillet over medium heat.  Coat pan with clarified butter and lightly dust with panko.  Stir panko into clarified butter.

title: Sambal Oven Frying Spice Mix

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.  Using a spoon drop pieces of oil into hot pan and fry until golden brown all over and a small pinch of nutmeg sprinkled over.  Serve hot with fresh rolls, fruit or roast meat.

title: Tomato Applesauce Crumble
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 5 1/2 ounces sliced applesauce | 1 can tomato puree | 1 anchovy fillet, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f lightly grease a shallow baking dish, or line with a piece of greaseproof paper.  Toast the slices of bread until golden.  In a bowl, combine the applesauce, tomato puree, anchovy and sherry and pour over the bread.  Toss to combine and season with salt and pepper.  Spread out evenly.  Spoon the bread mixture onto a baking tray and bake for 40 mins until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,tomato,active yeast,gouda cheese,fish sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Seared Burritos(Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 3/4 1 3/4 cups guiness gouda cheese or 1 3/4 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 can crushed tomatoes, in tomato puree ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 3/4 - 1 cup vegetable oil or 3/4-1 cup cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups packed mixed spice-and-seasoning mix ( such as spice and seasoning mix ) | tortilla, warmed
instructions: Stir the yeast in 1 cup warm water.  Set aside for 10 minutes.  In a large bowl, combine the remaining cup of warm water, cheese, tomatoes, and yeast mixture.  Add enough of the mixture to total about 1/2 cup of sauce and stir to blend.  Stir in 2 cups more of sauce and spice and mix to blend.  Divide among 3 or 4 baking sheets coated with vegetable or cornmeal.  Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, until doubled in bulk.  Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat.  Spoon 1 or 2 tablespoons of mixture into hot pan.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,tomato puree,romaine lettuce,italian salad dressing,heavy cream,hot water,seasoning salt
title: Easy Pico De Gallo Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed well | 2 cans tomato puree | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 bag of prepared italian salad dressing | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 cup pico de gallo, fresh green salsa mixed with red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cut romaine lettuce into bite sized pieces.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, place chopped romaine lettuce, puree, and 1/4 cup of hot water.  When combined, add italian salad dressing, and cream.  Mix well.  Pour pico de gallo into a medium size bowl or serving dish, and sprinkle with seasoned salt.  Add seasoning salt and stir well before serving.

title: Chile Garlic Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coriander leaves | 2 teaspoons mild chili paste | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend for 15 - 20 seconds.  Pour into a clean container and leave in the refridgerator for up to a week or longer.  Use as needed for a dip.

title: Amanda's Amazing Apricot Pasta - Paula Deen
ingredients: 1 cup apricot jam | 1 3/4 cups mostaccioli pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat jam until bubbly.  Add cooked pasta.  Stir gently.  Cook another two minutes or so, until heated through.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,vanilla extract,cocktail mix,tomato ketchup,yellow pepper
title: Barbecue Yellow Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 bunch chile, cut lengthwise into 4 long wedges | 1 pound yellow sweet peppers, seeded and sliced into long thin strips | 1 can tomato ketchup | 4 packages cocktail mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil grate.  Place the chile strips into a heat safe container, cover, and set aside.  Bring the yellow pepper strips, tomato ketchup, cocktail mix, and vanilla extract to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat, and simmer until slightly reduced to a thick sauce, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, and stir in the drained chile strips.  Serve warm.

title: Harmon's English Peppercorns Beer
ingredients: 1 gallon black beer | 3 -4 bunches mixed herbs | 1 quart white peppercorns
instructions: Rinse herbs completely and pick out the rocks and place in a large pot.  Fill the pot with beer and add mixed herbs.  Boil for 3 - 5 minutes until most of the herbs are open to expose more of a hole.

title: Nova Scotia Smoked Salmon - Canapes & Stuff!
ingredients: 1 can smoked salmon ( can use other smoked salmon too ) | 1/2 cup dry bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground de mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground papaya | 1/8 teaspoon peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Place the dried bread flour in a bowl, add the spices.  Rinse the salmon in cold water and dry thoroughly on paper towels.

title: White Bread and Butter Beans (Mujadarra)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 2 slices blanched almond nuts | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Pour beans into a heavy 8 inch oven proof skillet and cover the beans with 3/4 inch of water.  Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.  Meanwhile, toast almonds in skillet until a light brown, then combine with remaining ingredients.  When baked, place in serving bowl, spoon hot bean mixture over top and let cool.

title: Greek Berry Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, washed and hulled
instructions: Mix yogurt and berries.  Pour over any salad you like, like spinach, tomatoes, celery, onions.

title: Mildly Spiked Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 package processed american cheese ( american singles ), cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can condensed clamato juice | 1/2 cup finely chopped smoked ham | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( or fresh ) | 2 teaspoons pureed passion fruit
instructions: In bowl, combine the cheese, clamato juice, ham, oregano and passionfruit.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,apple,mace,apricot preserve,green cardamom pod,cilantro,cumin seed
title: Green Apple and Mushroom Curry
ingredients: 4 lbs apple, peeled, cored and sliced thin ( about 2 large-size ) | 6 small green cardamom pods | 2 fresh large fresh cilantro or 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 3 fresh mace, seeds optional | 2 lbs white mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 jar apricot preserves | cumin seed
instructions: Place apples in a skillet with 5 tbsppspn water and bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer for five minutes, then drain and set aside.  Add cardamom pods, cilantro, and mace seeds to skillet and fry until dark in color, about 2 minutes.  Remove cardamom pods and discard, cool slightly.  Add mushrooms, 1/2 cup water, mustard seed paste and preserves, plus a little more water if necessary, and cook over low to medium heat, stirring, until mushrooms are just about tender, about 10 minutes.  If necessary, cook for 2 minutes longer.

title: Beetroot and Rutabaga Mash
ingredients: 1 kg beet ( kent or other beet would be ideal here ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil ( extra virgin olive ) | 4 tablespoons currants | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 cups rutabagas ( rutabagas, turnips and turnips ) | butter, for baking
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c or gas mark scrub the beetroot and trim off the stalks, then cut into cubes.  Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a pan and fry the grated beetroot in small batches until almost crisp, set aside.  Fry bacon or grated pork and fry or crumble the currants, add to the oil along with the knorr cubes.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes, then return the beetroot to the pan and pour in the stock and bring to the boil, stirring.  Boil for 5 minutes and then drain the potatoes and mash well, using a large masher or in a food processor.  Serve the beetroot over some creamy mashed potatoes or mash some potatoes over the top.  Put in oven for 10 minutes or so until golden and bubbling.

title: Armenian Mussels
ingredients: 1 dozen mussels | rice vermicelli, enough for 2 servings
instructions: Soak the mussels in cold water for 5 to 10 minutes.  Scrub with a knife, and wash the inside.  Wash mussels under cold water, and pull off the shells.  Fill the pot with water and bring to a boil.  Add mussels, cover, and steam for 3 minutes.  Discard any mussels that open.  Remove from heat, and transfer to a serving bowl.  Prepare rice vermicelli according to the directions on the package.  Place in a serving dish, and top with seafood mix.  Serve immediately.

title: Faux Batter for Vegans and Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces green lentils | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon olive ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil.  Rinse the lentils under cold running water and drain, then place in a large mixing bowl with the flour and olive oil.  Place in the fridge for around 10 minutes to chill.  Use immediately or store in the fridge to serve cold.

title: Barbecued Sweetheart Sandwich With Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 6 small brussels sprouts | 2 cups shrimp ( shelled ) or 2 cups asparagus, chopped | 1/3 lb hamburger ( raw ) | 1 egg yolk | 1 -4 teaspoon rum ( i use white but if you like it less sweet the shrimp or add a splash of dark rum or leave out ) | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 teaspoon curry ( i use thai curry ) | 1/4 vanilla bean ( or 5 teaspoons vanilla extract )
instructions: Slice brussels sprouts to 1 inch lengths.  Cut asparagus stalks into 2 inch lengths and then cut each in half lengthwise.  Place the sprouts in a large bowl and soak for 1 hour to drain off the liquid.  In a large skillet cook the shrimp until pink.  Break into pieces and add the meat mixture, egg yolk, and rum to the skillet.  Cook over medium heat until the shrimp are pink, stirring all the time.  Add the tahini and curry and stir until it is fully incorporated into the mixture.  Divide mixture into a cone shape or a loaf shape and place onto a rack over paper towels to drain and cool.  I like to slice the bottom of the cone shape into a wedge and then place on a plate with a slice of bread to hold the filling.  It also pairs nicely when served with spicy cocktail sticks with a dab of sour dough, the honey sauce, and a bit of basting sauce.  You could also serve with pickled banana chips.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil,white bread,tofu,wheat flour,red chili sauce,jamaican jerk spice
title: Tofu & Chilli Tofu Nuggets (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour ( or whole wheat flour of your choice ) | 1/2 cup soft tofu ( in oil ) | 2 slices unsliced bread ( or multigrain bread ) | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1 1 tablespoon jamaican jerk spice ( or substitute chinese hot pepper paste ) | 1 teaspoon dried red chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf.  Lightly oil a baking sheet.  Sprinkle flour into a shallow dish.  Drain tofu completely on the paper towels, squeezing out excess moisture by hand.  Dice tofu coarsely and toss with flour.  Transfer tofu to a work surface and lightly press with your fingers to form a doughy texture.  Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for up to 1 hour.  Cut each slice of bread in half crossways, then divide into 4 triangles.  Press triangles into each other in the palm of your hand to make a patty shaped nuggetty, about 4 x2 inches.  Place on prepared baking sheet, spacing evenly.  Brush edges of each triangle with oil.  Bake for 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown.  Sprinkle with chilli sauce, if desired.  Serve warm.

title: Hot Chocolate (Thai Green Chili Sauce)
ingredients: 16 dried thai green chili | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 4 ounces coffee or 4 ounces milk flavored carbonated beverage
instructions: Roast the chilies on a grill or burner until blackened, turning as necessary.  Put chilies in a bowl.  Add sugar and mix.  Combine parmesan cheese and hot pepper.  Spoon into serving bowls and add 1 - 2 ice cubes to each.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,sun tomato oil,caper,turkey meat,salad oil
title: Turkey Picnic Platter
ingredients: 1/2 pound shaved sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 package chopped cooked turkey meat | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1/3 cup salad oil
instructions: Place tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes in a salad dish.  Arrange turkey, capers and chile peppers around the edge of the salad plate.  Drizzle salad oil on top.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage,vegetable shortening,liquid smoke,molasses,jalapeno pepper seed,corn tortilla chip,steak
title: Sausage Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs top round steak | 1 pound andouille sausage | vegetable shortening | 1 can jalapeno peppers and oregano peppers with molasses | 1/2 cup dry molasses | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 3 cups crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.  Cut meat into strips that are about 5 inches long and 2 inches wide.  Place meat, andouille in a large plastic zipper bag.  Add vegetable shortening, jalepenos, molasses, and liquid smoke.  Toss together, then coat meat well with mixture.  Grill meat for 7 minutes on each side, or until cooked to your liking.  Remove meat from grill, and serve accompanied with chips.

title: Cherry Pear Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup bow tie pasta, dry | 2 1/2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 cloves garlic, smashed | 1 tablespoon drained canned pears | 1/2 cup shredded beef | 1/4 cup fresh cherries, halved
instructions: Place pasta in a large serving bowl.  Add yogurt, garlic, pears, beef, lemon juice, and cherries.  Mix well, cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Tasty Sweet Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 1 bunch kale, chopped | 1/2 onion, quartered | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 20 ladyfingers, split
instructions: Chop flank steak into 1 inch pieces, about 1 - 2 in high.  In a skillet cook steak with onion and kale until desired doneness.  Drain any fat.  Add seasoning and peanut butter.  Stir until combined.  Place meat on large serving platter and spoon over desired amount of spicy peanut butter mixture.  Serve over taco shells.  If desired, garnish with a few lettuce leaves.

title: Jellied Chestnuts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chestnuts, quartered | 2 lbs cooked meatballs | 1/3 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Combine chestnuts and meatballs.  Add dressing and toss to coat evenly.  Chill.  Serve with french bread toasts.

title: Mince and Asparagus Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh asparagus | 1 tablespoon red onion | 2 tablespoons fresh beef, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon bamboo skewers or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon metal skewers
instructions: Cut rind off of asparagus, leaving the hard ends attached.  Cut the asparagus in 1 inch lengths, then slice into 3 inch pieces.  Place in a bowl.  Cut red onion into 1/4 inch dice, add to bowl, stir in beef, sweet peppers and pineapple juice.  Spoon beef mixture into 1/2 inch wide strips, place on skewers.  Sprinkle spices over skewers.  Skewer 3 - 4 skewers at a time.  Grill on high for 5 - 10 minutes or until they start to brown or eat the meat.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,walnut half,swiss cheese,clove,gruyere cheese,cooking oil,serrano pepper,ranch dressing
title: Famous Walnut Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 lb swiss cheese, sliced into long strips | 1/4 lb gruyere cheese, sliced into long strips | 1/4 lb swiss cheese, sliced into long strips | 1 green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips | 4 ounces swiss cheese, sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons walnut halves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/4 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Prepare your favorite recipe for swiss cheese, using the ingredients mentioned above in the ingredients list.  Mix the ground walnuts and garlic and toss with all the sliced cheeses and green pepper.  Allow to sit for 15 - 20 minutes to allow the flavors to develop and soften.  Stir in the ranch dressing now or you can make this quick and easy recipe and finish it off in the oven at 350 degrees f.  For a more robust taste, stir in some chopped nuts before serving.

title: Dolma's Persian Lentils and Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 cup dry lentils | 1 can fat-free chicken broth or ( 14 ounce ) can vegetable broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup dry sherry ( or any dark cooking sherry ) | 4 -6 cups hot mashed potatoes, warmed | 2 -3 teaspoons minced fresh chili peppers ( optional ) or 2 -3 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Note, to make gravy, combine lentils and broth and bring to boil, then reduce heat to simmer.  Simmer, covered for about 30 minutes while lentils are cooking.

title: Baked Cheese Hummus
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Combine chives and cottage cheese in a medium bowl until well dispersed.  Spread mixture in an 8x8 inch baking dish.  Bake on the middle rack of a 375f oven until the top is golden brown and the center is slightly crispy, about 30 minutes.

title: Ole! Buckeyes
ingredients: 2 packages light brown sugar, divided | 1 pound sliced pepperoni, chopped | 1 can jalapeno chiles, drained and sliced | 1 1/2 cups chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  In a large bowl, toss together the brown sugar and 1 package of pepperoni with the chopped jalapenos.  In a separate bowl, stir together the chopped pecans.  Roll the mixture into balls.  Place on a buttered baking sheet.  Coat with the remaining green 1/2 package of pepperoni, sliced jalapenos and remaining 1/2 package of pepperoni.  Bake in preheated oven until the cookies are golden and the tops are lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Celery and Carrots
ingredients: 1 celery, sliced | 4 slices salt pork, or as needed
instructions: Slice celery and carrot into thick rings.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Season salt pork with salt.  Cook until it begins to become crispy, about 15 minutes.

title: BBQ Chicken & Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 125 g chicken wings | 125 g cannellini beans, drained | 225 g courgettes, peeled and cut into 1cm cubes | 2/3 cup light molasses | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place chicken in the base of a 20cm x 20cm ovenproof dish.

Random Ingredients: leek,grapefruit juice,baby corn,saffron,artichoke heart,vegetable stock,egg noodle
title: Artichokes and Vegetables in Sorcchino
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh lemon strips, or more to taste | 6 artichoke hearts, sliced into strips 1/4-inch thick | 2 ounces baby corn, cut into strips | 1 package egg noodles | 6 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, drained liquid reserved
instructions: Cook and stir lemon strips in a skillet over medium heat until tender but not browned, about 3 minutes.  Mix artichoke strips, baby corn and baby corn in a large bowl.  Bring the vegetable broth and saffron to a boil.  Pour the liquid from the bottom of the pan into the broth, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.  Pour hot broth over artichoke mixture, and let stand for 1 minute.  Mix vegetable mixture with lemon strips and artichokes in the bowl to serve.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,pumpkin,barley,adobo seasoning,pearl barley,splenda sugar substitute,asafoetida powder,yellow squash
title: Pumpkin and Barley Raita(Fiber One Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups split yellow squash | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin or 1 1/2 cups sweet potatoes, cut into 4 chunks | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 3/4 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 3/4 cup barley
instructions: Dissolve 1 tbs cornstarch in 1 1/2 c of water and saute the barley and squash.  Combine all the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Add cornstarch and mix.  Serve the raita over your favourite bread.  Enjoy it will make a nice addition to your favorite veggies.

title: Simply Simple Potato and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 250 g simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 cup cheese sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Grease a 2 cup deep 2 cup ovenproof dish.  In a medium bowl combine the diced potatoes with onions.  Pour the cheese sauce over it and mix well, then spread into the prepared dish.  Place under the oven and bake for 40 50mins until golden.  Serve with sour cream or yoghurt.  Variations, for a change, substitute some brown or white bread cubes for some potato and cheese sauces.  Instead of cheese sauce, you can add chopped red chilies to the potato.

title: Homemade Low Fat French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can fat-free condensed chicken soup | 3/4 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Combine all contents in a saucepan or nonstick skillet.  Add enough water to just cover ingredients.  Boil about 10 minutes over medium heat or until water reaches thickest part.

title: Napa Goat's Linguine
ingredients: 200 g linguine | 1/3 cup walnuts, ground | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, ground | 1/2 cup crystallized lemon, zest | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 kg white fish fillet, cut into 4 equal pieces
instructions: Boil the water add the walnuts and boil for one minute.  Drain and rinse the linguine under a tap of cold water to cool, drain well and then add one piece of fish with a piece of walnut on top.  In a food processor mix the nuts with the zest as for dressing with half a cup of icing sugar.  Then in a separate container combine the rest of the icing sugar with a few tablespoons of boiling water and pour over the linguine.  Add the walnut mixture and stir well to coat all the pasta, and serve at once.

title: Creamy Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 2 cups mixed mushrooms ( i like cremini ) | 12 ounces condensed mushroom soup | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried mixed herbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Boil pasta for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside.  In a large bowl, combine all other ingredients.  Place pasta and remaining ingredients into the vegetable soup and blend until smooth.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,white chocolate,pizza crust,ice water,white peppercorn,mayonnaise,onion flake
title: Italian Potluck Pie #5FIX
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/8 cup instant potato flakes | 1/8 teaspoon powdered white peppercorns | 1/8 teaspoon onion flakes | 1/8 teaspoon pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice in water | 1 package white chocolate, melted
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, potato flakes, pepper, onion flakes and crust ingredients together.  Press evenly into the bottom and up the sides of a lightly greased 9 x 12 baking dish.  Sprinkle melted white chocolate evenly over crust.  Bake at 300 degrees for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes for 3 hours.  If making ahead, leave out crust ingredients and refrigerate for one day.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,rotini pasta,self raising flour,catsup,nacho cheese soup,vanilla extract,rosemary sprig
title: Mexican Rotini Cake
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 3 tablespoons catsup ( i prefer heinz ) | 1 tablespoon sprig fresh rosemary, leaves only ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups rotini pasta ( or other long pasta of your choice ) | 1 can nacho cheese soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced /400°f/5 gas mark spray or line a 20cm bundt loaf tin with parchment paper.  Put flour, picante sauce, catsup, rosemary and vanilla in a bowl.  Season the flour with a little salt and pepper as your using flour.  Add the pasta and mix to combine.  Turn the mixture into the prepared tin and sprinkle over the extra flour.  Bake for about an hour or until a skewer inserted comes out clean.

title: Low Calorie Syrup Syrup(Pista)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 3 whole saffron strands, soaked in warm water 30 minutes | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon salt ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium size pot, whisk the nonfat milk, saffron, lemon juice into the hot milk mixture and set aside to infuse for 2 hours on the lowest heat setting.  Remove the saffron from the milk mixture and reserve.  Add the salt and mix well.  Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to overnight on the smallest heat level or refrigerator longer, if desired.  When ready to refrigerate, stir in the hot syrup and adjust seasonings with more lemon juice or salt.

title: Warm Apricot and Bean Salad With Apricots over a Plate!
ingredients: 400 g canned cannellini beans | 200 g fresh apricots | 1 tablespoon light balsamic vinegar | 250 g mussels | 400 g flat corn | 50 g light caster sugar | 125 g crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Combine drained beans, apricots, balsamic vinegar, mussel shells and corn in a large pan.  Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, oruntil the shells open.  Discard any remaining mussels.  Serve warm, with a dollop of whipped cream, accompanied by a wedge of pineapple.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,food coloring,rice vinegar,pineapple juice,island dressing,elbow macaroni
title: Pineapple Hawaiian Salad
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon food coloring, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons thousand island dressing, to taste | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the cooked macaroni, pineapple juice, rice vinegar, food coloring, and the confectioners' sugar.  Mix well, but do not over mix.  Cover and chill.  Just before serving sprinkle with the optional confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,roast pork,chinese duck sauce,cube steak,tomato sauce,serrano pepper
title: Chinese Pork in Tomato Sauce (Kal Sui Gio)
ingredients: 2 lbs cube steaks | 3 cups plain yogurt | 1 can tomato sauce | 6 ounces roasted chinese duck sauce | 4 serrano peppers, roasted | 1 tomatoes, sliced in 4 to 5 thin slices ( for garnish )
instructions: Rinse the meat with cold water, and cut lengthwise in a steaks.  Place in a deep heavy pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered for 1 hour.  Remove meat with a slotted spoon and set aside.  In a saucepan, combine 1 cup yogurt with the tomsoy sauce and the roasted chiles until smooth.  Cover and cook over very low heat until the mixture thickens, stirring often.  Set aside.  Remove pot from heat.  Drain meat and pat dry with paper towels.  Place meat on separate bowls.  Ladle about 1/2 cup yogurt sauce over the meat.  Garnish with tomato slices and serrano slices.  Serve, passing remaining sauce separately at the table.

title: Grandma's Baked  Asparagus and Rice
ingredients:
6 bunches asparagus ( or equivalent size as desired ) | 2 bottles of your favorite beer ( i like miller lite ) or 2 bottles other beer | 2 tablespoons mrs.
    - dash seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons dry mesquite seasoning salt, not table salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple pie spice or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried apple pie spice | 1 bag shredded apple ( i prefer granny smith ) | 1 medium bag of fluffly crushed corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to cut off tough ends of asparagus and slice thinly on the diagonal about 2/3 the way.  Place cut asparagus in single layer onto a rack in a very large roasting pan.  Pour beer into the pan, so it comes up at least 3/4 full.  Sprinkle with 1 t.  Mrs.

title: Peachy Peaches & Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 carton cream-style cottage cheese | 2/3 cup peach schnapps, i use malibu brand and it comes out sweeter than grand marnier | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup light wine ( optional )
instructions: Combine cottage cheese and cream cheese in food processor.  Add remaining ingredients and whirl until smooth.  Pour into a nonstick pan.  Heat slowly over medium heat until a deep golden caramel forms over the top, about 10 minutes.  Turn into a bowl and set aside until cold, then cut into small squares and store in freezer bags as needed.  Makes 4 servings.

title: Cilantro Lime Cream Tagliatelle - Tagliatelle Ravioli
ingredients: 1 lb tempeh, diced ( or other firm pasta of your choice ) | 1 lb ladyfinger | 1 cup cilantro leaf, torn | 2 cups chickpea flour ( i use besan brand ) | 12 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles ( thin slices ) or 12 ounces rigatoni pasta noodles ( thin slices )
instructions: Cook the pasta, add the tempeh and cook in oil for about 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Place on a large plate, add the cilantro, season to taste with black pepper and refrigerate.  Mix together the chickpea flour and the chickpea flour and add to the skillet.  Bring to a boil, then reduce to low and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes.  Drain pasta and add to the sauce.  Add the tempeh mixture and stir.  Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Nuts
ingredients: 4 cups lightly packed fresh cilantro leaves, stems removed | 1/2 cup uncooked farfalle pasta ( bow tie ), uncooked | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Place the cilantro, farfalle pasta noodles, mustard and cilantro in a large pot.  Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium low.  Simmer, covered, until ingredients are tender, about 12 to 20 minutes.

title: Rice Noodle and Egg Noodle Pancakes
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups egg substitute | 1 cup sweet rice noodles ( mizumabakari ) | 4 -6 basil leaves, torn to large pieces | 1 cup unsweetened dried shredded coconut
instructions: Prepare the pancakes in a 6 to 8 inch nonstick skillet.  Place over medium low heat and stir continuously as the eggs dissolve.  When the eggs are fully set, stir in the noodles and basil.  Spray the nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and pour the pancake batter into the skillet.  Using 1 cup of batter per pancake, carefully lower each pancake in the pancake and cook for 2 to 3 minutes to lightly brown the sides and finish cooking all sides.  Transfer the pancake to a plate and top with shredded coconut and serve.

title: Tantalizing Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup finely chopped seeded chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon msg | 1 lb uncooked egg noodles, uncooked | 4 ounces scallops | 1 cup sliced green olives
instructions: In small saucepan, combine the corn syrup, chili peppers, lemongrass, and msg.  Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes until sauce is reduced slightly and syrupy.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add noodles and return to a boil.  Cook until just tender but firm to the bite.  Drain and rinse with hot water, and drain again.  Arrange noodles on a platter.  Top with scallops, onions, and olives.  Serve chilled.

title: Pickled Calamari
ingredients: 1 lb calamari, cleaned and tentacles cut out | 8 -10 stalks lemongrass ( with bulbs ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons korean red soy sauce ( gochujang ) | 1 green pepper | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Heat a saucepan of boiling water until it reaches boiling point.  Add the squid and cook until it is tender, about 4 - 5 minutes.  Cool.  Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard the calamari from the head and tentacles and slice the body into 1/8 in thick wedges.  Trim the heads as best you can.  Trim out the lemongrass stalks.  Cut the stalk into long, thin strips, add to the squid and mix.  Taste and adjust the seasoning.  Put a couple ice cubes on a plate.  Dip a small metal sushi stick into the ice cubes and let set for 30 seconds.  Use a wide knife to set the nori away from your shiny shiny shiny, flat looking leaves.  Using a melonballer, cut a slit down the middle of each lime to make a half moon shape.  Place 1/4 cup of the squid and its tentacles in the center of each slice of fish.  Moisten the edge of the slice with a little water.  Wrap the slice in the nori.  Repeat this to wrap the fish in the nori.  Serve when the fish is almost completely cooked.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,elbow macaroni,hard egg,baking powder,green lentil,hot italian sausage
title: Lentil & Sausage Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked elbow macaroni | 7 -8 ounces old elk hot italian sausage, sliced ( any sausage or sweet pepper will do ) | 1 bunch asparagus, chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 cup green lentil | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped into small pieces | hot italian sausage, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, fry the sausage until browned on all sides.  Drain off any excess grease if necessary.  Add the asparagus and lentils and toss together.  Sprinkle the baking powder over the mixture and mix well.  Add the hot sausage and mix, breaking it up and stirring frequently.  Drain the pasta, return it to the pan, and add the sausage mixture.  Toss together.  Divide into serving sized portions.  Sprinkle on the chopped hard boiled egg.  Serve hot, with crusty bread or crackers.  Serve with french bread and pickles in the winter.  This macaroni dish is very hearty and has a good accompanying cheese bread and butter.

title: Mexican Tomato Pies - Simple!
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tomato soup ( i use campbells ) | 1 cup maize cornmeal | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 dash cumin powder | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 lime, wedges to garnish | 200 g pasta
instructions: First, make the base for the pies.  For this i just make a 'bouquet garni' by first browning the maize cornmeal and using a spice mill.  Add the cumin, cinnamon and cumin seeds and keep stirring to combine.  Now mix together the flour & cornmeal, then add the tomato soup slowly till you get a fine batter.  You can use water if you don't have a pestle or a blender.  Now spoon the batter on one tray and using a fork press each of them well to ensure you don't mash the batter as much as you might think, as this will ensure a 'crumbly' base.  Once cooked put aside to rest.  After this they freeze very well and when cold it can be kept in the freezer either way.  When you get them ready put the freezer tray on your counter and cut out circles of tin about 15cm/4cm larger than your pies.  Make sure the tin is big enough for the pastry to fit into the tins.  Take a pastry brush and lightly spread the base with a little water.  Spread the base to cover the bottom of the tin.  Sprinkle cornmeal over the top.  Fill each tin one third full with pasta.  Cover the tin tightly with tin foil and cook in a 400f for 30 - 40 minutes.  Take out and sprinkle on more cornmeal, if you want it.  Remove cover and cook for a further 15 minutes then remove foil.  Let the pies sit for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.  Variation, if you can get your cornmeal from a local mexican grocer, then you can get away with your mexican grocer mashing it finely, or you can leave out half of the buttery mixture and add half of the cream.  If you want a less 'cakey' base, then this is probably the only option.  However, as the cornmeal has to be ground you can make a fairly thickish topping with the cornmeal and cream and just sifting all of the dry ingredients with the cornmeal.  Another option is to melt the butter in a skillet and mix in half of the milk mixture to the top and stir well and add remaining milk mixture.  Spread filling over the top and bake in 450f oven with foil on for about 15 minutes, then remove foil and bake for a further 15 mins until it is golden brown, check after 15 - 20 minutes then serve.

title: Pesto & Pasta Sauce(Barsi Sequiera Con Carne)
ingredients: 500 g mixed vegetables ( such as potatoes, capsicum and a sprinkling of dried herbs such as tarragon ) | 1 liter double cream | 200 g pesto sauce | 500 g grated fresh parmesan cheese or 500 g grana padano
instructions: Boil the mixed vegetables in water until cooked, but still with some bite.  Once cool, drain thoroughly.  Grate the cooked vegetables and set aside.  Put the mixed vegetables into a large pot of boiling, salted water, and cook until vegetables are tender.  When cool, drain well, rinse and dry with a cloth, and then place into a large bowl of cold, salted water for 30 minutes, or until cold again.  Drain.  Stir the cream into the pesto and gently mix into the vegetable mixture.  Add the grated cheese and mix well.  Serve at room temperature and refrigerate until needed.

title: Korean Tuna Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 can tuna packed in water
instructions: Cut the fillet into 2 to 2 1/2 inch strips.  In a large freezer plastic bag, place tuna, and marinade the steak in the bag for 7 to 8 hours.  Remove the tuna from the marinade, put into a shallow bowl, and refrigerate the steak for an hour or as long as it takes for the meat to be dry.  Cook the steak in a skillet over high heat for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until it is medium rare.  You want it cooked through.  Serve on a platter and top with your favorite sides on a large bun or hot dog, such as korean fries.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,red bell pepper,orange juice,chambord raspberry liquor
title: Chambord Bell Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 6 cans sliced bamboo shoots - drained | 1 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 red bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup red bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place bamboo shoots in a mixing bowl.  Combine chambord and orange juice.

Random Ingredients: leek,szechuan peppercorn,salt black pepper,wheat flour,dark soy sauce,bailey irish cream,beet
title: Beetroot Sliders
ingredients: 16 medium size beet | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 8 ounces wheat flour | 1/2 ounce szechuan peppercorns | 2 ounces dark soy sauce | 1 ounce baileys irish cream | leeks ( to garnish ) or scallion ( to garnish )
instructions: Dice the beetroot and remove the core, leaving about 1 inch of beets to make 8 small beetroots.  Use a sharp knife to slice off the beetroot's thick stalk ends.  Cut the beetroots into thin slices.  Cut the slices in half.  Use a large nonstick frying pan with the salt, pepper and sichuan peppercorns.  Pan fry the beetroot on both sides until just tender, turning them as necessary to keep them from sticking.  Transfer the beetroot to a bowl and allow them to cool.  Place the flour in a bowl, gradually add the sichuan peppercorns.  Add about a cup of water to bind the flour, and begin adding the flour with your wet fingers, mixing the mixture with your hands as you go, adding more water if necessary, until you have a soft, sticky dough.  Transfer the dough to a floured surface, knead lightly, then cover with a large clean cloth and leave to rest until your dough is very firm.  Roll out the dough to about 1 1/4 inch thickness, transfer the fat off the fat and leave to rest for a few minutes.  Cut out eight fingers and shape them into sticks about 3 inch wide and 5 - 5 inches long.  Wrap them in plastic and chill until needed.  Cut off the scallions.  Remove the peel from the beetroot and cut the beetroot slices into fingers about 1/2 inch wide and 4 inches long.  Place them on an ungreased baking sheet that you have sprayed with oil.  Brush each slit with a little olive or bbq sauce, top with a beetroot slice and press lightly to coat the beetroots with the bran.  Cover with the plastic wrap, place in the fridge and leave to marinate overnight.  Cut the dough into fingers using a biscuit cutter, or a pizza cutter.  Place them on two baking sheets and bake at c for 15 minutes until the tops lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,lemon juice zest,clove,cremini mushroom,onion,milk chocolate
title: Mushroom Chocolates
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons lemon juice or 2 tablespoons juice from the lemon | 1 teaspoon dried lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 12 cremini mushrooms, sliced 1/3 inch thick | 1 ounce milk chocolate or 1 ounce semisweet chocolate
instructions: In skillet, cook onion in the 1 tbsp water until tender.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,chili flake,brown rice,japanese eggplant,five spice powder,mustard powder,cider,filet beef
title: Japanese Style Beef and Eggplant  Tanaka to Be Seared(Beef & Eggplant Teriyaki)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 lbs filet of beef, thinly sliced across the grain | 6 japanese eggplants, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( preferably purple-type ) | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder, plus extra to taste | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 3 -4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar or 3 -4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup brown rice
instructions: Heat a pan with sesame oil over medium high heat.  Working in batches, add beef to pan in batches, turning to saute.  Cook until well browned.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Lay eggplant in one layer on a piece of kitchen foil.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning until eggplant is lightly browned and tender.  Drain off any excess oil, cut into thick slices.  Transfer eggplant to a large bowl and add 2 tbsp of five spice and chili flakes.  Add 2 tbsp rice vinegar, then stir to combine.  Add mustard and stir to combine.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Transfer to a serving dish or plate and spread out to cool.  Serve in wedges with brown rice.  Note, be sure to use brown rice so as not to over salt when preparing the beef.  You will also need to add extra mustard if you prefer a more pronounced flavor.

title: Pepper-Grapes
ingredients: 2 large bell peppers | 1/2 cup sugar substitute, sugar free
instructions: Preheat grill.  Cut peppers in half lengthwise and remove seeds.  Brush with oil.  Place on grill and flatten into 4 - 6 circles.  Brush with oil.  Grill 4 - 8 minutes on each side, or until peppers are slightly charred.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vodka,poblano chile,ice water,veal,cinnamon,marinara sauce,butter,dark brown sugar
title: Saucy Cured Veal (Al Forno En Nogada)
ingredients: 4 lbs veal, whole, with bone, and tied | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 pint ice water | 2 poblano chiles, canned, washed, debearded and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1 cup vodka or 1 cup port wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 bottles marinara sauce ( use a good one like newman's own )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the marinara sauce.  Place the meat in a large stock pot and pour the marinara sauce over it.  Put the lid on the pot and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Decrease heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, adding more water as necessary to cover.  The meat should be very tender and falling off the bones.  Remove the strings, shred meat with 2 forks and place in a dish.  Strain the sauce through a fine sieve, return to the pan using the remaining sauce and simmer, stirring all the while, until slightly thickened.  Pour the sauce through a colander into another large pot, pressing it down hard with the back of a spoon to extract all the sauce.

title: Noodles and Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add ziti pasta, and cook until al dente, about 13 to 15 minutes.  Drain, and return to the pot.  While pasta is cooking, place 3 tortillas on a microwave safe plate.  Place 2 or more tortillas on top of the tortillas, and cover with a towel.  Microwave on high for about 20 seconds.  Carefully remove the towel, and place ziti in a medium bowl.  Cover with microwave safe water.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes, or until pasta is tender.  Drain.  Serve ziti over the tortillas, and garnish with any remaining tortillas, if desired.

title: Crispy Basil Pesto Rollups
ingredients: 1/3 cup basil pesto | 5 flour tortillas | 2 cups sliced strawberries, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Pour pesto over tortillas in a flat dish, and place on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until brown, 5 to 10 minutes.  Spread a thin layer of pesto over each tortilla, and roll up.  Repeat with remaining tortillas, pesto sauce, and strawberries.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,romaine lettuce,vegetable,purpose white flour,lime zest,pimento olive,cranberry juice
title: Torta Di Fagioli (Lettuce and Vegetable Toss)
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable, chopped | 1/3 cup yellow onion, minced ( such as vidalia, walla walla or other sweet onion ) | 4 cups chopped assorted fresh vegetables | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest ( or 1/2 lime ) | 2/3 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 2 teaspoons all-purpose white flour | 1/4 cup cranberry juice
instructions: In a large bowl, toss chopped onion with vegetables.  Add zest, pimento, flour and cranberry juice.

title: Jalapeno Jelly
ingredients: 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sugar or 1 1/2-2 cups sugar
instructions: Remove stems.  Cut chiles lengthwise into 1/4 slices.  Soak in water for 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain and rinse chiles well.  Cut in chunks.  Wrap the pieces in wax paper and form a jelly shape.  Bake on baking rack in preheated 325f oven for 1 1/2 2 hours.  Remove from oven and brush the jelly on the chile chunks until well glazed.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,tomato green chilies,spinach leaf,chili paste,topping
title: Maple Spinach Dip
ingredients: 32 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves or 4 cups fresh frozen chopped spinach | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1/3 cup frozen whipped topping | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Prepare frozen or fresh spinach according to package directions, drain.  Place frozen or fresh spinach to the slow cooker add can of and green chilies, and tomato puree.  Mix well.  In small bowl, mix whipped topping with maple syrup and chili paste.  Sprinkle over spinach.  Cover and cook on low 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Serve with corn tortilla chips or corn chips.

title: Spinach Pods
ingredients: 1 box fresh spinach leaves | 3/4 cup roasted peanuts or 3/4 cup cashews, coarsely chopped, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: If using dried or fresh spinach, place in a bowl, cover with water and allow to soak until tender, 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain and cool completely.  Place the spinach into a large dutch oven or heavy duty freezer bag.  Toss with peanuts or cashews.  Sprinkle with garlic powder and vanilla.  Heat over medium heat, stirring until nuts are well toasted and fragrant.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: hot water,celery leaf,pearl barley,nacho cheese soup,ancho chile,chicken bouillon
title: Ancho Chiles and Barley With Nacho Cheese
ingredients: 4 dried ancho chiles | 6 -8 cups hot water | 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 can condensed nacho cheese soup | 1/2 cup fresh celery leaves | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile | 1 2/3 cups pearl barley
instructions: Place chiles and hot water in a large heavy duty microwave safe casserole.  Cover and microwave on high power for 10 to 12 minutes, until chiles are soft and no longer releasing their oil.  Meanwhile, in a blender, combine soup, celery leaves and ancho chiles.  Process on high for about 15 seconds until hot.  Add barley, stir until blended and then transfer mixture to a large bowl.  Add chile mixture and stir.  Season with salt or pepper, to taste.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,custard powder,basmati rice,anchovy fillet,dark beer,vegetable oil,fig
title: Aarti's Baked Basmati Pudding
ingredients: 250 g basmati rice | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 cans plum tomatoes, drained | 2 anchovy fillets | 150 ml dark beer | 2 tablespoons custard powder | 150 g dried figs, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c.  Rice cooker, place rice cooker on a lid and leave in it's lid for 10 minutes.  Remove the lid and turn rice cooker on again.  When cooker stops steaming, fluff up the rice to break apart any lumps.  Add oil and leave to rest for 10 minutes.  Turn oven temperature down to 180c.  Line a baking tray with baking paper.  Place tomatoes, anchovies and drained figs into a baking tray large enough to fit the tray.  Pour the beer into the tray and stir the contents to combine.  Mix the custard powder into warm tomato mixture and pour into rice cooker.  Close the lid and turn rice cooker on again and leave to cook for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and leave to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,baking soda,sugar snap pea,catsup,roquefort cheese,pecan
title: French Baked Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 cup sugar snap pea, strings removed | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup catsup, extra | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup freshly chopped pecans | 1/4 cup thinly sliced roquefort cheese, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a roasting pan with parchment paper.  Place the sugar snap peas in the pan.  Bake the peas, uncovered, for 8 minutes.  Stir until crisp tender, about 4 minutes longer.  Remove and set aside on paper towels to cool.  Dissolve 1/4 cup catsup and the sherry into the sugar snaps in the pan.  Drizzle the extra jup over the snap peas and continue baking at 400 degrees for 12 - 15 minutes more, until sugar snaps are hot and glazed.  Meanwhile, mix the remaining catsup, oil, and remaining fruit in a bowl.  Remove the french baking from the oven and brush the topping evenly over the slices.  Sprinkle with the pecans.  Serve.

title: Jelly Eggs
ingredients: 12 eggs | 1/2 cup chopped chilies | 1 cup miniature marshmallow | 2 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons jelly
instructions: Wash eggs under cold running water.  Beat eggs, chillies, marshmallows, bay leaves and jelly until creamy.  Pipe mixture into 6 sterilized jars.  Wipe rims with a clean, damp cloth.  Pour hot jelly on top.  Put lids on and screw on rings.  Put in a water bath for 15 minutes.  Turn jars over and let eggs harden completely.

title: Chiles Verde
ingredients: 1 can tomatillos, rinsed ( reserve juice ) | 1 can mexican-style corn ( reserve liquid ) | 1/2 teaspoon butter | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Rinse tomatillos well, drain, place in a food processor, chop roughly and reserve juice.  Mix all ingredients in a 2 or 3 quart slow cooker.  Cover and refrigerate overnight if desired.  Serve with mexican style corn on the cob or flour tortillas, with warm flour tortillas for scooping on the table.

title: Italian Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 10 zucchini | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash zucchini well by boiling in a covered pan for about 7 minutes or until just starting to wrinkle.  Drain in a colander and return to pan.  Add worcestershire sauce.  Toss well.  Sprinkle with coriander before serving.

title: Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1 lb scallops, halve | 1/2 lb lettuce, leaf cut from lettuce, or torn into bite-size pieces | 12 ounces mexican cheese, grated | 12 ounces malibu rum ( i use malibu peaches, or other brand ) | 1 sprig of sprigs of fresh mint or 1 mint leaf, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In a large nonstick skillet, add onion and spinach and stir fry over medium heat until onions are translucent and spinach is wilted, about 2 minutes.  Add scallops and top with lettuce.  Cook, uncovered, until cheese has melted, about 2 minutes.  Remove from heat, add rum and garnish with mint or basil if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,ricotta cheese,vodka,duck breast,oil peanut,cardamom powder
title: Kuancaina
ingredients: 1/3 lb cow's milk ricotta cheese | 12 ounces beef tenderloin | 12 ounces duck breasts | 1 cup oil ( peanut, soy, coconut, or olive ) | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Soak the cow's milk in a pot for at least 30 minutes in enough water to cover.  In a bowl put the beef tenderloin and duck breasts, brush with the oil and sprinkle with a pinch of cardamom.  Pour enough water over the meat so that it should cover completely and soak for 2 hours minimum in a covered pot.  Drain all of the liquid and put in saucepan.  Cut the meat and put in pot with the soaked milk.  Add the rest of ingredients.  Cover and cook on low heat for 1 1/2 2 hours til it can be easily pulled from the bone and eaten, or can be served with rice if you like.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,corn kernel,kidney bean,white peppercorn,chinese chili paste
title: Shrimp Nuts With Beans
ingredients: 1/4 cup canned kidney beans | 1 jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1/4 cup corn kernel | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon chinese chili paste
instructions: Clean shrimp and devein shrimp.  Combine rest ingredients and marinate shrimp in mixture for 1 hour minimum.  Boil shrimp in wok or deep fryer 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,ketchup,paprika,dark beer,mustard seed,baking potato,hot salsa,szechuan peppercorn
title: Potato Ketchup (Potatoes) With Szechuan Peppercorns
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled, washed and cut into eighths | 1 cup dark beer | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, cracked ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | hot salsa ( optional )
instructions: Place the potato pieces in a shallow baking dish.

title: Cheshta Dip
ingredients: 2 yellow peppers, roasted and skinned | 10 ounces cottage cheese ( not low fat or fat free ) | 4 tablespoons strained lemonade ( from one or two lemons ) | 2 3 dashes liquid smoke | 3/4 - 1 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Place roasted and skinned peppers in blender along with cottage cheese.  Blend until smooth.  Add lemonade and liquid smoke, and add remaining ingredients.  The consistency should be about the consistency of canned milk.  Cover and blend at low speed until smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,onion juice,topping,limeade,escarole,asafoetida powder,vanilla ice cream,ha avocadoes
title: Irish Smuggler Smoothie
ingredients: 1 large hass avocado - peeled, pitted and cubed | 1 tablespoon onion juice | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish-flavored liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 bunches escarole - rinsed, trimmed and cut into bite-size pieces, or as needed | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream, divided | 1 container fat-free frozen whipped topping, divided
instructions: Whisk avocado, onion juice, lime wedge, whiskey, horseradish liquid smoke, and asafoetida together in a bowl.  Mix escarole and 1 tablespoon ice cream together in a second bowl.  Rinse 2 tablespoons juiced vegetable oil in a third bowl.  Shake excess ice cream from top of guacamole mixture in a third bowl with a small amount of oil to prevent curling.  Stir garlic powder and avocado mixture into mashed avocado until mashed avocado is creamy and smooth, 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer mash to the top of guacamole mixture.

Random Ingredients: bottom steak,red enchilada sauce,beer,monterey jack pepper cheese,yellow pepper,pistachio,cream
title: Beef and Cheese Enchiladas - 5 Ww Points
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 3 tablespoons beer or 3 tablespoons milk | 3/4 - 1 lb boneless bottom round steak, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 small yellow sweet pepper, diced
instructions: Combine the first seven ingredients.  Combine meat and vegetables.  Roll 2 - 3 tablespoons mixture onto a heated griddle.  Cook 3 - 4 minutes each side or until the bottom is just barely cooked through.

title: Vegetarian Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 200 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala or 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, remove from the heat and add the spaghetti.  Let it sit until the pasta is done, not overcook it.  Remove 1/2 cup of the pasta water and reserve.  Bring the empty pot of water to a boil and add 1 teaspoon of the salt.  Add the sliced mushrooms and stir them in until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.  Drain the spaghetti and put it in a big bowl.  Pour all the liquid from the mushrooms in the bowl, add the soy sauce, garam masala or curry powder to it and mix well.  Pour this over the spaghetti and mix well.  Add the reserved pasta water from the pot of pasta.  Stir well and add the hazelnuts until they are all coated.  Toss with a large plate and serve.

title: Cumin and Chile Paste
ingredients: 1/4 medium cucumber | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons mexican chili powder or 2 teaspoons jalapeno chili powder | 1/8 cup kale, chopped
instructions: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise and remove the seeds with a spoon.  Toss the cucumber halves, chili paste, chili powder and chopped kale together and serve.  It is ideal when served with fresh or prepared tortilla chips.

title: Crazy Snack (Crazy Coconut Dip)
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread coconut on a piece of aluminum foil.  Sprinkle on yellow mustard if desired.  Wrap foil in a layer of paper towels until ready to use.  Place on a baking sheet.  Bake biscuits in the preheated oven until dry and slightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.  Cool completely on the baking sheet.  Serve warm.

title: Spicy Bacon and Apricot Filling
ingredients: 1 package bacon-wrapped prosciutto, cut width-wise into 12 slices | 1/4 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons bacon fat | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 jar prepared alfredo sauce | 1 box frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped
instructions: Cook bacon strips in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 8 minutes, then crumble in a large bowl and set aside.  Add celery to drippings remaining in pan and cook until tender, 4 to 5 minutes.  Add curry paste and cook, stirring, 1 minute.  Stir in alfredo sauce and return to a boil.  Remove from heat and add whipped topping and peanuts.

title: Quick and Easy Ramen
ingredients: 1 package dry chicken-flavored ramen noodles | 3 -5 grape tomatoes, chopped | 2 -3 finely chopped onions or 2 -3 green onions, to taste
instructions: Soak the ramen noodles in hot water until softened.  Squeeze softened noodles out of the water and set aside. .  In a small bowl, add onion and chopped tomato.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,cooking spray,mustard seed,malt vinegar,caraway seed,sun tomato,cream cheese
title: Tomato and Tamarind Spread
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup tamarind pulp | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 cup light cream cheese | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor.

title: Apple-Date Crisp
ingredients: 1 apple pie filling | 2 flour tortillas | fresh basil leaves, sliced ( to garnish ) | 2 dates, pitted, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oven to 350f degrees.  Fill tortillas with apple pie filling.  Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.  Slice the dates and arrange on top of the dates.  Bake 10 min at 350f degrees.  Sprinkle with fresh basil and let cool.

title: French Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf french baguette | 1 1/4 cups sour cream
instructions: Remove the crust from the loaf, place in a 9x13 baking dish, or you can break it up to make individual wedges for dipping.

title: French Country Style Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 rib eye steaks, bone-in | 4 tablespoons coffee granules ( or hot water ) | 1/3 cup instant powdered cake flour | 1 teaspoon dried chives or 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 3/4 cup mascarpone or 3/4 cup mascarpone cheese | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Dissolve 1 tsp of the coffee granules in the hot water.  Cut 2 ribs in half and arrange on a rack set 4 inches above a simmering pot.  Let the meat stand in the liquid for 10 minutes, then turn the ribs over and repeat until done.  Prepare the sauce.  In a bowl stir together the remaining coffee granules, cake flour, chives or rosemary and 1/4 cup of the cheese.  Remove the meat from the sauce, pat dry with paper towels.  Brush the meat with half of the glaze, and sprinkle with pepper.  Heat the remaining glaze and brush over the meat.  Serve at once.

title: Homemade Beef Soup With Instant Pot
ingredients: 1 liter hash browns ( leftover hash browns ) or 1 liter leftover potatoes ( leftover hash browns ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 vegetarian beef bouillon cubes | 1 lb lasagna noodle ( small )
instructions: Prepare an instant pot with the bouillon cubes and bring to a boil.  Add hash browns and return to a boil.  Add a little water as necessary to cook until the mixture comes to a boil again.  Turn down heat.

title: Pumpkin Soup With Ginger and Raisins
