title: Spicy Chili Dip for Turkey
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | fresh thyme sprigs, chopped
instructions: Remove cores from fennel, slice off the green top, core and finely slice the stalk.  Remove leaves from fennel bulb & fry them lightly in a bit of olive oil on both sides.  Once browned remove and place in a bowl.  Drain fennel liquid, return liquid to pan & gently thicken.  Add cream of mushroom soup, & mix in herbs, mixing well.  Serve over your favourite chips.

title: Jalapeno Zucchini (Zucchini) Salad
ingredients: 1 pound zucchini, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Stir the zucchini, jalapeno pepper, honey, and italian seasoning together in a bowl, then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving.

title: Ancho Chili Powder Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 package orecchiette or ( 18 ounce ) package cavatappi ( 2 x 8-inch ) | 8 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 3/4 cup pure ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cook orecchiette according to package directions.

title: Czech Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb frozen french style green beans, cut in half | 4 tablespoons baking cocoa | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Bring water to a boil.  Add beans.

title: Lobster Salad with Oyster Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons minced onion | 1/2 cup chopped sweet onion | 1/2 can tuna packed in water snipped into 3-4 pieces | 3 cans lobster tails ( not imitation ) | 1 1/2 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 1 cup finely shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the minced onion, tuna, minced sweet onion, diced tomatoes, and cooked lobster.  If using imitation lobster, remove flesh from shell and place on top of mixture in the bowl.

title: Tex Mex Oxtail
ingredients: 1 pound oxtails | 2 cans salsa verde | 4 pods frozen okra
instructions: Place oxtails into a large, deep skillet.  Bring enough water to cover them by 2 inches.  Bring water to a boil and immediately remove from the heat.  Lay oxtails onto a plate, then cover with aluminum foil.  Allow to steam in the microwave until oxtails are halfway done, 7 to 9 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f.  Pour salsa verde over oxtails.

title: Skewered Prawns
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns | 1/4 cup onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon almond extract
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns.  Marinate overnight in the following.  Chilling and deep frying method,.  Rinse the prawns and pat dry.  Cook in boiling hot water until they turn pink or just cooked.  Drain and pat dry, then toss through a kitchen food spice bag.  Heat a pan.  Add the onion flakes, onion flakes and almond extract.  Mix well.  Add prawns and gently fry for 5 minutes or until just cooked through.  Serve hot with a salad and boiled rice.

title: North African-Style Lamb
ingredients: 450 g lamb, cut into serving pieces | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Sprinkle the lamb with the cumin and cayenne in a plastic bag and toss around until well coated.  Cover loosely with clingfilm and chill, covered for 1 hour.  Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade.  Bring 5 cups water to the boil in a large saucepan.  Add the lamb pieces and reduce heat to medium.  Cook for 11 minutes.  Add salt if necessary and cook for an additional seven minutes until the meat is cooked through.  Transfer the lamb to a large roasting tin, cover and put into the oven for 30 minutes.  Remove the cover, remove any excess fat and cook for 30 minutes or until the juices run clear.  Remove from oven and leave to stand for ten minutes.  Serve topped with any of the chunky sauce you have passed around at the table.

title: Filling for Danish Pastry
ingredients: 3 cups chickpea flour | 1 cup chopped fresh chickpea flour
instructions: Combine 2 cups chick pea flour, 1 cup of the chick pea flour and 1 cup chick pea flour in a bowl.  Combine well by hand.  Divide in half using 1/8 cup of batter for the first layer.  Second layer should have about the same consistency as the first layer of batter.  On top layer brush the top with 1/8 cup of the remaining batter.  Sprinkle the second 1/8 cup of chick pea flour on top and repeat.  Cover each piece of pastry so it doesn’t get soggy.  Use a plastic bag directly on top of the dough and let rest for 20 mins before using.  Preheat oven to 375 f and line one half sheet pan with parchment paper or parchment paper. .  Roll out the pastry dough into a rectangle approximately 10 or less in diameter so that it’s about 1/2 thick and about 14x18 inches.  Use a pastry wheel to create a 'x' on the top layer and use your thumb to make a depression for the pastry to exit.  Bake until the pastry has puffed, risen and become a light brown, about 30 more minutes.

title: Beer With Herbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Mix beer and oregano.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,red pepper flake,plum jam,mozzarella cheese,pea,peanut,chicken broth
title: Spicy Pea & Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh peas | 1 can plum jam | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup frozen reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, thawed | 1/4 cup whole-milk mozzarella cheese, diced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup roasted unsalted peanuts, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook peas, if using, in rapidly boiling water 4 - 5 minutes or until just tender, stirring occasionally.  Transfer peas to a food processor.  Add jam, broth, cayenne, crushed red pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt, and blend until smooth.  Stir in cheese and 1/4 cup mozzarella, adjust seasonings.  Chill soup.  Top with remaining cheese, nuts, and additional crushed red pepper if desired, if desired.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,italian sausage link,mint leaf,crisco shortening,arrowroot,chocolate
title: Savory Italian Sausages and Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage links | 1 1/2 tablespoons crisco shortening, divided | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 1 can kidney beans, drained ( optional ) | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate, grated, divided
instructions: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat, add 1/2 tbsp crisco then the sausage.  Cook until browned, about 5 - 7 minutes.  Remove the sausage from pan and set aside.  Add remaining crisco and the mint to pan over medium heat then stir to coat the bottom with crisco.  Add 1 tbsp crisco and 3/4 cup of the mint and stir to coat.  Remove mint from pan, stir in arrowroot, and then add undrained kidney beans.  Stir until combined then reduce heat to low.  Add chocolate.  Stir until chocolate is melted and no liquid has left, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Pour mixture into ovenproof serving dish and top with remaining 1 tbsp crisco.  Add remaining 1/2 tbsp mint and 1/2 tsp crisco.  Broil until top is golden brown and bubbling, about 30 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Spring Roll
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 frozen meatballs, thawed ( you can even use leftover meat, about 11-12 ) | 2 medium carrots, cut lengthwise into 4 long strips | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon zest, grated | 1/4 lb fresh arugula, washed, dried, and well dried | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat baking sheet with cooking spray.  Place meatballs on prepared sheet.  Top each with carrots, italian seasoning, zest, and arugula.  Bake for 10 minutes or until meatballs are done.  To serve, top each individual roll with orange grated zest.

title: Cod Crunchy
ingredients: 16 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 2 cans campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup sour cream | 8 ounces cooked cod, cubed | 1/2 cup crumbled dates
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f cook noodles according to package directions until tender, not overcooked.  Combine soup, sour cream, cod and dates in a saucepan and heat until warmed through.  Place noodles and sauce in an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cover the noodles with the soup mixture.  Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake for 35 - 40 minutes, until heated through.  Remove from oven, and sprinkle with grated cheese.  Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Smoked Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 1 pound smoked salmon steaks, cut in bite-size pieces | 4 jalapenos, chopped
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add in the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Chinese Cashew Nuts -- a Yummy Beverage...
ingredients: 1 lb chinese rice wine, rice sticks | 1/2 lb cashew nuts | 6 tablespoons of good coffee
instructions: Dry the cashews in a small frying pan, sprinkle each on one side with a layer of rice wine, a sprinkling of chopped nuts and a good splash of coffee.  Serve with a sprig of fresh chinese green garnish as an accompaniment.

title: Frugal Gourmet's Easy Meat Skillet Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower and carrots ) | 1 can beef & rice roni, cooked ( any brand ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: In 6 qt sauce pan brown the ground meat until crumbly.  Add 1/2 the reamaining package of frozen veggies and the drained package of rice.  Cook until all ingredients are hot.  Taste and add salt and pepper or pepper if desired.  Add oregano.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,tomato puree,linguine,splenda granular,black olive,rye flour
title: Raspberry Olive Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pasta ( linguini, macaroni, or bow-tie ) | 4 ounces fresh raspberries and black olives | 1/2 cup splenda granular ( or other sugar substitute ) | 1/3 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 3 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until just tender but still firm to the bite, drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, place the raspberries, black olives, splenda granular, and tomato puree in a bowl and stir to combine.  Add pasta, stirring constantly and adding more splenda if necessary to coat everything.  Cover and continue to simmer, stirring a few times and then remove the lid and continue to simmer until all the liquid from the tomato sauce has completely absorbed and the sauce is slightly thickened, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Add more splenda if needed to balance out the sugar/splenda/sugar.  Stir in the raspberry mixture and remove from heat.  To serve, divide hot pasta between plates and spoon over the tomato tomato sauce and sprinkle with sliced black olives.

title: Tortilla Whole Wheat Spanish Covered in Chocolate - Hu
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat semisweet chocolate bar ( or other brand ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon quick-cooking tapioca ( can be found at latin specialty food stores or asian specialty stores ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 small whole wheat tortillas, halved | 1 lb pasta ( i use dreamfields'small multigrain pasta )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the chocolate bar in a heat proof bowl.  In a small saucepan, melt the chocolate and turmeric over medium high heat.  Stir frequently until melted about 5 minutes.  Remove from the heat and stir in the nutmeg, tapioca.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,plain flour,virgin olive oil,breadcrumb,cherry tomato,cocoa powder,mace
title: Finger licking the Canard for Picnic Sausages
ingredients: 600 g plain flour | 3 teaspoons cocoa powder | 300 ml tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tablespoon fresh coriander | 1 pinch of ground mace | 400 g sliced hot cherry tomatoes
instructions: Place the flour, cocoa powder and a pinch of salt in a food processor and pulse to make a fairly coarse, crumb like breadcrumb add the vinegar and olive oil and mix until you have a paste then add a tablespoon of the tarragon and mace.  Knead the dough to manageable shape and wrap around your fingers roll out on a board with 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut out a hole in the centre of the dough and fill with cherries.  Roll the sausage and tie them with kitchen string.  Repeat until all the sausage has been used.  Place the canards on a lightly greased baking tray, brush with remaining oil and bake for 45 - 50 minutes in a preheated oven, or grill or cook in a hot frying pan on the stove top until the tops are slightly browned.  Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Sauce, Tomato and Basil
ingredients: 3/4 cup hot sauce | 3/4 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup fresh basil leaf, torn or torn into pieces | 2 packages miniature marshmallows
instructions: Combine hotsauce and monterey cheese in medium bowl and set aside.  Spray 2 qt casserole or pie pan with cooking spray.  Microwave basil mixture on high 1 minute at a time.  Stir until basil is wilted and stir into cheese mixture.  Spoon mixture into casserole.  Stir marshmallows into cheese mixture.  Bake at 400°f for about 10 minutes, or until hot and bubbling.  Serve with favorite cookies.

title: Parslied Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 2 heads chinese cabbage | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley
instructions: Separate cabbage leaves, wash and remove outer leaves.  Place leaves in a saucepan of warm water and bring to a boil.  Remove and drain leaves, place in a large bowl, cover with cold water and let stand 10 minutes.  Drain, drain and set aside.  Combine onion powder and parsley, salt and pepper.  Bring water to a boil in a wok.  Place cabbage in hot water.  Remove from heat.  Place a tea towel onto the cabbage to keep hot.  Cook cabbage leaves in hot water for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender crisp.  Place on a serving plate and pour parsley mixture over the top.

title: Rice Wraps (With Peanuts)
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat peanut butter | 4 tablespoons white wine or 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt ( can add more ) | 2 tablespoons dry white wine or 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 cans low-fat brioche flour tortillas ( or make sandwich wraps with other wraps ) | 3 cups cooked white basmati rice | pecorino romano cheese, grated | tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | fresh basil, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine the peanut butter, vinegar, and seasoning salt in a food processor or blender.  Process until smooth and creamy.  Fold in the wine and peanut butter mixture. To serve, sprinkle each wrap with some of the reserved cheese, garnish with basil, and serve immediately.

instructions: Sprinkle raw sugar over noodles in a bowl.

title: Arugula Pasta

instructions: Place garam masala in a small bowl.

instructions: Melt the horseradish on the lowest setting and add the cheese gradually.  It should sizzle.  Stir constantly.  Turn down heat.  Add coriander.  Stir well.  It should be bubbly.  When ready to serve, add the horseradish just before serving.

title: Thai Chilli Pistachio Cake
ingredients: 4 fresh hot red chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 120 g chopped fresh mint | 8 -10 fluid ounces single cream | 1 tablespoon smooth grainy mustard | 300 g yellow squash, roughly grated | 50 g chopped fresh papayas ( sweet potato ) | 5 tablespoons of freshly chopped mint, extra | 120 g finely grated chocolate
instructions: Pre heat up oven to 180c/350f/gas lightly grease a 10cm springform cake tin.  Mince the chillies roughly. Pour over the chilled chilli mixture and stir to coat.  Pour evenly into the cake tin and level the top.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes. title: Baked Lemongrass (Greece)
ingredients: 3 lemongrass ( about 1-1/2 inches thick ) | 10 -12 fresh berry ( from a can or other large stalk lemongrass ) | 1 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon chopped galangal | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons orange marmalade ( i use kewpie brand ) | 1/2 lb fresh blackberries | sliced baby leeks ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Trim the grass from lemongrass about 4 inches long and cut into three inch pieces.  Set aside.  Cut away hard end of lemongrass stalk and discard.  Cut crosswise into about 4 inches long lengths, then slice the leaves into a single piece.  Place lemongrass on a paper towel, place it on a cookie sheet, cover with a sheet of wax paper or plastic and place in the freezer.  Cut off tops of lemongrass and discard.  Slice about 2 inches long and set aside.  Bake about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally until lightly browned.  Remove from oven and cut off peel.  Remove peel, discard.  Cut into one inch pieces.  Strain liquid through several layers of cheesecloth or sieve set over bowl or paper towel and add lemon grass and blackberries to taste.  Season with salt and pepper and set aside.  To make blackberry dressing, mix bread crumbs into 1/2 cup hot fat until crumbs are crumb like.  Add 2 tablespoons orange marmalade and mix well with a fork.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Arrange cooked lemongrass on a serving platter and pour dressing over.

title: Yummy Spicy Beef and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 lb beef short rib, sliced | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 can pumpkin | 2 cups whole milk powder | 2 cups half-and-half | 2 -3 fresh red new mexican dried chilies, dried ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Spread the beef slices evenly in the baking dish.  In a large bowl, combine the oil, pumpkin, milk powder, half and half and chiles.  Mix well and pour over the beef.  Cover the baking dish well and bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until meat thermometer reads 160f for a fork.  If not served immediately, place directly on the broiler rack.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,beef liver,tomato soup,bamboo skewer,shrimp,corn tortilla
title: Beef and Shrimp Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin steak | 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and coarsely chopped | 20 bamboo skewers | 8 corn tortillas | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 12 beef liver, cleaned and cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large bowl, add the sirloin, shrimp, corn tortillas, and tomato soup.  Mix until well combined.  Divide into 12 portions, and stuff each portion with 2 to 3 slices of liver.  Roll each enchilada, and place on a large baking sheet with a cover.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tortillas are golden brown and heated through.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,milk chocolate chip,mayonnaise,elbow macaroni,plum tomato,coffee ice cream,ice water
title: American Chop Suey
ingredients: 1/2 ounce milky chocolate chip | 1/2 ounce mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons strong brewed coffee ice cream | 1 teaspoon instant coffee-flavored macaroni | 1 teaspoon skim milk chocolate chips | 2 plum tomatoes, sliced | 1 scoop ice water | 4 cups ice water
instructions: In small bowl, melt milk chocolate with mayonnaise over high heat.  Stir often, until chocolate begins to melt.  Remove mixture from heat.  Stir instant coffee in half teaspoon of hot coffee mixture.  Stir in macaroni, chocolate chip, tomatoes, and ice water to make macaroni cheese mixture.  Chill.  Just before serving, add ice.  When ready to serve, sprinkle with shaved chocolate.

title: Tamarind Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 450 g mexican blend cheese | 1 ounce tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 pinch cocoa | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 600 ml beer
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the cornflour and beer in a food processor and process them until evenly mixed.  The mixture will be fairly runny.  Add the cornflour and blend well, adding a little milk if necessary.  Add the beer and mix until the dough forms into a smooth ball.  Cover with plastic wrap and plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 150c, gas mark roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to about a 3mm thickness.  Using a cookie cutter, cut out circles or use a drinking glass.  Place a heaped teaspoon of the dough on your work surface and top with a teaspoon of chopped/chopped almonds or chopped pecans.  Brush the edge of each dough circle with melted butter, then cover it with a layer of shredded cheese.  Roll the dough up like a jelly roll.  Place the rolled dough on a greased baking tray and bake them for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.  Allow to cool down for about 2 - 4 hours before cutting.

Random Ingredients: agave nectar,golden syrup,barley,gingersnap,banana liqueur,table salt,coriander seed
title: Spicy Mashed Mashed Bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas, medium-ripe | 2 teaspoons coarse table salt | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/4 cup light agave nectar | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup barley, medium-ripe ( uncooked ) | 2 tablespoons banana liqueur
instructions: Peel bananas and slice in half crosswise.  Place in saucepan large enough to hold bananas in a single layer and add enough cold water to cover bananas by at least 2 inches.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until bananas are just tender but still have a few firmness.  Drain bananas, reserving water.  Peel bananas and discard liquid.  Mash 1 1/2 cups bananas with back of fork.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Add more syrup if necessary.  Transfer bananas to serving bowl and serve warm.

title: Chilled Spinach With Fresh Mint Chutney
ingredients: 15 ounces spinach, rinsed and squeezed | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper ( not the powdered kind ) | 2 tablespoons red wine ( i used pinot grigio ) | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Blend spinach, crushed red pepper, red wine, mint and buttermilk together for 1 minute or until well blended.  Serve chilled.

title: Easy Microwave Vegetables!
ingredients: 2 lbs assorted fresh white asparagus ( you can get the small green asparagus with the ones that are smaller then the regular asparagus ) | 1 can white asparagus ( white asparagus ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 ounce pineapples in juice | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspooon vegemite
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and set aside for 4 hours on 250% power.  Stove top, remove asparagus and toss in a non stick frying pan coated on the stove top or alternatively you can use a skillet cook on high for 3 min each side, or cook on low for 2mins and stir again.  Serve with a salad mix or with your favourite bread to savoury.

title: Italian Chicken and Peppers
ingredients: 14 ounces chicken breasts, boneless skinless cut in 3 pieces | 3 ounces hot pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Spray or grease a 12 by 8 inch glass baking dish or large roasting pan.  Arrange chicken and pepperoni in the dish.  Bake until chicken and pepperoni are no longer pink in center and juices run clear, about 30 minutes.

title: Simple Seasoned Italian Cheese for One
ingredients: 2 cups packed asiago cheese or 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( use kosher salt, can use white salt )
instructions: Combine the asiago and parmesan cheese until thoroughly smooth with no chunks of cheese.  Season with salt.  Roll mixture into 1 inch balls.  Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet, and cover with plastic wrap.  Let cheese balls rest for approximately 5 - 8 hours at room temperature before rolling them out to desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,jam,broccoli floret,beer,edam cheese,chili oil,wheat pastry flour
title: Beef  and Broccoli Parvardon
ingredients: 1/2 lb edam cheese | 1/2 lb smoked haddock ( or other smoked fish fillet, cut into 1/4-inch dice ) | 1 cup broccoli floret ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons wheat pastry flour | 1 cup beer or 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Dice cheese into ¼ inch cubes, set aside.  Chop fish fillet into ¾ inch cubes, set aside.  Cut floret into 1½ inch lengths, set aside.  Combine all other ingredients, except flour and beer or apple juice, in a large, heavy bottomed saucepan.  Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Stir in cheese until melted.  Place in an 8 inch square baking dish, coat with the flour.  Smooth top, and bake at 350°f until bubbly and brown, approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pea,plain yogurt,white flour,kalamata olive,gelatin,active yeast,milk chocolate melt
title: Easy Pea and Olive Mini-Chips
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 2 cups whole milk chocolate melts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups dried split peas | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons gelatin | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk.  In top of a double broiler, melt choclate, if using, in a small bowl over hot water, stirring constantly.  Add yogurt and melted chocolate and mix well.  Add yeast mixture, split peas and flour and mix just enough to combine.  Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and silky, about 5 minutes.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Lightly oil a baking tray, divide dough in half.  Grease each half.  Spoon rounded teaspoons of filling into 1/2 teaspoon holes of dough.  Sprinkle with sliced olives.  Bake at 425f for about 10 to 12 minutes, or until brown.  Cool on a wire rack.  Serve with warmed cream, coffee or icecream.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,chinese five spice powder,breadcrumb,ravioli dough,white bread,thyme sprig
title: Caramelised Ravioli (Lavoured Ravioli)
ingredients: 1 lb ravioli dough, fresh | 1 can sweet white bread | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 3 sprigs thyme sprigs | 1/2 cup flour | 1/4 cup chinese five spice powder ( or other spicy mix )
instructions: Place bread in bowl of a food processor and process finely until finely ground.  Drain bread and finely crumble.  Place breadcrumbs in bowl of processor and process until breadcrumbs is fine and mixture resembles sand.  Mix in the olive oil.  Add thyme and pulse a few times to combine.  Mix flour and five spice powder together and then add the flour mixture and mix well.  Chill dough in refrigerator for 30 minutes.  Add water to dough about 1 and 1/4 a cup at a time and mix until dough is workable.  Take 1/2 a teaspoon of dough at a time and roll lightly on a floured surface until about 1/4 inch thick.  Cut into 1 inch squares.  Place on lightly oiled baking sheet and brush tops with a little extra virgin olive oil.  Bake at 400 degrees for 12 minutes or until bottoms are light brown.  Watch the cooking of the ravioli.

title: Green Taco Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon cayenne powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Let sit for a couple hours or so in the fridge.  Mix well before serving.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,shrimp,caster sugar,kidney bean,sultana,tortilla,fruit pectin,pepper jack cheese
title: Kids' Heads Breakfast Tortilla Puffs
ingredients: 4 teaspoons mixed fruit pectin or 4 teaspoons figs | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon pepper jack cheese | 100 g shrimp, shelled, cooked and chopped | 1 bell pepper, diced into small cubes or 1 large bell pepper, diced into small cubes | 1/2 large sweet potato, grated | 100 g sultanas | 10 tortillas or 10 pitta bread, to serve | pecans or raisins, to serve
instructions: Combine sugar with pectin and set aside, in a small pan on low heat, stir in pectin mixture, pepper jack cheese and shrimp with a wooden spoon until combined thoroughly, the mixture is hot but not boiling.  Stir sweet potato into the shrimp mixture, add sultanas and mix thoroughly.  Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on each tortilla or pitta bread, fold each one into quarters and place in the fridge until ready to serve.  Sprinkle a little sultana or pine nuts over each punch before they set up, if making ahead, let set a few minutes.  When all the puffs are set, place on plates and serve with fruit accompaniments if desired.

title: Grandma's Irish Pie-   Pie (Cottage and Cheese)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs cottage cheese or 3 1/2 lbs ricotta cheese ( 10 3/4-ounces ) | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Line a 9 1/2-inch old fashioned tin with plastic wrap.  Put cottage cheese or ricotta in a bowl and mash in the ice water until the mixture resembles small peas.  Stir in a third of the biscuit mixture.  Pour into prepared tin.  Chill until set.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,icing sugar,lemon juice,vegetable broth,kiwi fruit
title: Quick Kiwifruit Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth ( i use low sodium ) | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled & sliced | 1 bunch cilantro leaf | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a pot over medium heat until it starts to boil.  Remove from heat & mix in the sliced kiwifruit and cilantro.  Using a spoon, stir for five minutes until heated throughout.  When the broth is almost boiling, stir in the icing sugar & lemon juice.  Serve hot with fresh fruit or ice cream.

title: Kesra - Queso Content
ingredients: 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, chopped | 7 -10 green cardamom pods, split
instructions: Take about one third of the cheese and top with the other half.  Springerle the seeds under cold running water until all the cheese is covered.  Serve at room temperature, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,family tea,gruyere cheese,dill,black olive,orange juice,beef stock
title: Kolaches Au Consentre
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 5 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 lb gruyere cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 3 cups beef stock | 12 black olives, pitted | 6 dried family tea bags | 8 sprigs fresh dill
instructions: Put the orange juice and white vinegar in a saucepan and heat gently.  Cut the gruyere into 4 pieces, using the diagonal lines on a cheesecloth or a ziploc bag.  Tie the cheesecloth or bag to the end of each olive piece.  Bring the stock to the boil in a heavy saucepan.  Add the onions and olives.  Cook, covered, over barely until the cheese is melted and the olives are cooked.  Pour through a strainer.  Let cool and divide into 4, depending on your taste.  Place the cooled filling into a 1 quart mold.  Pour the cooled stock over all and place a piece of cheesecloth or a ziploc bag on top of each layer.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Before serving, remove cheese cloth.  Place in a serving platter and garnish with fresh dill.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,green chili,green bean,spaghetti noodle,monterey jack cheese
title: Green Chili Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti noodles or 1 lb thin spaghetti, cooked and drained | 1 jar medium sized cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup green chili, chopped and divided | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  In 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, layer ingredients in order as follows.  Cover.

title: Thai Pasta With Salami and Cashew
ingredients: 1/3 lb salami | 2 stalks fresh lemongrass | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chopped chili | 2 tablespoons cashews | 1 lb of chopped raw edel cheese, with brined liquid | 2 cups dry ditali pasta or 2 cups other tube shaped pasta | 1 cup breadcrumbs ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse and dry salami.  Cut each into 4 - 5 lengths.  Remove the tough center portion of the lemongrass stalk.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,orange,green creme de menthe,egg white,celeriac
title: Mama T's Celeriac & Green Creme De Menthe Rounds
ingredients: 12 large celeriac ( about 4 pounds ) | 1 large egg white | salt & pepper | 1/4 cup green creme de menthe ( or more if desired ) | 2 teaspoons orange rind, freshly grated and peeled
instructions: Peel and dice celeriac, or cut into small pieces.  Put into the freezer to chill for at least 20 minutes.  Heat grill to medium heat.  Beat egg white in a small bowl.  Add salt & pepper.  Brush the top side of each celeriac slice with egg white & sprinkle with a bit of the mint, grated rind, creme de menthe, and orange rind.  Grill the slices over high heat, 3 to 5 minutes.  Turn once.

title: Baked Pulled Pork With Cranberries
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, bone-in ( 3 1/2 pounds ) | 4 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 4 thick slices of toasted bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place pork on a rack in a roasting pan.  Mix brown sugar and dried cranberries, and sprinkle over the pork.  Cover the pan with foil.  Bake pork 40 minutes.  Remove the pork from the oven and spread cranberry sauce evenly over the pork.  Return to the oven, and bake about 1 hour longer until pork is well done. .  Place cooked pork on a serving platter.  Bread should be slightly toasted and topping should have a golden brown color.

title: Chili Con Teque (Sauce of the Table)
ingredients: 8 tablespoons red table wine ( can or bottle ) | 1 green chilies, seeded and sliced into thin strips ( can or bottle )
instructions: Pour the wine into a serving bowl and pour just enough water into the bottom of the glass to reach a depth of 1/4 inch.  Add the chiles and stir to coat.  Note, chill is best when allowed to sit overnight in the fridge to develop the flavors.

title: Tart Applesauce
ingredients: 2 medium tart apples | 2 tablespoons aioli ( i like heinz ) | 1 tablespoon orange rind, finely grated | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mint, chopped
instructions: Core apples and cut into 1 inch chunks.  Place apple chunks and orange rind into food processor or processor container, and process until pureed.  Add heavy cream to pureéed onions.

title: Nasty Rice Krispies-Breakfast Nests
ingredients: 3 hard boiled eggs, halved lengthways | 1 1/2 cups rice krispies
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c, 190c, gas mark 3,.  Put the eggs in a mixing bowl.  Add the rice krispies stix and beat on low speed until well mixed.  Put a large sheet of greaseproof paper on a baking tray and place in the oven to warm up.  Take the rice krispies out of the oven and carefully spread out the rice krispies into shapes using a roller, making sure that they are evenly distributed.  Turn to brown on the other side.  When the paper is soft, cut into squares and toss gently in the tray making sure to toss so as not to break the rice krispy up.  Put the snack in an oiled paper bag and allow to set.  When it is cooled, store in a cool, dry place.

title: Crunchy French Bread Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup rye bread, dry ( italian bread is fine ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons triple sec or 2 tablespoons other light liqueur | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated or 2 teaspoons ground ginger ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | additional fresh ginger, for dusting
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir the rye bread with the catsup, triple sec, and ginger until thoroughly mixed.  Set aside to soften slightly and absorb flavors while you prepare all remaining ingredients.  Using a fine mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth, gently squeeze out all the excess liquid from the rye bread mixture, and set aside.  In a small bowl, stir the bread crumbs with the 1 teaspoon water until combined.  Dip the rye bread soaked bread into the crumb mixture, coating well.  Place the bread crumbs on a paper towel lined baking sheet, and let rest for approximately 10 minutes. .  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bake toast about 8 minutes, until golden.  Remove and dust with additional fine, dry bread crumbs before serving.

title: Luscious Homemade Lasagna
ingredients: 4 -6 fresh lasagna noodles, washed | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f.  Spread parsley on the bottom of a lightly oiled pan that has been lightly greased or sprayed with cooking spray.  Arrange a layer of noodles on top of this, sprinkle with pecans, and then repeat layering until you have used up all the noodles and pile on the remaining pecan pieces.  Bake for about 40 minutes.  Allow to sit for 2 - 5 minutes before serving.  Variation, instead of pecans, you can spread chopped walnuts on the meat sauce and sprinkle with parmesan cheese instead.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,green cardamom pod,red chili powder,spaghetti sauce
title: Spaghetti Green Cardamom Crumble
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour, preferably wholemeal | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 2 cups spaghetti sauce, jarred or prepared | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder ( to taste )
instructions: Place a nonstick frying pan on medium heat and add the flour and cardamom pods.  When the flour starts to give off a toasty aroma, add the spaghetti sauce and red chili.  Stir.  The sauce should be thick and the garlic and chili together if it is very spicy, add a little more sauce.  If it is too tart, add a little more garlic and chili powder.  Make sure you get a good balance between tart and sour.  Turn off the heat.  Pour your batter into the prepared frying pan and cook until golden on both sides.  Remove from heat and allow to stand for about five minutes.  Cut into crouton sized wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,taco seasoning,bell pepper,green enchilada sauce
title: Cheesy Taco Bell Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar green enchilada sauce | 2 cups crushed low-fat ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 large bell pepper, sliced ( you can buy this in the can )
instructions: Cook peppers in a skillet with a little olive oil.  When the peppers are done, remove the peppers and put them with the ricotta in a bowl and mix together with the taco seasoning.  Once cool add the sauce mix to it and let it chill in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours.  This can sit on the counter for a little while and you can eat it right away.

Random Ingredients: apple,beef chuck,channa dal,rose water,rice flour,macadamia nut,aubergine
title: Eggless Gourmet Beef Bites
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons apple powder or 2 tablespoons groundnut powder | 1 lb ground beef chuck | 2 tablespoons aaubergines, chopped or 2 tablespoons mushrooms, chopped | 1 medium aubergine, cubed | 2 tablespoons macadamia nuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons rose water
instructions: Combine dumplings ingredients in a bowl.  Shape mixture into patties by firmly pressing meat down with a fork.  Cook over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes each side or until done.  Serve with salad greens or with chutney.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,monterey jack cheese,brie cheese,ancho chile powder,red pepper,thyme,chicken,wheat flour
title: Jalapeno and Brie Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut into pieces | salt, to taste | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 red pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Season the chicken pieces with salt, then dredge in the flour.  Heat the oil and ancho chili powder in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring constantly until fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Stir in the red pepper and thyme.  Stir in the chicken pieces, and cook until chicken pieces are browned, about 10 minutes.  Place cheese on top, and place chicken pieces on top.  Allow cheese to melt, then serve.

title: Vietnamese Fruit and Mint Applesauce
ingredients: 2 ripe mango chutney | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup pappadams ( dry bread slices ) | 1 pint mixed fruit | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | chopped fresh fruit, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Puree mango chutney in a blender or food processor until smooth.  To make mint applesauce, cook wine, pappadams, and mango chutney in a skillet over medium heat until wine melts.  Remove from heat and stir in cayenne pepper sauce and sugar.  Serve immediately.  Garnish with chopped fresh fruit if desired.

title: Chunky Green Chili Chicken Pieces
ingredients: 20 ounces chicken | 8 ounces green chili peppers
instructions: Combine all in a ziploc bag.  Marinate in refrigerator 4 to 24 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,lemon zest,flour tortilla,gruyere cheese,almond milk,wildflower honey
title: Cheese and Wildflower Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup raw hazelnuts | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1/3 cup wildflower honey | 1/2 cup beef broth | 8 low-fat flour tortillas or 8 corn tortillas | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Heat pan over medium heat.  Spread 1/4 cup honey evenly over both sides of a large tortilla.  Sprinkle with lemon zest then place tortilla in pan seam side down.  Heat 1/2 cup of beef broth in microwave, or on high for 15 seconds.  Dip the entire quesadilla into the hot broth then spread honey side of tortilla evenly.  Fold bottom half of tortilla over.  Place on a tray and cover with plastic wrap until tortilla is firm.  Remove plastic wrap and slice into 4 wedges.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.  Arrange quesadillas on plate and sprinkle with cheese.  Serve with a side of sour cream/tomato relish.

title: German Fried Wine - Paula Deen
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces red wine | 4 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 2 tablespoons mustard and 2 tablespoon celery seed | 4 1/2 fluid ounces confectioners'sugar for dusting | 7 fluid ounces red wine, for dripping
instructions: Combine the 4 1/2 fluid ounces confectioners' sugar, 1 1/2 tablespoon ground mustard or celery seed in a glass jar.  Cover, and shake to mix.  Pour the wine in a thin stream into a small bowl, and sprinkle the top of the wine with half the prepared mixture.  Close the lid, and shake to blend.  Cover, and refrigerate the wine for at least 3 hours and up to 2 days before serving.

title: Thai Meatballs
ingredients: 8 garlic cloves, peeled | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh ginger, finely minced | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 2 lbs ground sirloin
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, mash the garlic until they are crushed and combined well.  Add the ginger and 1/2 cup of the soy sauce.  Mix and continue to mix until the soy sauce becomes a paste.  Add the remaining soy sauce and a pinch of salt and continue to mix until you have formed a paste.  Form the meat into balls about 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 inch in diameter, each about 3 inches long in size.  Bring a large pot or dutch oven half full of water to a boil over high heat.  Add the meatballs and reduce the heat to low.  Simmer the mixture slowly until they are very tender, 40 to 50 minutes.  Place the meatballs in a serving dish and cover with plastic wrap to prevent drying.  Add more soy sauce as needed to moisten.

title: Kielbasa With Sandwiches and Gravy
ingredients: 1 slice italian bread | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 medium italian sausage | 1/4 teaspoon basil | 1/8 teaspoon savory
instructions: Remove bread from package.  Cut into about 1 squares.  Toast bread with italian sausage for about 5 minutes on each side to toast lightly.  Slice italian sausage into 1/4 inch thick, 3 inch long sticks.  In a hot skillet, cook sausage for about 5 minutes, or until browned.  Drain.  Remove the sausage to a plate and slice against the grain into 1/4 inch slices.  Brown hamburger and sausage in the same pan used to cook the sausage.  Return sausage to skillet and drain any excess drippings.  In a casserole dish, place sliced bread on the bottom of the pan then add the hamburger/sausage mixture and drippings.  Add basil and savory.  Continue cooking until liquid thickens and bread is toasted.  Serve with meatballs.

title: Cafe Rio Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 cup beer ( a good `` tolerant '' beer ) | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 1/4 cups leftover broth ( from your fondue pot, heated )
instructions: In blender container, combine beer and mayonnaise.  Serve with tostada chips or assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,delicata squash,onion powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,green olive,mexican chocolate
title: Spicy Green Olives and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup delicata squash, sliced | 1 medium green olives, sliced | 1 small sweet onion, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 ounces mexican chocolate, grated and packed into small pieces, to coat rosettes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place all the ingredients, except cheddar, in a medium bowl.  Spray a 6 inch square baking dish that is lined with cooking spray.  Spoon the olives, onions, chocolate and curry overtop and bake, stirring the ingredients, until the cheddar is melted.

title: Gruyere Dauphinoise and Cumin Dip
ingredients: 2 cups chopped beef broth | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 garlic, minced | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed
instructions: Stir beef broth, sour cream, garlic, gruyere cheese, and cumin seed together in a skillet.

title: Moroccan Chickpeas and Plums
ingredients: 1 cup fresh split white chickpeas | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 meaty beef bouillon cube | 6 whole plum, halved ( about 8-inches, depending on size ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 2 teaspoons msg ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, mash the chickpeas until they are chunky.  Add the cayenne and knead into a thick paste.  Place in a bowl and crush the bouillon cube with a fork in a criss cross manner.  Add the crushed bouillon, plum halves, sage and msg to the chickpea mixture and mix thoroughly.  Heat a small amount of oil in a large skillet over med high.  Add the chickpea mixture and brown on all sides.  Pour into a shallow serving bowl or serve on its own.  Serve hot with couscous.

title: Easy No Salt Citrus Beer Canade
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate
instructions: Spoon 1 can of limeade into a resealable gallon freezer bag.  Add 1 tablespoon of limeade concentrate.  Shake bag to mix well.  Place in refrigerator.  Preheat oven to 500 degrees.  Remove can from freezer and allow to sit at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.  Pour beer mixture into a medium muffin tin sprayed with vegetable flavored cooking spray.  Cover loosely with foil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the top of the can is puffed and brown.  Allow to cool 5 minutes, then remove foil.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green bean,peppermint schnapps,red bell pepper,cannellini bean,red curry paste,brown rice,red pepper flake,sun tomato oil
title: Curry-Cooked Rice With Veggies
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 1/2 cups cooked brown rice ( rotisserie ready ) | 1/3 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 7 ounces mixed green beans, trimmed | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and minced | 2 tablespoons green mint schnapps, such as kahlua | 1 dash peppermint schnapps
instructions: In a medium skillet, combine curry paste, red hot pepper flakes, and uncooked rice.  Stir fry over medium heat 2 minutes.  Stir in beans and sun dried tomatoes.  Stir in green beans.  Drizzle in remaining ingredients and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through.  Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,hamburger,cheddar cheese soup,pineapple juice,broccoli floret,turmeric,sea salt,beef tenderloin
title: Grilled Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 1 lb hamburger roll | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 2 heads broccoli florets | 1/4 lb shaved hamburger
instructions: Mix cheese soup with pineapple juice, turmeric and salt.  Set aside 1/2 of soup mixture while preparing steak as desired.  Cut steak on the bias into eight 2 inch pieces.  Place meat into a bowl and pour in remaining soup mixture.  Place broccoli in another bowl.  Place meat onto another bowl and pour in broth mixture, then add to the broth bowl.  Place meat onto the grill and close and let cook until meat is desired doneness, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Turn off grill and let meat rest for 5 minutes while preparing vegetables and toppings.  When cooking vegetables, heat grill for high heat.  Place cheese filled beef on grill and close grill for about 3 minutes per side.  Remove from heat and let sit until meat is cool enough to handle.  Cut meat into thin slices and place on a plate with the broccoli.  Slice meat diagonally across the grain, place with broccoli on the cheese.  Pour the rest of the soup mixture all over meat and vegetables.  Top with shaved hamburger.  Let sit for about 5 minutes while you serve.

title: Easy Gravlax
ingredients: 1 can salmon | 1/3 ounce grand marnier ( or other other orange liqueur )
instructions: Rinse salmon under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels.  Place in a small bowl, and pour over enough grand marnier to cover and massage gently.  Leave a little room at the side.  Cover with aluminum foil and place under a hot grill for 10 to 15 minutes.  Carefully flake salmon with a fork.  Serve, drizzled with additional grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,tamarind juice,ice,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Tamarind Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked shell pasta | 1/3 cup seedless ra el hanout spice mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamarind juice | 1/4 cup ice
instructions: Soak the shell pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,turmeric powder,chinese cabbage,red chile,parmesan cheese
title: Chili Chunks
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chinese cabbage ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons red chilies | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Chop cabbage and chilies coarsely to about 4 or less.  If using chinese cabbage, remove outer green leaves before slicing.  Combine, chilies, vinegar, turmeric, and parmesan cheese in small bowl.  Pour over steaming hot vegetable mixture and toss.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,red chile pepper,green bell pepper,sparerib,green chile,russet potato,green cardamom pod,pasta sauce
title: Indian Spareribs
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style spareribs | 12 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 6 whole green cardamom pods | 3 fresh red chile peppers, halved, seeded, and split in two | 1 large green bell pepper | 3 large russet potatoes | 16 ounces canned cut green chiles | 8 ounces jar pasta sauce | 1 large green chile, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut 2 deep slits in the ribs of the ribs.  Brush ribs with oil and place in a roasting pan.  Place in the oven and roast for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, peel potatoes and dice in pieces that will fit into your baking pan.  Add the chiles and green bell pepper to the roasting pan.  Toss the vegetables with the oil, then add them to the roasting pan.  Roast about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender.  Meanwhile, in a separate roasting pan, bring the pasta sauce to a boil with 1/2 inch of water.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes for the pasta, and 15 minutes for the ribs.  Taste the sauce and adjust the taste if needed by adding salt or pepper.  Spoon the ribs back into the saucepan, cover lightly and simmer 5 minutes for the meat, or up to 30 minutes for the ribs.  Serve with sauce.

title: Healthy Oatcakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup oatmeal ( whole preferred ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Bake on an ungreased tray for approximately 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Blueberry Soup (Fruited)
ingredients: 5 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 1 liter broth | 1 pinch vanilla bean paste ( optional ) | 4 lettuce leaves, to serve
instructions: Pour the blueberries into a large saucepan with the broth.  Add vanilla bean paste if using.  Bring to the boil and simmer until berries fall apart.  Remove from heat and garnish with fresh blueberries.

title: Oven Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 chicken wings ( about 3 pounds total ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons arborio rice or 2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place two large sheets of aluminum foil on a baking sheet.  Separate wings from tips and tips while they are still attached to wire racks in a roasting pan.  Place wings in roasting pan with enough water to cover wings.  Place pan in the oven to bake until the wings are tender when pierced with a fork, 20 to 30 minutes.  While birds are baking, heat half and half in a saucepan over medium heat until lightly simmering.  Turn heat down to low.  Drain the chicken and pour half and half into the saucepan.  Simmer until warmed through, about 5 minutes.  Cut each chicken wing at the joint, and arrange on a serving platter.  Top with the warm tomato sauce used as the sauce.  Sprinkle each wing with arborio and serve with a sprinkling of italian seasoning.

title: Irish Cream Zucchini & Shredded Beef Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 zucchini, sliced in half lengthwise | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 -2 beef eye round | 1 cup long grain rice | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 carton frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet or wok with cooking spray.  Heat skillet to medium.  Add zucchini and cook, 1 - 2 minutes per side.  Remove zucchini and set aside.  Add meat to skillet and cook until well browned, turning occasionally.  Remove meat from skillet.  Deglaze skillet with 1/2 cup water and add the rice and 2 tbsp sour cream.  Bring to boil, stirring.  Return the beef and vegetables to the skillet.  Heat through.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,candy chocolate orange,angel hair pasta
title: Angel Hair Pasta Chips
ingredients: 12 ounces angel hair pasta | 12 ounces candy or 12 ounces orange sweet biscuits, finely grated ( 12 oz ) | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Boil the pasta according to the packet directions.  Remove the biscuit/noodle with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Add the chocolate or orange sweet biscuits to the pasta and toss together.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes before adding the soda.  Drain the pasta and add to the bowl with all of the ingredients, trying not to stir the sauce.  Mix well.  Serve immediately.

title: Egg Roll Salad
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 6 -8 leaves salad greens | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon soft mustard
instructions: In a small bowl, mash hard boiled eggs with a fork.  Remove the yolks from the bowl and stir in the finely chopped salad leaves.  Mix the breadcrumbs with the mustard and spread a small amount on a plate.  Spread the egg mixture evenly over the breadcrumbs, then roll up and secure with a toothpick.  Arrange the rolls in a flat serving dish, sprinkle with the remaining breadcrumbs, and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,sage leaf,turmeric,salt black pepper,arborio rice,gouda cheese,red potato
title: Ww 3 Points - Cheese Baked Potato Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons ground turmeric | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 can diced red potatoes, unseasoned | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 1 1/2 tablespoons dried sage leaves ( mccormick or similar cooking brand ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda ( optional ) | 1/2 cup gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a casserole dish, heat the turmeric over low heat with 2 tablespoons water.  Add rice and stir until rice has absorbed all the water.  Cook for 10 minutes.  Add the remaining ingredients and add the baking soda.  Mix well.  Cover and bake for 20 minutes.  Take out of oven, stir and add the cheese, serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,greek yogurt,ladyfinger,amaretto,red chilies,cinnamon,green bean,chicken wing
title: Creamy Greek Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings ( split wings, drumsticks ) | 2/3 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 can fat free cream of celery soup | 1 1/3 cups light cream of chicken soup or 1 1/3 cups light cream | 1 can green beans, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1 minced fresh red chilies
instructions: In a deep freezer bag combine one chicken wing, the other chicken wing and all other ingredients and shake several times to coat chicken wings.  Place chicken in freezer 8 hours.  Remove chicken from freezer.  Place one or two frozen wings in a large pot on the stove.  Add water until wings are covered but not touching.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 45 minutes or until tender.  Transfer to cutting board and cool for 15 minutes.  Slice remaining chicken wings and serve with dipping sauce and warmed dipping sauce, if desired.

title: Lunch Tortilla Crackers
ingredients: 1/4 cup flour tortilla | 1 tablespoon rum extract
instructions: Place 1 tortilla on your work surface.  Spread rum extract on top of tortilla.  Using the back of hands, push to one side that will form a crust.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup water, then press down gently. .  Turn to the right side.  Roll up and slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Repeat with the second tortilla.

title: Grape Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups chopped grape tomatoes | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.  Chill before serving.

title: Barley, Coriander and Red Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 600 g swedes | 375 g french dressing | 375 g barley | 300 g chopped coriander | 2 slices gingerroot | 1 lime
instructions: Boil the swedes til tender and then put off the heat.  Rinse and leave until room temperature.  Dry the barley and rinse well in cold water.  Squeeze out the excess water.  Put it in a deep pan, add the water, coriander, ginger and lime.  Let it boil for 5 minutes.  Add the barley and leave to sit another 5 minutes.  This will make it much easier to mix and serve cold.

title: Coconut Hot and Sour Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces vermicelli or 8 ounces spaghetti, broken in half or 2 quarts | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package.  Meanwhile, stir coconut cream into hot cooked pasta, tossing to heat.

Random Ingredients: walnut,chipotle chile,white onion,red curry paste,white wine,tea,port wine
title: Chipotle White Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 4 ounces spanish smoked ham ( from a tube or thick deli ) | 4 ounces tea ( herbal is best, but herbal tea if available is not to you ) | 3 ounces port wine, such as porto-infused port | 1 white onion, chopped | 3 ounces red curry paste | 2 -4 ounces walnuts or 2 -4 ounces pistachios, toasted | 1/2 - 3/4 chipotle chile, toasted
instructions: The night before, grill the ham in a non reactive saucepan.  When ready to serve, combine all the ingredients in a blender or blender and puree to desired consistency.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,raisin,arborio rice,dill,ham,taco seasoning mix,food coloring
title: Easy Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups hot water or 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 4 cups cooked and cooled leftover ham or 1 1/2 cups cooked ham | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 9 cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for kneading | 3 -4 tablespoons food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients together in bread pan you will be using.  Let raise in a draft free place for 1 hour, or until doubled in bulk.  Punch dough down.
