In a medium size bowl, combine the horseradish, chile pepper, rosemary and sugar.  Place the burger on top of the first piece of buns and sprinkle evenly with the pineapple juice.  Top with more salsa, if desired, and serve.

title: Grilled Zucchini With Pineapple & Green Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | ice | 16 pineapple chunks, preferably pineapple tidbits | 4 green zucchini, trimmed and very thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 8 slices crusty bread, about 3/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Place the asparagus on a plate with some of the excess tips.  Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat.  When it begins to smoke, add the remaining ingredients except for the bread, stir well and heat until the zucchini starts to brown, about 3 minutes.  Toast the bread until golden brown, about 3 minutes, cut through the slices and serve.

title: Sherry's Salsa
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Place tomatoes and chiles into a blender, and process until smooth.

title: Cheesecloth Mashed Yams
ingredients: 1 lb yam, peeled | 2 boxes kraft macaroni & cheese mix | 1 1/4 cups kef's shredded cheesecloth
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Bring a large amount of salted water to a boil.  Add yams, cover and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain and mash until creamy.  Combine macaroni, macaroni mixture and kef's in a 9x13 casserole pan.  Cover and bake for 20 - 25 minutes on a baking sheet, or until hot.

title: Peachy Butter Beans
ingredients: 14 ounces butter beans | 6 heirloom tomatoes | 4 tablespoons butter ( optional )
instructions: Cut heirloom tomatoes in half and, if using, split them horizontally.  With the cut sides facing out, open them out like an book.  Pour the beans into a microwavable jar.  Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes depending on the heat.  Stir or shake jar until beans are heated through.  Add a few drops of water and stir well.  The butter is good for this once a week, but i recommend heating up for a few minutes.  The butter will keep in the fridge for several days.  Enjoy.

title: Kidney Bean Burritos
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1/4 cup minced fresh herb, such as rosemary | 3/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon herbs
instructions: Drain beans, and mash with a fork.  Stir milk, herbs, and vinegar into mashed beans.  Beat vigorously until combined well.  Let stand until thickened to the consistency of a thick oatmeal consistency, about 20 minutes.  Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Roll heaping tablespoonfuls of bean mixture, about 3 inches in diameter, into burritos.  Arrange on a plate, and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.  Heat in the preheated oven until sugar is melted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cocoa powder,salmon fillet,rhubarb,part mozzarella cheese,celery rib
title: Warm Glazed Raspberry Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped celery rib | 7 fluid ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/2 cup light unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 small red chilies, finely minced | 2 cups fresh rhubarb, cut into 1 cm pieces | 1 can salmon fillets, drained
instructions: Stir celery with 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese.  Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Coat salmon with remaining cheese mixture.  Place salmon in nonstick coated baking dish.  Bake at 200°c for 40 minutes or until salmon is cooked.  Serve immediately.

title: Vietnamese Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise, light | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 fresh serrano chilies or 2 serrano chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: In a shallow glass bowl combine mayonnaise, vinegar and fish sauce.  Sprinkle generously over sliced beef.

title: Asian-Inspired Asparagus for Two
ingredients: 1 cup asparagus, trimmed | 1 lb pork steak, cut into two inch x two inch slices
instructions: Thin strips about 2 1/2 to 3 inches wide.  Snap off tough ends of asparagus as you add.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,sharp cheddar cheese,red food coloring,green cardamom pod,russet potato,olive oil,kielbasa
title: Chocolate-Cheese Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese or 2 cups mozzarella cheese | 2 cups grated russet potatoes | 2 1/4 cups grated kielbasa | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 3 -4 green cardamom pods | 3 -4 red food coloring ( for sprinkling ) | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed black koolaidas with patties, crushed and placed over the finished dish
instructions: Using a food processor/blender running, add the cheeses until the potatoes are very finely grated.  Add the remaining ingrediants and process to a velvety consistency.  Move the mixture into a small oven dish and pour the cheese/potato mixture over it.  Bake at 325 degrees until the top begins to brown, around 45 minutes.  Sprinkle with crushed black koolaidas and serve.  Note, if gratin does not have a lid for a large quantity of gratin dishes, consider adding 1 1/2 cups of grated cheddar cheese and 2 1/4 cups gruyere cheese to the gratin in the amount of grated cheese.  Follow the instructions on the container for sprinkling the koolaidas.  Enjoy.

title: Wasabi and Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1 lb golden raisin | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste, for soaking raisins ( to taste ) | 8 pinches dried parsley sprigs | 1/4 lime, juice of | cooking oil ( for frying )
instructions: Soak raisins in water for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, prepare wasabi paste.  Combine all ingredients, except oil, in shallow dish.  Add oil, mix well.  Serve at room temperature, chilled, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tapioca flour,dark sesame oil,wheat tortilla,white sugar
title: Asian Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 cup ice cubes | 1 cup tapioca flour | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 4 whole-wheat tortillas
instructions: Place ice cubes into a blender, and process until completely incorporated.  Stir in tapioca flour, sugar, sesame oil, and tortilla chips.  Blend on high until thoroughly mixed and slushy, about 1 minute.  Dip warm tortillas into hot oil, 2 to 3 seconds per side.

title: Chardonigay Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 fluid ounce gin | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Pour gin and white pepper into a shaker with 1/8 teaspoon of white pepper.  Shake for 15 seconds, strain into a cocktail glass filled with ice.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,rye bread,baking potato,beef stew meat,heavy cream
title: Roasted Beef and Potato Gratin
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 loaf rye bread | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Rinse beef chunks in a large bowl, and pat dry.  Cut rye bread into 3/4 inch thick slices.  Place in a large roasting pan large enough to hold the meat and potatoes in a single layer.  Drizzle beef with olive oil, and spread out to coat the surface of the bread.  Place the baking pan on the top rack of oven, and place in the oven.  Bake in preheated oven until the beef has reached an internal temperature of 140 degrees f, about 2 hours.  Allow roast to cool at room temperature, about 1 hour.  Meanwhile, place oven rack just below center of the oven.  Prepare the oven's broiler.  Bring the roasting pan's lid slightly ajar so the oven will be hot once it is preheated.  Set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat, and preheat the oven's broiler.  Place a large pot over medium heat, and add 1/2 inch of olive oil.  Place olive oil and 1/4 cup water in a large, deep skillet.  Place beef chunks in the hot oil, and brown on all sides.  Slice the roast into 1/4 inch slices, and place in the hot skillet with the water, and water.  Cook until meat is browned.  Arrange the potato slices around the outside of the roasting pan, and place roasting pan in the broiler.  Close the lid to the roasting pan, and broil until the potato slices have turned light brown and crusty, 4 to 5 minutes.  Place a large plate over the roasting pan, and flip the roasting pan onto the plate to ensure even browning.  Remove foil from the oven, place the pan on the top rack of the oven, and allow to heat through.  Once the beef has reheated, remove from the oven, and slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Place slices into a medium serving dish, and keep warm.  Warm the cream in a bowl over medium heat.  When the cream has been heated, whisk in 1 tablespoon of the cream and mix into the cooked beef pieces.  Remove from heat, spread beef and potatoes over remaining cream, and serve immediately.

title: Peruvian Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon low-fat buttermilk | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 medium pear, chopped | 1 package prepared polenta ( or your favorite cornmeal )
instructions: In a med bowl, combine the yogurt, buttermilk, mustard, soy sauce, lime juice and cumin.  Mix well.  Add the pear and mix until everything is evenly coated.  Place the ground pears on the pears.  Place the polenta in a 9 x 13 baking dish.  Scatter the polenta on top of the pears and pour the marinade over the top.  Cover and refrigerate the tray for at least an hour.  Cook in a 375f oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until the tortilla starts to get crispy and set.  Cut in the tortillas into small squares.  Serve with salsa if desired.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,frying oil,red curry paste,white onion,udon noodle,sherry
title: Spicy Thai Noodle Fritters With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces crispy udon noodles | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 2 large teaspoons frying oil | 1 small white onion
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  While noodles are cooking heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Coat bowl of ice cube tray with cooking spray.  Dip noodles into oil and drain.  Saute onion and curry paste in oil until onion is tender but not brown.  Mix noodles with sauce.  Serve warm, sprinkled with peanuts.

title: Breakfast Eggs With Sesame Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 4 slices bacon ( or turkey bacon ) | 1 mango | 4 eggs | 1/2 cup finely chopped salted cashew ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice by combining the 4 cups of jasmine rice & 2 cups of salted water & allowing to soak for approximately an hour.  The water should be about 1/2 an inch above the level of the rice & rice.  Bring rice to boil, cover and allow to cook for approximately 18 minutes.  Remove from heat & allow to sit covered for another 5 - 10 minutes.  Place the cashews in a skillet & fry until golden brown & fragrant, shaking the pan occasionally.  Set aside & allow cashews to cool slightly.  Break the eggs into a bowl & beat well.  Add mango & eggs to eggs & whisk to combine.  Gently fold egg mixture into the jasmine rice & cover with plastic wrap.  Allow mixture to sit at room temperature for approximately 5 - 10 minutes.  Once the rice is fully cooked, remove from heat & serve.

title: Pomegranate Crusted Roast Beef With a Proper Kick
ingredients: 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 cup vinegar ( to baste ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seeds | 1 lb deli roast beef ( trimmed of fat ) | 2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Combine brandy, vinegar and pomegranate in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  When mixture comes to a boil, add coriander seeds, stir and remove from heat.  Set aside.  Season roast with salt.  Using a vegetable brush, paint the entire surface of the meat evenly with the pomegranate brine.  Rub the coriander seeds into the meat and place on a cookie sheet.  Spread pomegranate flavored brine on meat evenly.  Place the oven safe roasting pan on the middle rack.  Preheat oven.  Place rack in center of oven.  Place meat on top rack.  Bake 90 minutes or until desired doneness.  Cut meat into thin slices, about 2 to 3 slices per slice.  Allow meat to rest for about 10 minutes before serving.  Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,white chocolate baking square,nori,ice water,parsley,black bean,baby spinach
title: Black Bean & Spinach Tofu Bento
ingredients: 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 6 tablespoons fat free soymilk | 1/2 cup cooked black beans ( black or brown ) | 10 leaves baby spinach | 1 -2 teaspoon parsley ( optional ) | 2 white chocolate baking squares ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Wash the seaweed in a bowl of cool water.

Random Ingredients: steak,rosemary leaf,hot oil,vanilla essence,mirin,sage,avocado,beef bouillon cube
title: Steak Avocado-Rosemary Soup
ingredients: 600 g steak, cubed | 1 beef bouillon cube | 150 ml mirin | 1 teaspoon dried sage ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons hot oil ( or any oil ) | 1 dash vanilla essence | 1 avocado, sliced and sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the bouillon cube, mirin, sage and rosemary to a simmer.  Add the steaks and allow to simmer for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the hot oil and avocado slices and simmer until the meat falls of the bone.  Serve hot.

title: Kielbasa and Collard Greens
ingredients: 8 lbs chuck, trimmed | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 lbs collard greens, cut in half | 1 1/2 quarts chicken stock or 1 1/2 quarts canned low sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Cut trimmed chuck into 1 inch cubes.  In a 6 to 8 quart dutch oven, combine all but peanuts.  Heat to boiling over high heat, skimming foam and fat.  Reduce heat to medium.  Add meat in 3 batches and cook, stirring, until browned entirely, about 10 minutes.  Transfer meat to plate.  To pot, add stock and cook over high heat, uncovered, until liquid is reduced to 1 cup, about 25 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a large heavy nonstick skillet set over medium high heat, combine meat and 1 - ¼ cups water.  Season with dijon.  Simmer until meat is just cooked through, stirring occasionally, about 1 minute.  Add peanuts and stir until coated.  Serve with peanuts.

title: The Perfect  Triple Sec Pudding
ingredients: 1 pinch nutmeg | 3/4 ounce fifth triple sec
instructions: Place the triple sec in a glass.  Pour in the double sec and stir.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,ginger garlic paste,yukon gold potato,curry
title: Potato Curry
ingredients: 8 ounces yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry ( indian style )
instructions: Put potatoes in a large saucepan and pour in enough water to cover them.  Bring to a boil, and cook for about 10 minutes, or until tender.  Drain.  Cut into chunks roughly 1 inch wide.  Heat the peanut oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Fry the ginger garlic paste until fragrant.  Add curry, and stir until it begins to brown, about 5 minutes.  Add the curry, and fry for 5 more minutes, or until potatoes are heated through.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate for later use.

title: Baked Fish With Fruit and Pepperoncini
ingredients: 2 smoked pork shoulder ( about 1 1/2-pound per pound ) | 1 ounce dried mixed herbs | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers | 1 can fruit ( apricots, mandarin oranges, peaches, pineapple, berries ) | 1/8 pint fresh fruit ( apricots, mandarin oranges, peaches, berries ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | fresh herb twists ( such as toasted fresh thyme, basil, chives, dill or parsley )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Wrap each smoked fish fillet with 2 oz each dried herbs and peppers, and place in an ungreased shallow baking dish.  Arrange the fruit attractively on top.  Spoon the remaining juice among servings, and top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: black olive,coconut milk,bengal,chickpea flour,pork loin,limeade concentrate
title: Lime Curried Pork Loin
ingredients: 8 ounces ground pork loin | 2 tablespoons bengal gram flour | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 can black olives, drained and sliced
instructions: Combine pork and bengal gram flour in a bowl.  Add chickpea flour.  Mix until just moistened.  Heat coconut cream and limeade concentrate in a separate skillet over medium high heat.

title: Irish Cabbage and Goat Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and thinly sliced | 3 ounces goat cheese, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup single cream | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large bowl, except for the cream and sugar.  Toss to coat well.  Serve immediately.

title: Bourbon and Fish Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 ounce fresh fish, preferably unshelled | 1/4 ounce gin
instructions: Fill 3 tall glasses the rest of the way with ice.  Pour the gin over the fish.  Float salt to cover and stir.

title: Chinese Restaurant Ice Cream (Vietnamese Style)
ingredients: 1 liter unsalted chicken stock | 3/4 cup frozen vanilla ice cream ( vietnamese ice cream ) | 1 -2 stalk fresh chives, thinly sliced
instructions: Put the stock in a pan over medium heat and bring to a boil.  Remove from the heat and immediately add the vanilla ice cream, stirring until the ice cream is completely dissolved, about two minutes.  Add the chives to the pot of stock and return to a boil.  Then cover and remove from the heat.  The ice cream will continue to steam as it melts into the liquid.  Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate until solid, at least four hours.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,butter,lettuce leaf,water chestnut,fennel seed,celery leaf,couscous,leg lamb
title: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb Wraps
ingredients: 3 lbs leg of lamb, cut into 6 pieces at joint | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 cup couscous | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 10 soft lettuce leaves | 3 celery leaves, washed, cut in half and thin sliced | 2 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 12 lasagna noodles | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f rub lamb with fennel seeds, place on a baking tray and bake for 40 minutes or until well browned and cooked to your liking.  Cool and then refrigerate for 30 minutes for stock.  Remove lamb from bones with a slotted spoon and remove any sinew and excess fat.  Meanwhile, put couscous to the boil, add 1/2 cup cold water and cover and set aside for 10 minutes.  After 20 minutes add the butter and cover again and set aside for 15 minutes.  While the couscous is cooking, cook the lamb meat in a large frying pan, brushing with the butter, until it is browned and crispy all over.  Remove lamb from pan, add the lettuce leaves, celery and water chestnuts, stir to combine and remove from heat.  Spread couscous mixture across each salad leaf and divide lamb between the three salads.

title: Roasted Dates
ingredients: 2 cups dried pitted dates | 1/4 cup bacon drippings
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Using your fingers, pry the dates in a clean cloth with paper towels.  Place them in a large bowl.  Sprinkle them with bacon drippings and toss to coat.  Spread them into a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven until they begin to give off a little dry juices, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,seasoning,greek yogurt,yellow onion,dark soy sauce,worcestershire sauce
title: Homemade Hazelnut Patties With Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning, of choice ( i like morton's nature's seasoning ) | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ground hazelnuts
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well.  Form into patties, about 3/4 inch, and sprinkle the patties with the nuts.  Cook over medium/hot heat, flipping once, until lightly browned on the outside.  Serve warm with sauce for dipping.

title: Brunch Appetizer
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili paste or 2 teaspoons rum | 2 cups baby arugula | 1 red capsicum | 1/2 slice pepperoni | 1/2 slice lemons | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons pizza sauce
instructions: Mix chili paste, arugula, capsicum, pepperoni, juice and spices in small bowl.  Arrange in shallow ovenproof dish.  Combine pizza sauce and pour over salad, tossing to combine.  Serve.

title: Grilled Roast Honey-Corned Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons dried minced horseradish
instructions: Place the horseradish on a clean dry plate.  Coat the breast with the horseradish.  Allow the chicken to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, or refrigerate for up to 3 hours.  Grill the chicken from the caraway side of the grill, basting once or twice with the caraway mixture until charred, 7 to 10 minutes per side.  Move the chicken to a cutting board, and let rest for 7 to 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Thai Cheese Popsicles
ingredients: 1 package sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons fresh lemongrass, minced | 4 large mixed fresh fruit, chopped ( e.g. mango, pears, peaches or any other firm-ripe fresh fruit ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil sprig ( optional ) | almond extract, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the cheddar, lemongrass, fruit, and basil and stir until completely mixed.  Spoon the mixture into ice cream cones, or stick a piece of cardboard on a baking mat.  Poke your finger into the center of each by rolling the flat surface of the cheese mixture from the center outwards, then turning it over once.  Repeat process until satisfied they have attained their proper uniformness.  You can refrigerate or freeze the patties, or even freeze them for up to 2 weeks before serving.  Drizzle or sprinkle with as much almond extract as you prefer.

title: Picante Shrimp in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 teaspoons mild picante sauce | 1/2 cup italian parsley ( or cilantro ) | 1 lb veal, cut in strips
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp if using frozen.  Toss with picante sauce and parsley.  Marinate shrimp 2 hours in refrigerator.  Bake shrimp 30 minutes in preheated 400°f oven.

title: Kålsalat - Cold Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 3 large cabbage | 4 beef hot dogs | 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 cups half-and-half or 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Remove outer leaves of cabbage, wash and cut into 2 inch pieces.  Heat a large pot over medium high heat, and carefully place the hot dogs and cabbage pieces, in the pot.  When the cabbage is tender and beginning to brown, stir in yogurt and half and half.  Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, and continue to simmer until heated through.  Serve, garnished with freshly chopped herbs and serve with additional lowfat yogurt on the side.

title: Mom's Chinese Cabbage Rolls (Szech Style)
ingredients: 1 kg finely shredded chinese cabbage ( cabbage with leaves ) | 1 kg ground hamburger ( leaner ) | 2 liters cooked rice | 1 liter gluten free bread stores in the fridge ( i like gluten free for my family ) | 1 liter gluten free bread stores in the fridge
instructions: Cook the rice and drain.  If you use a gluten free bread you will only need 4t of water but since this recipe is gluten intolerant please add more.  If using gluten free bread add, the 1t bread mix can be made for gluten free.

title: Okra and Pepper Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces okra, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 4 ounces champignon mushrooms or 4 ounces chantignon mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 8 packages frozen frozen frozen french style linguine, thawed | 12 squares edible silver foil
instructions: Place mushrooms together in an 8 quart pot with a large sprinkling of salt and the yeast on top of each layer.  Cover with some water and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to just above its lowest point.  Cover tightly, simmer for 10 minutes.  Uncover, remove tops of mushroom and cool for 15 minutes.  Stuff the mushrooms with okra mixture, and place on a plate.  Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the same skillet over medium heat and fry the linguine, according to package directions.  Cook the linguine until tender but still slightly firm.  Serve in a bowl or with toothpicks.

title: Chinese Fried Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages thin chinese noodles | 1 cup cornflour | 3 dill pickles, sliced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dill pickle
instructions: Rinse noodles and soak for 5 minutes.  Heat wok or frying pan with a high heat.  Add noodles to coat with oil.  Cook until golden brown, stirring constantly.  Transfer to bowl.  Add pickles and remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola cheese,cherry pie filling,oyster sauce,cool whip,lime wedge
title: Faux Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated creamy shrimp filling | 8 -12 ounces gorgonzola cheese | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 2 packages cool whip | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Heat the shrimp filling and sauce over medium heat for 2 or 3 minutes.  Beat together cool whip and lime juice until soft peaks form.  Add the gorgonzola cheese, oyster sauce and mix well.  Dip the four corners of each piece of phyllo in the cool whip and layer in 9x13 pan.  Spoon most of the shrimp mixture all over the pastry.  Keep the top covered with plastic wrap so that it doesn't dry out.  Let set for 15 minutes.

title: Mom's Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/8 cup white flour
instructions: Combine italian seasoning with the beef and beans.  Cook until hot.  If there is any oil left, add a bit of it to the gravy and whisk well.  Serve over your favorite cooked rice.  I normally cook it with a whole wheat egg and garlic bread.  This is what we do on top of noodles or at the table for lunch the next day.

title: Caribbean Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 1 cup chilled pineapple juice | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 iceberg lettuce, washed and dried
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the chocolate syrup and pineapple juice.  Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from the heat, and stir in the raisins and lettuce.  Fill the lettuce cups.

title: Chinese Chicken Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli | 1 chicken wings, drumsticks or 1 turkey drumsticks | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 large mace, crushed
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok.  Add mace to oil and fry the chicken, remove from wok, drain on kitchen paper.  Stir fry broccoli in oil and pour over chicken.  Cook until tender, around 10 minutes.  Turn off heat.  Cover and leave to sit for 5 minutes before serving with rice.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,veal,orange flower water,nonfat plain yogurt,baby spinach
title: Quick and Easy Kofte
ingredients: 250 g frozen mixed sprouts, thawed | 15 g baby spinach ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange flower water | 400 ml nonfat plain yogurt | light cream or sour cream, to serve
instructions: Place the spinach, water and orange flower water in a large heatproof bowl, place the bowl over a pan of simmering water.

title: Grumpy Corn Flakes
ingredients: 1 cup fresh corn flakes | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Mix corn flakes, vinegar, and garlic.

title: My Colcannon
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, skinless and boneless ( about 6 large chicken breasts ) | 2 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 jar chopped pimiento ( drained of fat )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Rinse chicken breast and pat dry with paper towels.  Place chicken in a greased shallow baking pan.  Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes.  Turn breast over and bake for an additional 30 minutes.  Remove chicken to the cool, cover and allow to cool.  Remove meat from oven and refrigerate for at least four hours and up to 1 day.  Drain fat from the chicken and return to the pan.  Add cabbage, pimento, salt and 1/2 cup water.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until cabbage is just wilted.  Serve immediately.

title: Muffuletta
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Cut the bread into 1/4 inch slices.  Toast the bread under a broiler for 1 - 2 minutes.  Spread your favorite sandwich spread with your favorite sandwich spread.  Sprinkle with pine nuts.  Place on a cookie sheet, under the broiler for 1 - 2 minutes.  Watch carefully.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,grain white rice,caper,chili sauce,pineapple chunk,rice vinegar,red bell pepper
title: Fruity Sweet Chili Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup bottled sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons drained drained canola capers | 1 can pineapple chunks, coarsely chopped | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1/2 medium red bell pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Rump Steak With Flicky Peppered Onions
ingredients: 3 large rump steak, about 4 oz | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400ºf.  Spray oil in frying pan.  Using tongs, lightly season the steaks with salt, black pepper and freshly ground black pepper.  Pour enough oil to just cover the edge of the pan.  Set aside in oven.  Turn off oven.  When oven has finished pre heat a pan of water until boiling.  Add the steaks to the boiling water.  Boil for 2 mins, remove with slotted spoon and drain the water.  Transfer pan of steaks to oven and cook for around 10 mins each side for rare or up to 20 mins for medium rare.  Serve with steamed rice.

title: Spanish Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs spanish onions | 3 eggs, seperated
instructions: Skin and finely cut onions into very wide 1/4 inch slices.  Place in strainer and rinse under cold running water until dry.  Place in mixing bowl.  Beat egg whites until frothy and gradually beat in yolks.  Beat egg whites stiff and fold into onion mixture.  Spoon mixture into hot buttered frying pan or deep heavy skillet.  Fry over moderately high heat, turning after 15 to 20 minutes, until edges are firm, puffy, and golden but centers are still soft.  Turn often.  Serve with chorizo, bacon, and other sausage.

title: Baked Rice With Ginger (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 fennel bulb, sliced thinly | 1 leek, thinly sliced
instructions: Rinse the rice well and drain.  Place in the rice cooker and set to ‘slow’ mode.  When the machine starts running ‘rice’, add all the ingredients to the rice cooker.  Cover and press start.  When the rice cooker stops steaming, transfer the rice to a large bowl.  When the machine stops steaming, place in the refrigerator until dinner time.  While the rice is steaming, place the sliced fennel, leek and orange in a frying pan and cook on both sides.  Allow to cool for 2 - 4 minutes.  Transfer mixture to the rice cooker and stir to combine.  Pour the heated sweet soy sauce mixture over the rice.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,tea,vanilla essence,five spice powder,coriander seed,farfalle pasta
title: Fast & Easy Spicy Chicken Rys
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 1/2 cups roasted boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup milk | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Boil water and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.  Put the coriander seeds, chicken thighs, cream, spices & vanilla essence in a blender& mix for a minute or so until well combined.  Drain the pasta and place in a deep serving bowl.  Pour the sauce over the chicken mixture& mix altogether well.  Serve immediately.

title: Mafe (Smoked Arbol)
ingredients: 2 arbol chiles, stemmed and sliced into half moon slices | 1/4 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Combine chiles and margarine in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover.

title: Caesar Salad--Mcuhar's Lettuce & Vodka  Lettuce
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and dried well ( or other salad greens ) | 2 cups boiling water | 2 tablespoons fresh vodka | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Tear lettuce into pieces & arrange about 1 cup in the bottom of a salad bowl.  Pour boiling water over lettuce, leaving 1/4 inch or so of lettuce in the bottom.  Add the vodka & salt and pepper.

title: Paprika Powder for Seafood
ingredients: 2 tablespoons paprika | parsley sprigs, as a garnish
instructions: Place the paprika in a small bowl.  Place the parsley sprigs in the bowl.  Stir in the paprika.  Cover the bowl with damp plastic wrap and refrigerate in a cool spot for 1 to 5 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,orecchiette pasta,half,tabasco sauce,chocolate,chicken stock,pineapple ring
title: Sicilian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces orecchiette pasta | 1 cup chicken stock | 8 small pineapple rings, cut in 1/2 | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 6 -7 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dried orecchiette pasta pasta | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: In a large pot add, stock, pineapple rings, vinegar and bring to boil.  Add orecchiette and cook until just tender without overdosing.  Drain pasta and return to bowl.  Add half and half and orecchiette to bowl, and toss well.  Chop chocolate and sprinkle over pasta.  Taste and adjust seasonings.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Boats- Eggs With Cardamom Beer
ingredients: 2 ounces dark beer | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 3 large cardamom seeds | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Heat the beer in a saucepan.  While it's heating, split the eggs in half lengthwise.  Remove the yolks from the whites and set them aside.  Grate the egg yolks into a mixing bowl with a teaspoon or so of freshly ground pepper, then stir in the finely grated egg whites into the yolks.  You should end up with a very thick batter.  Using an 8 inch non stick skillet, ladle in enough batter to cover the bottom of the pan.  Quickly tilt the skillet over the top of the batter so it coats the bottom evenly.  Cook the boats until just cooked, about 6 minutes for med.  Hard boiled eggs and 4 - 5 minutes for well done.  Let the boats rest in the pan on a plate covered in wax paper, for 1 - 2 minutes before serving.

title: Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, peeled | 1/4 cup medium grain rice or 1/4 cup golden rice, rinsed | 2 fresh mint sprigs | 1 tablespoon fresh chervil | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 3/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | mint sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place ginger in a bowl and pour enough water over ginger to cover it.

Random Ingredients: port wine,stewing beef,red enchilada sauce,green pepper
title: Tex-Mex Beef and Green Pepper Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 bottle red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 large green pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place stewing beef in a casserole dish.  Combine enchilada sauce, port and green pepper.

title: Cheese Skewers With Rosemary Infused Olive Oil
ingredients: 500 g provolone cheese, cut into 1/2 cm cubes | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 12 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 dash tabasco sauce | kosher salt, for sprinkling
instructions: Make the vodka by placing 1/4 cup vodka into a small bowl, sprinkle with salt and set aside.  Cut half the cheese into 1 cm cubes.  Place into the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment.  Add the remaining vodka and 1/4 cup olive oil to the cheese and using a large spatula, slowly incorporate the cheese.  Add the rosemary and tabasco.  The final mixture should be the consistency of whipped cream.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature until ready to use.  When ready to prepare the skewers, remove the plastic wrap and discard.  Put skewers into a shallow dish.  Place 1 tablespoon of the flavored vodka in the center and wrap the cheese around the vodka.  Transfer to the refrigerator to marinate for 1 hour.  Remove the cheese from the vodka and marinate in the salt for at least 30 minutes.  Remove the cheese from the vodka and rub the remaining vodka on the cheese using a long, sharp knife dipped in olive oil.  Remove the excess vodka from the vodka, slice in half and use to pour onto the cheese when ready to serve.

title: Smoked Mayo Salmon
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, skinned | 1 ounce apple, chopped | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon sweet tea | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon spice | 1/4 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingrdients in a jug.

title: Tortilla Eggs
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 pounds potato chips ( e.g. keebler chips ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Place the eggplant slices into the boiling water and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Place the potato chips in a food processor and process until the chips are well ground.  Set aside.  Place 1 teaspoon of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and stir in the salt, vanilla extract and eggplant slices.  Fry for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often.  Serve with scooped tortilla chips.

title: Apricot Chicken and Veal Piccata
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 lb veal, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 lb chicken thigh, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 3 small apricots, quartered | chicken bouillon, warmed
instructions: In shallow dish, combine orange juice, chicken bouillon and 2 1/2 cups cold water.  Add veal, chicken and apricots.  Season well.  Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 3 hours or overnight.  Serve on italian bread with warm chicken broth.

Random Ingredients: anise extract,cherry,onion powder,curry powder,heavy cream,phyllo pastry,chicken tenderloin
title: Cousin Cosmo Ties
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream ( whipping cream ) | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon crushed anise extract | 2 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 bunch dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f, or just until hot.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil generously sprayed with cooking spray.  Set aside.  Combine cream and curry powder in a saucepan over medium heat.  Stir occasionally for about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and add anise extract, chicken and onion powder.  Mix until well coated.  Set aside to cool.  Lay filo pastry on a clean surface.  Cut a small slit in the center of each filo strip.  Spoon about 1 t.  Of cream mixture into each strip along the length of the filo strip.  Roll up the filo pastry like a cigar, using a pastry tip to help roll the pastry up even tighter.  Cut each rolled out roll into 4 pieces.  Place on the prepared baking sheet.  Repeat with remaining filo pastry to make 4 smaller, wide loaves.  Brush tops of loaves with cream mixture.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the juices run clear.  Cool.

title: Cucumbers With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 2 -3 slices italian bread, toasted ( thin slices are best. ) | 3 tablespoons shredded peeled english cucumbers, well rinsed ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Toast the toasted bread lightly in a heavy skillet. .  Transfer to serving plates and sprinkle with the cucumber.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cherry pie filling,grape tomato,sea salt,irish cream,strawberry,yellow onion,rice noodle,ancho chile
title: Rice Noodle Salad With Fresh Strawberries (Chi-Chi)

instructions: Rinse the noodles and place in a large salad bowl, then mix together the onion, cherry tomatoes, sea salt, chiles, and 1/4 cup water. Taste and adjust seasonings.  To make vegetarian use canned or hard cooked vegetable broth.

title: Baked German Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon baking potato ( use 1-2 tsp, for a healthier and spicier snack ) | 1 -2 tablespoon non-dairy topping ( optional ) | 3/4 - 1 cup chocolate chips ( more or less )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees.  Grease a baking sheet or you can use parchment paper.  Bake the baking potato about 20 - 25 minutes, or until they test done, but haven't done any harm in the final product.  I have had these chips after cutting them in half and it is almost completely burnt.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,heavy cream,vanilla,cranberry,vegetable shortening,worcestershire sauce,cabbage,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Mexican Cabbage and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 2 large green chili peppers, chopped | 8 fresh plums tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 cup fresh cranberries, chopped | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In large bowl combine cabbage, chilies, and tomatoes.  Pour cream and worcestershire in with cabbage mixture.  Mix well.  Sieve dry ingredients and add to cabbage mixture.  Stir to blend.  Add shortening.  Stir well.  Pour into ungreased baking dish and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until browned and tender.  Turn off oven and leave the dish in the oven for an additional 30 minutes or until set.  Serve warm.

instructions: In a non stick skillet, cook sausage.  Drain and set aside.  Heat oil over medium high heat.  Add cottage cheese.  Cook until cottage cheese is hot.  Add spring onions and cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add sausage.  Add meat, pecans and onion mix to blend.  Shape into 12 balls, leaving about 1 inch space between each ball.  Serve warm, garnished with parsley.

title: Smooth Strawberry Tea
ingredients: 500 g strawberries | 350 g parsnips | 300 g sweet tea ( toblerone )
instructions: Clean and wash the parsnips.  Chop the strawberries.  Peel the tea.  Cut the tea leaves and decorate with strawberries.

title: Guinness Beef Steak With Orange Peel Sauce

instructions: Heat grill.  Dry steak on both sides and spread out in a single layer in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Combine tapioca, 1 cup hot water and orange peel.

Random Ingredients: radish,cottage cheese,chicken stock,red onion,salt pepper,brandy,stewing beef
title: Beef and Veggie Stew
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef | 250 g small radishes | 400 g small baby spinach leaves | 150 g cottage cheese | 1 small red onion | salt and pepper | 2 teaspoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Peel and chop the onion fine and sauté with brandy in a non stick pan until golden brown.  Meanwhile cut 1 tablespoon of the beef fat into 2 inch cubes.  When golden, remove onion from pan and set aside.  Add the beef cubes to the same pan and brown lightly.  Add the vegetables, sprinkle with salt, and mix well.  Put the beef mixture back into the pan and add the brandy and onions.  Pour the water from the beet in and bring to the boil.  Once boiling, cover tightly and simmer for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beet,onion,cardamom,peanut oil vegetable,beef stock,chicken bouillon,chicken,soya sauce
title: Nasi Goreng (Nasi Goreng)
ingredients: 2 cups chicken, cut into pieces ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons beets | 1 liter beef stock, boiling ( or chicken stock ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or any other vegetable oil ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 1/2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons ground onions
instructions: Take out the beets and wash them well and cut off the stems.  Wash the chicken and cut them into pieces about the size of the beets, about the size of the beets.  If using frozen meat and beets, boil them for about 8 - 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat a pot using a bit of oil and fry the onion in it until soft.  Remove them from the pan and set aside aswell.  Fry the chicken pieces in the remainul and set them aside aswell.  Add the beef stock to the pot using approximately one cup or more of stock to make a thickening sauce.  If using frozen meat and beets, add it here.  Put the chicken and beets in the sauce and fry until the meat is fully cooked.  You may not need all of the stock – you may have extra stock at the end.  Add the rest of the stock while frying the onion.  Add the chicken bouillon, soya sauce, ground cardamom and ground black pepper.  The mixture should look like very thick soup.  This usually takes about 5 minutes to serve.  You may have to put your wok in the microwave for about 1/2 a minute, depending on your microwave, until the soup is hot.  Serve hot with rice and boiled egg on the side.

title: Chicken and Noodle Noodles Served With Dried Cherries and White Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 ounces dried small pasta ( ditalini or large shells ) | 4 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 ounces white sesame seeds | 1 whole frying chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 4 cherry rolls | 1/3 cup white sesame seeds | 6 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine | soft white sesame seeds ( to garnish )
instructions: Preparation of noodles, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add salt and drop in the pasta.  Cook uncovered until tender.  Drain and run under cold water.  Drain again and return pasta to the pot.  Heat over medium heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a skillet.  Add the sesame seeds and toss to coat.  Transfer the seeds to a small bowl and set aside.  Chicken, heat a large skillet over medium heat, add the chicken pieces and sear them on both sides.  Remove them from the skillet and set them aside.  Slice the rolls crosswise in half, if desired.  When the pasta and chicken have all been cooking, stir in the sesame oil and remaining oil and set to the lowest heat.  Drain the pasta and chicken and break it into bite sized pieces.  Add the pieces back to the pan and add enough of the wine to the pasta and chicken to moisten.  Sauce, put the cherry rolls in the pan, turning around in the tomato sauce.  Cover and cook until it's dry slightly, just enough to sizzle a bit.  Add the beans and sesame seeds, cook until some of the oil appears on the bottom.  Stir in the cooked pasta and chicken.  Pour in an opening in the pan, mix everything together and serve.

title: Alouette's Melted aubergines
ingredients: 2 aubergines | 2 tablespoons red chili ( optional ) | chili pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in large frying pan over medium high heat.  Cut the aubergines in half lengthwise.  Slice each half into slices about 2 inches wide.  Fry with the chilli, until the aubergines are lightly browned.  Arrange them in a warm serving bowl.  Pour the chili flakes on top of the aubergines.

title: Pizza (Italian Style)
ingredients: 1 bun ( thin flour bread will work ) | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar | 2 cloves garlic ( pressed or grated ) | fresh basil leaf | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut sandwich in half crosswise.  Spread vinegar on both halves, leaving a 1/2 inch thick edge of each half.  If using, sprinkle with garlic.  Add basil, cayenne pepper, and sage.

title: Quinoa and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 24 asparagus spears, trimmed | 1/2 cup quinoa, for tossing
instructions: Place the quinoa, about 2 quarts, in a large pot and cover with about 1 cup water.  Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 40 minutes until quinoa is sticky and fluffy.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,salad oil,madeira wine,harissa,maple syrup,nonfat milk,romaine lettuce,milk
title: Portuguese Bread and Butter Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs romaine lettuce | 1 cup nonfat milk | 3 ounces of sweet canadian bacon, minced finely | 2 tablespoons sweet pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat milk | 1 tablespoon harissa ( or 1 t. hot pepper paste or 2 t. maple syrup ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil ( or olive oil, i used none ) | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon cultured nonfat milk
instructions: Line a large serving platter with lettuce leaves.  Arrange leaves evenly over lettuce.  In a small bowl, blend the sweet pure maple syrup with the nonfat milk, harissa paste, vinager or maple syrup, salad oil, nonfat milk, and nonfat milk, until smooth, about 15 seconds.  Drizzle dressing over lettuce and sprinkle evenly with crumbled bacon.

title: Easy and Delicious Black Beans (Vegetarians)
ingredients: 2 packages frozen broccoli, cut in half | 6 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 can black beans
instructions: Drain or rinse your vegetables in a colander, put them into the pot, and cover, turn on medium.  When the water starts boiling, boil for 20 minutes.  In a small saucepan, place your frozen broccoli and tomato puree, and bring just to a boil over medium heat.  Put the lid on and let simmer for 15 minutes, or until desired thickness.  Turn off the heat, but you can stir in your cooked broccoli right before you serve it.

title: Gourmet English Pea Salad
ingredients: 500 g yellow split peas, rinsed | 1 large white onion, thinly sliced | 1 green capsicum, halved, deseeded and cut into thin slices | 400 ml water, cold | 6 tablespoons kirsch, chilled | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 2 large potatoes, cooked, peeled and cubed according to packet directions
instructions: Boil the peas in 100ml of water for 10 - 12 minutes until nearly tender.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Transfer to a large bowl, add the onion, capsicum and warm water until well combined.  Pour over the kirsch and stir.  Add the rice wine vinegar.  Toss to combine.  Transfer to the serving platter lined with plastic wrap and serve.

title: Ginger Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and softened | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced fresh kaffir lime leaves | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the ginger root, vinegar, lime leaves, and kaffir lime filling in a small bowl, and mix until smooth.  Spoon about 1 1/4 tablespoons filling onto the center of each phyllo pastry sheet, and roll from the center toward the shortest side until the filling is completely encased.  Heat a lightly oiled baking sheet in the preheated oven until the phyllo pastry is golden brown, about 3 hours.  Allow to cool.

title: Cheese Sesame Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 3/4 cup bocconcini, diced ( a fresh biscuit ) | 4 ounces of your favourite jarlsberg cheese ( finely diced ) | 3 tablespoons sambal oelek ( or chopped fresh chilli pepper )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425°f / 180°c.  Combine all of the ingredients together in a bowl then, working from the center outwards, knead gently until dough forms into a roll.  Form into a log and wrap with plastic wrap or wax paper.  Place on a baking tray and flatten out as possible using a rolling pin.  Bake for 25 minutes, remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes then cut into biscut sized pieces.  Store in an airtight container for up to a week or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Spaghetti Squash-Stuffed Turkey
ingredients: 3 lbs fully cooked turkey, halved lengthwise and attached at the neck and breast halves | 12 ounces spaghetti squash | 2 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Place squash halves attached to a large baking sheet, cut sides down, on lightly oiled or parchment paper.  Sprinkle squash halves with salt, if desired.  Bake 45 minutes.  Turn squash over, sprinkle with salt and continue baking.  Add turkey, spooning approximately half the stuffing over the top, and continue baking.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes, or until cooked and stuffing is brown and the squash is tender.  Sprinkle squash with mozzarella, and bake 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Roasted Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 1/2 lb smoked pork ribs | 1 can diced plum | 1 loaf country bread | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  Roast poblanos, stem side up, on a rack or cookie sheet.  Place in a bowl until cool enough to handle.  Peel once cooled and set aside, slit the poblanos lengthwise using a small sharp knife.  Place between the skin and flesh of the chiles and press down slightly so they are flat.  Remove and save poblanos for frying.  In the bottom of a baking dish, place the ribs, plums and nuts.  Place 1/2 the poblanos on top of the pork and sprinkle with the bread crumbs.  Add the remaining poblano on top.  Roast for about 40 minutes, turning once.  Remove from oven and let sit on a rack for 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Green Beans on the Half Shell (Bread) With Sage and Apples

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/160cfan/350°f.  Trim the long skinny ends of the green beans, and wash them until the water runs clean in a sieve or a clean tea towel, then dry them on a baking tray with some baking paper.  Cut the apples into chunks and place them on a baking tray lined with kitchen paper.  Place the oven on the hob and preheat the grill to high, setting the heat half an inch or so.  Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the bread slices for about 2 minutes, or until golden.  Remove.  Arrange the bean chunks on a serving platter and top with apple and sage, then drizzle the creme fraiche over.  Toast the cardamom in a dry frying pan until fragrant, before adding it to the bread.

instructions: Stir molasses, milk, and chili flakes together in medium saucepan.

title: Lobster and Lobster Tostadas

Add potatoes, beans, and coconut rum and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.  Scoop the lobster meat and potato mixture onto a serving platter with a slotted spoon.  Spoon some more coconut rum over the top of the lobster and serve.

title: Simple Bruschetta

instructions: Heat broiler with a rack in the middle of oven.  Cut a bread roll into four slices.  Arrange the bread on a baking sheet, slightly overlap edges in the bread, and brush tops with olive oil or a sprinkle of salt if desired.  Bake about 8 minutes or, until bread is toasted.

instructions: Cut sirloin into 1/2 inch squares.  Combine the beef broth and the reserved 1 1/2 cup broth.  Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch microwave safe pan. title: Veal or Beef Croquettes (Fleur De Leche)

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Lemony Jam
ingredients: 18 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained well | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 pints sterilized jars chopped preserved lemons such as rinsed well | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallot | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained well, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped crystallized citron peel | 2 tablespoons white rum
instructions: In a large pot, bring tomatoes, mustard seed, and chili pepper flakes to simmer over barely heat.  Add lemon halves, shallots, and 1 1/2 pints water.  Simmer gently, uncovered, until tomatoes are thick enough to break apart with a fork, about 10 minutes.  Stir in preserved lemons, then rum.  Transfer mixture to jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace.  Cover tightly and process in a boiling water canner for 10 minutes, releasing processable lids.  Dial gauge pressure canner should be set in the center of the pressure canner without any pressure building.  Remove from heat and allow to sit 5 minutes before removing lid.

title: Ladyfingers
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour | 7 tablespoons grated orange peel | 2 tablespoons finely grated lemon zest | 1/2 cup chilled light cream or 1/2 cup whipped heavy cream
instructions: Lightly flour a shallow 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 pound towel.  Drain the flour through a fine mesh sieve into a large bowl.  In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the orange peel, lemon zest, and whipping cream.  Add the flour mixture and mix until just combined.  Divide the dough in half and shape to form a log about 10 inches long and 1 1/2 inches in diameter, placing side by side on a rack set over a shallow baking pan.  Wrap the log tightly in the towel to prevent drying out.  Chill the log 1 hour.  Using about 3/4 of the dough at a time, press it around the side of the towel to completely enclose the log.  Repeat with the remaining dough and ends of log.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Line the bottom of a large baking pan with parchment paper.  Cut the log crosswise into 8 slanting lines.  Cut the log crosswise into eight 1 1/2 wide strips.  Place the strips of orange zest side by side on the parchment paper.  Repeat procedure with the remaining strips.  Sprinkle each strip with flour.  Bake the ladyfingers until golden brown, about 25 minutes.  Let cool completely, then break into pieces.

title: Butterscotch Chips
ingredients: 1 cup butterscotch chips | ground cinnamon | 1 large stalk celery, sliced
instructions: Place the butterscotch chips and cinnamon in a large resealable plastic bag.  Close the bag, and shake bag to mix the chocolate and butterscotch chip flavors.  Divide the celery into 4 serving bowls.

title: Choc Mousse
ingredients: 2 cups finely grated dark chocolate | 1 large red chilies or 1 large hot pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot paprika
instructions: In a small bowl, combine dark chocolate, red chile and paprika and set aside.  In another very small bowl, combine choc mousse mixture, and set aside to set.  In a double boiler or deep bowl of hot water, melt chocolate and set aside until mixture becomes creamy, about 5 minutes.  Fold in choc mousse mixture.  Pour into glasses, top with a few drops of dark chocolate, and refrigerate until set.

Random Ingredients: vanilla vodka,apple cider,grape tomato,ha avocado,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Vanilla Avocado Cocktail
ingredients: 4 large ripe hass avocados | 1 bottle good quality vanilla vodka | 1 bottle grape tomatoes ( preferably with pith and pored ) | 1 bottle good quality parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved | additional freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Blend avocados with remaining ingredients in a large bowl until smooth.  Serve with extra grated parmigiano reggiano if desired.

Random Ingredients: french bread,coconut rum,sun tomato,garam masala,salt pepper,herb
title: Indian Bruschetta Toasts from Your Own Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g french bread | 4 -6 tablespoons unsweetened coconut rum | 2 -4 sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch slices.  Heat oven to 180 degrees celcius.  Spread rum on each slice of bread.  Arrange bread on a cookie tray and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake in oven for 10 minutes, or if preferred, broil a few minutes or until toast is golden.  Sprinkle top with herbs and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,rosemary,tomato soup,beef stock,cake flour,port wine,lemon juice,fennel seed
title: Cottage Fritters for the Microwave
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 5 teaspoons cake flour | 1 tablespoon instant beef stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato soup | 1 tablespoon port wine
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix.  Put the mixture in a microwave safe bowl with 1/2 cup of water covering the bowl and microwave on full power for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring after every minute.  Serve piping hot and with lots of butter and gravy, enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,sriracha sauce,jalapeno juice pepper,tomato green chilies,coconut
title: My Thai Coconut Salsa
ingredients: 16 ounces chopped tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 5 ounces canned jalapeno juice ( with chilies ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( about 3/4 cup, unsweetened ) | 6 tablespoons sriracha sauce ( i used trader joe's brand ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce ( i used ceviche brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oil butter,chickpea,beet,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,pistachio,granny smith apple,bicarbonate soda,saffron
title: Chickpea Beet Pudding
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas | 2 granny smith apples | 2 tablespoons oil ( i know this sounds gross but trust me, the end product ) | 1/3 cup pistachios ( if you have them ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | sazon goya con culantro y achiote ( i use goya brand ) or sazon goya powder ( i use goya brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, seed of
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Rinse and soak the chickpeas overnight.  Take out and rinse the chickpeas under cold running water.  Peel, slice, dice and fry the apples in the oil with a little water.  Put chickpeas in a casserole dish.  Add the pistachios, a little extra water if it looks dry add a little at a time and stir to mix.  Add saffron and all other ingredients.  Make a paste of the above ingredients and pour over the chickpeas.  Cover and bake for about an hour.  You can either serve with cream, ice cream or yoghurt on the side.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,gelatin powder,red sofrito sauce,okra,white flour,vinegar,oriental sesame oil,pearl barley
title: Chinese Okra Turnovers
ingredients: 1 package frozen pearl barley ( thawed ) | 2 teaspoons gelatin powder | 2 teaspoons red sofrito sauce | 2 teaspoons oriental sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons vinegar ( white or wheat ) | 1/2 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup okra ( frozen or fresh, cut into 1/2 inch cubes )
instructions: Mix all other ingredients.  Put dry ingredients in a medium bowl and make a well in the center.  Pour liquid ingredients in well.  Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high, add a little bit of oil and add the okra cubes.  Stir a few minutes until slightly browned, and remove from skillet.  Add the barley to the flour and stir to coat.  Spoon the okra mixture into the center of the doughnuts, and sprinkle with a little more flour for each turn.  Cook 5 - 6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

title: Molho's Santa Fe Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg rump roast | 1 head cabbage, cut into 1-inch long strips | 2 anaheim chili, cut into 3-inch long julienne | 1/2 cup walnut halves, halves | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro stem | 1 cup couscous, cooked
instructions: Soak 6 - 6 cup bowls, or similar container in water for 30 minutes.  Put meat into the baking dish.  Cut cabbage leaves and anaheim chilies in half and remove cores and seeds.  Wash meat in cool water until dried thoroughly and place on top of meat.  Make sure all is covered.  In a small bowl or cup, place walnuts, cilantro and couscous.  Mix well.  Roll meat into the couscous mixture.  Allow excess liquid to drip off.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,vegetable broth,egg noodle,chorizo sausage,meat,icing sugar,brown sugar
title: Noodles With Chorizo, Eggs, and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb ground lamb | 6 large eggs | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 small daikon radish, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup firmly packed brown sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked, cooked
instructions: In 8 inch skillet, cook sausage, ground meat and drain.  In 2nd skillet, cook egg, beating well.  Stir in broth, radish, and sugar, simmer, stirring occasionally.  To make meat sauce,.  Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally, until broth simmers, about 10 minutes.  Stir in meat and cook, stirring, 1 minute.  Add noodles.  Cook, stirring, 1 minute.

title: Margarita Cookies(Or Tacos)
ingredients: 1 large bag egg substitute | 4 sheets parchment paper ( preferably silver, round, or square ) | 4 tablespoons tequila ( optional )
instructions: Combine tequila, if using, and margarita shake mix well to combine.  Pour margarita mix into small shallow bowl, or one 8 oz.  Package of egg whites into a flat 10 x 15 x 1 x 1 jelly type non stick fry pan.  Heat over medium heat until whites are bubbling, lifting and rotating the pan as needed.  Using a rubber spatula, remove from heat and set aside.  Using a ruler and pencil, cut a circle of parchment paper 5 in diameter and 12 in round.  Carefully peel parchment paper from pan.  Cut strips with a very sharp knife into 3x7 or 8 in squares, removing any air pockets.  Place 1 cake or mini tortilla into the center of each square and moisten edges with 2 to 3 teaspoons of tequila dip.  Place a slice of egg white onto the cake or mini tortilla, wetting the edges as possible, and continue layering the tortilla and egg white until you have used up all the tequila.  You will have 12 to 15 circles or 6 large squares of tortillas or 6 smaller squares of egg white on the paper.  Place the paper cookies on a foil lined baking sheet, close the foil, and freeze until solid, about 4 hours.

title: Chicken Schnitzels with Pumpkin Seeds and Confectioner's Sugar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 cup potato seeds | 6 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 cucumber | 8 ounces pumpkin seeds | 0.5 bottle vodka ( optional ) | 8 ounces fettuccine pasta or 8 ounces other pastas
instructions: Using a food processor, finely grind the pumpkin seeds and confectioners' sugar together.  Combine the seeds and sugar mixture, then add and process again for about 10 seconds to combine.  Cut the cucumber in half and grate a couple of zest from the skin lengthwise.  Place the chicken strips onto plastic wrap and pound them into strips or croutons.  In a large bowl, mix the vodka and about half of the pumpkin seeds with half of the confectioners' sugar mixture and spread evenly over the chicken, shaking off any excess.  Spread the rest of the confectioners' sugar mixture over the potatoes and cucumber and spread evenly.  Add the shredded chicken and potato pieces and cover with wax paper.  Place in the refrigerator for at least 4 to 6 hours to overnight.  Drain off any oil that has collected on the plate.  Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta.

title: Spinach and Corn Relish
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh spinach | 1 cup fresh bread crumbs | 2 packages fresh spinach, washed and dried on paper towels
instructions: In a small bowl, combine syrup ingredients, stirring well until dissolved.  Mix in cooked spinach.  Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,saffron thread,caster sugar,avocado,cabbage,broth,nigella seed
title: Guayabagrill - Japanese Pickled Green Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 kg cabbage ( shredded fresh leaves or a small cabbage of your choice ) | 1/2 kg cabbage ( shredded ) | 6 saffron threads ( soak in boiling water to soften ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 liters cauliflower stock or 1 1/2 liters chicken stock
instructions: Place the shredded cabbage in a large bowl.  Add the saffron, sugar and vinegar and mix well.  Pour through a fine sieve, reserving the liquid.  Add the cauliflower stock and stir well to combine.  Cover and store in a cool place.  When ready to use, bring a pan full of water to the boil and add 2 - 3 spoons of olive oil.  Roughly tear 2 tablespoons of the cauliflower and add to the cauliflower.  Boil for 2 minutes then drain.  Use in the next meal when required.

title: Tres Leches (French Cream Cheese) Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cut cream cheese into small pieces and put in blender.  Blend until smooth.  Add vanilla and mix well.  Serve on crackers.  Enjoy.

title: Rosti
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat oven in a frying pan.  Place a non stick frying pan on a burner on low and add mustard.  Add mustard to your pan to spread the mustard.  Stir till thickened.  Slice into small pieces.

title: Chilli-Herb Marinade for Chicken and Fish
ingredients: 1 red chili, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 500 g fresh fish, cubed ( cod or halibut can also be used )
instructions: Mix the chilli, thyme and most of the garlic and chilli marinade together.  Add the pieces of fish and coat them lightly with the marinade.  Refrigerate over night, then turn out onto metal skewers or barbecue bbq or grill and cook the fish for 10 minutes or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,phyllo dough,cauliflower,chicken bouillon granule,garlic powder
title: Garlicky Cauliflower Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, chopped | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 18 sheets frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to saute the cauliflower in olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat until crisp tender, about 10 minutes.  Once the cauliflower starts to soften, stir in the cream of chicken soup, chicken gravy, chicken granules, and garlic powder.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,genoa salami,ginger juice,wonton wrapper,kielbasa,baking powder,white rice
title: German Pot Sticker Dumplings

instructions: Place the kielbasa in a small saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the kielbasa is very tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix the peanut butter with the salami.

title: Mexican Beef and Cornbread
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat | 2 cups sweet cornmeal | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: In a 9x9 inch casserole dish, stir together the beef stew meat, cornmeal, and cinnamon to make the topping.  Spread the topping over the top.  Bake in a preheated oven at 325 degrees f for 90 minutes, or until topping is bubbly and meat is cooked through.

title: Fully developed & Basic Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 5 -6 cups bread, crusts ( we use multi crust baking ) | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 4 ounces dry active yeast | 6 tablespoons salt, to taste
instructions: If using the multi crust method, make sure the bread is all the way coated with oil spray, then add the vinegar and tequila.  Mix well until the butter has melted.  Add the salt and stir to combine.  Pour the dough onto a large, greased pizza pan or stone and spread out the top with a rolling pin.  If using the multi crust method, divide the dough in two, placing each portion around the outer edge of the pan.  Allow to rise on a rack for 30 - 40 minutes before grilling.  Brush the grilling surface/moistening/oil surface liberally with oil and place the pizza dough inside to form a closed crust.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,jicama,chickpea,tofu,saffron thread,white flour,yukon gold potato,cilantro stem
title: Sponge Islands Tofu W- Spicy Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 16 thin dried tofu, cut into chunks 1/2-inch wide | 1 package firm tofu, slices cut into thirds crosswise ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1/3 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1 large saffron thread | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro stems | 2 lbs jicama, peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch sticks ( about 2 pounds ) | white flour, for sprinkling on top of each layer of potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf.  Arrange potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake 40 - 45 minutes, until tender when pierced with a fork, and beginning to brown.  Meanwhile, heat 1 1/2 cups lightly salted water over medium heat or in a skillet and crumble the tofu into the water.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,tabasco sauce,beef stew meat,corn tortilla strip
title: Fiesta Beef Strips
