instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f.  Place meat or stew meat in single layer in 9 x 13 baking pan.  Drizzle with maple syrup, tabasco and corn tortillas.  Bake, covered for 1 hour.  Turn beef strips and bake for 30 minutes.  Serve with rice, beans and flour or sour cream.

title: Boreks (Mussels)
ingredients: 1 kg fresh live mussels, rinsed and removed | 3 cm piece dried shallots | 2 kg shallots | 500 ml beef bouillon | 3 -4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Remove any beards from mussels, reserving any mussels that are open.  Put all the ingredients in a large bowl and stir to combine.  Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight.  Heat oven to 180c/350f.  Place mussels on a baking tray and close tightly for about 40 minutes or until a knife blade comes out clean.  This can take from up to an hour.  Serve immediately, with salad and bread.

title: Gramma's Ham Supper
ingredients: 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 pounds ham, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Place cream in a skillet over medium heat, and bring to a boil.  Slowly stir in ham.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.  Stir in green onions, and continue cooking until heated through and lightly browned, 5 more minutes.

title: Chicken and Sage Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( or 2 tsp dried sage flowers ) | 1 chicken | 3 -4 teaspoons oil garlic | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon sunflower seeds or 1/2 teaspoon crushed roasted peanuts | 2 -4 sage leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, for sprinkling | 1/4 cup grapeseed oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c degrees celsius.  Remove and discard the giblets, neck and giblets from the chicken and tear them into pieces.  Rinse the chicken pieces under running water then dry well with kitchen paper.  Place the chicken pieces, breast side up in a large roasting dish.  Prick the chicken breast all over, inside and out.  Combine the sage, garlic and pepper in a mortar, or with a knife mince until a paste consistency.  Spread the herb paste over the chicken, then shake the pan to ensure that all chicken pieces are coated with the spiced mixture.  Drizzle the sunflower seed oil over the chicken.  Place the chicken pieces in the oven, and cook, uncovered for 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally with the pan juices.  Remove the chicken, cut the slices in half and place in a salad or saucepan and pour over enough tomato or basil juice to cover all of the chicken.  Pour over enough extra tomato juice and juices for the chicken or tomato sauce if using, to taste.

title: Moroccan Orange Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped orange peel | 1/4 cup finely chopped mint | 1 cup ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mix thoroughly.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Stuff Potatoes or Potatoes With Mushrooms and Filling
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, peeled, cubed | 1 lb white mushroom, cleaned, cleaned and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Spray a baking dish with non stick spray or line it with parchment paper.  Place potato cubes in baking dish.  Sprinkle mushrooms over potatoes.  Bake for 1 hour.  Serve with tomato sauce or gravy.

title: Easy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket ( or brisket, about ) | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary ( i leave this out if you don't like ) | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 4 ounces mushrooms | 3 peach slices ( or a few slices of kiwi ) | 1/4 cup fresh mint | 2 -3 tablespoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Remove and discard the membrane from the brisket and slice across the grain in half.  Trim the fat from the brisket and place on one side of the brisket.  Cut up the rest of the ingredients into very small chunks and place in a glass baking dish, overlapping the slices as you go.  In a small bowl, stir together the 2 tablespoons of marinde with the remaining 2 tablespoons of marinade.  Pour this over the brisket.  Bake for about 2 hours or until the meat is tender.  Remove the brisket from the oven and place on a chopping board.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,ladyfinger,artichoke heart,manila clam,liquid pectin,liquid smoke,mustard powder,thyme sprig
title: Artichokes and Clams on a Bed of Mascarpone
ingredients: 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprig | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 pound lupa manila clams, scrubbed and debearded | 4 ounces fresh artichoke hearts, trimmed -quartered, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid pectin | 1 cup queso fresco, shredded | 4 tablespoons jarred liqueur or dimes | 8 ladyfingers, split in half horizontally
instructions: Stir mascarpone and next 3 ingredients in a small bowl to blend.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add clams.

title: Tasty Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks or 2 lbs round steaks | 14 ounces marinara sauce | 8 ounces dried shredded coconut | 1 -2 tablespoon dried sage leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice ( or 1 -2 tsp. fresh herbs, crushed ) | 1 pinch dried rubbed pumpkin seeds or 1 pinch sunflower seeds | 1 small tomatoes, finely chopped
instructions: Place meat in a shallow pan.  Cover with marinara sauce.  Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes, turning meat occasionally.  Drain meat and reserve marinara sauce.  Sprinkle spices over meat.  Remove meat from marinara sauce.  Sprinkle grated coconut over meat and tomato.  Put under broiler for about 2 minutes.  Turn meat and broil again for about 2 minutes, or until the meat is cooked to your liking.

title: Tara's Easy Easy Pizza Sliders
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | spices, mixed, for sprinkling
instructions: Stretch out the dough a little on a clean, dry surface.  Sprinkle with spices.  Using your fingers, press dough out to about 2/3 inch thick.  Place on a pizza pan that is flat and dusted with pizza seasoning.  Let rise for 15 to 20 minutes.  Pre heat your oven to 425 degrees.  While the pizza is rising, spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Remove from oven.  Bake for 5 - 10 minutes.  Allow to cool for a few minutes.  Cut as desired.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,salad oil,active yeast,plum tomato,beef chuck,baby bok choy,dashi stock,tabasco jalapeno sauce
title: Beef & Veggies (Togarashi)
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast or 2 1/4 teaspoons fast-rising dried yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm dashi stock | 4 - 5 lbs boneless beef chuck ( cut into 2-inch cubes or use up to 14-16 ounces lamb or pork ) | 1 cup mixed salad oil | 2 large plum tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 bunches baby bok choy, washed ( i've used regular choy, but some baby bok choy is okay ) | 2 teaspoons tabasco jalapeno sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup flour tortillas, cut into 6 pieces, for serving or bread, for passing at room temperate ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve 1 package of yeast in 1 cup of the broth in large bowl.  Add the remaining broth, and add the beef and turn to coat.  Cover and let stand in a cool place until doubled in bulk, about 15 minutes.  Heat 1 cup of the oil in a 5 qt.  Saucepan.  Stir in tomatoes, bok choy, and jalapeno and simmer 1 minute.  Remove from heat and add 1/4 cup water, cover and let stand 1 minute.  Drain meat and return to saucepan.  Add meat mixture and marinade to saucepan, mix, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until beef is tender and veggies are crisp tender.  If making ahead of time, cover tightly and allow to rise in a warm place but not a cold oven set at 400 degrees, 1 to 3 hours, or until meat is very tender.  When meat and veggies are tender, transfer to serving dish.  Stir gently before serving.  If using bread, cut into 1 inch cubes.  Transfer to saucepan and simmer until bread is toasted and lightly browned on outside.  Note, a good use of dijon mustard and aged balsamic gives this dish a flavor reminiscent of the rare.  If available, use yellow mustard instead of dijon, then brown 2 tablespoons before adding to stew.  To make bread crumbs, in a 4 qt.  Saucepan over medium heat, warm the remaining 2 cups of oil.  Remove from heat, add bread crumbs and toss well, then return to heat until oil and crumbs are golden brown.  Variation, if making ahead of time, cover loosely and let stand 1 hour before adding to stew.  Variation, i have been told that this dish tastes even better the next day and it is definitely tasteless.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,muenster cheese,russet potato,bread flour,lime juice,cod
title: Spud's Faux and Tangy Frog Stew
ingredients: 1/4 lb bacon or 1/4 lb turkey bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 3/4 lbs cod, cleaned and cut into chunks ( can sub other fish ) | 6 tablespoons good quality smooth chunky peanut butter | 1 cup of chunky peanut butter, no thickener added | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 cups of shredded muenster cheese
instructions: Fry 1 slice of bacon in a skillet over medium heat until it just starts to get crispy, then place it on a paper towel to drain.  Repeat until all slices are gone and then place bacon on paper towel or other towel to remove some of the fat you're going to use to fry right away.  If you haven't already done so, remove all but about 1 tbs of grease from your skillet except perhaps you have some kind of dark olive oil, this will turn into a lot of british pig eye stew right away if you don't add a few drops of lime juice.  You can use a couple tablespoons of peanut butter for the peanut butter, add in more as needed to the peanut butter and juice if you don't have any.  If the bacon bits are too thick now is the time to add in more peanut butter and/or juice.  Fry the potatoes, cod, and the remaining bacon in that skillet until everything is cooked through.  Drain all of the grease/fat from the pan in the skillet, then transfer this to a large casserole dish.  Spread peanut butter in in the pan, but don't worry about any more chunks of bacon.  Sprinkle in lime juice and stir.  The amount of lime juice will vary according to how tart/virgin your dish will be if your casserole is too full, it should take somewhere between 10 to 15 minutes for this to thicken up, so watch the casserole for the first few minutes as it can boil and get difficult.  This may take at least 1 to 1 1/2 hours and up to an hour.  Serve topped with grated cheese of your choice.

title: Cheesy Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb pizza dough | 1/2 lb cheddar or 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix cheeses.  Roll out dough on a floured surface.  If using cheddar, then sprinkle on top.  Spread the cheese mixture over the top.  Place dough in a lightly greased pizza pan.  Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until browned.  Cut into small squares.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,pinto bean,sharp cheddar cheese,pine nut,pineapple chunk,stout beer
title: Stout-Cheddar Party Dip
ingredients: 4 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1 cup stout beer ( i use coors light or miller lite ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight to let flavors meld.  Serve with toasted pine nuts with pumpernickel crackers.

Random Ingredients: black bean dip,vermouth,coconut milk,mushroom,pesto sauce,thyme sprig
title: Easy Black Bean Dip-Thai Style
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms ( drained if fresh ) | 1 can black bean dip | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( the jarred kind ) | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig ( or 1/2 t. dried ) | 1/3 cup coconut milk ( optional, i use a regular can of it )
instructions: Remove the stems from mushrooms, discard the hard caps and roughly chop them.  Remove the ribs and discard them.  Mix all the ingredients, except the coconut milk and stir well.  Simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes.  Stir again until heated through.  Note, don't boil or mash the beans too much, they will separate later.  You may even need to break them up again while warm.  Stir in the coconut milk and chill until ready to serve.  Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,chicken breast half,red bell pepper,beef sirloin steak
title: Easy Brazilian Twist

instructions: Prepare the grill for indirect grilling, or preheat the oven to 500 degrees f.  Place the steak cubes onto a square of aluminum foil.  Spread beef on top of beef, then top with diced tomatoes with ketchup and beer.  Fold the edges together to seal the meat.  Place the foil on the grill, close, and cook for 1 hour.  Open the foil about 1/2 of the way, and flip the meat.  Open the foil packet every 20 minutes for 3 to 4 hours.  Slice the meat and serve.

title: Dynamite-Smoked Pork Loin
ingredients: 800 g smoked pork loin roast | 1 can applesauce | 1 small red capsicum, sliced thinly | 100 g pickled red capsicums, sliced thinly
instructions: Open meat and place in a casserole dish or roasting tray.  Add applesauce and capsicum.  Serve with steamed green salad.

title: Thai Spiced Citrus Pepper Jar
ingredients: 2 teaspoons finely shredded orange rind | 4 teaspoons finely shredded cilantro stems | 1/8 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Combine orange rind and cilantro in a large jar.  Stir in peppercorns, pressing to extract flavor.  Seal.

Random Ingredients: red potato,kidney bean,burgundy wine,brown sugar,jumbo shrimp
title: Shrimp & Sweet Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup burgundy wine ( or your favorite ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3 medium red potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Cover and bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes or until shrimp are curled.

title: Swiss Choc Yoghurt
ingredients: 300 ml coconut cream | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder ( not dutch-process )
instructions: Heat ingredients in a pan over medium heat until boiling and thickened.  Enjoy, and watch your swiss choc yoghurt as you eat it.

title: Easy Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives, or to taste
instructions: Stir tomato soup and chives together in a bowl.

title: Sausage Mustard
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( or sweet italian ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mustard powder
instructions: Heat up your skillet.  Spray with non stick cooking spray.  Dump sausage into skillet and brown on all sides.  When brown and nice and tan, add mustard. .  Turn down and simmer on low heat.  Cook for about 15 minutes, then serve with your favorite sandwich recipe.  Also, if you like garlic, skip the mustard and cut the sausage into 1 inch chunks.  Try this with bacon, celery, and red onion.

title: Quick and Easy Molasses Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh yeast | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, divided
instructions: Sprinkle molasses over bread, let stand 15 minutes.  Stir together flour, and yeast in a large bowl.  Stir in 1/2 cup broth.  Mix in remainder of broth.  Turn onto a lightly floured surface, knead until dough is smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes.  Lightly oil a large cookie sheet, transfer dough to sheet, and turn 1/3 way up side of pan.  Cover, let rest 15 minutes.  Flatten dough to a 1/2 inch thickness.  Cover dough, let rest about 5 minutes.  Preheat broiler, and prepare a 13x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and cut into squares or triangles with a 3 inch cutter or pizza cutter.  Arrange squares or triangles on prepared baking sheet.  Drizzle about 1/2 cup broth over each square, bake 20 minutes, or until golden and bubbling.

title: Simple Spanish Pepper Soup for One
ingredients: 1 can stewed green bell peppers | 1 cup bottled garlic juice
instructions: Place green bell peppers and garlic juice into a medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,sea salt,basmati rice,meat,rice noodle,orange peel,angostura bitter
title: Easy & Delicious Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 cups rice noodles | 1 lb meat ( choice of chicken, beef & game ) | 1 whole small leg of lamb ( for stew or pork ) or 1 small veal ( for stew or pork ) | 2 teaspoons sea salt or 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 dash angostura bitters ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | fresh basil ( to garnish ) | 2 orange peel, cut into thin strips
instructions: Rinse the rice noodles under cold water and let drain.  Cut the meat into small cubes and sear them until nicely browned.  Chop them into pieces that are roughly the same in texture and size.  If the meat is already cut into small pieces, cook it, then add to the soup.  If not, add a dash of angostura bitters before you heat the soup up.  Add the rice noodles & meat & bring to the boil then reduce heat to simmer.  Cook covered until rice noodles are very soft & creamy.  When the noodles are done, stir them into the soup.  Taste & adjust with salt & pepper.  Garnish with basil & orange slices & refrigerate for a few hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend before serving.

title: Frangelico and Chicken Legs Stuffed With Green Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs whole chickens legs ( i use the breast tenders from costco ) | 2 heads fresh chard leaves ( or two 28-ounce packages frozen collards ) | 3/4 cup frangelico | snipped fresh sage
instructions: Wash and dry the chicken legs.  Place legs, chard and 1/2 tsp.  Of the crumbled frangelico all around in a 13x9x2 baking dish.  Cover and bake at 400°f for 2hrs or until the thigh meat is no longer pink and falling off the bone.  Remove the chicken from the pan, let cool, and remove the thigh bone from the legs.  Chop the legs coarsely.  While the chicken is cooking, place the remaining 1/2 tsp.  Frangelico and snipped sage in a small bowl.  Cut off the end of green stems from collards and place in a salad bowl.  Remove any loose leaves, discard them and chop.  Cover and set aside.  To remove stuffing from the chicken pieces, carefully remove the stuffing from the pan and arrange the stuffing in a 9x13 pan.  To make the stuffing, pour the reserved frangelico and sage drippings over the chicken legs and chard.  Toss together gently and turn gently to coat the chicken pieces in the mixture.  Preheat the broiler or position the rack on the center oven rack and place the chicken on a broiler pan.  Broil or grill 3 - 5 minutes per side or until light brown.  Turn and broil 3 - 5 minutes longer.  Remove from broiler and let stand 5 minutes, then slice into quarters and serve warm.

title: Almond Citrus Salad
ingredients: 180 g blanched almonds | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander ( or 2 tsp. mixed )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mortar.  Use pestle or a knife to crush ingredients.  Soup should be thick.  Use to dress chicken or fish salads.

title: Tibetan Fried Pork and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb pork fillet ( pork belly can be used ) | 1 package florets fresh broccoli florets ( or frozen ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tamari | 6 cups chicken or 6 cups vegetable oil for frying, see note below | 1 -2 tablespoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: Cut thin strips of pork on the diagonal.  Cut slices crosswise into slices about 1/8 inches thick and cut the strips crosswise through the middle, cutting down to the ends.  Place the pork in a bowl with the garlic, tamari and cinnnamom.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, but overnight is best.  Drain the vegetables well, removing and discarding any damaged bits from the steamer.  Heat 1 -2 tablespoons oil in large frypan or skillet over medium high heat.  When it is almost smoking, add the pork and cook it, turning it around until the edges are crisp.  You may have to do this in batches to get the pork to brown well and have a golden brown color.  Remove from the pan.  Transfer the pan to a plate and cover to keep warm.  Place the steamer over a large pot of boiling water.  When it comes to a boil, add the vegetables.  Cover and steam until the veggies are cooked and tender, 10 - 15 minutes, adding a little water during cooking if necessary.  Spoon the pork onto plates and top with the fried vegetables.  Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.

title: Spary Italian Style
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, thickly sliced ( about 3 slices, can use more ) | 3 cups uncooked spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp, about 5 minutes.  Spoon bacon and all but 1 tbls.  Of the bacon fat over pasta in skillet.  Return to moderate heat.

title: Tuna and Peas Soup
ingredients: 4 cans frozen peas | 1 can tuna, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a non stick pot.

title: Wild Mushroom Dumplings
ingredients: 50 wonton skins ( a box is fine too ) | 10 ounces oyster mushrooms, washed | 2/3 cup almond milk
instructions: Boil mushrooms in water for 5 minutes.  Drain and squeeze out excess water.  Chop mushrooms, set aside.  In a bowl put almond milk, add a little at a time and mix well.  Add mushroom pieces, mix well and put on a floured board.  Place a wrapper on top of it.  Bake at 170 degrees for 10 minutes.  To serve, pour mushroom filling on top and put back in oven to brown for 5 moremins.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,vegetable stock,ice cube,red wine vinegar,green chilies
title: Chili Sauce
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces vegetable stock | 4 fluid ounces red wine vinegar | 1 green chilies | 3 fluid ounces irish cream | 1 ice cube
instructions: Put all ingredients into a shaker and shake well.  If you feel the sauce is too thick for your liking, add some milk or cream.  Serve immediately.

title: Ww 2 Points - Spanish Coliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional, substitute with rum vinegar ) | 1 -2 tablespoon soymilk | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon light rum ( substitute with alcohol free splenda ) | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Wash the cauliflower, remove the tough outer leaves.  Break the head into small pieces and cut it into florets.  Wash sherry and dark rum into small pieces and set aside.  Prepare the sauce by stirring the cornflour into the tomato mix.  Add the sherry, sugar and rum to the tomato mix.  Heat about 1 tablespoon of the mix in a small pan, then stir in the milk to thicken.  Stir in the sherry vinegar and cornflour.  Keep warm on low heat.  Place the cauliflower into a large sauté pan and pour the tomato/paprika/cornflour sauce over it.  Cook for about 20 minutes, until cauliflower is slightly browned.  Turn up the heat to medium high, reduce the liquid to about one third.  Stir several times to make sure the pan doesn't stick.  Remove from heat and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chicken breast fillet,vegetable oil,oregano leaf,peanut oil,meatball,half cream
title: Tocino (Mexican Chicken)
ingredients: 900 g meatballs ( frozen ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 400 ml half-and-half cream ( reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 4 -6 tablespoons crushed roasted peanuts ( garnish ) | 1 1/2 kg chicken breast fillets
instructions: Using a fork, poke holes in the frozen meatballs to allow for easier cutting.  Place them into a zip top bag or covered freezer bag and add the meatballs one at a time, tossing to coat them evenly.  Heat the oil in a wok, add the meatballs and cook over a medium heat until they brown on all sides, then remove them from the pan and place them onto your plate.  Reduce the heat of the pan to low and add the cream a little at a time, stirring all the while, making sure it doesn’t curdle the cream.  Add the taco seasoning and oregano and stir well.  Add the meatballs back into the pan, mixing well and bringing the liquid almost to a boil.  Simmer gently for about 15 - 20 minutes.  Turn off the heat and add the crushed peanuts.  Serve with spanish rice and salad.

title: Hibiscus and Plantain Salad
ingredients: 3 plantains, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices | 3 cups fresh or frozen grapesfruit, sliced crosswise | 3 slices fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons dried hibiscus flowers | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3/4 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Combine the vegetables in a salad bowl.  In a small bowl, stir together the remaining ingredients.  Pour over the vegetables and toss lightly.  If using frozen grapesfruit, remove and discard the pulp.

title: Italian Coleslaw on a Bunch
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 jar alfredo sauce, warmed | 1 1/2 cups thousand island dressing
instructions: Pour heated alfredo sauce in a medium bowl.  Mix together cabbage and dressing.  Layer over salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: green,wasabi paste,guajillo chile pepper,mace,poultry seasoning,edible flower
title: Sauce Florence
ingredients: 1 pound frozen mixed green | 1/4 cup wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 6 guajillo chile peppers | 8 fresh edible flowers, for garnish
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the frozen green and wasabi, and return to a boil.  Cook the green and wasabi in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until no pink remains in the center of the wasabi and green food is very dark, about 30 minutes.  Stir in the poultry seasoning and remove from the stove.  To serve, arrange the guajillo chiles on a platter.  Top each chile with edible flowers and wasabi and wasabi sauce.  Mound the colorful green food on the side.

Random Ingredients: oat,mozzarella cheese,chicken bouillon cube,chicken breast,dark brown sugar
title: Famous PA Dutch Oven Chicken
ingredients: 1 package boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/3 cup rolled oats | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar ( more or less depending on your preference ) | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray cookie sheet with olive oil cooking spray.  Place chicken breasts in prepared cookie sheet.  Combine rolled oats, brown sugar, and chicken bouillon in large bowl.  Tear off 2 to 3 tb pieces of chicken from breasts and place in spice mixture using your hands.  Add to chicken.

title: American Kitchen Classic Chicken, Beans and Potatoes
ingredients: 8 bone-in, bone-in chicken thighs ( thighs may be removed and discarded for other use ) | 2 cans great northern beans, rinsed and thoroughly drained | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup ketchup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  In a large roasting pan, arrange chicken thighs skin side up.  Place orange slices in the cavity of the chicken and surround with beans.  Drizzle beans with balsamic vinegar and ketchup to taste.  Bake chicken until the juices run clear and chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour, basting often.  Add water if necessary.  Bake about 15 minutes, then remove the pan from the oven.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,brown rice,chicken bouillon cube,lettuce,serrano pepper,ginger garlic paste,fennel,white flour
title: Gluten Free and Easy Peasy Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb diced chicken or 1 lb chicken breast | 1 stalk fennel ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 tablespoon brown rice | 2 cups bottled chicken bouillon cubes or 2 cups mushroom broth | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped serrano pepper or 1/4 cup red chili
instructions: Dice chicken into 1/2 to 1 inch chunks.  Mix garlic, grated ginger, brown rice, flour, and brown garlic paste in a plastic bag.  Place chicken and bouillon in the bag and shake until chicken is coated on all sides.  Place in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish/dishes or baking pan.  Combine cream and beer for thickening.  Pour over chicken.  Bake in a pre heated 325 degree oven for about 1 hour or until sauce is bubbly and chicken is cooked through.  Serve over hot brown rice.  Garnish with lettuce, serrano peppers, and chopped fresh serrano peppers.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,lasagna noodle,celery root,rice wine,ginger root,beetroot,sun tomato oil
title: Creamy Beets and Rice Vinegar Rameno
ingredients: 1 pound beetroot, peeled and cubed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/4 cup rice wine | 12 lasagna noodles | celery root, peeled
instructions: In a large saucepan, boil beets and 1 1/2 quarts of water over high heat until tender, about 25 minutes.  Drain beets, and transfer to bowl of a blender.  Add soup, sun dried tomatoes, ginger, rice and wine to blender.  Blend until smooth, then pour half into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Lay lasagna noodles on a clean surface and spread with a layer of beet soup mixture.  Cover with 1/2 of noodles, then spread with soup mixture.  Repeat layers with 1/2 of noodles, and another 1/2 cup soup mixture, and 1/2 of noodles.  Top with 1/2 of noodles.  Repeat layers, ending with soup and cover with aluminum foil.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes.  Remove aluminum foil, and bake 45 more minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,beef sirloin,irish cream,dark soy sauce
title: Beef Brats
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef sirloin | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup irish cream | 6 hamburger buns
instructions: Place the sirloin in the freezer until almost frozen.  Place the dark soy sauce and irish cream in a small sauce pan and heat over hot water until the lumps are gone.  When the lumps are gone remove from the heat and let stand 10 - 15 minutes.  Cut the beef diagonally into thin strips.  Place the beef in the pan and coat with the soy sauce mixture.  Let marinate 15 - 30 minutes.  Cook the meat in the pan over medium high heat until done and browned on all sides.  Remove the meat from the pan and pour the pan drippings over the meat.  Serve immediately with the toasted buns.

title: Scottish Barley Ripe Barley
ingredients: 12 1/2 ounces quick-cooking barley | 4 1/2 ounces ground ginger | 1 1/2 ounces ground mixed nuts, such as pecans, walnuts, hazelnuts or pecans ( optional ) | 2/3 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Place the barley and ginger in a 3 qt saucepan.  Pour the vinegar over, bring to the boil then cover, reduce the heat and cook very gently for 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the barley is soft.  Remove the pan from the heat and leave it to stand, covered, for 15 minutes.  When the barley is almost cool, beat the barley and liquid together until the mixture is pale and creamy.  Mix in the nut, if wanted.

title: Kari
ingredients: 4 sheets nori | 2 heads kale, leaves broken up into small bits
instructions: Place the seaweed sheets in a deep, heatproof bowl.  Cook over a gas flame or on a tabletop burner, shaking the bowl once or twice to spread the nori over the seaweed.  Allow to steam for 10 - 15 seconds.  Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a serving plate.  Serve or allow to cool.

title: Chinese Brussels Sprouts & Rice
ingredients: 500 g brussels sprouts, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons limes or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons basmati rice ( steamed or steamed )
instructions: Place brussels sprouts in an oven proof casserole dish.  Add lime or lemon juice, soy milk & rice.  Cover & bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until thoroughly hot.  Serve immediately.

title: Mint Peppers
ingredients: 6 yellow peppers | 4 ounces boiled ham, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped mint
instructions: Heat the oven to 320°f peel the peppers and slice into long narrow strips, removing all inner stem.  Place the ham and mint in the center of each pepper.  Place the peppers in a roasting tin and cover with boiling water.  Roast for 1 hour, or until the cheese is melted.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coffee,pine nut,corn,beef roast,corn syrup,vegetable juice,white wine,ketchup
title: Pine Nut Beef Roast (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs lean beef roast | 2 cans condensed v8 vegetable juice | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup white wine ( i used a dry white sauce, but any type is fine ) | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 cup crushed corn | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons coffee ( optional )
instructions: Place beef roast in crock pot.  Drain vegies from juice and add to crockpot.  Place ketchup, wine, corn syrup and nuts in a small sauce pan and stir well.  Pour the mixture over the roast.  Cook on low setting for at least 7 hours.  About 20 minutes before serving, stir in the coffee for heat if desired.  Remove roast from crockpot or place on serving dish and cover to keep warm.  Remove the top layer of fat, slice and serve.

title: Saffron - Grilled Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/16 teaspoon saffron | 2 lbs hamburger
instructions: In a bowl place the saffron, and the ground meat.  Mix well and leave for 24 hours.  Heat your grill, or an open fire in your grill.  Form two or three oblong patties, each about 5 to 6 inches in diameter and 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick.  Brush the grates with oil, or dip the patties in the saffron coating.  Close the grill until the patties are well cooked.  Serve on toasted buns.  You may also serve them with a variety of condiments, such as tomato sauce, onion and green salad.  If freezing any hamburger i use a zip lock bag with a hole cut in the top of the hamburger, allowing enough room for it to thaw overnight or for it to freeze.  Serve with your favorite condiments, such as cheese sauce, horseradish or barbecue sauce.  Note, i've had them cook the patties by dropping them into a pan filled with a little boiling water.  Do not add any fresh butter until the patties have been cooked and placed in the pan.  The hamburger will be a bit sticky, but that’s good.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,red onion,kielbasa,pasta,french bread,oat,barbecue sauce
title: Easy Barbecue Sausage and Ham Pasta
ingredients: 10 ounces pasta | 1/2 medium red onion, chopped fine | 1/2 - 3/4 lb kielbasa or 1/2-3/4 lb other sausage | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, cut into slices ( the kind with the oil ) | 3/4 - 1 cup barbecue sauce ( like chris uses mesquite barbecue sauce ) | 1/8 cup old fashioned oats | 1 rustic french bread, cut in half
instructions: To make your favorite barbecue sauce, rinse and drain kielbasa or sausage in cold water.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook at a boil till tender, about 7 - 9 minutes.  Drain pasta and set aside.  While pasta is cooking, sauté onions in 1/4 cup olive oil over medium flame until golden brown.  Drain sausage and crumble.  Add drained sun dried tomatoes to onions and sauté for 5 minutes.  Add barbecue sauce, toss, and coat pasta with sauce.  To serve, divide pasta among 8 warmed serving bowls, spooning sauce over to make a nice crusty bread slice.

title: Pine Nut & Banana Chicken (Mediterranean or Greek or Indian Style)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken, cooked | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon oregano ( or less, add more if desired ) | 1 banana ( soft to sweeten )
instructions: Poke holes through the chicken breast with toothpicks if desired before placing in a dish.  Dry the pieces with a paper towel.  Mix all remaining ingredients and stuff the cavity of the chicken with mixture.  Pour marinade over the chicken.  Set in a baking pan.  Bake in hot oven on 425f for about 30 - 40 minutes, basting occasionally.  Serve warm.

title: Tofu With Brisket and Tofu
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, preferably a 2 pounder with a good grind of garlic and salt | 4 medium tofu, cut into cubes
instructions: In a large freezer proof container or plate with a tight lid, layer the tofu cubes, starting with the salt.  Next layer the beef brisket.  Top with tofu cubes pressing down to ensure they stick.  Cover with the lid or freezer wrap and freeze overnight.  The next morning, remove the lid and add the tofu cubes.  Cover and return to the freezer, again removing at least half the liquid.  I usually do this over night, because i have to.  If there is any left, then simply re freeze and re freeze.  Let stand 1 day to allow for a bit of time for flavours to blend.  Slices can be made at this point too.  If you do not want to freeze the beef, then just remove the beef from the freezer in a single layer and slice across the grain and return pieces to the freezer.  You can freeze the beef if you like.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,orange bell pepper,italian seasoning,salt black pepper,baby carrot,parsley leaf
title: Roasted Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole roasting chickens | 1 large orange bell pepper ( i like orange because it has a bit of red color and is so sweet as well ) | 2 medium baby carrots ( cut diagonally into 1/2 slices ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | fresh parsley leaves, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Poke holes all over the chicken, and place chicken on a rack over a large roasting pan.  Slice the orange bell pepper vertically into thin strips.  Slice the carrots into bite size pieces.  Place the strips into a large bowl with a little salt and pepper, and sprinkle the italian seasoning on top.  Rub the spices into the chicken skin and fat, then arrange the vegetables over the top.  Roast chicken until the meat registers 165 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer, and the internal temperature reaches 170° for chicken.  Let the chicken stand for 10 minutes before carving.

title: White Beans With Horseradish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 400 g dried navy beans, washed and soaked overnight ( white ) | 400 g canned white beans, drained | 35 g fresh honey roasted mustard powder | 35 g ladyfingers | 35 g thousand island dressing ( prepared in the bottle of horseradish )
instructions: Place the caraway seeds in a dry frying pan and toast over a low heat for 3 mins until aromatic, remove from heat and place in a plastic bag.  Add the beans and dry mustard and marinate overnight in the fridge.  Mix the honey with a little water, and add the honey mixture to the beans along with the ladyfingers.  Place in a baking dish in a pre heated oven, and bake in moderately hot oven for 20 mins, turning occasionally and adding more water if neccessary, until they are golden brown and tender.  Remove from the oven, then serve topped with plenty spoonfuls of horseradish.

title: French Bread and Butter Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 dash mustard powder | 10 slices french bread, cut diagonally
instructions: Dressing, whisk together vinegar, half and half, and mustard powder in a bowl until creamy.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,apple juice concentrate,baby portabella mushroom,cream tartar,beef broth,steak,butter,chicken
title: Roasted Beef Sandwich(ATK)
ingredients: 1 lb lean sirloin, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 4 beef broth | 2 teaspoons apple juice concentrate | 2 cups thinly sliced baby portabella mushrooms | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 4 slices apple flavored rolls, split ( toasted ) | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place beef slices in a zip top plastic bag.  Combine cream of tartar and meat juices and mix.  Pour into a resealable plastic bag.  Add mushrooms and reseal.  Refrigerate beef for several hours, or overnight.  Place beef slices on a large plate and cover with foil.  Place in a roasting pan, fat side up.  With a meat mallet or a rolling pin or clean hammer, pound beef until it is 3/16 inch think.  You may have to add a touch more beef broth.  Roast at 375°f for 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring chicken broth to a boil in a small saucepan.  Add cream of tartar and whisk to blend.  Cook for 2 minutes.  Spoon beef over toasted bread and serve right away with a side of roll.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,tamarind juice,anchovy fillet,black pepper,pecorino romano cheese
title: Anchovy and Sauerkraut Dip
ingredients: 2 cans sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 4 anchovy fillets, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons caribou sauerkraut juice | 4 teaspoons hot tuna or 4 teaspoons anchovy paste
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium sized saucepan and heat gently until cheese is melted and the anchovy and juice combine.  Serve warm with toasted bread for dipping.

title: Gurkensalat (Polish Mushrooms)
ingredients: 4 medium mushrooms, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 medium green olives, halved lengthwise | pickling cucumbers ( optional ) | cayenne pepper
instructions: Toss the mushrooms with the olives and the cayenne pepper to taste in a medium bowl.  Set aside to marinate for 2 - 3 hours.  The liquid will have drained somewhat and the mushrooms will give off liquid.  Keep in a covered jar and refrigerate.  Use within 1 week of making.

title: Sweet Lace Cider
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1 cup vinegar | 1 cup chopped capers
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients, and chill for a month before serving.

title: Tomato Crumb Topping for Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 loaf day-old white bread, crusts removed ( or 1 loaf ciabatta ) | 2 tablespoons oat | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce or 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 medium tomatoes, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°c.  Cut the slice of bread in half and arrange on an oven tray or baking board.  Cover with a piece of greaseproof paper and press the two halves together making small flat discs.  Flatten the discs slightly.  Crush the anise seeds using a mortar and pestle or a pestle.  Mix with the oat and aniseeds until well combined.  Pour the tomato sauce into a bowl and gently add the bread chunks with a splash of water to moisten.  Spread over the bread discs first, then scatter over finely chopped tomato.  Bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown and bubbling, shaking the tray after 10 minutes to ensure even browning.  Serve warm.

title: Roasted Blueberry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh blueberries | 2 teaspoons crushed anise seed | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 cup warm raspberry-flavored pepper sauce | 21 romaine lettuce leaves, washed
instructions: Place the blueberries in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of anise seed and let them sit for 10 minutes.  In an ovenproof bowl, stir together the anise seeds and yeast.  Add the remaining anise seed.  Roast the bread in the oven, setting the oven to broil.  When the bread comes out of the oven, drizzle the remaining raspberry sauce and remaining anise mixture over it.  Broil the bread for 10 minutes, turning once, or until it browns.

title: Radish & Taleagon Salad
ingredients: 4 large radishes ( each 12 to 14 inches diameter if using as a salad ) | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar
instructions: Grate the radishes from stem to tip.  Transfer the radishes to a bowl.  Sprinkle with the vinegar and stir to mix.  Serve.

title: Cod in Mango and Apple Dip
ingredients: 4 skinless salt cod fish, cut into serving portions | 1 large cucumber, peeled and finely diced | 2 apples, peeled, cored and diced | 2 cups nonfat sour cream | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 lime, juiced
instructions: Place fish on a piece of foil.  Pour cream and horseradish into a small dish.  Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fish and top with diced cucumber and apples.  Fold sides of the foil up to form a pouch.  Place the pouch on the grill and cook about 10 minutes, or until fish flakes.  Serve with the dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,mexican cheese,egg wrap,romano cheese,rotini pasta,almond,bulk italian sausage
title: Mexican Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 package dry rotini pasta | 2 links bulk italian sausage | 2 romano cheese, shredded | 6 egg roll wraps | 2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup sliced almonds | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Cook rotini pasta according to package directions.

title: Spanish Sausage
ingredients: 8 ounces hot italian sausage ( spicy ) | 1 tablespoon roasted minced red chilis or 1 tablespoon fresh green chili pepper
instructions: Remove casing from sausage using a meat tenderizer or meat mallot and flatten with a rolling pin.  Cut into 1 1/2 inch wide pieces.  Grill sausage under a preheated broiler or medium hot broiler, about 4 minutes per side.  Place on a paper towel lined plate.  Sprinkle with roasted red chilis.  Cut into 1/2 inch wide slivers.  Sprinkle generously with red chili slivers.

title: Polish Oranges With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 6 large oranges, halved and quartered | 2 red chili peppers, deseeded and thinly sliced | 12 ladyfingers, preferably ladyfinger-stamp | 200 g blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees centigrade.  Place one half a orange in each ovenproof dish, top with sliced chili and then spoon on half the blue cheese.  Repeat.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is melting, and the orange is slightly soft and lightly golden.  Allow to stand for 5 minutes.  Serve with extra blue cheese.

title: Venison, and Dried Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 1 package meat-on-dried beef bits ( i use the famous flavor of the ramen noodles ) | 1/2 cup grapefruit juice | 3 tablespoons corn oil or 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 18 slices venison bone ( about 1 inch thick ) | 3 ounces dried fruit, coarsely chopped ( i use apricots ) | 4 8 thin-cut venison loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f.

title: Tessa's Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 1 small bell pepper, diced | 1 small yam, diced ( about 4 in. ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons of grated mizithra cheese
instructions: Cook lamb and peppers in frypot or dutch oven until onions are translucent.  Add in yam and soup.  Stir and heat through.  Sprinkle with cheese and cook 10 minutes longer, or until bubbly.

title: Pasta With Cod, Raisins and Fennel

instructions: Cook and crumble sausage.  Set aside.  Wash and dry bok choy and cut into bite size pieces.  Drain well.  Cook italian sausage and mix with other ingredients.  Chill in refrigerator to allow flavors to blend.  Sprinkle the top with chopped pistachios before serving.

title: Grilled Norwegian Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds halibut fillets, cut in 1-inch thick slices | 1 pound asparagus, trimmed and cut in 1-inch lengths | 6 radishes, trimmed, halved | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Add the fish to a resealable plastic bag, and pour the sugar into the bag, turning to coat the fish evenly with the sugar.  Seal the bag, and shake.  Arrange the plastic bag on the grill grate, close the lid, and cook for 5 minutes.  Flip the fish, close the lid, and continue cooking for another 5 to 7 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork and is opaque and lightly crisped.  Open the bag, and drizzle 1 tablespoon of the remaining syrup from the bag onto one side of the fish.  Close the lid, and allow the fish to dry in the bag for 10 minutes.  If your oven has a convection oven, open the oven door and heat the grill.  When the oven door is hot, close the door and heat the grill.  Place the fish on the foil covered grate, close the lid, and grill until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Chipotle Skirt Steak

instructions: Cook rice in 3 cups of water until tender.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat remaining ingredients over medium heat to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally until mixture thickens, about 5 minutes.  Brush steaks with sauce.

title: Homemade Monkfish
ingredients: 2 lbs monkfish | 1/4 cup dried italian herbs | 1/4 cup dried parsley | 1/2 cup liquid smoke ( or less if desired ) | meat
instructions: Place monkfish in a large, heavy pot.  Cover with water and cook over high heat until the fish turns white, about 5 minutes.  Turn off heat, uncover, and let fish stand in the pot for 15 to 20 minutes.  Uncover and set aside.  Remove any bones, etc. , etc.  Cover and refrigerate 4 hours, overnight is best.  Remove fish from pot and rinse with cool water.  Drain.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.  Rinse and drain any excess water from fish.  Cut into 2 or 3 pieces, depending on desired size, and saute in a small amount of the liquid, until slightly browned, about 5 minutes on each side.  If desired, sprinkle a little more of the liquid smoke on top.

instructions: Boil broth.  Add veggies and flour and stir well until just mixed.  Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes covered on low until veggies are tender but not mushy.  Remove from heat and let cool.

instructions: Trim and halve the mushrooms.  Cut both packages into thirds.  Set aside.  Place the mushrooms and beef in the crock pot.  Mix the water and the dashi and pour over.  Cook on low. title: Ginger Rice With Asiago Cheese

instructions: Place the rice in a bowl, and rinse in several changes of cold water.  Place the ginger on top of the rice, and turn to coat with honey.  Cover, and set aside in the refrigerator. Pick up the ginger piece on the work surface, and slice the piece into strips about 1/2 inch wide.  Arrange the strips of ginger across the rice using either a spatula or a large knife.  Sprinkle rice with more cheese, and place under the rice, making it to fit well into the rice paddle.  Use a spatula to flip the rice onto the cheese and ginger.  Pick up the rice paddle again, and stretch gently with your hands until it is somewhat of a smooth package.  If necessary, secure the edge of the bowl to form a ring.  Slice into segments to serve.

title: Torta Di Pollo

instructions: Dilute the tomato paste by heating it in a saucepan with the grated cheese.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the freshly diluted tomato paste. Just before serving place the sliced ham on top of the tomato mixture and warm it slightly.  Stir in the fried eggs and garnish with lime wedges.

Combine the kale or chard and kale in a large serving bowl.  Stir in the jam and cashews or apricot jam until blended.  Sprinkle the vegetables with the seeds and serve at once.

title: Easy Brazilian Lemonade Cookies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 1 1/2 lemons, zest of or 2 lemons, juice of | 1 cup creme fraiche
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Sift 1 cup plus 1 cup, cocoa powder and juice from 2 lemons into bowl.  Beat in 1 cup and beat on high with electric mixer until well mixed.  Dough will be sticky.  Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 days.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.  Remove from refrigerator and bring to room temperature.  Break off small pieces of dough about 1 by 4 long, 1 1/2 or 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Shape each piece into a ball by gently stretching dough between your hands.  Press dough into 2 inch circle.  Place circle on baking sheets, leaving 2/3 inch at both ends of circles.  Bake for 7 - 10 minutes, turn with a spatula and bake another 5 - 10 minutes until golden brown.  Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes.  Pour 1/2 cup into a glass bowl, place over ice and stir until completely cool, approximately 2 - 2 1/2 minutes.  Beat in 1/4 cup creme fraiche.  Repeat 3 times, until the batter is smooth and frothy.  Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup crème fraîche into bowl at room temperature.  Makes 12 - 16 cookies.  Use as desired.  Note, can also be spread in a muffin tin and decorated with a few crème fraîche cubes, if desired.

Cook over low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the sauce thickens.  Cool the filling, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before using.

title: Swiss and Cranberry Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 medium tomatoes, halved | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 bag swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup dried cranberries or 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 1/4 cup sliced black olives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Place tomatoes inside lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Combine soup, cheese, cranberries and black olives.  Spoon soup mixture over tomatoes.  If desired, sprinkle with additional cheese.

title: Smooth Eggplant
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants | 100 g gouda cheese or 100 gouda cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Cut off any hard stem ends of the eggplants and slice off the hard, bitter part from the outside of the eggplant.  Cut off all the hard eggplants.  Place slices on a clean plate and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 160c/360f/gas spread the cheese out on your baking tray.  Cut the eggplant into thin rounds with a knife.  Spread the chipotle chilli powder on the eggplant rounds and grate the cheese from the block into the cheese.  Pour almond essence on the eggplant.  Cook for 15 to 20 minutes at 170c/360f/gas until golden brown on all sides.

title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried ancho chili | 12 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, carrot, turnip, cauliflower, parsnip ) | 1 large sun-dried tomato
instructions: Heat chilis in a small skillet over medium heat until just beginning to darken, about 6 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Cut veggies into wedges or bite size pieces.  Arrange on a serving platter.  Spoon chili over vegetables and serve with sun dried tomato on the side.

title: Pesto Lamb Kabobs
ingredients: 6 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 12 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 pounds lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Prepare grill for direct cooking heat and lightly oil the grate.  In a small bowl combine 2 tablespoons pesto, rosemary and mushrooms.  Thread the cubes of lamb onto skewers.  Season with salt and pepper.  Grill meat for 15 minutes on each side for medium rare, 15 for well done.  Drain kebabs, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,fennel powder,brown sugar,chickpea flour,lentil,beef,wine vinegar,sultana
title: Lentils Meatball Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger beef | 1/2 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon fennel powder | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 1/3 cups lentils | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients, except the lentils in a bowl and mix well.  Mix in the lentils and vinegar to make an even marinade.  Spread into a greased loaf pan.  Cook at 375°f for 1 1/2 hours.  Take out of the oven and let the loaf rest for at least 30 minutes before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,butter lettuce,water chestnut,asparagus,red bell pepper,manchego cheese,carrot
title: Sizzling Green Salad With Asparagus
ingredients: 24 cups water packed, stemmed, blanched asparagus | 1/4 cup butter lettuce, white part only cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/3 cup manchego cheese, chopped | 3/4 cup green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh carrot, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Rinse the asparagus, remove the tough ends if necessary.  Cut each spear into 10 pieces then cut into 1 inch pieces and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add asparagus pieces and cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until crisp tender and bright green.  Drain.  Arrange the salad leaves on a large platter or serving dish and mound the asparagus, cut side down, on top.  Top with the cheese, green and red pepper slices, carrots or lettuce.  Sprinkle over the cinnamon and cardamom.  Serve.

title: Raspberry Meatballs Appetizer (Dunken Ranchers)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/4 cup raspberries | 1/2 cup frozen sweet sweetened raspberries | 3 tablespoons minced green onions | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice roni, chopped very fine | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 loaf sourdough bread, lightly toasted
instructions: Combine the meat, raspberries, sweetened raspberries, green onion, and seasoned rice.  Stuff into the center of each loaf of toasted sourdough bread and place in a plastic bag.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Serve chilled with fruit cocktail.  This recipe can be made several hours ahead of time.  To make ahead, refrigerate and reheat, uncovered, in a 375 degree f oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,lettuce,yellow pepper,chili pepper flake,scotch bonnet pepper,mexican cheese,panko breadcrumb,green enchilada sauce
title: Spicy Mexican Stuffed Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 6 large yellow sweet peppers, tops cut off | 2 cups lettuce, shredded | 4 scotch bonnet peppers ( habanero or poblanos ) | 8 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 4 garlic cloves, roasted, peeled, and finely minced | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons green enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place the peppers in a large bowl of a large roasting pan, large enough to accommodate all of them in one layer, and fill with about 1/4 of the cheese.  Place garlic on top of the cheese, and add remaining cheese slices and peppers, respectively, on top.  Stuff peppers with cheese mixture, being sure they are completely covered with cheese.  Tuck top ends of the peppers under top.  Sprinkle the tops of the peppers with garlic, panko crumbs, chili flakes, and enchilada sauce.  Roast peppers, uncovered, for 15 minutes, depending on the size of the peppers.  Remove from oven, and cool slightly.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Mustard Duck Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 cup dried currants | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 pounds beef tenderloin | 1 pound duck leg
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Sprinkle currants and celery seeds on a clean cloth towel and rub with the dry ingredients.  Rinse duck with cold water, discarding any loose fat from meat.  Rinse duck well and pat dry.  Rub with mustard mixture.  Place duck on a rack in a roasting pan, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until juices run clear.  Remove duck, brush with duck liquor and continue baking 45 minutes, to an internal temperature of 145 degrees f.

title: Potatoes Ole (Pantry Friendly)
ingredients: 1 lb small red potatoes | 2 cups chicken broth | 1 jar salsa | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 cup frozen mixed-up fresh edible dough, such as marjoram or 1/4 cup marjoram leaves, washed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil with salt added to taste.  Add potatoes, bring back to boil briefly and remove from heat.  Transfer to a bowl and let them steam until tender, 20 - 45 minutes.  Drain potatoes and mash with potato masher to desired consistency.  Return mashed potatoes to prepared bowl.  Meanwhile, bring broth to boil, over high heat.  Once boiling add salsa and marjoram.  Reduce heat to medium.  Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender.  Stir occasionally.  Serve hot with frozen edible dough.  Note, store in refrigerator after step 2 if using frozen, let stand in a small bowl until thawed, stirring once halfway through.  If using fresh dough, prepare as directed above, adding a little vegetable oil to a pastry bag.  Sprinkle with flour, then add to boiling broth and simmer for 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Drain potatoes and return to pan.  Remove dough from pan and shape into a log.  Cut log into half at the side.  Cover and let sit to warm slightly.  Cut each log into 6 equal pieces.  Serve as follows, roll each piece of dough into a thin circle about 8 - 9 inches in diameter.  Using a pastry bag, pipe potato mixture onto each circle, pressing to fit over the potatoes.  Place in a large, shallow baking dish and pour chicken broth over potatoes.  Bake at 375° for 35 - 40 minutes, or until potatoes are golden brown.  If oven is not near, heat oven to broil.  Brush potatoes with a little water for best results.

title: Italian Sausage and Sweet Red Onions
ingredients: 16 links sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 red onion
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Cook sausage in the hot skillet until evenly browned, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,kielbasa,mexican oregano,cornstarch,peanut,maraschino cherry,ancho chilies,cream cheese
title: Savory Kielbasa With Creamy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 package frozen kielbasa ( or any other spicy link sausage you have on hand ) | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano ( dried, if you don't use fresh, it would only be needed to absorb the dry rub ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3 tablespoons chutney ( plain, or chunky ) | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained, reserving juice | 1/2 cup crushed peanuts, lightly salted ( you could also use chopped, i prefer the peanuts ) | 8 dried ancho chilies
instructions: Put sausage into microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for about 1 minute 1 - 2 minutes until sausage is partially cooked.  Mix sour cream and oregano and spread mixture over kielbasa.  In microwave safe bowl, whisk yogurt and cornstarch until smooth.  Stir in chutney and cherries.  Microwave on high for 2 mins, stirring often until chutney begins to bubble on top.  Sprinkle crushed peanuts over kielbasa.  Cover and microwave on high for 3 - 4 mins, stirring often until cheese is melted.  Stir in chiles.

title: Tender Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 kg beef brisket | 1/2 kg chuck | 2 large spanish onions | 1 red capsicum | 1 green capsicum | 300 g hamburger | 1 bottle hot sauce
instructions: Combine the beef with all the other ingredients and bake in a medium oven.  Simmer for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: fig,milk ricotta cheese,pea,paprika,new mexico chile powder
title: Mexican Fig Custard Cups
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fig, trimmed | 1 teaspoon new mexico chile powder | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Chop figs and put in a bowl with a teaspoon of chili powder and paprika.  Mix.  In a small bowl, blend ricotta and parmesan.  Stir fig/paprika mixture into ricotta.  Pour into muffin tins and bake 20 minutes, till cheese is melted and custard starts to bubble on the sides.

title: Guinness-Guilt-Free Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed
instructions: Rinse quinoa well 3 times and remove any stones or foreign foreign matter.  Place in a large bowl and cover with 2 cups of warm water.  Place bowl on top of a burner set on high heat and bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium low.  Keep burner on high and cook 1 1/2 hours or until water is absorbed or according to package directions.  The water should be absorbed.  Stir occasionally.  Taste and add more water if liquid is too thick.  The cooking time will vary depending on what type of quinoa you are using.  It should be slightly puffed up and a little dry at the edges.  When cool enough to handle, transfer quinoa to a large bowl and stir in any leftover water.  Cover in another bowl and refrigerate while quinoa sets.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,mandarin orange,nonfat milk,lemon peel,filet beef
title: Mandarin-Beef Macaroni
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1/8 cup dried mandarin orange, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lemon peel, finely chopped | 3 cups cooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 lb lean filet of beef, thinly sliced

title: Asian Sweet and Sour Cauliflower and Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, sliced | 2 cans great northern beans ( drained, rinsed and drained ) | 2 cans baby corn | 1 can tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | fresh ground black pepper, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Boil the cauliflower and sweet corn in a pot with plenty of water for about 10 minutes. Mix together the dark soy sauce, black pepper and some salt and pepper.  Tables the salad and place on a plate with the cauliflower and sweet corn.  Enjoy.

title: Aloo Baigan

instructions: Heat up the oven on 375 f.  Cut the eggplant slice into slices.  Lay them cut side up on a foil.  Put the margarine or butter in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish.  Place the whole potato slices evenly over the margarine or butter.  Put the diced chili into the dish.  Cook for 30 minutes.  Turn over the slices and cook until the potatoes are done and it looks crispy.

title: Irish White Salad with Blueberries (Cook's Il)

instructions: Place the cheese in a large salad bowl.  Toss with the lettuce, mixed sprouts and blueberries.  Make the dressing in a blender and place in a small bowl with 2/3 cup of the bailey's irish cream.  Blend until smooth, add the remaining bailey's and the remaining 1/4 cup of irish cream to taste.  Pour over salad and toss.

title: Dijon Made Beef Burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion, diced | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard, dry | 1 package small button mushrooms or ( 8 ounce ) package fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 package plain fine dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 1/2 lbs top round ground beef ( or other good beef )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  In a bowl, mix together 1/2 cup onion and the dijon mustard.

title: Spinach-Livers-Stir Fry Pork
ingredients: 3/4 lb pork tenderloin, julienned | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube | 4 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked according to package directions | 2 -3 anaheim chilies, sliced | 1/2 cup baby spinach, loosely packed | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil or 1/4 cup fresh basil, cut in half | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine or 1 1/2 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Add fish sauce, bouillon cube and anaheim chilies to meat and cook 1 - 2 minutes.  Then add noodles and continue cooking.  Turn heat to high and add spinach and basil.  Stir to warm through and then serve.

Random Ingredients: margarine,spice,grain dijon mustard,beef stew meat,chinese five spice powder,vanilla
title: Chipped Beef (Crock Pot or Not)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon whole-grain dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice | 2 tablespoons margarine ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the meat, mustard, five spice powder, vanilla, and mixed spice and set aside.  Melt the margarine with 1 t margarine in a large skillet over medium heat until just beginning to foam.  Add the meat mixture and brown on all sides.  Transfer to a 5 1/2 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 6 to 9 hours or on high for 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 hours.  Remove the cover and cook on high for 30 minutes.  Serve over cooked rice.

title: Lemongrass Pork Sticky Rice Balls With Tofu
ingredients: 24 ounces extra firm tofu, drained ( about 1.5 cans ) | 4 lbs pork spareribs, cut into 2 to 3 pieces | 1 tablespoon finely minced lemongrass, white part only | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, chopped ( about 3 springs ) | 1/3 cup fresh lemongrass, minced | 1/2 cup short-grain white rice | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Soak tofu in enough water to cover for 20 to 30 minutes.  Drain and cut into 1/2 inch slices.  Soak the spareribs in enough boiling water to cover for 20 to 30 minutes and drain. Roll out graham cracker crumbs on a floured surface, then press and shape the crumbs into balls.  Place the tofu into a large, shallow ovenproof casserole dish and bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until crisp and brown.  Scoop out and arrange on a serving platter and pour 1 tablespoon yogurt on top.  Serve with lemon wedges to soak up the juice while dipping.

title: Chicken Tenderloin Caribbean Style
ingredients: 1 chicken tenderloins | 1 ounce green olives | 3 tablespoons mango powder | 2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Heat grill to high.  Place chicken tenderloins on grill rack and cook, turning once until cooked through, about 3 minutes on each side.  Remove from grill and cover loosely with foil.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Slice into thin strips.  Place green olives on broiler pan and broil 2 to 3 minutes until blistered and dark green, moving edges toward edges.  Remove from oven and spread mango powder over top.  Broil for 20 to 30 seconds until lightly browned.  Transfer to platter and drizzle with red wine.

title: Pizza Luscious
ingredients: 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: Mix the maple syrup, orange juice, romano cheese, and basil together in a bowl.

title: Santa Fe Colcannon
ingredients: 4 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 4 cups jasmine rice | 8 -10 baby carrots, grated | 1 medium white cabbage, shredded | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded dark cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped celery rib
instructions: In 2 13x9 inch glass baking pans, place 1 1/2 cups of colcannon.  In 3 1/2 to 4 quart pan, layer the remaining colcannon, carrots, cabbage, and celery on top of colcannon.  In a 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart sauce pan, melt the 2 cheeses over medium heat.

title: Tortellini in Vinegar
ingredients: 400 g tortellini | 60 ml vinegar | 1 celery rib | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Place the tortellini in a saucepan of boiling water and cook for 2 mins until tender.  Remove from the heat.  Rinse in cold water and drain.  Place in a salad bowl and stir in the vinegar, celery, bay leaves and seasoning.  Chill for 20 mins then serve.

title: Easy Spanish Style Quinoa Pilaf on the Skillet
ingredients: 1 cup of white onion, minced | 1 cup long grain white rice ( not instant ) | 4 cups cooked quinoa ( i used my box. ) | 1/4 cup romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Fry the onions in olive oil.  Add the quinoa when they are cooked.  Add the remaining ingredients to the pan and stir to coat.  Cover and simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion,saffron strand,cherry tomato,vegetable,gouda cheese,beer,italian plum tomato,ginger paste
title: Turkish Kebab
ingredients: 1 pint vegetable | 2 lbs italian plum tomatoes | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 medium onion | 8 ounces gouda cheese, processed to powder ( or you can regular american cheese ) | 8 ounces beer | 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes ( canned or fresh - they will fall off the c ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash tomatoes.  Peel tomatoes, leaving stem intact.  Put tomatoes through the coarse blade with 3/4 tsp saffron, ginger paste and diced onion.  Add beer and puree until smooth.  Put this in a deep wide heavy based pan.  Cut off the stem and discard.  Cut tomato with knife blade horizontally in slices or chunks.  Cut a slice off the root end of each tomato so they can stand upright for the tomato.  Stir fry tomato until light brown.  Put tomato, tomato skin and seeds from the tomatoes at base of plate.  Cover tomato with cheese until covered and over.  Cook over low heat until cheese is melted.  Put tomato in a bowl filled with ice and cold water.  Chop the remaining onion very fine or dice.  Put them through a sieve or sieve if you don't mind texture.  Mix with puree and serve in shallow bowls.  Sprinkle with italian herbs if desired.  Note, you can also place in a non metallic container, it should melt right away, and you can place in a crockpot for 30 minutes per pound weight.

title: Salami and Cilantro Rolls (Salami Rolls) Welsh
ingredients: 6 ounces salami, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf, finely chopped | plain flour, for dusting | 1 1/2 ounces fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Put the salami and cilantro in a bowl and mix with the flour to bind them together.  Roll about 1 sixth of the mixture onto half the cilantro leaves, then shape into a cylinder.  Repeat and cover with a clean tea towel.  Put in the fridge for about 15 minutes so the rolls can firm up but not break too much.  Heat a griddle pan on the stove, grease lightly with oil then put the rolls in.  Turn once or twice until cooked though and golden each side.  Remove from the barbecue and set aside.  Serve warm in pieces with salads.

title: Roast Beef and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 kg roast beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 300 g minced stewing vegetables | 1 cup mixed stuffing | 1 teaspoon garlic oil | 4 parsnips, peeled and left whole
instructions: Put the roast into a large deep pot or dutch oven with a litre of cold water.  Add some salt and a splash of sugar if you want to.  Bring it to boil, skimming off foam as it rises.  Turn the heat down and let sit undisturbed for 2 – 3 hours.  When completely cool, drain and discard the solids.  You can now do three or four things.  You can either put the beef into a large zip lock bag, or you can put in a large ziploc bag for marinating and give as gifts.  You can refrigerate for use later, but be careful the ziplocs don't work very well for this.  Add the minced stewing vegetables, stuffing & salt and pepper to taste to the cold roast fat and stir until coated.  Leave in fridge for half hour.  Remove meat from bag and put into a pan with just enough cold water to come half way up the side of the meat.  Bring mixture to the boil, then turn down and simmer for about 2 hours.  You can skim as much fat as you can from the top of the pot, but be careful when adding fat.  Don't use any water when the roast is tender.  Take a large piece of kitchen paper and cut a slit 2/3 way down the side of the roast.  Put some stuffing into one slit and squeeze stuffing mixture.  You can now put that back into the bag, if you have leftovers for the next day.  These can then be placed in a bag with the rest of the stuffing, or eaten with chopsticks & served with your choice of vegetables.

title: Pear and Potato Salad
ingredients: 400 g pearl barley | 400 g drained silken tofu | 100 g corn | 4 iceberg lettuce, washed and dried | 1 pear, washed, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, add barley and stir.  Turn down heat to a simmer, add corn and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, or until just tender.  Meanwhile, put tofu, peas, lettuce and pear into a salad bowl and toss.  Add dressing to salad and mix well.  Serve immediately.

title: Sandy's Easy Tapenade (Mexican Pizza)
ingredients: 8 kalamata olives or 8 pink olives, pitted, sliced | 5 canned whole chilies, minced ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender jar, add enough cold water to cover.  Cover with lid.  Blend on high speed until mixture is smooth and a bit coarsely chopped, but still has some texture.  This usually takes a few minutes.  Transfer to a glass bottle and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,red food coloring,pineapple juice,black pepper
title: Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/3 cup black pepper | 2 teaspoons pink food coloring | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In saucepan over medium heat, combine 1/2 cup pineapple juice, pepper, and food coloring.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.  In a small bowl, combine remaining 1/2 cup pineapple juice and remaining 1/3 cup water.  Pour into a pie plate, place pork on top and set aside.  Pour boiling liquid over pork, cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours.  When ready to cook, preheat grill to medium high.  Remove pork from food coloring and discard food color.  Place pork on grill and roast for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, until pork is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Beef and Pecan Penne
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 parsnip, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 celery, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 medium bell pepper, cut into 1/2- to 3/4-inch squares | 1/2 cup pecan halves or 1/2 cup walnut halves, toasted | 1 1/4 cups pasta ( penne, macaroni ) | 1 1/4 cups fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Place vegetables in bottom of greased 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Cover with beef and par bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.  Stir and spoon half and half evenly over beef and vegetables.  Top with nuts and bake 5 to 10 more minutes, till beef browns.  Serve beef, vegetables, and liquid in a large warmed bowl.

title: Cucina Mushrooms

instructions: Mix the lemon pepper and the clove and put in a pan with the mushrooms and a little bit of water.  Simmer until done.  I serve it with pumpernickel.

title: Seared Steak with Peach and Dates

instructions: Place steak into a shallow, 6x8 inch baking dish.  Pour 1/2 cup peach slices and dates atop the steak.  Sprinkle lemon juice over the fish.  Gently sprinkle black pepper over the fish. Grill steak 4 to 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f.  Remove steaks from baking dish.  Cover and keep warm in a 200 degree f preheated oven.  Grill steak 3 minutes per side for medium rare, or to desired doneness.  An instant read thermometer plunged into the middle of the steaks should read 140 degrees f.  Remove steaks from baking dish to a cutting board and let meat stand for 5 minutes.  Slice the steaks.

title: Pollo Alla Campagnola

instructions: Cut stems from mushrooms.  Place mushrooms and caps in a large bowl of water and let stand 15 minutes.  Drain.

title: Chicken or Fish Pakistani Style
ingredients: 1 lb chicken or 1 lb fish | 1 lb ugandan fish fish or 1 lb any chicken, cut in chunks | 6 ounces prawns or 6 ounces prawns | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/3 cup kraft zesty italian dressing
instructions: Combine the first 7 ingredients and let marinade in refrigerator overnight.  Dinner note, i use the zesty italian dressing for my prawns and prawns or other vegetables. title: Easy Italian N' Cheese Pasta with Kielbasa

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place kielbasa on a foil lined baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, turn and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until sausage is browned.  In a saucepan, cook the pasta as directed on package.  Drain well and return to the pot.  Add the ricotta cheese, dill and pepperoni.

title: Green Tomato, Mango Chutney Barley and Barley Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups firmly packed green tomatoes | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh mango | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1/4 cup barley ( rice flour )
