title: Mango Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 7 ounces butter, cut into small pieces | 6 ounces mango chutney, preferably major greys | 7 ounces tomato paste | 11 ounces double cream | 7 ounces red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated nutmeg or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom ( or more ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons za'atar spice mix ( or more )
instructions: Melt the butter in a saucepan and cook the mango chutney stirring constantly.  Do not allow the butter to brown.  Add the tomato paste and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes.  Then add the cream, wine and spices.  Reduce heat and continue simmering for 10 minutes until all the tomato sauce has dissolved.  Remove from heat, remove and discard any solids and store in the refrigerator until needed.  This sauce can be used immediately, or refrigerated and reheated later, for up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,oyster sauce,rum extract,beef stock,rigatoni pasta,marjoram
title: Havana's Rigatoni and Beef Tips
ingredients: 2 bags rigatoni pasta | 1 lb ground beef round | 5 teaspoons rum extract | 5 tablespoons beef stock | 2 teaspoons marjoram | 5 cans cream of chicken soup
instructions: Cook rigatoni until al dente.  Brown beef in a large skillet.  Drain.  Place in slow cooker and add remaining ingredients.  Cook for 4 hours on high.  Serve hot.  Can be served cold and reheated.

title: Spicy Tofu Pastry
ingredients: 500 g silken tofu ( or other firm tofu ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind taco sauce | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc.  Mash tofu to smooth consistency.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well to combine.  Cut four sheets of filo into four pieces.  Cut each into four strips and place a row of pastry on each sheet.  Scoop about 2 teaspoons of tofu mixture into centre of each pastry strip.  Brush one edge of pastry with a little water and fold pastry over, pressing to seal.  Cut in half and cook for 20 - 25 minutes on stove top or in a panini press or fryer.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,garlic powder,winter savory,cannellini bean,cocoa,brandy,clear honey,sesame seed
title: Cannellini Beans and Sesame Sage Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 6 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1/2 cup cooking wine ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon winter savory | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa
instructions: Pour sesame seeds into a large skillet and toast them in a single layer, stirring until they begin to turn brown.  Put beans, cooking wine, and brandy in a food processor and process until the mixture is smooth.  Add honey, garlic powder, winter savory, cocoa, and sesame seeds, process just to combine.  Adjust seasonings and adjust to mix with your taste.

title: Creamy Peanut Butter Mushroom Tortilla
ingredients: 1 cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter
instructions: Heat grill pan or skillet to 325 degrees f.  Slice mushrooms and place on baking sheet.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Add peanut butter and cook about 3 minutes or until hot.  Watch carefully.

title: Kris' Amazing Beef Scallop and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pound russet potatoes, scrubbed clean and diced | 1 pound chicken cutlets, pounded thin | 1 pound beef steak, pounded thin and cut into 1 inch strips | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the hot, unprepared potatoes on a rimmed baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender.  Meanwhile, place chicken on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, or until slightly charred and juices run clear.  Remove skillet from heat and spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray.  Sprinkle meat with romano cheese.  Place a cooked slice of cheese over the meat.  Return to oven and bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until cheese has melted.

title: Apricot Lila’s Lasagna
ingredients: 1 fresh lasagna sheet, cut into 8 even pieces | 1 package roasted apricots, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon flour tortillas or 1 tablespoon corn tortilla | 2 tablespoons mirin ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons soy sauce, sweet rice wine, if needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Place the parchment paper on an ungreased baking sheet.  Spread the parchment sheet evenly over the parchment paper.  Arrange a layer of lasagna sheets across the parchment paper.  Top this with a layer of apricots.  Top the apricot layer with 2 more sheets of parchment, and a second layer of parchment or corn tortillas.  You will end with a paper covering layer of apricots. .  Drizzle with mirin or soy sauce.  Repeat to make a second layer of lasagnas, with each tomato arranged on top.  Use spatula to brush the tops of the lasagna with a mixture of mirin and soy sauce.  Bake in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated through and the tomatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,white sugar,black peppercorn,dark rum,tomato puree,red chilies,baking powder
title: Spiced Madras Prawns (Shrimp)
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark rum | 2 small red chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Heat the rum on low heat, then remove from the heat.  Add the ground chillies, then stir in the tomato purée, peppercorns, rice, sugar and 2 tablespoons of the rum mixture.  Cook for 20 minutes, then take off the heat and leave to cool.  Refrigerate overnight.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,green,green enchilada sauce,bok choy,green curry paste,salmon fillet,tahini
title: Green Curry Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup chinese five spice powder ( see note for instructions ) | 1 pound salmon fillets, cut into 2-inch-thick pieces | 1/2 cup diced green chard | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 package frozen cut greens, thawed | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix tahini, five spice powder and 1/2 cup water in a large bowl.  Add salmon.

title: Pete's Lime Swiss Steak
ingredients: 300 g of good-quality round steak | 200 ml sweet-mexican sour mix | 150 ml mix | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Pete's fresh sweet sour cream is usually only available at pakhouse.  The sour cream is made with very good quality sour cream, but tastes much better the longer it is allowed to mellow.  Cut the meat into good thick slices and then into good thin slices across the grain.  Mix the sour cream, cornflour and lime juice well.  If you need to make a larger quantity, it is easier to mix with a whisk or spoon as long as you are able to get a creamy consistency.  Heat a large pan of oil to medium and then sprinkle in the mix.  Fry the meat quickly on both sides until it is browned and almost crisp, then place in a dish and put in a warm oven proof dish.  Pour in the sauce over the meat and bake at 200c for 10 minutes or until it is heated through.

title: Auntie Lori's Chicken and Beef over-the-Hole
ingredients: 2 -4 chicken cutlets | 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 1/3 cups carnation evaporated milk | 8 ounces broken spaghetti
instructions: Boil about 6 quarts worth of water in a large stockpot until it comes to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,beef stew meat,beet,sambal oelek,sun tomato
title: Beef and Beet Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 can whole beets, undrained ( with the juice, such as calamari or great northern ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 3 tablespoons sambal oelek | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock ( veggie protein )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a crockpot and simmer on high for 3 hours.  Serve warm.

title: Saffron Figs
ingredients: 15 large small to medium sized fresh figs, stems removed | 4 saffron strands, broken into 2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup cornflour | 16 teaspoons chunky salsa | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat the grill.  Place the figs on skewers or in small bowl.  In a small bowl, crush the saffron into 2 or 3 pieces using your hands.  Dip in the cornflour, coating evenly.  Using a skewer, char the figs at the grill or in the oven as needed to help keep them from burning.  Brush with 2 teaspoons of the salsa and set aside.  Use a fork to nestle each fig into a saffron coated frypan on the grill.  Close the grill.

title: Swede Hash
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 1/2 cup butter | 1 large leek, thinly sliced | 1 large green chili pepper, thinly sliced | 1 large yellow pepper, cut in 1/4-1/2-inch dice | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon rum | 1/2 cup chopped green chilis or 1/2 cup chillies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Bake the russet potatoes for 45 - 60 mins until they are tender, stirring once during cooking.  Melt the butter in a large skillet or wok and cook the leeks over moderate heat for 8 - 10 mins until softened.  Add the bell peppers, leeks and chilies and cook a further 5 - 7 mins, stirring frequently.  Add the catsup and rum to the pan with the potatoes and heat through.  Sprinkle with coriander to serve.

title: Bechamel Sauce for Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons bicarbonate of meat flavored bechamel sauce | 1 lb roast beef ( chuck roast ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the oven to 450f/gas heat the oil and bicarb on a large, well oiled roasting tray and roast the beef on very high heat for 10 minutes.  When the meat is rare but still rare transfer it to a warmed ovenproof dish and roast the beef in the caramel sauce for 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,gnocchi,red pepper flake,white fish fillet
title: Gnocchi With Seafood & Dried Mozzarella
ingredients: 500 g white fish fillets | 2 cups cooked gnocchi | 250 g fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Line a shallow baking dish with foil.  Tend to overlap.  Place gnocchi in a large bowl and cover with boiling water.  Leave for 5 minutes, drain.  Place fish, mozzarella and red pepper flakes in a single layer in the base of the dish.  Pour over the water.  Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until gnez is soft.  Serve with rice.

title: Perfect Cod Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod ( cut into 4 pieces ) or 2 1/4 lbs russet fish ( cut into 4 pieces ) | sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Place fish on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.  Sprinkle with salt.  Roast in a 350°f oven for 45 - 55 minutes, basting every 15 minutes with pan juices.  Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dolmades (Malaysian Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine rice vinegar, canola oil, coriander seed, and black pepper in a skillet.  Bring to a boil.

title: Nuclear Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups pomegranate, crushed | 1/2 cup sugar substitute
instructions: Put crushed pomegranates on flat dish.  In bowl, mix sugar with rest of ingredients.

title: The Best Creme Ever
ingredients: 600 ml soymilk or 600 ml soy milk | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence
instructions: Pour or gently whisk all of the ingredients together until well combined.  Chill and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,cauliflower floret,vanilla essence,sage leaf,red kidney bean
title: Beans and Noodles
ingredients: 6 -8 small cauliflower florets | 1 can red kidney beans | 4 -6 slices fresh sage leaves | 2 -4 tablespoons vanilla essence | 1 lb egg noodles ( optional )
instructions: Simmer the red kidney beans for about 2 - 3 minutes.  While still hot add the sage and the vanilla essence and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the egg noodles and cook until the noodles are cooked through.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,cremini mushroom,xanthan gum,parmesan cheese,clear honey,vanilla pudding mix
title: Soy and Chilli Pudding With Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen cremini mushrooms | 4 ounces dried vanilla pudding mix ( or 2 1/2 ounce prepared vanilla pudding mix or 2 1/2 ounce prepared vanilla pudding mix ) or 4 ounces instant vanilla pudding mix ( or 2 1/2 ounce unprepared vanilla pudding mix or 2 1/2 ounce unprepared vanilla pudding mix ) | 1 serrano chilies or 1 habanero chile, slit lengthways | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | parmesan cheese, curls ( just a little to garnish )
instructions: Using a knife, break down the dried mushrooms and place them in a bowl with water to cover.  Soak the mushrooms overnight, at least 20 minutes.  Drain the mushrooms and put them back in a pan of boiling water and cook them for 30 seconds to remove some of the water.  Remove and leave until cool.  Place the vanilla pudding in a microwave safe bowl, cover with cling wrap and microwave on high for 2 mins or until the pudding is firm and pliable.  Drain the water and add the honey.  Mix the xanthan gum with a little water and stir it into the water and honey and mix, then add the pudding mix.  Remove and set aside.  Place the chile under an open grill and heat the mixture until lightly toasted.  Remove and leave to cool.  When it is cool slightly, rub the surface with your fingers to remove any excess seeds.  If using vanilla pudding or vanilla pudding, add the pudding and allow to swell about 5 times its volume with the addition of the vanilla sugar.  Place the toasted chile on individual slices of toast or on a tray.  Top with the warm mushroom mixture.  Sprinkle with grated parmesan or a few curls of parmesan cheese.  If using vanilla pudding, add and mix the water and honey.  Mix and enjoy variation with dried pecans, or a bit of finely chopped almonds or hazelnuts may be sprinkled on top of this.

title: Baked Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 1 package extra lean ground beef | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.  Sprinkle salt over beef and stir in wine.  Reduce heat to medium.

title: Quick Barbecue Bacon Meatballs With Swiss Cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  In a medium bowl, combine frozen meatballs, barbecue sauce, swiss cheese, feta cheese, mint leaves, garlic paste, and curry powder.

title: Yam Meatballs - Yams-Meat-Grilled

instructions: Prepare the meat using the ground yams.  Grill, covered, over a medium flame for about 10 minutes, or until the surface turns brown.  Turn and grill the other side.  The meat should be very dark.  The yam should have a reddish brown colour.

Random Ingredients: sauce,onion soup mix,tahini,dark soy sauce,cooking spray,scallion
title: Onion Sauce & Tahini Dipping Sauce

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  Prepare and heat nonstick skillet.  Coat pan with cooking spray.  Dissolve onion soup mix in tahini, then add soy sauce and hot sauce.  Stir mixture on low heat until slightly thickened.  Spread tahini dipping sauce over one side of serving tray.  Place slices of scallions over dipping sauce and sprinkle over the scallions.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,self rising flour,prawn,chicken breast,nam pla,bell pepper,tomato
title: Shrimp Bannock
ingredients: 400 g shrimp, chopped into smaller pieces | 1 bell pepper, chopped into 2 cm long x 1 cm long strips | 1/8 cup nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 400 g self rising flour | 3 chicken breasts, chopped into 3 cm long x 1 cm long strips | 3 medium tomatoes, chopped into 3 x 1 cm long x 1 cm long strips | 1/2 cup nam pla ( fish sauce )
instructions: Boil shrimp with nam pla for 5 minutes.  When shrimp is cooked remove from heat and place on a cold dish.  Cover shrimp with cold water and soak for 8 - 10 minutes. .  Sift flour into another pan and add 1 cup water.  Stir with a whisk until mixture becomes a thick sauce.  Add salt to taste.  Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok.  Add prawns and cook on both sides.  Remove from wok.  Add 1 tbsp oil to wok.  Fry the bell pepper strips and tomatoes until cooked.  Add shrimp, bell pepper strips, nam pla and stir fry for 2 minutes.  Place all ingredients in a large bowl.  Add a cup of water and stir until ingredients mixed well.  Pour hot mixture over mixture in bowl and set aside for 20 minutes to macerate the flavors.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,pita bread,sugar,stir fry vegetable,fish sauce
title: Lumpia-Veggie Patties
ingredients: 3 medium russet potatoes, scrubbed, peeled & cubed | 1 cup fresh stir-fry vegetables, sliced ( such as bok choy, green onion or chile ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 teaspoon sugar | 3 pita breads, warmed
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan, cover with cold water & bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce the heat to medium & cook until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through.  Drain well.  While the potatoes are cooking, prepare the stir fry vegetables.  Stir fry the vegetables with the sugar & fish sauce until tender.  To serve, toast the patties, either either one at a time or under a preheated broiler.  Place a patty on each warmed pita & top with the fried vegetables & more fish sauce, if desired.

title: Grilled Nectarine Peanut Sausages With Grape and Smoked Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb raw nectarine, sliced ( about 1-2 nectarines per person, depending on how much juice you have ) | 1/4 lb raw chinese long sausage, sliced ( or a combination of pork, veal and other sausage ) | 1/4 lb smoked pork sausage, sliced | 3 tablespoons peanut butter, smooth ( creamy or chunky ) | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pickled chili pepper | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: First prepare the grill.  Put the nectarine in a shallow glass bowl.  Add the chinese chinese sausage & top with the peanut butter.  Add the hot sauce, toss well.  Add the sundried tomatoes & hot pepper & mix well.  Serve immediately on a plate topped with the briney sun dried tomato.

title: Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, sliced into 2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees.  Prepare baking dish by spraying with shortening and dusting with flour.  Pat dry pieces of the meat with salt and pepper.  In heavy oven proof bowl, add mustard and oil.  Dip meat into the hot mustard and oil.  Place in the prepared baking dish.  Cover and bake at 300 degrees for 90 minutes, or until meat is done.  Serve with potatoes or vegetable of choice.

title: Japanese Zucchini Soup
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons sprite ( i use sprite brand, just a splash ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock | 100 g baguette | 1/2 square piece semi-sweet chocolate
instructions: Cut zucchini lenghtwise in thin slices.  Mince, add all other ingredients except bread.  Simmer for 2 minutes on medium heat till zucchini is soft.  Slide off heat and stir in the bread.  Serve hot with melted choclate or a bit of mirin.

title: Perfect Beef Brisket and Gorgonzola Arancini
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 cup arborio rice, uncooked | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 ounce gorgonzola | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Place brisket in crock pot.  Arrange on lid, and cook on low 6 hours.

instructions: Prepare grill or broiler.  Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray.  Arrange sauerkraut mixture in pan.  Sprinkle with pineapple pieces, parsley and cheese.  Broil 2 to 6 minutes or till cheese is lightly melted.

instructions: Combine vegetable oil, garlic, and carrot in a mug.  Top with asiago cheese.

title: Smoked Salmon with a Kick
ingredients: 5 pounds salmon fillets | 1 cup cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 slice of orange peel | 1 slice of chipotle powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis
instructions: Pour hot smoke sauce over salmon fillets in a bowl.  Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes, turning.  Reserve remaining sauce.  To make the sauce, mix cream of mushroom soup, heavy cream, orange peel, dried chipotle powder, ground white pepper, dried chipotle powder, ketchup, and ketjap manis in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Easy Coconut Tiramisu - Crock Pot

instructions: Pre place bacon in the bowl of a crockpot.  Add the green onions, mushrooms and the coconut milk.  Stir to combine.  Place the crockpot on low.  Cover and cook for 2 hours until the liquid in the bottom of the crockpot is gone.  About 20 minutes before serving, sprinkle with the ladyfingers.  Mix in the cardamom.  Mix in the butter until incorporated and pour immediately over the ladyfingers.

title: Crunchy Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 3/4 cup pure maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place thawed spinach, maple syrup, cornstarch and tobasco in saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.  If too thick, add water.  Stir and cook 3 minutes longer or until sauce is thick again.

title: Basic Chinese Pepper Seasoning Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons chinese seasoning | cooking spray
instructions: Combine asafetida, hot pepper seasoning and chinese seasoning in a bag.  Seal and shake to mix, then store in an airtight container.

title: Zippy Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup sliced fresh button mushroom | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 jar beef gravy | 1 jar lager beer or ( 12 ounce ) jar white beer, of choice | 2 teaspoons dried chives | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 jar marinara sauce, heated
instructions: Trim excess fat from chicken.  Cut into 3/4 inch cubes.  Set aside.  In 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart slow cooker, combine chicken, mushrooms, yellow, yellow pepper, and 1/2 the onion, reserving all but 1/2 cup of the mushrooms, and 1/2 the chives.  In blender or food processor combine gravy, beer, chives, and italian seasoning.  Pour over chicken mixture.  Cover cooker and cook on low heat setting 7 - 8 hours.  Before serving, if no meat is used, chop all ingredients and stir into the chicken.  Let stand 10 minutes to allow broth to be absorbed.  Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Apple Olive Pancakes for One
ingredients: 1 apple | 1/2 cup kalamata olive | 2 -3 tablespoons all-purpose flour, to coat | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 -2 teaspoon fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Grill or pan fry the apple.  Finely chop it up and mix it in with the olives.  Add the remaining ingredients to the creamed mixture, stir to combine.  Scoop into a serving platter and serve.

title: Mexican Recipes

instructions: Sprinkle gelatine over meat in mixing bowl.  Stir to combine.  Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup of the hot water.  Stir gelatin mixture into meat mixture.  Add the remaining hot water and cheese.  Stir until combined.

title: Spiced Shrimp (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3 )

instructions: In a small bowl, toss the shrimp with the soup base, vinegar, and cumin.

title: Deviled French Prunes
ingredients: 12 prunes | 4 teaspoons fresh tarragon ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons english mustard | 1/2 cup loose black currant ( chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy half and half
instructions: Remove prunes from shells with stems removing the center stem.  Cut off ends and remove and discard the center pits from each prune, keeping shells small and intact.  Place prunes in large pot of boiling water for 10 seconds.  Remove the prunes and drop them into a large bowl of cold water to cool.  Using a slotted spoon remove the prunes and set aside.  In a frying pan, heat half the butter over medium heat and add prunes.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes.  Drain on paper towels.  Return the prunes to the pan, raise the heat to medium high and add the mustard and currants.  Stir the mixture to coat the prunes and reduce heat to low.  Stir in the heavy cream just until simmering, about 5 minutes.  Serve warm or chilled.

instructions: Cut beef tail meat into 1 inch strips.  Place chicken legs, skin side down, in a large skillet with ketchup, and simmer over medium heat until chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes.  Melt cocoa in a skillet over low heat, and remove from heat.  Set chicken aside.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Spread each piece with a piece of cheese.  Wrap phyllo in foil, and place on a baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until phyllo is lightly browned.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and melt 1/2 cup of the cocoa.  Arrange 3 to 4 pieces of meat in the center of a phyllo sheet, and top with a layer of cauliflower.

title: Pesto Pasta

instructions: Spray a 9x5x3 inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Place roast, beets, spinach, orange juice and lime juice in a large dutch oven.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.

title: Guac Monkey Spread

instructions: Place all the ingredients into a food processor.  Process to form a smooth paste adding a little water if necessary.  Process until desired consistency is achieved.  Serve with icecream on a chilled bed of icecream.

title: Apple Beef Brisket & Chips (Serves 8)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 tablespoon beef fat, melted | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 large apples, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped celery | 3 cups coarsely torn whole grain bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°.  Sprinkle brisket evenly with bouillon and set aside.  Heat beef fat and ginger in a large dutch oven over medium high heat and sear brisket on all sides until caramelized and brown.  Transfer brisket to roasting pan and set aside.  Add apples, chilies, celery to drippings in pan and saute until apples and celery begin to become translucent, about 5 minutes.  Deglaze pan with water.  Pour half of glaze over brisket.  Cover with aluminum foil or glass lid and braise in center of oven 20 minutes, then remove and transfer brisket to serving platter/dishes.  Cover loosely with foil and let rest 1 hour.  Remove foil and slice brisket across grain very thin to serve at once.  Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Lazy and Homemade Beef Ribs
ingredients: 5 lbs beef short ribs ( any cut can be used ) | 2 cups half-and-half ( or more ) | 3 garlic cloves ( or minced ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon green
instructions: Clean and rinse short ribs under cold running water.  Pat dry with paper towels.  In a large slowcooker, layer meat, garlic, celery seed, and green onion.  Add half and half or as needed to cover meat.  Cover and cook on low 2 to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: wheat spaghetti,red chili pepper,worcestershire sauce,white wine
title: Worcestershire Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 cups small whole wheat spaghetti | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until it is al dente.  Drain.  In a small shallow casserole dish, combine worcestershire sauce, chili pepper and wine.  Top with spaghetti.  Microwave on high for 1 minute or until heated thru.

title: Swiss Chard ( Swiss Chard) Filling for Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, chopped | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon bacon fat ( optional )
instructions: In a blender or the bowl of a stand mixer, combine all ingredients together.  Chill in a small bowl for 20 minutes before using.  Using one serving, fill corn muffin cups with enough of the saucy mixture to fill them 2/3 full.  Let stand 20 minutes before unmolding and eating.  Note, prep time does not include 20 minutes refrigerated.

title: Chinese Confinement
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 chinese cabbage | 1/2 cup dates | radish
instructions: Cut cabbage into 8 pieces.  Prepare cabbage with soup mix.  Peel, wash and chop dates.  Place cabbage pieces in deep pressure cooker.  Pour date mixture over cabbage and onions.  Close pressure cooker.  Place lid on pressure cooker.  Seal and heat on high for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Let cool.  Take off lid.  Garnish with radish.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,tart apple,pam cooking spray,cranberry,black sesame seed,mexican tomato
title: Grilled Apple & Cranberry Sesame Seed Apples and Cans
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( craisins craisins ) | 2 tablespoons paprika & 2 tablespoons red currant jelly, for drizzling | 1 medium tart apple ( such as mcintosh, gala, or other good-quality sweet apple ) | 1/2 cup mangoed mexican-style diced tomatoes | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 1 spray pam cooking spray
instructions: Place the dried cranberries and paprika in a small bowl or ziploc bag.  Shake off any excess air and sprinkle the jelly evenly over the dried fruit, pressing to make it adhere.  Arrange the apple slices in an even layer on a large nonstick skillet.  Spray a skillet evenly with cooking spray and grill over medium high heat until starting to char, about 3 minutes on each side.  Remove from heat, scatter sliced sesame seeds over, and allow to cool slightly before serving.  Tip, while grilling, remove any skin from the apple when just starting to turn black.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,white wine vinegar,liquid honey,yellow bell pepper
title: Caribbean Yellow Pepper Relish
ingredients: 20 yellow bell peppers | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup liquid honey ( to taste )
instructions: Remove membrane and seeds from peppers.  Cut peppers into 1 wide slices, then halve.  Place peppers in a bowl, then add all remaining ingredients and stir to blend well.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or more before serving.  Will keep for up to one week tightly covered in the refrigerator.

title: Spicy Mexican Parsnips & Garlic Mash
ingredients: 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 pints water chestnuts, drained, finely chopped | 2 medium parsnips, peeled and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mexican seasoning | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: Heat sugar in pan, add water chestnuts, parsnips, curry powder and mexican seasoning.  Cover & cook gently for 10 minutes.  Stir in salsa & return to heat.  Bring to boil for 2 mins, stirring as you go.  Tip into a bowl and serve immediately.  If you haven’t got microwave ready, leave the lid on the pan & place on high heat for a minute to steam.  Remove from heat & leave pan on the heat for a few seconds before removing lid & fluffing mash, you may need to steam for the last minute or two.  Serve with fresh green vegetables or steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,yellow bell pepper,green cabbage,sun tomato oil,tomato green chile pepper,veal,kalamata olive,rice wine vinegar
title: Taste for Zuccotto
ingredients: 3 cups zuccotto or 3 cups beef broth, heated | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, chopped and set aside | 1/4 cup chopped red green cabbage | 1 small yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup halved sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped kalamata olives | 1/3 cup thinly sliced raw small deli-style veal, cut into thin strips ( optional )
instructions: Combine warmed zuccotto, tomatoes, cabbage, and yellow pepper in large serving bowl.  Add 1/4 cup each sun dried tomato oil and vinegar.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,apricot jam,spinach leaf,sugar,stout beer,feta cheese,thai chile sauce,italian seasoning
title: Sarasota's Stampede Nuts With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs spinach leaves, cleaned and washed well | 1 cup granulated sugar | 1 cup low-fat feta cheese, crumbled | 2 1/2 - 3 cups light italian style beer | 1 cup thai chile sauce ( bottled in jar ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Pour 2 cups of cold water over the leaves of steamed spinach in a large bowl.  Cover tightly and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes to plump the leaves slightly.  Squeeze moisture from spinach if it does.  Chop leaves in half lengthwise and rinse.  In a heavy skillet or deep sauspan, combine water, sugar, feta cheese, hot pepper sauce, cumin and italian style beer.  Bring to a boil, stirring constantly then simmer gently, uncovered, for 15 minutes.  Stir in chile sauce and cumin, remove from heat, and stir in basil leaves, cover and let stand, stirring occasionally, for about an hour to thicken the sauce.  To serve, spread each 1/4 cup of the alted dressing over the nuts.  Place 2 - 4 leaves of the steamed spinach in the pan and drizzle the remaining dressing over the top.  Serve hot.

title: Hot Pepper or Chili Sauce
ingredients: 5 cups whipping cream | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes
instructions: Whip the whipping cream until it begins to thicken slightly.  Stir in the hot chili flakes.  Cover the bottom of a double boiler with half of the cream then the hot pepper.  Heat until hot to the touch, 3 - 4 minutes.  Turn over the double boiler and spread the remaining cream to cover the surface.  Cover with a cloth and allow to set at least 2 hours, and possibly overnight.  When it has time, place it in the refrigerator for at least two days, and preferably overnight.  The longer your cream sets in the refrigerator, the better it will taste.

title: Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 pounds chicken parts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f.  In a dry skillet, toast sesame seeds until golden, about 5 minutes.  Add sage, basil, sherry, and chicken.

title: Matsubu Mithai Kiyaar (Artichokes in Sweet Soy Syrup)
ingredients: 4 pounds artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup coarsely ground matzo meal | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place artichoke hearts in a large pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil.  Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until artichoke hearts are tender and easily pierced with a sharp knife, about 20 minutes.  Drain artichokes and squeeze as much water as possible from the hearts to remove hearts that remain in the water.  Shred the artichoke heart into strips about 1/2 inch square.  Stir matzo meal, allspice, salt and pepper into the cooked artichoke hearts.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,self rising flour,hoagie,cornstarch,bell pepper,canola oil,pear,basil leaf
title: Pear and Pepper Panini
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 pint canola oil or 1 pint light olive oil | 1 cup jarred roasted sweet pepper, drained and chopped | 4 large ripe pears, cored and sliced 3/4 to 1 `` | 3 -4 leaves fresh basil leaves, chopped ( to garnish ) | 4 hoagie rolls, split and toasted
instructions: Combine flour and cornstarch in a large bowl.  Heat oil to medium in a deep skillet or deep fryer.  Combine the flour mixture and splenda, beating until smooth.  Stir in the peppers until well coated in batter.  Add the pears and basil.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,mustard powder,white sugar,red chili pepper
title: Pancho Villa Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 heads garlic, peeled | 1/4 cup ground dry mustard powder | 2 1/8 cups white sugar | 1 red chili pepper, halved, seeded and julienned | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place the garlic cloves into a large baking dish.  Drizzle with mustard powder and sprinkle with sugar.  Roast in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until brown and fragrant, about 35 minutes.  Transfer to a food processor or blender and add red chile and pecorino romano cheese.  Puree until smooth and creamy.

title: German Popped Pork Loin With Cauliflower and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 package german sweet chocolate | 1 head peeled and chopped cauliflower | 1 pound pork loin
instructions: Stir soymilk and graham cracker crumbs together in a wide pot.  Cover a large bowl with cheese.  Add sweet chocolate, cauliflower, and pork.  Spread a layer of soy mixture on the bottom of a jelly roll pan.  Sprinkle with another layer of soy mixture on top.  Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and place in the refrigerator.  Let chill about 2 hours before serving.

title: Chessy Pork Steaks
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 500 g pork steaks | 500 ml raspberry jam | 400 ml tomato juice | 2 tablespoons cognac | 600 ml milk
instructions: Preheat oven 220c degrees.  Place sesame seeds and cumin in a large dry frypan, toast over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden, stirring every now and then.  Slice the pork into strips, season, and cook in a heavy based pan for 4 - 5 minutes or until lightly browned.  Transfer to a greased oven proof dish.  Combine jam, tomato juice and cognac in saucepan.  Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Pour over meat, cover tightly and bake in oven for 1hr 30 minutes until tender.  Remove from oven and serve in a rich gravy over mash.

title: Rocky Mountain Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh salmon, skin on | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup ice water | 1 can hearts of palm, rinsed and cleaned
instructions: Prepare an outdoor smoker ( like pheasant or campari, smoker ) with a hood or smoker, or have your outdoor grill set 6 inches below a coals burner, creating a smokey environment.  Place salmon on your work surface.  Lay the cans of tomatoes evenly on the salmon, on top.  Sprinkle on 1/2 cup grand marnier and 1/2 cup water.  Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, and continue to simmer for 20 minutes, or until the salmon is flaky.  Place the rinsed hearts of palm, on low heat, and continue simmering for about 30 minutes, or until potatoes and onions are tender.  Stir salmon occasionally until done.

title: Quick Guacamole Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Whisk jam and guacamole together in a bowl.

title: Italian Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 2inch cubes | 2 cups jasmine rice blend | 1 bunch italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 6 cups rice bubbles
instructions: Place pork and jasmine rice in roasting pan, with cover on bottom, and add enough water to cover all ingredients by 1/2 inch.  Cover tightly with lid and place in large roasting pan.  Add parsley leaves to roasting pan.  Put lid on roasting pan, and bake at 325 degrees for 30 - 45 minutes, or until cooked.

title: Mamma's Lentil Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 6 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook lentils in small amount of boiling water.  Cook 1 - 2 minutes.  Drain.  While lentils are cooking, heat tortillas, one at a time, in oven.  Split each tortilla in half and place on a greased baking sheet.  Spoon hot lentils down the center of each tortilla.  Sprinkle with grated cheese.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Chinese New Year Buns
ingredients: 480 g chicken legs | 1 tablespoon dried red pepper | 1 tablespoon dried shallot | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 100 ml chili oil | 50 ml roasted red peppers
instructions: Place the chicken legs on a clean tea towel and rub the skins off completely.  Tear any excess fat from the chicken legs.  Set aside.  In a big bowl, mix the red pepper and shallot with the dried yeast.  Place the chicken legs in the bowl.  Rub together the shallots with salt.

title: Rice Coffee Crusted With Smoke Ham and Wine
ingredients: 2 cups fine grain white rice | 6 ounces smoked black forest ham, diced | 1/2 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons kirsch | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 4 teaspoons cornmeal
instructions: Soak the rice in enough water to cover it by 4 inches.  Drain it from the water, then spread it out on 2 rimmed cake pans.  Bake in a preheated 325f oven for about 1 hr, or until the center grain is tender.  Remove from oven, then allow to cool to room temperature.  Reserve 4 cups of the cooking water.  Place ham in a large mixing bowl and pour boiling coffee over.  Stir well, breaking up any clumps.

title: Pork Spareribs and Shrimp With Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork spareribs, cut 3-4 inches in length | 2 1/3 cups tap water | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined, with tails left on | 12 ounces rotini pasta
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, add the ribs and bring to a boil.  Turn down to a simmer and cook until tender, about 3 hours, skimming and discarding any scum that rises to the surface.  Remove from the heat and uncover.  Place the shrimp in a large bowl and set aside.  Return the water to a simmer.  Cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Cook the pasta in the pasta water with salt and garlic, according to package directions, until al dente.  Drain.  Place the shrimp, cooked pasta, and pork ribs into bowls.  Top with the shrimp mixture.

Random Ingredients: white bread,masa harina,advocaat,corn flake,cajun seasoning,jerk seasoning,heavy whipping cream
title: Cheater's Savory Salsa Verde
ingredients: 5 cups crushed corn flakes | 1 1/2 cups masa harina | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups canned jerk seasoning | 4 tablespoons cajun-style jerk seasoning | 4 tablespoons texas-style dark corn flakes | 1 loaf crusty white bread, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together corn flakes and masa harina until well mixed.  Whisk cream and jerk together in a separate bowl until thoroughly mixed.  Stir cream mixture into the masa harina mixture until thoroughly mixed.  Transfer batter to a bowl, and mix in remaining ingredients to make a large enough batter to cover hands.

title: Kolhapuri (Fenugreek Leaves)
ingredients: 1 leaf fresh fenugreek leaves, washed and cleaned | 4 -5 cups beef broth
instructions: Soak the kolhapuri for a minimum of 1 to 2 hours.  The broth should have reached about 500 degrees f on a broad flat surface it's not meant to be layered on one layer in a baking dish.  Drain all water.  Wrap the leaves loosely around the broth and tie them with kitchen twine to form a pouch.  Put it on the oven rack, or in an open flame proof casserole, and set the oven timer on high.  Heat the broth over medium low heat until it starts to boil.  Remove from heat.  Let it steep in the broth while you prepare the kolhapur.  To serve, remove the pouch, and scoop a leaf vein out of it.  If you didn't notice, it should have been discarded by now.  Add a little broth to the left over broth to moisten and prevent it from drying out.  Serve with hot roti, bread, kolhapur and greek salad or with pita bread.  Variation,.  Add a little olive oil, to moisten or flavor the gravy and vegetables and toss the kolhapur.  A few drops of anise oil can be sprinkled over to taste.

title: Broccoli Fried Spiced Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup broccoli floret, cut into florets | 1/2 - 1 cup cauliflower floret, cut into florets | 12 teaspoons light rum ( optional, i like it ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice ( see mixed spice ) | salt and black pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large frying pan.  I use a stainless steel wok.  Stir fry on high heat until the cauliflower has turned opaque.  This should take a time of 3 - 5 minutes or so don't walk away from it turn to low and simmer.  Serve at once.

title: Chicken Penne With Brandy
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmesan-reggiano cheese blend | 1 package small boneless skinless chicken breasts ( cut into strips ) | 30 ladyfingers
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a 10x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  In a medium bowl, stir parmesan cheese blend with chicken.  Sprinkle chicken mixture over chicken.  Arrange in baking dish.  Bake 15 minutes.  Spoon any accumulated juices from baking dish over chicken.  Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f, and bake uncovered 20 - 25 minutes or until no longer pink and juices run clear.  Remove from oven.  Cool 10 minutes, then slice.  Serve warm with more grated cheese if desired.

title: Spicy Apricot and Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 -2 hot chile pepper, sliced thin ( optional ) | sea salt
instructions: Warm the preserves over medium low heat in a saucepan until warmed through.  This can be done in a crock pot, or at room temperature, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: panir,chili oil,whipping cream,spinach,lemon juice zest,sea salt,pinto bean,coconut milk
title: Pancake Pintos With Spinach
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans | 1 cup coconut milk | 2 lemon juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 pints spinach, washed, rinsed, drained | 400 g panir | 600 ml whipping cream | sea salt
instructions: Drain the beans, place them in a large pan, with the coconut milk and lemon zest and enough water to just cover.  Bring to the boil and boil for 8 - 10 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Heat the olive oil in a large non stick pan and gently fry the spinach until just wilted.  Meanwhile, cook the pancake mix in a blender or food processor until smooth.  Stir in the cream.  Season with salt and serve with the pintos.

title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 large onion, sliced | 2 serrano chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 tablespoon vegetable fat | 1 teaspoon mexican spices ( see note at point 1 )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas put the lamb into a large casserole dish or roasting tin, add the onion and the chillies.  Pour half the cream over the meat and leave overnight, stirring or until meat is completely coated.  Turn oven down to 350f/180c/gas add the rest of the cream and the spice mix, mix well.  Bring to the boil, then pour over meat.  Cover with foil and bake for 1 hr 30 minutes, until meat is tender.  Note at point 1, i don't find a long cooking option as my family has dogs with which they love.

title: Lebanese Tuna Salad
ingredients: 500 g black lentils | 1 can tuna, drained | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lettuce
instructions: Rinse black lentils in a pot of water until water is clear.  Add tuna and white pepper to lentils and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate.  Drain mixture and place on a large serving platter.  Top with lettuce leaves.  Serve with breadsticks or fresh vegetable sticks.

title: French Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni or 1 cup other medium sized pasta, i use whole wheat if i am in a pinch | 1 small can of ketchup ( or tomato sauce if you wish ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In medium size pot, bring salted water to boil.  Cook macaroni until al dente.  Drain and place back in pot.  Place next five ingredients except ketchup in the bowl of a food processor, place about 2/3 of the hot macaroni on top and pour ketchup over it.  If you prefer a thicker sauce, add little oil.  If you prefer a thinner sauce, add more water.  Add rest of the hot macaroni.  When the last 4 - 5 minutes of cooking, mix in ketchup, serve.

title: Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 pounds chicken wings | 1 head cabbage leaf | 8 ounces fontina cheese, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay the chicken wings at the bottom of a large baking pan.  Lay the cabbage leaves around the chicken wings.  Pour enough water into the pan to reach halfway up the sides of the birds.  Bake in preheated oven, about 45 minutes.  Uncover, and bake 10 more minutes.  Crumble fontina cheese over birds, and return to oven.  Bake chicken to desired crispiness, 10 to 15 minutes for well done.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 165 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,pinto bean,spring onion,taco seasoning
title: Easy Black-Eyed Peas and Bean Dip (South Beach Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 1 bag frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 1 bag pinto beans, cleaned and rinsed | 1 bunch spring onions, chopped | 1 packet taco seasoning ( i use light tasting but adjust to your taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook on low heat until heated through.  Serve with your favourite bread, crackers or toast.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,lamb stock cube,arborio rice,daikon radish,italian plum tomato,cucumber,caster sugar,oil
title: Kurdish Lamb Biryani
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water, mixed with a little lemon juice | 1 lamb stock cube ( optional ) | 400 g daikon radishes, sliced thinly | 200 g arborio rice | 200 -250 ml italian plum tomatoes, cut in 2 cm cubes | 1 small cucumber, cut into 1 cm cubes | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Heat 1 t of the oil in a pan.  When hot, add the orange blossom oil.  When the oil shimmers, add the lamb stock and dissolve the stock cube if using.  Stir well and add the daikon.  Increase the heat, add the rice, cover the pan and simmer gently for 5 minutes.  Stir in the radishes and tomatoes and simmer until all of the liquid is absorbed.  Add the sugar and continue to stir occasionally for a further minute.  Transfer the risotto mix to a serving bowl and stir through the rest of the oil.

title: Grilled Halibut - Mediterranean
ingredients: 1 lb halibut fillet | 1 can green olives | 1 cup packaged italian spices | 1/4 cup frangelico | 8 ounces small shell pasta
instructions: In a ziploc bag, combine olives, italian spices, frangelico & fish.  Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Grill fish over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes per side, or until fish flakes when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,rice noodle,cherry stem,salad green,red onion,cumin,italian parsley,water chestnut
title: Canadian Bacon, Rice Noodle Salad Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice noodles | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh cherries with stems and nectar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup chopped salad greens | 2 slices canadian bacon, chopped
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions using boiling water.  Drain.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,iceberg lettuce,red capsicum,russet potato,wheat flour
title: Potato Crunch
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 4 cups mixed chopped vegetables ( red onion, green pepper, broccoli ) | 1 red capsicums, green pepper ( capsicum ) | 2 egg yolks | 1 cup whole wheat flour or 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour, etc
instructions: Slice potatoes thinly and boil for ten to ten minutes on top of salted water then add vegetables for five minutes.  In a bowl whisk two egg yolks.  Add flour and stir in with a fork, add water if mixture thickens.  Remove vegetables from heat and drain off excess water.  Place potato mixture in small bowl with egg yolks then fold in gently.  Pour into a lightly greased and floured tray and bake at 200c for ten to fifteen minutes,.

title: Grilled Russian-style Beef
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped fresh dill ( about 1 bunch fresh dill and 4 springs fresh dill ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint ( about 1 bunch fresh mint and 1 springs fresh mint ) | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1/2 cup tea, hot | 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into chunks
instructions: Combine dill, mint, orange zest, and hot tea in a medium bowl and set aside.  Pour hot oil into a 10 - 12 or 12 inch sauté pan, leaving a film about 2 inches wide at bottom.  Heat oil over medium heat.  Working in batches, add steak and cook 3 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon remove steak and immediately transfer to a platter.  Set aside.  Reduce heat to low.  In the same pan, raise heat to high.  Add mint and orange mixture and boil, stirring, 30 seconds.  Return beef to pan and reduce heat to medium low.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until meat is richly flavored and no pink remains.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white rum,habaneros,red chili powder,cornbread,maraschino cherry,green salsa,bacon
title: Caribbean Bacon and Chile Fritters
ingredients: 6 strips bacon, cooked and crumbled | 24 maraschino cherries | 12 small dried red chili peppers, seeds and membrane removed | 1 ounce white rum | 3/4 cup green salsa | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 12 cornbread
instructions: Wrap each tortilla with a few pieces of bacon, securing the edges with toothpicks.  Place tortillas on a foil lined baking sheet.  In a large sauté pan over medium heat, combine sour cream, red chili peppers, rum, and salsa.  Cook, stirring frequently, until chili paste is very hot.  Place one piece of corn bread in the bottom of a large glass measuring cup.  Spoon about a teaspoon of sour cream mixture into each piece of bread and place back in pan.  Continue to cook tortillas until desired consistency is reached, stirring often.  Serve hot.

title: Quick Garam Masala Oil (Made Easy)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cooking oil | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Mix well before using.  Use to keep refrigerated, oil free, and easy to use.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  "risotto"
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Halve, cut and discard the stem of the eggplants by scraping off the white pith.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel the eggplants lengthwise.  Using a round skewer, place 1 tablespoon of pepper into each cut side of the eggplant.  Insert your fingers under the eggplant at one end and gently pull them out.  Slice the eggplants crosswise into 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal.  Arrange the eggplants in a large bowl or tray.  Sprinkle lightly with salt and toss with 2 tablespoons of green chile.  Pour over 2 tablespoons of water and leave to soak for 10 minutes.  Taste for salt.  You can serve with a vegetable, pita, or as a side dish.

title: Watermelon Smoothie (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 kg watermelon, rind and pith removed, cut into chunks | 150 ml water, reserved from cooking | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 150 ml soymilk
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender or processor until smooth.  Serve.  Note, you can use canned watermelon, but be careful with the soymilk since meat is already very salty.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,rice vinegar,maple syrup,vegetable stock,beef steak,chicken breast
title: Maple Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 lb top round beef round steak | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon instant beef stock, disolved in | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: annatto seed,sirloin,egg noodle,dinner,carrot juice,tomato sauce,shell pasta
title: Brazilian Meatball Soup II
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 egg noodles | shell pasta | 1 teaspoon annatto seeds | 1/4 cup carrot juice, or water | 1 can tomato sauce | 12 frozen dinner rolls, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix sirloin, egg noodles, shell pasta, annatto seeds, carrot juice, and tomato sauce together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.  Press half of the mixture mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Spread meatball and half of the pasta mixture over the meatball mixture.  Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 1 hour more.

title: Noodle Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 bag seasoned rice noodles | 1 lb steak fillet, cut into strips | 1 lb frozen corn | 1 can condensed beef soup | 2 -3 hot chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Brown steak in sauce pan.  Add seasoning bag, mix well.  Place in casserole dish.  Add soup and chillies if using.  Bake covered at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,porridge oat,dark chocolate,rice,yeast,chick pea,kosher salt pepper,hungarian paprika
title: Cheat's Yummy Beef & Vegetable Bread
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups plain gluten-free bread flour | 1 1/4 cups coarsely ground porridge oats ( i use oats of the grocers brand ) | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper ( or 1/2 tsp iodized ) | 1 cup vegetarian barbecue sauce ( kame dark ) | 1 cup cooked chick-peas, drained ( canned or fresh ) | rice or warm chapati
instructions: Sift 4 1/2 cups flour and oats, add yeast, paprika, salt & pepper.  Add warm beef broth and barbecue sauce, if using, until mixture forms a dough.  Turn out onto floured board and knead very gently 1 minute, place in bowl & cover with damp cloth while you prepare the rest of the recipe.  Preheat oven 425 degrees f.  Punch down the dough, divide into 2 balls, then gently knead each for 3 - 5 minutes, or press and roll out each one until it becomes a round and fitable loaf.  Place on baking sheet, cover with damp cloth & let rest for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile flatten each dough into a rectangle about 1/2 wide and 5 in height, then cut into 24 squares.  Place on baking sheet & bake about 5 minutes, or until done. .  To serve, place warm noodles on plates, arrange around the side of the toast.

title: Beef Banana Gravy
ingredients: 500 g beef stew meat | 3/4 cup stock | 2/3 cup banana | 3 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium sized saucepan.  Cover and cook on low heat for two hours.  To use, simply stir through and serve in a soup bowl over mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Shrimp and Plantain Fritters with Guiness
ingredients: 12 medium prawns, peeled ( shrimp are larger in size ) | 1 tablespoon chopped thyme | 1 cup guinness stout | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno | 1 medium yellow pepper, finely diced | 1/2 cup seeded and finely diced plantain, unpeeled ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Using medium, sharp knife, cut 2 or 3 slit in each shrimp and set aside.  Mix thyme and guinness in a small bowl. .  Heat up the balsamic vinegar until the glaze is fragrant and aromatic and stir once or twice.  Dry the prawns until they turn pink.  Chop all vegetables.  Place shrimp in a large bowl and drizzle with the balsamic glaze.  Stir to coat well and let sit for about 10 minutes so flavors can combine.  If you are serving right away, remove shrimp from bowl, arrange on platter or plates and top with remaining vegetables.

title: Salsa-Stuffed Squids
ingredients: 24 small squid | 1 jar hot salsa | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Remove heads from squid.  Remove eyes and dark tubes from inside of squid and discard.  Remove tentacles from body and separate squid bodies from body.  Using a small spoon, hollow out most of the tentacles just enough to make room for stuffing.  Rinse well and drain.  Combine all stuffing ingredients and stir thoroughly.  Fill and stuff the squid with stuffing mixture.  Place in large pot of lightly salted boiling water.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until tender.  Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture for garnish.  Serve remaining stuffing for dipping.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,monterey jack cheese,simple syrup,radish,chicken breast
title: Quick Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2 - inch cubes | 1 package baby carrots, peeled | 12 pickled radishes, in brine, drained and thinly sliced | 1 1/8 cups simple syrup | 16 mild monterey jack cheese or 16 pickled swiss cheese, slices
instructions: Place chicken cubes in bottom of crockette/pan.  Add carrots, radishes, and simple syrup over chicken.  Cut 6 slices of cheese into 6 or 8 slices of the same size as vegetables.  Top with 2 slices of cheese.  Place chicken pieces on top of vegetables.  Top with remaining cheese.  Broil in crock until golden brown on both sides.  Serve with salsa, warm bread, or eat plain.

title: Mexican Chocolate Shortbread (Copycat)
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 packages dry ladyfingers | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 large serrano pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 12 ounces dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Set oven rack at center position and preheat oven to 325°f and lightly oil a 9 x 13 inch loaf pan.  Bring 1/2 cup oil to a boil in medium nonstick skillet.  Carefully dip ladyfingers into hot oil and place on paper towels to absorb as much oil as possible.  Pat dried cookies dry with paper towels.  Beat mayonnaise with serrano with electric mixer in 2 batches with whisk until smooth.  Stir tomato paste into mayonnaise mixture until smooth.  Transfer to bread mixture and stir in chocolate.  Transfer cake mixture to prepared pan, spreading evenly.  Place loaf pan in larger pan of hot water and bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes.  Cool for 10 minutes, then remove from pan and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Store in airtight container at room temperature.

title: Cauliflower, Ham and Lemongrass Stew
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1/2 liter margarine or 1/2 liter butter, melted | 150 g ham, cut into strips | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, crushed | 2 teaspoons walnuts, chopped | 500 g sweet potatoes, cut into chunks
instructions: Trim the cauliflower and break it into florets, then cook them in boiled water.  Melt the margarine or butter, add the ham, lemon grass and walnuts.  Add the sweet potato.  Simmer for 10 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: mango,red potato,ladyfinger,pesto sauce,apple juice,vegetable stock,cremini mushroom,non greek yogurt
title: Mango Veggie Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces sliced cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup dried mango | 6 large cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup diced apple ( i use a non stick apple that has medium sized chunks, but a mango would be a bit sweeter ) | 1/2 cup non-fat greek yogurt ( low or light ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, made with | vegetable stock, as required | 36 ladyfingers ( optional )
instructions: Boil up stock in a pan until boiling.  Then add yogurt/vegetable broth mix and mushrooms.  Let simmer for 10 - 15 minutes.  Add sliced apple.  After 5 minutes, the mango will have released its juices in the soup, and all of that liquid can beabsorbed out.  Remove from heat and enjoy.

title: Cafe Rio-style Sweet and Savory Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup instant brown rice | 1 teaspoon beef base instant coffee | 1 teaspoon instant powdered saffron | 1/4 teaspoon ground coffee
instructions: Combine brown rice, instant coffee, saffron, and ground coffee in a bowl.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,steak,beef rump roast,pepper,fennel bulb,brown gravy mix,monterey jack cheese,veal
title: Easy Beef and Vegetable Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 beef rump roast | 1 veal rump roast | 1 -2 green capsicum | 1 -2 fennel bulb | 1 -2 tablespoon brown gravy mix | 2 slices monterey jack cheese | pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 -2 tablespoon butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c.  Place beef, veal and the fennel in oven dish.  Roast at 180oc for 1 hour.  Cut green capsicum into 1/2cm slices and place on top of beef.  Top with brown mix.  Return to oven and bake for 2 hours or until tender.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,orange,red chile pepper,whipping cream,tamari,watermelon,fenugreek seed
title: Red Chile Cornmeal Porridge
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 2/3 cup water | 1 cup grated orange rind | 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh fenugreek seeds | 1 large red fresh chile pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tamari | 2 tablespoons warm whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the yellow cornmeal and water.  Stir in the orange and fenugreek seeds.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,italian dressing,turnip,active yeast,rose extract,date,lemon wedge,double cream
title: Classic Irish Glazed Vegetable Bread
ingredients: 1 ounce active dry yeast | 1/2 cup guacamole or 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons dried italian dressing | 12 ounces of assorted frozen small turnips, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon rose extract | 1/4 cup double cream | 2 teaspoons lemon wedges | rosemary and italian dressing
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of the guacamole.  Place in 3 greased 8 inch square pans, brush tops with 1 t.  Dressing.  Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.  Stir, then set aside.  Combine turnips and remaining guacamole in a large bowl.  Cover and let stand for 20 minutes.  Dissolve rose extract in remaining guacamole, then spread all over veggies.  Turn pan as necessary over low heat until glaze coats all surfaces of glazed turnips.  Cover & let stand about 20 minutes.  Turn off heat.  Brush top of bread with remaining glaze.

Random Ingredients: red wine,mexican oregano,ginger paste,bacon dripping,dark chocolate,ginger juice
title: Mole Colorado
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons other fat | 1 teaspoon garlic and ginger paste | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/4 cup packed dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ginger juice
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, heat bacon drippings or fat through browning on both sides.  Add garlic and ginger pasted and cook for one minute stirring continuously.  Add the red wine, dark chocolate, mexican oregano and ginger and cook for several minutes.  Pour into a greased 8x8 square pan spreading evenly over the bottom until the mixture is slightly raised and the bottom is lightly browned.  Cool.  Cut into squares or squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,ginger garlic paste,greek oregano,baking cocoa,beef chuck
title: Beef Steaks and Oregano Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gelatin | 1 can stewed beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup greek oregano | 1/4 cup baking cocoa | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste, or to taste
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over stewed beef in a bowl.

title: Feta Salad With Sesame Yogurt

instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well to combine.  Pour into a serving plate and garnish with toasted sesame and fresh mint leaves.

title: Saucy Cilantro Mint Spaghetti
ingredients: 2/3 cup spaghetti sauce mix or 2/3 cup dry spaghetti sauce mix | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 10 -15 leaves culivated fresh mint or 20 -25 leaves cilantro
instructions: To freeze, place ingredients in a large freezer proof container or tupperware container.  Freeze 20 minutes to firm or about 30 minutes to firm up.  To prepare, after defrosting, remove spaghetti from freezer.  Combine with spaghetti sauce mix.  To serve, heat in microwave until liquid is absorbed.  Serve with shredded lettuce, tomato, sour cream or chopped fresh vegetables, such as broccoli, pepperoni, zucchini, etc.
