title: Slow Cooker Lamb Gyros
ingredients: 1 onion, halved and sliced | 1 yellow squash, coarsely chopped | 1 pound lean ground lamb | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons minced onion powder | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 3 tablespoons light tasting taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon season salt | 1 tablespoon minced onion powder | 1 tablespoon seasoned salt
instructions: Place onion and squash in a slow cooker.  Mix lamb, 1/2 cup taco seasoning, brown rice, 1/2 cup taco seasoning, brown rice, 1/2 cup taco seasoning, rice vinegar, chicken bouillon, 1 tablespoon onion powder, seasoned salt, and onion powder.  Divide among slow cooker bowls.

title: Garlic and Green Herb Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely minced green sweet pepper ( capsicum or bell pepper plus any red or white pepper ) | 1/2 cup finely minced flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, with stems | 1 can canned water chestnuts, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well.  Serve immediately.

title: Mustard Seed Croissants
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 1 package ladyfingers | 4 tablespoons chickpea flour | 4 teaspoons greek seasoning
instructions: Place the mustard seed in a skillet over medium heat.  When the seeds crackle, remove them from the heat.  Brush the bread generously with mustard seeds.  Dip the ladyfingers into the chickpea flour, then into the egg water.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Place the toast onto the skillet, and cook the bread until the bread starts to brown, about 2 minutes.  Flip the toast, and sprinkle with greek seasoning.  Continue cooking until the bread appears dry and the filling is hot.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,yellow onion,white sugar,tzatziki,asparagus spear
title: Asparagus Salad IV
ingredients: 3/4 pound fresh asparagus spears, trimmed and chopped | 1/4 yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup toasted black sesame seeds | 1/2 cup toasted white sugar | 1/4 cup toasted tzatziki
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the asparagus, onion, black sesame seeds, sugar, and tzatziki.  Cover, and refrigerate 4 hours before serving.

title: Stuffed Beetroot
ingredients: 8 ounces ham, chopped ( i use deli smoked ) | 2 small beets, cooked and diced | 12 pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon sugar | rosemary leaf
instructions: Saute ham in a medium skillet.  Add diced beets and pepperoncini, simmer for 3 minutes.  Add spices and sugar, simmer for 3 minutes.  Spoon stuffing onto beets, stuffing gently, sprinkle with fresh minced rosemary.  Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,basil leaf,clove,horseradish,lamb shoulder,lamb chop,half cream,self rising flour
title: Lamb Chops in Horseradish Cream
ingredients: 8 lamb chops | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stem | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 1/2 tablespoons self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Combine lamb chops, half and half, cilantro sprigs, cloves, and basil in a large glass bowl.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Mix horseradish with flour.  Dip meat chops into horseradish mixture.  Place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink on the inside.

title: Couscous - Tasty Oven Version
ingredients: 1 large onion | 400 g black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 210c/gas mark chop and slice the onion in half.  Mix together the olive chopped onion and chopped black olives.  Slightly oil a baking tray, pour the sauce mixture into the tray and spread to cover the base evenly.  Cook for 40 mins, uncovered, in the oven, then check and stir to make sure it's cooked completely.  Remove the lid, and continue cooking.  You will need to mix every now and then.  When the mixture is well thickened, remove from oven or it may not be to your liking.  Cool a little and serve with couscous.  Also delicious cold off the stove or cold, warm, hot or cold, with a fresh green salad enjoy.

title: Easy, Low Fat, Whole Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup dry oatmeal | 3 tablespoons miracle whip | 1 teaspoon cumin seed ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the oatmeal, miracle whip, cumin and dried flakes.  Leave to sit for a few minutes to absorb the flavours before eating.  The dry flakes can be used to sprinkle over the hot foods for a healthier breakfast just add them to the oaty or other dishes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,herb,onion soup mix,pineapple chunk,lemon peel
title: Tropical Herbs and Pineapple
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mixed dried herbs | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 cans unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained | 1 white sugar | lemon peel
instructions: Combine dried herbs, onion soup mix, pineapple and sugar in small saucepan over medium heat.  Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Slice lemon peel into thin strips.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,brussels sprout,baby spinach leaf,saffron strand,spice,beef,dill seed
title: Lebanese-Style Stuffed Baby Spinach (Hara Kebara)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh brussels sprout | 1 pound ground beef | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh dill seeds | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh dill | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 3 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach leaves, washed | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 1 pinch saffron strands ( optional )
instructions: Remove the beet leaves from the stem ends.  Cut away the hard stalks as thinly as possible.  Place the beet leaves on a cutting board and gently roll them until evenly covered with slices of fresh green.

title: Shrimp Cantaloupe with Cantaloupe and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 pound cantaloupe, peeled and sliced into rounds | 1 pound yukon gold potatoes, quartered and cut into thirds
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place cantaloupe rounds on a baking sheet, and lightly salt with kosher salt.  Bake until dry and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes, but not completely browned.  Turn off oven, and coat melaloupe with cooking spray.  Remove from pan and brush evenly with cooking spray.  Return to oven for 5 minutes.  Stir shrimp and cantaloupe into shrimp and melaloupe, and continue cooking for 5 more minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Macadamia Pork (Charcoal)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin roast, fat trimmed and cut into 2 by 2 inch cubes | 3/4 cup macadamia nuts | 1/2 cup thick slab bacon or 1/2 cup vegetable shortening
instructions: Combine pork and 1/2 cup macadamia nuts in a heavy resealable plastic bag.

title: Chinese Charred Kidney Beans
ingredients: 14 ounces dark red kidney beans | 2 cans consomme | 8 slices rye bread | 1 -2 slice galangal | parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight.  Drain and place in a heavy pot to cover with water.  Drain any remaining water.  Bring to a boil then simmer for 1 hour or until tender.  Dice the galangal and place in the beans with some of the juice.  Cook for 10 minutes then add to beans.  Add a little water if too thick.  Remove from the heat and allow to stand for 15 minutes.  Serve with rye.  Garnish with parsley.

title: Charoset
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and knead on floured surface until soft, shape into ball.  Place on a lightly greased baking sheet, cover with a damp cloth and allow to rise for 1 hour at room temperature.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and sprinkle flour over, shaking the parchment paper to prevent sticking.  Place dough on baking sheet and prick top with a fork several times it bubbles.  Fold one end over and gently press the dough toward the centre to form a rough circle.  Turn dough over and repeat for the other side.  Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and prick top with fork several times.  Bake approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,vanilla vodka,rotel tomato,linguine,mango,italian parsley,coriander,active yeast
title: Spicy Raspberry Martini with Mango Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, divided | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt, divided | 3/4 cup light cream cheese ( neera ) | 1 medium ripe mango, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch rounds ( for freezing, use your food processor to shred the flesh of mango ) | 1 large firm ripe mango, peeled and shredded ( for freezing ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh coriander | 2 -3 tablespoons italian parsley | 2 -4 tablespoons vodka | 1 cup diced, seeded canned rotisserie chicken ( see note )
instructions: To make the pravies, dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the yogurt.  Mix the remaining yogurt, sour cream, and vanilla with a fork.  Stir the yeast mixture into the yogurt mixture along with the mango, coriander, parsley, and remaining 1 1/2 cups of yogurt.  Stir until blended.  Add the chicken and stir until thoroughly incorporated.  If necessary, add more yogurt or cream to thin mixture.  Place the puddings in a shallow glass or ceramic bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap, and allow to rise until doubled, about 1 1/2 hours.  Make as thin puddings as possible.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Lightly grease or spray a large baking sheet.  Pour the vodka into a glass measuring cup and stir to combine.  Drizzle vodka into a separate plastic cup.  Remove the plastic wrap from the puddings in the glass.  Carefully spoon the vodka into the puddings and smooth so that every pudding is coated with vodka.  Refrigerate until solid, at least 3 to 5 hours.  Slice each martini in half horizontally without creating a pocket.  Spoon the chicken flavored puddings into the halved martini glasses.  Garnish each cocktail with 1 tablespoon diced ginger.  Using a slotted spoon, lift puddings from the glasses with a slotted spoon and put them in a warm oven, positioned on the baking sheet.  Alternatively, spoon puddings into a plastic bag and let the puddings sit for up to 3 hours.  Repeat with remaining puddings.  If serving warm, chill before serving.  Notes on ingredients, if using fresh mango, add the seeds to the diced mango at the beginning.  If using canned or fresh mango, drain and rinse in cold water.

title: Healthy Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g uncooked chicken breasts | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup ouzo | 1 1/2 tablespoons dates, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pistachios, finely chopped
instructions: Trim chicken breasts of any excess fat and cut diagonally in half.  Place in a food processor and pulse until fine.  Add the ouzo and pulse well.  Add the panko and pistachios and pulse again.  Add the date and stir until mixed together.  Add the chicken and mix gently until the chicken is all covered.  Place the kebabs 1cm thick on a tray and bake at 200 degrees for 20 minutes.  Turn the oven off and leave until the kebabs are cool or for longer.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,silken tofu,phyllo pastry,chicken breast fillet
title: Kylie Kwok (Chicken and Noodles Croquettes)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wide egg noodles | 350 g chicken breast fillets, cut into slices | 140 g silken tofu, drained | 180 g phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Place noodles in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water.  Place bowl in oven and set aside for approximately 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large frying pan on medium high heat.  Add chicken.  Cook for 3 minutes or until just cooked.  Remove from heat and allow to cool.  Heat oven to 200c.  Place half the tofu in a baking dish.  Top with noodles, and cover with remaining tofu.  Cook for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and set aside for 5 minutes.  Cut fillet into thin strips.  Add to noodles and stir gently to combine.  Transfer mixture to a large bowl.  Cover with remaining egg noodle mixture.  Place a piece of pastry over the top.

title: Blueberry Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 pint fresh blueberries, rinsed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup sour cream ( for dipping )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the chili oil over medium heat.  Add the beef and saute until meat is browned about 5 minutes.  Add the blueberries, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Transfer the beef and blueberry mixture to a platter.  Stir in the sour cream.  Serve hot with crusty bread or crackers.

title: Sage, Green Beans and Olive Spread
ingredients: 500 g green beans, trimmed, ends chopped and steamed until tender | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 2 teaspoons dried sage, leaves
instructions: Put all ingredients in your food processor and pulse till desired consistency, i like mine quite chunky and smooth.  Store in an airtight container.  Will keep for a couple of months in a cool dry place.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,brown rice,veal knuckle,dark chocolate,pimento,rice wine,ancho chile powder
title: Pueblo Rice
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice, cooked ( mexican rice rice is best ) | 1 1/2 lbs veal knuckle, cubed | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1/4 cup pimento, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet dark chocolate | 1/4 cup corn kernel ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Add rice to crockpot, sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the wine, meat, spices, and pimento.  Add remaining wine and cook on low for 8 hours.  You may add more wine, spices, or other liquid you want to eat in the meal.  During the last 20 minutes, stir in the corn and chocolate.  Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Green and White Cucumber Scones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour, measured after measuring | 1 english cucumber | 1 1/2 cups green beans, topped and tailed
instructions: Cut out 4 - 6 scone rounds from the cucumber.  With a 6cm round cutter, cut each circle into 8 wedges.  Place the dough on a biscuit roll or griddle.  Cover with a tea towel to prevent drying out.  Place a rounded teaspoonful of the scone mixture on each scone.  Bring the edges of the scone over to meet in the centre.  Cook over hot coals for 1 - 2 minutes or until the scone begins to turn golden.  Carefully transfer scone to a paper towelling tray.  Stand for 1 minute then carefully transfer to a wire rack.  When all the scone scones are cooked, place the steamed green beans on a large board or tray.  Cover with plastic wrap and allow to stand for 2 - 3 minutes before cut into 4 wedges.  Serve with tea and tea pickles.  The scone will keep for 1 - 2 days in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,dark soy sauce,gruyere cheese,lemon juice,pepperoni
title: Empanadas De Arrabbiata (Cheese Phyllo Bites)
ingredients: 1/2 lb gruyere cheese | 8 ounces sliced pepperoni, minced 1/2 inch ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce ( gluten-free if desired ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 packages frozen chopped phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a small bowl, combine the cheese, pepperoni and soy sauce.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo on work surface, brush with oil and sprinkle with half of the cheese mixture.  Place 3 to 4 sheets of phyllo in a 1½ cup glass measure.

Random Ingredients: black olive paste,oregano,asian chili paste,bell pepper,corn
title: Chile Salt (Korean BBQ Sauce)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black olive paste ( korean hot pepper paste ) | 1 tablespoon asian chili paste ( kochu jang ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 whole bell peppers, chopped ( any color ) | 3 -4 tablespoons corn ( can use frozen, but i prefer frozen ) or 3 -4 tablespoons fresh green peas ( can use frozen, but i prefer frozen )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container.  Note, you will have varying amounts of ingredients depending on ingredients and amount of salt required.  Makes 3 cups of sauce.

title: Goat's Tortilla “Cheese” With Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, about 12 | 8 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 2 ounces fresh romano cheese, grated | 1 avocado, peeled, pitted and cut into small cubes | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 24 ladyfingers | 32 1/2 ounces pasta, prepared according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,russet potato,taco seasoning mix,chili sauce
title: Crunchy Feta Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, halved | 1/3 cup chili sauce ( bottled or homemade ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 ounces crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Spray baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange half of potatoes, cut side upper third of wedges, in a single layer on baking sheet.  Mix chili sauce and taco seasoning mix in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: sesame paste,rice vermicelli,taco seasoning,asiago cheese,pork tenderloin,almond paste,pomegranate molasses
title: Muamba's Grilled Pork Rolls With Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, kha ( or other seasoning ) | 1/2 tablespoon almond paste | 1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses | 1 package nori ( dry seaweed sheets ) | 1 package rice vermicelli | 1 1/4 ounces asiago cheese | sesame paste
instructions: Remove all fat from the pork and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Combine taco seasoning, almond paste & pomegranate molasses.  Set aside.  Separate sheets of nori sheets & allow them to soften while you prepare the others.  Cut the sushi stick in half crosswise, then cut each half crosswise into 6 slices.  Set aside.  Cut the pork into about 6 strips.  Place 1/2 tbsp sesame paste & 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar in a bowl.  Stir well, let it marinate while you prepare the rolls.  Spread a thin layer of nori on a plate & cover with another sheet of nori, shiny side down.  Spread 1/2 tbsp of the pork mixture along the nori over the nori, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edge.  Top with about 1/4 cup of the shredded asiago.  Roll into a log.  Repeat with another 1/2 tbsp rice & a second log of pork & a third log of pork.  When all the rolls are rolled, brush the remaining 1/2 tbsp of sesame paste on the top of each roll.  Gently place the rolls on the greased sides & press them together.  Repeat to make 2 more rolls.  Cover them with a damp cloth or plastic wrap & set aside.  When all rolls are finished, heat up the grill.  Lightly oil the grill grate.  Grill the rolls 4 minutes per side or until they are done.  While the rolls are grilling, prepare the dipping sauce.  Cut 1/4 of each nori sheet into 5 strips, set aside.  Cut remaining strips into small strips & set aside.  Place 1/4 cup of shredded asiago cheese on each sheet of nori.  Season both sides with sesame paste, set aside.  Place 1 - 2 rolls on each serving plate & top with 1 tablespoon of remaining asiago cheese.  Serve 3 napa cabbage leaves for each diner to put on their own side with some dipping sauce.

title: Pecan Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup coarsely chopped toasted pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Bake potato in preheated oven 30 minutes, or until golden brown and tender.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Place pecans in a shallow dish. instructions: Pour all in blender or food processor.  Cover and run until smooth.

instructions: Wash and drain sprouts.

title: Chilli Potato Pancakes

instructions: Put the potatoes, peppers, flour and half the spring onions in a food processor and pulse until it forms a soft dough.  Pour the potato mixture into 2 well oiled 8 x8 baking moulds. Turn out onto a serving platter and cut off the crusts and serve hot.

title: Fiery Scented Hot Pepper Spice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon juniper berries
instructions: Place all in a spice grinder.  Grind until fine and air tight.  To make hot peppers, pour into a dry hot, non stick fry pan and fry 10 seconds on each side before shaking pan.  Store in an air tight jar.

title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 small burdock root, peeled if large | 1 small yellow pepper | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: To peel burdock, cut off the root ends and break off the tough stalk.  Place in a medium saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil, then cover and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 40 minutes.  Transfer to a ricer and remove the peel.  Set aside to cool and then remove the stalk, then break the root into quarters and set aside.  Peel yellow pepper and cut into 1 inch pieces and stir into the burdock stalks, removing any membrane or seeds if desired.  To prepare sheets, line a 9x13 inch pan with a piece of phyllo pastry.  Cover with a layer of phyllo, brushing with glaze.  Cover with 1/3 of the burdock mixture, then half of the pepper and half of the gelatin.  Repeat layers ending with phyllo, pepper and gelatin.  Pour the remaining glaze over the top.  Sprinkle with remaining phyllo, if desired.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Cover tightly and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven.  Cut into squares when cooled and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,ginger garlic paste,hazelnut,mustard oil,rosemary,rump roast
title: Indian Beef Aubergine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary ( or use dried ) | 1/2 cup coconut cream, well stirred | 1 lb rump roast, trimmed of fat
instructions: Mix the chopped hazelnuts, ginger garlic paste, and rosemary together.  Add the coconut cream and mix well.  Spray the surface and underside of the roast with cooking spray.  Spread all over with the nut mixture.  Wrap tightly in aluminium foil and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours, or overnight.  Heat the grill.  Remove the meat, wrap in aluminum foil, and barbecue or grill pan about 6 minutes per side, until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f or the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f.  Remove from the foil, slice and serve.

title: Noodles with Dijon Dressing
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, or more to taste
instructions: Fill a saucepan with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Stir in the soba noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and rinse with cool water.  Drain again.  To serve, spread the soba noodles on a plate, and top with dijon mustard, shallot, and lemon zest.

title: Tomato Cilantro-Grape Salsa Pie (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cans peeled and diced italian tomatoes, drained | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1 jar salsa ( medium or hot ) | 4 teaspoons catsup ( no-sugar ) | 1 cup bell pepper, diced, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place tomatoes and tomato paste in pressure cooker.  Dissolve tomato paste in hot water.  Add salsa, catsup and bell peppers.  Secure lid, and bring to high pressure over high heat.  Reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 seconds.  Remove from heat.  Remove lid.  Hold lid of burner down over high heat until steam begins to escape, but before lid becomes a tight lid.  Carefully remove from heat, and release from heat, placing lid onto warmed pie plate.  Top with cheese, if desired.

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over moderate heat.  Add asparagus and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.  Add mango nectar, vinegar, corn and water.  Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until asparagus is cooked.  Drain.  Divide asparagus among 4 bowls.

Brush the quesadillas with oil, and place them on the griddle.  Close the lid, and cook the quesadillas in batches over medium high heat for about 15 minutes, until the cheese has melted.

instructions: Combine all ingredients and combine well.  Pour on the sliced zucchini.  Cover.  Serve immediately with steamed rice for a main meal.

title: Japanese Five Flavoured Meatballs
ingredients: 600 g pureed lean pork | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 2 teaspoons port wine or 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 pinch ground star anise | 4 medium japanese mayonnaise | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise
instructions: Place your oven rack in the center of the oven.  Preheat your grill and the oven's heat to 200 degrees c.  Whisk the pork, honey, port, star anise and anise together in a bowl.  If you are using pork spareribs or spareribs cut in half lengthways and cut across the width on the diagonal.  Shape the pork mixture into 24 meatballs, about 2cm in diameter.  Place on a foil lined baking sheet and bake for 8 - 10 minutes until cooked through.  Meanwhile, place your mayonnaise and flour in a large mixing bowl and using a large metal spoon, mix in the honey, 1/2 teaspoon of the star anise and 1/4 cup of the white flour gradually with a wooden spoon until well combined.  Add the remaining 1/4 cup of white flour and mix until the dough is firm enough to shape.  Using a round bladed knife, roll each meatball on to a lightly floured surface until well coated.  Place the meatballs on a medium baking sheet and place in the oven.  Roast for 15 minutes until dark golden brown.  Add the reserved white flour to the meatballs and return to the oven for a further 5 minutes for each batch.  Serve immediately with japanese mayonnaise, wasabi and pickled vegetables.  Variation, if you would like to make it into a meatball sandwich, add 1 teaspoon of white flour to a cup of cold water prior to boiling.  The water should be cold before boiling or boiling, and when added the water should not come to a boil before adding the water.  The flavour will become stronger and the flour will have reduced.  When it is, your meatballs will stick to the foil and will not cook the heat.  To achieve this, when making this meatball sandwich, it is helpful to line the sheet of foil with kitchen foil.  This helps keep any juices flowing in the oven during cooking.

instructions: Heat a large non stick pan.  Cut the squash into cubes and cook in boiling water for about 10 minutes or until tender.  Rinse and pat dry with paper towel.  Using a mandolin, finely chop the squash.  Drain.  Put the pumpkin and squash into a large bowl.  Add the ricotta cheese, rice wine and half the raspberries, then mix well.  Rinse the tuna and pat dry.  Slice the tuna into 5mm thin steaks.  Stir the marinade into the cheese mixture, using some of the marinade if necessary.  Pour the mixture into a large rectangular baking dish, spreading evenly.  Bake in a moderate oven for 35 - 45 minutes or until the top has darkened slightly.

title: Chile Cheese Omelet
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 tablespoon kewra kefalotiri cheese
instructions: Slit 1 eggs in half along its length.  Remove yolks.  Place under broiler and broil on high for 2 minutes or until edges are brown.  Remove egg yolks and place on serving plate.  Mash together coriander powder and kewraotiri cheese.  Dip 1 egg yolk in 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture and then the other egg.  Dip both sides of the egg in cheese mixture.  Heat a griddle or frying pan.  Put 1/2 tablespoon of cheese mixture in the center of one of the eggs.

title: Dali Breakfast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground dal | 1 large banana ( medium is best )
instructions: In a small, heavy frying pan fry your dal and banana slowly until soft.  Note, for a slightly different taste, use less dal and banana.  You may not need to add any water but it'll add to the mixture and give it a little sweetness that sneaks up on you as you fry.  Enjoy on your favorite breakfast roll.

title: Sautéed Mushrooms With Corn and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pansir, cubed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh shiitake mushrooms ( or dried shiitake caps ) | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon winter savory or 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 3 -5 ears fresh corn, cut from cob
instructions: In a large nonstick fry pan put the panir in.  Over medium heat add in the mushrooms and sprinkle with the baking soda.  When the wine has almost all evaporated add in the shiitake mushrooms.  When the shiitake mushrooms have begun to soften add the savory or oregano.  After 15 - 20 minutes turn the heat to low add the corn and cook for 5 minutes.  Turn off the heat.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Lentil and Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup red lentils ( or any other red lentils ) | 2 cups chopped fresh strawberries | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Cook lentils in boiling water for 20 minutes, then drain.  Allow to cool.  Place half of the strawberries in a small bowl and top with 1/4 cup of lentils.  Repeat twice with remaining strawberries.  Sprinkle with cottage cheese.  Top with remaining remaining berries.  Serve.

title: Easy English Pepper Raspberry Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 yellow pepper, seeded and chopped | 18 raspberries ( frozen can be substituted )
instructions: With an electric mixer, cream together cream cheese and yellow pepper until smooth.  Stir in raspberries and mix well.  Chill before serving.

title: My Favourite Puds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice
instructions: Rub margarine into flour.  Stir half the orange juice into the mixture.  Put into a 9 x 5 x 3 inch baking dish lined with greaseproof paper. Remove from heat and pour over the greaseproof paper, which has been lightly toasted.  Allow to cool.  Cut into squares or rectangular pieces.  Serve hot.

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Cook bok choy heads in the boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and drain.  Peel heads from heads and chop meat, separating leaves and stems.  Cut leaves into strips and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook pork meat in the boiling water until no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes.  Add bok choy and simmer 5 minutes.  Drain and discard water.  Remove 1 package of oysters from shucked bok choy heads and trim the meat.  Slice the oysters and set aside.  Place the slices of kielbasa in the top of a double boiler over very low heat and stir until lightly browned.  Remove the roux from the heat.  Slowly pour in cream, stirring constantly.  Heat and stir over very low heat until reduced by 1/3, 30 to 45 minutes.  Return the pork and bok choy leaves to the boiler, stirring to distribute the flavors.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Cut the carrots in half lengthwise.  Cook carrots with half of the chicken stock until desired tenderness is achieved.  Dice the onion into small chunks. Pour into bowls, and top with the carrot mixture.  Add the sesame seed oil.

instructions: Wash, trim and remove root ends of rhubarb stalks.  Cut rhubarb stalks into 5 to 6 inch lengths, cutting off hard top ends if necessary if not entirely trimmed.  Combine ketchup, zest and juice into a medium pot.  Add the rhubarb and potato.

title: Lebanese Peas

instructions: Cook peas in boiling water to cover, until tender.  Rinse peas under cold running water, drain well.  Place peas in serving dish, and sprinkle with garlic and lemon juice.  Serve warm.

title: Vegetarian Baked White Bread Salad With Oyster
ingredients: 1 lb white bread, cubes ( i use low-fat bread ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( i recommend using canola ) | 2 packages steam-cooked oysters, sliced ( reserve 1/3 cup of the liquid ) | 1 cup sliced celery leaves | 1 cup diced green pepper ( or red ) | 1/2 cup green beans, topped and tailed | cooked rice krispies

title: Choc-Y Goong

title: Fruit Baked in Poppy Seed Sauce

instructions: Pour cold water in medium saucepan, and place on medium high heat.  Meanwhile bring water to boil, and then cook rice according to package directions. title: Smoked Trout in Gravy

instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place fish on an oiled baking sheet.  Broil in the broiler until lightly golden, 3 to 5 minutes.  Turn and broil the other side until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.  Serve with broth for dipping.

title: Chorizo Bean Sprouts with Zucchini and Beans

instructions: Drain the chorizo, reserving 1 tablespoon of fat, and place in a pan with the zucchini.  Add the curry leaves and bring to the boil.  Once boiling, add the beansprouts, season, and then simmer for 12 - 15 minutes until tender.  Serve with flatbread or toasted grated carrot.

title: Basic Refreshed Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon white vinegar ( don't use vinegar-canola or vegetable )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the oil, vinegar and vinegar.  Mix well to blend.

title: Cheesy Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 large red enchilada sauce ( mild ) | 12 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Prepare a 9x13 baking dish by spraying with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, mix both cheeses.  Add 3/4 of the enchilada sauce to the cheese in the bowl.  Spread mixture evenly over the bottom of the baking dish.  Fill the spaces with 1/2 of the cheese mixture.  Continue the layers and top with remaining enchilada sauce.  Cover with foil, and bake at 350 degrees, for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Guiness
ingredients: 2 cups apple cider | 1 cup dry white wine | 3 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, bring the cider, wine, oregano, and lime to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to medium.  Simmer to reduce juices by 3/4, about 45 minutes.  Strain into a large bowl.  Serve warm with lime wedges.

title: Homemade Gruyère Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb gruyere ( use the coarse type at room temperature, and use the type on the baggie ) | 8 ounces water chestnuts, chopped
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and grind well until it reaches a creamy texture.  Spread on toasted bagels and chill.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,wheat flour,rhubarb,pepper,mandarin orange,green cardamom pod
title: Rhubarb and Mandarin Grissini
ingredients: 6 -10 ounces rhubarb | 1 italian bread, cut in pieces ( i use challah, about 8-9 ounces total weight ) | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 bunch green cardamom pod | pepper, a few grinds | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Wash the rhubarb and cut it into small pieces.  Mix and put water on to boil while preparing the rest of the recipe.  Cut loaf into 1inch slices.  Place the sliced rhubarb into a skillet, cover with water and boil gently until it is tender.  It should be quite firm.  Remove from heat, then drain.  When the rhubarb slices have cooled sufficiently, cut the tips into about 2 inch lengths.  Scoop about 2 tablespoonsful of the rhubarb out of the loaf pieces.  Save the rest, and chop the rest.  Place the flour on a clean flat surface and make a well in the center.  Break up the cardamom pods into a tea ball and add a few grinds of pepper.  Put the green cardamom into the well.  Dunk the rhubarb pieces one at a time into the prepared flour mixture, coating both sides.  Take each piece and roll into a ball on the lightly floured surface.  When all the pieces are finished dipping, heat a small skillet and sear each piece till golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.  Serve hot, with fresh mandarin oranges.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,marjoram,chick pea,graham cracker crumb,filet mignon,garam masala,sherry wine vinegar,shallot
title: Sweet and Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 filet mignon, cut into thin slices ( i use a little more ) | 1 1/4 cups fresh garam masala ( about ) or 1 1/4 cups curry powder | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup shallot, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 2 cans chick-peas ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Pound the mignon slices with a meat mallet or rolling pin.  Combine the garam masala, shallots and marjoram in a small bowl.  Spread the chick peas in the bottom of a small bowl.  Spread the crumbs on a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap or a towel.  Set aside.  Drain the garbanzo beans and place them in a small bowl.  Toss with the garam masala and set aside.  Drain the chicken slices and dip them in the crumbs to coat.  Set them aside on paper towels to drain some of the excess liquid.  Line a broiler pan with foil and brush with salad oil.  Arrange the chicken slices on the tray and broil 6 inches from the heat for 10 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is slightly charred and cooked through.  Arrange the crumbs on a plate or platter and top evenly with the chicken.  Drizzle with salad oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,large shrimp,pesto sauce,dill,yukon gold potato,maraschino cherry,tarragon
title: Giant Shrimp With Pesto and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and butterflied | 8 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into half moons | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 4 -6 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons maraschino cherries | 1 1/2 teaspoons tarragon or 1 1/2 teaspoons sage | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place shrimp in a bowl or baking dish with 1/4 cup of butterflied water.  Stir in potato slices.  In a small bowl combine the pesto sauce and maraschino cherries.  Toss with shrimp until coated.  Sprinkle shrimp with remaining 1/4 cup of butterflied water and dot with 1 tablespoon pesto.  Bake in preheated oven for about 30 to 40 minutes or until shrimp are lightly browned and potatoes are tender.  Serve with remaining pesto sauce on the side.  Note,.  Potato halves can be cut in half if desired.

title: No-Cook Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce or ( 28 ounce ) can prepared low sodium tomato soup | 1 -2 scallion, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional ) | 8 slices scallions, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional )
instructions: You will need 5 cups of pinto beans and tomato sauce for this one dish recipe.  Heat the pinto bean sauce in a small saucepan until bubbly.  Add pinto beans, tomato and scallions and mix.

title: Aarsi’s Perfectest Puree for Meat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons pistachio nuts | 2 1/8 cups chicken stock | 1 cup fresh pistachio nut
instructions: In a small saucepan, over low heat, melt the oil.  Stir in pistachios 1 tablespoon at a time and allow them to fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until they have softened and are golden brown.  Stir in the stock, bring to a boil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the mixture reaches the consistency of custard.  Pour into a small bowl.  Cover the top with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour.  Remove plastic wrap, and place the remaining pistachios in a small frying pan over medium heat.  Cook until lightly browned and aromatic, taking care not to burn.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pistachios to a bowl.

title: Persian Style Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried english muffins | 3 tablespoons assorted fresh vegetables ( sliced almonds, pistachios or cashews ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 small lettuce | 1 small mint
instructions: Toast muffins.  Combine remaining ingredients and spread on toast.  Note, toast can be garnished with grated cheese or sour cream.  This is also great with sambal oelek.

title: French Steak House Ribs
ingredients: 12 lbs of large prime steaks, not the fast | 16 fluid ounces dry mustard powder | 3 fluid ounces corn oil
instructions: Cut a slit in the side of the prime rib's top.  This will allow for easy removal from the bone.  Rinse all pieces of meat under cold water and pat dry.  In a large, heavy freezer bag, mix together the dry mustard powder, corn oil, and salt and pepper to taste.  Add the meat and shake off the excess air from the bag.  Add the mustard mixture and massage well to coat the meat in the mixture.  Allow to sit for 2 to 3 hours in the freezer.  The marinade will thicken just as you roll it up.  Remove the meat and shake off any excess dry mustard.  Preheat the broiler and place the meat on an oiled rack or broiler pan set about 6 inches below the temperature of the fire.  Broil, uncovered, for 10 to 13 minutes, or until the meat registers 139f on an instant reading thermometer.  Transfer the meat, skin side down, to a baking sheet and set aside for 10 minutes.  Pour off all fat and add a splash or two of water.  Place in the freezer and let sit 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: couscous,green pepper,yellow pepper,active yeast,rhubarb,chicken thigh,ancho chile powder,kosher salt
title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Couscous
ingredients: 16 ounces chicken thigh, preferably thighs attached | 1 can rhubarb, rinsed and drained | 2 small yellow peppers, cut into chunks | 1 small green pepper, sliced | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock or 1 1/4 cups slow-cooking chicken broth
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker.  Cover with 2 cups water.  Cover and cook on high 5 to 7 hours or on low 3 1/2 to 4 hours until chicken is tender and cooked through.  Discard any thawed bits of meat that remain.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Uncover.  Stir until well blended.  Serve warm or allow to be reheated uncovered.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,double crust pie,iceberg lettuce,spinach leaf
title: Apple Spinach Tart
ingredients: 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 teaspoon double-crust pie crust | 3 granny smith apples, chopped | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl combine iceberg lettuce, pie crust and apples.  Mix well and then spread mixture into an unbaked pie crust.  Sprinkle top with spinach leaves.  Bake in preheated oven 50 minutes, until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,red cabbage,gruyere cheese,pepperoncini pepper,salt substitute,lima bean,onion soup mix
title: Lima Bean and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 100 -200 g lima beans | 1/2 small red cabbage | 1 -2 pepperoncini pepper, sliced in rounds ( optional ) | 1 -2 small radicchio or 1 -2 leafy greens | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | salt substitute | onion soup mix, to coat the beans
instructions: Boil the lima beans in lightly salted water, drain and add some chopped up vegetables.  Add salt and pepper at this point to your liking of taste, the traditional saltiness would be too salty as the flavor is quite bitter for this recipe.  I usually add more salt to taste.  In a small bowl mix together your onion soup mix with about 1/4 cup water to make a paste, stir in that mixture, put on the coleslaw and put in the fridge to chill.

title: Peanut Powder
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: In a bowl combine flour, ginger powder and pinch of salt.  Make sure the salt is incorporated by adding a pinch of salt.  Make a well and add the mixture and knead it with hands.  The mixture should be elastic.  Shape into a ball.  Cover with a clean cloth and set aside for 30 minutes.  Divide the dough in 8 equal portions.  Shape into balls the size of a large walnut.  Heat a non stick skillet on medium high.  Add the dough.  When the edge of each ball of dough is not sticking, flip them over.  Cook on the first side, then turn.  Cook on the second side for 2 to 3 minutes.  This depends on the heat of your skillet.  Remove each dough ball and drain on paper towels.  Roll out onto a floured board or cloth to as many sheets as you can.  Roll out again on a floured board to as many sheets as you can.  These will eventually be folded into 'cigars' or star shaped, gummy looking cookies.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,dijon mustard,hazelnut,french bread,icing sugar,rosemary,beef roast,thyme
title: Kelly's Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef roast ( i buy a frozen one ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary ( i use dijon ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 loaf french bread | 1 1/2 cups hazelnuts ( i like hazelnuts )
instructions: Cook roast over medium hot gas mark and cut in two lengthwise.  Remove as much fat from beef as possible.  In a ziplock bag, combine all other ingredients except the bread, the hazelnuts and the olive oil.  Place the olive oil, beef, and 1/2 of the bread in the bag and close the package.  Put the bag in the fridge for about two hours to marinate.  After marinating, preheat the oven to 425 degrees.  Remove the bag of marinated beef and place it on a foil covered baking sheet.  Slice the remaining bread into 1/2 thick slices, then arrange the slices on the bread.  Dip the bread into the olive oil then place in the oven.  Bake until meat is browned and the cheese has begun to melt and have melted.  Remove from oven.  Let stand 10 minutes then cut into slices.  When the bread is cooled slightly, spread on extra olive oil.  Cut in half and serve with the meat and bread.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,white pepper,coconut cream,dark beer,feta cheese,table salt,dijon mustard
title: Cauliflower with Mustard, Feta, and Black Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup packed dark beer | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coconut cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cauliflower | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine beer, dijon mustard, coconut cream, 1 tablespoon chopped cauliflower, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan with a lid over medium low heat.  Bring to a simmer, and reduce heat to low.  Simmer, uncovered, for about 5 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender, stirring occasionally.  Remove vegetables from the saucepan, and stir in 1/4 cup feta cheese.

title: Fish With Chipotle Ghee
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon asiago cheese | 2/3 cup oil or 2/3 cup ghee | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 3 -4 lbs fish, cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 cups tapioca flour or 2 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: In a bowl, mix cilantro, cheese, asiago cheese, spices and 1 cup of the oil or ghee.  Heat remaining oil or ghee in large skillet over moderate heat.  Fry fish pieces in hot oil for two to three minutes without moving.  Remove with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl.  Reduce heat to low under skillet and saute fish for 20 minutes or until fish are golden brown.  Remove fish and drain excess grease on paper towels.  In the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish or skillet, place a small amount of tapioca flour mixed with baking powder.  Sprinkle tapioca flour around side of dish or skillet and place fish pieces in liquid mixture in dish or skillet.  Pour enough hot water into dish or skillet to cover fish and to moisten it.  Do not bake.  Cover and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours or overnight.  Heat oven to 350 degrees f and bake uncovered for 45 to 60 minutes or until fish is cooked.

title: Gram Dressing 2007
ingredients: 1 cup dark corn syrup | fresh broccoli floret | roasted green pepper
instructions: Mix corn syrup and water together and bring to boil.  Simmer until thickened.  Drain.  Chill.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,sherry wine vinegar,chili sauce,mozzarella cheese,saffron thread
title: Cheese and Saffron Spread
ingredients: 1 lb mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, pulverised | 2 tablespoons butterscotch chips, roasted | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine cheese, pinenuts, sherry and sweet chilli sauce.  Spread on ungreased pan.  Cool slightly.  Cut into small squares, serve with crackers or crackers.

Random Ingredients: cream,rosemary,fish fillet halibut,crisco shortening,yellow onion,artificial sweetener,garlic powder
title: Fish Fillets With Sweet and Spicy Sour Cream
ingredients: 6 tablespoons crisco shortening | 1 yellow onion, sliced into rings | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 2 lbs fish fillets ( halibut, cod, snapper, or sea bass can also be used ) | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon artificial sweetener ( optional )
instructions: Heat crisco in a frying pan over medium heat.  Saute onion in shortening in the oil just until slightly golden.  Add garlic powder and rosemary and saute another 30 seconds or so.  Add fish, turning with a fork to coat.  Turn fish over.  Place into a shallow baking dish.  Combine sour cream and sugar and spread over fish.  Bake at 350f.

title: Cheese for Chips and Chips
ingredients: grated cheddar cheese, grated on a box grater, the sharp type not the old cheddar | 1 veggie bouillon cube, or to your liking
instructions: Place the cheese in a paper bag and add the boullion.  Place in the microwave for 4 mintes on 100% power, then turn on the high power for 4 - 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted.  Serve on chips and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,liver pate,ice water,green cardamom pod,broccoli floret,green chili,pumpkin puree,whiskey
title: Moroccan Broccoli With Pumpkin Puree
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 600 g dried liver pate | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 green cardamom pods | cayenne | 2 bunches green chili, finely chopped, reserve the seeds | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley | 1 cup unsweetened pumpkin puree
instructions: Cook the broccoli florets in lightly salted boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes.  Drain.  Place the pate in a bowl and season to taste.  Toss with yoghurt.  Add 2 tablespoons of the cardamom seeds and a pinch of cayenne.  Toss to coat.  Gently tear the chillies with chinese scissors and add to the pate along with 2 tablespoons of the parsley.  Toss to coat, then season.  To assemble, place three spoons on a heat proof serving plate.  Add a third spoons of the pumpkin puree and top with a third spoons of the pesto.  Top with a third spoons of pumpkin puree and add a third spoons of pumpkin puree and a third spoons of pumpkin puree.  Finish with a third spoons of pumpkin puree and a third spoon of the parsley.  Repeat until all the ingredients have been used.  Plate and sprinkle with extra chinese parsley.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,golden raisin,chunky salsa,tea,molasses,whipping cream,ancho chile powder
title: Rice Balls With Warm Salsa and Chiles
ingredients: 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 cup arborio rice | 4 tablespoons molasses | 8 ounces brewed teabags chunky salsa | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 10 1/2 ounces whipping cream
instructions: Place 1/2 of rice and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Cover the pan and reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer for 15 minutes without removing the lid.  When the rice is tender, stir in the rest of the ingredients and blend well.  Form balls the size of a golf ball and roll in the remaining rice.  In a cast iron skillet, toast the rolled balls over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from skillet.  Place the toast crumbs on a plate and place the cooked rice balls in the crumbs.  Roll the balls in remaining crumbs.  Serve hot.

title: The Most Perfect Fish for Chilean Recipes
ingredients: 6 whole fish, heads on | 8 tablespoons hot paprika | 4 -6 tablespoons savory, ground | 2 -3 3 -4 ounces mexican cheese or 4 -6 ounces jalapeno pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Cut the heads of fish into 3/4 pieces.  Place in a large oven proof skillet with enough water to cover completely.  Set the pan on lowest rack over medium heat and bring to a boil. .  Cook fish over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until a fork breaks readily in the flesh and flake easily with a fork.  Strain fish and discard the water.  Place the fish pieces on plates or serving plates and sprinkle the top with the chile powder and savory.  Sprinkle cheese ontop and broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat.

title: Pork Risotto, Arancini, Sicilian
ingredients: 8 ounces pork shoulder, sliced 1/2-inch thin | 1 3/4 cups arborio rice | 1 1/4 cups mineral water | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 2 -3 cups ice
instructions: Start by soaking the pork in a medium sized bowl of cold water for at least an hour. .  Remove the pork from the liquid with slotted spoon leaving the water in the bowl and drain the liquid through the kitchen cloth.  Remove all the meat from the liquid and discard the solids.  Chop roughly and set aside.  Boil 1/4 cup of the liquid with the remaining ingredients in the bowl of a food processor equipped with a high blade.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cream chicken soup,white wine,kidney bean,spinach,white toast
title: Spinach, Bean, Sausage & White Wine Toast
ingredients: 3 ounces white toast | 12 ounces spinach, shredded & dried | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup white wine | 1 orange peel, chopped finely ( garnish ) | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat heavy skillet over med high heat.  Turn heat to low and place the toast in it but do not preheat.  Cover and cook 2 - 3 mins, stirring often.  Remove from heat.  Drain off excess fat.  Combine the soup, white wine and orange peel in a bowl & mix well with beans and add the mixture to the bread in the skillet and stir gently over heat for 3 minutes.  Place the toast on a platter & garnish with the orange slices.

title: Easy Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 frozen phyllo pastry sheet ( for a 14-ounce pizza ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded fresh basil or 1/2-3/4 cup of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Lightly spray a pizza stone or jelly roll pan with non stick cooking spray.  Unfold the phyllo pastry sheets on a large work surface, gathering them into large triangles, and place the triangles in the pan.  Sprinkle with the basil.  Bake in the oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until phyllo is dry and lightly browned.  Remove from oven, and allow to cool until warm, approximately 5 - 10 minutes.  Break out each phyllo pizza into 3 pieces.  Use the back of a spoon to spread evenly over the surface.  Sprinkle with some more of the basil if desired.

title: Arugula in Green Jelly (Gobbled)
ingredients: 150 g arugula, washed and cleaned | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 green chili, coarsely chopped | 25 g almond paste | 1 -2 tablespoon sparkling water
instructions: Remove the excess stalks from the arugula, then clean the leaves and the stems and roughly chop.  Soak the bean heads, stalks, leaves and stems in boiling water for 15 minutes and drain.  Place the tomato paste in a pan, add small amount of water.  Heat until it reaches 220 degrees c on the stove.  Add green chilies and almonds to the mixture.  Mix well with a spoon.  Pour the jelly in and let it boil until jelly becomes viscous.  Stir the mixture continuously and cook until it is again thick.  Pour in sparkling water.  Stir.  Put the arugula leaves on a plate and pour jelly over them.  Eat warm or cold.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,cayenne pepper,egg,celery seed,lentil,puff pastry,mango,green chili
title: Spicy Chocolate Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 cup lentils | 1 green chili, finely chopped | 1/2 small mango, chopped | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 4 phyllo pastry sheets | 6 eggs
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave or in double boiler and refrigerate till cold.  Combine lentils, chilli, mango, celery seeds and cayenne.  Taste for seasoning and set aside to cool.  Lightly grease 12 muffin cups.  Place 1/6 of the spiced chocolate mixture in each cup.  Layer pastry on top, brushing each with melted chocolate.  Fill pies with remaining chocolate mixture and serve.

title: Ginger and Garlic Scented Steak
ingredients: 12 -15 slices fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground mixed dry spices ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over a medium flame.  While the pan is heating up, spread out the ginger garlic paste all around the pan, keeping each slice attached to your hand so that it can stand up vertically when cooking.  Place the sirloin steak into the hot pan and sprinkle with the thyme and coarsely ground mixed dry spices.  Spread the skillet out evenly and allow the mixture to sit while you cook the other side until the surface appears dry, about 2 - 3 minutes.  Sprinkle the pan with additional salt if desired.  Remove the pan from the heat and allow to sit covered for 15 - 30 minutes until the sauce is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups of the desired consistency and the meat is cooked through.  Serve warm or chilled.  The beef will keep for several days and can be frozen and reheated later.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,yoghurt,black eyed pea,lettuce leaf,arborio rice,plain yogurt,broth,cremini mushroom
title: Black Eyed Pea Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, rinsed and patted dry | 15 cups hot broth, heated to 90 120 f-115 f ( hot but not boiling ) | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 2 lbs cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 12 ounces arborio rice, long grain and wild rice blend | 8 ounces curly leaf lettuce leaves, washed | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 large lettuce leaves, leaves separated | 3/4 cup low fat natural yoghurt
instructions: Combine the black eyed peas with the hot broth and let soak overnight.  Strain the liquid through a fine mesh sieve.  Reheat the liquid over low heat until reduced to a creamy, simmering liquid.  Stir in the yogurt and remove from the heat before adding any of the cremini mushrooms.  Add the rice and cook over low heat until just tender 5 to 8 minutes.  Place half of the lettuce on the bottom of a wide, shallow baking dish.  Top with half of the rice and then half of the black eyed peas.  Repeat layering, ending with the black eyed peas.  Pour the yogurt and sour cream over the top and sprinkle with the sesame oil.  Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap, place a sheet of plastic wrap on top, and refrigerate overnight.  To serve, transfer the rice to a serving dish and sprinkle with the remaining lettuce.  Garnish with the toasted sesame seeds.

title: Ginger Stewed Sweet Onions
ingredients: 4 cups diced sweet red onion | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh ginger root | 6 cubes chicken bouillon | 6 cubes chicken flavor instant consomme or other instant chicken bouillon | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place the onion in the slow cooker, and sprinkle with ginger and chicken bouillon cubes.  Add consommé, stirring to combine.  Cover, and cook on high for 4 hours.  Mix cornstarch and vanilla until smooth, then stir into broth.  Cook 15 to 20 minutes, until gravy is thickened.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,pepper sauce,baking soda,collard green,pumpkin seed,peanut butter
title: Thai Greens
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut butter | 1/3 cup low-fat pumpkin seeds | 1/3 cup hot pepper sauce ( kikkoman kecap manis ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 lbs collard greens, chopped | 1/4 cup kiwi fruits, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Blend the peanut butter, pumpkin seeds, hot pepper sauce, baking soda and collard greens.  Spread in a greased jelly roll pan and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Top with kiwi fruit and return to oven until hot, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,turkey,milk ricotta cheese,hash brown potato,basil leaf,vegetable,cinnamon,potato traditional
title: Baked Greek Potato & Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole wheat mixed frozen potatoes, thawed ( or other dry potato ) | 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( such as carrot, zucchini, celery, turnips, etc ) | 1 small potato traditional, grated ( or other egg substitute or vegetables of choice ) | 1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves ( or 2 tsp dried basil ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried parsley ( or to taste ) | turkey ( optional ) | fresh basil leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a 9 inch square baking dish.  Spread the potatoes into the prepared dish.  In a medium bowl, mash the potatoes and vegetables together using a potato masher or fork.  Spread the ricotta evenly across the potatoes and sprinkle evenly with the basil, cinnamon, parsley, and turkey.  Carefully transfer the vegetables to the baking dish.  Top with the potato ricotta mixture.  Bake for 40 minutes in the oven, until the cheese topping is brown and bubbly.  Remove from the oven, remove from the baking dish, and garnish with fresh basil leaves when it is done.

title: Clove Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints heavy cream | 6 whole cloves
instructions: In a deep 2 - 3 pint saucepan heat the cream.  When hot, remove the pan from heat and add the cloves.  Stir well and immediately remove clove mixture to a bowl and cool to room temperature.  Cover, leave to come to room temperature.  Strain, discard solids, refrigerate overnight to develop flavor.  Before serving refrigerate at least a few hours.  The cream will soften as it cools.

Random Ingredients: pretzel twist,hazelnut,oregano,russet potato,natural peanut butter,iceberg lettuce,egg noodle,habanero pepper
title: Huitlacoche (Huitmans' Peanut Butter Noodles)
ingredients: 1 can low fat natural-style peanut butter ( or almond butter ) | 2 -3 habanero peppers, more to taste ( depending on taste ) | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cored cut into bite size pieces | iceberg lettuce, sliced into 1/8 inch pieces ( for garnish, or other leaf lettuce ) | 6 ounces dry pretzels, crushed in the food processor | 1/8 teaspoon hazelnuts ( finely chopped ) | 1 package egg noodles, cooked ( we like whole wheat or angel hair )
instructions: Pour peanut butter into the bowl with the eggs and let sit 10 minutes.  Add oregano and mix.  Add lettuce, pretzels, and hazelnuts.  Stir gently in one direction so it doesn't break up.  Let sit in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. .  Cook the noodles, drain in a colander and let cool completely.  Put in a serving bowl.  Place a bed of lettuce on top.  Place a dollop of the peanut butter on top of each serving of noodles in separate dishes.  Enjoy.

title: Lebanese Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 package fresh mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut cheese into 1 inch cubes.  Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Top with parsley and mace.  Bake 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg thigh,lime juice,corn tortilla chip,mushroom,currant,italian seasoning,beef brisket
title: Quick and Easy Crock Pot "Rachael Ray's Coq Au Vin"
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( the kind with bone in to help it all soak up the grease and make it a bit more secure ) | 4 lbs chicken legs-thighs | 1/2 1/2 lb mushroom ( i like crimini, shitake, japalero or your favorite combination, if you want to have them ) or 1/2 lb white mushroom ( i like crimini, shitake, japalero or your favorite combination, if you want to have them ) | 1 can chicken legs-thighs | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup dry crushed corn tortilla chips ( also called flavored ones ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Wash chicken up, cut down to the size of the brisket and place in large covered crockpot or crockpot.  Pour on 1/4 cup water.  Sprinkle italian seasoning over the chicken.  Add 2nd can of water, cover top with lid or a dish towel and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.  After 8 hours remove meat and place on cutting board and shred with 2 forks.  You can also use your forks to shred the meat into bite sized pieces.  Combine shredded meat with rest of ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well.  If you are serving your meal with fresh crusty bread spread bread on it's slice and sandwich bread slices to help bread soak up some of the juices.  The bread is supposed to be so big that it will absorb the juice.  I suggest serving this with sour cream, guacamole, lettuce, salsa, and/or cheese.  It's up to you how many people you are serving.  Also, if you are serving to guests, they may add chopped carrots to the meat as well as a green salad of mixed greens.
