Random Ingredients: rice,yeast,date,kielbasa,plain yogurt,mint sprig,chat masala,beef stew meat
title: Beef & Goat Cheese in Yoghurt Curry with Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons keltbasa, masala | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 teaspoons chat masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint sprigs or 1 1/2 teaspoons other curry powder | 2 cups rice, cooked | 2 fresh dates, sliced
instructions: Soak the keltbasa in ½ cup warm water for about 10 - 20 minutes.  Cut the meat into cubes, dust with the masala and brown.  Set aside.  Heat the remaining 1/2 cup of yoghurt in a pan and add the dried mint.  Remove from heat and stir in the fried meat cubes, salt and chaat masala.  Mix well.  Set aside.  Cook rice, separate into two bowls or dishes, pour beef on top and garnish with dates.  Serve with naan and chutney of your choice.

title: Fabulously Easy, Simple No Oil Canola Oil Canola
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dried tomatoes and tomato puree | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat a nonstick or cast iron skillet over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes.  Add dried chili flakes and saute for 30 seconds.  Immediately add the tomato puree and olives and stir.  When bubbling, cook for another one minute to thicken, stirring constantly.  Serve hot.  This takes about 12 minutes to achieve a good consistancy.  Keep the olive oil from going brown.  Variation, add mushrooms, potatoes, tofu, or zucchini when you add the olive oil.

title: Tunisian Bread Pita
ingredients: 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 4 pita breads | 2 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.  Spread the monterey jack cheese onto one side of each pita bread slice, leaving a 1 inch border and a 2 inch border around the edges.  Spoon 1/4 teaspoon harissa into the center of each bread slice.  Place a second bread slice, buttered side up, on top of the filling, and gently press the two sandwiches together to make sandwiches that are approximately 2 inches thick and slightly oval shaped.  Heat the broiler rack and a metal or ceramic baking mat on the stovetop, about 5 minutes.  Place the sandwiches onto the baking mat, sprinkle with remaining harissa, and broil until lightly browned and bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,garlic paste,avocado,english cucumber,walnut oil,wide rice noodle,potato flour,chickpea
title: Garlic Chickpea Noodles
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh garlic paste | 4 teaspoons finely chopped walnut oil | 4 tablespoons chickpeas, drained | 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/4 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon potato flour | 1/3 - 1/2 small avocado, diced | 8 ounces wide rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In a medium skillet, combine the garlic paste and 1/4 cup chile paste.

Random Ingredients: apple juice concentrate,lime zest,bulk italian sausage,gingerroot,green olive,rack lamb
title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs lean racks of lamb, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/3 cup apple juice concentrate, thawed | 2 limes, zest of, grated | 6 ounces bulk italian sausage, cooked small | 1/4 cup green olives | 1 1/2 inches fresh gingerroot, peeled and minced
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a container with a lid and shake well.  Arrange alternate layers of lamb & sausage in the bottom of a shallow glass dish just large enough to hold salad.  Pour the dressing over the salad.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 3 days before serving.  Serve either chilled or at room temperature.

title: Paneer ( Indian Vegetable Soup With Paneer)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves | ice water | 4 lbs pork shoulder ( trimmed of fat and excess fat ) | 2 pieces aluminum foil, rinsed and patted dry ( about 4 inch round )
instructions: Place the fenugreek in a soup tureen or 3 quart heavy non aluminum kettle and add enough water to cover.  Bring to boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until the fenugreek is tender, about 1 hour.  Remove the soup tureen from the heat and cool.  Trim the pork, and cut into 2 by 1 inch cubes.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat.  When the water reaches a boil, add the pork, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until the pork is tender, about 20 minutes.  Remove the pork from the pot using a slotted spoon and set aside.  Set the soup aside.  Ladle 2 cups of broth and some of the soup broth into a blender or food processor and puree until smooth.  Transfer the pureed soup back to the pot, add the pork and heat gently over medium low heat until the pork is warmed through.  Place the foil on a rimmed baking sheet and place a piece of aluminum foil on the foil.  Spoon the soup into the baking sheet, about 3 to 4 inches in from the edge, and carefully spread the soup into a circle about 4 inches across the foil.  Return the paneer to the stove, pressing gently to compact, and let it cook undisturbed until the soup has formed a crust on top, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve at once with warm flatbreads and fresh plain yogurt.

title: Chargled Yellow Squash and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yellow squash, diced | 3 tablespoons yellow bell peppers or 3 tablespoons red bell peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons trimmed asparagus, tips trimmed or 2 tablespoons broccoli, cut into 1/2 inch bite size pieces | 1 tablespoon capers or 1 tablespoon kroger brand extra virgin olive oil | 1 ounce feta or 1 ounce greek feta, crumbled
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss to coat.

title: Spanish Hazelnut Spread
ingredients: 1 ounce hazelnuts, toasted and skins removed | 1 can pimientos, drained
instructions: Remove hazelnuts from can, and carefully break into very small pieces.  Place in a food processor, and pulse until nuts are finely ground.  Add pimentos for texture.  Transfer to a small bowl or mold, and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate to mellow flavors for 1 week.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,creme fraiche,squash,orange,chorizo sausage,ginger garlic paste,mirin,yellow squash
title: Tropical Hot Chorizo Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces chorizo sausage | 4 ounces yellow squash, sliced thinly | 4 ounces zucchini, sliced thinly | 1 orange | 1 lime, juice of | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: First place all the dressing ingredients together in a blender and blend until smooth, using a little water if necessary to form a thick dressing.  Add any remaining dressing ingredients, mix well and store in the fridge until ready to use.  Slice the chorizo into chunks and fry in a non stick frypan until golden.  Remove and cool.  Cut rind from zucchini and the orange and combine with the chorizo and zucchini into the salad.  Next combine the citrus and pour over the dressing and toss to coat well.

title: Marinated Rib-Eye Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 21)
ingredients: 1 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 4 -6 cups romaine lettuce leaves, washed ( i prefer green ) | 4 medium roma sweet rollers or 4 medium sandwich buns
instructions: To make the dressing, combine onion in a small bowl and set aside.  Arrange lettuce leaves on a lettuce counter or lettuce plate until ready to serve.  Arrange the sweet rollers or sandwich buns on a serving platter.  Drizzle the dressing over each roll or serve on the side.

Random Ingredients: black dal,mandarin orange,apple,onion soup mix,romaine lettuce,basil,mayonnaise
title: Fruit Salad (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 small apple, peeled | 1 medium romaine lettuce | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 can black gram dal ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in rice cooker.  Add water until rice cooker stops cooking.

title: Toast Twirls
ingredients: 4 cups cake flour | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup soft toffee
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl, and stir in the yeast.  Make a well in the center, and pour the softened toffee into the well.  Stir the mixture until the dough gathers together into a firm, smooth ball.  Turn the dough out onto a very lightly floured surface to knead it 1 to 2 times, until smooth and elastic.  Place the dough in an oiled bowl, and turn to coat.  Cover, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours.  Lightly oil a loaf pan or other oven.  Punch down the dough, and knead it briefly on a lightly floured surface.  Place the dough in the pan, and turn the dough over so that it is lightly coated on all sides with oil.  Cover, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.  Punch down the dough.  Turn it out onto a lightly floured surface.  Stretch the dough between your hands and roll into a rope about 15 inches long and 1 1/2 to 2 inches in diameter.  With a sharp knife, carefully cut the rope into 1/2 inch slices, working toward the center.  Arrange the slices in a circular pattern into the loaf pan, and place the loaf pan on a cookie sheet.  Cover, and let rise until doubled, 30 to 40 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Bake the Twirls for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until they are golden brown and crisp.

title: Mashed Potatoes Beans and Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup dried kidney beans
instructions: Clean& dice potatoes.  Add beans, 1 1/2 cups of water and bring to boil.  Cook until potatoes are tender.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,flour tortilla,dark rum,marjoram,artichoke heart,greek oregano,topping
title: Beer Panzanella
ingredients: 1 can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and cut into strips | 1 pint dark beer | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon dried greek oregano | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 12 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine artichokes, beer, rum, oregano, and marjoram in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: flour,belgian endive,cooking spray,almond,pinto bean,vanilla extract,pork shoulder,pecan half
title: Pork Empanadas With Belgian Endive (Sylvia Burkes)
ingredients: 2 belgian endive, stems trimmed out | 4 teaspoons light fat cooking spray | 2 lbs lean boneless pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 cup pinto bean, soaked | 1/4 cup almonds, coarsely chopped ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup pecan halves, coarsely chopped ( about 1/4 cup ) | flour, for dusting
instructions: Position a rack in the center of an oven and heat to 325 degrees.  Cut the endive in half crosswise and remove the leaves attached to the leaves.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, then spray the paper with cooking spray.  Sprinkle the endive leaves with the salt.  Turn the oven on to its lowest setting and warm the oven to 200 degrees.  Using a 3 1/2-pound pork shoulder, evenly spread each slice on all four sides, then roll the meat into a log 3 to 4 inches long.  Using a sharp knife, make an indentation in each log with a toothpick.  Place the pork in a small, shallow baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour. .  Spray a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.  Cut each log into 3/4 inch thick slices crosswise.  Arrange the endive slices on the pan in an even layer.  Sprinkle the pork with the vanilla and salt.  Add the pinto beans and almonds to a saucepan of boiling water, then cook until tender, 3 to 2 minutes.  Drain and toss with the pecans, the remaining 2 teaspoons of the vanilla, and the 1/4 cup flour.  Spread the dutch oven out over the endives.  Bake until the bread is golden on the edges, about 20 minutes.  Transfer the empanadas to a serving platter and serve immediately.  Variation, for a milder version, cook 2 pounds of cooked, shredded pork shoulder in 2 cups of water to yield 6 servings.

title: Quick and Easy Microwave Chicken and Ziti With Starbucks-Makes 1 Serve
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups cooked chicken, sliced | 1 package ziti pasta or ( 8 ounce ) package fettuccine | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules ( optional )
instructions: In a 2 quart microwavable casserole dish stir together chicken, ziti and coffee.  Microwave on high 4 to 6 minutes or until ziti is tender and chicken is heated through.

Random Ingredients: tomato,green cabbage,beef roast,nonfat plain yogurt,rice noodle,asparagus
title: Beef and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes | 1/2 pound beef rinsed and trimmed fresh asparagus | 1/3 cup green cabbage, finely chopped | 1 pound thin rice noodles | 2 cups nonfat plain yogurt, whisked | 1 package frozen spears asparagus, thawed
instructions: Place tomatoes and rinsed and trimmed asparagus in a saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.  Add cabbage, and cook until tender crisp, about 2 minutes.  Remove asparagus from heat, and drain, and cool.  Place cooked noodles into a bowl, and mix with yogurt.

title: Portuguese Onions (Portuguese)
ingredients: 1 kg onion | 1 cup white wine
instructions: Peel and slice the onions, then fry in a pan until golden.  Pour the onions in a large bowl.  Add any of the other fillings you like and mix.  Cover and cook over a low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Tender Brussels Sprouts Antipasto
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprouts | 8 ounces tuscan pecorino or 8 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/4 cup brewed tea | 2 tablespoons nigella seeds ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons whole nigella seeds ( optional )
instructions: Wash sprouts.  Place in boiling water and cook according to package directions.  Place cheese in small bowl.  Drain water from sprouts.  In same small bowl, add tea and spread a generous teaspoon of nigella on top of the cheese.  Place sprouts in microwave safe baking dish with remaining cheese.  Cook on high for 4 minutes, or until sprouts are tender and cheese has melted.

title: Tomato Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 6 large firm tomatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon sliced peeled fresh ginger
instructions: Combine the ginger slices and tomatoes into a blender.  Blend until mixture is smooth.  Bring to a boil, and simmer 10 minutes.  Serve immediately over hot cooked rice.

title: Traditional Mince and Ricotta Salads
ingredients: 500 g minced mutton | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 50 g black olives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well with a large knife, until well combined.  Chill mixture for approximately half an hour before using.  Use 2 desert spoons dipped in cold water to divide the mixture.  Using the back of a spoon, spread the salami or sausage mixture into a circular shape.  Cook mince in batches and brown in a hot frying pan.  Serve alongside cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,parmesan cheese,chicken bouillon cube,seasoning salt,peanut,baguette,beef chuck roast
title: Peanut and Beef Sandwiches with Parmesan Croutons
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( i have a butcher who cut the meat into 8 small loaves and a butcher who does not like to slice the whole roast ) | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped or 2 tablespoons peanuts ( or two ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | seasoning salt | cayenne pepper | 4 crusty baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to place the roast in the bottom of an oven proof skillet which has been sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray or oil.  Sprinkle the meat with the chopped peanuts or a combination of the above suggested ingredients.  Top with a sprinkling of the parmesan.  Pour all but about 1/2 of the broth onto the pan drippings.  Rub the remaining broth over the top.  Sprinkle with the season salt, cayenne and a little more of the parmesan on top.  Bake in a preheated oven for 45 50min until the sauce is bubbling.  While it bakes, remove the roast from the oven and slice thinly, to serve.  If you have enough time to spare/prep the broth, place roast on baking sheet and tent tightly with foil and bake for about 1 hour. .  Remove foil and cook for another 15 minute.  Remove roast from oven and allow it to rest for about 20 more minutes before slicing thinly.  You want the meat to be warmed through and very, very hot.  Cut baguette into slices, 1/3 of an inch wide.  Arrange half the meat on the side.  Arrange sliced baguette on the meat, with the remaining meat on the side.  Place shredded parmesan on top, and return to oven for 5 minute, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Let sit for 10 minutes.

title: Tex Mex Pinto Bean Dip
ingredients: 3 cans pinto beans ( or black beans ) | ice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grapeseed oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red pepper powder
instructions: If beans are dry, add more water, 1/4 cup at a time.  Cover and cook for about 1 hour.  Drain the whole can of beans and rinse in cold water. .  Add the grapeseed oil and red pepper powder to beans and mix well.  Set aside.  Can be eaten hot or cold.  Can garnish with lime wedges.

title: Grilled Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 lb turkey | 1 lb chicken thigh
instructions: Grill.  Place in a ziploc bag and marinade them for 2 hours in the refrigerator.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Put a little smoke in the bag and put in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes until juices run clear.

title: Spanish Shrimp Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound jumbo shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails removed | 1 cup chopped pine nuts | 2 packages tortillas | 3 cups confectioners'sugar, or more as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook shrimp in boiling water until bright pink, about 3 minutes.  Drain.  Shred shrimp and set aside.  Spray a skillet with cooking spray.  Heat the skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in pine nuts.  When lightly toasted and fragrant, stir in the shrimp and tortillas.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,dill,balsamic vinegar,plain flour,half cream
title: Kosher Halva
ingredients: 8 ounces half-and-half cream, warmed | 1 ounce plain flour | 1 -2 teaspoon dill, finely chopped or 1 small dill sprig | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | balsamic vinegar, for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees.  Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and mix well.  Bring to the boil, and reduce heat to medium to medium low and simmer until thickened, but still slightly warm, about 10 minutes.  Cool to room temperature before adding the drizzle.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Andreas Viestad's French-Style Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs white pearl onions | 1/2 cup molasses | 3 cups parsnips, shredded | 4 garlic cloves, roughly chopped | 1 jar vodka | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Simmer pearl onions in 2 cups water for 20 minutes, drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, place molasses in a deep frying pan and bring to a boil.  Boil for 10 minutes, then lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes.  Remove onions and mash with a potato masher until smooth.  To assemble, add 1 cup of parsnips and stir.  Add 3 cloves of garlic, parsnip mash, vodka and sesame oil.  Toss with the noodles until coated.

title: French Quarter Apple and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup papaya, peeled, cubed | 1 cup apple, cubed | 1 cup fresh grape | 1 celery rib | 1/2 cup fresh herb, minced, i use a mix of chervil, peppercorn, oregano, chives, tarragon | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Mix everything together.  Pour over salad, cover and chill.  Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

title: Easy Black Beans in a Sweet Pot
ingredients: 2 cans black beans ( washed and drained ) | 1 cup chicken broth or 1 cup canned chicken broth | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | cumin
instructions: Strain undrained black beans and reserve liquid.  In a medium saucepan, stir in remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Bring to boil.  Cover, reduce heat.

title: Somali Sauce - Moroccan Tomato Ketchup
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe plum tomatoes, cut into 3/8 inch slices | 1 tablespoon harissa, a few teaspoons hot | 3 large egg yolks
instructions: Mix the egg yolks with a little of the water for a thick paste and stir into the tomato mixture.  Simmer sauce for 20 minutes.  Serve at room temperature or covered and refrigerated.  Note, alternatively you can puree the sauce, but not as smooth over cooked vegetables.  I prefer to do this at home.

title: Rice Au Papet - Simple French Rice
ingredients: 2 cups white rice | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 -2 bouquet garni or 1 -2 mushroom, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse rice.  Heat a large pot to very hot, then add the rice and fry it for a few seconds, or until it starts to brown.  Pour the entire contents into the pot with the bouquet garni or mushrooms to serve.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Simmer until all the liquid is absorbed and some of the rice grains start to turn golden, about 20 minutes.  Turn off heat and let sit for about 10 minutes.  Mix the 3 tbsp cornstarch with a bit of water and stir into the rice.

title: Easy Beef Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced red onion | 1/2 cup minced fresh shallot | 1 jar beef gravy | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together onion, shallots, gravy, lime juice, and parmesan cheese.  Place beef tenderloin in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Pour marinade over beef.  Cover dish with plastic wrap.  Cover dish, and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.  Preheat oven to 180 degrees f.  Remove meat from marinade, and coat with additional parmesan cheese if desired.  Cook in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until meat is firm.

title: The Real Barley & Sultana Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 cup white or barley brown sugar ( 250g ) | 300 g sultanas | 1 pinch dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 100 g walnuts, roasted
instructions: Put barley in the microwave oven, place on lid.  Cover & cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turn half way, cook for an extra 1 to 2 minutes if using brown sugar.  Drain barley and beans, leave to cool.  Slice sultanas into quarters, remove seeds and set aside.  Mix sugar, vinegar & walnuts, sprinkle over barley & beans, toss.  Enjoy.

title: Moroccan Spiced Olive Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil, warmed | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour olive oil into a glass measuring cup, and sprinkle with about a pinch of cayenne pepper to taste.  If there is no such thing, use a pinch of cayenne pepper.

title: Spicy Mashed Blackberrie Dip
ingredients: 1 pound lean blackberrie | 4 ounces thickly flavored chunky salsa ( your favorite, i like to use the chipotle pepper cheese chunky salsa ) | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash and dry the blackberrie.  Cut the block into 6 or 8 serving sized pieces and put into a large bowl.  Toss with the salsa and let sit while preparing the salad.  Make the syrup by mixing the vinegar with the balsamic, and pour over the blackberrie, toss well until coated.  Serve with vegetables, crackers, or bread slices.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,black pepper,golden raisin,mango powder,red pepper
title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons red pepper | 3 tablespoons dried mango powder | 2 tablespoons ground black pepper
instructions: Place the rice, raisins, red pepper, mango powder, and black pepper in a large bowl.  Toss until evenly coated with the dressing.  Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or serve cold.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,milk ricotta cheese,corn tortilla,yellow onion,canadian bacon
title: Bacon and Mexican Ricotta Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1 package shredded whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, chopped ( about 3 ounces ) | 4 medium corn tortillas, torn into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup self-rising flour ( divided )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f.  Lightly grease two 9 inch round cake pans.  In a large bowl, combine onion.  Using 1/2 cup of the ricotta cheese, mix in 1/2 cup of the bacon and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt.  Spread half of the cheese mixture evenly over bottom of each dish.  Repeat with remaining cheese mixture, bacon and salt.  Sprinkle half of the bread mixture evenly over the cheese.  Arrange tortilla pieces over cheese layers, overlapping to fit if necessary.  Repeat wrapping layering, ending with cheese on top and covering with plastic wrap.  Bake for 40 minutes.  Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before cutting.  Serve warm or cool.  Note, if using regular ricotta cheese, you may need to add more 1½ - 2 teaspoons of water to compensate.

title: Basmati-Rice Pilav
ingredients: 300 -400 g basmati rice ( rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons chives ( fresh finely chopped )
instructions: Cook the rice as per its directions.  Leave to cool whilst preparing rest of meal.  Mix rice with chives and chillies to serve.

Random Ingredients: gold tequila,swiss chard,cornflour,buttermilk,apple juice,vegetable oil peanut,sesame seed,dijon mustard
title: Citrus Swiss Chard With Buttermilk
ingredients: 3/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup reserved cooking liquid | 1/3 cup golden tequila | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 lbs swiss chard, cleaned ( or baby spinach ) | 3/4 cup buttermilk ( to cover )
instructions: Combine applejuice and reserved apple liquid in a small, heavy saucepan.  Whisk in tequila, cornflour, sesame seeds and dijon until combined.  Place chard in a colander over a bowl, coating with the liquid.  Let sit until chard is wilted, about 2 minutes.  Rinse chard well with cold water, drain well and transfer to large pot of boiling salted water.  Simmer, covered, until chard is crisp tender, about 12 minutes, and drain.  Whisk buttermilk into chard until incorporated.  Stir chard, then taste for seasonings.  Pour chard into a shallow dish.  Chill, covered in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Mexican Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 bag tortilla | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Mix and eat.

title: Orange and Pork Broccoli
ingredients: 2 orange peel, in rounds | 1 bay seasoning packet | 5 ounces fresh pork loin, cut into 2-inch squares | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Line a large baking sheet with foil or parchment paper.  Cut 2 circles from orange peel using a vegetable peeler, taking care to remove all of the white peel and white pith.  Toss orange peel with bay seasoning and 1/2 the pork pieces in large bowl.  Spread the orange and pork strips evenly over the orange strips and bake on prepared baking sheet for 12 - 15 minutes or until the pork is cooked through and beginning to brown.

title: Easy No Can Be Guacamole Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar red enchilada sauce ( plain or flavored ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Combine ingredients and shake until well combined.

title: Shrimp, Shrimp and Yellow Squash Goya Enchilada
ingredients: 1 teaspoon shrimp, peeled, deveined and chopped | 1 yellow squash, chopped | 1 radish, diced | 1 dash baking soda | 1 dash freshly grated nutmeg | 24 inches 10-inch fresh gumbo-corn flour tortillas
instructions: Cook shrimp in a small skillet with olive oil from a jar with a 1/2 teaspoon of salt over medium heat, stirring often, about 3 minutes, until just pink, about 1 minute.

title: Mushrooms & Swisswafers
ingredients: 500 g white mushrooms, wiped clean | 2 cups self-rising flour, sifted | 1 cup walnuts, roasted, chopped | 12 cups romaine lettuce, washed, spun dry and torn.
instructions: Place the mushrooms, flour and nuts in a bowl.  Knead until combined, place in a plastic bag with plenty of excess air and seal.  Divide the mixture into 12 balls, one small and one large.  Roll each one between your hands to flatten the surface.  Repeat with the remaining mixture and allow to dry on a clean tea towel lined baking tray for 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 220c.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until browned.  Stand 5 minutes before serving with your favourite salad and cheese fraiche.

title: Chilean Lemongrass and Vinegar Seasoning
ingredients: 12 cups sliced lemongrass | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1 teaspoon saffron thread, crumbled | 1/3 cup bottled picante sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh spring onion | 1/3 cup coarse sea salt | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | peppercorn, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine lemongrass, 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt, 1 teaspoon saffron threads and picante sauce in heavy medium saucepan.  Bring to boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low.  Cover and simmer until fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cool to room temperature.  Transfer lemongrass and 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt to heavy medium bowl.  Add 1 to 2 tablespoons warm water.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,allspice,american cheese,lemon juice,vegetable oil,arborio rice,chili,ghee butter
title: Spicy Ghee Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 slices bacon bits | 1 teaspoon chili | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 mexican cheese or 2 edam cheese, cubes | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 teaspoons ghee ( not clarified butter )
instructions: Heat oil in pan over medium heat.  Cook bacon bits until crisp.  Remove from skillet and place in a bowl.  Heat bacon grease in same skillet.  Add rice and stir fry until white.  Add seasoning and vegetable oil.  When there is no more juice in the skillet, toss in chilis, allspice and cheese cubes, stirring until cheese begins to melt.  Add bacon bits, cheese and lemon juice.  Serve.

title: Swiss Cheese Dipping Dip
ingredients: 200 g swiss cheese, grated | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup veggie crumbles ( i use morningstar farms veggie delice ) | crushed ice
instructions: Place cheese, spring onion, crumbled veggie crumbles, crushed ice and some crushed ice in a bowl, mix well.  Place in fridge for at least an hour minimum.  Serve with crackers.

title: Rice Wedges With Seasoned Mozzarella
ingredients: 4 -6 rosemary sprigs | 1 package mccormick� taco seasoning | 2 cups mexican rice or 2 cups cooked rice | 1 - 1 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Place the sprigs in a large bowl.  Remove the sprigs from the bowl and using hands, rub the seasoning over half of them.  Let sit 30 minutes. instructions: Drain liquid from meat if any.  Put meat and bones in the bottom of your pan and dump liquid inches.  Add all other ingredients.  Add broth to top, and mix ingredients until all ingredients are mixed inches.  Cover with a towel and leave in a warm place until bread is double.  Make bread to rise slowly in the pan.  Cook until bread is double about 45 - 60 minutes depending on your pan.  I usually bake 30 - 60 min at 350, sometimes lower the range to 325 and cook 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Avocado Appetizer
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados | 6 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup black peppercorns | 1/3 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: Cut avocado in half, remove pit, scoop out avocados with a spoon, and discard.  Combine 2 avocados with prosciutto, sherry, peppercorns and cilantro.  Garnish with sliced tomato.

title: Savoury Oil Sauce for French Fries
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon spices, spice world | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon of natural ale or 1/2 teaspoon sparkling wine | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup icing sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the oil, spices and 1/2 t of the cheese until a smooth paste forms.  Stir all the liquids from the bottle into the spice and cheese mixture.  Using a fork, combine all of the ingredients in a small saucepan.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, and cook until the mixture thickens slightly.  Sauce can also be thinned with a bit of milk or cream.  Pour into large, clean tupperware dish and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let excess oil drip off.  Serve with french fries, bread cubes, puffs, icecream, etc.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,green olive,pineapple juice,kaffir lime leaf,spaghetti,vanilla ice cream,ice water
title: Pineapple Green Cabbage and Olive Nests
ingredients: 3 ounces spaghetti | ice water | 1 -2 tablespoon ice water | 1 green cabbage, shredded | 8 -10 slices pineapple with juice, drained | 8 -10 green olives, sliced ( i use pimento stuffed olives ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves, crushed ( optional )
instructions: For the noodles in a pot of well salted boiling water set the heat for maximum time and you don't need to boil.  For the nests in a large pan bring the spaghetti to the boil and add 1 - 2 t ice water and cook for 10 - 12 minutes until the noodles are cooked.  Drain and refresh in cold water then drain again.  Heat remaining 1 t of olive oil in a large frypan over medium high heat.  Stir fry the cabbage for 5 - 6 minutes.  Add the sauteed cabbage and pineapple.  Top the pile with the olives and lime leaves.  Add the noodles.  Top with lots of black pepper.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ring bologna,cod fillet,jalapeno chilies,red cabbage,greek yogurt,white vinegar,szechwan pepper
title: Cod Fish With Pickled Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage ( about 1 lb., or more ) | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 lb cod fillet ( or more ) | 1 -2 jalapeno chilies ( or more ) | 1/2 cup toasted greek yogurt | 1/4 cup prepared pickled red cabbage, cut into thin shreds ( about 12-14 small ) | 1/4 cup diagonally sliced pickled red cabbage, for topping | 1/4 cup pickled jalapeno chilies ( or more )
instructions: Cut the head from the cabbage.  Trim away as much of the hard stem and core as you can.  Cut the cabbage into large chunks about the size of a large cherry.  Place into a colander in the sink and sprinkle liberally with salt, shaking well to remove any excess moisture.  Set aside the colander.  In a deep 6 to 8 quart pot, combine the vinegar and salt to taste in 1/2 of the water.  Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.  Add the cod and simmer, uncovered, for about 5 minutes.  Do not overcook, or the fish will be tough.  Remove the fish from the heat and let completely cool in the liquid.  Cut the fish into 1 inch pieces.  Halve the jalapenos.  Cut them in half if your chiles are large.  In a small serving bowl, combine the yogurt and the drained cabbage.  Cut the cod into 1 inch pieces and toss with the yogurt mixture.  Taste and adjust the salt, adding more vinegar or vinegar as needed.  Line a plate with plastic wrap and arrange the fish slices on the plate.  Top with the remaining yogurt mixture and top with the pickled cabbage.  Place the pickled red cabbage on the platter and serve with hot pepper pickle and pickled red cabbage, if desired.

title: Chipotle Garlic Roasted Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: In a medium size bowl, dissolve the beef bouillon and ginger in the hot beef bouillon mixture.  Add the chilies and continue to stir until evenly coated.  Heat the oven to 375°f remove the gingerroot and onion from the bowl and place the onion on a rimmed baking sheet.  Bake the onions until they are beginning to caramelize, 20 to 25 minutes or just until they are glazed and lightly browned.  Stir the caramel from the edges every 5 to 10 minutes and be patient.

title: Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 12 small corn oil ( lard or butter ) | 3/4 cup white vinegar | 2 1/4 cups cornflour | 1 piece lemon peel, finely shredded | 6 allspice berries
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of the oil in a pan until simmering.  Reduce heat and add cornflour, stirring well.  Simmer for 2 minutes or until thickened.  Add the remaining oil.  Remove from heat and stir in the lemon peel.  Add allspice berries and toss to mix.

title: Quick and Easy Escarole Escarole
ingredients: 6 heads escarole | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Trim the ends from the escarole, then place in a large pot with about 1 gallon water.  Cover, and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,mustard,poblano chile,taco seasoning,green chilies,dark brown sugar
title: Fantastic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar apricot jam | 1/2 package taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons dry mustard | 1 can green chilies | 1 can poblano chiles, drained
instructions: Mix jam, taco seasoning, brown sugar, dry mustard and chilies together in a large bowl.  Spoon into an oven proof skillet coated with cooking spray.  Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 45 minutes.  To serve, top with pepper.

title: Macaroni Cheese With Pimentos
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 1/2 lb green peas | 1/2 lb macaroni weight tri-colored spirals | 1/2 lb red peppers or 1/2 lb pimiento stuffed olive, sliced | 1/3 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced, drained | 1 teaspoon powdered turmeric | 2 tablespoons green pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 2 teaspoons dry white wine | 2 teaspoons msg
instructions: Boil your macaroni so it is tender.  Drain and cool.  To prepare the cheese mix the cheese ingredients in a food processor.  If it is too soft, add more cheese.  Mix all the veggies together, and then set aside.  Boil macaroni until tender.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 8 slices rye bread | 1 teaspoon black cumin seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the yogurt and cumin seeds together.  Cut the rye bread into cubes.  Spoon onto a cutting board, and spread with the yogurt mixture to coat.  Sprinkle on some salt.  Cut a slit along the side of the cheese to show how far the cumin has taken up the yogurt.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,shaoxing wine,date,queso fresco,chili pepper flake
title: Chilli Oil (For Beef and Eggs)
ingredients: 200 g beef bouillon cubes ( cube is important in this recipe ) | 200 g shaoxing wine | 100 g chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 200 g queso fresco ( or any other hard cheese of choice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili pequins ( or other dried dates )
instructions: Wash your blender well then blend the liquids in it.  If you have a mortar and pestle you can use a blender if you don't have the time.  Keep all the solids inside the blender till beef is ground up.  Now it is time to add the queso fresco by pouring it through a sieve into another bowl.  Then add the chilies and chili flakes by pouring through a sieve.  Pour the chilies and chili flakes through a sieve or a fine mesh sieve.  Once ground up, you should be able to form small patties out of this, then you can add your chili oil.  Note, the consistency of your oil determines the thickness of the patties.  By reducing the quantity, you reduce the quantity of oil and the thickness of the oil.  However you prefer, once your oil is reduced, you can adjust the thickness of your oil depending on the thickness of the oil and therefore, your oil will not be as thick as when you cut a steak.

Random Ingredients: white corn tortilla,corn syrup,sun tomato oil,mozzarella cheese
title: Corn tortilla Sandies
ingredients: 4 white corn tortillas or 4 mexican-style corn tortillas, cut in half | 12 -16 ounces sour cream or 12 -16 ounces sour cream | 6 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 6 -12 teaspoons corn syrup, to dip tortillas | sun-dried tomato oil
instructions: Cut your corn tortillas in half.  Take one half of the tortilla and place on a clean cutting board and slice the corn tortilla into a circle or triangle with your sharp knife or razor blade.  Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Place the tortilla circle on the cookie sheet and spray with nonstick cooking spray again.  After you make your tortilla crumbs, spread the remaining cheese on top of the crumb/cheese mixture.  Place in the freezer for about 15 minutes to firm.  When it is all frozen use a fork and remove it from the freezer.  Take a toothpick and poke all over the cheese and set aside.  Now cut your tortilla circle or triangles into 3 or 4 squares and place on the cookie sheet.  After ten minutes, put a dollop of sour cream on top of each square.  Add a layer of crumbs on top of the sour cream.  Then put another layer of crumbs on top of the sour cream.  Then put another layer of crumbs.  Put another four square of sour cream over the sour cream.  After five minutes, put another four square of sour cream over the sour cream.  Finally, put another four square of sour cream over the sour cream. .  Add another layer of crumbs to the sour cream.  Repeat the layers, ending with sour cream.  Spray a frying pan with nonstick cooking spray and put in your corn tortillas.  Cook them on a medium hot fire until they are golden brown on each side.  Turning each one while.  Remove on paper towels to drain excess fat.  Garnish with chopped tomato oil.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,squid,amaretto,cooking apple,chuck roast,cayenne pepper,grainy mustard
title: Southern Style Beef With Calamans
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 2 large cooking apples ( peeled cored and sliced ) | 4 tablespoons amaretto ( light cream sauce or half and half will do ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Season the chuck roast with the desired amount of a liberal amount of salt and pepper.  Brown the chuck roast on all sides in a skillet.  When browned slightly transfer it to a 4 qt.  Slow cooker.  In a bowl, toss the sliced apples together with the amaretto to coat well.  Then add the apple mixture to the pot with the meat and turn it all in the apples and amaretto.  The amaretto will do just about anything that will melt the apple and spice.  Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.  Add a dash of salt and cayenne pepper and taste.  Simmer for additional 20 to 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and cool.  Skim any impurities that rise to the top and discard.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chinese rice wine,green pepper,water chestnut,active yeast,taco seasoning mix,peanut butter,pumpkin
title: Pumpkin Filled Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces active dry yeast ( rapid-rise ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter, creamy is best | 2 cups warm water | 1 2/3 cups cooked ground pumpkin | 1 can green peppers, diced | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained | 1 package taco seasoning mix | chinese-style rice wine, for dipping
instructions: Heat oven to 500°f.  Sprinkle a round baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.  In small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water.  Stir in peanut butter and remove 1 cup of the wet ingredients.  Add to yeast mixture and beat with 1 cup of the chicken broth.  Stir in remaining broth, pumpkin, green pepper, water chestnuts, and taco seasoning mix.  Transfer filling to baking pan.  Brush tops with wine.  Cover and let rise in warm spot until puffy, about 30 - 60 minutes.  Bake, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Cut in squares if desired.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,lemon juice zest,yellow pepper,ladyfinger,paprika,orange juice apple,baby spinach,lime wedge
title: Prawn and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb large raw shrimp | 1/2 small baby spinach | 3 ounces ladyfingers | 1 red, yellow pepper, julienned | 1 orange, juice and zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | paprika | orange wedge
instructions: Wash the shrimp, remove the heads but leave just the shells.  Rinse well in cold water.  Shell and devein the shrimp.  Toss together with all other ingredients.  Serve at once or store in the fridge for up to 5 days. .

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,cocoa,romaine lettuce,ginger paste,green chili pepper,cream mushroom soup
title: Mushroom, Ginger & Green Chili Salmon
ingredients: 3 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 5 tablespoons onions, minced | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 5 canned jalapenos packed in oil, drained ( i usually leave them out ) | 1 -2 green chili pepper, chopped ( depending on how spicy you like it )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a non reactive bowl and mix until well blended.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Season the salmon on both sides with the ginger paste and place in the pan.  Cook until brown, about 5 - 7 minutes per side depending on how crispy you want it.  Place cooked salmon on top of the veggies.  Use a slotted spoon to add the green chili peppers on top of the salmon and veggies.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,cooking spray,mandarin orange,lemon juice,szechuan peppercorn,garlic clove,brewer yeast,baking powder
title: Chinese Mandarin Orange Peel Bread
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 packages refrigerated yeast or ( 2 3/4 ounce ) packages fast rising yeast | 1/2 teaspoon cracked szechuan peppercorns | 1 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 4 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  Spray a 9x5 loaf pan with cooking spray.  Combine grand marnier, yeast, and peppercorns in a small, heavy nonmetal bowl and set aside.  Combine flour, baking powder, lemon juice and garlic in a large bowl.  Add dry ingredients to yeast mixture and beat until well mixed.  Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour.  Let cool in pan for about 15 minutes.  Turn out onto rack and cool completely.  Slice and serve.

title: Artichoke Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped ( 2 cups ) | 2/3 cup ketchup | 1 package pre- baked flour tortillas | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat combine the artichoke hearts, ketchup and pepper.  Stir frequently until heated through.  Spread 1/2 cup artichoke mixture on one side of a tortilla, and top with about 1/2 tablespoon artichoke mixture and 1/2 tablespoon ketchup for each tortilla.  Fold two tortillas together, enclosing the filling and pressing them together in the tortilla around the edges so they are not folded too tightly.  Repeat with the remaining tortillas, filling and ketchup mixture.  Place quesadillas onto a greased grill over medium high heat.  When both sides are slightly toasted on the bottom, carefully flip and top with remaining ketchup mixture.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,corn oil,baby back pork rib,cajun seasoning,plum tomato,manicotti
title: Pernil-Style Piggy Spuds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 sheet frozen baby back pork ribs | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 cans plum tomatoes, chopped & seeded | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 16 manicotti, cooked
instructions: Heat sesame oil and brush on the bottom of a large saucepan coated with cooking spray.  Place the ribs into the pan and add the corn oil.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, turn ribs over and cook for an additional 3 minutes.  Turn off heat and stir in 1 can of tomatoes with juice and cajun seasoning.  Cover tightly and set aside to allow flavors to mesh for about 30 minutes or longer.  While the sauce is simmering, cook pasta to desired temperature and drain.  Pour sauce mixture over the cooked pasta and toss to coat all ingredients.  Adjust the seasoning for taste.  Set the sauce aside to allow flavors to blend.  Serve or refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,head iceberg lettuce,coriander seed,black peppercorn
title: Homemade Hot Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorns | 1 head iceberg lettuce, cored and shredded | 1 package sweet italian turkey sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Grind coriander and peppercorns in a spice grinder set over small bowl.  Stir shredded lettuce into biscuit crumbs using your fingers until coarsely ground.  Place sausage slices in a large bowl.

title: Tofu Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, undrained, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup diced mango chutney, heated | 3 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons diced dried fruits, plump, dried or fresh
instructions: Place tofu on a serving platter or dinner plate.  Top with mango chutney, parsley and fruit.  Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight for flavors to develop.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  and Garlic
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled ( the thin skinned ends intact, and the ends trimmed ) | 1/2 cup sherry | 2 tablespoons garlic paste ( or 2 minced large cloves )
instructions: Cut out the core of the eggplants.  Remove the tops and any browned outer layers from the eggplants, discard them.  Cut each eggplant lenghtwise but not through their skins into 1/4 thick slices.  Slice each slice crosswise into 3 rounds.  Heat a medium oven proof skillet and add sherry over medium heat.  When it begins to boil add garlic and cook for about 1 minute.  Add sliced eggplant slices and cook, turning occasionally, until the eggplant slices are browned and cooked through.  Sprinkle with the garlic paste and serve immediately.

title: Scotch Sweet Sausage and Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 package italian sausage | 1 package rolled whole wheat flour | 1 package regular-size shredded romaine lettuce | 1 teaspoon molasses
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Prick the sausages with a fork and cook until nicely browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Place the sausage on a plate and cover to keep warm.  Pour off grease.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 8x8 inch baking dish with a little olive oil.  Stir together the flour and ground Romaine lettuce in a bowl.  Stir in the molasses.  Stir in the sausages.  Spoon the mixture onto the lettuce and mix well.  Roll up each warm roll and place seam side down in the prepared baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Open the wrap and spread a dollop of yogurt into the middle of each roll.

title: Foolproof Corned Beef and Poblano Chili
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corned beef brisket, finely chopped | 1 lb dried fava beans, preferably california green beans | ice, as required | 1 poblano chiles or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded, cut into thin strips and blotted with a kitchen spoon
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a large casserole dish, cover and cook over moderate heat for 2 hours.  Alternatively, cook covered in a 325 degree oven for 2 hours.  Remove from heat and serve over ice.  Garnish with shredded cheese.

title: Quick Coconut Snack Bars
ingredients: 2 packages frozen margarine or 2 packages butter cookies, crusts removed | 2 cups shredded sweetened coconut | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon rind, minced fine
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  In medium bowl, stir margarine or butter cookies, coconut and lemon rind until well blended.  Press mixture evenly into 1 1/2 quart greased 13x9x2 inch baking pan.  Bake 18 to 22 minutes or until edges are golden.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,corn,basil leaf,red potato,cherry,white corn tortilla,meat
title: Holiday Tacos and Vegetables
ingredients: 12 white corn tortillas | 1 lb ground meat | 1 can solid white corn | 1 can cherry tomatoes | 1 package frozen yellow corn kernels | 1 cup fresh basil leaf, rolled and tied | 18 bamboo skewers
instructions: To grill meat, place meat and vegetables in a saucepan, cover and cook over medium high to high heat.  Cover until meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  While meat is cooking, wrap tortillas in foil, heat in oven for 10 minutes.  Remove meat, vegetables and nuts from pan.  Slice.  Place meat on a plate, place in bowl with cheese and toss gently.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,apple juice,sun tomato oil,dark chicken meat,romaine lettuce leaf,chicken breast
title: Pounded Chicken Gyros
ingredients: 1/4 pound thinly sliced cooked chicken breast | 1/4 pound thinly sliced pepperoni | 1/4 pound chopped, partially frozen sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 3/4 cup apple juice | 4 romaine lettuce leaves | 12 pinches dark fried chicken roll ( optional )
instructions: Set 4 sheets of wax paper on a flat surface.  Press 1/3 of the chicken and pepperoni together in a small, flat dish.  Divide the sun dried tomato slices between the two sheets of wax paper.  Add 1/4 of the apple juice, 1/4 of the celery, and 1/4 of the onion.  Stir to combine.  Wrap up the remaining 2 sheets of wax paper.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,garlic salt,chili powder,orange flower water,black bean,pork sausage,marinara sauce
title: Mexican Pork Sausages & Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork sausage ( i use spicy ) | 1 can black beans | 1 garlic clove | 1 teaspoon marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Brown the sausage.  Pour off excess fat, add the beans, garlic, marinara, orange flower water, chilli powder and garlic salt.  Let simmer over low for 2 1/2 hours.  Serve over your favourite chips.

title: Lentils and Apples (Ribollita)
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 2 small tart apples, eggras | 1 can refrigerated biscuits | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur
instructions: Cook lentils in a large saucepan until tender, around 45 minutes or slightly al dente.  Cool a small piece of biscuit at the edge of a double thickness of paper towels and gently press the biscuit through it with a spatula to flatten.  Cut apples in to bite sized pieces.  Remove biscuits and apples and spread on a tray with a thin layer of amaretto.  Sprinkle each biscuit with a little more amaretto and press it into the tart apple mixture.  Place cookies, apple and onion in layers on the top of tart apple mixture.  Cut remaining biscuits into thin slices and arrange on top to create a border around the filled biscuits.  Refrigerate for as long as possible.  Cut into quarters and serve.  You can also use a biscuit cutter to cut out any large biscuits you may not use.

title: Chile French Bread With Grilled Bread and Limes
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 slices french bread | 4 sprigs fresh red chile peppers, split into rings | 4 thin slices of canned limes
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Tear bread in four and place on the grill.  Grill bread for 2 to 3 minutes, or just about 5 minutes on each side.  Toast chiles and limes in a dry skillet over medium high heat, stirring often, until the chiles are fragrant and lightly flavored with the chiles.  Remove from heat.  Spread limes on toast, top with grilled bread slices and garnish with roasted chiles and lime wedges.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,gruyere cheese,broccoli floret,farfalle pasta,pepper sauce,sun tomato oil
title: Bow Tie Pasta with Gruyere and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked bow tie pasta | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 12 minutes.  Drain.  Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water.  Pour buttermilk into a skillet, and heat over medium heat until steaming.  Pour buttermilk with 1/2 cup reserved pasta water into the skillet.  Bring to a boil.  Remove from heat, and simmer until heated through, 5 to 7 minutes.  Stir in the cheese with hot pepper sauce, sun dried tomatoes, and broccoli.  Toss with hot cooked pasta to serve.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,black pepper,potato starch,orange food coloring,margarine
title: Spiced Penne With Orange and Potato Starch
ingredients: 3/4 lb sweet potato starch | 1 pint orange food coloring | 1/4 cup margarine | fresh ground black pepper | 1 lb fresh penne pasta, cooked al dente
instructions: Boil water in large saucepan, add potato starch while still hot.  Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, stirring frequently to avoid lumps.  Lower heat, add in food coloring, margarine, and pepper and simmer slowly until mixture has thickened, stirring frequently.  Cook pasta according to package directions, drain when al dente.

title: Mexican Green Beans with Cilantro
ingredients: 1/2 lb raw green beans, cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces | 2 cans reduced-sodium fat-free beef broth | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: Place green beans in a 3 qt crockpot.  Top with beef broth and cilantro leaves, cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours.  Note, the cilantro can also be added to a chili or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: white bread,dog bun,italian breadcrumb,greek pita bread,vanilla sugar,mace,green cardamom pod
title: Greek-Style Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 12 hot dog buns, sliced into half | 3/4 cup greek style pita bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup fresh italian flavored breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup plain white bread, cubed | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, lightly crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°.  Line an ovenproof pan with foil.  Place the hot dog rolls on the foil and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the bread is dry and crumbly.  Set aside.  Place the bread pieces in a food processor or blender.  Pulse until coarsely ground.  Stir in the pita, bread crumbs, white bread, brown sugar, vanilla sugar, and cardamom pods.  Pulse until just combined.  Transfer to a serving dish or shallow baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours.  Cut into four wedges.

title: A.1.R.O. Soup With Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cold cooked rice | 4 cups cold cooked quinoa | 8 maraschino cherries, cut in half | 1 teaspoon dried sage, crushed | 5 cans chicken breast, undrained | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 bottle vodka | 3 tablespoons fat-free reduced-sodium bacon-flavored topping
instructions: Combine cold and quinoa and rice in large pot and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.

title: Steamed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 lb pork butt, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs ribs of beef | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 can beer or ( 440 ml ) can beef broth | 1/2 lb fresh asparagus tips
instructions: In a medium sized pot, simmer the meat cubes in water for about 35 minutes, or until tender.  Remove, drain and set aside in a large mixing bowl.  Add asparagus tips and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until just tender crisp.  Slice the beef into thin strips and set aside in a bowl.  Add the meat, fat and the beer to the meat and stir until meat is coated.  Place meat slices in a steaming basket and steam for about 20 minutes.  Use the reserved meat fat to saute the asparagus in a skillet.  To serve, place some cooked asparagus on a plate and pour some cooking juices over the top.  Sprinkle lightly with paprika.

title: Japanese Sushi-Kake
ingredients: 3 medium baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons mirin ( sweet cooking-based cooking sauce )
instructions: Wash and remove the skin from the potatoes.  Slice into large, thin slices.  Arrange on a baking sheet 1 inch above a very hot grill.  Cover with a plate to keep the potatoes under a very hot grill.

title: Nona's Nona's Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 0.5 bottle spaghetti | 1/4 cup grated graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cook the spaghetti however you normally like it and drain when ready.  Mix the baked beans with the graham cracker crumbs.  Make the bi carb soda with a little of the beer from the can.  Mix the soda with a little of the bean/graham cracker mixture.  Dip the bean mix into the beer/graham cracker mixture, drain and enjoy.

title: Sauerkraut, Cabbage & Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut, well rinsed | 2 cups shredded cabbage leaves | 2 cups coarsely shredded mozzarella cheese | 6 ounces dried wafer fettuccine, prepared but very al dente | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground orecchiette, crumbled
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crumbled fettuccine and cheese and place over medium heat.  Cook and stir until sauce coats the fettuccine.  Stir in cheese.  Serve at once.

title: Green Chile Green Chile Float
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 2 cans chopped green chilies ( canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a greased glass or plastic container.  Cover and refrigerator 3 - 4 hours to chill.  Serve with fresh fruit slices.

title: Spicy Ragu Pasta
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta, broken in half | 1 pound frozen pearl onions, thawed | 5 fresh red chile peppers, quartered | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon ground paprika

instructions: Whip eggs with sugar then mix in liqueur.  Add shrimp paste and mix thoroughly.  Put 1/3 of balls into a baking dish and refrigerate before baking until needed.  Bake in a preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes at 400 degrees f.  Drain shrimp paste on paper towel.  Roll balls in shrimp paste then put onto waxed paper until cool.  Chill before serving or freezing.

title: Cabbage and Apple Pork (Pork Cookbook)
ingredients: 1 can pork tenderloin, cut into four thick slices | 4 medium head of cabbage ( sliced thinly ) | 1 small apple ( peeled and chopped ) | 8 ounces spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 2 serrano chilies, deveined and deveined ( i 'd try a whole serrano chile, but you can use one or two for less spice )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet or wok heat the oil until shimmering.  Add the garlic and pork slices.  Fry on one side for about 5 minutes, until browned on the outside, but not dried out.  Turn over and add the cabbage.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until all the cabbage is limp, but slightly softened, about 3 minutes.  Add apple and spinach.  Cook for a minute or two until spinach is wilted.  Taste and add salt, pepper and chili flakes to taste.  Serve in a bowl or on a bed of hot rice.  For vegetarian use only pork meat.

Random Ingredients: chicken,head cauliflower,mint,salt pepper,provolone cheese,mandarin orange,taco shell
title: Crunchy Stuffed Cauliflower With Mandarin-Smoked Pork and Cheese
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, separated into florets | 2 ounces shredded provolone cheese, for topping | 1/4 cup chopped mint | 2 tablespoons minced pickled ginger | 1/4 teaspoon chopped mint | salt and pepper, to taste | 4 taco shells | 1/4 cup mandarin orange slices, for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a baking dish, combine cauliflower, provolone cheese, mint, pickled ginger and chopped mint and season with salt and pepper.  Arrange stuffed cauliflower in one layer on a plate.  Top with taco shells, mandarin oranges and crispy bacon.  Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, until bacon is crispy and cauliflower is soft.

title: Pork Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 quarts pork butt | 1 1/2 quarts pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns, coarsely crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pork butt, pork shoulder, peppercorns, and sugar in a large pot and set over low heat.  Simmer for 2 hours, skimming occasionally.  Remove the pork pieces from the pot and reserve the peppercorns.  Reserve the peppercorns.  Chop and strain the stock.  Let cool to room temperature.  When it's cold, skim off any foam with a spoon or fork and discard the bones.  To serve, pour through a fine sieve and skim off any extra fat or impurities.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,chambord raspberry liquor,spring onion,serrano pepper,white pepper
title: Chambord Roulades
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon spring onion, finely sliced | 1 jalapeno pepper
instructions: If you are using a knife to cut the pepper into fine rings, use a pastry brush to brush the pepper and onion with raspberry liquor.  Place flour, chambord, pepper and onion slices on a board or flat surface and roll the ingredients into a sausage shape.  Roll this mixture over the flour then dip the roulades in the flour and shake well so that the roulades are all coated.  Heat the carbato over a fairly low temperature until very hot, but avoid smoking and allow the roulades to spread evenly.  Serve immediately.

title: Graties or Ghee Oil
ingredients: 2 cups ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 limes, juiced
instructions: Melt the ghee in a deep skillet, over medium heat.  When melted, pour the lime juice into the skillet, and let it get very hot.  Use tongs to carefully pry 1 cup of the melted ghee into the hot ghee.  As many as will float to the top in one layer, the graties will turn a beautiful golden brown brown, and be ready to serve as a side dish with the fried fish.

title: Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 teaspoons yeast | 1/4 cup white rum | 6 cubes fresh stew meat, such as velveeta | 1 lb broccoli, cut into florets | 2 tablespoons cornstarch paste | 12 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 t.  Rum.  Add 1/4 cup of the meat.  Let stand about 10 minutes.  Boil 5 cups of water with the 3 teaspoons salt and 2 teaspoons sugar in a 3 quart saucepan over high heat, stirring occasionally.  Boil beef over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 12 minutes.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes.  Combine the rest of the rum with 1/2 cup water and cornstarch paste in a small bowl and stir well.  Stir into stew mixture in saucepan, add broccoli and cook until the gravy is thickened, about 5 minutes.  Taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary.  Serve with lime wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,yukon gold potato,queso fresco,pineapple juice,cognac,farfalle pasta
title: Chef John's New Orleans Golden Potato and Pineapple-Cognac Macaroon Filled Pasta
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup cognac | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup dry crumbled queso fresco | 4 cups dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/4 cup bourbon ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Swirl in the potatoes, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until they are tender but not completely cooked all the way through, about 20 minutes.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two.  Drain again and cool completely.  Transfer potatoes to a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,garam masala,madeira wine,farfalle pasta,bay leaf
title: Tandoori Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup dry madeira wine | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 pounds farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 teaspoon garam masala, or more to taste | 1 1/2 cups dry bread crumbs
instructions: Combine the madeira, bay leaf, and 1 1/2 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.  Stir in farfalle, and return to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the pasta is tender yet firm, about 12 minutes.  Remove the bay leaf, and stir garam masala into the cooked pasta.  Transfer the pasta to a large serving bowl, and stir bread crumbs into the sauce.  Toss with the pasta.

title: Slow Cooker Jook
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cooked chicken | 1/2 cup prawns, chopped | 1/4 cup ginger ale | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine chicken, prawns, ginger ale, chocolate chips and garam masala in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high setting for 3 hours.

title: Lite Capsicum & Raisin Crumbs
ingredients: 1 green capsicum, finely chopped ( red bell peppers ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 220ºc.  Line a baking tray with baking paper.  Combine capsicum and crumbs in a medium bowl.  Combine baking soda and water in a small jug.  Stir until soda is dissolved.  Gently stir the dry ingredients into the crumbs mixture.  Roll tablespoons of the mixture into balls 2cm in diameter.  Place on baking tray.  Bake on oven shelf for about 15 minutes, until golden.

title: Lebanese Beef Fricassee for the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, 1/2 inch thick | 2 tablespoons mint leaves | 3/4 lb fresh peas or 3/4 lb frozen peas
instructions: Prepare meat by trimming excess fat and grilling.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,extra virgin olive oil,oil,cayenne pepper,cold water,cod
title: Blueberry Cod
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh blueberries ( can sub frozen, thawed ) | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 -4 lbs cod ( about 8 to 10 servings ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cold water | cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place the blueberries in a bowl with enough water to cover and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes.  Drain well and set aside to dry slightly.  Rinse and pat dry the cod.  Season with salt and pepper if desired.  Heat the oil in a large, shallow baking dish then add the cod and cook over high heat for 2 minutes, or until the fish is firm and opaque.  Transfer to a serving dish.  Heat the water to a boil in a small saucepan and add the cayenne pepper.  Place the saucepan over very low heat and stir.  Let cool slightly.  Spoon the blueberry sauce over the fish.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,enchilada sauce,mustard powder,adobo seasoning,thai basil,balsamic vinegar,egg yolk,lettuce
title: Creamy Basil-And-Adobo Tampico Huevos Rancheros
ingredients: 1/4 cup light red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thai basil | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 3/4 lbs lettuce, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon torn fresh basil
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.  Place lettuce leaf in a wide, shallow dish.  In a small bowl, combine the dressing ingredients.  Spoon 3/4 of the sauce over the top of the lettuce, then top with the salad, then top with the remaining sauce.  Sprinkle with basil.  Serve with warm tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,parsley,pear,ra el hanout spice mix,french bread,demi glace,zucchini,green bean
title: Vegetarian Olive & Garlic Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 loaf french bread | 200 g lebanese zucchini or 200 g eggplants | 200 g green beans | 100 g shaved arabic olive | 1/2 cup mixed sprouts ( rocket ) | 2 tablespoons of belgium demi-glace or 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 teaspoon hazelnut kernels or 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/4 teaspoon mr.glace mixed spice mix
instructions: Heat grill to high.  Cut a long piece of aluminium foil, large enough to fit in to a large pan.  Place on the grill, and toast for about 4 - 5 minutes or until golden.  Cut the french bread in half lengthwise and leave to cool completely, then cut diagonally into 3 long wedges.  Scoop out the bread from the loaf into a bowl, leaving 1/2 cm at each end.  Chop zucchini and beans, and place in the bowl with the zucchinis and beans.  Cut olives in half, and add to bowl with zucchini, beans, sprouts, and mr.  Glace.  Toss well, then chill for 20 minutes.  Stir well, then drizzle into the bread, and scatter over nuts.  Serve warm with tomato sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,okonomiyaki flour,cashew,kidney bean,self raising flour,pinto bean,molasses,mace
title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans, drained | 400 g kidney beans, drained | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup mango, chopped | 1 cup cashews, flakey | 1/2 cup molasses ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c mark.  Place beans in a bowl and stir in the lemon zest.  In a small jug combine flour, mango and cashews.  Add to the bowl with the beans and cashew mixture. Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,milk chocolate chip,clam,flour tortilla,red bell pepper,white flour,mango peach salsa
title: Clam-And-Peach Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 small red bell pepper, diced | 12 flour tortillas | 1/4 cup reduced-fat milk chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1/2 cup fresh sourdough bread, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 can chopped clams in juice | 1/2 cup white sweet potato chips | 1 tablespoon finely chopped and seeded fresh mango or 1 tablespoon peach slivers, for garnish
instructions: Combine bell pepper, tortillas, chocolate, flour, and sourdough bread.  Spread on half of the tortilla, then top with clams, then cheese.  Top with remaining tortilla.  Sprinkle mango and peach chips over and around quesadillas.  Grill over medium heat until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Pasta With Bow Tie Dressing
ingredients: 1 box bow tie pasta | 1 container pasta dressing ( any flavor ) | 1 bunch fresh basil
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil.  Add bow tie pasta and stir to loosen.  Cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes.

ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh lemonade | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cups chilled peach slices, about 3 to 5 inches in diameter
instructions: Arrange a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 400 degrees.  Cut 2 shallow slits in the top of each sea bass fillet, being careful not to cut into the flesh.  Sprinkle with salt.  Arrange fillets on an aluminum foil lined baking sheet.  Roast the fish for 10 to 15 minutes, or until it flakes easily when tested with a fork.  Drain off any excess juices.  Combine mustard, lemonade and 1/3 cup of the cilantro in a small bowl.

title: Vanilla Russian Bread
ingredients: 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, softened | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 3 cups flour | 1/4 ounce yeast
instructions: Cream the margarine or butter until it is creamy.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,orange bell pepper,red bell pepper,chili paste,salmon steak,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,cardamom,gelatin
title: Smoked Salmon Terrine
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared mustard seed | 1 ounce unflavored gelatin | 2 oranges, bell peppers, diced | 2 red bell peppers, diced | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 2 teaspoons tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 24 ounces salmon steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place mustard seeds in a small skillet and toast them over medium heat, stirring constantly, until they pop.  Remove seeds from skillet and grind together with a mortar and pestle.  Reserve the mustard oil and refrigerate the mustard powder.  In a large bowl, with a strainer over a bowl, combine mustard powder, 1 ounce of the reserved mustard oil, the bell peppers, chili paste, tabasco sauce, cardamom, and mustard seeds.  Mix well with a spoon.  Arrange salmon in an 11x7 inch glass mold.  Pour half of the mustard prepared mustard mustard on top and sprinkle other ½ ounce of mustard over salmon.  Cover with remaining mustard mustard mixture and cover salmon with aluminum foil.  Bake for 1 hour.  Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes or until salmon is no longer opaque in the center.  Let cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,yellow bell pepper,mexican oregano,cardamom,chicken breast lengthwise,oyster sauce,hot pepper,horseradish
title: Seared Chicken With Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup butter | 1 small yellow bell pepper, minced | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( or your favorite dip ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 3 drops hot pepper, sriracha is good for kick
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and grease a shallow roasting pan.  Place the chicken and any juices that have gathered in the dish, in a dish and stir with a fork to combine well.  Set aside.  Melt butter in a 9 nonstick frypan over medium heat, swirling it around and rotating the pan occasionally, until foamy.  Add bell pepper and stir fry for 5 minutes or until softened, but not browned.  Stir in horseradish, oyster sauce, mexican oregano, and cardamom.  Season all with pepper, using more or less as needed.  Transfer the pan to the oven and transfer the chicken to the pan.  Cook, uncovered, stirring at least once or twice to brown all over and release juices.  When the chicken is well browned, transfer it to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Summertime Clam Cakes With Avocado
ingredients: 3 hass avocadoes, cut in half lengthways and stoned | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped carrot | 2 tablespoons dried crisp tapioca flour | 5 medium clams, scrubbed and debearded | 1/3 cup drained canned blueberries ( approximately ) | 1 1 bunch spring onions, stalks trimmed and finely sliced
instructions: Mash avocados with cilantro, carrot and tapioca.

title: Simple Cajun-Style Salt
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon sea salt, or to taste
instructions: Combine mustard seeds, sea salt, and black pepper in a mortar and pestle or a spice mill or spice mill and grind into a powder using the flat side of a sturdy knife.  Store in a sterile container.

title: Lime and Lime Grilled Onions
ingredients: 8 large green and white onions, peeled ( about 2 to 4 cups ) | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/3 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs
instructions: Peel onions, using a vegetable peeler or vegetable peeler, and cut off the root end of onions.  Cut onions lengthwise into thin strips and then cut the strips crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices.  In a medium bowl, stir together the sugar with the juices from the lime peel and juice, then drizzle over the onions and toss to coat.  Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs and marinate at room temperature for 45 minutes or up to 2 hours.  Heat a grill or grill pan to medium high and lightly oil grate.  Grill the onions, turning and brushing with the marinade, until tender and well browned about 10 to 12 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,pico de gallo,baby spinach,purpose flour,gin,basil leaf,coleslaw mix
title: Gin-Glaze Salad
ingredients: 1 cup packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 packages coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup gin or 1/4 cup vermouth | 1/2 pound baby spinach | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh pico de gallo
instructions: Prepare the dressing by whisking the brown sugar, flour, coleslaw mix, gin or vermouth, spinach, basil and pico de gallo in a large salad bowl to blend.  Toss with the dressing until evenly coated.  Chill before serving.
