title: Smoky Cucumber and Red Kidney Bean Crostini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup white bread flour ( or gluten-free flour, or corn starch ) | 2 teaspoons granulated sugar syrup | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon fat free liquid smoke, such as balsamic | 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cucumbers, cut into cubes
instructions: For the crostini, combine the vinegar, bread flour, sugar syrup, liquid smoke and worcestershire sauce in a small bowl and set aside for 10 minutes.  For the filling, combine the balsamic vinegar, liquid smoke and worcestershire in a small bowl and set aside for 10 minutes.  For the salad, combine the red kidney beans and cucumber in a large bowl and mix.  Add the filling mixture to the chopped vegetables, toss, garnish with more sliced cucumber and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,grape tomato,curry paste,sesame oil,peanut,cornstarch,horseradish
title: Spicy Peanut Dip
ingredients: 6 -8 red grape tomatoes | 1 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon grated horseradish | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons thai hot curry paste | 2 cups cornstarch, divided
instructions: Slice tomatoes about 1/4 inch thick.  Arrange in a bowl.  In a small bowl, toss peanuts with horseradish, sesame oil, cornstarch and curry paste.  Set aside.  In a small skillet, warm 1/2 cup of cornstarch over medium heat.  Stir until sauce is smooth, and add in remaining cornstarch little by little while stirring to keep from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Pour hot cornstarch mixture over the tomatoes and toss well, just until evenly coated.  Pour remaining cornstarch mixture over the peanuts and toss well.  Garnish with tomato slices and serve either warm or chilled.

title: Pimentados De Ajo (Tuna and Mushroom Salad)

instructions: Rinse and drain tuna, set aside.  Mix together all the salad ingredients, pour over tuna and sprinkle with the toasted almonds, marinated mushroom and pork or chicken.  Gently mix all together.

title: Crimson Bubbles
ingredients: crushed ice | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Fill a tall glass ¼ full with crushed ice and pour in the hot oil.  Swirl the ice.

title: Ranch Chips

instructions: Layer all ingredients in a large mixer.  Beat at low speed until blended.  Spread about 1/4 of each chip mixture on plastic wrap or corn chips.  Let stand 1 hour.  Cut into 4 or 6 small pieces.  Serve.

title: Baked Corned Beef (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 -3 kg corned beef round roast or 2 -3 kg corned beef with spice
instructions: Make sure the roast is fully cleaned and then rinse well with cool water.  In a crock pot place the corned beef, then add enough cold water to cover it, add 1 tablespoon of spice mix per half a quart jar, and turn the roast over several times to soak.  Allow to soak at least 6 hours, up to 3 days. .  Allow the roast to come to room temperature, then turn and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours and on low for up to 8 hours.  Note, use a 5 1/2 quart slow cooker.

title: Crab With Chilli and Green Onions
ingredients: 2 crabs, shelled | 1 green chili pepper | 1 orange
instructions: Heat a little olive oil in a karahi.  Add the chilli and onion, and stir fry over a low heat for about 5 to 7 minutes or until they have softened slightly.  Remove the squid from the shell, removing all bones or hard cartilage from the body.  Devein and cut the body into pieces, and place them in a serving dish.  Squeeze the juice from the orange into the pan, then pour the juice over the squid.  Sprinkle the onion mixture over and serve.

title: Bread Crusted Stilton
ingredients: 11 ounces stout beer, such as guinness | 3 1/2 ounces watermelon slices | 8 ounces italian bread, cut into 1 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Lightly grease a baking sheet.  Pour stout into a large glass measuring cup.

title: Walnut Rice With Walnuts for Two
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/2 cup walnuts, very finely chopped
instructions: Wash and well dry rice.  Set aside.  Heat the dry rice in a skillet or deep pan.  Stir and fry walnuts, about 5 minutes, until fragrant but not burned.  Add the rice and mix well.  If using whole walnuts, place them in a mortar and pestle or large saucepan of boiling water.  Keep shaking the pan constantly to prevent the walnuts from burning, until all of the walnut oil has been absorbed, about 15 minutes.  Rinse off the walnuts.  Transfer to a dish, stirring once or twice.  Allow to cool.

instructions: Combine cream, vinegar, sour cream, 1/8 teaspoon chicken bouillon, red wine vinegar, cream of tartar, and remaining chicken bouillon.

instructions: Heat oven to 450°f spread roasted red pepper, artichoke hearts, yogurt, crumbs and chili paste on the baking sheet & sprinkle with chile.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Grilled Filet of Beef With Mascarpone and Lime

title: BBQ Tostadas

title: Mexican Beef Ties
ingredients: 1/2 kg boneless beef shoulder, cut into 2. 5 cm cubes | 3 tablespoons almond flour or 3 tablespoons almond meal | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, sliced to about 1 cm ( or dried tomatoes soaked in warm water to cover ) | 2 -3 green chilies, seeded and thinly sliced | 150 g white chocolate ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or slightly less if using australia australian beef taes.  Place the beef in a shallow, oven proof dish.  Mix the almond meal with the sundried tomatoes and chillies.  Spoon over the beef and sprinkle with the chocolate.  Bake, covered, for about 50 minutes or until the beef is cooked and tender.

title: Salmon and Noodle Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Lightly grease a 12 inch pizza pan with cooking spray.  Spread rice noodles evenly in the prepared pan. Remove from heat.  Spoon onto pizza crust.  Top with chicken, olives and crust slices.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon each of vinegar and nuts.  Cut each pizza into 8, 4 wedges.

Random Ingredients: espresso coffee,onion seed,barbecue sauce,cream mushroom soup
title: Easiest Starbucks Coffee Dip

instructions: In a medium sized microwave safe bowl, mix together the coffee, cream of mushroom soup, and chopped onions.  Transfer mixture to a crockpot.  Prepare serving dishes with a coffee filter cut in 1 inch pieces.  Spoon hot coffee mixture into the cups with a slotted spatula or a wooden spoon.  Serve the dip immediately with additional hot barbeque sauce if desired.  Use a microwave safe serving dish, or a roasting pan.  Microwave hot coffee mixture until hot and bubbly, about 45 seconds.

instructions: Place the sundried tomatoes in a bowl and toss with the confectioners sugar, garlic, sherry, bean sprouts and freshly ground black pepper and mix well.  Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Fondue with Sausage
ingredients: 3 loaves walnut roll | 3/4 lb pork sausage | 1/2 lb fresh green beans | 1 cup dried curds | 5 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons lager beer ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh apricots | 2 pckg. pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Toast and drain rolls.  Remove crusts, if necessary.  Cut rolls in half, lengthwise.  Trim ends.  Cut each half into 4 equal pieces.  Remove top crusts if necessary.  Cut remaining rolls into 3 pieces.  Place 1/4 pound of sausages on each bread piece.  Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until slightly browned.  Remove sausages from broiler.  Cut sausages into 1/2 inch slices.  Combine mayonnaise and lager in a small bowl.  Combine remaining 1/4 pound sausages and chopped apricots in a small saucepan.  Cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, or until heated through.  Cut the sausages into 1 inch wedges.  Serve hot with the sausages.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,pork heart,heavy whipping cream,lard,bread dough,baguette
title: Pork Heart and Baguette Crostini
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough | 4 ounces pork heart ( preferably boneless, sliced into bite-sized strips ) | 3 tablespoons lard ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 cup baguette ( thin slices of hearty country-style bread )
instructions: On lightly floured board, knead bread dough until smooth, about 5 minutes.  Cover dough and let rest 10 minutes.  In a large skillet, over medium high heat, heat pork heart.  Add lard and cook until light brown, 7 - 8 minutes.  With a slotted spoon, remove meat.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,chipotle chile,applesauce,green chili pepper,heavy whipping cream
title: Fresh and Easy Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chipotle chiles | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 -5 tablespoons applesauce | 1 green chili pepper
instructions: Place chiles, lemon extract, and cream in blender and blend for a few minutes until smooth.  Transfer to medium saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Strain mixture through a fine mesh strainer back into saucepan and heat over medium heat for about five minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in applesauce and green pepper.

title: Quick and Easy Taquitos
ingredients: 1 can tortilla | 1 pinch chili flakes ( optional ) | 1 pinch italian seasoning
instructions: Put a scoop of chili in your palms and make a hole in the center.  Fill the hole with crushed tortilla.  Make a second hole in the tortillas with chili.  Add your italian seasoning and mix it through.  Skewer it into a hot tortilla.  You can cut as big or as thin as you like.  I use a wooden skewers to cut out the heat in the pot.  If you want to cut into hot tortillas, put them in a plastic bag to set out the heat.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,bell pepper,chili bean,eggplant,scotch bonnet pepper,chipotle pepper,basil,salt
title: Chipolte Con Lechon
ingredients: 2 chipolte bell peppers | 4 scotch bonnet peppers | 3 tablespoons salt | 3 cans chili beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons sliced basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons basil | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 eggs, slightly beaten | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Dice peppers and set aside.  Place in a large bowl, add 1 - 2 tsp of salt.  Set aside.  Cut chillies into 1/4 x 1/4 sticks. Add the chipolte chilies and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 - 5 min, or until soft.  Add the bell peppers, scotch bonnet peppers, a 1 tsp salt and basil and cook, stirring, 3 - 5 min, or until pepper is tender crisp.  Stir in chili bean mixture, 1/8 tsp salt and 1 egg.  Cook, stirring for 2 minutes.  Serve with any mexi or other chinese meal.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,angel hair pasta,red chili powder,chipotle chile adobo,yeast,sugar,margarine,black olive
title: Mexican Macaroni Grill Pizza

instructions: Bring salted water to boil and salt it for pasta.  Drain pasta and rinse while preparing the other ingredients.  Combine yeast, 2 1/2 cups of the sugar with 3 tablespoons of the margarine, olives, chili, olive oil, salt and pepper in a large bowl and stir to dissolve yeast.  Add the remaining 1 1/4 cups of the sugar and stir well to combine.  Add the yeast mixture and stir until all of it dissolves.  Cover with a cloth and let stand for 5 minutes. .  Divide the pasta among four 4 serving plates or two 12 inch pizza pans, spreading to coat the outsides.  Pour the pizza sauce over the pasta and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of the sugar and the remaining 2 tablespoons of margarine.  Bake at 400ºf for 12 – 14 minutes.

title: Mini Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup mini chocolate chips | 12 green olives
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf.  Lightly coat cookie sheets with cooking spray.  In small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of the chips and 2 tablespoons of the olives.  Mix well.  Using fingers, cut out and discard rounded 1/2 inch circles.  Place 1 teaspoon of the remaining mixture on lower third of each circle.  Press 1/2 inch of chocolate in center of each cookie until completely covered.  Gently tapping the bottoms of the chocolate should make the biscuit dough easier to roll out.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,steak,white onion,soy sauce,shrimp paste,black eyed pea,arborio rice,chickpea
title: Prawn and Chickpea Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 small white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon black vinegar | 3 cups arborio rice | 200 g chopped cooked prawns ( shrimp ) | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/4 teaspoon shrimp paste ( optional ) | 150 g shucked black-eyed peas
instructions: Put the chopped onion, vinegar and rice in a bowl and set aside.  Heat 1 tbs oil over medium heat and dry fry the prawns and prawns for 2 - 3 minutes, until cooked.  Transfer to a plate and cover with a damp tea towel while you continue in the same dish and heat another tbs oil over medium heat.  Add the shrimp paste and stir fry for a further 3 - 4 minutes.  Add the prawns, soy sauce and chickpeas and stir fry for a further 1 - 2 minutes.  Pour in the rice mixture and cook for a further 1 - 2 minutes, until rice is coated with oil and the ingredients are piping hot.

title: Chilled Oranges With Oranges in Brown Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon fresh leeks or 1 tablespoon scallion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon oatmeal | 1 teaspoon fresh sweet tea leaves or 1 teaspoon dry-roasted or 1 teaspoon dried lukewarm earl gray tea | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | scallion, sliced | lettuce leaf
instructions: In a small bowl, mix and mix together the cocoa with the leek or scallion, tomato puree, oatmeal, tea leaves or coffee leaves.  In a small saucepan, add the cream and stir until heated through and starting to thicken.  Stir this mixture into the orange mixture.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Cinnamon Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 250 g brussels sprouts, cleaned, trimmed and quartered | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Place the brussels sprouts in a pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil and cook until just tender but not soft.  Stir in the cinnamon and remove from heat.

title: Crock Pot Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon minced chile powder | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup finely shredded pork shoulder | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix mustard & chili powder.  Coat crock pot with cooking spray.  Layer pork, 1/2 cup whipped topping & mustard mixture, on bottom of slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,fettuccine pasta,peanut butter,cauliflower,coriander powder,lime juice zest,rocket
title: Cauliflower Stir-Fry

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Cook the pasta in rapidly boiling salted water for about 6 minutes drain.  Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep ovenproof frying pan.  Add the cauliflower, stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until just starting to soften.  Stir in the peanut butter and lime zest.  Season with black pepper.  Add the remaining ingredients and fry on the top shelf of the oven for 12 - 15 minutes until the cauliflower is just tender.  Serve immediately.

title: Saffron and Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 dash saffron, crushed in a mortar and pestle with | 2 cups chilled whipping cream, divided
instructions: Combine dried currants, sugar & saffron in a bowl & set aside.  Beat 2 tbsp of cream in a large bowl until it has stiff peaks, then beat in remaining cream & pour the cream over the currants.  Chill cream, covered, for 3 - 4 hours & remove from refrigerator before serving.

title: Spicy Shrimp Burgers

instructions: Mix all the prawn sauce ingredients together and mould into thick patties.  Bake on a tray in a moderate oven until cooked through, about 30 mins, turning once.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,duck breast,lemon juice,red onion,parsley sprig
title: Duck Torshi
ingredients: 1/2 lb duck breast | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup finely chopped red onion | 4 fresh parsley sprigs | 1/3 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut duck into 1/2 dice.  Combine remaining ingredients and marinade the duck for 24 hours, refrigerate.  Remove duck and place in a ziplock bag.  Marinate for a few hours in refrigerator, turning bag over frequently for even marinating.

title: Apple Onion Jam (Kumquat Al-Tamara)
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 green apples ( about 5-6 lbs. )
instructions: Cut the ends off the onions and leave them whole or cut off the peel into about 2 inch pieces.  Peel the apples and cut them into pieces about the size of the onions.  Put them in a large, heavy pot and add enough cold water to cover them by about 2 inches and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer for about 3 to 4 hours.  Drain the onions well and set them aside to cool.  Remove the onions from the water and slice into about 1/2 slices.

Random Ingredients: beet,liquid smoke,heavy whipping cream,pork rib,horseradish,rice wine,cayenne pepper
title: Dijon Borscht

instructions: Place ribs in a large saucepan with enough water just to cover, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer until cooked through, about 1 1/2 hours.  Drain.  Cool.  Remove and discard ribs.  Remove bones and fat from bones.  Chop the ribs into thin pieces.  Combine ribs, beets, horseradish, cream, rice wine, and honey.  Season with cayenne pepper and mix well.  Chill sauce, several hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend.  Serve with reserved ribs for dipping.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,sea salt,apple juice,oil,onion soup mix,asafoetida powder
title: Apple-Filled Fish (Mattar)
ingredients: 2 lbs asafoetida powder | 5 lbs fish fillets | 1 dash oil | 1 onion soup mix | 1/2 cup apple juice | sea salt
instructions: To make a paste and marinade, rub the asafoetida all over the fish fillets.  Make sure that the fish fillets do not touch the water.  The fish should soak into the paste.  In a pot, heat the oil, place the fillets in and brown on one side.  Turn the fillets on the other side.  Sauce, place onion soup mix in and mix.  Boil apple juice until it is half way boiled add salt to taste.  Pour it over the fillets and put it into the oven until fish is cooked.

title: Simple Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon soya sauce
instructions: Mix dark soy sauce and soya sauce with a spoon.  Spread in a jar bought from you supermarket.  Shake bottle to mix well.  Keep stored in the refrigerator.

instructions: Cut chicken into chunks and remove excess fat.  Brown chicken in butter, in batches if necessary.  Remove chicken to slow cooker and add chili pepper, garlic, jam, bouillon, oregano and any remaining sauce mixture.

title: Warm Sage & Sage Chips #2

Using a pastry brush, coat sage chip with cooking spray.  Use the remaining spray to coat the chips.  Place on the prepared cookie sheets.  Bake 7 - 8 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Lemon Tuna Steak

instructions: Place tuna in a zip lock bag with the zest of the lemon.  Marinate at least 3 hours or overnight.  Preheat an outdoor grill, broiler pan, or your burner. Serve on warmed plates with lemon wedges.

title: Capers and Onions
ingredients: 8 ounces jar capers | 1 onion, very thinly sliced
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the capers, and onion until the onion is limp.  Serve immediately on toasted bread with crackers.

instructions: Boil split peas for 5 minutes, drain.  Bring remaining ingredients to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until peas are heated through.  Remove from heat, adjust seasonings and serve hot over hot rice and garnish with peanuts.

Spoon marinade over meat.  Enjoy with your choice of side.  The salsa is great on mexican rice.

instructions: Heat oil in a skillet on medium high heat.  Add green chilies and cook until fragrant.  Add soup, jam, vinegar, and rice vinegar.  Reduce heat to medium low and cook, stirring frequently for 1 to 2 minutes.  Remove hot sauce and stir into hot soup mixture.  Serve.

instructions: In a large bowl, gently mix together the cucumber, cheese, and vinegar using a fork.  Scrape down the bowl with a spatula until the cheese is well blended.

instructions: Stir corn syrup, madras curry powder, shrimp paste, vinegar, and sugar together in a pot until sugar melts, 5 to 10 minutes.  Add red pepper flakes.

title: Rigatoni With Cinnamon

instructions: Start cooking the rigatoni.  Drain pasta, place in a large bowl.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup boiling water and 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon.

instructions: Combine the lettuce, cottage cheese and ginger ale in a small bowl and season with 1/4 teaspoon of salt and a pinch of freshly cracked black pepper.  Toss gently with the vegetables. instructions: Mix dry ingredients, put aside.  With hands, blend in the meat until it looks right.  Make into 24 balls and put into a crock pot. Toss to coat everything and cook over moderate heat for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Shredded Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 -2 jalapeno chile, stemmed and cut into thin strips | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and minced | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 lbs thin spaghetti, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup shortening
instructions: In a skillet, cook beef, chiles, and chipotle until beef is browned.  Drain.  Add chickpeas.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, pour a small amount of oil into a large saucepan and heat over medium heat.  Add cooked spaghetti and 1/2 cup of cooking liquid.  Toss until evenly coated with sauce.  Remove from heat, and add 2 to 3 tbs.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese

instructions: Whip all ingredients until soft peaks form.  Stir in enough heavy whipping cream to make 3 tablespoons of stiff peaks.  Sprinkle with coarse salt and caraway seeds to serve.

Lay each half on top of the other, brushing each half with more melted butter.  Place tray on cookie sheet.  Repeat.  When all half are filled bake for 20 – 25 minutes.

instructions: Peel and core the pineapple.  Cut into wedges.  Wash them in cold water until the water runs clear.  Drain well and cut them into slices about 1 inch wide.  Cover and store in the refrigerator.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Brush a baking sheet with colored egg whites.  Place a wedge of pineapple in the middle of each egg white.

title: Tostada (Mexican Salad)

instructions: In separate bowl whisk tomatoes and chillies until blended.  Add lettuce to tomato mixture and stir until coated with dressing.  Serve in shallow bowl and garnish with cilantro.

title: Cara's Quick and Easy Italian Sausage & Cranberry Pasta Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces italian turkey sausage links | 1 box part-skim ricotta cheese | 4 ounces canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained and sliced | 1 can cranberries | 1 tablespoon chopped italian-style cooked vegetables ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a skillet over medium heat, cook sausage, breaking it up into small pieces with a spoon, until no longer pink using your fingers if necessary. title: Vietnamese "Vietnamese Coffee Potatoes"

title: Sage and Ginger Crusted Beef Rib Eye
ingredients: 6 teaspoons tex-mex seasoning | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 4 beef rib eye steaks, 1 inch thick | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons panang curry paste | 1/2 cup crushed rye bread or 1/2 cup kefalograviera
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Lightly coat your meat with 1 teaspoon tex mex seasoning, 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste and a small amount of the crushed graham cracker crumbs.  Place the ribs between 2 sheets wax paper or aluminum foil and carefully pound them with a meat pounder or mallet until they are just thicker than a coin.  Spread the remaining 1 teaspoon of tex mex seasoning and 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste on the short ribs.  Roll the ribs in the crumbs coating all sides.  Place the meat on a baking sheet and place the panang curry paste on top.  Bake, turning once, for 1 1/2 hours, to an internal temperature of 140 degrees f.  Remove the meat and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.  The cooking time does not reflect the time to rest.  The meat can also be served warm, as it is easier to shred when served warm.  Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: nacho cheese flavor doritos,oil,pizza dough,black bean
title: Quick 'n' Easy Calzones
ingredients: 1/2 lb pizza dough, rolled | oil ( i like lots ) | 1 can refried black beans | 1 can nacho cheese flavor doritos, finely crushed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450, roll out dough to a size that you can handle, using a rolling pin or your hands to shape the dough.  Brush the dough with oil and sprinkle with some crushed doritos.  Roll up like a jelly roll, starting one inch or less from the edge.  Repeat with the rest of the dough.  Place on a greased cookie sheet about halfway full, or you can use a 9x13 pan.  Bake 20 minutes or until golden and crispy on top.

title: Lebanese Macaroni Grill Kebabs - Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut in to 2 inch pieces | 250 g smoked ham, cut into 2 inch pieces | 150 g farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta or 150 g spaghetti, cooked | 1/4 cup coriander | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 150 ml buttermilk
instructions: Mix all the marinade ingredients except the bread crumbs, chili powder & bread crumbs in a large bowl.  Add the bread crumbs and chile flakes whisk until they start to bind to the meat.  Thread pieces of meat and ham onto skewers and grill.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,coconut milk,monterey jack cheese,cottage cheese
title: Coconut Cheese and Parsley Nests With a Twist!(Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 2 cans coconut milk ( fat-free is best ) | 1/2 lb cottage cheese | 1/2 lb reduced fat monterey jack cheese, shredded ( to taste ) | fresh parsley sprig, for garnish
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth, set aside.  Place the nests in an 8 by 8 by 2 inch baking dish.  Spoon the mixture into the nests of the nests, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and broil for about 10 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: ice,cream chicken soup,chorizo sausage,italian seasoning,swiss cheese,rosemary,flat leaf italian parsley,panko breadcrumb
title: Italian Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 2 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 ounces of mild chorizo sausage or 4 ounces mild mexican chorizo, sliced 1/2 inch ( can substitute other chorizo flavors ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 1/2 cup crushed ice | 3/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: For the meat patties, combine all ingredients except the ice and rock salt in a large bowl and mix well.  Roll the chilled patties in the rock salt.  Using 2 meat patties, brush both sides with the rock salt.  Grill the meat patties on a lightly oiled grill directly over medium direct heat, until lightly browned, about 4 minutes per side.  Allow 10 minutes for the cheese to melt and the 10 minutes for the cheese to brown slightly.  Remove from the heat and serve on a lightly buttered slice of cheese.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pam cooking spray,chicken chunk,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese Buns
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups chicken chunks, roasted ( or canned ) | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | pam cooking spray | pam cooking spray
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the yeast with 1 cup of the broth.

title: Tea Smoked Linguine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lard | 6 ounces smoked linguine | 2 cans chicken broth | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/3 cup brewed tea
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the lard over medium heat.  Place linguine in the skillet, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Cook until al dente.

title: Cream Cheese Sauce for Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 4 ounces mascarpone cheese, creamed | 2 tablespoons cornflour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 8 ounces half-and-half
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the mascarpone cheese together with the other ingredients.  Pour into a saucepan and heat gently.  Do not allow to boil.  Cook pasta according to the package directions.  Drain and serve with a dollop of cream cheese sauce.

title: Siesta Mousse - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons unsweetened flaked coconut, toasted | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon lime extract | 2 cups sweet salsa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a large bowl combine the parsley and coconut.  With your hands, crumble the crumbs into the parsley mixture.  Stir in the lime extract.  Press half of the crumbs into the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch baking dish.  Drizzle with half of the salsa.  Spread remaining salsa atop the top and bake for 25 minutes, or until the topping is a pale golden brown set.

title: Jamaican Stuffed Black Olives
ingredients: 20 oktober olives | 3 -4 ounces coconut milk, canned | salt | black pepper
instructions: Slice a small hole in the side of the olives, being careful not to cut all the way through.  Fill with the black olives.  Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,garam masala,rose water,taco seasoning mix,rum
title: Spiced BBQ Rub for Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 packets taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons rose water | 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons rum | 1/4 cup light rum | 1 lime wedge, for squeezing
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the taco seasoning mix, rose water, garam masala, and rum.  Brush onto the pork roast and rub marinade onto well.  Cover and refrigerate meat until ready to grill.  Preheat grill for 5 to 7 minutes on one side, turn and cook 5 to 7 minutes on the other side.

Random Ingredients: pasilla chile,jalapeno pepper,maraschino cherry,golden raisin,scotch whisky,cauliflower
title: Pancho Villa Salsa
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1/2 cup scotch whisky, plus additional whisky for garnish | 1 cup golden raisin | 4 dried pasilla chiles, roughly chopped | 1 can sliced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped ( optional ( optional )
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large pot with 1/2 cup water.  Cook over high heat until cauliflower is just beginning to soften, about 20 minutes.  Drain.  Heat 1/2 cup whiskey in a large skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pastry crust pie,red wine vinegar,cilantro leaf,navy bean,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin Empanadas
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves | 1 - 1 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 cup canned navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut beef into 1 inch cubes.  Place the beef in a large bowl and add zest, cilantro & vinegar.  Toss until well mixed.  Stir in beans.  Pour the mixture into pie crust.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Smoked Prosciutto, Red Curry and Fontina Hot Dish - No Eggs
ingredients: 8 slices prosciutto ham, chopped | 3 scallions, sliced | 1/2 cup sweet pickled sweet red curry paste | 1/2 cup fat free meat stock | 1 cup reduced-fat fontina, shredded
instructions: Preheat your broiler.  Arrange ham on a baking sheet, and broil 3 minutes per side.  In a small saucepan over medium heat, cook, stirring constantly and scraping up browned bits, the scallion, and curry paste.  Cook 1 minutes, stirring constantly, and pour into a medium bowl.  Stir in your meat stock and cover with plastic wrap.  Let sit 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green leaf lettuce,tea,heavy whipping cream,barbeque sauce,meat,icing sugar
title: Cowboy Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground meat | 3 heads green leaf lettuce, torn into leaves | 4 ounces sliced barbeque sauce | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 8 leaves green leaf lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Heat the grill to low.  In a large bowl, mix together the ground meat, green leaf lettuce, barbeque sauce, and icing sugar.  Fold in the cream.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil so that it ends up touching each other.  Place the salad on the prepared baking sheet.  Place the remaining leaves of green lettuce on top.  Cook 5 minutes.  Cut in half.  Carefully open the leaves of lettuce and serve with meat and barbecue gravy.

title: Sweet Cinnamon Pickles
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 3 canned bamboo shoots | 2 packages cinnamon sugar
instructions: Rinse the cabbage.  Wash well several times.  Core and chop into bite size pieces.  Place all ingredients into a bowl and mix with about 1/2 cup of water.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Mystic Seaport Sauce from a Canadian Living Magazine
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup diced fresh basil pesto | 1/4 serrano pepper, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon sliced ripe olives, topped ( optional )
instructions: Heat broth, brown sugar, ketchup, pesto, chile, and olives in a saucepan over medium low heat until hot, but not boiling, about 5 minutes.  Note, if using whole basil leaves, remove them before using and discard the stems.  Note, for a thicker sauce, reduce the amount of pesto and chile.  For thicker sauce, use more chicken broth.

Random Ingredients: spinach,black eyed pea,white flour,marjoram,dill weed,saffron thread
title: Baked Saffron, Spinach and Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 10 black-eyed peas | 10 dried saffron threads | 1/2 bunch fresh dill weed | 1 sprig fresh dill weed | 10 ounces fresh spinach, washed and trimmed | 1/4 cup stone-ground white flour | 5 -6 teaspoons dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f split the peas.  Place the peas in a large saucepan and fill with enough water to cover them.  Add enough water to cover them by 1 inch and bring to a boil.  Lower the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until they are tender but not mushy.  Drain the peas and cool them.  Place them in a large casserole dish, cover with about 1 inch of water and soak for about 2 hours.  Meanwhile, place 1/2 bunch of fresh dill weed in a mortar and crush with a pestle or a wooden spoon.  In a medium bowl, combine 1/4 bunch dill weed with 1/4 bunch dill weed.  When peas are done soak for another 1 to 2 hours.  Drain the peas and transfer them to a food processor or blender.  Turn on the blender and add the remaining dill, dill and spices and 1/2 cup of white flour.  Blend together until the stuffing is a smooth, moist porridge like consistency.  Spread half the stuffing on top of the peas in a thin layer and sprinkle with a teaspoon or so of chopped fresh dill.  Repeat for another layer.  Dampen the edges of the stuffing with 1 to 2 teaspoons of flour.  Roll the stuffing around the stuffing and tie it with kitchen string.  Place on a baking dish and cover with the rest of the stuffing.  Make a small impression in the top of the stuffing with your fingers.  Place the casserole dish in the oven after 15 to 20 minutes and continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes or until your stuffing is golden and bubbly and delicious.

title: Taco Bell Home Fries
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, diced | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Prepare the squash according to packet instructions.  Spread the seasoning packets off the squash with paper towels.  Place squash in a single layer in a foil lined large baking dish.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until done.  Serve.

title: Stuffing with Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 1 lb seedless cucumber, cut in half lengthwise and sliced | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Mix stuffing mix with water and tabasco sauce.  Stuff cucumbers with stuffing, placing in center of baking sheet.  Bake about 20 minutes, stirring halfway through to make sure they brown all the way.  Turn after 30 minutes and allow to brown a little.

title: Greek Style Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket | 1 package dry ziti pasta
instructions: Trim and discard fat from meat.  Slice brisket into 1 inch pieces.  Prepare spaghetti according to package directions.  When meat and noodles are cooked, transfer to a large pot.  Stir in ziti, cover, and heat to boiling.  Reduce heat.

title: Egg-Dusted Tuna Pastry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs canned tuna ( i use a little less of each ) or 1 1/2 lbs fresh tuna ( i use a little less of each ) | 3 hard-boiled egg yolks | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Mix the hard boiled egg and egg yolk together and beat together with an electric mixer.  Cut the tuna into 8 slices and pat each slice out to about 1/2 inch thickness.  Then dip each slice in the egg mixture and coat with the egg wash.  Place on parchment lined baking sheets.  Bake at 400 for about 40 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.

title: Truffle Dijon With Ethereal Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup neufchatel cheese | 1/4 cup dijon mustard ( or other mild mustard ) | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Cut the romaine in half lengthwise, so you have long ribbons.

title: Fava Beans (Zucchini)
ingredients: 1 1 large fava beans or 1 large zucchini, halved | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock, hot or 2 1/2 cups homemade stock
instructions: If using fresh fava beans or zucchini, trim ends and peel thoroughly.  In a saucepan, bring 2 parts of the stock to boil, drop in the fava beans or zucchini and cook for about 4 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beans and zucchini to cold water, cover and set aside.  Continue cooking the remaining stock in the same manner.

title: Spicy Okra With Chorizo #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 1 can spanish chorizo, sliced ( mild for spicy ) | 1/2 cup strong black coffee
instructions: Thaw frozen okra for 30 minutes or so.  Cook chorizo in skillet on medium heat until done.  Remove from skillet.  Add okra to chorizo drippings and cook.  Serve topped with black coffee.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,chicken breast,pinto bean,napa cabbage,pizza dough
title: Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 1 medium head napa cabbage, cut into 1 1/2-inch wedges | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough | 1 cup canned pineapple chunks, drained and tidbits reserved | 2 cooked boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Arrange cabbage wedges in the bottom of the pan.  Top with beans.

title: Wasabi Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup wasabi ( or to taste, kewpie brand recommended ) | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon amaretto or 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Combine wasabi and vinegar in a small bowl.  Stir in amaretto or vodka.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate to develop flavor.

Random Ingredients: white rum,cumin,white chocolate chip,veal,red pepper paste,onion flake,fish stock
title: Veal With White Chocolate
ingredients: 8 ounces good quality white rum | 8 ounces good quality white chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 -2 tablespoon fish stock | 1 teaspoon red pepper paste | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dried onion flakes | 2 lbs veal, pounded thin
instructions: Pour the white rum into a shallow pan then pour the dark chocolate chips onto the top.  Leave to stand a few minutes while you make the rest of the meal.  Cook the stock and red pepper paste in a pan until the chocolate is melted.  Remove from the heat, add the onion flakes and chopped veal and set aside to cool.  Now divide the ground beef mixture into 6 serving portions.  Spoon the cooled melted chocolate onto the beef mixture and roll in the onion flakes.  Roll in remaining melted chocolate.  Grill in a hot oven until done on both sides.

title: Copenhagen Mushrooms (Cucumbers)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dill, chopped ( fresh or dried ) | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, diced | 3 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | cayenne powder, to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the dill with the cucumber and mushrooms.  Salt and pepper lightly.  Sprinkle with cayenne powder to taste.

title: Butterfly Ham Hoki Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 100 g butterscotch chips, softened to room temp | 30 ml mirin ( sweet rice wine, or dark soya sauce ) | 1 teaspoon dry red chili, finely minced | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh horseradish | 1 ounce unsalted butter | 8 ounces devilled ham, cut into long strips, but very thin ( i used smoked ham ) | 3 ounces mixed pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine egg yolks.  Put butterscotch, mirin, chili and horseradish in a small stainless steel saucepan and heat over a medium high heat until boiling.  Reduce heat to low and simmer gently until mixture is thick and creamy, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally.  Place in the refrigerator until cold.  Preheat oven to 375°f.  Using 3/4 cup of the cooled dressing mix, fold in ham and spread out on a parchment lined jelly roll pan to about 3 mm thick.  Top with egg yolk mixture, then with rest of the cooled dressing mix.  Bake until lightly golden around the edges, and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean, about 50 - 60 minutes depending on height.  Let cool slightly before cutting into 12 - 16 slices.

title: Lime, Bacon and Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 4 ounces bacon, cut into thin strips | 2 lime wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the potato, onion, bacon and lime wedges in a large bowl.  Toss, then serve immediately.

title: Baked Beef Shank for Crock Pot
ingredients: 500 g beef shanks | 4 bay leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in cooker and turn on.  Turn on until beef is thoroughly covered.  Cook on high for 12 hours or low for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,flat leaf parsley,topping,cayenne pepper,stevia powder
title: Toffie's Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 3 chicken breast fillets, cut into thin slices | 1 package frozen whipped topping | 1/2 cup fresh flat leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons stevia powder ( optional )
instructions: Make kebabs by placing chicken and frozen whipped topping on skewers and dipping into a mixture of cayenne pepper and stevia to taste then pressing into the chicken to adhere.  Preheat barbecue or grill pan on medium high heat.  Prepare a large platter with a lid with the following toppings, parsley.  Break kabobs into pieces.  Place the kebabs on the skewers and surround with the parsley.  Garnish with chopped parsley tops.

title: Creamy Scotch Bonnet Pepper Sauce for BBQ Chicken & Veggies
ingredients: 4 ounces can cream of chicken soup | 1/3 - 1/2 - 3/4 cup scotch bonnet pepper
instructions: Drain the canned soup into a glass bowl, pour in the can of soup and stir with a fork until heated through.  Sprinkle with scotch bonnet pepper, and serve with your favorite meat or vegetables.  Makes 4 - 4 servings of for each bite.

title: Tuscan-Spiral Pasta
ingredients: 7 ounces rotuced-fat spiral pasta ( about 1 cup ) | 5 tablespoons fat free molasses | 2 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple syrup | 4 cups chopped red onions | 1/2 cup shredded kale or 1/2 cup baby spinach, leaves | 2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1 pear, cored and chopped | 1/4 lb small bocconcini
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, stirring occasionally.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a large deep frying pan, combine the molasses, pineapple syrup, onion, kale and anise seed.  Stir to blend.  Stir in hot pasta and pear.  Garnish with the bocconcini slices.  Serve warm.  Makes 5 servings.

title: Nabisco Lime Chicken
ingredients: 4 large chicken legs ( about 12oz each, if possible ) | 2 limes, juice and zest of
instructions: Cut a small slit in each piece of chicken and stuff each piece very lightly with lemon zest.  Tie legs together with kitchen twine, using kitchen string.  Cook over medium high heat until chicken is well browned.  Baste with pan juice when basting with pan juice.  Continue cooking, basting with pan juice, until chicken is tender, about 1 hour.

title: Dried Sauce(Vegetarianized)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried craisins ( or other dried brown rice ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( or lemon extract )
instructions: Bring 3 - 4 cups of water to a boil and add craisins.  After five minutes add the lemon juice and cook 30 seconds.  Stirring constantly, stir in additional hot water, if you wish to thin it for thicker sauce or thicker sauce.  Remove pan from heat and cool to room temperature.  Pour into a small bowl and cover with plastic wrap, then chill for upto a month before using.  This sauce will keep in dry airtight containers like you see in the photo.

title: Super Easy Chunky Salsa
ingredients: 1 bottle chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon dry coriander seed
instructions: In bowl of electric mixer combine salsa, coriander and salt to taste.  Stir to mix well with rolling pin.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

title: Spicy Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut bite sized | 1/2 cup dried kale | 4 pods green cardamom pods, seeds and fiber included | 2 tablespoons whole fenugreek seeds
instructions: Remove kielbasa casings, and cut into 1 inch pieces or 2 to 3 inch squares.  Punch down the kielbasa.  Mix the kielbasa, remaining ingredients in a large bowl, and refrigerate overnight or a couple of hours, until the flavors blend.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Store in fridge up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: beef,parsley,oyster sauce,yukon gold potato,green chilies,coconut oil,lime juice
title: Creamy Beef Hash or Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, halved ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Heat potatoes in a microwave oven until tender, about 12 minutes, turning once half way through.  Meanwhile, coat a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with some cooking spray.  Heat coconut oil in a heavy, large skillet over medium high heat until just smoking.  Add beef and cook, stirring and breaking up with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink, about 3 minutes.  Add half of parsley and chiles.  Transfer beef mixture to a large bowl and stir in lime juice and oyster sauce.  Pour beef mixture into hot baking dish.  Top with remaining parsley and chiles.  Cover baking dish with foil and bake at 400°f until potatoes are tender and meat mixture is hot, 25 to 30 minutes.  Serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: green chile,kosher salt,lamb,ra el hanout spice mix,orzo pasta,strawberry
title: Lamb and Raisin Orzo Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb orzo pasta | 2 1/4 lbs lean lamb, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cans diced green chiles ( hunts and use 1/4 can of diced green chilates ) | 1/2 cup seedless raisin ( moroccan-style or regular if preferred ) | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 3 cups fresh strawberries, halved crosswise ( or any type of fresh fruit )
instructions: Cook orzo until al dente for 8 minutes.  Drain immediately and set aside.  In large skillet, brown meat in 1 tb oil until lightly browned.  Drain and return meat to skillet.  Add green chilies, raisins, and salt.  Simmer over medium heat for 12 minutes.  Transfer meat mixture to prepared baking dish or casserole dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Return to moderate oven and bake, uncovered, until heated through and meat is cooked through again, about 15 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.  Garnish with green onion.

title: The Perfect Russian Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground blanched almonds or 2 tablespoons ground sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon good quality vodka | 1/8 teaspoon real nutmeg or 1/16 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in jar of your blender or food processor.  Blend until desired texture is achieved.  Cover and refrigerate.  Shake well in fridge before serving.

title: Spicy Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1 bunch kale, washed and dried
instructions: Wash kale and cut into bite size pieces.  Steam or cook kale until wilted, about five minutes.  Remove kale leaves and place on a paper towel or other bowl to drain juice.  Once drained, mix in chutney.  Transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Mexican Style Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | crackers | 1/4 chopped jalapeno pepper
instructions: Combine the cottage cheese, milk and jalapeños, and use to stuff crudites.

title: Port Spiced Black Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine | 1 lemon | 1/2 cup strained stock from canned black olives ( i used 1/2 cup of the juice drained from 1 can, drained ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate or 4 tablespoons chopped dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon chopped coriander ( optional )
instructions: Slice the lemons crosswise into thin slices, then cut into thin slices too.  Stir the wine through the juice from the can of olives and coriander seeds.  Chop the chocolat in the blender until it is finely grated, stir into hot tapenade and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,yellow onion,coriander powder,tart apple,basil pesto
title: Pesto and Apple Skewers
ingredients: 2 peeled and cored tart apples | 1 small yellow onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange peel
instructions: Thread apple and onion onto skewers.  Mix in pesto and spices and serve.

title: Chianti's Spaghetti Sauce with Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce, for meat ( prego is cheap ) | 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1/2 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 tablespoon cognac | 3 3/4 cups cornmeal or 3 3/4 cups polenta | 1 1/2 cups canned green beans or 1 1/2 cups lima beans | 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas
instructions: Place a large pot of water on to boil.  In a large bowl with your hands, mix cornmeal to cornmeal.  Dredge meat in cornmeal.  Add to boiling water, stir and let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove from pot, add amaretto, cognac and chick peas to your pot, stir.  Return meat to pot and heat through.  Serve over your favorite pasta.  You may add frozen peas and/or roasted peppers if desired.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,salsa verde,parmesan cheese,couscous,salt pepper,mustard powder,chocolate chip,celery
title: Yum Yum Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup salsa verde ( mild salsa ) | 1/2 cup couscous | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon dried mustard powder | 1/4 ounce bittersweet chocolate chips
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl, mix well and set aside.  Place couscous and salt and pepper in a medium size, microwave safe bowl.  Add 3/4 of the dressing and the chocolate chips and stir until blended.  Add remaining dressing and mix well.  Cover and cook in microwave in microwave on high 2 minutes, shaking bowl occasionally.  Cool.  Stir to combine and serve with french fries and a green salad.

title: Sake Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, sifted | 1 1/3 cups potato water | 2 tablespoons sake | 1 lime, zested | 3 yellow bell peppers, cut into 1-inch segments
instructions: Mix flour, potato water, and sake together in a bowl until dough reaches a smooth, malleable consistency.  Stir in lime zest.  Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over medium high heat until water sizzles.

title: Tomatoade
ingredients: 12 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1 sprig sage leaf | 1 cup tequila ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, combine cherry tomatoes, sage leaf, and tequila.  Simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Achiote Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 4 teaspoons the tea | 1/2 lb sai in pork ( cured pork ) | 1 ounce spice, achiote powder | 1 packet achiote powder | 2 ounces brown sugar
instructions: Soak rice.  Soak sai in oil until cooked, 2 - 4 hours.  Boil.  Boil.  Cool.  Dice pork.  Remove skin, bones and blood from pork.  Soak rice in oil until cooked add to rice.  Mix the achiote powder and sugar.

title: Homemade Enzymes
ingredients: 10 bunches fresh cilantro leaves | salt and pepper, to taste | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash and dry the cilantro leaves thoroughly.  Tear off a 12 - 12 bunches of leaves from the cilantro leaves and put in a blender.  Add about 2/3 cup water, about the consistency of cooking spray, and about 3/4 teaspoon white pepper.  Blend well.  Keep in mind that the cilantro leaves may be a bit coarse.  It should retain a nice texture.  Place the cilantro leaves to one side in an airtight jar.  Store in a cool, dark place for 5 days or longer so the flavors have time to blend.  Variation, substitute 1 teaspoon of ground white pepper for the white pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon of allspice for the cilantro leaves.

Random Ingredients: apricot,red bell pepper,green pepper,sago,onion seed,chili paste,peppercorn,beef chuck
title: Apricot Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 can sago, drained | 3 green peppers, julienned | 3 red bell peppers, julienned | 3 tablespoons sago, extra | 3 tablespoons paprika | 1 -2 tablespoon peppercorn, dried | 1 onion seed | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot

Grill, covered, 15 - 20 mins, brushing with sago mixture and turning over once, until beef is cooked medium well and beginning to brown.

title: Fish With Orange Liqueur
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup red cabbage, shredded | 8 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Brush fish with cream, and arrange on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven, for 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.  Remove fish from oven, and set aside to cool.  Increase oven temperature to 450 degrees f.  Remove fish, and transfer to a serving dish, tent with foil, and set aside. title: Tofu Chips

instructions: Drain the tofu well and pat dry.  Make sure the moisture is absorbed.  Sprinkle anise seed on top and press with your palms until the turmeric is evenly distributed. Place each piece in the center of the prepared pan then drizzle the entire contents of the baking sheet on top.  Let sit in a cool place for 10 - 12 hours or a room temperature area for up to 8 hours.  To serve, place on a plate with some rice and wrap in a paper towel.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and lightly oil a large baking sheet.  Place the red potatoes in a saucepan and cover with salted water. title: Shelly's Irish Cream Lamb-Goat Stew - for a Crowd!

title: Faux Irish Champagne Chicken in Champagne
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, halved | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 -8 russet potatoes, peeled | 125 ml good hot coffee | 2 chicken stock cubes | 15 ml pickling salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place the chicken thighs skin and excess flesh on the inside of a large casserole dish, or glass, which should fit snugly under the chicken.  Tuck the legs into the chicken, then season with salt and pepper.  Place the potatoes into the dish and, using a sharp knife, cut into 1 cm thick slices.  Pour in the water to come halfway up the side of the chicken pieces, and put the dish on the top shelf of the oven.  As soon as the oven starts to set it should not take longer than 10 minutes.  Remove the casserole dish from the oven and put the lid on it.  Set the chicken pieces, breast side up, back into the casserole.  The dish will eventually be full, with the potatoes.  Pour in the coffee.  Cover lightly with foil, then leave it in there for a further 30 minutes.  After 30 minutes, release the foil and give it a good stir every 10 - 15 minutes and check the liquid content of the liquid if you think the liquid is drying out.  If you want a crisp, slightly browned chicken that is cooked through, then leave off the heat for a few minutes longer.  Serve the chicken with some lovely seasonal salad, bread and vegetables.  Irish Champagne is made with wine made from gala and sugar, and is used as a dominating flavoured accompaniment in stilton cheese soup or made with creams or cream.

title: Lazy Tuna Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 1/2 cup sugar | 9 lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Combine tuna, sugar and 2 - 3 tbsps water.  Spread 1 cup of sauce mixture inside bottom of casserole dish.  Top with cooked noodles, pressing noodles down slightly.  Cover with remaining 1/2 cup of sauce mixture to cover.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Cover loosely and bake at 350degrees for 35 - 45 minutes.

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 6 tablespoons mustard seeds | 4 cups oil for frying | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mustard seeds with enough water to cover.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Crush the seeds with a pestle and mortar.  Heat the oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f.  Stir the salt through the mustard seed mixture, mixing well with each addition.  Transfer the mustard seed mixture to a baking sheet.  Dip the chips in the oil.  Fry in the hot oil until the chips are golden brown, about 3 minutes.  Drain on paper towels.

title: Mexican Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, cut into 1/4-inch pieces

instructions: Line the bottom of a 9 inch round baking dish with tortilla chips.  Arrange 4 ladyfingers in dish, overlapping slightly.  Top with 2 tablespoons cherry flavored tortilla chips and 2 tablespoons tomato slices.  Cover with remaining 4 ounce tortilla chips, 2 per serving.

title: Pasta with Beans, Dilled Pickles and White Pimentos
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 3 tablespoons pickles, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill pickle, chopped | fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine beans, pickles, 1/2 tsp of black pepper sauce, dried rosemary and dill pickle.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.  Rinse the beans in a colander and pat dry with a absorbent paper towel.  Place in a skillet with 2 cups water.  Cover and boil 8 to 10 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.  Drain off any remaining water.  Mix together sugar, hot pepper sauce and palm sugar.  Cook and stir until sugar dissolves.  Drain cooked vegetables, add the beans and stir to combine.  Serve warm.

title: Chinese Style Noodles - Bo Ling
ingredients: 6 -8 stalks bok choy | 1 cup chopped bell peppers ( can use red if you prefer )
instructions: Trim bok choy, leaving about 2 1/2 inches of stems attached.  Slice leaves in half lengthwise.  Combine all ingredients and stir until vegetables are well coated in the mixture.  Chill in refrigerator for 30 - 30 minutes.

title: Wasabi Ham Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wasabi powder | 2 pounds ham, cut into cubes
instructions: Pour wasabi onto a plate, and place ham cubes into it to soak while the wasabi sets, about 30 minutes.  Place wood skewers in a saucepan or metal bowl, pour in enough water to cover ham cubes, and place over medium high heat.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until water is reduced and thickened, about 1 hour.

title: Scallops With Creamed Molasses or Can Beans
ingredients: 1 lb scallop, cut into halves | 1 lb tempeh, cut into thin slices | 4 fluid ounces molasses | 2 tablespoons lard, melted
instructions: Place a large pot of water over medium high heat.  Add the scallops and stir once or twice until the scallops turn slightly opaque.  Add the tempeh and continue stirring until the scallops turn opaque.  This should take about 5 minutes.  Stir in the molasses and keep at a boil while stirring to make sure the scallops don't stick.  When the water starts boiling, add the lard and remove the scallops from the pot.  Place the scallops on a serving dish and pour the hot molasses sauce over them.

title: Cousibou (Beef and Chickpea Stew)
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, in 1 inch cubes | 1 liter milk | 2 cups red wine | 1 cup chickpeas, washed and drained | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, roughly grated ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves ( minced ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaf ( minced )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the meat.  Mix all of the above ingredients except the parmigiano and parsley and make sure the meat is covered with a little of the milk.  Marinade in the fridge overnight, turning it over in the marinade, and turning it over every once in a while if you can, it works just as well.  You can set it aside for up to 24 hours or you can transfer it into the pot and bring to a boil on the stovetop and simmer.  Once you can smell the aroma coming through your stew and the sauce becomes thick, you can stir well so the garlic does not burn.  Remove the meat to a plate.  Make sure the rest of the ingredients are cooked to your liking then return them.  Put the finished stew in a bowl.  Sprinkle with the fresh parmigiano.  Use fresh parmigiano on top of each serving if you like and serve.

ingredients: 1 package sun-dried tomato and orange spaghetti ( the zesty-flavoured ones ) | 8 ounces fresh pumpkin puree | 3/4 cup cooked penne or 3/4 cup rotel | 12 ounces of prepared ramen noodles ( the flavourful ones ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1/2 of a white label pumpkin seeds or 1/2 of a yellow pumpkin seed | 1/4 of a 1/2 cup of whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425f and line two cookie sheets with parchment.  Combine all ingredients except the pumpkin and noodles and spoon into a large pan sprayed with olive oil.  Bake for about 35 minutes, uncovered, until the top is crispy and browned and it just starts to wilt.  Remove from oven and spread on a plate with a plate towel to blot the surface.  Spread on the pumpkin pumpkin seeds and return to the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, until the outside of the pumpkin seeds has darken and the top has become crisp and browned.  Remove from oven and spread out and cool for 5 minutes.  Cut the cooked noodles into 1 x1 sticks then spread 1 teaspoon of olive oil into a baking tray.  Spread 1/2 of the noodle sticks onto baking tray, in 2 slices, to cover the noodles.  Pour ¼ 1/2 of the pumpkin mixture onto noodles, spread evenly, then spread ¼ of the tomato mixture onto noodles.  Top with ½ of the remaining noodle sticks, then spread the remaining pumpkin mix on top of the tomato mixture.  Sprinkle pumpkin seeds on top and bake on the same tray for 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is crispy and browned and the top is bubbling.

title: Blueberry Blueberry Beans

instructions: Rinse blueberries and drain liquids.  Place beans in a bowl.  Pour in frozen blueberries over beans.  Cover and put in refrigerator overnight.  The longer the better so it absorbs the flavors.

title: Thai Chili Beef Soup

title: Avocado Cream Fruit Tart

Allow to cool to room temperature before cutting & serving.  Best made the day before, & stored covered with a piece of plastic wrap for up to 2 days.

title: Mul-Mutton Goulash

instructions: Cut away any excess fat from the mince, cut into 1 1/2 by 1/4 pieces and brown in 1/4 c.  Hot fat in large heavy kettle, add the onion, and cook slowly, stirring, over low heat until softened.  Add the spice mixture and 2 cups water. Add the pasta and enough of the liquid to make 1 1/2 c.  Sauce.  Stir to combine and simmer, uncovered until pasta is cooked and sauce is quite thick.  Pour sauce mixture into a shallow bowl.  Cut the shortening into 1 1/2 to 2 slices and sprinkle over the meat mixture.  Sprinkle with the chopped pecans.  Bake in a 325 degree f.  Oven for 2 hours.

Spread equal amounts of filling in the cabbage rolls, and place on an ungreased cookie sheet for about 15 minutes, or until edges are browned and filling is beginning to set.  Top with mozzarella cheese and bake for about 12 to 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli and Nuts on Toast
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen broccoli, thawed if frozen and drained | 8 ounces frozen chopped beets, thawed if frozen | 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 3 ounces good quality bittersweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam ( i use raspberry flavored raspberry for this ) | 1 1 ounce gruyere cheese

Cook over low heat, swirling the chocolate until smooth.  Stir in beet mixture, cook 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cut cheese into strips and dip in hot mixture.  Eat right away.

title: Sizzler Lamb

title: Green Chile Enchilada Sauce

instructions: Fill a large pot with enough water to cover the bottom of the saucepan. Transfer carrots to a bowl, and toss with about 1/2 half of the green chile enchilada sauce.  Cover, and chill remaining sauce for 1 hour, until flavors blend.

title: Mahi Mahi With Chocolate Salpicon
ingredients: 8 mahi mahi fillets | 1/3 cup soymilk | 1/3 cup choc chip | 5 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced mushrooms
instructions: Rinse mahi mahi fillets and dry.  In shallow dish, place soy milk over low heat and cook for 5 minutes.  Spray skillet with pam for extra fat.  Dredge mahi in soy milk and place in pan.  Cook until browned on both sides then place on plate.  Place chocolate chips, vinegar and oregano over skillet.  Cook until chocolate melts.  Place mahi mahi on top and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice and Corn Mix
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked yellow cornmeal ( masa harina ) | 3/4 cup whole grain white rice or 3/4 cup basmati rice | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 cup bisquick
instructions: Place all ingredients in 3 1/2 inch greased, 11 inch x 3 inch baking dish.  Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of water.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes, stirring once, or until rice is just startrring.  Uncover, stir, and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until mixture is firm.  Store covered at cool temperature.

title: Macadamia-Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, washed & cut in florets | 1 acorn squash, cut in wedges | 2 tablespoons roasted cashew-roasted unsalted macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 2 -3 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce ( or to taste ) | fresh rosemary ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove top 1 rib from each cauliflower floret and set aside.  Place remaining head part of cauliflower, cut side down, on baking sheet.  Roast at 425 degrees for 15 minutes.  Remove inner leaves and stalks from cauliflower.  Chop each leaf fairly finely and then place into mixing bowl with remaining ingredients to combine.  When cauliflower is done, drain well and place in serving bowl.  Place the reserved stem part of the cauliflower from previous step atop the head.  Drizzle the roasted cashew oil from chiles over the top.  Serve at once with the macadamia cream.

title: Herbed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 fresh mushrooms | 3 tablespoons italian parsley | 2 tablespoons sweet tarragon
instructions: Wash the mushrooms under cold water.  Remove the stalks from the mushrooms by gently slicing off the tips around the body.  Cut off the loose dirt.  Place in a bowl and pour in 1 1/2 teaspoons of the dried herbs.  Mix well.  Cover and leave in a cool place for 4 hours, then drain.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 cups plain spaghetti sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a small cup of hot spaghetti sauce.  Let sit until bubbles appear on the surface of the yeast.  Add the yeast mixture to the warm spaghetti sauce and stir to dissolve.

title: Chipotle Cream French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | 3 -4 tablespoons rice wine ( can choose a sweet, rice flavored wine ) | 2 -3 chipotle peppers, seeded and minced

With a floured hands, roll the dough out into a rectangle about 2 1/2 inches in diameter.  Using a serrated knife, cut the dough into 2 inch squares and place them about 1/2 inch apart onto the prepared baking sheets.  Using a spatula, spread 1/2 cup of picante sauce on the top and sides of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border on each.  Spread 1 teaspoon of chili pepper flakes onto the chili flakes.  Place the remaining 2 cans of crushed tomatoes into the center of the dough, placing them about 1 inch from the edge of the dough.  Cover with plastic wrap and let sit for about 8 minutes.
