In a large bowl, mix the eggs with the caster sugar and mash together.  Add the cooled potatoes, mash in well, then stir in the remaining pimento, black beans and plenty of freshly ground black pepper.  Spoon into molds or small, warmed jars and cover.  Refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight, or overnight, turning twice or three times.

Random Ingredients: tequila,rom tomato,cooking spray,cooking oat,saffron thread,chuck,bok choy,serrano chilies
title: Beef and Oat Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 6 large roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 3 serrano chilies ( with seeds ) | cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs chuck, cut into strips 1/2-inch wide | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 3/4 cup tequila | 1 bunch shredded bok choy
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.  Add tomatoes and chilies and saute 1 or 2 minutes more, stirring occasionally.  Add beef and brown.  Add oats and molasses, cook and stir 1 minutes or until well mixed.  Place meat in slow cooker and top with vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lamb,russet potato,cognac,oyster sauce,dark rum,creamy peanut butter,bisquick baking mix
title: Lamb & Oyster Scones With Crispy Biscuits
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup rich dark rum ( or cognac ) | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup original bisquick baking mix ( i use my recipe ) | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cubed ( i use red or yellow potatoes which are all i had. ) | 1/2 cup cognac
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a 9x13 baking pan with 3 tablespoons of butter & set aside.  In a bowl, combine peanut butter, rum and oyster/ cognac.  Crumble lamb or beef into a medium saucepan & add to creamy mixture.  Add bisquick and toss until combined.  Add potatoes & stir to combine.  Transfer to prepared baking pan, and level.  Mix together remaining 3 tablespoons of butter & cognac & brush onto top, then sprinkle cognac onto top.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until edges are golden & sticky.

title: Shwarma Beef and Bulgur Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rigatoni pasta or 1 cup penne pasta | 1/2 lb round steak, thinly sliced | cooking spray | 2 medium fresh ginger paste | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon dried ground ginger paste | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped raw bulgur
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package instructions.  Drain.  Coat a large frying pan with cooking spray.

title: Poblano Chiles Roasted in Clove
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles | 2 cloves | 4 fluid ounces orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: Preheat your broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Remove the membrane from the underside of the poblano chiles by placing them on a cutting board or onto a cutting board with the tip of a sharp knife, breaking them into strips about 1/4 inch thick or so and removing each strip as you work.  Cut the strips crosswise into strips about 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches long.  Cut the strips lengthwise into 2 x 1/4 inch strips.  Place the poblano peppers on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them evenly, and season with salt.  Broil the chiles under the preheated broiler until the poblanos begin to blacken and blister, turning and pressing them against the hot pepper frequently with a fork, about 8 minutes.  Turn the chiles over in the pan and roast for 3 to 4 minutes or until the peppers are just starting to blister and are darkly roasted.  Once the chiles are thoroughly roasted, turn off the oven and allow the chiles to rest in their foil.  When completely cooled, peel the skins off the chiles by placing on a cutting board and using a melon baller, scoop out the flesh of the chiles using a small spoon.  Using a large spoon, scoop out the flesh from the shells and throw into a bowl with remaining ingredients.  Chop the mixture into very thin strips the size of the chiles and toss with the peppers.  The mixture should be very moist but can be used a few hours or over night after the soaking.

title: Ginger Paste for Spareribs
ingredients: 1/2 ounce fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 maraschino cherries
instructions: Cut the stems off of the cherries and throw the cherry flesh away.  Mash together with a mortar and pestle or with your hands.  If you don't use a mortar and pestle, just put the cherries into a bowl and crush with your hands, making them easier to crush.  Add the ginger garlic paste and stir.  The ginger garlic paste will keep for up to 5 days in the fridge.

title: Mustard Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/4 cups vegetable oil
instructions: In a mortar, pound mustard seeds with dry mustard powder to a fine powder.  Gradually add oil in a slow, steady stream.  Remove from the mortar when oil has been absorbed.

Random Ingredients: basil,parsley,seasoning salt,orange peel,beef bouillon cube,fine breadcrumb
title: Italian Meatballs in Tomato Sauce (For the Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef or 2 lbs ground lamb | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, minced | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 2 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients, except bouillon, until thoroughly blended.  Add bouillon and mix well with meat.  Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours.  Form into 1 - ½ inch balls and place on a lightly greased slow cooker.  Cover slow cooker and cook on low heat setting or high heat setting for 5 hours.

title: Ginata - Japanese Mocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce jalapeno | 12 slices lemongrass | 1 sazon goya
instructions: Slice jalapenos lengthwise.  Cut lemongrass into thin slices lengthwise.  Slice sazon goya into thin slices crosswise.  Combine all ingredients.  Serve with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,yellow onion,sesame seed,lasagna noodle,active yeast,mustard powder
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | sesame seeds
instructions: In large bowl, combine yeast, peanut butter, mustard powder and 1/2 cup of the onions.  Add remaining onion.  Add noodles and noodles.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds.  Let stand 30 minutes or longer, tossing occasionally.  Note, this can be served warm.

title: My Mom's Famous Noodle Salad (Molho)
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces elbow macaroni | 2 cups korean radishes, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dashi-style liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons green peppercorns, coarsely crushed
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Cook elbow macaroni in boiling water for 9 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Mexican Artichoke-Heart Stew
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 1/2 poblano chiles | 1/2 lb beef stew meat, with bone | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/3 cup lard | paprika
instructions: Cut the artichokes in half or in half again lengthwise.  Remove the choke and discard.  Peel, seed and dice the artichokes.  Cook them in boiling water on medium heat until tender crisp.  Cut the jalapeños in two and remove and discard the jalapeño flesh, cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Cut the chiles lengthwise in half or in half again and remove and discard the seeds and ribs.  Rinse and pick off the remaining jalapeños, place in a microwave safe dish with a lid, and microwave on medium high heat for 15 to 20 seconds.  Combine marinade ingredients and set aside.  Remove the artichoke heart from the refrigerator, drain the marinade, and dry well in a clean kitchen towel and dry again.  Heat the lard in a large skillet, add the cajun heart pieces and cook until browned, about 7 minutes.  Take the cajun heart off the heat and place in a large bowl.  Add the artichoke marinade mixture and the chiles and toss gently.  Sprinkle over the paprika, and serve.

title: Coconut and Thyme Grape Soup
ingredients: 1 liter grape juice or 1 liter unsweetened coconut juice | 1 -2 cinnamon stick | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves ( i prefer the italian ones ) | cinnamon, to serve
instructions: Put the grape juice or the coconut juice in a saucepan to heat until almost barely boiling.  Add the cinnamon stick and fresh thyme in small increments until the consistency is smooth and fragrant.  Then remove from the heat and whisk in a few drops of cinnamon as you go add the cinnamon stick and fresh thyme leaves.  Strain through a fine mesh sieve.  Note, if you want a stronger flavour, blend the whole lot of a while stirring.  Pour into hot hot soup bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lard,oyster sauce,black olive,pecorino romano cheese,soy sauce,bread dough
title: Oysters Rockefeller Rollups
ingredients: 1 prepared bread dough | 3 tablespoons pork fat, cut into 1/4-inch pieces or 3 tablespoons lard | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Roll out dough to a 12 x 7 rectangle on a lightly floured surface.  Place 1 strip of dough on each piece of dough.

title: Duck Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried apricot, finely chopped | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 small chili pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place all in a heatproof bowl.  Heat in microwave until hot, but not boiling.  Use 1 teaspoon of hot sauce to test temperature.  You may need to keep the heat low.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,pear,pork sausage,sage leaf,basil,onion powder,kaffir lime leaf
title: Caribbean Bbq
ingredients: 5 pounds boneless pork loin roast | 1 can pork sausage | 2 quarts pork fat | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 1/2 clove onion powder, or more to taste | 1 large pear - peeled, cored, and sliced
instructions: Mix pork fat, sausage, basil, sage, onion powder, and quartered pear in the bottom of a stock pot.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,dark soy sauce,topping,basil pesto,chicken cutlet,potato traditional
title: Best New Potatoes Ever!
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed potato traditional mashed potatoes traditional | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons basil pesto ( the kind with garlic ) | 1/4 cup prepared frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken cutlet | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place potatoes in a bowl and add the soy sauce, and mix well.  Drain potatoes and return to the mixing bowl along with pesto.  Spread potato mixture evenly into a 9x13 inch aluminum baking dish.  Add the whipped topping and cut the chicken into 1 slices.  Arrange the chicken slices evenly over the potato mixture.  Dust with confectioners' sugar.  Bake at 425 degrees f for 25 to 40 minutes, or until potatoes are golden brown and the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.  Serve warm.

title: My Low Fat Low Fat Greek Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Warm the nonfat dry milk powder in a small sauce pan.  Add basil leaves.  Allow milk to dissolve.  Store refrigerated.  Enjoy it's a secret.

title: The Best Noodles Recipe Around... Ever!
ingredients: 1 lb noodles | 2 -3 lbs turnips | 2 -3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 cup dried noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Break up the noodles into bite size chunks of about the size of the turnips you’re going to use up.  You’d have to do this in batches, so be sure to make sure you stir them gently to keep them from sticking.  Put the chopped turnips into a large pot of boiling salted water and cook them for 10 –15 minutes until tender.  They're done when the turnips are easily pierced with a fork.  Drain the turnips.  Put them into a bowl of iced water to prevent them from discoloring.  When the turnips are very cold, take them out and toss them in a very large bowl with the white sugar and dried noodles, tossing to coat.  I recommend you use an 8 or 9 round metal baking dish if you've got them.  Spread noodles on a baking tray, and top with a layer of the turnips.  Sprinkle with a little brown sugar.  Bake for about an hour and a half, stirring frequently, or until bubbly and the top is golden.  The turnips should be cooked through now, and the noodles and turnips will be nice and soft.

title: French Potato & Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 24 ounces crescent dinner rolls | 2 eggs | 12 ounces ground beef or 12 ounces ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 2 cups beef broth or 2 cups beef consomme
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Heat rolls for 20 minutes to make them softer.  Separate eggs.  Dip roll dough in egg then in meat.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375 degrees 10 - 15 minutes.  Top with sauce, cheese, beef and fennel seeds.

title: Walnut Poblano Bark
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1 1/2 cups ground walnuts | 1/4 cup salad oil | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place poblano chiles onto prepared baking sheet, and cut each chile into 8 long strips.  Combine ground walnuts, salad oil, and thyme in a bowl.  Dip each chile strip into walnut mixture, and place onto prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, and edges are crispy and beginning to crackle, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pancake Mix for Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups colby monterey blend cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Place cheese in a bowl, sprinkle with cocoa and stir until well blended.  Spread mixture evenly on cookie sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 3 - 5 minutes or until cheese is browned and crisp.

title: Baked Cod Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, cleaned and cut into pieces | 1 egg roll wrap, thawed | 12 whole wheat flour ( approximately ) | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ground turkey, mixed spice
instructions: Place a piece of fish in freezer for about 1 hour before cooking it, to firm up a bit.  Remove the fish from the freezer and defrost if needed.  While the fish is defrosting, place the egg roll wrap on a lightly floured work surface.  Roll the wrap around the fish pieces.  Use a sharp knife to help separate any pieces of the wrap from the skin which will be sticky and unappealing.  Arrange a handful of meat onto the skin, leaving about 1/4 inch thick to seal the wrap.  Wrap each piece of fish into a wrapper, and using your finger, make a hole in the center of the wrap about 1/2 inch deep.  Add the shallots to the hole, and roll the wrap around them to seal.  Repeat until all the fish and wrappers are stuffed.  Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon ground turkey on each wrap.  Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place the wrapped fish into a lightly oiled baking dish that has been lightly brushed with the melted butter.  Bake for 15 minutes, then brush again with the melted butter.  Reduce the heat to 400f, and bake for 10 more minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the rolls are browned and crispy.  Allow to rest for 4 hours or overnight in a covered tin container before serving.  Garnish with a splash of white jasmine rice or chopped peanuts.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,dark raisin,hot sauce,hungarian paprika,romaine lettuce leaf,bulgar wheat,rutabaga,herb
title: Nepalese Bulgar Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark raisin | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons ground mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons hot sauce, like tabasco, sriracha | 2 romaine lettuce leaves | 1 medium rutabaga, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup bulgar wheat | 1/2 cup cornflour
instructions: Boil bulgur wheat, according to package directions.  Meanwhile, mix ingredients well so it will be mixed well.  Place the romaine leaves in a bowl and just as bulgur is boiling, toss with cooked bulgur, then top with the rutabaga slices.  Spoon on the hot sauce, and finish off with the cornflour.  Serve with some fresh bread.

title: Broccoli in Mustard-Crispy Broth
ingredients: 1 head broccoli floret | 1/4 cup packed brown mustard
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and stir in the mustard.  Add the broccoli, cover, and steam over medium high heat for about 5 minutes.  Stir the broccoli with a wire strainer over the cooked broth until all the vegetables are coated.

title: Olives from Scratch
ingredients: 32 green olives, drained ( not marinated, or just green pitted ) | 4 egg yolks | 1 cup vinegar | pimento-stuffed green olives, with or without skin, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius / 425°f.  Put all ingredients on a baking tray in a food processor, or blender and process until smooth.  Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and form round thickish patties.  Wrap each patty in aluminium foil.  Place in a roasting tin, bake for about 40 minutes or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,apricot,coffee,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,rose water,beef chuck steak
title: Quick and Easy Faux Burritos
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck steak | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, or to taste | 2 tablespoons instant coffee, or as needed | 6 sprigs fresh rose water | 12 tortillas, divided | 12 dried apricots, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 320 degrees f.  Cut chuck steak diagonally into 2 inch wide strips.  Stir chipotle peppers into adobo sauce.  Spread one side of beef strips with the soaked chipotle pepper mixture.  Roll beef around beef to completely enclose it.  Place on a baking sheet, and brush with remaining chipotle pepper mixture.  Bake in preheated oven 5 hours.  Bring about 2 cups water to a boil in a skillet.  Add rose water, and simmer until reduced slightly, about 5 minutes.  Warm tortillas and apricots in the heated tortillas, and spoon about 2 tablespoons of beef mixture into each warmed tortilla.

title: French Chocolate Mashed Potatoes for Two
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes | 3 inches cube-cut chocolate squares | 1 package angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the potatoes into a large baking dish with the 1/2 cup of water.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about an hour, or until potatoes are tender enough to work with.  Remove and discard the skins from the potatoes and cut into chunks about 1 1/2 inch wide and 2 inch long.  Set aside.  Place the chocolate squares and angel hair pasta in a bowl of salted water and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until melted.  Add the potatoes and stir to combine.  Pour onto the potatoes and stir to blend.  Spread potato mixture into a roasting pan and bake for 40 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Spiced Pine Nut Bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons compressed yeast | 1 cup unsweetened coconut flour | 1/2 cup unblanched pine nuts | 6 ounces chorizo sausage, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried red chile, crushed | 6 leaves fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of the coconut flour, then stir in the rest of the coconut flour.  When the mixture forms a ball, stir in the pine nuts, chorizo, dried red chile and cilantro.  Cover, and let ferment in a warm place until the dough has doubled in volume about 45 to 60 minutes.  Lightly flour the work surface.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,beef bouillon,red pepper,onion,fennel seed,orange juice,grand marnier
title: Orange Beef Sauce II
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice | 2 teaspoons instant minced onion | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon minced red pepper
instructions: Place beef bouillon and fennel seeds into dutch oven on medium high heat or broiler pan.  Stir in orange juice and heat until hot.  Stir in remaining ingredients and heat through.

title: Fruit and Chicken Sausage Rolls  (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 kg rhubarb ( roughly 3 small ) | 2 kg mixed fresh fruit | 1 1/4 kg chicken | 120 g rice sticks | 1/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Clean & devein the rhubarb.  Chop roughly & chop the chicken.  Put 1kg of mixed fresh fruits & the remainder of the ingredients into a large pot & cook on the hob until the fruit is soft.  Take the sherry & leave on a low heat.  Take another 50g of mixed fresh fruits, & finely chop the rest.  Take a tablespoon out of the palm of the hand & place 1/3 of the mixed fresh fruit, & 2 tbsp of sherry on the top, this will give it your filling.  Keep adding the rest of the mixed fresh fruit until you have finished filling your whole mess.  This takes a long, good idea.  Put your entire mess into your pasta maker, but not necessary.  Take your pasta & put it in a colander, & press it with the bottom of the palm of your hand.  It takes a couple of minutes to get to the pasta texture.  You may have to make a bit of glue from the pasta maker & then glue the pasta into the sauce.  Cook a few minutes more.  Serve in slices with a bit of sherry on the side.  Can also be served with a good cold glass of brandy or cognac + a sprig of fresh mint.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,green chili pepper,mango chutney,rigatoni pasta,brown sugar,zinfandel,angel hair pasta
title: Chicken, Mango & Zinfandel Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 container mango chutney | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 4 ounces vermicelli pasta or 4 ounces small angel hair pasta | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 16 ounces trimmed zinfandel | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces penne | 1 can cut green chili peppers, drained
instructions: Puree chutney, brown sugar, vermicelli, and chicken in processor until smooth, about 1 minute.  Transfer to large bowl.  Toss with pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta liquid.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.  To serve, arrange tomato pieces, green chilies, and pasta in serving dishes, and top with reserved chicken mixture.

title: Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry cranberry sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Cover and let sit 10 minutes to blend flavors before serving.  Serve with your favorite bread or vegetables.

title: Kosher Cauliflower Noodle and Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 1/3 cup sliced ripe olives ( such as nicoise, pimento or black olives ) | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 package rice noodles | 3 tablespoons olive, cut in thin strips | 1 package prosciutto, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 small cauliflower floret ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients and put in large skillet.  Cook, covered over medium high heat until cauliflower is just tender, stirring occasionally, about 10 minute.  Stir in cheese and cook until melted.  Spoon 1 t.  Of mixture into center of rice vermicelli.  Top with 1 t.  Of prosciutto.  Fold in both sides of wrap and ends, and pleated sides up, and secure with toothpicks.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,chili powder,veal,cucumber,beef bouillon granule,ice water,soy sauce
title: Quick Beef and Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 kg beef bouillon granules | 1 -2 cup soy sauce ( depending on individual taste ) | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 125 g frozen minced cucumbers, defrosted | 1/8 - 1/4 cup ice water, according to taste | chili powder, to taste
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except for the ice water, in a saucepan.  Bring to boil, simmer for 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat, blend thoroughly.  Pour into soup bowls.  Serve immediately.  If desired, sprinkle with chili powder.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried pinto beans | 3 slices bacon, chopped
instructions: Combine beans and cover with water.  Let stand 1 hour.  Drain.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Butter one 9x13 inch casserole dish.  Fry bacon in medium skillet until brown, about 10 minutes.  Mix with beans and sprinkle with bacon.  Bake, covered, for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,sharp cheddar cheese,ginger garlic paste,mexican cheese,chambord raspberry liquor,cream chicken soup
title: Chambord Rompope
ingredients: 4 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 medium fresh grated mexican cheese blend | 18 frozen cream of chicken soup | 1 can chambord raspberry liquor | 1/2 cup finely minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  In a 1 gallon plastic bag.  Place cheeses 1/2 at a time on counter top.  Shake to combine and then add remaining ingredients.  Line baking dish with plastic wrap that covers the whole bottom of the dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown, and set.  Allow mixture to sit for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Faux Dessert Seasoning
ingredients: 2 -3 large yellow onions, yellow ( depending on the size ) | 2 star anise ( one per serving )
instructions: Slice onions in half, if they are too large, they should look like the edges of a large onion.  They will release a lot of liquid but should not be able to touch them.  I cut the star anise to expose the whole anise.  This way they stay fresh until you need them again later.  If they don't, the flavors will be slightly altered by the amount of liquid they release.  Store in a dark air tight container in the fridge.  Note, if your onions are exceptionally large, you can also cut them in half, if they are small, and store in one piece.

title: Blueberry Beef Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, chunks | 1 package frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot.  Cover.  Cook on high for 6 hours or low for 10 hours.  Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,swiss cheese,bread,yellow onion,salt,cottage cheese,littleneck clam
title: Clams With a Mashed Cheese and Yellow Onion
ingredients: 7 tablespoons swiss cheese | 4 large sprigs fresh thyme | 4 large littleneck clams | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder | 1 cup cottage cheese | fresh bread, slices toasted and cubed | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Rinse the littleneck clams and place them in a pot of salted boiling water.  When they come to the surface, remove and reserve the liquid.  Remove the stems and beards from the sprigs of thyme and set aside.  Place the rest of the hamsters, cleaned and dried, into a large sauté pan and add the littleneck clam liquid.  Place the lid on the pan, place it on the burner of the stove over medium high heat and bring the liquid to a simmer.  Keep the contents warm over low heat.  When the liquid is starting to simmer, set the timer for 15 minutes to cook through.  Remove the clams with a slotted spoon and place them into a bowl of cold water.  Add the curry powder to the liquid and mix well until the curry is fragrant.  Do not allow the curry to boil once the mixture has cooled completely.  Reserve and set the remaining ingredients aside.  Place the littleneck clams, 1 tablespoon olive oil and about ½ teaspoon salt into 2 or 3 cold sauté pans, reserving 1 tablespoon salt for later.  Fill with ½ cup of the clam mixture, and cook over medium heat until the clams open.  When the clams open carefully remove the top shell of the shell with a slotted spoon, leaving as much clam liquid in the shell as possible.  Repeat, cooking the rest of the clam mixture in batches.  Keep the cleaned clams in the pan.  Pour the remaining clam mixture into a soup pot and heat for 5 minutes to blend well.  Add the cottage cheese and stir well to blend.  Ladle into warmed soup bowls and serve with toasted toasted bread cubes.

title: Panko Crackers
ingredients: 5 cups potato, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Layer potatoes in a glass 9x13 baking dish.  Sprinkle with panko.  Bake for 50 - 60 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,celery salt,pepper,yellow cornmeal,pasta,midori melon liqueur,tea
title: Midori Bean Cornmeal Cake With Noodles and Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped sweet pepper | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup instant tea | 2 teaspoons midori melon liqueur | 4 ounces pasta ( uncooked, i used roni's lightly sliced pasta ) | 1/4 lb bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: In a frying pan, add the cornmeal, instant tea and celery salt.  Using a whisk, add the pepper, celery salt and teh midori.  Stir constantly, cooking until the teh midori is fragrant, about 2 - 3 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to package directions.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Remove the noodles from the heat.

title: My Favorite Vegetable Smoker Corn
ingredients: 2 cans baby corn | 5 tablespoons margarine or 5 tablespoons butter, softened | 2 1/2 cups hot tap water | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Melt margarine.  Add water and baby corn.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer, uncovered stirring occasionally for 20 to 25 minutes.  Ladle into hot, buttered 1 quart casserole dish.  Top with parsley and smoke.  Cool 5 minutes.  Run cold butter knife under hot liquid.

title: Mango-Onion Cheese Ball (Paneer)
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups whole milk | 2 habaneros or 2 jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 5 tablespoons onion powder | 1 cup diced mango | ice, crushed
instructions: Place the milk, habaneros or jalapenos, onion powder, mango, and salt in a blender and blend on high until the ingredients form a ball.  Pour mixture into an ice cream freezer bag, seal, and freeze until the cheese Ball becomes firm.  Transfer it to a serving plate and serve with crackers.

title: Venison Burger
ingredients: 1 pound ground venison | 1 can coconut milk | 12 hamburger buns, split | 24 ounces pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, combine venison, coconut milk, and hamburger buns.

Random Ingredients: cranberry sauce,kasuri methi,american cheese,yellow pea,breakfast sausage,penne pasta
title: Mexican Pasta with Sausage and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 lb turkey breakfast sausage | 1 bunch kasuri methi ( dried fenugreek leaves and stems ) | 24 slices american cheese | 1 jar cranberry sauce | 1/2 cup dried yellow peas
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, brown the sausage in a skillet.  Remove sausage.  Drain off fat.  Stir in the kasuri methi and cook for a minute or two.  Add drained pasta and sausage to skillet.

title: Garlicky Parsley Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh italian parsley | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Gently wash the parsley.  Cut off the top 1/3 of the parsley, just enough to expose the leaves, removing the 'crostion' to expose the leaves.  Leave the stems attached at the bottom and just the top of the parsley to keep it from burning.  Wash the top and stem of the parsley with a damp cloth.  Cut away the tough bottom leaves just below the top, but try to remove all of the bitter layer of white matter.  Tie the top of the lettuce in bundles of 5 or 6 large leaves of the same size, or use a pretty woven towel to keep your hand over the bundles.  Wash well in several changes of water.  Dry and cut off all the eyes and any stringy or tough white matter that might have crawled through the lettuce.  Serve the chopped parsley in a bowl with a sprinkling of chopped white and black olives, or use as an accompaniment for meat or soup.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,sumac,tomato juice,jalapeno pepper,cumin seed,heavy cream,pine nut
title: Tomato Cream Sauce (Middle Eastern)
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 5 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 4 tomatoes with juice, chopped | 1 cup heavy cream, whipped | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, saute the pine nuts, toasted sesame oil, and jalapenos until they soften, about 10 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pine nuts, toasted pignoli nuts, and toasted pine nuts to a food processor.  Add tomatoes and puree together.  Add cream and continue pureeing until thickened.  Transfer to a glass, glass bowl, or non reactive bowl.  Stir in minced onion and cumin seed, and allow to sit at room temperature for at least 2 hours before serving.  If using fresh tomatoes, remove juice and peel.  Stir with a fork to remove the excess moisture.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Momma's Canning Powder
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups canning salt | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained of juice ( can use canned )
instructions: Dissolve salt in enough water to cover the bamboo shoots and bamboo with juice, until the salt is absorbed.  Fill an ice cube tray with boiling water and run a knife through salt until very coarsely crushed.  Mix salt well with remaining liquid and canning jars.  Wipe jar with fresh lids and tighten jars.  Wipe jar tops with clean, cool dry cloth.  Put jars on ungreased counter, leaving 1/4 inch space between jars.  Store in a cool dark place.

title: Frozen Strawberries on the Half Shell (Waffelskorpor)
ingredients: 20 large fresh strawberries | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Wash, hull and slice the strawberries thinly.  Place a large sheet of wax paper on the table and place a cutting board over the paper.  If you are using fresh strawberries, cut them in half at the stems.  The easiest way to do this is with a sharp knife or paring knife.  Place 2 strawberries at the bottom of the paper on the cutting board.  Sprinkle half of the cardamom seeds all around the strawberries, followed by a layer of crushed cardamom seeds.  Repeat these layers 3 more times.  Wash and layer the next 3 ingredients on top of them.  Cut into 4 pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,caramel,madeira wine,green chile pepper,bread,fruit,wild rice,chicken stock vegetable
title: Wild Rice With Hot Fruit
ingredients: 1 package wild rice, dry | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup dry madeira wine | 2 canned pineapple rings, drained | fruit, of your choice ( optional ) | green chile pepper ( optional ) | green pimento stuffed olive, with juice, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Place the wild rice, stock or vegetable stock, madeira, pineapple and green chile peppers in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, for about 45 minutes, or until the wild rice and fruit are tender.  Serve hot, garnished with green pimento stuffed olives, and with warm toast soldiers.

Random Ingredients: pigeon pea,vanilla extract,cauliflower,pepper,clove,single cream,dark rum,lamb chop
title: Bahama Mama Jitom
ingredients: 1/2 ounce ground cloves | 150 750 g pigeon peas or 150 750 g shelled pigeon peas | 150 450g cauliflower or 450g cauliflower | 1 tablespoon dark rum or 1 tablespoon rum, to taste | 3 tablespoons single cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | fresh ground pepper, to taste | cauliflower, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: If using poblanos, pick the stem ends off, place in a pan with just enough water to cover, and boil until it changes color.  Drain and discard water.  Wash, de stem, and chop coarsely.  Place the pigeon peas, cauliflower or cauliflower in a pan with water to cover, bring to the boil and cook until the veg are just tender.  Drain the water, reserve a few tablespoons of the liquid and set pot aside.  Discard the clear liquid in the pan and mash the peas coarsely with a potato masher.  Add the peas and liquid to pot, and simmer slowly, partially covered for 15 minutes.  Add the rum and cream, stirring occasionally, to help mix well and allow to simmer while you prepare the jitom.  Garnish with ground pepper, taste and adjust seasonings to personal preference.  Serve over basmati rice, with plenty of freshly ground black pepper on the side.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,white bean,scallion,cornflour,vanilla essence,glutinous white rice,filling
title: Rice With Beans (White Beans) and Cornflour
ingredients: 120 g glutinous white rice | 120 g long grain mustard | 40 g cornflour | 300 ml white bean | 1 scallion, split lengthwise | 1 -2 scallion, split lengthwise | 2 drops vanilla essence | 200 g prepared filling
instructions: For the rice, cook the rice with plenty of water, until it has absorbed all the water except for 1 cup.  Add mustard, cornflour and salt.  Bring to boil, stirring all the time.  Reduce heat to very low.  Cover and cook for about 40 minutes or until water is absorbed and rice is cooked.  Stir the beans and scallions into the rice to start breaking it up.  When the steam stops, stir in scallion, scallion and flavourings.  Serve.

title: Fennel and Apple Kebabs
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 green apple | 3 bamboo shoots | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Slice fennel and apple into 2 or so slices.  Cut bamboo shoots into julienne strips.  Combine all ingredients and toss through the mixture.  Allow flavors to blend and shape into small balls.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,dijon mustard,brown rice flour,kidney bean,flat leaf parsley
title: Kidney Bean Burji
ingredients: 1/2 cup light brown rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rice, turmeric and mustard.  Mix in the parsley.  Stir in the kidney beans.  Heat the mixture for 3 - 5 minutes or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: yeast,bailey irish cream,spice,green cardamom pod,beef,mace,coconut cream
title: Bailey's Beef Jerky
ingredients: 400 ml low-fat coconut cream | 1 liter beef fat | 1 liter baileys irish cream | 1 liter fresh grated coconut ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 liters mixed spice | 1 tablespoon baking powder mixed spice | 3 tablespoons green cardamom pods | 1 ounce yeast
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Set in a bowl covered with plastic wrap and leave to ferment at room temperature for about 4 days.  Keep refrigerated for 2 weeks.  Take out of refrigerator 1 week before using.  Dissolve 1/4 to 1/2 tsp of the mixed spice in 50ml boiling water.  Then dissolve with 1/2 teaspoons sugar.  Add to meat when ready and leave to soak for 2 weeks.  You can even leave for up to 14 days and add 1/2 teaspoon of mixed spice.  Soak for 2 weeks in cold water before using.  Drain and use as desired when grilling.

title: Smoked Rye Bread
ingredients: 4 thin slices rye bread, crusts removed | 4 whole peppercorns
instructions: Toast the bread under the broiler for a few seconds, just to brown the bottom.  Place a slice of smoked rye bread on a slice of peppered peppercorn.  Sprinkle with a little more peppercorns and serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Hotdish Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 3/8 inch slices | 2 cans chili beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans chicken, drained ( use juice of one whole large ) | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 pinch chili powder, for heat
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray.  Heat on heat until hot enough that a slice of beef will sizzle.  Turn heat down to low and keep warm.  Cook the steaks until no longer pink over medium high heat, 2 - 3 minute or untill medium rare.  Add the beans and juice to skillet in a slow cooker, stir well to combine.  Add the mustard powder.  Mix well.  Turn your slow cooker on low.  Strain the meat juices into slow cooker.  Drain the steak slices of meat and place between two plates.  Spoon some sauce over your steak slices.

title: Cumin and Mustard Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Grind all ingredients in spice grinder or mini coffee grinder until mixture forms a paste.  Store unused mixture tightly covered in an airtight container.

title: Crispy Onion and Garlic Shanks
ingredients: 8 beef shanks ( about 2 to 2 1/2 pounds total ) | cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1 cup shredded unpeeled onions ( about 4 medium ) or 1 cup fresh onion ( about 4 medium ) | 1 loaf fresh bread, cut into 1/2-inch chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f with rack in the middle.  Spray a medium size baking dish with cooking spray.  Place the shanks in the dish and pour enough water in the pan to cover the shanks.  Cover and bake until the water is absorbed, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,chick pea,tamarind paste,cumin,chipotle chile,eggplant,head romaine lettuce
title: Chickpea and Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce | 1 large tomatoes, diced | 1 ounce dried chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 1/2 cups canned chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the romaine, tomato, chipotle, tamarind paste, and cumin.  Place the chickpeas in a strainer and drain.  Toss with the olive oil and set aside.  To serve, place 1/2 of dressed salad in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of chopped chipotle.

title: Barbecue Salmon With Sultanas, Asparagus

instructions: Grill the asparagus, in batches, until crisp.  Meanwhile, toss the sultanas with the barbecue sauce and serve with the salmon.  Tip.  Make sure the barbecue sauce is very hot.

title: Strawberry and Sour Pork Sandwich

title: Caribbean Islands Fruit Kabobs

title: Splenda Granita
ingredients: 1 cup splenda or 1 cup sugar substitute | 1 cup grapefruit juice
instructions: Combine splenda, juice and 1 cup water in a medium saucepan.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until mixture boils.  Stir frequently. Freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions.  Note, this can be made ahead and frozen along with the remaining 1 cup of juice.  Reheat before serving if desired, as splenda may curdle.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sea scallop,white miso,mint,yellow onion
title: Miso and Scallops With Mint
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup yellow onion, sliced thinly | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried mint ( more or less to taste ) | 1/4 1/4 cup white miso or 1/4 cup tamari | 6 2/3 ounces sea scallops ( about 1 1/2 inches diameter, see description ) or 6 2/3 ounces scallops ( about 1 1/2 inches diameter, see description )
instructions: Coat a 12in saute pan with cooking spray.

title: Linguine With Soy Crumbs & Turmeric
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook the linguine in a pasta pot with 3 cups of water for 25 minutes with the lid off.  In a small bowl, combine the soy and tremeric.  Reserve the 3/4 cup of the remaining sauce.  When the linguine is done, drain, and rinse in cold water till no longer cloudy.  Toss with soy/tremeric sauce to coat and set aside.  Coat a 9 by 12 inch baking pan with oil, and set aside.  Put 1 tablespoon of the oil in a skillet.  When oil is very hot, put the bread crumbs in a paper towel with a teaspoon or so of the turmeric.  Sprinkle over the bread crumbs and add just enough of the reserved sauce to moisten the bread crumbs.  Turn the crumbs over just to coat the top of the crumbs.  Then sprinkle the remaining cup of soy over the bread crumbs.  The finished result should be moist and slightly crusty.  Cover the pan with a lid and set a few more shakes of turmeric on top.  Let marinade in pan for 1/2 an hour.  Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes.  Enjoy in a large bowl with lots of bread crumbs on the side.

title: Teriyaki Mushrooms (Almond-Mushrooms)
ingredients: 24 field mushrooms, cleaned | 16 ounces teriyaki sauce | 3/4 cup sherry wine ( sweet spanish wine ) | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cut off any excess mushroom stems, and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine the teriyaki sauce, sherry/onion, oregano, and almond extract and mix well.  Arrange the mushrooms in a glass pie pan, pour teriyaki sauce over mushrooms, and place on baking sheet.  Broil or grill mushrooms 7 to 9 minutes, until tender.

title: Easy French Coffee Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.  Sprinkle with toasted hazelnuts in the container or coffee filter.

title: Kalitsa
ingredients: 1 kg beef tenderloin, cut into chunks | 500 g semolina
instructions: Pour the semolina into a large mixing bowl.  Mix all the seasoning, with 1 - 2 tbsp water and place into a large pan.  Bring all the dry and the semolina together and mix over a medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring continuously.  It should become translucent and a thick sauce.  Allow the mixture to cool completely.  Place the meat in an oblong pan with all the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Make sure none of the meat cubes touch any liquid.  Cover the meat with aluminium foil and cook in low oven for 4 weeks.

Random Ingredients: carrot,clove,coriander powder,rib beef,oil,cooking onion,angel food cake
title: Quick Beef Samosas
ingredients: 4 lbs rib of beef or 4 lbs top round beef | 4 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 large cooking onion | 3 whole cloves | 3 carrots | 2 teaspoons cooking onions | 1 1/2 packages angel food cake
instructions: Heat oven 250 degrees f.  Trim excess fat off meat.  Cut into 1 slices.  Spread all ingredients on meat and on one side of the angel food cake.  Close the lid and place heavy object on top.  Place in a roasting pan.  In the oven it will have an internal temperature of 160 degrees f when taken off of oven, the meat will be very tender.  Remove from oven 15 minutes before serving.

title: Ancho Chutney
ingredients: 4 dried ancho chilies | 1 red capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 1 cup balkan yogurt
instructions: Grind the ancho chillies, red capsicum and finely chopped chilies using a mortar & pestle into a fine paste.  In a bowl combine the blended chutney & balkan yoghurt & mix well.  Cover & chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Corn and Bacon Braid
ingredients: 2 ounces salt pork, chopped | 4 tablespoons bacon fat | 3 ounces dried red chilies, chopped | 3 ounces corn, drained | 1 tablespoon crushed sage | 200 g pine nuts, drained | 4 medium eggs
instructions: Place the salt pork in a frying pan, pour over 100ml boiling water, bring to boil, then simmer until the pork is cooked through, but not crisp.  Transfer to a bowl and reserve.  Allow to cool slightly.  Slice the bacon and fry in the bacon fat in a frying pan until crispy, then remove with a slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper.  Dry fry the chillies until soft, then tear them into small pieces and fry in a frying pan with the remaining ingredients till they are starting to brown, shaking the pan constantly.  Spread in a well greased 30cm x 30cm lamington tin the corn filling should run almost to the edge.  Crack the eggs into a bowl, cover with the bacon drippings and chopped bacon, mix well and set aside for 20 minutes.  To serve slice the bread in half and toast in the oven for about 5 mins or until just crusty.  Spread the toast with the filling and continue with the remaining stuffing.  Alternatively, cover with foil and warm for 10 mins at 150c, then slice and serve with salad and bread and dressing.

title: Asian Sushi
ingredients: 8 ounces japanese-style spiced sushi rice | 4 cloves garlic, slivered | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 2 1/2 ounces parsnips, halved | 1 small brussels sprout, halved, root ends trimmed, and sprouts trimmed | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped
instructions: Prepare idahoan signature™ russets mashed potatoes according to package directions.  Remove 1 cup of idahoan signature™ hot fries from hot water, leaving 1 teaspoon of potato starch in the pot, and place in a large bowl.  Place reserved idahoan signature™ hot fries in the same bowl.

title: Linguine With Fresh Raspberries and Spicy Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries, plus more for garnish ( or frozen raspberries ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced | 2 1/2 teaspoons grated lime zest | fresh ground black pepper | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry, to serve | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: For the linguine, bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat.  Add the linguine, and cook, uncovered, until 'al dente', about 8 minutes.  Drain.  For the sauce, put the raspberries, 2 tablespoons of the minced cilantro leaves and the lime zest in a microwave safe bowl, and crush them with the back of a heavy spoon until they resemble coarse crumbs.  Add pepper, and season with salt.  Meanwhile, place the remaining cilantro in a small bowl, add enough water to the juice, to cover, and add it to the pasta.  Add a generous squeeze of lime juice, as desired, and stir.  Add the raspberries to the pasta and toss to combine.  To serve, divide the linguine among four dinner plates, and sprinkle with the raspberries and remaining cilantro leaves.

title: Yoghurt Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yoghurt ( low fat or regular or gluten-free ) | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard ( not sure on ingredients, as i tend to like a lot of mustard in mine )
instructions: Prepare a bowl with a flat top and lid and put it in the fridge for around 5 minutes.  I leave my lid on, but you can also use your british yogurt in place, just like regular yoghurt.  Put the yogurt, mustard and mustard in the bowl and stir.  Cover with the lid and chill.  Done right,.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 1 pound kielbasa | 1 cup lukewarm water
instructions: Sprinkle the kielbasa with salt and let stand in a warm place for about 20 minutes.  Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water and stir into the lukewarm water.  When the kielbasa is completely covered in the yeast mixture, begin kneading the dough in a bowl that has been turned upside down on a towel with a lid that has been rinsed in a few drops or so of oil.  When the dough has become a ball shape, punch down and knead briefly.  Oil a large bowl, place the dough, and turn to coat.  Cover with a cloth and allow to rise in a warm place for about 2 hours, or until it has doubled in size.  When about time comes to a boil, punch down the dough and knead briefly.  Knead in more of the water as needed.  Place the kielbasa on a cloth covered with a towel, and let rise until doubled in size.  When the dough has risen, punch down again and pull off small chunks of dough about the size of a ping pong ball.  Form balls with your hands and place onto a floured board.  Roll out each ball to about a thick rectangle about 1/4 inch thick.  Cut the kielbasa into 1/2 inch slices and arrange across the bottom of the pan.  Let the kielbasa slices float in the pan for a few minutes so that they will absorb some of the flavors.  Cover with a cloth and let rise for 1 more hour to 1 hour, or until slightly puffy.  Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Bake the kielbasa slices for 20 minutes, turning only once.  Cool slightly on a cooling rack.

title: Taco Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken thighs | taco seasoning | black pepper | 1/4 cup agave syrup or 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1/4 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Place each chicken thigh on a greased foil lined baking tray.  Mix in taco seasoning and black pepper.  Roast at 350 degrees approximately 45 - 50 minutes or until skin is dry.  Meanwhile make the marmalade.  Place the 2 tablespoons of agave syrup in a saucepan, stir in the 1/4 cup orange marmalade and heat over low heat until warm.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,mint leaf,fast rising yeast,extra beef
title: Tarragon Steak Rolls (Steak Rolls in French Fry )

instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine beef, tarragon, and mint leaves.  Blend or squeeze yeast into liquid.  Let sit 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Raspberry-Herb Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup raspberry vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped fine | 1 large head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 cup fresh cherries, chopped
instructions: Whisk vinegar, tarragon, chopped lettuce, and chopped cherries together.  Pour over salad and toss to coat.  Chill and serve.

title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 egg ( beaten ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon msg | 2 packages mixed salad greens
instructions: Place eggs, garlic, sesame seeds, and msg in a bowl and combine.  Add salad greens, and mix well.  Dip each egg roll into egg mixture and roll in sesame seeds until coated.  Chill until ready to serve.

title: Langosteen - Finnish Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried beans sprouts | 1 large red fresh orange peel, about 2 inches long | 6 slices bacon drippings | 8 whole anchovies | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Wash the bean sprouts clean in a colander.  Remove most of the water, rinse again in the sink, drain.  The rest of the sprouts may be done in a blender, dropping them into a large bowl.  Squeeze the orange peel into the bowl and squeeze out any excess water.  Slice the orange peel as thinly as you can.  Heat the bacon drippings in a wide frying pan, using a wooden spoon to do so.  When the bacon starts to sizzle and turn crispy, add the whole anchovies. You may push some of the bean sprouts into the hot oil just before they are done to make room for the fried beans.  When done, drain most of the oil from the pan, if any.  Mash half of the anchovies in a bowl with a fork, then add to beans along with their sauce ingredients.  Transfer to a serving plate, and serve hot.  Note, fried beans freeze well, tightly wrapped in plastic wrap, for up to four weeks.

title: Ancho Blanco Dip

instructions: Blend all ingredients and serve.

instructions: Mix prawns and oysters in a bowl with tamarind paste.  Preheat oven to 200°c.  Spoon half of the mixture into a baking tray and spread evenly into the trays.  Drain pasta and place under the hot broiler for 3 minutes.  Turn out onto plate and cover with foil.  Repeat with remaining mixture.  Serve at once.

title: Blueberry And Chili BBQ Sausages

instructions: Mix the blueberries, cherries, chilies, and taco seasoning in a large bowl and make sure that the blueberries get mixed in well.  Heat a pan and add about 2 - ½ tbsp olive oil. title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Mint Salad

instructions: Rinse and dried the sun dried tomatoes very well.  Combine in an attractive salad bowl.  In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients, mixing well.  Stir through the mint.  Divide evenly among the serving bowls.  Serve warm.

instructions: In a large skillet combine chicken, celery and salsa.  Bring to boil and cook uncovered 5 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.  Cool.  Preheat oven to 325°f.  Place chicken in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and bake 40 minutes.  Remove cover and continue cooking 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.  Transfer chicken to a cutting board and shred using 2 forks.  Increase oven temperature to 350°f.  Spread half of the crumb topping evenly over chicken.  Spread remaining crumb topping over crumb layer.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 - 40 minutes longer.

title: Zingy Mexican Fondue for Guests and Mine

Transfer fondue to fondue pot.  Discard vegetables.  Keep fondue warm while preparing meat fondue.  Transfer fondue to serving bowl, ladle into heated serving dish, sprinkle with a little cheese and serve at once.

title: Kale and Yogurt Salad With Oranges And Lemon
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale ( washed thoroughly ) or ( 5 ounce ) bunch lacinato kale ( washed thoroughly ) | 400 -400 ml yoghurt ( may use low fat greek yoghurt, but we like ours plain yogurt ) | 1 tablespoon orange flower water or 1 tablespoon rose water | salt and pepper
