instructions: Mix the capers and whiskey together in a small bowl until combined.  Stir the peppercorns into the caper mixture until coated.

title: Chorizo & Chorizo Crumble-Bake
ingredients: 150 g raw chorizo sausage, sliced | 200 g fine dry breadcrumb | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | mixed vegetables, of your choice
instructions: Place chorizo and breadcrumbs in a small mixing bowl, and season with salt and pepper.  Stir through until well combined.  Press mixture evenly into an ovenproof fry pan.  Bake on middle shelf of oven for about 15 to 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.  Serve warm accompanied by fresh mixed vegetables.

title: The Best Pinto Beans
ingredients: 4 cups water | 1 1/2 pounds kale | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 can pinto beans
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a pot, and stir in the kale.  Place the lid on the pot, and cook over medium heat until the kale leaves easily remove from the heat.  Rinse the cooked kale under cold water, and cut it into pieces, discarding any tough ribs or leaves.  Mix in the sugar, and pour into a food processor with 1 can of pinto beans.  Blend until smooth, then pour into a bowl, and stir in remaining 1 can of beans.  Cover, and serve as a side dish with warm tortillas or steamed rice.

title: Mushroom and Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 16 ounces canned tomatillos, drained | 19 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 teaspoon mace
instructions: Place sirloin in crockpot.  Add remaining ingredients, except poppy seeds and cocoa, stir well.  Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  Uncover, stir well and sprinkle with poppy seeds.  Turn crockpot to high for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve with warm bread and steamed basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,seasoning salt,white pepper powder,caster sugar,thai red curry paste,pork shoulder
title: Thai Red Pork Roast
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder, fat removed | 3 bell peppers ( capsicums ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste
instructions: Score the roast very deeply in vertical lines about 1cm deep.  Heat a large frying pan, add pork and fry on all sides, taking care with burns or membrane until browned.

title: Corn and Coconut Prawns in Coconut Oil
ingredients: 1 2/3 lbs corn ( shucked, with tails left on ) | 3 cups coconut oil ( a bit less to make the coconut less oil ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Dry the corn on both sides with a paper towel.  Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat, add the corn and cook on medium to medium low heat with a lid on the oil will not let you see any oil spill over.  When the kernels turn light tan, add the salt and pepper to taste.  Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,stewing beef,dark soy sauce,pineapple,salsa,lentil,coconut powder,french bread
title: Cindi's Indonesian Beef & Dhal on Toast(Or Tacos..)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 3/4-inch cubes | 1 can lentils, drained | 1 jar salsa, any heat, medium heat | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1 can coconut powder | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 3 cups french bread, cut into 1-inch slices | 3 packages corn tortillas, torn in half
instructions: Brown beef with coconut powder and soy sauce.  Drain.  Serve over bread cubes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cornmeal,mirin,vanilla essence,pesto sauce,beef tenderloin,pork shoulder
title: Pesto Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced on the diagnol diagnol to a 1 in. x, to med | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups of shelled pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons sweetened veggie oil, extra-virgin | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 cup cornmeal, to make a sticky consistency, use a good-quality, grainy cereal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Using a meat mallet or rolling pin lightly pound each slice of beef thinly against the grain.  Place in a pan and cover with foil.  Bake for about 20 minutes.  Turn slices, and bake for about 10 mins more, or until cooked all the way through.  Place on a warm platter and cover.  Let stand for 10 minutes.  Warm up the pesto sauce, mirin, and remaining ingredients.  Serve with the steak.

title: Lebanese Lemon Zest
ingredients: 2 lemons, zest of | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Peel the zest from 1 lemon and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Place on a large, shallow baking dish, then place in the 375°f oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden brown.  Squeeze out excess juice.  Add the zest to the lemon juice and stir to coat.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until puffed and ternsized.  Cool for 5 minutes, then serve at room temperature.  Variations, lemon zest may be sprinkled with sesame oil.

title: Raisin-Crumb and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb raisins | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Boil raisins in water until plump.  Drain, but save 1 cup of the liquid.  Mix the bread crumbs and a cup of the heated raisins.  Mix the crumb mixture with the drained raisins.  Roll into walnut sized balls.  Bake at 325 f for 20 - 25 minutes serve hot.

title: Cocktail Guacamole
ingredients: 1 hass avocado, peeled, and peeled | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Cut 1 avocado in half and carefully remove pit.  Place the halves in a medium bowl and mash well with a fork.  Stir in limeade concentrate, poultry seasoning and cardamom until well combined.  Cover and refrigerate until needed while making the cocktail.

Random Ingredients: green onion,beef brisket,hard egg,barley flour,mayonnaise,orange peel,cornstarch
title: Beef and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons barley flour | 2 tablespoons orange peel, grated | 1 bunch green onion, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Rinse brisket thoroughly.

title: Green Chile Fire Relish
ingredients: 2 cans whole green chili peppers ( the mild yellow ones and the hot ones ) | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Cut green chilies into chunks and then place into a blender.  Add ice water and process until chilies are thoroughly blended and chilies are completely pureed.  Can be stored air tight covered at room temperature up to one week.  Use immediately as a condiment to use as a condiment to accompany meat or lamb sandwiches, or use for sandwiches as a vegetable accompaniment.

title: Raspberry Cream
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Combine milk powder and raspberries in a medium bowl, stirring to blend.  Chill mixture for at least 1 hour for flavors to blend.  Use immediately or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Chocolate and Watercress Pork Burger
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh watercress | 1/4 cup miniature chocolate chip | 2 tablespoons finely chopped roasted pumpkin seeds | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Spoon into greased and floured chafing cup.  Bake at 325° for 20 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,ice,rice flour,almond paste,chicken bouillon cube,cremini mushroom,raspberry
title: Almond Beef Tenderloin and Rice Flapjacks
ingredients: 3 -4 -5 lbs beef tenderloin | ice, as needed | 3 ounces almond paste | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons rice flour ( glutinous rice flour will do in a pinch ) | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 package frozen raspberries ( defrosted in hot water )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Rinse beef and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut a slit down 1/4 inch from top of tenderloin, leaving a 1/4 inch rim.  This allows for easier slicing.  Place meat on a sheet of plastic wrap and pound gently so as not to tear or tear apart.  Sprinkle salt on top of the meat and wrap tightly in a double thickness of foil.  Place in a shallow roasting pan.  In a small bowl, mix almond paste, mushrooms, rice flour, bouillon, and raspberries until smooth.  Pour over meat and bake for 45 min to 1 1/4 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 155f.  Let sit for 5 minutes before cutting and eating.

title: Spiced Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup blanched whole almond | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Roast the almonds in a dry nonstick skillet over medium hot heat, shaking the pan constantly, until lightly browned and fragrant, 7 to 10 minutes.  Set almonds on paper towels to blot dry.  Meanwhile, mix the cumin and cayenne pepper to taste in a small bowl, stirring to blend.  Drizzle the cumin spice with the almonds near to the nut oil.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,grain rice,couscous,cumin seed,baking soda,yellow mustard seed,cardamom pod
title: Couscous and Pepper Pickle  (Indian)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain rice | 3 1/2 - 4 cups hot pepper flakes | 4 -5 whole cardamom pods | 1 baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( or 1 teaspoon of baking powder ) | 1 bunch parsley or 1 bunch savory sprig | yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Put rice in a large bowl and cover with boiling water.  In a small, non stick wok or other saute pan put the pepper flakes, cardamom pods, cumin seeds and mustard seeds and fry them on high stirring for a minute or so to toast the spices.  Drain the rice and add to the bowl and pepper mix and mix.  Let sit about 20 minutes for the flavors to soak into the rice and the liquid to mix and coat the grains with the spices.  Taste and add salt if required.  Put in fridge to cool down and store in fridge for up to 3 weeks although it is usually a lot longer tasting but still delicious.  When you are ready to eat, mix the rice and peppers, parsley and mustard in with the couscous mix.  You can add more mustard seeds if desired.  This is great served with hot tea.  Note, you can also add 2 - 3 tbs of sugar if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,bread flour,angel hair pasta,white mushroom
title: Stuffed Mushrooms With Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 3 cups bread flour ( approx ) | 3 cups white mushrooms ( approx ) | 1 lb uncooked angel hair pasta ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of the flour that you have to use to make the bread and yeast.  In a large mixing bowl, combine all three cups of flour, the 1 package of butter, and the 1 teaspoon of salt using your hands or a fork.  Add 1/2 the liquid that you had previously dissolved in the 1/2 of flour and mix with your finger tips until well combined.  The liquid should be the consistancy of soft butter.  Mix the dough into a ball.  You may be creative with this, as I used almost all of the flour until the dough ball seemed like little dough.  Place the dough in a large floured bowl, cover with a towel, and set aside in a warm area to double in size.  Once the dough is double, knead for 10 minutes.  While dough is kneading, prepare the mushrooms. .  Preheat the oven to 400°.  When dough is double in size, divide in half, and roll each piece into a 7 inch long snake about 8 inches long and 3 inches wide.  You will need to stretch the pieces a little bit so they will be able to stick together.  Make sure when you take them out of the oven that they don't move too far and over.  With practice, you will get better with practice.  Once you have stretched them a bit, knead your pasta for 6 minutes.  The dough should have a smooth, elastic consistency.  Put 1/3 of the mushroom mixture into each of your 3 pices of dough and press closed.  Place the dough on a floured baking pan which has been covered with tinfoil and let rise for approximately 20 minutes.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until the bread has turned a golden brown color and the mushrooms are cooked and soft.  Let rest for 5 minutes and serve with a nice and thick marinara sauce or your favorite cheese of your choice.

title: Lebanese Nuts (Mama Roti)
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup olive oil | 1 lb nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oil until almost smoking in frypan.  Stir fry nuts, stirring constantly, until golden brown.

title: Frozen Salmon with Chipotle - Rick Bayless
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb salmon fillet | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo ( canned ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon orange peel | 1 can tuna, drained of its oil
instructions: Place salmon in medium size freezer bag.  Sprinkle with dried chipotle.  Close and freeze.  To make the tuna and salmon, remove from bag.  Dredge salmon in flour and orange peel, coating all sides.  Place tuna in a deep pan and cover with lid.  Freeze for 20 - 30 minutes until almost ready to cook, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: vodka,coconut extract,gin,oregano leaf,lime,salad oil,yellow bell pepper
title: Papaya Salpicao (Italian Sweet Potatoes)
ingredients: 4 large yellow bell peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime, peeled, seeded and juiced | 1 1 cup freshly grated smoked papaya ( about 4 oz. ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime zest or 1 1/2 tablespoons orange zest, grated | 1 1/2 cups seasoned rum or 1 1/2 cups vodka | 1/3 cup salad oil, such as olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract, or more to taste | fresh oregano leaves, for garnish
instructions: Trim the bell peppers of all fat and dark green spots.  Place the peppers on a baking sheet.  Roast them under the broiler, turning halfway through, until blackened all over and blistered all over, about 15 minutes.  Watch closely.  This should only take about 10 minutes.  Move the peppers carefully to a bowl, discarding any remaining black peppers.  Let the peppers cool until no longer warm to touch or refrigerate until completely cooled.  Peel the peppers, split in half horizontally and scoop out the seeds.  Carefully scoop out the seeds from 1 pepper half without hurting the flesh.  Discard the skins.  Cut the remaining 1 pepper half into 1/4 slices.  Cut the pepper slices in half again horizontally and scoop out the meat.  Cut the reserved pepper halves in half again and scoop out the skin.  Set the shells and meat aside.  Combine the reserved pepper pulp pieces, reserved pepper flesh and the rum and set aside.  Pour oil into a large skillet.

title: Fresh Cranberry Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained and pressed | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1/2 cup orange marmalade or 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Drain the tofu well on paper towels and pat dry with paper towels.  Slice the tofu into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Put the tofu, blueberries and seasoning in a sauce pan on medium heat, stirring often, just until the berries burst about 2 minutes.  Pour in the orange marmalade mixture and stir to incorporate the juices.  Simmer until slightly thickened.  Garnish the dish with the sage.  Enjoy.

title: Sour Cream Cheese Pastries (Pastai D'olive)
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets ( about 2 inch in diameter ) | 1 package cream cheese spreadable cheese, cut into cubes | white vinegar, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Cut a rectangle of parchment paper about 20x9 inches.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,vanilla vodka,tomato sauce,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Pound-Up   a Layered Vodka
ingredients: 1 bottle full-body vodoring vodka | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 box monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Pour vodoring into a large freezer bag.  Add tomato sauce and pepper jack cheese.  Stir to combine, and freeze in an ice cube tray.  When ready to serve, thaw, place on plate, top lightly with marmalade, and chill for 1 hour. .  Note, the best way to do this is to scoop it out and roll in a corn meal mixed with oil, then place in a plastic freezer bag so it becomes a very flat layer of brown film on top for a nice dark brown color.  This allows the sauce to layer into your crock pot, allowing the sauce to go into the bottom of the crock pot through the layers of cheese and pepper jack cheese before finishing with the cheese layer on top.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,orange blossom water,red onion,stuffing mix,cocoa powder
title: Easy Chocolate Rice Vinegar Balls
ingredients: 1 bag seasoned stuffing mix ( or your favorite flavor ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups red onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a large bowl, mix rice vinegar, onions, orange blossom water, and cocoa.  Add cereal mix and stir to thoroughly combine.  Add enough water to make the mixture dry, slightly sticky, and somewhat wet.  Mix all ingredients thoroughly.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours, stirring every 2 - 3 hours.  Roll into 1 inch balls and roll again on lightly floured surface until slightly flattened.  Place onto a lightly greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly.  Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Remove from sheet and cool on wire rack.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,lovage,cherry,hot chili sauce,soup,beef chuck roast
title: Beef Gravy With Savoury
ingredients: 800 g beef chuck roast | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 3 tablespoons sour soup | 1 dash fresh lovage | 1 fresh cherry | fresh sage, to taste
instructions: In a heavy bottomed pan, brown roast.  Add some water and simmer slowly for at least 1 hour, or longer if necessary. .  Remove the beef from the broth and drain off any accumulated fat.  Remove the meat from the pot with a slotted spoon and cool under cold running water.  Make sure you don't catch any of the blood that rises to the surface.  Cut the meat into cubes or shred, and return it to the sauce.  Mix together the chilli sauce, sour soup, lovage and a good sprinkling of salt and pepper.  Add the chopped cherry and sage.

title: Lek Sticks
ingredients: 3 leeks, thoroughly cleaned, white tops only and sliced into thick rounds | 6 sheets rice paper | 4 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c line a baking tray with baking paper.  Put the leeks and approximately 1 tbsp tabasco sauce in each piece of paper, then arrange one round at a time on the baking tray and brush each edge with the remaining tabasco sauce.  Bake the leeks in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until cooked through.  Allow to cool slightly before placing on a cutting board.  Serve with your favourite side dishes.

title: Baked Beans With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 3 cups brussels sprouts ( about 4-8 ) | 1 tablespoon tamari, divided ( or soy sauce ) | 1 garlic clove, minced | 2 -3 teaspoons pine nuts | 1 large fresh fig, chopped coarsely | chopped cilantro, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place sprouts on an ungreased baking sheet and brush all sides with 1 t tamari and 3 t minced garlic.  Make sure the whole nut has been roughly distributed over the sprouts.  Sprinkle figs with pine nuts and any remaining minced garlic.  Bake for 12 - 18 minutes, or until they are tender.  Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine,genoa salami,tomato,pistachio,jicama,red onion,green chile pepper
title: The Real Italian Robustos
ingredients: 24 slices genoa salami | 12 slices jicama | 1 pound ripe tomato, cut into wedges | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 green chile pepper, cut into rings | 1/4 cup pistachios, grated | 3/4 cup white wine
instructions: Toast the salami for 2 to 3 minutes at 400 degrees f.  Cut the salami into 2 or 3 pieces per slice, and arrange them on a plate.  Place the tomato wedges, red onion, chile pepper, pistachios, and white wine in a steamer basket over boiling water, and steam the tomatoes over the open flame of the steamers for 10 minutes.  Serve the briskly flavored robustos with the wine on the side.

title: Raisin and Spice Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup seedless raisin-free preserved ra el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oil and vinegar.  Add the spices and toss to thoroughly coat all the raisins.  Add sugar if desired and store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Raspberry Crabsticks
ingredients: 1 lb lump crabmeat, picked over and picked over | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons horseradish, grated | toothpick | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 2 teaspoons mint sauce
instructions: In another bowl, combine 1/2 tblspsps.  Of chili powder with crabmeat and let stand 5 minutes.  Dip crabmeat into hot chili powder to coat completely.  Chill.  Arrange on a baking tray and bake in a medium oven or 425f oven for 30 - 35 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Spinach, Mustard, Parsley and Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup yellow mustard seed, and 2 tablespoons prepared dijon-style mustard | 2 cups chopped fresh italian parsley ( about 8 leaves )
instructions: Spread mustard evenly in ungreased 8 inch square baking dish.  Sprinkle both sides of mustard evenly with about 1/4 tsp each of the coarsely chopped parsley and coarsely coiled yellow mustard seeds.  Scatter remaining 2 tbsp of coarsely chopped parsley on top of mustard.  Cover with plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature for 45 - 60 minutes.  Uncover and let cool 30 - 60 minutes longer.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,lime juice,orange juice,iceberg lettuce
title: Healthy Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lettuce, outer leaves removed ( about 3 pounds ) | 6 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( optional )
instructions: Remove the leaves from the lettuce, and using very damp hands, squeeze out all excess water before removing the outer lettuce leaves.  Coarsely chop the center section of the lettuce into 1/4 inch dice.  Place all the ingredients, except for the oil, into a plastic bag, and shake to mix.  Place 1 tablespoon of the mixture on each lettuce leaf, roll up, and serve with salsa.

title: Fried Corn Risotto With Horseradish Cream
ingredients: 6 cups corn, kernels and husks removed | 1 1/2 cups single cream | 1 cup coriander mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup rye bread, cut into small cubes | 5 1/2 tablespoons ghee or 5 1/2 tablespoons butter | 1 jar arborio rice
instructions: Rinse corn kernels and husks, removing any tough or damaged husks.  Place corn kernels between 2 sheets of wax paper and roll over to form a 6 - 8 inch long cylinder.  Chill for 30 minutes.  Heat cream and coriander in a large, heavy based saucepan or stockpot over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes, or until the cream comes to just below boiling point.  Remove from heat and add cereal and mace, stirring with a fork to combine.  Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan over high heat until smoking, but not smoking.  Spread half of the rice into a shallow pan lined with a shallow dish to catch any water.  Layer corn rasotto on rice and spread evenly with cream.  Place pan over medium high heat and cook for 20 seconds, or until heated through and light golden.  Turn off heat.  Repeat with remaining rice, reheating hot oil and cream in pan if any water has evaporated during cooking.  Remove from heat and sprinkle with horseradish cream.

title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed | 6 tablespoons sago | 6 tablespoons tomato puree, strained | 1 tablespoon lime juice, fresh | 1 english cucumber, grated
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of anise in a dry pan over low heat.  Add toasted sago and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.  Stir in the tomato puree and leave to simmer for 2 minutes.  Stir in the lime juice and cook for 4 - 5 minutes, or until heated.  Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the grated cucumber.

title: Easy Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 8 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 3 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bake potatoes for about 1 hour, or until tender.  Cool, peel, and mash with cheese and butter until smooth.  Stir in warm water and dry yeast.  Pour into a greased 9x13 inch pan.  Cover with a towel, and place in a warm place to rise until doubled.  Bake in preheated 350 degrees f oven until top is golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Fenugreek Leaves
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 3 1/2 tablespoons english mustard
instructions: In a small dry frying pan, toast the fenugreek seeds over medium heat, shaking the pan constantly, until they become fragrant and dark golden in color and smell aromatic.  This should only take 3 to 4 minutes.  Transfer the fenugreek to a pestle and mortar.  Stir in the mustard and coarsely grind to a fine powder.

title: Curry Catfish
ingredients: 4 catfish fillets | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 3 baby carrots
instructions: Brush catfish fillets with curry paste.  Lightly coat with curry paste and set aside in refrigerator for 30 minutes.  Preheat coals or gas grill to high.  Place catfish on grate and cook for 5 - 10 minutes per side or until easily flaked with a fork.  To serve, top fillets with carrots and curry sauce.

title: French Tomato Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 8 ounces fresh plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Process the cream cheese.  Using an electric mixer, slowly add the tomatoes.  Stirring occasionally, add the mustard and mozzarella cheese. .  This makes a small mound of soft cheese filling in the center.  Place the mound of mixture on a serving platter or onto four individual round slices of french bread so each slice is fully covered.  Serve.

title: Lebanese Salads
ingredients: 2 lbs meat, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1/3 cup vinegar
instructions: Combine meat and lemon zest.  Place all ingredients into dish and mix until coated evenly.  Turn onto foil covered plate and refrigerate 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Preheat broiler.  Remove dish from refrigerator and wipe surface lightly with a damp cloth.  Broil about 3 minutes on both sides, or until browned.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,lettuce,egg noodle,penne pasta,panir,thai red curry paste,meatball,sesame oil
title: Penne With Meatballs & Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 1/2 cuppanir, cubed | 4 ounces meatballs, sliced | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon shredded parmesan cheese | 2 cups lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup lightly toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions.  Meanwhile, set aside.  In large bowl of your food processor, combine panir and cubed meatballs, curry paste and sesame oil.  Add pasta and meatballs to pan.  Mix well.  Remove from heat.  Toss with parmesan.  Transfer to bowl with sesame seeds.  Cover.  Refrigerate until firm.

title: Basil and Orange Sauce(Albondose)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1/2 cup sofrito sauce | 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorns, crushed | 1/3 cup fresh basil, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil over moderately high heat.  Lower flame to moderate and simmer for 10 minutes or until liquid has reduced slightly.  Transfer to a blender.  Cover and puree until smooth.  To serve, place 2 tablespoons of sauce on serving plate and decorate with basil.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,cumin powder,mace,kosher salt,bamboo shoot,hard egg,tahini,red potato
title: Fish and  Vegetables in Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet, cut into small chunks | 1 lb hard-boiled egg, cut into half moons | 1/4 cup tahini | 4 -6 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | kosher salt, a dash | red potatoes, cut into large dice | 2 cans bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray or grease or line with parchment paper.  Using a food processor or blender, blend or process fish, egg, 2 t.  Tahini, cumin, mace and 2 t.  Butter.  Place 1/4 cup veg over fish mixture along with remaining tahini, 2 t.  Butter and 1/4 cup tahini.  Taste and adjust seasonings if needed.  Place fish mixture in a single layer on oiled cooking sheet.  Top with potato, if using, and bamboo shoots.  Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes.  Remove veggies and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,italian seasoning,brown onion,black coffee,bread flour,taco seasoning mix,macaroni
title: French Onion Macaroni Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni, uncooked | 1 package cream cheese | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( or mix oregano and cilantro ) | 1 tablespoon instant brown onion | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning, dry | 1/2 cup black coffee | 1/2 cup bread flour
instructions: Cook macaroni as per package directions, drain and rinse with cold water and place macaroni on a greased cookie sheet.  In a large mixing bowl, add cream cheese, italian seasoning, onions, taco seasoning and black coffee.  Mix well, then add bread crumbs.  Mix well and spread the cheese mixture on the macaroni.  Cook in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Baked Escarole-Style Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1/2 pound lamb shoulder, cut into cubes | 1 pound escargot, washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place lamb cubes in a shallow baking dish, pouring enough water into the dish to coat the meat.  Cover, and bake in preheated oven for 2 hours.  Remove cover, discard herb and stir.  Return to the oven, and bake 45 minutes longer.  Turn off oven, skim fat, and remove meat from roasting dish.  Cool 15 minutes, then skim fat.  Increase oven temperature to 250 degrees f, and place escargots in a bowl.  Toss with enough water to coat, and place into a medium bowl.

title: Portabella and Beef With Salsa Verde #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box linguine ( or spaghetti, or other short pasta ) | 2 beef, stewing, cut into small cube cubes | 1 cup portabella mushroom, sliced | 2 pomegranates in palm, seeds removed | 1 can diced green chiles
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  In a large frying pan, add beef and brown well.  Drain the meat well and return it to the bowl.  Over low heat, add mushrooms, green chiles and pomegranate seeds.  Remove seeds of chiles and add mixture to beef in the frying pan.  Place saucepan over medium heat and stir well.  Simmer for 20 minutes or until sauce thickens.  Serve over cooked angel hair pasta.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,nonstick cooking spray,golden raisin,iceberg lettuce,vegetable stock
title: Vegetable, Raisin and Maple Lettuce Soup

ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 3 -3 ounces pimientos, minced ( optional ) | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 pint dry white wine | salt and black pepper
instructions: Heat tomato sauce and pimento paste together in sauce pan.  Stir over low heat in a pot that can be covered.  Add garlic and cook until it begins to brown somewhat.  Pour in orange juice and cocoa powder.  Cook until almost all the liquid has evaporated.  Add wine and cook just until it evaporates.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for 30 mins. , stirring occasionally.  Season to taste with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.

title: Harissa Ice Cream for Dining
ingredients: 1 package harissa ( spicy algerian spice blend ) | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Mix ground harissa and vanilla ice cream together.  Pour into freezer container and freeze several hours.  Once completely chilled, unmold and serve.  This is good with a salad and lots of green chutney.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,cardamom seed,garam masala,bell pepper,orange juice zest,matzo meal,egg noodle
title: Orange and Chilies Matzah
ingredients: 3 tablespoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons finely mashed cardamom seeds | 2 tablespoons orange juice packed zest | 1 teaspoon hot black mustard seeds | 2 medium bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 cup matzo meal
instructions: Prepare grill to medium high.  Combine garam masala, cardamom, orange zest, pepper, and mustard in food processor.  Process until smooth.  Divide mixture into 3 parts.  In a large bowl, combine 1 portion of the spice mixture and the remaining spice mixture.  Dip half of the noodles into the egg, coating evenly.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Place the reserved spice mixture in the hot skillet.  Cook noodles until barely cooked but firm.

title: Tamari Tacos
ingredients: 2 packets taco seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 cup coriander
instructions: Mix the tamari and coriander.  Serve over your favorite grain.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rice wine,eggplant,part ricotta cheese,vegetable carrot
title: Giovana's Eggplant Parmesan
ingredients: 3 eggplants | 1 can cornstarch | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 1/2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 1/3 cup fresh grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup rice wine or 1/3 cup dry white wine
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f cut off ends of the eggplants and prick the outer skin all over.  Place on flat oven rack.  Place on side in oven to bake until blacken, about 45 minute.  Skin should blister even with the tip of a knife.  Immediately place eggplants in a bowl and cover with water.  Let stand for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, drain.  Remove stems from eggplants, reserving liquid.  Cut remaining eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices.  Combine ricotta and parmigiano reggiano and set aside.  Cut 1 eggplant slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Spray large nonstick skillet with pam cooking spray.  Place 5 slices in skillet.

Random Ingredients: mango,red cabbage,chinese five spice powder,red onion,bread flour,bell pepper,tamarind pulp,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Sweet & Sour Sticks
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1/2 red onion, peeled | 1/2 bell pepper | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 ripe mango
instructions: Cut the cabbage in half lenghtwise and cut into quarters.  Slice the onion and pepper into half lenghtwise and cut into sticks about 3 inch sqd long.  Put into a bowl, drizzle with 1 tsp of oil and mix the contents gently with your hands or the hands.  Add the rest of the oil and mix the contents gently with your hands.  Place the stick into a frying pan in a single layer, with the other tbsp of oil.  Cover and simmer gently for 10 - 15 minutes or until the carrots are softened and the onions are crisp.  Stir twice as the mixture browns and the liquid is reduced.  Remove it from hob and keep warm.  Wipe and soak the tamarind in 1 tbsp of cold water, for 20 - 30 minutes.  Crush with clean fingers and add this mixture to the cabbage mixture along with the five spices.  Stir well, cover the bowl and cook gently for 2 - 3 minutes.  If you need to cook the mixture on low flame, set a very low heat otherwise, it can boil over quickly, due to the tamarind pulp.  Stir once or twice more.  Check the seasoning and if necessary, remove the bowl from the heat.  Remove the stick from the frying pan and slice with a hot knife into sticks about 3 5cm wide.  Scoop out the flesh, discarding the seeds.  Pour off the juices and discard the liquid into a colander set inside the serving plate.  Serve with chinese rice and a little freshly steamed broccoli over a bed of chinese greens.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,fennel,basil leaf,peanut butter,plain flour,taco flour tortilla,semolina flour,chili oil
title: Peanut Butter, Anise Seed and Fennel Enchiladas... Easy!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili oil | 2 cups plain flour, sifted | 1/3 cup semolina flour | 1/3 cup fennel, chopped | 1/3 cup peanut butter, smooth | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon basil leaves | 4 rolled low-fat taco-size flour tortillas | 1/4 cup sifted icing sugar or 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f grease a non stick baking pan and set aside.  In a bowl sift the all purpose flour, semolina flour, fennel, peanut butter, anise seeds and basil.  In a small bowl mix the flour mixture, then spread the mixture in the prepared baking pan.  Bake for 15 - 15 minutes, until cooked and firm.  Cool for 5 - 10 minutes then transfer to an ovenproof dish, dust lightly with icing sugar and return to the oven for 2 - 3 minutes to crisp.  The enchiladas should have a nice golden golden color.  Serve with a dipping sauce such as sour cream or guacamole on the side.  Enjoy.

title: Homemade Lemon Stock from Economical Recipits
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth | 1 teaspoon coarse salt | 1 1/4 ounces grated lemon peel
instructions: Rinse the beef broth in a sieve over a large container covered with cheese cloth secured over a large bowl.  Stir the salt into the strained broth.  Add the shredded lemon peel.  Bring the mixture to a boil in a heavy 2 quart saucepan over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer very gently, loosely covered, stirring once or twice, until the liquid is reduced by approximately 1 1/4, about 6 hours.  Add more condensed broth, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, if necessary.  Remove the pan from the heat, cover, and cool completely before opening.  Store in cool, dry place.

title: Easy Pistachio Cheese Party Pinwheels
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen pistachio pudding mix | 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere or 1/2 cup swiss cheese | 1/4 cup cocoa ( optional ) | 1 small chopped ripe avocado | 1 small chopped peach | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 cup orange rind
instructions: Prepare cookie sheet.  Cut pistachio pudding base into 2 inch squares.  Place one square on cookie sheet.  Spread with 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese, 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, 1/4 cup cocoa and 2 tbsp peaches.  Repeat on remaining squares, spread with remaining mozzarella and other cheese.  Bake at 400° for 10 - 15 minutes or until light brown, not hard, but not brown.  While hot let cool for 5 - 10 minutes and then remove from cookie sheet.  Spread remaining mozzarella cheese on top and bake at 350° for 15 - 20 minutes or until light brown and bubbly.  Cool for 5 - 10 minutes and then remove from cookie sheet.

title: Easy Microwave Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice ( i use v8 or you can use v-8 without it ) | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Pour tomato juice into microwave safe bowl.  Cover with lid or aluminum foil.  Cook on high in 5 minutes.  Remove lid/foil.  Turn heat to low, place garlic in juice, stir.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Stir every so often.  Stir.  Microwave on high for 10 more minutes.  Serve over pasta or rice for a complete meal.

title: Potato Chicken & Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 2 1/4 cups mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 -2 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c/450f/gas.  Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or roasting tin.  To make the crumble topping, mix the potatoes with the walnuts and mustard and season with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle over the chicken breasts.  Roast in the oven for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked and the potatoes are softened.  Take out of the oven and leave to cool slightly.  Remove the chicken from the crumbs.  Serve the chicken and potatoes on a warmed dinner plate then pour over the creamy sauce.  The creamy sauce should also slightly thicken.

title: Creamy Pistachios
ingredients: 12 pistachios, unsalted | 1 cup half-and-half cream or 1 cup low fat sour cream
instructions: Roast the pistachios in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat, turning them, until they are browned and fragrant, about 10 minutes, and cool slightly.  Puree them in a blender, working in batches if necessary, and return to the skillet.  Stir in the half and half and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until the mixture is warm and smooth.  Stir the cream into the pistachio mixture and adjust the seasoning.  The mixture may be kept, covered, for up to 3 days in the refrigerator.

title: Tamarind Tea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 4 sprigs rosemary
instructions: Fill a small bowl with water and let it reach a slow boil.  Add tamarind pods and let them steep for 10 minutes.  Strain the water, and pour into the tea.  Let sit for five minutes before removing the tea from the pitcher.

title: Beer-Glazed Trout and Avocado Dip
ingredients: 4 large ripe hass avocados | 1/2 cup beer | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh spearmint | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 tablespoons dried spearmint, leaves crushed
instructions: Peel avocados and remove pit.  Cut avocados in half lengthwise, scoop out the pulp.  Cut the shells in half, remove pit.  Cut flesh into pieces.  Place the avocados, beer and mustard seeds in a medium bowl and stir to mix.  Add the sesame seeds and chopped spearmint.

title: Broa & Sheep's Refreshing Herbed Bread
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb bread | 1 whole chicken | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast | 1 can stuffed olives, chopped | 1 green beans, ends trimmed, cooked, chopped | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, sliced or 1/4 cup bacon bits, of your choice | 2 -3 whole cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Combine all ingredients in crockpot.  Cover tightly and cook on low for 7 - 10 hours.

title: Spicy White Bean Dip from the 70's
ingredients: 2 cans pink beans, drained ( i prefer red kidney beans ) | 1 cup chopped pepperoni ( i used deli sliced ) | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( or basil ) | 2 -3 slices fresh pineapple ( or other pineapple slices, if you prefer )
instructions: Drain all of the canned beans except for 1/2 cup of juice.  Place all ingredients except pineapple slices or slices in food processor and pulse until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Serve with slices of pineapple.  Or use in place of the pepperoni slices.

title: Turmeric Relish
ingredients: 2 cups chopped dates ( prunes or dates ) | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine.  Store in a dark, cool place.

title: Pesto Yogurt (From Foodfit website)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pesto sauce, preferably homemade | greek yogurt | greek yogurt ( panna cotta ) ( optional )
instructions: If you've got a greek panna cotta, use it.  If you're not using it, you may need a bit of plain yogurt and a bit of strained or nonfat yogurt.  Let the yogurt come to room temperature for at least an hour before using it.  Make sure to leave it in the fridge.  Before using, let the yogurt sit out for at least an hour.  After you've allowed it to reach room temperature, scoop out the whey.  If not using it right away, let it sit out at room temperature for about an hour.  You want some nice air bubbles to form around the panna cotta to help keep it from curling while slurpping up sauce.  If you don't like your yogurt a little softer, refrigerate until needed.  When your yogurt is at room temperature, put it in a bowl, add the pesto and fold.  Serve immediately with patties or vegetables.

title: Angel Hair With Almonds and Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta | 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 10 -12 teaspoons mixed spice, for sprinkling
instructions: Cook the pasta until just shy of al dente.  Drain and run through a food processor.  Place in a large mixing bowl.  Add the remaining spices and mix well.  Add the almonds.  Sprinkle over the top and toss everything together.  Let sit at room temperature for an hour for flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,white fish fillet,dark rum
title: Grilled Whitefish With White Beans #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 2 lbs white fish fillets | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Combine beans and fish in a baking dish, cover and refrigerate over night.  Preheat grill and lightly oil grate.  Grill fish on hot grate 6 - 6 minutes per side or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,clove,milk,cooking tapioca,cherry tomato,chicken bouillon granule
title: Tomato Chicken With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup skim milk | 3 -4 fresh cherry tomatoes, cut in quarters
instructions: Place chicken in a 3 3/4 quart slow cooker.  Combine bouillon granules and cloves.  Pour over chicken.  Turn chicken to coat with bouillon.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 to 8 hours or until chicken is very tender.  While chicken simmers, skim off any excess fat.  Skim fat from cooking liquid.  Cool chicken just enough to handle.  Transfer chicken to a cutting board.  Strain fat and juice from chicken through a fine sieve or paper bag.  Discard solids.  Cool chicken slightly, then slice into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place chicken, tomatoes and any accumulated juices in a large bowl.  Whisk in vinegar.  Cover and marinate at least 3 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Serve as is with salad or noodles, if desired.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,salsa,golden syrup,plum tomato,kalamata olive,pineapple juice
title: Curried Plums and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes ( cut into wedges ) | 1 teaspoon golden syrup ( or sugar for sweeter tomatoes ) | 2 teaspoons curry paste ( or 1 -2 teaspoons your hot curry paste ) | 4 teaspoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons crushed sesame seeds or 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Combine tomatoes, syrup, paste and pineapple juice in a small saucepan.  Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.  Serve on italian toast if desired.  Garnish with sesame if desired.

title: Tiramisu With Spicy Baked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 teaspoon green chile paste | 10 1/4 ounces smoked salmon, drained | 1 baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees.  Pound tenderloin to 1/4 inch.  In a bowl, mix greek yogurt, amaretto, chile paste, and green chile paste.  Cut cheese baguette into 4 pieces lengthwise.  Cut each piece crosswise into 4 slices.  Spread each piece with approximately 2 tablespoons of the yogurt mixture.  Top each piece with equal amounts of the salmon and cheese.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 45 minutes.  Brush top side of bread slices lightly with oil.  Place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in middle of oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until tops are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: herb,sea salt,baking soda,soya sauce,lima bean,large shrimp,chocolate,almond
title: Nasi Goreng
ingredients: 1/2 lb raw large shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails intact | 2/3 cup shelled lima beans, soaked overnight | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 3 tablespoons finely chopped whole almonds | 1 tablespoon fresh herb, of your choice ( oregano, basil, dried ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda ( lard or butter if you wish ) | sea salt | grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Heat a small frying pan with a knob of butter over medium heat.  Add the almonds and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes until they start to lightly brown.  Stir in the soy sauce and cook, stirring frequently, for 30 seconds more.  Add the beans, stir, and cook for a further 30 seconds, then remove from the heat.  Place the shrimp in a bowl and pour the soy sauce/oil/liquid mixture over them.  Add the remaining ingredients, mix, and stir until the shrimp are coated.  Set the dish in the refrigerator, covered with a sheet of foil on the counter.  In a large skillet, heat some tbs of butter/tamari over high heat.  Add the shrimp and cook, stirring, for 5 - 7 minutes until they turn pink.  Serve immediately, sprinkled with grated chocolate, if desired.

title: Ricotta & Parsley Pesto Bread
ingredients: 10 cups fresh parsley, packed | 2 cups fresh basil, packed | 3 cups ricotta cheese | 3 1/2 ounces country-style white bread, crust removed & cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Place the parsley, basil & ricotta cheese in a chopper & blend until smooth or put through a food processor once again to blend.

title: Stir Fry Penne With Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1 cup stir-fry sauce
instructions: Boil, cook and drain pasta using package directions.  In large skillet, heat sauce to boil.  Add pasta to sauce.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,irish soda bread,grain rice,rice,asiago cheese,mango chutney
title: Asiago Pan Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 boxes uncle ben's long grain rice | 2 cups long grain rice, washed well and drained | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 7 ounces asiago cheese or 7 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 1/2 ounces mango chutney | 2 tablespoons irish soda bread or 2 tablespoons prepared breadcrumbs
instructions: Prepare the rice according to the directions on the box.  In a pan, fry the asiago until crispy.  In a large bowl combine the hot rice with mustard, chutney and bread crumbs stirring until mixed.  Place asiago slices on a plate and coat with bread crumbs.  Spoon rice over the top and serve.

title: Polish Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 -3 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped into pieces ( about 2 � by 2 � by 1/2 � by 1/2-inch ) | 5 -6 large fresh plum tomatoes - rinsed, dried and sliced 1 inch thick | 2 -4 cups salt pork ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place sweet potatoes in a bowl, and sprinkle with salt, cover bowl and refrigerate for one hour.  Bring to room temperature, and cook potatoes 20 minutes, or until they can be easily pierced with a knife.  Drain well and place in a mixing bowl.  Add fresh tomatoes, and 1 cup water, and stir well.  Add enough water to fill potatoes about halfway up.  If you like your potatoes a little thicker, stir in more water.  You may add more or less water if the mixture is too dry.  If too sour, add more sugar, to taste.  Pour mixture into a 3 quart baking dish or 9 x 13 inch baking dish and bake for 1 hour, until sweet potato slices are light brown and crusty looking.  Remove mixture from oven, let cool for 20 minutes, and remove.  Slice as thinly as possible, and serve.  I serve this plain or with a green salad and ice cold milk.

title: Aji Salatasi (Peppercorns Tofu)
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon sofrito sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard ( to personal taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed black peppercorns
instructions: Cut tofu in half lengthwise.  Make slits all over the tofu.  Mix vinegar, sofrito and mustard, pour over tofu and marinate 15 minutes.  Grill over a hot coals or under a broiler until crispy, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,sherry wine,yellow onion,cilantro leaf,spaghetti,blueberry,clove,chinese wine
title: Blueberry Spaghetti With Spicy Sauce - Yum?
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti | 3 small yellow onions | 1 small bell pepper ( or 1/3 cup frozen pepper ) | 1 cup frozen blueberries | 6 tablespoons spanish sherry wine ( or 3 tbsp other white wine ) | 6 tablespoons rice wine ( or 3 tbsp red wine ) | 4 whole cloves | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Cook spaghetti.  Chop onions& peperwhile.  While pasta cooks, slice pepper& cilantro into small slivers or smaller pieces.  After cooking, drain and rinse pasta and veggies.  Drain.  Saute onions in 2 tbsp spanish sherry, stirring constantly for 1 minute.  Add remaining ingredients, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer until sauce is reduced to 1 cup, around 5 minutes.  Add pasta mixture and mix gently together.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: black bean,white bread,slab bacon,brown lentil,tomato,phyllo tart shell,garlic paste,chili pepper flake
title: Lentil Pie
ingredients: 1 lb cooked lentils | 1/2 lb cooked black beans | 1 tablespoon black chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 6 slices thick slab bacon, diced | 8 sheets white bread ( can use pita bread ) | 1 package phyllo tart shells | 1 large tomatoes, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Saute bacon until crisp.  Add black pepper, garlic and chili flakes.  Add lentils & beans and simmer for 20 minutes.  In a 9x13 pan, layer crumbled bacon/garlic mixture, crumbled bread, tomato & 1/3 of the lentil mixture.  Repeat layers, finishing with 1/3 of the lentil mixture.  Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until crust begins to brown.

title: Apricot Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried apricot preserves | water | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place apricot preserves into a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Stir in water to cover.  Arrange mushrooms over the apricot preserves, and bring back to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Lobster and Wine Vinegar Salad
ingredients: 1 lobster tail | 1/3 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Break lobster tail apart in half if necessary.  Clean tail and cut in half if necessary.  In a large bowl, place lobster and 1/3 cup of wine vinegar.  Toss well to coat well.  Cover and refrigerate several hours.  Drain lobster tails and discard marinade.  Shake off any excess.  Arrange lobster pieces on salad plate, top with remaining 1/3 cup of vinegar and serve with toothpicks or toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,granny smith apple,chicken broth,garam masala,chicken stock,coriander,pineapple juice
title: Apple Chutney for Two
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple, peeled, grated or 1/2 cup diced apples | 3/4 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients through pepper, stir in stock and pineapple juice.  Bake in an oven on 200c for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,beef loin steak,coriander,cooking spray,half cream,yeast cake,molasses
title: Aussie Beef Roll (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 500 g beef loin steaks, trimmed | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons instant yeast cakes | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped, plus extra, to serve ( cilantro ) | 500 ml half-and-half cream | cooking spray | 4 tablespoons madeira wine
instructions: Cut beef into short thin strips, and brush both sides with molasses and sprinkle with coriander.  Cover and leave at room temperature for 30 minutes, or cover and leave in a warm place for 5 hours or up to overnight.  Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons luke warm water.  Slightly grease a 20cm x 30cm swiss roll tin with cooking oil.  Place meat and half and half in prepared swiss pan, spreading evenly.  Sprinkle with yeast.  Bring edges together and press lightly with a rolling pin.  Place on top of meat in swiss pan to cover meat.  Cover and leave in a warm place for 45 - 50 minutes or until firm.  Remove from pan and sprinkle with reserved coriander and cut into 8 equal sized pieces.  Preheat griller to high.  Spray with cooking oil and grill roll for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,yellow squash,vanilla essence,peppercorn,tofu,apple juice,pork tenderloin,sugar
title: Hainanese Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 8 ounces pork tenderloin, cubed | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 cups apple juice | 1 yellow squash, diced | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Sauté pork in a nonstick pan with sugar, worcestershire, peppercorns and 2 tspn vanilla for 5 minutes.  Add 1 cup of apple juice to pan and bring to a boil.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Blend the remaining ingredients with the pork and reheat.  Serve over rice or pasta.

title: Simple Vietnamese Style Dry Fried Oysters
ingredients: 1 cup grated lemon peel | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place shrimp in a large bowl and sprinkle with the lemon peel.  Turn to coat.  In a medium bowl, combine bread crumbs and oyster sauce.  Using a spoon, stir crumbs into shrimp until well mixed.  Drain shrimp completely, wiping off excess oil and reserving any juice.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Spread crumb mixture onto hot pan.

title: Frozen Ricotta
ingredients: 4 ounces romano-romano ricotta cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon chilies, chopped finely ( depends on how hot you want it ) | 2 -3 ounces rum ( depending on how much you add )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Take a large bowl, put ricotta in it.  Mix with your hands until all the cheese has been incorporated.  I prefer a hand held mixer for this step.  Put in refrigerator while you do your sauce.  Take the chile and set aside.  Crush the chile finely and add it to the ricotta.  Mix well with the ricotta.  Put on the counter, and work it with your hands.  Make it into a ball, cover with plastic wrap, and put in refrigerator.  To do that, take the plastic wrap and pull it apart.  You want the ricotta to hold shape, not be like glue.  Put it back in the refrigerator, and mix with your hands until all is incorporated.  Make sure to take the plastic wrap out of the fridge about 4 - 5 minutes before you have to put it on the counter or it will not roll out correctly.  Take the plastic wrap out of the fridge, and then put in your freezer.  It will take about 11 minutes to thaw.  Put your baking dish in a big saute pan for the first 2 - 3 minutes, and put on a burner of your choice on medium high.  I use the microwave safe one for the first 1/3 to 1/2 minutes.  Take the plastic wrap and put it in the pan.  Let it sit for a moment, then take it out.  Put it back in the pan, on the burner for the next few minutes, and put on your oven shelf.  Depending on how much rum you like to drink, you can go a bit heavier it's up to you.  If you decide to go that route, take it out, put some paper towels on the counter at the bottom of the oven to dry it out, if you decide to go that route, put it back in for about 15 - 20 minutes.  If your oven is hot, and the cheese has melted into it.  At this point i usually make sure to put the dish in the oven on the middle shelf in a 325 degree oven for about 20 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.  It really helps to get it wetter and more solid.  Take the dish out of the oven, and let it sit for about 20 minutes.  It would be perfect once you take it out of the oven and take out the plastic wrap.  Take the cheese out, and put it back into the bowl until it is totally cool.  You may want to put it in the fridge to get it solid.  Sift or mix with a handheld mixer for a few minutes to remove the saltiness, but i really don't do anything to do with it.  Scoop out the cheese into nice chunks, and put on a rack in a nice dark baking pan like a cookie sheet.  When it is cool to the touch and not cold, put it on your work surface.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,oreo cookie crumb,celery rib,turmeric,sherry wine,chicken,farfalle pasta,beef chuck
title: Peruvian Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 6 cups fresh romaine lettuce leaves, chopped | 2 celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 3/4 lb medium dried farfalle pasta or 3/4 lb bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 1 cup sherry wine or 1 cup other sweet vermouth | 1/2 lb fully cooked boneless, skinless chicken, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup oreo cookie crumbs
instructions: Sprinkle beef with tumeric.  Arrange in one layer on baking sheet.  Bake at 300°f until meat is lightly golden brown and crusty, about 35 minutes.  Meanwhile, mix together romaine, celery, and farfalle.  Divide salad among 4 serving bowls.  Top with beef mixture and crumbs.

title: Honduran Spicy Wood Shooters
ingredients: 2 -3 bamboo shoots | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine the hot pepper and cayenne pepper in a small bowl or a resealable plastic bag.  Add the bamboo shoots and close bag.  Marinade for 2 - 12 hours in the refrigerator, tossing occasionally.  Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes prior to using.  Cut into strips 4 - 5 long and 1/2 wide.  Arrange on a small dehydrator rack.  Close the door and set timer for 15 minutes.  Open the door slightly and rearrange the strips onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 5 minutes on the rack.  Turn off the oven and allow the wood to cool, about 15 - 20 minutes more.  Remove and blot dry with paper towels.

title: Pudina
ingredients: bread cubes | serrano chili or cayenne pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bread machine and select the appropriate crust type and time to dry.  If using cayenne pepper, add before the end of baking.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,cocoa powder,pecorino romano cheese,asafoetida powder,bread,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 10 frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1 2/3 c per cup ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) or 1 pinch comino grated fresh nutmeg ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3/4 cup bread
instructions: Place thawed artichoke hearts, chili garlic sauce, cheese and a pinch of the asafoetida or nutmeg in the container of a food processor.  Pulse until combined well.  Taste dip and add more sauce and/or cheese as desired.  Spread mixture in a 2 quart casserole dish.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 3 days.  To serve, preheat oven to 350f, spray a 9x13 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Melt bread in microwave, stirring often, until toasted and creamy.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,cider vinegar,green olive,meat tenderizer,self raising flour,hot paprika,feta,crouton
title: Paprika Wrapped Meat - Feta
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat or 1 lb ground lamb | 1 cup crumbled feta | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 3/4 cups self-raising flour | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 cup crouton
instructions: Mix meat with seasonings.  Shape into 6 patties and roll in flour.  Bake at c for 30 minutes in a moderately hot oven.  Meanwhile mix dressing and mix well.  Place patties on hot rack in baking dish and cover with vented foil.  Simmer for about 25 minutes.  Combine the topping ingredients.  Stir in salad.  Slice meat to serve.

title: Sweet Chili Sweet Potato Cakes
ingredients: 3 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 fresh green chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc.  Bake sweet potatoes in a baking tray for 45 minutes.  When cool, mash with a fork.  Add chilli powder, lime juice and mix to combine.  Pile on to 24 greased and lined mini stick tray.  Bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes or until golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,triple sec,beef,bean,chipotle chile adobo,matzo meal,bread dough
title: Matzoh or Chipotles Filled Beef Braid #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 can baked beans, drained, rinsed | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon bread dough | 1/2 cup matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Mix together ground beef, drained baked beans, chipoltes, vinegar, triple sec, and bread flour in a bowl until well combined.  Spoon mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake 35 - 40 minutes or until crust is golden.

title: Baked Snow Peas for Two
ingredients: 1 lb small snow peas ( about 2-1/2 lb. ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped crystallized garlic or 1/4 cup whole roasted garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Scatter steaming rack down center of oven.

title: Balsamic-Spiked Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, fish sauce and dry roasted peanuts.  Set aside 2 tablespoons of the peanut mixture.

title: Cannys' Rump Roast
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh rump roast | 1 can lager beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Remove the rump roast from the can.  Wrap the rump roast evenly in the parchment paper.  Stuff with beer.  Refrigerate roast 2 hours, or overnight.  Place the rump roast on the prepared baking sheet, and bake for 5 to 6 hours in the preheated oven.

title: Barbecue Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts | 1/4 cup prepared barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin | 2 tablespoons salad leaves, rinsed | 1 loaf white bread, grilled | 1 ounce chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place chicken breasts between two sheets of wax paper and pound down with a mallet.  Spread 1/4 cup bbq sauce over each breast and top with remaining bbq sauce, vinegar, and mirin.  Allow to marinate for 2 to 24 hours.  Preheat grill.  Remove chicken from marinade and cut in quarters.  Place bread on grill.  Grill until browned, turning once.  Top each piece of grilled chicken with 1/4 cup mint.  Allow to rest for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Tamarind Sausage (Spicy)
ingredients: 1 pound mild italian sausage | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Cook italian sausage in the sausage grease, turning continuously, until browned, and no longer pink.  When sausage is done, remove from skillet and allow it to cool slightly.  In a medium bowl, heat cream over medium heat until it bubbles, but doesn't boil.  Stir in tamarind paste and remove from heat.  Transfer hot cream to a bowl, and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,oregano leaf,whipping cream,cardamom pod,red chili pepper
title: Fish Saute With Sour Cream (Sinangag)
ingredients: 3 lbs red snapper fillets, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves or 1 tablespoon minced cilantro | 3 cardamom pods, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon freshly crushed red chili pepper ( or less ) | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oregano with the cardamom, chili peppers and whipping cream.  Stir for one minute and then whisk in the sour cream mixture.  Set aside.  In a large skillet, lightly coat with cooking spray.  Add the fish and saute until lightly browned.  Add the sour cream mixture to the fish mixture and lower the heat.  Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, turning once or twice.  Serve immediately.

title: Pesto Vinegar
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/8 teaspoon allspice berries
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a jar.  Close lid and shake well.  Keep refrigerated.  For best results, shake well before serving.

title: Cheese Baked Veal
ingredients: 1 veal, rinsed, patted dry and fat trimmed | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1 cup low-fat monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Pat the veal dry and place in a heavy pan that will completely wrap the veal in a thin layer of cheese.  Pour 1/2 the pesto over the veal.  Bake for 45 mintues, turn once, and bake for 15 minutes.  The cheese will brown slightly and the veal will look creamy.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,jicama,chili flake,cashew,rigatoni pasta,lemonade concentrate,half cream,italian sausage
title: Zippy Sausage and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 6 tablespoons prepared mustard powder ( or your own ) | 1 jar lemonade concentrate, frozen ( or other ) | 1 pint double cream, chilled ( or half and half, frozen desserts ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( about 8ozs ) | 1 large jicama, chopped | 1 cup unsalted cashews, chopped | dried chili flakes
instructions: Remove sausage casings and discard.  Crumble and cook sausage until no longer pink.  Drain fat.  Return sausage to skillet.  Stir in remaining ingredients except cashews and chili flakes.  Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Prawn Candy
ingredients: 2 ounces tamarind pulp | 2 ounces herbs, of choice, minced
instructions: Put tamarind pulp and herbs in a bowl.  Crush and mix together until the mixture becomes moist.  Fill into ice cream tins and freeze until set.

title: Pimento and Olive Salad Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 1 pinch salt | 1 green leaves fresh basil, torn into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Combine pimento stuffed olives with salt and green basil in a bowl of a blender.

title: Roasted Crescent Peppers
ingredients: 1/3 cup cranberries | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1 green bell pepper - seeded, membranes removed, and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the cranberries, maple syrup, green bell pepper, and dried herb blend in a 2 quart casserole dish.  Spread cranberry mixture into the casserole dish, and bake 35 minutes, until cranberries are browned.

title: Cured Sticky Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons minced chives
instructions: Place the steaks between 2 wax paper, each 1/4 inch thick.  Using a meat pounder or sharp knife, make cuts on both sides of the steaks 2 or 3 times, to within 1 inch of the thickness for each steak.  Tie with kitchen twine and place in glass baking dish.  Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon chili flakes.  Cover and let marinate at least 2 hours in refrigerator.  Pour off marinade and spread on wax paper.  Use the reserved marinade to baste the steak.  Roast uncovered at 300° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours, brushing with the reserved marinade at least twice during cooking.  Transfer steaks to serving plates and sprinkle with chives.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,hamburger,self raising flour,soda water,dijon mustard,cremini mushroom,caraway seed,snow pea
title: Cottage Fritters With Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 225 g sliced cremini mushrooms ( about 4 ) | 115 g chopped hamburger | 115 g chopped baby grey mushrooms ( about 3 ) | 50 g snow peas | 50 g self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon coarse wheat flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder or 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon crushed caraway seed
instructions: Place the mushrooms and hamburger in a large bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients and mix until just combined.  Heat a frypan, add 1 tsp oil and fry fritters a few at a time until golden underneath, about 3 minutes each side.  Transfer to a paper towel lined baking sheet and keep warm in the oven at 200°c.  Serve with the sweet and sour sauce.

title: Raspberry, Bourbon & Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 1 box frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons dried mixed italian herbs | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh raspberries | 1 tablespoon bourbon ( optional ) | 1 dash italian herbs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place turkey in frying pan with a generous drizzle of oil if necessary.  Gently press the turkey into the flour, shake off any excess, and break it into chunks while cooking.  Cook over medium heat until it browns.  Meanwhile, mix raspberries and italian herbs in a bowl, and cook and stir over medium heat until heated through.  When the turkey is cooked and heated through, remove from heat.  Add the raspberries, and stir to combine.  Pour rice into bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with a lid.  Spoon in the meat mixture, sprinkle on the cheddar cheese.  Dot on the raspberries, pour on the bourbon and sprinkle on the italian herb mix.  Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until bubbly and the raspberries start to pop along the sides of the dish.

title: Chinese Style Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried pinto beans | 3 -4 cups oil | 1/2 cup fresh ginger-garlic paste, with | season salt | 1 tablespoon oat
instructions: Place the beans in a large pot, pour boiling water over them, just enough to cover them.  Add all the remaining ingredients and stir.  Cover and cook over medium heat for approximately 4 hours.  Stir the beans after half an hour and check for doneness. .  The beans will be soft, creamy, and crispy when ready.

title: Spicy Beef Pasilla
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin or 1 lb boneless lamb, cut into very thin slices | 2 tablespoons brandy ( or cognac ) | 2 packages farfalle pasta or ( 16 1/2 ounce ) packages other tubular pasta, cooked | 2 tablespoons masa harina ( mexican corn flour ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh serrano chili | 1/2 cup crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Heat a large skillet until very hot but not smoking.  Add beef slices to the pan and saute on both sides until lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes per side.  Transfer to a paper towel lined plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm while making pasta.  In a small bowl, combine brandy or cognac and set aside.  Turn on the broiler.  Place farfalle pasta in a large bowl.  Add 1 1/2 cups water, a pinch of salt, 1 tablespoon masa harina, a pinch of minced chile, and 1/2 tablespoon grated cheese.  Toss until mixed evenly and evenly coated.  Add the brandy, then stir to combine.  Place a platter on top of the farfalle pasta, then ladle over the beef and sauce.  Sprinkle remaining cheese evenly over top.  Broil the cheese until it is bubbly, 8 - 10 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,italian bread,pine nut,chipotle chile adobo,canola oil,salmon fillet
title: Salmon Sandwiches from Company's Coming
ingredients: 3/4 lb salmon fillet, skinned and boned | 1/4 canola oil | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 slices italian bread, toasted | shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Combine oil, nuts, chiles, and bread in a shallow bowl.  Drain the salmon fillet.  Pat into bread slices.  Drizzle with oil mixture.  Garnish with lettuce.

title: Cumin-Grilled Butter Rounds for One
ingredients: 1/2 head unsalted butter, softened | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seeds
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Mix the butter, ground cumin, and ground cayenne pepper together in a bowl.  Spread the butter mixture onto the preheated grill grate.  Grill butter until lightly browned and the edges are dry and crispy, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,lettuce,cheddar cheese,graham cracker crumb,dark soy sauce,parsley,pimento olive
title: Parsley Cheese Logs from Brazil
ingredients: 14 ounces cheddar cheese | 15 pimento stuffed olives | 2 tablespoons parsley | 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut cream | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 8 lettuce, washed, dried and torn into small pieces | 2 tablespoons shredded sweetened coconut cream | 1/2 cup crispy rice cracker crumbs
instructions: To prepare the filling, in a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, mixing well.  With a pastry brush, spread the filling evenly over the prepared cheese logs.  To prepare the bread, preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cut the cheese log into 8 wedges, then arrange the wedges in a single layer on a cookie sheet.  Bake for 25 to 35 minutes, rotating once halfway through.  Serve warm or at room temperature.  To prepare the lettuce, spread bread slices with rice crackers and sprinkle evenly with the crispy coconut cream.  Repeat until all lettuce is spread.  Top with a sprinkle of the shredded coconut cream and garnish with fresh herbs.

title: Teriyaki Pork and Kale
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 3 ounces sliced chicken breast halves, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 package frozen kale, thawed and well drained | 3/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup hot sauce
instructions: Cook pork and chicken in 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce and hot sauce in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat about 2 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned and juices run clear.  Stir in kale and cook until kale is wilted, 3 to 5 minutes longer.  Mix pork and kale mixture into skillet.  Serve with remaining teriyaki sauce.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,kaffir lime leaf,beef bouillon cube,purple onion,chicken,cannellini bean,whipping cream,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Puerto Rican Chicken Soup
ingredients: 5 -7 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 4 -5 chicken pieces | 6 cups fresh water | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 purple onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian flat leaf parsley | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Separate lime leaves, if using, and tear the stalks into 3 chunks.  Place in a large stockpot.  Add chicken pieces, and water.  Bring to a boil, then simmer till chicken is done, about 15 minutes.  Add bouillon cubes, onion, and pepper.  Simmer for another 5 minutes.  Add beans and parsley.  Simmer for a few minutes.  Remove chicken from mixture, reserving broth for later.  Reserve broth.  Serve bones along with chicken.  Place soup in a blender with 1/2 cup reserved broth and pulse to desired consistency.  Transfer soup to a bowl and mix in cream.  Serve hot with more salt and pepper as desired, such as fresh cream.

title: Rice Cubes With Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup white rice ( or korean rice porridge ) | 5 -6 green onions ( white parts only ) | 2 tablespoons cashews | 1 tablespoon cashews | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Wash the rice and soak in water for an hour drain the rice.  Put the rice on a flat surface and then spread the rice with plastic wrap using a rolling pin.  Spread on the cashews, green onions, cashew nuts, cardamom for taste and spread all over the rice.  Add the rum if using.  Wrap tightly in another piece of plastic wrap or in wax paper.  Place in a cool place and leave as is, for at least one day, shaking the house periodically to make sure the rice is not soaking up the rum.  You can leave it in a cool place for upto 24 hours, but it will decline as it ages.  When you do, you can take it out of the house and set it aside to cool.  You can add more or less of anything you want depending on how much you like it.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,chili garlic sauce,tomato ketchup,coconut cream,bread crumb,quail egg
title: Spicy Egg Quail With Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 4 quail's eggs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh horseradish | 1 can coconut cream | 1/4 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1 1/2 cups tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons prepared chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Lightly grease a baking sheet and line with parchment paper.  Crack eggs into a medium bowl and cover snugly with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes, shaking the bowl occasionally, until egg whites are firm.  Wash a little bit of the egg yolks and set aside.  Remove the whites from the plastic wrap and place them under a warm water bath.  Stir gently until whites are hard and white.  Remove the plastic wrap and press hard, milled egg yolk through a fine sieve and discard the yolks.  Place the whites in a bowl in which cold water has been.  Toss to blend.
