Dip the seasoned bread crumbs into the yolk and then transfer to the bowl with the egg whites.  Whisk for a minute or so.  Dip each egg in the egg and then coat with the bread crumb mixture.  Arrange on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, until golden brown.  Remove and cool for a few minutes.  Heat the coconut cream over medium heat, stir in the chile sauce and continue to simmer for a few minutes, until heated through.  Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin French Toast
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls ( or baguette ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree | 4 cardamom pods
instructions: Place 1 hoagie roll onto microwavable plate.  Microwave until golden brown.  Spread 1 t.  Pumpkin puree onto 1 hoagie roll.  Top with another hoagie roll.  Sprinkle remaining pumpkin puree over.  Microwave just until hot& bubbly.

title: Fudge Brownies
ingredients: 1 can cola-flavored cola-flavored brand buckwheat brownies mix | 1 can rotel | 1 package fudge brownie mix | cooking oil | 1/2 cup rice cakes or 1/2 cup miniature chocolate chips ( for topping ) | 2 fresh mint sprigs ( for topping )
instructions: Cook brownies according to directions on brownie mix.  In a deep pan, heat cola cola, rotel, and brownie mix over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hot, about 8 - 10 minutes.  Stir fry rice cakes or miniature chocolate squares in oil over medium heat.  After chocolate melt, add the fried rice cakes and mint sprigs.  Stir until well combined and heated through.  This should be rather thin at this point.  You may not need all the syrup, depending on how creamy and thick you prefer your brownies to be.  Serve brownies warm with butter.

Random Ingredients: midori melon liqueur,clove,spanish onion,chili paste,salmon fillet,tomato paste,rice vinegar,corn oil
title: Midori Salmon With Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, cut in 4 equal parts | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup sweet moroccan onion, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 - 1 1/2 cup midori melon liqueur or 1 -1 1/2 cup other liqueur, of your choice | 1 -2 tablespoon corn oil | 1 -2 teaspoon whole cloves ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste, to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl set aside 1/2 cup of the sweet moroccan onion & 1/2 cup of the Midori liqueur.  In a small bowl set aside the rest of the sweet moroccan onion & mix the remaining 1/2 cup of sweet moroccan onion, tomato paste & 1 1/2 cups of Midori liqueur.  Blend with a whisk or spoon til well combined and set aside.  Using a small, heavy skillet such as a nonstick skillet heat some corn oil on medium heat.  Place fish fillets in the oil & sear 3 - 4 minutes on each side.  Remove fillets to a clean plate & tent tightly with plastic wrap.  Add more oil to skillet if needed.  Add sweet onions to skillet & saute 3 - 4 minutes til slightly softened.  Add remaining 2 - ½ cups of Midori liqueur to skillet & continue to cook 5 - 10 minutes until reduced by approximately half.  Add spice mixture, 1 teaspoon at a time, until desired consistancy is achieved.  Pour sauce over fish & serve.

title: Gluten Free, Vegan Breakfast Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( raw, regular or medium grain ) | 1 cup grape | 1 3/4 cups apple juice ( fresh is best )
instructions: Boil water and add quinoa.  Cover and turn off heat.  Let stand for about 5 minutes.  When quinoa is cool enough to handle, drain and fluff with fork.  Replace cover and fluff again.  Add grapes and juice and mix gently.  Cook a few minutes or until you get a pretty yellowish orange color.  Put quinoa on plates and garnish with orange slices.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,tuna,cointreau liqueur,heavy cream,spring onion,pork,white flour
title: Tuna Salad With Bacon
ingredients: 500 g firm white fish fillets | 200 g light smoked pork fat | 4 tablespoons finely sliced spring onions | 4 cups freshly made romaine lettuce | 500 ml heavy cream | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 3 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Cut each fillet from the tail on the underside into strips.  Trim and gently flatten the strips.  Place the strips on a greased tray and spread with cream.  Sprinkle each with a little grated bacon and sprinkle with onion.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,coffee powder,baking soda,monosodium glutamate,creme fraiche,phyllo pastry,soymilk
title: Homemade Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups soymilk | 3 tablespoons creme fraiche ( or vanilla yogurt ) or 3 tablespoons cream ( or vanilla yogurt ) | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 3 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional ) | 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Combine soy milk, creme fraiche or yogurt, coffee powder, bay leaves, baking soda, and monosodium glutamate in a large bowl.  Combine phyllo and a bit of the liquid from soy milk mixture in a separate bowl.  Layer 5 sheets on each of four sheets of phyllo brushed with olive oil and fold them together in a half moon shape.  Place filled pie in a large baking dish and brush the top with more of the liquid.  Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cumin,bean,dark soy sauce,green chilies,kidney bean,sushi rice,clove garlic
title: Munchy Bean Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups cooked sushi rice | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup packed dark soy sauce | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 fresh green chilies, seeded and minced
instructions: Place drained rice, kidney beans, refried beans, soy sauce, garlic, and cumin in a large bowl and mix well.  Place a bamboo sushi mat on a bamboo sushi rolling mat with the long edge toward you.  Place a generous layer of the bean mixture across the bamboo rolling mat.  Roll the sushi into a cylinder and cut into 1 inch pieces.  Repeat twice with remaining ingredients, ending with bean mixture on the bamboo rolling mat.  Serve with lime wedges and tamarind sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,vegetable stock,cream mushroom soup,beef broth,orange zest,salmon steak
title: Creamy Salmon With Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups fresh orange juice from zests | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 3 cups low-fat vegetarian beef broth | 1 cup low sodium vegetable stock | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 salmon steaks or 4 salmon fillets
instructions: Combine orange juice, zest & orange rind in a large bowl.  Gradually whisk in broth and 1 cup of soup.  Drain salmon well.  Place salmon in crock pot.  Pour remaining soup and 1 cup orange juice mixture over the salmon.  Cover and cook on high for 5 hours.  Turn the salmon over, cover and cook for an additional 5 - 10 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.  Place the remaining soup and 1/2 cup orange juice mix in crock pot and heat through.  Place the salmon in bowls and ladle salmon soup over the salmon and serve.

Random Ingredients: water,chipotle chile adobo,horseradish,grape,cumin powder,coconut milk,tomato green chilies,bulk pork sausage
title: Smokey Mexican Party Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup bottled coconut milk ( one 16-ounce can ) | 1/4 cup water | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced grape or ( 12 ounce ) can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained and rinsed | 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage ( at least 1/8 inch thick ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: In large saucepan, combine coconut milk, water, horseradish, cumin and chipotle peppers.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Quick & Easy Balti Burger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb salmon | 1 dash garam masala powder | 1 dash sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chicken stock or 1 teaspoon broth | 1/2 ounce blue curacao
instructions: Mix all ingredients together & form into patties ~ 1 inch thick.  Grill over medium or medium low to med heat, basting once or twice with the sauce until the patties are cooked and the top is nicely browned.

title: White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans ( navy beans ), drained | 1/4 cup gorgonzola, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Mix together the white beans, gorgonzola cheese, and bean crackers in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

title: Eggplants in Hot Bean Sauce
ingredients: 10 japanese eggplants, sliced | 3 cups sweet red bean, drained | 3 cups japanese sweet red capsicum ( komatsuna ), sliced | 400 g button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Fry the eggplants on a non stick skillet until it becomes dark and firm on the outside.  Remove the eggplants from the skillet and place on a paper towel to drain.  Slice the eggplant into rounds approximately 4 x 1 x 1 cm.  Heat 1 tbsp.  Oil over medium heat and cook the eggplants in batches until just cooked.  Remove each batch after 4 minutes to a serving plate.  Remove the skin from the capsicum and mushrooms and slice into thin strips.  Add the eggplant and capsicum to the skillet and bring to a boil.  Serve hot.

title: Traditional British Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Mix flour and mustard powder.  Using the heels of your hands, work dry ingredients together on your rolling pin until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.  Roll dough into long sticks approx 2 in diameter and about 2 in height.  Wrap in clingfilm, then place on a tray.  Slice off 1 - 2 cm pieces of dough and use for dipping.  Or, for a twist bake on a greased baking sheet at 180 degrees celcius for approx 10 minutes until golden.

title: Friggrod Dois (Cuccetted Pecans)
ingredients: 3 cups pecans | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Remove the tops and stems from the pecans using a knife or a candy shears.  Place the nuts in a large bowl.

title: Fruit Balls
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup chopped dried arborio rice | oil | assorted fried nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place cake flour, bread crumbs, apricot preserves and rice in a blender or food processor.  Blend on high speed, 20 seconds for each ingredient, 30 seconds for flour, 1 seconds for rice and 1 seconds for rice.  Add enough oil to hold mixture together.  Form into 1 inch balls.  Fry in 1/2 inch batches, turning so both sides are browned, about 1 minute.  Drain on rack and serve with additional chopped nuts if desired.

title: Moroccan Spiced Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, coarsely crushed | 1/2 lb cauliflower floret, medium | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/3 cup kalamata molasses or 1/3 cup honey | 1/2 cup grated mild cheese | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil and add the carrots.  Boil for 4 - 5 minutes, or until just tender.  Drain well.  Return vegetables to the pan, and coat with the cocoa.  Heat the molasses/honey over low heat until fragrant.  Add the cheese and cinnamon stick, and cook for 5 minutes over low heat, stirring constantly.  Serve immediately, or chill in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,salad green,dijon mustard,turmeric,peppercorn,hard egg,flour tortilla
title: Tajib's Ultimate Salad
ingredients: 1 package salad greens | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 teaspoon flour
instructions: Wash, dry and tear your salad greens.  Slice eggs, if using large ones, as you prefer, but slice the small ones too.  Mix together the dressing of mustard with turmeric, peppercorns and flour till everything is blended and dressing is smooth.  Place salad greens on serving plate.  Slice up hard boiled eggs as best you can.  Drizzle dressing on salad.  This can be served with tortilla chips but, toasted, and crushed tomatoes works too.  Note, use splenda, if a thicker dressing is desired.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,madeira wine,agave nectar,pecorino cheese,lemon pepper,cardamom seed,pork,coriander powder
title: Mexican Pork for Two
ingredients: 3 lbs pork ( butt, shoulder etc. ) | 1 -2 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup madeira wine ( or water ) | 2 lemon peppers ( remove seeds or membrane and cut into 1-inch squares ) | 3 tablespoons pecorino cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon pisco original chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed coriander seed
instructions: Cube pork into 1 - 1 1/2 cubes about the size and height of your index finger.  Sprinkle each side with coriander powder and then brown in a hot cast iron skillet or your favorite pot.  Add broth and turn heat on high until pork is dark red in color and liquid dries up.  Turn heat to low and add all remaining ingredients except pecorino.  Place in a casserole dish and bake until pork is cooked.  Serve over hot white rice with pecorino.

title: Duck Confit
ingredients: 1 whole duck, cleaned | seasonings salt to taste | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup brandy ( not necessary ) | 1 romano cheese, grated | 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1 cup peanuts, crushed | 1 tablespoon ground cloves
instructions: Place duck in a 9x13 inch roasting pan and sprinkle with seasoned salt.  In a small bowl, whisk together honey and brandy.  Pour glaze over duck and scatter with cheese.  Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 2 hours.  Mix together cabbage, peanuts, ground cloves and serve with duck Confit.

title: Grilled Snapper
ingredients: 4 red snapper fillets | 1 can stewed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the grill to high.  Lightly oil the grate.  Place fillets in a heavy baking dish, and season with salt.  Cover, and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until fish flakes easily when centers of fillets are pressed.  Mix tomatoes with juices.  Spoon over fillets, and grill 5 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.  Serve fillets with tomato sauce, if desired.

title: Italian Robusto Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces grand marnier or 1 1/2 ounces other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 jar capers
instructions: Crush capers with the back of a spoon into a small bowl.  Beat with electric mixer until frothy.  Add grand marnier or other orange flavored liqueur.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,sugar,pot roast,bacon,japanese eggplant,rice wine vinegar,shrimp paste,potato
title: Hot Potato and Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 3 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 pound bacon | 2 japanese eggplants | 2 cans large shrimp paste | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 pound peeled and deveined sweet potatoes | 1 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Line a medium baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil.  In a large bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, 1 pound bacon, eggplant, shrimp paste, potato starch and vinegar until well blended.  Add sweet potatoes and bread crumbs.

title: African Edamame Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces edamame | 6 ounces buttermilk | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder ( optional )
instructions: Rinse edamame and allow to drain.  Add enough water to cover to edamame and bring to a boil.  Cook until cooked through, adding more water if it becomes too dry.  This can take anywhere from 10 - 20 minutes depending on the size you are using.  This soup tastes even better the next day.  You can cook the onion powder and just skip the onion powder.

title: Quick Barbecued Marinated Beef
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Marinate beef in ginger garlic paste and olive oil for at least 2 hours.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,anise,tomato ketchup,red cabbage,butternut squash,red bean,cilantro leaf,coconut milk
title: Red Bean, Butternut Squash and Barbecue Coleslaw
ingredients: 120 ml coconut milk | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon freshly ground dried anise | 3 ripe butternut squash, halved lengthways, then cut into matchsticks | 1/2 medium red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Place coconut milk, ketchup, barbecue sauce and anise in a saucepan over medium heat.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, until liquid is reduced by three quarters, about 10 minutes.  Add butternut squash, cabbage and cilantro.

title: Spinach Chicken with Walnuts
ingredients: 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips | 1 jar marinara sauce | 3 cups torn fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a mixing bowl, mix the walnuts and the chicken breast.  Spread 2 cups of the marinara sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Put the chicken breasts and the spinach in the baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,chicken bouillon,shrimp,feta cheese,oriental sesame oil,bow tie pasta
title: Cousin Debbie's Greek Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 pound uncooked bow tie pasta | 1 pound uncooked shrimp | 3/4 cup cubed feta cheese | 1 tablespoon italian flavored sesame oil | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup lemonade, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add bow tie pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Sautéed Fresh Purple Onions
ingredients: 8 ounces purple onions | heavy cream
instructions: Peel and cut the onions into rings about 1/2 inch thick and set aside.  Heat up a little of oil in a frying pan and fry each onion gently until they turn slightly golden.  Drain on kitchen paper and serve hot.

title: Lebanese Cognac Lassi
ingredients: 1 ounce cognac or 1 ounce brandy | 1/2 - 1 cup plain yogurt ( or to taste )
instructions: Put cognac into a cocktail shaker, or a 1/2 to 1 cup measuring cup.  Add to shaker the yogurt as per instructions on bottle, then strain into martini glasses.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lasagna,peanut oil,pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef chuck roast
title: Real Easy Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 8 medium lasagna sheets | 6 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | vegetable oil cooking spray | pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to spray large cookie sheet with oil.  Cut chuck roast lengthwise into four pieces.  Spread one layer of lasagna noodles on cookie sheet.  Spray each with cooking spray.  Arrange half of roast in middle of lasagna noodles.  Spread with pepper.  Repeat layers of noodles and meat until all ingredients are used.  Spray top layer lightly with no stick cooking spray.  Slip lid onto cookie sheet and place in the oven.  Set oven temperature to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Cook for approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,grain mustard,sun tomato,pre mozzarella cheese,rum,bean sprout
title: Baked Mexican Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed beans sprouts | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon rum | 1/2 cup fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees.  Lightly oil a jelly roll pan.  In a bowl, combine the bean sprouts, sun dried tomatoes, mustard, cardamom, and rum and gently stir to mix.  Cut the mozzarella into sticks about 1/4 inch thick and divide among the bean sprouts.  Bake at 400 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes, or until bubbly outside and hot throughout, and slightly golden brown in the center.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato sauce,chicken broth,ricotta cheese,hash brown,pork tenderloin
title: Baked Italian Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 lb lean pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup frozen mixed frozen hash browns, thawed | 1/2 cup fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf degrees.  Coat a large non stick ovenproof skillet with cooking spray.  Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the bottom of the pan.  Arrange pork over the tomato sauce, then top with the chicken broth.  Bake covered for 20 minutes.  Place the skillet in a roaster and bake for 5 minutes longer, until meat thermometer registers 160ºf.  Remove meat and let stand covered for 5 minutes before slicing.  Meanwhile, make the salad topping, in a bowl, stir together ricotta and remaining 1/2 cup pan juices until smooth.  Fold in the ricotta mixture until well blended.  Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,plain yogurt,star anise,yellow mustard seed
title: Niter Kebab Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 1 red chile pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon star anise, or to taste
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl.

title: Kaffir Lime Chunk and Quinoa with Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 4 cans chickpeas, drained, rinsed well | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon allspice | 4 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 2 cups beef broth
instructions: Place quinoa in medium bowl.  Meanwhile, soak chickpeas in water to cover overnight.  Next day, drain chickpeas, reserving liquid and soaking liquid.  Rinse and drain excess liquid.  Drain off all but 1 - 2 tablespoons of liquid and set chickpeas aside.  Heat oil in dutch oven or deep skillet on medium high heat.  Add allspice, kaffir lime leaves and beef broth.  Simmer 30 - 45 minutes, until quinoa is tender.  Stir quinoa into beef and chickpeas.  Keep warm on low until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,celery seed,corn,beef chuck,chicken tender,lemon pepper,jalapeno pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Shredded Chicken on a Buns with Asparagus
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen corn, thawed | 8 -12 ounces frozen asparagus, thawed and ends trimmed | 2 cups shredded beef chuck | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for sprinkling | 1 tablespoon finely minced sweet pickled jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon grated celery seed | 1/8 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: In a 7” nonstick skillet, bring 1 quart water to a boil over high heat.  Add asparagus and cook until tender crisp, about 6 - 7 minutes.

title: Easy Tangy Tuna
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast, about 1 1/2 lbs | 1 can tuna | 1/4 cup fresh ginger juice | 1/4 cup kitchen bouquet
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the beef into a roasting pan and cover.  Cut away any excess fat from the roast.  Place the fat into a non stick skillet or dutch oven and add the water.  Place the roast in the boiling water and cover.  Cook for 1 1/2 hours.  You want the meat tender and the liquid thickens it down a bit at 1 hour.  When meat is cooked, remove meat and discard the fat and bones and place in a saucepan.  Take all of the juices and drain the juice into a clean saucepan.  You can strain this strained juice to use in a pan and refrigerate it if you like.  Place the pan back on the stove, add the ginger juice and kitchen bouquet and heat on medium.  Add the tuna and heat until it is warmed through.  Pour the tuna over the meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,white chocolate baking square,yukon gold potato,red curry paste
title: Red Curry Potato Balls
ingredients: 8 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/8 cup red curry paste ( use more or less depending on taste ) | 1/4 cup finely grated fresh gingerroot | 12 white chocolate baking squares, melted
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan of salted water, cover and bring to the boil for 10 minutes.  Drain and toss with the curry paste and ginger.  Chill, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes.  Preheat the broiler.  In a shallow serving dish, place the melted white chocolate and roll the potato mixture to coat evenly.  Place the balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Broil for 2 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 6 ounces elbow macaroni | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 cup semolina ( polenta ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine ( not cooking sherry ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, then drain.  Brown steak in a large skillet.  When cooked, remove steak from skillet and set aside.  Drain all but 2 tablespoons of fat from skillet.  Combine macaroni, sherry, oregano, and mace in another skillet.  Cook about 2 minutes and add to skillet, mix well.  Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: au jus mix,pomegranate molasses,chicken breast half,salt,basmati rice
title: Pomegranate Rice Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 envelope dry au jus mix | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 1 1/2 cups cold basmati rice | salt
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray.  Place chicken breast and 2/3 cup of marinade mix in crockpot and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours.  Remove from crockpot and cut into small 1/2 inch cubes.  Remove and keep warm until ready to serve with pan juices.  Meanwhile, add rest of the marinade mix to pan and heat until boiling.  Put rice in bottom of baking dish.  Spoon chicken on top of rice.  Spoon hot sauce over chicken.  Bake in preheated oven about 10 to 15 minutes or until crispy.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,mandarin orange,dark corn syrup,hazelnut wafer biscuit,half,double cream,chicken stock,sofrito sauce
title: Peking Mandarin Orange Hazelnut Fudge
ingredients: 8 ounces dark corn syrup | 8 ounces light sofrito sauce | 3 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons double cream | 4 large egg yolks, whisked | 7 ounces hazelnut wafer biscuits, broken into four | 8 ounces mandarin oranges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place the corn syrup and sofrito in a large ovenproof saucepan over a medium heat.  Stir occasionally until the sugar dissolves.  Add the stock, bring to the boil, and then add the cream.  Boil briskly for 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly.  Turn the heat off and leave for 10 minutes or so.  Whisk the egg yolks until thick and lemony in color.  Stir 1/4 of the hot corn syrup mixture into the egg mixture followed by the nuts.  Turn the mixture into a bowl with the broken biscuit, and pour the remaining hot corn syrup evenly over the top.  Stir until thoroughly mixed.  Tip the fudge into a buttered 8x8 cake tin and bake for 40 minutes or until lightly golden.  Allow to stand in the tin for 5 minutes then turn out onto a wire rack and cool completely.

Random Ingredients: green olive,spice,taco seasoning mix,buttermilk,white onion,cranberry,curry paste
title: Curried Nite Buttermilk Fish
ingredients: 1 large white onion, diced | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 can whole canned pink okra, drained, chopped, juices reserved | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 3 teaspoons mild curry paste | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup chopped green olives, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  In a skillet, saute the onion in the butter over medium heat until tender.  Stir in the okra, buttermilk, curry paste, taco seasoning, and enough olive juice to make the mixture moist but not soupy.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,peanut oil,yellow cornmeal,garlic head,red chili pepper,pecorino romano cheese,lime wedge
title: Spicy Fried Corn Bread!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of freshly grated pecorino romano cheese, plus extra for sprinkling | 1 large garlic head, cleaned and very finely minced | 1/2 yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce, more to taste | 2 pinches dried red chili peppers, for garnish or 2 pinches paprika, for garnish | 2 teaspoons peanut oil, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place the pecorino romano cheese, garlic clove, cornmeal, hoisin sauce, chili peppers and a pinch of salt in the work bowl of a food processor or blender and process until smooth.  Heat one teaspoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Dip the cornbread mix all at once into the oil, and fry until golden brown around the edges.

title: Potato Chips (Tortilla)
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes | 1 tablespoon salt, use kosher salt
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into chips using a box grater, or you can buy potatoes that are already cut into chips the size of your grater, do not use a food processor or a sharp knife you need a coarse grater to grind the potatoes.  The salt in the chip water is optional.  Place the oil in a frying pan, add the chips and fry on low heat, stirring constantly until the potatoes are cooked, shaking the pan.  Take the potato chips off the oil when the chips are completely cool and remove the chips and serve by spreading them around a plate with your favorite mexican cheese dip.

title: Chicken Gruyere
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 2 cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Place the casserole dish in the oven.  Squeeze the excess moisture out of each chicken breast.  Arrange the chicken pieces in the casserole dish.  Sprinkle the gruyere on top.  Return the oven to the oven for 15 minutes, then remove from the oven.  Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,dashi,green chili pepper,curry paste,lemon grass,paprika chipotle powder,tortilla
title: Spicy Soft Tacos With Asian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups light sour cream or 2 cups low fat sour cream | 1 -2 tablespoon instant dashi ( i use a knorr instant kit ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mild curry paste ( depending on taste desired ) | 1 teaspoon paprika chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon minced hot green chili peppers | 3/4 teaspoon finely chopped lemon grass ( optional ) | 2 cups grated asiago cheese | 3 tortillas ( i use flour tortillas for this recipe )
instructions: Mix the sour cream, dashi, curry paste, paprika, chili powder, green chile peppers and lemon grass together and refrigerate.  When ready to serve, heat some oil in a skillet.  Spread the cheese into center of a warm tortilla and use a fork to scoop about 2 rounded tablespoons of the spicy cream mixture into the center and place it in the hot oil.  Fry over medium heat until browned and bubbly.  Serve.

title: Roasted Red Onions
ingredients: 3 medium red onions | 1/2 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f°.  Wash and cut top and bottom off the onions, and then cut out the root part.  Then cut into 1/2 thick slices crosswise.  Place slices in a 9 inch square baking pan.  Mix the cheese with a few drops of water to prevent the cheese from sticking.  Pound a few pieces of cheese to a thickness of about 1/4 inch, and sprinkle over the onions.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until the onions turn a deep brown and the cheese is bubbly around the edges, stirring at least once or twice.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,chili sauce,pepper flake,rice noodle,red chilies,chicken bouillon,mirin
title: Prawn Noodle Soup (Chakkien Gai)
ingredients: 12 dried red chilies, soaked in hot water for 5 minutes | 4 tablespoons dried chili sauce | 6 red chilies, halved | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs large raw prawns or 1 1/2 lbs prawns, peeled but not peeled | 1/8 cup chicken bouillon | 1/8 cup mirin ( sweet soy sauce ) | hot cooked rice noodles
instructions: Soak the dried chilies in hot water for 20 minutes or until softened.  Peel them and cut the flesh in pieces about the size of a rice noodle piece and set aside.  In a medium bowl, marinate the prawns in the mixture of the dried chilies, chili sauce and hot pepper flakes for 5 minutes.  In a large nonstick wok or skillet, stir fry the prawns or prawns in hot oil over medium high heat for 10 minutes or until they just change color.  Add the marinated chilies and fry 1 minute, stirring continuously.  Add the reserved water, the stock and the cooked shrimp pieces or prawns.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Uncover and boil rapidly for 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve hot, garnished with hot cooked rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: green bean,pizza crust,currant,chili pepper flake,vital wheat gluten,shrimp,beef eye
title: Low Fat Pizza With Shrimp, Beans, and Chilli Strips
ingredients: 1 package frozen shrimp, thawed and drained | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed | 1 cup low-fat pizza crust | 2 tablespoons vital wheat gluten | 1 tablespoon currants or 1 tablespoon sultanas | 1 -2 hot chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried shrimp, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Defrost shrimp under cold water, remove heads and shells, if large, and slice them into 1/2 inch pieces.  In a large, shallow bowl, combine shrimp, beans, pizza crumbs, gluten, currants, chili flakes, and dried shrimp, if desired.  Preheat oven to 425°f or high.  Spoon mixture onto dough, and sprinkle with additional toppings if desired.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,sherry wine,bicarbonate soda,orecchiette pasta,salsa verde,trout fillet,pastry
title: Smoked Trout With Pastry Ramekins
ingredients: 500 g trout fillets, skin on | 1/2 cup salsa verde | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 cup dry sherry wine | 2 cans pumpkin seeds | pastry for double-crust pie | 1 cup raw rice or 1 cup acvados ( see note )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220o c.  Line a 20 x 25cm swiss roll tin.  Slice open trout fillets and place, skin side down, in baking tray.  Combine salsa verde, bicarb, sherry, pumpkin seeds and trimmings in a jug.  Pour over trout fillets and place on tray.  Brush tops of pastry with beaten egg and bake for 20 mins, then reduce temperature to 210c and bake for another 40 minutes.  Note, i was not really sure about the date and just put them in a bowl with the date, and everything else, and just allowed to come to room temp for about an hour.  Note, if you make your own risotto, follow the instructions for your risotto.  Serve with a side of crusty and leafy bread.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,turkey breast,apricot preserve,cream tartar
title: Apricot Smoked Turkey with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/3 cup sour cream ( i use greek style ) | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 packet bacon fat free turkey breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf.  Combine all ingredients, except turkey, in a bowl, and mix well.  Pile half of the turkey mixture on a 2 1/2x3 loaf pan, and spread with a spoonful of the apricot filling.  Repeat layers again with remaining turkey mixture.  Bake for 15 minutes at 400ºf, or until center of turkey is done.

title: Moroccan Style Poppy Seed Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bread flour | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 cup chopped dates | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 4 thick fillets salmon fillets, room temperature | 1 1/2 cups poppy seeds ( available from asian food shops )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Combine the flour, orange zest, dates and cilantro in a shallow dish.  Dredge each fillet in the flour, shaking off any excess.  Heat a nonstick skillet until very hot.  Lightly brush the pan with oil and place the fillets into the pan.  Cook about 3 minutes, just until the fish flakes easily.  Spread the poppy seeds over the fish.  Turn the heat down to low, cover with a damp tea towel and place in the oven.  Cook the fish for 7 minutes, turning once, or until browned.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,green pea,chili powder,celery leaf,coconut,yukon gold potato,bread flour
title: Indian Veggie Chapati
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold potatoes, diced | 1 cup frozen green peas | 1/4 cup chopped fresh celery leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coconut | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper
instructions: Place the potato and peas into a pot, and cover with water.

title: Matzoh Meal Pancakes
ingredients: 1 poblano chile ( the big red bell pepper ) | 5 large egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 5 tablespoons matzo meal | 4 large green plantains ( should be about the size of a large plantain )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Peel a thin slice off the top of the green plantains for a garnish.  Cut into thin 2 inch long strips.  Slice off the chile and remove and discard seeds.  Cut the plantains into thin about 3/8 inch long wedges.  Cut the slit from the outer top, taking care not to mash and discarding the tough outer part of the plantain that holds the plantain together.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, whisk together the egg whites, the saffron, and 4 tablespoons of matzoh meal or semolina or 1/4 cup of flour.  In a large saute pan, place a small skillet or 2 inch of oil for a griddle and heat until hot but not smoking, over medium high heat.  Drop a cup of the mixture into the pan and cook about 2 minutes per side.  Transfer the cooked pancake onto a serving platter.  Top with a second griddle, or two.  Sprinkle the plantain slices on top of the pancake.  Gently but thoroughly, place the plantains around the pancake and serve.

title: Pasta With Rum
ingredients: 1 gallon light consomme or 1 gallon light beef consomme | 1 lb fettuccine pasta or 1 lb rotini pasta | 1 pint frozen corn ( thawed ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory or 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 2 ounces dark rum or 2 ounces bourbon | 1 package frozen whipped topping
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente, drain and set aside.  In a saucepan, bring consomme to a boil with corn.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes.  Stir in marjoram, savory and rum.  Remove from heat and stir in frozen whipped topping until desired thickness is achieved.  Serve a few bowls of the consommé on the side for dipping, and some fresh grated parm.

Random Ingredients: green tea powder,sauce,catsup,cherry,anaheim chile pepper,coleslaw mix
title: Cowboy Green Tea Salad
ingredients: 18 cherry rolls | 1 tablespoon green tea powder | 1/4 cup sliced anaheim chile peppers | 1/4 cup coleslaw mix | 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon catsup
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the cherry rolls, green tea powder, anaheim chile peppers, coleslaw mix, hot sauce and catsup together.  Add more chili pepper if desired.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cumin,part ricotta cheese,bay seasoning,navel orange,vegetable oil cooking spray,rhubarb,snow pea,chicken bouillon granule
title: Rhubarb and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen sliced rhubarb | 1 navel orange, sectioned | 1 box part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 2 large stalks stalks chopped rhubarb ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon bay seasoning
instructions: Prepare dressing, puree rRhubarb stems, orange sections, ricotta, pineapple, and 1/2 of the zest.  Dissolve bouillon granules in 1/4 cup of water.  Spray small bowl with cooking spray.  Combine with rhubarb to coat and set aside for 15 minutes.  Drain pineapple in a strainer, run cold water over berries until no more water remains and set aside until needed.  Sprinkle with cumin and stir to coat.  Prepare salad, combine all salad ingredients except the reserved pineapple juice and pour salad dressing over salad.  Serve chilled.

title: Curried Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon cake flour ( maida ) | 1 tablespoon curry
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together chickpeas, cake flour and curry.  Mix until smooth.  Cover and keep aside to stand for 10 minutes.  Shape into flat round pancakes, about 1 inch diameter.  Bake in a preheated 400? f oven for about 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tahini Sausages and Sausages With Italian Bread and Cherry Syrup
ingredients: 4 lbs stew meat | 3/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup sweet paprika | 4 lbs mild italian sausage | 1/3 cup maraschino cherry pieces | 4 loaves italian bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the bread and mix well.  Marinate the sausages for at least 6 hours and up to 24 hours.  Remove the sausages from the brine and grill.  If the sausage is brown, place on a broiler pan or bbq and broil.  If the sausage is soft, broil under the lid of the grill or in a grill pan for 10 minutes.  Serve hot with italian bread and a fresh cherry.

title: Rice With Rice and Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice or 3 3/4 cups pearl barley | 2 cups beef broth
instructions: In a large pot, combine all the ingredients except rice and broth and bring to simmering.  Cover and set aside.  Remove from heat, let stand 1 hour.  Fluff up with a fork, or divide into smaller portions and serve.

title: Chipotle Garlic Paste (For Frying)
ingredients: 2 ounces chipotle chiles | 2 ounces red chilies ( or 2 tsp. tabasco peppers )
instructions: Slice chile.  Stem chile with fork or knife.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,gelatin,walnut half,seltzer water,green zucchini,poblano chile
title: Mexican Walnut Zucchini (Huitlacoche)  from the Farm Journal
ingredients: 6 cups cubed green zucchini | 1 small fresh poblano chile, seeded and minced | 1 1/2 cups walnut halves | 1/4 cup unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in apple juice and water.  Set aside.  Rinse the zucchini well, trim off the root ends and scoop away the membrane.  Scoop out the pulp with a teaspoon.  Set aside.  Combine the zucchini, poblano pepper and walnuts with the gelatin mixture.  Dissolve the gelatin in the apple juice and water.  Pour over the zucchini mixture.  Arrange on a serving dish.  Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 cup tamarind paste | 2 -3 cups sake | 1 -2 tablespoon tapioca flour ( or corn starch ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground dried ancho chile ( optional )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine tamarind paste, sake or corn starch mixed with enough water to form thick paste.  Stir constantly to avoid sticking.  Add chiles.  Blend and transfer to a jar.  Store tamarind sauce in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,chicken bouillon,pepper sauce,fenugreek seed,canola oil
title: Cheddar Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 -3 drops hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, sprinkle the cheese with the fenugreek and then stir in the chicken boullion, pepper sauce and oil.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.  Stir before serving or setting the spread on to cool on a serving platter.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Nacho Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups fat free chicken fat free chicken meat, diced into thin strips | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained
instructions: Set a burner on medium high grill.  Add diced chicken and diced tomatoes and green chilies.  Stir fry on low heat for about 7 minutes.  Serve hot as dip.

title: Sautéed Walnut and Chive Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1/2 shallot, chopped | 1 green capsicum, sliced | 1 can kidney, drained | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Combine walnuts and shallot and stir fry in a little oil for 2 minutes.  Stir in capsicum and kidney.  Stir in tomato paste and chives.  Season with more pepper and salt if desired.

title: Oat Germ & Corn Cakes,
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes | 5 1/2 ounces corn kernels ( fresh corn in season, in season frozen corn is recommended ) | 3 4 tablespoons light mayonnaise or 3 tablespoons salad dressing | 1/2 cup dark rum | 3 1/2 ounces oatmeal
instructions: Process corn flakes, corn kernels, mayonnaise and rum in food processor until it achieves a fine consistency.  Add the oatmeal and process until blended.  Using a round, flat, metal spoon, scoop 1 - ¼ oz.  Mix into a well seasoned 8 inch oat and press into a disc lined wax paper.  Flatten disc and cut into nine 6 x 6½ rectangles.  Cover the wax paper with a double thickness of foil and let it sit undraised at room temperature for 45 minutes.  Refrigerate until cold, then store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Seared Steak With Herbs
ingredients: 4 steaks ( sirloin, rump beef, or other cuts ) | 4 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons herbs ( your choice ) | 4 pieces cooked ham ( or other slices cut to desired serving size )
instructions: Pound the steaks very thin or cut to desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,black mustard seed,bay leaf,chicken stock,orange,lemon juice zest,hamburger,tortilla chip
title: Hamburger Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 limes, juice and zest of | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 cup chicken stock | tortilla chips, for garnish
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, cook the hamburger until brown.  Break up the hamburger and add to the pan with the lime, orange and lemon juices.  Add the bay leaf, black and mustard seeds, chicken stock and simmer on low heat for approximately 25 - 30 minutes or until the mixture is syrupy.  Allow to cool completely.  Serve it on top of a bed of tortilla chips, sprinkling it with more chips as desired.

title: Swiss Cheese Pasta With Cardamom and Soy
ingredients: 500 g swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 500 g dry penne | 5 cardamom seeds | 2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Dice the cheese into 2cm cubes.  Add the soya sauce and flour.  Simmer a little bit.  Cook pasta as it is usually done, add more soya.  Drain cooked pasta, add the cheese to it and mix everything together.  Serve with some parmesan, a nice salad and garlic bread.

title: Greek Lamb and Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb, cubed | 1 cup pitted kalamata olive, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, washed and torn
instructions: Toss lamb with olives and red wine over high heat, stirring constantly for 10 to 15 minutes, until lamb is brown on all sides.  Add lettuce and toss.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Barbecue Country Ribs
ingredients: 1 can rotel, divided | 5 pounds beef short ribs
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f.  Mix half the rotel, half the bacon, half the rib meat, and half the remaining rotel together in a baking dish to coat thoroughly then place the dish or casserole in the preheated oven.  Bake until beef is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Brazilian Olive and Paprika Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 250 g kalamata olives ( i actually make them from greek olives ) | 4 teaspoons paprika | 200 g plain soymilk | 4 medium oranges
instructions: Cut orange in half.  Grate the pith from the oranges using a coarse grater or a vegetable peeler, keeping slices whole.  Roughly chop the zest off of the oranges.  Juice the oranges, discarding most of the white pith, removing white pith as this will enhance the spiciness of the cheese.  Combine orange zest with kalamata olives and paprika.  Add soy milk and mix thoroughly.  Marinate overnight at room temperature in the fridge.  When ready to grill, remove cheese from marinade with a large spoon.  Lightly oil grill grates and place orange slices on grate, taking care not to put the flames of fire directly on the cheese.  Remove cheese from grill, put one piece of orange zest on the cheese, pressing it a bit into the cheese.  Turn cheese over onto the other piece of zest and press it a bit to remove the juice.  Set zest aside for about 30 minutes so that any steam from the pan has left the cheese to rest.  When the cheese has rested, remove zest from grill and wrap each olive loosely with a piece of cheese so that it doesn't loose its shape as it rests.  You can even wrap it up individually in foil, securing it with a pretty toothpick.  It should be covered and refrigerated for at least an hour.  Grill the cheese for about 20 minutes, turning when necessary.  Slice and serve immediately.

title: Swiss Broccoli-And-Cheese Soup in a Hurry
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 can tomato puree | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cored, seeded, and finely chopped | 1 cup chopped swiss cheese | 1 can condensed beef broth
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until it crumbles and is no longer translucent.  Add the tomato puree, yellow pepper, and swiss cheese.

title: Slow Cooked Irish Goat Stew
ingredients: 2 cups fresh au jus from a 3 pound goose | 1 small boiling cherries or 1 small pear | 1 large dried hot chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 4 goat shanks | 1 jar beer | 8 small fresh cilantro, leaves only | 2 tablespoons ground fresh ground coarse salt ( such as kosher )
instructions: Prehat oven to 300°.  Put goose and cherries into slow cooker insert and then add hot pepper flakes, savory and oregano and pour in beer.  Cover tightly with lid or a tent of aluminum foil and cook on high for 6 hours.  Remove cover and stir.  Add cilantro, reserving about 1/2 cup cilantro leaves and continue cooking for an additional 1/2 hour to allow flavors to marry.  Season with salt, if necessary.

title: Herbed Noodles With Pickles
ingredients: 12 ounces fettuccine pasta | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill pickle | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herbs such as parsley, basil, dill or 1/2 cup fresh dill | shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook fettuccine in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water over medium heat until al dente.  Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid.  Return cooking liquid to a saucepan.  Add pickles, herbs and 1/2 cup cooking liquid.  Cook and stir over medium heat until pickles are tender, about 4 minutes.  Add cheese and cook until melted.  Drain pasta and transfer to a bowl.  Toss with pickle sauce over low heat.  Serve immediately.

title: Garam Masala Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Combine masala, ground ginger and cayenne pepper.  Add water to just make a thickish paste.  Add rice and stir to coat.  Simmer, covered on low heat for 25 minutes or until all water disappears.  Stir in oregano and enjoy.

title: Eggplant(Aubergine) and Pork Filling for Egyptian Tagine
ingredients: 4 ounces ground pork ( i use lamb ) | 1 leek, bulb of | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 ounce aubergine
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Clean the leek and cut off the root ends, leaving about three inches of stalk.  Slice the leek lengthwise, then slice lengthwise into half rings.  Place the strips in a heavy frying pan with a lid, turn the heat so it gently simmers, and cook until the juices evaporate.  Add the lamb and continue to cook until it begins to brown.  Tip the leek into a bowl with the orange blossom water, add just enough to cover, and mix well.  Let stand for 5 minutes.  Wearing a fine mesh sieve, squeeze out excess moisture, and remove the vegetables from the pan.  Line a 10 in.  Square tins with greaseproof paper, then cover with lid and steam the mixtures for 12 minutes until very warm and aromatic.  Uncover the mixture and mix gently.  The mixture should form a smooth paste.  Transfer the mixture to a food processor and puree it until smooth.  Return the paste to the pan and bring it to a boil.  Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring all the while to ensure the paste coats all of the vegetables.  Turn off the heat.  Transfer the filling to the prepared tine dish to cool.  Cut the aubergine in half lengthwise, scoop out and discard the skin, and chop finely.  Add to the sauce along with the pork, along with any juices that have accumulated on the surface, and mix well.  Pour the sauce over the filling and stir so that it is combined.

title: Curried Chicken With Tropical Fruit
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 chili, deseeded and finely chopped | 400 g diced chicken | 2 tablespoons oysters, chopped | 2 tablespoons pineapple chunks, juice reserved | 150 g mixed tropical fruits, julienned
instructions: In a large frypan combine 1 tablespoon of curry powder, coriander and curry paste and fry over medium heat for 1 minute or until fragrant.  Remove from heat and add chilli, chicken, oysters, pineapple juice, fruit and remaining curry powder to frypan and cook, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes or until heated through.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Place short rib pieces in shallow 2 qt.  Microwave safe dish.

instructions: Take lettuce and put it in a blender.  Add soda and mix it until mixture turns into a paste. title: Mexican Blanco

instructions: Combine in a glass bottle with plastic wrap.  Shake well for at least 2 days.  Serve with lots of grated white cheddar on top or add a little taco seasoning for a kick.

title: Lemon Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 2 lemons ( or equivalent amount of lemons ) | 3 lbs chicken thighs, cut up | 3 loaves italian bread
instructions: Trim off any excessive fat, especially if it is heavy.  Place a couple of pieces of bread into a shallow dish or bowl.  Rinse the chicken under cold water to remove the water and dust with salt.  Combine the lemon juice and zest with water and set aside.  Squeeze the juice and set this aside.  In a large saucepan, put the chicken pieces in and coat in the lemon zest water mixture.  Cover the pan and cook over low heat with a cover on.  This should take about 40 - 45 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, or until the chicken is soft and cooked through.  Drain the chicken, place on a hot platter, cover and keep warm. instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the egg and okra, mix until well mixed.  Divide the okra mixture into two large bowls and stir fry with herbs and sauces.  You can also use a wok, soya sauce works well for this.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Spicy Apple Cider Marinade or Tenderizer

instructions: Mix well.  Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Mexican Potatoes Stuffed With Pinto Bean Pinto Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs unpeeled red potatoes, quartered | 1 1/2 pints pinto beans, picked over, washed and drained | 1/2 lb bocconcini, cut into 1/8-inch slices | 1/2 ounce mirin | 1/2 ounce triple sec liqueur
instructions: Note, it's best to prepare these just the right, not the actual cooking, and not the old fashiony cooking method they're sold to produce.  They cook very quickly in a large pot and can be frozen.  Bring a pot of water to boil and salt lightly.  Add the potatoes and a generous pinch of salt.  Cook uncovered over medium heat until just tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a large baking dish, piling the larger potato pieces down into the pot.  Set aside.  Place the pinto beans in a large pot, add enough water to cover them by 2 inches and set aside.  Boil until tender but still firm, about 25 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the bag of the drained potatoes in a large bowl.  Add enough pinto bean water to cover the potatoes by about 1 inch.  Rinse with cold water and mash together with a fork or potato masher.  Cut a hole into the center of each potato and stuff a piece in the bread.  Arrange 1/2 tablespoons of mashed potato in the center of a piece of potato.  Dip the hole of your finger in cold water and press around the hole to close.  Repeat with the remaining potatoes and filling ingredients.  Arrange the stuffed potatoes in a baking dish and pour 1/2 cup of the reserved pinto bean water in and around them.  Pour in the last 1/2 cup of pinto bean water and the mirin and then cover the baking dish with foil.  Bake for 45 to 55 minutes in the preheated oven, until the potatoes are tender and the outsides are crispy.  Serve with warmed, homemade bread.
