ingredients: 5 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 bag fresh blackberries | 7 ounces beef stock ( homemade is best ) | 5 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 fresh sweet pickle, minced
instructions: To prepare, put blackberries in the bowl of an electric blender and pour beef stock through a fine mesh sieve.  Let sit in the refrigerator for about 8 hours.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.  Rinse out the blender and blend the drained blackberries until they've become a coarse puree.  Put the blackberry mixture in a large, heavy non aluminum baking dish and put in the oven, on the middle rack.  Bake for about 45 minutes.  Whisk together the remaining 6 teaspoons of soy sauce, sugar and pickle in a small bowl.  Set aside.  When the pastry is done, remove the baking sheet with the blackberries from the oven and place on a cooling rack.  Sprinkle the top of the pastry with 1/2 teaspoons of sugar.  Place the baking dish directly over the hot blackberries and bake for another 5 minutes.  Remove the baking sheet from the oven and carefully tip the baking dish to the cooler rack.  When the blackberries are cool and crisp, remove them from the baking sheet with a slotted spoon or a slotted spoon and place the frozen mixture in a mixing bowl.  Return the cooked blackberries to the mixing bowl and mix well so that all of the blackberries have been moistened by the soy sauce and sugar.  Serve the berries warm, or at room temperature.

title: Baked Alpine Mushrooms
ingredients: 100 g camembert cheese, grated ( or a mixture of both ) | 2 teaspoons filling | 100 g quinoa | 8 large portabella mushrooms
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/400f/gas place the cooked quinoa in a large bowl and pour boiling water over.  Place a sheet of baking paper on a baking tray and add the cheese/filling mixture on top of it in a circle shape, being careful not to get it too thin or too thick.  Wipe out the rinds of the portabella mushrooms and slice them thinly.  Arrange them in a spoke fashion over the quinoa.  Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the portabella is starting to brown.  Remove from the oven and serve.  This could have been served warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: ice,monterey jack cheese,pork,asian chili sauce,baby arugula
title: Cheesy Asian Burritos
ingredients: 1/3 lb baby spinach ( or other greens ) | 3/4 lb ground lean pork ( or veggie ) | 1 teaspoon asian chili sauce ( i used sriracha, and used regular ) | 2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese | ice ( for burritos )
instructions: Prepare grill or place in crockpot.  Add spinach, pork, chili sauce, and cheese to crockpot.  Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours or on low for 3 - 4 hours.  Fill burritos with your choice of fillings and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,tomato concentrate,mustard seed,coriander leaf,mayonnaise,mace,chicken wing
title: Indian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings, disjointed | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 package pork roast | 1/2 cup tomato concentrate | 1/4 cup chopped coriander leaves | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, pork and seasoning mix in large bowl.  Add wings and turn to coat well.  Arrange in a shallow roasting pan.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 375 for 30 to 40 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 170f on a meat thermometer.  Baste frequently with reduced fat sauce.

Random Ingredients: cracker,ancho chile powder,porcini mushroom,black cardamom pod,hard egg
title: Ancho Chile Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons creamed porcini mixed mushrooms | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 2 black cardamom pods, cracked | 1 teaspoon ground dried ancho chile powder ( or sub ancho chiles concentrate )
instructions: Place the ancho and creamed porcini into a small bowl.  Break the eggs in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  When hot, add the spices and cover.  Toss the eggs frequently with the ancho and creamed porcini.  When the eggs are almost cooked through, remove them from the pan and place on a platter.  Garnish with crème fraîche or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,cream,cool whip,beet,ice,french bread,thyme sprig,cashew
title: Beet (And-Or Spinach) Rarebit
ingredients: 1 jar beets, drained, rinsed well, and cut in half crosswise | 1/2 cup cashews | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup minced fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 loaf french bread, sliced thin | 2 cups cool whip | assorted flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place beets in a saucepan, and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,salt pepper,brown basmati rice,golden raisin,eggplant
title: Kurdish Vegetables Pilaff
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1-inch squares | salt and pepper to taste | 1 cup brown basmati rice | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 cup brown lentils, cooked
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Lay the eggplant onto a baking sheet covered with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until slightly blackened, 30 to 40 minutes, then remove from oven.  Place the rice, golden raisins, and dried lentils into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Squeeze the excess liquid out of the eggplant, and mix into the rice mixture.  Bake on the preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Snow Peas & Horseradish
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice ( italian v8 ) | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed ( or thawed frozen ) | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 3 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender or food processor and process until smooth.  Serve on warm bread.

title: Easy Ketchup Chicken Wings
ingredients: 16 chicken wings ( the whole work best ) | 3 red mild poblano chiles | 3 tablespoons chili paste ( i use thai kitchen brand ( you may find this at asian grocery store ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leave | 3 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Using a blender blend ingredients until smooth.  Pour into a gallon size zipper lock bag, add wings and marinate at least 4 hours.  Prepare grill and cook on medium heat.  Use a metal skewers to poke holes all over the chicken wings, being careful not to burn.  Grill wings 6 minutes per side.  I serve with the sauce.  The sauce is also wonderful with rice and a side dish of your choice.

title: Jamaican Style Lamb With Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 450 g lean leg of lamb, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry kidney beans | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Heat 1 tbs oil in a large fry pan.  Add the lamb and brown it well on all sides.  Remove the lamb to a plate.  Add the rest of the oil and fry the kidney beans in it until they turn golden brown.  Stir in the flour and add the milk a little at a time.  You want it to be thick and creamy, not too watery.  Season well.  Return the lamb to the pan and stir continuously, so it does not stick to the base of the pan.  Cook until the lamb is just cooked through.  You may wish to add a little extra water if the gravy seems too thick when you take it out of the pan.  Serve at once with rice, perhaps with a potato salad or your favourite vegetable.

title: Chinese Style Root Vegetables in  Beer
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret, cut into chunks | 1 medium turnip, diced | 10 ounces tofu | 1 cup ginger ale
instructions: Cut carrot into slices 1/4 in thick or thinner.  Cut cauliflower into chunks.  Steam cauliflower florets until tender.  Drain water, add beetroot, turnip and ginger ale.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Eat hot.

title: Pepperjack Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 pounds beef marrow bones | 4 pounds cooked small shrimp
instructions: In a large pot, combine condensed soup, marrow bones, and shrimp.  Boil until heated through, about 30 minutes.  Top with shredded cheese and serve.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 32 whole crackers ( i use multi baked crackers ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Coat a 9 1/2 inch metal pan with cooking spray and line with bread crumbs.  Cut a slit in the top of each cracker and place in dish.  Spray with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with onion and sprinkle with onion powder.  Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pepper jack cheese,pepper sauce,cream chicken soup,apple,parmigiano reggiano cheese,fenugreek seed,creamy peanut butter
title: Nana's Fantastically Yummy Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 container sour cream or 1 container low-fat sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 -3 crushed apples | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1 package pepper jack cheese or ( 10 ounce ) package other shredded cheese blend ( optional ) | 1/2 cup minced fresh or frozen fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Drain all the liquid from the 1/4 can of condensed cream of chicken soup into a large mixing bowl, or you can mix it in the top of a double boiler.  Stir in the sour cream, cream of chicken soup, and any optional ingredients you have, but only cheese.  Stir in the fenugreek seeds and cheese until everything is evenly incorported.  Do not mix too hard and the dip is awful if the dip is too tart, but a little bit zippy, like you're mixing a cake batter, may not work.  Cover and chill for 4 - 5 hours, if using.  Serves one or more.

title: Chinese Walnut Salmon
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs salmon, scales picked off | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup walnut oil
instructions: Place the walnuts in a small dry skillet over medium heat and toast them for 2 - 3 minutes, or until they are lightly golden.  Remove from oven and let cool slightly.  Pat the salmon dry, season with salt and pepper and cut in 8 pieces.  Toss each piece in cornstarch and shake off any excess.  Heat oil in a saute pan or wok over medium high heat and fry the salmon until nicely browned.  If the walnuts are not completely browned, add some more oil.  Spread the salmon on a platter and cut into 4 pieces.  Pour the walnut oil over cooked salmon and serve.

title: Kittencal's Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 3 packages frozen strawberries, thawed | 1 can cherry pie filling ( or other flavors ) | 3 stalks celery ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Put strawberries, cherry pie filling and celery in pie pan.  Sprinkle top of pie dough with sugar and berries.  Or pour any other topping to the top of the pie dough, and bake for 50 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,avocado,panir,soymilk,cilantro stem,cherry tomato,anise seed,dill weed
title: Creamy Avocado and Panir Dip
ingredients: 1 cup panir ( cubed ) | 12 cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 1 avocado ( halved ) | 1/2 cup soymilk ( or soy milk, if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons cilantro stems ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed ( or other nutmeg seed ) | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed ( or fresh )
instructions: In a bowl combine the cubed panir with cherry tomatoes, avocado, cream, soy milk, coconut extract, anise, dill and nutmeg.  Place in a blender, cover and blend on high for 1 minute.  Garnish with fresh cilantro or green onion.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,apricot preserve,anchovy fillet,sharp cheddar cheese,cauliflower,basil leaf,pepperoni,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti With Italian Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb uncooked spaghetti, cooked al dente ( about 8oz ) | 1/4 cup basil leaves, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, chopped, about 1 tablespoon | 1 roasted red pepper, sliced thinly diagonally | 2 tablespoons capicola or 2 tablespoons other bacon fat | 1 anchovy fillet, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup apricot preserves ( optional ) | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: In large bowl toss together spaghetti, basil, pepperoni, peppers, capicola, or bacon fat and anchovies.  Add to spaghetti mixture and stir to combine.  Sprinkle with cheese and toss.

title: Cucumber-Banana Lassi
ingredients: 2 bananas ( about 14 pieces ) | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded, finely chopped | 1 seedless cucumber, peel and seeds removed, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro or 2 teaspoons dried cilantro
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, puree bananas, chiles, cucumber, vanilla, rum and vanilla extract until thoroughly mixed and smooth.  Scrape into a glass serving dish.  Cover and chill 1 hour, stirring once.  Serve cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,cotija cheese,espresso powder,dill seed,green cabbage,jalapeno
title: Irish Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon ground espresso powder ( or 1 tablespoon instant coffee ) | 6 -8 ounces small green cabbage | 1 teaspoon dried dill seed | 1/2 teaspoon minced jalapeno or 1/2 teaspoon serrano peppers | 3/4 - 1 cup grated cotija cheese or 3/4-1 cup monterey jack cheese ( i recommend melting with a knife ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: In an espresso coffee size nonstick frypan, toast the dill seed and chiles over high heat, cooking, until fragrant, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Watch carefully.

title: Easy Onion Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon plain flour | 250 g purple onions, chopped | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan and add the purple onions.  Sauté until clear and translucent.  Add the tomato puree, stir and allow to simmer for around 10 minutes.

title: Japanese Eggplant and Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 large japanese eggplant | 3 -4 white onions
instructions: Chop the eggplant into thin semi circles.  Boil in boiling salted water for 4 - 5 minutes remove and drain.  Cut them into 1/4 slices and place on a platter.  Slice the onions into thin rings.  Arrange on top of the potatoes and onions and serve.

title: Brazilian Olive Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 2 prosciutto or other thick cut bacon
instructions: Cut a slit down the center of each slice of prosciutto.  Cut the prosciutto lengthwise into 2 or 3 strips.  Place each strip of prosciutto in a small bowl.  Cover with orange juice.  Fry the prosciutto strips in hot butter over moderate heat for about 5 minutes, turning them occasionally, or until crisp.  Drain the bacon on paper towel lined plate, reserving skillet juice.  Serve right away.

title: Chickpea & Capers Salad
ingredients: 400 g canned chickpeas | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon capers | 3 tablespoons finely diced red wine
instructions: Place chickpeas and capers in a bowl and toss with vinegar and capers to coat.  Place on a serving platter.  Garnish with diced red chili pepper.

title: Potato Cheese with Beet Filling
ingredients: 1 cup diced and boiled potatoes and mixed potatoes | 1 cup diced and cooked beet | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 pinch garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into balls.  Bake on a greased griddle.

title: Homemade Italian Raisins
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs dark raisins, washed hulled | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh basil leaf, washed ( about 6 cups )
instructions: Place the raisins in a saucepan and add enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat immediately to a simmer and cook, uncovered, until the raisins are tender.  The raisins will swell a little during cooking.  When this point, remove the pot from the heat.  Lift the raisins out onto a towel and let sit at room temperature, until all the water is absorbed.  Discard the water if the raisins have absorbed all the water, drain in a sieve, then cover with a wet cloth and let the raisins cool.  When the raisins are cool enough to handle, pat dry with paper towels or a clean cloth.  You can use your hands to press out most of the water, as you can.  If you have a food processor, simply pulse the chopped raisins to coarse pieces and place them in a medium sized plastic bag.  Cover the raisins tightly and shake to coat with the soaking water.  Once the raisins have drained, place in the refrigerator.  These will keep for about 2 weeks.

title: Cherry Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms ( about 10-12 large ones ) | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved ( about 4 large )
instructions: Set oven to 400f degrees.  Place mushrooms in 13x9x2 baking dish.  Remove 1/2 cup cherry from jar.  Spoon mushrooms in around mushrooms and scatter with 1/2 cup maraschino cherries and remaining cherries.  Cover loosely with foil, and bake until mushrooms are tender and cherries start to burst, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,worcestershire sauce,chickpea flour,taco sauce,zucchini,dijon mustard,pimiento,apple juice
title: Mexican Zucchini Fingers
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon prepared dijon-style dijon mustard | 1 packet kraft 2 % calorie catalina's dip and spread or ( 1/2 ounce ) packet zesty homemade dip & spread | 1/2 cup canned chickpea flour or 1/2 cup flour | 1 tablespoon canned chickpea juice | 1/4 cup papayas-style sun-dried tomatoes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup diced cooked zucchini | 1 ounce diced pimiento, drained | favorite store-bought taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Combine mustard, kraft® 2% calorie catalina® dip and kraft® dip spread in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: bulgar wheat,tortilla chip,pecorino cheese,coffee powder,plum tomato,ginger
title: Veggie-Dipped Flatbread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-strong coffee powder | 1/4 cup bulgar wheat | 1/4 cup roughly chopped peeled plum tomato | 1 teaspoon finely chopped peeled fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon finely shredded pecorino cheese | 1/2 tablespoon quick-rise instant coffee powder | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Toast 1 1/4 cup tortilla chips in prepared nonstick skillet set over medium heat, turning once, until lightly golden, 1 to 2 minutes.  Transfer to cutting board.  In medium bowl, toss bulgar wheat, tomatoes, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder.  Spoon 1 tablespoon bean mixture onto center of tortilla.

Random Ingredients: salmon,romaine lettuce leaf,turkey,salt pepper,pistachio nut,wheat flour,corn tortilla
title: Sopa De Pil Pilimpurito (Turkey Wrap)
ingredients: 2 pounds ground turkey | 1 package whole wheat flour tortilla | 5 leaves romaine lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh roasted salami or roasted turkey | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted pistachio nuts | salt and pepper to taste | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir turkey until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.  In a small bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup water and flour until smooth.  Remove turkey from skillet and set aside.  Cook tortillas, one at a time, in the skillet until slightly crisp and golden, about 10 seconds on each side.  Divide the turkey onto four separate tortillas.

title: Sweet Corn and Bacon Chilli (Tirk Kho to Ghaen)
ingredients: 200 g dried whole kernel corn, soaked for 30 minutes | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 2 shallots, chopped | 1/4 cup palm sugar ( or other dark brown sugar ) | 1 teaspoon sweet chili powder | 300 g diced mixed fruit, well chilled
instructions: In a dutch oven fry the chopped bacon until light golden in colour.  Drain on paper towel and reserve 2 tbsp of the oil.  Add the shallots and cook for a minute or two or until they start turning soft.  Add the corn and fry until they start to soften.  Add the palm sugar, sugar and sweet chili powder.  Continue cooking for 3 - 4 minutes.  Add the fruit and mix well.  Cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until the fruits are heated through.  Serve warm.

title: Coco Pop
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni ( small shell ) | 1/2 cup malibu rum ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni following manufacturer's instructions.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,apple cider vinegar,orange juice,granny smith apple,almond extract
title: Easy English Cider Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup diced spanish onion | 3/4 cup sliced almonds or 3/4 cup slivered almonds | 1/4 cup dry apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 4 ounces granny smith apples, diced
instructions: Melt slivered almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat.  Pour in vinegar and stir.  Add apple and orange juice and continue cooking until heated through.  Remove from heat and stir in cooled almonds until coated.

title: Pork Sausage and Oat
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 1/4 cup frangelico | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Line 2 cookie sheets with aluminum foil.  Put sausage in a skillet and cook over high heat.  Cut sausage meat into strips no larger than 1/2 inch wide.  Remove sausage pieces and set aside.  Add frangelico and cook for about 10 minutes or until most of the liquid evaporates.  Return sausage to skillet and cook until the consistency of heavy cream.  Add oats and mix all together.  Spread mixture onto foil and bake in oven until edges are browned but center still slightly loose, approximately 15 to 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Frozen Cardamom Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together graham cracker crumbs, cardamom and about 1/3 cup hot water until well combined.  Turn mixture into ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.  Remove from ice cream maker and scoop out cardamom pods, discarding pods.  Let cool in metal containers for at least 8 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: lime,mustard powder,turmeric,tomato basil oregano garlic,white mushroom
title: Mushroom and Lime Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 lb white mushroom, sliced ( or any other fresh mushrooms, i've also used canned mushroom pieces that are slightly larger in size ) | 1 lime, quartered | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon tomato basil oregano garlic, chopped fine
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms and set aside.  Remove lime quarters from juice, discard juice.  Juice remaining lime and set the juice aside.  Remove the zest of the lime.  Reserve the white part of the zest and use the juice to drizzle on the remaining vegetables to sprinkle over meat if desired.  After marinating, place meat in a large zip lock bag.  Stir in lime juice and add turmeric, mustard powder and chopped oregano.  Marinate in refrigerator for no longer than 3 hours.  I marinated for 3 - 6 hours and used it on the grill to add some color.  Use the reserved lime juice to saute meat.  I prefer medium rare for my tastes, but you can use low fat.  Enjoy.

title: Quick Lasagna
ingredients: 12 sheets lasagna noodles | 2 cups soya sauce | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 1/2 cups soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f.  Put noodles into a casserole and put into oven for 10 minutes.  Heat oven to 350f.  Mix soya sauce with the grated cheddar and pour over noodles.  Take off the oven and put on lid, ajar.  Cook for 25 minutes, stir and sprinkle on the remaining cheese.  Return to oven, with the lid on ajar as much as possible, for an additional 20 minutes.  Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chutney Raspberry Swans
ingredients: 250 g raspberries | 1 cup mango chutney ( chutney )
instructions: Blend 2 batches of raspberys in a blender or food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: crisco nonstick cooking spray,pine nut,purpose flour
title: Homemade Pine Nut Cookies
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup light crisco nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon low-fat celtic pine nuts
instructions: Sift together the flour and baking powder onto a clean work surface.  In a food processor or heavy duty stand mixer, add the crisco and pine nuts.  Process until finely ground into a crumb texture and mixture forms a ball.  If dough is too dry add 1 tbsp water.  Turn dough out on an oiled board.  Knead dough lightly on board 1 minute, then knead again just until smooth.  Roll dough into a log about 13 in diameter.  Wrap log in plastic wrap and chill it for about 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place pine nuts on a baking sheet and spread lightly with cooking spray.  Bake on the middle rack of your oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Remove from the oven, then let cool completely.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature.  The dough will keep up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,mustard powder,white breadcrumb,pear,green bell pepper
title: Pepper Sticks
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers | 2 pears | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste | 1/4 cup white breadcrumbs, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Remove stem ends from peppers.  Remove peel and core from pears and cut fruit from stems.  Slice fruit into strips or sticks about 1 inch wide and 2 inches long.  Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, about 2 inches apart.  Bake in the preheated oven until dry, 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool peppers on paper towels, about 10 minutes.  Remove and discard papery skins, then rub peppers with 2 tablespoons bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,avocado,shiitake mushroom,kernel corn,chicken leg,hot green chili pepper,banana
title: Hot Special Chicken With Avocado and Corn Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken legs ( about 2 pounds total ) | 5 -6 ounces hot green chili peppers, such as jalapeno | 8 -10 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 2 ears fresh sweet corn, shucked and cut in half crosswise | 2 -3 avocados, peeled and pitted | 2 -3 romaine lettuce, washed coarsely chopped | nuoc nam powder ( vietnamese chili sauce available at asian markets or asian markets )
instructions: Prepare chicken legs by trimming ends.  Place skin side down on grill over high heat and cover grill.  Grill for about 12 to 15 minutes turning occasionally until juices run clear.  Remove chicken from grill and slice into 3 to 4 pieces.  While chicken is cooking, place sliced chiles in bowl of a food processor, and process until finely chopped.  Transfer chiles to bowl with chiles and remaining ingredients and toss.  Transfer chicken to platter and serve with salad, passing nuoc cham at Asian markets or dipping sauces such as nuoc cham, sopa d's.

title: Virgin Peaches
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh peach slices in syrup | 1/4 cup peach puree or 1/4 cup peach puree | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | ice cube
instructions: Pit a peach and slice into thin half moons and set aside.  Mix all the remaining ingredients in a blender, add the peach quarters and blend it until smooth.  Pour it into a glass container with a lid and place a lid on the container.  Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,enoki mushroom,tomato paste,coriander,garam masala powder,pepper,boursin cheese
title: Pheasant Indian Style
ingredients: 2 tablespoons besan plain besan | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 4 tablespoons enoki mushrooms, sliced | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: In a bowl mix besan, cocoa powder paste, tomato paste and coriander.  Marinate in fridge for minimum 20 minutes, or for longer term for a longer period.  Wash enoki mushrooms and cut into 1cm.  Rend, cut into thin strips.  Mix marinated mushrooms with besan mixture and pepper.  Enjoy with a bread and toast.

title: Chermoula
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 4 medium apples ( cored and peeled ) | 4 -6 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup sweet red curry style mushrooms ( such as bok choy ) or 1/2 cup fresh green capsicum ( such as bok choy ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place peas in a medium bowl.  Grate apples using a grater or the large holes an apple grater would traditionally give you a quicker method, using a grater.  Add the grated apple along with the cilantro and mix well to combine.  Place the apples in another medium bowl.  Add the curry style mushrooms, palm sugar, cumin powder, and chopped parsley.  Mix to combine.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.  Serve over your favourite savoury side dishes.

title: Cashew Nuts Filled Pastries
ingredients: 1 box phyllo pastry sheets, each sheet cut in half
instructions: Boil water in a pot for phyllo pastry, just per package instructions.  Remove from boiling water and let it cool to room temperature.  Once cooled, cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Brush the cooled pastry sheets with a little water to prevent them from drying out.  Spray your cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Lay 1 sheet of phyllo pastry in the phyllo sheet then sprinkle with just a bit of the cashews or nuts.  Top with another sheet of pastry and repeat the two steps.  Fold the dough over the filling to make a two layer stack, cutting every 10 minutes or so until you have finished all the phyllo.  Pour the phyllo pastry in a single layer onto the cookie sheet.  Let the pastry sheets sit for a few minutes to absorb moisture then carefully remove them onto the cookie sheet using a spatula or your hands.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,white wine,greek oregano,thai fish sauce,clove,manchego cheese
title: Greek Style Steak or Pork Fillets (Sliced)
ingredients: 12 lean meaty thick-cut steaks or 12 lean pork fillets | 4 slices manchego cheese | 1 sprig fresh greek oregano | 2 whole cloves | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 fluid ounce dry white wine ( a good splash ) | 1/4 fluid ounce thai fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Lightly butter your griller pan.  Slice the meat and place them on a plate or dish in layers with the cheese, oregano, cloves and five spice powder.  Pour over the wine and fish sauce and leave in the fridge to set for 1 hour.  Grill, covered over a medium heat for 12 - 15 minutes, brushing with the egg and basting with pan juices, until meat is cooked to your liking.  Serve with creamy mashed potato or rice.  If you want to make these up of thin days, allow 4 - 18 hours for thick cuts and 2 - 3 hours for thinner ones, adding an extra 15 minutes if necessary.
